Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Ferb, what do you wanna do today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about Perry, what does he want to do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, he's a platypus, they don't do much. I for one, am starting to get bored, and boredom is something of up with which I will not put! The first thing they're gonna ask us when we get back to school is "what did we do over the summer?". I mean, no school for three months. Our life should be a roller coaster! And I mean a good roller coaster, not like that one we rode at the state fair.

Name: Fair Worker
Dialog: Please exit to the left.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Man, that was lame. Why, if I built a roller coaster, I would... (Gets idea; angelic chorus plays) That's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb. I'm gonna pick up a few things. You boys stays out of trouble, okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay mom. (At Ferb) We're gonna build a roller coaster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm in charge, right? You did tell them I'm in charge?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Relax, Candace, nobody has to be in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But what if there's a emergency?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Like what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if a... What if a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the house? (smiles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: If that happens, you're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (she enters into the backyard) Mom says I'm in charge, conditionally.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whatever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute, what are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Homework.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's cool, you wait till the last minute then.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm watching you. (Goes through the door) And I'm in charge, conditionally!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello? Oh, hi, Stacy! No, I can't get to the mall right now. Mom just went to the store, she left me in charge, well, you know, conditionally.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And if you go, can you see if Jeremy is there? No, no, he's the cute one that works at Mr. Slushy Burger.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, he totally smiled at me the last time I was there. I just about died. No, I told you I can't, I'm watching my brother and step-brother.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and they never get into trouble, 'cause Mom never catches them. One of these days though, I'm going to see that she catches them red handed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you hold it down, I am trying to use the phone! (at Stacy) Mom left me in charge, so there will be no shenanigans today. What are doing right now? Why do you ask? What do you mean you can see it from your house? See what?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, what is this?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I'm gonna tell Mom, and when she sees what you're doing, you are going down. (runs off) Down! Down! Down! D-O-W-N, down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna need a blowtorch and some more peanut butter.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Candace, is Phineas... home?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Down, down, I say!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (hearts in eyes) Hey Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building a roller coaster.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: In your backyard?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Some of it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow. Isn't that kind of impossible?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Some might say.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Does your step-brother ever talk?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb? He's more of a man of action.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I was gonna go to the pool, you wanna go swimming?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Kind of in the middle of something here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, right. Okay, I'll see you later then. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. (at Ferb) Hey Ferb! You got enough rivets up there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons unknown to us, he bought up 80% of the country's tin foil. I want you to get over to his hideout right away. Find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. As always Agent P, it is important that your cover identity as a mindless domestic pet remains intact. Now, get out there. We're all counting on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, the way I see it, the fuel rockets kick in at the mall's parking lot, then we release the snakes during the corkscrew at the interstate. I'm gonna go get the snakes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! You gotta come home, right now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Did a satellite crash into the house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no. You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Seems like we've had this conversation before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I seem to recall you telling me that the boys were training monkeys to juggle bicycles, and when I come home, there was a stunning lack of monkeys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I still don't know how they cleaned that up so fast.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what's the emergency this time?

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're building a roller coaster!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, seriously, isn't Phineas a little young to be a roller coaster engineer?

Name: Factory Manager
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be a roller coaster engineer?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Factory Manager
Dialog: Well, I must say, I'm very impressed, the forms all seems to be in order, although I'd never seen them filled out in crayon before. So, if there's anything I can get you, anything at all, just let me know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you think we could borrow one of those gadgets?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, this is the life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, what an unexpected surprise. And by unexpected, I mean

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I, Doctor Heinz Doofenshmirtz, have covered the entire eastern seaboard in tin foil, and when I put my giant magnet, next to my genius, Magnetism Magnifier, I will pull the East, in westerly direction, thereby reversing the rotation of the earth. You may ask yourself, why would he do this? What could he possibly have to gain? Well, let me just answer that question, I haven't really worked on all the bugs yet. I mean, tin foil alone costs a lot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But Mom, I'd tell you, they're building  it, and it's huge!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Phineas and Ferb present the Coolest Coaster Ever now open"? Mom! (runs off)

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb got a roller coaster? You think we get a discount if we bring the flier?

Name: Another kid
Dialog: Maybe we better take it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gestures toward the empty post, head turned away) There, look, look, look, see? I told you I'm not crazy, I told you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (dryly) And you're not crazy because...?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I see your point, Candace. No crazy person would scream at a post like that. I'll be at the dairy section if you wanna come yell at some cheese, or anything. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, children of all ages! May I present to you a spectacle most of the morning in the making

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, who wants to go first?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: To fasten, insert the tab into the metal buckle. To release, just pull back on the -- oops.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you get the picture. Well, that's about it, enjoy the ride.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys all signed the waivers, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax, they're just rubber!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look, there comes the AH-AH-AH-AH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...I really make of my money back, I-I-I want a really spacey real estate, and sell it again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha, you missed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaaoow!! Ow, Ow, Ow, Aaooww!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now you are too late. Quake in your boots and watch helplessly, as the unimaginable electromagnetic forces, pull the eastern seaboard, thereby reversing the rotation of the--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well...that didn't work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, we have a two ton ball of tin foil traveling 200 miles per hour directly at us! Quickly, we must separate the magnet from the Magnifier before it's too late!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now I know I have that club card in here somewhere. I always have it with me, but my purse is a disaster area, you know how it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh! Mom? Mom!? (She rushes off.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's no use, it's no use, we are doomed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You did it! You saved us, Perry the Platypus! (The ball of tin foil crashes through the building.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, look, look, see?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (pause) Okay, I give up, what am I supposed to be looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns to see the empty parking lot) No!! It's not POSSIBLE!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (going back inside) I'm gonna go get the cart.

Name: Candace
Dialog: IT WAS RIGHT HERE AND IT WAS HUGE!!! (sees the rollercoaster fly away) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walks past, taking her cart) Time to go. I've got frozens.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, so you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, yes, that would be my guess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine, then lets go home. Now! (She pushes her.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice hat, Isabella.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Funny, I don't remember this in the blueprints.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And I'm sure this is new.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehehehehehehehehehe!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I worry about you sometimes, Candace.

Name: Employee
Dialog: Welcome to Mr. Slushy Burger, may I take your order?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyone want fries?

Name: French Man
Dialog: Croissant?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyone want a... (French accent) "quasson"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, if that thing crashes into earth, Candace is in charge.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We should have charged more.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, we're here, are you happy now, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. (At Linda) See Mom, I told you they weren't there!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on Candace, help me with the groceries. (goes off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but, but, but... (Continues under)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (comes back) Let's go. (pulls her away)

Name: Kid
Dialog: Hey Phineas, that was great.

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Way too cool.

Name: Third kid
Dialog: That was awesome! Can we do it again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, only one ride per customer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was great, Phineas. So, what are you gonna do tomorrow?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't know yet.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (pets Perry) Maybe you could teach Perry some tricks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, he is a platypus, they don't do much.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: They're the only mammals to lay eggs.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Maybe he'll lay an egg.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool, see you tomorrow. (goes to the gate) It really was the coolest coaster ever. You guys makes a great team.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, a brother is a brother, but I couldn't have asked for a better one than Ferb. You know what I mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh-ho-ho, man! I could smell the peanut butter!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that was impressive. See you, guys. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what should we do tomorrow? There's a world of possibilities. (pause) Maybe we should make a list!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) Mom!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from inside) Give it a rest, Candace!

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: This is Stanky Dog comin' to you on the hottest of the summer! Unless you live at the beach, I say take it easy and do nothin' today. Yup, just find yourself a shady tree, and maybe an aquatic mammal of some sort, and blow the whole day off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. If we let a little heat stop us from having the best day ever, then the morning DJs win.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh, boy, it's hot today! So what are you up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're making our own beach, right here in the backyard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Oblivious) Oh, how cute. Well, I'm off to my spa day. You boys behave yourselves and don't bother your father. He's finally cleaning out the basement. (Leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Mom! Yes! You heard her. We can't bug dad which makes me in charge... by default. (pauses) Carry on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna need more sand. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Lawn gnomes across the Tri-State Area are disappearing, leaving thousands of gardens unprotected from the evils of black magic. We suspect Doofenshmirtz. Get right on it.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be a landscape contractor?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Offscreen, dreamy look and voice) Hi, Phineas. (Walks up to him)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building a beach. Check it out.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can me and the Fireside girls be lifeguards? We need to earn our Aquatic-Safety badges.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, I've been a friend of Suzy's longer than Katie, so I should've been invited to that party first. I don't care if they're lab partners! We're locker neighbors. And locker neighbors trumps lab partners any day. (Gasps) Sorry Stacy. Gotta go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Welcome to our beach.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hah! You call that a beach? This is WAY below your usual standard. This isn't even worth a call to mom. You know, if you guys ever want to be popular, you're gonna have to stop playing in sandboxes. (Gets hit by a beach ball) Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Candace, what do you think?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! I'm calling Mom. (dials the phone)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jenny? Stacy?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: You never told us you have a beach in your backyard!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're going to be the most popular girl in the neighborhood.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I will?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I just saw Jeremy and his buddies with their surf boards.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy's here? (Panting, drops phone) Gotta go! (Zips off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (chuckles) Yes, yes! Just look at the bounty of gnome riches! Oh, this is a strange one. Wait, who are you? ... A platypus? ... PERRY THE PLATYPUS?! You are mine now! (Presses button, garage door opens) Oh no, wait, wait, wait. That was the garage door opener. You are mine now! (Presses button, large monitor activates) And that was the TV remote. I've got to start labeling these things. Aha! YOU are mine NOW! (Laughs maniacally) Finally, I will rid myself of you! (brings out another control) But first, turn your attention to the giant screen and... (the garage door closes) Hmm, maybe I need to turn the cable on first?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's get this beach party started!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look! I can see our house from up here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Coconut falls) Oh! (Falls on crab, Groaning)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: How low can you go? How low can you go?

Name: Dancer
Dialog: Look! So that's how low you can go. We've been asking that question for generations!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? What's everybody looking at?

Name: Dancer
Dialog: For winning the limbo contest, you are now officially crowned Queen Wahini of the beach! All hail Queen Wahini!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (overjoyed) I can't believe it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've never been happier in my entire life!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Something is very wrong. Not a single call from Candace. (Checks her phone) Not even a text message. Oga, hose me down. I'm going home.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I think I finally got the right one. Now, Perry the Platypus, (Shines flashlight on him) you will finally understand...my PAIN! (presses remote)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) Back in Gimmelshtump in the days of my youth, the Doofenshmirtzs' were a proud family. But those were lean times for my father and our beloved lawn gnome was repossessed. Who would protect our zatzenfruit garden from those witches, spells and wood trolls? From a tender age, my father decided that it would be me.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewege dich nicht! ("Don't move!")

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) While the other children played Kick-the-Schtumpel and eat Doonkelberries, I would stand for hours.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewege dich nicht!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All through the cold night as the Spitzenhounds howled, my only companion was the moon. And my neighbor Kenny.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) Bewege dich nicht!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And since my lawn gnome was taken away from me, I will destroy every lawn gnome in the entire Tri-State Area! Behold, the Destruct-inator! And now, Perry the Platypus, to activate my creation! (pushes a button and opens Perry's trap) NOOOO!

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Surf contest!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Out of my way, Dinner-bell.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello, Buford. Perhaps you missed the sign.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (reads the sign) "No Bullying, No Yodeling"?

Name: Man
Dialog: (Austrian accent) I don't like this any more than you do.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: First up in the surf contest is Bobby Nelson. Oh! And Nelson eats it on five-footer! And there's Django Brown shooting the curl, and here comes Buford Van Stomm! Ohh! He pummels Brown with a Philadelphia traffic stomp! And now he's got him in a Half-Nelson, now a Full-Nelson, oh! And now he's actually beating him with Bobby Nelson! Here's the scores from our judges. And Buford doesn't like it one bit. (Buford smashes the table with Bobby) Next up is Phineas Flynn, and it's great to see a young surfer show such confidence. Uh-oh, what's this? (Buford splashes through the holographic Phineas) Oh, those kids today and their holographic projections. He's in the pipeline, now he's hangin' ten! He's hanging twenty! He's hangin' thirty-two! Now he's just hangin'! The crowd loves it! I don't think there's a name for that! The crowd is doing the wave, and Phineas is surfing it! Let's go to the judges.10 to the 5th power, infinity, and oh! It seems Phineas Flynn's radical surfing has made judge #3 re-think Einstein's theory of relativity! Cowabunga, laws of nature!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, are you having fun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Eee... (Cell phone rings) just one second. (dreamily, on phone) Hellooooo?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, Candace? Is everything okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ohh, everything is just wonderful...

Name: Linda
Dialog: And...Phineas and Ferb? What are they doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ohh, such wonderful things...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, I'm coming home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, WHAT?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (On phone) I'm right around the corner; I'll be there in two minutes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! No mom, you can't! (Linda turns off the phone.) Oh, wait, wait! Uhh... (at Jeremy) Stay right there! (runs off) I've got to stop her! (Looks out the backyard gate) Oh, no, no, no, no... (Linda arrives) Mom, Mom, pleeaaasee, Mom! Go away! Don't come in!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Is that a volcano?

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: GNOOOOOMES!!! (Gnome hits him) Oof!

Name: Man
Dialog: Run for your lives!! It's gnome-ageddon!!!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Who's protecting our gardens?!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, tell me the truth. What is going on here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs, talking fast) Phineas and Ferb built a beach in the backyard, just like they said they were going to. But instead of just a cute little beach in a sandbox; it turned out to be this absolutely huge beach, with a coastline, and palm trees, and a pier, and hula dancers, and water skiers, and tiki huts, and dolphins, and dancing, and surfing, and everybody from the neighborhood showed up-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oof!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...and then I was just about to share a smoothie with Jeremy when a coconut dropped on my head, and ...and just for a moment, it seemed that the wily Buford would steal away the coveted surfing trophy from under the noses of our heroes...then I can only continue my benign reign and spread love, happiness and ultimate popularity throughout my kingdom! If you would just let me have my moment!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well everybody, looks like that's all for today!

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! (X3)

Name: Candace
Dialog: If you don't believe me, go see for yourself.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was great.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So how was your day at the beach?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, wait, my kingdom...my Jeremy...it was all so beautiful...! (panics, at Phineas and Ferb) WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO MY PARADISE?! (pants)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, I think it's time to get you out of the sun for a little while. (she and Isabella leads Candace away.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think she had fun.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Stanky Dog here with a special shout-out to my two new pals, Phineas and Ferb, for hosting a beach party that was hot, hot, hot. And speaking of hot, slather on the sunscreen listeners, cause tomorrow's weather calls for another scorcher.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: With a slight chance of scattered lawn gnomes.

Name: Phil
Dialog: Oh, boy! Did that kid stink or what? But maybe YOU'VE got what it takes to be

Name: Candace
Dialog: Auditions! Today?!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Yes, today! At two o'clock sharp.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grabs the TV and kisses it) I gotta tell Stacy! (Runs, bringing the TV with her and falls)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That pop star stuff might be fun at first, but then you'd be stuck with a dead end job. Too bad you can't just do it once and move on.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, what you're talking about is a one-hit wonder.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One-hit wonder? What's that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, a musical act goes to the top of the charts with a catchy tune and meaningless lyrics.

Name: Singers and Lindana
Dialog: Fun fun fun!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (voiceover) Then they throw a big diva tantrum, lose their label, then fade to obscurity. Before they know it, their song ends up as

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (writing) A one-hit wonder... (Shows checklist, listing in order

Name: Candace
Dialog: But Stacy, what am I going to sing?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello, what are you gonna wear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you think?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Too much. (Candace wears a bikini; now offscreen.) Too little. (Candace wears a pinafore.) Ugh, too clean. (Candace wears torn cords and a hippie t-shirt.) Too dirty. (Candace wears a street clothing.) Too street. (Candace wears a goth suit.) Too goth. (Cut to her.) Where'd you get that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: My mom's closet. You like it?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Nah, too retro.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Perfect!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice, huh?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, you should've tried that on first.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "Chika, chika, choo...wah". Meaningless lyrics done. How's the catchy tune coming along?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent! We'll be done by lunch! Hey, where'd Perry go?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello? Hello-oo? Anybody there?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good morning Agent P. We just received word that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up construction toys at an alarming rate. We need you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We'll meet back in the entrance in an hour.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Stacy! We gotta hurry so we could get a spot in li -- yayaya. (realized the line's too long) I've never sang in front of so many people!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? (shows her a LOT more people in the audience)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) I can't do this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh yes, you can! You're not a quitter; you're a fighter!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sure you are! You're a lean, mean, singing machine!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's it, yeah! Now you're looking like a winner!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (arranges herself) And that is what a gorilla looks like when you try to take away its food. Oh! Hi, Jeremy! Are you auditioning too?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nah. I came to see this hot new band called PFT. I downloaded their song this morning. It's tight! The hundredth contestant gets to sing onstage with the band!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? (She walks through the entrance and becomes the 100th contestant.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, looks like that's you.

Name: Phil
Dialog: Congratulations! You're the hundredth contestant! (Pulls her away)

Name: Phil
Dialog: (over speaker) Ladies and gentlemen, this young lady has the honor of singing onstage with PFT. So now, the band you've been waiting for

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? You're the hundredth contestant? How serendipitous. This'll be like a brother and sister thing! Now I'm assuming you've heard our hit single. I mean, who hasn't, right? It's a big hit. (gives her sheet music) So here's the words; don't worry if you get lost. The lyrics are meaningless anyway. I'll point when it's your turn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, the Ferbettes! I'm Phineas and this is Ferb, and we're gonna sing a song!

Name: Ferbettes
Dialog: Never gonna stop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute! What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm cuing you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How'd you get a hit single?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it wasn't easy. It took most of the morning and half a dozen phone calls. But if you're willing to put in the work-

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! I'm gonna tell Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay...tell her what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pauses) Ooh, I'm just gonna tell.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom, you've gotta see this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) Let me guess. Is it unbelieva- (Candace pushes her) WOOAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Ben Baxter
Dialog: Hi, I'm Ben Baxter, Huge-O-Records. Why don't you come by my office in an hour and we can talk about your future.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Future? Cool. He must be a psychic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on! (They arrive at the stage; she presents a shadow that appears to be Phineas and Ferb's heads.) See?! There they are onstage!!!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, once again... (Spotlight lights up.) Marty the Rabbit Boy and His Musical Blender!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, we're getting you an eye exam. (pulls her away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Wait!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha, everything is ready!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (doorbell rings) Oh, what is it now? (opens the door and saw the disguised Perry) Oh, are you my new temp? Well, let me just get you up the speed. I know it's bit of a mess. I'm just putting the finishing touches of my latest maniacal plan. You see, in a few minutes, I will unleash an unprecedented reign of terror upon the entire... (holds a magnifying glass on the eastern coast of the U.S.) ...Tri-State Area! And Perry the Platypus will never be the wiser.(Perry removes the Groucho glasses) Perry the Platypus? You're a temp? Are times that hard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! I told Mom I don't need glasses! (takes off glasses) What the --

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, No! No! Wait! Uggggg...

Name: Candace
Dialog: MMMMMOOOOM?!?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry, Perry the Platypus, but you are too late! (pushes a lever that makes the building alive as a robot)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (wearing a jacket) Ooh, this one's nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Come here! You've gotta see this! (drags her out, setting off the shoplifting alarm)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace! I haven't payed for this yet!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha! When it comes to havoc, nobody wreaks like me!(Perry removes a metal cover of a storage) Wait, wait, wait, you're not supposed to touch that! (Perry removes a wire)Hey, hey, no fair!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, what a great painting! How did you get permission for that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, they didn't mind. The building's scheduled for demolition.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seeeeeee??!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAHHHH!!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Uh, ma'am, you're gonna have to come back and pay for that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Yes of course, officer.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAHHHH!!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Hey, weren't you Lindana?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, I was! I can't believe you recognized me.

Name: Guard
Dialog: Well, I was a huge fan. (pauses, serious) You still have to pay for the jacket.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) I know.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus. I tried to ignore you, but you forced my hand.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now...I shall relax with a nice, tasty deli platter. Oh-ho-ho, where are my manners?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gives Perry his share) Here you go, Perry the Platypus. Care for some pepper? Just say when. (Continues to pour pepper) Anytime.

Name: Ben
Dialog: (from inside) Boys, let me start by saying we love your act and we want to be... (cuts to the boardroom) ...in the Phineas and the Ferb-Tones business. And by the way, aren't you a little young to be pop stars?

Name: Ben
Dialog: Well, okay then! We prepared to offer you a very lucrative contract if you'll just sign exclusively with us for your follow-up single.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (suddenly angry) Follow-up single? (rips up the contract under the following) Who do you think we are, some two-bit hacks who will keep writing new songs just because you pay us obscene amounts of cash?! Phineas and the Ferb-Tones are strictly a one-hit wonder! (The band enters the elevator) Good day to you, sir!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Diva tantrum, check. (Pauses, listens to the "Gitchee Gitchee Goo" elevator music) Elevator music, check.

Name: Ben
Dialog: Ah, who needs 'em? We still got this video tape of their performance. We could do live CDs, DVDs, pod-casts, heck, we can digitally re-create their images to make our own sitcom! The Phineas and Ferb Show! We could squeeze twenty years of entertainment out of this one video tape.

Name: Manager
Dialog: (screams) That giant robot's coming right at us!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (still pouring pepper) Wow, you sure like a lot of pepper. I'm more of a paprika man myself. (Perry blows over the pepper, Dr. D coughs) It will take more than condiments to foil my brilliant plan!

Name: Ben
Dialog: The tape!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAHHH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAAAAAHHHHH!!! (Lands on a soft mattress) Ooh! What an unbelievable stroke of luck! (The mattress folds in half) Oof! I'm okay! I'm still better than the... (gets stepped over by the robot) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry chatters; a bus pulls up and they get on) Come on, guys. We still have one thing left to do.

Name: Phil
Dialog: And the winner of the day's "Next Super American Pop Teen Idol Star" is... (Screen zooms out to reveal

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. What's wrong?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm better than that guy. Oh, I should've taken blender lessons.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So why did you run off earlier?

Name: Candace
Dialog: My brothers. (sighs) They always ruin everything.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, you like to sing, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Then you shouldn't let your brothers' fun ruin your good time. You know, if you get a chance to sing, you oughta sing. I gotta go, I'll see you later. (Walks away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey Candace. (Shows the stage for the PFT Reunion Concert) You're still the hundredth contestant, wanna come up and help us out?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was great! I've been thinking of my brothers all wrong! They're not a nuisance. They're my ticket to-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, you've been great! This is the last time we're ever gonna sing that song. We're retiring, good night!

Name: Mall Operator
Dialog: (via loud speaker) The mall is now closed and will re-open at 9

Name: Announcer
Dialog: You loved her in the '80s. Get ready to love her again. Lindana's mega hit "I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun", and been remixed and re-translated into your favorite languages

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Whatcha watchin'?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, nothing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Ferb, what should we do today? I mean, besides giving Perry a bath.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (peeking over the fence) What is that wonderful noise?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I have got to take a new picture of myself for my blog. I didn't realize mine is already a week old. (Takes a picture of herself) That's better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: WHAT ARE YOU DOING TO MOM'S CAR?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We tricked it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't even know how to drive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, duh. That's why Ferb built this remote.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deeply) Oh, you are so busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opens door) Mom?! (closes door, opens another) Mom?! (closes door, opens another) Mom?! (closes door, reenters garage) Um, where's Mom? (smiles awkwardly)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's playing bridge at Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro's!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh, they won't get away with it this time!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, Candace, dear. Bubela, how good to see you. What a coincidence. Do you know your mom is here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmm-mmm. Yeah, I do, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro. I need to talk to her if you don't mind.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oy-vey. Look how tall you are now. You must've grown a couple of inches since the last time I've saw you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was last week, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Well your mom's inside, dear. Where are your braces? I thought you were wearing braces.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. MOM! MOM! MOM! (runs inside)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you have got to see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. What's the red button for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOOOOOOOOM!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it? What do you want me to see?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (guestures toward the boys) Quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys! (to Candace) Well, if that's all, I'll just be getting back to the game.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good thing we've beefed up the suspension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woah! What else can it do?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Dreamy look and voice) Hi, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're entering The Swamp Oil 500 today.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aren't you gonna need a pit crew?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you know a pit crew?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well...I know a few people who work well together.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! You're hired! See you at the track. (To Ferb) Hey Ferb, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons completely unknown, he's purchased a giant airship or blimp, as the kids say. Your mission is to find out why, and if necessary, put a stop to it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Dreamily) Hi, Phineas. I got your pit crew.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! See ya in the pits.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls. We're dealing with a 426 cubic inch, fully-blown V8, with hypo lifters, radical cam and a limited slip differential.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Would that be electronically fuel-injected?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?! PHINEAS! PHIN-E-AS!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey! I can't hear the cars!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! I didn't know you were a racing fan!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy. (Slaps) Who, me? Oh, yeah! Yeah, I'm a big fan of those, uh, uh...that red one is cute!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, that's Billy Ray Digler's car. He's great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, he's the best. That Billy Roy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Billy Ray.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Billy Ray. I-I love it when he turns left... and then he turns... left again, and then-

Name: Dave
Dialog: And in the 3rd lane, the newcomers Team Phineas! Now is it just me, or does he look a little young to be behind the wheel of a 700 horse power racing machine?

Name: Rick
Dialog: Yes. Yes, he does.

Name: Dave
Dialog: And look, he's already got his own screaming fans!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On screen) PHINEAS!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace is rooting for us!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you're on the big screen!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On screen, slow mo) PHINEAS!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And your little brother's gonna be on TV!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas--? (sees him being interviewed) On TV? (Stands up) TV! That's it! They are so busted! Can you wait here for a second? (zips off, but comes back) Thanks. (zips off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it, Candace? I'm right in the middle of a 3-No trump.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on a payphone at the race) Turn on the TV!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right. All right, Candace. This better be good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from the phone) Well? Well? Do you see it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a second, honey.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Turn on the cable box first.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. All right. (Presses another remote, ejecting a CD) Wait. 'Kay, that's not it. Um, is it this one? No, this is another phone.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I turned on the stereo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cringing) Mom, hurry up!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, just a second! (Presses the right remote)

Name: TV Narrator
Dialog: Are you embarrassed about flaking? Itching? Peeling?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, this is a dandruff commercial. Is there something you're trying to tell me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Are we good to go?

Name: Rick
Dialog: And with the race about to start, there's the Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated blimp!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. I'm glad you're here. Actually, I was just getting ready to serve some PLATYPUS UNDER GLASS! You're just in time to witness my latest invention...my Deflate-inator Ray! Which I will demonstrate by deflating the tires of the Jefferson County Motor Speedway! After which, I will deflate everything in the Tri-State Area! That way, if anyone want's anything flated, they will have to talk to me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you are in big trouble, mister--! (Cars zoom past her, leaving her burnt)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you got a little...

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (takes picture) Smile! Souvenir picture? Only a dollar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH! (shakes herself clean) Wait a second. (Grabs camera, runs off)

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Takes a picture of Phineas driving) Ee-ee-ee-ee... now, I gotcha!

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (Snatches picture) Hey, Missy. Two pictures, two bucks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, uh, I've only got a dollar, but uh, I just want the one. You can just tear the other one up, 'kay?(The photographer rips one picture)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rides out on bike) I've got 'em, NOW! Heeheehee.

Name: Rick
Dialog: And on the fast on the inside lane is Number 42, Team Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Do you think we can get any more power? I mean, I know it's just a battery. But I was thinking

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We should bring Phineas in for a pit stop. All right, Fireside Girls, let's move, move, move!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That helmet looks so manly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hit it, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm so proud of you girls. And the bow was a nice touch, Gretchen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing) Listen to those fools, as they worship their candy-colored race car man. How about a little demonstration of my deflationary prowess? (Fires laser)

Name: Man #2
Dialog: I got it! (Ball hissing, tires screeching)

Name: Race Car Driver
Dialog: AAH! (Tires screeching, rams a sign)

Name: Rick
Dialog: The Team Phineas car is avoiding every obstacle! It's like he can see the whole darn track at once!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OH YEAH!

Name: Racers
Dialog: We're okay! (Car zooms by)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well Mom, what do you think of this?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You've...looked better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? What do you mean--? (looks at picture, starts to cringe)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Already they fear me, listen to their screams, huh? Imagine the mayhem once my Deflate-inator ray is fully charged. (at the mouse in the machine) Run! Run like the wind, my little indentured rodent. And I will give you some cheese. Heh, I know I had some around here somewhere.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think there's some- There used to be some Roquefort around the back here. I don't...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm? AYYY! AY-AY-AY-AYYY! (Glass breaks) Agh! Oof! (Laser fires, Blimp deflating) Hmm. I suppose I should've seen that coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) But Mom, you've gotta believe me! (cuts inside) Wait a minute. I bet it's still on TV! (runs off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Flatly) That's good, Candace. Go watch a little TV.

Name: Dave
Dialog: And look at this amazing finish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stammering) Mom, come quick! Come look-look-look-look-look!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right! I'm coming! (stands up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Dave
Dialog: Oh no! A blimp is about to hit the broadcasting tower! Oh, the hu-

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah-huh...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (leaving) Deal me back in, Viv.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Looks like we're walking.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mimicking Linda) "Why don't you go back home, Candace?" "I'm busy with my bridge game, Candace?" She has no idea!! (echo)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotcha.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AHH-AHH-AHH-AHH-AHH! AAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Runs up to Vivian's house and repeatedly knocks on the door hard) MOM! MOM! MOM! MOM! MOM!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, Candace, hello. I can't believe you grown so much, it's unbelievable--

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOM! (Goes to the living room) Mom, you've gotta see this! It's about your car!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (While Candace smiles) All right. (Candace drags her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (literally pushes Linda across the street) Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you're wearing out the heels of my shoes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See Mom?! Look, look! I told you--

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Gasps) But...who did this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You mean...they...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (overlapping) Yeah, yeah, yeah! (laughs chaotically)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overjoyed) They washed my car!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mood changing with each word) Yes!!--No--What?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's beautiful!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I gotta admit, I thought you we're exaggerating a bit, but this is really worth getting excited about!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walking in the background, trophy in hand) Hi, Mom, we're home!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys! I saw what you did today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Referring to the race) Yeah, how'd you like it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I loved it! Now who wants some snacks?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Thanks, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (At Candace) Honey, close your mouth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OH YEAH!
Scene opens up with a monster destroying the Tri-State Area.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "To think... To dream... Whether 'tis nobler to love, I know not." Ah, The Princess Sensibilities. My favorite play. What is going on out there?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you keep it down out here?! You guys ruin everything! I am trying to practice the art of acting. And I will not be disturbed by your little movies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not so little anymore. Last week our website got 176,000,000 hits.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, sorry I'm late. They're filming down the street.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Filming? What What are they filming?

Name: Linda
Dialog: A movie version of the play The Princess Sensibilities.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I would be perfect for that part! I've been practicing it for my drama club all summer! I'm gonna get discovered!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's serendipitous. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are, Agent P. There's something very strange going on with Dr. Doofenshmirtz. He's been very quiet lately. A little too quiet. I want you to find out what's not going on, and...uh...put a...stop..to it. I suppose. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is! Excuse me. Uh, Mr. Producer, sir?

Name: Producer
Dialog: I can't talk to you right now. My lead actress just quit!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well sir, this is your lucky day! (Clears throat) I will replace her. Besides, I know her lines by heart. Listen. "To think, to dream, whether 'tis nobler to love, I know not."

Name: Producer
Dialog: Heh. That's not bad. And you know your lines. Mmm, I don't know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll do it for free.

Name: Producer
Dialog: You're hired.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?

Name: Producer
Dialog: You bet! With the money I save, I'll be able to hire the hottest new directors in town. Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! I could get used to this!

Name: Man
Dialog: Miss Candace Flynn, here's your contract and your bagel. This is Antoine, your dialog coach, Nikki, your swimming stand-in, and your personal trainers Olga and Chicago Joe.

Name: Olga
Dialog: Charmed, I'm sure.

Name: Chicago Joe
Dialog: Drop and give me 20!

Name: Producer
Dialog: Candace, baby! Let me introduce you to the directors of this film.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb? What are you doing here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're directing the movie. Our new agent arranged the whole thing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look. My client gets 3% of the gross and a piece of the back end, or he walks. Yeah, that's right. You mess with the bull, you get the horns, buddy. (Phone rings) Hello? Syd, baby, you got that 3rd act in line yet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, wait! Don't you think they're a little young to be big-budget movie directors?

Name: Producer
Dialog: With 176,000,000 hits, they could be in diapers for all I care.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I don't remember any monsters in The Princess Sensibilities.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just finished the rewrites this morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "The Curse of the Princess Monster"? That is not what I signed up for! Besides, I can't wear this! No one will see my face!

Name: Producer
Dialog: Yes, but in the end, the curse is lifted! And in your big dramatic scene, you will look stunning! This film could make you a star.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? A...a...star?

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey! Ugly monster! You're needed on the set!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming! (Music playing) Oof! Oof! Won't you stay on? Oof! Darn!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Why do you keep breaking down my doors? Why don't you knock first? It's not even locked! This time, you'll pay. That's right, fork it over. What? Are you kidding me? This isn't just drywall, you know! It's solid oak! That's more like it. You can't just go busting into people's houses for no reason, you know. Besides, I've given up evil to pursue the art of cheese making. Do you like stinky Limburger? It's a Doofenshmirtz family recipe.

Name: It's not ready yet. It still has to age for 58 and 1/2 years. (Watch ticking) But who's got that kind of time? Which is why I created
Dialog: The Age Accelerator...Inator.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Candace. This is a very important scene. It is nothing less than the emotional backbone of the whole film. Oh, and the villagers are coming at you with everything they've got.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, what do mean the villa-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Action! The air force!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grunting) Ugh! Ow! Ungh! Hey! Wait! Uh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The space armada from the planet plumbing supplies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (groans)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Beautiful! That's a print!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (Whispering)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. That's a little embarrassing. (On megaphone) Okay, people, nice rehearsal! Let's take it from the top!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! Is this banana hat for some cool tropical dance number?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're trying to come up with some exciting camera angles for the big chase scene. So we strapped a camera on to this starving monkey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah! Wait! No! (TV static)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughing) Sorry that monkey cam didn't work out. We're gonna try it with Ferb this time. Now take this sandwich and remember, Ferb hasn't eaten lunch yet. (Ferb imitates the monkey while beginning to charge) Hold on tight.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH! Wait! NO! (TV static)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. In this scene, the monster; that's you, gets attacked by 800 cubic feet of rats, spiders, and snakes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There is no way I am doing that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax. They're made out of rubber.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well the snakes are rubber, anyway.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH! Get em' off me! Get em' off me! Get em' off me! Get em' off me! Get 'em off me! Get 'em off me! Get 'em off me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Candace, this is your beauty shot. The curse has been lifted, and you are no longer a monster. Now this scene, is what the heart wants, but the mind can't have. Take one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "To dream... To be free of the curse."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Beautiful. Keep going. (On megaphone) Cue the magical girly dust!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Whether 'tis nobler to be loved..." Achoo! (Thud)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On megaphone) Cue wind machine!

Name: Ferb

Dialog: But everything will be gone by the time Mom gets home. Isn't that right, Mr. Miggins? Unless… (she grabs a sack, an oil can, and a football helmet which she puts on, and lays a trap for a Brobot; a Ferbot walks near the oil can and drinks from it; Candace leaps from the cellar and traps the Ferbot) Aha! (She carries the sack with the Ferbot in it to the front yard and calls Stacy) Stacy? Oh my gosh! Guess what? Ugh, Stacy, I can't understand you. Why are you crying? Yeah. Crying, crying, it hurts, right. Got that. Uh-huh, Oh, hi, Mrs. Hirano! What? Stacy got her ears pierced? Gee, what a terrible thing that I had completely no idea about! Anyway, gotta run, Mrs. Hirano. Give Stacy my best! (Throughout this, a garbage truck arrives. A man takes the bag with the Ferbot in it and tosses it into the dump area. It drives away, and a Fred's Fertilizer truck pulls up. A man drops off a bag of fertilizer and the truck drives off. Candace barely notices; she walks back to the bag and kicks it) Poor, mixed-up Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, bros. How's the old Chamber of Invisibility coming along? (Robot whirring, Chamber of Invisibility zapping) Wow, it works! Well done. (To Ferb) Hey, normally I'd be saying that to you, Ferb. Just kinda weird saying that to a Ferbot. Come on. Let's see how the Microscopic zoo is doing. (To Robots) Hey, guys. Mind if we see how things are coming along? (To Ferb) Hold her steady, Ferb. Wow! That's amazing! And according to this microscopic newspaper machine, the zoo's really packing them in! Well, I guess we can categorize this project as a success. Hey, that is the best tunnel to the center of the Earth I've ever seen. Boy, I bet that was fun to build. You know, Ferb, even though these robots were a success and completely on model, I kind of miss working on stuff. You know, just you and me. Hey, what's this? Thanks. Hovercraft lounge chair? We were gonna build that next week! Oh, no! The Phinedroids and Ferbots have run out of projects, so they're designing their own! Have we learned nothing from Mary Shelley's Frankenstein? Look! They've started their own overpriced coffee franchise! That's so '90s.

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: (offscreen) This is terrible!

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: We have an entirely new problem!

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: The coffee's making them go haywire! And that one's having trouble falling asleep.

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: Poor little guy. (Robot whirring) That's it! You guys are drinking way too much coffee! I'm shutting her down!

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: Well, that's no good. Time to show these robots who's in charge!

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: Uh, Ferb? I think they're in charge...

Name: Phineas (cont'd.)
Dialog: Oh, there it is. (Turns off radio) My new girlfriend's house. Now I can erase all those embarrassing messages. And then I can start leaving new ones. What?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (cont'd.)
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! How did you escape my net? It was the mouse, wasn't it? Get out of the way, Perry the Platypus! Don't make me drop this giant magnet on you! Well, then, as a lazy tailor would say, "Suit yourself." (Flips the switch making the magnet fall on Perry, but Santa Claus picks up the magnet) But that doesn't make sense! It's the middle of July!

Name: Santa Claus
Dialog: Ho, ho, ho! I'm on a summer run! Farewell, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bah, humbug.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this is how it ends, Ferb

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Scoffs) '80s music is so 2002. (Linda arrives.) Mom, mom, mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi, honey. I got some very nice shots here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, that's great, Mom. Check this out! (opens fertilizer bag with eyes closed) Ta-da! (Pause)

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's a very nice bag of manure, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opens her eyes, looks in bag) What?! AAAAH!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (drops her pictures while she was screaming) Candace! You made me drop my pictures!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe it's not too late! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, mom, mom! (runs off) You've gotta see this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. I've done this nineteen other times. (with her eyes closed) But this time, I can say with the utmost confidence that there are Phineas and Ferb robots in our backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, Candace. There are "Phineas and Ferb robots" in the backyard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Who wants to see pictures?

Name: Computer
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's a Candroid!

Name: Candace (cont'd.)
Dialog: Oh, give me that!
Scene opens up showing runway models going down a runway.

Name: Gaston Le Mode (on TV)
Dialog: Behold! Feast your eyes upon the fashion of the future!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. (said in the same manner as Isabella) What'cha waaaatchin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Only the latest looks from the world's greatest fashion designer, Gaston Le Mode.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. Why would anyone want to wear goofy looking clothes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not goofy! Fashion designers create art. That people live in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. I never thought of it that way. (At Ferb) Ferb, put the Cold Fusion Reactor on hold!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Pulls lever)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Gaston Le Mode (on TV)
Dialog: As now, to my world tour, I, Gaston Le Mode, will be at the...

Name: Voice-Over
Dialog: (dubbing over Le Mode) Googolplex Mall!

Name: Gaston Le Mode (on TV)
Dialog: ...today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: 1, 2, 3, testing, testing, 1, 2, 3-- (Camera shows that he is not wearing pants) Agent P, you're early! Carl, cut to close up! (Camera zooms in) (To Perry) Oh. (Clears throat) Basically, Doofenshmirtz has been acting up again. He's stockpiling the usual strange and unrelated things. This time, it's copy machines and ink cartridges by the thousands. We need you to find out what's going on right away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. If we're gonna tackle this fashion design thing, we've gotta do something really special. It has to be cool. Comfortable. And undetectable by radar. Something that absolutely screams summer! Ah, I think you're on to something, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (enters) Hey, Phineas. What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I are working on designs for our new clothing line. Take a look at what we've got so far.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Very impressive! Need any help? (Shows the Fireside Girls holding dressmaking equipment) The Fireside Girls and I are trying to get our sewing badges.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo hoo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! Let me show you something, "Mr. I Break Through Walls Whenever I Want"! (Button beeps and a robot arm holding a roll of duct tape pops out of the floor and tapes up the crack) There you go. Oh, one more thing! (Button beeps and the arm ties up Perry with the tape) Oh, look! I have captured the rare "DUCK-Taped Platypus"! (Laughs maniacally) You know, like duck-billed... Never mind. Anyway, let me show you my evil scheme. I call it the Copy and Paste-Inator! Now, there's nothing I hate than waiting in line. All the time wasted in stores, and amusement parks, where I could be spreading more evil in the Tri-State Area! I will make copies of myself, and they will do the waiting for me. I know, it sounds a little crazy but, look. You're all tied up. And (sits down in the Inator seat) I am stepping into a giant copy machine of my self. (has crazy eyes as he say the next words) Who's crazy now? (Electricity zapping as the Inator closes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is; The world's most famous runway of Gaston Le Mode. Oh, Stacy, can you imagine the glamorous life of a supermodel?

Name: Supermodel Candace
Dialog: Hi, I'm Candace. I'm sure you recognize me from my countless magazine covers. You know, being a supermodel is hard work; The bright lights, the deafening applause, and all those paper cuts from counting my huge stacks of money. That's why I start every morning with Candace Os.

Name: Man
Dialog: Candace Os. Part of a nutritious breakfast.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace Os?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) I really shouldn't fantasize on an empty stomach.

Name: Man #2
Dialog: (Gasps)

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Finally! After years of bitter struggle, I, Gaston Le Mode, have created the ultimate design; The ne plus ultra in haute couture. But alas, I cannot find a single model with a neck long enough to complement my design.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Sorry, Gaston, but only someone with a freakishly long neck could fit into--

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Yes. Everyone is sorry. Where will I find that swan-like neck?

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Pardon, Monsieur, I have great news!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: (excitedly) A Jerry Lewis marathon on TV tonight?

Name: Man #2
Dialog: I wish! But no. Better yet, I have found her!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi.

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Look at this! Mon Dieu! It is perfection!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: You are my Cou De Crayon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your Cou De Crayon? Cool!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Allez! Allez! Let's get you to makeup.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Screams) I-- I think I just tanned my eyeballs. Ugh. Now, with a push of a button, I will make history! (Laughs maniacally) By the way, do you like my mural? It's a silhouette of me going... (Laughs maniacally; Pushes button) All right, let's see, now. (Ding) Oh, needs a little more toner. Oh, copy jam.

Name: Doofenshmirtz #2
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why is it when people copy their butts, it comes out perfect?

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: We're almost ready. now, let me see. (Candace turns around) Oh! Absolutely beautiful!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (blushes) Oh, why, thank you!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Now, wait right here while I introduce you to the crowd.

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: Package for Gaston Le Mode.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: (excitedly) Is it a poster of Jerry Lewis?

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: I wish!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: All right, all right. But this better be important. (unrolls the paper) Ooh! Gasp! This design! It's comfortable. Cool. And undetectable by radar. It absolutely screams summer!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't new! I've seen this before!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Do you know who designed it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did, sir. It's part of the Summer All The Time collection.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: C'est magnifique!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you guys doing here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's all thanks to you, Candace. We thought fashion design was lame, but you convinced us to give the glamor world a chance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But-but-but-but--

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Mademoiselle, Candace, there has been a change in plans. You will wear this on, s'il vous plait.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I-I-I--

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Or you could wear this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not in this life! Sayonara, amigo! (stomps across the runway in anger) I am so telling Mom, and you guys are so busted! (falls into the crowd) I'm okay!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: But mademoiselle! Sigh. Okay, ladies, time to get changed and strut your stuff.

Name: Women
Dialog: Thank you, Gaston.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Ladies and Gentlemen, I, Gaston Le Mode, am proud to present this stunning new collection

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: And to give a big hand to the designers, my latest discovery, (Snapshot) Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Ferb. Our designs have really caught on.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Everyone who is anyone is wearing Summer All The Time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a bad morning's work.

Name: Woman #2
Dialog: Nice outfit, handsome.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: You are on fire.

Name: Candace
Dialog: When Mom hears about this-- (Sees two people) Hey, wait a minute. Where did you get those outfits?

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: These? Why, these are the only latest hit designs from the Summer All The Time collection. Everybody's wearing them. I mean, jeez, where you been?

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Phineas and Ferb, The Kings of Couture!"? That was fast.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? There you are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You left your cell phone and your clothes in there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Stacy? You too?! You look just like Ferb!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, thanks, Candace! Most of this is a genuine label, but the shoes are a total knockoffs. I heard there's a riot Uptown at this one store that got a fresh shipment. I gotta run before they sell out. Bye! Oh, and Candace? Friendly tip; That Gaston stuff is so 42 seconds ago.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus, a whole army of Doofenshmirtzs! Perfect copies of me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #3
Dialog: Hiya, handsome.

Name: Doofenshmirtz #4
Dialog: Right back at ya, fella.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You, here! Grab me some corn dogs!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #5
Dialog: Sure thing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You, go fetch me some movie tickets!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #6
Dialog: You bet your britches!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And you, go ride that new rollercoaster a couple of times, okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz #7
Dialog: Okey-Dokey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, me too! Go, go, my facsimiles! Go wait in line so I never have to!

Name: Doofenshmirtzs
Dialog: (Cheering)/Geronimo!/Whoopee!/Santa Claus!/Native American icon!/Hey, there's the mall!/Well, that was fun!/Ooh, what fun!/Oh, I landed in a puddle.

Name: Doofenshmirtzs
Dialog: Look at the puppies! (All talking at once)

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, you see what these people are wearing?

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: Some kind of retro pharmacist outfit.

Name: Man
Dialog: I feel so 2 minutes and 5 seconds ago.

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: Hey, let's get back in style!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #8
Dialog: Now I have two!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aren't they adorable? How about you jump, and fetch me something too, huh? Something like, um, your doom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz #2
Dialog: Hey, don't hurt the little bunny rabbit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How did you get out of the trash, you drop-out bohemian? (To Perry) I'll be right back. I've got some deleting to do. That's right, tremble, my rejected friend. (Button beeps) Oh no! I pushed the "Delete All" button by mistake!

Name: Doofenshmirtzs
Dialog: (Disappears)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look what you made me do! Oh, guess who's paying for this! What is this? Hey, why did you jump out that-- (Gasps) Oh, you clever, little plat-- (Screams) Well, that wasn't very bright! Now we're both going-- (Screams) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Mom, you want to see something crazy?!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Oh, I think I'm looking at it...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Mom! You see?!! (Points, then, after a moment, looks downward, deadpanned)

Name: Linda
Dialog: So you dragged me all the way down here for a...pharmacist convention?

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Face it, mon ami, your designs are 3 minutes and 37 seconds ago.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, well. We had a great time. Hey, Gaston? What's with the new outfit?

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Are you kidding? No one's claiming this look yet! I have to get out in front of this thing and take credit for it all. That's how you stay in business, kid. Au revoir!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, Phineas, I still like your style.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks. (To Linda) Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look. We're all here. Why don't we get some lunch? (leaving) I think there's a pizza place right over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, go ahead. Eat all you want. My dreams are smashed to pieces, and all you can think of is food! Well, just remember, Gaston said I'll always be his Cou de Crayon.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You do realize that that's French for "Pencil Neck"?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Smile, Boys! (takes a picture) Aw, you two look so cute!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at the camera) She means well.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be back in a few hours. Have fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, right. You better not pull any of your weird stunts, got it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Western drawl) Don't fret none, school marm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, he was like totally checking me out when little Miss Pants walks in front of me. Yeah, yeah! So I was like "Uh, hello?" and so she was like "Oh no, you di-in't!" and I was like "Oh yes, I di-id!"

Name: Man
Dialog: Mighty sorry, Buckaroos. Time to rein in those ponies.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. What are you doing here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just earned my milking badge, and it was so easy. All you do is squeeze and pull and squeeze and pull and squeeze and pull and squeeze and pull, and- so, whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're riding ponies, (Western drawl) but it makes a feller hanker for the real thing. You know, livin' out on the open range. Ridin', ropin', brandin'. Bustin' broncos and breakin' wind with your amigos under the western skies. (Normal voice) Heck, we could even ford a stream! I don't even know what that means, but it sounds fun! (Spits) Oh, and spitting. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: ...Yeah. And she was like "Oh no, you di-in't!" and-- Oh, there you are, Agent P. Oops. I forgot to turn off the laser sharks again, didn't I? My bad. Anyway, the evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is at it again. Not only does he have 3 books about insects overdue at the library, but he's cornered the market on aluminum siding. He's hold up on his water fortress on Lake Winimahatikihaha. Ha-ha. I love saying that. You must find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. That is all.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! As usual, your timing is uncanny! And by uncanny, of course I mean

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, Perry the Platypus, let me introduce to you my assistant, Vanessa.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whatever. (Music buzzing on headphones)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Nervous laugh) She's new. Anyway, at this very moment, termites all over the Tri-State Area will be controlled by me! Using my Termite Controlling Helmet. See? See? The have cute little helmets just like me. (Laughs) I don't want to tell you how long it took to put them all on. So, watch this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon I will have them devour all the wood in the entire Tri-State Area. Then everyone will have to buy Aluminum Siding from me! (Laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're through, Perry the Platypus. Through! Now it is time for Platypus Flambé! (Laughs maniacally) (At Vanessa) Vanessa, did you bring the little wooden head the termites made?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So anyway, I was like, "You talkin' to me?" and she was like all in my face, and-- TERMITES! (Screams, Termites buzzing) Holy cow! (Termites buzzing, Screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, a stampeding herd of cattle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're headed straight for town! We gotta do something!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All we need are a couple of horses and we could-- (Termites buzzing, Horses whinnying) Huh. Let's go! (Western drawl) Let's round us up some cows! Come on, Isabella! Yee-haw!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh. (She notices a pony, Harp strumming, pony whinnies)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh my gosh! Stacy, I'm, like, in a stampede! It's like-- (Falls into mud, cows mooing) Uh, just a sec.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Phineas?

Name: Candace
Dialog: PHINEAS! Stacy, I gotta go. (Guitar, Pig squeals)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: YEE-HAW! Hyah, cow!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was delicious.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hyah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A stampede through Downtown? I mean, who does this? Those two are gonna get it! (Screams) Oof!

Name: Haney
Dialog: Well, what can I do for you, little lady?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What have you got to stop a stampede?

Name: Haney
Dialog: I think I might have just the thing for you. Let's see... A scary wolf puppet!

Name: Haney
Dialog: Imagine your a cow, You're there minding your own business, chewing your cud with the other heifers when suddenly (Howls) "I'm a very hungry wolf. I like to eat cows. Ooh, I'm so hungry." (Puppet rattling)

Name: Haney
Dialog: Uh, no. Of course not. Oh, a genuine silent cow whistle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You sure this will stop a stampede?

Name: Haney
Dialog: As sure as the day is long.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sold!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, what do you know? It works! (Ding, Cows mooing)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, stop! Uh oh. (Screams, Blows whistle) Hey, this cow whistle doesn't work!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, they're so going to get it. (At phone) Mom, they're driving a herd of cattle right through Downtown.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, um, I'm a little busy, sweetie. I'm having my hair done at Babs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, that's perfect! Well, they're coming your way! Quick, look out the window! Do you see any cows?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's cute, Candace. Okay, Babs needs to comb me up. Gotta go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Any last noises, Perry the Platypus? You know that chirping silly noise that you make?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's the one! (Laughs, Rope burns) Wait, don't touch that button! No, the other one. Yes, that one! That's the one you should not touch! (Gasps, Alarm buzzing)

Name: Female computer voice
Dialog: Self-destruct sequence initiated.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now you've gone and done it!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You put a self-destruct button in a death chamber? I'm so out of here. This is the worst Bring-your-daughter-to-work-day ever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tell your mother you had fun though.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, by the way, I'm taking the last escape pod.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's okay, I'll just take the jet pack. Now where did I put that-- Oh, what was I thinking? I put a jet pack in there too? I might as well have given him an escape hatch! I mean-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well... guess I'm running. (Screaming) Heeelp meee! Help! Ugh! (Screams) Wait! (Stammers) I forgot my little wooden head!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! Yes, we are safe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Western drawl) Yep, just a-lopin' them doggies down the long, lonesome trail. Ain't this livin?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Western drawl) Boy, howdy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're stampeding again! Quick, head them to the off ramp!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're headed for a cliff!

Name: Cow
Dialog: Phew! (Mooing, thud)

Name: Cow #2
Dialog: Uh oh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, strum something! It'll calm them down!

Name: Phineas/Isabella
Dialog: Yee-haw!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yo, cows. Uh, hyah. (At Ferb) Hey, Ferb. We're fording a stream.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Cactus! Oh! Snakes! Ugh! Scorpions! Oh! (Water splashing)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) You think may think that I am defeated, Perry the Platypus. But I still have my Termite controlling Helmet! (Laughs, Jet pack sputtering; Screams) Save us, Perry the Platypus! Woah. Oh, (Laughs) I survived!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (Flips switch)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, what was that? Did-did you just hit the reverse switch? Oh, why did I put that on there? I can't even reach it! What is wrong with me, anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Termites buzzing) (Screams) Wait! Go away! (Screams) Stop! Help me! Help me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this has been fun, but we ought to be getting the herd back into a coral. Where can we find a coral?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was easy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Screams) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. That was so awesome.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, kids. Did you guys have fun?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yee-haw!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yo, doggie!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grumbling)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace! Are you okay, sweetie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I so don't want to talk about it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right. Get in the car, snappy pants. (At the boys) What was that about?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I reckon herding cattle ain't for city folk.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Boy, howdy!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Humming) So, what are you boys thinking of doing today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb are literally standing on their heads next to their backyard tree) Uh...we don't know...it's too hot to think...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yeah, mom and I are getting rid of a few old things at the antique store, but I think I've got just what you need. (a moment later...) A snow cone machine just like when I was a kid!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How does it work?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey? We need to go. The antique show closes in just 12 hours.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, kids. I'll leave you in charge of the machine and be easy on your sister. She's been a bit on edge lately.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Snow in July. (Angelic chorus) That's it! I know what we're going to do today! We're gonna need a lot more ice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is all this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a snow cone! You want some?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean crushed ice covered with blue carbs? Lame.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe Perry wants some. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I'll get right to it. This time, we're worried about Doofenshmirtz buying laser pointers. I mean, 2 or 3 of them would be fine, but he just put in an order for 18,000 of them?! Only a crazed, evil and diabolical mind would do that. (as Perry salutes) I'm sure you'll know what to do, Agent P. (Agent P transition to...)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're making S'Winter!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: S'Winter?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's a unique and logic-defying amalgam of Winter and Summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why have snow in the winter when it's too cold to enjoy it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys are gonna need some help. (Whistles; the Fireside Girls appear to help)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think cheerleaders are overrated anyway. I mean, being gorgeous and popular? Does that matter in the real world--? (Her room goes dark due to the snow blocking her window.) What is going on out there?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woah! This looks great!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grunting, Pants) Phineas! What's going on here?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's summer and winter together. It's S'Winter!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Some people call it "Wummer"!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm calling Mom, you know. (dials phone but stops when she sees Jeremy) Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. You want to go skiing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I'd love to, but, uh, but I am so afraid of heights.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Bummer. Well, see you later, then. Dee Dee, wait up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Dee Dee? (dials phone) Stacy? Who's Dee Dee? A Swedish exchange student?! I gotta go. Hey, wait for me! Let me through! Let me through! Oh, out of my way! (climbs on a ski lift Vanessa is riding on; grumbling) My brothers are just driving me crazy!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Scoffs) You should try spending an hour with my dad sometime.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Oh, I had no idea this thing was so high! (Gasps, ties her seatbelt up) There. Great. Here I go. (tries to get off the ski lift but couldn't) Wait! Wait, wait, wait! No, no, no, no-o-o-o-o-o-o!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: As soon as he walks through that front door, no more Perry the Platypus. (Piano playing) It's genius, right? (sees Agent P) Oh—Oh, I told Nancy to keep the back door locked! (Clears throat; At tape recorder) Note to self; My evil deed for tomorrow. Fire the maid. (At Perry) What are you looking at? Not so fast, Perry the Platypus. Don't worry, it's not what you think. It's my special recipe for quick-hardening chocolate! Between you and me, my popularity has plummeted to an all-time low. But everybody loves chocolate! What if I could recreate chocolate in my own image? Behold! The Melt-inator 6500! Powered by thousands of laser pointers! It has a melting capacity...of 7. That's on a scale of 1–5, so that's a big number. Here. Watch this. Collect my harvest through the city streets, where it will be processed with my secret ingredients to produce the most irresistible confection in the Tri-State Area. Now do you understand what you are up against? Come on, you didn't get any of that? You didn't get any of that? (Sighs) Okay, I will start again. First of all, my popularity is an all-time low.
