You got that, right? Okay. Then--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing tennis rackets on her feet as if they were snowshoes) Alright. That should do it. I'll just walk all the way up to the top. Nothing will stand in my way. (falls deep in the snow) Why is it so dark out here? (A horse and sleigh ram her head) Ow! Oh, that hurts! Wait a minute. I got it! (has Buford ride her up the mountain; snickering mischievously).

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...With my Melt-inator 6500. There. Did you get it that time? Well- (Sighs) Well, I'm not going over it again. Time to get started. At this very moment, the world's largest chocolate bar is passing through town on the way to The Smithsonian, but it will never arrive! In 5, 4, 3-- (Sighs) 2 1/2, 2 1/4. Is that it? Is that—you're not going to do anything? You're just going to stand there like a dead fish? I'm giving you a chance to do something here! Oh, this used to be more fun. 1 1/2, 1 1/4! You know, in some cultures, it's considered rude not to particip-- (Agent P kicks Doofenshmirtz) Ugh! Perry the Platypus? But how did you-- (Gasps) You ate your own heinie? (Grunting) I must aim it quickly! (Aims at the world's largest chocolate bar, but Perry cranks up the speed, making Doofenshmirtz crash into Perry and the Melt-inator aim at the Flynn-Fletcher car)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (On screen) Oh, the kids are going to love this Austrian-style cuckoo clock. Oh, I wish you'd let me buy the large one. (The Melt-inator fires, melting the tires of the car and making Linda scream) Maybe we should pull over and see what's going on. (cut to them examining the flatness) That's peculiar.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Good thing we also bought those 4 spare tires, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, Buford. (Gives him a treat) Now all I need to do is find my Jeremy. Oh no! He's talking to Dee Dee! I gotta put a stop to this! Oh, Jeremy! (slips on the ice) Wait! Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Who's that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams as she falls off a cliff) Why does this keep happening to me? (lands in the water and one of the fishermen pulls her up now frozen in a block of ice with her teeth chattering)

Name: Fisherman
Dialog: Too scrawny. Throw it back. (Fisherman 1 does so)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Dee Dee! You're a really great skier!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace! (puts a helmet on her head) Glad you could join us! This is gonna be great! (she screams at this; they then run into a snowman but Candace gets hit) How did that miss us? (They then run into a tree, which hits Candace) That's just weird. Hold on! (They then freefall making Candace scream, cling to the board, and land on Ferb) That's the spirit! (screams as they land on a sled track) 'Scuse me, Bob. Pardon me, Bob. One side, Bob. 'Scuse me, Bob. Whoopsy Daisy. There we go. It's a bobsled. (They then go down a ramp and into the air. Phineas notices that Candace is missing) Uh, have you seen Candace? (notices Candace under the snowboard) Oh, hey! Here she is! You rock, Candace! I didn't even know that was possible. (They then bounce off a hot-air balloon and over some clouds) Hey, look! A cloud angel! (They then bounce off the balloon in a different direction) Now this is what I call free-styling!

Name: People
Dialog: Nice run, guys!/Totally awesome!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, that was really cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Snorts) Really?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You're quite the S'Winter athlete. By the way, have you met Dee Dee?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Annoyingly) I don't believe I've had the pleasure.

Name: D. D.
Dialog: Derek Dukensson.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh.

Name: D. D.
Dialog: But you can call me D. D. Nice to meet you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, nice to meet you, D. D. (giggles; the car horn honks from out front.) Mom and Dad? Back already? This is going to be the bestest day ever! (runs off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You almost foiled my plan! (Perry is seen ensnared by pink sticky string.) Luckily, I had an extra can of sticky string to subdue you with. Oops, I forgot to plug it in. I always wait 'till the last minute 'cause it takes a lot of power. (plugs it in, only for the electricity to go out in Danville...)

Name: People
Dialog: (Clamoring and moaning in disappointment) Aw, man!...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, everybody! My Mom's got hot chocolate! (People cheering)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Dad! Hee-ee-ee-ee... Look at what Phineas and Ferb did to the backyard!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (grunting) Just a second, Candace...!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, hurry! Come on, come on! They used a snow cone machine to build --

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, do you mind opening the door for us?!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well honey, what do you think?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad! Hurry up!! And it's a mix of Winter and Summer! (Linda and Lawrence come out; with her eyes closed) They call it

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'd think that'd be "Wummer", wouldn't it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know what, Ferb? Today was the best S'Winter day ever. (At Candace) Last chance, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Splats face into snow cone)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh! There you are, Perry.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We're going to the circus! We're going to the circus! (Cut to the kitchen, where Phineas, Ferb, Isabella and Django is eating Pow cereal... aside from Buford) I am here and ready to go to the world-famous Cirque de Lune.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have a seat. We're goin' in a minute.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ok. We're going to the circus! We're going to circus!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, hold your horses, kids. It says here that the lead of Cirque de Lune has a severe allergy. They're canceling today's performance.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's a bummer!

Name: Linda
Dialog: If it's anything like Candace's parsnip allergy, whew! I don't blame him for not wanting to appear in public.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Isabella) She gets blotchy. Red, weird voice thingy. (whispering) Not good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, honey, looks like that frees you up to join me at the mall. Our trio is recording our first album today

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Mmm mmm, should be swinging.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cheer up, guys. I'm sure you'll have a fun day anyway. (She and Lawrence leave the kitchen) Bye, kids, be good. Have fun!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It must be so cool to be in the circus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. (snaps his fingers) Hey, Ferb, let's put on our own Cirque. This'll be great! Ferb can set up the tent, I'll be the ringmaster.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We can sew up some arty costumes.

Name: Django
Dialog: Hey, for a trick, I can put my leg over my head. (Tries and falls over) Ow. I'll work on it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Even Perry can have an act! The Amazing Perry! (trumpets sound as Perry faces the camera with food in his mouth, drooling)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, I have a mystical, magical act I would like to perform. It's stupefying!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I have another act that'll bring the house down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, get the tools!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's do this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sleeping next to a framed photo of her boyfrined; yawns) Good morning, Jeremy. (fake boy voice) Good morning, gorgeous. (normal voice) Oh, Jer! (Candace giggles and rubs a framed photo of herself against the Jeremy photo, making kissing sounds. She is soon alerted to power tools whirring and thumping) I'll be right back, Jeremy. (she looks out of the window) What's going on? (Ferb has just set up the tent) A circus? Can't they give me a break for one day?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This looks great, Ferb. (machinery hissing) Hey, have you seen Perry? I put on his costume.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (clearing his throat) Okay, Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is buying bio-mechanical equipment and... (chuckles) ...elocution tapes. (laughing) W-we don't know why. (Perry walks away) Where are you going, Agent P? Wait, wait, wait, wait. Don't-Don't go. I'm not laughing at you. I just heard a funny joke earlier this morning and- Please-please, Agent P. Turn around so we can conclude our meeting. (camera phone snaps) Carl! (3x) What's your e-mail? Gonna send this to you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, twerp, I brought the props for my act.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, what exactly is your act?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I fly into mud with a paper bag on my head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, then.

Name: Buford
Dialog: The peeps are gonna love.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I'm not even gonna call Mom. Nope, not gonna call! (Unfortunately, the sound of an elephant forces her hand, and she calls Linda)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (recording album at the Squat 'n' Stitch inside Googolplex Mall; answers phone) Candace, honey, listen. I can't talk. We're recording. Is it life or death?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (back home...) Well, no, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I gotta go! Bye! (Candace growls in frustration)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heya, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: My mom told me to bring over these homegrown veggies for your family. You know; she and your mom are doing that jazz thing today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, circus, huh? Cool. Cool. I guess it's more of a cirque than a "circus". (laughs)

Name: Candace (earlier)
Dialog: (in her Jeremy voice) Good morning, gorgeous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. (giggles)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't you think?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't you think we should sit together to watch the show? If-if you want to.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. (hacking cough, wheezing)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Say, are there any wild parsnips in here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, I think that's all that's in there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (choked gasp) Later.

Name: Man
Dialog: I'm dancing with your wife, pal. You got a problem with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm dance... (clears throat) "I'm dancing with your wife, pal. You got a problem with that?" Oh, yes, that does sound tough.

Name: Man
Dialog: Yeah, I ate your last nectarine. You got a problem with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I ate... (Agent P crashes in as usual; coughs) Perry the Platypus, look. Could-could you just use the front door from now on? Could you just do that for me? I mean, (Clears throat) "Yes I ate your last nectarine. You got a problem with that?" Sounds tough, huh? But not tough enough! (He pushes button on a remote and Perry gets trapped in a net) You see; ever since I was a child, I had a high, squeaky voice! But not anymore. Behold

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course, it had to be wild parsnips. Allergy pills, allergy pills. Aha! Quick! Before my voice goes through the reaction. (She finds there are no pills left. She now has in a deep, manly voice) Noooooooooooo!

Name: Mindy
Dialog: Hey, Jeremy. Wanna sit together at the show?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Mindy can't sit with Jeremy! Gotta stop this, gotta tell Mom! Can't go out looking like this! (The camera pans to a paper bag on the floor. Outside...)

Name: Mindy
Dialog: So, how about us sitting together?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Now wearing the paper bag and a grey jacket, she runs past them) 'Scuse me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, it's good, bro. (at Mindy) Thanks, but I promised Candace. (Candace runs off down the street)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (from inside the cirque tent; over P.A.) We're moments away from Ferb and The Amazing Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. You guys are up next. Where's Perry? (Perry, back in his cirque outfit, walks towards the boys) Oh, there you are.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And now, for my final trick, (cut to main stage) I will reattach my thumb! Feel the rhythm, feel the rhyme, come on thumb, it's healing time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's hear it for Baljeet the Stupefying! But now, prepare to be astounded when The Amazing Semi-aquatic Perry, aided by Ferb, attempts to jump through that hoop into the Shallow Pond!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Ooh! (Ferb tosses Perry onto the trampoline and he goes through the hoop and lands in the bucket of water)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Let's hear it for the Amazing Semi-aquatic Perry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Psst. Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, have you been near the wild parsnips again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, but you gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it now?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let me spell it out for you, Mom

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom, so you gonna come home with me?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Are you kidding, hon? Let's do another! (Candace groans as walks off back to home)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, but you are too late. .... (Perry attenpts to turn it off but Doof smacks his hand away) Wait! Wait, don't touch that! .... Stop it! Stop it! (Perry tickles Doofenshmirtz) Stop it, I told you! Stop it! I said, keep your hands off of that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I got my costume all set. Be sure to introduce me as The Amazing Baggo.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, we've been thinking about your act and have some suggestions. Modify your torque and reverse the angle of trajectory.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I still get to land in the mud, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, yeah, yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I want the mud.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you, Django, the Human Pretzel! (Django moans) That's gotta hurt. And now, our next act will catapult through the heavens, and land in a pit filled with the mysterious Aztec mud of doom!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Ooh! hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace runs in the tent) Jeremy! Jeremy! Jeremy! (gasps) He saved me a seat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I give you The Amazing Baggo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ta-da! Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Guys, cut it out! Let go!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That dude's stealing my act! (Ferb pulls the lever; Candace gets flung out of the tent, screaming; Ferb whoooos)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. He must have been lighter than we calculated.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no! This is Buford's moment to shine! (jumps into the pit of mud) Hey, everybody, over here! (All cheer)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait. How'd he get down there?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps Buford truly is amazing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great, now this thing's broken. (The tube of Doofelium lowers into the hole Candace made)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, ladies and gentlemen, (voice-pitch rising) I give you our entire cast in our grand finale, (shift to Agent P gliding down) featuring The Amazing Perry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Voice rising) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS! (the crash causes an explosion)

Name: Kid #1
Dialog: Whoa! Thanks, Phineas!

Name: Kid #2
Dialog: I thought your cirque rocked, Phineas.

Name: Kid #3
Dialog: Thanks, Phineas. You're the coolest.

Name: Boy
Dialog: That was the best circus I've ever been to.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well Phineas, awesome as usual!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom, Dad, you missed our cirque.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, it sure looks like you had fun. (Perry chatters) Who wants to hear my CD?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh, I do.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: All right, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. (They go in the house)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (crawls; moans, back to her usual voice) Oh, well, at least I'm back to normal.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. My mom played me some of their CD. Your singing is awesome! How'd you get your voice to sound like that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, same as all the great blues singers

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, you know, kids, this theater was built over 70 years ago in this Neo-Egyptian style. And apparently, there used to be a pharaoh's tomb display with a mummy in a sarcophagus. I mean, you couldn't pick a better place to watch a classic, old mummy movie.

Name: Explorer
Dialog: (In movie) There's an inscription here. An...an incantation of some sort. "Owah Tagu Siam!"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, where do you find a mummy?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hidden deep in the bowels of the pyramids. (Phone rings) Whoops, better put this on vibrate.

Name: Explorer
Dialog: (In movie) The incantation will make the mummy come to life and obey your commands. Well, beat me with a chicken. (The mummy starts beating him with a chicken) Ow! What?! Ooh! Hey! Stop! It's an--ow! Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Dad, is it hard to get into a pyramid?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, indeed. Often you had to negotiate many booby traps that were set centuries before.

Name: Explorer
Dialog: (In movie) You ridiculous mummy. You just tripped one of your own booby traps. (There is a rumbling noise, and rocks begin to fall on the explorer and the mummy) She's gonna blow! (They run for the exit, barely getting out in time)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome booby trap! (at Ferb) Ferb, we should get our own mummy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That would be awesome! (At Lawrence) Dad, can we--

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Snoring)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. We'll be back before he wakes up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, those bozos aren't pulling anything on my watch! (Grunts)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz is at it again. It appears that he's purchased a string of odd items

Name: Computer voice
Dialog: Dive. Dive. Dive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mr. Employee, sir, where's the mummy exhibit?

Name: Employee
Dialog: (Presses button) Manager assistance requested.

Name: Employee #2
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Employee
Dialog: These boys want to know where the mummy exhibit is.

Name: Employee #2
Dialog: It's in storage. In the basement.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guess who's goin' to the basement!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, where are the restrooms?

Name: Employee
Dialog: Manager assistance requested.

Name: Employee #2
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look! Pith helmets! We might be going the right way. Say something pithy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it. I'm calling Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Laughs) Ohh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, forget it! I'm going in myself.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you hear that? Maybe it's the mummy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Eww. My shoe is all squishy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, Ferb? What are you doing? Woah! Who know looking for mummies would be so much fun? Watch this! (Thud) Ugh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, this was our first booby trap! Woo! Hey, look! The storage! We're here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh, when I catch them... (Ball rolling) (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, give me a break!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bubble gum? Oh, really old, stale bubble gum! Blaugh! Phineas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Almost done, just this one more little bit!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! As usual, your timing is incredible! And by "Incredible", of course I mean

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Owah Tagu Siam! (Air hissing) There's nothing here but fakey promotional lobby junk. For all we know, there might not be such thing as a mummy. (At Mummy Candace) Yeah, I'll be right with you. I mean-- (Gasps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Screams; Slams door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I didn't expect them to be so scary. I mean, can you imagine the angry, twisted soul hidden under those bandages?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Makes me shudder. But you know what? We came down here looking for a mummy, and I'm not leaving without one. Let's get him!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We got our own mummy! Now, how are we going to get it home?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And...finished! (Button beep)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It is working! (Laughs) It is functioning properly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) Perry the Platypus? You defeated my bubble of pure evil? Ooh! (Lasers firing; Water flooding) Oh, no! What? (Bubble pops) Is my nose really that pointy? (Screaming and grunting)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know what this is? Our second booby trap! (Water splashing) There you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: WOO-HOO-HOO! OH YEAH! WOO-HOO! OH YEAH! (at Candace) Hey, Candace, you missed all the fun. Allow me to introduce our mummy. (realizes the "mummy" isn't there) Hey, where's our mummy? Mummy? Mummy?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, Mummy has supper waiting for us at home. (At Candace) Candace, why are you all wet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You know, mummies had their brains pulled out through their nose.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Scoffs) The lucky ones.

Name: This article is in need of improvement in the following area(s)
This article is in need of improvement in the following area(s)
Dialog: Clean-up  "...Because the worst part of the party is the cleanup, am I right?"

Name: This article is in need of improvement in the following area(s)
Dialog: The transcript needs scene transitions.

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: We're giving away free tickets to see everyone's favorite girl rockers - The Bettys.

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: Eeeee!

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: All you have to do is be the 444 and 4/4 caller...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah! I love fractions.

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: ...and you and your best Betty buddy will get to ride with the band on The Betty bus to see the show.

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: Eeeeee!

Name: Radio announcer
Dialog: Call now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after dialing the phone) Oh, it's busy! I've just gotta win. Clearly I'm your biggest fan. See, even my Betty boombox which rests on my Betty bedside table next to my Betty bed runs on Betty batteries.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Grab her hair) Obsession rocks! (Release her hair)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. (phone rings)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, it's ringing!

Name: Phone announcer
Dialog: Congratulations, you're the winning caller!

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: EEEEEEEEE!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Imagine, a whole day of hanging with Crash and the band. And, as an added bonus, a whole day of not thinking about my goofy brothers. Just me, you and The Bettys! (horn honks) Ooh, they're here.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bye. Enjoy your music concert.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Be careful.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have fun on your journey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe we're about to board The Betty Bus.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I bet the bus driver's gonna be a spaced-out rocker.

Name: Dennis
Dialog: H-Hello, girls. My name is Dennis, and I'm with the radio station. (pig snorts) That is Sir Bacon, the band's mascot. According to our focus groups, girls your age overwhelmingly find that cool.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Totally!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, this place is a total pigsty.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: We love it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Stacy, it's them.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Shh, they're creating.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We're your biggest fans.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, we won the contest. Now we get to hang out with you all day.

Name: Crash
Dialog: (British accent) Keep it down. We're trying to write a song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure thing.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, no problem.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's The Betty Bass Guitar!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, I know...

Name: Crash
Dialog: Check this out. (at Candace and Stacy) So tell me, girls, would you like to be part of the music-making process and help us write a song?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, oh, my gosh.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Would we?

Name: Crash
Dialog: Great. First, we can't possibly write a song in this filth, so you girls can start by cleanin' up the bus. Here you go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Ferb, what should we do today? One - an escalator to the moon? Two - become secret agents? Three - clone giant hamsters. Hey, where's Perry? Huh. I wonder where he goes when we can't find him. What the...? Some sort of secret room? Wow. What in the world? A secret underground headquarters with a particle disruptor and, oh, a hovercraft. Looks like we're gonna be secret agents, huh? When did you find the time to build all this, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, I –

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. Hang on. It's here somewhere on this clipboard from which I have yet to look up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agent P. P for Phineas. Nice touch, Ferb.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually -

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, yes, here it is. Dr. Doofenshmirtz. Huh, what a surprise. Building some sort of destructo ray. End of the world. Yada, yada, yada. I'm faxing you the coordinates.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good googly-moogly! Do... Carl. Carl, who are those kids?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, boy. They're Agent P's owners, sir. Looks like they found one of our secret tunnels.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sweet. We got our mission, Agent F. To the hover jet.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is that the hover jet? Oh, no, they didn't! (at Perry) There you are, Agent P. Those boys are in jeopardy and not covered under our hover jet insurance plan, so, stop Doofenshmirtz and protect those boys. (at Carl) Oh, and where are you going, Mr. The Boys Will Never Find A Tree Tunnel?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow... Laser beam, magnet ray, cup holder. You really thought of everything, Ferb.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually –

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold that thought. The Bettys' tour bus. Candace is on there. We should go say hi.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're all done cleaning the bus.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Oh, we can't get to our song till we deal with our fan mail. Think you could help?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, oh, my gosh...

Name: Missy
Dialog: Great. You can start with this bag.

Name: Tink
Dialog: (British accent) And here's the shredder.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Check this one out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahem. "Beloved Bettys, your band is the biggest, baddest, most bangin' buncha -" Hey, this is my letter. They didn't even read it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, but don't forget - we are on the bus helping the band write a song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I guess you're right. And you know what the best part is? I haven't even thought about my brothers the whole day. (She sees her brothers out the window.) Stacy, look, it's my brothers!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Huh? I don't see anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: B-But I could've sworn I –

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think the cleaning supplies are starting to get to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That must be it. That's gotta be. I'm not even gonna look.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voice over) Stop Doofenshmirtz. Protect the boys. Stop Doofenshmirtz. Protect the boys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (hums) Ah, nothing like a nice snack before testing the Destructinator. Aah! Hey, Perry the Platypus, why do you always go for the nose?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here you go.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All 250,000 letters opened and shredded.

Name: Tink
Dialog: I just thought of something. The outside of this bus is dirty, too.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, Stacy, I'm beginning to think that The Bettys have just been taking advantage of us this whole time.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What are you talking about? They've been nothing but... Look out! ...nice to us since we got on the bus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh-heh. My automatic tennis ball server can go all night, Perry the Plat-

Name: Male computer voice
Dialog: Destructinator countdown initiated. 30 seconds to activation.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Ferb, this evil villain lair is awesome. I see you carved it out with dynamite. Nice. Aw, cool, you got an automatic tennis ball server. Sweet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what's going on, Perry the Platypus? (muffled speech)

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're finished washing the outside of the bus. It nearly killed us, but we're finished!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Great work, girls. You've earned a special "surprise."

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really?

Name: Missy
Dialog: You get to scrub the toilets.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yay, toilets! They're so much fun to scrub!

Name: Tink
Dialog: And be sure to get underneath the lid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, that is it. We're through being your tour monkeys. Right, Stace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yay, a Betty Bowl Brush!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You've just been using us this whole trip. Is this how you treat your fans? It should be your fans that inspire you to make music. If you can't see that by now, then drop me off at the next Betty Bus Stop.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Unfortunately, guys, she's right.

Name: Tink
Dialog: I feel like a bit of a Betty butt-head.

Name: Crash
Dialog: We're sorry for treating you so bad. How can we ever make it up to you?

Name: Missy
Dialog: I'll let you bang my Betty Bongos.

Name: Tink
Dialog: Or play my Betty Bass Guitar.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Hey, guys, that's it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...you'll go Betty, Betty far?

Name: Crash
Dialog: Perfect. That rocks.

Name: Dennis
Dialog: Hey, girls, what's goin' on?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We just helped the Bettys write - Wait a second. Dennis, if you're here, then who's driving the bus?

Name: Dennis
Dialog: Oh, come on, I'll show you. Autopilot.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Wow, cool.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By the way, I love that giant ray gun counting down to zero. OK, seriously, when did you make all this?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Look, for the last time, I didn't –

Name: Candace
Dialog: He fainted.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah! Unh, unh. There's something wrong with the Betty Brakes, and I can't stop the autopilot.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Grab the Betty Emergency Brake!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) The Betty Brake broke!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How did you make a working destructo ray?

Name: All
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, that's the bus Candace is on. I get it. We have to save Candace. What a cool mission.

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: AAAAAAH!

Name: Crash
Dialog: Say, what's all the fussin' about?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The b-b-bridge! We're gonna crash!!!

Name: All
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Plat- Oof. Bleah. Curse you, Perry the Plat- Oof. Bleah. Curse you, Perry the - Bleah. Why did I buy so many mops? Oof.

Name: Girls
Dialog: HELP! HELP!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming, Candace.

Name: Girls
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agent F, activate the magnet ray. It's too heavy.

Name: Missy
Dialog: Huh? C-Candace? Whatever you're doing is working.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you designed this thing. (imitates Captain Kirk) Can you give me any more power? Excellent. We did it. Our sister's safe.

Name: The Bettys, Stacy
Dialog: (cheer) Brilliant!/You did it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agent F, let's head home.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Way to go, Candace. Now we are your biggest fan. How can we thank you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you can come to my house and clean up my room.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm serious.

Name: Crash
Dialog: How about you sing with us onstage instead?

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: (both gasp) It's a deal. (both squeal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I can't wait to get home and tell Mom all about our secret spy adventure. Hey, what's goin' on? It's like we're stuck in some sort of tractor beam. Aah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. Seriously, Phineas, what are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (imitates James Bond) That, my friend, is classified information.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, what a great day. Not one phone call from Candace with some crazy, unbelievable story –

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom, guess what Ferb did. He made a secret tunnel and a spy headquarters and a villain's lair and a hover jet shaped like Perry. Tell her, Ferb.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, I – !

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait a second. Why are you two soaking wet?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ach! I give up! (stomps off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We fell in Isabella's pool.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That I believe. (at Perry) Oh, hi, Perry. (at herself) I wonder how Candace is doing.

Name: Crash
Dialog: Oi! We'd like to bring a very special person to the stage. She's not only Bettys' best fan, but she also saved all of our lives! Ladies and gentlemen, Candace, and her best friend Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What do you think your brothers are doing right now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who cares?

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Okay, Isabella. Say "Aaaah".

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (opens mouth) Ahhhh...

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Oh, good. The swelling has gone down dramatically. I'll be back to check on you soon. (exits)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Isabella, what'cha dooooin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Raspy voice) Oh, just recovering. But I finally got my tonsillectomy patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just came by to cheer you up. And to see if you're well enough for our event.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry, guys. My throat still hurts like crazy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's cool. Sorry, gang. We've got to postpone the Trojan War reenactment till further notice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, the best part of getting your tonsils out is that you get to eat all the ice cream you want.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mountains of it! We could have the biggest ice cream sundae ever made! (to Ferb) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! First, we gotta draw up some plans. Wait, no time for that. You go to Blueprint Heaven; I'll head home and meet the delivery guy. (Phone beeps) Hello? Blowtorch City? Yeah, I'll hold. (to Isabella) When are they letting you out of this joint?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This afternoon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perfect, we should have just enough time.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: So, I'm going out, Vanessa. Remember, you're at your Dad's this weekend.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Great. A whole 48 hours of evil.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Vanessa Doofenshmirtz, your dad's not evil. We just didn't get along. We wanted different things.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Was one of those things "To be evil"? Because he's evil.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: He's not evil, honey. No one's evil.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, Mom. He's evil. You don't notice about him? He has evil schemes. Normal people don't have schemes of any kind. And there's this secret agent that always bursts in, and--

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I think you're being overly dramatic.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Mom, I'm not being dramatic. Dad builds evil contraptions every day. Wait. (Phone beeps) Let me check on something.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Phone beeps) Yup. He's even got his own evil jingle right on his answering machine. (Speed dial) Listen!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On Phone) Hello?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, hello, Heinz.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad! Why did you pick up? You always let the machine get it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I heard it ring the first time, so I was standing by the phone. Oh, could you pick up some blueprints for me on your way over? Thank you, sweetie.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Great. Now he wants me to pick up some evil blueprints for his latest evil contraption. And as soon as he's done building it, I'll have proof! I'll call you, and you can see for yourself.

Name: Worker
Dialog: So, you need plans to build a giant sundae maker, do you? Hmm, I'm not sure if we sell blueprints for that anymore. Whoa! Hold on, sweetie. No need to get upset. I'll go check in the back, okay? Okay. Let's see. Giant sundae machine. I got a yogurt machine! How's that sound? Yeah, I don't care for yogurt either, baby. I'll keep looking. You're in luck. I found one! Now, what do you need, sweetie?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm here to pick up an order for Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Worker
Dialog: Oh, yes. Your Daddy just called.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, how's it goin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Can you bring it back here? Thanks. That's great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her phone) You're not going to believe it, Stacy. But when I turned around, Jeremy was standing right behind me. Well, he was sitting, and he was a couple blocks away, but he was right there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (from outside) Keep it coming, keep it coming! Okay, stop. Great. Stack 'em over here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, Stace? I'm going to have to call you back.

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: And that's the last of it. Eh, just need you to sign here. Say, aren't you a little...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Young to be using titanium plating and an industrial arc welder? Yes. Yes I am. I get that a lot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you know I'm in charge, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, isn't that just if a satellite crashes into the-

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! When Mom's at her cooking class, I'm in charge. Now, what are you up to out here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'd like to tell you, but it's gonna be a big surprise. Hey, wait a second. Have you seen Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to wake you, Agent P. Looks like Doofenshmirtz is getting sloppy. He sent his daughter right into our sting operation and purchased blueprints for a Space Las-inator. We intend to pass him fake plans, but due to a rookie error, and by "rookie", I mean Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, my bad.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The plans he received are real; terrifyingly real.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Again, I must apologize, I was in character--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You better step on it, Agent P. Before it's too late.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Can you give me a hand unpacking this stuff, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not gonna help you. But as soon as I figure out what you're up to, I'm calling Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Say Hi for me!

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: Bonjour, class. Today we will be making crepes Guilbaud.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, is everything all right? Well, if you don't even know what he is doing, how do you know if it's a problem?

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: (Clears throat) Is there something you would like to share with the whole class?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sorry, sir. (At Phone) Candace, I'll talk to you later, okay? (Phone beeps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls) I'm keeping an eye on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. You got the blueprints? Excellent! Isabella's gonna love it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you—you're early. I haven't even started yet. My daughter should be here any minute with the blueprints, though. Oh, there she is. (At Vanessa) Good morning, Vanessa. You remember Perry the Platypus.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, hi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, why don't you have a seat in my waiting area? Read some magazines! Sorry they're in Spanish, I--I steal them from my neighbor. You know, evil never rests.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So, Dad, this plan, it's evil, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, yes it is! It's nice to see you taking an interest in the family business.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's all I need to know. (Phone beeps)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I'm in class now, Vanessa. I have to go. Mmm-hmm. Mmm-hmm. Yes, Vanessa, I'll leave my phone on. (At Linda) Teenagers. Ugh. What are we making this week?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I think it's crepes, but you know, I can't understand his accent.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, it's finally ready! (Button beeps) Too bad you can do nothing but watch as I launch my Space Laser-Inator!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, I bet that thing must be really evil, huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, take a look out that window and tell me what you see.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, not much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly! Ever since that stupid billboard went up, my panoramic view is completely ruined. I used to have this perfect vantage point for enjoying the delicious misery of others.

Name: Man
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Woman
Dialog: You owe $78,000.

Name: Man #3
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, after I launch this baby into orbit, my problem will be solved! Then, I can go on to eliminate all the other annoyances that make my skin crawl! Like, uh...nature! (Laser zaps) Beauty! (Laser zaps)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Morning talk show hosts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon, there will be nothing that can withstand the wrath of Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Doctor? Since when were you a doctor?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They don't just give these out to anybody, you know.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Anybody with 15 bucks, they do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's enough looking! I'd love to debate you, but I have some pressing business to take care of, like remaking the Tri-State Area in my own, twisted image! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh my gosh! This is worse than I thought! Oh, Dad is going to be so busted.

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: Now, carefully pour the batter. Slowly, slowly. (Phone rings, Glass smashes)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake! Vanessa?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, this better be important.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: He's doing what?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, are you sure you're not exaggerating just a little bit?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well, it's not that I don't believe you, honey...

Name: Linda
Dialog: But every time I race home, I find out everything is just fine.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Yes, I'll be right over. (Phone beeps)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm on my way. (Phone beeps) Teenagers!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Tell me about it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, to launch my creation and begin my reign of terror! Evil terror. (Button beeps, whirring; Ding) Huh? Ah. (ice cream splats onto him) Ugh... Well, this can't be right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Get ready for a giant sundae!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this can't be right. Lemme see those blueprints. Oh, wait a minute. Those are the plans for a Space Laser-inator, apparently. I was wondering what that thing was for. That must be the laser. (briefly, we see the laser on the ground) Good thing we didn't attach it, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom! Hurry!! Come on, come on!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids. How are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just about to make a nice handmade ice cream sundae for Isabella.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that is so sweet! Come on in the kitchen. I'll help you with it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Come on, Mom! Hurry!

Name: Vanessa (cont.)
Dialog: (with her eyes closed) See?! Evil!! I told you!!!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Hmm...um, that's not evil, dear.

Name: Charlene (cont.)
Dialog: Bit much, perhaps. Heinz, what is all this? I thought you were lactose intolerant.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am!!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (presses button; more ice cream falls) Oh... I'm paying you way too much alimony. (Notices Perry, now in pet mode) And what's over there? That is no way to treat your pet!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But Mom, that's a secret agent!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: A secret agent? He's just a little platypus. They don't do much, you know.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, guys, this is amazing! I was afraid you guys were gonna go overboard and build some giant sundae contraption or something!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, we were gonna do that, but we accidentally build a space laser instead. (At Ferb) Ferb, you're usually so focused. How did you get those plans confused?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, how's it goin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Snap out of it. What happened back there?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (pause) I was weak.
Shimmy Jimmy!
Ooh ooh ooh ooh ooh-ah!
Ooh ooh ooh ooh ooh-ah!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Another gem from the Har D Har toy makers!

Name: Hyena
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha!

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: (turns off TV in its flagship store at the Googolplex Mall) There, you see? It sells itself! Shimmy Jimmy is our number one toy! I hope you are ready to face some costumers, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (winks) You can depend on me. (answers her video phone, which rings) Hi, Stacy. Yeah, it's so cool. The first day of my first job, and the best part is Jeremy works right across the aisle! I could watch him make hot dogs all day. Any moment now, Jeremy will look over and notice how cute I look.

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: Candace, you're not wearing your Shimmy Jimmy hat! (places said hat onto her head)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? Is that you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah! (drops her cell phone)

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: Candace, look! (Cut to the door where Phineas, Ferb and Linda wave, aisde from Perry.) You have your first customers! (Candace walks towards them) Oh, and don't forget to do the laugh! Go on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (no nonsense) Welcome to the Har D Har toy store. Ha ha ha ha.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey. I'm so proud of you. I'm just going to leave the boys here to browse while I make some exchanges. (walks away) Back in a bit, working girl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Could we hear the laugh again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't bug me, you insects.

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: (clears his throat) Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Monotone; Instrumental

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Ferb hands the toy to him) Seems like that would get old really quick.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Oh, like you geniuses can make a better toy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pause, as the instrumental ends) I know what we're doin' today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (cntd) Okay, then. (while writing on a notepad; Ferb walks with a hammer and a toolkit) what we need is a toy so stupidly simple, (Ferb drills with a electric screwdriver; He rushes back and and forth with a jackhammer) so basically bland, (Ferb jackhammers; He rushes back and forth with a paintbrush and a can of blue paint of Perry's skin color, in which the platypus wanders away) so idiotically uncomplicated… (Ferb splatters paint; He rushes and forth with a blowtorch) that it can do absolutely anything. (flames whoosh) Hmm. Say, where's Perry? (Ferb whistles; He runs off, throwing away the notepad and pencil) What do ya got?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Perry runs and jumps to his chair) Ah, there you are, Agent P. We suspect that your nemesis, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, has been pilfering bricks from buildings across the Tri-State Area. Animals are rioting, convicts are escaping from the zoo. It's chaos! You've got to stop him, Perry, (Perry salutes) before it all falls down.

Name: Board Member #1
Dialog: As you can see, our sales have plummeted. (inside) Kids just aren't interested in climbing toys anymore.

Name: Board Member #2
Dialog: Y-Yeah, but we've always made climbing toys. I mean, who could forget Climbin' Simon, or what about Ascendin' Brendan, and then of course, there's Ladderman Larry, or the classic Climby Jaimie?

Name: Board Member #1
Dialog: Stop it!

Name: Board Member #2
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Board Member #1
Dialog: (pushes the toys off the table) What we need is a fresh new toy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (in another room… he and Ferb, pushing a cart, enters) Greetings, movers and shakers. I'm Phineas and that's Ferb. And do we have a toy for you.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: Hold on there. Aren't you a bit young to be toy designers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well... I don't think so. (pauses) And now, it's fresh, it's new, it's incredibly hip! Soon to be the biggest hit of the new toy season,

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...the Platypus.

Name: Board Member #2
Dialog: Uh, what does it do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the beauty part! It does absolutely nothing! Now it can be anything we want! Like an airplane! Or a race car! Or maybe a bucking bronco. You can even turn a mean tango.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: Just a minute. We could promise the moon without really promising anything. (pauses, then chuckles) I love it!

Name: Man
Dialog: Brilliant, J.B.!

Name: Woman
Dialog: I loved it from the beginning even before I heard it.

Name: Board Member #1
Dialog: Are you all crazy? It's just a thick, stupid block of wood! And it doesn't do any- AHHH!! (Falls down a trap door)

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: I love it! What are we talking about?

Name: J.B.
Dialog: Glad we're all on the same page. Phineas and Ferb, we're gonna produce your toy that does nothing. I'll put both of you in charge, and double your salaries. What'd ya say?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, we've never made a salary.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: Well, then, I'll triple it.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: Here's the factory, boys! This is where it all happens!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Somehow I never pictured a toy factory as being this...boring. (pauses) Time for a makeover!

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: Boys, I got an angle on our new toy you are going to love. (reveals poster #1; Perry dressed as a super hero) Perry the Atomic Super Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's just a platypus.

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: Right. Got it. Just a platypus.

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: Ha, you're gonna flip for this. Are you ready for... (reveals poster #2) ...The Mad Marauding Marsupial of Death!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's just a platypus.

Name: Worker #1
Dialog: I don't get why we have to wear these silly outfits.

Name: Worker #2
Dialog: I like it. It gives me purpose.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is a toy factory. How'd this chocolate river get here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who the heck are you guys?

Name: The Ba-dink-a-dinks
Dialog: We are the Ba-dink-a-dinks!

Name: A Ba-dink-a-dink
Dialog: You set us free when you remodeled the factory. We'd been trapped in the basement for years, making foam peanuts and snipping the tabs off of plastic.

Name: The Ba-dink-a-dinks
Dialog: We will now lay waste to the surface dwellers!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, then. Carry on.

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: This one is dynamite. (reveals poster #3; Perry in secret agent mode) Secret Agent Perry the Platypus. Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you have anything else?

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: Uh, no. No, no I don't.

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: (reveals poster #4, which Ferb gave to him) "Perry the Platypus Inaction Figure. It does...nothing"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as balloons and confetti falls) That's it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (chuckles) Well, if it isn't Perry the Platypus! You've arrived precisely on cue. Allow me to explain. Voila! (removes a cover, revealing a replica of the Tri-State Area) A precise 1/100th scale replica of the Tri-State Area! (chuckles) You'd be surprised how much free time I have. Now, with all the bricks that I've, uh... (chuckles) collected, I'll construct... the Great Wall of the Tri-State Area! Thereby cutting off the citizens from the rest of the world! (laughs) And how do people get in and out of the city, you ask? With this! Official Doofenshmirtz-approved toll booth! I haven't really worked out a price point yet, but it won't be cheap, I can tell you that!

Name: Boy
Dialog: I want a green one!

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: Here you go, little angel.

Name: Boy
Dialog: Yay! My own Inaction Figure!

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: Candace! Come on out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing a platypus suit) You're kidding, right?

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: Fantastic, you look like number 1!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I feel like number 2.

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: That's the spirit! Now, go out there and bring us some customers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, this is so embarrassing. I'm just so glad that Jeremy's on break. If he saw me in this thing, I think I'd plotz.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: 'Scuse me, sir? Oh, Candace? Wow, in that outfit, I couldn't even tell you were a girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs weakly)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: See you later, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't worth $3.50 an hour.

Name: Bridgette Oshinomi
Dialog: I'm here live with Phineas and Ferb, creators of the international toy phenomenon, Perry the Platypus Inaction Figure.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Exotic backgrounds not included.

Name: Bridgette Oshinomi
Dialog: Simply amazing! (To the boys) What was your inspiration?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we have a pet platypus named Perry. (To Candace) Oh, hi, Candace. Nice suit. (to the TV reporter) Now, as I was saying, he's a platypus. He doesn't do much.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I should've known those two were behind this. (pulls out her cell phone) Time to call Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it, Candace?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace. Calm down. I'll come by and see you as soon as I'm done with the exchanges.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, how did you escape? Hmm… I probably should have used cement. Ah, no matter. You'll never catch me! (laughs; He runs on the rooftops with Perry in pursuit; chuckles) You can't stop me, Perry the Platypus! You couldn't stop me with a billion Perry the Platypuses! Because I am unstoppabl- (Doofenshmirtz falls from a skylight and into a container of Perry the inaction figures) -llllllllllllle! (laughs) Finally, I lost you, Perry the Platypus! I'm free of you! (notices the inaction figures, then screams) Get 'em off of me! Get 'em off of me! Get 'em off of me!

Name: Worker #1
Dialog: So, did you see the game on Saturday?

Name: Worker #2
Dialog: Yeah, a real nail biter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shoo, shoo! Go away! Whoo! Now, that was just disturbing. Waah! No, no! Get away from me! (falls into a box)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ("Quirky Worky Song") So, Ferb, (Perry freezes when he hears his voice.) I think the sale projections are… (Record scratch; Phineas looks at Perry, who's now standing perfectly still and still in agent mode.) Hey, people, (picks Perry up) I thought we agreed we weren't gonna do this. (tosses Perry over his shoulder) How many times do I have to say it? (Perry lands in a dumpster with all the rejections.) He's a platypus. They don't do anything. (He leaves the factory with Ferb.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (Agent P looks around, trying to find where the voice is coming from. He finally shrugs then leaves; deciding that the mission is over.; Instrumental version of Perry's theme) Wait, wait! Where are we going? Is that sea water I smell? I hope I'm not on a boat, (the delivery boat departs) 'cause I get sea sick.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: So, how does everyone likes my new suit?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Excellent!

Name: Man
Dialog: Fantastic!

Name: Board Member #2
Dialog: Have you lost weight?

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: You look really good!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Um, that man isn't wearing any clothes.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: There you are, Phineas and, what's-his-name? Perry the Platypus is a smashing hit! So, what's your next big idea?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going home.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: But, but, but, but why? You're at the top of your game! You've got your whole career ahead of you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's supper time. Mom's makin' fried chicken, but thanks for a great day. (He and Ferb exit.)

Name: J.B.
Dialog: Oh, that's just great! Any of the rest of you geniuses have an idea?

Name: Marketing Employee
Dialog: Ah, I found this in my office with a pile of shattered glass, J.B.

Name: J.B.
Dialog: What's this, a brick? (pauses) That's brilliant!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, who would buy a brick for a toy?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It does absolutely nothing.

Name: Boy
Dialog: Sweet!

Name: Boy #2
Dialog: They have it!

Name: Boy #3
Dialog: Oh, wow, they got the bricks!

Name: Boy #4
Dialog: The bricks!

Name: Store Manager
Dialog: These brick toys are selling like pancakes. Candace, keep up the great work!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing a brick costume) One at a time, one at a time! You'll get your bricks.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. The things they make us wear, huh? At least you don't have a weenie on your head!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) He understands me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, we're almost there. What's the first thing you're going to do at camp, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Find a nerd, take his underpants, and run 'em up the flagpole.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't think Camp Phineas and Ferb has a flagpole.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Then I guess I'll just find a nerd and take his underpants.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You may have my underpants. They just got very messy all of a sudden.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thanks, but it ain't the same if Buford don't rip 'em off of you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about you, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The Fireside Girls and I are going to work on our accomplishment patches.

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Yay! Accomplishment patches!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about you, sis? What's the first thing you're gonna do at camp?

Name: Candace
Dialog: First of all, it's not camp. It's just Grandma and Grandpa's cabin, and it's boring.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But we made T-shirts.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Secondly, I don't like the outdoors, okay? I don't like bugs. Phineas, are you even listening to me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I seem to have misplaced my ant farm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Do I have to go to Grandma and Grandpa's?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I think it's rather sweet that Betty Jo and Grandpa Clyde invite you kids and all your friends every year.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I'm not a kid. I'm a young adult. Can I do something with you guys?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Of course you can, Dear. You can join us at the antiques symposium. This year's keynote address will debate Shellac vs. Lacquer.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Phineas) I'll take one of those shirts. (Sobs)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Where are they?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Look. Oh, here they come now. (Clyde laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hiya, Grandpa!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, hello Phineas! You haven't changed a bit!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grandpa, that's not me! That's Perry!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Huh? Huh? Oh, oh, right. Looks like I need to get my glasses fixed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) With the glasses.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: And Turbo Ferb-o! Put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there, put 'er there! (Laughs) Still a man of few words, I see.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, actually I--

Name: Clyde
Dialog: So, where's your sister?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello? Hello! What do you have to do to find a cell signal in this place?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi Grandma. How can you stand living out here in the middle of nowhere?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, come on, honey. It's not so bad. You'll see.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Alright, nature lovers! Time for vittles!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) "Vittles" is "Grandpa-ese" for "food". Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about that, Agent P. We haven't used that tree slide in years. Not since I was at... the Academy. (Sad music) Anyway, Doofenshmirtz seems to be up to something, Agent P. He's hold up at his evil woodland retreat. Your mission is to find out what he's up to. Please, Agent P. Be careful. (Thinking) The Academy.

Name: Kid
Dialog: But I don't want to go to the Academy, Daddy.

Name: Man
Dialog: I'm not your father, and it's been decided.

Name: Kid
Dialog: I love you, Daddy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you pesky bugs! I am trying to tan here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I thought I'd bring my favorite camp counselor a Phineas special.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That is just a glass of limeade. And I am not a counselor.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. The girls have finished pitching the tents. (The Fireside Girls salute in front of their tents) Can you sign here for our Tent Pitching achievement patches please?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, as camp director, I'd say I'm "Doing my job".

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Gather around, kids. There's an old legend, well, not that I believe it, about the Sasquatch. A race of giant, hairy creatures living up here in these very woods. (Kids gasp) If my memory serves, I think there was a song written about it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? Do you remember any of it?

Name: '(Song
Dialog: "He's Bigfoot")

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He remembers.

Name: Kids
Dialog: (Cheer)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: One more time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Am I the only adult here? Why can't my grandpa act his own age?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: I think you should act your age. And have a little fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Grandma.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: There's all sorts of fun a young adult can have here. You've just gotta use your imagination. So come on! We're making stick figures! Out of real sticks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grandma!

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: All right, all right, all right. We'll think of something else.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Oh, uh, hello. I'm looking for Strudelcutie4427. (Notices Perry, picks him up) Wow, aren't you the cutest little thing? Are you my date for this evening?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! (Laughs) Uh, that would be me. I'm Strudelcutie4427. Nice to meet you. Uh, this is my pet platypus. He was just going outside for a nightly walk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Oh, could I hold him a little longer? He's so sweet. (At Perry) Oh, yes. Yes you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Well, I guess he can stay a- A little bit, but- You know what they say. Three's a crowd and whatnot. (Laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Gulp) Ahh. Just how I like 'em.' You've just earned your marshmallow patch, my friend. (Candace sighs) So, Grandpa, what should we do now? Tell scary stories? I got one!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Oh, Phineas, you always start. Why not give another kid a chance?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Yes. How about you, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Okay. Anyone else? Uh, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: W-what? Uh, uh, oh. Thank you. (Flashlight switch flips; Wolf howls) Well, this is a story about a kid who comes to this country, and goes to camp. He, like, has to share a tent with a bully. It's really quite terrifying, actually. Quite terrifying. (Crickets chirp; Flashlight switch flips)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Take it away, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Grandpa. I've got a good one. It's about Bigfoot!

Name: Dimitri/Pedro/Ginger
Dialog: Bigfoot?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bigfoot?

Name: Squirrel
Dialog: Bigfoot?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grandma!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Sorry, dear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: You are the cutest thing I've ever seen. Yes, you are. Yes, you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, some people say we look alike.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Uh, I don't think so. (At Perry) Not at all. No, not at all.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, darling, you haven't even touched your cucumber water. I made it especially for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: You know, Strudelcutie4427 was a lot less needy online.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs) I'm going to go get some air.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: ...Lot less needy online. (Door squeaks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sips cucumber water, Spits it out) Oh, I don't even like cucumbers! Why do I always get the crazies?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And they say that when the moon is full, like it is tonight, Bigfoot will return, and exact his revenge. (Leaves rustling) Huh? What was that noise?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I really should have packed more underpants... (The kids continue to scream endlessly in fear and terror.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He hears their hollers; Gasps) That sounded like screaming children! But it's not my birthday. (He falls off the balcony screaming)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys crack me up! (Laughing)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, what are you talking about?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's no Bigfoot! It's just Ferb in the tree! Look! See? They're just dummies! (At Ferb) Nice rope skills, my friend!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Then... who is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, it's an inflatable Ferb. (Air hissing) Sounds like Ferb too.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was awesome!

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: What was that? You better stay here while I investigate. (She goes outside, allowing Perry to escape) Oh! (sees the leaf-covered Doofenshmirtz) Bigfoot?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Bigfoot!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no! Wait! It's me! Ugh! (The date hits him with her purse, causing him to fall)

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Strudelcutie4427? Whoops.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Whoa! That was a good one, boys. You sure got us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't take it anymore!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was just a joke, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're a joke, Phineas!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Candace, Honey, calm down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Calm down? Calm down?! I don't wanna calm down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Your screaming might attract a real Bigfoot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A real Bigfoot? Oh, give it a rest, Phineas! Everyone knows there's no such thing as a real- (sees Bigfoot behind her. The monster roars.) Oh, fine. What's this one made of? Popsicle sticks and glitter?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh. GAAAAAH! (Bigfoot grabs her and eats her; making the kids run away)

Name: Clyde
Dialog: (Laughs) Looks like we fooled 'em, ma! (Laughs)

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: (Laughs) Did you see the look on their face? (Laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was so cool!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, good one!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you got an inflatable Grandma, too.

Name: Grandma Betty Jo #2
Dialog: Oh, I'm not inflatable. I'm your Grandma's identical twin. I only come out once a year when these two want to prank someone. Well, back to my closet.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: See you next year, Lorraine. (At Candace) Oh, come on. Let's round up those scared kids and have some hot cocoa.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (falls down and lands on the ground) It's not the worst date I've ever had. There was that one that kept stabbing me with a fork. Get this off of-- (sees the Bigfoot dummies and runs for it)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughs) I sure got you guys! You should have seen your faces! Only unsophisticated, immature brains would believe in monsters. (Laughs) Yes, it takes a mature adult, such as myself, to know that there's... no such... thing... as... (Stammering) Bigfoot! (she screams and runs inside; the other kids look but see nothing)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I do not believe her one bit. Too much overacting.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I smell ham.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry. Why are you all covered in lipstick?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One more time!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What are you up to today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're racing our remote-controlled monster trucks. (Remotes clicking)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't see any monster trucks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's 'cause we rigged them to go light-speed. You how those stock motors are. They never give you enough action.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (oblivious) You boys have such active imaginations. You must get it from your father.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Let's see... Green goes to number 5. (Laughs) I'm painting!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Charlene's here. I'm off to my cooking class.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye, Mom. (At Ferb) Final lap, Ferb. (Cars zooming) Aw! Another photo finish. I'm never watching closely enough to see who won.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Despair speaking.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Care to explain why "Despair" isn't picking up her cell phone this morning?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Because of a little thing called PARALLEL PARKING! You see yesterday, Dad was teaching me how to drive...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, Candace. All you have to do is park between this plastic trash can, and that plastic trash can.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I put it in reverse... AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH! (drives back and forth slamming into the two trash cans)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (moving phone back and forth) AAH! AAH! AAH! (Sobbing) Then Dad said my parallel parking needs a little work! It means I'll never get my driver's license! I'm such a loser.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh my gosh, Ferb. I can't believe it! I've never noticed how soft our carpets are. But more importantly, we have to help Candace get her confidence back. Any ideas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is perfect! The Candace Crusher! Nothing says confidence like a monster truck. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hey Agent P. So, get this

Name: Carl
Dialog: And Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I already told you your name's not that cool. Anyway, do your stuff, Agent P, and stop that- DOOF! (Laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Take it all the way back. Keep it moving. Waterfall, the orange cones, parts, left to the garage, bleachers, right, um, Giant Baby Head... any where's good.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Kisses; Horn honking) Oh, hey boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, you might want to wipe the queen off your face.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, oh, yeah, thanks. (Notices the monster truck) CRIKEY! A monster truck!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Isn't it sweet? It's to help to teach Candace how to parallel park and stuff. We figured out if she learned how to drive on of these monsters, she's got the confidence to drive anything.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh yeah, brilliant. But I better check with Mom about this. (At phone) Uh, hello honey, yes, yes, oh gosh, I love you too, darling. Uh, are you aware the boys have a monster truck in the backyard?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honestly, you're as bad as Candace.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, okay. Just checking. (At Phineas and Ferb) It's a go, boys! I'll get your sister!

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: Ahem. Madam Flynn, I have told you a hundred times, (Bashes phone) NO PHONE CALLS IN CLASS! (Phone ringing; Laughs) Hello? (At Linda) It is for you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I think the boys are building a monster truck.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Um, honey, I gotta go. No- B-Big chef. Big meat tenderizer in front of mommy. Bye bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, this seems like a good idea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I gotcha.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what's the point? I'm never gonna be able to parallel park.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, sis. It's just to build your confidence.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, don't forget to buckle up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But we can't drive here. It's just the backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gentlemen, I have a unique investment opportunity for you. I'm sure you're all aware of the popularity of monster trucks, right? But you know, they are not really monsters, just big, stupid trucks! So, I came up with my own line of monster trucks! Behold!

Name: Very evil, don't you think? And there's even one that looks like me! Look, look! (Laughs) We'll corner the markets! And just to be sure, I have created
Dialog: The Monster Truck Away-inator! (Dramatic music) You know, to do away with the competition.

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: But is it safe to use?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sure, let me demonstrate. (Fires laser, shooting at the evil investor) See? It doesn't affect people at all!

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: (Head swelling up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Except maybe a little swelling, but don't worry, it will go down. You know, probably. Now, watch what it does to this miniature monster truck! (Fires laser; Evil Investors talking at once) I don't know where it sends them, maybe another dimension.

Name: Alien
Dialog: (Eats the miniature truck)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Of course, that was just a toy. Let's try it out on a real monster truck. Huh? Which brings me to my next invention. The Monster Truck Locate-Inator! (At Perry) Perry the Platypus? Guess what? That's not a monster truck locate-inator at all! It's a Chinese platypus trap! (Laughs) I got you. Here's the real Locate-inator! Okay, now, where is the nearest monster truck? Yes! Right here in Danville! Okay, everybody, get in me and we'll go.

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: Are you sure you want to bring him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Well, yes, of course. He's my nemesis. I have to show him everything.

Name: News Reporter
Dialog: Good afternoon, Danville! Dink Winkerson here, and this is little Isabella Garcia-Shapiro from Fireside Girl Troop 46231. And she got a little announcement to make.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (inhales, man's voice) WEDNESDAY, WEDNESDAY, WEDNESDAY! GIANT MONSTER TRUCK RALLY RIGHT HERE IN DANVILLE! CANDACE THE CRUSHER TAKES ON ALL COMERS! BE THERE, BE THERE, BE THERE! WE'LL GIVE YOU THE WHOLE SEAT, BUT YOU'LL ONLY NEED THE EDGE! (normal voice, giggles) Thanks, Dink.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Candace. All you have to do is maneuver through this traffic cone course.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. So I put it into drive... AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't think we're gonna get a deposit back on those cones. Okay, Candace. All you have to do on this test is go up this gentle incline.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, you look nervous.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No, of course not. I- I have full confidence in you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, this incline is getting kind of steep!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. It gets steeper!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Next, the break portion of the test.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I can't believe I did it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Breaks handle) Oh, well done!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, left on to Maple Drive, and here we are! Oh, great. There's no parking spot! I should've invented a Parked Car Away-Inator.

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: Oh, ja! That is something that I vould buy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look at him. He's got a big head, suddenly some sort of marketing genius.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, well done, Candace! Let's- (Cars revving)

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: You're Candace the Crusher?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes...?

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: I heard pigs could fly, but now I've seen everything! (Laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That doesn't make any sense.

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: It doesn't have to; I got a monster truck! Woohoo..!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Candace, those dudes need to suck our mud!

Name: Candace/Lawrence
Dialog: AAH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a photo finish! The winner will be decided by our final event

Name: Candace
Dialog: Parallel Parking?

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: Ha ha! You're goin' down, girlie! Check out the finesse! (Backs up car, hits trash can) AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH...!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: See, Candace? Even a trained professional has trouble from time to time. Now, I want you to just relax, and park this car!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Parks car) Yes!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Playing Fanfare)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perfect!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time for some Monster Truck Away-Inating! Okay, steady now... Here we-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? But-but, but how did you get out of the Chinese platypus trap?

Name: Man
Dialog: Ancient Chinese secret. (snip snip)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't remember inviting him. (At Perry) No, wait! Perry the Platypus! No, no! Please! Don't turn the dial to the "Doofenshmirtz mobile and Evil Investors away-inator"! (Perry flips switch) I have to rethink my dials. (Car disappears)

Name: Evil Investors
Dialog: Hey, look guys! My swelling went down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, shut up.

Name: Alien
Dialog: (Eats Doofenshmirtz and evil investors; Burps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Bubble pops) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'm proud of you, darling. You really made them eat mud.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Comes out of monster truck and falls onto mud)

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: Gotta admit it girl. You're good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, aren't you Buck Buckerson? The famous monster truck rally promoter?

Name: Buck Buckerson
Dialog: That's right, and me and my boys are headed to a rally up in Badgertown. Only the track up ain't near as good as this one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can have ours. We're through with it.

Name: Buck Buckerson
Dialog: That's mighty nice of you. Haul her away, boys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks for the ride, Charlene.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Presses button and monster truck turns into car)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, why on earth are you all covered in mud?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Because she's a tire-spinning, gear-grinding, clutch-burning, backfiring, paint-trading, red-lining, overheating, throttle-stomping truck drivin' girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I learned how to parallel park!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (wakes up) Ferb, are you hearing what I'm hearing? Candace singing. Early in the morning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, that's all right. I like that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Gasps) It's Mom's birthday! How can we forget Mom's birthday? Where have all the days gone? (Flashbacks start; Riding a Rollercoaster) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (In search of a mummy) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (Herding cattle) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (Surfing) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (On stage) We can't forget Mom's birthday. (Being chased by a dinosaur; Roaring) Isn't there something I'm supposed to remember? (Flashbacks end) We should do something nice for Mom, what with Dad being out of town on business and all.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Candace, once from the top.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I got an idea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom, let me be the first to say--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: [He and Ferb slam the door open onto their sister] Happy birthday, Mom! We brought you some periodicals - like Mom Daily, Mom Weekly, Mom Bi-weekly, and just the way you like it, a half-caff, double-frapp, mocha choco-latte mezzo-espresso.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, wow. You boys really outdid yourselves.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Au contraire, mon mere. I declare it's our mission to give you the best birthday ever. So relax, enjoy some reading, and no peeking till we come get you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, those boys are too much! Mmm. Oh, I smell eggs and bacon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro! We appreciate you helping us out. Ooh. Another call. (Beep) Talk to me. Buford, my man. Uh, hold on. [To Ferb] Needs roughage. [To Buford] Thanks, Buford. Glad we can count on you. (Candace clears throat) Hey, Candace. Wanna man the omelet station for Mom's birthday?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm doing my own thing. (Phineas and Ferb blinks) Well? Aren't you going to ask me what it is?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. Uh, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's a secret.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. 17 minutes ago, our spy satellites located Doofenshmirtz. He's hiding out in his mountaintop castle laboratory, where he's purchased some suspicious items over the internet, including a giant metal sphere and two animatronic wax robots, you know, like they have at theme parks. Gosh, those things give me the creeps, the way they're all robotic and waxy? (Shudders)

Name: Candace
