Dialog: (in her room, she’s making a crude birthday card) The boys may have won breakfast, but wait'll Mom sees this homemade birthday card. "Love, the child who loves you most, Candace."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Linda is blindfolded.) All right, Mom. Almost there.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, this is so exciting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, you can look.

Name: All
Dialog: Happy birthday!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Gasps) What a beautiful breakfast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Made with love.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And sweat.

Name: Linda
Dialog: And by "sweat", you mean hard work.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, this may not be a fantastic breakfast, but—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Mom's birthday card! (All gasp)

Name: Candace
Dialog: "To Mom"? Heh. It may be big, but bo-ring. (Broadway music as the card opens to be one spectacle)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, boys. I can't believe you two made it yourselves. (Candace's eye twitches twice in disbelief and she eats her birthday card)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, The Unicorn Whisperer, the feel-good movie of the year. And soon it will be gone. (Laughs maniacally; Agent P appears) Oh, no! It's Perry the Platypus! Ha! I fooled you, Perry the Platypus! I'm not really scared! (Laughs) I'm not scared, because I have a new security system. Voila! (door opens to reveal two robots that look like Abraham Lincoln and George Washington) Ha ha! Do you like them, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Wax Robots
Dialog: Get him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got them very cheap from a wax museum that went bankrupt. Ha ha! Ha ha ha! I love it when dreams fail. As you know, I've been trying to take over the Tri-State Area for quite some time now, and I realized this Tri-State area's filled with things I detest, so many things, like— (stops at a blinking traffic arrow) like blinking traffic arrows. Stop blinking at me, telling me where to go. Point. Point. Point. Ooh, I hate you. Let's see—what else? Ear hair. Oh, yes, I've always hated you. Pelicans. Terrible creatures. What—what are you, a bird or a garbage disposal? Ugh, musical instruments that start with the letter "B". You get the idea. It's a long list. I've been working on it for a while. Anyway, I realized I should build something that would make all those awful things disappear. Behold, Perry the Platypus — Shrink-spheria! You like it? I was going to call it a Shrinkinator, but I've done that whole "inator" thing before. It's just been done to death. Bring him over here! I want to show him how it works. I enter the name of something I hate. P-e-l-i-c-a-n. Pelican. And Shrink-spheria homes in on its molecular structure and then turns all the particles into sparticles, thereby shrinking it into a teeny, tiny speck so small I never have to see it again. So good-bye to you, Perry the Platypus. Enjoy your presidential suite! (Laughs maniacally and closes the door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Glad you like the card, Mom.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's a simple postmodern fusion of origami and pop-up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, and just wait till you see your present. Okay. Stay right there.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I hope the boys don't go overboard with my present. All I'd really like is that dress from that cute little sundress shop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean that really cute one with the polka dots? (goes out on her bike) I know what she wants. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Perry the Platypus, say goodbye to blinking detour signs! Forever! (Laughs maniacally; The Shrink sphere blasts and bye bye go the detour sign) Yes! I'm an evil genius! Ha ha ha ha! Now I have to wait 4 minutes for it to recharge, which isn't so bad. I think I'll go with pelicans next. What do you think Perry the Platypus? Pelicans next?

Name: Wax Washington Robot
Dialog: I cannot tell a lie. I'm melting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.  (with the blinging left-sing invisible, the moth van falls into a road hole and the moths fly away and fly around at the dress) Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yoo-hoo, Mr. Pelican, I'm going to shrink you now. Hee hee hee hee. Wh-why is it not working? Something's blocking the-- (sees Parry rattling the antenna) HEY! (he goes to Perry who proceeds to attack him)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, everybody! Look what— You got to be kidding me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our first supermodel sports a chic, stylin', notcouture sundress perfect for our birthday queen to sip iced lattes while enjoying a faboo day in the sun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hum. Well, they have the wrong sundress. It's okay, but it is not as great as this. (sees the moths on the dress) AAAAAH! (runs inside)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Candace? Where'd she go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! (he sees he pressed one of the buttons) Oh, well. Good-bye to musical instruments that start with "B"!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Panting) Wait a minute! I can still give mom the one thing the boys can't! The gift of music! Played on my friend

Name: Timecard
Dialog: (man reads) "Five minutes later..."

Name: Candace
Dialog: (desperate) It's a good thing I play the balalaika! (Balalaika disappears) It's a good thing I play the bagpipe! (Bagpipe disappears, verge of crying I should've manned the omelet station!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (the deafeated Candace goes to the backyard) Candace, honey, come join us. The boys have put together a little video.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Here, you can do the honors.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine, whatever. [starts video]

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On video) Happy birthday, Mom. (Photos are shown of Linda from over the years.) From birth, to young adult, to mid-sized adult, from the 80s to the 90s, Mom enchants everyone she meets. But who is this person we call Mom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uhh... [The two wax robots appear]

Name: Wax Lincoln Robot
Dialog: (Whirring) A house divided cannot stand.

Name: Wax Washington Robot
Dialog: Yeah, what he said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, you melted their wax, but you can never melt what's inside—pure evil! (The two robots leap out, only to fall in the sphere making it explode] Ehh. I should have seen that coming.

Name: Wax Lincoln Robot
Dialog: We can't seem to get a break.

Name: Wax Washington Robot
Dialog: Your breath smells like candles.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isn't this wonderful?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Yeah, really great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On video) But a true testament to what a great Mom you are, is that your daughter would take the time to write this song.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice song, sis. (Ferb gives a thumbs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (goes over to hug Candace) What a beautiful song, honey! I only wish Dad could have heard it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I really wanted you to have a happy bir--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, I almost forgot. We set up a satellite up-link with Dad.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh, a satellite up-link.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (On screen) Hello, love. Happy birthday.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, honey! I miss you. And you're missing the festivities. The boys threw me the greatest party. And Candace wrote me this really amazing song. Can you hear me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (the platypus appears) Oh, hey, Perry. Where have you been? You missed all the fun. (Perry chatters; Fade to black)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What a beautiful summer day. Do you boys have anything exciting planned?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're either gonna make this nuclear-powered submarine or this incredible shrinking ray. But for some reason, Ferb and I can't seem to make up our minds.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I've made up my mind. (hugs them) You two have the most wonderful imaginations.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's real, you know.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What's real, dear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The submarine? The shrinking ray? They're really gonna build that stuff.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walks up) Well, actually we haven't (Candace pushes him away with her spoon) decided yet--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking fast) Anyway, when I try to bust them, everything will just magically disappear. Always happens. you'll see. Well, you won't see. I'll see, trust me.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Oblivious) As usual, the imagination in this room is astounding! (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With the spoon in her mouth) Hello?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (On phone) Hi, Candace. (cut to him) It's Jeremy. I was wondering if you wanted to go for a walk today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I would very much enjoy going for a walk. Wherever shall we go?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: To my uncle's restaurant?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! That sounds do-able! Why not pick me up around noon? Okay! Goodbye. (hangs up, dials) Oh, my gosh! Guess who just called and asked me out on a date!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Who!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On phone) Hold on! Let's conference in Jenny!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay! (dials) Ahh!

Name: Stacy/Jenny
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Stacy/Jenny
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Stacy/Jenny
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Stacy/Jenny
Dialog: (On phone) Ahh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (overlapping) LET'S GO OUTSIDE!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Submarine, shrinking ray. I just can't make up my mind!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) What'cha doooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Walks up walking her dog) Hi, Phineas! You remember Pinky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, yeah! Hi, Pinky!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Showing her Fireside sash) Hey, check out my new sash! It's got all my accomplishment patches sewn onto it. (holds aforesaid sash in front of him) See?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. That looks totally irreplaceable.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Pinky, I need that sash for a Fireside Girls ceremony this afternoon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Isabella, we'll get your sash back.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But how? It's in Pinky's stomach.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm... (realizing) Ferb, you're a genius! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, thanks for coming. It's Dr. Doofenshmirtz. He's been hiding out in the old abandoned vacuum cleaner factory. You know, at building across town with the giant vacuum cleaner on top? Man, I can't believe that place closed. I blame the Internet. (pause) Your mission, Agent P, is to find out what Doofenshmirtz is up to and then stop him.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, how are we gonna retrieve my sash?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here. Ferb made this multimedia presentation. We shrink the sub down with Ferb and me in it and put in Pinky's dog food. After he eats us, the sub extrudes two mechanical arms, which fold up the sash to microscopic size and pull it into the sash storage unit. Finally, we pilot up into the mouth and have Pinky drool us out. Easy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gross, but cool! But Pinky will eat anything but dog food. He likes grilled cheese sandwiches.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a problem. You make the sandwich. We'll make the sub.

Name: Man
Dialog: Okay. A subatomic shrinking module, hydrostatic ballast tank, and a case of AA batteries. Sign here, please.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aren't you wondering if we're a little young to be building a submarine?

Name: Man
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. We get that a lot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: One grilled cheese sandwich, hot off the... Oh, cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. You're just in time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys amaze me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: When we're inside, we'll activate the shrinkage. You take care of the rest.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Check it out, Pinky, your favorite.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It worked! All right, Pinky-Winky, time for some cheesy-weesy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (While running after Pinky) No, Pinky! Chasing the cat is so cliche! You're better than that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after opening the door to the garage) Listen up! Jeremy will be here any second and I wanna tell you... (notices the grilled cheese sandwich) Ooh, grilled cheese, my favorite. Might as well eat now, so I don't look like a pig on my date.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? I... You know, we always do the same thing. I have a scheme, you try to stop me, I trap you, I tell you my scheme, you escape, then we fight, and I'm defeated. Let's mix it up a little. Let me tell you what. I will tell you my scheme first and then I will trap you! What do you say, huh? Yes, this is much better. Okay, so here it is. The Make-Up-Your-Mind-inator! (chuckles) You know, when you're waiting to order a pizza and the person in front of you can't decide on a topping. Ohh, I hate that! I hate it! (mumbles) I will destroy anyone who can't make up their mind!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Echoes) Destroy anyone who can't make up their mind!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I can't seem to make up our minds.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Should I go with Make-Up-Your-Mind-inator? Or is that too-on-the-nose? It's funny. Now I can't make up my mind. Oof! (Perry attacks Doofenshmirtz in a frenzy and cuffs him to a wall) Perry the Platypus! What are... Well, I--I did not see that coming.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Calling headquarters, huh? Hmm. Yes, you—you didn't even give me a chance to trap you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? I was going to put you in that giant snow globe over there. (Camera switches back to him) Now I have to return it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! What's wrong? Oh! You caught Doofenshmirtz, huh? That's weird. Usually he traps you, then you escape and then...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We mixed it up a little!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hang tight, Agent P. Backup is on the way. I mean, it would be, if we had some. Uh, I'm gonna make some calls.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. (chewing noisily) This is good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It worked! Pinky's chewing! Prepare for swallowing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Jeremy's here! (Gulps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Whaah! (Sonar pinging) Wow. Pinky's neck is really long.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Belches) Heh heh. Heh. Excuse me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did it, Ferb! We're inside Pinky. How about a little road trip music?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now to find that sash. Hey, tacos! Ah, tacos. You know who makes the best tacos? Mom. These kind of remind me of the ones we had... for dinner last night. Hey, Pinky didn't have dinner with us. Wait a minute. Candace's favorite cereal?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, where are you? Pinky ran away, and when I came back, the sandwich was gone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, let me call you back. (to Ferb) Yeah, we're inside Candace's stomach.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's creepy on so many levels.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Looking at his watch) This backup of yours is taking forever. (Points to the left while Perry gets up and stretches) I have a travel chess set in my bag over there. (Perry walks in the opposite direction) Do you play chess? (Still pointing to the left) Over there, actually.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha! I tricked you, Perry the Platypus! (Takes a hairpin from his hair then uses it to pick the lock on the handcuff) Do you like my Any-Flat-Surface-Magnet-Belt? It sticks to any flat surface. Hee hee hee hee. Guess what? There's no travel chess set in this bag, either. (gets trapped by the other magnet belt) There was one of these in both bags, so whichever one you chose, you would be stuck. Just like I'm... stuck... right now. What, uh... wh-what time is that backup getting here again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, here we are. Let's tap into Candace's nerve center so we can see what she sees. Ears. Eyes. Look, we're getting an image. She's on her date with Jeremy. That means we're on a date with Jeremy.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Again, creepy on so many levels.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, excuse me. My phone is ringing. Hello?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, I know this sounds weird, but Ferb and I shrunk down in a submarine. We were in that sandwich you ate, and now we're in your stomach.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you wacko? Don't call me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! We can prove it! (to Ferb) How do we prove it? "(Ferb pulles up a feather duster to tickle Candace's insides)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughing) Whoo! Yeah! (Whispering harshly) What is going on?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, monkey bars. Do you still get sick when you hang upside down?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Why?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Candace. We have to help Isabella. So, arms and legs!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh heh. Heh. Never better. Never better! (straining) Phineas, I'm going to... (Gulps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! All right! Yeah! What happened?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you sure you're okay?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Come on, my uncle's restaurant is right over here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Any other ideas? "(Ferb pulls out the feather duster again and tickles the inside of Candace's throat)"

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Coughs, clears throat) I have a tickle in my throat. (Clearing throat)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Stay right here. I'm gonna go get some water.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on the phone) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb built a SHRINKING SUBMARINE!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on the phone) Candace, I'll see it later. Right now, I have to swing by Jeremy's uncle's restaurant and pick up some sandwiches for your father.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perfect!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Farewell, Perry the Platypus!

Dialog: Well, how'd you like to sing for our parents' wedding anniversary?

Dialog: That'd be righteous, dude, but good luck getting the other guys.

Dialog: Who can resist the power of rock-'n'-roll?

Name: Danny
Dialog: Love Händel reunion. Rock on, little dudes.

Name: Customer
Dialog: The spirit of rock'n'roll has called out to me!

Name: Danny
Dialog: I knew it. That'll be $1,800.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, thank goodness you're here.

Dialog: Love On the Run at your service, my friend. So, what did you forget today?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (inhales) Anniversary.

Name: Love On the Run Driver
Dialog: Ooh, the big one.

Dialog: That's your Love-O-Gram. I'll get the rest of your stuff out of the truck.

Dialog: Ooh, that was exhausting. Ah. I have one last surprise for our lovely guest. This will be the grand finale of Vanessa's party - the world's largest firecracker! (camera pans over to the firecracker, which Doofenshmirtz has tied Perry to) And when I say "awkward," I mean for you, not so much for me.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So I wonder what new look Bobbi has envisioned for me this time. You know, he was in my favorite band - Love Händel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Love Händel?

Name: Linda
Dialog: He doesn't like anyone to talk about it, though...

Name: Linda
Dialog: ...so don't bring it up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I gotta take this. (whispers) How's it going?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We got Danny. Now we're gonna convince Bobbi Fabulous. And if we can't, well, Ferb's got a backup plan.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. Bobbi Fabulous is Mom's hairdresser. Where are you right now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Walking in the front door of Bobbi's salon-(realizes) Oh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You doofuses! Mom's gonna see you and wonder what you're up to!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You gotta keep Mom distracted while we talk to Bobbi.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Say, Mom, maybe we should get you ready for Bobbi.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You look like you need some conditioner!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry up, hurry up, hurry up!

Name: Fabiana
Dialog: Do you have an appointment?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, no. We're here to see Bobbi. You know, the bass player from the band Love Händel.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: Fabiana, who are these little people?

Name: Fabiana
Dialog: I don't know, sir.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: You're a mess. And you... Feudal Europe is so last month.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're trying to get Love Händel back together.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: Oh, for heaven's sake, talk to the hand.

Name: Bobbi's Hand
Dialog: Secretly I'm very lonely.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You see, the first time my dad kissed my mom was at a Love Händel concert. And it's their anniversary-

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: B to the O-R-I-N-G.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not yet, Ferb.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: Anyway, you don't need me. I just play bass in the background. Nobody even remembers me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you kidding?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hot towel!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You have to admit, he looks pretty darn good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what is going on?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dry cycle!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: May we take that as a yes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on his phone) Hello? Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. What's up?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guess what band's getting back together.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Love Händel?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, yeah. How'd you know?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It was the lead story on the 5

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Can you help us out?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're already on it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who would have thought that a drummer from a rock-'n'-roll band would end up in a place so quiet? Say, could it be?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Pardon me. Would your name be Swampy, ex-drummer for the band Love Händel?

Name: Sherman
Dialog: That, my friend, was a past life. The name's Sherman. Why you asking?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Because they're reforming for one night only. It's a celebration of our parents' anniversary.

Name: Sherman
Dialog: Well, that sounds charming, boys, but I haven't played drums since the accident. Fell asleep in a metronome factory. When I awoke, I had completely lost my sense of rhythm. I've been hanging out here ever since.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Shh!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ugh! Would you just go join the band?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, that's not it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't know why you're making me do this, Candace. I mean, when do I ever dress this fancy anyways?

Name: Employee
Dialog: So how you ladies doing in here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great, but we need to keep looking.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Employee
Dialog: Well, we certainly have plenty of dresses for you to try on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And we have plenty of time.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (groans) Candace!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: OK, now let's see. "Lead the way for the lovely lady with an elegant wave of your hand. "For you and only you, insert your name here..." Oh, thanks for the light. Hey! No, no, wait! No, no, help me put it out! Do something!

Name: Love On the Run Performer
Dialog: (groans) Well, that hardly ever happens.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, well, so much for that. I guess it's not a total loss. I mean, this is still presentable, right?

Name: Love On the Run Performer
Dialog: Eh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Dad, we're back.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, please, please, stop.

Dialog: Nobody ever lets me finish my number. That's it. Call me when my ride's here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's lasagna in the fridge.

Dialog: Thank you.

Dialog: Oh, boys, it's really hopeless.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fear not, Daddy-O. We got you covered. (at Ferb) Hit it, Ferb.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Love Händel?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Surprise, baby girl! Happy sweet 16th birthday, my little Vanessa!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh! Not again!

Dialog: Well, come on in, come on in. Check the place out. I decorated it all myself. Well, mostly. Wait till you see this. Wait right there.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Please stop.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, without further adieu, the grand finale!

Name: Vaness
Dialog: What, a big firecracker?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no. Perry the Platypus tied to a big firecracker. Together we will launch our nemesis into the sky!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You mean your nemesis!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I took the liberty of going through your address book and inviting all your little friends, including a nice fella named Johnny. He had hearts by his name. I think I know what that means.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You did what? I don't want them to see this! I'm a teenager. This... this is for a little girl. Don't you know me at all?

Name: Danny
Dialog: I have to admit, I never thought I'd wear this stuff again.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: (holding up Sherman's old outfit) Ooh, look.

Name: Sherman
Dialog: Hey sorry, folks. Not gonna happen.

Name: Danny
Dialog: Dude, is that the cake from the trash?

Name: Sherman
Dialog: What? You can't let good cake go to waste.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: Looks like it all went to waste to me.

Name: Sherman
Dialog: Watch it, Mr. Tease and Curl.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: This is exactly the kind of slovenly behavior that ruined Love Händel.

Name: Sherman
Dialog: No, it was infighting due to pressure from a dwindling fan base.

Name: Danny
Dialog: What are you talking about?

Name: Sherman
Dialog: It was in that special.

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: You saw that too? Did I look fat? I thought I looked fat.

Name: Danny
Dialog: That's it. This is ridiculous. I'm out of here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, wait. You can't go. Mom's not back. What about your fans?

Name: Danny
Dialog: Phineas, I admire your optimism, but besides your dad, be honest. What fans?

Name: Danny
Dialog: (crowd cheering) Whoa.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She doesn't like the party. I can't believe I failed again. Well, at least I can watch you explode. Hey, that's not fair! Well, then have a taste of my ray gun, Perry the Platypus! Take that! Name: Danny
Dialog: (crowd cheering) Sorry, Phineas, my friend, but we gotta go on now, or we're gonna have a serious fashion metal riot on our hands.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No, no, you can't start without Linda. Oh, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, it's Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What are all these people doing on our street? Hey! Candace. Honey, what's going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Dad.

Dialog: All right, boys, let's blow the roof off this place.

Dialog: No! It's going to blow the roof off this place!

Name: Danny
Dialog: One, two, three, four!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Linda! Linda, darling.

Dialog: Linda, where are you?

Dialog: Is that Love Händel?!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (gasps) Wow.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, actually, my dad put it together... with some help from Perry the Platypus. (at Perry) Thank you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (crowd cheering) Did you do all this for me?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I had a little help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Candace fist bump) Prepare for live feed to screen, and wipe to source.

Name: Love On the Run Performer
Dialog: ...My heart!

Dialog: That's my mom.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, don't just stand there. Kiss her!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Happy anniversary, darling. (Candace brings Phineas closer to her)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Nah Na Na-Na-Na-Na-Na-Na-Na-Na-Nah

Name: Danny
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Hey, Vanessa, is that your dad up on the rocket?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: He'll be okay. He blows up all the time.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Well, he sure did a cool job with this party.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah. Yeah, I guess he did. Thanks, Dad. You finally got one right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Plat-- Wait, is that Love Händel?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaah! (thud)

Name: Danny
Dialog: Goodnight, Tri-State Area!
(The scene opens up showing a sky view of the backyard).

Name: Game Announcer
Dialog: Get ready! Round 1! Fight!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Laughs) You're mine, meat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? You want a piece of me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh uh, I want the whole thing, baby.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what are you young ladies doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wrestling, Mom. Favorite game.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'll just be running a few errands. First, I'll get the groceries, then to the florist, and then to the car wash.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, whatever. Kinda busy right now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Call if there's any trouble.

Name: Candace
Dialog: With my brothers, might as well call now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. You're right, Ferb. I guess it would make a sound. Say, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are, Agent P. It has come to our attention that all pigeons have left the Downtown area. Of course, on the upside, I haven't washed my car in weeks. (Clears throat) We can, uh, only assume that Dr. Doofenshmirtz is involved. You know your mission.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That about does it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We remodeled our old tree house. What do you think?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh my gosh! Wow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, check it out! This is the main crib.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sweet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's take the tube to the top.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Tube?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. It's the fastest way up.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Are you sure about this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax. We haven't missed yet.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. You're our first passenger.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Screams while zooming through the life ring tube. Finally, she lands at the top) Awesome.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let 'er rip.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ah! (The boys land on Isabella with a thud and everyone laughs about it)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check out the view. Pretty sweet, huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No doubt. What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's just Candace's old tree-house. (Shows old tree-house) She doesn't use it anymore.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's just sad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, what if we gave it a makeover?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure! Something more...well, I don't know...Candace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very effective, don't you think, Perry the Platypus? (Sips drink, then spits it out upon realizing Perry is here) Perry the Platypus?! (at some pigeons) Get him! Stop him! He's headed for that clearly marked exit!

Name: Game Announcer
Dialog: Winner! Winner!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls as she throws her controller down)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Attention, Candace! Come out to the backyard! We have a surprise for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Check out your old tree house. I think you're gonna like it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps; camera shows a newly remodeled tree house) No way! I better call Mom.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, don't be such a fuddy-duddy, Candy. Come on, let's check it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Tire swing lowers) I don't know, Stacy. I think they're up to some-- (tire swing lifts the girls up) Whoa! This is so weird. I can't believe it's my old tree house. Carpets, furniture, entertainment center. I mean, look at all the bells and whistles. (She says as they walk past literal bells and whistles. Ha! Puns!) Maybe my brothers have been replaced by aliens.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, and now they're gonna fatten you up so they can eat ya!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (As they enter the elevator) I can't believe they did this all for me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On speaker) You may begin bouncing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bounce?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Laughs) Come on! Bounce!

Name: Both
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you think of your new tree house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I love it! You thought of everything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It gets better. Try pressing the THF button.

Name: Candace
Dialog: THF? What's that? Some sort of sound system? (Stacy presses a red button, reading "THF". The tree house slowly transforms into a robot) Uh, Phineas? What does THF stand for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tree House Fight!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Laughs) This is so rad!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Oh snap! (Phineas and Ferb's treehouse transforms as well)

Name: Tree house
Dialog: I'm takin' you down!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: AAAAAH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus, you are no match for my pigeons. I have conditioned their tiny, little bird brains to do exactly what I say, by using my brand new very evil invention called

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, hey. How's it goin'?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Observe! With this, I can implant the target image on their tiny, little brains in a flash! (Zaps the machine at the pigeon, making it lose its feathers) It-- It works better from a distance. Anyway, today at Town Hall, they will award the key to the city to My-Goody-Two-Shoes-Brother Roger. Oh, how I loathe him.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I like Uncle Roger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you, Vanessa, but I don't believe I was talking to you. Is your name Perry the Platypus? No, I don't think so.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Sighs) I so should have gone to summer school.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I will not be attending the ceremony, but my pigeons will be there to rain on his parade! (Laughs) You see, Perry the Platypus, my brother Roger is at the top of a very long list of people I despise. (At Vanessa) Vanessa, music please.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, you see how I held that last note, good, huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tree house fight!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Bring it on, maggots!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: (As Isabella holds up a Round 1 sign) Whoo! Awesome! Yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now what?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look! The controls are just like the video game! Let's show 'em our mad skills. Woo-hoo! Let's dance, dweebs! (They wrestle)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, stop leading!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You stop leading. (They pass through an old man's garden; the old man sees them and assumes it was the Super Grow Plant Food) Give him the twister!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Right! (Throws Phineas and Ferb in the air)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Score!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hit the crash button! (Ferb does so, and they get covered in tires and brace themselves for the crash, and they land by one of the downtown buildings)

Name: Candace
Dialog: YES!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Woo! Well done, Candirocks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's nail 'em!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. (Dressed as a pirate) The enemy is upon us! Man the cannons! (Cannon comes out with Ferb wearing a blue hat) FIRE! (Cannon fires)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh. Yow! What now?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Try pulling some levers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yipe! (Pulls a lever causing the pink robot's mouth to open and purple water balloons to fire)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb wearing Army outfits) Incoming! (He and Ferb get hit by the purple water balloons)

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Yeah!  (The yellow robot's mouth opens to reveal water with a lifeboat, an oar and a couple of fish to come out) Ew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (wearing knight's armor) Egad, man! It's an end run around the middle! (Ferb's revealed to be wearing a Scottish outfit) Sound retreat!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (salutes and plays the bagpipes)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. That's funny. I haven't gotten the usual call from Candace. (Get her phone out and calls her)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come and get me! (Sticks its bottom out releasing a horse and runs; Candace's cell phone rings)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (On phone) Candace, honey, I'm at the car-wash, and I'll be heading home very soon. Bye bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no! (Can phone drops down)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb to Robo-Girls; (he and Ferb are wearing chicken costumes) Last one home is a big old purple pickled egg!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Imitates chicken clucking noise)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, the award ceremony. And there's my insipid brother Roger. (the tower viewer goes out) What? Oh, let's see if I've got another coin. Now, what was I saying-- Oh! I despise him so much. You are about to witness a truly petty act of vengeance, Perry the Platypus, brought on by my own mindless jealously. (At Vanessa) Vanessa, fire the harpoon! (Vanessa shoots the harpoon) Perfect. The time has come! Do not fail me, my pigeons! (The pigeons walk out on the rope in a line)

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ladies and Gentlemen, as the most handsome and charming man in all the Tri-State Area, I hereby promise to keep our city clean.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: (Applause and cheering)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pay attention and learn something, Perry the Platypu-- Wait, wait! Where's Perry the Platypus? He's escaping, with the Poop-inator!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Whoa! (They start to roll home with Agent P in tow)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Uh oh. This is not going to end well for me, I'm afraid.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's what you get for using a bunch of stupid pigeons.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait for me! (runs with her) Hold the door, please. (The door closes on him, and when the other door opens, Doofenshmirtz runs inside) Come on, come on, come on, come on! (Too late, as the pigeons assault the screaming Doofenshmirtz as the door closes)

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Woo-hoo!/Way to go!/Yeah!/Awesome! (While that was happening, Linda pulls in the driveway)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) We beat ya. You're both big old purple pickled eggs!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You were out of your tree.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, we were first.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nuh-uh, we were.

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: We were.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Looks like you're having fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Mom, you know what they say. (Candace and Stacy proceed to shoot a water balloon at Phineas)

Dialog: Fun never falls too far from the tree house. (Gets hit by a water balloon as well)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You see, you see how I held that last note, good, huh?

Dialog: (Playing bugle)

Dialog: (Gasping) It sounds like somebody strangling a cat! It must be Grandpa! Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Coughing) I cannot believe we ate the same food.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Burps) Believe it.

Dialog: Grandma, would you show me where the shower is?

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: Shower? Why, sure honey. Would you like a massage and a fruity drink too? How about a manicure and a mud facial while you lay by the pool eating crab cakes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can do without the sarcasm.

Dialog: Chow time's over, campers. Time for our nature walk to Badbeard Lake.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why do they call it Badbeard Lake?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Well, it's a body of fresh water surrounded by land-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, the Badbeard part.

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Oh, right. It was named after Badbeard, the most ruthless freshwater pirate ever to plunder a lakeside community.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: And in the middle of Badbeard Lake lies Spleen Island, where legend has it Badbeard buried his bountiful booty. Heh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Booty?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: You know, treasure.

Name: Kids
Dialog: (Gasps) Treasure?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Aye, mateys- Oh, just a sec. (Marker squeaks) Arrrgh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why are you talking like a pirate, Grandpa?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Arrrgh! I'm trying to tell the story of Badbeard the Pirate. There's a song about it. Say, does anyone have a concertina? Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Me? (Pulls out concertina) Yes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Well, I didn't say it was much of a song. So, meet me at the trail head in 5 minutes.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Aye, aye, Captain Grandpa!

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: That's the spirit!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Stretching out his overalls) Oh, dear. I seem to be missing my underpants.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Boring. I'm calling Stacy.

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Left is right. Right is wrong.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't get any reception up here.

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: So stay clear of the orange moss. The slightest touch, and the orange moss will absorb through the skin, causing wild hallucinations.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Oh no! Was that the right side or the wrong side? No, wait. The left side was the right side. (Gasps) Moss! Orange! (Screams; Runs off)

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Thar she blows mateys. Badbeard Lake.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Ooh!

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: And thar be Spleen Island. The bones of them that hunted the treasure all be lyin' below in Davy Jones's locker.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: Candace? Where's Candace?

Name: Perry
Dialog: (Puts on his fedora, takes out a remote, and presses its button, when it doesnt work presses a few more times.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P, and thank you for your help, Agent E. Sorry to alarm you, Agent P, but we're remodeling our regular base here. Actually, my wife's doing it Mexican-country style. Dialog: Oh, she'd love to! Ha-ha. (at Candace) We need that footage if you wanna bust 'em. (She gives her a cowboy hat with a camera sticking out of it.) We disguised the camera this time. Don't lose it.

Name: All
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Now let's test my Gloominator 3000-inator! A couple of these ought to be enough. Let's see. Whoo-hoo! Look at them go! .... Perfect! Now for the real thing. .... Hmm. Maybe I can squeeze a few more in there. Lemme see. Perry the Platypus? Bobo the rabbit! Do you know that I've been looking for you since the seventh grade? (top hat cocking) Aah!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe you spent our entire life savings on a bunny farm and forgot to buy any bunnies!

Name: Farmer
Dialog: But, dear, I...

Name: Farmer’s Wife
Dialog: I mean, what did ya think - rabbits were just gonna fall outta the sky?

Name: Farmer
Dialog: Looks like somebody owes me an apology.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: Touché.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, Lulu, did we get enough footage?

Name: Lulu
Dialog: Did we ever! (Brief shot of the TV monitors showing the footage.) Now we need you to call your mom for the big confrontation scene, and I'll call the station manager.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Candace. What took you so long?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just get over here as soon as you can. This time, it's gonna be different.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: Sir, you should come over here right away. This will be our best show ever, I guarantee it!

Name: Kid 1
Dialog: Hey, that evil scientist just stole my bike!

Name: Kid 2
Dialog: Hey, that nice duck just gave me 20 bucks for my skateboard.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: Ooh! This is great! I can smell that second season pickup. .... What was that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) My mom is here.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: My station manager is here.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what's going on? Who are these people? Could you please...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, we're gonna be on TV. I can finally prove everything.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: I'm talking about ratings dynamite here, sir. (With her eyes closed) Tell me that's not ratings dynamite!

Name: Station Manager
Dialog: That's not ratings dynamite, that's a suburban backyard.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: (sputtering) But I had no idea... What? I don't understand... What?! Where is everything?!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome to my world.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: Wait a minute, wait a minute! The video tapes! All the proof is still in the van! Come on, gimme a "bust 'em"!

Name: Both
Dialog: (Fist bumping in time) Bust 'em! Bust 'em! Bust 'em!

Name: Station Manager
Dialog: You get that a lot?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Pretty much every day around here.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: It’s in the van, it's in the van, it's in the van, it's in the van!

Name: Station Manager
Dialog: I don't think I can take this everyday.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You get used to it.

Name: Lulu
Dialog: The van... (Reveal the van is gone.) Where is the vaaaaaan?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! So nice of them to leave the keys inside.... That's what you get for being the good guy. You have to stop at all the traffic signals. (laughs) Uh... Oh, no! What.... What is this? Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, kids. Keeping cool today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Hi, Mom."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Oh, there you are, Perry."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And Ferb says...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And that's why I never wear suspenders in public.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Now for some snacks."

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why do you kids come inside for some pie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I'll take some pie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Cuts to Candace and Lulu sitting on the doorstep, holding plates of pie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now you can understand my pain. Want some pie?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm getting dizzy! Oh! Maybe I'm supposed to turn into a skid. Whoa!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe you sold our lucrative bunny farm and bought a van rental place! And you didn't buy a single van! (Hears the van falling over her) Not one word.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: BAM!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And that is why the 18th century sewing thimble was not only a slice of history, but a compelling example of American grit and perseverance. Hmm? Hmm? Hmm? Yes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great, Dad.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, that was wonderf... (She fake snores)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, I'm kidding! Hon, your speech is gonna be a big hit at the antique thimble symposium.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's gonna knock 'em dead.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, which we're gonna be late for if we don't get on the road! Thanks again for looking after the kids today. Candace is skating at the park, all numbers are on the fridge.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Be good for your grandparents, boys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye!

Name: Grandma Betty Jo
Dialog: You wanna go down and embarrass your sister at the park?

Name: Phineas and Clyde
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You got it, Candace! You may be rusty, but you got it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I can't turn around...or stop, but I got it! I wonder if Jeremy's skating here today. Does this helmet make my butt look big?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See? I told you Ferb was a good skater.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Ooh, that's my boy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, isn't that your family?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Yoo-hoo!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Hello!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Jump in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am so not with them! Turn me around, Stacy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Grandma, where did you get the moves?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Well, boys, I was quite the skater in my– (She skates into someone) Oof! Watch where you're--

Name: Woman
Dialog: (Gasps) Betty Jo? Of the Tri-State Bombers?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Hildegard? Of the Saskatoon Slashers?

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: I thought I smelled the last of you back in '57, when I whipped your sorry behind, took the trophy and became the rightful Queen of the Derby!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, Grandma, you were in the rollerskating derby?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Not only was I in it, I was champ! It was years ago.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: (Narrating) The night of the final match between the Bombers and the Slashers. We were on our final lap. What was left of my team used our signature move "The Whip" to send me to the finish line. Hildegard's team had the same idea. The trophy was mine until...

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: You only won because you cheated!

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: "Anything goes", remember?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Well, what do you say we try it again, cheater?

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Anytime, anywhere.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: You skate like a water buffalo!

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: (in background) You couldn't win a race against a one-legged stuffed owl.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: (in background) Take your teeth out or I will do it for you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? Why is my grandma yelling at your grandma?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's your grandmother?

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Come on, Jeremy. You and your little sister are on my team. Suzy!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Yes, Grandma?

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Me, you and Jeremy are a team. Got it?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: So I need two of you kids on my team, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you can have Phineas and Ferb, Grandma. I'm not–

Name: Suzy
Dialog: But it's not fair, Candace. Our team has two girls and one boy, so you need to be on your grandma's team so it's fair. Cause it's not fair if it's two boys and one girl against two girls and one boy, so you have to skate, Candace, or else it won't be fair.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then it's you, Ferb, and Grandma! You'll make a great team!

Name: Candace
Dialog: B-But–

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I guess it's set, then. We gotta do it for our grandmas. Right, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, (She chuckles) right.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Psst. See ya on the track, chump!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, great. Hey, wait! There's nowhere to have a rollerskating derby, remember? The old derby track got torn down and turned into a tattoo parlor!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Leave the rink to us!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hmm. Uh, nice entrance, Agent P. But you do realize there's an elevator over there, right? Okay, just pointing it out. Doofenshmirtz is up to something. I want you to get out there and put a stop to it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't be part of this race. I mean, what if we win? Would Jeremy still like me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All I know for sure is boys hate to be beaten by girls.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: There you are, hon. You know where your dad keeps his glue gun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Glue gun? What are they up to? Later, Stace. I knew it! I just knew you would be up to something by now. Et tu, Grandpa?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: No, I just had one. There's more if you want.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, just wait until Mom hears about this!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Heads up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oof!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Lace 'em up tight, dearie! We've got a score to settle. Win! Win! Win! (She growls)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Ooh, yeah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Will you cool it with the noise, Perry the Platypus? I've got a splitting headache. I was at this evil mixer until late last night, it was crazy. Can you hang out for just one moment? I'm almost there. Hold on. (Doofenshmirtz presses a button, and a cage falls on Perry) Ow! Oh, I've got to get a quieter trap. Now that you're trapped, I will tell you my evil plan. I'm miserable because I can't grow facial hair. It all started when I was about 15. (He begins to flashback, but then stops) Oh, you know, my head hurts too much for a flashback. Anyway, I've tried everything to grow facial hair. It's all so painful. I hate people with beards, et cetera, et cetera. So, who do they erect a statue of right next door? Rutherford B. Hayes, our 19th president! Only the president with the best facial hair of all! Just look at that thing. There's no beard like 19th century beard, Perry the Platypus. Anyway, that horrible statue must be destroyed as it is a constant reminder follicular failure! Oh. Give me just a moment, Perry. This hurts me more that it hurts you. Literally.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: ...And then on the final lap, we'll use The Whip to send the weak skater. (to Candace) No offense, honey, but that's you. Over to the finish line—To victory!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All I know for sure is boys hate to be beaten by girls.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! Have you no mercy?! Come on, Grandma. Let's go home.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: And remember, honey, show 'em no mercy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What am I going to do? I can't beat Jeremy's grandmother. And I can't let my grandmother lose.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On intercom) Skaters to their marks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, great. Maybe I'll get lucky and get hit by a bus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (As an announcer) Hello, everyone, and welcome to today's main event. The "anything goes" grudge race of the century between Grandma Betty Jo and Grandma Hildegard. I'm Phineas Flynn, and I'll be your announcer for today's action, along with our color commentator, Grandpa Clyde!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Yellow, green, blue!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent color, Grandpa.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Glad to oblige.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, let's rock and roll-erskate derby!

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Remember kids, two words...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oof!

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: ...road kill!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Come on, honey! We've got butt to kick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And they're off!

Name: Phineas and Clyde
Dialog: (Smash their guitars) Yeah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we're back! Grandpa?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Orange, purple, chartreuse!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, Perry the Platypus, in order to rid myself of that horrid, bearded statue, I've invented the... (He pushes Perry's cage but soon stops) Ugh. Perry the Platypus, this is so heavy. Can you just step out for a sec? I've invented the Bread-inator! Not only will this machine emit a ray that will turn Mr. President into whole-grain bread, it will also release a flock of hungry magpies that will devour the doughy statue! Beard go bye-bye! (He laughs maniacally) Ow, ow. Aw, my evil head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming to the end of the race. The crowd is going nuts!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Come on, Candace, time for The Whip!

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Okay, one, two, three!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Go catch her, Jeremy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Candace and Jeremy neck and neck as they come down the strait.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I don't think so.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! Candace, you've  got to teach me how to skate like that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait! Candace and Jeremy are back in the race, but they're going the wrong way! (Suzy begins to backpedal to avoid Candace and Jeremy) And now, Suzy is going the wrong way too! At least Ferb's still going the right way! (Ferb gets swept up by the Candace/Jeremy/Suzy rocket train going the other way) Oops, spoke too soon.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: And don't even think about any rough this time, sister, or I'll kick your fat–

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And it's Betty Jo pulling away! It's Grandma Hildegard coming up on the shoulder! (Hildegard lands on Betty Jo's shoulders) And by "shoulder" I mean Betty Jo's shoulders!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Get off of me! I can't see!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Grandma Betty! It's Hildegard! It's Betty! It's Hildegard! It's a tie!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: A tie? Ooh. Betty Jo ain't gonna like that.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Well, at least I won this race.

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: You won? You're crazy! I obviously crossed the finish line first!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Wrong! And, get off, cheater!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Grandma, that was really fun! I thought it'd be lame and I'd hate it, but, I had fun.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: How about you, Hilda? Did you have fun?

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Yeah, I did. Maybe it ain't so important who won but that we had fun with the kids.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Yea, maybe it ain't important. But just for the record, I won.

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: You mean, even though you lost, it's having fun that's important.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Who are you calling an loser, cheater?

Name: Hildegard
Dialog: Who are you calling a cheater, loser?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: That's it! Race ya to the Rutherford B. Hayes statue! Go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He sighs) Perry the Platypus...my head is killing me. This is all a wash anyway. I'll turn on the ray and you'll turn off the ray, thwarting my plan. Let's just get it over with, all right? Ray on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ray off. Good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just going to lie down for a bit. I promise I'll be more evil next time, alright?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, all right, we've had our kicks. But Mom's still gonna flip when she sees this. (A car door shuts) That's her car! You are so busted! (she skates into the house)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming out of the house) Mom, come on, come on! The boys built a giant roller rink in the backyard– uh...giant loaf of bread?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (in the same intonation as "I don't know") Ah 'unno.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (skates back inside) Moooom Mom! The boys built a giant loaf of bread in the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (inside the house) What? I thought you said it was a roller rink.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It was, but now it's a loaf of bread! (skates back out) Come on, come on! See?! (stops to see that the bread is gone)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (comes out with Lawrence) Candace, what are you talking about?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: B-b-b...bread...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (at Phineas and Ferb) Boys, I think she's finally lost it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Dad. How'd your speech go?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I have to say it was "thimbly" wonderful.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, what's this thing do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wha–? (Candace is launched off)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, guys. Candace around?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Good catch, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She giggles) He sure is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Beat you to it again, slow poke. (Laughs) Hey, Ferb. Ready to build the fastest, safest, most on-time backyard railroad ever?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right! You man the boiler, I'll handle the brakes. Perry can be the station's mascot.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. It's really nice out today. It's almost like everything in nature is simultaneously saying

Name: Squirrel
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Bird/Worm
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Spider
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Baby Spiders
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Patient
Dialog: Ahh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb, everyday we do something really big. But you know the one thing we haven't done? Relax. I say we take advantage of this perfect day and have the best do-nothing day ever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Stacy. Yes, yes. I'm ready for Jeremy's band's outdoor concert at the summer festival! Today's gonna be amazing! (Clock ticks) (Sniffs) All right, what gives? It's already 9

Name: Phineas (in Candace's mind)
Dialog: Good thinking, Ferb. We'll put these decoys up so Candace thinks we're doing nothing. Then, when Candace isn't looking, we'll do something! (Wicked laughter)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Not today, they don't!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're doing nothing today.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'm off to the festival to set up my tea cozy stand. Bye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye, Mom! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hey, Agent P. Carl, give me a close up. So, uh, anyway... Stop Doofenshmirtz. (at Carl) Hit it, Carl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not here for "Hi's". Today is a pivotal moment in my life. You see, Jeremy's band is gonna play at the festival. Jeremy's gonna see me in the crowd. Not just because I have front row seats, but because I'm gonna be cheering harder that anyone else. Like this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, Candace. 'Cause today we're doing nothing anyway.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And don't try to give me-- Did you say "Nothing"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nothing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Nothing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nothing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Standing is something.

Name: Phineas/Ferb
Dialog: (Slowly fall on their backs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm. Well, you can't do nothing forever. And when you stop doing nothing, I'll start doing something, and that something will be busting you! (Slams door) Look at them plotting my downfall. (Dials phone)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Phineas and Ferb are doing nothing! Nothing, in a relentless effort to ruin my day!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, why can't you just relax, and let your brothers enjoy their do-nothing day?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Could it really be possible? Could Phineas and Ferb actually be doing nothing? You're right, Mom. I should just try and relax until Stacy picks me up for the concert.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Exactly. Love ya.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, If they really are doing nothing, I guess I've got some time to go about my personal business. Let's see... What do I usually do? I know! I'll call Stacy and tell her how I'm busting Phineas and Ferb for-- Oh yeah, can't do that 'cause they're not doing anything. Wait a minute! I know! I'll put this camera in just the right spot so when Phineas and Ferb are-- Ugh! And then when Phineas and Ferb walk by I'll-- Ugh! Well, if there's one thing I know, I'm gonna look sooo good when I bust them for-- Agh! Face it! You cant do anything unless you're trying to bust them for doing something. And if they're doing nothing, then... (Sobbing) "Who is Candace?"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Is it the perfect day to build one of these or what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Candace, it's like we said; We're pursuing the best do nothing day ever. But if you put it in our inbox, we'll try to build it tomorrow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Crumples blueprint) Ugh! (Rips out another blueprint) Huh, huh? Time traveling submarine? Come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, now you're just taking pages from our project book.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Blushes) How can I inspire them to build something? Argh! (Turns on TV)

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Are you a boy, doing nothing with your stepbrother today? Do you like high adventure?

Name: Boys
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Then we have the product for you! It's the Amazing Man-Eating Dinosaur-Themed Totally Sick Waterslide of Doom! That's right, kids. The Amazing Man-Eating Dinosaur-Themed Totally Sick Waterslide of Doom Can be delivered in just minutes! And it's so easy to assemble, even a 5-year-old can build it!

Name: Boy
Dialog: I did it!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Call now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dials phone)

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: There, that's the last of it. By the way, aren't you a little too old to be building one of these?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, yes. Yes I am. Okay, I'll get this thing started. And then because they're men, they'll want to take over and show me how to do it. Then I'll call Mom and bust them!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus. I'd like to introduce you to something. (He zaps Perry, causing the latter to run in slow motion)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My Slow Motion-inator! This way, you're too slow to foil my evil scheme and I don't have to worry about capturing you. Problem solved. Anyway, let's get down to business. I don't know if you've ever noticed, but I'm not exactly very... Mmm, what do the kids call it these days? Handsome. My doctor says it's genetic, but I don't blame my parents. I blame everyone else in the entire Tri-State Area for being better-looking that me. So, I invented this. My Ugly-Inator! (Frog croaks) It harnesses the horned frog's unpleasant appearance to render it's target ugly! Let me give you a demonstration on handsome movie actor Vance Ward.

Name: Vance
Dialog: Hi, I'm Vance Ward.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If it can turn him ugly, it can turn anything ugly. Are you ready, Vance?

Name: Vance
Dialog: I guess, but I didn't get a script. I mean, what's my motivation in this scene?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Motivation? Oh, I think it will be clear to you in a second. (Shoots Vance with Ugly-Inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Now onto the rest of the Tri-State Area! Oh, and Perry the Platypus, you know what the best part of my plan is? I can do it from the comfort of my own living room! With my favorite flat-screen TV and recliner. (Sits on recliner) Ah...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, boys. I see you're still doing nothing. Oh, don't mind me. I'm just carrying a few construction supplies for a really huge super cool contraption. (Laughs) You know, like the ones you used to build. Well, I figured I'd get in on the fun today. Oh, pardon my reach! Just trying to get into the most convenient position to drive this stake into the ground. Oh yeah! I'm really having fun now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I know what you're gonna say. Of course you can take over the whole operation.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, actually, I was gonna ask if you could keep the noise down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, well, back onto the important things in life, like having fun! (In a cement truck) Remember when you used to have this much fun? (In a crane) All this fun could be yours too. All you have to do is join me! (Building the contraption; jackhammer clinking) Okay, okay, I don't want to brag, but fun loves me more than it loves you right now... (Cell phone rings)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoop! (Laughs maniacally) Yoo hoo, Perry the Platypus, come and get it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I forgot! You're too slow to catch me now! (Laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, duh! Of course! You were going for the Slow Motion-inato--. Wait! Wait, no! Don't touch the reverse switch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs; Zaps Perry with Ugly-inator) (Honk) (Snorts; Laughs) You should see yourself! You're so ugly! (Ugly-inator zaps TV) (Honk; Zaps recliner) (Honk; Lever flips, Anchor goes down)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, where are you? It's time to go! (Gasps) Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who's having fun now?! It's like boredom's a bad rash, and I'm a shot of cortisone!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing? I've been trying to call you all afternoon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What does it look like?! I'm busting my brothers!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But the concert's starting right now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Jeremy! Oh, my gosh! I spent so much time busting my brothers, I forgot about the concert!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what's happening?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It didn't say anything in the instructions about being lifted up in the air!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: (Screaming)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who are these guys?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: They must be the opening act!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Now I'm ugly! Oh. Oh, I get it. Hardy-har-har.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My autographed picture of Vance Ward! Oh, you've perverted my ugly invention with something beautiful!

Name: Vance
Dialog: Thanks, whoever you are. Now, get me out of here!

Dialog: Yoo-hoo! Sir Charles! They can't even hear me up here. (She yells) Yo, Chuck! (Growls) What is going on down there? (She attempts to open the door, but only manages to pull the handle off) Oh, come on! Hey, guys! I am locked in the tower!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the spirit, Candace! You sound like a real damsel in distress!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She growls) I have got to get out of here. (She tries to grab a spear from a knights grip) Let go! Come on, let go! Fine! Have it your way. (She picks up the armor, and smashes through the door. However, soon after the armor becomes undone, and Candace lands in it, making her look like the Black Knight)

Name: Charles
Dialog: Well, then, since you chaps are just about put together, I think it's time I popped next door to fetch my own armor.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's something almost disturbing about this. Hey, look. he's back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grunts)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Charles, we'll help you get on your horse and do a practice run.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Muffled scream)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You didn't think I'd recognize you, did you? But I do! You’re Dr. Lloyd Wexler, my greatest hero in all of evil science. Oh, I can't believe I'm actually talking to you! You know, I wrote my thesis on one of your early ransom notes. Gee, you wouldn't mind if I just hung around with you today, would you?

Name: Perry
Dialog: (He blinks twice)

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: Lords and ladies of the court, I declare that this contest is to begin!

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: Are you boys ready over there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're ready, Grandpa!

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: How about you, Charles?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Muffled screaming)

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: That's the spirit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, our catapult works.

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: Way to hang in there, Charles.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guess we won, Ferb. Yeah!

Name: Charles
Dialog: What ho, chaps. Still up for a bit of a joust?

Name: Stubbings
Dialog: Your lance, sir.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Charles? Then who's that?

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: Perhaps it was the ghost of the Black Knight. But I wonder where his Hounds of Heck are.

Name: Man #2
Dialog: (Upon seeing this) It's the ghost of the Black Knight and his hounds of Heck!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It makes me so happy to be surrounded by so much evil. Oh, look! It's your autobiography. It’s always been a dream of mine to have you read it to me. (He pauses) Oh, wait, wait, wait, wait! (Pulls out a teddy bear) Okay, now I'm ready.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) Come on! Don't be shy. Paragraph 4. "Upon an evil winter's heart." Go ahead.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (reading from the book) "Upon an evil winter's heart, the heavy hand of regret infrequently alights. The malevolent path is one trod without the cumbersome shackles of sentimental introspec... spec... spec... spec... spec... spec... spec..." (He whacks the CD player with the book)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, that's funny. I don't remember you saying "spec" so many times. (Perry rips off his disguise) Dr. Wexler, you're a platypus. (Perry, looking annoyed, puts his fedora on. Doofenshmirtz gasps) Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want to say that I knew it was you all along, but I can't because I didn't. So now, I guess I'm supposed to surrender, which I might do if we weren't standing IN THE MIDDLE OF AN EVIL WEAPONS EXPO! (He runs to the giant robots, and gets in one) Ah-ha! Perry the Platypus, your giant robot dragon is no match for my giant robot... Queen Elizabeth I. Hmmm. W- Would you mind switching robots with me? Would you mind too terribly? Please? (They switch robots) Thanks. Thank you very much. I just prefer this one. Thanks. Now, Perry the Platypus, your silly, girly Queen Elizabeth I robot is no match for my giant, fire-breathing... (Perry's robot shoots a laser blast at Doofenshmirtz) Ow! Ow! Wait! I didn't know she had laser eyes. I want to trade back. (Perry sends a punch at Doofenshmirtz) Oof! Well, yours may have laser eyes, but mine breathes (The dragon robot shoots fire from behind Doof) f- (He screams as the fire rushes past) (The dragon robot stops shooting fire) That was a stupid design.

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: Commence with round Two!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, oh! Ferb, I think we put it on sideways this time.

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: It's a draw!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: This just in

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Reading from a newspaper inside a taxicab driving past the fight)) Good heavens, look at that! They're making a new version of Jane Eyre.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Obviously, your Queen Elizabeth I is no match for my dragon! (The Queen Elizabeth robots breaks the headlock she was in) That Queen Elizabeth is a tough old bird.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Thank you for pressing the self-destruct button.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that's just great!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Thank you for pressing the ejection button. Remember to take a parachute with you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now you tell me!

Name: Charles
Dialog: Look, everyone, it's the ghost of the Black Knight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess he's still in search of the dragon.

Name: Computer
Dialog: To order a parachute, please call our help desk. Self-destruct in 3, 2, 1.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Charles.

Name: Grandpa Fletcher
Dialog: Jolly good, old bean.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah! There you are, Perry.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello. we had the most amazing time. Look! I found this 19th century barometer. Anything interesting happen 'round here?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I hear there's a new version of Jane Eyre in the offing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, it's true. The boys built an elevator to the moon in the backyard today.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Last time I checked, the yard was noticeably moon-elevator free.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's true. We were up there! Ferb did the whole "one giant step" thing. Check out this moon stuff we brought back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh. You boys are so adorable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah! You don't believe it. I'm so over this.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh Candace, revel in your brothers' imagination. Makes life so much more fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Yawns) Pushing the boundaries of time and space sure makes a guy tired.

Name: Linda
Dialog: See? How fun is that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Night, boys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Night, mopey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mimics) "See? How fun is that?" If only they'd believe me...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Look at this. I got a traffic ticket from that camera they installed across the street. Oh, that blasted device picks up everything on the block 24 hours a day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Doesn't it run out of tape?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, no. It's on a compressed CD thingamabob. It can store months of digital video.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Video.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, you know we drive on the right.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes, so you keep telling me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotcha!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Excellent trick, Agent P. Sorry to disturb you at this late hour, but we are about to give you the most important mission of your career. Our computer indicates that a city security camera located near your civilian hideout has recorded your comings and goings as a secret agent. It's crucial to the agency's security that you get those recordings and bring them back to HQ for special disposal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (puts disk in laptop and gasps) There it is! The elevator to the moon, ha! And the time they built the rollercoaster and the beach and the roller rink! Ooooooh! (grabs pillow, laughter is muffled) Can it be? Actual proof? Everything they've done over the summer? (to Perry) Oh, Perry, it's soooooooo beautiful!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you okay? Your muffled emotion woke us up. What'cha watchin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, just a little summer mini-series called... "Evidence"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool, our moon elevator! Mom would love this! I wonder if she's still up, let's show her!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Let's show Mom. (to Perry) Oh, Perry, Perry, Perry. I will remember this night always. Just think

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right Candace, what's going on in there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I finally got the evidence that'll prove that...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh! Not this again! Show me in the morning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How's 7

Name: Linda
Dialog: And you, too! Outta here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna pencil her in for 7

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Make that 9

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is it? Oh-Oh, Perry the Platypus. Uh, hold on one second What? The pressures of an evil life! I need a grind guard. Wait a minute. Why are you here? You're not due to shatter my plans till tomorrow. Oh. Come on in.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hi. I'm Norm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it? You just want to borrow Norm? My giant robot man? Fine. Knock yourself out. I'm going back to bed. Just so you know, he's a little low on oil. Oh, and-and, Perry the Platypus-- I don't want to see one scratch on that machine.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hi. I'm Norm.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Ferb wants to get started on the multimedia presentation for Mom. Can we borrow the CD? (Tries grab the disk but Candace slaps his hand)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way, Phineas. There's no way I'm lettin' this baby out of my sight. This is the single greatest moment in my life, and there is nothing you little creeps can do to take it away from me.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hello, children. I'll take that. My name is Norm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What was...that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know, but it was cool.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Keep it down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So...you guys didn't make that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, but I want one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But that thing ran off with my disk! My evidence!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. We'll help you get it back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys would help me bust you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure, if it'll make ya happy. Plus, battling a giant robot, how cool is that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excellent!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's go kick some robot heinie!

Name: Norm
Dialog: What a lovely evening.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There he is!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Uh-oh. We need to get the lead out. Switching to hyper-transportation mode.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna need a faster bike.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Any word from Agent P?

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So I guess all we can do is wait.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And hope, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And hope.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And also wait.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I already did "wait," Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Did we do "hope"?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ugh. I didn't become a major so I could sweat out a vaudeville routine with an intern.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Of course not, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, does anyone know any good songs? How about you, Agent D?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent C?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, remind me again why all the agents are animals.

Name: Female computerized voice
Dialog: Estimated time to destination, 3.05 minutes.

Name: Norm
Dialog: We'll be there in no time!

Name: Female computerized voice
Dialog: Warning

Name: Norm
Dialog: I could sure use an oily beverage.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Ahem. Sir, we lost Agent T last November.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oooh! Right. (clears throat)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, everyone, one more time with feeling. (Agent C clucks)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good thing we had this extra rocket engine, huh?

Name: Norm
