Dialog: Whoop. Here we go again. Uh-oh. (Oil leaking) Someone forgot to replace the oil cap. (Jet rockets break) I guess I'm walking. (He walks over a draw bridge which lifts up with Norm in the middle of the opening)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Go get him, Ferb!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hey, kids, this is not a gymnasium! (He shakes Ferb off and the draw bridge opens completely. Norm hangs by his legs on both sides of the open drawbridge) Boy, I'm sure in a pickle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoo-hoo!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Perhaps I should've worn cleats.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, help! The oil! I-I'm slipping!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming! Hold on, Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, Candace, the disk. You didn't save it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? And let you fall? You may be a pain, but you are my brother. (She and Phineas hug) Besides, I still have that big rocket for evidence. What happened to the rocket? (Rocket explodes)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Good thing we got off of that, huh?

Name: Candace/Phineas
Dialog: All right, Ferb! You got the disk!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right! (Ferb flies off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb? Ferb, where you going?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: What did I miss?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was almost weirder than the giant robot.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I trusted that your mission was a complete success. Good work! Now, hand it over for the special disposal procedure. Careful, now. Careful.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Got it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, you've saved this organization. If there's anything we can do for you in return, don't hesitate.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I can't believe it! It seems my video traffic ticket's been cleared. I guess there is someone up there looking out for me.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Outstanding, Agent W!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent C, don't do that.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm Norm.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (after a pause) You know, Carl, it's weird that he is not an animal. (Pauses) We should fire him.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm already on it, sir.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On her cell phone, in her room) Oh, my gosh, Stacy! Oh, my gosh! Oh, my gosh! Oh, my gosh! Jeremy asked me if I could meet him at the fair later today next to the Ferris wheel. Oh, no! I almost forgot I'm scared of heights! What am I going to do?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Calling from downstairs) Candace, we're leaving now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I'm having a teenage crisis!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't forget we're going bowling. We need you to keep an eye on the boys.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Preferably two.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bowling? That sounds fun. Hey, Dad, is it alright if we use that old lawn-bowling set?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Sure thing, boys! Knock yourselves out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Toodles!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb, with a few modifications, we could really zip up this old lawn-bowling set.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello, Phineas. What'you doing? Ooh! I just sounded like Isabella.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna build the world's biggest and best bowling-ball game!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Four feet? Ferb, we could beat that record in our sleep.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, get the tools. We've got a record to shatter.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why? Does it bug ya?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, yes, a little.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Then, yeah, it's necessary.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All right. Fair enough. Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Ooh, sorry about that, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. We've tracked Doofenshmirtz to an old abandoned warehouse, and he's made some suspicious purchases, 10,000 packets of powdered hot chocolate, a hotdog vendor's cart, a medium-sized parka, and a pair of red flannel long johns with a flap in the back. Don't ask us how we know. Get out there and kick some Doofen-butt.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow! That is one big bowling ball.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look at that, Ferb! Told you we could do it in our sleep.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what do you think I should wear to the fair tonight? I'm thinking my favorite red blouse with my white skirt and red matching socks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I'm gonna have to call you back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was amazing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, Phineas! Another strike!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That makes four in a row! In your face, Buford!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha ha! Yes! What he said! In da face! (Laughs) Uh-uh, I mean... You will get him next time. Clearly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, did you get that strike?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who's next?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, just what do you think you're doing out here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you're just in time. It's your turn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just wait until Mom hears about... Then again, you guys always seem to make everything disappear before Mom gets home. But if I take the evidence to her at the Bowl-A-Rama, then she'll have to believe me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace, you were right about Phineas and Ferb this whole time. We should've believed you.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And just to express how sorry we are, here's my credit card. You have our permission to ruin us financially.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, that is so cool how you busted your brothers like that! Will you marry me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, you wanna give it a try?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I do, Jeremy, I mean, uh... I'd love to give it a try!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right. I'll show you how it works.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, first of all, the cockpit's on a gyroscope so it stays level. Here's your monitor, and this is the trackball you use to steer. Now, no matter what, never hit the gyro stabilizer lock button! It'll disable the gyroscope, and you'll spin around like a greased pig on roller skates.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, use the trackball. Don't hit the button. I got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right. You seem to know what you're doing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do I ever? This is a piece of cake. Bowl-R-Ama, here I come!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Candace, try to take it slow at first!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs hysterically as she controls the ball)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way to go, Candace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Where's she going? She's freestylin'! We've gotta follow her and see what she does! Let's go, team!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Right on time. It seems like you've got quite a chill there! I want you to meet my latest creation

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's headed for the Bowl-A-Rama!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs hysterically)

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, dear, Candace hasn't called.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, don't worry. I'm sure the kids are having a ball.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh! That's gotta hurt.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So where does this lead?

Name: Construction Worker
Dialog: Huh. Heck if I know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, the map of Danville's underground. (Ferb pulls out aforesaid map) Looks like she's headed downtown.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop, stop, stop, stop, stop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: '(The ball stops on a railroad)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Oh, good, it stopped! (Eyes widen) WAIT... (Notices a train coming via monitor) Go, go, go, go, go!

Name: Barry
Dialog: That's one big bowling ball, Bob.

Name: Bob
Dialog: You betcha, Barry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here she comes!

Name: Buford/Baljeet
Dialog: Go, Candace!

Name: Buford
Dialog: There she goes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, guys! To Seventh Street!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Candace! You can do it! Go, Candace!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Go! Go! Go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet, what's the world record for the largest pinball machine?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am not sure, but I know we can beat it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everybody, split up and let's keep her in play until we get to the fair.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm out of control!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAH! HELP!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way to keep it goin', Ferb.

Name: Man
Dialog: Oop, better luck next time, little man. (to Isabella) Isabella, darlin'!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Set me up, Shady Joe. I'm feelin' lucky.

Name: Shady Joe
Dialog: Oh! That's my girl! You give it your best shot.

Name: Shady Joe
Dialog: Help yourself, anything from the top shelf.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Welcome, Danvillians, to the World's Most Pointless Records Awards! Let's meet some of our record holders. Here we have Cletus with the world's hairiest pig. Next to him is Margaret with the world's stinkiest cheese. And finally, we got little Timmy holding the world's fattest gerbil. Let's have a big round of applause for the most pointless world-record winners!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! We've got two more World's Most Pointless Records for our own!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Well, then, step right up, sonny, and tell everybody what they are.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our first entry is for the world's largest bowling ball, and the other is for the world's largest game of pinball!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Wow! Well, let's see 'em!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Wait for it.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Looks like we have two more World's Most Pointless Records! (Gasps) Wait, two records in one day? That's another world record!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: To the fair, my pets, where the freezing of the Tri-State Area will begin! (Later notices the bowling ball) Wait. Wait, what is that? A giant bowling ball? AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAH! (Eventually lands next to Jeremy on the Ferris wheel)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, Candace, you made it. I was thinking you weren't gonna show. Although, you know, usually we get on at the bottom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Giggles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On microphone) We'd especially like to thank our sister, Candace. We couldn't have done it without you, sis!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, your brothers are all right. Hey, are you okay? (Candace points to the ground) Oh, afraid of heights. Don't worry, I got ya.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about you, Perry? Is there anything you'd like to add?

Name: Shady Joe
Dialog: Step right up, ladies and gentlemen, step right up! It's only a dollar to see the mysterious Penguin-Man. Is he man? Is he penguin? Or perhaps some logic-defying amalgam of man and penguin? A manguin, if you will.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I used to have goals. They were evil goals, but they were goals.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Prepare to feel the wrath of Buford.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Don't bring that smack-talk around here. This is my house!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Technically, this is our garage.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She's on a roll.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No girl has ever beaten Buford. Watch and learn. It takes a highly trained eye and a quick wrist to...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: To score like that, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Recovers from initial shock) Hey! I wasn't ready.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what am I going to do? Jeremy's coming over to take my picture for his photo class.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, what's the...? (notices Candace's hair) Oh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (reveals her hair is messed up) Yeah, you think he'll notice? This is the worst bad hair day ever! I'm officially freaking out! (picks up her cell phone) I'll call and cancel.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No, wait! Just wear a hat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! A hat! ..... How's this?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, your hair looks better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but the strap is cutting off my... (the hat rips off) I'm gonna need something stronger.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright! This is the tie-breaker.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I thought the last two were.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah. It's this one.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Tell you what I'm going to do, Buford. I'm going take this ball and I'm going hit into your goal in one shot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, is that right?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Absolutely, and you want to know the funny part? There's nothing you can do about it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bring it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs) You missed.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait for it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What about this?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ain't that how it works, Buford?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Nice foosing, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are making such a racket that I can't focus. I need time to fix my hair. 'Cause when Jeremy gets here, I don't wanna be wearing this stupid--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello, Jeremy. Ha.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You look sporty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you like it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, that's perfect. (holds up a camera) The sport shoot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, that didn't really count, 'cause it's just a dainty little girls' game.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It could be the biggest game in the world, and girls could still beat boys. (pauses) Biggest game in the world. Did you get that, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we're on it. (at Ferb) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Great. It's boys against girls. And to give ya a fair shot, I'll even take Shrimpy here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am honored.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, who's on your team?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, can you be on the girls' team with me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isabella, I'm a little busy right--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Perfect. Real action shots. Oh, you'll look great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? OK, I'm in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are, Agent P. Sorry about the stairs, our elevator maintenance guy is on a corporate retreat with our slide-waxing guy. Anyway, our intelligence tells us that Doofenshmirtz has been shopping around for a show dog. We need you to infiltrate the pet store and uncover his evil plan. Me, I'm goin' home early. It's taco night. Ha-ha.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So those are the official rules for the F-Games. Any questions?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. Why are they called the F-Games?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, why is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "F" for Ferb.

Name: All
Dialog: (gasp) Ohh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I, too, have a question. If I miss the third shuttlecock with my rubber chicken, does Buford have to jump over the chokecherry bush before or after the girls finish peeling their tangerines?

Name: All but Baljeet
Dialog: After!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aw, man, pay attention. You're embarrassing me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, then let's get out there.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, definitely big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh. Extra points for recycling. The girls' score is now the square root of pi, while the boys still have a crudely drawn picture of a duck. Clearly, it's still anyone's game.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I'm looking for a purebred show dog.

Name: Shop owner
Dialog: Well, we have various award-winning breeds to choose from.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, what about him?

Name: Doofenshimrtz
Dialog: Oh, he's perfect. Oh, yes. Coochie-coochie-coo. You are Doctor D's precious little puppy, aren't you?

Name: Shop owner
Dialog: Sir, I'm not even sure if that's a dog.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't try to wheel and deal with me. I get a big alimony check every month, so money's no object.

Name: Shop owner
Dialog: Oh; well, in that case, he's ten thousand dollars.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, coochie-coochie. You are my little coochie-coochie. You are my ticket into the Danville Dog Show, and together, we will make them pay for all I have suffered.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Back when I was just a little schtumpel, my father came home with a brand-new spitzenhound puppy that he won in a game of Poke the Goozim With a Stick. (Goozim roars) My father said the dog was like the son he never had and named him Only Son. Only Son became an award-winning show dog, bringing my father fame and fortune, while I was forced to be the lawn gnome. Y-You remember that story, right, with my neighbor, Kenny? I don't have to go through - OK.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, to recap, my entire fragile self-esteem is totally dependent on your performance today at the dog show, but, you know, no pressure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And don't worry about your lack of training and experience, because I have an ace in the hole. .... This - the Misbehav-inator. It, uh, well, it does what the name implies. Watch this. (dog yips) Ha-ha-ha. Bad dog! (dog barks) Ah, nothing can stop us now. Hee-hee-hee-hee. (gasps) Aah! Hey, what was all that about?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Uh, ha-ha, now I'm very embarrassed about all that "coochie-coochie-coo" stuff. Wait, wait. Where are you going? Bring back my Misbehav-inator!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now for the tiebreaker event. Giant foosball. Get ready to foos.

Name: Buford
Dialog: This is so my game.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But didn't Isabella beat you at this earlier?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quiet, you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ready, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I feel like a kebab.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I, too, feel a certain element of kebabism.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I said quiet, you. Let's play.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's the first ball.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I feel this may not be the best way to block a shot. Clearly I was - Clearly I was wrong about that. That was most effective. Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace blocks. The ball is up...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ..it's going...it's going... It's going!...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my. Ohh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah! Ohh! Isabella, I have feet too, you know.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry, Candace.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aaaah! Suddenly I am not feeling so fresh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we've reached the all-important fruit level!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The what? (Watermelon destroys her helmet. Buford laughs and ends up with a fruit in his mouth. Ferb continues to shoot fruit everywhere.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It looks like the final ball is drifting lazily into neutral territory. Folks, we may be looking at a draw.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, no, we're not.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, no! That would be cheating.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Heh-heh-heh-heh. Boys rule!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah, my hair! Jeremy's gonna see my hair!

Name: (Isabella spins Candace; ball whistling. Ball ricochets off Candace flying towards Buford) Buford
Dialog: Uh-oh. (Ball hits his stomach, which goes flying and ends up crashing the wall of the territory) WHOOOH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They've done it! The girls have snatched victory from the jaws of defeat!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Candace, your hair looks great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggles) Really?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, Buford, that was a great game. Come on, be a good sport.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Like I said before, losing to a girl doesn't count. (gets zapped by Doofenshmirtz's -inator) What I meant to say was I had a wonderful time. I guess you were right. Girls are just as good as boys. Thanks again. Woo-hoo! The F-Games rock.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That was completely out of character.

Name: Man
Dialog: T minus 3, 2, 1.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks, guys. It was a lot of fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The next F-Games will be even better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but much better is when Mom sees this. Look at that thing. I'd just like to see you try to get rid of that before Mom ---

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, kids! What's new?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing, Mom. Absolutely nothing is new.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Feeling Candace's hair) Well, your hair sure looks new. I like it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks. It took a lot to get it this way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isn't today great? Today is such a great day! Everything is so great!

Name: Linda
Dialog: My, Candace, what's got you in such a good mood?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy asked me to go play croquet with him in the park!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, well, be sure to be home in time for the barbecue. We're gonna be watching Kermillian's Comet fly past the Earth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A comet? Cool!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It only comes around every seventy three and a half years.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We'll be barbecuing steaks for the whole neighborhood! Why don't you bring Jeremy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You had me at "steaks"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why is it called Kermillian's Comet, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Kermillian's Comet was named after an ancient Danville astronomer, Augustus Kermillian, who discovered the comet.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's also been said that if you wish on a comet, your wish will come true.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Come on, Ferb. I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: By the way, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Talking throughout the Flynn-Fletcher's television set) Agent P, (Perry puts on his fedora) Sorry to disturb you, but we have an emergency. We've just been informed that all steaks in the Tri-State area have disappeared. This has Doofenshmirtz written all over it. Go lay your smack-down on him, Agent P. The fate of the world rests entirely in your hands.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Walking into the living room) What, the fate of the world?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, welcome to our telethon. If you're just joining us, your dollars are helping us to find a cure for, um... antidisestablishmentarianism.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Goodness me, that sounds dreadful!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, it is. It, um, makes you look pale and weak, (He shows Carl) like this young lad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh dear, the poor thing. Look at that. Wait a minute. Antidisestablishmentarianism? That's more of an ideological stance than a disease. Isn't it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, well, look at that. (He hides Carl) Seems they just found a cure. Thanks to all the viewers who donated. Bye now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, you ready to go?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yeah, sure. Hey, did you know they've just found a cure for antidisestablishmentarianism?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great. I can finally take off this puce ribbon.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You remember my little sister Suzy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I thought it was just going to be us.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, my folks asked me to keep an eye on Suzy for the afternoon. Who's my favorite girl?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I am, I am! (She giggles) Would you show me how to play croquet?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure thing, kiddo.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is this pie homemade?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, my Mom made it. I'll go get some plates out of the picnic basket.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, tell her that it's just– (Suzy hits a croquet ball into the pie, shoving it in Candace's face)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, what happened?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait here. I'll go get a towel.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: So we meet again, Candace Flynn. There's only room for one girl in Jeremy's life, and that is me. And here he comes now. ... Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Here's the towel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry about the pie, Jeremy. I–I don't know what happened.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, that's okay. You want a soda?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, that'd be great.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Here, take mine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, thank you. That was really– (She opens can and gets sprayed by the soda)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, there's some street performers over there that– I'll go get another towel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These are the blueprints for our giant observatory, Ferb. First thing we need is a lens.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. Hey, Ferb, new hairdo. Check it out.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I are building a giant observatory to watch Kermillian's Comet tonight.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh, that sounds like fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna put on a laser light show and, as a grand finale, we're gonna laser our faces into the comet. That way, when it comes back in seventy-three and a half years, we can all show our grandchildren. Oh, yeah, my parents are cooking steaks for everyone.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You had me at "our grandchildren."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: STEAKS! You– you had me at "steaks."

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, we need to get ten t-bones... No steaks? Oh, dear. Let's try uptown.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, you wanna see those street performers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm gonna go grab some snacks. I'll meet you over there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Come on, Suzy. Let's go... Suzy? Suzy?

Name: Elderly lady
Dialog: (Feeding squirrels) Here you go. There's plenty for everyone. (to Suzy) Well, hello there, little girl.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Hello. Could I have some nuts to feed the squirrels?

Name: Elderly lady
Dialog: I'd love to, but I only have one left.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (yelling) Gimme the nut!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: The lady screams and whimpers as Suzy picks up the nut she dropped in fright)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Suzy? Suzy? Where are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaaah! There are squirrels in my pants!

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: That girl's got some serious squirrels in her pants.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There are squirrels in my pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels! Squirrels!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels in my pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels! Squirrels!

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: Wow, she had actual squirrels in her pants.

Name: Street Performer 2
Dialog: We just got served.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: One moment, please. ... (Doofenshmirtz comes out wearing two steaks as glasses) Perry the Platypus? What are you looking at? ... Oh, these. Yes, these are my latest invention - steak specs. I came up with the idea after your last little visit. (Doofenshmirtz shows Perry his black eye) With these on, you don't have to constantly hold a piece of steak to your black eye. See? See?... I plan on mass-producing these. I'll make millions. Let me show you. (He shows Perry a containment unit for all the steaks) I've stolen all the steaks in the Tri-State Area, and I keep them here in my steak containment unit or SCU (Pronounced skʰʌ), for short, or maybe it should be SCU (Pronounced skʰu). ... I'm a little on the fence about - Wait. What are you doing? (Perry pulls down a she, revealing an -inator) Oh, that? That's just a giant heat ray in case I want to do something evil later.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Why don't you stay here with Suzy, and I'll go buy you some ice cream?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no. You stay here, I'll go buy the ice cream.

Name: Street Performer 2
Dialog: (Watching) Oh, man, we got served again.

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: I'm goin' back to culinary school.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Returning) Here you go. All they had was fudgie bars.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, what happened?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There were so many of 'em. The horror, the horror.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Maybe you should sit down. So what happened again?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Are you okay? I have something that will make you smile. I want you to meet Mr. Chippy. (pulls a squirrel from behind her back)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get that sick creature away from me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, it's okay. It's just a squirrel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's not the one I'm talking about.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What happened to her?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (While petting the squirrel) I don't know, but these violent mood swings are probably a sign of deeper emotional imbalance.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Heh-heh-heh. Bubbles. Hee-hee.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Observa-Ferb-atory. Step this way, please. Single-file line. The laser show will begin momentarily. Please, no flash photography or cell phones. Thank you. (To Ferb) All right, Ferb, that's everyone. Kill the lights. Space - it's really big. It's filled with planets of all shapes and sizes and millions of shiny stars. Space has also got huge comets soaring through it, including one named after the ancient Danville astronomer Kermillian.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Arriving home, and seeing the observatory) What's going on? ... Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, behold - Kermillian's Comet. ... Commence laser-engraving sequence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you guys put your face on a comet? Ooh, I'm telling Mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good idea, Candace. She's gonna love it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. You're not trying to hack into the ray-gun system, are you? Wait, what am I worried about? You'll never guess my super-secret password.

Name: Heat laser
Dialog: "Doofalicious". Access granted.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, that's enough.

Name: Heat laser
Dialog: Overload.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He groans) This should be fun.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Ooh, wow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, take it easy with the lasers. Remember, we still got an 8

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, what's happening? (The observatory explodes) That was so cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (A beam from the heat ray focuses on the Steak Containment Unit) Not the SCU! (Pronounced skʰʌ)  Now that I'm looking at the sign, I think it really does look more like SCU (Pronounced skʰu). ... Not the SCU! Come back here! Perry the Platypus, come back. Ooh, something smells delicious. (The top of Doofenshmirtz's building explodes sending steaks flying) Curse you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Arriving home) I can't believe we drove around the whole city and couldn't find one steak.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, they used a laser to carve their faces in the comet.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Candace, I don't see anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no.You could only see it from their observatory. Come on, come on. See?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I don't see an observatory.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sorry, everyone! We looked all over town, and we couldn't find any steaks.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, man. I even brought my own plate!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: At least we can all enjoy Kermillian's Comet together.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, before it disappears for another seventy three and a half years.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs up to them) Just wait! When I'm eighty-eight, you will be so busted! (runs off)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, you'd be eighty-eight and a half.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Whatever!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: So, honey, make a wish.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I wish we had steaks.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, me too.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be honest. I didn't think that would work.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did not bring a plate. I thought they would be provided.

Name: Street Performer 2
Dialog: Dude, we should getting served.

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: Yeah, I'm gettin' used to it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean you came over to check on me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Of course.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, that's Kermillian's Comet. Did you make a wish?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And did it come true?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It just did.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels in my pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels! Squirrels!

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: (On the closing logos) Wow, she had actual squirrels in her pants.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. When I heard you were sick, I came right over. Today I am your servant.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Gosh. What a good friend. (Coughs)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I brought you a get-well package. Miso soup-- heats itself, don't ask-- Who Wants To Be A Total Idiot 3, and rocky road ice cream! You don't want everything to be good. And you don't have to worry about your brothers - your mom says they're off playing miniature golf. (Scoffs) How lame is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys. What gives?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Little Duffers has closed its doors forever. And I was all set to destroy you on the mini links.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I was gonna bury you on the fairway.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Metaphorically, right?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, yeah, right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But how can they close Little Duffers? I've been coming here since I was little. Littler, anyway. Huh?

Name: Owner
Dialog: (Scottish accent) Sorry, lads, but Little Duffers is officially out of business.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But this is the only miniature golf course in Danville.

Name: Owner
Dialog: Aye. People just don't respect the game anymore. They think it's just golf in miniature. But it's not! It's miniature golf.

Name: All
Dialog: Gosh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a sad thing when a town loses a major sports franchise.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's too bad. This was the perfect day for miniature golf. Hey, everyone, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Linda) Hi, Mom. We'll be out back building a miniature golf course.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's fine, dear. After all, it's only golf in miniature.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) What's that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Your brothers own a giant crane? No way!

Name: Candace
Dialog: They are so bu... bu... bu... (Writes on a notepad then hands it to Stacy)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What's this? Dancing weasels? (Candace rotates the notepad) Oh, "busted." Oh, you want me to bust your brothers. You know, you really gotta work on your penmanship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Find out what they're up to and report back to me.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No problemo. I'll handle it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah-ah... achoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Gasps) Awesome plan. We should be finished before lunch.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Listen up, twerps. Just because Candace is sick doesn't mean you can get away with anything. I am now her eyes, ears and mouth. Basically I'm her whole face.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What a good friend.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, right? She wrote you this message.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm... Weasels. I think she means it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I knew they were weasels! So anyway, what's all this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're only making the greatest miniature golf course in the whole world! Or at least in Danville.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Isn't it kind of big?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you know, it isn't golf in miniature.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's miniature golf! And it's so unbelievably cool! With a windmill and a dinosaur, and – (Candace silences Stacy by covering her mouth with her hand)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) You must not be seduced by the coolness! Focus!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're right. I can do this if I stay focused. Focus, focus, focus! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just looking over your request for vacation time. We're ready to approve it, but there's one small problem. And by "small problem," I mean "big problem." And by "approve it," I mean "deny it." Sorry, Agent P. I know you've been putting in a lot of extra hours, but we've got word that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has bought a new house in the suburbs. Three bedroom, two and a half baths, central air. Nice place. We need you to find out what he's up to. Here's his new address. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay. Focus, focus, focus. You can do this, Stacy. Don't get seduced by the coolness. Wuh-oh. "Elevator to the coolness"? (Steps on to the elevator) This is so cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, you're up.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Hey, Stacy. What do you think of our miniature golf course?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's so... I mean, I've come to deliver a message with an unimpressed demeanor.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. We're on our way to the next hole. Why don't you come along?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, okay, but--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Stacy, what was it you were gonna tell us?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, right, well, Candace is gonna... call...!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What kind of hole is this, anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's the air hockey hole. Check it out.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wicked!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, look at us. We're glidin' on air.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hole in one! I mean, goal! I mean...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah! We all, like, freaked out! Can you believe it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) No, no, I can't. Did you, by any chance, tell them I was going to call mom?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, I was gonna, but the elevator and the slide, and... (Candace slaps her hand over Stacy's mouth)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Hush! Focus! We need evidence! Two words

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, by Mark Twain. Translated into evil. Chapter one. "Tom Sawyer's dislike of Aunt Polly was rivaled only by his hatred of puppies."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Waah! Oof! Perry the Platypus! You scared the dunkelschtup out of me! Don't you know it's rude to bust in on someone's new home unannounced and... (Gasps) A housewarming gift? Oh, how thoughtful! How thoughtful. Thank you. Look, Perry the Platypus, as much as I hate to admit it, I'm not really up to anything terribly nasty today. So, you're welcome to chill out here for the day. It's nice, huh? Huh? What do you think? If you need, I'll even sign something that says I was up to no good.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Are you catching this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Yes! Yes! This time we've got them, but you need get the boys in the picture. (Giggles then Coughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There you are. We've been looking all over for you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You gotta play through.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hold this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Stacy, what are you doing? Focus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice focus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Aahh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like the crowd's going wild.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That is so cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Aah!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Whoo-hoo! Yes, yes, yes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) No, no, no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, here we are. We've reached the final hole. You better put on your dancin' shoes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Poor Stacy. What was I thinking? Okay, Candace. Looks like it's up to you. (She gets off her bed. As she takes tiny steps her slippers squeak)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, this is nice, eh? But, you know, I don't think suburban life is for me. I'm thinking of just adding a breakfast nook and flipping the property. The main problem is my neighbor, Phil. He is truly diabolical. His fruit falls into my yard, his dog poops on my lawn, he leaves his trash cans out too long, and... Oh, I'm at my wit's end! And the worst, the absolute worst, is his leaf blower.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, that's it! Time to end this once and for all! And no one is stopping me!

Name: Behold, Perry the Platypus! The ultimate suburban weapon
Dialog: the Atomic Leaf Blower-inator! This will be the last time his stray leaves blow onto my lawn.

Name: Behold, Perry the Platypus! The ultimate suburban weapon
Dialog: Yah! Aahh! Turn it off! Turn it off!

Name: Behold, Perry the Platypus! The ultimate suburban weapon
Dialog: Good, just like planned. Now, I'll blow every leaf onto his property! Ha-ha-ha-ha--ha-ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) At least the golf course can't vanish if they're still in it. Come on, Mom.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Phil the neighbor!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing out of bed? Wasn't Stacy taking care of you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) She was seduced by the coolness. Follow that miniature golf course!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What does that even mean?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) Look behind you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't see anything.

Name: Farmer's wife
Dialog: You know you should've been setting aside a portion of your profits over the years with the understatement that money would be used to upgrade your vestment. What did you think? A shiny new miniature golf course would just fall out of the sky?

Name: Owner
Dialog: You'd be surprised what falls out of the sky in Danville.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, isn't that great? They remodeled Little Duffers.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I still don't know how we ended up at Little Duffers.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I don't know why we didn't build it here in the first place.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace! Did you hear? I won! I actually won in miniature golf! It just goes to show you that if you focus, you can accomplish anything. (Sneezes)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sorry, I forgot to bust your brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hoarsely) It's okay. I'm sorry I got you sick.

Name: Mad scientist
Dialog: You know what we're going to do today, Talbo? It's time to test...THE TELEPORT! (Flips a switch, causing the teleports to activate. Talbo teleports to the one to the right, only get to singed.) Eureka! Now I can teleport myself anywhere in the world!

Name: Talbo
Dialog: Wouldn't you have to take one of those teleport things there first? Oh, but then you'd already be there. It kinda renders the whole thing redundant, doesn't it?

Name: Mad scientist
Dialog: Do you want me to remove your tongue again, Talbo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! (turns off TV with the remote) I know what we can do today, Ferb. (chuckles while Ferb covers his mouth with his hands) No, not the tongue thing. The teleporter.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (off screen) Hey, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Ferb and I are gonna build a teleport device.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (oblivious) Oh, great. I wish to teleport to where my earrings are. I've lost them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The dangly smoky topaz or the hoops?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hoops.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, she must be wearing the blue dress. We'll keep an eye out for 'em. (at Ferb) Come on, Ferb. We're burnin' daylight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Teleports completed! .... Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sniffs) (record scratch) Ew!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're not supposed to be here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I told Phineas and Ferb to keep you outta my room. (kicks the bedroom door open as she's holding Perry) I'm gonna give them a piece of my mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Do you know where Phineas and Ferb are?

Name: Linda
Dialog: They're in the garage, honey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, by the way, Jeremy's gonna be here soon. Please try not to embarrass me in front of him again.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What do you mean, again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Remember my fifth-grade graduation with the inflatable–

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that's right. My bad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is a glorious day for mankind. Ready with the camera so we can document it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cheese!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How many times have I told you to keep Perry out of my room?! (notices the teleports) What are those?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Teleports. Pretty cool, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so bus – Aah! (trips on a controller, disappears through one teleport, and appears from the other)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. It worked. (suddenly looks concerned) Candace? Are you OK?

Name: {Editor's Note
Dialog: Until Perry and Candace switches back, this transcript refers Perry in Candace's body as Perry/Candace and Candace in Perry's body as Candace/Perry.}

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (pointing at her brothers) Wait a second. How you guys get so big? (gasps) And why is my hand green? (takes a pink mirror from a nearby box) AHHHHHHH!!! I'M AN UGLY, SMELLY PLATYPUS!!! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (talking over) Amazing. You and Perry going through the teleport at the same time must have switched your brains.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Oh, you think? You guys better change me back now or I'll... Wait...JEREMY'S GONNA BE HERE SOON!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a problem, sis. We'll just put you both through the teleporter again. Hey, where's Perry? Uh, I-I mean Candace. I mean Perry in Candace's body.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder where he scampered off to. Any ideas, Ferb?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. We built a teleportation device and accidentally switched Candace and Perry's brains.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? That's so cool!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: You wouldn't think it was so cool if you smelled like this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're looking for Perry so we can switch them back to normal. Wanna help?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You betcha.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (off screen) Carl! How many times have I told you, lift the seat when you're done.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Sorry!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, there you... (Realizes what he saw) Uh-oh. Carl, I think we have a breach of security.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) What do you mean, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There's a teenage girl in here.

Name: Carl
Dialog: A teenage girl?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, brilliant disguise!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Man! I thought it was a real girl. (walks away in disappointment)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Now for your mission. Slushy the Clown statues have disappeared all over the Tri-State area. Without that clown, there's just nothing fun about lunch anymore.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? Hey, Candace! Awesome scooter! Hey, wanna come to Slushy Burger with my mom and me? Was that a yes or a no?

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: I don't know, but I like the hat.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, it's a good look for her.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Come on, guys! Are you almost done? Jeremy's gonna be here soon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb's printing up the last one now. Looks great, Ferb.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (reading from the flyer) "Lost platypus. Looks like a girl"? Why did you use that picture? I don't want anyone to see me like that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the only picture we had. (at Isabella) Good job, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Glad I could help!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Aaaah! Now everyone will see that horrible picture!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OK, Candace, just stay here while we post these around town. We'll find Perry in no time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Ejecting a voice box) Not anymore!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A teenage girl?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the teenage girl?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm going to replace it with my own evil jingle. I just have to finish writing it. I'm having a hard time finding a good rhyme for "evil," though, you know. Believe me, I've tried. Keevil, deevil, feevil, weevil... You know, none of these are words.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: You guys lost a platypus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Officer 3323. Tell Charlie we have a 10-91-P. Yeah, it's a platypus. Looks like a girl. MIA. (at Phineas and Ferb) Don't worry, boys. After a nice lunch at Mr. Slushy Burger, the Tri-State area's finest will be on the job.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By the way, our mom's also missing her earrings.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Which ones? The dangly topaz or the hoops?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The hoops.

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Oh, that's a shame. We'll get right on it.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Mom, you won't believe what Phineas and Ferb did!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What did they do this time?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: All you have to do is look at me!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: If that's Jeremy, tell him... I'm getting ready. I don't want him to see me like this.

Name: Linda
Dialog: OK, Candace, now what's so important? .... Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Flynn. Is Candace here?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, she's still getting ready. You know girls. Have a seat. While you wait, I'll make you a snack.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Perry. Come up here. How's my favorite little platypus today?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Oh hee- hee- hee- hee I mean... (tries to imitate Perry's chatter)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: (reading the billboard) "Lost platypus. Looks like a girl." You know, that's insulting to the platypus. How are we supposed to tell if it's a girl?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why don't you watch some TV while you wait? Oh, hey. I've got some great baby movies of Candace.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ohh! There she is in the bathtub. (bubbles gurgle) Oops! Little bubbles.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (off screen) Mom! Remember what we talked about? My fifth-grade graduation?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Fifth-grade graduation? What is she talking about?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Ugh! (off screen) Just turn off the home movies!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Meevil, steevil, cleavil.... As soon as I get this done, lunchtime will never again be fun. Oh, great! There's a rhyme! There's a rhyme, but sure, everything rhymes with "fun." (Perry/Candace tries to hit him with a tail, and only waves her behind in his face) .... Ha! You don't have a tail anymore. Now you are no match for me! But wait a minute. I-I-I can't hit a girl. Gets hit with Perry/Candace's shoulder bag) Oof! Did you have that purse when you came in? .... Well, I'm out of here. .... (Speeds away, leaving a smoke statue, which dissipates, revealing Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What just happened?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're such a nice boy, Jeremy. I can why Candace built a shrine of you in her room. (laughs) Oopsy! I probably should've not said that. Thanks for feeding Perry while I look for my earrings.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, no problem. .... What's in this platypus food, anyway?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mostly worms and insect larvae. (Candace/Perry starts to barf then Linda puts her outside) Oh, Perry! Now I have to get the carpet cleaned again! Hey, maybe I lost my earrings while folding Candace's laundry. Why don't you help me look while you wait, Jeremy?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Am I sweating milk?! Being a platypus is so gross!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait! I can't-I can't fight when you're dressed as a girl. It's so...como se dice... awkward. .... Look! Shoes on sale! .... Curse you, Perry the teenager!

Name: Male teen
Dialog: Hey! The girl missing her platypus found Slushy the Clown.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: This is horrible! Mom is inside, ruining my love life!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Great. Change me back now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this is how you went through the first time, right? You were holding Perry?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (Holding Perry/Candace) Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes. Hurry! Oh! He's a lot heavier now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if it worked.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted! I'm telling Mom! (she leaves)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You might consider bathing first.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I gotta get out of this! (Hits a button on the panel of a machine, it fires) Gah! Oh, dear. My old Shrinkinator. (sighs) I suppose I should've unplugged it before I turned it into a planter.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (comes into the garage with an evil look on her face) Come on, Mom, hurry up! (at Phineas and Ferb) You're busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) See?! see?! It's right there!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, my goodness!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Did you make these?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh... yeah.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (gasps) These are so much nicer than the ones I lost!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks, boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (jaw drops)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (at Candace, closing her mouth) Close your mouth, honey. You'll catch flies.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Great. Now I have this song stuck in my head.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: And that, ladies and gents, is how I defeated the wild tigers in the Amazon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome story, Grandpa Reg.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I'm sure you'll hear plenty more fantastical stories during Gran and Gramp's visit.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, hon, I was thinking we could all head to the mall.

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: What a splendid idea! I'd love to treat Candace to some new clothes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I'll be in the...car.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Could we just stay home and hear some more of Grandpa's cool stories?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sounds good to me.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wonderful. We'll see you boys later.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: My boy, what's this behind your ear? It's me scrapbook!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How'd you do that?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: It's just a little bit of "How's you're father". I may seem like a barmy ol' git now, but when I wasn't so long in the tooth, I had some grand larks and engaged in a fair amount of derring-do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Translate.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: When he was younger, he did a bunch of stuff.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Here I am as a young lad. I made my livin' work at the family Fish and Chips shop. But I was destined for bigger things. I was known as The Great Flying Fishmonger. Here's my first jump over my dear mum's tea society. Me jumpin' a whale, a ton of crumpets, the Queen Mum. But there was one jump that haunts me to this day; McGregor's Gorge of Doom.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: (Narrating) People turned out by the thousands to witness me in my trusty motor bike, the Holy Mackerel, make our biggest jump yet. The event was so massive, I hired a local band to write me a theme song.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: But it wasn't exactly a toe-tapper. Then all of a sudden, it started to rain. I had to postpone my great feat. The second go at it weeks later had the same result! And yet another attempt; nothing but blasted rain again.

Name: Man
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Yeah. I've got teeth not to brush.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Over the years, my eyesight went, and with the lumbago... (Grunts) ...Sciatica... (Creaking) ...Bursitis and... Wait for it...(Boing!) Trick knee, jumpin' McGregor's Gorge is an intention lost to the past.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Grandpa. So whatever happened to the Holy Mackerel?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: She's right over there. Although I see your mother turned her into a lamp.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Grandma, you're gonna love this mall! I'll show you my favorite store, and there's this little dress that-- (Ding) Hmm... (Dialing) Stacy, I have a strange feeling that ground just broke in my backyard. I need you to get over there and tell me what's going on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Judging from this photo of McGregor's Gorge, we're right on track! Who's the tiger?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. We're helping Grandpa Reg fulfill his crushed dreams.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where's Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's in the garage restoring the mackerel.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool. Well, I brought this cute little toy over for Perry. Where is he?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. I don't know.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, hey, Agent P. Monogram's thrown his back out...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm on the floor, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...so I'll be giving you your assignment, okay? Okay.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Do a closeup.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Huh? Oh, yeah. Huh. (Beep) (Clears throat) Doofenshmirtz has been purchasing some suspicious items

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just hand me my pills, Carl.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: What's all the kerfuffle, lads?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can open your eyes now.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: (puts arms down, monocle falls off) Blimey! It's McGregor's Gorge and the Holy Mackerel! Ferb, you've restored my pride and joy! But, uh, I can't operate a motorbike in my condition. Remember the- (Boing!)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. Ferb's tricked out the whole bike. Lumbar support, padded seating, ergonomic controls, and the best part - Side cars! See, as much as we wanna help you fulfill your dream, we also really want to jump a gorge.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Well, then you'll come with me. The Flyin' Fishmongers shall jump again!

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: Oh, my dear! You look like a queen. Brava!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing British clothes) Uh, can we get out of here, like, now? Before anyone I know happens to see--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? I almost didn't recognize you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! I-- I, uh--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I gotta meet my Mom at the food court, but I'll see ya later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughs nervously) (Phone rings) Hello? Oh, hey, Stacy. (At Linda) Mom! Stacy just told me the boys built a huge gorge in our backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That hat might be a bit too tight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, just come in! Into my trap! Yes! Sticky flypaper, Perry the Platypus! (Laughs) Quick story? Back in Druselstein in the days of my youth, there was a bully named Boris, and he always wore big, black boots. They called him "Big Black Boots Boris". He was always kicking sand in my face. When I was in the sandbox; Sand. My first date; Sand! Balancing my checkbook; Sand! The beach-- Oddly enough nothing. But I couldn't relax, because I kept waiting for it. Now, though, he will be the one doing the waiting. Behold! The Now who'd blinded by sand-inator! Or maybe the Who's crying now-inator or, something like...something with the "Inator" suffix. In any case, it's a giant sand kicking machine! You see, Perry the Platypus, Boris has moved to the Tri-State Area, so now, I am going to cover his entire house in sand! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Come see The Flying Fishmonger jump McGregor's Gorge! Tell your friends!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Do you know how dumb you look?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I thought it would be a good way to get more attention.

Name: Girl (Cindy)
Dialog: I love your outfit. It's so cute.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Gorge!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gorge jump!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fishmongers fly again!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Come see The Flying Fishmonger jump the gorge; Live.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) That's our yard! Mom! Mom! Come here! I need you to see this! (drags Linda to the TV and motions toward it with eyes closed)

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Sponsored by Gorgeous Cream Pore Paste.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, you're pores aren't that big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, what you've all come to see, The Flying Fishmongers!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And here to play the Fishmonger's anthem are Isabella and the Fireside Girls. Hit it!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Well, me boy, looks like I'll never get to fulfill my dream.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys. You can stop playing. Wait a second. Start again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Stop. Start.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grandpa, the song's so dreary, it's causing it to rain. What if we pep it up a bit?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Pep away, me boy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella, crank it up a notch!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okey-Dokey! (At Fireside Girls) Ready, girls?

Name: Newspaper Boy
Dialog: Extra, extra! Fishmonger and kids jump McGregor's Gorge!

Name: Newspaper Boy
Dialog: Extra, extra! Fishmonger and kids plummet to their doom!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Maybe we should have let it rain!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Grandpa! We've got a backup plan! (At Ferb) Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Pulls lever, Plane wings come out)

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Good show!

Name: Newspaper Boy
Dialog: Extra, extr-- Aw, forget it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that can't be good.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Spot of tea?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, all right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, can we speed up this pony ride a little?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Honey, I'll have you ladies home in two shakes of a lamb's tail.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Whoo! That was a close one.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Pulls wing, throws it in water)

Name: Kids
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Good show, me boy! Good show!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) The home of my former nemesis. Time to kick a little sand, eh, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tube socks? What is this, 1974? Well, it's too late now...oh! (Button beeps) What are you doing?

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: Home again, home again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, finally!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Thank you, lads. For helping this old codger fulfill his dream.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs into the backyard) Ha! You guys are sooooo busted! (sees the gorge) Look at this, it's better than I thought! There's no way you're gonna get out of this one! (runs off) Oh, Mom? Mom?!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cut it out, Perry the Platypus! No grabbies! Ha! No stopping it now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Even on my Sand-Kicking machine; Sand!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Must say, love the new anthem.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: But I do miss the old one. Couldn't I hear it one last time?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got it, Grandpa. One last time, girls!

Name: Candace
Dialog: These two have really done it this time, Mom, (with eyes closed) look at what they did to the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow! (gasps, her perspective) You guys made the lawn look great! (At this point, Candace turns around) Oh, it's all weeded and watered. Oh, well done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I...I... (Squeaks) I...

Name: Linda
Dialog: What else did you do today?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Well, these two roister-doisters wheeled out me old iron, built a crackin' match for McGregor's Gorge, and helped this daft ol' git one last knees-up.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I have absolutely no idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello. Is this the Johnson residence? I'd like to speak to Jeremy Johnson. This is Candace Flynn. Why am I calling, you ask? Because I have a question about our algebra assignment. Thank you, I'll hold. Okay, okay, let's see... opening jokes, opening jokes. Hey there, Jeremy! This is Candace Flynn. So what do you get when you cross a yak and a martian?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, could I interrupt for just a sec?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, Jeremy Johnson, did you just call me "Honey"?

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, Candace. I just want to tell you I'm off to my book club. I left the phone number on the fridge in case of emergency. And Candace, honey...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I hope you're not planning on talking to that banana all afternoon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and Platypuses, introducing the latest party craze to sweep the nation

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think the lesson here is never drink so much chocolate milk before planning our day's activity. (At Mariachi band) Bye, guys. Sorry. Good work there, though. There's that smile, Arturo. Gracias.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha do-- (Hiccups)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you okay?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. I just came by to see whatcha do-- (Hiccups) --ing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. That's a bad case of hiccups you got there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I know. They're driving me crazy. (Hiccups)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not to fear, Isabella. Ferb and I will help you cure your hiccups.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Hiccups)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is on the move. We tracked him to these coordinates when we suddenly lost his signal. We have two scenarios to explain his disappearance. First, that magical elves have caused Dr. Doofenshmirtz to vanish to the land of angry corn people. The second, is that he may be on his secret, hideout-shaped island with the initial "D" carved into it that satellites found in the exact, spot, where he... vanished... uh, you know what? Uh, forget the magical elves thing. Way off base with that. Anyway, on your way, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You can call him Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I said you can call him Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Isabella. The best way to cure the hiccups is to scare them away. So what scares you?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmm... (Hiccups) Well, there was this haunted house at the state fair-- (Hiccups) That was pretty scary.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! Ferb and I are gonna make you the scariest haunted house ever! (Organ) Zombies, werewolves, and ghosts, and vampires, and witches!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Clears throat)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! The only way you're building a haunted house in this backyard is over my dead body.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Deep voice) That's the idea. Blah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it, you little psycho! I'm calling Mom! (Door slams; she then opens it) And I am not using the banana this time! (Door slams again)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys heard that, right? It wasn't just me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Build a haunted house, my foot! (Phone dialing) They're so busted. Yes, hello. This is an emergency. I'd like to speak with Linda Flynn. To whom am I presently speaking?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Jeremy, that's whom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: J-J-Jeremy? (Stammers) Jeremy who?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Jeremy Johnson. My Mom's hosting a book club today, who is this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We seem to be breaking up. I-I'm going into a tunnel... Sunspots, I-- ¡No habla español!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? HERE? How could this be? I'm shocked. (walks over to a map of the ocean with his hideout on it) I mean, it would have taken a total evil mastermind to have guessed that you'd track me to this point, find the secret hide-out, glide in under the radar and infiltrate through this access vent, make your way over to this crate, activating my automatic arm and leg restraints. Right here? This is the part where I get all sarcastic and pretend you surprise me. "OH, PERRY THE PLATYPUS?!? HOW? WHAT THE? WHO THE? WHY THE..." Oh! ...Finally ending here, where I finish showing you my brilliant plan. You see Perry the Platypus, this secret hideout doesn't actually belong to me. It belonged to my mentor, Professor Destructicon, Kevin, to his friends. Sadly, he was just captured in the midst of his latest plan to set fire to the sun! Redundant, perhaps. But before they locked him away, Kevin asked a favor of me

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, just breathe and relax. (Sighs) Let's try this again. Hi. Uh, Linda Flynn, please. But if she's too busy, uh, then maybe there's someone else who can deliver her a message. Maybe someone in their teens!

Name: Girl
Dialog: Uh, who is this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is Candace. Candace Flynn. And who is this?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I'm Suzy, Jeremy's little sister.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it is such a pleasure to meet you on the--

Name: Suzy
Dialog: You called for Jeremy, didn't you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Oh, no, no, no, no, no.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: You say you want your Mom, but you really want Jeremy. Isn't that right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's not true.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I'm sorry, (Paper crinkling) We seem to be breaking up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop crinkling paper! I know that trick!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Bye bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait! It's true. I want to speak to Jeremy.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I thought so. (At Jeremy) Jeremy, some girl's on the phone for you! (At Candace via phone) But never, ever forget, I am, and always will be Jeremy's favorite girl. Got it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmm-hmm. Yes.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I got it, my favorite girl. (At Candace via phone) Jeremy here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, yeah, yeah, it's me. (Giggling)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, you know, your mom's over here for the book club.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. Well, I just have this silly question to ask her.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, they're breaking for coffee. (Jazz music) Wanna come over? We can hang out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was great, Ferb. But you should really save those screams for later, when the house is up and running.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I-- I mean, sure.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool. See you in about 20 minutes? (Hangs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Faints)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now I'll just load up a few things that Professor Destructicon let me store here. If there's one thing Kevin understood, it was closet space. Now, I'll just, uh, grab my keys to the escape jet, and, uh... Hmm. I could've sworn I put them in my lab coat. Oh, they're probably over here on the computer console...no. Ah, the kitchen. Hello? Keys? (Laughs) This is a little bit awkward, but have you seen my escape jet keys?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? You have? Well, that's great! Where are they?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You won't tell me? Is this because you don't speak, or are you just being a jerk?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I can't believe it. I'm finally going to Jeremy's house. Okay, now, what would the perfect look be? (Gasps) I know

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, boys! I'm off to the Johnson's book club. Jeremy invited me over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, when you see Mom, could you tell her some snakes got lost in the house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay! You boys have fun. See ya!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, troops. Thanks for coming on such short notice. Buford, I know this is cutting into your canasta game.

Name: Buford
Dialog: This better be good, pointy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, it is. Isabella has been cursed...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...with hiccups!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Worse case I've ever seen. We're building this haunted house to scare the hiccups out of her. To do so, we must dig deep into those terrible places any sane man shoves into the darkest, twisted corners of his mind. Each of you must find out what scares you the most. As you can see, today we're building a haunted house, electronically controlled by this giant organ. Every room is monitored on these screens. And by playing the keys... (Organ plays, Pop) ...I can trigger all sorts of surprises. So with your help, my friends, we can build this house with enough horror to destroy the involuntary contraction of Isabella's diaphragm muscle once and for all! (Applause) Oh, there you are, Ferb. (At Crowd) Okay, people, let's get our scare on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Am I getting warmer? Hmm? (Laughs) The sofa. My keys fell between the cushions, right? Uh, no. Oh, come on! I defeated you fair and square, Perry the Platypus! Why can't you accept your death with dignity and maturity and play "You're getting hot and cold" with me? Fine, be that way. I'll find my keys myself and teach you the meaning of grace under fire.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Disintevaporator beeps) Please! I'll do anything! Oh, for the love of Great Caesar's ghost, what would you have me do?

Name: Dog
Dialog: (Barking; Chomp)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Oh, help! Somebody! Oh, get it off me! These are designer jeans. Wait, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Ah! My hair! Help! No-- (Splat) Huh?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Laughing maniacally)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why are you doing this to me?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Laughing maniacally)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy? What's going on out here? (At Candace) Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, uh, hi, Jeremy.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Upsies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, no! Don't pick her up! She's evil! Evil! Can't you see? She's out to get me! She did this to me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Laughs) What are you talking about? Little Suzy wouldn't hurt a fly.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Giggles) Ba-ba.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! She's trying to get rid of me! Can't you see? I can't take it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! If you can't see it, I should leave while I still have a shred of dignity left.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, come back!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Bye bye.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. Whatcha do... Ph--Phineas? (Hiccups, Bell tolls, Wind blowing, Howling, Bats squeaking, Roaring)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Hiccups) Darn. It didn't work, Phineas. What else you got?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, we've got plenty, if you're up for it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I-- (Hiccups) g-g-guess so.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Boo, boo, I say!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I am not Baljeet. I am the scariest thing known to man, a failed math test.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, right. We're just gonna move on now.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You can run, but it won't be to the college of your choice, I tell you!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello? Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Behold; the face of evil.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, are you supposed to be Jeremy's little sister? You said you were gonna be something scary!

Name: Buford
Dialog: She is scary, man. She gives me the willies.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Little Suzy Johnson gives you the willies?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You don't know, man. You don't know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um...we'll catch up with you later, okay?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wash away the horror. Wash away the horror.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Isabella, did it work?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Hiccups)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I was afraid she would say that. Well, there's one more thing we could try.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Panting) What the-? (Suzy's poodle jumps off her head) What the-?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't believe this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let me get this straight. If I set you free, you'll give me the keys, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, why didn't you say that, like, an hour ago?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look, they were under your cute little platypus foot the whole time. (Laughs) Hurry, open, open, open. Now I grab my stuff. Hurry, hurry, hurry, must hurry. Seat belt, and ignition! (Engine whirring) Whew! That was close! (Laughs) Now, let's just make sure I didn't forget anything in my haste. Let's see, I've got my old basketball, the lamp, the Christmas lights, the umbrella, Perry the Platypus, the Disintivaporator, my golf -- PERRY THE PLATYPUS? (dramatic shock sound plays) THE DISINTIVAPORATOR?! (dramatic shock sound plays again) MY GOLF CLUBS?!? I don't even play golf! Oof! (Punches landing, Screaming, Laughs) How do you like it, huh? Agh! Wait, wait, wait. Hold on. Time, time, time. I got a hair caught in my mouth. Blagh. (Grunting, Laughs, Alarm beeping) Since you saved me the trouble of opening the hatch, let me show you out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those two are in such big trouble!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, raise the antenna. Let's see if we can up the scariness factor. You see, our haunted house is powered by static electricity. Maybe we can get a lightning strike to fire things up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Echoing) Um, hello? Phineas? Ferb? You two are in big trouble? (Door slams, Wind blowing) Okay, you guys, stop fooling around. You guys better come out now. I'm getting really mad. (Skeleton cracking) What was that? (Screaming, Hissing)

Name: Milly/Ginger/Gretchen
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Door
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Stay away from me! (Panting)

Name: Vampire
Dialog: (Transylvanian accent) Good evening. It is evening, isn't it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Too much, Ferb! Too much! Watch out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Baljeet/Buford
Dialog: (Grunts)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (Screams)

Name: Baljeet/Buford
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Baljeet/Buford
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! When Mom sees that you've built a haunted house in the backyard with werewolves and vampires and a Giant Floating Baby Head? What's that even about?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And then there was a giant Jack-in-the-Box with a suit of armor that nearly took my head off, and you--you just drive me crazy! When I tell Mom what you've been doing, you are going down! Down, down, down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isn't there any chance that that cured your hiccups?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Hiccups)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you get out of here?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom's home. Perfect! (runs to her) Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom! Wait till you see what Phineas and Ferb have done!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's happening? Uh, guys? A little hellllllllllllp...!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Falls, screams)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Quick, everyone! Sashes!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now that...was scary. Hey, my hiccups are gone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? Absolute terror! These little creeps destroyed our backyard leaving this ugly mess in its place!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Baljeet. (At Candace) That wasn't very nice, Candace. (walks inside leaving Candace stunned)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here you go, Perry the Platypus. Enjoy your disintevaporation!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deeply) Ee-ee-ee-ee... (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's back! Mom, it's back!

Name: 'Candace
Dialog: It's back! I told you! It's returned.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, excuse me, I forgot my satchel.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walks back inside, flatly) Goodbye, Candace... (Door slams)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Walks up) What's the matter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb are the matter. This day was ruined and I didn't get to hang out with Jeremy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry, but you know, it was the best day for me! Due to my incurable case of hiccups, I spent an entire day showered with undivided attention from Phineas! It was wonderful!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hiccups?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. You ran away so quickly, we didn't get a chance to--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hiccups)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sounds like you got a bad case of the hiccups.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hiccups)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Here, come on. Let's see what we can do about that. I got a glass of water with your name on it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hisses)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (To Buford) What? What did I do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Heh, heh. Um, I- I'll, just uh, go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was a great day, Ferb. What did you think the scariest thing was?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Definitely the Giant Floating Baby Head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, where did that come from?! (Ferb shrugs) Hm.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Hiccups) Darn.
