Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. We thought it only fair that the show you're about to see may disturb you. It may shock you. It may even horrify you!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Spew out a hairball)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You've been warned.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like a real summer storm! (Thunder crashes) Well, our plan to stand alone in a field with a metal rod is out.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: (Reading a newspaper) This weather isn't fit for man nor platypus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Comes out of curtains) Good morning, Agent P. (Puts his arms behind him) The mission you're about to receive may shock you. It may even horrify you! But then again, probably not, I mean, heh. You have been doing this for awhile. Anyway, sorry about the tarp behind me. Storm caused some water damage, and-- (Looks at his watch) Ooh! Cheese and crackers! Late for my cousin's wedding. Gotta go. Doofenshmirtz is up to something, and you know what to do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. I wonder where Perry goes off to.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Lost your platypus, eh? (Camera zooms out) That reminds me of a really great monster story.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tell us, Grandpa!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: It's about Ferb's ancestor. He was his great-great-great-great-great-great-great-great-great-great uncle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: (Turns on a flashlight) It was a long time ago, back in the old country, on a cold moonlit night.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Your great uncle Ferbgor was assisting the famous Dr. Phineastein (In the flashback a platypus walks up) in the macabre task of collecting spare parts from semi-aquatic mammals. (In the flashback the platypus gives Ferbgor a steering wheel and runs off)

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Hey, Ferbgor, the Monster's (Ferbgor walks up) Ball Best Monster Contest. A big prize goes to the best monster! Sweet. I know what we're gonna do today! (Cackles)

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: (Narrating) Back at Castle Phineastein, the boys began building a monster.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Jumps in) Can you at least tell a story in color, Grandpa? (The flashback changes into color. The castle's in different colors, the sky is pink with a rainbow behind the castle)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Jumps in) Perhaps muted color would be better. (The flashback turns into a faded green and muted grey background, with the characters in the flashback now in color)

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: (Jumps in) Who's telling the story anyway? (Grandpa Reg goes off and Candace and Phineas run off-screen. The camera zooms into the castle) Did I mention that the boys had a conniving and disapproving governess named Constance?

Name: Constance
Dialog: (While using a quill) So, anyway, (Clattering) Jeremiah was, like, totally checking me out when-- Will you hold it down? I am trying to use the quill!

Name: Phineastein
Dialog: Isn't it beautiful, Ferbgor? We're on the verge of bringing life to the (Walks to the counter) best monster ever. Okay, let her rip!

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: It's alive! ALIVE!!! (Laughs maniacally and the platypus monster sits up) And it's really big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How big, Grandpa?

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Bigger than a refrigerator but smaller than a really big refrigerator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't close that door! (The door slams. The camera zooms out and he walks on-screen holding a candle) Oh, that's just great! The storms made my security system go all cuckoo, and you just locked us in. (Sighs) Well, you might as well make yourself comfy, 'cause we're stuck in here till the power comes back on. (Thunder crashes as the scene switches to Doofenshmirtz and Perry sitting in chairs) Ooh, quite a storm, huh? Reminds me of a story Papa Doofenshmirtz used to tell me to scare me into wetting the bed. (Laughs) That prankster! (Camera zooms into him) It began a long time ago with my great-great grandfather, Dr. Jekyll Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Jekyll Doofenshmirtz puts the screw on a machine) (Narrating) He was obsessed with being (Jekyll Doofenshmirtz screws the screw into place) the most evil scientist of his time. Back then, to be considered truly evil, you actually had to have an angry mob after you.

Name: Jameson
Dialog: Your 11

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The angry mob?! Ooh, they're early. Show them to the parlor.

Name: Woman
Dialog: (Sips)

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Top of the morning, angry mob.

Name: Man
Dialog: Let's hurry this along, Doctor. We've got a tar-and-feathering at noon.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, of course, of course. This time I know I've created something evil enough to warrant your full attention and anger. The Concoction Brew-Inator! A diabolical machine that produces a potion (Turns the Concoction Brew-Inator on) to turn a normal man, (The Concoction Brew-Inator turns off) like myself, (Grabs the cup) into a horrible monster! (Drinks the potion) Now... tremble before me!

Name: Mob
Dialog: (Laughing)

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Seen as a fairy) What? You're not so much trembling. Wait, wait, wait, wait! Come back! (The mob leaves. The last person in the mob closes the door) So you're not an angry mob right now, but... I bet you're slightly irritated, right? I should get points for that! I should get points for that.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Uh, where was I? Oh, yes! Now, the boys had a real monster on their hands, and they had to get him ready for the big night.

Name: Phineastein
Dialog: Come on! That-a-boy! Check it out, Ferbgor. (Throws a fish in the Platypus monster's mouth) To make sure we win that monster contest, I taught him a few tricks. Watch this. Play dead! (The platypus monster doesn't move) Huh? Huh?

Name: Constance
Dialog: (Still using the quill) So I said, "Oh no, you di-in't!" (Growling) And she said-- What was that? (Opens the door) What's going on down there? (Goes down the stairs) I will go straight to the angry mob and tell on you. (Opens another door) Aha!

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Oh, hi, Constance. (Holds up the Best Monster Contest poster) We're gonna enter the Best Monster Contest.

Name: Constance
Dialog: How are you gonna answer a monster contest? (The platypus monster walks behind Constance) You don't even have a monster!

Name: Platypus monster
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Constance
Dialog: He's right behind me, isn't he?

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Constance
Dialog: (Screams) (Steps back and grabs Dr. Phineastein's shirt) I'm. Telling. Mob. (Runs off, screaming. She comes out of the castle on a bike) Angry mob, come quick! (Stops the bike) Phineastein and Ferbgor have created a giant green monster!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Didn't you tell us last week that they created a 2-headed cow?

Name: Constance
Dialog: We're wasting time! (Bikes off) Now let's hurry before the monster gets away!

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Back to normal) Jameson, I think I found the problem. I had the Brew-Inator set to "Fairy Princess" by mistake. (Turns the dial) You know, in hindsight, I question even including a (Turns on the Concoction Brew-Inator) "Fairy Princess" setting to begin with. (The Concoction Brew-Inator whirs then turns off. He grabs the cup) But, you know, live and learn. Cheers! (Drinks the potion) Hmm... Evil has an interesting flavor. I must tell my friend, Dr.-- (He grunts and screams as he turns into a monster)

Name: Jameson
Dialog: Hmm... It actual worked.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know! I'm just as surprised as you are! Put her there, Jameson! Psych! (Laughs) (Jumps a few times) At last! A whole new world of evil has opened up to me! You know what this calls for, don't you?

Name: Jameson
Dialog: A rampage, sir?

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly! Oh, and clean your uniform. (Laughs) Evil!

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's me!

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, not a plan so much.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While doing rabbit ears on two people having their picture taken) I'm winging it, actually.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's right.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't think that's word.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oops, gotta go. (Chuckles) (Runs to Castle Phineastein) Evil! (Knocks the handle) (Evil laughing) Hyah! Got your nose! (Laughs) I got your... I... I... I really do have his nose. (The platypus monster is seen without his bill) Oops. Heh. Okay, okay. Well, we'll just put this back. (The platypus monster is seen with his bill, but slanted) There you go. Good as new.

Name: Platypus monster
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: EVIL!!!!

Name: Phineastein
Dialog: Oh great! (Puts on his hat and jacket) We really have to stop losing our monsters.

Name: Villager
Dialog: Blimey! Look what's coming!

Name: Villagers
Dialog: (Screaming) Run!

Name: Villager 2
Dialog: (Walks to his balcony, seen wearing only his underwear) I'm finally cured of my irrational fear that a giant platypus will see me in my underpants. (The platypus monster walks by) It's even worse than I imagined!

Name: Isabella lookalike
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Hello? (Bats squeaking) (Camera pans to the inside of the cave, showing three monsters) Are there any monsters in there?

Name: Monster
Dialog: Shh.

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: No, I guess not.

Name: Constance
Dialog: It was right here! You have to believe me! A giant platypus! (Mob grumbling) Wait! Mob, look! (Picks up a poster) The Monster's Ball! (Turns the poster) This is where they must have gone. (They walks out of the castle) Follow me!

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: We're looking for a giant platypus monster. Have you seen one by any chance?

Name: Isabella Lookalike
Dialog: Funny you should ask. We spent the entire afternoon together. We went swimming, had a little lunch. Did you know he eats raw snails? Ew! I stuck to PB and J on whole wheat.

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Where is he now?

Name: Isabella Lookalike
Dialog: He went into town to enter the Best Monster Contest.

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: (Grabs Ferbgor and shakes him) Of course that's where he went! What were we thinking? Come on! (They run off)

Name: Isabella Lookalike
Dialog: Goodbye then! Tell him to save me a dance!

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Thinks for the lift, mister! (He and Ferbgor hop off) Let's go!

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Back to normal) Best monster, indeed. Wait till they get a load of pure evil! (Knocks off the punch bowl, cups and drink dispenser and puts the Concoction Brew-Inator on the table) We'll just adjust the dial, and-- (Turns around and notices the platypus monster. He gasps) Yah!

Name: Contestant
Dialog: Monster fight! (Starts a fight with a contestant dressed like a hippo. Soon everyone else starts fighting)

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While being slammed on the floor) Really, really, I don't have your nose! Wait wait. Time out. Allow me one little drink before we continue. I'm parched, okay?

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Here, boy! (At Ferbgor) I hope he hasn't gotten into any trouble.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Drinks a potion) (Chuckles) Just wait till my potion kicks in, you big, dumb monst-- (Grunts and turns into a fairy) What? But I-- I thought I had it set to-- (Flies to the Concoction Brew-Inator and turns the dial. The platypus monster grabs him and yelps. 2nd Flashback ends)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And, well, I forgot exactly what happens after that. (The lights come back on) Oh, hey, the lights! What do you know? (Gets up and stretches.. Perry also gets up and stretches) Oh, I got no time for my diabolical plan now. I've got the chiropractor at 4

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Oh, there you are, platypus monster. (Camera pans to inside the building) And to think I worried you might get into some mischief.

Name: Host
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, we're ready to announce the winner of the Best Monster Contest.

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Hey, we're just in time.

Name: Constance
Dialog: (Comes out of the building) Mob! It's here! The monster's in here!

Name: Man
Dialog: We're coming! Don't get your knickers in a twist.

Name: Constance
Dialog: (Walks into the building by the Concoction Brew-Inator) They are so busted! (Notices the Concoction Brew-Inator) Oh, refreshments! (Grabs the cup) This monster hunting is thirsty work. (Drinks a potion) That's a peculiar taste.

Name: Jeremiah
Dialog: Hey, Constance.

Name: Constance
Dialog: Oh, Jeremiah!

Name: Jeremiah
Dialog: I can't remember a day when you looked more beautiful. (Constance turns into a monster) Well, now I can.

Name: Host
Dialog: Ladies and Gentlemen, the winner of the Best Monster Contest is... (Camera pans to Constance as a spotlight shines on her) That!

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Way to go, Constance! (Thumbs up) Good show!

Name: Man
Dialog: There it is!

Name: Constance
Dialog: Wait! No, no, no! I'm not the monster! (She screams, throws the flowers, and then runs through the wall. The mob chases after her)

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: Oh well. (Touches the platypus monster's hand) Win some, lose some, boy. (Camera zooms into him) You'll always be the biggest, baddest monster to us.

Name: Isabella Lookalike
Dialog: (Dressed in her contest outfit) I see you found your giant platypus.

Name: Dr. Phineastein
Dialog: That's right. And we'll never lose him again.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: And that is why there are pumpkins.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, Grandpa, you were telling us about a giant platypus monster.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Ooh, that sounds exciting! Tell me about that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But you were-- I mean-- I didn't-- (Sighs) (The lights come back on) I've got nothing. Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Platypus monsters are the only monsters to lay eggs.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Let's continue our tour! Over here, we have the work of the great environmental installation artist Beppo Brown.

Name: Django
Dialog: That's my Dad!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: As Django can tell you, his father Beppo is famous for his monumentalist recreations of everyday objects.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Django, it's so cool that your dad makes such huge things! Look at that giant toothbrush! And that giant dental floss. (Pans down) It's even been used. Whoa! And how about that giant baby?

Name: Django
Dialog: My Dad didn't make that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Django, isn't that your Dad over there?

Name: Django
Dialog: Yeah! I'm gonna go say hi!

Name: Beppo
Dialog: You're taking it too literally. It's the juxtaposition of the doughnuts and the mountains that--

Name: Django
Dialog: Hey, Dad!

Name: Beppo
Dialog: Hi, Django! How are you're friends enjoying the tour?

Name: Django
Dialog: They love it! Wanna hang out with us?

Name: Beppo
Dialog: Uh, sorry, bud. But I gotta answer a few questions for these people and talk to them about my new project, but I promise I'll catch up with you just as soon as I can. Have fun!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Okay, folks. (Camera zooms out) Please take some time to look at Beppo's fabulous exhibit! Oh, and don't miss his newest addition, "Doughnuts Over the Mountain", which can be seen from the viewing platform.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Let's check it out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'd like to see the giant mascara brush again. What do you say, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where's the giant exit sign? (Sighs) I'd rather be at home with Perry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What do you suppose Perry does when we leave him at home?

Name: Man
Dialog: I love you, my darling.

Name: Woman
Dialog: No, I love you more than you love me.

Name: Man
Dialog: I hate you. (Hugs woman)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to bother you on your day off, Agent P.

Name: Woman
Dialog: I love you!

Name: Man
Dialog: I thought you hated me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, you've got to concentrate. It's Doofenshmirtz again. He's expecting a visit from his old, evil science teacher, Dr. Gevaarlijk. You must get over there pronto. Those two together are a bad combination. Don't worry about your stories, we'll tape them for you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Your Dad's exhibit is really amazing! I can see where you get your artistic talent from, Django.

Name: Django
Dialog: Oh, I don't know, Phineas. I made this for my Dad, but it hardly compares to his stuff.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is a great painting! Your Dad would love this.

Name: Django
Dialog: But it's so small, and everything my Dad makes is so big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why don't you just paint something bigger? Look out there, Django. Your father's display just happens to be right next to the Unpainted Desert. And that gives me an idea. (to Ferb) Ferb, we're gonna need some really big art supplies.

Name: Django
Dialog: Hey, we can use my Dad's old exhibit! He called it (Flips a light switch) "Really Big Art Supplies".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Gevaarlijk already? (Opens door) Oh, oh, it's just you, Perry the Platypus. I don't have much time today. You see, my old evil science professor is visiting, and we've always had a rather strained relationship. (Puts down a chair) I think it's best expressed through song. (Presses a button on a remote and the chair traps Perry) Tell me what you think, but no pressure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, now you know my plan. (Footsteps approaching) C-Can you hold on a second? I've got to go settle up with the dancers. (to Dancer) Okay, so you guys are all union, right? (Signs check and rips it out of checkbook) All right, here you go. And... Hey, you know, when I'm done with this thing, maybe you and I could, uh... (Dancer walks out of room) Uh, okay, okay. I'll call you! (At Perry) I think I got a shot there.

Name: Django
Dialog: So this is the famous Unpainted Desert.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not for long!

Name: Django
Dialog: Thanks, guys! I think I can show it to my Dad now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Showing the finished painting) It's not finished until you sign it!

Name: Django
Dialog: You're right! We should all sign it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) My professor is here! (Laughs as he walks to the door) Now, Perry the Platypus, you will tremble before the mighty, (Opens door) Dr. Gevaarlijk!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Hello, Heinz. My, look how big you've gotten. (Walks off) Of course you still have that slouch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Gevaarlijk, so good to see you.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Oh, ja, I've come all the way from Gimmelshtump for chit-chat. So, show me what you're doing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am sure you will be most impressed with my latest evil inventions. (They walk into a room) Here, we have the Deflate-Inator.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Hmm... Did it work?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, well... No, not really, but I-- Here we have the Drill-Inator!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Did anyone get hurt with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmm... No, just-- Just me. (Chuckles) But, uh...

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Did any of these actually work?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, (Laughs) No, not really. But follow me. (They walk to the kitchen) I do something impressive over... There. My brand-new... Blender-Inator! (Opens the lid and puts a Granny Smith apple in the Blender-Inator) Spelling doom for even the toughest of apples! (Turns it on) Bow down to me, Granny Smith!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Ja, I'm sure if I was a pomaceous fruit, I would be trembling. Where is your Phone-Inator? I need to call a Cab-Inator'.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, uh, it's, uh, just, uh... (Dr. Gevaarlijk walks away and he stops her) Wait, wait! Don't go. Let me show you this; my very own nemesis.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Oh Heinz. How can he be your nemesis? (Camera zooms out showing Perry is his normal pet mode) He's doesn't even have a hat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no, I made that mistake a couple times, too, but that's him, I swear!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: In your letters, you said your nemesis was a (Takes out a letter) suave, semi-aquatic personification of unstoppable dynamic fury.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He is! No, you've just got to see him in action. Here. I'll let him go. (Presses a button on a remote and the chair trap releases) Go ahead, (Puts the remote away in his coat) Perry the Platypus. Thwart my plans. Come on. (Crosses his arms) Let me have it! (Pause) Let me have it, big guy!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get thwartin'!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: He's just a platypus. They don't do much, you know?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! Wait, wait, wait, wait! He's just about to do something. Wait for it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. I guess it's just a platypus. I could have sworn that was him.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Heinz, this is just sad.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, one more thing. (Walks her to a different room) This is going to blow your socks off.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know the boys must be around here somewhere. (Notices the viewing platform) Wow, what a view! Well, may as well see what this doughnut nonsense is all about. (Walks to the telescope and looks to it) Wow, it's actually pretty cool! (Moves the telescope to the Unpainted Desert) So this over there must be the Unpainted Des-- (Camera zooms out as Candace notices the painting) Hey, that doesn't look unpainted to me! (Zooms in on the painting autographs) PHINEAS AND FERB?!! (takes the telescope away from her eye and smiles) Oooooooooh....BUSTED!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs off) Mom, Mom, Mom!

Name: Django
Dialog: Dad, Dad, Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doctor, Doctor, Doctor! Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to shout. To honor your visit, I will blow up the moon!

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Blow up the moon? But that would mean--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! No more stupid songs about moons.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: (to the camera) I do despise moon-related songs. (to Doofenshmirtz) Continue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It takes a lot of power, so I can only fire it once, but don't worry. (Leans on his ray) I have it planned down to the last-- (The ray is pushed downward. It fires a laser and it hits a dam. The water starts flowing from the dam) (While looking through binoculars) Oops! (Chuckles) No more songs about dams?

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Oh, but I like a good toe-tapping dam song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you've gotta see this! (Runs off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, at least she's excited about art.

Name: Django
Dialog: Dad, you've gotta see this! (Tries to tug him from the media group)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Take a look at that!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Donuts over the mountain.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, the other thing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I see what you mean, Candace. The natural beauty of the Unpainted Desert is like a work of art!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, there is nothing natural about the-- (Turns her head and notices the painting disappeared) Huh? But...but...but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom! Hey, Dad!

Name: Linda
Dialog: There you boys are!

Name: Django
Dialog: Okay, Dad, this way! It's time for your big sur... prise? (Looks around for the painting and takes out the small picture) But, um....

Name: Beppo
Dialog: Whatcha got there, Django?

Name: Django
Dialog: Well, I made this for you, but (Beppo takes the picture) it's kinda small compared to what you do. It's not real art.

Name: Beppo
Dialog: It's beautiful, son. (Shakes his hair) You're a real artist.

Name: Django
Dialog: Really?

Name: Beppo
Dialog: With your permission, (Holds up the picture) there's a very special place I'd like to put this. Come on, bud.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. There's no higher place of honor than the fridge.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Especially a giant fridge.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Depressed) Oh, Dr. Gevaarlijk, today was supposed to be the day that I impressed you (Walks away) with the enormity of my evil schemes and finally earn your respect.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: Oh Heinz. Evil doesn't always have to be on a big scale. You can spread evil in the little things you do everyday.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Touched) You're right.

Name: Dr. Gevaarlijk
Dialog: (Walks to Doof) But sadly, you can't even do that! You're a total failure! You sicken me, Heinz Doofenshmirtz! (Walks away) Gevaarlijk out! (Slams door)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. That could have gone better. (Perry walks up) Oh, there you are, Perry the Platypus. Oh, you... You saw that, huh? Yes. Of course. (Pause) You think I'm evil, right? (Perry smiles) Thank you, Perry the Platypus. (Camera pans to Perry and him looking at the moon) Thank you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Dad! Whatcha watching?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, it's a favorite kids show from when I was a lad. Oh, they don't make this anymore.

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: No pointing and laughing, kids! Because now it's time for another adventure of Captain Implausible!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: When we last saw our hero, the Earth was being threatened by evil space aliens.

Name: Alien #1
Dialog: Bow-chicka-wow-wow.

Name: Alien #2
Dialog: Chicka-chicka-choo-wop.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Captain Implausible?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: That's right! He possesses virtually every super power there is.

Name: Captain Implausible
Dialog: (Throws rocket at UFO, which blows up)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: (Cheering)

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: Wasn't that great, kids? Ya can't beat Captain Implausible. It's impossible!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Chuckles) That was the best! And I happen to own the single greatest collection of Pinhead Pierre paraphernalia in all the world.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gosh.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yeah. I'm not proud.

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: Time for the question of the day. Thank you, Debbie. And the question of the day is, "If you could have one superpower, what would it be?"

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (pauses video) You see, right there. Modern cartoon shows never ask the really big questions, do they?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! We could have as many superpowers as we want if we were cartoons! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (unpauses video) Oh, well, at least Perry will watch these with me. Won't you, Perry? Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I apologize for using the emergency chute and, uh, for not telling you we had an emergency chute. But there was an emergency. Shoot! (Laughs) Sorry. (Clears throat) What I'm about to say is highly classified, Agent P. The last century, the forces of good and evil have been locked in a desperate race to harness and control the limitless power of dance.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Dance! How was that, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You came in a little late there, Carl. Get back over there. We'll try it again. (Clears throat) Blah, blah, blah, the power of dance.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Dance! Better?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Early. Anyhoo, much to our horror, it appears the side of evil has won. Have you seen the latest issue of Evil Beat! magazine? Dr. Doofenshmirtz has created a ray that causes people to dance uncontrollably. It's up to you to stop him, Agent P. But be careful. It's a known fact that no one - no one - has ever defeated evil while dancing. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. We'll be up and running in no time. (Cow moos) Hey, sis.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold it right there, busters. (Truck beeping) Before I squeal on you rats, and you know I must, will you please tell me what's going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're building an animation studio so we can make our very own cartoon show.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought cartoons were all made by computer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, that's right. This is just for show. This is where the magic happens. It's the PF-5000 Animatron. All you do is tell the machine what you want. I'd like my cartoon character to have the power to be everywhere at once. I'll be called Multi Man! And Ferb would have a utility belt and use lots of crazy gadgets. He'll be called, um, Ferb Guy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I would have super mind control and use telepathy and telekinesis to keep you super-dweebs under control with your lame-o superpowers.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could call you Control Freak. Come on, let's watch. (Music instrumental, whirring) We start with a few crude drawings. (Chickens clucking) We compile those into a storyboard, and it all gets fed into the computer. Then we add a little story and some pithy dialog. (Monkey screeches, Cat meows, Parrot noise) The Executron analyzes it and makes a few notes.

Name: The Executron
Dialog: Does not track. Whose story arc is this anyway? This one is not one of my favorites.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Artbot addresses the notes.

Name: The Artbot
Dialog: (Beeping, Glass smashing) No more notes. No more notes. (Crashes)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Few changes are made, then it goes to timing. (Chanting) The shreds get fed into here, and somehow it all comes together here in the Animatic. Check it out. We're super dudes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are super busted as soon as I tell Mom.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whatcha do-- (Isabella elbows him) Ugh!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come into the Phineas and Ferb Studios, and we'll show you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Isabella, about that "Whatcha doin'?" back there-

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Up, up, up! We'll talk about it later.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Over here is where we add sound effects. Did you know that for years, a balloon was used for the majority of sounds you hear in cartoons? Ferb will demonstrate. Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Ding)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: May we be in the show, too?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Absolutely. A very wise and small-headed man once asked, "If you could have any superpower, what would it be?"

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I would harness the power of rainbows, unicorns and sweetness to defend all that is good and just. I'd become... The Rainbow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that's great. What about you, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's an interesting question you pose, as it reveals not only one's impulses and desires, but one's deepest fears as well. I'll go with Belchman.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, fights crimes with different burps.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. How 'bout you, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Isabella took mine.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. School seems to be very important to you. Books, being responsible and studious, getting good grades...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! That's it! I will become Hanuman Man, a flying blue monkey that can grow as massive as he desires to crush all in his way!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pause) Fun choice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was perfect, guys. Now let's record the voices for the scene where the heroes ask the villain for help.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I –

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace. You're just in time to help us record the voices.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There is no way on Earth I'd ever help you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cut and print. That's why we call her "One-Take Flynn".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs maniacally) Something tells me that you might have seen this month's Evil Beat! magazine, eh? Wait, wait, wait. Look. It's like there's two of me. You see? Hmm? Huh? I suppose you're wondering how I harnessed the power of dance. Well, to be honest, it was not so much on purpose. What happened was my dryer broke, so I was trying to create a ray that would instantly dry my clothes. But instead, well, look.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Still sopping wet, by the way. Turns out anything I hit with the ray starts dancing. For instance, a dryer repairman.

Name: Dryer Repairman
Dialog: Help! I can't stop getting down! Ohh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quiet, you.

Name: Dryer Repairman
Dialog: Ah, sweet, horrible self-expression through movement!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I figured as long as I invented the thing, I might as well use it to whip up a little evil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I set it up right over there next to the– Ow! (Crashes through magazine cover; Ray charges up) Hey, you know, it cost me a lot to have that printed up! Oh! (Laser fires; Bouncy music) To add insult to injury, the platypus is leading.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it's all up to the Animatron 5000 now. (At the kids) Hiya, kids! You can stop laughing and pointing, because now it's time for - (Pants fall) Whoops. (Kids laughing) ...The new adventures of Team Improbable!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Rainbow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hanuman Man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Multi Man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb Guy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Belchman.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Versus the Control Freak!

Name: Control Freak
Dialog: You're going down! Down, down, down!

Name: Control Freak
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, this is just out of control. Hello? Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Voicemail recording) Hi, this is Mom. Leave your psychotic rant about the boys when you hear the beep.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh! Mom, come home quick! There's a giant mob, I'm a super fiend, I'm roasting them with laser vision, and - Hey, what do you mean, "Psychotic rant"?

Name: Pedro
Dialog: Hey, look, everybody, it's the Control Freak.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Has everyone gone crazy?! (to the boys) There you are, you worms!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isn't the show great?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you joking? How could you make me the evil villain? Now everybody hates me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Au contraire, big sister. You're the star of the show.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The crowd loves you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But they're booing and hissing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course they're booing and hissing. You're the villain. Right, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: A hero is a hero, but everybody loves a great villain.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? Well, maybe I should go feel the love. (Puts head out of curtains, Tomatoes splatting) Love feels a lot like tomatoes.

Name: Control Freak
Dialog: Oh, you'll never get away with this! You are SO busted!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs) We made a killing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But we weren't charging admission.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ha-ha. Ha. Well, what are ya gonna do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, everybody, let's take a bow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They like me! They really like me! (Gets hit by a tomato) Feeling the love again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I'm getting pretty good at getting down. What do you think, huh? After all, everyone knows dancing is evil! Perry the Platypus, what are you doing? Stop with the conga line. We're doing the Macarena. Perry the Platypus, where are you going?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't believe it! You defeated evil while dancing! Curse you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Suddenly I feel like dancing. (Stops car)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'm here. Now where's this "giant, animation studio"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It got up, and it danced away.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It...what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It got up, and it, danced away.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) It got up and danced away?

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? It even sounds crazy when you say it. I'll be in my room.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look at this, Norm. My brother Roger has been elected mayor! Look at him. He's honest and reputable and, ugh, law-abiding! Oh! There isn't room for both of us in the Tri-State Area! Hmm. Norm, I know what we're going to do today.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha eatin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fruity Rainbow Flakes. You want some?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no, thanks. I already had breakfast. (Picks up the cereal box) You know, I've never really seen one of these in real life.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You haven't?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No, but I'd sure like to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom. What's with the satellite dish?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's a protective collar. The vet says that Perry needs to wear it for the rest of the day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I still don't know how he scratched himself up so much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I think it's cool.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's a bold fashion statement, all right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Speaking of bold fashion statements, have you seen Candace today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Mom!!!!!!?~

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is a total disaster!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What? What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The dry cleaner switched my clothes with some Goth chick! I look like a total freak! Like I'm all outsider-y.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder what happened to Candace's clothes.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Is on her cell phone wearing Candace's clothes) I can't believe it, Lacie. I look like a walking candy cane. I mean, how many evil scientists' daughters do you know who-- (She bears drilling from outside.) Hold on, Lacie. I can't hear myself gripe.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Chuckling/humming)

Name: Norm
Dialog: What'cha doooin'?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "What'cha doin'?" What does it look like to you? I'm building an evil empire. My very own Fortress of Eviltude.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Aren't you a little old to be building a fort?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, I'm not. Shut up.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I told you a hundred times, I –

Name: Norm
Dialog: Don't forget, Friday is cake day.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I have to call you back. (Closes cell phone) What on Earth is going on here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Vanessa! Well, you're looking... uh... Oh, no matter. Where we are going, you can dress up like a clown every day if you want.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wh-What do you mean, "Where we're going"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We're moving... to a golden country on the sea, a country created by the greatest mastermind of our time, me. Assisted by Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm drilling.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I bring to you... Doofania! Where there will be no brothers trying to make me look bad. No. I will be the ruler of my very own evil empire!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You're building your own evil land?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes, an evil country.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And you made a plush model?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yeah. You know, I, uh... I had a lot of... felt.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You do know what this means.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That we'll finally have that special daddy-daughter bond you've always craved?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No. It means I am finally gonna have proof. Ha! You are busted.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm gonna tell Mom.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Great. Tell her what?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (On her cell phone) Mom, Mom, you've got to come quick. There's proof that Dad is evil.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (At the spa getting a massage) Vanessa, honey, I'm having my me-eeee day, remember?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, but –

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Look, hon, why don't you give your old dad a break? Just try to make the best of it, and I'll pick you up later. (Ring) Oh! Time for my seaweed mud wrap. Gotta go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is everything all set, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Ding)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great. Now we-- Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P? Hello, Agent P? Agent P? (At Carl) Carl, he does know this is scheduled for this morning, doesn't he?

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's on his calendar, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I mean, we sent the e-mail, right?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think so. Let me check.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Singsong) Mommy-mi-moe-moo. Blah-blah-blah-blah-blah. Me-ma-moe-moo-my-pa. (Clears throat) Ma-moe-mee-ma-moo.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. What'cha doooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you know how you said you'd never seen a rainbow in real life?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, actually, I –

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold! (Beep) The Rainbow-Inator!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's nice, Phineas, but I--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Made with real crystals and super-charged with Fruity Rainbow Flakes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You don't understand, I--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Soon there will be a giant rainbow that will sprawl across the entire Tri-State area! (pause) Or at least that's the plan anyway.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, could you hold the door for me? I have to return this novelty lawn mower your father got.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Frustrated groan) I just don't want anyone to see me in these clothes.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You think you feel ridiculous? I'm carrying a jackalope into a lawnmower store.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom. I'll wait for you in the car.

Name: Mindy
Dialog: Candace! When did you go Goth?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? I didn't!

Name: Mindy
Dialog: And... send. (beep) Wow, 50 replies already.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (On cell phone) Candace, I heard you're Goth now. Why didn't you tell me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Norm, I've got to give it to you. Under my genius supervision, you turned out extremely adequate work.

Name: Norm
Dialog: We're all very impressed with your numbers, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Although something seems to be missing. I know, it's Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's keeping him? Gee, I hope something horrible happened to him.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Does someone need a hug?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Of course not, you glorified waffle iron! Just launch it now.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Talking on her cell phone) Mom, I'm at the docks. You gotta get down here right away.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (Muffled) Okay, honey. I'll see you at FEH.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You'll see me at 5

Name: Charlene
Dialog: No. FEH.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: FEH.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "Feh"?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Yeah. FEH.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Confused) Okay...I'll see you at "feh".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hi, Vanessa! What do you think? My own country, eh?

Name: Norm
Dialog: I love what you've done with the place.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah. Yeah, I think it's nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This time I am staying right here where no one can see me.

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right, suit yourself. (sees a policeman writing a penalty ticket next to a car)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Oh no! Mom's gonna get a ticket! (Inserts coin in parking meter) That would have been embarrassing.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Whoa. Candace, are you going Goth now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, uh, I'm not wearing this. I mean, I'm wearing it in that it's actually on my body right now, but I'm not attached to it. Not to say that I'm attached to my other clothes. I mean, I can actually take them off. No, no, no. But, I mean-- I didn't want to put these-- I-I want to put clothes on, but I-- It was a mix-up, Okay? The dry cleaners and a-- a jackalope lawnmower, and-- (Pants) Do you like it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, Norm, the anthem, please!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: D-Does it feel like it stops too quickly? Eh... We'll work on it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, good, Mom's here! Mom, where have you been?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I told you on the phone I would meet you at FEH, the Freight Emergency Harbor?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, never mind that, but Dad and Norm built an entire country on the sea. Come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Isabella, ready to see your first rainbow?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But, Phineas, I keep tellin' you--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh no, don't thank us yet, Isabella. I only wish Perry was here to see this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, power it up! Isabella, pour, pour!

Name: Fishermen
Dialog: (Notices the rainbow) Ooh! Wow!

Name: Fisherman
Dialog: (Throws fishing rod grabbing Doofania, air hissing) Oh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that can't be... good. (The Structures of Doofania tip over and sink into the ocean's surface)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: See? You see? Look, look.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I do see it. What a cute little city! Oh, and it's soft! (At Doofenshmirtz) Heinz, you made a plush model?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I had a lot of felt!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well, at least it holds together. (Squeaking) Remember that dining set you tried to build for our apartment?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's hard to forget when you keep reminding me.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But-- but-- but...

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, come on, Vanessa. I think we need to get you out of the sun.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Who's up for a game of lawn darts?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'd prefer to play hide-and-seek because I don't want to see you.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Ouch.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You know, in retrospect, I question the inclusion of a self-destruct button in the first place.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bless you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I work alone, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's a solo.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Isabella, what'd you think of your first rainbow?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, it was really pretty, but it's not my first rainbow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But you said you'd never seen one in real life.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No, no, I've never seen a unicorn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh! (Sees a unicorn on the cereal box, which can be barely seen on the side under the rainbow) That's completely different. Hey, Ferb, I know what we're doing tomorrow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, I almost forgot. It's the end of the day. You don't need to wear that thing anymore. (Takes the Elizabethan collar off of Perry) Enjoy your freedom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: 8...9...10! Ready or not, here I come! (Takes hands away; sees Norm hiding behind a pole, which is revealing) Huh? Oh! No, no, no! It's called hide-and-seek! You hide, and I seek. I cannot seek if you don't hide. So you go hide yourself. Ignoramus. Go, go, go. Let's - Let's try this again. (Recovers eyes) One, two, three...ten! (looks over at the crates) Now, where is he?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (waves behind the crates) I'm right here, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (facepalms; notices Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry the Platypus. (At Norm) Hey, Norm, look who decided to show up!

Name: Vanessa/Candace
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Vanessa/Candace
Dialog: You know, the stopping is still bothering me.

Name: Radio Announcer
Dialog: It's another gorgeous summer day here in the Tri-State Area. Ladies, have you asked a date to the Night of the Falling Stars Girls-Choice Dance yet? It seems Danville's gone star-crazy waiting for the meteor shower tonight!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A meteor shower? How cool is that? Just think

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hey, boys? Boys? Oh there you are! Hey, look what I got for you online!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool! You named a star after us!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You're now the owners of a little piece of the universe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you get one for Candace too?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I did. Yes, of course I did, although she doesn't really care about this stuff. Anyway, they're practically giving 'em away online! D'you know, it's even better than the Oklahoma land rush of 1889!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah, those corny history references made me fall for him in the first place. Vivian and I are off to our mahjong tournament. Have fun today, boys.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, darling. Good luck.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good luck!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, what am I doing standing here when I can be out buying more stars?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Now that we own a star, we should go check it out! And how cool is space travel? The g-forces, eating dinner out of a tube, going to the bathroom without going to the bathroom, not to mention the weightlessness. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Jeremy, I was wondering, uh... if you'd like to go the Night of the Falling Stars Girls-Choice Dance with me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: With you? You've got to be kidding me. (He begins laughing)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on the phone) And that, Stacy, is why I can't ask Jeremy to the dance.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You realize that's kind of a worse-case scenario, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That could very well happen. What if he says no? What if he laughs in my face?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You can't let fear rule your life, Candace. Jeremy likes you. He's not gonna say no. Now, I'm gonna hang up, and when I do, I want you to call Jeremy. Don't man the phone, girl. Phone the man!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I am not gonna let fear rule my life. (Dials number)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Muffled) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy? Yeah, I can't do it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And this is Mission Control.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Kinda small.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, it looks small on the outside. But Ferb really knows how to maximize space.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, can I ask you something? Will you go to the dance-

Name: Katie
Dialog: Excuse me Phineas, can I get you to sign some liability waivers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing. (To Isabella) Hold that thought, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. No prob.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why are you guys walking so slow?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dramatic effect.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys ready?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (From inside the rocket) The star coordinates are pre-programmed. Let's light this candle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All systems go. Commence countdown.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (In a deep voice) Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, (A bird crashes into rocket) two, one. (She clears throat, then peaks in her normal voice) Ignition.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we need a Jump-start.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what if while I'm asking him, a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the— Wait a minute, what is going on out there? I'll call you back, Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Positive to positive, negative to ground, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Climbing into Phineas and Ferb's spaceship) Brothers. Does every sister have to deal with this? No. Do I have to deal with this? Of course. You'd think I'd have better things to do and other things to worry about. Every single day, it's one thing after another. But do Mom and Dad see it? No. Do they get in trouble? No. And another thing– (She enters the cockpit, to find Phineas and Ferb aren't there)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Got the remote?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, guys? I think you should see this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? How'd you get in there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Yelling) I can't hear you! My cheeks are covering my ears!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We should probably help her. Good thing we built two rockets.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, it's pretty.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was for Candace to see her star. I don't know why she took ours.

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: (In a space shuttle, preparing to dock with the space station) Uh, ready to park this puppy?

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Oh, it's bad enough this happens on earth. Now space?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming to get you, Candace! Hey, she's coming in! (Speaking to candace over video phone) Candace, don't worry. It's pre-programmed. As long as you don't start hitting buttons randomly, everything will be okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't hear you! I'm too busy hitting buttons randomly!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By the way, Candace, where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know. He must've gotten off before we launched.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, afraid I have terrible news. It's Doofenshmirtz. He's built a space station, and due to budget cuts, we have no way of getting you into space. Now, I've contacted the president, and... Agent P, are you in space? Nice work. You are always one step ahead. Your mission is to find Doofenshmirtz and stop him, Agent P.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (Floating in space) Agent P? Agent P?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, guys, what are all these red flashing things heading toward my rocket?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, those are asteroids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Asteroids? (She screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just like Beggar's Canyon back home. We're catching up to her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oop, she lost her engines. Let's go get her.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe it's Perry the Platypus. (He traps Perry in an ice cube tray) Hohohohoho Perry the Platypus, what are you doing here? I thought you guys were having budget cuts. Well, it just shows to go ya. Hey, let's walk and talk. So, you're probably wondering why my space station has two enormous arms. Well, what you should be wondering is why it has two giant hands! Ha ha ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Flashing back) See, during my teen years, I was very adept at hand shadows. It was great for entertaining at parties, and for meeting Fräuleins. But then one day, there was a new puppeteer in town. His name was Hans, and his hands were huge. We called him "Huge Hands Hans". His puppetry was garbage, but unfortunately, it was good enough for my Fräulein. I lost her to a boy with bigger fingers, and I never did a shadow puppet again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Until tonight! (He laughs) And when the sun rises in one hour; see, right over there; Then everyone in the Tri-State Area will see my enormous hand shadows on the moon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There she is! Uh-oh, this isn't good. Candace, you're in a decaying orbit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What does that even mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You just need to get to the spacesuit on the hook behind you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now put it on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm putting it on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now walk over to the door.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm at the door.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now just open it and take a little spacewalk to our ship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, there's nothing to be scared of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing to be scared of? There's the never-ending, icy-cold, soul-sucking darkness of space!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I hear negative!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There is no way I'm going out there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just a few yards away. You can't let fear rule your life.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course I can. That's my thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, just calm down and take Ferb's hand.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb's hand? (Ferb grabs her hand, and leaves Candace's ship, dragging Candace along, back to Phineas's ship) Thanks, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mission Control? Come in, Mission Control.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, did you find Candace?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. We've got her, and we're on our way home.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Excellent. So, Phineas, speaking of home, there's that dance tonight, and– (An alarm begins beeping)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold that thought, Isabella. I think we're out of fuel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Find some fuel somewhere and let's go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's gonna be hard. We're kinda nowhere.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean we're stuck here in the empty void of space?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas... what is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have no idea.

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Uh, will the owner of a red station wagon please move your vehicle? You are in a shuttle loading and unloading zone only.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have no idea. (reading the signs that was emitting the light) Milk shakes? Wow, that was so bright, I thought it was a star. Maybe we'll find some fuel here. (The rocket lands) Are you sure you don't wanna come with us? Ferb says the oxygen levels are just like Earth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh... I'm sure. Just find some fuel, and let's get out of here!

Name: Bartender
Dialog: One sarsaparilla coming up.

Name: Alien
Dialog: I love you, man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi. I'm Phineas, and this is Ferb.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Wait a second. You're Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Hey, everyone, it's the new owners!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: New owners? Those coordinates are right here. Ferb, this is our star. Wow. That sign really is bright.

Name: Alien 2
Dialog: I told you they'd show up.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: So now that you own the joint, what do you think of it? I know, it's a little run-down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have a few ideas for this place.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You do realize that's a worst-case scenario, right, Candace? But I do feel for ya. I've been trying to ask Phineas to that same dance all–

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas. What's taking those boys so long? They were supposed to find fuel ages ago. Later, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. No prob.

Name: Doorman
Dialog: (In a Cockney accent) Stop right there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me in, buster.

Name: Doorman
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb don't take kindly to gatecrashers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm no gatecrasher; I'm their sister!

Name: Doorman
Dialog: Ooh, sorry about that. Honest mistake. You won't mention this to them, eh?

Name: Alien 3
Dialog: Uh, I'm their sister.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, guess what? This is our star!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought we were getting out of here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I thought we'd fix up the place. You know, pride of ownership? Take a load off. Have a shake.

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: I can't do it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, are you okay?

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: No. The bicentennial Taming of the Yarks Dance is tonight, and I wanna ask the girl of my dreams, but what if she says no? What if she laughs in my face? What if her friends laugh at me? What if her friends' friends laugh at me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aren't you being a little overly dramatic? I mean, really, what's the worst thing that could happen?

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Uh... the entire planet could blow up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Please. I think you should just ask her to the dance.

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Really? You think so?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I do. Really.

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Well... Okay. (He takes a breath) Here goes nothin'. Ahem. Sylvia... will you go to the dance with me?

Name: Sylvia
Dialog: (Appearing, attached to his head) Well, of course. I've been waiting for you to ask me. I mean, even if you asked someone else, I'd still have to go with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? That wasn't so hard.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So... Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I get it. Big lesson. Yeah, well, I learned that it wouldn't be hard to ask Jeremy out if he was growing out of the back of my head. Now you find us some fuel, and let's get outta here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. I just wanted to know if she liked the shake. (to the bartender) You don't know where we could find some rocket fuel, do ya?

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Rocket fuel? It's all Ronaldo drinks.

Name: Ronaldo
Dialog: (In an Italian accent) Only imported rocket fuel.

Name: Ronaldo
Dialog: Grazie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I'm sensing Candace wants to leave.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you cut that out?

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Okay, that's it. I'm not waiting anymore. (The two astronauts lift the car away) Great. Let's park the shuttle. (A flying saucer lands) Oh, come on! (He throws his helmet off in fury, and quickly puffs up because of it) Uh-oh. I think I should go inside now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why are we stopping?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. We have plenty of fuel. The battery's worn down. Candace, were you using the videophone without the engine running?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Was that a bad thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If by "bad", you mean we're stranded in the never-ending, icy-cold, soul-sucking darkness of space... then, yeah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon, Perry the Platypus, the sun will be at full strength, and my plan will come to fruition. Unless, of course, it's overcast... (An alarm begins beeping) Eh, but what are you going to do? Proximity alert? Why are there so many people in space? What's up with that?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You need another jump-start? Candace, didn't you have the engine running when we were talking on the videophone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Am I the only person who doesn't know this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, any suggestions, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sensors are indicating a massive power source in your area.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Where? I don't see it. (Doofenshmirtz's ship rises behind Phineas, Ferb, and Candace's) Wait a minute. I see it. It's Mom's car! We're saved! Ferb, toss me the starter remote. (Ferb shrugs) Ooh, that's right. We left it at home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's a starter remote?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, legally we're too young to start a car. We get away with it by using a starter remote. But you, Candace, have your learner's permit. Looks like you'll be doing the jump-starting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Oh, no, no, no, no, no. Can't you guys just find some old nuts and bolts lying around and jerry-rig up some kind of machiney-deely-bob and get us out of this situation?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Candace, we are just kids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ( She groans) Why am I arguing this? Hand me the suit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let me turn on the oxygen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Does this suit make my butt look big?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it does. Maybe I had the pressure up too high.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Never mind. I'll fix it. (She backs up, and transfers the inflation to her hands) Well, I guess this is preferable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can do this, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can do this. I can do this. I can do this. I can't do this. I can't do this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Watching) What is this? Now, why would an astronaut wear such big gloves? Wait a second! (He gasps) Huge Hands Hans?! It's Huge Hands Hans! He found me out in space! Oh, you're not going to steal a job from me this time, Huge Hands Hans! Nor my Fräuleins!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did it go again, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's positive to positive.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Positive to positive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Negative to ground.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What ground? We're in space!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no. Ground just means any piece of metal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any piece of metal? Well, then why do they call it ground? Why don't they just call it me- (She turns around and sees Doofenshimrtz's spaceship reaching to grab her)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong, Candace? Candace? Candace, what's wro- (Phineas sees the ship as well) Oh. Danville, we have a problem.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls, turn to the giant robot section of your Fireside Girls manuals.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, anything?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Still looking.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Here it is. Okay. According to this, you should get the heck out of there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great, but we've got no power. She didn't connect the— Candace, negative to ground!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Negative to ground, Candace! Negative to ground!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you mean negative to metal! (She attaches the jump lead to the robot, thereby giving the rocket a jumpstart) I did it! I did it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She did it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Huge Hands Hans is getting away! Not this time, freak fingers!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz chases after them) Just you wait, Huge Hands Hans! You can run, but you can't hide! You know, he can run, but he can't– (Perry's ice tray smacks Doofenshmirtz across the face) Ow! Wait a second. How did you--? Oh, I see. That's it— (Perry, with the remote control launches back at Doofenshmirtz) That's not fair! Oh, that's it, It's on now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, I hate to bother you again.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no bother.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got anything else? The robot's gaining on us.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It says they don't corner well.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They don't corner well? Wait a sec. Candace, fasten your seat belt. We're taking a little detour. (They steer the spaceship into the asteroid belt, swing Candace around) Now, how is she passing us?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, what are you doing?! (She screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See? Corners like a dream.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! Run away, Perry the Scaredy– Oof. (With his face puffed up from exposure to the vacuum of space) Oh, I think I need to put on my spacesuit. Uh oh.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And now, my good man, you ready for this? Your tip. Your very own star.

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: Uptown, they give quasars. (He drives off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sweet land!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas, you guys were great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks. You weren't too bad yourself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh. (She giggles) Thanks. So, would you like to go to the Night of the Falling Stars Girls' Choice Dance tonight?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, what's our schedule like?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we'll be there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Both of you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Why don't you come by, and we'll all walk over together?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. No prob.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks for the lift, Viv.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stares at her rocket ship and walks up to Linda) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, sweetheart. Oh, look at your outfit. Hey, guess what? We won! (flatly) But the grand prize was a star.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (eating pizza) Ooh, whoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiles) Mom, that's great, but you gotta see something in the yard. Come on, you gotta see it! Come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right, I'm a-comin'.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. Uh, I'll be right with you after I pull my car into the garage.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, it's still here! (to Linda) See, Mom? There! Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm just backing the car in! I'll be right with you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: So what did you want to show me, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (facepalms) Just go make some pie...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Or... (leaving) How about a healthy fruit salad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, curse this tin can! Ugh, I'm going to need a jump-start! (Phineas and Ferb;s rocket crashes into Doofenshmirtz's, causing it to begin to fall towards earth) I, uh, no, I guess it won't help now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I just wanted to say thank you. We were in a pretty precarious situation up there. If it wasn't for your bravery, who knows what would have happened?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? You think I'm... brave?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you kidding? Ferb was goin' on and on about it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I was brave! (She gasps) I was brave! I'm not gonna let fear rule my life anymore! Now I've gotta go. I've got a mission to accomplish.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry. Where ya been?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, will you go to the dance with me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Reveals she's in her spacesuit) Yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I've been waiting for you to ask me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Only, uh, uh, Candace, is that what you're gonna wear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why? You like it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, look.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A shooting star, just for us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Screaming) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! And you too, Huge Hands Hans!

Name: Voice
Dialog: It's the final frontier, baby.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have you seen bolt #473?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, it's still here. Oh, come on, Mom! We're really coming down to the wire on this one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Door closes) Mom! (She runs away then runs back) Oh, great and magical being who make all things magically vanish before Mom sees them. Knock it off!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks, Vivian. See you Tuesday for totem pole carving.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Quick, Mom, look! Before it disappears!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, if it isn't the welcoming committee. -

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time for dry, witty remarks! Must move. Move, move, move, move! Move, move, move, move!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't you get tired of this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Linda
Dialog: The same old routine every day. Doesn't it ever get--" mm, I don't know-- boring?

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...You know what? You're right. I guess it has gotten a little old. I just get so frustrated. I always come so close to busting Phineas and Ferb, but it ends the same way every single time. I look and say there's a massive "thing" Phineas and Ferb built right in front of me, but every time you look, you always say...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I...see it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is. "I see it." Right on you. Wait, what? Come again?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I see it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean you see my point?

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, Candace. I see that! (she points at the tower)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) You do?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: How could I miss it? But I don't understand. How the...? Or who the...? B-- What the?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! Check it out! The Flying Car of the Future; Today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is that my...car?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Ecstatic) She sees the car, too!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (To Ferb) The Flying Car of the Future; Today, is still pulling a bit to the right.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (In the distance) PHINEAS! FERB! GET DOWN HERE THIS INSTANT!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Mom, be right down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (To Linda) So, what do you think, Mom? Pretty cool, huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cool?! This is the most dangerous thing I've ever seen!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, we were safe. Ferb invented a new invisible helmet head system. (He and Ferb take off hats that look like their normal heads) "When life's never dull, wear a hull for your skull."

Name: Linda
Dialog: How dare you do all this without permission!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But all our building permits are in order.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I mean, my permission.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This morning I asked you if we could modify our car to make it fly.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I was talking about your toy car!! How could you possibly think I meant my station wagon?! You are in SO much trouble, young man!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But...we do this sort of thing every day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Her anger now replaced with shock) What?!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sounding a bit smug) See, Mom? I told you...but you never listened.

Name: Linda
Dialog: But I...

Name: Memory-Candaces
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb built a rollercoaster! Phineas and Ferb are one-hit wonders? Phineas and Ferb carved my face into Mount Rushmore. Phineas and Ferb are driving cattle. Phineas and Ferb built a giant tree house robot... (The next several begin to slur together as they quickly come to her) are promoting a boxing match...built a beach in the backyard...built a time machine... built a ski resort! Are directing a movie... built a haunted house... built a giant sundae maker... are getting the band back together... Phineas and Ferb are in my large intestine!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace. All the times I called you delusional and mocked you to my friends behind your back, all those journals I've filled with an eye towards stand-up comedy...but you were telling the truth! I'm so sorry. You're the best daughter any mother could dream of having.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally, you realize that!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, what's all this yelling about? (Notices the tower) Oh, my word! That is impressive.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Did you know about this?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I -- I...I -- I, uh...no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Clearly overjoyed) What are you gonna do to them? No TV for a month? Or -- they have to serve me for a year. (gasps) How about confiscating their toolbox? (gasps) I know! Take away their seats on the city council!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You have seats on the city council?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We rotate out with the Board of Selectmen.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, some punishment may be in order, but, look, there's no harm done really.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look, Ferb, here's bolt number 473. I hope that wasn't important.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, at least the self-parking works.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grinning widely) Ee-ee-ee-ee!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm sorry, but this is really for your own good. We need you both to understand that what you've been doing is way too dangerous. I'd never be able to live with myself if you got hurt.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were wearing helmets. (A sergeant walks behind the bus then holds a Smile Away Reformatory School brochure with an image of a sun on it.)

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Don't worry. Your boys will be in good hands. As you can see from our realistically illustrated brochure, the Smile Away Reformatory offers a serene, peaceful environment in which safety, discipline and responsibility are encouraged. Your boys will be whipped into shape in no time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I'll be honest, Ferb, I didn't see this coming. (Notices Baljeet is on the bus too) Baljeet? What are you doing here?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I got kicked out of summer school because my grades were too high. But then I heard about this place. Sure, they break you down and strip you of your identity, but school is school.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bye, boys. See you at the end of summer!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, I actually busted Phineas and Ferb! (sighs) This is the happiest moment of my life! Woo-hoo! (Candace acts like an acrobat. Elsewhere in the sky, she skydives with two teenagers, soaring pass a meadow.) I'm finally free!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That doesn't look like the brochure.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I was too excited to wait. (Takes off his wig) I shaved last night. Just call me Bald-jeet. Heh-heh. Get it? "Bald-jeet"?

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Okay, listen up, maggots! You are here because your parents (Mockingly) are worried about you. Now, the way I see it, the root of all children's problems is unacceptable levels of imagination, fun, creativity and unbridled enthusiasm! Don't you eyeball me! Our goal at this school is to crush the dangerous elements inside you and replace them with structure, order, discipline and conformity.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: What--? (he looks over to see Phineas and Ferb doing something to their bunk bed) Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, this is a very inefficient way to clean a bathroom.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: That's the idea! Now, make it shine!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: And no funky rhythms! (Leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought it had more of a free-form jazz vibe. Huh. Well, you can't please everybody.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Ow-ow!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What did you do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I tripped over Ferb's old toolbox.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, do you wanna go horseback riding?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's your hurry? Let's relax for a little while. You know, with Phineas and Ferb gone, I've had a blast doing things I wanted to do. But it's strange. I kind of miss the little guys. It's as if there was a whole other side to our relationship that I never noticed before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Stace, you're kind of bumming me out with the song there.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, you finally have everything you ever wanted. Call me when you get over it. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ok. Maybe a little TV will take my mind off things. (turns on the TV)

Name: Morty Williams
Dialog: Today on "The Morty Williams Show," "My Kid Is Bad, and I Want to Blame Others!" We'll go inside the nation's toughest reformatory school, where free-thinking children undergo complete personality re-programming and have all the creativity and imagination sucked right out of them. They are forced to think inside the box.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a second. They didn't belong in a place like that. I know what I have to do.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? How did you get in here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: There's a huge gaping hole in the side of your house.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, well, Phineas and Ferb would've usually fixed that by now.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You wanna go horseback riding?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you stop already with the horses? Jeremy! I know what I'm gonna do today! I'm gonna bust my brothers...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Didn't you already do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Out! Bust my brothers out!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool. I always liked your brothers. I'm coming with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) You mean, like a date?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. A weird sort of prison-break kind of date.

Name: Recorded female voice
Dialog: Age-inappropriate building is unsafe and irresponsible. Good boys don't make anything but their sisters happy. Creative acts are imitable and dangerous. Using your imagination is morally wrong.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The book was so much better.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. It's a letter from the board of selectmen. The city council is proposing a millage to cover the overage from last quarter, and they need Phineas and Ferb's input.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (sighs) Perhaps we were a bit hard on them.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, they really did believe they had permission. I suppose it was all a big misunderstanding.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let's go get 'em, shall we? We can take the Flying Car of the Future...Today.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Weren't you supposed to get that changed back to normal?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes, but you must admit, it's pretty cool!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, it's pretty cool.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hey, where's the Flying Car of the Future...Today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Agh! Sorry. The Flying Car of the Future...Today is pulling a bit to the right.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are you kidding? This is the best date ever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming laugh) Whoa-oa-oa!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Maybe we should walk the rest of the way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. (starts to reach for the tools)

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts them with water) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're... gonna do...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Ferb...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...know...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...what...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No, no, no, no, no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (shivering) Hey, F-F-F-F-F-F-F-F-F...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (laughs) Yes. I've finally broken them.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You okay, Candace?
