Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'm trudging. I never knew people actually trudged.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Look, we're here.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: What do you want?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um...uh, hi. Yeah, I'm here to see my brothers, Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: They don't graduate till the end of the summer. Get lost.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So much for the direct approach. It's time we tried it Phineas and Ferb style.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Is this gonna work?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just like the Trojan horse from history class. They'll accept this as a gift, then after everyone falls asleep, we'll jump out and rescue Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: You two again? I thought I told you to get lost!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe we gotta think bigger.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Wow, what a thoughtful gift. Too bad I don't have room for you, handsome. I'm gonna have to get a bigger yard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (whispers) Now's our chance.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yes, we did i--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what is this, hair? Gross! I bet you regret coming along with me now, huh?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Actually, I'm kinda havin' fun. You know, crazy, prison-break kinda fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And, ew! Look at this. "Baljeet's summer wig. Store at room temperature"? Huh? The Morty Williams Show? Wait a second. I've got a plan. It's foolproof.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deep voice) Yes. Clearly I'm Morty Williams, and I'm back to do another segment.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Hey, aren't you a little...female to be Morty Williams?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, well, you know what they say. The camera adds...masculinity.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Great. Well, come on in, Morty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're doing a follow-up show on Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: My biggest success stories. Right this way. Ah, Phineas and Ferb. Such curious and self-reliant children. So fun-loving, imaginative and creative. Fortunately, we got to them just in time. See for yourself. (to Phineas and Ferb) Flynn, Fletcher, fall in! (Phineas and Ferb come out of lockers, to Candace) You see, here at the Smile Away Reformatory, our motto is, "It's structure, order and discipline today, so tomorrow it's Smile Away." Our methods have been proven 100% effective since... (continues under)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (whispers) Guys, it's me, Candace. We've come to bust you out of here. Now's our chance. RUN! (to Sergeant) Just testing. Wow, you've done a great job of turning them into, uh...that.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Yes. Yes, we have.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, yeah, I-I think we should really get some more footage of you.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Oh, really?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. You've got..."it," mister. So, uh, let's see. Uh, close your eyes.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Uh, like this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Now stick your fingers in your ears. Perfect. Now go, "La la la la la la la la la!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: The lights are all wrong. Go inside the janitor's closet. (Sergeant's singing continues) And...action! (Slams door on him) Come on, guys, we can escape now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Robotic voice) Escaping is wrong, and wrongness is bad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We don't have time for this. Grab 'em!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why is Morty Williams running off with our children?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I don't know.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Attention, all personnel. Two students have escaped with the help of Morty Williams, syndicated daytime talk show host. Weekday mornings. Check local listings for time and channel. (dogs barking)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, this way!

Name: Morty Williams
Dialog: Yep, it's time to go back inside the Smile Away Reformatory School for more footage. Those zombified brats are making me one rich - (shouting; dogs barking; barking continues)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) I've got to buy us some time.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: It's Morty Williams! Get him!

Name: Guards
Dialog: Oh! Ow! Ow!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute. Look. They tricked us.

Name: Guards
Dialog: Get him! (dogs barking) Get him!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We made it! Okay, guys, this is your department. Fix the car, quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Robotic voice) Age-inappropriate building is unsafe and irresponsible.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't have to build anything. Just figure out how to fix it! I'm getting your toolbox. See? Your tools!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A bridge? You can build a bridge across the ravine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good boys don't make anything but their sisters happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great, great. Make me happy. Put on your helmet head systems, use your tools and do what you do best - build a bridge and Save Us!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Creative acts are imitable and dangerous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Listen to me, guys. Forget everything they told you. Creativity isn't bad. It's the best thing about you. (Sobbing) You two can do anything, and that's why I've always been secretly proud to be your older sister. What have I done?! What have I done?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb...I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! They're back!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Too late. They're mine. (dogs barking) And so are you. (gasps; rocks crumbling; gasps) Look!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (dogs whimpering) Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry has a hat?!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (screams; gasps) La la la, la la la la, la la la la, la la la - (thud)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you think he'll be...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Where did you get that... Mom, Dad! Thank goodness. The strangest thing just happened.

Name: Baljeet's voice
Dialog: Fear not. Your parents are here now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The real shock is you're just noticing this now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: I'm just as confused as you are, Kevin.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, since I have no idea what will happen next, I need to tell you something. I love you, Candace Flynn. Will you marry me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy! I always dreamed - (record needle scratches) Wait a minute. That's it! I'm dreaming!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That would explain the talking zebra.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nah. I see him all the time. This, this is actually the freaky part. And it's all just been one...big...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dream! (pause) So none of that really happened. I never actually busted Phineas and Ferb. I am so happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And suddenly Mom, Dad and Baljeet were controlled by a giant puppet master!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, so I'm standing there, and Jeremy comes over and says (pauses to correct her words) certain things. And...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (to Lawrence) Go grab my journal. This is comedy gold.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, we should build a device that projects your dreams like a movie. I'd love to see what Perry dreams about.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I almost forgot. Perry was in the dream too. He was like a super-secret agent or something.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps that's where he disappears to everyday.

Name: SSSN
Dialog: Hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Wait, What are you doing? Hey!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait a minute. What's going on? I haven't even finished my cereal!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, your cover's been blown! You're going to have to relocate!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, hey, Perry. What's wrong, boy? You sounded like you were having a bad dream. It's okay now. Go back to sleep. (lies down and closes eyes, going back to sleep)

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: I said no funky rhythms!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'know, Ferb. He's right. That was a little funky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What should we do today? (First slide appears) Build an underwater skate park? Sounds pretty wicked! (Second slide appears) Fly with rocket-powered bat wings? Awesome! (Third slide appears) Teach Perry tricks. (He and Ferb looks at Perry) He's just a platypus. He doesn't do much.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. You might wanna go check up on Baljeet. I was walking by his house and heard him scream... "AIIIEEEE!!! I'M DOOMED TO BE AN INCOMPETENT FLUNKEE FOREVER!!! Ever...ever...ever..." (pause) I added the echo part.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds pretty serious.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet! It's Phineas and Ferb. (Opens door to Baljeet's room) Why are all the lights off?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Darkness is a shroud that hides my shame.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Turns on light switch) Hey, buddy, why don't you tell us what's going on.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because of the 17 summer school classes I am taking, I qualified for the science fair. So I decided to design this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Takes blueprint; he and Ferb holds it up) A portal to Mars? Cool!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, not cool. (Grabs blueprint; rolls it up) When I showed my teacher, he said...

Name: Male Teacher
Dialog: A portal to Mars? And what does it do?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, without over-complicating things, it's a portal to Mars. You step through it and you're on Mars.

Name: Male Teacher
Dialog: Well, this is very...creative. But, unless you can build a working model, the best I can give you is...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: An A-minus?! That would be the worst grade of my life!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why don't you just build one?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am not mechanically inclined like the two of you. To truly understand my predicament, I feel it will be best expressed in a song. (Claps hands twice)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Did you have him when you came over?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, uh...Agent P. (Clears throat) It appears that Doofenshmirtz has made some rather unusual purchases. Chicken wire, three metric tons of baking soda and lederhosen. Those leather bib-front shorts that make you look like a walking cuckoo clock? (Pauses) Man, he is one sick puppy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're all set for the science fair tomorrow.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Inside I am thanking you a thousand times, even though on the outside I remain quite frugal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Baljeet, you're already set up.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (With a wide smile "frozen" on his face) I have been here since midnight waiting for everyone! I can't stop smiling! I have got cramps in my cheeks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here, let me help you. There you go, buddy

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ahh. Now I'll just hang out and "be cool" till my teacher gets here. (Wide smile appears on his face) Uh-oh, it is happening again!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, Jeremy, no one makes a corn dog like you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hi, Candace. Nice binoculars.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Chuckling nervously) Yep. Yep, they definitely are working. I--I just bought these for my dad and was just...uh, you know, making sure that they work, and they sure do. You can see really far away or really up close. (Notices poster on counter) "Help wanted"?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah! You should apply. We could work together.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean side by side?

Name: Wendy
Dialog: Hi, there. I'm really really motivated! Really really positive! Really really high-energy! And would like to apply for the job.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me, I'd also like to apply for the job.

Name: Manager
Dialog: Ladies, I'm afraid I only have one opening. How about a competition to see who gets the job?

Name: Wendy
Dialog: Sounds like a great idea to me. (At Candace) Good luck. (Extends hand; quickly takes it away) Ooh, too slow. I think I'll call you Molasses.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Molasses. Well, I think I'll call you something...slower than molasses, that's for sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't part of the competition, is it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, welcome to my truck of doom. (Stops truck; Pushes a button)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose you're wondering why I'm wearing lederhosen. (Pauses; Perry glares at him) What? I've the legs for it! (Stretches right leg on dashboard) Eh? Eh? Eh? (Lowers right leg) Anyway, it will all become clear soon enough!

Name: Woman
Dialog: (Growling, low-voice) Come on, Hansel! Move it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wise guy, I'm just explaining... Oh! (Chuckling) Sorry, madam. Sorry. (To Perry) Her voice was so masculine and growly. I thought it was a man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, people must call her "sir" all the time on the phone. It must be so em... (Laughs) She's standing right behind me now, isn't she?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not one word, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! A line! (At a boy) Oh, brother! What is this, a model of Pluto? (Laughs) That planet doesn't even exist anymore, you moron!

Name: Male teen
Dialog: Thanks for holding my spot in line, little brother. (To Doofenshmirtz) What were you saying about Pluto?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nothing. I'm sure it's...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Groans; pulls model of Pluto off his head) I suppose you are wondering why I am putting myself through all of this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Voice over) When I was young, I entered a science fair with my very first Inator. I-- I wasn't very clever with names yet. It was just, you know, Inator. Just as I was about to demonstrate my invention to the judges, a kid with a baking soda volcano stole the show! The next year, I tried again with my even bigger Inator. And again, my thunder was stolen by a baking soda volcano! I had enough of science. I decided to devote my life to poetry instead.

Name: Young Adult Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The movies are gray, the TV is black, the horses are running, please bring me some food.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Voice over) Yet, curiously, I still lost to a baking soda volcano!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But never again! Behold! (Removes tarp) The world's largest baking soda volcano! I mean, it's got to be the biggest one here, right? It's gonna win. (Pauses) I feel confident.

Name: Elderly man
Dialog: Next?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, we're next.

Name: Elderly man
Dialog: Aren't you a little old to be entering this science fair?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! What makes you say that? I mean, look at me! I'm wearing lederhosen!

Name: Elderly man
Dialog: (Pauses) Okay. Go ahead.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Chuckles; to Perry) See? I know what I'm doing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Cheerfully) Hi, Mr. McGillicuddy.

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: Well, I see you've built yourself a prototype, but the question still remains

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I think...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course it works! Baljeet, fire it up.

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: Ok, so I see science fair.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Take a closer look, Mr. McGillicuddy.

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: Wow! A science fair on Mars! Baljeet, you have just validated my entire career as an educator! You get an A+++! (Voice squeaks) I'm gonna go get the judges!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon I will show them the havoc created when an acid and a base combine! (Laughs; dramatic music) But first I have to find an outlet 'cause there's a nice laser show that goes along with it. We'll take this out and put mine in. (Chuckles) Hello!

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: It's right over here. (At Baljeet) Baljeet, show our judges what Mr. McGillicuddy has taught you.

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: Ah, um, just a moment. It takes the skilled hand of a master professor. (Chuckles) Hello! Mr. Martian! It's Mr. McGillicuddy. (Chuckles) Uno momento.

Name: Judge #1
Dialog: Who's up for corn dogs?

Name: Judge #2
Dialog: I am.

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: A-ha! Turn it all the way up to high. (Switches dial from "low" to "high") Yes! That should do it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder what's wrong with the portal?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah, no matter. Actually, I never cared about winning. I just wanted a good grade.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aah. Well, who's up for corn dogs?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Me!

Name: Manager
Dialog: Girls, your first task is to dress these dogs with ketchup and mustard. I'll be back in a bit to check your work. Good luck!

Name: Wendy
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Holds up a bottle of ketchup) Hey, no fair! I ran out of ketchup. (Squeezes the bottle, then grins sheepishly.) Oops. Now I'm out of ketchup.

Name: Wendy
Dialog: (Squeezes a bottle of mustard) Oops. Now I'm out of mustard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Squeezes a bottle of relish twice) Oh, look, I'm out of relish!

Name: Wendy
Dialog: (Laughing)

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: It's gotta work, it's gotta...work! Huh? (notices the plug to the portal)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now just add some vinegar and... (Perry lands on his head; he screams)

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: It just wasn't plugged in. There's an outlet over there. (Notices a high voltage outlet; plugs the cord in, cackling) It's working! It's working!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ew, gross! I smell like...salad. (Mumbling; slips on vinegar; lands in the volcano, which then "erupts") Say goodbye to this pair of lederhosen. Hey, I'm unhurt! Yes, I am invincible! Wait, wait, wait, wait! Where am I going?

Name: Judge #1
Dialog: All right, so what was it you wanted to show us?

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: (Stuttering) No! It was here!

Name: Judge #1
Dialog: Come on, let's go find a real winner.

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: But... But... But...

Name: Girl
Dialog: Excuse me, am I too late to enter?

Name: Judge #1
Dialog: Are those mechanical arms?

Name: Girl
Dialog: Why, yes. I used them to make this baking soda volcano.

Name: Judge #1
Dialog: (Gasps) A baking soda volcano? Cool! 1st prize!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Mr. McGillicuddy
Dialog: But...

Name: Manager
Dialog: Well, seeing as you've used most of my ketchup and mustard to dress yourselves, I'm afraid neither of you get the job.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Snail! I'll call you you Snail. Ha!

Name: Wendy
Dialog: You're quick.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just can't believe you built a portal to Mars and didn't go through it yourselves!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, we did.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: But that's another story.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, look.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: To truly understand my predicament, I feel it will be best expressed in a song. (Claps hands twice)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's see, who should I call first to hang out with? (Holds up cell phone) How about Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Via recording) Hey, it's Jeremy. You know what to do after the (beep)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Jeremy. It's Candace. Uh, just seeing what's going on today. Call me back if you want to. Okay, bye! (Closes cell phone) Oh, man, that never gets easier. Oh, well, I'll just call Stacy. (Opens cell phone) She's probably been waiting by the phone all morning.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Via recording) You've reached Stacy's mobile. Leave a message, I'll get back to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Stace! It's Candace. Where are you? Call me! Hmm. That's weird. Who else can I call? I know! Jenny! I haven't seen her since the boys built a beach in the backyard.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jenny, hey, it's Candy.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: (Via recording) Leave a message, I'll get back to you as soon as possible.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Call me. Hmm. Who else do I know? Becky, this is Candace. I know we haven't talked since kindergarten, but... Hey, Wendy. This is Candace. We shared a seat on the bus to planetarium. Hello? Clarissa, this is Candace. We played volleyball at camp. Jill? Nancy? Barbara? Olga? Chicago Joe!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Information.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See a movie with me. (Screams) Where is everyone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are they all out having fun without me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So all my friends need some time to themselves, huh? Well, not without me they're not.

Name: Manager
Dialog: Hey; I'm looking for Jeremy too. I need him to work tomorrow. Our fry guy just defected over to Taco Tepee. (at Taco Tepee manager) You win this one, Cooks with Grease!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Am I that bad to hang out with?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh! A text message. And it's from Stacy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "CYL, BFF, S." What does that mean? Let's see. "Candace, You Loser....Bad Friendships Fail...Stacy." Harsh!

Name: Pidgeons
Dialog: (Cooing)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) Feels like I don't exist anymore, like I'm a nobody. I wish I could go to some cool faraway place and start over. Wait a minute. Those are Phineas and Ferb's bikes!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Inside I am thanking you a thousand times, even though on the outside I remain quite frugal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See you tomorrow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just built a teleport to a cool, faraway place.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that's all I needed to hear! Candace Flynn is out. Peace! (Walks through the portal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Welcome to Mars.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mars?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, no! The portal is broken! Ooh, now I will not get a good grade at the science fair tomorrow, and, uh,... there's also the issue of your sister stranded on a distant, barren planet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, we can fix it. Heh. Candace is probably laughing about it as we speak!

Name: Candace
Dialog: PHINEAS!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what's up? Oh, are you here to...? Oh, no, no. I'm running a little behind. I'm still in the middle of basic plotting and scheming. Of course, I-I...can't give you my evil scheme monologue because I write that last. Sorry! That's just how I roll.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait! Why don't you help me? That way I can finish faster and you can defeat me faster. It's win-win! Let me grab my coupons. We'll start by shopping for some supplies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted! (echoing) Busted...busted... Now I truly am alone. (Notices a Mars Rover) Hey, it's one of those Mars Rovers. I'm saved!

Name: Man
Dialog: (Screaming) I can't take it anymore! I've been staring at red rocks for 20 years! That's all that is on that stupid planet! Red rocks! Face it, there's no life on Mars. That's it! I'm shutting this place down! Game over! (The screen shuts down)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (While kicking at the Mars Rover) Stupid Rover! You're not going to ignore me too. Take that, you ugly, unmanned exploratory vehicle! And that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, that's what I thought. (Notices a Martian) Huh?

Name: Martian
Dialog: (Taps the broken Rover)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you?

Name: Martian
Dialog: (Screeches)

Name: Martians
Dialog: (Speaking in a foreign language)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on? What are you doing? Put me down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There! I think we fixed it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, that is Venus. And that is Earth in prehistoric time. (Gasps, yells) Change it, change it, change it! Hey, look, it is us in the future fixing the portal.

Name: Baljeet of the future
Dialog: Hello, Baljeet of the past! Just watch us. That is how we learned to fix it. Gesundheit!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Thanks. (Sneezes)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It worked. Cool! (At Baljeet) Ok, give us 20 minutes to find Candace, then open up the portal.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, please be careful. I still need your help at the science fair tomorrow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Something tells me Candace was here. Good thing you brought your tools. I got an idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, what's going on? (A Martian places a crown on her head) Ooh. You're making me your ruler?

Name: Martians
Dialog: (Speaking foreign language)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! Let's get this party started! Crank the tunes.

Name: Martians
Dialog: (Blinking)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, you know, music. You guys don't know what music is? Well, it's like...it's like this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! You're getting it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoo-hoo! Follow that music, Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You are much more attentive than my friends on Earth, and better at building statues of me. Come on, let's walk and talk. Of course, I'll do most of the talking. Okay. To make things easier, I'll call you Good Stacy, and you, Good Jenny. And...huh?

Name: Martians
Dialog: (Speaking foreign language)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, okay, what the heck? (Smashes a Mars Rover)

Name: Martians
Dialog: (Cheering)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas? Ferb?

Name: Martians
Dialog: (Chattering indistinctly)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're here to rescue you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why would I go back to being a nobody when I could be the queen of here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, there's a lot of... Uh, Candace, what's up with your friends?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, ignore them. They're harmless. Hey, why don't you hang out while so you can tell everyone how popular I've become.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While pushing a shopping cart) Okay, I've already got the chicken wire. Let's see. Oh, here! (Hands a list to Perry, who's sitting in the child's seat) You-you...take the list and cross things off as we go. Should we get something for later, like...like...one of those big pickles or a three-bean salad? (he bumps the shopping cart against another one)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that was awkward.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just gonna go for a walk. (A group of Martians points to a Mars Rover) Uh...uh...guys, not now, okay? (more Martians surrounds her) No, really, I would just like to got for a walk alone. (Groaning) (At Phineas and Ferb) There you are! Where've you guys been?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb was just explaining to the Martians how we got here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. Wait, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb speaks Martian. They're really excited about the idea of a science fair.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Figures. I'm the queen of little green nerds. Can you tell them that I want a little time to myself?

Name: Ferb, Martian
Dialog: (Both speaking Martian)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: They say fine, but not without them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Groans) Okay; just because I need to do things without you, sometimes, doesn't mean I don't like you or don't appreciate your friendship.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But Candace, isn't that...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, just like my friends with me. Whoop-de-doo!

Name: Martians
Dialog: (All speaking Martian)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It appears the Martians are blaming us for their queen wanting to leave.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quick! Get in! Queen Candace is out! Peace!

Name: Martians
Dialog: (All screeching)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you know they could do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, but get this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. You got your cell phone on you? (At Baljeet) Hello, Baljeet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How is it we have bars here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We kinda need you to open the portal now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're gaining on us!

Name: Giant Martian
Dialog: (Screaming)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, thanks for your help. I usually hate shopping, but, you know. You make it fun.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What, that? Oh, that's my first Inator. Good story. I'll tell you all about it tomorrow. Well, I should probably get back to my latest evil scheme! (Slams door with a foot) So long...sucker!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, hello, Candace. Where've you been? I want you to see my telescope.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A telescope? Perfect!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I don't even remember what this does. (He pushes a button on the Inator, and a green beam shoots out of it) Oh, that's right, it just shoots a beam into space. No wonder why I lost to a baking soda volcano.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb built this portal to Mars. I went through it and was crowned queen of the Martians. Now I know it sounds crazy, but this time, I have proof.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who does that look like?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (while looking through the telescope) Hmm. Well, it looks a little like a rhesus monkey wearing a powdered wig.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Let me see that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stuttering)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighing)

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, guys! Where have you been all day?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: I was at the dentist.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I was taking my little sister to the movies.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Didn't you get my text message? "Call You Later, Best Friends Forever. Stacy."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. (Chuckling) That's what I thought it said. It's funny, I kind of thought you guys were avoiding me.

Name: Unknown guy
Dialog: Actually, I was trying to avoid you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Pauses) Do I know you?

Name: Unknown guy
Dialog: No, that's how great it's been working. Unknown guy is out. Pee-ace!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am invincible! Wait, wait, wait, wait! Where are we going?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Groaning) Where am I? (The Martians surrounds him) Okay. Be cool, okay? (Notices the crown) What? Oh, you're going to make me your king? Well, ok, if you must. (Stuttering) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have you seen bolt #473?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, it's still here. Oh, come on, Mom! We're really coming down to the wire on this one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Door closes) Mom! (She runs away then runs back) Oh, great and magical being who make all things magically vanish before Mom sees them. Knock it off!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks, Vivian. See you Tuesday for totem pole carving.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Quick, Mom, look! Before it disappears!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, if it isn't the welcoming committee. -

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time for dry, witty remarks! Must move. Move, move, move, move! Move, move, move, move!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't you get tired of this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Linda
Dialog: The same old routine every day. Doesn't it ever get--" mm, I don't know-- boring?

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...You know what? You're right. I guess it has gotten a little old. I just get so frustrated. I always come so close to busting Phineas and Ferb, but it ends the same way every single time. I look and say there's a massive "thing" Phineas and Ferb built right in front of me, but every time you look, you always say...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I...see it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is. "I see it." Right on you. Wait, what? Come again?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I see it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean you see my point?

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, Candace. I see that! (she points at the tower)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) You do?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: How could I miss it? But I don't understand. How the...? Or who the...? B-- What the?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! Check it out! The Flying Car of the Future; Today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is that my...car?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Ecstatic) She sees the car, too!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (To Ferb) The Flying Car of the Future; Today, is still pulling a bit to the right.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (In the distance) PHINEAS! FERB! GET DOWN HERE THIS INSTANT!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Mom, be right down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (To Linda) So, what do you think, Mom? Pretty cool, huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cool?! This is the most dangerous thing I've ever seen!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, we were safe. Ferb invented a new invisible helmet head system. (He and Ferb take off hats that look like their normal heads) "When life's never dull, wear a hull for your skull."

Name: Linda
Dialog: How dare you do all this without permission!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But all our building permits are in order.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I mean, my permission.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This morning I asked you if we could modify our car to make it fly.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I was talking about your toy car!! How could you possibly think I meant my station wagon?! You are in SO much trouble, young man!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But...we do this sort of thing every day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Her anger now replaced with shock) What?!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sounding a bit smug) See, Mom? I told you...but you never listened.

Name: Linda
Dialog: But I...

Name: Memory-Candaces
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb built a rollercoaster! Phineas and Ferb are one-hit wonders? Phineas and Ferb carved my face into Mount Rushmore. Phineas and Ferb are driving cattle. Phineas and Ferb built a giant tree house robot... (The next several begin to slur together as they quickly come to her) are promoting a boxing match...built a beach in the backyard...built a time machine... built a ski resort! Are directing a movie... built a haunted house... built a giant sundae maker... are getting the band back together... Phineas and Ferb are in my large intestine!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace. All the times I called you delusional and mocked you to my friends behind your back, all those journals I've filled with an eye towards stand-up comedy...but you were telling the truth! I'm so sorry. You're the best daughter any mother could dream of having.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally, you realize that!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, what's all this yelling about? (Notices the tower) Oh, my word! That is impressive.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Did you know about this?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I -- I...I -- I, uh...no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Clearly overjoyed) What are you gonna do to them? No TV for a month? Or -- they have to serve me for a year. (gasps) How about confiscating their toolbox? (gasps) I know! Take away their seats on the city council!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You have seats on the city council?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We rotate out with the Board of Selectmen.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, some punishment may be in order, but, look, there's no harm done really.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look, Ferb, here's bolt number 473. I hope that wasn't important.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, at least the self-parking works.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grinning widely) Ee-ee-ee-ee!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm sorry, but this is really for your own good. We need you both to understand that what you've been doing is way too dangerous. I'd never be able to live with myself if you got hurt.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were wearing helmets. (A sergeant walks behind the bus then holds a Smile Away Reformatory School brochure with an image of a sun on it.)

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Don't worry. Your boys will be in good hands. As you can see from our realistically illustrated brochure, the Smile Away Reformatory offers a serene, peaceful environment in which safety, discipline and responsibility are encouraged. Your boys will be whipped into shape in no time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I'll be honest, Ferb, I didn't see this coming. (Notices Baljeet is on the bus too) Baljeet? What are you doing here?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I got kicked out of summer school because my grades were too high. But then I heard about this place. Sure, they break you down and strip you of your identity, but school is school.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bye, boys. See you at the end of summer!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, I actually busted Phineas and Ferb! (sighs) This is the happiest moment of my life! Woo-hoo! (Candace acts like an acrobat. Elsewhere in the sky, she skydives with two teenagers, soaring pass a meadow.) I'm finally free!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That doesn't look like the brochure.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I was too excited to wait. (Takes off his wig) I shaved last night. Just call me Bald-jeet. Heh-heh. Get it? "Bald-jeet"?

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Okay, listen up, maggots! You are here because your parents (Mockingly) are worried about you. Now, the way I see it, the root of all children's problems is unacceptable levels of imagination, fun, creativity and unbridled enthusiasm! Don't you eyeball me! Our goal at this school is to crush the dangerous elements inside you and replace them with structure, order, discipline and conformity.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: What--? (he looks over to see Phineas and Ferb doing something to their bunk bed) Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, this is a very inefficient way to clean a bathroom.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: That's the idea! Now, make it shine!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: And no funky rhythms! (Leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought it had more of a free-form jazz vibe. Huh. Well, you can't please everybody.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Ow-ow!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What did you do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I tripped over Ferb's old toolbox.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, do you wanna go horseback riding?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's your hurry? Let's relax for a little while. You know, with Phineas and Ferb gone, I've had a blast doing things I wanted to do. But it's strange. I kind of miss the little guys. It's as if there was a whole other side to our relationship that I never noticed before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Stace, you're kind of bumming me out with the song there.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, you finally have everything you ever wanted. Call me when you get over it. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ok. Maybe a little TV will take my mind off things. (turns on the TV)

Name: Morty Williams
Dialog: Today on "The Morty Williams Show," "My Kid Is Bad, and I Want to Blame Others!" We'll go inside the nation's toughest reformatory school, where free-thinking children undergo complete personality re-programming and have all the creativity and imagination sucked right out of them. They are forced to think inside the box.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a second. They didn't belong in a place like that. I know what I have to do.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? How did you get in here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: There's a huge gaping hole in the side of your house.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, well, Phineas and Ferb would've usually fixed that by now.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You wanna go horseback riding?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you stop already with the horses? Jeremy! I know what I'm gonna do today! I'm gonna bust my brothers...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Didn't you already do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Out! Bust my brothers out!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool. I always liked your brothers. I'm coming with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) You mean, like a date?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. A weird sort of prison-break kind of date.

Name: Recorded female voice
Dialog: Age-inappropriate building is unsafe and irresponsible. Good boys don't make anything but their sisters happy. Creative acts are imitable and dangerous. Using your imagination is morally wrong.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The book was so much better.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. It's a letter from the board of selectmen. The city council is proposing a millage to cover the overage from last quarter, and they need Phineas and Ferb's input.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (sighs) Perhaps we were a bit hard on them.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, they really did believe they had permission. I suppose it was all a big misunderstanding.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let's go get 'em, shall we? We can take the Flying Car of the Future...Today.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Weren't you supposed to get that changed back to normal?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes, but you must admit, it's pretty cool!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, it's pretty cool.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hey, where's the Flying Car of the Future...Today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Agh! Sorry. The Flying Car of the Future...Today is pulling a bit to the right.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are you kidding? This is the best date ever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming laugh) Whoa-oa-oa!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Maybe we should walk the rest of the way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. (starts to reach for the tools)

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts them with water) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're... gonna do...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Ferb...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...know...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...what...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (Squirts) No, no, no, no, no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (shivering) Hey, F-F-F-F-F-F-F-F-F...

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (laughs) Yes. I've finally broken them.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You okay, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'm trudging. I never knew people actually trudged.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Look, we're here.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: What do you want?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um...uh, hi. Yeah, I'm here to see my brothers, Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: They don't graduate till the end of the summer. Get lost.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So much for the direct approach. It's time we tried it Phineas and Ferb style.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Is this gonna work?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just like the Trojan horse from history class. They'll accept this as a gift, then after everyone falls asleep, we'll jump out and rescue Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: You two again? I thought I told you to get lost!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe we gotta think bigger.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Wow, what a thoughtful gift. Too bad I don't have room for you, handsome. I'm gonna have to get a bigger yard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (whispers) Now's our chance.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yes, we did i--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what is this, hair? Gross! I bet you regret coming along with me now, huh?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Actually, I'm kinda havin' fun. You know, crazy, prison-break kinda fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And, ew! Look at this. "Baljeet's summer wig. Store at room temperature"? Huh? The Morty Williams Show? Wait a second. I've got a plan. It's foolproof.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deep voice) Yes. Clearly I'm Morty Williams, and I'm back to do another segment.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Hey, aren't you a little...female to be Morty Williams?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, well, you know what they say. The camera adds...masculinity.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Great. Well, come on in, Morty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're doing a follow-up show on Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: My biggest success stories. Right this way. Ah, Phineas and Ferb. Such curious and self-reliant children. So fun-loving, imaginative and creative. Fortunately, we got to them just in time. See for yourself. (to Phineas and Ferb) Flynn, Fletcher, fall in! (Phineas and Ferb come out of lockers, to Candace) You see, here at the Smile Away Reformatory, our motto is, "It's structure, order and discipline today, so tomorrow it's Smile Away." Our methods have been proven 100% effective since... (continues under)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (whispers) Guys, it's me, Candace. We've come to bust you out of here. Now's our chance. RUN! (to Sergeant) Just testing. Wow, you've done a great job of turning them into, uh...that.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Yes. Yes, we have.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, yeah, I-I think we should really get some more footage of you.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Oh, really?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. You've got..."it," mister. So, uh, let's see. Uh, close your eyes.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Uh, like this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Now stick your fingers in your ears. Perfect. Now go, "La la la la la la la la la!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: The lights are all wrong. Go inside the janitor's closet. (Sergeant's singing continues) And...action! (Slams door on him) Come on, guys, we can escape now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Robotic voice) Escaping is wrong, and wrongness is bad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We don't have time for this. Grab 'em!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why is Morty Williams running off with our children?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I don't know.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Attention, all personnel. Two students have escaped with the help of Morty Williams, syndicated daytime talk show host. Weekday mornings. Check local listings for time and channel. (dogs barking)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, this way!

Name: Morty Williams
Dialog: Yep, it's time to go back inside the Smile Away Reformatory School for more footage. Those zombified brats are making me one rich - (shouting; dogs barking; barking continues)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) I've got to buy us some time.

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: It's Morty Williams! Get him!

Name: Guards
Dialog: Oh! Ow! Ow!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute. Look. They tricked us.

Name: Guards
Dialog: Get him! (dogs barking) Get him!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We made it! Okay, guys, this is your department. Fix the car, quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Robotic voice) Age-inappropriate building is unsafe and irresponsible.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't have to build anything. Just figure out how to fix it! I'm getting your toolbox. See? Your tools!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A bridge? You can build a bridge across the ravine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good boys don't make anything but their sisters happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great, great. Make me happy. Put on your helmet head systems, use your tools and do what you do best - build a bridge and Save Us!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Creative acts are imitable and dangerous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Listen to me, guys. Forget everything they told you. Creativity isn't bad. It's the best thing about you. (Sobbing) You two can do anything, and that's why I've always been secretly proud to be your older sister. What have I done?! What have I done?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb...I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! They're back!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: Too late. They're mine. (dogs barking) And so are you. (gasps; rocks crumbling; gasps) Look!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (dogs whimpering) Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry has a hat?!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: (screams; gasps) La la la, la la la la, la la la la, la la la - (thud)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you think he'll be...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Where did you get that... Mom, Dad! Thank goodness. The strangest thing just happened.

Name: Baljeet's voice
Dialog: Fear not. Your parents are here now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The real shock is you're just noticing this now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: I'm just as confused as you are, Kevin.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, since I have no idea what will happen next, I need to tell you something. I love you, Candace Flynn. Will you marry me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy! I always dreamed - (record needle scratches) Wait a minute. That's it! I'm dreaming!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That would explain the talking zebra.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nah. I see him all the time. This, this is actually the freaky part. And it's all just been one...big...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dream! (pause) So none of that really happened. I never actually busted Phineas and Ferb. I am so happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And suddenly Mom, Dad and Baljeet were controlled by a giant puppet master!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, so I'm standing there, and Jeremy comes over and says (pauses to correct her words) certain things. And...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (to Lawrence) Go grab my journal. This is comedy gold.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, we should build a device that projects your dreams like a movie. I'd love to see what Perry dreams about.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I almost forgot. Perry was in the dream too. He was like a super-secret agent or something.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps that's where he disappears to everyday.

Name: SSSN
Dialog: Hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup, hup!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Wait, What are you doing? Hey!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait a minute. What's going on? I haven't even finished my cereal!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, your cover's been blown! You're going to have to relocate!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, hey, Perry. What's wrong, boy? You sounded like you were having a bad dream. It's okay now. Go back to sleep. (lies down and closes eyes, going back to sleep)

Name: Sergeant
Dialog: I said no funky rhythms!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'know, Ferb. He's right. That was a little funky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're here!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, Lake Nose.

Name: Linda
Dialog: This is just what i needed. A nice, relaxing family getaway.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Such beauty, such tranquility. A fisherman's paradise. Yes, of all the lakes in the world, I'm glad we picked the Nose.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's charming, dear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Looks out the car window) I still can't believe I get to be on the Lake Nose lifeguard squad with Jeremy. The lifeguards at Lake Nose are considered the coolest of the cool. All the other kids look up to them and have to do whatever they say.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (With a Lake Nose guide) Or they'll get eaten.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly. I-- Wait, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It says here "Many believe these murky waters are home to Nosey, the ferocious Lake Nose Monster".

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughs) Nosey? Yeah, I'm so sure. There is no such thing as a Lake Nose Monster. Right, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, Candace there's no such thing as lots of things, and there's such thing as many other things. (Spins the steering wheel) Is Nosey such a thing? (The car stops turning) Well, you see, that's the thing, isn't it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, is this one of those cultural things again? Because I'm not sure they'd even know what the heck you're talking about in England.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh! It's possible Nosey has survived (Camera zooms in on him) because Lake Nose is unusually rich in zinc, a common metal used in everything from sunblock to pennies. Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, of course! Nosey the vicious zinc-eating dinosaur. Now it makes perfect sense! Thank you, crazy people I live with!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It doesn't say "Eats it". He probably just absorbs it through his skin. (Camera pans to him) Ooh, look! (Flips the guide) They have pictures of him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Reading the guide) Elephant, log, dolphin, driftwood, tire, driftwood, rhesus monkey wearing a powdered wig, driftwood, driftwood, you aren't old enough to know what that is, driftwood, driftwood, it's usually driftwood. (Camera zooms out) So don't go humiliating me by, I don't know, building some boat (Picks up luggage cases) to find the Lake Nose Monster or something.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Some boat to find the Lake Nose Monster (Camera zooms in on Phineas and Ferb) or something. (At Ferb) Ferb, are you not saying what I'm thinking? (Pause. The camera zooms out) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Wrist communicator
Dialog: Log in.

Name: Wrist communicator
Dialog: Log out.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Exit to your left, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I hope you enjoyed Lair Entrance

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, in focus group tests, 6-year-olds overwhelming preferred singing animals to a piece of paper with numbers on it, so I-- (Clears throat) Anyway, your mission

Name: Operator
Dialog: I'm sorry, sir. We do not deliver our hot wings to the bottom of a lake.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw come on! I'll tip 15%!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Our analysts agree

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At the dock with a boat) I think we're all set to get definitive proof that Nosey really exists.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Walks onto the dock wearing lifeguard uniform) All right, what are you two up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've just built a boat to find the Lake Nose Monster.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Didn't I specifically tell you not to do specifically, exactly just that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, specifically, you said not to humiliate you by doing that. So we won't!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Quick, I caught them red-handed!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Walks onto the dock) What is going on out here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, so where is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Where is what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The giant Lake Nose Monster search boat you made!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You mean Nosebud? She's right there.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You boys made this? I'm very impressed!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, look! They made a boat. It's actually waterproof and everything. That's pretty cool!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace. If you're so worried... (Calls out) Honey!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Dashes to the dock) Yes, dear?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Can you please go out on the lake with the boys to make sure they don't get into any trouble?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Chuckles) Well... (Dashes off and comes back wearing fishing gear) If I must. (Camera zooms into him) Well, who knows? I might even be persuaded to tell a few of my world-famous fishing stories.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I guess that's kind of a punishment. But come on, Mom, that's all you're gonna do?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Right, what was I thinking? (Holds up a bottle of sunblock) Here! Don't forget to use plenty of sunblock.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look! Zinc.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sweetie, aren't you gonna be late for your first lifeguard shift?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, give me some zinc.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (While carrying a surfboard) Okay, be cool and confident. Cool and confident. Hey, Jeremy! (Jazzy music plays) So, what do you think?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You look great!

Name: Captain
Dialog: So, you're the famous Candace Flynn? (Pulls out his hand) Bob Webber.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Shakes hands) Thanks for the lifeguard job, Mr. Webber.

Name: Bob
Dialog: "Mr. Webber"? Pshaw! Mr. Webber's my father. Call me "Captain Webber".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, okay.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) Okay! You two take care of my beach now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) Okay! And watch out for Nosey! (Laughs)

Name: Candace and Jeremy
Dialog: (Feign chuckle) Uh, okay.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) (Echoing) Okay!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: ...So he said, "Try ignoring it and hope it goes away. (Camera zooms into them) And you know what? It did. After 17 weeks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Dad, great story. (Ferb raises his hand and Phineas puts it down) Uh, we're gonna start our search for Nosey now, okay?

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) (Echoing) Okay!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, did I ever tell you boys about the time I caught the infamous Big Mouth Ramon?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Splendid! Then I'll set the scene

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb...

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) (Echoing) Okay!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb run out of the elevator) Let's find us a lake monster.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's in the drink. Do we have eyes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If anything's gonna get proof of Nosey, it's Marco Schnozolo.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. To be honest, not much happens around here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, too bad. I guess we'll just be forced to kick back and have fun.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah! We could take turns saving each other.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? (Snaps his fingers) Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (Blushes) Oh, sorry.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: As I was saying, being a lifeguard takes focus and concentration.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Focus, right.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: If you just keep a calm, cool head, you'll be fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) THE LAKE NOSE MONSTER!!!! EVERYBODY, (Rings the bell) OUT OF THE WATER!!! (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On a megaphone) GET OUT! RUN! (Screams)

Name: Bob
Dialog: Huh? Wha--? What?

Name: Bob
Dialog: Everyone, please, calm down! (The crowd stampedes on him)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Pulling a woman's arm) Go, ma'am, leave your child! There's no time! (Whistle blows) Save yourself!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Blows whistle) Hey, Candace!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Everybody calm down! We're safe, look! (Picks the "Lake Nose Monster" up) It-- It's just some driftwood.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Driftwood? (Chuckles nervously) Sorry, everyone. It's safe. You can come back, okay?

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Comes out of his stampede hole and snaps his fingers) That was not okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? (Chuckles) Thank goodness, I-- I thought you were the guy with my hot wings. In two more minutes, my order will be free! Yes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh for crying out loud! (Takes the hot wings) Fine. Okay, what was that? 15 bucks? All right, here's 10, 11, I got more here. Hold on. 1, 2, 3, 4, there! $15! And don't forget your tip! (Presses a button on the steering wheel, activating a diving helmet trap. He chuckles) Pretty good, huh? (Camera zooms out) So, Perry the Platypus... (Bites off a hot wing) I bet you're wondering why I'm sitting down here at the bottom of a lake. Well, the answer is simple. Mmm-mmm! This is really good, man. You want some? (Takes a box with the red wings) Here, here. (Perry takes a hot wing) Take the blue cheese. (Perry takes the blue cheese and pours it on the red wing) Do you know, I-- I prefer the ranch. Take the blue cheese. (Perry bite the red wing, and Doof holds up a napkin) Here's a napkin. (Perry takes the napkin) Anyway, the answer why I'm here is simple. Zinc. Lake Nose has a ton of zinc, and this machine goes around and filters all the zinc from the water. (Camera zooms out, showing a zinc tank) See, see? Zinc! So I figured I'd go around collecting all the zinc, and then use that zinc in some evil way to rule the world! You know, with zinc. Just think of the evil uses that off with zinc! (Pause. He looks around) I mean, seriously, can you think of some? Cause I got nothing. (Walks to a chart) I mean, look at here with all the good uses for zinc. Huh? All this good stuff, and over here? Nothing. All I got is "Some evil "Zinc Ray-Inator" or something, and, and look here! I wrote "Big laundry". I-- I don't even remember what the reason was, so I assumed I remembered some big genius Idea. Big laundry. (Deep voice) Big laundry. (Normal voice) I, it-- It's crazy! I'm a crazy person.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (snap) Okay! Candace, since it's your first day and you are understandably eager to impress old Captain Webber, I'll give you another chance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you, Captain Webber. Don't worry, from now on, I'll be okay.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (snap) Okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, at least the beach is empty now. (to jeremy) It makes our lives a lot easier.

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, is this where they saw Nosey?

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: You bring the camcorder?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So...many...people!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. Just stick with me and I'll get you through this, okay?

Name: Bob
Dialog: (snap) Okay! Jeremy, we're gonna have to move you down to Station 7 to cover this crowd, okay?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, okay.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (snap) Okay! (leaves) Candace, you stay here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: WHAT?! Wait...by myself?! But—

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Let's be unsafe!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: I'm gonna run with scissors!

Name: Woman
Dialog: I brought some glass to the beach!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Here, Nosey, Nosey, Nosey. Hey, look, Ferb, it's a red herring! I say we follow it and see where it leads us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What was that? (The giant line begins moving and comes apart.) Check the perimeter cameras! (Ferb walks up to the perimeter cameras, but one by one, they all also go offline.) Without the cameras down here, we're— (The lights go off) blind.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Emergency power on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So much for getting proof. What was that? Did we find the Lake Nose Monster?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No. (The chomped off camera sinks down.) It found us. (The lights go out.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, fire it up! (Ferb flicks a switch and we hear the turbine engines rolling.) Cool! That's weird. All the cameras are still down. It's gonna be much harder to get proof that Nosey exists now. You man the starboard window, I'll go portside. (A sea creature appears behind him.) We'll see who spots Nosey first. (Phineas looks at the menacing creature behind him.) I win! (to Nosey) Stay calm. (Nosey growls and Ferb backs away) No sudden movements. Okay, try panicking and making a lot of sudden movements. (Nosey grabs the camera that Ferb is holding and sinks down and smashes it to pieces with his tail.) I don't think Nosey was attacking us at all. He was just going after the cameras. He must not want the world to know he really exists.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It was either back up the fire escape or lose the pants altogether. Then suddenly it hit me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Hey, watch it, brats! (Cut to her approaching a couple of kids burying their friend in the sand.) No! You're supposed to bury everything except the head! Hey, no! We do not drink the lake water! (Cut to two kids holding cups. Wide shot to reveal an older man sipping the water through a drinking straw.) That goes for your children, too, sir!

Name: Little Girl
Dialog: Excuse me. My daddy came to see Nosey, but I'm scared. Is he really coming back?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, I don't know, sweetie. I was being silly before and overreacted. Sometimes we see things that aren't really there, but don't worry. I promise I'll protect you if...I...see... (Wide shot of the lake. Nosey's head appears out of the water.) THE LAKE NOSE MONSTER!!! (Everyone jumps out of the water screaming.) Quick, kid, run as fast as your little legs can carry you! Follow the train tracks north! You should hit Ackerton by sundown! Blend in! It's a college town! Get a retail job and save up enough for a bus ticket to the Canadian border! Someone will get in touch with you when the coast is clear!

Name: Bob
Dialog: Candace! Is this your Lake Nose Monster?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (nervously) Surprise?

Name: Bob
Dialog: You're in big trouble, young man! (snap) Okay! Just a little prankster! We're safe!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I thought you said this would be funny.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It is! You got in trouble! (He laughs loud and long.)

Name: Bob
Dialog: Candace, what on earth are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm sorry, Captain Webber, I thought I saw—

Name: Bob
Dialog: I know. Look, I'll let you in on a secret. There is no Lake Nose Monster. It's just a little tall tale, like Bigfoot or that face on Mars. See, they pretend that Nosey is real so tourists from all over the world come here and buy Nosey T-shirts and snowglobes. But.. (Throws the snowglobe away)

Name: Man
Dialog: (offscreen) Ow!

Name: Bob
Dialog: ...it's just pretend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Bob
Dialog: (snap) Okay! So that's it. No matter what you see, I never again want to hear you say—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) THE LAKE NOSE MONSTER!!!!! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!!! HURRY!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) Hey, do you still have that little digital camera you got for Bastille Day? (Ferb takes it out and gives it to his stepbrother. Phineas snaps a photo. This angers Nosey more. He goes up to the window.) Bup-bup-bup, check this out. (He throws the camera on the ground and it shatters to pieces. He stomps on the remains.) See, boy? Your secret's safe with us. (Nosey smiles and disappears.) Hey! Where'd he go? (Nosey appears in the submarine) Is it me, or is the Lake Nose Monster easier to find than Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmmm... Ooh, wow! (chuckles) Time out, man, I need a breather. (He falls to the floor on his back) Oh! I wish I didn't eat the hot and spicy right after the honey glazed. Speaking of wishes, you know what I never understood? Genies. They tell you to wish for anything you want and then they add some terrible twist. Like you-you wish to jump high, so he turns you into a frog. What—? Why? Who gains from this? The genie? I— Where's the benefit? (Perry gets out a device to make his escape.) You should be fighting genies, man, not me. I'm not the problem. Genies. Genies are the problem. (gasp) I got it! (Perry stops cutting through the bars and Doof sits up) Zinc foil! (Pause as Doof lies back down) Eh, not really evil, is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here. You want some corn dogs, boy? (Nosey sniffs the dogs and smiles. He takes a big bite out of them. He smiles and claps his fins happily.) He likes it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! Someone's calling! (Cut to a videophone. Phineas answers it. Baljeet appears on screen.) Y'ello?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas, is your refrigerator running?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, we don't have a refrigerator, Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Then you better go catch it? (The gang all stare. Baljeet speaks to someone offscreen.) I thought you said that would be funny.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (appearing onscreen) It was! You look stupid! (laughs) It works on so many levels. (feed gets cut off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Nosey. This is just our videophone. See, when we talk to people, we can see them on this screen. (Shows an image of himself and Nosey on the screen.) And this is what they see. (Nosey gasps.) What's wrong? (Nosey gets welled up with tears and snarls and leaves.) Oh, wait, no! We weren't taking your picture! Come back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe he fired me. And this time I actually saw it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (approaching her) Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know it sounds crazy, Jeremy, but I saw it, I really did! I mean, not the times when I saw it and it wasn't it, but this last time, when I saw it and it was it! You believe me, don't you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well...mm...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) It's okay. Earlier this morning, I wouldn't have believed me either. In fact, I was even mocking my... (gets an idea) brothers! That's it! They'll vindicate me! They're out there right now getting proof that Nosey is real!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I can't believe it! We were probably the first people Nosey ever trusted and look what happened. Come on, Ferb! Let's suit up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it looks like we got all of the zinc from this area. It's time to move on to the next quadrant! "Quadrant." "Quad-rant." Quad—It's—It's a weird word when you think about it. "Quadrant." "Quad-rant." (Perry resumes filing the bars.) Quad—It's—See? Now it doesn't even sound like a word.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look! It's Nosey! (Cut to Nosey looking sad.) He doesn't look too good. (They swim up to him.)  What's the matter, boy? (Nosey groans. Phineas looks at his watch.) Oh, no. The zinc levels in the lake seem to be dropping. Nosey needs zinc in order to survive. (Ferb takes out the sunblock their mother gave them earlier.) Sunblock? With zinc! Good thinkin', Ferb! Here, Nosey, this'll make you feel better. (Phineas pours some sunblock onto Nosey's head. Nosey revives but then looks scared at something and swims away.) Where do you suppose he's going? (The ground shakes) What's that? (Doofenshmirtz's device comes up to them and sucks practically everything in its path. Phineas and Ferb hold onto a branch. Nosey returns and hits it.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wait, w-what was that? (Perry jumps out of the scuba mask and the bars drop off.) Huh? You were trying to escape?! After I shared my wings with you! Well, granted,  I did trap you like a monkey— (Perry punches him.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Nosey! (Phineas and Ferb take off their helmets.) We understand now. If we prove to the world that you really exist, they'd never just let you live here in peace, huh? (Nosey shakes his head and dives down.) It's too bad you don't exist, Nosey, cuz if you did, I think we'd become great friends. (Winks. Nosey winks back.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I said, "John, it's great, I love the tune but the words. 'All you need is a Phillips head screwdriver', it just doesn't really ring true, does it?" (Phineas and Ferb reappear on the boat.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got you now, Perry the Platyp— (He trips on a wing. The lair rams into the submarine and the boat begins speeding.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oho!  There was simply no way we could get through the entire petting zoo—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh, any day now. Hey, where are you going?! (Perry goes into the bathroom and slams the door.) Oh—Oh, I see. (The toilet is heard flushing) That's—That's the hot wings working there. Ha ha ha. (A knocking is heard. Pan left to reveal Perry outside the lair.) Hey, how did you—?! Oh, you got out through the—I—I see.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: So, anyway, there I was, four hours from the nearest dental supply store...

Name: Lawrence and Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Bob
Dialog: Mmm...delicious. Best hot wings in town. (snap) Okay! I think I'll go for a little swim. That whole "waiting 20 minutes after you eat" thing is all a big hoax. (Takes out a snowglobe.) It's just so we can sell these cool "Kid with a cramp" snowglobes. (Bob wades in the lake and looks through his binoculars.) Hmm. That boat's moving pretty fast. I'd better get out of the w—Oh! Cramp!

Name: Bob
Dialog: Can't move! (Cut to a shot of the snowglobe followed by a closeup of Bob's lips like in Citizen Kane.) Nosebud. (He drops the snow globe. Candace jumps on Bob and gets him out of the way.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: ...and that is how I caught Big Mouth Ramone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool story, Dad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How you feeling, Captain Webber?

Name: Bob
Dialog: (snap) Okay! Thanks to you, Candace. How would you like to be reinstated as a Lake Nose lifeguard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well... (snap) Okay!

Name: Bob
Dialog: Don't get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did you get it? Did you get the proof that Nosey really exists?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I can honestly tell you that a ferocious, man-eating lake monster does not exist in Lake Nose.

Name: Guy
Dialog: Aw, man!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. So does a non-ferocious, friendly lake monster exist? Do you have proof of that? Hmm?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do we have proof? No. (winks, points and smiles)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, if such a creature did exist, I believe its habitat and safety would be all of our responsibility to look after and protect.

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute. Everyone, that British kid is saying something really, really...boring.

Name: Kid
Dialog: Yeah, let's get out of here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I didn't think it was boring, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what I think? I think you two found Nosey, but you didn't bring back any proof, specifically just to make me look foolish, in front of all of these— (Sees a chomped camera in the lake) Wait a minute. (Picks it up) Look at this! Only one thing could've made a bite mark this big! Yes! I have proof! Now they'll have to...believe...me... (Sees the sad expressions on her brothers' faces.) Or maybe you were specifically trying to protect Nosey. (Phineas smiles.) Oh. I'm gonna have to do the right thing here, aren't I?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're proud of you, sis. (Ferb gives a thumbs up.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throwing the camera in the garbage) Yeah, yeah. Candace is crazy, but the monster is safe. (Nosey appears out of the water and smiles at Candace.) Oh, great. Look who finally showed up! (Nosey kisses her.)  Fine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, looks like I'm stuck down here. Guess I'll have time to figure out what "big laundry" mea—Oh. (sees a huge pile of dirty clothes) Oh, that's right. It's Tuesday. (gasps) I know! (runs to the bathroom) I can get out the same way Perry the Platypus did! (Toilet is heard flushing and water comes out from under the door.) Oh! Oh! Oh, that didn't work at all! Oh, now I really gotta do the laundry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What to do, what to do, what to do today. Any ideas, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about you, Perry? Bursting with any plans?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah. I'll never get tired of you doing that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome. (Chatters) Come on, Ferb. Fire one off.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Chatters)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder what that means.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! I know what we're gonna do today! Let's build a Perry translator. We can finally figure out what (Chatters) means. Some say he's just a mindless platypus, but he might actually be thinking some profound thoughts. Just like another quiet animal I know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, it's been four days. (Rolls her chair to a picture referencing Cinderella. The faces are replaced with Candace and Jeremy's faces) I'm not expecting Prince Charming to bring me a glass slipper or anything, but a phone call would be nice. (Phone beeping) Hold on, I've got another call. (Gasps) (Holds up the phone, showing a heart with Jeremy's face in it) It's him! Call you back! Bye! (Phone beeps) Hello?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. It's Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, good morrow to you, sir.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Chuckles) I mean, what's up?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I just got the new Destruction Mayhem 3 game. I thought maybe you'd like to come over and try it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Oh, yeah, you, me, and little Suzy playing a video game, huh?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy? No. She's at her friend's house. (The door knocks and he pauses the game) Uh, hold on, Candace. Someone's at the door. (Opens the door)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Panting) So, video games?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All set over here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Now all we need is our subject. Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. Sorry about the lights. We're using an alternative energy source, and haven't got it working smoothly yet. I decided it was high time our operation went green. All right, assignment, assignment. Oh, let's see... We're saving paper by printing on the same one over and over again, so... Uh, sorry for the life on me. (Turns the paper, showing black ink all over it) I can't make this out. Hmm... Well, I'm sure it says something about Doofenshmirtz. Go get him!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Gets up and walks off-screen) For crying out loud, Carl, (Carl is seen pedaling the generator, panting) pedal faster. I gotta check my E-mail.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! (Perry switches to pet mode. Phineas walks on-screen) Oh, there you are. Come on, boy. Here, just take a seat. (Puts him on a stool) Stay. All set.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Holding up a mic) Okay, Perry. It's time to hear what's on your mind. Hit me with your (Chatters) shot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Ferb and I invented a Perry translator so we can finally figure out what he's saying.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's great. (Her face becomes sheepish) But don't you need Perry to be here for it to work?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Turns his head, noticing Perry is gone) That was weird. Perry was here a second ago.

Name: Translator
Dialog: I sure love worms. (Phineas and Ferb hear this and turn to Isabella, thinking she said that)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Don't look at me.

Name: Translator
Dialog: Big, fat, juicy worms!

Name: Translator
Dialog: Gotta find 'em, gotta eat 'em!

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Whoa.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello, birdie. Do you understand me?

Name: Translator
Dialog: Aren't you a little young for inter-speciel communication?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes I am. How about you, squirrel? Do you understand me? (Points the mic at the squirrel)

Name: Translator
Dialog: Oh, I do. Do you have any nuts for me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's so cute.

Name: Squirrel
Dialog: (Squeaks)

Name: Translator
Dialog: Yeah yeah yeah, I'm cute. I'm cute. Now, nut me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. This works on all animals.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, do you think it would work on my dog, Pinky? He barks at the door when a doorbell rings on TV. I'd love to explain the whole concept to him.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Couldn't hurt to try.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Runs off) Great! I'll be right back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! With a device like this, all animals can finally say what's on their minds.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm really glad you wanted to come over, Candace. Most girls really aren't into stuff like this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pssh. Most girls. I guess I'm just cool like that. Yup, love me my video games. (A poodle pops up) Who's this?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, that's Suzy's dog. (Rubs her head) Who's a good girl? Who's a good girl? Yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Who's the good girl? Who's the good girl?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Obviously, not me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Don't be shy, It's just me. Come here. (A cage falls) (Laughs) You like my new cage? I got it from a second-hand shark supply store. It was half off, because you know, something bit half of it off. So, here's my evil plan

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I see what you're saying, but you don't have an argument. They're giving you 12 cans a day. Technically, you're not underfed. All right, next!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh yeah. I've been getting a lot of complaints about the vacuum. Just let it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, look at this. I'm getting the hang of it. (Game beeping)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, actually Candace, you just paused it. (Game sounds) And now you've reset the game.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Oh no. These we're brand new.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, bad dog! That's weird. Suzy trained her so well.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Suspiciously) I see. Suzy trained her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe this. Hey, that's my shoe!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, okay in there, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. (at poodle) (Gasps) Don't even think about it! (Gasps, throws paper towels into toilet)

Name: Poodle
Dialog: (Drops shoe)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where's my shoe? No, no, no! (Grunting)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Ready for the third level? (Door slams) Candace?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's up?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay. We've got 78 complaints about food quantity, 42 requests for belly rubs, and we're still trying to explain TV to Pinky.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Again, forget the idea of little people in there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, what exactly are we supposed to do with this information?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm...

Name: Ginger
