Dialog: Okay. The Jones's hamster is gonna lose it if someone doesn't oil the wheel in its cage.

Name: Hamster
Dialog: Hmph!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Well, what now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's what we'll do. Let's tell all the owners what their pets want! Starting with this little fella right here. (hamster squeaks) Sorry. Lady. Lady right here. (at Candace) Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We made an animal translator! We'll tell you all about it later. Right now we're on a mission. Come on, guys.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See ya, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: An animal translator? I have had it up to HERE with stupid animals today! Why would you wanna know what stupid animals are saying? Oh, I can tell you what they'll say

Name: Doberman
Dialog: (barks into mic)

Name: Translator
Dialog: Get her!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Band members
Dialog: Oof! (Groaning)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, with a push of this button, we will move out of the automobile age, and USHER IN THE AGE OF THE BO-AT! I'm driving on water! Look at me! I'm BO-AT-ing! Woo-hoo! Living the dream! Perry the Platypus? How did-- I always forget you are a semi-aquatic mammal. (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz in the face)

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOM! MOM! ANIMALS HATE ME!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey. That's just ridiculous. Perry likes you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) Huh. Huh. Never mind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Don't open the Metropolitan Oval Aquatic Trench! (moat opens up) No, no, no, no, no, no! Hey, look! It spells "MOAT". I never noticed that before. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! You're here! Come on, come on! You gotta see this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, will you--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! (gasps) I can't believe it. Everything is still here. There it is! They built an animal translator!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that's adorable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. No, it is not!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. We built an animal translator. Look!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? You're gonna see. It really works! Heeheeheeheehee.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Perry. We've been waiting all day for this.

Name: Translator
Dialog: (plays back Perry's chatter)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, well. I guess it doesn't mean anything.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Aw, you know he's saying, "You guys are the best!" Now, come on everyone. Inside for some lemonade.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bu-bu-bu-bu-bu-bu-bu-bu-but... (sighs)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, where'd you go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I-

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I brought you your shoe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, don't worry. I washed it. Here. Allow me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? You 'kay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Enchanted.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, yes. The Daily Crossword puzzle. Today's theme

Name: Linda
Dialog: The Ferrule.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, of course. 2, across; Uh, the tip on the elbow. Honey?

Name: Linda
Dialog: The olecranon.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I thought so. Yes, easy-peasy, that one. Next, the tip of the shoelace. Yes, yes, that little hard tip at the end of a shoelace is... Honey?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't know.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You don't know?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! It's like living with a bunch of monkeys! Just look it up on the computer!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But isn't it weird none of us know it's name?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, that's why they make smart word box for tell monkey hard brain hurty things.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Removing prepositions makes it more condescending.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow. 20 people emailed me the same video. I gotta check this out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Laughs) That is so humiliating. I have to send this to Jeremy, Jenny, The Track Team, Chicago Joe-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, uh, Candace? Smart word box find name shoelace tip?

Name: Phineas/Ferb
Dialog: (Imitates sizzling)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. Could you wait? I'm dealing with something that matters here. Ugh! The internet crashed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know. Baljeet! This kinda stuff is right up his alley.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Useless Shoelace Facts, Volume 8. "The plastic or metal tip on the end of a shoelace is called an... aglet. A-G-L-E-T. It is one of the most useful, yet tragically ignored inventions in all of history".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gosh, Ferb. That seems like a great injustice, huh. (At Baljeet) Oh well, thanks Baljeet.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay. A-G-L-E-T. Brilliant!

Name: Linda

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I can't take anymore! I'm just gonna call him!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking out the window) Hey, what's with all these kids?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's what I thought! Phineas and Ferb! I've so got them this time! (She snaps a photo with her phone, but looks at it to see a lot of fists in the air.) I can't send that to Mom! 'Scuse me! Comin' through! One side!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey! No cuttin' in line!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's my backyard! I outrank you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Goldie's Aqueous Extravaganza.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh! Yaaaahh! (She lands in the aquarium.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, our sister, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! Ablblblblblblblblblblblblblblbl...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the spirit, Candace! Everybody!

Name: All
Dialog: (wagging their tongues) Ablblblblblblblblblblblblblblbl...

Name: Candace
Dialog: MAKE THIS FISH PUT ME DOWN!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a mammal, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way to go, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did I get in this fish show?!?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mammal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! You're a natural, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look at that! (an octopus swims by) Ferb, where did the octopus come from?

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Must...take...picture! (She snaps a pic.) Send!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I've gotta tell you, I read your first book and I love it.

Name: Bridgette Oshinomi
Dialog: Do you have a high-strung teen at home?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, you could say that. (her phone beeps) Ooh, this must be her.

Name: Bridgette Oshinomi
Dialog: She sent you a picture? Lemme see.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well...okay.

Name: Bridgette Oshinomi
Dialog: How bad can it be? After all, I've been through with own— (She sees the picture of Candace freaking out) Oh. (gives the phone back to Linda) I think that you need the rest of the set. (gives two books) Uh, and why don't you take a whack at that first book again?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, Perry the Platypus, (activating his inator) it is time for revenge! Goodbye, hot dog street ven— (Perry pushes Doof to the ground.) Oh, what the?! How did you get out of my trap? (Cut to reveal a wooden Perry in the trap with a tag saying "DECOY" on it.) A decoy? That doesn't even make any sense! But, okay, I surrender, I'm a reasonable man. (reaching around) I know when it's time to (grabs a bratwurst and whacks Perry with it) fight back! Waa-ha! (Perry wipes away the grease on his fur, takes off his fedora, and produces a hot dog from out of it.) Woo-ho-ho. Your hot dog is no match for my bratwurst!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, just kidding! I—But I made you look, didn't I? Huh? Huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute, is that Jeremy? What's he doing here? (Gets slapped by an orca tail.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, did you get my messages?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Messages? (Gets slapped by another orca tail and looks at her phone, while riding the dolphin.) Eleven messages? (Rides the dolphin, which goes through a hoop held up by Ferb.) He called me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Go, Candace!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not so hotsy-totsy now! Are you, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Computer
Dialog: Fire.

Name: Candace
Dialog: He called me! I can't believe he really called me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What happened to all the fish? (slips on the ice) Aaaaaaaahhh!!! (She falls and gets caught by Jeremy.) Oh, my!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! You were great back there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great show, Ferb! I don't remember freezing the tank being part of the finale, but that rocked! Looks like it didn't freeze all the way through. Nice.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, so what? Big deal. So it missed it's initial target. A minor setback. (Perry puts his finger on one of the bratwursts in the pile.) No wait! You'll disrupt the pile's equilibrium! (Perry takes the bratwurst out, nothing happens.) Well, hot diggity do— (All the bratwursts fall onto Doofenshmirtz and crash through the building and go down the streets.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I've been trying to call all day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh... hehehehehehehehehehehe...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (puts her down) Do you wanna go do something?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Omigosh, yes! (She bends down, and her butt somehow causes the ice block to move, taking the stadium seats with it. Linda's station wagon parks.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Really, you didn't even look at your messages?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I know.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's okay, Candace. You looked like you were pretty busy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi, Mrs. Flynn.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You have to come to the backyard! (Pushes Linda into the backyard) Phineas and Ferb built a whole aquarium with whales and everything!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'll call ya in a little while.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You'll see! (Closes eyes) Tada!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Look, honey! I brought ya a book.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did Jeremy just say he'll call me in a little while? (gets out her phone and dials) How long is that supposed to be?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess Goldie and her friends are headed to the ocean.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, you know what they say, if you love something, set it free.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we do that every day with Perry. (Perry, also up in the tree, chatters.) Oh, there you are, Perry, we were just talkin' about you.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Are you takin' a shower now?

Name: Herman
Dialog: (offscreen, obnoxiously) Yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: As president of the Healthy Dessert Club, I declare that nothing says low-calorie, non-fat more than gelatin.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You wouldn't have started this club because gelatin is Jeremy's favorite dessert, would you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? No!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew! Gross! Phineas and Ferb! Your smelly rodent pet is germing up the cabinets! Where are those two?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right here, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But how? How did you get there? How did you get where you are so fast?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, we're just putting the finishing touches on our molecular transporter. Would you like to try?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do I look like someone who wants their moleculars transported? Now get that stinky pet out of our cabinets and go scramble your molecules somewhere else!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (To Candace) Bye, Candace!

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Would you guys like to try some of our gelatin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, wait! They'll just end up doing something weird and ruin the party!

Name: Jenny
Dialog: How is sharing gelatin with them gonna ruin the party?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Eye twitches) Some... how?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You want cherry or grape?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grape, please.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, wait.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, guys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I guess that wasn't too weird.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's as fun to eat as the crazy, fun things you can do with it.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: The cartilaginous fibers from the bovine patella structure, that gelatin's extracted from, gives it that fun, bouncy quality.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What did I tell you? Weird. Now, let the professional handle this before it gets out of hand. Why don't you make your own gelatin and leave us alone?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! I'm not finished!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stay away from me and my friends and my gelatin that I don't want ruined with your ruiny ruinness. Hm. (To Stacy and Jenny) What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. Thanks for letting us use your pool as the largest gelatin mold ever.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You bet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, release the gelatin mix.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, ooh, ooh, may I add some of my favorite flavor?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure, buddy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (He pours in his favorite flavor) Hah-hah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On megaphone) Stirring team, commence mixing operations.

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Aye, aye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Wanda Acronym
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, glad you're here. Professor Poofenplotz has replaced all the fine handbags in the Tri-State area– Good grief! Perry the Platypus, what are you doing here? Your lair is across the street. Good day to you, sir.

Name: Wanda Acronym
Dialog: Ah. Agent Pinky, finally.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. I hear you took a wrong tube and ended up over in Wanda's division. Well, Doofenshmirtz has sent you a video message. Take a look.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On video) Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus. I'm sure you're getting this. I– I was hoping you would stop by today for some tea. See, I've got all these little tea things set out and ready and, um... Uh, please use the front entrance, Perry the Platypus, because– Uh, because, uh, all the other entrances don't work today. So bye-bye. I'll see you later today! Coming in through the front entrance.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So you see, Doofenshmirtz has invited you to tea. We don't know what it could possibly mean. We think– But don't hold us to this. We think that maybe, just maybe, it could be a trap. We do, however, like to give people the benefit of the doubt, uh, so try to have fun. Monogram out.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How's it lookin', Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks good. And judging by my chronometer here, it should be just about time. There's only one thing to do now.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You mean test the resiliency of our cartilaginous collusion with vigorous application of weight and velocity?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Exactly. Let's jump on it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And now for the themed gelatin sculpture part of our get-together. Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I made a pair of shoes. You know, 'cause I like shoes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nicely done. And how about yours, Jenny?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Well, I fashioned this dove to symbolize my desire for world peace and a true—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Get a load of my entry. It's Jeremy's head.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, he's dancing. (She dance as gelatin Jeremy head wiggles)

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Hey, what's that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That looks awesome.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: We should go over there and check it out.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Totally.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But that's just Phineas and Ferb and their friends.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Don't be so uptight.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, come on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nah, it's okay. Go ahead.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, if you're sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That does look kinda fun. Maybe I should... totally bust them for this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is nice, huh? You know, I was thinking the other day about how much better you would be as an ally. So I created this. I call it my Turn-Everything-Evil-Inator. Now, you just sit still. Okay, great. You know, after I turn you evil, we can use it to create a whole army of evil minions. Won't that be fun? Hold still. (Doofenshmirtz fires his -inator at Perry, while Perry dodges the rays) Hey. I'm beginning to think you don't want to be allies at all. I'm not trying to make it personal!

Name: Gelatin Monster
Dialog: Evil!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who added the evil flavor?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It's curry. It's not inherently evil. Maybe a little spicy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, I'm going home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the–?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait till Mom sees this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Muffled from inside the gelatin monster) You guys are so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess we gotta rescue Candace.

Name: Holly
Dialog: But do we fight a gelatin monster?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll beat him the same way we created him

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I know what we should do today!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: For Candace, our neighborhood and all the good gelatin left in the world!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I missed you several times, and I probably won't hit you anytime soon. I get that. But I must have hit lots of other things, and with a push of this button, those lots of other things will come to my side. And together we will defeat you!

Name: Gelatin Monster
Dialog: Master!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working. He's melting down the drain.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have got to reexamine my life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here they come, Perry the Platypus. Here they come, all of my minions. (He laughs) (A bar of soap and a toothbrush come to his side) I c– I– I could've sworn I hit more threatening stuff than this. Really, really pathetic.

Name: Gelatin Monster
Dialog: (Growling) Master.

Name: Gelatin Monster
Dialog: (The Gelatin Monster climbs up Doofenshmirtz's building, and enters his lair)'

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha, a gelatin monster. I knew there was going to be something fun. Get him! Now you can bow down before my cartilaginous creation. It's so corrupt and cantankerous and carnivorous and, uh... Uh, low in calories and ca– Ca– Cow– Couch. Hm. Ah, that's all I got.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My Turn-Everything-Evil-Inator! My monster! No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My Turn-Everything-Evil-Inator! My monster! No! My beautiful, fruit flavored monster! You come back here, Perry the Platy- (He slips on the bar of soap, and the toothbrush lands in his mouth)Whoa! Oof! Mm. This isn't the toothbrush I use to brush my teeth.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, there's everyone. Candace, I thought you were having your dessert party today? What are you doing at Isabella's?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got two words for you, Mom. Gel-a-tin. I am sick of it! Sick of it! Totally sick of it! (Snorts)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, I heard you were having a dessert party, so I made you this out of gelatin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw. Nah, I'm still sick of it.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: So kids, are you enjoying your visit to England?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, yes Grandpa. We even learned how to use real thatch.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Well, thatch terrific! (he laughs with Phineas) That was a good one.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There's nothing to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing for us to do.

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: What? Why don't you read my old collection of Sherlock Holmes? I've got the whole collection right here.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Gee. Thanks, Mrs. Fletcher.

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: Dinner's at 1900. That's 7 o'clock for you Yanks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, yes. Reading. That's what they did before they invented fun.

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: I heard that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it's better than nothing. (Both she and Stacy begin reading) Hmm? Mmm-hmm... Hmm...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, is everybody ready? We're going to take you kids to see the London Eye.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: One of our largest Ferris wheels in the entire universe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Girls, are you ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, wait, almost finished.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Candace, you stayed up all night just to finish that book?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no. We finished the whole collection.

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: Before they invented fun, indeed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? Oh, there he is.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: See you later, old boy. Be good now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz is up to no good here, in the UK. And, uh, after your last mission in London, we ran into some trouble with the British Spy Union. So joining you today is Agent Double 0-0. And joining me today is the lovely Inspector Initials.

Name: Inspector Initials
Dialog: Double 0-0, you and Agent P will be assigned the same mission against Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: You realize this man is a Platypus?

Name: Inspector Initials
Dialog: They're American, Double 0-0. Just be glad it's a mammal.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ooh. Rrreow. Well, go get him, Agent P.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: What? That's it? No files? No location? No contact? What kind of a mission is this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It was enough for the mammal.

Name: Inspector Initials
Dialog: Ooh. Rrreow.

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Alright, you lot. Have a splendid day in London. We'll be back tonight after the International Haggis Festival.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: There's twenty-nine individual flavors!

Name: Grandpa Reg
Dialog: Cheerio.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Here are your tickets for the London Eye. You might want to get in line now, 'cause it looks pretty crowded.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We'll pick you up around 4

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: Have fun!

Name: All but Ferb
Dialog: Bye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you know what? Ferb and I will meet you back here later. See ya!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Bye, guys! (to Candace) Hey, let's go shopping!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did you hear that? Even in England, my brothers have some scheme planned.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: How can you tell?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't have to be Sherlock Holmes to—Ooh! Stacy, that's it! Who did we stay up learning about? (she hakes her) Who is the total king of busting?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sherlock Holmes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Maybe I can finally bust the boys once and for all if I use Holmes's method of deduction! Come on. This will be fun! You could be Dr. Watson.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: That's it. We're taking my car.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: Now this is a motor car. It has pretty much everything. Radar, Subatomic Sonar, Nuclear Particle Response System, and a MP3 player. (Button beeps) Don't touch that, it's the ejector– (The seat ejects sending Double 0-0 flying out of the car, which eventually comes to a rest as Double 0-0 catches back up and retakes the driver's seat) And I suppose you think that's funny.

Name: Candace
Dialog: By using Holmesian Deduction, we'll be one step ahead of the boys. We can get Mom and finally show her–

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh. Shoes. (Stacy stops at a storefront)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy? I need you to focus!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sorry, sorry. Got a little distracted there. You know, London, cool stores, shopping.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they are! Now why are they going into an auto parts store? Alright, Watson. Here's where the deducing begins. (she gasps) They've acquired a fleet of automobiles. And they're in there buying a bunch of little air fresheners for them. Or... they're buying motor oil for their giant robot! What do you think, Stace? Stace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (returning with shopping bags) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Oh, who's your little friend here?

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: I'm Agent Double 0-0, from Her Majesty's secret service.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Double 0-0? I-isn't that just triple "O"?

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: No, that's not how you say it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It spells "OOO", does it?

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: It's just Double 0-0.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's "P" and you're "OO", so together you spell-

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: No, they're not "O"s, they're zeros. Alright?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was just going to say "Oop". Looks like I struck a nerve there!

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I must apologize, all of my traps are platypus-sized.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: What about this then? (he motions to a large rocket engine above them)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that. You see, as I get older, I find it's harder and harder to read my small, little wristwatch. So, I will launch Big Ben into space, and fly it all the way to the Tri-State Area. (He demonstrates on a scale model) La-la-la, here I am, la-la-la, I just woke up and want to know what time it is – Yes! I am a genius!

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: So that– That's your whole plan?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, in a nutshell, yes. What do you think?

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: Am I on one of those hidden camera shows? You realize you could just buy a bigger watch? Or maybe a wall clock?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, but then I would have to drive to a store, and find a parking space, then you have to choose from, like - dozens of styles, I- It just seems like so much work. This will be much less complicated.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (upon entering the auto parts shop) Okay, Watson. Excuse me sir, were these boys in here earlier?

Name: Worker
Dialog: Well, them two bics were 'angin' about an' they got a bit o' the bushies an', uh, also ran back an' carted off some ol' bangers that ah didn' need. Oi! Aren' they a bit harrish for them kind o' bushies?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Flipping through a Cockney for tourists book) I'm working on it. Ah! He said "They were here, they carted away some junk from out back, and, aren't they a little young to be doing that?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. Yes they are. (Stacy and Candace enter the back lot) Aha! It's crawling with clues out here! Hmm... Look at these circular indentations in the dirt. (She sniffing) And the subtle scent of rubber in the air. By Jove, Stacy! What could it be?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, "Free Tires"? (She looks at a sign advertising "Free Tires")

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe, maybe... We need more clues!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I think I'm close to figuring it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The rocket engines under Big Ben begin to start up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm going up to the top of the tower, I'm sure you two have a hot time together! (He laughs and exits)

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: Don't worry, Agent P. I'll have us out of these before you know it. (He activates a laser on his watch and begins cutting through the restraints)

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they are. (Phineas and Ferb get into a taxi that promptly pulls off) They dropped a notebook. The page is torn, but it says "To big race 1600 Water S." Water Street! The final clue! They're having a race at 1600 Water Street! Ooh, I gotta call Mom! (To her mom through the phone) And that's why you've gotta come down to 1600 Water Street. (She and Stacy arrive at 1600 Water Street which is nothing but an old abandoned building) Huh? I don't get it! I thought I'd figured it out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (On the phone) Hello? Hello? Candace, are you there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Mom. Disregard everything I said.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, sweetheart.

Name: Grandma Winifred
Dialog: Remember, no snacking. Dinner's at 1900.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, okay. See you later. (To Stacy) What if 1600 isn't a place, but a time?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I didn't get that impression.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Impression! Stacy, you're a genius. Wasn't it in one of those Holmes stories that they used pencil lead to reveal an impression on paper? Well, if my hunch is right... (She takes an impression of the missing half of the page) "To do today

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: (firing his laser) Just a few more minutes.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: Ow! Oh, there you go. Good thing I had the watch laser. Now Doofenshmirtz took the stairs, but if we work our way up the inner mechanism of the clock, he'll never see us coming.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow! Candace, you're amazing! You totally figured it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I guess I did. Now, on to the busting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Operating the water slide) Next!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys! Do you like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I figured you guys were up to something. The tires, the pipes, I see what those were for, but what was with the pineapple?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that was for Ferb. He was hungry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mocking) Oh, and the butter too, huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no. He's using that for speed.

Name: Referee
Dialog: (Inside the car) It's a new world record!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom's gonna flip when she sees about this! (She starts dialing the phone, but the grabber takes her up the tower and she goes down the slide, screaming)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (answering the phone) Hello? (Candace tries to speak, but her speech is gibberish due to a bumpy area in the slide)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Someone with a thick cockney accent. (she turns off her phone) Wrong number.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Can I take a turn?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Go for it. (Stacy goes up) Last customer of the day. (He goes up too)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Whoo-hoo! (slides off, lands in Candace's car)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's what I'm talking about! (slides off, lands in car)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh! It's 4

Name: Linda
Dialog: (not hearing this) I hope the kids had fun today.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On top of the tower) Well, It's about time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! Mom, Mom!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (seeing Big Ben about to launch, taps on Candace's shoulder) Uh...Candace?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not now, Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But --

Name: Candace
Dialog: (she bangs on glass more) Mom! Mom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz laughs maniacally) Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (landing on the water slide Phineas and Ferb Built) Hey, look at this! It's like a ride! (part of the slide begin coming off) Woo-hoo! Cannonball! (The entire slide breaks into pieces and land in the water. Doofenshmirtz lands on the pavement) Well, I was expecting a bigger splash...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Watching it all) Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Here come the girls!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you gotta– !

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look at your cute outfit!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you gotta look at– (Candace motions towards Big Ben)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Big Ben! Gorgeous!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deadpan) But-but-but-but-but...

Name: Winifred
Dialog: Ah, here come the boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom, you missed all the fun.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Looks like we did. All right, let's catch a cab and head home. Come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like Candace and Stacy did some shopping.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I'll never understand fashion.

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: Ah-ha! Well, that took longer than I thou— Wait! (He looks at watch several times and sighs) Oh, I wish I had a bigger watch.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: "Boys are human beings too. (Camera rotates, showing Stacy holding the magazine) If you're interested in one of them, make them feel comfortable by asking him questions about himself." Okay, they lost me at the "boys/human beings" thing.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, this article specifically says not to growl psychotically. It makes boys feel uncomfortable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look at them down there. Planning something. Oh, I'm gonna bust them today for sure.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's what you say everyday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that's because they build something everyday. Seems like every time I get Mom and I'm ready to bust, their stupid invention disappears.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, looks to me like you're going about this the wrong way. Don't focus on the boys; focus on the invention. If you can find out where the stuff goes, maybe you can take your Mom there and she'd finally see the evidence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! Stacy, you're a genius!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, go figure! Would you call my mom and tell her that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yo.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, you know how you guys, like, build stuff everyday?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you know how you make it disappear at the end of the day?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And-- What do you mean "No"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't make it disappear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Scoffs) Well, then where does it go?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't know what happens to it, but it helps with cleanup. And Ferb here says to never look a gift horse in a mouth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So you're telling me you're not even a slightest bit curious as to where the thing goes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I guess we're a little bit curious. Hmm... Why don't Ferb and I build something and you guys keep your eyes on it? Maybe you can find out where the thing goes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sounds like a plan! (At Stacy) A plan of busting! (They high-5, at Phineas) All right boys, make it big and make it obvious.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now remember, we can't take our eyes off of this for even a second.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What if I need to blink?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here! (Pulls out an aerosol can) Use this! Saline solution.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, (Opens Ferb's welding mask) where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What do you think, too much? Oh, I'm just getting into the mood. I'm going to Vegas this weekend. (Pause) Okay. (Takes a sheet) Our sources tell us that Doofenshmirtz is working on an invisibility ray, and that can't be good. Get out there and put a stop to it. (Perry runs off) And may luck be with you! Lady luck, baby! Hot-cha.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just building a big and obvious ride in our backyard!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool! Can I ride it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nobody riding anything! We're just gonna watch it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace wants to see where it goes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa! What is that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. It's just another one of their cool rides. Just get behind us and help us watch it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: How's my schedule?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, right now you're just carrying me around like luggage.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We're in!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? You're just in time. (Pulls out a remote) Just in time to be trapped! (Presses the remote button. A crashing sound is heard. Perry looks around for the trap) Didn't Major Monogram tell you I was working on an invisible ray?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, I made one, and now you're in an invisible cage. And so you don't get bored, I put in an invisible tin cup in there for you to play with.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, see? Fun with sound. Behold, Perry the Platypus, (Presses the remote button) my Invis-inator! (The Invis-inator fires) And why would I need an Invisibility ray like this, you ask? Well, you know when those cute, little Fireside Girls come by to sell their-- Their cupcakes, or their-- Or their raffle tickets or whatever?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And you forgot to close your shades, (Gretchen and Katie walk up to the door. Gretchen knocks the door) so they come to the front door, and they could see you! (Gretchen and Katie peek through the window) They could see you, watching TV or whatever, (Doofenshmirtz sits back) and you can't pretend that you're not home (Doofenshmirtz sinks in his chair) because they can see you! And they have those big, pleading eyes making you feel guilty, and-- (Scene switches back to Doofenshmirtz) So, I'm just gonna shoot them with a ray so I don't have to look at them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! No shuteye, girly.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus, the entire Tri-State Area-- (Scratching) Hey, what-- What are you doing? Is that an invisible file? You've forced my hand! I have no choice (Presses the button) but to open the trap door, (The door opens) and releases the invisible tiger! (Turns around) Hmm... Uh, are you feeling any biting or scratching in there, because--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Is seen with his coat scratched, carrying a whip and chair) Back, you tiger! Ow! Where-- Where are you? So I can snap my whip at you! (Snaps the whip twice) Get in there! Get back, get back! (Drops the whip and presses the button) In there! (The door closes) I attribute that to poor planning. (Throws away the chair) If I had the tiger door inside your cage, you would have been-- (Gets hit by Perry swinging on a rope. Doofenshmirtz rolls into the Invis-inator's ray) Now, Perry the Platypus, you can never be sure where the final strike will come from. (Perry turns around) Ah, I'm an imperceptible enigma. I move in silence-- (Perry kicks him) Ow! Oh you followed the sound of my voice, maybe I should stop talk-- (Perry punches and kicks him) Ow, ow, ow! Quit it! (He knocks down a chair and rolls into the Invis-inator's ray, causing him to become visible again) Interesting! If you're already invisible, it turns you visible again-- (Perry throws the chair at him) Ow! Oh well that came out of nowhere.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, how long is this gonna take?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean it usually disappears as soon as the kids are done playing on it-- (Gets an idea) Oop! Wait a minute, that's it! (At the gang) You guys gotta play on it! Go! Go have fun! Go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Is seen sitting on Baljeet) Eh, my schedule's flexible.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I used to be.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs) WOO-HOO-HOO! OH BUFORD LOVES THIS!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it, laugh. Laugh while you still can.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Look at you! You're just a bottom! (Perry punches him) Oh, it's on now! (Charges at Perry, who throws him over. Doofenshmirtz's body is now half invisible) Oop! Look at me! I'm just a top!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, fun's fun! Now everybody, back in your seats! Now if we just keep watching it...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any minute now... (Horn honks. Candace gasps) I can't believe it! Mom's home! (The Invis-inator's ray hits the ride) There's no way she's gonna miss the-- (Notices the ride disappeared. She screams) Phineas, what did you do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't... Th-th-- Think I did anything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, it's Mom! It only happens when she comes home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Do me a favor and just back down the driveway a bit!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, okay. (She backs away. The Invis-inator's ray is heard)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any changes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believed that worked! (At Linda) Okay Mom, come back! Come back! (Linda drives back. The Invis-inator's ray hits the ride, causing it to disappear)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's gone again!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, how are you doing that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back back back back back! (Shoves the car backwards. She steps around the spot) There's gotta be some kind of sensor in the driveway! (Camera switches to Linda) But where is it? (Camera switches to Candace stepping around the spot) It's gotta be here somewhere! (Ray fires)

Name: Kids
Dialog: It's back! (Candace looks back, leaning) It's gone! (Candace leans forward) It's back! (Candace leans backward) It's gone! (Candace repeatedly leans forward and backward) Back! Gone! Back! Gone!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Looks out the window) Candace, you obviously have some issues with the driveway. I'm just gonna park in front. (Backs away to the front of the house. The ray fires, and the ride come back)

Name: Kids
Dialog: It's back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, she can see it from the front yard! (Runs to the car) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a sec, honey. I'm getting my stuff.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! (The ray fires, and the ride disappears) No!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace, it's still here! It's just invisible!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! (Runs to the backyard) It's still here?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, check this out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hum... (Gasps) Paint!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (With grocery bags) Candace, where are you going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll be right back! (At the garage she grabs a can of paint, then runs back) Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You think you've beaten me, but you haven't, 'cause I can turn the Invis-inator into a Disintegrator, with just the simple (Pushes a button. The ray prepares to fire) push of a button!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, I was using that!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey kids!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I got some--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Running excitedly, with the can of paint) Coming through!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You'll see! Everyone will see! (Cackles maniacally. She dumps the paint on the spot where the ride was, causing the paint to splat on the grass. Candace drops the paint can) I don't understand! I don't understand! (Tries to feel the ride) I just don't understand!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I have no idea what you're up to, but you're more that welcome to join us for cookies when you're done cleaning up. (At the kids) Come on kids!

Name: Kids
Dialog: Yeah!/Cool!/Go Mom!/Buford loves cookies!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, we were all watching it, and Quantum Theory states that the mere observation of an experiment changes its outcome.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now you tell me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, what's that noise? (Gurgling continues) Is that your stomach?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I'm hungry, too. That trendy restaurant Mom and Dad took us to last night wasn't exactly satisfying.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, can I borrow your glasses? I can't see my entrée. You know, because it's so small.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, I think we got that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How hard is it to have a trendy restaurant that's fun to go to, and has great food? That's it. I know what we're gonna do today, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Phone rings) S'up, Stace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, are you sitting down? I don't want you to have an aneurism.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why would I have an aneurism?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: 'Cause someone just IM'd me that someone else heard someone else overhear that Jeremy is gonna call you and ask you out for a special evening tonight! (Both squeal) Candace, do you need medical attention?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. I need attention... from the doctor of love!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Paging Dr. Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Doctor, I got a fever.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Deep voice) Well, let me take care of that, little lady.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, a special evening. (Phone beeps) It's my call waiting.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, just calling to remind you...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, it wasn't him.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Don't worry, he'll call.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I decided to build a restaurant. Hey, you could be our hostess!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hmm. What'cha eatin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys can bus tables. Baljeet can be our soda jerk.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I make a mean milkshake!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb will be our chef.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I can work the velvet rope. (holds it out) I never leave home without my velvet rope.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh... where do you keep that?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll never tell.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, what's the name of your restaurant?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Chez Platypus, of course! By the way, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? Nothing available for tonight? Oh, never mind. (To Perry) Er, sorry, Agent P. It's date night tonight with the wife, and if I don't figure out something special to do, I'm royally in the doghouse.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Rreow! Pkshh!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Anyway, Agent P, sources indicate Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to one of his evil schemes. I need you to get out there and put a stop to it. Good luck.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Jeremy's dreamy pre-set ringtone! Hello? Hello?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace/Jeremy
Dialog: (In unison) This is Candace/Candace, it's Jeremy. Jeremy? Candace? (Both laugh) Okay, you go. Okay, you talk, you talk. (Both laugh)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, so, I was wondering if you wanted to do something tonight? Just the two of us?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Giggles, squeals) Sure. That'd be great.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, awesome! Uh, so I'll pick you up later?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, bye.

Name: Candace/Jeremy
Dialog: (In unison) Yes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Power tools buzzing) Oh, no. (Candace sticks her head out the window) Listen, you twerps. Sometimes your stuff messes with my stuff, and tonight I got some big stuff going on. So you leave your stuff out there, and leave my stuff alone, or you'll get some of this stuff! Get it?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, are we pairing the chicken entrée with the soup?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus! You must have noticed how I reinforced the locks, but, you know, not the door. Well, let's just get you out of... You're... You're really trapped in here, just... Just like I planned, obviously. So let me tell you my latest scheme. I'm so tired of all these happy couples around me, romantic and laughing, mocking me with their happiness. Well, not anymore. My De Love-inator satellite will eliminate the feeling of love in the entire Tri-State Area. All I have to do is press this button. It would be so easy to press it right now. It would be so simple, but, you know, I've got a date tonight, and I like to stay optimistic. But if we don't hit it off, I'm definitely gonna ruin it for everyone else.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi. Ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm, like, so looking forward to tonight. A special evening, just the two of us. So, what do you have planned? Horseback riding? I just love horseback riding. Oh, you stopped.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ta-da! Your brothers have opened the trendiest restaurant in town, and this is where I'm taking you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. Uh, really? Heh. How... fun.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, i-if you prefer to do something else...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well...

Name: Woman
Dialog: Platypus-themed restaurants are so now, so wow. It will be a miracle if we get in.

Name: Man
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's definitely eat here. But no way are we waiting in this line. I practically own the place. (To other people in line) Come on! Outta my way, people! VIP coming through! (To Buford) All right, Buford, make with the rope and let us in.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Name?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: "Me" who?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm Candace. Candace Flynn?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're not on the list. You should have made a reservation yesterday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This restaurant didn't exist yesterday. I demand to be let in right now.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Good evening, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I forgot to make a reservation.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No problem, dude.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did that guy just bribe you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: He didn't bribe me. He just caught my attention in a monetary fashion. Now, back in line.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Right this way to your table, sir.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. Have you seen Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No, not lately.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I noticed in your online profile that you say you like tall men. Is--? Is--? Is that true?

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: That's right. And you're not very tall at all.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I-I'm 6'2". I slouch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: My last date was 6'9". Now, that's a good-looking man. But I'll be honest, I've never been able to resist a man in a lab coat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) Really? Look. Look, I'm wearing one right now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey. There you are, Perry. We've gotta put you in your place of honor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: I'm usually extremely attracted to blonds.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I-I see.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: But there is something about your windblown style that gives me goose bumps.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? Well, I-I must say, it's quite a bit of work in the morning, you know, but apparently worth it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There you go, Perry. Now everyone can see you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We need a chicken special for table five.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Enjoy your meal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really. You're letting complete strangers in. I'm the owners' sister. I demand to be let in right now! I'm supposed to be having the time of my life!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? I really don't mind waiting a bit. It's actually kinda fun just hanging out here with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really?

Name: Buford
Dialog: All right, next party, step this way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, how do you feel about evil?

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Huh? That's a weird question.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is it? I-I'm just making conversation.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: But I love it. Look.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You have an evil tattoo. Look, look, look, just like mine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: I can't believe we have so much in common. Y-you know, I don't even put "evil" on my profile anymore because it attracts so many weirdos.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't I know it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it. I'm calling Mom and making her tell the boys to let us in. (To Linda) Mom, Phineas and Ferb made an exclusive restaurant in the yard and you've got to tell them to tell Buford to let us in.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, okay, honey. We're just finishing dinner. We'll be home in a minute.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Argh! (At Jeremy) Jeremy, hold our place in line. I'm going out front to wait for my Mom.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But Candace...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Oh, looking for my remote, are you? Well, here. Take it. I don't need it anymore. I am in love!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Sven, I heard a trendy new badger restaurant just opened up the street.

Name: Man
Dialog: Cool.

Name: People
Dialog: Ooh, badger restaurant./I love badgers.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Platypus-themed restaurants are so four hours ago. Let's bail.

Name: Man
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Boy
Dialog: I haven't eaten badger in a week.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ah, the public is fickle.

Name: TV Host
Dialog: Excuse me, young man. I'd like to buy your restaurant. I envision a chain of platypus-themed restaurants as far as the Tri-State Area can see.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Heck, dinner service is over. You can have it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad, the boys have a restaurant in the yard, and they're not letting me in. You've gotta put a stop to it! Come on!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Goodbye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have fun with the restaurant!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, guys? Ugh, whatever.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Excuse me, miss. Do you have a table for two?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Giggles) Right this way, sir.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Enjoy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, Candace, I've had a lot of fun in your backyard, but this is the best time yet.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look. How adorable! (To Candace) Candace, you want me to put a stop to this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No, no, no! Go! Shoo! Keep moving, nothing to see here. (To Jeremy) Now, where were we?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have never been so happy in my entire life!

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Oh—Heinz-- (Laser zaps) I feel nothing. (stomps away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But—But—But—!

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: (offscreen) Nothing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, the remote's not working!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, you could walk five feet and change the channel the old-fashioned way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, be for real, Mom. I'd rather watch the stupid nature show.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walks out of the room) I'll get batteries while I'm out.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: This week on Walking with Nature, one of the world's slowest creatures; Chelonia mydas, the sea turtle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gets up) Five feet, huh? (sits back down) Nah, it's still not worth it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb, time to make the sunniest day ever!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess it's already as sunny as it's gonna get. (He and Ferb climbs down the tree.) Wow, it's not even lunchtime and we're already done with today's project. Think about it, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That means we have the whole rest of the day...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...to do another project.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's like having two days in one! (slides down the tree trunk) Can't ask for better than that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry, do you have any cool ideas for projects?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's an egg. Perry laid an egg! You know what this means, don't you? We're gonna have two Perrys! Congratulations, old boy! You're gonna be a... Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: How did you like our new pneumatic transporter? I used it myself this morning.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? (Camera pans back to him) Oh, who am I kidding? The new pneumatic transporter sucks. I mean, literally, sucked every piece of hair off my body. Anyhoo, Doofenshmitz has brought up the Tri-State's entire supply of krill. Krill?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Krill is a small shrimp-like creature that plays an important role in the diet of the humpback whale.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (scoffs) ..Krill.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb, Perry's egg is getting kind of cold.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (shakes his head) No, I don't think that's gonna cut it. This calls for desperate measures. (Ferb takes the egg) We need the ultimate, best-ever egg hatcher. Ferb, I know what else we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Five feet for popcorn, fine! (sits on the couch) Five feet to change a channel? I don't think so!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: This turtle is seeing the world for the first time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, this little fella is kind of cute.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Here's one that's found himself in the unforgiving position of being stuck on his back. Watch as he instinctively turns to his stomach.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa! Cool!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: But the sea turtles' struggles are just beginning. Without the protection of their mother, they face many predators. As you can see, they make easy prey even though the safety of the ocean is a mere five feet away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gulps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Ferb, let's get our nurture on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Easy does it! There! Activating temperature control.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Initiating platypus lullaby loop cycle.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nothing says "mother's love" like a giant, robotic platypus butt.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Unbeknownst to the delicate infant turtle, it's caught the eye of a sea hawk, and he's looking for a meal.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Sadly, the sea hawk wins this battle. Unlike humans, sea turtles don't have a mother to protect them through these crucial moments of infancy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (while Candace runs into the backyard) Hey, Candace, Perry laid an egg!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (picks up the egg) It's okay, little guy. Candace is here to protect you! (at the boys) What are you doing to this precious gift of life?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: After Perry left his egg unattended, we decided it would be best if we watched over it for him. Given the rudimentary needs of the average egg, we calculated the heat transfer due to elemental exposure, plus the positive developing life responses to familiar and expected sound, and factored the obvious visual surroundings. The result was the Plat-a-Droid, but since we were pressed for time, we only built the platy-posterior.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after a pause) That's so wrong in so many ways, I don't even know where to start! An egg is like a little baby. It needs a living, breathing mother. It needs... Hold on one second.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (now wearing her "mom" suit) Okay, let's do this thing for real!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! You're just in time for my backstory. You see, it all started a lifetime ago.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) I was young and in love with a beautiful girl. She taught me how to see the beauty of life, and I taught her how to hold a petty grudge. She was very interested in whales, for some reason. In retrospect, it was probably more of an unhealthy obsession, but to win her heart, I created the Whale Translator-inator! I rented the best oceanographic vessel that I could afford, and we headed out. But when I turned the Translator-inator on...

Name: Whale
Dialog: (via the Translator-inator) ..What a loser that guy up there is! She should dump that pink chimp and go out with a real mammal like me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) She left me for that trash-talking 35-ton pile of blubber. And broke my fragile, 10-ounce utterly-too-human heart.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Unfortunately, my Translator-inator only worked in one direction. So I was not able to tell the whales what I thought of them. Until today. Watch this. (mimics whale cry) See, I taught myself whale song. I just told him he's fat, and he has barnacle breath.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, come on, who's diabolical?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, first things first. Dismantle that thingamajig of... of weirdness. Sometimes, I swear, I'm the only normal one in this family. (pause) Like I said. Weirdness. Now, let's get serious. See what I'm wearing here? Serious. This egg's not gonna hatch itself. We need to build a nursery.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have this cool blueprint for an incubator!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Too antiseptic. Think warm and loving, not cold and clinical! Hugs and kisses, not hard and mechanical!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So how does it feel to have your platy-posterior handed to you on a plate, son?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (continues imitating whale cry) (laughing) I just told him his macaroni and cheese recipe is too cheesy and not macaroni-y enough! (laughing) (imitates whale cry)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, Perry the Platypus. Where are you... Where are you going? Wait! Wait! My evil plan isn't evil enough for you to foil? Is that it? Really? I've just insulted the macaroni and cheese recipe of a whale! What part of that is not evil?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you get back here and thwart me this instant!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There, that just about does it. (at Candace) Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a large-sized cradle) I'll say when it just about does it. Mmm-hmm. Hmm. Hmm. (at the egg) And how's my wugga wuggums? So cute! (at herself) Hmm. Not bad for a couple of boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're pretty good at this, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You bet I am. This is what real mothering looks like!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stymie meee! Foil meee! Hey, what about the fact that I held a petty grudge against an inferior mammal all these years, huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thwart me, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (once again following Perry) Aw, come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (joyfully) I hope it's a girl! (at the egg) Come to Mommy, snooka wookums!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? It was just a bird?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's not just any bird. That's a rare whale song-singing double-breasted angle hooper...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (getting pecked by the angle hooper) Ow!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: ...the natural enemy of the platypus in the wild.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay. I have something really evil. Really, really. It's actually evil. (pause) Just kidding. Ha-ha! (mimics whale cry)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Ow!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (opening the back door) Candace, I have your batteries. (looks at Candace, surprised) Candace? What are you wearing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's... my mom suit.

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right. I'll try not to take that as an insult. What is the rest of this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace has us build this to show us what motherhood is like.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (doubtfully) Okay. Candace, you made them build all this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. That's not fair!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, Candace, you're gonna have to clean all this up. Mom suit. I swear. (walks off) I'm not even gonna ask.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How do you only manage to see this one? Why only mine? (walks towards the gate) Wait! Come back! This is so unfair! Wait!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (opening the gate) Hey, Candace. I was just stopping by to invite you... (awkward pause) Hmm. Well, nice mom suit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at Linda) See? He gets it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screaming; falls into a whale's blow hole)

Name: Woman
Dialog: Heinz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Elizabeth?

Name: Elizabeth
Dialog: Best decision I ever made.

Name: Buford
Dialog: See? Isn't this the coolest game ever? It's called Jump and Duck.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, how'd you get your face in there?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Easy. I just use this camera, see? (takes picture of Phineas)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (with spinning eyes) Cool.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (demonstrating how to add in the picture, tilting the game controller and wildly pushing buttons) And then you do this, and this, and this and this and this and this and this, and this, and this, and this, and this and this, and then this and this, and then that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is awesome.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her cell phone) Stacy, you are talking to the luckiest girl in the house. Jeremy is taking me to the summer cotillion! Cotillion. It's like a dance. Yes, it's a real word. All I know is it's gonna be great. Wait, I just thought of something, two somethings actually. And one of them is pointy. Stacy, I'll call you back. It's time for a little preemptive bust.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, beyond jumping and ducking, what's the actual objective of this game?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's called Jump and Duck. Duh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can see no educational value in this game.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (at Baljeet) Duck!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughing) Consider yourself educated.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I stand corrected.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Far be it for me to cast dispersions on jumping, and or ducking, but I think you can improve this. With a little effort we could-

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Now in the backyard) Okay. What are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Playing a video game.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it? That's all you're doing today? Huh. How normal. I guess my night's safe after all. Who would have guessed you two would get sucked into a video game? I'm going to go get ready.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Angelic chorus in the background) "Sucked into a video game". Brilliant! Ferb! I know what we're going to do today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. I've been monitoring Doofenshmirtz's internet activity. First, we know what you're getting for Christmas. Don't ask our lips are sealed... it's a vase. Second, he's been doing a lot of research into the molecular of taffeta, satin, and most ominous of all, Velour. Ugh! (Monogram shudders, and the feed cuts out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Introducing the all new and improved, Jump and Duck. The world's first truly immersive video game experience. Hey Ferb, throw the switch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room) Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And once your zapped into the video game by the digitizer-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, what's going on? I was drying my hair.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry about the power, Candace. Ferb went to check the circuit breaker.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy is going to get here any...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the video game) ...minute. Hey! Where'd you guys go?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We didn't go anywhere, but you're inside the video game.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean I'm in the... (Birds and angry fruit begin chasing Candace)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, cool. How come she got to go first?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, you are too late. Wait, is it eleven o'clock yet? (Pauses for a beat) Now! Now you are too late. So Perry the Platypus, tremble in fear before the most twisted, nightmarish creation the world has ever known! The ball gown-inator. (Doofenshmirtz grabs the Ball gown-inator, and fires it at Perry, leaving him in a ball gown. Perry tries to jump at Doofenshmirtz, but falls due to his ball gown. A pair of mechanical arms pick of Perry so that he is at Doofenshmirtz's level) See, Perry the Platypus? It's hard to fight when you're in a ball gown. It's portable too. Ooh, you look so elegant, like you're going to a cotillion. It's a word, it means dance. So, why would I created such a device as this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) You see, back in Gimmelshtump in the depths of my childhood, my parents were expecting a brand new baby girl. My mother spent months knitting pretty dresses. Unfortunately, the baby turned out to be a boy, and because we were out of material, I was forced to wear those same dresses for an entire year. Drawing mockery and scorn from all of my manly classmates.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now with my ball gown-inator, I will be the manliest man in the Tri-State Area! You know, by comparison. Because everyone else will be wearing dress. After I shoot them with my ball gown-inator. Am, am I over explaining this? Because I have this whole musical number prepared, and... Oh, oh you're good. (at the dancers) Take five girls.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys better get me out of here. I still have to get ready.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we designed a whole bunch of different worlds you have to go through to get to the boss, but you know just, just continue screen right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can't you just press a button and get me there now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you want cheat codes. No, we don't roll like that. Just jump and Duck. (Candace gets hit by fruits) Okay not necessarily in that order. Just choose the appropriate action that corresponds to the approaching fruit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace What does that even mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Duck! (Candace got hit by the door) Now run! (Candace gets hit by a ramp) Duck! (Candace's head got sucked) Okay, you can try to jump here (Candace fall on a platform) Duck! Duck! Duck! (Candace falls on the stairs) Okay stop falling Candace keeps falling) stop falling (Candace keeps falling) (talking to Ferb) Sheesh. Maybe we should go help her. Don't worry Candace, we're coming!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm, maybe they should call it Jump, Duck, and Blow (Candace then begins to run through the world, shooting everything in her path)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, what happened here? Oh that's right, Candace has her hair dryer. We'll just follow the carnage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, Perry the Platypus, that dress sort of suites you. If you know, you just eventuate the positive as they say... Um, I'm going to stop talking now, I'm moving into a weird-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Muffled by Perry's dress) Hey what the...? What going on here I got... Oh, it's on now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Hanging under the balloon) Oh great, now everyone's staring.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, the castle. Nice art direction, Ferb. I guess Candace already made it to the boss level. (The boss, designed after Buford appears behind them) Sweet! Come on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I forgot that we made Buford the boss. It's a little disturbing having him trying to obliterate us, but it made him so happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey ugly! Drop the twerps you freak. (The Boss does so, and walks toward Candace) Nobody picks on my brothers but- (The bosses knocks Candace over, causing her to lose the hair dryer, and diminishing her health)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace look out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright Candace, way to--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! Ferb! Phineas! Ferb! (The two brothers dissolve) NOOOO!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace, what's the matter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well yeah, we have, like four lives left.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. You guys let me believe you were really dead? If we ever get out of here you're going to be so... Hey, what's going on?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome, we're out. So you must have beat the boss.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, it was a piece of cake.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool, how'd you get him the second time?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean, "second time"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know how after you defeat him the first time, he comes back, and this time he's twice as strong? What'd you do then?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The last level's in the real world. Run!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No guys, he looks like a nice guy.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, maybe not.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Mockingly) Oh, now I see the educational value.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Glaring) You know, eventually I'm getting out of here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hehe, exactly as planned.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (From behind the boss) Hey you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella! No!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Leave my friends alone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: NOOOO!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Takes out a camera) Smile.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Isabella, that was great.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know what they say, the bigger they are the harder they de-pixelate.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sea-Foam-Green? I'm actually more of an Autumn.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (In the distance) Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no! Jeremy's here. How am I going to get ready in three seconds?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Apparently, do what we did.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't remember changing. Is this part of the gam-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well what am I going to do!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, you look beautiful. ... I guess you all look beautiful.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, we think it's part of the game.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: ...Okay. Shall we go, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh...yes.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Why do they call it a cotillion anyway?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, don't get me started.

Name: Cotillion Crowner
Dialog: ...And the queen of the summer cotillion is...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh I am honored. And at the same time humiliated, so thank you and curse you.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: The Chronicles of Meap. Starring Lorenzo Lamas as Meap. Episode 38, "More Than Meaps the Eye".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's the bottom of the ninth inning, bases are loaded. It all comes down to this final pitch from Ferb the curve Fletcher. And the wind up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And it's a striiiyiiiiyiiike! And the crowd goes wild! (Cheers)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, it looked way outside, but then it was right in the zone. There's a lesson, baseball fans

Name: Candace
Dialog: Boring, dull, stupid, lame, heavy-handed and derivative.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, thank you for those insightful reviews of books you haven't read.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, that's why books have covers; to judge them. I mean, why did you choose these books from the library?

Name: Linda
Dialog: They looked interesting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Point taken. Okay honey, I'm off to help Dad at the antique store. Oh, hey, here's a package for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My Bango-Ru!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: My Bango-Ru. They're these adorable Japanese characters that are so in right now. Like in a kitschy way. The lead guitarist for The Bettys has one painted on her guitar. Stacy and I designed our own dolls online.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, assuming none of that is teenage code for something I should be worried about as a parent, I'm off.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye Mom. I got to call Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Bango-Ru!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bango-Ru!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I just got my little bunny-bear! It's a cross between a bunny and a bear! You get it? It's the most precious thing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just got mine too. He's a cross between a cow and a frog. I'm calling him "Señor Frowwg". He's gonna be the cutest thing, you're just going to...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? What's going on?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just discovered why cows and frogs don't date.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, We'll still have fun at the Bango-Ru Convention today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Yeah, I guess.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, let's see what this bad boy can do. Go long! Pop fly!. (Phineas launches the ball into the sky) Cool! (The baseball hits a spacecraft, which starts falling toward Earth) Oh, here it comes! (Phineas sees the spacecraft) Hey, Ferb I know what we're going to do today. Run for our lives! (The spaceship crashes in their backyard) Whoa, I think we may have just stopped and/or started an alien invasion. I hope he's not too angry, or hungry.

Name: Alien
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that is cute. Hey, are you okay? We're really sorry about your ship.

Name: Alien
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's your name?

Name: Alien
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Meap! I'm Phineas and this is Ferb.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whatcha got there? Hey, this must be his father. Don't worry, Meap. We'll fix your ship, and you'll be with your dad in no time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey Ferb, I know what we're going to do today, Let's get ourselves totally busted by crashing our stupid toy in the backyard.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi Candace. It isn't a toy. It's a real live alien spaceship!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh good! Because this isn't a cell phone. It's an inter-galactic little brother buster-izer. Which I'll use on you if you don't clean up this mess. What's with the spaceship anyway? Haven't you guys, you know, been there, done that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We weren't planning on going into space. But if we did, I'm sure there's still a ton of cool stuff left to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, well I'm all done with outer space. Never again! I'm going to stick with Earth, where I'm the one in charge of busting people who do things they're not supposed to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Oh, that is the most adorable thing I've ever seen in my entire life! You guys made a Bango-Ru doll?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's Meap.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He talks?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, more than Ferb, but "Meap" is pretty much the only thing he says.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well you and your little Bango-robot better not show up at the convention and make me look bad. (She turns around and steps on a baseball launcher, launching a ball into somebody's window) ...That's strike one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay Ferb, let's fix us an alien spaceship.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Where do you want to start? Hey Ferb, have you seen Perry?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P! I wonder what exciting mission we have for you today. (starts itching his nose) Excuse me, my nose is really itchy. Doofenshmirtz has purchased a lot of carpet, he must be up to something bad. Because he's a bad, bad person... He's this bad. (Holds up his arms to show how bad Doofenshmirtz is. He starts to laugh) I can't do this. Carl was doing my arms. See? (Turns around to show Agent P) Oh, too funny, anyway, stop Doofenshmirtz with the carpet thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It seems to run on a quantum front loading system. Can the wew system support that? (Ferb gives Phineas a "thumbs up") Hang on I'll bring you down.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi guys! What'cha doin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi Isabella. come over here and we'll show you. (Phineas realizes Ferb is still attached to the contraption) Oh, oops, sorry Ferb. We're fixing up this spaceship that belongs to our new friend Meap. Meap, he's the most adorable thing in the world.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? Are you sure there's nothing, or no one that's more adorable?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, not a chance. (Isabella frowns dejectedly) Here, see for yourself... Meap? Meap?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Bango-ru!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dejectedly) Bango-ru.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Notices Meap, and mistakes it for Candace's Bango-ru) Oh, Candace! Look at it! It's so cute, I could die!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Oh no...

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And it makes little noises. How did you do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh well, Phineas and Ferb, you know?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, they tricked it out for you, cool. Come on, lets go to the convention. (She rides off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right behind you. Hmm. Your reign of terror has come to an end Señor Frowwg. (Tosses him into a trash can and then rides off. Meap sees Señor Frowwg and shoots a rainbow death ray from his mouth, defacing Señor Frowwg)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. I jury-rigged Ferb's old GPS device, to create a cute tracker. It locks on to the cutest thing in the area, so it should lead us right to Meap. Let's see if we can get a signal. (The cute tracker beeps) Got something!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, that's probably me. Sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, it's three miles in that direction. Ferb, why don't you stay here and finish the ship? (Ferb salutes Phineas, and knocks himself in the head with a wrench) Isabella, want to come with me and help me find Meap?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Sure, I still haven't gotten my "You wouldn't know cute if it bit your legs off" accomplishment patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Let's go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, just in time for your little lesson in static electricity! (A mechanical hand rubs Perry against the carpet, causing him to poof out, then flicks Perry onto a wall, trapping him) Looks like I rubbed you the wrong way, Puffy the Fuzzypus. You might ask; Why the carpet? What is he doing? What is going on? Why is he listing questions I might ask him? Well, I believe the answers are best expressed in back story form.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
