Dialog: When I was a boy, the smell of pork emanating from me was so bad because of well, (Back in Doofenshmirtz's lair) well the reason's unimportant, it was part of a different emotionally scaring back story. I'm not getting into... regardless the smell of pork was so bad (Flashback) that no one would come near me. So one day the carnival came to town and I needed money because of, (Back in his lair) well another back story that, basically my parents disowned me, I was being raised by ocelots. (Flashback #2) The point is, I had to get a job at the carnival, but the only work was at the dunking booth, and not as the guy who got dunked, I was what they threw to dunk him, which is again a whole other back story. Okay, long back story short, I got a balloon at the carnival, I drew a face on him, I sprayed him with special "Life-Long-Lasting" spray I created, and I named him Balloony. He became my best friend in the whole world, yadda yadda yadda. Then one tragic day, when I was protecting our garden as a lawn gnome, whatever you remember that back story. Balloony started floating away. I tried to reach out and grab him, but...

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (from inside) Bewege dich nicht! (Don't move!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I never saw Balloony again. (Flashback ends) He's still out there, somewhere. Not to put to fine a point on it, but I put that Long Lasting spray on him. So he's still out around. And I plan to bring him to me! Balloons, you see, are attracted to static electricity, so I created this. Behold the Static Electro-Amplif-Inator! Keep beholding, keep beholding, beholding, and we're still beholding, and scene.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I keep getting some kind of cute interference...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's me! I'm endangering the mission, I shouldn't've come!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No. Now it's cleared up. I wonder how Ferb is doing.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Warp-Drive signature detected.

Name: Alien
Dialog: He he. I have you now.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We must never speak of this again.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Agreed.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You're digging my ride from outer space.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: This is so weird.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's like a strange alien world.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh! Bango-Ru purses!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way! Let me see! Let me see!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look how cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think I saw this on the on the red carpet the other night.

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: What? Hey!

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: I got it. (Picks up Meap) Irresponsible kids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm totally going to have to get some Bango-shoes to go with this!

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: Hey, is this your doll, young lady?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: We found it abandoned on the floor over there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sorry.

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: Your irresponsibility makes our job as security guards a million times harder! Someone could have stolen it. Or tripped over it.

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: That's right. Injuries, lawsuits, stolen property.

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: Even death!

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: Yes, you could have killed me.

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: Me too!

Name: Guard 1
Dialog: We're lucky to be alive.

Name: Guard 2
Dialog: Yeah, you're in big trouble.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The cute signal's getting stronger.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas...?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How come you think Meap is so cute. What does that even mean anyway? Cute.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I can't define cute. I just know it when I pick it up on my cuteness meter. Although, I keep getting this weird cute interference from somewhere.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Sweet you tricked it out! Isabella and I are hot on Meap's trail, let's bounce.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Riding her bike) You can't ban me from Bango-Ru conventions for life. I ban myself! (Looks at Meap) What kind of a toy are you anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In a thought bubble) It isn't a toy, it's a real live alien spaceship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! You're not a toy! You're a real live alien.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace, you found Meap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: More like he found me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, his ship's fixed, so he can get back to his family now.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's happening?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're caught in some kind of tractor beam! It's pulling us in! Maybe it's the space authorities. Did we do something wrong?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, it occurs to me that not all of the modifications I made are technically "Street Legal".

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on? Wait! Come back! (At Meap) Who was that? (Meap pulls out the photo of an alien) That was your father? But why...

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's not your father? It's a mug shot? Oh no! Phineas and Ferb have been abducted by an intergalactic criminal!

Name: Meap
Dialog: (Sadly) Meap.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where's he taking us?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look! He's headed for that small cloud!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's no cloud, that's a space station.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I got a good feeling about this!

Name: Alien
Dialog: Ha, you thought you were clever disguising your ship, but I've got you now ...whoever you are.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey look, it's Meap's dad.

Name: Alien
Dialog: Alright, what the heck is going on here? Is this some kind of joke?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm Phineas, that's Isabella, and this is Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's your name?

Name: Alien
Dialog: I am know by many names throughout the universe, well two mainly. Mitch, and some of the guys call me Big Mitch. Anyway, where did you get this ship?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Meap's ship.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Meap?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: About "yay" high, big eyes...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The biggest!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Kinda looks like this?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's Meap?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's Meap!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: That's my mortal enemy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? He seems like such a nice guy.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: He is; I'm not. You see, I steal rare creatures from their home worlds, and imprison them on my ship. I'm a...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're a zookeeper?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: No, that sorta legitimizes it. Umm...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're a poacher!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Yes! I'm a poacher.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's wrong! These poor creatures shouldn't be lock up here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, they should be brought back to their homes and set free.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Oh, really? Maybe I should lock you three up in here as well.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, that's cool. Tonight's taco night at home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi Mom. Phineas and Ferb have been abducted by an evil alien, and I'm here with another alien, who isn't his son, and... How does that sound so far? (Meap blinks) I agree. Craaazey! What are we going to do? (Meap walks off, and returns with one of Phineas and Ferb's baseball launchers) Play catch? Well, if you think it will help. (Meap begins to pull out pictures, in an attempt to explain his plan to Candace. First with Phineas and Ferb) Phineas and Ferb. (Meap pulls out a picture of Mitch) Your father. (Meap pulls out another picture of him)  No, right not your father. A bad guy. Say where do you keep all these pictures?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap! (Signals for Candace to focus)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, stay focus. (Meap next pulls out a picture of the space station) Their in a giant spaceship. But how are we supposed to get up there and save them? (Meap grabs the baseball launcher, and shoots a baseball into the sky) Oh! I get it. Duh. You're trying to tell me something. (Pause) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So you know when you walk around in socks and rub them across the carpet, you get that little static shock? (He comes out from behind the screen) Behold, the new uniform of pure evil! I call it the socky-shocky-suity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Would you three sit still? You don't get it. You're my prisoners. You should be afraid of me! (Turns his attention to his monitor, showing Meap coming toward him) Ah, like a moth to the flame.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa. I got this situation totally under control.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (Still looking at his screen) You kids might be of some use to me after- Hey, hey, don't go in there. (Phineas, Ferb, and Isabella leaves through a door) You'll track dirt back into the corridor. Ugh, I'll deal with them later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, check this place out. Well, now I know how to find Phineas and Ferb. They'll be where the cool stuff is.

Name: Phineas/Ferb/Isabella
Dialog: WooHoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ca-Ching! Okay, I'll go in and get them, you stay here. This could get dangerous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, cool!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: So, we meet again.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: I agree, it ends here. Oh, and by the way I talked to your little friends, and just so we're clear, I am not your father.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I'm almost done charging up to socky-shocky-suity suit. You know it's the technical side of evil I think people don't really appreciate. There! Now watch as every balloon in the entire Tri-State area is ripped from the hands of children, clowns, and ... clown-children. Hahahaha. (He connects himself with the Static Electro-Amplif-Inator ripping balloon from children, clowns, and clown-children, filling up DEI) Wow, that's a lot of balloons.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know on paper, this was the outcome too.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Oh yeah?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh man, what the... (Seeing Mitch) Oh, Hello.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: We're right in the middle of a showdown, if you don't mind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Uh, I get it. It looks serious. Nemesis confrontation. One of those "it ends here" kind of things. Whoo-ee Not fun. Okay, well don't mind me, I'm just playing through as they say.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're doing fine, just ignore me. I'll show myself out. (Opens a door)

Name: Mitch
Dialog: No! That's where I keep--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's you. Balloony.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Hey! That's the most unique creature in my collection. Collin. My best friend.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What! That's Balloony, my best friend

Name: Mitch
Dialog: No, I found Collin just floating all alone in space.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I actually drew his face! Look, look, I signed it.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: That's a birthmark.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A birthmark! It's a balloon you idiot! "Collin". Come on Balloony, let's scoot.

Name: Doofensmirtz
Dialog: Ba-Balloony?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Ha. See? Collin is my best friend.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You've changed, Balloony. And I though you were actually back-story worthy. It makes me sick! Well, I don't even need you anymore. Yeah, I've got an even better best friend. He's a really good listener, he even put up with me going on about how great you were! Ha! (Perry finally climbs into the spaceship) It's clear to me now that my real best friend is Perry the Platy—Oof! (Perry knocks him out of the large hole in the bottom of the ship)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, hello? Falling to my doom here! (Perry jumps out to go help him)

Name: Mitch
Dialog: All too easy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was awesome.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I knew there was still more cool stuff to do in space.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh oh.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are they?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. (At a robot) Hi. (Robot shoots laser at Phineas) Okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Holding the baseball launcher) Strike three. They're out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! What ever happened to strike two?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh... Where's Meap? I told him to wait right here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm, I'm having trouble picking up his cute signal.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, since you obviously won't figure this out on your own, I think I'm the one causing the cute interference.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't be silly Isabella. I took into account your cuteness, and adjusted the cute-meter settings accordingly from the beginning. See, look what happens when I change it back to normal. (The cute-meter overloads due to an excessively strong cute signal from Isabella) Oops, so much for finding Meap.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Do you think he's okay?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: No, no I don't.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Mitch.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Points the Baseball Launcher at Mitch)  Get away from him, Mitch!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Foolish children, only now do you understand your grave situation.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (Makes voice high and squeaky) "Hi, Mitch!" "Look at the cool stuff, Mitch!" "Blah, blah, blah, MITCH!"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha. He totally nailed you, Ferb.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Silence. I mean seriously, seriously. You're still not getting this. You're all trapped, on my ship forever! Like animals in a cage. Get it? You lost, I won!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (After opening Meap's cage with the baseball) Go, hide.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoa.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I... I don't believe it.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Okay, okay I surrender, you can stop behaving in a way counter intuitive to how you superficially appear. We get it. Hey! Stay away from my universal mustache translator. Ow! MEAP!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap! (He puts on the mustache translator) Children, thank you for your help in bringing down this villainous scoundrel. You see, I am an intergalactic security agent who roams the universe, busting people who do stuff they're not supposed to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're like the me of the galaxy.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Exactly. I am pleased to not only have made some true friends, but to have met a kindred spirit as well.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought Meap was a helpless little creature. Huh, I guess I learned to never judge a book by its cover again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) An alien monster! Get to the ship!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Actually that's my mother-in-law, so yeah she's correct. Let's get out of here! (Phineas, Ferb, and Isabella follow)

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Hahahahaha!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to save the universe?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I want your hat on my desk!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Balloony!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Colin!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Jeremy's going to be there?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: The Chronicles of Meap, Episode 40.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Meapless in Seattle.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: In a world. There, I said it, happy?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from inside) All right Candace. (Cuts to the kitchen where she picks up her purse on the counter, where Candace is sitting and dialing her phone.) I'm off to the grocery store. You're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa-whoa-whoa wai-wai-wait! By "in charge", does that mean I'm in control of everything around here while you're gone?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (turning around) Yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Including Phineas and Ferb? I'm the complete overlord of them?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (suspiciously) Suddenly I'm a little scared. But, technically, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So like, in a court of law, any—

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I'll be back later. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deeply) Excellent! (singsong, to something offscreen) Oh, boys?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hear ye, hear ye! Mom has left me in charge, so I hereby demand that you do nothing crazy today. No building any whoosy-whatzits, or goozy-mahookoffs! In other words, don't be the world's most annoying brothers for one afternoon, okay?

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: Your brothers are annoying you, too?

Name: Girl (cont'd)
Dialog: Hi, I'm Mandy. (opens the fence gate and approaches Candace) And me and my world's most annoying brothers are visiting our aunt next door for the weekend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you're Mrs. Weaver's niece. You have annoying brothers?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! My brothers, Thaddeus and Thor, are constantly building the most annoying contraptions on Earth! Soapbox cars with lawn mower engines...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh-huh.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: ...tire swings that launch over the roof...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh-huh!

Name: Mandy
Dialog: ...a mini shopping center for the cat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally! Someone who relates! Listen to how annoying Phineas and Ferb are. One time...

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: (snaps) Gum me. (Thor gives his brother a gum ball, which he chews and blows.) 'Sup, chumps? Thaddeus. Thor. Overheard you two like to build stuff. Where we come from, we're known as the best. Jealous?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No. No, I'm not.

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: Well, you should be. Today, we're building the most awesome fort ever. What do you think of that, suckers?! Ha! Hahahahaha!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. (waves) Good luck. (Ferb gives a thumbs up as Thaddeus and Thor exit the scene. Phineas suddenly gets a cool demeanor on his face as he snaps.) Gum me.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Puh-lease.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Where is he, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) I don't know, sir. Maybe he decided to quit.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Quit? Well, why would he wanna do that?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, remember his last mission? You were pretty tough on him, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hmm. You're right, Carl. I can be pretty rough sometimes. (sadly) Poor Agent P. Do you think the little guy will ever forgive me? (Perry finally drops into his chair to see Monogram crying, but he then looks up happily) Oh, uh, Agent P, you're here! Ahem! (seriously) So, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been sighted in the Danville Park. We need you to make sure no one is in any danger. (Perry salutes and leaves) There he goes. (guiltily) Jeez, Carl, just hope I wasn't too rough on him this time.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) I don't know, sir. He looked pretty upset to me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (putting his head in his hand) I hate myself.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: I dunno, Candace. In terms of obnoxiousness, I'm sure my brothers have your brothers beat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! I beg to differ. Yes, they're both obnoxious, but my brothers' stuff has a sprinkling of awesomeness...which makes it that much more annoying!

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Um, have you not been listening? Today, my brothers are building a fort and it'll probably be the most obnoxiously awesome fort ever built!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not if my brothers are building one!

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Oh yeah?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! It's on, sister!

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: Well, Thor, I know who we're gonna outdo today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There you are! I order you to get out there and build a fort!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought you wanted us to take the day off and not annoy you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those kids next door are building a fort and I will be annoyed if theirs is better than yours!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, we don't do this to compete. We do it for fun.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And for the ladies. Rrrrrow. (raises eyebrows seductively)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, do it cuz I say so!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (disgruntled) Oh, hi, Perry the Platypus. Welcome to the Doofenshmirtz family reunion. They're just about to start the dreaded kickball game that my mother organizes every year. The one my brother's team always wins. You see, I'm not very coordinated with my feet. But with my hands...Hey, watch this. (Doof reaches offscreen and grabs a table with several cups on them. He does a few impressive stacking tricks with the cups.) See? I hold the cup-stacking world record. But does my mother care? No! (pushes the table offscreen) You see, Perry the Platypus, throughout my childhood, my mother's love was always inexplicably linked to kickball. You know, I think—I think this is best expressed through song. (strums a balalaika)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Love Händel!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Goodnight, Gimmelshtump!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How do you like that, Perry the Platypus? Love Händel, in my flashback! I know people. (Perry just gives him a look.) This year, it's going to be different! W-W-Wait right here, I'll show you! (He exits offscreen. We hear a mechanical noise, and he comes back with an electronic leg.) Behold, the Kickinator 5000! Could you help me practice, please, please? Just take the ball and go over there and then just roll it to me. Go ahead. Any time. I'm ready. (The ball rolls to Doof, but nothing happens.) Well, you—you threw it too early! (Gets the ball back) Couldn't you tell I wasn't ready? (He throws the ball back and Perry catches it) Come on, try again. Okay, do it right this time. (The Kickinator 5000 suddenly kicks Doof's chin and he lands on his bottom. The ball rolls off.) It's, uh, you know, it's a process.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building a fort.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: Showin' two chumps how to build a fort!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no, he di'n't! Phineas, how can I help?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Stainless steel 18-8 woodscrews, eh? (scoffs) The choice of amateurs!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why? What kind of screws are your brothers using?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: That's classified.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isabella! Get a tarp over that thing ASAP!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What color?

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: Hey, where's Harry?

Name: Harry
Dialog: Yo! Over here!

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: Well, he is a contractor. They don't do much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, slowly. Not so fast! I can hardly keep up with it!

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: Heads up, Heinz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what? Just—Just bring the ball in front of the Kickinator. Just—Put it right th—What are you doing? I didn't say a mile away! Right here! Bring it closer. Okay. No, no! Oh. That's a little bit better. Step back and get ready to witness some real kicking. (He kicks the ball perfectly, and the ball goes into a tree. A bird falls out.) I did it! I did it! (The Kickinator kicks his chin again and he falls on his back.) I still did it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, guys, it's do or die time. This is the chance to really show your stuff, cuz there's no you're gonna lose to a couple of lame-os AND THEIR LOSER SISTER!!

Name: Mandy
Dialog: (offscreen) I can hear you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I KNOW!! I SAID IT LOUD!!!! (car honks, Candace gasps) Mom! Gotta get rid of her!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Mom, you're home, you're home! But, uh, I-I think you should go back to the grocery store.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Because I—I bet you forgot, uh, that stuff!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looks at her list) Oh, I guess I did. (gives Candace some bags) Alright, throw these in the kitchen and I'll be right back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Boy, that was close.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I'm next!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (on the mound) Alright, easy out! Everybody move in!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, you're not even a Doofenshmirtz anymore!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: I kept the name!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (from the bleachers) You can do it, Dad! (to the person sitting next to her) He can't really do it.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: (on a megaphone) Welcome, citizens of Danville! I give you the architectural stylings of Thaddeus and Thor!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfft.

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: What you architectural illiterates see here is a split-level edifice, complete with slide and licorice dispenser. (He pushes a button and a piece of red licorice comes out.) Huh? What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on megaphone) People, people, I'm not gonna soft pedal this. That was adequate, but I think we're ready to witness the greatest architectural feat this town has ever seen! I give you Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Thaddeus
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha ha! You call that an architectural feat?! Ha! Ha! Ha! Ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! (drops her megaphone) Have you lost your minds?! You've completely humiliated me in front of everyone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, Candace, this—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, all summer long, you build the most amazing things and the one time I reach out to you as a sister, the one time I count on you, you give me this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, Candace—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Just leave me alone! (runs off) Excuse me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, wait!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Woah!

Name: Mrs. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (picking up the megaphone) Ladies and gentlemen, topping our fort is our homage to old-school construction. And now for the rest of it. Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tada! (the kickball hits the fort) Our modern take on a well-known classic!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I...I did it. I did it! Ha ha! Who's the loser now, huh?! L-O-S-E-R! Who's the loser?! You are! Let's boogie! That's right! Let's boogie!

Name: Roger
Dialog: You're out.

Name: Mrs. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (running down from the bleachers) Oh, Roger, my son! (lifts her son up) You make me so proud, again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But... (The Kickinator kicks Doof again) OW!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, here's the foyer. All imported marble, by the way. Here's the bowling alley. Pool. Telescope. Terra cotta army room. JET ENGINE WIND TUNNEL! And scoring stage with 40-piece orchestra.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We don't, however, have a licorice dispenser. That was a nice touch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, that rocked.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Nice going. You broke their brains. Come on, boys. I'm taking you home.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, I got the stuff.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, Mom. At least you came through.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Well, Candace, as much as I hate to say this, your brothers are the best. (walks away, to her brothers) A ten-story addition with a swimming pool! Ugh! Why didn't you think of that?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiles) Could it be true?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, have you seen this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm looking at it! ...Wait, where are you?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) In the kitchen!!

Name: Linda (cont'd)
Dialog: When I said, "throw these in the kitchen," I didn't mean it literally!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah yeah yeah. Come on, Mom! (exits)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace!!! I'm not going anywhere until you take care of this mess!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, fun's fun, but there are those pesky zoning laws.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooooh, I just felt a disturbance in the cup-stacking universe. I think my record's been broken.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That wasn't so hard, now, was it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiles, grabbing her mother) Mom, let's go, let's go, let's go! (Cut to outside) Mom, I've been trying to tell you all summer! They make these amazing things! Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you're right! It is amazing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom, we've built a fort.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's wonderful! (to Candace) Isn't it great? The boys are starting to take an interest in building things. (goes back into the house) Who wants stuff?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) We do!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Stacy. We've got about ten minutes until Jeremy's party, so you've gotta help me decide. Should I go with this swimsuit or this swimsuit? (Pulls out two swimsuits, only very slightly different colors)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hmm, that's tough. One on hand, if you go with the achromatic pink, it kinda says "Hi, I'm Candace, and I'm bedraggled and pallid". Trust me, you don't want that. I've been both. But, if you go with the more saturated pink, it kinda gives you that "overkill, out-to-kill, my currency is urgency" look.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't want that. I've been all three.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let your subconscious do the deciding. Go with the one you touched first.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course! Stacy, you're a fashion phenom.

Name: Stacy

Name: Candace
Dialog: (From her window.) What the heck is going-- (Gets cut off mid sentence as she is sprayed by water from the turbo-charged uber-nozzle.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It works!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it looks like that anti-platypus security system was a total waste of money. I am so taking that back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank goodness for old reliable traps, huh? I'm so glad you're going to hang around. (Laughs) Anyway, you arrived just in time to witness the unveiling of my latest invention. Let me introduce to you the Mountain-out-of-a-Molehill-inator. All my life, I was told, (Begin a series of flashbacks) "Don't make a mountain out of a molehill," "Don't make a mountain out of a molehill," "Don't make a mountain out of a molehill." Well now I intend to do just that. This machine will infuse electricity into a small little sphere of compressed nitrogen molecules, which I will then drop into the earth and it will make all the tiny little molehill molecules grow and grow into enormous mo-- (Stops mid-sentence) You know, it's kind of complicated. I learned about it on some kid's website. (Shows computer monitor with Carl's website on the screen.) Oh, oh, and you know what else I found on the web? It's these pictures of cats and they write these—oh, l-l-l-look at this one, "Invisible Cheeseburger". (Perry, still upside-down, looks unimpressed.) No, huh? Well, it's not for everyone, I just think they're funny. Anyway, so I take the sphere, electrify it, drop it in the ground, ta-da! Mountains! Out of molehills! (Perry unimpressed) I know when people say that, they usually mean it figuratively, it's an analogy, bu-bu-but making a point, I can do whatever I want.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I will be honest. I think we look ridiculous.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Are you kiddin'? (Flips his sign, stands on his hands, and holds it with his feet.) I make this look good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, let's fire this baby up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, they are so busted! Alright, you dweebs, what's going on here? (walking into the conveyor belt) I don't have time for this! I've got a huge date and—AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!! AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming out the wash) Blech! Ptoo! Let me outta here! Just wait 'til I get my hands on those two little— (her phone rings) Jeremy?! Oh, hi, Jeremy! Are you here yet?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Well...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm havin' a hard time gettin' there. (Cut to outside the car to reveal a huge traffic jam.) Looks like the whole town is going to this cool new car wash.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) I might have to make it some other time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, no! I-I mean I've got to put you on hold. (picks up other call) Stacy! Wow, I can't believe you're still there.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So how is "hard to get" working?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Working? Now I'm impossible to get! And now Jeremy's playing hard to get.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! This car wash is really hoppin'! At this rate, the star-nosed mole will be saved in no time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I'd love to bust you, but if you don't speed up this car wash, I'm going to miss my date with Jeremy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No biggie, big sister.  (on phone)  This is Big Squirt to Super Suds.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on intercom) ¡Accelerado, por favor! (Ferb pulls a couple of levers and the wash and the song speed up.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Too fast! (She spins around the roofs of the cars before the belt stops and she lands on the windshield of Jeremy's car.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! That was quite an entrance!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! Heh-heh, heh, heh, you made it! Oh, I must look like a wreck.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, you look great! Hop in! (Candace opens the side door and gets in.) What'd you do to your hair?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hot wax...and a sealer I think.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I like it! I'm really glad that you're goin' with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's nothing I'd rather be doing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I put an energy whatchamacallit in here and... (pushes the remote, nothing happens. Pushes it rapidly several times, still nothing happens.) Nice. (He walks up to an electrical fuse-tank and opens a small door and gets a battery out.) Wow, these things go fast. I guess I need a new battery. (Looks in his electrical toothbrush) Nope. (Looks in a toy car.) Nope. (Looks in a flashlight.) Uh-uh. (Looks in Frankenstein's monster's head.) Not here. (Looks in a cymbal-banging monkey toy.) Nope. (Looks in his radio.) Ah! Nope. (Looks in his smoke detector.) Nope. (Looks in his alarm clock.) Nope. (Looks in Norm's butt.) No. (Cut to Doof holding a new battery.) Finally! (He loses his grip on the battery and it goes under the fridge.) Ah, dangit!! Oh, sorry, Perry, I didn't mean to get all street there. But now (bends down) it's probably got all that grease and refrigerator fluff on it. Oh, there's my retainer! (He puts it in his mouth off screen.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is so romantic. It's like we're going through our very own tunnel of l—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen to the Fireside Girls) Go! Go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAHH!!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No worries. I'll protect you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, here we go! The energy ball is growing and... (He presses the button and the ball drops onto the platform.) Ah. Alright, time for the unstuckinator. (A giant boot crushes the inator. We pan down all the floors of the building as the energy ball goes through every one of them.) You know, in hindsight, I probably shoulda done this in the basement.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. I guess that's who's been eating Mom's hydrangeas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, looks like they're safe now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's workiiiing! It's workiiiiiiiiing!! And so much better than I thought it would! (Perry throws his fedora, which breaks apart some heating tunnels and drop onto the switch) All my life, everyone told me I couldn't make a mountain out of a molehill, well, everybody, take (Doof gets electrocuted) THAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA-ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do I even bother? (The giant boot crushes Doof.)

Name: Computer
Dialog: System overload. Cliché explosion imminent.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who wears a shoe this size anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Japanese Guy
Dialog: Oh, no! It's a hideous giant mole!

Name: Guy with Huge Mole on His Head
Dialog: Hey, shut up!

Name: Japanese Guy
Dialog: No no! That mole, ya fool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know what that was, but let's do it again! (her phone rings) Stacy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on videophone & Angrily) Candace?! What the heck are you doin'?! You're supposed to be playing hard to ge—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh. Ohhh, where am I? Hey, check it out! An aglet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So this is why you shouldn't make mountains out of molehills. (The mole goes into the ocean.) Curse you, giant mole!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There goes a perfectly good car wash. (sees Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (walks up) Oh no! Now, how are we s'posed to save the star-nose mole?!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I think he can take care of himself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, no more peach and pumpernickel sandwiches before bed. (Candace trips over Agent P, she looks back) YOU!

Name: Candace
Dialog: For an animal that doesn't do much, you sure know how to make a mess of things!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I've got bad news and good news. The bad news is you're being reassigned to a new, more evil villain. His name

Name: Carl
Dialog: You keep pushing him down, but he keeps coming back up!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not funny, Carl. That's just disgusting.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You laughed earlier!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It was a pity laugh. Anyway, Dr. Doofenshmirtz had to be downgraded to minor threat status, and we've just assigned Agent S to his case. The good news is you've been relocated away from your host family to this new family in the Quad-State Area.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (whispering) It's the other way around, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, yes-yes, of course. Bad news is the relocation, and the good news is the new villain thing. Uh...just make sure you take your belongings from the house when you leave.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good morning, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's so great about it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not much. We can't find Perry anywhere. He's never missed breakfast, not even once.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh, you don't think he could've argued with someone, at say... 3

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, he never would've gone outside on purpose. Everybody knows that platypuses are supposed to stay inside at night. You haven't seen him anywhere, have you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (nervously) Well, maybe he just wandered off. Doesn't he always wander off at some point in the day? A-And then later, when he comes back, you say, "Oh, there you are, Perry", and he says, (mimics Perry's chatter)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, but he's always here in the morning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'd be devastated if something happened to him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold on, I'm coming! (He opens the door and a gift basket is sitting in outside in the hallway.) Another gift basket? (He takes a card off of it.) (reading) "We regret to inform you that due to The Regurgitator's recent evil behavior, you have been downgraded to a minor threat. If you believe this to be a mistake, please fill out the included appeal." A minor threat?! Regurgitator. Ugh, well there's a lot of weirdos out there. (He goes to his computer and types on it) Oh, here we go. He has his own blog. (He reads) "The World's Most Evil Villain"?! Who does this upstart think he is? It's time to show him who's boss! (He rushes off screen and the towel is laying on the floor, his head appears with a nervous smile as he quickly picks it up.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Ferb. Activate the Platy-Attracker 3000. If Perry's anywhere in Danville, this'll bring him home.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. I didn't know there were so many platypuses in Danville.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ' Geez, what a dump! (enters into the motel) (mockingly) So much for Mr. Big Shot Super-villain. (walks over to the man at the front desk) Uh, yeah hi. I'm looking for someone named... (Checks piece of paper) Mr. "The Regurgitator."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do not push? Hmm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, my Heinz henie! Look at this. All this technology, a giant vacuum tube, and they can't afford a throw pillow? (notices The Regurgitator nearby) Oh, hello.

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: I am The Regurgitator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, okay. My name is Heinz Doofenshmirtz. (pauses) Tadaa! ...Oh, I'm sorry, I don't know have the whole... Where are those lights coming from, by the way, when you do that?

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: You're that disturbed lunatic from Danville.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you've heard of me?

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: Yes, and you've heard of me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously. Where's that coming... (Notices Perry in a trap) Oh, look, you've already captured Perry the Platypus! My, you do work fast.

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: Why don't you fill up these forms and I'll consider you for a three-year internship. (hands him some papers before walking away.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am not here to apply for an internship. (looks at the first sheet) Ooh! You offer maternity leave.

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: You can start by making a fresh pot of coffee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope, Ferb, not Perry. This little guy's eyes are too close together and his beak is orange. Perry's is more of a tangerine. Nope, too fat. Too thin. Too cartoon-y. (Holds nose) Whoa, that one smells like meatloaf!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry? Perry the Platypus! Huh? (notices a platypus tail sticking around a nearby corner.) Perry! Get over here. (runs over and pulls on the tail) You're coming home with me so I won't get in trouble with the...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (A woman taps her on the shoulder and Candace sees it's not Perry or a platypus, but a beaver she was pulling.) You have a pet beaver?

Name: Woman
Dialog: You have a pet platypus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Touche.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope, too blue. Too angular. Too French. That one's just a duck with a beaver tail taped on. Well, that was the last of them. Maybe we need to think bigger. And with music! Perry just loves music, remember?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's get the guitars. I've got an idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What are you looking at, Perry the Platypus? This is a great job! And look at all I've accomplished. I mean, just today, I organized this evil invoices, swept his evil lair, picked up his evil dry cleaning. And look, I even had the time to do this, see? "Best Boss." And if I do a good job, I could be promoted to head assistant in just three months! Where are you gonna be in three months, huh, huh?

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: Never mind the three months. I'll take care of him right now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute. First of all, he's my nemesis! And you can't get rid of him now. Where's the fun in that? You need to explain your whole plan to him. Don't you have a nemesis?

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: Me? The world is my nemesis! (pauses before clicking some buttons on his watch) Sorry, this thing doesn't always work. The world is my nemesis!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry's gone, and it's...it's just my fault. I can't take it anymore. I'm gonna have to tell the boys. (notices the silhouettes of Phineas and Ferb through a curtain) Oh, there they are. Well, I guess now's as good a time as any. Phineas, Ferb, I just have to tell you that I'm the one who...

Name: Marty the Rabbit Boy
Dialog: Hey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Marty the Rabbit Boy and his musical blender?

Name: Marty the Rabbit Boy
Dialog: Maybe this'll make you feel better. (plays the chorus of Gitchee Gitchee Goo on his blender)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Eh, not so much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't look at me like that, Perry the Platypus. I know what you're thinking. I-I'm not some lowly intern. I'm an evil scientist! I'm Heinz Doofenshmirtz, and he should be bowing down to me! (at the Regurgitator) Hey you, Mr. Regurgitator! Let's get things straight!

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay. (to Perry) See that, Perry the Platypus? Compromise.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who am I kidding? Grrr. (at himself as he goes over to The Regurgitator) You can do it, you can do it, you can do it. Okay, Regurgitator! I've done everything for you. See those hard-to-reach files up there? Well I invented these rocket shoes just so you can reach them! And look at this! I even put in the self-destruct button that you forgot!

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: What? Why is it counting down?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, well, I may have pressed it by mistake. But at least I didn't push the release button I installed inside Perry the Platypus's cage!

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: Look what you've done! You've pushed my buttons for the last time, you disturbed lunatic!

Name: The Regurgitator
Dialog: Now get ready to--(gets sucked up by the vacuum tube) Aaaahhh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We did it! We did it! Lo hicimos! We did it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Congratulations, Agent P. You've defeated the Regurgitator. As a matter of fact, he just landed in our prison. You can return immediately to your host family, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz is once again your nemesis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, if we're enemies again, does that mean... (Perry drops him) Aaaah! Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (tumbles before finally landing on a throw pillow) Oh, now see there, a throw pillow. You, you guys do it right!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. From the top of this building, everyone in the Tri-State Area should be able to hear us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, why don't you sing one?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Larry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I ran out of rhymes, all right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Comes and takes Candace's microphone) Good job, Larry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome home.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, crew, prepare to set sail for the hunt of a lifetime! Ensign Isabella, raise the jib!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aye, aye, captain Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ahoy, Ferb! Any sign of the great white whale?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys better not be talking about me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Boys, can't you wait until we get the boat in the water?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, it's not actually called a boat, darling, it's called a sloop. When we're on sea there's no right or left, only port and starboard.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So... which side has the restroom?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's not a restroom, it's-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's called the poopdeck.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well no, actually, it's called the head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? Cause poopdeck makes much more sense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, can we just get this over with? Jeremy's throwing a romantic summer soiree at sunset tonight. I'm kind of on a deadline here.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, don't worry, darling, it's only gonna be a three hour tour.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A three hour tour?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You can use the time to soak up some vitamin D.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Candace distracted - check! Kids with the lifejackets!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Excellent! Family pet. Say, where's Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, Perry stayed home. Baljeet's watching him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey Baljeet, what'cha doin'?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am watching Perry the Platypus. I promised to not take my eyes out off him all day.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, this is lame.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He's a platypus, they do not do much.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Maybe he needs some motivation. (Swings a baseball bat)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, no please! I have given them my solemn oath to protect the little monotreme until the Flynn family comes home.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What is that weird noise?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know, maybe a car alarm? (Perry stands up and puts the wristwatch communicator into his mouth)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, I think it stopped. (The wristwatch communicator is still beeping inside of Perry. Baljeet and Buford look at him)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, what'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My king-of-the-world bit. Hey, check that out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And look at those cool flags.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: According to my Fireside Girls manual each one of those flags has meaning. The blue flag means crab season and the yellow flag means hold the mustard, and that one, I'm not sure what that one means.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, who turned off the sun?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, here it is. The red flag with the black box means...storm warning!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You kids get below! I'll head us back to shore! Wooah!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, we're heading towards that whirlpool.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Keep faith in me, my darling! I have everything under control!!!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on Perry's wristwatch communicator) Agent P, come in! Agent P? Blast it, Carl, why doesn't he answer?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think it's comin' from his stomach. (He picks up Perry, and put onto his shoulder)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He must be hungry. I will get him something to eat.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't worry, little ducky thing, we're gonna take good care of you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is everything all right, Agent P? I'm sensing you're in a bit of a jam. Can you get us a better view of the situation?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gonna hug you and squeeze you and never let you go.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Looks like we picked a bad day to send all of our field agents to sensitivity training. We're all out of options. (gasps) I was hoping this day would never come, but, Carl, this is your big chance!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ugh, I think it's finally clearing up.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, the ship held together pretty good, didn't it? (Cut to reveal Lawrence is holding the wheel surrounded by debris from the wreckage.) Of course, we'll have to re-attach the wheel (Cut to reveal the sloop on a rock.) and fix that, uh, giant hole. Now, kids, are you all right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're fine!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, where's Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are. And there's Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, what gives?! (She pulls the squid off to reveal a fish in her mouth and lobsters on her ears. She pulls the lobsters off and spits out the fish.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (inspecting the hole) Whoa, this doesn't look too good at all. Kids, don't come up here! It's far too dangerous! Mum and I will fix the boat. Candace, why don't you look for some food? And, boys, you could find us some shelter if you like. We may be here for a while.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A while?!!? You mean we're stranded?!? That means I won't get to Jeremy's party before the sun sets!!! We'll be stuck here forever eating rocks and bugs, then I'll have to marry a monkey and have monkey kids and name them Xavier and Amanda!!! (sobs)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And we'll love them anyway. Candace, the sooner we get started, the sooner we all get to go home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Stay safe, everyone! (Linda waves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Shelter....shelter.... Well, this spot has potential.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great, let's get started!

Name: Montage
Dialog: The gang map out the shelter and get started working on it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on monitor in truck) Remember, Carl, nothing distracts kids like ice cream. You need to get rid of those two boys so Agent P can proceed with his mission.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (salutes) Aye aye, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Both hands on the wheel, Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, sir.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, Perry, I could not find the platypus food.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, boy!

Name: Baljeet and Buford
Dialog: (running off) Ice cream! Ice cream!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I almost forgot Perry. Come along. Let us get you a little treat. (Baljeet grabs Perry, who holds onto the grass.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gimme a double caramel fudge.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Here you go.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ugh! Hey, this is butterscotch ripple! (A small door slides up on the truck with a lit arrow. Perry spits out his fedora, puts it on and zips into it.) Is this your first day on the job or somethin'?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, he didn't charge me! Rookie mistake.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did not even get to—Wait?! Where is Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Glad to have you back, Agent P. You lost some time, but I brought along the escape cone.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on monitor) Agent P, we've just received reports that Doofenshmirtz has been buying up all the laundry detergent in the Tri-State Area. We want you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. You'll need to use your tracking device to find him before your delicious ice cream cone melts. (Perry salutes. An island appears on the screen. Perry lands on the island.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (imitating her father) "Oh, Candace, go find us some food." Yeah, like a quart of ice cream is just gonna fall out of the— (The strawberry ice cream from the escape cone lands on her head.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, where is Perry the Platypus? He should have been here hours ago. (Perry approaches him) Ah, Perry the Platypus. Well, y'know, I had a trap for you, but no time. (Grabs him and runs off) This one's a little complicated, okay? (He puts Perry in a chair in front of a screen.) You remember a few schemes ago when I couldn't figure out what "Big Laundry" meant? (A slide of Doofenshmirtz from "The Lake Nose Monster" appears on the screen.) Well, this! (Another slide appears) This is what I meant! I am nefariously planning to provide the entire population of the Tri-State Area with free laundry, (change slide) which will drive out of business all of the local laundromats, (change slide) freeing up prime real estate locations (change slide) for my newest franchise

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Perry! Where are you?! Oh, it is no use. I fear he is gone for good.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why don't you just buy him a new one? They won't know the difference.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You cannot just buy a—Wait. That gives me an idea!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We don't need to eat. We need to get out of here! (tries to get a coconut off a tree) I swear, if I don't get to Jeremy's party— (A monkey appears from behind the bushes and kisses her) Yuck! Monkey cooties!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what do you think of our shelter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dusts herself off and shouts in her brother's face) CAN'T YOU JUST BE NORMAL FOR ONE DAY?!? All you had to do was make a little lean-to for survival.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, there's survival and then there's living. (Zoom out to reveal the entirety of the shelter. Phineas pushes Candace inside.) Let us give ya a quick tour. We've got everything we need to make our maritime mishap as enjoyable as possible. Here's our warm and cozy family room, a fully-stocked kitchen. We even have indoor plumbing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're giving a monkey a shower?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yep, had to be done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grrrr! Don't you realize I have a very important party to go to?! If you're going to all this trouble, you could have built us a bridge back to town!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But Dad didn't ask us to build a bridge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or you could have built us a coconut-powered hovercraft!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But Dad didn't ask us to build—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or-Or you could have made a gigantic slingshot and shot us back to the mainland!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, not bad. (Ferb makes a note of it) Mind if we use that someday?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (leaves) Oooh, you two are gonna be so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait. No, Candace! Not that way! That's the— (Candace opens a door that leads to nothing and falls) emergency exit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I was trying to tell you, it's not done yet. There's gonna be this whole slide thing that dumps you into the hot tub! We're waiting on some parts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, Perry the Platypus! (Cut to reveal Perry raveling up a towel.) You put that down right— (He smacks him with it) Ow! Ow, that smarts! (Doofenshmirtz throws his shoe at Perry. Perry jumps as the shoe misses and hits the Monkey Enslave-inator off of the monkey. The monkeys all look angrily at Doofenshmirtz.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Candace, do you want a banana smoothie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got you guys this time! There's no way you could dismantle your stupid tropical dream house before I drag Mom back here to bust you! (Candace walks out.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So... no smoothie then?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Ow! Oh! (Doofenshmirtz comes out of the laundry basket dressed as a bride to Perry's groom. Perry lets him have it, but then jumps away.) That's right, run away, Perry the Pla—AAAAAAHHH!! (Doofenshmirtz falls into the giant washing machine. A bunch of monkeys on one side drop clothes into the machine.) Nice try, Perry the Plat— (Another group of monkeys drop in detergent.) Wai-wai-wait, what are you doing? Don't throw the bright colors in with the—Hey that's too much soap! (bulbs as the monkeys push the start button) Curse you, Perry the Pla—I told you no starch!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Volcano!! (slides down a palm tree) We need to move now! (She grabs Phineas and Ferb as the bubbles take the shelter away with it.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait until Mom and Dad find out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Run, Candace! Pink lava behind you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pink lava?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, that's it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great job fixing the ship, honey. (Cut to reveal the sloop is still on the rock.) But how are we going to get it back in the water?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, well, um...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad, we gotta get outta here!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Woo! Hurry up, kids! Women and children first!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Kids, we're headed home!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You were magnificent, captain!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Can't we go any faster! Come on, steer this thing! Go go go go go!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, Buford. (Buford gives Baljeet a tennis ball and a black marker.) Perhaps this will buy us a little time. Frozen waffle, please. (Buford gives him a frozen waffle with a bite mark out of it.) Ugh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry. Got hungry.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ugh. Maybe they will not know the difference.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think it's pretty convincing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, who am I kidding?! We will have to tell them the truth!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (runs off) You're on your own, Jeet! I'm outta here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Baljeet, we're home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold on, Jeremy! I'm coming!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my friends! (sobs) I hope you can forgive me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet, wait till you hear what we did today.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But I have something to tell you first!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! Aw, and look at that! (Perry approaches the fake platypus) Baljeet made Perry a little friend. Thanks, Baljeet. I knew we could count on you. (Baljeet faints.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb? I'll be over at Vivian's house for a few hours. You kids have fun.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What kind of fun can we have when it's raining?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We could talk about our feelings.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, I'll rephrase it. What kind of fun can we have when it's raining?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I would not mind talking about my feelings.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Punches Baljeet) How do you feel now?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Whimpers) In pain.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There, we're done. I guess that was fun.

Name: Off-Screen Voice
Dialog: How about a game of hide and seek?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who said that?

Name: Boy
Dialog: I did!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who are you?

Name: Boy
Dialog: Allow me to introduce myself. (Walks over to Phineas and Ferb) I'm Irving. I'm your biggest fan! (Chuckles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How long have you been sitting there?

Name: Irving
Dialog: A couple hours. My horoscope says I'm a background type. (Raises book entitled "P & F") Check it out. I've kept a scrapbook of your adventures. (Opens book to a picture of Phineas, Ferb and co. on the rollercoaster) This is the time you built that rollercoaster . (Flips page to Phineas and Ferb on a Chariot at Paul Bunyan's Pancake Haus) And this is the time you built those chariots. (Flips to picture of Phineas and Ferb in the kitchen with Irving in the background) And this is when you had that soup .

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Scoffs) Oh, what a nerd.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that a lock of Ferb's hair?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Snatches book back) Don't touch it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Irving suggested hide and seek.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Isn't the house a little too small to play a good game of hide and seek?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps the problem is not that the house is too small, but that we are too big.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's right! You kids hang tight while Ferb and I use the technology from our submarine adventure to make a new shrinking machine. Ferb, I know what we're going to do today!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (reverently) You said the words. Hey, can I say the Perry thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wha?

Name: Irving
Dialog: You know, when you say "Where's Perry?"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: O...kay.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Where's Perry? Ah, oh wait, wait, I can do better. Where's Perry? Where is Perry? Wherefore art thou Perry? I wonder where that Perry went.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, where is that platypus? Where the P-man at?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. We've received some disturbing calls from Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? Monogram...are you home? If you're home, please pick it up. Pick it up. Hello? Oh, I hate these machines. Okay, listen. I'm being evil and I need Perry the Platypus to come over and stop me. (Beep) Wait-- wait, did I hear a beep? Did the machine just cut me off? Oh-ah-oh I don't know what to do. You know what, I'm just going to call back.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I want you to find out what he's up to and--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? I-- I think your machine cut me off before, what I was saying---

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Find out what Doofenshmirtz is up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here it is, a shrinking machine. Now, everybody touch the top of the machine.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow! We're really tiny! Phineas, your coffee table is huge!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Chuckling) Look at this pencil.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Somebody take a picture of me next to this dust bunny!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas, this is amazing! Everybody should shrink.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Get teeny.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Get tiny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Be small!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (As Baljeet slides in) Safe!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, you caught me. I've been putting recyclable trash in the regular trash bin; I am so bad! You've taught me a valuable lesson. From now on, I'll be green. I'll be all the shades of green. (places circular device on Perry's back under pretense of patting it as he sees Perry out) They will call me El Verde, and tell my tale in Greenland. Goodbye now, drive safe, and thanks for busting down my door. I deserved it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright gang, we can start that game of hide and seek now.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Yells) Earthquake!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, it's Candace. Hey, Candace is it! Everybody hide!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone) Stacy, the bow is totally cute. It's your signature look. You have the bow, and I have (Pause) some weird metal contraption in the living room. (Runs up to it) Stace, I'll call you back. This thing was obviously made by Phineas and Ferb, so it must do something.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Running with Phineas) Phineas, look, on the umbrella stand!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no, she found me. I guess I'm it! (Screams as Candace opens the umbrella catapulting Baljeet to the ceiling, onto the lamp)

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I'm okay!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We gotta get that shrinker back!

Name: Irving
Dialog: You guys always have a plan.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have a plan.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll just have to wing it.

Name: Irving
Dialog: There's no winging, there's no winging in the book. You guys have just been improvising this whole time? (Dramatically) Oh, how heroes fall!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey guys! Remember me? Up here with the dead flies?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sit tight, Baljeet! We'll have you down as soon as we can.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How can I sit tight? With that air conditioner up there freezing me! (Teeth chattering) So cold. So cold.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Activate bug eye-bot. (The bug eye-bot activates) Yes, my little robot eye, find Perry's address for me. That's right, walk towards the front door so I can see the number. Oh, it will be so delicious to know where Perry lives. I can ring his doorbell...and run away! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hey Mom?! I want to show you something! (normal voice, looks back) Yep, I'm one step ahead of you boys, one step. What the heck is this (presses antenna, shrinks) THIIIIIING! (Gasps) I'm shrunk! (Crashing noise as the shrinking machine falls next to her) Where's the reverse button?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Hello? Hello? I could have sworn I heard someone kno-- (Gasps) Oy. That's not a good place to put a toy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro! It's me, Candace! Helloooo!? (Screams and falls off ledge, onto the grass) Guess I deserve this for trying to be one step ahe-- (Screams, as she bumps into a growling caterpillar, which is shown to really be harmless after she runs away)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, we've got to get to that machine across the street.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Groaning) What's the point? We're vacuum bag filler.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thanks for that, Captain Bring-Down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Some kiddie TV show? Agh, the signal must have gotten switched. (Presses buttons) Aw, and now I've lost the picture entirely. (Pause) Hm. I hope it doesn't go rogue.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is that thing? Did we ever make mechanical bugs?

Name: Irving
Dialog: There's nothing in the book.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, split off now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thread 'em and throw 'em guys!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Come on, Fanboy, you want to live forever?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Is that an option?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (As Isabella jumps down, pulls out the needle embedded in the table leg, and takes over for him; faintly) I'm okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great job, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thank you very much.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (War cry) Yeah! Yeah! (screams. He rips off the bug's robotic eye and holds it above his head before throwing it down to the ground)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I couldn't have said it any better myself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was awesome, Phineas.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, but guys? We're still small. What now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you're a genius! Everyone on?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Taking a picture) Hey, I don't have to digitally insert myself.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Go tell it to your blog.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's get Baljeet.

Name: Isabella and Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where is he?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't see him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look over there, something's moving!

Name: Everyone but Ferb
Dialog: Ewww!Baljeet

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Pinky, no! Down! Bad dog. Where are your manners?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are you doing there, short stuff?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, thank goodness!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who smells like fly guts?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I had to survive, okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on! Hands on!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All right, Phineas!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yay, Phineas!

Name: Irving
Dialog: You did it, Ferb!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Isa, is that you?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Yeah, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted! Wait 'til Mom sees this! (runs off) Moooom?!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Giggles) She's gonna go get your mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Pounding his computer screen) Ohh. Work! Work!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on. Ooh, hey, random pounding works. Oh good, we're back on the Perry show.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahhh! All right, Perry the Platypus, could you just do me a favor and hold this up to the street address in front of-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom! You gotta see something in the kitchen! (grabs her arm and drags her, only to spill her coffee) Come on, come on, come on, come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You think you're so clever, Perry the Platypus. But for the first time in my life I can actually use a self-destruct button that I have installed! Prepare to be vaporized, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Mom?! See, see?! (Sees nothing on the counter) WHAT?!! But it was right here!!! I swear there was this machine...and we were tiny...but then we got bigger... (rest is under) and, and...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain, overlapping) Oh, teenagers.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Hormones, all it is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that's done. And no comeuppance.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do I feel so empty?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now this is a ship. My, she's yar. Is she ready to sail?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She's shipshape in Bristol fashion.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What does that mean?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: What does "yar" mean?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas! Ferb! I need your help!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (As he and Ferb pulley themselves down to ground level) Hey, Baljeet. I thought your friend Mishti was visiting from India.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: She is. But- she is different now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Different how? Did she turn into a werewolf or something?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, she is- a girl!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She was probably a girl the whole time.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Let me explain. Four years ago, back in India, we used to have such a good time together.

Name: Young Mishti
Dialog: Give it to me!

Name: Young Baljeet
Dialog: No, no, no! Me! Give it to me!

Name: Young Mishti
Dialog: No, me, me! (Baljeet shoves her out of the way. She promptly does the same thing to him.) I'm open!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And she never ever showed any kind of sign of werewolfism at all?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If we could just stick to the topic, please. Five minutes and forty-eight seconds ago, back in my home...

Name: Baljeet's mother
Dialog: (offscreen) Baljeet! The Patels are here!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Coming! Misht-aah...!

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Hi, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So after hiding in the bathroom, I jumped out the window and came over here as quickly as possible. I do not even know how to act in front of a girl! I do not even know what girls like.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hm. Isn't it like "sugar and spice, and everything nice"?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is what they are made of. I do not want to build one. Duh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'know, I think what girls really like is romance.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Romance?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we learned all about it in this movie we watched last night. Dinner, music, candlelight, and all on a romantic cruise over the ocean blue. Lucky for you, we happen to have a ship right here. Ferb, cancel the giant bottle. I know what we're going to do today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, you're gonna have to pick it up a little, sir. They're starting to boo.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I've gotta hear, Carl. (A machine starts beeping nearby, signaling Perry's arrival) Oh, he's here!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Now on screen in Perry's lair) Agent P, sorry about the delay. Doofenshmirtz is at it again, he's been frequenting hobby shops and well, Carl's worried sick. Aren't you, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, not really sick, sir, I am a little concerned.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Overlapping him) What did I say about contradicting me in front of the agents?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, that's pretty much it. You can go, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's it. Okay, Carl. (Sounds of rock band)

Name: Baljeet's Mother
Dialog: Baljeet? Aren't you in the bathroom?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I climbed out the window.

Name: Baljeet's Mother
Dialog: Oh, I thought it was a...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Mother, please! May I just speak to Mishti?

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet. What's up?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Clears throat) Um... If you do not already have plans for this upcoming afternoon...

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Actually, I had plans with you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, okay! Well, if you are busy...

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Oh, no, Baljeet! What did you have in mind?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, some friends of mine have planned... (pulls out brochure and reads it to her) "an all-inclusive luxury cruise around Danville Harbor".

Name: Mishti
Dialog: A boat ride? Cool! I will go get my stuff.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Still reading the brochure) "Highlights of the evening will include a romantic candlelit dinner with-"... oh, she is gone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just wish Jeremy was more romantic. You know, like Romeo-and-Juliet romantic, but without all the dying.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ahoy, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, Stacy, I'm gonna have to call you back. (Pushes another number on speed dial)Hey, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Wearing a salad bowl attached to a pipe on her head, an unknown whirring noise emanating from it) Candace, make it quick. I'm in the middle of something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (leaning out her window to see the ship) Phineas and Ferb are leaving on a cruise ship- but I don't even know where they're going!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (As the whirring noise gets louder) I can hardly hear you. What's this about a ship? Are you at the harbor?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'm at home! Wait, the harbor! That's where they're going! I'll bust them there.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (As he stops blowing into the pipe attached to the salad bowl on Linda's head, revealing him as the source of the whirring noise) Was that Candace on the phone?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah. She probably doesn't know we're in the living room.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: So, what do you think? (Starts blowing into the pipe again)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (After a beat) You know, you're right. It does kind of sound like the ocean.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. You like my scale model? (Gestures to a cardboard model he has made of Danville) I even put my own little building in there, look. Look, there it is! (points at the building) Ah, yes, my home. I can still remember the day I bought it. Flashback!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My real estate agent had already shown me hundreds of other places within my budget... (These places include a rotting old cabin, a rotting old mobile home, and a port-a-potty) ...but none of them were acceptable. (A man walks out of the port-a-potty as the real estate agent opens the door for Doofenshmirtz to look inside. Doofenshmirtz face palms) That was until he showed me this magnificent building, with a view all the way to the ocean! (Doofenshmirtz delightfully looks at the ocean view from his balcony) But the first night I realized why the price was so cheap. All night long, foghorns from passing ships would sound. I couldn't understand why all these ships were there... (Doofenshmirtz stands at his window, staring at the ocean full of ships) ...until one day, I turned my neck to the right about forty-five degrees, and there, I saw it. The Danville Lighthouse! It was attracting the ships like moths to a flame.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, what I am going to do is move the light house all the way over here, to the other side of town! (moves his cardboard lighthouse to the other side of the scale model) The boats will follow it, like moths following a...have I already used that, uh...that metaphor? I think I...oh, how about bees going to...whatever bees go to, or flies to...oh, let's just go with the moth thing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: For your safety, Mishti, I invite you to hold on to the rail. It appears to be very clean, which I know is important to you now that you are a girl.

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Waving) Hey, Isabella. What'cha doooin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The Fireside Girls and I just got our Shrimp Net Repair Patches. What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A romantic cruise. You wanna come?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Gasps in delight) You want me to come on a romantic cruise with you?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (oblivious) Yeah, it'll be fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (a little nervously) Um...okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew it! Time to call Mom. (Dials her phone, then tries to yell into it, but a seagull squawks at the same time, scaring her)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (As another unknown whirring noise is occurring in the background) Candace? I can't understand a word you're saying.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, if you're feeding the geese again, I hope you're not wearing a tube top. (Hangs up, then looks at her husband, who is once again the source of the whirring noise) Do you mind?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Now it sounds like a spaceship.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, let me try.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, they've gotta come back sometime, and when they do, I'll be standing right here ready to bust them. (Three seagulls land on her head and shoulders, imitating her on the lookout. She shakes her arms to shoo them away) Would you get off of me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (romatically) Wow, Phineas! This is so romantic!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (oblivious) You think this is romantic? Wait 'til you see what else I have planned. (Isabella blushes, and he takes her hand. He leads her inside the ship.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (At the camera) Yes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, show the happy couple to their table.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Here is our table, Mishti. Is this okay with you? It is not too drafty, is it?

Name: Mishti
Dialog: It will be fine, Baljeet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cue music! (At Isabella) Classical music. Very romantic.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cue rose petals!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cue...'pid!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, everyone. I'm wearing a diaper.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At Isabella, who is obviously not buying it) So...do I know romance, or what?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Completely deadpan) What.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Oblivious) I said, do I know romance, or --

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I heard you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This food is really good, do you not think so?

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Uh, yes...I guess so.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Subtle, yet pungent.

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Yes, very.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Still hanging on the rope above the table) Hey, can you pass me one of those bad boys?

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Uh...look, Baljeet, I appreciate all this, but, uh...I just want to hang out, like we used to.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But, uh, are you sure you do not want to hear more music?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Did somebody say music? (Begins to sing) Ohhh-- (The rope snaps and he falls, crushing the table)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've attached rockets to the lighthouse, so when I push this button, it will fly to the other side of town, the ships will follow, and then I can finally get some sleep!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I suppose I should've put some sort of steering mechanism on it, but, um, live and learn.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? How did you escape?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
