Dialog: (As he bends down) What's that? (Perry punches him in the nose) Ooh! I guess I walked into that one. (He falls backwards, right onto his scale model of Danville, destroying it) Aw, man, I worked all weekend on that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look, this staple makes a perfect little chimney. I hope Perry the Platypus appreciates all this hard work.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (As she walks by in the background) He won't.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what, Perry the Platypus? I think it's time for you to go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's right, go on! Your services are no longer required. The lighthouse is gone, and there's nothing you can do about it. So you might as well run back to Major Monogram and tell him you lost this one.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Did I... Mention how nice the weather is?

Name: Mishti
Dialog: (Sighs) Several times.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well... It is nice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. We've tried everything in that romantic movie but nothing seems to work. The orchestra, the petals, the love song. The only other thing they did in that movie is sink the ship.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That ought to do it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I must apologize, the ship sinking was not in the brochure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Is this romance or what?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, where are the life preservers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have any!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've got "Fun Preservers"! Hit it, Ferb.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, that's the end of this diaper.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everybody, to the Fun Preservers!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, oh! Cupids first!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So you are telling me that even though you are now a girl, you still like to have fun just like in the old days?

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Of course, Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Then you would not mind if I went like...this? (splashes water on her face)

Name: Mishti
Dialog: Not if you do not mind if I go like...this! (shoves him off of the Fun Preserver)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, this romance stuff was fun. We should do it more often.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes. Yes, we should.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, you guys better tell me what you were up to on that cruise ship.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just whipping up a little romance for Baljeet and his friend, Mishti.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You created romance?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And...did it work?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like it. They seem to be having a great time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you think you could do that for me and Jeremy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't see why not.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I love having some kid's feet in my face as much as the next guy. But how about we just go grab a Slushy Burger?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (In his pajamas) Ah, finally, a good night's sleep. (Shuts his eyes. Crashes are heard in the background)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Opens his eyes) Hmm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (With his eyes closed) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, what the heck is that sound? Come on, Ferb, I know what we're not gonna do today. We're not gonna figure out what we are gonna do today as long as that noise keeps up! (he, Ferb, and Perry leave)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (slams open her window) If you don't stop that racket, I am so gonna bust you... empty... backyard?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (closes window) Candace, stop trying to bust your backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rushingly picks up her cell phone) Jeremy! Yes? Yes! We'll see you in a bit. Thanks. No, you get off the phone- (phone disconnects) Hello?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, what's the scoop?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy just invited us to his friend's concert!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I don't know... Lately I've been feeling like a third wheel around you guys.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, goody. The Chart.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Jeremy only calls me "Candace," and nothing else. When a guy makes you his girlfriend, he comes up with a nickname for you. A pet name like, "baby," "honey," "Peg-Leg Pete!" His own personal stamp!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe you should just let whatever happens happen. You know, naturally.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) Naturally? (the wail starts again.) Where is that coming from?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet's house? For such a mild-mannered kid, we wind up here for a lot of weird reasons. (Ferb is shown with fingers in his ears.) Ah, I wish I had some earplugs. (Ferb holds up a dual earplug shaped like fingers.) Thanks dude! (cut to Baljeet's room, where he is holding a guitar and facing the wall.) So, uh... What up 'jeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, uh... Hello my friends, I did not hear you come in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is everything okay?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If by okay, you mean that my life is a meaningless, black cauldron of swirling failure... then yes, everything is groovy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's not at all what I meant by "okay."

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I signed up for a class called "Summer Rocks," believing it was a geology course. It turned out to be a rock-and-roll camp, and no matter how hard I study, I just do not rock! I could actually get an e- (tries to say "F") an- Oh, I cannot even say that terrible letter. ineas! erb! What am I going to do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was an interesting sound you were getting out of your guitar. I think you'll be just fine!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That was not my guitar. That was me. I call it "The Fail Wail." (begins wailing again)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet. Baljeet! Whoa! Hey! (Baljeet stops wailing.) Thank you. We can show you how to rock!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Absolutely. Hey, I think the Fail Wail scared Perry off!

Name: Usher
Dialog: Ticket, please. (Perry hands him a ticket) Right this way! (guides Perry to his chair) Enjoy the show.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Evil... wait... You... await... Evil... awaits...

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Cut, cut!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, come on! (to Perry) Sorry, Agent P. Carl's been taking some film classes and now believes I'm stifling his creativity as my cameraman.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (pats Monogram with a makeup sponge) Camera artist.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Seems Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying baby supplies all over town. One could only imagine what he's doing. Two can discuss it between themselves; more than two is frankly a waste of our resources. Good luck, Agent P! (Perry leaves)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, once more with feeling!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The agency isn't paying for these classes, are they Carl?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have read every book on the history of rock music.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gosh, Baljeet, rock and roll isn't about books! It's about letting go and having fun! Rock and roll is a way for you to tell the world how you feel!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Feel about what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Expressing yourself! I mean, what do you do when you're angry?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Math.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Okay, well, what about when you're sad?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Math!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Happy?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ma-ath!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So every feeling you have makes you want to do math?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not know if it is so much cause and effect. I do a lot of math! The feelings come and go.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What kind of concert is this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's the "Summer Rocks" graduation concert. Jeremy's friend Coltrane is an instructor. (spots Jeremy and Coltrane talking) Look, there they are!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's Coltrane. He's really cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm, I guess he is. Hey, wait a minute... You like Coltrane!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, I've never actually talked to him before, but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quick, what should we do? Hide? No, wait, pretend you're a talent scout. Ooh, here! I think I have a fake mustache on me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's just go over and say hi. (leads Candace over to the two boys, who are talking)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (to Coltrane) What do you think it means when a girl leaves a fake mustache at your house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking up with Stacy) Hi guys!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey gals!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! "Gals." Yeah, that's me, "the gal." Gosh, when did you start calling me that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (to Coltrane) Hi, I'm Stacy.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Hey, how ya doin', Stacy? I'm Coltrane.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I like your hair.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Thanks. I like your bow. Let me show you round.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Cool! (the two of them leave)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heeey, Coltrane and Stacyyyy... that was easy. (Candace glares at him) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awww, congratulations, it's a platypus! (laughs) What do you think of my new Nanny-inator? Nice, huh? (pushes a rocking chair up to the playpen) You know what time it is? Evil story time! (sits down) See, I wrote my new evil scheme (holds up a book titled "My Evil Plan") in pop-up book format. Once upon a time, yesterday, like a quarter to six, (opens book to page of Doofenshmirtz sitting in front of a TV) I was watching a nature documentary, and I learned how before a baby's born, its constant companion is the soothing, steady beat of its mother's heart. Even after it's born, the sound of the mother's heartbeat (turns page to a happy mother holding a baby) continues to be a safe, calming beacon to a growing child, (turns page to an annoyed mother holding a grown man) in some cases up until their early thirties. Suddenly, I was struck with a brilliant idea

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Rock's not about getting good grades and following the rules; it's about rebellion! It's about using music to express your true feelings and emotions! Just play how you feel! (Baljeet plays a single chord) Baljeet, that's- that's just an A chord.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I feel like I want an A!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is gonna be harder than we thought.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Do you think you could teach me how to play the bass?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Let's see if you have big bass player hands. (they hold up hands to compare sizes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from a bush, trying to imitate a bird) Bu-GA! Bu-GA! Ooka-ooka-ooka-ooka!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, excuse me for a second. (Candace repeats her "bird call") I have to go talk to my friend in the bushes.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Cool! I gotta go get this show started. Save me a dance?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still in the bush, still making her "bird call") Koo-koo-koo-koo-kooooo! Ki-KA! Ki-KA! (Stacy walks up to her) Ooka-ooka-ooka-ooka! Eega-eega-eega!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What are you doin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How's it going with you and Coltrane?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think it's going really well! He asked me to save him a dance!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He did? What do you think he meant by that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'm pretty sure he meant he wants to dance with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm. Men and their impossible endless riddles!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So how's it going with you? Has Jeremy nicknamed you yet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe Jeremy just isn't the kind of guy who nicknames people.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh. You could be right.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look, here he comes now!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (greeting people as he passes them) Yo, T-Bone! Hey, Clammo! What up, Sassy Miss K? Momo! Binkie... (reaches Stacy and Candace) Hi Candace, where you been?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'll, uh... I'll see you later.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Catch ya later, Staceroo. (Candace glares at him again) What?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ohhhh, I do not know about this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'll be great! Just remember what we practiced

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am about to let my feelings out through these pleather pants!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I'm almost ready, Perry the Platypus. (pointing to a heart monitor on his wrist) This monitor takes my pulse and transmits it to the Bum-Bum-inator, which will then broadcast my heartbeat to all the babies in the Tri-State Area. See? (the Bum-Bum-inator begins beating.) You might say I'm wearing my sleeve on my... I- I mean my heart is wearing, uh... Never mind, whatever, you get it! Ah-ha-HA-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!! (raises the Bum-Bum-inator through the roof, broadcasting the heartbeat)

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: And now, the band you've all been waiting for

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (hears the heartbeat and mistakes it for a drumbeat) Hey, cool beat, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh... thanks? (Begins mimicking the beat; Phineas and Ferb start playing as well. Baljeet peeks around the curtain from backstage.)

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: What's up, Baljeet? Your band is waiting for you onstage.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can't do it! I just do not know how to rock! I know I am going to get a bad grade!

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Wait, what are you talking about, "grades"? This is Summer Rocks! There are no grades.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No grades? Oh, so it is pass/fail?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: No! We use a free-floating curriculum to encourage kids to just... rock out and have fun!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (outraged) I do not believe this! I wasted all this time in a class without grades?!? Aohhhhh! If only there were some other kind of outlet for me to express these feelings to my like-minded peer group! (comes to a realization) Pardon me! I want to try something!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh yeah! I have got something to say!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, now to relax and keep my heart rate slow and steady, you know, 'cause too much excitement would cause my heart to beat too fast and short out the Bum-Bum-inator.

Name: Nanny-inator
Dialog: Change time! Change time! (Perry jumps on the Nanny-inator's arm when it reaches for him, climbs out of the cage while the Nanny-inator accidentally breaks itself, and tackles Doofenshmirtz, who grunts while his heart rate rises, causing the music to speed up as well. Perry chases Doofenshmirtz around the room.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, stop chasing me; I'm supposed to keep my heart rate down!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I am so upset!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Somebody gimme a grade!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh oh. Not good. (the Bum-Bum-inator shorts out and flies across the sky, yanking Doofenshmirtz along with it) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE- (passes over the Summer Rocks stage) Wait, is that the Baljeatles?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just call me "Can't-Dance Flynn."

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (laughs) Okay, that's your new nickname.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what? No! I'm not supposed to nickname myself! You're supposed to come up with it! (starts crying) You don't even care enough to try!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, wait a second! I call you Candace, but not because I don't care enough to come up with a cute nickname for you! I call you Candace 'cause... I happen to really like that name.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You do?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Of course I do! 'Cause it's your name. (they hug)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (standing next to Coltrane) That was easy. (they look down and see that they're holding hands, then smile at each other)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Baljeet, if it means anything, I'd give you an A+ in rock.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No. That means almost nothing.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I need a car. I can't keep riding on the back of your scooter every time I go someplace. It's totally embarrassing.

Name: Biker
Dialog: Hey, sweetheart. How'd you like to take a ride on a real bike?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She's sixteen!

Name: Baby alien
Dialog: (giggles) Oh, yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, ever since I installed the Away-inator on my helmet, driving is fun again!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, check this out. (looking at a map) The Super-Duper Megastore is the largest supplier of everything in the Tri-State Area. Heh. I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm gonna buy Jeremy a gift. It's the anniversary of the very first time Jeremy and I went to Slushy Burger. He spilled a cheese dog on me and mustard got all over the place. He was so sweet.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hmm. Tough one. I don't think they make a card for that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Mom, what are you gonna get at the store?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I need a 25 pound tub of mayonnaise and 80 pounds of potatoes to make potato salad for the bridge club.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Puts away his map) Wow. That's a lot of potato salad.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Parks the car) Remember to meet me back at the car in three hours. (Everyone leaves the car)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, think of it, Ferb. Fifty-two million, six-hundred thirty-seven thousand square acres of unbridled consumerism all under one roof.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Wolf whistles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can whistle that again.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Wolf whistles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (While walking him to the Park Your Pooch department on a leash) And you get to go to the pet-sitter's, Perry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes off his helmet) If you want a car, (Vanessa takes off her helmet) you're going to have to prove to me that you're responsible, that you can do things by yourself.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: How could I do that when I'm always on the back of your scooter?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Walks into the superstore) It's a conundrum, isn't it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (talking from a screen set into the bone) Psst. Agent P. Agent P. (Perry puts on his fedora) Down here. (Camera zooms into the bone) It's the new dog bone communicator. Pretty clever, huh?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I thought of it, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I'm trying to use the bone. (to Perry) Anyway, Agent P, we've learned that Dr. Doofenshmirtz is shopping for parts to build another one of his outlandish devices. Put a tail on him.

Name: Man
Dialog: You look fabulous!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So I've got to find some way to prove to you I'm responsible. There must be an easier way to earn a car.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what they say about taking the easy way.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What do they say?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I could tell you, but that would be taking the easy way, and you know what they say about that. Ooh, look! Pizzazium Infinionite!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Film Speaker
Dialog: You've heard of hydrogen. You may know boron. But of all the elements on the periodic table, none is more fascinating and less abundant than Pizzazium Infinionite. Pizzazium Infinionite was first discovered by fortune hunters fifty years ago in the year 1894. No one is really sure what it does, but look to the future for hover vehicles powered by Pizzazium Infinionite, in the world of tomorrow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? That's what it is.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Where did you get the...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's gone! Someone took the last one!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What luck! Pizzazzium Infinionite! That science prize is as good as mine!

Name: Buford
Dialog: So why am I here again?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because, (hands it to Buford to hold) as a person of superior intellect, I require an angry wall of meat to protect my science project.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Angry wall of meat, huh? Yeah, I can do that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great. Now I have to scour this whole place and find the Pizzazzium and probably have to wrench it out of the hands of some random shopper.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wait, Dad. I can do this for you. I can go find this--this Pizzazzium thing and prove to you that I can be responsible. That I can do things on my own. Then you can get me my own car, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't know. Are you sure you can...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Of course I can. I'm me. It'll be a piece of cake.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We'll see.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sing-song) I'm not hearing a no.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sing-song) I'm not saying a yes. (pause) Here, you can take this Pizzazzium locator. It'll help.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How am I gonna find that one perfect gift in this humongous store?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, isn't Jeremy into camping?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So maybe a pocket knife, or a fishing lure,...or a compound bow. (imitates someone shooting an arrow) Take that, apple on kid's head!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) He said he needed a lantern!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, a lantern's good.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And then I will start my own foundation to... Are you not hearing me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? Buford hungry. (accidentally drops tube of Pizzazzium Infinionite over balcony)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I really have to rethink having you as my wall of meat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Too big.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Too small.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I don't want to get him just any old lantern.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You can't expect the perfect gift to just drop out of the sky.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... (holds hands out in expression and the tube of Pizzazzium Infinionite lands in them)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Woah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's perfect! It's all futuristic-y and cool...and it dropped out of the sky!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, I guess I stand corrected.

Name: Candace
Dialog: When Jeremy looks into its bright glow, he'll think of me...(Candace and Stacy notice the switch) Hey, what's this?

Name: Both
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey buddy, watch where you're... Say, you look fabulous. (a brief clip of "Fabulous" plays) Haven't I seen you somewhere before? (Perry chatters then flees the scene) No need to get huffy, you ran into me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ahhh. You know Ferb, I think I know what I want to do every day.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (beeping gets more rapid, and she notices the tube of Pizzazzium Infinionite on the ground) Well, that was easy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: ...I gotta get it, gotta g... gotta get it, gotta get it, gotta get it, gotta get it, gotta get it, gotta get it...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! Mine, mine mine mine mine mine mine!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wha- hey! Watch where you're... Oh great, now this thing is broken, and they've got the Pizzazziu... (sighs) Look, (to Ferb) thanks for your help, but I can do this on my own, okay? (runs away with Pizzazzium locator)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) That lantern was the perfect gift.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Buford and Baljeet! How did they get it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you've gotta try this chair! I can't feel my brain!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (searching through the ball pit) Ugh, I hope nobody sees me in here.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ferb, honey, aren't you a little old to be playing in the ball pit?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay then. (walks away; Vanessa emerges from under the balls)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Your name is Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well yes, it's short for... (the vacuum pulls up the Pizzazium) Oh, here it is.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (grabs Pizzazium and runs out of the pit) Thanks, Ferb! See you around!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (walking up to a lawn mower with a sign above it) Push button, start mower. Does this really work?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I will take that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, my fingers look just like snakes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (at a "Mystic Eye" table) Oh, it's one of those 3D things. (holds up the picture) I can hardly see the... (Perry crashes through the picture, dropping the Pizzazium) Oop, there it is.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ferb!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Check it out! They do make a card for a spilled cheese dog with mustard.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, Ferb. You certainly know how to show a girl a good time! (holds up the Pizzazium) I've gotta get this to my dad immediately. (Ferb throws the Pizzazium into the tennis ball launcher, which fires) Whoa! (the Pizzazium bounces and rolls past Doofenshmirtz, in line at the checkout counter, to the entrance of the store; Doofenshmirtz gleefully picks it up) Well, that worked.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got it! I got it! (Perry moves the alarm sensor at the entrance, causing the security alarm to go off) I got it! (two security guards show up)

Name: Security guard
Dialog: Excuse me sir, you know you have to pay for this. (takes the Pizzazium)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was! I was going to pay!

Name: Security guard
Dialog: Tell it to the judge.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't worry, guys, we'll- we'll get this all straightened out. Va- Vanessa! Vanessa... (the guards drag him away) No no, you can't take me, I don't have anyone to curse!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, Mom. Do you think you found everything you need?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I think I have enough to tide over the bridge club.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's a lot of potato salad.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, time to find out where they dragged Dad off to. Guess that car will have to wait. Oh, yeah. Thanks. (kisses Ferb on the cheek and leaves; the floral background and music start up again)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (appears next to Ferb, shaking) Did I miss something? (Ferb touches Phineas' nose, making him stop shaking) Thanks, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is it here yet?

Name: Mail Lady
Dialog: Sorry, boys. Not today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, rats.

Name: Mail Lady
Dialog: Oh, wait, boys. I almost forgot, your mom's Penny Shopper.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! When you two gonna move that stupid box out of the doorway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Box? When did that come?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The delivery guy brought it while you two were camping out in the mailbox.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, man. I can't believe it's here! Finally, the world-famous x-ray vision glasses. This is gonna be great! Whoa! We got totally ripped-off! Ferb, let me see that comic again. Oh, for crying out loud! "Amazing illusion"? "Fool your friends"? "Does not actually provide x-ray vision". Oh, man, this is a rip-off! It's just like the body building course we got last summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And I was so looking forward to looking through things.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, that's it! I know what we're gonna today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! Are you the cutest thing ever? Aw, you're so adorable! I just could eat you up. Not literally, but you know what I mean.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz is up to his usual shenanigans, but we have a more serious problem. There's a rouge agent on the loose, and he's in your area. Carl's working with our field agents...to create a composite sketch.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Finished, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? You said you could draw! (to Perry) I'm sorry, Agent P. In the meanwhile, he may try to find one of your secret passages and infiltrate your lair where he could hack into our mainframe. So, be on the lookout for any suspicious characters.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, Ferb, there's Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe that's where he disappears to all the time. Well, if he got himself up there, he can get himself

Name: Phineas
Dialog: down. Anyway, we've got the frames and the polycarbonate lens solution. Now what we need is something that really improves eyesight. (Snaps his fingers) Hey, I know!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, Ferb, you're way ahead of me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've hired a professional artist and got much better results. We've identified the

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: rogue agent as Dennis. He's a mercenary for hire and master of disguise. You need to stop him at all costs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: First, I'm going to name you Mr. Cutie-Patootie. Then we'll give you a complete makeover, and teach you some cool tricks. You stay put while I find you a new stylish outfit. Let's see what we got here. (While Dennis, now standing upright, searches for an entrance to Perry's lair) What am I doing with a scepter? Huh. Next! Leopard headbands are so last year. Ooh, here's some of my doll clothes! Eh, let's skip the tiara. What is this? Leg warmers? Who wears leg warmers? I definitely don't.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mr. Cutie-Patootie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I finally found— (Notices Perry, then nudges him out from her room with a foot) Get away from him! I don't want your blandness to rub off. (Picks up Dennis, then slams the door) Aw, poor Mr. Cutie-Patootie. Don't mind him. Once I'm done making you over, you're going to be new alpha pet.

Name: Dennis
Dialog: (Coughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I know! Matching shoes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I found it! These shoes should complete the outfit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Ah, Perry the Platypus! How unexpected for you to burst in my nefarious..." (Looks at a script) Nefarious? No, it's not. It's too much, even for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus is due any second. (checking the time on his watch) Hey, it's getting a little late. Where is he?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, who needs him? He never does anything until after I tell him my plans. He just stands there like a potted plant. (pauses, then notices a potted plant) In fact... (places a folded newspaper hat on the plant) Ah, Planty the Potted Plant. How unexpected! (pushes a button) I'd invite you to foil my latest scheme, (A rope comes down from a vent) but I can see you're all tied up. (Planty gets captured) You see, I don't even need Perry the Platypus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom's just got back from the grocery store, so we ought to have plenty of carrots for our x-ray glasses.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you very much!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, actually, Candace, we need those.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really? For your stupid x-ray glasses?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (angry, shows hand) Hey! They're not stu --

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you know what this is?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, is it not a rabbit?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is an actual living creature that uses carrots for food instead of science experiments.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: So, why is he wearing a tutu?

Name: Candace
Dialog: He likes it! Don't worry, Mr. Cutie-Patootie. They're just jealous.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, maybe Isabella has some carrots.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, let's start with some simple tricks. Sit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Roll over! (Pause) Do the Worm! (Pause) Now the Robot. (Pause) Great! Wow, you must really like carrots. (Runs out of the living room)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What the? (Looks over to see Perry and Dennis in pet mode) Oh, a bunny rabbit. Candace must have gotten a new pet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Planty the Potted Plant, since you're just hanging around.... (chuckles) Let me demonstrate the brilliant evil-losity of my latest inven...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Grr. You see? See, that's what I'm talking about. Ever since those condos next door started

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: allowing pets, it's been driving me bonkers! All day and all night with the barking, barking, barking! (pulls the lever) Oh, that is why I created my latest masterpiece of evil... giant Dog-Biscuit-inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you! Thank you for my point for me! (to Planty) Now, I'll cover it with an irresistible gravy coating, and then it will take off and soar through town, getting all the dogs to chase after it until they follow it right off the edge of the Tri-State area! (smiles smugly) Well, Planty the Potted Plant. Pretty clever, eh? (pauses, then pushes Planty away) Don't give me that look. Prepare to launch...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, how did you do that? (Gets hit on back of his head again) Ow! Ow! Come out in the open where I can... Ow!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Stomp harder, Ferb! This carrot juice is gotta be really concentrated.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just waiting for the concentrated carrot extract to mix with the super heated optical polymers. Now I dip the frames to the x-ray solution. It may take a couple of hours to set properly.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Or just five minutes in my Quick-E-Bake Oven. Fireside Girls are always prepared. (Places x-ray glasses in the Quick-E-Bake Oven)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Taps the x-ray glasses) Looks like they're ready. (Hands them to Phineas)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here goes nothing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, it sounds like it's coming from my house.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mom, what's wrong?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: I lost my wedding ring!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Mom, when did you have been doing since you last saw it?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Ah, si, si, si. I was fixing some lunch, then I washed the dishes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Raises an eyebrow) Dishes, huh? It looks like a job for x-ray vision glasses. (Blinks, then finds Vivian's wedding ring stuck in the drainpipe) I found it!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Ah, thank you, Phineas. Uh...where is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Down in the drainpipe under the sink. (Moves left curtain) We'll have it out for you in a jiff. (to Ferb) Quick, Ferb! We need a 14-inch pipe wrench, a blowtorch, and a jar of mayonnaise.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Ooh, that's very sweet of you boys, but I think I'll call my regular plumber. He's bonded.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Takes off x-ray glasses) Okay, suit yourself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The glasses work great!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Puts the glasses back on) This is gonna be fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks our x-ray vision glasses have passed all the quality control tests.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good thing, because we're stocking up quite a pile of orders.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. It's time to order a big truck load of carrots.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mr. Cutie-Patootie?! Where are you?! MR. CUTIE PATOOTIE!!!

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: Intruder alert. Intruder alert.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, hello, Agent... (Gasps) No! Not you! Agent P, you've got to stop him before he...

Name: Female Voice
Dialog: Access granted.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (While talking on the phone) Yes, ma'am, you heard me right. I need three metric tons of your highest grade carrots delivered A.S.A.P. (Person on the other end answers) Why yes, yes I am.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Have you seen Mr. Cutie-Patootie? I can't find him anywhere.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, did you check the backyard? He might be there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. How about the kitchen?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs wearily) Well, Planty the Potted Plant. You have proven yourself quite the adversary. Why don't we just...call this one a draw? (Plops himself against the door) I'm kind of pooped.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Curse you, Planty the Potted Plant!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good work, Agent P. (Gives a thumbs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't suppose he could've run away?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry. I'm sure he'll turn up. (Notices that all the carrots have disappeared) Hey, what happened to all the carrots? One minute there's a backyard full of carrots. I turn around for half a minute and; Poof! – now they're gone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome to my world.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that must be really annoying.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Notices Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry tiredly lies on the stone walk; she then pets him) At least you're still around. Do you like wearing pink?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: On behalf of the entire Agency, I like to thank you for your valiant service in one of our darkest hours. (places a medal and a fedora on Planty) Planty the Potted Plant, welcome to the Agency.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... my... gosh! I can't believe it! We're finally gonna have our first... (with Stacy) Spa day! Algae infused seaweed mud wrap...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hot rock rub and volcanic mineral scrub!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (surprised) Fun?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Mud, seaweed, volcanic rock.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not fun, it's relaxing. Which means it's enjoyable, which means it's fun. Grown-up fun. You wouldn't understand. Besides, the Le Rub de Scrub Spa is very exclusive. You can't even get in unless you know someone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are you guys getting in?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I know Stacy...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: ...and I know this neighbor who knows this hair-washer, who knows this bank teller, who knows this back-waxer who works at the spa.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and I know Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Well Ferb and I aren't connected like you guys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on. Let's get going. (she and Stacy walk away)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, guys. Where you goin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're going to the spa.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah. We're gonna get totally immersed in self-indulgence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And mud.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See? I told you it was fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I think we're going to build a spa. (to Ferb) What do you say, Ferb? It'll give you a chance to do your seaweed rap. You know... (imitating turntable scratches) Huah!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (blinks then rolls his eyes; pause) Okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bills, bills, bills. Ooh, half off at Slushy Burger. Keeper.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, what a little cutie. .... What's a cute little love bug like you doing out here all by yourself? .... I'll call you Mr. Fluffy Pants because you're fluffy and you look like you're wearing pants. Plus, you remind me of my Uncle Fluffy Pants.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what do you think? Soak, steam, sauna then shower? Or shower, steam, soak then sauna?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Yumemy. Uh, uh, I mean...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm on my way to build houses for charity. You girls want to come with?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, we can't because we're going to the... (Candace quickly elbows her) Ow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, wow, philanthropy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But what about the... (Candace elbows her again; she falls to the ground) Ow!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, it's okay, Candace, if you guys are too busy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, what was that all about?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, please hold. (to Stacy) Look, I don't want him knowing about the whole spa thing. He'll think all I care about is myself.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uno momento, por favor. (to Stacy) Look, look, we'll go "help people" for, like, 15 minutes and then we'll go to the spa.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your call is very important to us and will be answered in the order received. (to Stacy) We'll still be able to make to our spa day.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, if you'd rather have a spa day...

Name: Candace
Dialog: You heard spa day? Because I said, "Hurrah day". Like, "Hurrah, I can't wait to build houses." That's what we're doing, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Salt scrub. Nice, nice. Milk bath. Good. Hey, where's Buford with the seaweed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, the volcanic rock is here.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: Yeah, you're going to want to let this cool down a bit before you use it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, he's such a cute little kitty. That's right. That's right. He loves his tuna fish. Yes, you eat that and I'll be over here working on my latest project. (pushes a button; chuckles) I'm painting.

Name: Mr. Fluffy Pants
Dialog: (Meows)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, I see you found my blueprints.

Name: Mr. Fluffy Pants
Dialog: (Purrs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You like those? You like...? (the little kitty proceeds to start shredding the blueprints) No! No, not my blueprints! (beeping) No!

Name: Mr. Fluffy Pants
Dialog: (Jumps up and down on the controller.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no. What are you doing? I worked all... (blubbering) No, not the Gloom-inator! No, no. Get off, get off.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Wow. I hope it doesn't rain on us. (sighs) Anyway, I want to thank you all for volunteering today. Now, if I could have you two on drywall duty. And, you, you're on baseboard duty. (to Jeremy) And I could use you on conduit duty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, sorry, girls. I've got you two earmarked for nail duty.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Woman
Dialog: And that doesn't mean manicures.

Name: Stacy, Candace
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Heh, don't worry, Ferb. Your secret's safe with me. Don't we have one more truck coming?

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: Excuse me, we have a delivery for Phineas Flynn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's me.

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: We've got 18 cases of cucumbers right here. (camera pans to the aforesaid cases)

Name: Delivery Man 3
Dialog: Say, aren't you a little young to order all this?

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: Yes, yes, he is. (to Phineas) Sorry, Phineas, he's new.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, welcome to the job. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, say, Carl, have you seen my parachute pants?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, they're very nice, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not what I meant.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I know, sir, I was making a joke.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, that's.... Of course. That's very funny.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Thank you, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, where are they?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'll go get them.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, you're... you're here. Ahem. The, uh, Tri-State Area is mired in gloom and we believe Doofenshmirtz is behind it. We thought he retired the Gloom-inator, so this one is a big question mark. I'm sure you'll know what to do, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, Carl, how are we doing on those pants?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Did you want the ones with the triangles or the imitation paint splatters?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Triangles. And make it snappy. (pauses) I got the urge to pop and lock.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's hurry up so we don't miss our appointment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: How's it going, girls?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you know, we're just over here helping and being all buildery and stuff.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool beans. I'll let you get back to it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, cool beans. Cool legumes. (accidentally hits a hammer on one of Stacy's fingers)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, we'll just finish this wall and then we'll be able to make it to the... (lets go of a ply-board she was holding and then waves) Oh, hi, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's so dreamy. See what I mean?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, don't touch the... Oh, get away from that, you bad, bad kitty. No, not the Erase-inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not the Bigger-inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Look what you did to the moon. It's huge. It's... Uh... It's... Uh... It's actually kinda pretty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while gesturing and waving his arms around) No, no. You think I did all this...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It wasn't me, I tell you. (points to Mr. Fluffy Pants) It was Mr. Fluffy Pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I call him Mr. Fluffy Pants. You know, he's fluffy, he looks like he's got pants. Plus, he reminds me of my Uncle Fluffy Pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who never actually wore any pants. Come to think of it, I don't know why we called him that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. Anyway, I just love giving people nicknames. For instance, you're Mr. Duck-Bill Face. And Major Monogram, I call him "Monobrow". (laughs) That's a good one, you know, because he's... He's got the one, you know? And his little friend, the intern, is Dr. Coconut. (pauses) Yeah. Sometimes I wish I didn't know so much.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Stacy, don't you just love how Jeremy buckles his tool belt on the third loop?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (muffled cries)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamily) Me, too. We're so gonna get married some day. Did I tell you what we're gonna name our kids? Xavier and Amanda.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's it! Our appointment's in five minutes, and I'm going with or without you.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, are you leaving? I was kind of hoping that maybe you could help me with a teensy-weesny little task. I need that slab of concrete turned into rubble by sundown. You don't mind, right? I mean... After all, it is for the less fortunate. Thanks, I knew I could count on you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I just finished my side of the house and I'm heading home. It was nice hanging out with you all day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Jeremy. It was nice hanging out with you, too. All day. (giggles) Did you hear that? We hung out all day.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (while causing a mess with the jackhammer) Ah, help me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming. Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Out of the way!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm sorry we had to clean up everything destroyed and had to rebuild it, I'm especially sorry I made us miss our spa appointment, but most of all, I'm sorry for being a bad friend. I was just trying to impress Jeremy and I lost sight of...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, you can stop that right now. You're starting to sound like one of those TV show we like to make fun of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Stacy, I...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look, the way I see it, you prevented me from going to the spa, almost killed me with a jackhammer, dropped a wall on me, I've gypsum in my hair, and basically wasted my whole day. But you did it for love, so it's okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, remember that time in the third grade?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean when you glued that hamster to my hair just to impress Billy Clark?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, it's just like that.

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: (sigh) Billy Clark.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, I guess we're even.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: My.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gosh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's not plugged in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, sis. Wow, you seem pretty wiped out. Looks like you two could use a spa day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A backyard spa? You guys are so bust...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, that sounds great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you two are our last customers. We're gonna go ahead and close up, but you're welcome to stay as long as you like.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, I keep telling you; it's not me, it's him. (points to the right) Look over there. Look.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Stacy? .... What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're enjoying the spa.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What spa?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, Phineas and Ferb... The spa's gone, isn't it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: What does that even mean?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah. Never mind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? See, I told you it wasn't me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Mr. Fluffy Pants! (he grabs the cat just in the nick of time) Wait. Wait, wait, wait. Oh, that was close, Mr. Fluffy Pants. You almost... (screaming) You know, I think you're more trouble than you're worth.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, he seems okay. He seems so lovely-dovey.

Name: Boy
Dialog: My cat. I've been looking all over for him. (holds up a missing poster)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (after a long pause) Ah, I'm going to have to do the right thing here, aren't I? Fine. Here you go.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Aw!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't you people have jobs?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we finished the superstructure, but what we really need now is a tool that would fuse wood and metal out of a molecular level.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Technology like that is twenty years away; you will need a time machine. Luckily, I have been working on a design. I have no field about all the quantum physics yet, but if you give me a couple of days...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or we could just use the one at the museum.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There is a time machine at the museum?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we took it back to the Mesozoic Era.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You got to hang out with dinosaurs?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, earlier this summer.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm. (sarcastic) Well, thank you for inviting me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. Or I should say, I know what we're gonna do twenty years from today.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys! Watcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're time-traveling.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can I come?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why not?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Yes, Stacy. They're building something out there. But I decided the problem is I always drop the gun. So I'm gonna wait 'til just the right moment--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello? Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're on the move; I'll bust them now! I'll bust them now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Twenty years forward, and away we go! (disappears)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So that's it! They're time-traveling again! And the best part is they have to return to this exact spot. And I'll be standing right here with mom to bust them when they do. Actually, right over here. I'll be, uh...crushed by the machine if I was standing there. And...I'm talking to nobody.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here we are, twenty years in the future. Isabella, wait. You're the only one we can trust to watch the machine. (leaves)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (romanticizes) He trusts me... (leans over the lever and transports her in time) Oops!

Name: Janitor
Dialog: (sees it) Yeaah, I hate cleaning that thing anyway.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, I see the museum finally had that new wing. And would you look how Danville's changed... Hey, mobile homes, flying cars, jet packs... Hey, look at that! That looks like...it is! It's Candace twenty years older! I almost didn't recognize her—she looks so relaxed. And those must be her kids in the yard.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: I can't believe you, Xavier and Fred. You two are so lazy; it's summer vacation and you're wasting it! You guys never do anything!

Name: Xavier
Dialog: Well, I'm sitting under this digital tree.

Name: Fred
Dialog: And I'm sitting next to him.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: (to Future Candace) Do you see your two sons out there doing nothing? They never do anything!

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Oh honey, don't exaggerate. I wish you would just get along. Your uncles Phineas and Ferb and I were great friends as children.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The future. (sees Xavier and Fred) Hi guys. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Xavier
Dialog: I'm sitting under this digital tree.

Name: Fred
Dialog: And I'm sitting next to him.

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Oh Stacy, every job has its problems. But there's gotta be an upside to being president of Uruguay. No, huh. Me? I'm fine, the kids are fine. Xavier and Fred are in the backyard with young Phineas and Ferb. (realizes) YOUNG Phineas and Ferb?! Gotta go, Stacy. Good luck with that llama legislation.

Name: Xavier
Dialog: ...and yesterday, I was sitting on the left.

Name: Fred
Dialog: And I was sitting next to him...

Name: Xavier
Dialog: ...on the right. We like to mix it up.

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: It IS them! I bet they traveled here from the past. (climbs up the tree) Ohh, look how cute and... BUSTABLE they look. Wait, isn't this just a digital tree? (falls down) AAH!

Name: Xavier
Dialog: Hey mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace...

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: AAAAAHHH!!! I'm telling MOM!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, that reminds me. Where's Perry?

Name: Future Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I finally got you, Perry the Platypus. The end game is finally he-ere. (plays checkers) Oh wait, I moved one piece. (sees Future Perry sleeping) I'll just put it back.

Name: Future Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAAH! AAAAHHHH!!
