Name: Candace
Dialog: (off screen) Ahhh!! (jumps onscreen) There are squirrels in my pants!

Name: Street Performer 1
Dialog: That girl's got some serious squirrels in her pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There are squirrels in my pants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels in my pants!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't go away, folks. When we come back, we'll have the final four. (He pauses and holds up three fingers. He realizes his mistake and holds up four. The crowd laughs) Plus, a special video that will ENSLAVE THE TRI-STATE AREA!! HAHAHA... I mean... engrave my pie-plate carrier! (pauses and picks up pie plate carrier) Look, it's silver! It was a wedding gift. I got it in the divorce! That's right ladies, I'm available!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, you're getting paid for this? I have to do this for community service! I gotta do like, 200 hours!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This show is only half an hour long.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have to do this 400 times?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, and we're back. We're counting down the top 10 Phineas and Ferb music videos from Season 1, as picked by you, the viewers.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you are definitely buying lunch.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, here's a little number I like to call four.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I kind of miss the little guys. It's as if there was a whole other side to our relationship that I never noticed before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Stace, you're kind of bumming me out with the song there.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Tubular. If I'd been wearing socks, they would've rocked right off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're not really wearing socks?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, but not at the moment. (at Carl) Carl, how are my socks coming?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Almost done, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, here's video number 3.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Fantastical. (at Doofenshmirtz) Say, Doofenshmirtz, what'cha working on over here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Your doom. (drops a cage on Monogram)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly-moogly. (at Carl) Carl, get me Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) He's in the green room, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that should be easy then. Please enjoy music video number 2.

Name: Dancer
Dialog: All hail Queen Wahini!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe it!

Name: Singers
Dialog: Say!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: "Brother, whatcha gonna do today?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughing maniacally) Now my ultimate triumph is in hand! Prepare to be hypnotized by a video scientifically created to get stuck in your heads, forever!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Noooooo!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Avert your ears, Agent P! Cover your ears!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, no, oh, get back in there! Wait why isn't..? What? Perry the Platypus? I swear, of all the aquatic mammals I hang with, you are truly the most uncooperative!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's working! It's working!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh no, Agent P, it's stuck in their heads. We need something even more catchy to counteract it. But what could we...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P, this is no time for decorating. (looks at monitor) Ohh, I see.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Not the number one requested Phineas and Ferb song! New extended version, never before seen. Not that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, the Ferbettes! I'm Phineas and this is Ferb, and we're gonna sing a song.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great job, Agent P. You stopped Doofenshmirtz, saved the Tri-State Area, and finished the music video countdown. (at the camera) Well, thanks for tuning in, folks. We'll see ya next time. (at Doofenshmirtz, who is now trapped in the cage) Say good night, Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, someday I'll get out of this cage, but your name will still be Francis.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know about you, Ferb, but I think bubbles have a great sense of humor. Look at what that bubble's doing to my face. (laughs) You make me laugh out loud, bubble.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What are you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're blowing bubbles and relaxing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I remember being relaxed, but that was before I had this! (shows Phineas and Ferb a schedule)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That looks like a color coded schedule.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That's because it is. Every minute of my entire day is planned out right here. Remember how you told me to seize the day? Well, consider it seized!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's not exactly what I meant.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, is it time for me yet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not quite. (brief pause) Okay, now. (Buford licks his finger and sticks it in Baljeet's ear)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you have any extra time for a bubble?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, I guess I have time for one.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, oh! Can I blow a huge one so I can crawl inside it and float around like a little woodland pixie? (stops, realizing his mistake) Did I just say that out loud?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes you did. But that actually sounds fun minus the pixie part. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! There's no better way to see Danville than from inside a huge bubble.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I wanna float around! (again realizing his mistake) Like men.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wanna come, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My schedule is extremely tight. I doubt I even have a second to answer your question. Maybe if I move my polka recital back. Okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! So you're coming?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No! I moved polka back so I could answer your question! It would take some major rearranging, but I think I can at least come and watch you make the bubble.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Haha! Right on time! I had Perry's absence on my schedule!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Shh! Quiet, Carl! He's coming!

Name: Major Monogram/Carl
Dialog: Surprise!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Alright!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy Birthday, Agent P! (blows into kazoo) (awkward pause) It's not your birthday, is it? (Perry shakes his head) Are we close?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Told ya!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Put a sock in it, Carl! (clears throat) I, uh, was a bit too busy planning your party, so I'm not sure what Doofenshmirtz is up too, but I am sure that it's no good. Get to the bottom of it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, Candace, are you ready to do some practice driving for your permit?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm easing my way into the driver's seat. I start with what's familiar and slide into the new.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well start sliding. We've got errands to run.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, you drive!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your dad says you're already good at parallel parking.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was in the backyard! That's way different than the open road!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I thought you wanted to be the first of your friends to have a driver's license.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm sliding.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, I'm so glad you're here. I did get your invite to your birthday party over the internet, and naturally, I couldn't go, since it was most likely a trap. Anyway, I got you this. (hands Perry a birthday card) It's just a card, but here you go. (card traps Perry) Surprise! Haha! I finally figured out why my evil schemes always fail. You see, I am totally, completely, unlikeable. No, really, so I asked myself, "what are the two most liked things on the planet?" The answer? Country music and western music. So now, I'm bringing them together for the first time. I'm calling it "Country and Western Music." I know, I know. I'm brilliant, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great bubble design, Ferb. Now all we need is the missing bubble ingredient.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey guys. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Making changes to my schedule.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're building a machine to make the biggest, most durable bubble ever.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, right. Nobody ever asks what Baljeet is doing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have just about everything we need for our durable bubble, but if you guys wanna help out, we still need some sap from a maracanut tree.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, we can definitely do that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent! While they're doing that, we can finish the design on the transponder. See you girls back at the field!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know what you're thinking, "But Doof, you have a terrible singing voice! Well, feast your eyes on this little baby! (unveils a cowboy hat) Ta-da! I call it the Yodelinator! Pretty cool, eh? Oh, right. You just think it's a big cowboy hat. It's so much more! (presses a button on the hat) See? Huh? See? It's designed to make my singing voice sweet and mellifluous. So, my first gig is in an hour. Come on, you can help me hand out fliers. Everyone's going to (singsong) love me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You can do this, Candace! Just look into the turn and ease your foot off the brake.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm l-l-l-l-looking into the turn....(gasps as she sees Phineas, Ferb, and the rest of the kids with the bubble machine in the park) (just as a bus with two monsters on the side pulls up, blocking the view) Mom, look! Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I don't find that funny.

Name: 'Candace
Dialog: 'No! Behind the bus! (honks horn) They were building some kind of contraption! I'll show you! (swerves left)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh good. Now we're-- Candace, slow down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice work as usual, Ferb! All we need now is the final ingredient.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! We got the sap you guys needed. Here! (hands him a vial)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks! (pours sap into bubble machine. Ferb pushes a button and turns a valve. The machine begins blowing the giant bubble, which slowly encases the gang as Phineas speaks) At this stage, the maracanut sap isn't fully congealed. So we can pass through the semi-permeable membrane with ease. (bubble walls give way and he is inside the bubble) Voila!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Girls, I think we just earned our Passing-Through-A-Semi-Permeable-Membrane patches! (Fireside Girls cheer)

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, there they...... (they see only the machine)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Perhaps I should get tired of asking this, but....what am I supposed to be looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! They were right there in the...(sees the bubble floating behind a building) Hold onto something, Mom. (floors the accelerator)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, that was very entertaining, but that is all the time I have scheduled for. (notices how high they are) Oh, wait. You are already airborne. And I am already still with you. (begins to panic a little) I do not believe this! My schedule is totally blown! I am going to miss my polka recital!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've heard you. It's a small loss.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, trash cans again!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oops, heh heh. My bad. Where'd they go? (sticks her head out the window to see them floating away)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I think we've all had enough of your driving!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not now, Mom! I have to get this car into the sky! (drives at full speed again)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (screaming) Candaaaace!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, no! How long are we going to be up here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (reclining) Awhile.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And...and how do you even STEER this thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're at the mercy of the breeze.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughs nervously) Sure, when you say it like that, it sounds relaxing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey everybody! Downdraft! (They float down and pass under a bridge)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no, look out! Power lines!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Girls, you know what to do!

Name: Isabella and the Fireside Girls
Dialog: Leeeeaaaannnn! (they all slam against the side of the bubble and it swerves, avoiding the power lines. Everyone cheers)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Cactus garden!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Lean! (this time, everyone slams against the side and the bubble swerves into an alleyway)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: PUBLIC ART!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: With our angle of descent, leaning will be ineffectual!

Name: Everybody else
Dialog: What?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: We're gonna craaash!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no! I knew I should not have forsaken the rigid beauty of my candy-colored schedule!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The bubble is expanding. It's Baljeet's breathing! (Baljeet keeps going) It's blowing the bubble up! Everybody breathe heavy like Baljeet!

Name: Fireside Girls and Isabella
Dialog: Yes sir!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're doing it! (Everyone cheers) Baljeet, you totally saved us!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: When in danger, I always hyperventilate.

Name: Cowboy singer
Dialog: Thank you, everyone! Thank you very much!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm next, Perry the Platypus. After this concert, I will be the most well liked man in the Tri-State Area!

Name: Person 1
Dialog: I like that guy!

Name: Person 2
Dialog: Yeah! Let's do whatever he says!

Name: Person 2
Dialog: He's terrible!

Name: Person 3
Dialog: Yeah! It stinks so bad I wanna break somethin'!

Name: Person 3
Dialog: That really wasn't worth it.

Name: Person 2
Dialog: You can't mix country and western! They's two completely different types of music!

Name: Person 4
Dialog: That song was horrible!

Name: Person 5
Dialog: Yeah, those lyrics was way too on the nose!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, that wasn't as successful as I'd hoped.... (grabs jet-pack and puts it on) but at least I can beat a hasty retreat before I'm too humiliated!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? (laughs nervously) For your information, I had these way before I met you. (jet-pack shoots by and he walks away) (Halfheartedly) Okay, see you tomorrow.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, watch where you're going!

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're around here somewhere. (she sees the bubble) Ooh! Ooh! (laughs crazily) There they are! Headed for the old drawbridge! You're mine!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, stop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't! (the drawbridge opens and they rocket into the sky. Linda screams and covers her eyes. The bubble floats in front of them) There they are! I told you! I--Mom, open your eyes!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (terrified) Not until we're back on the ground!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (they shoot past the bubble) Mooooom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was Candace driving.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Her car control has gotten a lot better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, we're back on the ground! Ahhhhhhh! (eye twitches)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay Candace, now just gently...apply...the brake.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm tryiiiiing!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow. This whole relaxation thing is...well, relaxing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, at least take your foot off the gas.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (enraged) Oh, you think? You think?! (lifts her foot) There! How's that?! Is that better!?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, guess your father was right. You do have parallel parking down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look! There they are!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I can't see anything. "They" who?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The boys! They're up in there in the -- (the bubble pops, releasing the kids onto the rides) Ugh.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi boys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (riding a bouncy animal) Hi, Mom! Nice parking, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! No! It's not -- but they were up -- (leans on the car wheel, setting off the horn)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb, I guess we should consider this day

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There you are, Isabella! (Laughs) I made a funny. It's always humorous when one refers to oneself in the third-person. You try it, Pinky.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, not a hard and fast rule, I guess. What's that? I hear a sash calling me to earn it some more new patches. Come on, Pinky.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Sesquipedalian.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Here's your "Saying a Word No One Else in the Room Knows" patch! Does anyone else want to try?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Shh! Someone's coming! Defense positions.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Look alive, people! It's our fearless leader.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys, what'cha doin'?

Name: Holly
Dialog: Earning patches!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, did you guys decide what patch to get today? 'Cause I have a suggestion!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Let me guess. The "Let's Help Phineas and Ferb" patch?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's called the "Help Thy Neighbor" patch, Adyson. Don't make up patch names.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: I already have 52 of those.

Name: Milly
Dialog: I have 53. Remember, I went back one afternoon after everyone else went home.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I know. Don't remind me.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: You just want an excuse to see Phineas.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The very thing I live for.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: All right, then! Let's go see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Why don't we ever go see what Baljeet is doing?

Name: Milly
Dialog: Because we've done that before.

Name: Holly
Dialog: Yeah, and that patch wasn't worth it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, where's Pinky?

Name: Wanda Acronym
Dialog: Hello, Agent Pinky. Professor Poofenplotz has been making a barrage of inquiries about hairspray, of all things. It's all very suspicious. Suss it out and put the kibosh on it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, to be perfectly honest, I don't know what I'm doing. I don't know what I've been doing. Always getting so wrapped up in these silly projects that I don't care about. It's you I care about, Isabella! (changes into a centaur and Isabella rides off on him) Can we be together forever and ever?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah! We can definitely do that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. (Record scratches and Isabella's fantasy fades away) While they're getting that, we can finish our designs on the transponder. See you girls back at the field.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Phineas! Oh, my gosh. What did he say? What does he need? (Sighs) I was in Phineasland again.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: We'll explain on the way, Chief. Right now, we have to find the rare maracanut tree, and earn our "Sap Collecting" patch.

Name: Milly
Dialog: What's that patch for?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: It's the "I Just Saw a Cute Boy" patch.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Where?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Duh! (points to Baljeet) That one over there with the color-coded schedule.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (Pinky arrives) Pinky the Chihuahua! So you thought you can sneak up on me? Stop shaking, you jittery little pest. (Holds Pinky, and shakes. She doesn't shake anymore after releasing.) Anyway. I woke up from my beauty sleep and thought to myself, "What the heck? Why not try to take over the world again?" But, as you know, Pinky, I can't very well take over the world until I'm drop-dead gorgeous! But I can't make myself beautiful, because I ran out of my favorite hair spray. It went a little something like this.

Name: Worker
Dialog: Can I help you with something, ma'am?

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Yes. Can you tell me where you've moved your Stiff Beauty hair spray?

Name: Worker
Dialog: Oh, I'm so sorry, ma'am. That product has been discontinued. As it turns out, only amusement park clowns used it. And ever since the old amusement park shut down, Stiff Beauty hasn't been selling.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Discontinued?

Name: Worker
Dialog: Discontinued.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: So what you're saying is Stiff Beauty's no longer going to be sold.

Name: Worker
Dialog: Right. That's what "discontinued" means.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: (after a pause) How about I discontinue YOU from this dimension!

Name: Worker
Dialog: This so isn't worth minimum wage.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: The only supply of Stiff Beauty left in the world is at the old abandoned Old Abandoned Amusement Park. And I intend to use my Me-Mobile to get me there!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: According to this Fireside Girls book on dendrology, the maracanut tree is indigenous to mountain valley micro-climates. So it looks like we're heading in the right direction.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi. Excuse me. Um, hello. Earth to hippie. (Imitates Didgeridoo reverb) Excu-u-u-u-u-u-use Me-e-e-e-e-e-e.

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Whoa! You just harmonized with me.

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Oooh!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Would you possibly know where the maracanut trees might be located?

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Indeed I do, my formidable little flower. Behold. (Shows tree stumps)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no! What happened? Where did they all go?

Name: The Guru
Dialog: They were all chopped down so their sap could be used for... (Tears up) ...hair spray. Such a shame.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, there aren't any left?

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Don't fret, my pet. There happens to be one sole maracanut tree left in existence. It's at the old abandoned Old Abandoned Amusement Park over on the next hill.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Did you just say "the old abandoned Old Abandoned Amusement Park"?

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Yes. The old abandoned Old Abandoned Amusement Park.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Old abandoned" twice?

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All right.

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Step up, little sister. Let me bestow upon you the Key of Wisdom. (Drops key) Bask in its glory!

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Cool, huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Um...

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: He's gone!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Wow.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: No, he's not. He's right over there. (Points to The Guru, trying to make an escape quietly)

Name: The Guru
Dialog: Oh, uh... Hey! hey, hi... Hey, little sisters. See you on the flip side!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, Mom, am I doing great or what?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, "Or what." Candace. Trash cans!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, here we are, I guess. Oh, I get it! It was actually called "The Old Abandoned Amusement Park"! And now it's old and abandoned. Hence, "old abandoned" twice. Girls, we're goin' in. We've got a tree to find! (The girls race to various attractions in the park) Fireside Girls, report!

Name: Katie
Dialog: Nothing up here, Captain!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Ditto, Chief!

Name: Holly
Dialog: It just smells like feet in here.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: These clown lockers are just full of cheap hair spray!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It has to be around here somewhere. Creepy roadside hippie gurus are generally reliable. Wait, I think I found it! (Points at a tall ride in the back of the park)

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Milly
Dialog: I think you're right, Chief.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: This should be it.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: This must be it, Chief. I think you're right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Reading a placard near the ride) "Stickiness is the most underrated of all the -nesses, and of all the stickinesses, the sap of the maracanut tree is the sticky-messiest. This Temple of Sap attraction is a monument to the rare and beautiful maracanut tree, the world's greatest stickerizer." Looks like we've tracked our quarry to its lair, girls! Although, if their biggest attraction was a sap-themed ride, I understand why this place closed down. Girls, get your gear. We're climbin' up.

Name: Holly
Dialog: Probably not a good idea. (Punches the wall of the ride) The whole thing's structurally unsound.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Look out!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: The whole place will fall!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: And there's no way to get that tree!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Calm down, girls. Have you forgotten who we are? We're Fireside Girls Troop 46321, and we never give up!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, let's procure the sap for Phineas!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Yay, Phineas!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, and Ferb too!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: And Ferb too!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: And Baljeet!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, the old hippie didn't mention how to get to the top of that, all he gave us was this Key of Wisdom.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Groovy!

Name: Katie
Dialog: Jinkies!

Name: Milly
Dialog: Far out!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Dy-no-mite!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Pinky the Chihuahua! Well, Momma knows haw to deal with bad little doggies!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Bad bad bad bad bad bad bad bad bad do...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, there's no engine, but it looks like gravity will do the trick.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All right, girls. Are we ready to get that "Reckless Disregard for Life and Limb" patch?

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Aye-aye, Captain!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All right, ladies! Lean!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Lean!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: So, how exactly is this gonna work?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Girls, sashes! Now!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gretchen, you have the controls.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: What good will that do?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just trust me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, my goodness, what a cute little tree!

Name: Milly and Katie
Dialog: Aww.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Isabella? What now? We're gonna CRAAAASH!!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no, we're not. Everybody... lean! (They all lean on the port side of the van, causing it to spiral down to the ground. As it lowers, it snaps the wire on Pinky's grappling hook. The van lands successfully on the ground. The Fireside Girls cheer.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls. It's time to tap that sap!

Name: Katie
Dialog: I'm on it!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Hold it still, Katie. (She captures the sap in a test tube) We got it, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. We got that sap you guys needed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent, Isabella! That's the last ingredient we need. (Isabella looks delighted) Now all we have to do is... (changes into a centaur) run away together.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Isabella? (Record scratch) Isabell-a? Phineas said, "Thanks."

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Thanks." He really does appreciate me.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (Pushing the infatuated Isabella off-screen) Yes. Yes, he does.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Yes! At last, my own lifetime supply of Stiff BEAUTY!!!!!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: (through gritted teeth) I may be stiff, but at least I'm beautiful.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Curse you, Pinky the Chihuahua...!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Have you forgotten who we are? We're Fireside Girls Troop 46321, and we never give up!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, the camera's all ready!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're almost finished with our exact replica of the Temple of Angkor Wat, constructed entirely out of playing cards. Hey, where's Candace? I bet she'd love to see this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Does He Think You're Pretty Enough? Ten Ways You Could Be.. Better." Wow. Ten ways? Thank you Quazmo Magazine. (cell phone rings) Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Umm, so listen. I'm really sorry, but something's come up and I won't be able to make it to our date tonight. I hope you understand. Hello? ...Candace, are you there? ...Hello?...Helloo? Well, I guess we got cut off.

Name: Candace
Dialog: He just broke our date and hung up on me. Oh, it's probably not as bad as I think. Let's see what Quazmo has to say about it. (Starts blubbering)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Last card. You do the honors, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!

Name: Tarzan look alike
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Umm, hey, Candace. Everything okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Beat it, dweebs! I'm having a crisis!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like Candace is in a serious funk. I wonder what we can do to snap her out of it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh, I know! It's all right here in Tween Bleep magazine. "Three Sure-Fire Ways to Lift Your Friend Out of a Serious Funk. Number one

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A completely different look? Come on, Ferb. We need somebody who's good with make-up and fancy hair-dos.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Umm, okay. I'll just stay here with my "Expert Makeover" patches and... Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, uuh, well, due to your...reprehensible behavior over the past few days, (screen changes to Perry robot kicking over a trash can) which I can barely believe is even possible (changes to fake Perry stealing cash out of a truck) from an agent of your caliber, (changes to fake him throwing money out the window of a car, then to him eating cereal at his host family's table but that Doofenshmirtz's home and Doofenshmirtz's table)  who has learned nothing but the best in his field I, uhh, uh, actually, I don't know what's particularly bad about this clip here, but, we have no choice but...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why? Why'd you do it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not yet, Carl. Wait till I'm done here. (to Perry) You are officially.. discharged. (to Carl) Okay, now, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why? Why'd you do it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cuff him, boys.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Red alert! Red alert! Renegade agent on the run!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, Jeremy has, like, totally lost interest in me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What makes you think so?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quazmo magazine!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'll be right there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that was almost impossibly fast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woah, woah, wait! You're not Stacy! Hey, hey, hey! What is going on? Huh? (Clown pulls out a pie) Uh, wait a minute. Now, don't try anything funny! (Pie splashes in her face)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, are you ready for some cheering up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looks in mirror) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH! (Birds fly, dogs bark, seals jump in water, monkeys beat up Tarzan look-alike.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No biggie, Shlocko, you gave it your best shot.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In hindsight, a clown may not have been the best choice to do a makeover.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ya think?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what else does the magazine say?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Step number two

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure! Make her laugh. Candace has a great sense of humor. Remember that time she got her face caught in the sink?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, how 'bout now we get you some ice cream?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good afternoon, ladies.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Or we can do this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have a table reserved for you close to the stage, Miss Flynn.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh. This is SO cool.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On microphone) Hey, hey, hey, hey, everybody! We havin' fun yet? First up, our favorite math-formula funny man, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Holding a plastic dummy that looks just like him) Thank you. Thanking you much. So little Jeet, I hear you went to New Delhi. And did you try the chicken club?

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: Wow, that's really what you're going with? You know, just do the water drinking bit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay. The Pythagorean theorem...

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: The square of the hypotenuse of a right triang... (coughs then head falls off, then Baljeet coughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's hear it for the dummy! And that puppet wasn't bad either.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Next up, my favorite vegetable-based comic, Broccoli Top!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gonna do some prop comedy for you, and you're gonna like it! Okay, what have we got? (reaches into the box and gets a house) Here's a...here's a house. For, uh...I don't know. A mouse or something. (drops and breaks house; gets a book from his box) Here's a book. Hey, what am I...what am I supposed to do? Read? (throws book) Next! All right, let's see what else we've got! Um, and here's, uh, um... (gets out an oyster shell) An oyster shell, look! My...my mom went to a seafood restaurant...I don't have any...it's just...to me, it's just interesting. I'll put that one back in the box. (puts shell back in box) What else we got? Oh, here we go. Look! (pulls out Baljeet) A nerd to go with the book!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am in both acts.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (throws Baljeet off stage and onto Ferb's drum set) Thank you! Buford's still in the building!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't making me feel any better.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? You wanna wrestle?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Coming up next, Ferb Fletcher!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ahem. So, how about that airline food?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (not laughing along) This, is making me feel worse.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (still laughing along) Ahahaha, what's airline food?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Worried) Doesn't look like it's working.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what does it say for step number three?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It says... "Introduce her to someone new."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That should be easy. There are lots of nice people in Danville she's never met. Ferb, I've got an idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey fellas! Look who decided to make an appearance. (to Perry) You see, it occurred to me that what I really should be doing is fighting fire with fire. And by fire, I mean Perry the Platypus. And by fire, I ALSO mean Perry the Platypus. It occurred to me while I was on fire. I made a bunch of doppelgangers to discredit and totally destroy you. Behold the Plata-Proliferator-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Meet Terry the Platypus, and say hello to Larry the Platypus, and say aloha to Jerry the Platypus. (shows distorted Perry lookalike) Yeah, he was the first one out of the batch, but you know, he was so cute, I couldn't bear to...(Jerry hits Doofenshmirtz with the pipe he was drooling on) Ow! Ow! No, no Jerry you cannot hit people, you do not... (Jerry hits him again) No, use your words Jerry. (talks to the Perry lookalikes) Anyway, all you guys, go get him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awwwww.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look at this, Stacy, he won't even answer his cell phone.

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: Excuse me, Miss Flynn? You and a guest are cordially invited to the Mixer Mingler.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mixer Mingler? Say, aren't you that dummy from the night club?

Name: Little Jeet
Dialog: She's talking to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's obviously some lame attempt from my brothers to cheer me up. I'm not going.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Come on; it will do you good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as they climb up the machine) Oh, would you look at this? If I wasn't so depressed, my brothers would be so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: With the Mix 'n' Mingler, you'll meet someone new every two seconds. Now, let's fire this thing up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fasten your seatbelts!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe I'm doing... (The machine starts spinning) AHHHHH!

Name: Chorus
Dialog: (background chanting) Mix, mingle, mix, mingle

Name: Candace
Dialog: I like your pants?

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Here, you can take 'em.

Name: Rooster
Dialog: Yeah, I'm followin' him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You forgot your socks.

Name: Man 9
Dialog: I need a hug.

Name: Creepy man
Dialog: Esh, eesh eesh eesh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Next!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mix, mingle, mix, mingle, mix, mingle, mix, mingle.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, folks. Prepare for emergency ejection. ('pulls a cord)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In hindsight, a simple ice cream cone might have been more effective.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: See?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (tearing up) Congratulations, Agent P. I knew it couldn't be you causing all that trouble. (sobs) You are officially reinstated.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, a little ice cream always makes me feel better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe you're right. I'll have two scoops of...Jeremy? (Jeremy turns around) Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't wanna break our date. I just wanted to earn some extra money, so I could surprise you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A surprise, for me? Oh, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy! This was so worth the wait.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'm just glad you're not one of those people who freaks out just because someone cancels a date.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs awkwardly; tosses magazine over her shoulder) Right.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: (on radio) Good morning, Danville! Excitement's in the air today as we await the announcement of the Paisley Sideburn Brothers' first concert visit to the Tri-State Area! Phone lines are clogged and web sites are crashing as local music fans try to get first crack at the hottest concert tickets of the decade!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Must...get...tickets...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Zzzzzzzzzzzz... (She takes her head out of the keyboard to reveal many keys in her face. They pop out to the music of "Shave and a haircut, two bits". She spits two keys out of her mouth.) Oh, still not on sale! (A crash is heard) What the?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, isn't it a bit early to start building another crazy contraption?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What, this? We're still cleaning up from yesterday. It's funny, the cleanup usually takes care of itself, but we've been working all night on this one. (A recycling truck comes to take the dumpster.) That's the last of it, guys! Thanks! (to Candace) It was our biggest project ever! How could you miss it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was kind of busy. (Her phone rings. She zips inside and picks up.) Stacy, what's up?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!! My ticket is in row R!!!! Close enough to smell them!!!!! What did you get?!!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ticket? How'd you get a ticket?

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: That's right, folks! Unless you've had your head stickin' out of a window, you know those tickets just went on sale and sold out in 13 seconds flat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sold out?

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: That's right! Sold out! But you still might be able to catch this special added benefit concert tonight at the Fireside Girls Jamboree!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I still got a chance! What the heck? "FIRESIDE GIRLS ONLY! PLEASE ENTER YOUR PATCH #"? (types frantically) Gotta guess the right numbers. Gotta guess the right numbers. "YOU HAVE EXCEEDED YOUR LOG-IN ATTEMPTS"? No, you've exceeded your log-in attempts!! PHINEAS!!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your little friend, Isabella, she's a Fireside Girl, right?! What's her patch number?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm not sure. But I can ask her when she gets back from her meeting at the Fireside Girl lodge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Lodge, huh? C'mon, you're takin' me down there. Now!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. We're not sure what Doofenshmirtz is up to, but we're sending you to his lab. (Puts on a pair of safety goggles) And we're using this new transporter device we've been working on. It's not approved for testing on humans yet, so you get to try it out first. (Perry gets a worried look on his face.) Good luck, Agent P. Carl, fire it up!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Yes, it's true that the Paisley Sideburn Brothers tickets (cut to inside the lodge) can only be ordered by an active-duty Fireside Girl. But if you just want to—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tell you what, I'm joining up! (slams her hand on the podium) Set me up, sister!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay. I hereby nominate Candace Flynn into membership in the Loyal Sisterhood of Fireside Girls.

Name: Katie and Ginger
Dialog: I second! Jinx! (they giggle)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Alright, girls, come to order. (to Candace) Now, just fill out this application, read the training manual, sign the insurance waivers, and you can be sworn in at our meeting next week.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Next week?! But that's too late!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm sorry, but the traditional procedure comes straight from the Fireside Rules of Order (shows her what looks like a portrait of an old lady in a rocking chair) as established by our founder, Eliza M. Feyersied.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that's a stupid rule.

Name: Eliza M. Feyersied
Dialog: (from the "portrait") You watch your mouth, little lady!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who puts a picture frame on a window?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is there anything Ferb and I can do to help? Candace really wants to see that concert.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, if-if you don't really want to be a Fireside Girl, then—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No no no, I do, I do! I've gotta get to that concert!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, you're not listening to me. You don't—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfft! Forget it! I thought Fireside Girls were supposed to help people.

Name: Eliza M. Feyersied
Dialog: There is another way!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You don't mean—

Name: Eliza M. Feyersied
Dialog: Yes! Isabella, please read Article 9, Section Charlie, Footnote 6.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "A troop leader may award full Fireside Girl status to any girl who has earned 50 patches." But, Mrs. Feyersied, 50 patches in one day?! Is that even possible?!

Name: Eliza M. Feyersied
Dialog: Well, it depends on how badly she wants it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bring it on!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Alright! All you need is a cadet uniform and we can get started.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Where can I buy one?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ouch! (she puts her finger in her mouth)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Uh, Agent P, we've teleported you three feet too far to the right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! Do you even realize how much trouble it is to set a trap?! And for what?! You just jump out of the way!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Ah, here we go. We've recalibrated the teleporter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (scratching his head) I don't know what just happened, but I like it. Now, with you safely inside the cage, (pushes a button on a remote) I can unveil my new device of doom. (the inator rises from the floor) Behold, the Metal-Destructinator!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fifty patches in one day?! (cut to inside to reveal Candace now in her uniform) Where do I start?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By combining the shortest linear distance with the highest population density, we've plotted a course for you that's optimized for the greatest number of patch-acquiring opportunities in the shortest period of time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then after you wrestle the crocodiles, you'll corkscrew through the overpass and free fall past the flaming high wire to make your last delivery and receive the 50th patch. Got it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is all that really necessary?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going to need you to plant one of these Fireside Girl markers at the site of each task so the girls at the lodge can track your progress. Now, is Candace Gertrude Flynn your full legal name?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. Yes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great! You just earned your Honesty Patch! Congratulations!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? That was easy! C'mon, let me do another!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh, I think you just earned your Enthusiasm Patch!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! Two down! (does a happy dance)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: 48 to go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yippee! This is easy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. (quiz show music plays in the background) 15 senior citizens need help crossing a street that's 50 feet across.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, goody, I'm great at word problems.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, there's 15 senior citizens that need help crossing the street. (Cut to reveal Candace on roller skates on a conveyor belt.) Good luck, Candace. Don't forget your helmet. (He pulls the lever and gives her a helmet as she rolls down screaming.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (looking through binoculars) Senior-service patch

Name: Montage
Dialog: Candace is seen making a totem pole with the heads of a mask, Phineas, Ferb and herself. She marks the totem and receives another patch from Isabella. Cut to show a patch with three ice cream cones and two rotating arrows on it. Candace is now in an ice cream parlor juggling ice cream cones. A check is marked off on the patch. Candace, Phineas, Ferb and Isabella are now climbing a mountain. She marks it. A mountain patch is added to her sash.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Running with the Bulls Patch

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And Running with the Bullies Patch

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Discovering Something That Doesn't Exist Patch

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here you go, Candace. Wrestling an Alligator in a Sewer Patch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alligator, you're goin' down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon, Candace, you can do it! Pin him already! (The gator continues to put up a tough fight. Phineas points to his watch.) We're running behind! (The fight continues) This is really putting us off schedule.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So let me explain my new evil scheme. A while back, my doctor put me on a low-carb diet, but I still can't lose those last ten pounds. (Lifts his shirt up revealing his rather large gut. Puts his shirt back down.) Every time I get close to my goal, there's this knocking at the door.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who is it?

Name: Milly
Dialog: Fireside Girls. Would you like to buy some of our cupcakes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cupcakes you say? I-I really shouldn't. I should get back to my exercise. I'm almost down to my goal.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Oh, we understand. Have a nice—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (swiping the log out of her hands and giving her money) Alright, you talked me into it!

Name: Milly
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So with my weakness for high-carb sweets, there's really no other choice but to get rid of the bridge to the Fireside cupcake factory. And my Metal-Destructinator can turn any metal object into broccoli. I know what you're thinking, why broccoli? But, w-well, y'know, it's healthy. It's like the opposite of what I'm trying to get— It's—It's poetic justice. It's—Well, it's not—not justice, exactly... Poetic evil. It's poetically evil. Now, to make some last-minute adjustments... (hums)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wrestling an Alligator in a Sewer Patch...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what's next?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're a bit behind. You can finish out the rest while you work on your Delivering Cupcakes Patch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sounds easy enough.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you have to deliver all these cupcakes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: All these?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. We've built you a rollercoaster delivery system.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, let's do this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Siga sentados, por favor.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you speaking Spani—?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here are your cupcakes! AAAAAAAAH! (some bugs crash into her face, she spits some out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bug Collecting Patch

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to hurl!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Motion Sickness Patch

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Paisley Sideburn Brothers! Let's hurry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ready to fire. (Perry flings the screw out of one of the holes of the trap with his tail. It hits the inator and then hits Doof in the eye.) Ow! (He suddenly turns the inator aiming it at the trap. The metal bars turn into broccoli. Perry jumps onto Doof.) Ow! Yeah! Oh! (Perry pushes Doof's face into the inator several times.) Quit it, you annoying little pest! (The inator fires.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Last one!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that was fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fun?! Are you nuts?! And how did a rollercoaster turn into broccoli?! And why broccoli?! How does that make any sense?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, focus. You've still got five minutes and it's 20 blocks away. So, uh...good luck with that. (gives her the log)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I can do this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now that's persistence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I see the building and I still got three minutes! (She reads the directory.) Got it, 38th floor! (She runs to the elevator, but it is out of order) Out of order?! Okay, stairs. Step aerobics, don't fail me now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come back here! (Perry grabs a piece of the inator and bends it.) Oh, what are you doing down there?! (Perry activates it and salutes and gets teleported away. The inator turns into broccoli.) Uh-oh. Aaaaah!! (Groans and spits some broccoli out) Curse you, Perry the— (knock at the door) Coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fireside Girl. Here's your order of cupcakes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aren't you a little old to be a Fireside Girl?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, we are all very impressed. (cut to inside) You earned more patches in one day than anyone in the history of the Fireside Girls

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Aw, nuts!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I know I did all 50 and I made sure to plant the markers and everything. (holds up a marker) Huh? Looks like I forgot one. I'll just run back before it's five o'clock.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm sorry, Candace. Y'know, you may not have lit up the entire board, but you did demonstrate remarkable persistence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean I get a persistence patch? And that makes 50, right? (short beat) There's no Persistence Patch, is there?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nope. 'Fraid not.

Name: Eliza M. Feyersied
Dialog: Hold on, Isabella. Little Miss Sassy Mouth here gets a special patch for breakin' the all-time record. (salutes) Congratulations, Fireside Girl! And here's your ticket for the Paisley Sideburn Brothers concert.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo! Yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb? How did you guys get in?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella invited us. She's allowed to bring guests, you know.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's what I kept trying to tell you, Candace, but you were so insistent on becoming a Fireside Girl. Maybe you can start working on your Good Listener Patch next.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon, Candace, you can do it! Pin him already! (The gator continues to put up a tough fight. Phineas points to his watch.) We're running behind! (The fight continues) This is really putting us off schedule. (chomp) Ooh! That's gonna leave a mark.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes. On the alligator.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do you find it as curious as I do that your menu has not changed since you opened in 1929?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I know! It's awesome, right? It's our motto

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, in that case, I--

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pushes Baljeet out of the way) Step aside, weiner! One Windmill Dog, hold the bun.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (produces Buford's order) Excellent choice.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You saved my life.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It was nothing. (notices Buford bowing to Baljeet's feet) What are you doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am your humble servant.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's the Bully Code. I live my life by it. (produces a card and gives it to Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: "If a nerd shood save a bully's life, the bully is the nerd's slave for life." "Should" is misspelled.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Duh! It was written by bullies.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is very nice, but I do not want a slave.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Too bad, you got one.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Goodbye. (departs)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I will empty my mind of all thought, except for Baljeet. (stares at the ceiling for a moment) There, that was easy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (walking along the streets of Danville) You are following me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: At a respectable distance, little master.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) So, what do you think?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What am I looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Duh, it's a new red shirt!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's from Jeremy! He sent me a picture. (looks at picture) Aw, look at his cute, little wiener hat. Let's send him a picture of me. Make sure you get my good side. How's the lighting? (Stacy takes the picture) Wait, you took it while I was still talking!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me see. (shows an ugly Candace) (gasps) I'd better erase that. (pushes button)

Name: Phone
Dialog: Picture sent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no! I hit the wrong button!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy Um, go into the menu and--

Name: Phone
Dialog: Picture sent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, not again!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Here, let me see. (accidentally takes multiple pictures of Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, no, stop!

Name: Phone
Dialog: Pictures sent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm ruined.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, he's at work, so maybe he hasn't looked yet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We've got to get to Jeremy's phone, come on, we're going to Slushy Dog.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (while Ferb is showing blueprints to him) Peanut butter and jelly robot races, masking tape mummy gymnastics, a jelly bean monetary system for emergenations...I don't know. I'm not feeling any of them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb are up to something, I'd better tell Mom.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, the photos. (She pushes her away.) Eyes on the prize.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Sorry to disturb you on Canada Day, but the world's top evil scientists have been photographed leaving Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated. Something big is going on, real big. I need you to infiltrate his headquarters.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) Ahem?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry. We need you to infiltrate his headquarters. Carl thinks I need to be more "inclusive". Find out what he's up to!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Have you come to sign my cast? (over a close-up of said cast, with multiple signatures on it) Look, I saved you a spot right there. It says, "Save for Perry." Well, it was a bigger spot before I wrote, "Save for Perry," but there's some room there. Grab that marker.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-ha! You've heard of the Internet? Well, this is uh... well, it's-it's just a net. But you're caught. (gets up and uses crutches to support him while he walks along) In exactly thirty minutes, the Tutti McFrutti ice cream man will park his truck in front of my building. I know, because I was standing there yesterday when HE RAN OVER MY FOOT! But today, I will reek my horrible vengeance! Behold, the Re-tire-Inator! Because, you know, he ran over my foot with the tire, and I'm going to hit him with a giant tire. Re-tire. It's not like a retire, like stop working. It's not that Retire-Inator. That's-that's actually over there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got it ready. It's filled with crossword puzzles, and a big, fat, house cat that will lay on my belly and warm me into my...senior years. Anyhoo, where was I? Oh, yes. Evil laugh. (laughs manically)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little Master, I've washed all your dust jackets and dusted all your cold knick-knacks.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (over a shot of various foods placed on a bookshelf) Those are not knick-knacks! They are food, and they should be in the refrigerator!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ohh, I have disappointed you, Little Master. I will strive to do better.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not strive for anything, and I am not your little master.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll just fluff up your pillow, then! (Baljeet runs away) Little Master? Little Master?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stay away from me!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (runs up) Phineas! Ferb! I saved Buford's life, and now because of the Bully Code, he is my personal servant! It is driving me crazy! You have got to help me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, okay. We just have to get Buford to save your life, and then you'll be even.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But how?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I see Jeremy's phone.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Where?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There! His message light is still blinking. That means he hasn't retrieved his pictures yet!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, let's just...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What are you two doing here? I mean, not that I don't like surprise visits from you, but this room is for Slushy Dawg employees only.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're Slushy Dawg employees.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We are?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. We did our training at the downtown branch to surprise you. (beat) Surprise.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, that's rad!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I have absolutely no idea what I'm doing. What are all these buttons for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's hot dogs. How hard can it be? (gives Stacy some fries) Here, fry something. I'm gonna go etgay the onephay. (runs off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ugh, you know I don't speak Spanish!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace, I see you've sent me some pictures. I can't wait to check 'em out later when I take my break.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (fake smiling) Yeah! (frowning) No!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I found out what all the buttons are for.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes. This thing is definitely the thing! What is this thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This contraption, my friend, is completely foolproof.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let me explain. You'll "accidentally" step on to that platform, which will launch you up and over that flight of stairs, where you'll be kicked and rocketed through a piece of sheet-rock onto a trampoline. Then conveyer belted up to a rotating system that will drop you onto a spring, bouncing you all the way to that red X, where Buford will be standing, waiting to catch you, saving your life.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, I am thoroughly terrified, yet tingling with excitement!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace? (walks up to her with headphones) While I check the stockroom, can you take the drive-thru orders?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, my favorite!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on speakerbox) Uh, welcome to Slushy Dawg, can I take your order?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? You work here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?! You eat here?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, where are you? (waves) Can you see me? Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh— (walks over to Stacy) This is weird. My mom's here.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think your brothers are, too. Across the street.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are they up to?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on headphones) Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? Mom! Drive up to the window! You gotta see what the boys are doing!

Name: Linda
Dialog: The boys are here, too? Hon, I'm boxed in. I've got a heck of a line in front of me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fill orders, fill orders. (takes and gives a bag) Hi, enjoy your meal. (to the next car) Come again. Enjoy your meal. Bon appétit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Baljeet. You just stand on that platform and when Buford comes along, we'll guide him to the right spot. Although, it has occurred to us that you're giving up something really cool here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're spending all this energy trying to stop Buford from being your faithful servant, when the reality is having the biggest, toughest kid in town (Ferb nods) as your personal bodyguard is a sign of supreme coolness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, think about it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm, maybe you are right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Ooh, hear that, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tootie McFrutti has arrived on time! In a few seconds, he'll be flattened by a speeding tire.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Oh no no no! (The inator hits Doof's good foot.) OW!!! NO!!! Oh, my good foot! My good foot! OW! Ow ow! My bad foot! Oh, my good foot again! Oh, no, my bad foot—Oh, this is really a viscous cycle!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, I'm takin' my break now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-huh. (laughs nervously)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, we gotta get Mom up here so she can see what the boys are doing. Keep throwing food out the window! (she leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Jeremy, can I borrow your phone? Thanks. Erase photos bust boys erase photos bust boys!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little Master, Little Master, I finished color-coding all of your overalls. Whadaya want me to do next?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, first, I would like you to iron all of my books, then perhaps polish my retainer, then you can start my college applications. Massage my toosties. Sew my name onto my underwear, organize my book reports by subject. Ooh, build me—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Weenie! (Buford pushes Baljeet out of the way.) Alright, we're even.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What? Aw, man.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! All photos erased! Now, onto the boys! (runs up to the gang) Hey, just so you know, Mom's on her waaaaaaaay— (Candace steps on the platform and the contraption activates.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Stacy, you're here, too?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah. Candace wants you to go out front to see what the boys are doing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, just give me a chili dog and I'll be on my way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sheetrock. (Crash!) Trampoline.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I saved your life. Now you're my servant.

Name: Candcae
Dialog: Ugh, all right, ew! (gets up)

Name: Buford
Dialog: But the code! You've got no honor!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, wow! You okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, yeah. Here's your phone.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (flips it open) There's a picture on it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No no!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, that's a great photo of you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Phew!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Now about your job...

Name: Candace
Dialog: No worries. I quit.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, you guys wanna hit Slushy Dawg before we go home?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oh, heavens, no. Slushy Dawgs never get any better.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Boys? (looks at the contraption) Hmm. (beat) I'll never understand public art.

Name: Man
Dialog: Oh cool! Old records! Lindana. Now that's a blast from the past. Wonder where she is now... Probably singing at retirement homes.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, give me that. (takes the box of records)

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, you look familiar.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Dad, what are these?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh wow, those are my old black and white detective movies.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you mind if we watch them?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Not at all boys, the projector's inside.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great, come on Ferb.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh I see you like that little doll. Well lets see... that'll cost you, uh, fifty cents?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll give you a dollar.

Name: Detective/Narrator
Dialog: She rolled into my office like a fog bank. Mysterious. Cold. My instincts told me this dame was nothing but trouble. But trouble's my middle name... Well not really. My middle name is "Trumble"...Sounds a lot like trouble.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, this detective stuff is great.

Name: Detective/Narrator
Dialog: She had something she needed to say. And she spoke with the voice of an angel...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! Where's the box that was in my room?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well dad was taking boxes out to the yard sale...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, Dad, wait! (She arrives at the front yard) Dad, is that the box from my room?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well yes...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think I put my little Mary McGuffin doll in there by mistake. Have you seen her?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I just sold her for a whole dollar. Here, you can have it.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: How about two dollars?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? What are you doing here? This isn't your weekend.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes I know, but I have a surprise for you and I just couldn't wait!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (excited) A surprise? Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, it's something you've always wanted. Something you've asked for time and time again. In my hand, I hold the key to...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: ... My new car!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holds up Mary McGuffin doll) No, your happiness! Remember when you said if I got you a little Mary McGufffin doll, I'd be the world's greatest dad?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, when I was like, seven.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: At long last I have found one! I have been scouring the Internet and... and Garage sales trying to find the discontinued doll.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, I can't believe you remembered I wanted this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Remembered?! I never stop looking!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I may be an evil scientist, but it doesn't take a degree purchased from the Internet with your ex-wife's money, to know how special and important you are to me.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's so sweet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I'd better run. I bought a used -inator today at the garage sale, and it's missing one small part.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really? what does it do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't know yet, it's missing a part. But whatever it is I'm sure it will be pure evil!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Talking to the doll) Well, at least you're not evil.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Talking like the detective from the film, with his and Ferb's bedroom painted black and white) It was a dull, hot day in Danville, and she swept into the room like a cool, tropical depression. I could tell by the way she walk, she had something on her mind, either that, or she was chaffing from the heat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Her voice flowed soft and smooth, like butter on toast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And why are you talking like that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She was observant, maybe too observant.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why is everything black and white in here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (talking normally) We painted everything like an old detective movie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What about you guys?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Detective makeup.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Detectives? Perfect! I know what you're going to do today! Track down my little Mary McGuffin.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Piece of cake. (Ferb hands him a piece of cake) Ooh, chocolate. Thanks Ferb. We'll have you're little Mary McGuffin back faster than you can say, "Hey, where's Perry?"

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, Agent P is here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can see that Carl, now get back in that corner until I tell you, you can get up. Fifteen minutes left on the timer.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay Sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. we, we just found out that Doofenshmirtz is scouring the Tri-State Area for some kind of on-off device.

Name: Carl
Dialog: A switch, Sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Right, we think it may be a switch, but we don't know what it's for so, we need your help. Good luck Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating while Ferb plays his sax) The sun beat down on the city like a hammer, a relentless hot beating hammer hammering down like a big metaphor that was... hot, for some reason.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop with the narration and start finding my doll!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We decided to investigate at the scene of the crime. We talked to a Lawrence Fletcher, a tall gaunt looking average Joe who... (Ferb stops playing the sax, and Phineas switches back to his normal voice) Sorry.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Is that my old black and white saxophone?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We thought the investigation could use a little ambiance.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, delightful. How can I help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We need you to tell us everything you can about the man who bought the doll.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let me see... He had some kind of a German accent, and ooh, he was wearing a lab coat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A lab coat, huh? Ferb? (Ferb begins to play the saxophone again) For an average Joe, he gave us an above average clue. Our next step was clear.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Who is he talking to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, don't get me started.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Vanessa, Charitable Charities is here. Do you have your box ready?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah Mom, it's next to my bookshelf.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oops, looks like something fell out. (She picks up the Mary McGuffin doll, and puts it in the box)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (At the Charitable Charities man) Here you go.

Name: Man from Charitable Charities
Dialog: Aww, thanks Char. I'll pick you up at eight.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: See you then Sam.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating) We figured the best place to find a man in a lab coat was at the Lab Coat Emporium. We interviewed several suspects.

Name: Suspect 1
Dialog: Well, yes I was at a garage sale, but as you can see, I don't have an accent.

Name: Suspect 2
Dialog: Yeah, I have an accent, but I have not been to a garage sale.

Name: Suspect 3
Dialog: Whoa! Hey kid, slow down. I can't answer all these questions.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well that wasn't very productive. Was it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We decided to have a talk with the owner.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Shines a bright light onto the owner of the Lab Coat Emporium) What do you know about a man in a lab coat with a German accent, frequents garage sales?

Name: Owner
Dialog: Oh, that guy, I don't know anything about that guy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright Ferb, lean on him.

Name: Owner
Dialog: Alright, alright I'll talk. Okay, there's this guy. He comes in every week for a lab coat. He has me put everything on his ex-wife's tab. See, her address is on the bill.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I do see. Well thanks a lot for your help. You can wrap it up Ferb.

Name: Owner
Dialog: Can I take this makeup off now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe how lucky I was at that garage sale, someones personal collection of on-off switches. Score! (Begins trying the switches on his -inator) Hmm, looks like this one doesn't fit, more where that came from. Nope. How 'bout this? Come on, Papa needs a band new -inator. (Gets hit in the head with a rubber duck) Oh! what the--? Perry the Platypus, are you making your own keys now? Oh, you like all the stuff I got at the garage sale? Want to know what else I got? This lobster trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs evilly) Yeah, anyway, sorry I can't tell you my evil scheme, because I... I don't know what this does yet. I'm still looking for an on-off switch. Life was much simpler when I worked as a lawn gnome.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Yes, dear?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Have you seen my little Mary McGuffin Doll?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Could it be the one I just put in the box for Charitable Charities?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh no, Dad gave that to me.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well, I'm sorry I didn't know. But I think the truck is still out there.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (She runs out the door, passing Phineas, Ferb and Candace as they come up.) Wait! Sam! I want to retain a portion of my mother's charitable donation!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Talking to Charlene) Hello ma'am. We'd like to ask you a few questions.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Are you with the census?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, ma'am, today we're detectives.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be detectives?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If it's all the same to you ma'am, we'll ask the questions.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, okay come on in. Would you kids like some apple juice?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That would be nice ma'am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright lady, what do you know about the little Mary McGuffin doll? (takes a sip of apple juice)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: You too? Well like I told my daughter, I gave it to charity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well... nothing, that's it. The Charitable Charities truck just left, that have a few locations 'round town, so I'm not sure which one they're going to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright Ferb, pack it up. We've got some charities to visit. But I think we're going to need to update our approach.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating during a montage asking Charitable Charities if that had the doll) We checked out act of the charitable charities in Danville, using every cop persona we could think of. In every case, it seemed we had the wrong location.

Name: Charitable Charities Manager 3
Dialog: Aren't you kids a little young to know about all these old detective shows?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes we... (Pauses and puts on sunglasses in a Horatio Caine like fashion) ...are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, how many different kinds of on-off switches can there be? I mean, look at this. An octagon? And one shaped like the Statue of Liberty? That doesn't even make sense. Oh, and here's one. The exact same size and shape that I'm looking for except it's upside-down. I mean, the words are actually printed upside-down. What kind of a dummkopf would invent an upside-down... switch...that... (Pauses, sighs, and flips the switch so that it's right-side-up.) I did it! Time to find out what this bad boy can do! (He flips the switch) On.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Not realizing what is happening) Off. On. Off. On. Off. On. Augh, I'm herring a clanking voice, so I know it's doing something. (Realizes that the -inator opens the lobster trap) Oh, the -inator and the cage they're connected. It's just, opens and closes the... Well I guess that's why I got the cage for free.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! I was talking! (Doofenshmirtz begins to sword battle with Perry, with a moose antler, and a marlin) Take that, and that! Hey lets see if you can take a couple hits, from the 70's! (Begins to throw record at Perry, who avoids them, and hides behind a painting) Ahh, that takes me back... Hey where'd you go? Yow! Is that, that shark's head? Are you trying to make me cry? Wait hold on one second here, just a second. It occurs to me that all this does is open and close a lobster cage, so it's not evil, much less illegal. Besides, I've run out of clever fighting puns so... Curse you Perry the Platypus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There she is! My little Mary McGuffin Doll!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Speaking to Vanessa, who was also grabbing for the doll) I'm sorry, but this is my doll.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, it ended up here by mistake, and it's actually my doll.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You might think it's your doll, but it's not. I'm going to have to ask you to pleas let go!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You please let go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You let go!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (to Phineas) This is exactly why they took that doll off the market.

Name: Sally
Dialog: Look. She's perfect, and I just love her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, forget it. I guess I'm too old for dolls anyway.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, maybe I don't really have to have the one object my dad spent years to find in order to show me his affection. (pause) No, actually I do. (at Sally) Give me that, kid!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking to Vanessa on the phone) So you just took it from the little girl and left her there crying? Wow, that is evil! Honey, I am so proud of you! It felt good didn't it? Yeah, we can build on this.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, boys, I thought I heard a noise out here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Say, there is something pretty peculiar going on here, now, don't tell me! You turned the entire garage upside-down, now why on earth would you do that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're searching for Ferb's favorite skateboard.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (yelling to Linda) Dear! Are you aware the boys have turned the garage upside-down, looking for Ferb's skateboard?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) As long as they clean up after!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, right-o. (to Phineas) Ooh, just a minute, does that skateboard have a Union Jack on the bottom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the one!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Turn the thing right-side up and come in the house. I believe I solved your mystery.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You heard him, Ferb. Let's turn it over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what have you got, Pop?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Take a gander what a certain old geezer posted on his blog.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, it's Grandpa! (chuckles) Ferb, he must have left your skateboard in England the last time we were there. I know! We could create a highly intricate and sophisticated machine, that will transport any object from anywhere on the globe to our backyard!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, why don't you just build a new skateboard?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, I don't think so.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: If it's all the same with you, Father, we're going to build the machine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, Mom. What's with the getup?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm on my way to join Vivian Garcia-Shapiro, at the Mexican-Jewish Cultural Fair today. Would you like to come along?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me think...um, no.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (leaving) Oh, well, suit yourself, bubelita!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's give her a trial run. Start with something small.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Check it out, dweebs! Betcha can't shoot this apple off my head.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (at the camera) Hmm, not really what I meant. But, okay.

Name: Buford
Dialog: But I still got my apple here, William Tell!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nice buzz cut. High and tight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! It worked. Now, let's try it on something more complex.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm complex! Really, I'm like an onion.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa. It's like there's thousands of you guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops! (inserts another picture and presses button) I forgot to install the Fly Filter. Better try that again...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Buford. Are you all right?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I have a weird craving for something stinky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's all right. (gives Ferb a photo) Okay, Ferb, let's get that skateboard before Grandpa breaks his neck.

Dialog: Okay, stay calm! (grabs and drags her daughter) Just move away from it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Friends, bullies, Irving, at 0900 hours, a UCO (or Unidentified Crashing Object) landed in our front yard. We reverse engineered a piece-by-piece duplicate of the strange object. We have called you here to help us discover what this object is and how it works.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Soon, the entire village of Whiskershire began following the Earl's lead to, of course... (phone rings again) Uh, do forgive me. I-I-I'm awfully sorry. Hello?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, you have to come home right now! This thing is freakin' me out!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Uh, L-Linda, my dear, I love you, but you couldn't have chosen a worse moment to go completely bonkers! I'm sorry, but I've got to call you back! Bye!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (very Candace-esque) Ohhhh, he doesn't believe me!! He said I sound crazy!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps in realization) Ohhhhh, reeeeeeally???

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah! You know I'm not imagining this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course not! Gosh, that must be so frustrating to have someone not believe you when you're telling the truth!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, you don't know the half of it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That feeling you have right now

Name: Linda
