Dialog: Why?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now, keep in mind how Dad just made you feel, okay? Phineas and Ferb have reverse-engineered and built an exact duplicate of this thing and at this very moment, they're trying to figure out what it does by forcing it to belly dance and work in a library. (smiles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, I love you, but you couldn't have chosen a worse moment to go completely bonkers!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (yelling below) Pierre!! (giggles to Perry) Did anyone look? A-hee-hee-hee! I betcha, like, half the people down there are looking around, like (fake French accent) "Who called my name?" (laughs in his normal voice)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, Isabella, I sometimes wonder if it was mere coincidence that it was you and I chosen to portray the young, happy couple.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Chosen?" Baljeet, you charged to that empty chair like a crazed wolf.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, here we are, madame and monsieur.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And what can I get for you this afternoon?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah-buh-bup! (the device stops) Give. (The device approaches Phineas, bowing apologetically, and gives him the candle.) Hmm... Interesting.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, there's been no change in the last ten minutes. I should call your father.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, Mom, I understand. Obviously, you're not gonna come see what Phineas and Ferb are up to until this is resolved. So here's what we're gonna do! First of all, no more calling Dad! If I don't convince you to come home to bust the boys after a couple of calls, I go get you!

Name: Linda
Dialog: But what if he doesn't wanna come with me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did that ever stop me?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: This statue, which stands outside the Whiskershire Rectory, still holds the Earl's actual spring stick, yes. The spring stick is used as such

Name: Linda
Dialog: Move it, Fletcher!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, any questions?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Ah, the quaint town of Whiskershire. It's a great place to fly nilly-willy through, manacled to a rocket skiff this time of year.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Friends, bullies, Irving, we've reached our conclusion as to the purpose of the object that landed in our front yard. We believe that it is an anti-romance rocket created to scan for, and then eliminate romantic elements from potentially amorous situations.

Name: Isabella, Baljeet and Irving
Dialog: Ohhhhhh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So it's not a wedgie machine?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hehehehehehehehehehehehe...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Hehehehehehehehehehehehe... This is gonna be awesome, Stace! So when they get home, I'm gonna drag both of them into the backyard and it'll be a busting feeding frenzy!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: W-W-Wait a minute! Perry the Platypus, where are you—? Oh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Two anti-romance rockets falling in love.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's what I call "ironing".

Name: Linda
Dialog: There! Tell me that's not terrifying!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (looking at his daughter) I'm so sorry I doubted you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overlapping) Wait...But...Candace, where did that thing go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stops dancing) Hmmm. I don't know! But, Mom, you and Dad hafta come to the backyard with me right now and see what the boys are— (Sees the two devices rocketing over the house leaving a puff of smoke in the shape of a heart. She sighs.) Nevermind.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I wonder what would make someone want to build something to destroy romance in the first place.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, if you reverse-engineer the human heart, you're bound to find love at its core.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And...gross smushy red stuff!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes. Love and gross smushy red stuff.

Name: Irving
Dialog: And ventricles!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, I think ventricles are already included in gross smushy red stuff.

Name: All but Ferb
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahh, a nice relaxing day at the beach. Nothing but the waves, the sun and peace and quiet...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford drank all the sunscreen!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Coconut is my favorite flavor!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who wants to play volleyball?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I spoke too soon.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace, look, there is a sandcastle building contest over there. You used to love those. You should sign up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! Wait... (mutter) Why brother? With these two here, there will be no competition. They'll build a real skyscraper out of sand, with a working elevator, and window-washers, and a parking garage with flying cars! They'll totally steal my thunder!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, there are something else we may be doing today. With a minimal amount of research, Ferb found out that the lost city of Atlantis is probably located right off the coast of Danville!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh! I hope I will see a real life seahorse! And get my Underwater Equestrian Patch!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'd like to see a shark! I heard that those are the toughest fish in the ocean.

Name: Irving
Dialog: I got in the car when your mom stopped for gas. I'm just happy to be here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow...

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ooh, and I bought my camera, to take pictures of all the action!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guess we know what we're doing today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Imitating Major Monogram) Ahh, Agent P! Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been to every plant-nursery in town, buying up little seedlings and now he's out with he's blimp. Find out what he's up to!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Ohh... eheheh... sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Are those my old mustache clippings?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Some of them?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry you had to see that, Agent P. Please find out what Doofenshmirtz is up to!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom! We're gonna go find the lost city of Atlantis! Be back later!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What some imaginations...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Oooh! They're leaving! Mom, get out the turret molds. We've got a sandcastle to build!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everybody, follow me! And remember, if you get lost, the surface is up!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Wow! Is that the Titanic over there?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! It's Amelia Earhart!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah, the tomb of Poseidon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Focus, guys. We're looking for Atlantis, remember? (to Ferb) Which way, Ferb?

Name: GPS
Dialog: Take phytoplankton road north.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hold it! (He takes a picture) That one's for my wallet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why is water always so warm next to you?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm so glad that you wanted to join the contest. This'll be fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: If we're going to do this, we gonna do it right! Here, fill these buckets with water, I'm going to go find some sand.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Spraying the plants in his blimp) Lunchtime, my little plant friends! Yes, you like your water, don't you! Everyone gets H2O, even you little... Oh, Perry the Platypus! You landed into my fertilizer trap! Look at you. You've potting soiled yourself! (He laughs) So, I got to thinking, why use animals or insects to aid in my evil scheme, when there are these shiftless do-nothing-plants just laying around? So, I've created a super evil growth formula, that when sprayed on my plants, that will turn them into thorny, prickly minions! With them under my control, I will rule the Tri-State Area with an iron fist, and a green thumb! Hahahaha... (He sniffs) And, if you don't mind, I'm going upwind of you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're almost there, guys!

Name: GPS
Dialog: Turn right at kelp.

Name: Irving
Dialog: These sculls are pretty cool! (An eel takes Irving's camera) Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's okay, Irving, you still have the greatest camera ever made.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Where?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right here, the human mind. You can take pictures with your mind and store them in your memory. Try it!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Okay... Click! Well, I guess that worked...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Seahorses!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You can get your Underwater Equestrian Patch now!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Umm... that was a joke. They're way to small to ride...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Not if you scoop up a whole bunch of them! (He scoops up school of seahorses, and rides seahorses) Giddy up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys. Look what I found! A door with ancient runes telling us how to open it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Forget that! Step aside! (He punches the door, revealing Atlantis)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or that.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Click!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And everything is so pretty

Name: Irving
Dialog: Okay everyone, move closer, while I put my camera on a timer!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (whispering) I think he's taken this camera thing into a weird level.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Say cheese! Click!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We are so privileged to be in this strange and beautiful place. To think that the greatest mind in history have been searching for Atlantis for thousands of years.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Those guys are punks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We should bring this up to the surface for the whole world to see!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes. That is a great idea.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How do we do it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Up! Up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace and Linda's Sandcastle falls over) Err! This is the third time it's fallen! I used to be good at this! Now I'm Frank Lloyd Wrong! When did it get so hard?

Name: Girl
Dialog: (Standing next to her sandcastle) Oh man, this is super simple!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Argh, I hate this stupid contest. I quit!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, will you relax? This is supposed to be fun.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Hey, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?! Hi! (She stutters) What brings you to the magnificent shores of Danville?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I'm the judge of the contest this year.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Way! I'm excited to see what you two come up with! But you better get started, time's tickin'!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? Why are you just standing there? Sand castles don't build themselves. Chop chop!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus? Your efforts to try to stop me have been fruitless. Fruitless. Y-you like that one? Yeah, that's a good one! Fruitless? Next time you'll "leaf" me alone! Heh heh heh. Yes, Perry teh Platypus, I can be a fun guy. Get it? Fungi? The plural of fungus? Heheh... it's a... Yeah... Anyway, grow my green minions and get him! (He turns on a machine, and sprays the plants, making them thorny, carnivorous, and sentient) Wait, wait not me, not me... Hey, wait, don't be, don't be grab... I gotta turn this off... this has become a thorny situation...

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Four weather balloons and helium canisters, for underwater delivery...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's us!

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Aren't you kids a little young to be discovering Atlantis?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes we are.

Name: Deliver Man
Dialog: Well, good for you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright guys, let's get to work!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no, Jeremy is almost here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Help, Perry the Platypus, help! (The plants squeeze Perry out of his trap) Yes, yes, Perry, you got it! That's it, you're free now, and move over here... wait! Where are you going? Perry the Platyp... (Doofenshmirtz gets slapped by a vine)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay guys, tie the balloons to the four corners of Atlantis. Looks good, Ferb!

Name: All
Dialog: Wohooo! It's working!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Judging a sandcastle) Lookin' good, guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (To Linda) Looks kinda...

Name: Linda
Dialog: ...cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (A piece of their sandcastle falls off) This is horrible! Jeremy's gonna take one look at this, and think that I'm a big losery loser!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, Jeremy's smart enough to separate your sandcastle from his feelings about you!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, now last, but not least, we have the Flynn-Fletchers...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it's not perfect but... we had fun doing it, so, I give you, our sandcastle.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (looking up, and seeing Atlantis) Holy Moly, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, I know, it's not great, but we did our best.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are you kidding? It's amazing! You win, you win! I'm gaining to get your blue ribbon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (A vine chomps down on Doofenshmirtz's nose) AHH!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I have to say, I think Jeremy can't separate his feelings for you from his feelings for this sand castle. He must like you more than you thought...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehe. I know! Let's go get that blue ribbon!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you came back and saved me! Thank you, Perry the Platy... (He begins to breakout) Hey... wha... what's this? I'm having an allergic reaction to these stupid plants! Curse you, inadequate immune system!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What happened?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Did anybody see it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why did it go back down?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps the lost city of Atlantis wanted to stay lost.

Name: Irving
Dialog: At least I got the pictures in my head. Hey! I had my thumb in front of the lens the whole time! Oh, now all I remember is my thumb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb are in their beds, on top of a massive ski jump) Ahh! Christmas Eve. It was a great idea to climb back into bed this morning. Oh! I almost forgot! Helmets! All set? Let's do this thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, they can't all be fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb are making a Christmas special!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're slowing down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I...see...why...dogs...enjoy...this...sensation!!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Delayed! What do you mean delayed?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, the snow storm has delayed your grandparents' plane. Your father and I have to wait here at the airport until they arrived. It may be hours...

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I need your help! Stacy told me that Marcos told her that Jeremy told him that he got the perfect gift for me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sarcastically) Oh no. How will you manage?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, think! If Jeremy found the perfect gift for me, then I have to find the perfect gift for him!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I thought you already got a gift for Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did, but I can't show up with an obvious, stupid present that anyone could've gotten him. The perfect gift means that you totally get the other person in the most deep and paying-attention-y way. If his gift to me is perfect and my gift to him isn't, he's gonna be so hurt and insulted, and think I'm lame and thoughtless, and he'll stop liking me! (bawling)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace, honey, I don't think... You poor thing. (pauses; sighs) Forgive me, boys. What are your brothers up to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (slipping into busting mode) Not a thing. Which is weird. What are they up to? (Talks fast) Love you, Mom, gotta run, bye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Plow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: House!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming in too fast!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those two are sooooo busted! (yanks open door, realizes the boys are there) ...For lolly-gagging in bed? (The parachute deflates outside) That's not like you two.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've been working on a way to seize the day, while also not having to get out of bed so early. I think we can cross that one off our To-do List.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me see that. (She snatches Ferb's clipboard) What is this? Number one was write letters to Santa Claus. What, did you start this To-Do list when you were three years old?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We write letters to Santa Claus every year. Don't you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wah-hahahaha! Letters to Santa?!? Ahahahaha! That's for little kids! Hahaha!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Santa's not just for little kids, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, fine. Let's assume there is a Santa Claus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well of course there is. There's been a ton of reported sightings. Oregon, 1978. Northern Scotland, 1954. The so-called Santa Cloth found in Istanbul, 1912.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Santa's one of our biggest heroes. Talk about making the most out of one day. Imagine flying around the whole world, delivering toys and gifts to everybody in one night. Ferb and I have done some cool stuff in our time, but that, that's something else.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Again, let's assume there is a Santa Claus. He's got it easy. The hard part is trying to figure out what to get people want when they don't write you a letter, telling you exactly what they want most. And by "people" I mean "Jeremy", and by "you", I mean "me"... and uh, no the rest is pretty much literal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well I'm sure Jeremy would get exactly what he wanted. If he wrote his own letter to Santa.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bwahahaha, letters to Santa!? (Laughs) That's for little kids. (Laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. She's lapped us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait that's it! I'll trick Jeremy into writing a letter to Santa, so I can sneak a peek and learn what he wants straight from the horse's mouth. And by "mouth" I mean "pen", and by "horse" I mean Jeremy, and... yeah we're good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or you could ask him directly what he wants to avoid any unnecessary complications.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You are such a child sometimes. (She leaves the boys' room)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb, just think of all the wonderful things Santa does for us, and he never asks for anything in return. Wait, that's it! Ferb, are you thinking what I'm thinking?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: As usual, we're...Oh! Ugh! Man, no, that's not at all what I was thinking! Oh! Dude!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Yeah. That's it. I'll call in the troops, you wonder where Perry is.

Name: Snowman
Dialog: Hello! Wintertime's fun! Follow me! (Motions to Perry, begins to walk toward the road. Perry follows him.) Come on! Follow me! ...plow!!!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. there you are. Merry Christmas. Oh great, you brought snacks.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wintertime's fun, follow me.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Secret Santa time. Agent P. Ah, here you are.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, a "Sal Tuscany Christmas". You lucked out, Agent P. Your secret Santa has exquisite taste.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Glaring) Criminy, Carl. It's supposed to be a secret Santa.

Name: Carl
Dialog: What? No! I didn't get it for him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Huh, right. (Chuckles)

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, really I didn't!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The more you protest, the more we know you gave it to him.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Fine! Think what you want! Whatever! (Huffs in anger)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, Scrooge. We got it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh-oh, sorry Agent P. I guess evil never takes a holiday. If you'll direct your attention to the screen. Good morning Agent P. A wise man once said... eyes on the screen.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A wise man once said, "Evil never takes a holiday". We don't know what Doofenshmirtz is up to. But he's evil, and evil people hate Christmas. It's a cliche, sad cliche. Good luck, Agent P, and Merry Christmas.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Stop filming your butt, film mine. It's a party!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Happy Christmas Eve, my little drummer boy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. You know I don't play drums. I play guitar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know silly-billy. So, Whatcha doin?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Not sleeping anymore. How 'bout you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just thought it was the perfect day to show some Christmas spirit. Like when you were young and wrote letters to Santa... (Phineas and Ferb are seen hosting some of their thing to thank Santa) Would you keep that lame junk away from my window!? (to Jeremy) I'm sorry, what was I saying?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: ...Writing letters to Santa Claus?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bwahahaha, letters to Santa!? Oh! Brilliant idea. Let's get together and write letters to Santa, and be very specific, within a reasonable price range. For fun. I'll be over in a bit.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, this isn't one of these thing...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehehe, he doesn't suspect a thing. (pause) I just hope this works... (sits on her bed) 'Cause I don't have a clue.

Name: Candace
Dialog: 'Cause I hear it's perfect.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome! Phase one complete. Hey guys.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Cool clubhouse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no. This is not how you would say a "clubhouse". This is the ultimate rest and relaxation lounge, perfectly tailored to the jolly, rubenesque world traveler. (Awkward pause) It's a rest stop for Santa.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, I see.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, why did you not just say that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Highlights include

Name: Isabella/Buford/Baljeet
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) BWAH HA HA HA HA! LETTERS TO SANTA!?! AH HA HA!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you always get the presents you asked for?

Name: Isabella/Buford/Baljeet
Dialog: Pretty much, yes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course. Now did you ever write a thank-you note to Santa?

Name: Isabella/Buford/Baljeet
Dialog: Well, no, but...nobody ever told... (sighs) no.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I think it's time someone did something cool for Santa to show him we appreciate everything he does for us. So we're gonna turn the entire city of Danville into a giant, shimmering thank-you card for Santa Claus.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So what you're saying is it's not a clubhouse.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, what the heck. Kickline!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have an intense BURNING indifference!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I didn't even create the Naughty-inator myself because I compulsively, obsessively, just couldn't be bothered. Nah, the plans were mailed to me from Borneo where my Uncle Justin is rumored to be in hiding. It's really a sweet gift, but how can I destroy Christmas without having a good reason? (sighs) Well, I guess I have no choice. (Presses a button and a chair pops out of the ground and he flops in it) But to sit and wait for a reason.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright everyone, I want to thank you all for helping. Grab yourself some decorations, and let's get our grateful on.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, in a minute Candace. I'm right in the middle of something here. I was thinking you could maybe help me finish decorating. First.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! It'll be too late! The stores will all be closed! And by "stores" I mean "the post office", and "by buying a gift", I mean "mailing the letters".

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You didn't say "buying a gift".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, good. That would have been a dead giveaway.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, everyone! The next decoration delivery is here!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: The tinsel!

Name: Candace
Dialog: W-wait, come back! Our letters! We have to write them quickly! I already licked the stamps!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, all I really want for Christmas is the ability to hate Christmas. Is that too much to ask? (knock on door) Hmm, were you expecting anyone?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, yes. How can you hate Christmas listening to that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Bring us figgy pudding." (chuckles) Well you can say please. But you know whatever great. Figgy pudding.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa! What! Are you threatening me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How dare you! No one barges into my home and demand desserts. What sort of plan is that anyway? Let's go to a stranger's house and insult him in song form and refuse to leave until he hands over a fruit dish that no one's prepared since the 16th century. Well, if that's how things are, I have my reasons to push this button. So long, Christmas, you're Feliz Navi-dead to me! (Pushes button) (chuckles) See? Uh, it was Spanish.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Chuckles) 'Tis the season to be naughty!

Name: Old Caroler
Dialog: Can I at least get a diet soda?

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: What do we have here? Oh! Tsk! Tsk!

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Oh Blay'n. Oop! What do you have there?

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Oh just a bunch of last minute naughties. It's a shame, huh Clewn't?

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Kids! They get worse every year. Ungrateful little... I'll go sit in the dark and mutter to myself.

Name: Burdensome elf
Dialog: He wasn't always that way. In fact, he used to love kids. In fact, he used to be where the action is. Toy making. In fact, he was the fastest, best toymaker of them all. In fact, they used to call him "Clewn't, the fastest, best toymaker of them all." Though they just called him "Clewn't" for short, which also happens to be his name so the nickname thing was a kind of a moot point. In fact... (The camera zooms out to see Blay'n gone) "Just go up and talk to the first person you see. That's how you make friends." I'm never going to another seminar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, listen, you twerps. Your ridiculous efforts to thank Santa Claus are getting in the way of my ridiculous efforts to get Jeremy into writing a letter to Santa Claus. So why don't you... Hey, what's with the clouds?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Is it me, or does the sky look really dark and ominous, as if its foreshadowing events which will have a negative impact on our lives.

Name: Mailman
Dialog: I'm sorry kids, looks like everyone in Danville got a return on their letters to Santa. They've all been stamped "naughty".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, look! I did it. I wrote a letter to Santa saying in great detail what gift I want most.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! Thank you my Little Town of Bethlehem. I'll just hang onto that for you.

Name: Mailman
Dialog: Oh, I'll take that buddy. Maybe you'll have better luck with Santa than your friends.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but... uhh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Santa thinks everybody in Danville's been naughty.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now that's just nonsense.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, but how can that be.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, well, let's see. What's different this year than last year? Oh, I know! You went out and got everyone in Danville involved in one of your off-the-cuff, harebrained schemes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You think this could be my fault?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, who can say really? But, sometimes, we do naughty things without having any idea they're naughty. Sometimes we do an entire summer's worth of them. (glares at Phineas)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Could this be true?

Name: Isabella/Buford/Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no...I mean how could...well I guess it...

Name: Isabella/Buford
Dialog: Maybe.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am cold.

Name: Anchorman
Dialog: This is Gordon Gutsofanemu reporting from the Googolplex Mall here in downtown Danville. The Christmas all but banished ever since Santa Claus stamped big red "naughty" across this once nice city.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gasp) It was all a bad dream! Christmas wasn't cancelled!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas! No matter how many times you try that, it's not going to work.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe if I hadn't gotten out of bed today, I wouldn't have done the things Santa thought was naughty.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, what? Are you going to stay here for the rest of your life?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why not?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, for one, the mall closes in twenty minutes.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't see what everyone's so worried about. I got this system, see? You act any way you want all year long, but then right before Christmas, you do one big act selfless act of kindness and Santa will wipe your slate clean. Works like a charm.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really? So I might still have my one big Christmas wish come true?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Maybe.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Are you not going ask me what my Christmas wish is?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nope. It'll only wanna make me hurt you, which will counteract my one act of kindness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All I want is one sweet, special Christmas kiss under the mistletoe.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm outta here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not from you! From a pretty girl! Do not flatter yourself!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh! Don't you see what's going on out there? Game over! Your plan failed! There's no figgy pudding! There's no Christmas! You can all just go home!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh!

Name: Josh
Dialog: Come on guys, let's do But, it's Christmas, Becky.

Name: Becky
Dialog: You got to get over me Josh!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, bye. I gotta get home. Suzy's pretty upset that about Santa not coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But wait, no! Let's do some last minute window shopping.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, tell me what's wrong. I can't read your mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes you can. That's the problem.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I don't understand. What is it you want from me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, right! Like you need me to tell you that. The question is, what do you want from me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I just want you to tell me what you want.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine! I just want you to tell me what you want.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I don't want anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing? Right, yours is perfect, and I show up with nothing. Do want me to look like a total monster!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, that doesn't even make any sense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just that I think you're perfect, Jeremy. So I don't understand why you want to make me to feel like I'm not.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you should know me better than that. Look, I have to go home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh how did this go so wrong?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All except for Buford, 'cause he's got that whole "last minute reprieve" theory.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's gonna work. You watch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No! Y-You know what? I ca-can't except this. I know Danville and Danville is not naughty. We need to send a message to the North Pole to let them know there's been some sort of mistake.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But how do we do that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, they're not evening answer our mail.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! I've got an idea. Ferb, I know what else we're gonna do today.

Name: Man
Dialog: The North Pole? Well I hate to tell you this Phineas, but WJOP only reaches the greater Danville area. We just don't have a very powerful transmitter.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You leave that to us.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Danville. What's he talking about?

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Let me see that list of last minute naughties.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: They're all from the same place.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Hmmm. We've got to get to the bottom of this....

Name: Everyone
Dialog: (While Clewn't and Blay'n talk)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, uh guys. Don't hate me, but I went into the kitchen to get some almond brittle...love it!...and lo and behold it turns out I did have some figgy pudding. Quite a bit actually. I, I guess this whole thing was pretty easily resolved. I feel kinda sheepish for making a big deal. Anyway here, figgy pudding.

Name: Josh
Dialog: Come on, guys. Our work here is done.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bye bye now. Thank you for the evil motivation for destroying Christmas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was fun at least.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What do you think the chances are that anyone in the North Pole saw that?

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Hello! Hello! Hello!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'd say pretty good.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: So, what's all this business about Danville, then?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) What's this? A Sal Tuscany Christmas... Score! What a perfect way to enjoy the last several hours before Christmas officially doesn't come.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright! You know, this one's really grown on me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So that's what happened. Do you think it could be a mistake?

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: A whole city deemed naughty at once.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: I've never seen anything like it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh hey Candace. These are two of Santa's elves.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You gotta be kidding me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Blay'n, Clewn't, this is my sister.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Ah yes, Candace Flynn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know who I am?

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: No, that's not a good thing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're here trying to figure out why Danville was branded naughty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, maybe everyone did something naughty.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: No, it doesn't work that way. You see, everyone does naughty things from time to time but that's different from being a naughty person.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: You see, Santa's very forgiving.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Oh, jolly to a fault, if you ask me.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Well, something is definitely screwy around here. According to these readings as if the city itself is misbehaving.

Name: Voice
Dialog: Uh-oh, uh-oh, uh-oh, uh-oh, uh-oh. (A little monitor comes out)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh-oh, Agent P. It turns out Carl was lying about getting you that Sal Tuscany CD.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I never said I got it for him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Quiet, Carl! Haven't you caused enough harm? (to Perry) Your "so-called" Secret Santa must've somehow infiltrated the agency and uh, until we get to the bottom of it, whatever you do, do not play that CD.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Boy, this Sal Tuscany guy is good. Let me crank it up some more.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the? How did he...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so we'll have Christmas. I simply don't care. Curse my intensely burning apathy towards Chri-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, it is hopeless. I am never going to get my special mistletoe Christmas kiss. (Gets a wedgie from Buford) Ah!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I'm never going to get my one great act of kindness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Those were long johns.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about you, Isabella? Isn't there some big Christmas wish that your afraid won't come true?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, um, we don't celebrate Christmas. But I got the coolest stuff for Hanukkah. Eight straight days of dreams come true. I mean... I'm with you guys. Boo, no Christmas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, guys. Do you really seem like bad kids?

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: No, no, you're all good kids.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, I knew your heart will lead you to the truth.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: No, actually the meter suddenly gave you a "nice" reading.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Yeah! "Nice"! "Nice"! Everywhere! Everyone "nice". (meter reads Buford) Except for him. Sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that's great. All you have to do is tell Santa and Christmas is back on, right?

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Uh, mmm. It's not that simple. You see, Santa's already left. The elves loaded the sleigh and map out his route; it's too late now. Santa's not coming to Danville.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: It's too late now. Santa's not coming to Danville.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that doesn't seem fair.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: What are you gonna do about?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Me?

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Him?

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Yeah, him. You saw his file.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (thinks for a moment) Ferb, I know a third thing we're gonna do today. We're gonna save Christmas. Who's in?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Me.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I'm in.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Me too.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I guess I'm in too.

Name: Everyone but Candace
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Blay'n, dust off my toy-making gloves. I've found a reason to believe again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Friends, I'm not going to lie to you

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, are you sure that's not a clubhouse?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, I'm sure. Hang on, everybody, here we go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The cloud layer is too thick. I can't see. What happened to all the lights?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Everyone was so bummed out, I guess they never turned them on.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll take care of it. Just get me in low.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good luck, Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: All right, Buford, here's your chance.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: All right, who's first on the list?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's Buford, but it says he's naughty.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Plow!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Christmas is coming! Christmas is coming! Christmas is coming! Turn the lights on!

Name: Boy
Dialog: Did you hear that? Christmas is coming!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Hey, let's get those lights on.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Yeah, let's turn on the lights!

Name: Man 3
Dialog: What are we waiting for?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford did it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But it still says he's naughty.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: Oh, what the heck. It's Christmas.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: So, what does he want?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To be thought of as nice by his friends.

Name: Candace/Baljeet/Isabella
Dialog: Aww.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Merry Christmas, old buddy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's beautiful.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish Santa could've seen it. Oh, well. Come on, guys, let's make up some lost time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good going, guys. We only have a few more blocks to go.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We gotta hurry if we're gonna make it by Christmas Day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, next up

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: What does he want?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We can skip this one. I already got him what he really wanted. Yes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming up on the last house. Fire away!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, no, it is stuck.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's Wendy Stinglehopper's present. She asked for a really big hat.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Isn't that that pretty girl from the math team?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I know what I must do.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Be careful, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh! Almost got it. Ah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Goodbye, my friends! Ah!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, that was fun.

Name: Wendy
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, uh, hi Wendy. Did anyone order a really big hat?

Name: Wendy
Dialog: Eee! My hat! Oh how can I ever thank you?

Name: Wendy
Dialog: Hey, look, mistletoe.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay yeah, yeah, I get it. A taste of my own medicine right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, I hate Christmas. Yes! I hate Christmas! Woohoo! This is the best Christmas ever!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great job!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice shootin', Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well done. If you'll excuse me, I gotta see Jeremy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great work guys.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not to alarm you, but your house is on fire.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's not fire, it's steam! Come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't believe it! Santa!

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Uh, sir, what are you doing here?

Name: Santa
Dialog: Having a shvitz. Steam is just what the doctor ordered.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We thought you weren't coming to Danville.

Name: Santa
Dialog: And pass up on enjoying this cool rest stop you made me? Ho! Ho! Ho! Unthinkable! And thanks for doing the Danville run for me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You knew?

Name: Santa
Dialog: Of course I knew! I'm Santa Claus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh what a mess. Curse you, Sal Tuscany! (smashes the CD) Well, I probably should call Uncle Justin and thank him for the gift anyway. Hello, operator? I would like to place a call to... Barneo? I thought it said Borneo. Wait, where's Barneo? The North Pole! Wait a second! The letters of "A Sal Tuscany Christmas" spell "Santa Claus" with an embarrassing leftover "Y". Let me see that picture. Sal Tuscany is Santa Claus?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah! Jeremy! I was just coming to see you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I don't know what that was all about before, but I wanted to give you your present.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) The earrings I wanted. Jeremy, how did you know?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I remember you loved them in that magazine. And you were even gonna have your good necklace made into a pair like them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's so sweet. How did you afford these?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I sold my electric.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy. You were gonna trade that in to get that cool, new silver one.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You knew that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I guess I know you as well as you know me, my bowl full of jelly. Here's your gift.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: The silver guitar! But how?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I sold my good necklace.

Name: Candace/Jeremy
Dialog: It's perfect.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Merry Christmas.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Merry Christmas.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Funny how things worked out so that everyone pretty much got what they wanted.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What did you wish for, Phineas?

Name: Santa
Dialog: May I do the honors? I like this one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Santa
Dialog: "Dear Santa, you are one of my biggest heroes. All I want for Christmas this year is a chance to be like you. Thank you, Phineas Flynn." Ho! Ho! Ho! Merry Christmas, Phineas. And by the way, good job.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, that was fun.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Good job.

Name: Santa
Dialog: Well, kids, it's time for me to head home. So you're sure you don't need this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, we made it for you.

Name: Santa
Dialog: Great! I'll take it to the North Pole, and use it as a clubhouse.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I knew it was a club house.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: Goodbye!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Goodbye Blay'n, Clewn't. Merry Christmas!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See you guys. Thanks Blay'n. Thanks Clewn't.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Merry Christmas to ya.

Name: Clewn't
Dialog: So long. And... thanks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, Santa! It's true isn't it? You planned everything so everyone's Christmas wish would come true.

Name: Santa
Dialog: Well, Santa's gotta have a little fun. (starts to fly off) Ho! Ho! Ho! Merry Christmas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh wait! Ferb, what did you wish for?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Take a look at this morning's paper.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "World peace"?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No, no, this one down here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "Local boy gets harmonica"! Hey, great picture!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Mom and Dad are back.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Hey kiddies! Merry Christmas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grandma! Grandpa! You made it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Merry Christmas.

Name: Winifred
Dialog: I made figgy pudding.

Name: Snowman
Dialog: Hello! Wintertime's fun! Follow me! (Motions to Perry and starts to walk towards the road) Plow! (The camera focused on Perry covering his eyes and carrot rolls over to Perry but it was revealed to be a vegetable stand) You know, on second thought, don't follow me! Man, that was close. (Walt Disney logo comes on) (Disney Channel origanl logo comes on too)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what's the plan today, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, your mother's jazz trio has a gig at the Mayor's Day festivities, and I shall be running the antiques auction, oh yes! I'm very excited because we have a collection of steamrollers on the block, all imported from England.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're kidding. There's a market for that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, you'd be surprised, what with Steamroller Today magazine and Wacky Steamroller videos posted on the Internet. The public is going crazy for the flattening arts.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfff. People and their silly trends. (to Linda) Hey, Mom, can I get a pink streak in my hair?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why would you do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To express my individuality! Everyone's doing it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: No! (to Lawrence) Alright, well, I'm all set. I've got my lucky guitar strings, wearing my lucky underwear, and, of course, I've got...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, no! My lucky gold guitar pick! (Gets down on all fours to peer into the crack) It's wedged in the wall.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, here. Try my lucky butter knife.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, it's too far in. (Stands) You gave me that for our anniversary.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, don't worry, love. I'll get a contractor in here to retrieve it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I hate the idea of someone cutting a hole in my nice wall. Well, I can't worry about it right now. I've got music to make!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Whoa, yes, we'd better go. See you kids at the festival later, okay?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Bye!

Name: Phineas/Candace
Dialog: Good luck!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today, Ferb! Hey! Where's Perry?

Name: Computer
Dialog: Computer authorizing DNA, one moment please. Access granted.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. How do you like the new spitoon lair entrance? (Beat) Anyway, your mission. Mayor Roger Doofenshmirtz is being honored today with a statue at the Mayor's Day Festival. (Background of screen becomes a weather map with Heinz's and Roger's faces on it.) Considering Doofenshmirtz's hatred for his brother, the forecast suggests mild tomfoolery with a sixty percent chance of slapstick violence. Good luck, Agent P. Now on to Tom Perkins with sports.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're done, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just built a device that temporarily scrambles your molecules so you can pass through solid objects. Let's see if it works.

Name: Bobbi Fabulous
Dialog: Now listen up...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey we almost forgot, we have to get that pick for Mom! I'll be right back. (phases through wall)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I asked Jeremy if he was going to the festival and he's like "Yeah, are you going to the festival?" and then I go...(She notices Ferb, Isabella, Baljeet, and Buford staring at the blank wall that Phineas passed through)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey...

Name: Ferb, Isabella, Baljeet, Buford
Dialog: (without looking around) Hey.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Got it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (drops the apple in her hand in shock) ...Call you back Stacy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (puts ball on the table) Hey Candace, we're heading out to the festival. See ya!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes out phone and dials) Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on stage at the festival) Hello? Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I know this sounds crazy. I mean, no crazier than all my other calls. You've got a gig, you're upset about losing your lucky pick. Like, you're going to come home now and see what I'm rambling on about. No, you know, I should bring the ball to you! Yeah that's a good idea. Mom, forget this call ever happened. Bye! (hangs up)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (deafened by the music) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking to a Perry bobblehead) You see bobblehead Perry the Platypus, I have created a powerful -inator that will deface anything it contacts! Including my brother Roger's statue that's being unveiled at today's festival. It's going to humiliate him! Isn't that genius, bobblehead Perry the Platypus? (flicks the bobblehead)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (seeing the bobblehead bounce) Oh yes, so you agree. You know, I miss our little talks, don't you? Oh, what do you know anyway? (throws bobblehead out the back window)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (picks up the phasing ball) Walk through walls eh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, now I'm mad. (activates the ball and walks through the wall) You've outdone yourselves boys. Wait 'til Mom sees this.

Name: Roger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Citizens of Danville, it is an honor to be your mayor and a pleasure to serve.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (getting out of the microbus) Oh, no, Roger, it is I who will be serving you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hm... okay, push up and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Those are my keys, aren't they? (On the phone) No, I don't have my card. Yes, the keys are still in there and it's running. (Engine shudders to a stop.) Okay, now it's not running; now I need gas... Forty-five minutes huh?... (Sighs) Well I'm not going anywhere. (Puts phone away) Eh, well at least I can get my -inator. (Aims the -inator.)

Name: Roger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: As we get closer to unveiling this perfect replica of my body...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Plat...! (gets punched by Perry) Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? That's a... it's an arts and crafts project! I've got a life outside of you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you Perry the bobblehead!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Bummer, I have a flat!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, we can fix it.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And now, ladies and gentlemen, what you've all been waiting to bid on. I give you, the antique steamrollers! (crowd cheers)

Name: Crowd member
Dialog: They're so beautiful! (cries)

Name: Wilbur Wilkins
Dialog: Steamrollers stink!

Name: Orville Wilkins
Dialog: Yeah, pump trolleys rule!

Name: Old lady
Dialog: (gasps) It's the Wilkins brothers!

Name: Old man
Dialog: Just ignore them Arlene. They try to cause trouble at every steam-powered antique auction in the Tri-State Area.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Shall we start the bidding?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Enjoy your last moments of freedom, boys!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you might have destroyed Plan A, but behold! (Another -inator rises from the bus) Plan B! (Pushes a button and the -inator explodes) Which I have just destroyed, so now we're even. But not even I am prepared for Plan C! (Third -inator rises from the flatbed) Behold! The Be-Gone-Inator! How do you like me now Perry the Gone-a-pus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, so I missed. Oh whatever, I have a bigger bother to be-gone. Goodbye, stupid Roger statue!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And Lot Number 2 is a little beaut from Aveling & Porter built in 1924. Do I have any bids?

Name: Crowd
Dialog: I do! I do! I do! Here!

Name: Orville Wilkins
Dialog: Nobody's paying a lick of attention to us Wilbur.

Name: Wilbur Wilkins
Dialog: Yeah! Let's get out of here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Impatiently) So how long does it take you to fix a flat? Tick tock!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Running through the festival) Excuse me. Pardon me. Coming through!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aghh! You can build a rollercoaster in a day, but it takes you 12 minutes to pump up a tire?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Did anybody else just see the inside of a steamroller?

Name: Buford
Dialog: How do you know what the inside of a steamroller looks like?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have a life outside of you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, the tire's fixed.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And Lot Number 5 is sold to the woman in red. And now the last item of the day

Name: Candace
Dialog: (struggling to get the door off of the porta potty stall, while Balthazar gives her a high five) Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm... what are the odds?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey mom! I'm glad we caught you. Ferb and I found your lucky gold pick.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh boys! Thank you! What a relief; I just hate playing without it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Look at this! Look at me!

Name: Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro
Dialog: Linda! We're on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I've gotta go. And just because I won't let you get pink hair, you don't have to wear some weird door. The trends these days...

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walking away) Cool door Candace. (to the others) Let's get a good spot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'd wear a door. Heck, I'd even wear a window if it'd fit.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walking past the group) Hey guys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no! Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You seen Candace?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's standing in the door.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no! Oh no! Jeremy can't see me like this. Oh my g..! Oh no! (winds the door's toilet paper around her head)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...and four. And breathe. Whew, just doing some stretching. Oh hi Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, our moms are going to start playing when they unveil the statue. Wanna go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamily) Sure.

Name: Roger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, without further ado! (Statue is unveiled; crowd cheers; band starts playing.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well Ferb, it looks like everything worked out for everyone today.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (standing with Perry on his flatbed, balanced on the edge of the cliff) I can't believe nothing worked out for me today. After... I.. I had a A, B, and C and they all... 'course I destroyed the B so...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey where are you going? Curse you Perry the Platypus! (Rolls past the Wilkins brothers)

Name: Wilbur Wilkins
Dialog: Hey look at that! A pump-less pump trolley!

Name: Orville Wilkins
Dialog: Now that's old school.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Aunt Tiana, you and Bob have had so many cool adventures.

Name: Tiana
Dialog: I know huh? And here's a picture of Bob and me jumping out of a helicopter into the South American rainforest. Turn the page, Bob.

Name: Bob
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Oh, here's where we dodged all those man eating plants in the Amazon. Bob?

Name: Bob
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: And here we are climbing the icy peaks of Kilimanjaro. I thought the view was just spectacular, but Bob was just--

Name: Bob
Dialog: Eh, okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Where ya going next?

Name: Tiana
Dialog: To the Galapagos. We leave tomorrow.

Name: Bob
Dialog: You know, we’ve been on so many trips together, this time, I want to go with someone else...

Name: Bob
Dialog: ...My wife. Tiana, will you marry me?

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Linda
Dialog: How romantic.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Way to go Bob.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, corny. But apparently effective.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You could get married in the Galapagos!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! You can't get married in the Galapagos. When I was little, you promised me that I would be your bridesmaid. What about my needs?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Oh, that's right. I did promise you that, didn't I? Well, we could go to the courthouse before we leave.

Name: Bob
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, not okay! We have to have a real wedding. We can have it in the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you can't plan a real wedding in a day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Duh! (Rushes off and comes back wearing a dress) I've been planning this since I was 10! I could set up the perfect wedding and get you two kids married in a way you'll never forget, and have you on the plane to the Galapagos with time to spare. Now you and mom go to the salon to get up-dos, and French manicures. Then head to Tri-State Bridal and ask for Oga. Now go!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay then, wouldn't want Aunt Tiana taking her vows in safari wear!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Candace, I know you're going to plan a wonderful wedding, especially with Phineas and Ferb helping.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right! Ferb, I know what we're going to do--

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no no no. You don't know what you’re going to do today. They're going to build some sort of wedding rocket to the moon, or lawn gnome beach party of taffeta!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Then you steer the boys in the right direction, and have fun, okay?

Name: Bob
Dialog: (Off screen, distant) Okay!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At Ferb) Lawn gnome beach party of taffeta. Make a note of that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (At phone) Hello? Lake's Cakes? I'd like a 7-tiered.... Oh no, make that 10-tiered white cake with raspberry filled... (Beep) Please hold. (Click) Yes, Flowers? Oh, yes, I need something with smell... (Beep) Oh um, please hold. (Click) I'm back. I want something with cinnamon...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, sis.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me. (At Phineas and Ferb) Can't you see I'm busy? (At phone) Yes, I'm still here. Hold please! (At Phineas and Ferb) Will you two scram?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb and I wanted to see how we could help.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just go do something and get out of my way! (At phone) Huh? Oh no, not you. It's my... (At Phineas and Ferb) Go plan the grand entrance!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay! (At Ferb) I guess we could make an entrance that's kinda grand. (Pause) So, have you seen Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Major Monogram's screen lifts to reveal Perry sliding down a chute to his chair) Agent P, thank goodness you're here. As you've probably heard by now, Danville's experiencing a shortage of decent, healthy food and someone's been buying up all supplies of unhealthy food additives. This has Doofenshmirtz written all over it. (Image pops up on screen with Doofenshmirtz's picture and signatures by the man himself) We have no idea why he signed it that many times, but anyways, we're all counting on you Agent P!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (At phone) No; I said crab puffs! (Beep) Please hold. (Click) Why would I want my cake in a vase? Oh, you're the florist, not the baker.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Off screen) Alright ladies, let's do a run through!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Through helicopter noise) Looking good Isabella! (Candace comes to the backyard) Oh, hey, sis!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Parachuting down from the helicopter) Hey, Candace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See Aunt Tiana, Bob, and the wedding photographer will parachute into their wedding, just like they did in South America. At the helicopters) Let's bring those puppies back down. We want to save our fuel for the actual grand entrance!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Absolutely not! You are off grand entrance duty. Just go take care of the flowers, while I order the cake. Got it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess we could--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just do it! And don’t interrupt me. (Walks away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, she's good. I'm going to have her plan my wedding. Ferb, make a note.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Off screen) I got it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Surprise, Perry the Platypus! (Giggles madly) Okay, (Presses elevator button) enjoy your trip! (Giggles again) Oh, oh, the look on his face was priceless, (Giggles) Oh, here he comes back. Alright, try not to laugh, okay. Ahaha, did you enjoy the other floor—Wait, Perry? (Second elevator door opens revealing Perry) Perry the Platypus? (Goes inside the elevator) Huh, where did he go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, (Groans) No!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, not beef, chicken! Oh, you're the cake guy? (Beep) Oh, hold please. (Click) What? No I don't want to save money on my car insurance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I told you not to interrupt me. (At phone) Not you, don't hang up. (At Phineas and Ferb) This better be good!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I just thought you'd like to see how the flowers turned out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Why didn’t you say so? (Walks into the backyard) Oh wow, this is so beautiful—Wait a minute, are these--?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Venus flytraps! Just like in their adventure in the Amazon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don’t worry Candace, they only have a taste for insects and small vermin. (Flytrap latches onto Candace’s head) Hey, he likes you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get this thing off me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Removing the Venus flytrap off Candace) Are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: One moment. (Dials on her phone)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello? (Candace screams through the phone; Linda hangs up) So, are you and Bob thinking of having kids?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what can we do next?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Next? What can you do next?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Aunt Tiana said that we should help, and it is her wedding when you think about it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright. But! No trampolines, no robots, no rollercoasters, no firework spectaculars, no native dancers, no running of the wildebeests--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Walking into his apartment) You could have at least gotten into your trap. It's on the table. (Perry ties himself up) You know, I do appreciate you trying to mix it up, but I do have a schedule to keep. Ready? Let me show you my latest project. The Junk Food-inator! It sprays my special mix of boiling hot high-fructose corn syrup and hydrogenated coconut oil. To turn all healthy food into toasty warm junk food! Soon, everyone will become lethargic overweight blobs. Easily controlled by me! (Laughs) Because I will be the only one left eating healthy food, like these delicious broccolis! (Eats) Mm, well, the only problem is, I'm not quite used to the taste—- I'm used to eating the junk. I'll just dip it in here (Dips broccoli into the Junk Food-inator and eats it) Mmm, Oh that's much better! I could eat this all day. I can feel myself getting healthier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: --No giant robot groomsmen, no mechanized rice catapults, no rocket to the moon, no bringing the moon down to earth, just regular good old fashion wedding stuff like you might find at a regular everyday perfect wedding.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Like?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Like—- Ice! It's summer, it's hot, people want something with ice, okay? Make ice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, what do we have in the ice file?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I could eat this stuff all day. Just look at this lifelike glow I've acquired. I'm the picture of health! And all from eating nothing but this... ah, I don't know what's under here, but I think it's a vegetable. I'm as strong as an ox! (Squelching noise as his stomach pops out from his shirt. Doofenshmirtz breathes out heavily as he gets tired) But nobody else will be after fire off my Junk Food-inator. (Machine rumbles, but stops, having run out of corn syrup and coconut oil) I should really refill this. But you know (Yawns) I'm so tired. I should really take a nap first. (Falls over into Junk Food-inator and starts snoring)

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Yeah, the cakes all set up out back just like you asked.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you!

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Hey, aren't you a little too young to be a wedding planner—Oof!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! (Slams door) No, I'm not! (Rushes out back) My perfect cake done! (She unveils the cake to have the strangest assortment of tiers, ranging from fish bones to a chicken cage at the bottom) No! My perfect cake! Mr. Delivery guy, come back! (Candace runs past a window only to come back to see her disheveled appearance) The horror.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace! What do you think of our ice sculpture? We incorporated all of Aunt Tiana's and Bob's adventures. There's even a slide she can ride down to the altar.

Name: Isabella and Ginger
Dialog: (Sliding down) I do!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sobbing) I'm telling-- (Car honks) Mom! Maybe it's my perfect day after all! Mom! Aunt Tiana, hurry up, you've got to see this thing.

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Is she always like that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Some days are better than others!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hopping up and down) It's Phineas and Ferb! They've ruined everything!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll go check on Lawrence and Bob.

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Candace, let's go have a look.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Rushing to the backyard) Look at this cake, it has a chicken in it! (Chicken noise)

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Oh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: And my hair! I think it may also have a chicken in it!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Oh my...

Name: Candace
Dialog: And this! (Gestures to the enormous ice sculpture)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Auntie T! We're just putting the finishing touches on the scorpions. Look! The venom is sparkling apple cider!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Oh my goodness. Candace, I- I...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't say it, Auntie T, I failed you! I turned your special day into the worst wedding ever!

Name: Tiana
Dialog: (In tears) But I love it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You huh?

Name: Tiana
Dialog: I mean your hair, it's all the rage down in Montevideo. And the cake! It's like a crazy hodgepodge of everything I love. And this! Wow, all I can say is, (Hugging Candace) thank you. You planned a perfect wedding. Now why don't you come inside and help me with my dress?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Waking up to Perry’s chatter) Wait, what, who am I? Oh, oh, it’s me! Perry the Platypus, how did you free yourself?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. But it's too late! While I was napping, enough grease dripped off my face to fill the Junk Food-inator. Nothing can stop me now! Hoo, I gotta sit down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the--? (Scorpion collides into the -Inator) Suddenly I feel like a glass of apple cider. I don’t know how you did that, but get ready to pay, Perry the Platypus! (Stomach growls) Uh, can you hold on one second? (Goes to washroom; toilet flushes) Okay, here we are, let’s do this-- (Stomach growls) Uh, uh, you know, just hold on. (Door closes) Ah you know Perry the Platypus, uh, you can just let yourself out. I...I may be a while.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Are you ready Aunt Tiana?

Name: Tiana
Dialog: Wow, you even made it snow! Wait, what about the ice sculpture with all our great adventures?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: They say the step you’re about to take is the beginning of your greatest adventure yet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Little corny there, bro.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Just (Picking up guitar) teeing up the song.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh yeah!

Name: Bob
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Chicken
Dialog: Ba-kaw!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, where's the justice of the peace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: AW, NUTS! Ugh, just give me a minute. (Walks away and dials phone)

Name: Chicken
Dialog: Ba-kaw!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I can't remember the words.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What to do. What to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gangway, on your right. One side, coming through. (trips over Perry) (at Phineas) Argh! How many times have I told you to keep Perry out of my way when I'm balancing eggs on a spoon?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, never?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I would have thought it would have been understood.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What the heck are you doing, anyhow?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm training for this year's father daughter picnic competition. And I'd really like to win for a change.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, c'mon! We're not finished practicing!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'll be right there, sweetheart, I'm just clearing a spot for the trophy we're going to win today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, those trophies are lame. "Last place?" "Nice try"?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, c'mon, how about his one? First place! (Takes out a trophy)

Name: Candace
Dialog: It means "loser", Dad. (Makes an L shape with her fingers on her forehead)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, that's not very nice, is it. But look on the bright side, Candace, this year we might take home one just like this. Ta da! (Makes a W with his three fingers on his forehead)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Third place?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No, winner. It's a W.

Name: Linda
Dialog: How are my two favorite competitors doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. (Leaves)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I've got a few errands to run. But I should be there by the time the contest starts.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, please try to make it, I think Candace could really use someone cheering her on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you hear that, Ferb? I know what we're going to do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (notices the lair entrance) How peculiar. Anybody there -- (falls through the door and slides down to Perry's lair) Oh.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. (Lawrence gasps and hides behind the hovercar) Doofenshmirtz has been doing some research on the structural properties of glue. It's probably not... (continues under)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Say, that fellow wearing the dashing fedora looks awfully familiar...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (gasps) Perry?!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Why do I get the feeling I wasn't supposed to see that? (trips on a cable) Ooh! That hurt. (lands in the memory eraser and mumbles)

Name: Computer
Dialog: Memory erase sequence initiated. 5% completed.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Hi, Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (he and Ferb are bouncing on something) Hi, Isabella. Come on in.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (enters) What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, just trying to generate 40,000 cubic feet of compressed air.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's it for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'll see in a minute. I don't wanna blow the reveal too soon.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Anything I can do to help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We still need some pom-poms, a fog machine, and 372 feet of bungee cord!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (she wrote this down) You got it!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Memory erase

Name: Carl
Dialog: (deactivates the memory eraser) Mr. Fletcher, are you okay?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Daddy?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh-oh. (sees Monogram try on fake mustache) Major Monogram, we have a situation here. Mr. Fletcher got caught in the memory eraser!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly, Carl! This could bring down the entire organization. (straightens his mustache) Get him back to headquarters right away so we can restore his memory.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Dada!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We can't let the family see him like this, he's got the brain of a toddler. We need to restore his memory before he's missed at the Father Daughter Picnic.

Name: Carl
Dialog: But that'll take over three hours!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah-ha-ha-ha! Dada!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Better hurry before it's time to change him.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I have--

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Da da da da da da da da!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Will you stop it? I am trying to have a conversation.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: WAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!

Name: Carl
Dialog: As I was saying sir, I may have a solution. (presses a button, opening a garage) Anticipating just this kinda situation...

Name: Carl
Dialog: I have been building robot replicas of the Flynn-Fletcher family. We can get Agent P to operate the Mr. Fletcher robot, until we can replace him with the real Mr. Fletcher!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: W-wait a minute. You anticipated a specific situation like this?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yup.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wow, that's a little creepy, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes. (pause) Yes, it is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...and by "inopportune", of course, I mean, "Completely opportune!!" I was just about to drop an entire container of "eulg" on the Tri-State Adult Diaper Factory! And what is eulg, you may ask? It's the opposite of glue. (Squirts some on a boombox.) A few drops of this will make anything fall apart. See? Now, witness as I—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, (Perry holds up a finger to signify "wait a minute") Agent P, you must abort your current mission! There is something much more important than Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? I'm right here! I can hear you, you know!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Rendezvous back at headquarters. Monogram out. (hangs up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine, fine. You have somewhere more important to be. But don't you want to know (Perry jets away) why I want to destroy the adult diaper factory? It's a terrific backstory!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, this is gonna be a backstory, too, someday!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad! Where could he be? Dad, come on, we gotta go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, you wanna see what we—?

Name: Candace
Dialog: DAD!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, she'll see it soon enough. (To the Fireside Girls and pulling a rope to unveil something) Ladies and girls, I give you... (the dust cover comes off to reveal a blimp with an electronic sign with the words "GO CANDACE!" on it) the floating pep-squad mobile!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Go, Candace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on. Let me give you the tour. First stop

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Fireside Girls, start your pedaling! (The blimp takes off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Memory restoration, 7% and counting.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's why you'll be controlling this robotic version of Mr. Fletcher. (He carries Perry up and into the robot.) Unfortunately, the operation manual is in Dutch. (Gives Perry the foreign manual.)

Name: Carl
Dialog: But we were able to find a Dutch to French dictionary, and a French to English dictionary.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Godspeed, Agent P. (Perry salutes back.) Now, commence startup.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Startup successful. Now try the body controls.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Body controls seem to be good. Now try talking.

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: Jolly good, Candace. As long as it's okay with Mum, it's okay with me. Stiff upper lip and all that.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, is that all he can say?

Name: Carl
Dialog: The kit originally came with one default phrase.

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: Lovely windmill, isn't it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, those kooky Dutch! Now, Agent P, try to emote.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oops, sorry. (Puts the face back on.) Sometimes this happens. I'm still working out the bugs then. There, good as new.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (looking at his watch) And not a minute too soon. (gives thumbs up) Good luck, Agent P. Monogram out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if you talk to Dad, just tell him to meet me at the park. I couldn't find him anywhere, so I came down by myself.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm sorry, Candace. I got stuck in a bit of traffic, but I'll be there as soon as I can.

Name: Candace
Dialog: If Dad doesn't get here soon, we'll have to— (The Lawrence robot appears.) Oh, nevermind, Mom, he's here! (to the robot) Let's go get checked in for the contest!

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: As long as it's okay with Mum, it's okay with me. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. I'm Phineas Flynn. We have a perfect view of today's first event

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Charge!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, look up there! (Cut to inside the robot where Perry is viewing Candace's busting attempt.) Phineas and Ferb are flying in a giant blimp!

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: As long as it's okay with Mum, it's okay with me.

Name: Contestants
Dialog: Everyone, heave! Pull!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa! Come on, Dad! Dig in your heels!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great, Dad! Looks like we're still losers!

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: (follows her) Jolly good, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Our father-daughter teams are changing positions and settling in (a pie appears on the sign) for the gooseberry pie eating contest. Each team will have sixty seconds to eat as much pie as possible with their hands behind their backs.

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Ew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now it's time for a real crowd pleaser! The father-daughter balloon animal sculpting contest. We've got a butterfly, a snail, Oh, and a snake. Very creative.

Name: Judge
Dialog: And, uh, this is a—?

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: Lovely windmill, isn't it.

Name: Judge
Dialog: That's not technically a balloon animal. Zero points!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can you believe that?! She mocked you. Dad? (puts her hand on the robot) Ouch! Dad, you're burning up! I'll go get you some water. (Runs off.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, I'm afraid your robotic Mr. Fletcher is overheating. Apparently, Carl forgot to top off the coolant levels.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sorry, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You've got to keep that robot under control until we can make the switch. (Perry salutes.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here ya go, Dad. Drink lots of water. (gets out her phone and dials) And where's Mom?! (The head of the robot opens up and Perry grabs the water bottle from the robot's hand and squirts lots of it inside.) She should have been here a long time ago!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on phone) Candace, I'm just a few blocks away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, hurry, Mom! You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb have creat—

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on phone) Ooh, sorry, Candace. Going through a tunnel. Gotta go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the robot) Well, you look a lot better. Let's head on over to the water balloon toss.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Closing in on the target. (Cut to the plane to reveal Doof reading a map.) With Perry the Platypus out of the scenario, nothing will stop me! (laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excuse me, sir, could you stand up and sit right back down?

Name: Man
Dialog: I...suppose.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, we started a wave!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gently. (She catches the balloon then throws it back to the robot, who catches it.)

Name: Lawrence Robot
Dialog: Jolly good, Candace. (Throws it back to Candace.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa-ee! (catches it) We're doing great, Dad! (She throws it back to the robot whose arm stretches out long, literally, and catches it.) Wow, nice reach!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've finished restoring Mr. Fletcher's memory. You need to distract the girl so we can make the swap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh. (runs off) Don't worry, Dad! I'll get it! I'll get it!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. (Carl pushes Lawrence out. The robot takes his "5" sign off and puts it on Lawrence.) Thanks, we gotta hurry! Off you go! (Pushes Lawrence through the bushes. Perry comes out of the butt again and Carl shakes his hand.) Nice work, Agent—

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: (offscreen) AHHH!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Our cover's blown! We gotta move! Go go go go!!! (The truck zooms away.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ugh, my head. Where am I?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad! Dad! I caught the balloon and the judges gave us some points for the longest distance!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ow, yes, but where are we?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think we're in second place. Let's go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The adult diaper factory! I'll be over the target in exactly, ah, (tips the eulg bottle over while looking at his watch) five min— (gasps and watches some eulg hit the back of the plane) Oh, no, that's not going to be good. (The plane comes apart.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Welcome to the final event. Ready? Set? (waves flag) GO!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Keep up with me, Dad! We're getting out of rhythm!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'm trying!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Oh, Dad, it's hopeless.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bubble gum, bubble gum, running in a sack. (Candace smiles) Hop to the finish and don't look back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, you remember!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, park the blimp and get everyone down here for the final cheer!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're on our way! (She parks the blimp and the Fireside Girls slide down the ladders.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
