Dialog: (praying) Pleaseiwannaliveiwannaliveiwannalive! (lands on something. Zoom out to reveal it's the blimp.) What? I'm alive! Woohoo! (Part of the plane lands on him.) Ow! (More parts of the plane fall on him. Followed by a nail, which deflates the blimp) Curseyouperrytheplatypuseventhoughyouwerenteinvolvedinthischemewhatsoever!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You got it, Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Look, we're pulling ahead!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And, look! There's Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on a megaphone) Go Candace! Go Dad! Go Candace! Go Dad!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Go, Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great job! I'm so proud of you guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, it was awesome!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Look, honey!

Name: Judge
Dialog: (offscreen) And the winner is...Candace Flynn and her dad, Lawrence!

Name: Linda and Candace
Dialog: Yippee!!! Yay!!!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Huzzah!!!

Name: Woman
Dialog: (giving them the trophy) Congratulations!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you! Heh. And thank you, Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Do you know, Candace, I don't remember much of what happened here today, (hugs his daughter) but I'll never forget this moment with you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Hey, haven't I seen you before?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, we gotta fire up the memory eraser again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside, chuckles) Oh, Jeremy, I had no idea you've felt that way about me. (Cut to inside; she is talking to a paper mache Jeremy.) But I still have a lot to accomplish before I get married. (pause) Hold on. (puts candles between it) Much more romantic. (the phone rings) It's you! (on phone, in dreamy voice) Hello, Jeremyyyy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi, Candace. I was wondering if you could do me a favor?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamy voice) Yeeeaaahhh...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Listen, I got called into work and my parents aren't home, do you think you could look after Suzy for a few hours?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamy voice) Yeeeaaahhh...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'll be right over. Thanks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamy voice) Yeeeaaahhh... (needle scratch) Huh? Uh -- wait -- what did you say? Jeremy? NO! JEREMY! (to the paper mache) I'll be right back. (runs out panicking) Mom! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Moooom! Jeremy's dropping off his little sister and I --

Name: Linda
Dialog: How nice. A babysitting job.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Mom, you don't understand! She's EVIL!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't be silly, Candace. She's just a little girl. How much trouble could she be? (Sees Phineas and Ferb under an out of control sprinkler) I see you've discovered the broken sprinkler. Yeah, I'd better get to the hardware store! It's beginning to look like Niagara Falls out here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Niagara Falls? (sits up) Know anything about that, Ferb-meister?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (sits up) It's over 167 feet high. It's also tremendously popular with daredevils.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (with lots of unshaven hairs on his face) I can't believe you forgot to pick up new razors, Carl! Now I have to go on camera without a clean shave!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Me, too, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? You don't have a single hair!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I have one, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ew! Agent P, you're here! We're getting very suspicious about Doofenshmirtz. He hasn't ordered any bulk items from the Internet in days. Get over there and put a start to it! (Perry salutes.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you disgust and fascinate me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Suzy'll be here any second! I hafta get this place in shape! Must! Hide! Anything! Suzy! Can! Use! Against me! (She throws away kitchen knives, the microwave, the blender, and Mr. Miggins in the trash. The doorbell rings. Cut to the front door, Jeremy and his little sister appear. Candace answers it wearing a very heavy protective suit.) Oh, hey! Hi, Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? What's with the outfit?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I get...cold.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (in non-belief) Uh...huh. Well, it's a statement. You guys have fun now. Bye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'know, even though I know that was papier-mâché, that's still an impressive throw!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys! (to Baljeet, who is inside a baby carrier held by Buford) What's with the baby carrier?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ask him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (chewing gum) My chiropractor recommended it. It's just as humiliating as a half-nelson, and easier on my tennis elbow. (crunching loudly)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's that grinding sound?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Tuff Gum! Like the song sez...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, can I have some?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, I don't think so. It's for bullies only.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) You got any regular gum?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, everyone. Ferb and I have built a giant waterfall, right. And we wanna do a test run. Who's in?

Name: Buford and Isabella
Dialog: (raising their hands) Me!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Can I go?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, just be careful. Cuz I worry about you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. (Perry gets tied up by a pair of electronic hands tying a shoelace around him.) How do you like my new Shoelace-inator? It's the perfect match for my new Carbon-Footprint-inator! (Cut to what looks like a giant black foot.) I made it entirely out of carbon paper I kept from the 1970s. I always thought it was going to come back. Tsk. Shame. Anyway, people are always talking 'bout reducing their carbon footprint. I don't really know what that means, but it sounds evil. "Carbon footprint." So, my plan is to leave giant carbon footprints all over the Tri-State Area! (Cut to Perry attempting to bite off his trap.) Don't bother, it's double-knotted.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (evilly) So, Candace, are you ready to have some...fun?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: N-No-no-no. I'm good. I hate fun.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I've got a little game we can play.

Name: Candace
Dialog: G-g-g-g-game?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (rummaging through her backpack) It's called making...

Name: Candace
Dialog: M-m-making?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: ...paper...

Name: Candace
Dialog: P-p-p-paper?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (nicely) ...dolls!

Name: Candace
Dialog: PAPER DOLLS?!?! Huh?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: It's for you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: For me? Aren't you going to do something horrible to me?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Oh, no. Making you look bad is just one of the ways I control Jeremy. If he's not here, I'm off the clock.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, you can control your brother?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Can't you get your brothers to do anything you want?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way! I can't get them to do anything!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Un-ac-ceptable. To the backyard!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Hey, guys! (giggles) What'cha doin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (angrily) Um, hello?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Suzy! We were just puttin' the finishing touches on our waterfall ride.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ah, just watching all this work makes me thirsty. What I wouldn't do for a cool lemonade.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lemonade? Whatever you'd like, Suzy. (Ferb gives Suzy a glass.)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Thank you. (She sips as Candace looks in surprise.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have so much to learn.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Well, now that you've watched the master at work, it's time for you to get yours.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me? Oh, no! I'm not ready! I-I...

Name: Suzy
Dialog: What do you want?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To bust my brothers?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (like a drill sergeant) Is that a question or a mission?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A mission.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: So say it!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I wanna bust my brothers!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: MEAN IT!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I wanna bust my brothers!!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: OWN IT.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I WANNA BUST MY BROTHERS!!!!!!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Even better, get them to bust themselves.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get my brothers to bust themselves? (in realization) Get my brothers to bust themselves. Get my brothers to bust themselves!! GET MY BROTHERS TO BUST THEMSELVES!!! GET MY BROTHERS TO BUST THEMSELVES!!!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: GO, GO!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: GET MY BROTHERS TO BUST THEMSELLLLLLLVES!!!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks up to them) Hey, boys! What'cha doin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ugh, do I even need to be here?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Going over Niagara Falls in a barrel. Wanna come? It's gonna be sweet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (being carried by Buford up the ladder) If Buford does not drop me first.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Alright, Candace! Time ta bring it on home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, I want you to pick up the phone right now—

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Psst! (smiles widely)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everything okay, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (back in her normal face) D'oh! Can you just help me out and call Mom?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What? So she can come and see this gigantic insanely high waterfall we built in the backyard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great idea! Can I borrow your phone? (Candace gives Phineas her phone, and he dials.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Suzy) Hey! (Suzy gives Candace a thumbs up.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whadaya know? It's Candace. Right on schedule. So what kind of unbelievable contraption have Phineas and Ferb built that requires me to come home immediately?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An unbelievably cool waterfall ride right in our backyard! You gotta come home right away!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas? Is that you? You sound just like Candace. I mean, you sound like you, but the things you're saying—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on phone) Hurry up! You gotta see it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, alright, just as soon as I find the right sprinkler part! (hangs up) I curse the day these things were invented!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (a little hoarsely) Everything is going— (clears throat) Everything is going according to my plan! Soon, Danville will know what it is to be trodden upon by true genius! (Perry attempts to get out of his trap) I think I'll start with a pond or bushes or something. You know, to beef up the whole anti-environmental theme I've been dancing around. (Perry finally comes loose from his trap.) Wait, where was that from? (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz.) How did you get out of that double knot? (Perry flings himself at Doofenshmirtz, but Doofenshmirtz pulls a lever opening a window, and Perry jumps out.) Hey, you like the window? I just had it installed! Sayonara, Perry the Platypus! (Agent P's parachute pops out.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, Buford, we're ready for you! You can let 'er rip!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Roger that! (grinds loudly)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Better eighty-six the gum. It's a choking hazard.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, all right. (takes it out and sticks it onto the faucet) But I'll be back for that bad boy. Alright, let's do this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I CAN'T WAIT FOR MOM TO SEE THIS!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is it! Today's the day! It's my day! It is my day!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But was Buford not in the barrel with us?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bullseye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, that was great! I can't wait for Mom to see it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me, too! (car horn honks) Mom's home! Yes! (grabbing Phineas) C'mon! Let's go tell Mom! Let's go let's go let's go!

Name: Manager
Dialog: Congratulations! You are now an official driver for the Mr. Banana Company. (Perry drives off) Man, that is so funny, I literally just wrote a song about a platypus driving a banana truck! Hmm. Hmm? Wait! My demo!

Name: Manager
Dialog: Aw yeah, I'll bet you a fiver!

Name: Manager
Dialog: That there's a mobile mammal!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom Mom! Phineas wants to show you something!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We built Niagara Falls in the backyard! Wanna see it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why, I'd love to, honey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Yes! Finally!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Danville, get ready for a carbon footprint you'll never forget!! (The Carbon-Footprint-inator stomps onto the faucet, but the gum gets stuck to it.) What? What? Oh, see? This! This is why I hate nature! It's always getting stuck to your foot! Yech!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There ya go.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe it! You walk away from a profitable miniature golf franchise and open up a spring water bottling plant right in the middle of town! What? Didja think a mountain spring was just gonna fall out of the sky?

Name: Farmer
Dialog: You never believed in me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, we'll try this again. Blah blah blah carbon footprint! (Cut to trucker Perry. He pulls the brakes, and the back part lifts, dropping the big banana off of it. The carbon footprint slips and kicks the blimp deflating it. Doofenshmirtz sighs.) I suppose this was inevitable. Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (Crash!)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, kids, you're right. It does look like Niagara Falls back here. (Puts a sprinkler part on the leak.) But this part will fix that. Voila! So, who wants pie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! How could this be?! It was supposed to work this time! Don't you have anything to say?!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Results may vary?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (giving Candace a hose) Hold this, please.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: How's it going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perfect! Everything is— (gets squirted) Guess we're back on the clock.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Splishy-splashy! (giggles)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Woo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Haha, gravity. Hm, I wonder if there's any way around that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, right now we're just thinking about defying gravity.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Please, even you can't change the law of gravity. It's a universal law, like "You can't wear white after Labor Day".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An absolute law without a hope of appeal? That's despotism! Somebody oughta- Hey, that's it! I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, I didn't see him there.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl...

Name: Carl
Dialog: One minute, sir! Just finishing my status update. "Carl's interning like there's no tomorrow!" Done.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I just completed your intern evaluation report. You've earned a gold star in every category except one. You need to show more initiative.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I've never gotten less than a gold star in my whole interning life.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I do have 24 hours before I have to submit my evaluation. Prove that you can show initiative and that gold star is yours.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'll start right now by triple-checking the chattosphere for suspicious activities.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Nice job on the blueprint for our Anti-Gravity Fun Launcher. I just posted it on our website so Baljeet can check the math. (phone rings) Hey, Baljeet, that was fast.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your blueprints are 97% accurate. But you accidentally placed a cosine where you needed a quadratic differential! (laughs) Not to worry. I fixed it. I will send an attachment.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There's absolutely nothing going on today.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Have you finished that puzzle yet?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I lost the stupid box lid. Now I can't figure out how to solve it.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Then you could finish building me a bride out of icicle-pop sticks like you promised.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'd like to help you out, Norm. Really. But look at my tongue. (his tongue is blue) See? Look at that. My doctor said no more blue raspberry icicle-pops until the blue dye flushes completely out of my system.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Why must I be alone?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't know. Why are raspberry icicle-pops blue? (Norm kisses the icicle-pop stick bride) And I know what you are doing, Norm! You're a sick, sick robot! I need a really evil scheme. But-- Oh, it's so hard to create when I'm in one of my moods. (uses computer) Maybe I can borrow someone else's plans from the Internet. (types; sees blueprints) Blueprints, and...search. Ooh, an Anti-Gravity Fun Launcher! How about the Anti-Gravity Evil Launch-inator? There. I changed the name, that makes it mine. This could be the greatest scheme ever!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gasps) Doofenshmirtz just downloaded a blueprint. (reads the blueprint) "Anti-gravity fun launcher"? Sounds fishy. Let's run it through the anagram decoder. (sees the words "Evil Fanatic Hunt R Raygun" on the screen; gasps) Major Monogram!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You don't have to yell. I'm right here.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz just downloaded these plans for an anti-gravity fun launcher. But when I run that through the anagram decoder, the letters form "Evil Fanatic Hunt R Raygun".

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Looks like you're missing an E.

Name: Carl
Dialog: They're probably just trying to mislead us. Let's check the source. (looks at the Flynn-Fletcher file) Agent P's owners! They must be in league with Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't know, Carl. Sounds a little far-fetched.

Name: Carl
Dialog: But wait, listen to this. It's a seemingly innocent voice recording of Phineas. (plays the voice recording)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voice recording) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Carl
Dialog: But if we play all those syllables backwards in a random order, we get...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voice recording) Let's help Doofenshmirtz d-destroy the Tri-State Area.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Keep a close eye on those boys. See what else you can find out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we need you to track down a missing agent. Code name

Name: Carl
Dialog: So, who is Agent G again?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Garry the Gander? Oh, that's just a wild-goose chase. Get it? Goose, gander? Heh. Uh, we had to distract Agent P because he's too close to Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Then who will investigate the boys?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hm, we need to send someone in undercover. All the agents are out on their missions. (upbeat theme plays)

Name: Carl
Dialog: (squeals)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, Agent Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You can count on me, sir.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Now where's Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, guys, chop-chop. Time to prove Sir Isaac Newton wrong.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I've reached the target. Over.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Roger that, Carl. Now observe, then infiltrate.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who's that, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, kid. You wanna help?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Phineas) Me? Sure. (to Monogram) Sir, I've made contact.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, thanks. What's your name?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh... (thinking) Say a cool name like Nitro, Dax or Steel. (to Phineas) My name is Carl. (groans)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice to meet you, Carl. Come and join us in the fun.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Monogram) Sir, I've gained their trust. (to Phineas) So, what kind of scheme is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just having fun challenging universal laws.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Baljeet) So, I hear you're the math genius behind this operation.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, no, no, no. Phineas and Ferb's blueprint was already brilliant. I just made a minor modification.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Interesting. (to Ferb) So, Ferb, you don't talk much, do you?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, I--

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, what's that over there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice job, everyone. It came out perfectly. Who wants to go first?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think our guest should go first.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Ah, uh, me? (muttering; walks into the Anti Gravity Fun-Launcher)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, let's see what we can do about that pesky gravitational pull.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gets hit with Anti Gravity) Ah! What's happening?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry. It only lasts fifteen minutes. Looks fun though, doesn't it? Let's all go.

Name: Isabella, Baljeet, Carl, and Phineas
Dialog: (cheering and laughing)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Coming through.

Name: Carl
Dialog: So, what exactly is the evil purpose in all of this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Evil? This is just for fun.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hey, guys, wait for me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb floating in midair? Ooh, they are so busted this time. I've gotta find Mom.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (on Carl's watch) Carl, status update. Over.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I can't. (Ferb ties him up and he floats into midair and screams)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? Carl! Oh, no, they must be torturing that poor kid. Don't worry, little unpaid intern, help is on the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for bringing this down for me, Norm. For some reason, it runs on solar power.

Name: Police
Dialog: How many times do I have to tell you

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, uh, it's not a vehicle. It's an evil device. You see, this is what I do for a living. (gets a ticket; changes to a shocked face)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, don't! Oh!

Name: All
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Man #1
Dialog: Gary ze Gander? I know nothing! (sees Perry come over to fight; speaks in foreign language)

Name: All
Dialog: (cheering and laughing)

Name: Carl
Dialog: That was so much fun. Remember when Isabella--?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (clears his throat)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who's that?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, hello, son.

Name: Phineas, Ferb, Baljeet, and Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Carl's dad!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, children. Carl, uh, your mother and I were worried when you didn't come home. Uh, are you in trouble?

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, Maj-- Er, Dad. I was just playing with my new friends. Sir, situation neutralized.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Abort mission. (over radio) I repeat, abort mission.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, uh, ahem, son, it's time to go home-- and...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Aw, come on, Dad, can't I just stay for five more minutes?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, no, we have to go. Your, uh, mom is making dinner.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See you later, Carl. It was a lot of fun. Nice kid. Last one in has to clean up.

Name: All
Dialog: (cheering)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stop! (panting) Hm. That's an interesting shape. It looks famil-- (steps on a soda can) Aah! (sighs; sees the "Anti-Gravity Fun-Launcher / Anti-Gravity Evil-Launch-Inator) Wait. An anti-gravity evil launch-inator. I found another one. Heh. What are the odds? (turns on his phone) Norm, get down here. I need help.

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Our next guest is a covert secret agent. We've pixilated his face to conceal his identity. (to Perry) Now, I understand that you're searching for a long-lost colleague. (sees Perry's picture) Oh, you brought a picture. Now, viewers, if you see this agent, call in immediately.

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Well, I guess he found him. Hey, buddy, you forgot your pixilation!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, you're spectacular. I never knew you could do that.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Did you know I could also do this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? Wow. I should really read your instruction book.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes, yes you should.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (drives into the Norm Truck)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the car with Linda) It's about thirty feet tall with electrodes and stuff!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Mm-hm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You'll see, I'll just open the gate, and you'll -- (opens the gate) Eek! It's gone!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) That's a shocker.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) Norm, you've really outdone yourself today.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Does this mean--?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, you'll have your icicle-pop stick bride.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Police officer
Dialog: You got a license to drive a robot with more than two axles?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, um, uh...

Name: Police officer
Dialog: That's what I thought. Okay, Charley, pull her up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, motor vehicle code! (he gets towed away)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm very proud of you, Carl. But my feelings for you can be better expressed in your evaluation.

Name: Carl
Dialog: All gold stars!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Agent P. Sorry about the wild-goose chase. You were just too close to this case. But don't feel bad. No one could ever find Agent G. He's been missing for far, far too long. (Perry pulls out Agent G) What the--? Agent G. On an extremely extended vacation, hm? Well, Agent P deserves a vacation more than you do. He deserves one, but unfortunately, evil never rests. So, we'll see you tomorrow. Well, this is getting a little awkward. Carl, my arm's getting tired and he won't salute back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, here's the doo-hickey that fuses with your spinal cord.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey guys. What'cha doooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Today, we're gonna fuse our nervous systems with Dad's laptop and surf the web using only our cerebral cortexes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow! Surely that would be quite an exciting project.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey Baljeet. Why are you dressed like a vegetable samosa?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because today is the Tri-State Area Unification Day! I learned all about it in Assimilation class. You see, the Tri-State Area was the bi-state area until our founder, the great John P. Tristate, uttered the immortal words

Name: John P. Tristate
Dialog: The, uh, bi-state area should be united with that adjacent area right over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But we knew that. I was just wondering why you're dressed like a vegetable samosa.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, that. My Uncle Kamal is doing an exotic cuisine float in the parade, and I'm the...

Name: Phineas and Baljeet
Dialog: Vegetable samosa!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I thought I was supposed to be the vegetable samosa!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why can we not both be vegetable samosas?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, sure, two vegetable samosas! Why don't we all just dress like vegetable samosas? In fact, why don't we just all dress like mashed potatoes and take the word exotic right off the sign?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, wait!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, man. It's over! I'm gonna go find another nerd!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But what about the Tri-State Area Unification Day parade?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? Is that what this parade is for?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Does no one know what today is?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, excuse me, but that adjacent area was founded by my great-uncle Otto H. Adjacent! He didn't wanna be no part of no Tri-State Area unification, and neither do I! The blood of Otto H. Adjacent runs through these veins, and blood is thicker than water! (leaves)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, mango chutney is thicker than blood.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Yelling) You're dead to me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) Parade? I love parades. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today instead! We're gonna... Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. Well, let's get down to brass tacks... (reading his clipboard) What's this? "Happy passive-agressive relationship day"? Oh, is that today?

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's okay, you probably weren't gonna get me anything, anyway.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Weel, I completely forgot.

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, no, you know I didn't even want a present.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Anyway... Where were we? For some reason Doofenshmirtz has purchased a tow truck. Which isn't evil in itself, but he may be planning on towing something evil, so, check it out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Are you ready for our girl's day out?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just a sec mom! (She goes outside) Aha! Wait a minute. Are you guys just out here arranging kiddie wagons?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: At the moment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm, carry on. (Candace gets into the car with Linda) All clear, luckily the boys aren't up to anything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A little to the left. There you go.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you have to promise me that you won't obsess about Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, sure Mom, I promise.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't just promise this time. Rise your right hand. Do you Candace Gertrude Flynn, solemnly swear not to obsess about your brothers, or you'll suffer the pharaoh's curse?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The pharaoh's curse?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes or No?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, yes.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, now we can ave fun.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? (Doofenshmmirtz activates a trap, trapping perry in a door) Hahaha! You like that? I call it my "Indoors-inator". I got the idea from the Perry-shaped hole you left in my wall, and in my bathroom door, a-and in my fridge. Man you were hungry that day. Anyway, here's my evil plan. (He reveals his new -inatr) Ta-da! I'm calling it the "Duplic-8-inator". Get it? Duplic-, then the number "8", then -inator. I'll bet you're wondering what it does, huh? Here I'll show you.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe you started a monkey basketball team, and you've only got one monkey.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: Oh great, now three of them are going to have to sit on the bench.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? It duplicates everything eight times. When I zap those streets there will be eight time the traffic, and Danville will come to a standstill! That's where I will make off like a bandit. You see I bought this tow-truck off the internet, I'm going to call it the "Tow-inator" or something. And open a service, and then I'll go and... 'Course it'll be hard for me to drive anywhere, with all that traffic. T-that's a bridge I'll cross when I get there.

Name: Nerd
Dialog: (From atop a building) I've never been bullied into stopping a parade before. What should I do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Sighing) I don't know if this is working out. Can you talk in a Indian accent?

Name: Nerd
Dialog: Indian accent? No. I can do an English accent, instead! (Speaking with an English accent) Hello gov'! Top of the mornin', toodle pip! Last night Mr. Governor, my toilet was broken in two.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (He sighs) Actually that was pretty good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, let's show everybody what Tri-State unification is all about. Cue Love Händel!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, water hazard ahead. Commence operation

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ahh, nugget!

Name: Nerd
Dialog: (Speaking with an Italian accent) That's a too bad. Maybe you should a dress like a policeman and a re-reoute a the parade.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (After a slight pause) If that wasn't such a good idea, I'd flatten you.

Name: Nerd
Dialog: Momma mia. That was a close.

Name: Linda
Dialog: See Candace? Isn't this nice just to get away and enjoy a day together?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're right Mom, this is the best. I'm not even going to think about– Mm, you know. I'm not even going to say their names.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's the spirit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just going to sit here and enjoy, Ooh, the parade coming by. Haha, look at that kid in the cute little car. (She notices that the kid is Phineas) Gah! (Candace slaps both hands over her mouth) Mom! Ah! What am I doing? I am blocking my view. What my brothers do doesn't affect me. Letting it go for just one day. (She takes a breath) Nails. Happy relaxing fun.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You say something, honey?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now they're headin' for the junkyard. Removes gravitational pull, it'll be impossible to escape. Am I thinkin' of a junkyard, or something else?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb treacherous terrain coming up. Execute operation

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Watching) AHHHH! Otto H. Adjacent will be avenged!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, which button was it? Because one of these buttons just makes it fire will-nilly all over the place. And, I don't want to hit that one by mistake. (Perry uses his tail to knock on the door that is holding him) Oop, someone's at the door. I'll be right there. Oh excuse me Perry the Platypus, what can I do- (He opens the door, freeing Perry, who punches Doofenshmirtz into the Dupic-8-inator, setting it off) Oh see there, that's, that's the willy-nilly button. (Perry dives at Doofenshmirtz, while the -inator fires off randomly)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, this place is so fancy-shmancy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I just hope it isn't too noisy with that silly parade going on outside.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Believe me, I'm trying to tune it out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what looks good to you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Blocking her view of the parade with her menu) Remember the pharaoh's curse. Wait! It doesn't count if she sees them herself! Hey mom, I bet you can't turn your head 180 degrees like an owl.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Turning her head) Nope, just ninety.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, can you show me that twisty yoga move you do again?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Maybe after lunch, dear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm curious what the back of you chair looks like, can you turn around and show me?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace, what's up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Why can't you just turn around!!??

Name: Linda
Dialog: (turning, just as Phineas and Ferb's floats leave) Okay you want me to turn around? I'm turning around. Can we just eat lunch now?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pauses) Fine...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (From atop a building, overlook the parade) If that parade makes it to the end, my hopes for the Adjacent Area secession are through. I gotta stop it.

Name: Nerd
Dialog: (Speaking with a German accent) What is your next plan? I know it is going to be something clever!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's it! The other accents were amusing, but that one's just offensive. (He hops onto one of the passing floats)

Name: Nerd
Dialog: (Still speaking with the accent) Wait! What about me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm firin' you as my nerd.

Name: Nerd
Dialog: Das ist nicht gut. (This is not good.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's weird that our floats are floating away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, well, they are called "floats".

Name: Buford
Dialog: (From atop one of the floating floats) What the–? (He unties a singular balloon, that pulls him away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A platypus balloon? (The balloon passes by a billboard with a man wearing a fedora, and the balloon picks the hat up.) A Perry the Platypus balloon?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace I'm having a great time with you today. See how relaxing to os when you're not abscessing about your brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't take it anymore!! Mom, I really tried to my best to give you a day, but it's...the boys. The boys! They're in the parade! With giant floats! So come on, you've gotta bust them. (Grabs her and runs off)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Still floating on the balloon, and seeing the Tri-State area) Wow, it's all just one, big place. No Bi-State area. No Adjacent Area, It's all just one big Tri-State Area, right over there! (The string he was holding onto rips off the balloon, opening a hole on the balloon) Mamma!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know this balloon is actually– (He is cut off, as the balloon flutters about wildly) AHH! Curse you Perry the Platypus Balloon!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Seeing Buford fall) Oh no! Buford is in trouble! I must do something! (He goes to a man selling balloons) Please, my bully is in trouble, let go of all of your balloons.

Name: Balloon Man
Dialog: Yeah, okay. (He releases all of his balloons)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Balloon Man
Dialog: No, thank you, vegetable samosa.

Name: Fighter jet Pilot
Dialog: Uh, did you guys see that? Let's investigate.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What we really need is a grand finale, so spectacular, that people will always remember Tri-State Area Unification Day.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey what's that?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Coming down from his balloon, then releasing them) Happy...Tri-State...Unification...Day! Woo-Yeah!

Name: Fighter jet Pilot
Dialog: Yeah, just some Unification Day Parade stunt.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That'll do it. Hey Buford great finale.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, it was really, really nice.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nice? Ah, now I gotta go do some'in' to balance out the universe. See ya' on the news. (He walks off)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, wait, no Buford. No. No. No. Please don't. (A red liquid splashes Phineas, Ferb and Isabella) I was going to eat those jelly doughnuts.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Missed ya' Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Right back at ya' buddy.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: An thus the universe is balanced.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Behold, Phineas and Ferb have taken over the parade!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi mom!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hi Phineas and Ferb's mom. Say Cheese! (He takes a picture)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, how adorable!

Name: Pharaoh
Dialog: Excuse me. Are you Candace Gertrude Flynn?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pauses) Yes.

Name: Pharaoh
Dialog: Curse you. (He walks off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I tried to warn you, honey.

Name: Man's voice
Dialog: Last night's meteor may not have been as innocent as we thought...

Name: Man
Dialog: ...look what happened to Dr. Zachary!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (High-fives Ferb) Cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now what? (Walks into the living room) Alright, what are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Watching the Invasion of the Human Overlords marathon. They're playing all five movies tonight!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that all? Pfft. Well enjoy your lame, colorless marathon. I'm heading back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, who's that?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's Dr. Abernathy. He's a scientist!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's kind of hunky for a 50s guy.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Don't worry. I'll you keep safe.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Thanks, doctor, but please call me Amanda.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Alright... Amanda.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sold! (Quickly sits on the couch) Get me up to speed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The aliens are replacing the heads of all the humans with their own shape-shifting, multi-eyed heads, which can then assume the form of the host human.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get out, and then...?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Once they replace more than 51% of all the humans, they can assume control the earth for their own nefarious purposes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Shut up! And...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way! Is there no way to stop them?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If only you can catch them if they're in their human state. That's when they're at their weakest.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then how you can tell if they're aliens?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's three kinds of ways to spot an alien. First, they have strange vocal patterns. They don't get human linguistics.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Pass me that frie-bop, please.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: You mean this hammer?

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Oh, yes, hammer. Frie-bop is what we call it in Ohio... where I'm from.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What else?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're anatomically disproportionate.

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Now I need the sprigle-kronk.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: The what?

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Never mind. I'll get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But the clear sign is that they can safely remove any human head, and replace it with their own multi-eyed, shape shifting head.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah. I guess that will give it away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pointing to the TV) Like this.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: Doctor? What's wrong. Are you alright?

Name: "Dr. Abernathy"
Dialog: Yes, Amanda. I'm fine. We're all fine, and soon you will be too!

Name: Amanda
Dialog: NOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!

Name: Alien
Dialog: Sorry, Amanda, but we've waited long enough.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: NOOOO!!! (her head is in a jar) This can't be! What's happening?

Name: The real Dr. Abernathy
Dialog: I tried to warn you.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: Doctor, your head is attached! You're human again!

Name: Dr. Abernathy
Dialog: Yes, and once Dr. Zachary returns from heading into those dark, ominous woods alone, with his not fully charged flashlight, you will be too... Amanda.

Name: Amanda
Dialog: But it was all right here! Oh, why did I think anyone would believe me? I was a fool! (sobs) A fool...!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, you guys. That was awesome. Guys? Uh, guys? Wow, it's tomorrow already. I gotta find those guys and tell them how it ended. ... Guys, guys, guys, ugh--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Mom. Have you seen the boys?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, I think they're upstairs. Can you do me a favor and take the laundry up? I'm late for an appointment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks, hon. I'll be back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Holding up a t-shirt) Oh, how cute. Ferb's torso is so tiny. (Upstairs; at Ferb) Oh, there you are. You know, that movie was so...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (shouting indistinctly over computer)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oops, sorry. I'll just put these in your room.<

Name: Ferb's cousin
Dialog: (Scottish accent) Oh, I wish you were there, Ferb.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: So do I. Tell Uncle Angus and Aunt Mora thanks for the candy.

Name: Ferb's cousin
Dialog: Too right. Scotland out. Peace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Phineas. Oh, my gosh, you missed it. By the end everyone got their heads back and everything went back to normal. Well, sort of. The entire laboratory disappeared. But I loved it. I can't look at anything the same way ever again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool, glad you liked it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I-- I almost forgot the coolest part. (In the backyard) Hey, guys. Guys. You're never gonna believe this. At the end, they-- (ominous theme playing) (gasps) Ferb? (sees what looks like Ferb removing his head, she screams and runs to the panic room) Oh, my gosh. Ferb's an alien. Whoa, whoa, whoa. Hang on a second. I'm sure there's a perfectly good reason Ferb can remove his head. I mean, it's not like he had any of the other telltale signs, is it? Oh, no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Strange vocal patterns...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Holding up a t-shirt) Oh, how cute. Ferb's torso is so tiny.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anatomically disproportionate... (gasps) THEY GOT TO FERRRRRB!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Phineas! I-- I know you're gonna think I've completely lost it, but I'm pretty sure that Ferb is an alien. I've got to find his head and re-attach it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My brother's an alien? How cool is that? But I think you may be letting your imagination get the best of you, sis.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, a non-believer, huh? Well, you know what? I'm gonna get proof. You'll see. Ferb's an alien!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about the distraction, Agent P. The ladies are helping to, uh, (reading from a card) "net-roy-er the lair."

Name: Carl
Dialog: Tré biens, Monsieur Monogram. Trés bien.

Name: Maids
Dialog: Bonjour, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Bonjour, Madame.

Name: Maids
Dialog: (giggles)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So we're having a bit of a cleanup here, which coincidentally is what Doofenshmirtz seem to be having as well. He's put some old "-inators" up for sale on an evil auction site. If one of those devices were to fall into the wrong hands, it could be catast—Could—Could you please wait for me to finish, Mimi?

Name: Fifi
Dialog: Non "Mimi." Fifi.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oui, Fifi. (at himself) Oh, now I've lost my train of thought. (at Perry) Anyway, get out to Doof's place and put a stop to it. (at Carl) How much is this costing us, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Une petite fortune.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: "Petite." That means small, right? Well done, Carl.

Name: Maids
Dialog: (giggling)

Name: (Song
Dialog: "You're Not Ferb)"

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (opens the door) Oh, hello. You must be here about the ad, right? Well, come on in. It's right over here. (closes the door; dramatic music) Behold the Wrapped-Up-in-a-Nice-Little-Bow-Inator. (Perry, disguised as an evil scientist, blinks) I bet you're wondering what it does, huh? Well, let's say your nemesis is arriving sooner than expected and- And your place is a complete mess. (camera pans to a messy "bedroom") Tidying up is a snap (snaps fingers) with the press of this large, red button. (pushes aforesaid button) See? Wrapped up in a nice little bow. (close up of a box tied up with a red ribbon) You can also use it to hang your clothes on. (hangs one of his lab coats on the Inator) Just like a treadmill. (camera quickly pans to a treadmill with clothes hanging on it) So although my ad said firm, I am flexible, so make me an offer. (Perry blinks twice; Doofenshmirtz rubs a hand behind his head) Wow, you're a good negotiator. Okay, half price. (camera pans to a baseball bat and a container of baseballs) And I'll throw in my Druselstein minor-league baseball collection.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? (grabs the baseball bat) Well, it's a good thing I still have my Druselstein minor-league bat. (Perry goes into a defensive position) Have at you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggling) Well, Phineas, what do you think? Wait. Before you say anything, look at these photos. I stalked "Ferb" all day. (shows Phineas some photos) See? Proof positive. Ferb...is an ALIEN.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, well—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, no, just wait till you see. Here, here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here, here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here and here. And listen to this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine. Here, here, wait, what about this hideous ball of goo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Listen, Candace, as cool as it would be for Ferb to be an alien, that's sadly not the case. Here, follow me and I'll show you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, show me what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, old pal, our dear sister here thinks you may be a sinister extraterrestrial visitor.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I saw Ferb's head ripped off by a hideous alien monster.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you must mean this reverse power coupling unit we're repairing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Reverse power coupling unit?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. That's all it was. Ferb's no more alien than you or me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—But what about all this evidence I've been collecting?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, even though Ferb's not an alien, we are fixing a spacecraft for a friend of Meap's.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just finished and we're about to launch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb, you're not an alien!...uh, you're about to launch? You guys are so busted, I'm getting Mom!

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: (poking an uncooked chicken) Go. Go. You're free, little skin bird.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (quietly) Mom?

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: Oh! Candace, you scared the bejabbers out of me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, I've got something to show you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the backyard)Seriously, Mom, I've waited for this moment a long time. (to Phineas and Ferb) All right, you two, let's get this show on the road!

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: Yes.

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: You two have done a great job repairing my ship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So busted! Ha -- (stops dancing) Huh? Your ship?

Name: Meap's friend
Dialog: (speaks in alien dialect)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, Garbog. I hope you finished your study on the habits of the human female parental unit.

Name: Garbog
Dialog: (speaks in alien dialect)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I -- I -- (sobbing)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (When Doofenshmirtz grows too much, he pushes his inator away. Perry then jumps onto it and escapes.)Curse you, Perry the Plat- (he groans, then spits out a chair) Why did I ever order such a large bedroom set?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Wow, you know, it's quite a bit roomier in here than you'd think.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mother? Is that you? I mean, really you?

Name: The real Linda
Dialog: Candace, I don't have time right now. I have frozens.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep. That's you. (pushes her) Come on, Mom, quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice design on that rocket gantry, by the way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And it folds up for easy storage. Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Please, please, please, please be there...!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) And I'm seeing...the backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: NOOOOOO!!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sobs) But it was all right here! Oh, why did I think anyone would believe me? I was a fool! (sobs again) A fool...!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Mom! You're nobody unless you're somebody in Glosstacular lipstick!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right, Candace. At least let me stop the car.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm nobody unless I'm somebody! I'm nobody unless I'm somebody!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I want you boys to pick out some nice back-to-school clothes. (Phineas, Ferb, and Linda enters the store, and presently walk back out) Wow, that was fast.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we do have a signature look. (Phineas sheepishly grins as they have the opposite clothes) Although Perry's mixing it up a bit.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cute. Okay, here's some quarters for the arcade. I'm gonna see what's keeping your sister.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. See you later, Mom. With this many quarters we can play seventy-two straight hours of– Hey, check it out. This was my favorite ride when I was little.

Name: Repairman
Dialog: Better enjoy it while you can, boys. These old fellows are pretty worn out. I'll be back in a little while to haul them away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What a shame. I wonder if they're still as much fun as they used to be.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, in retrospect, I may have over-romanticized those memories. But I'll bet with a little effort and some unstable uranium isotopes, we could make them that much fun. Ferb, I know what we're gonna– Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (playing a DDR-equse game with Baljeet as Perry walks past) Oh, get with the beat. You're messing up my score.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, are you sure I don't have any more clean uniforms?

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's the last one, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I mean, seriously. I'm growing mushrooms under here. (He sniffs himself) I don't smell too bad, do I?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I can't smell a thing.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that's a relief. I thought maybe I was–

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, I can't smell a thing, sir, I have no sense of smell.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Really?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I was born without nostrils, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I thought you were joking about that on your resume. (Perry arrives) Ah, Agent P. Uh, just give me a few seconds. (Major Monogram transfers to the screen of the video game cabinet) Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up every can of aerosol deodorant in the Tri-State Area. And I'm starting to smell like a science-fiction convention. We need you to find out what he's doing with all those aerosol spray cans and put a stop to it. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I just called in a to-go order for Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: Hey, Vic? You got an order for Doofyberg?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, "Doofenshmirtz." Heinz Doofenshmirtz. Surely you've heard of me.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: Okay, order for Hans Doofensmit. Is that right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, "Doofenshmirtz." Doofen-- My brother is the mayor.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: Roger Doofenshmirtz is your brother?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: And your name is?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heinz Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: Do we have an order for a Hans Doofenblatz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (growls in anger) Mark my words. You will remember the name of Heinz Doofenshmirtz. Hm! (He walks out of the diner, but soon pops his head back in) Could I still get my whole wheat on rye?

Name: Waitress
Dialog: Sure, what's your name?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All done.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Isabella.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, losers.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, guys.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't tell me you're playing with that lame kiddie ride.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've tricked it out, and now it's pretty awesome.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll be the judge of that, step aside. This better be worth a quarter. (Sarcastically, as the ride shakes back and forth) Ooh. This is so exciting. Let me catch my breath.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What is not to like? It has what every kid loves

Name: Phineas
Dialog: May I suggest pressing that red button?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ooh, can I? (He presses the red button, and the ride sprouts a rocket engine and takes off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what do you think?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Screaming) I got it. Woo-hoo! This is awesome!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. How predictable. And by "predictable," I mean completely...dictable, I guess. Anyway...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, don't bother trying to escape. The walls are made of a super-slick alloy and treated with a few dozen coats of non-stick cooking spray. I'm sure you've noticed my impressive collection of aerosol spray cans. Every can of aerosol deodorant, hair spray and bug repellent from the Tri-State area. All mine. I'm tapping into their ozone-depleting propellants to fuel my latest evil scheme

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, Glosstaculick! Now I can blow up a bounce house and my lips would still be shiny! (She starts to put on lipstick, but Buford zips past her, ruining it; now in busting mode) I bet Phineas and Ferb are behind this...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, that was fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks up to them) I've got you this time! And to make sure this doesn't disappear, I'm going to sit here on the evidence 'till Mom comes back!

Name: Buford
Dialog: This is gonna be worth a quarter.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Help me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang on, Candace, we're right behind you. Good thing we tricked out the other rides. Come on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang on, Candace! We're coming!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nuts. Lost her in the skyline. Isabella, we need you to get us an aerial view.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure, Phineas. Whee!

Name: Farmer
Dialog: Well, what do you know? Nostradamus was right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, she just flew through a barn and her lips are still shiny.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my friends. It appears that I am out of fuel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, Baljeet. (On radio) Just put in another quarter.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But all I have is a dollar. (He notices that the machine takes bills) Oh. What do you know. (He tries several times to get the ride to take his dollar, but the machine won't) Hm. Oh, come on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, water. It's like drinking wet air. Now, Perry the Platypus, sit back and listen as the entire Tri-State Area screams the name Heinz Doofenshmirtz and never forgets it again! (Two aerosol cans fall into Perry's trap, and he uses them to propel his way out) Hold it right there, Perry the Platypus. (Doofenshmirtz tries to crush Perry with his giant mechanical hand, but Perry dodge it) Agh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh. (She screams) Phineas, help, I'm falling!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just put in another quarter.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't have another quarter! (continues screaming)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He laughs) Hey, nice move, Perry the Platypus, I got to "hand" it to you. Here, let me give you a "hand." Hey, hey. I'm gonna crush you with my big mechanical "hand." Ha! Well, I– I guess that one was just literal, but I've got you now.  (Candace bursts through Doofenshmirtz's lair, cutting off the giant hand) Wow. Nostradamus was right! (Perry uses the giant hand to smack Doofenshmirtz into the trap he was previously in) Ow! You know, I don't come to your house and– Wait, these don't have any chlorofluorocarbons in them at all. These aerosol cans are completely harmless! Wh-what was I thinking!? Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, I got her. Yee-haw!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good work, everybody. Let's bring it on back to the store.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At the store) (To Candace) Well, it looks like you made it back in one piece.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are gonna be so busted when I show Mom what you did to those rides.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Repairman
Dialog: All right, one side, kids. We're replacing these old rides with brand-new identical ones. With special emphasis on the identical. See you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye, now. Well, that was fun. Maybe tomorrow we can supe up our old bikes.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Lame.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's what you said about the kiddie rides.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I was right, until I wasn't.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking fast) Here it is, Mom, I'll show you! If you'll give me a quarter, please? (She sits in the ride)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Aren't you a little old for kiddie rides?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, I'm not! Check it out! (puts quarter in ride)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (dryly) Well...I guess it does have rocking back-and-forth and slowness?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (After ironing his dollar bill) Okay, dollar, this is your last chance. (The ironing table goes off; Baljeet kicks ride in frustration, the ride goes off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! We're going to the Space Adventure film festival! It's gonna be awe-soooooommmme!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can do better than that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls, grunts) (hears Phineas continuing the music)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wears headphones that make music)

Name: Irving
Dialog: (from inside) According to my motion sensors, (cuts to him in his room at his computer, banging is heard outside) Phineas and Ferb are awake!

Name: Albert
Dialog: (bangs down Irving's door) What did you lock your door for, Ir-ving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: To keep you out, Al-bert!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Older brothers should have 24-hour access to younger brothers' rooms. It's a good thing I used an old secret military technique I taught myself. (walks over to the computer) Who are those dorks?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb are not dorks; They are the coolest exponents of awesome stupefaction in the universe!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Yeah. Just because you put it on... (Close up on the computer, it reads "Phineas and Ferb FANSITE") your fansite doesn't mean it's true. (Back to them) And could we talk about all these pictures?

Name: Irving
Dialog: What? Too obsessive.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Well, there is that, but I'm just saying your composition stinks. (looks at a picture) I can't even tell what this is a picture of.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (walks up) A solar-powered flock of mechanical hummingbirds. Phineas and Ferb built them.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Yeah, right. That's a hoax!

Name: Irving
Dialog: How dare you! (walks to another picture) I suppose this cold-fusion powered merry-go-round they built was a hoax, too!

Name: Albert
Dialog: I can tell a fake a mile away, little brother. They call me

Name: Irving
Dialog: It's NOT fake!! Phineas and Ferb really build these things! A-A-And I'll prove it to you!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Well, I have important older-brothery things to do right now. But if you give me the address, I'll meet you there at noon.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. I've instituted a new short-order message technique. Listen carefully. (rings the bell) Doof is up, put a stop, curses on the side. Well, let's go, Agent P. My orders are backing up. Adam and Eve on a raft, rack em'.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Is that a mission, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, it's my lunch.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (walks up) Hello, boys. Are you ready for your space thrills marathon?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, it's called Space Adventure. It's an adventure in space.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hmm... (calling out) Phineas?! Ferb?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) They went to the movies.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No Phineas and Ferb today.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What am I gonna do?! Albert goes back to boarding school tomorrow! He'll think I'm a liar!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have an idea. (Wipe to him later on) Phineas and Ferb made me this 3D projector. I can project one of their projects right into the yard here. Your brother will think they just built it.

Name: Irving
Dialog: And it wouldn't be lying because they did actually did build it. What have you got?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, let us see. (transitions to Eiffel Tower) Oh, this is from the time Phineas and Ferb built a full-scale replica of the Eiffel Tower. I will hide the projector in the bushes.

Name: Irving
Dialog: But look. Albert is impossible to fool. They call him "The Truth Detector".

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know, I'm convinced.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Uh-oh, and he's supposed to meet Phineas and Ferb too.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Too bad we are not Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (gasps) I've got a crazy idea. Time for a makeover.

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: (squeal)

Name: Buford
Dialog: A manly one, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Full steam ahead. Chugga-chugga, chugga-chugga, whoo hoo! Oh, hey, there. Is that the Doofenshmirtz choo-choo? No, it's not! You will all be late for your jobs and be fired. (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus. Hello. Have you come to see my new hobby? Scale model reproductions of actual railroads, train depots... look, even scale model litter. Shameful. My father bought one for me when I was just a little evil, but you know, he wouldn't let me play with it.

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Father, may I play with my trains now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz's father
Dialog: Nein!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now that I'm old enough to buy my own, I'm disappointed by the shabby quality of the cheap model reproductions. Which is why I'm going to travel the globe and shrink the world's greatest architectural treasures. (breaks out of Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated) Just to put them in my train set, see? The Shrink-inator ray is for the shrinking, the cardboard box is for holding the shrunken treasures, and the bicarbonate of soda is for my motion sickness. First stop

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah, we are ready.

Name: Irving
Dialog: WHAT?! No! No no no, you can't BOTH be Phineas!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is what I told him, but he would not listen.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Phineas gets all the lines!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Irving, are you here?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (gasps) He's here! Quick, put these on.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Irving! Irving, I thought you were pulling my leg, but this is remarkable.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Really, you're buying it?

Name: Albert
Dialog: What?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Nothing.

Name: Albert
Dialog: So, when am I gonna meet this Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, well, what do you know, they are here now.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (as Phineas) Hello, I think you know what we are doing today.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (as Ferb) 'Ello, I'm from England and I don't talk much.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, this is my older brother Albert. Albert, meet Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Hmm. Remember earlier when I accused you of pulling the wool over my eyes? Well, I take it back. It's a real pleasure to meet you boys.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What?

Name: Albert
Dialog: So, tell me about this Eiffel Tower.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (as Phineas) Um, it is big.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And Mexican.

Name: Albert
Dialog: I thought it was French. What do you know. Learn something new every day.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Are you serious?

Name: Albert
Dialog: I would be honored to watch the great Phineas and Ferb at work. Would you mind building something?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (as Phineas) Sure.

Name: Irving
Dialog: No! I mean... I know they would love to. Albert?

Name: Albert
Dialog: Shh, they're working.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi Phineas. Hi... Ferb? Okay, what'cha doin'?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (whispers to Isabella)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, okay. What'cha doin'?

Name: Albert
Dialog: They're building something live. In person.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (as Phineas) Nice.

Name: Albert
Dialog: The simplicity of the design enhances its innovation.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Really? The simplicity of the design? Okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: First stop on our shopping spree. You know, I've always dug the Sphinx. I mean, what is it? A man? A cat? A cat-man? It doesn't matter. And gotcha. Now I switch on my Shrink-inator ray and... it's mine now. There you are. Perfect. Look at-- look at the detail. Well, you know the saying

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooooh, what are those two up to now? (Cuts to her perspective out the window.) Okay, Phineas and Ferb are standing in the yard with two nerds, Isabella, and the Eiffel Tower. (Cut back to her.) That's nothing but trouble! Wait a sec... (She gets out binoculars, cut to her view from them.) Those aren't my brothers. (Zoom in on Buford and Baljeet) What?! Is that Buford and Baljeet?! (Cut back to her, she gets out her phone and dials it.) Oh, I am so calling Mom! (Stops) Hold on. If those aren't my brothers, why am I calling my mom? Why not call Buford and Baljeet's moms? That satisfies the Mom response, and the bust urge! I'll call that dork Irving's mom, too. And what the heck? Why leave my mom out of the party? (She laughs, plays another song on her headphones and dials numbers, humming.) Information, please. (Hums more.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so we have the Great Wall of China, oh, excuse me, I mean the Great Small of China, and the, uh-- The Shrinx (Sphinx), and the Teeny Tower of Pisa (Leaning Tower of Pisa), and the Roman Coliseum-- The Coliseum-- Coli-- I have to think about that one. No matter. Because last but not least, the Taj Ma-Small (Taj Mahal). Ha-ha, oh, that's a good one. Back to the Tri-State Area and let the fun begin.

Name: Albert
Dialog: You guys are amazing. What else can you do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (as Ferb) Um, I can turn my head completely around.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Wow. I wish I was that double-jointed.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Really?

Name: Albert
Dialog: Really. Well, it's been a real pleasure and an honor to meet you guys. Come on, Irving, let's go.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I can't believe we tricked the un-trickable.

Name: Irving
Dialog: I am at a loss for words, dude.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's see, the uh-- the Roman Coliseum. The, uh, No-Man-Can-See-'Em-Because-It's-So-Tiny. No, that's not a good-- (Perry hits him) Ah!

Name: Albert
Dialog: That was really, really amazing.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, really?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Albert That's right.

Name: Irving
Dialog: So your super-senses weren't tingling when, oh, I don't know, Ferb had eyes in his mouth?! Didn't that give you a moment of pause?! A scintilla of doubt?!

Name: Albert
Dialog: What are you talking about?

Name: Irving
Dialog: I can't believe how gullible you are. That wasn't the real Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Well, of course it was. I saw their pictures on your wall.

Name: Irving
Dialog: That was two kids in costume and that Eiffel Tower was a hologram, Mr. "Ta-Ruth Detector".

Name: Albert
Dialog: Sorry, little bro. There was no way that was a hologram.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, yeah? Well, let's go back and I'll show you.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Yeah, let's do that.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What did you think, Isabella? Was I a convincing Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No. No you weren't.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, but totally nailed Ferb.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I almost forgot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, w-w-what are you doing with that? Oh, no, my-my Eiffel Tower! Gotcha. Uh, hey, Perry the Platypus, I saved the Trifle Tower. (Eiffel Tower) No, Perry the Platypus, don't zap it again. It will make it grow. (cries out) Oh, no, I'm shrunk.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think it was my stomach. I told you, I'm starving.

Name: Irving
Dialog: See it and believe it, brother. See-- I can run right through-- (bangs into the tower) it. But it was-- but I had you.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Consider this a lesson learned, Irving.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (cries out)

Name: Albert
Dialog: (drags Irving away) No one pulls the wool over the eyes of The Truth Detector!

Name: Baljeet's mom
Dialog: Hello, Linda.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, ladies.

Name: Baljeet's mom
Dialog: I got a call from Candace...

Name: Buford's mom
Dialog: ...Who said something about our sons and busting!

Name: Irving's mom
Dialog: (Walks up) Are Irving and Albert okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Walking out the front door) Hello, ladies! (Runs up to them, pushes Linda) Come on, come on, moms! (She drags Biffany offscreen, Mrs. Tjinder and Mrs. Du Bois follow.) I can't wait to see the looks on your faces when you see the spectacle that's in the backyard, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, put up your dukes! Wait-- Wait-- what are you doing?! (Perry puts him in his hat.) Hey, this place is nicer than my first apartment.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We're over it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes we are.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, moms! (Enters backyard) A-ha! (Pause, Linda and the other moms come by in the background.) Huh?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace, you built this? Nice to see you're starting to take an interest.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!! No-no-no-no-no, where's the Eiffel Tower? (runs up to them and feels around) Oh, wait. I've seen this, it's invisible! I've just got to find it! (Cuts to a bored Linda and the surprised mothers, she continues offscreen.) It has to be around here somewhere!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) And look! (Runs up) Here are Buford and Baljeet, your sons being bad! (Stretches Ferb's head) They're in disguises! Uh, really good disguises! (Grunts while stretching Phineas' head, chuckles deadpanned) It'll come off in a second.

Name: Baljeet's mom
Dialog: Does this happen often?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (With disdain) Yes, yes it does. Welcome to my world. How about a cup of tea? (She walks offscreen, Lawrence and the moms follow her.)

Name: Buford's mom
Dialog: I hope you got cookies!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Of course, Biffany.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, let me guess, Mr. Goody-Two-Shoes, we're going to return everything I shrank, right? Huh, even the Roman Small-iseum? Hey, look, I finally figured that one out, huh? Ow! Oh, curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggles) Mom, Mom, Mom! (opens car door)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, honey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grabs Linda's arm with eyes closed) Wait til you see what Phineas and Ferb are up to now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs) See?!?...What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Mom, hey Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but but -- !

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) I'm going to go check on my roast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: URRRRRGH! (ties hair into bow) But, but, but, but, but, but, but, but...but...but...but...but...but...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (as he walks by a dismayed Candace) You've inspired me; I'm growing out my bangs.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (as he also walks by) Namaste, compadres.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (untying her hair) Ohhhhh, no matter what I try, I just can't do it! It's impossible!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The impossible is possible! With a little teamwork. That's what the Fireside Girls say.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Teamwork?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure! How do you think I got this mountain-moving patch?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pause) By...mindlessly repeating a flawed busting strategy?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Noooo, through teamwork! See that mountain over there? It used to be over there. With a little teamwork, you can do anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Teamwork. Teamwork! (dials phone) Stacy? I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Thank you for letting me choose today's activity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries, Baljeet.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It is Nerd Awareness Week.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is called "spinning tops."

Name: Buford
Dialog: LAME!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Of DOOM!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright I'll give it a shot.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, everyone! Here is how you play

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So then, what?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: YOU DO IT AGAIN! AH-HA-HA-HA! Ah. It is lame, isn't it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not at all, Baljeet. It just needs a little more oomph.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I was hoping you would say that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anybody notice a distinct lack of egg-laying mammals in the backyard? Baljeet, would you do the honors?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Boy howdy! Aham. Ah...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Where's Perry? Oh, there you are. Didn't uh...see ya...sittin' there. Anyway -- our sources tell us that Doofenshmirtz is up to something and if we're gonna put a stop to it, we'll need a little of that old egg-laying mammalian magic.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (gasp) Why how did -- oh, why that little scamp?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, ladies. I've got a crew, I've got a plan, I wanna bust. Questions? (Stacy raises her hand) Stacy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Do you have this jumpsuit in pink? Cause I'm not really a tangerine kind of gal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (eye twitches) WHY IS EVERYTHING SO DIFFICULT?!? (sobs)

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Maybe if we help her bust her brothers, she'll be done with all this busting stuff for good.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're absolutely right, Jenny. Hey, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I was just kidding about the color, I love orange.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: And I'm all about persimmon. So, what do we do next?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You've heard of Boot Camp? Well, ladies, welcome to Bust Camp!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Mom.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, hurry up with that coffee! I still got that terrible morning taste in my mouth. (smacks lips)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Coming right up, sir! Scalding hot, just the way you -- (trips on rug, spills coffee) Whoopsie daisy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAAAAAHHHH!!! Ow! I know I didn't make you that smart, but you can't even walk straight? (doorbell rings)

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'll get it. (opens door, delivery guy is there) You'll be so delighted when your package arrives in six-to-eight weeks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My new nemesis toy! Go run my bubble bath while I open it. I wonder which one it is. (opens it) Oh, not another platypus. I was hoping for something more like Manny the Mongoose or something. Hey, let's see if it lays eggs. (The "platypus toy" kicks him.) PERRY THE PLATYPUS?!?! Say hello to my little friend! (He pushes a button on his watch, and an inator rolls in.) My new Straitjacket-inator! Ha ha! it was tailor-made just for you by my other little friend. (Whip pan to reveal a small robot.) It may be small, but it's stronger and smarter than Norm and it's so much more efficient.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Listen up, team, I'll be at the front of the house tracking Mom on my GPS device.  (Cut to Stacy and Jenny asleep.) Jenny, (Jenny wakes up.) you'll guard the gate. See to it that Phineas and Ferb stay in the hot zone. Stacy, (Stacy wakes up.) you make sure whatever they built stays there 'til Mom comes home. To achieve that goal, we use the following busting jargon

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The pea is in the pod!

Name: Jenny
Dialog: The condor is in the nest!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Phineas and Ferb have built outer space in our backyard! (Cut to reveal crudely drawn cardboard cutouts of Phineas and Ferb and the "project". Cut back to Candace to reveal "Linda" is just a dummy.) Nice drill, ladies. I'm-a lovin' teamwork!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, nice us's! When did you make those?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wheeling the dummy out) Pay no attention to them, "Mom".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, this new robot of mine is much more evil than Norm. Course, it can't talk, but that can be a good thing. And it even has a convenient blender attachment. (The robot's dome opens and produces a smoothie.) Next, I'm thinking of a platypus purée. (cut to Norm's room) This new model requires so little energy to run it really makes clumsy old Norm quite obsolete. (Norm peaks out from behind the door.)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Now I know I have a heart, because it's breaking.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're ready to go. You sure you don't want one, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Naw, I still say it's lame.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fair enough. Canopies down, everybody.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ready!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (the canopy closes on his fingers) Ah! (he reopens it and closes it properly) Ready.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, bring out the radiant power source.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can't plug the tops in or the cords would get all wrapped up. So we created a power source that will radiate energy across the yard to anything that needs it. (Ferb activates the power source and climbs back into his top.) Okay, everybody, now, the secret to a good top spin, if I can call it that—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha, good one, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This is almost as fun—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (bumps Baljeet) I'm going for my bumper patc— (gets bumped by Ferb)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Code red, busters! The condor is on the wing! I want feet on the ground! It's real this time!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Moving in! (swings down from the top of the tree)

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Rock and roll!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah, still lame. (walks to the power source) Maybe I can liven things up a bit.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What's going on?! Why are they going so fast?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, look at him, he's— He's positively shaking with anticipation at the thought of helping me take over the Tri-State Area. He's— (The robot suddenly begins to transform and grow.) Hoo-hoo-hoo! I-I didn't even know he could do that, whatever it is. Wow! I'm a better evil scientist than I thought!

Name: Robot
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz, your pathetic schemes have all failed! Step aside and let the true master take over!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) He can talk! (gets blasted by the robot) And shoot, too! Ow! Save me! Save me, Perry the Platypus! AAAAAHHH!

Name: Robot
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, my fight is with Doofenshmirtz, not you.  (He flicks Perry off and Perry flings out of the building.)

Name: Major Monogram
