Dialog: Agent P, an unusual power wave has struck the city with potentially disastrous consequences. Forget Doofenshmirtz, find the source of that power wave, and dismantle it.

Name: Robot
Dialog: Prepare to meet your maker, maker! (He powers up his hand and blasts, but misses when Doof trips.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm feeling such an odd mixture of pride and mortal terror.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Mostly terror! Mostly terror!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The condor is in the nest! Let's go, condor!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what is going on?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You'll see! Just wait.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, I'm guessing your brothers are doing something wildly dangerous?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I've got a few seconds to kill before my bladder bursts like a water balloon, so let's get this over with. (walks in the direction of the backyard, but Candace stops her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Teamwork! I mean, we've got to wait for the signal! Any second now.  Come on, girls, give me the code!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Without the headsets, how can we signal Candace?!

Name: Jenny
Dialog: I don't know!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: How can she not hear this racket?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's quite a racket back there. Are you sure you don't want me to take a look?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way! Not until I get the signal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm! Norm, help me, I'm gonna be puréed!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sorry, sir, no can do. I'm bringing coffee to the new boss.

Name: Robot
Dialog: Sounds delicious. Just a moment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAh! I don't want to be a smoothie!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Here you go, sir. Just the way you— ("accidentally" throws the coffee mug) Whoopsie-daisy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, it's lucky for me you tripped on that rug again.

Name: Norm
Dialog: There was no rug, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awww, thank you, Norm. I shouldn't have been so hard on you, but how come you were not affected by that strange energy thingy?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (puts Doof down) Don't you remember? I run on squirrel power! (opens his cavity to reveal a squirrel running on a wheel)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! I should really read your operation manual.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait for the signal. Wait for it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is getting a little uncomfortable. Eject, everybody! (He ejects from his top.)

Name: Jenny
Dialog: I lied about the persimmon.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, Candace, enough's enough!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! (grabs her mother, on her headset) Is the pea in the pod?! Is the pea in the pod??! What's up with the pea?!?! (They finally get into the backyard.) Not again!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, kids. So what was all the big racket back here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were just playing with our tops.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb...were all spinning around and around(?)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And they were running so fast...And it flew away into the clouds!

Name: Jenny and Stacy
Dialog: Giant tops of doom!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) LAME!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You girls are beginning to sound a lot like Candace.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: They were huge!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And suddenly—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, will you two give it up already?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: But you said to wait until she offers pie.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh! Good idea! Who wants pie?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: (raises hand) Me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (raises hand) Me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (raises hand slightly) Me.

Name: Phineas and the Gang
Dialog: Us!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! (He pets Perry and his leg kicks.)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I think we've outdid ourselves today; The ultimate frozen yogurt machine. We have enough frozen yogurt to last the entire summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. (The lizard jumps ahead.) Check that out, Ferb. Hey, there little guy. You want some frozen yogurt? (The lizard flinches.) Yeah, sorry. We don't have mushroom and larvae flavored.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think he likes you, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys! What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool, he disappeared! We found this lizard.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, I've seen one of these before. According to the Fireside Girls' Manual, that lizard is a North American chameleon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then we'll name him Steve.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: O...kay....why Steve?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: 'Cause he looks like a Steve.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Huh. Can't argue with logic like that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I'll see you after you teach your guitar lessons.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, I only have two appointments today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Appointments." Well, all right, Dr. Six-Strings. Good luck with your "patients". (hangs up and giggles) "Dr. Six-Strings." Now that's banter. Heh. (gasps as she sees the giant frozen yogurt machine) Aha! (Steve disappears again) I finally caught you guys! That thing's not going anywhere! You guys are so busted this time! (runs out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like he's still hungry. Don't worry, little guy. We'll come back with some food. (Ferb puts Steve on the grass and pats him on the head.) I think Mom just stocked up the fridge.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I bet Perry's gonna love Steve. Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz has been stocking up a lot of high-end sound equipment and musical instruments. In fact, he jut outbid me on this sweet vintage solid-body maple-top guitar.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Ouch! You totally got sniped!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Anyway, we need you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. (Perry salutes) Good luck, Agent P. (The chopper comes out of his seat and he flies away.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hi, Mr. Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, actually, it's Dr. Doofenshmirtz. But, y'know, whatever.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walks in) Are you ready for your first lesson?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, yes. Please come in. I have a very special melody that I'd like to learn how to perpetrate—I mean play. (He plays all open strings on the guitar as his daughter walks into the room.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad. I'm headed out to the— (sees Jeremy) Oh, a guitar player, huh?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yup.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So, uh, do you know anything by the Scraping Fangs?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nah. Not really into the heavy stuff.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (disappointed) I'm outta here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (examining his sheet music) Ach! Ach! It's so hard to see all these little notes. D-Do me a favor and flick on that light switch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no no no no. No, this. (showing a lever on the floor) This is the light switch! Ugh! (He pulls the lever) I tried to make it as obvious as possible.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (pointing out the window) But what was that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was just my prototype Gigantinator ray. It's n-nothing to be concerned about.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, I finally caught them! (eyes closed) Ta.... (sees there's nothing there) Dah... AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Maybe you should take it easy today and run some errands with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Steve's sure gonna love these mushrooms. (realizes he's not there) Steve, where are you? Steve!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (looking down) Uh... (she kneels down and picks up a pebble) Guys, look at where you're standing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! It's a huge footprint.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: A huge chameleon footprint.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you realize what this means? Some giant chameleon took Steve!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (looking over the fence) The rest of the tracks lead into the city.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're coming to save you, Steve!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How'm I doing? I rock, right?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Um...heh. What's so special about this freaky guitar solo?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it all started at the...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) PYRAMIDS OF EGYPT! I traveled there to, you know, discover the hidden secrets of the PYRAMIDS OF EGYPT! And then it hit me! The answer to my quest was staring me in the face. Hidden in those hieroglyphics was a seemingly random series of musical notes. You see, the PYRAMIDS OF EGYPT! were built with the help of alien intelligence. The Egyptians learned how to play a cryptic guitar solo that would summon an alien armada to help them perform feats of mind-blowing power.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That mystical melody is now in my very hands. And once I learn to play it, I can summon the aliens to me and I will become overlord of the TRI-STATE AREAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Have you considered switching to decaf?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to talk all through our lesson time.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, I'm charging by the hour, so knock yourself out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's just I'm used to doing all the talking with my nemesis. (Perry drops off the chair.) He's a platypus.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, my friends have a pet platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is he fierce, cunning, and good with a grappling hook?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, no. Their platypus doesn't do much. (Perry jumps out of the building and takes a plunger and sticks it onto the bottom of the "nose" of the building.) Well, let's take another shot at learning this solo. (Doof plays the riff better.) Hey, doc, not bad. I think you might be getting it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, the tracks just stop. What's casting this big shadow?

Name: Phineas and Isbaella
Dialog: Whoa! (They run away but Ferb stays put.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, what are you doing? Wait a minute. (Ferb opens the bag he's holding and takes out a mushroom, which Steve eats.) It's just Steve! Wow! How did he turn into a dinosaur?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Actually, it's just a giant chameleon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But "dinosaur" sounds cooler.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stupid errands. (The car shakes.) Huh? (A la that famous dinosaur movie, Candace looks in the side-view mirror and sees Steve with the others.) What? AAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I get it. The sound of Candace's scream freaks him out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What's wrong, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming out of the car and grabbing her mother again) Mom Mom Mom! Dinosaur! Follow me! Ha ha, ha, ha, the boys are so busted this -- Hey, where'd it go?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys. What are you doing here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looking for Steve, our dinosaur. Can we keep him?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Keep what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Steve.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is he invisible?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, he is.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, cute. Alright, Candace, let's go home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Invisible friends? Uh, pfft! I'm so getting to the bottom of this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's okay, Steve. Candace is gone. (Steve reappears.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Steve, wait! Steve!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to bother you, Agent P. We just wanted to let you know we'd be temporarily unavailable. Seems there's a giant dinosaur running amok downtown and Carl wants to go check it out. (Carl leans into the frame wearing a "I Heart Dinosaurs" baseball cap.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, I think you've got it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Ah, great! Can you give me a hand moving my amplifinator out onto the porch?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Your what?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's my omni-directional amplifinator. It will blast my scorching guitar licks in all directions, ripping through the vacuum of space to summon the alien armada that will help me conquer the TRI-STATE AREAAAAAAAA!!! I don't know why I always say that loud.

Name: Carl
Dialog: This is so cool!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'd try to recruit him but I don't think we have a hat that big.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Steve? Steve, where are you?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There's no way we can catch him. He moves too fast. Maybe we should just give up.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Give up?!? Give up?!? The day may come when we'll give up on fruitless searches after a mere eleven minutes, but that day is not today! The day may come when our favorite reptile may be lost from our memories and his enduring love of mushrooms forgotten, but that day is not today! (At this point, several passersby gather around to hear this speech.) Today we search! We will search for him in the streets, we will search for him in the trenches, we will search for him in the alleys and the mini-malls and the cul-de-sacs of this fair land. We'll search for him in the multilevel car parks and municipal recreational facilities. (A truck labeled British Imports with a Union Jack on it drives up behind him, giving the appropriate patriotic feel.) And we few. We happy few. We small band of brothers — and girl from across the street. We shall not cease 'til he is found!

Name: All
Dialog: Yaaaaaaay!!!!

Name: Policeman
Dialog: We'll help ya find your friend! What does he look like?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's a giant lizard about 40 feet tall.

Name: Man
Dialog: ...Oh. You could have mentioned that up front.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Yeah, count me out.

Name: Man 3
Dialog: You're on your own.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Steve! Steve, where are you?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You're really rockin' now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The spaceships should be here any minute. And then, it will be time to pump up the volume!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (looks at his watch) Well, that's the hour. I'm gonna pack up my gear. I got another lesson across town.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, but the aliens are on their way.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) Okay. Tell them I said hi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They're almost here. Oh, look, here they come! Perfect! The crescendo of all my— (Perry finally arrives on cue) Ah, Perry the Platypus. You don't stand a chance against my awesome heavy metal gear! (He presses a wawa pedal and the amp next to him releases a trap.) Ha ha! Get it? Get it? Heavy metal. Like it's...? Ah.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Steve?

Name: Steve 1
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry. Wrong Steve.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Steve, where are you?!

Name: Steve 2
Dialog: (behind a newsstand) Right here. How can I help ya?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, I don't think you're the Steve we're looking for.

Name: Steve 2
Dialog: You might wanna check at the Steve Convention.

Name: Steve 3
Dialog: Hey, Steve!

Name: Steve 4
Dialog: Cool name, Steve!

Name: Steve 5
Dialog: Hey, Steve-a-rino!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm... (looks one way and smiles) Steve!

Name: All Steves
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no, not you. That Steve.

Name: Steve 6
Dialog: Aaah! Steve is a giant monstrous dinosaur!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh, I guess they don't like chameleons. Nice to see you again, Steve old boy. (The guitar riff is heard in the distance. Steve looks at it and sees that the amplifinator looks like a giant mushroom. He tramples over to the "mushroom".)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, wait! Come back!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nothing can stop me now! My alien friends, I command you to— (Steve's monstrous hand grabs the "mushroom".) No! Oh, stop! Aaah! (Perry comes out of his trap) This is not working the way it did on paper!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Perry flips the sheet music upside down and takes the guitar and strums. He plays the guitar behind his head and plays the riff in reverse. Steve covers his ears. The saucers all fly away. Steve eats the amplifinator and Perry jumps on him.) Curse you, (He Townsends the guitar) Perry the Platypus!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Um, do you wanna pay by cash or check?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Maybe I could trade you for some evil lessons?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'll take cash.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Whoa! Woohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! Alright, Steve, let's go home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Mom thinks I'm imagining the whole thing! (Cut to Candace's bedroom where she is on the phone and holding a glass of water.) And I know Phineas and Ferb are behind this. (She sets the glass down. It begins to shake just like in the movie.) Huh? (Steve's giant eye appears in the window behind her. She runs downstairs.) MOOOOOOOOOOMMMMMMM!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Steve. (Steve's stomach growls again)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sounds like he's still hungry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, big guy. We'll be right back with some food.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, what's the point? I'm just going to sit here in the dark and rethink my life. (He flicks the "light switch" off and the Gigantinator reactivates.) Whoops, heh-heh. Wrong switcher. Y'know, I—I can see how that would be confusing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (zipping out the door with her mother) Look, Mom! See it?! Look at the gigantic dinosaur!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looks down at Steve) Uh-huh, don't you think that's a bit of an exaggeration?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but... (sadly walks away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (coming out carrying a giant bag of mushrooms with Ferb) Hi, Mom! Hey, looks like Steve's looking like his old self again.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So this is your new pet dinosaur?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it's actually a chameleon. You said we could keep him, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Of course. I'm sure he'll blend right in. (Steve goes into Ferb's hand and disappears again.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, Mr. Monogram, now this is a G-chord.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, actually, it's Major Monogram. You see, I'm in charge of an elite group of secret agent undercover animals who— (clears throat) You don't mind me going on about this, do ya?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, man, I charge by the hour, so knock yourself out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What to do, what to do?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, guys. What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that's what we're trying to figure out. Hey, are you Fireside Girls missing any specific accomplishment patches?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's see. What's next on the list? (reads a list of patches until she comes to the right one; snaps fingers) "Rodeo Clown" patch!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What does a rodeo clown do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: They keep the bulls from knockin' you over, like this! (knocks Baljeet over)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I can see how that would be helpful.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can build mechanical bulls and have a robot rodeo. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Seems the Tri-State Area's association of evil geniuses, the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally United For Frightening Investments in Naughtiness, is having some sort of huge gathering. All of the other agents have been deployed, but none have reported back. We fear they've been captured. Now, see what you can do, Agent P. (salutes) Monogram out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tiny Cowboy live in concert!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Um, Candace? Candace?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tiny Cowboy is our favorite band ever! AHH!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: CANDACE! I can't go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wha...?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It...it's my mom. She doesn't want me to go to the concert with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Doesn't she like me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No, no. She likes you just fine, she just thinks...you're, I don't know, flighty and unfocused from time to time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Unfocused"? What could possibly give her that... (hears motor whirring) Wait, did... did you hear that? Was that Ferb's band-saw?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Focus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, right.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Mom said if I'm going to a grown-up concert, she wants me to go with someone more...grounded and mature.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can be grounded and mature.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I can certainly fake it long enough to convince your mom. Remember that time I pretended to be Irish for a whole week?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Indeed I do, Miss O'Flynn!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We can do this!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: AHHHHH!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Welcome, one and all, to the second annual Inator Creator contest. And now, please welcome last year's winner, Rodney!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Thank you. Feast your eyes, boys. (reveals trophy belt) Ta-daaaa!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Look upon this belt of victory.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, I'm taking that puppy home with me, 'cause I'll have a greater Inator this year. Not a greater, it's...I-I'm not gonna break a block of cheese and make nachos for you guys. It's-it's greater in the sense that it's better than it was last year. (pause, walks away) That's what I mean.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All right, let's concentrate on your look. Ta-da!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing fake glasses) But... they're just a pair of fake glasses.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Exactly. Nothing says real focus like fake glasses.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (in the background) Cowgirls and cowpokes, welcome to the Flynn-Fletcher Bros' Rodeo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute! What's going on out there?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: They'd better not be... (gasps) Feeling...busting...urge!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Easy, girl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great job on these cowboy hat helmets, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A rodeo?! (dials phone) Got tell Mom!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wait. Following all over yourself to bust your brothers is exactly what makes you look so flighty and unfocused.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I must repress my basic urges to bust.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Repressing basic urges to bust is pretty responsible, isn't it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is it ever! Look at my mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cake is a sometimes food. Cake is a sometimes food.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: All right, cowboys and cowgirls, it's time to get along, little doggy. Or even a short little doggy. I'm here all week. Try the veal!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Finally, Perry the Platypus! All the other animal agents were here on time before they got captured. I'm just saying. It's embarrassing. Anyway, join your friends in the inhospitality suite! (tosses Perry into metal container) Ha ha! Oh, and Perry the...

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Heinz, stop monologuing with your nemesis and show us that supposed Inator of yours already! (to his cronies) Doofy rented a private room off the convention floor, because he's still working on his! (they laugh)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Laugh enough, now, Rodney, but soon, you'll be crying like a...uh, like a...like a...something that's cries.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Boo-hoo. Boo-hoo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: OH, he makes me so angry! I'm... uh, because he's so right! I need time to finish my Inator! All I've got so far is the fog machine and that's just to add some "pizazz" to the presentation. I could turn it on and fog out the whole contest, but all that would do is buy me some time...hey!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, shoulders back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Check!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Steady walk?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Check.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Serious look.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Check! Uh, Stacy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm feeling the busting urge.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Howdy, Candace! Enjoying the rodeo?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhhhh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Eyes on the prize, Candace, stay in character.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm sure your mom let you go to a concert by yourself when you were a teenager.

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Mmm...no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahem. Good afternoon, Mother. Good afternoon, Dr. Hirano. Pardon the interruption, but is there any tediously responsible errand of a focused and mature nature that I can perform for you? Balance a checkbook, pay the bills, perhaps file some taxes?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why do I feel that all of this has something to do with busting your brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! (hears mechanical bull) Eh-heh, no. That would be childish of me.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You see? Candace level-headed and responsible. She's not a bit worried about what Phineas and Ferb are doing right now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hears mechanical bull) What?! Yes! No, yes, I mean, i-if a responsible focused person...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Like Candace...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Were to see her brothers engaged in some potential reckless activity,... (gets elbowed) Ow! THAT was childish.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: There's no case to ruin it whatsoever!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: This is hideous.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is getting pretty foggy. Should we call the rodeo off?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, we'll just incorporate it and have a foggy robot rodeo! YEE-HAW! Ride 'em, cowboy!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ride 'em where?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You should see what I'm doin'!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This fog is making my hair frizzy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's so nice to sit and be responsible for a change. Just...focused, you know? And Candace and I were thinking that, oh, a live musical event might be a good opportunity for us to really...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ma...ma...m-m-m-m-m...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? Tiny Cowboy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ma... ma...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (whispering) Candace, the concert!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't help myself! MOM! PHINEAS AND FERB BUILT A RODEO IN THE BACKYARD WITH MECHANICAL BULLS AND BLEACHERS AND IS REALLY DANGEROUS! COME ON, YOU GOTTA BUST THEM! (drags Linda with her)

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: This even I have to see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opening door) Come on... hey! What happened to Danville?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's quite a fog bank.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (blows) Follow me, come on, come on. This way, ladies. Pick up the pace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, slow down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Focus, must finish Inator. (hears applause) Wha... what's all that noise out there? I don't get it, what... what's there to applaud? My fog machine should've obscured everyone's Inators. What could it be...

Name: Rodney
Dialog: I give you, the Fog Clearer-Inator!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Once again, Rodney gives us just what we need, just when we need it. That puts him in the lead.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: WHAT!? An electric fan? I knew I could beat that if I just had a little more time! (sighs) Wait! (Stares at the Agent Containment Unit)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, we've been walking forever! Where's the backyard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm... (sniffs, licks, sniffs again) That way! I can smell Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: And what exactly do they smell like?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Motor oil and competence!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! Oh! Heyhey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know, something's making my bull go whacko!

Name: Scientist 1
Dialog: The animal agents are free!

Name: Scientist 2
Dialog: My Inator! How disquieting!

Name: Scientist 3
Dialog: No, Agent C!

Name: Scientist 3
Dialog: Oh, my Mom's gonna kill me-e-e!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: No, it's just an electric fan! It's been official to mankind!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Heh heh heh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That balloon! It's making the bulls angry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, kid, you think you can let go of that balloon?

Name: Kid
Dialog: This balloon cost me fifty cents!

Name: Audience
Dialog: LET GO OF THE BALLOON!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! The fog is lifting! (enters backyard) Aha! (fog lifts fully) Uh...rodeo? Bu--bu-bu-bu-but the... there was an... and I saw... a-and the bulls...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, so much for Tiny Cowboy.

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Ohhhh, you can go to the concert. Candace's single-minded determination to bust her brothers shows focus. Something she hopes rubs off on you, young lady.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz, I see you finally managed to cobble something together. What do you call it? A...Later-inator? (sarcastic laugh)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Noooo, I give you...the Eradicate Rodney's-Inator-inator!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: What?! No fair! (sobs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: LIKE A BABY! YEAH, THAT'S RIGHT! That's what I was looking for. AND... IT'S THE LAST INATOR STANDING!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz wins by default!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: By default, my favorite way to win!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Unfortunately, the trophy belt was destroyed in the fight. So...uh, oh! (grabs the balloon that just floated by) Here, take this balloon instead.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes the balloon) Eh, a prize is a prize. (at the balloon) I'm going to call you...Balloony II. (hears mooing) What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, this was fun, but I'm gonna go wash my hair, now.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's because of the humidity!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here it is. The Phineas-and-Ferb-edge-of-insanity-kiss-your-butt-goodbye-gravity's-a-stone-cold-sucker-nightmare-rail-skate-track-obstacle-course of doom! You ready, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops. (He and Ferb watch, cringing as the board is going down hit by hammers, attacked by a leopard, among other things before it reaches the bottom and blows up) You know, it occurs to me we could get hurt. I guess the "of doom" in the name should've tipped us off. Well, Ferbooch, unfortunately, there's only one way down

Name: Dentist
Dialog: Okay, Linda, you may feel a little pressure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you've gotta come home! Phineas and Ferb built a nightmare-rail-skate-ramp of doom on top of the house! You've gotta—!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Her words sound funny because she has a dental instrument in her mouth) Oh, you have got to be kidding me! In case you haven't notice I'm kind of in the middle of something here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that even English?

Name: Linda and the dentist
Dialog: Out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, alright, jeez! Don't take it out on me; I'm the good guy here! (She leaves)

Name: Dentist
Dialog: Alright, let's get back to your root canal.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah, thank goodness.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. What's up with the getup?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm going for my Intrepid Reporter Patch. Can I report on what you guys are doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool! Isabella Garcia-Shapiro, the Fireside Girl Gazette. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I have built the ultimate extreme skate track obstacle course!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Awesome! I knew I could count on you for the coolest story ever! Have you attempted a run yet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we decided we need to make a few tweaks and adjustments so we can, you know, survive and stuff.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, I'll be back in an hour. Hopefully I can make the Early Mid-Morning Edition! See ya! (She leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Instead of modifying the track, maybe we should modify ourselves. Together we could be the best skateboarder ever! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've just received an alarming message from Doofenshmirtz. Watch closely, and join us in girlish panic if you’re into it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) Citizens of Danville, I, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, have seized control of the Tri-State Area and am now your supreme leader. Seriously, life as you know it is over. (Shows him speaking to a crowd) Thank you and remember

Name: Monogram
Dialog: With Doofenshmirtz in charge, no man, woman, child, or hat-wearing mammal is safe. You must find out what’s going on. (He puts on a wig and Carl gets in a baby carriage) Carl and I will be on the lamb, incognito. Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have to blur the line between skateboard and skateboarder. We can combine dirt biking, ATV racing, in-line skating, street luge, motorized scooters, and Bulgarian folk dancing. Of course, all this extreme fun requires extreme safety

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What, you think we should add more Bulgarian folk related elements?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, less! Less Bulgarian--okay, wow. I thought we were on the same page. But no. It's cool. Whatever. Time to suit up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, video link active. (in a deeper, robotic voice) How you doin', Ferb? Oh cool! Look what it does to my voice! Ohhh, yeaaah. How about a little test run?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) Hey, what's that? Turn down the music.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Distantly) He's stuck in a tree, and I can't get him down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) Sounds like Buford's in trouble. Hey, Ferb, maybe we can use this suit to help him. Hold on tight! (He jumps in the air) Hit the rocket boosters!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) Whoa! Yeah, hey Ferb, check us out! We're flying!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, I'm back! Phineas? Ferb? (She sighs) Well, I guess there goes my Early Mid-Morning Edition story...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) There they are!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Help, my nerd is stuck in a tree! (Clicks his tongue holding up a piece of paper and a calculator) Look, it's your favorite calculator and some math problems!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! Fractions? (While he stands he loses his footing and falls, shouting)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Baljeet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) I got you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What is that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! This is so much worse than hitting the ground! (Continues shouting)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Hugs Baljeet) He saved my nerd!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow! That was amazing! I can't believe Phineas and Ferb missed it...

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not fair. Every time I try to bust Phineas and Ferb it's always "Candace, I'm shopping," "Candace, I’m having root canal surgery," "Candace, I'm deliberating with a sequestered jury. How did you even get in here?" Then my-- (seeing Phineas and Ferb fly past in the super suit) Oh look, a flying man! (She suddenly stops) Wait a second. Isn't that impossible? Wait another second! Something impossible plus that thing existing in real life equals... (She gasps before pedaling toward home) Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) Well, we've figured out how to fly. Now we need to figure out how to stop flying. Deploying grappling hook!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the robotic voice) Well, at least we stopped flying.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ex-leaders of the Tri-State Area, I have called you here to help ease the citizens into this exchange of power.

Name: Building Superintendent
Dialog: I thought you called me here to re-caulk your tub.

Name: Crossing Guard
Dialog: I'm only the crossing guard at Fourth Street and Maple. I'm not really sure how much authority I have.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Silence! Are you suggesting that I attempted to gather the leaders of the Tri-State Area but the best I could do was a crossing guard and my building super?

Name: Crossing Guard
Dialog: No, but now that you mention it...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Silence! Wrong! You're wrong! Do you know who that is? It's only Roger Doofenshmirtz, the mayor of Danville! So shut up! What do you know; you’re only a crossing guard!

Name: Crossing Guard
Dialog: That's what I'm trying to tell you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Silence!

Name: Roger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm sorry, but if we're not really gonna plan Mom's birthday, then I gotta jet.

Name: Crossing Guard, Building Super
Dialog: Yeah, us too.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, hey, hey, wait!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great, Perry the Platypus. This is all I need... So what did you want to talk to me about-- (He's suddenly hit by a chair and Perry starts going toward him. Doofenshmirtz quickly tries to scoot away) Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa whoa!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, the suit makes the clean-up fast, fun and efficient! I feel bad about missing Isabella. I hope she found something else to write a story about.

Name: Unknown blonde Fireside Girl
Dialog: Early mid-morning edition! The Beak saves the geek! (Tosses the newspaper at the driveway)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (picks up newspaper) "Superhero comes to Danville, by Isabella Garcia-Shapiro. I call him The Beak." Hey, I like that. (During this sentence the scene switches to Khaka Peu Peu's house, with him reading as well) "With The Beak watching over us, everyone in Danville is free to have...

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: "...the best day ever." Best day ever, huh? (picks up an eye mask) We'll see about that.

Name: Khaka Peu Peu's Wife
Dialog: Are you in there complainin' again about never havin' a good day in your life?

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: Well, I never did! Where's my best day ever, thank you very much? Ha, I told her. (is hit by a chair) Oh!

Name: Khaka Peu Peu's Wife
Dialog: I heard that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A superhero? That's not at all what we planned to do today! (His phone rings and he answers) Oh, hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, where'd you go? You really let me down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, sorry about that.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's a good thing something else came along for me to report on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I know, but, hey, maybe we can make it up to you.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, how would you like an exclusive?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Excited) Great! Meet me downtown in five minutes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Will do. (He hangs up) Come on, we have to go tell Isabella we're The Beak.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ahem.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fine, we can take the suit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew it was— (Is hit by a newspaper) Blech! "Superhero comes to Danville." Well, they're about to get super-busted!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Well, I've gotta admit this flying thing is pretty fun. Hey, look, there's Isabella. Yo, Isabella-- (He's hit into a building by Khaka Peu Peu)

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: Take that, birdbrain! Behold, the Khaka Crawler. I built it in my basement out of discarded washers and dryers, thank you very much. And I'm gonna make sure no one has the best day ever!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Hide my baby!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, where are you? There's this giant robot machine attacking downtown Danville! I'm all alone here! Call me as soon as you get this. (To herself) Come on, Isabella, this is what being an intrepid reporter is all about!

Name: Roger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, this is not good, Melanie. I'll bet they'll try and pin this on me.

Name: Melanie
Dialog: It's not like you're the one who used the unsigned proposal for defending Danville from giant robot attacks as a coaster. Oh, wait, you were.

Name: Roger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, it's so easy to blame the guy in charge. "The guy in charge." Ha-ha! That's it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And... whoa! Uh, you know that whole taking over the Tri-State Area thing? I-I was just bluffing. I-- I hoped maybe if I just told everyone I was in charge, they'd be too lazy or too busy to, you know, actually... check. (His phone rings) Oh, hello, Roger. (He makes a face to Perry) Uh-huh. What? You are? Me? In charge? It worked? You're kidding! Y-You're not kidding?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, where is Phineas? He'd know what to do. Please, Phineas. Where are you?

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: Who knew wrecking everyone's day would be this much fun?

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Hey, you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The Beak!

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: Oh, you're back for more, thank you very much.

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: Oh, great. Now I have to restart, thank you very much.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Dude, who are you, anyway?

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: If you're here to give Danville the best day ever, then I'm here to give Danville the worst day ever. You can call me "Khaka Peu Peu!" (The crowd laughs) What? Oh, come on. It's a family name, loosely translated as "The Strong Fist," or "That Strong Fist." Thank you very much!

Name: The Beak
Dialog: All right, let's wrap this up. (He uses the grappling hook to wrap up the legs of the Khaka Crawler) Hey, cool, my first superhero pun.

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Well, don't quit your day job, Mr. Comedian.

Name: Man
Dialog: Actually, I thought it was pretty clever.

Name: Charles
Dialog: Yeah, 'cause, see, it, it wrapped around the legs.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: If you didn't like that one, maybe this'll be a hit. (He hits the Khaka Crawler into the air with one of its legs)

Name: Charles
Dialog: (To the man beside him) Yeah, see, 'cause--'cause he hit him.

Name: Man
Dialog: I'm not an idiot, Charles.

Name: Khaka Peu Peu
Dialog: This isn't over. You haven't seen the last of Khaka Peu Peu! I'll come at you through what's most important to you. Thank you very much!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You were amazing!

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Isabella Garcia-Shapiro, the Fireside Girl Gazette. Would it be okay if I asked you a few questions?

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Um, I can't talk right now. Gotta go, bye. (He flies off)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, uh, okay. Bye. Thanks for saving me.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: We can't tell Isabella we're The Beak now. That would put her in danger. The life of a superhero is a lonely one, Ferb. Even after only eleven minutes.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: What will become of our heroes now? Find out in the next exciting episode of The Beak.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: We now return to suburban Danville, where things continue to happen.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Are you sure Phineas and Ferb are really The Beak? He's just so heroic and hunky.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Barf-aroni with cheese! Stacy, please. Phineas and Ferb are doing something totally bustable that's also mobile. We can lure them right to Mom to bust themselves.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And how exactly will we do this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if they wanna play superhero, then we're gonna play super-villain. Call me The Dangiraffe.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Right, and where do I fit in?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You'll be my henchman.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Your what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's like the bridesmaid of crime.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, got it. Although, it looks like they've got their hands full with Khaka Peu Peu.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's obviously some big, stupid dress-up game they're playing with their little loser friends. Now, if my research is correct, the way to defeat a superhero is to come at him through what's important to him. (She holds up a picture of the boys and Linda before laughing maniacally)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, check this place out. Suh-wanky. Melanie?

Name: Melanie
Dialog: Hello, Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, please call me Supreme Leader Doofenshmirtz. The Great.

Name: Melanie
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I see Roger left me a note. Let's see. "Bro, thanks for filling in for me. You're going to make a great fall guy. I mean, mayor." Aw, that's so sweet. (Perry shakes a box he's holding) Go ahead and put that on my new desk. (Perry sets it down only to have it wrap around him, trapping him) Ha ha! Made you carry your own trap. Now, my first order of business is to make all the citizens of Danville bow down--

Name: Melanie
Dialog: No, it's not. Here's your schedule and all your missed phone calls. Let's focus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, uh, wow, uh, okay...

Name: Melanie
Dialog: And if you hadn't noticed, the city is in the grip of fear and panic caused by an evil super-villain intent on destroying our way of life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? But--but that's my job!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There. You can't even tell we've built our secret lair up in the tree.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Hides the remote behind his back) Nothing! I mean, hi, Isabella. We're not doing-- Nothing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where have you been?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He scratches his ear) Um, oh, you know us. Busy, busy, busy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Right. While you two were busy making sure your summer day was "fun", other people were busy saving Danville. (She holds out a newspaper showing the Beak)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He scratches his ear again) The Beak, huh? Check it out, Ferb. A real superhero.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And I need your help to find him. I thought there might be some clues in the photos I took that could help him stop Khaka Peu Peu.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Snorts at the name)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Fine, if you guys aren't going to take this seriously, I'll find The Beak on my own.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, wait.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I gotta go. Bye, Phineas. (She leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, to the nest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready, Ferb? Let's wing it.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Ba-caw!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She calls Phineas' phone) Phineas, quick, Mom is in danger! (She screams before hanging up) And the award goes to... Oh, wait, shoot. (She calls him again) On the corner of Fourth Street and Maple Drive! (screams before hanging up again) Beautiful! Now it's all up to The Dangiraffe.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So then what does The Dangerbil do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I told you. You're my henchman. Hench or something.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, no, you did not just tell me to hench.

Name: Candace

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! (traps Perry in a roll of toilet paper) Ha ha, ha ha ha! Amazing what you can do with toilet paper! Which you would know, if you were a real plumber. In fact, it's amazing what you can do with all kinds of paper! (showing several stacks of paper in the background) And no, I'm not a hoarder.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotcha! It's a good thing I threw away a lifelong friendship to keep an eye on you two and your ridiculous...uhhh???

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lemonade stand. We liked your idea so much, we decided to go for it. And it's turning out to be a big hit.

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Wow! This is the best lemonade I've ever had! Hit me again! (Ferb pours him some more lemonade)

Name: Candace
Dialog: A regular old lemonade stand? That's it? Huh. That means there's, uh, nothing for me to bust today, which means...I have a free day! Phineas and Ferb, I've got to hand it to you. Finally, I can like normal mediocre kids doing normal mediocre stuff. Thanks for giving me the day off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that's a lot of paper. Would you like to know what I'm going to do with it all? Well, I'll tell you. (retracts a screen in front of Perry and the show begins)

Name: Man
Dialog: Birth of an inator! The wheel, the light bulb, the frozen pop with two sticks, so you can give half to a friend. All profound inventions in their time, but they fail in comparison to the Paper-Cut-Inator (shows a picture of a machine with a cannon with claws around it)...(???) of the world-renowned evil genius Doctor Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was sick that day!

Name: Man
Dialog: This new and exciting inator turns any kind of paper, into razor sharp slicing missiles (pronounced as Mis-eye-lles) and hurls them toward an unsuspecting tri-state-area...watch out Danville!!

Name: Second man
Dialog: Ouch! Something bit me!

Name: Man
Dialog: That something is evil science, tiger! Good thing the local pharmacy is fully stocked with new Doofenshmirtz Brand Adhesive bandages (shows a bandaid with the sick Doofenshmirtz face as the logo). They are terrific and expensive! And brought to you by Danville's newest soon-to be trillionaire, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz. (the picture is seen again) Thanks, Heinz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that picture's gonna haunt me.

Name: Man
Dialog: And happy evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (video off) Not bad, huh? I'm gonna do all of my Inator introductions like that from now on! It just so much more professional looking!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to the mall! I'll call Stacy. No, wait. Stacy's mad at me. And I'm mad at Stacy! But I can't go by myself. I'll look like a total dork. Okay, I'll just get a new best friend!

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey there, Jenny. As of no doubt you heard, Stacy has elected not to renew her option on being my best friend. So, as someone who has expressed interest in the past, I thought you might want to bail yourself of this exciting opportunity.

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Come on, Candace. You just want someone to go to the mall with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you go?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Sorry, but I can't. I've got to get to the save the pigeons rally. Save the pigeons!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, got to cast that net a little wider. (going through list of names in phone) Jeremy? No, I can't talk about Jeremy with Jeremy. Mad at Stacy. Jenny, pigeons. Mom? No way! Yuck! How did HE even get in here?! Delete! Okay, who next? (more rapidly at each turn) Jeremy, Stacy, Jenny, Mom. Jeremy, Stacy, Jenny, Mom. Jeremy, Stacy, Jenny, Mom. Jeremy, Stacy, Jenny, Mom. (gasps) How can I only have four friends?! And one of them's my mom!

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: Hey, best friend!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: I've been looking everywhere for you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, I don't know you, but okay!

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: Come here. Let's go to the mall.

Name: Girl 2
Dialog: Hey, did you see that lonely girl?

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: Yeah, she was all by herself and singular.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as the customers clamor) I'm glad people are enjoying their lemonade, but it's getting really hard to keep up. We better check in with Isabella. Isabella, how is phase two coming along?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hold on, Phineas! (at the Fireside Girls) A little more to my left. (at Phineas) Franchise locations are a go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Easy, folks. Relief is on the way.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Here you go.

Name: Ballpit Kid
Dialog: Hey, everyone! It says there's a new Phineas and Ferb lemonade stand opening with no wait!

Name: Lemonade man
Dialog: They have a lemonade stand inside the grocery store, the bookstore, and the mall. It's even being served on my favorite airline! (rips shirt to reveal his chest tattoo of the P&F lemonade corporation; and puts on lemonade-shaped hat) YEAH! OH, YEAH! LEMONADE! IN YOUR FACE, ORANGE JUICE! BOO-YAH! THAT'S RIGHT, BOO! YAH! LEMONADE!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, no more for that guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let me show you my Paper Cut-inator in action!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He steps on the edge of the toilet paper, causing Perry to spin very quickly, then shoves some paper into the Paper-Cut-inator) First, we get a piece of paper, and then we put it in and--oh! That auto-feeder. It scares me every time! Okay, Danville. Get ready for some serious minor cuts in liberations!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I wouldn't want to be getting one of those rejuvenating sea salt scrubs right now. The stinging would be unbearable! It just takes a little while to warm up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! Finding a new best friend is even harder than I thought! Makes me kinda miss Stacy! Why did I let our friendship go?

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you lost your best friend, huh? Yeah, I know how you feel. I lost my best friend once. Little guy, all yellow-y and scaly. His name was Biff, turned into this whole brouhaha. I had to fight a squid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a min--wait a minute, what you're trying to say is that if Stacy is really my best friend, I should just apologize to her. And if I'm really Stacy's best friend, she'll take me back! (runs off)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, sure! It's all about you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not too late to fix this! I can still have a best friend forever! Stacy, there she is! Right next to the Phineas... and Ferb... Lemonade stand. (looks at the cup she has been drinking from, realizing she has been drinking from Phineas and Ferb Lemonade, followed by several of the P&F lemonade franchises, until finally stopping at a beauty salon where some one is doing Linda's hair) Mom! I'll tell mom! But wait! Stacy! Mom! Stacy! Mom! Stacy! Mom! Stacy! Stom! Macy! Seven! Wolverine! Shish kebab! Marmalade! Hominahaa... (mutters indistinctly)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, it's almost warmed up. Are you watching Perry the-- What? What the...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How did you get out of that!? It's two ply!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Spitballs? Oh, I get it. Paper fight! (makes a figure used in paper football and throws it at Perry who ducks and raises two arms as the paper football flies between his arms) GOAL!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am NOT in love with Sophie! I am not! Oh, you're gonna get it now, Perry the Platypus! (puts on paper hat) Boom! (no effect) Well, that doesn't do much. I'm gonna get you with the Paper-Cut-inator! (trips) Flypaper? Well, it doesn't matter! Look!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: One piece? That's it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A plunger jam?! Ah, I hate those! They always make the Paper-Cut-Inator-- (Hundreds of paper slices fly around Doofenshmirtz injuring him all around) EEEEEEE-Explode! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Lemonade-Making Machine
Dialog: (squeezes lemons which squirt in the paper cut) LEMON JUICE! (It malfunctions, causing all P&F lemonade stands to go out of business)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, folks, we're sold out!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Go home, you losers, we're dry!

Name: Crowd
Dialog: (groaning in disappointment)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Biff (sobbing)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, Candace, isn't that Stacy over there? Hi, Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looks at Candace)

Name: Linda
Dialog: You okay, honey?

Name: Bus driver
Dialog: Come on, kid. I'm on a schedule.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looks at the lemonade stands)

Name: Bus driver
Dialog: Come on, kid. In, or out?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, there's something I got to tell you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it, honey?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That if you want me, I'll be at the mall with Stacy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Um...okay.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (as she and Candace board the bus) Welcome back, best friend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, best friend.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I have had my eye on the cutest pink dress for you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Aww. It's nice to see Candace enjoying herself for a change. Now, where are those lemonade stands I keep hearing about?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb, I think it's time to shut her down.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (claps twice)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys. So, what did you two do today?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Just normal, mediocre kid stuff.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sounds great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad! I just got some great lemonade from the new stand down the street. It's really sour. Do you want to--(slips on some paper; exclaims)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: OW, THAT SMARTS, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, Dad? You know he's not here, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I know, but I'm sure it's his fault.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you lost your best friend, huh? Yeah, I know how you feel. I lost my best friend once. Little guy, all yellow-y and scaly. His name was Biff, turned into this whole brouhaha. I had to fight a squid.

Name: Pilot
Dialog: (while an airplane makes its landing) Ladies and gentlemen, we'll be touching down in Hawaii momentarily, but remember aloha means "hello" and "good bye". Try not to get the two confused.

Name: Wahanies
Dialog: Aloha!

Name: Candace, Lawrence, Linda, Ferb, and Phineas
Dialog: Aloha!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I do hope that was hello.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I've always wanted a vacation this close to a volcanic hot-spot. Do you smell what I smell, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (sniffs) Hmm-mmm. Magma.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your father and I are looking forward to the Annual Couple's Surfing Contest.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I can't wait to wipe out!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Dear, "wipe out" means falling off the board.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, I know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, there's only one thing I'm saying hello-ha to! Relaxing! And taking a break from trying to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? It's hard work!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, kids. Let's check out the gift shop while your father checks us in.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I am a little rusty on my Hawaiian, but here goes. Buenos dias, señor. Me llamo Lawrence. (Good day, sir. My name is Lawrence.)

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Oh, no, no. That’s not necessary. We speak English here. Hawaii is part of the United States.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Is it really? (pauses) How remarkable. Well, we're the Flynn-Fletcher family. Two adults, three children, (holding up a pet carrier with Perry inside it) and our pet platypus, Perry.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Excellent. Why don't you join your family while I get the bellhop to attend to your bags?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wonderful.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (on the phone) Help desk. Can we get a bell person in to pick up the family's bags and platypus. (pauses, then notices the now empty pet carrier) Oh, hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (via a screen on a Tiki statue) Aloha, Agent P. I see you're able to subliminally persuade your host family to take their vacation in Hawaii. Still have no idea how you managed to do that.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, I'll decide where we go on vacation as soon as I clean out Perry's litter box. (looks into the litter box with the Hawaiian islands drawn on it) Hey, how about Hawaii?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As you know, Doofenshmirtz is in the area of the Big Island. He's obviously up to no good. Find out what's he up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) Sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh... I promised Carl to get him one of those hula wigglers for his dashboard. He thinks it would be neat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, what's this? Pineapple scented serenity lotion with SPF. "Apply and feel instantly serene". (to Linda) Mom! I totally need the serenity lotion!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check this out. "Aqua Primates". A-Primes, Ferb. (flips the box over) The back of the box shows them crowning the queen, fighting robots, and designing websites. Ferb, we've totally got to get this! Hey, not to be redundant, but... Where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Well, first of all, I just want to state for the record that this island was not my first choice. I wanted Skull Island right over there, but it was already booked for Jacob Bernstein's Bar Mitzvah, and so all there was available was... Pink Unicorn Island.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So go ahead and laugh it up. (Perry smirks) I will say this was considerably cheaper than Skull Island and look! (holds up a pink bathrobe with a pink unicorn embroidered on it) I get to keep the robe! (drops the bathrobe) Oh, where are my manners! Aloha! (drapes a lei over Perry) That's Hawaiian for... (the lei quickly binds Perry, who glares at him) you're trapped! And why am I here? you ask. See these little, mini volcanoes? They contain a certain primordial ooze I need for my latest evil device. Behold, the De-Evolutionator! I... don't know why it looks kind of looks like a giant fish bone. It's just how it came in the kit. (pours the ooze into a pan, then tosses the bucket) When I unleash this baby on the Tri-State Area, it will make every man, woman, and child moonwalk backwards down the evolutionary chain, finally stopping at a wimpy little Pliopithecus. (singsong voice) Ooo, I'm Pliopithecus. I'm not evolved enough to stop a modern man like Doofenshmirtz. (laughs) And that's when I swoop back into town and take over. Isn't that just Darwin?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Preparing to relax. (walks out of the hotel) Boy, do I need this.... Ooh, why is there so many people here? ... Wait! Wait! One last chair! Excuse me! I was here first!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Relaxation.... Come to me, serenity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Well, the A-Primes hatched, but they're really tiny. And it looks like they only do one trick

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I don't care if it's a Ferris wheel to Jupiter or a bionic meatloaf. I'm going to relax. Now go ahead. Run along.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Time to dump them in.

Name: Lifeguard
Dialog: Hey, what are you two kids doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're putting our A-Primes in the pool before they outgrow their container. Is that against the rules?

Name: Lifeguard
Dialog: Well, let's see. (reads the rules from a board) "No running, diving, pushing, or modern expressionism". Nope, nothing here. You guys are good to go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. (at Ferb) Let's add the A-Primes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, Candace. You're finally doing it. Relaxing. It's all good.

Name: Yoga Instructor
Dialog: Aloha, molihini, or guests. In the spirit of lalauea, or peaceful relaxation, let me be your kumu, or teacher, in an outdoor yoga class free for hotel guests.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pathetic, isn't it? Some people don't have the discipline to relax on their own. They need to take a— Oh, who are you kidding? You're taking the class. A little extra serenity can't hurt. (covers herself with the serenity lotion) Oh, this stuff is slippery!

Name: Yoga Instructor
Dialog: Everybody, find a mat. So, let's start with a gentle standing back bend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! (falls backwards into the pool)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, oh! Improbable creature wrangling time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew it! I knew my obnoxious brothers would ruin my relaxation!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shooing some cats away) Shoo, shoo! Get out of here! It's not a real fish! (at Perry) As I was saying, the De-Evolutionator will blast past the Pacific Ocean, bounce off the satellite, and completely blanket the Tri-State area, de-evolving everyone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How are we doing in the back row? Can you see okay? Alright; away we go! (turns the knob on a controller to "de-evolve", but nothing happens) Oh, for badness sake! What now? (climbs up to the lens) Oh, I see. It's.. it's a little smear on the lens. I just... (wipes away the smear)

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (to the A-Primes) Oh, um, excuse me. Excuse me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, mister. Have you seen a group of giant, wet aqua primates running through here?

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (pointing to the right) Elevator!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You two are so busted!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Hold it right there, young lady! I'm the manager of this hotel, and if there's going to be any busting to do, I'm going to do it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... but... but... but... Wait, a minute. I'm on vacation, he is working. I pass the bust baton to you, sir! Aloha! (sighs in contentment)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (while he and Ferb case after the A-Primes) Come back here! ... Stop!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Stop right there, young men! What is the meaning of this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh... I'm not sure I understand your question.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (at the A-Primes) Stop! Come back here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. For someone living in Hawaii, he's awfully stressed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (noticing the size of his right ear) Okay. This I don't even get.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, Candace. You're finally doing it. Relaxing.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (to the A-Primes) Come back here! Stop!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are we going to round up the A-Primes?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hello? Room service?

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Please? I'm going to call your mother!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (via recording) Hello, you've reached Linda Flynn-Fletcher, and if this is Candace, I'm sure that what ever the boys are doing, is nothing.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: (growls in frustration)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, Doc. Folberg and his wife are trying to drop in our wave.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooo, those crazy coots! I'll just do an old-school drop de-turn on them, eh? Cut back up on the face, through the sloop, do a nice inner tail, and drop into the green room for a bit of tune time.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You got that off the Internet, didn’t you?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes I did.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cowabunga!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What is it? Oh, great. Now I'm a single-celled organism. Now how am I going to drive home?

Name: Hotel Worker
Dialog: You boys ordered a giant flashlight from room service?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Hotel Worker
Dialog: You're in luck. We're just about to take that off the menu.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (signs the form then hands it to the hotel worker) Here. (at Ferb) Let's switch this baby on. (switches the giant flashlight on) Hopefully the A-Primes haven't forgotten their one trick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! They're moving towards the light.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Are you Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Your boys are doing something in the back, and you have to see it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, wait! Don't throw that out! No! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Perfect. They're still here. (to Linda) Come quick! Come look! .... See? Look at the slimy, disgusting creatures.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that's not a very nice thing to say.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggling) Yeah.

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: But... but... but... but there were all these...

Name: Linda
Dialog: My apologies if my daughter put you up to this. (at the boys and Candace) We'll be upstairs, kids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, dude. I know, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm starting to get the hang of it. I think this motion refers to the swaying of the palm trees.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yeah; and this motion says this Brit can move it! I wonder how the boys are doing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nicely done, bro. We’re becoming quite the islanders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at a sand sculpture of Jeremy) Oh, Jeremy. I must be the luckiest girl in Hawaii.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is that? (picks up tiki charm and puts it on) Ooh, a good luck charm! (mysterious music plays and the tiki charm glows) With its own theme music.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who could've guessed my De-Evolutionator would backfire on me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright! Put your psudopods down. Hey, what's that? My De-Evolutionator. Right there on the ocean floor. If it's still working, I can throw it in reverse, fast forward, and evolve back to my former wickedness! It's a good thing I installed this molecular scale control panel. It seemed frivolous at the time, but I'm glad I did it. And... (evolves back into his normal self, then swims to a nearby island) Ugh. Phew. It's strange that my underwear and socks evolved with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aloha, bros.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Cool necklace. Where did you get it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, you like it? It's my lucky charm. It was delivered to me by tranquil, Hawaiian waves. What are you up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well; we've done our share of terrain-based activities, so we’re going to try some semi-aquatic endeavors.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Speaking of semi-aquatic... Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. We still don't know the current whereabouts of Dr. Doofenshmirtz, but we're picking up a strange signal from the island of Wa Ta Lot Ta Hoie. It could be a (???) for the missing De-Evolutionator. (folds up the map) You better investigate. Good luck, Agent P. (at Carl) Carl, more ice!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Coming, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: With the De-Evolution-inator back in my hands, I can reverse the settings, and I'll have the most highly evolved brain on earth! (hits himself with the De-Evolutionator, only to have his head swell up) Now that I'm so smart, I don't think it was such a good idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my precious, little good luck charm. I'm so glad I found you. (trips over a tackle box) Whoa! (face plants into the sand) Well. AAAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Single Guy
Dialog: If this wasn't meant to be, someone give me a sign?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (background voice) No, no, no, no, no! (slams into the window)

Name: Single Guy
Dialog: Well that's good enough for me. This single guy is out, peace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh. I could've been killed. I’m so glad I have my lucky charm. You totally saved my life.

Name: Waiter
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Agh! Well; that could've been a lot worse, but thanks to my lucky charm I can-- ... No worries! I got my lucky charm on. (screams) ... Well, I guess it could've been worse. ... Okay, that does it. This thing is totally bad luck. ... Well; little amulet, this girl doesn't any more misfortune. So bye-bye, bad luck! (tosses tiki charm into garbage can; mysterious music plays) Over it!

Name: Hotel Manager
Dialog: Ooh, nice necklace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!? How’d this get back on! (screams) ... (at a native) Please help me! How do I get rid of this?

Name: Native
Dialog: You must take it to the island of Wa Ta Lot Ta Hoie to the top of the volcano, and...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course! It can only be destroyed if the first which it was formed. Hold on, volcano! I'm a-comin'!

Name: Native
Dialog: We work for tips, you know! (at himself) And, she's gone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, I need a ride to Wa Ta Lot Ta Hoie?

Name: Man
Dialog: Sure, just grab that tow line.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tow line? Do you mean... this? ... Hey, wait! Why is this happening to me? No more bad luck!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, sis. Way to hang loose!

Name: Laird
Dialog: Cowabunga, kids!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Laird Hamilton?

Name: Laird
Dialog: Last I checked. Say, aren't you dudes a little young to be riding this kinda surf?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No worries, bro! We're just gonna hot dog this honker past the bone-yard to the sand.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got that off the Internet, didn't you?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes, yes I did.

Name: Laird
Dialog: Alright, then. Hang loose, kooks. (at Candace) Later, wahanie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang ten, water man! (at Candace) See you on shore, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm doomed. (ends up on shore with a manta ray stuck to her head) I'm cursed. (at the boys) Phineas, Ferb, I need your help. I can't get rid of this tiki charm.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, personally I'd be a little more worried about that manta ray stuck to your head.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? (looks up) Ugh. You know, after the day I've been having, I didn't even notice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here, Candace. Let's us get rid of it for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That won't work. Every time I try to get rid of it, my luck gets even worse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries, Candace. (takes the tiki charm from her then tosses it away) See? Nothing! No bad luck. Perfectly fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... but... but... but...

Name: Laird
Dialog: Wow, you got pounded. Let me give you a hand. (pulls the manta ray off Candace's head then throws it into the water) Looks you could use a little luck. (gives Candace the tiki charm) Here, I found this on the beach. (at the boys) Later, dawgs.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Later, brah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, it's back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What can we do to help?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We need to get to the top that volcano and throw it in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright then. I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Being stranded on a deserted island is much easier with a normal sized head. Oh, I got something. ... It works! I found a platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Perry the Platypus!?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just because we're stranded on a deserted island, doesn't mean we should abandon our normal lives, don't you think? Because then the Tiki gods would win! (pauses) So, I made myself supreme ruler of the Tri-Coconut Area when no one was looking. It stretches all the way from the big rock over there where I'm drying my socks and undies to those three coconut trees at the end of the beach. And I have my minions. Look, if they don't obey, I eat them. What's that look?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you're looking at the De-Evolutionator. Is that why you're here? Well, don't worry about that. I had to disable it. It was doing bad things to my head, man. I keep it around for the crabs. They really seem to like it.... I know. Weird, huh? They get all Kubrick-y on it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! ... Okay, fine! Go ahead along! See if I care, but your little webbed feet away from my... (a crab pinches his finger) Ow! Oh, you're so going to be crab cocktail.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus! I'm drawing a line in the sand. You are not allow to cross this line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooo, refreshments!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Where you get that? Could I... Could I have some? (pauses) What, the line? (erases part of the line) Oh, look, I was just kidding about it. Look! Look! Look! It's not a real line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not a barrier. Aw, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Smarty-pus! (Perry quickly looks up) Feast your eyes on this! Behold, the Sand-inator! (Perry glares) I bet you're wondering what it does, huh? Huh? Well... Well, it's easy. It causes great, irritating sand to wedge itself into your swim trunks, causing it to chaff, get a rash, and have a lousy day at the beach. How do you like...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hah, you don't wear trunks. What is that? A European thing? (gets hit by an incoming wave) Oh, hey it works. I have sand in my trunks and it's really irritating.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I may be starving and dying of thirst, but at least I got my hovel. What does he got? Nothing! He's a platypus. They've... got like... webbed fingers and no opposable thumbs. Practically flippers.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But... but... What? Those are my minions! Whoa, whoa, whoa! Traitors!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are we there yet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: For safety sake, I think Ferb and I should check out the scene before you go up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. Whatever you say. I'm not taking any more chances.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's taking them so long? Phineas? Ferb? Oh, no. ... Uh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (holding some tiki charms) Check it out, Candace. There's tons of these.

Name: Native
Dialog: Hey, wahanie. Looks like you took the long way. Most people take the escalator, you know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No! I can't handle any more bad luck.

Name: Native
Dialog: It's not bad luck. That just means your table is ready. Let's see what other luck it brings you.... Ah, looks someone's getting a free dessert, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way, I don't want anything of that necklace brings me. Goodbye, good riddance, Candace is out, peace!

Name: Laird
Dialog: I'll take that free dessert if you're not going to eat it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No thanks. I just glad I got rid of... that... bad... luck.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got to get off this island. What I need is a BO-AT, or boat as I now been told how it's been pronounced. (notices Perry, who's loading bags of coconuts onto a boat) Oh, look! A BO-AT! ... A boat! (at Perry) Ah, Perry the Platypus. I've decided that our efforts would be better spent if we work together to get off the island. Here, let me help with it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't mind if I borrow your boat. (laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (emerging from the sand) Nice work, Agent P. Agent W will take it from here. (at Agent W via wristwatch communicator) Rubber ducky is in the water. Over. (at Perry) Uh... What do you say we get something to eat? I hear there's this great restaurant on the other side of the island. (holds up a tiki charm) I found one of these. Maybe we'll get a free dessert.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aah! Ow! Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha, ah! So long, Perry the Sucker-pus! Look after my minions! (at himself) Those little traitors! (pauses) Oh, for crying out loud!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (at a coconut and a pelican) Listen up, both of you. Let's get one thing straight. I am supreme ruler of this place and don't you forget it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uhh, hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Jeremy! It's me, Candace!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hi Candace. You realize it's like... 2am in Paris.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oops! Ahahah... Sorry... I... was just wondering how your vacation's going.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Actually, it's funny you called because you were in my dream just now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Excited) Really?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, it was weird... You and I were in this Dixieland band and there was an iguana playing an oboe...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I gotta go, Jeremy. I'll call you later. (Runs outside, calling someone else) Mom! Do you hear that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I can't hear anything over all this road construction.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (As she talks the robot is jumping behind her causing her to pause a few times) But Mom, they've built a giant...rope jumping robot and it's... Phineas will you turn that thing off? I'm trying to bust you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can't, its become self-aware! The jump roping was his idea!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, I'm here. What did you wanna tell me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Backyard now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Slightly irritated) Excuse me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Backyard now, please?

Name: Robot
Dialog: I jump, therefore I am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right back here, Mom! (eyes closed) Look, there they are.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids. Did you have fun today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes we did.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Good for you. I would've been home sooner, but it took me an hour to drive around the road construction in the neighborhood. It sure would be helpful if they could just make the days a little longer. (chuckles) Who do I call about that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, do you mind? We have a visual gag going on here. (It disappears to reveal Ferb used a triangle to make the noise) Thank you! (To Ferb) Our vacation is more than halfway over, and what have we accomplished? Okay, so we built a rollercoaster, we traveled through time twice, found Atlantis, blah blah blah blah blah blah blah, see? We've hardly done anything! We need a real challenge. We need to create the biggest, longest, funnest summer day of all time!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
