Dialog: Well, Vanessa, are you looking forward to seeing Tokyo on our daddy-daughter trip?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah... I was really hoping for Paris. I mean, I did drop all those hints, but I guess Tokyo is more exotic.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, that's why I chose Japan over Paris at the last moment! That makes perfect sense. There is no other ulterior motive behind it all, so, you know...

Name: Airplane Captain
Dialog: Uh, this is your captain speaking, we're expecting a slight delay for our arrival to Tokyo.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's always something. Turbulence, headwinds, giant jump-roping robots...

Name: Robot
Dialog: (Hanging on the jet airplane) I dangle, therefore, I am...

Name: Candace
Dialog: So Mom, while you're away, I'm in charge, right? For two whole days?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's right. Remember, no boys over.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course, Mom. Jeremy's in Paris anyway. So... When you say I'm in charge, what exactly do you mean by that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, to put it simply, I mean, "You're in charge."

Name: Candace
Dialog: So if Phineas and Ferb are up to something bust-worthy, and I am, as you say... "In charge", I have free reign to call you as many times as necessary?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Quite the contrary, Candace. Being in charge means you handle things yourself.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yup. Basically, if you're really in charge, you won't need to call at all. You see, if the boys are doing something bust-worthy, that means you're not doing your job and you would be in trouble too.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woah, woah, heavy! By busting the boys, I bust myself?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, there's the rub. Right next to the pair o' ducks. I'm also packing this book of puns!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Bye kids!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Mom! Bye, Dad! Have a nice time!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have a successful endeavor!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dreaming) Paris... French girls and... Jeremy... Iguana playing an oboe... (She sits up and calls someone) Stacy? I am freaking out here!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ugh... I'll be right over.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! Thanks! And could you bring some breakfast? (Stacy hangs up) Hello?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So Phineas, whatcha doin'... Up so early?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Today is the summer solstice, the longest day of the year! And Ferb and I are gonna make it even longer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So you built the Statue of Liberty?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No... (Sees his invention in shape of the Statue of Liberty) Oh, wow. That is weird. (He removes the sheet cover) Behold! The Amazing Sun-Beater 3000!

Name: Isabella/Fireside Girls
Dialog: Wow! Amazing!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a name followed by a big number!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's fast and it runs on vegetable oil, so it's environmentally friendly. In this ship, we will travel around the world as the sun does, making this, the longest day of summer, even longer! That'll give us twenty-four hours of continuous daylight; and add the extra fifteen hours we would've had anyway, that's almost a forty-hour day!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It can't be done! There's only twenty-four hours in a day and that's that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yes and no. You see, Buford, if you define the day by the passage of the sun, and we follow the sun by traveling around the...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, nah! Don't try to confuse me with your sorcerous ways. There's nothin' I've ever seen that would make me believe you could pull this off. Except for that time-machine thing, and oh, and the rollercoaster! But other than that, nothin'! Oh, and the time you played that song when the platypus came back, oh... Man, nature just bends to your will, doesn't it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, nothing's impossible if you believe you could do it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, I don't believe and therefore it's impossible. And what's more, I bet you can't do it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You bet us?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I bet you! And if you lose, you're gonna have to stand up in front of everyone and say that you are governed by the laws of physics and summer's not whatever you want to make of it. And what's more, you've gonna spend the rest of your summer doin' nothin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And what happens when we win?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hmmm... I'll eat a bug.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, you'd eat a bug right now if we asked.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Are you asking?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Buford
Dialog: All right. How about I give you back your bike I took when we were little?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My bike!

Name: Baby Phineas
Dialog: Bu gaga gu...

Name: Baby Buford
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Baby Phineas
Dialog: No... Bu gaga gu.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about this? When we make it back here before the sun sets, you gotta give everyone their bikes back.

Name: Random man
Dialog: Mine was the one with the unusually large front wheel.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I still get to eat the bug though, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I want the bug.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, what are you doing? You're putting your entire world view on the line. And for what? A bunch of bikes?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And a bug!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, it isn't about the bikes. It's about my world view. You see, we all gotta ask ourselves just one question.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Clay Aiken?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. I hired a stunt singer, what do you think?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (To Ferb) Chaka Khan. Nice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, hi, Agent P. Major Monogram isn't here right now, but he left this note. (Tries to mimic Major Monogram's voice) "Dear Carl, I haven't been kidnapped so don't come looking for him... I mean me." Kinda weird, though, that he took the time to cut each letter out of a magazine. Anyway, Doof is on vacation with his daughter in Tokyo right now which is where the Annual World Good Guy convention is being held, and Major Monogram is the keynote speaker. Coincidence? 100% yes! So I guess you got the day off!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All right, you got your breakfast. What's eating you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you know how Jeremy's in France for another week?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, so?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you know what they have in France?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The pyramids?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! French girls!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Come on, Candace. Everybody knows that you and Jeremy are an item.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not officially... He's never even called me his girlfriend. We've never even kissed! That means Jeremy's single, in Paris, and surrounded by French girls. I'm no fool, Stacy, I've seen the oil paintings.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, you got to believe in yourself. What do French girls have that you don't have?

Name: Candace
Dialog: At the moment, Jeremy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, if you want him to call you his girlfriend, maybe you should call him your boyfriend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can do that? I can use the B-word first?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sure, why not?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, and Stacy, pyramids? Really?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, right. That's Belgium, isn't it?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Look at this, it says that the tallest structure in Tokyo is the Tokyo Tower. And it even looks like the Eiffel Tower!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? It's just like we're in France! Oh, here's my bag now!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I can't believe you brought work with you!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, you've got some guy tied up in here.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, Vanessa. We've got some guy tied up in here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I've got a name, you know.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right. Vanessa, Major Monogram. Major Monogram, Vanessa. There, you happy now?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I've never been happy.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, let's go get a taxi.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'd prefer a town car.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quiet, you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we're getting a slight late start because of the broken wing, but here's the whole route. With stops in Tokyo and Paris to refuel.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're going to Paris?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, wanna come?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: To the City of Love?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Obliviously) That's what they call it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're asking me to go to the City of Love with you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, it'll be fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now, let me see if I got this straight...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey Dinner Bell! I'm goin' with you to make sure you don't cheat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. So Baljeet, you wanna come too?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, naturally--

Name: Buford
Dialog: I get one carry-on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right. Carry on, then. Did you get that wing fixed yet?

Name: Chaka Khan
Dialog: I guess so. We pretty much used up all the packing tape.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, the clock is ticking, everyone!(Candace comes outside, ripping through the map)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! What's going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're flying around the world to make the longest, funnest day of summer ever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no, no, no. Mom left me in charge, and I say you and your little friends are not going anywhere--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, check out this giant map!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Looks at the map) You're going to Paris...? France?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the plan. We'll have to stop and refuel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (There's a short silence while she thinks before she gets a determined look on her face) Like I was saying, you and your little friends are not going anywhere...without me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No, no, no, no, Candace! This is a bad idea! About as bad as you've ever had in a loong line, and I love you when you say this, really, really bad ideas.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, they're going to Paris! Where Jeremy is!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You promised your mom you'd keep your brothers out of trouble.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What better way to look after them than by going along and keeping them out of trouble along the way?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You realize that's a massive rationalization, don't you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah, totally.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, say hi to Jeremy for me! And hey, you should stop by and see my cousins in Tokyo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, did you get the giant map packed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, mad folding skills. You guys all ready?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ready for you to lose!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, everyone, make sure your tray tables are stowed and your seats are in their full and up--

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Okay, girls. We have roughly forty hours to get this backyard in line and set up for the party. Let's go, go, go!

Name: Clay Aiken
Dialog: Who left her in charge?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Here, make yourself useful. (hands him a rake)

Name: Clay Aiken
Dialog: (Stares) You know, we're only booked for the hour!

Name: Clay Aiken
Dialog: Scene opens with the Amazing Sunbeater 3000 flying over a body of water.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what did you guys think of the Pacific Ocean?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, probably like my fifth favorite ocean.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Next stop

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It says here that the Tokyo Tower is the tallest self-supporting steel structure in the world!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look down there, that guy just fell off his bike.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But..it says nothing about a...giant water balloon.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Suspiciously) Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do you like it?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: We're supposed to be on vacation.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, we'll be on our way as soon as Major Monogram drops this water balloon on the entire International Good Guy convention.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I would never pull an elaborate childish prank like that. It would ruin my reputation! Destroy my credita- oh, I see where you're going with this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! And best of all, without your leadership, it will totally put an end to the...yes... What's the name of your organization again?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The O.W.C.A. The Organization Without a Cool Acronym.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay. Well I'm going to put an end to Ah-ooh-CA, I guess...? Wow, that really isn't a cool acronym.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Told ya.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Tokyo, Japan.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Stacy has family down there. We should visit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're one step ahead of you, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here we are!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoops. (He clicks a button and the landing wheels pop out) I thought it sounded a little grindy and sparky.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Kon'nichiwa! Suteishī no tomodachi desu! ("Hello! We are friends of Stacy!")

Name: Bāchan Hirano
Dialog: Hey, everybody! Phineas and Ferb are here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Stacy sure has a lot of cousins.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, do you guys have any vegetable oil we can use? We need to refuel.

Name: Cousin
Dialog: Oh, sure. Obaachan owns a tempura restaurant.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks a lot! We'll say hi to Stacy for you! (The plane takes off, and everyone is still dancing) Man, Tokyo's a fun town!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have no idea what just happened.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No one in the Agency will ever believe that I dropped that water balloon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, they will. Because you're going to confess that you did it on-camera for the world to see!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You can't make me talk. I have nerves of steel and...an iron will and...gold teeth and a...copper spleen. Basically, I'm 35% metal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man. It must be hard getting through the airport.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, don't get me started. Anyway, you can't make me talk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah? (Puts his fingers on the Major's mouth as if he's the one talking) "I am Major Monogram. I dropped that water balloon. I have poopy pants." Eh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well. I stand corrected. That's actually very convincing.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad! This entire trip has been about your work! That's it! If you don't want to spend time with me, then I don't want to spend time with you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! Where are you going?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm going to the airport and I'm flying to Paris. (Perry lands beside her) Hey, Perry. (to Doofenshmirtz) Alone if I have to!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, wait! (Vanessa stops) You have all the traveler's checks.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Traveler's checks? Really?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ohh, did I say traveler's checks? Uhh, no, no... I do wanna spend time with you... Ohh look, look. I'll drop the water balloon right now and... (gets kicked by Perry)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cheese and crackers! Oh, excuse me, you two... But uh...is that button supposed to be blinking like that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yep! That means it's working!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ohh, this can't be good. (She gets hit by the water balloon and falls)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! NOO!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, they caught her! They caught her!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Vanessa?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No matter where we go, Ferb knows everyone.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Thanks, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a good thing we came along when we did. So where do we drop you?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't know. Where are you guys going?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we're off to Paris to refuel then back to Danville.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Can I just come with you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait... You saved her and now you're running off with her like...? OH! I have very mixed feelings about you! (to Perry) Uh... Perry the Platypus, how did you get here? I-I need a ride. Could you guys help me out?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're kidding, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! I have to save my daughter. This is a big deal! Oh please? Please please? Oh, please please-y weasy please please? Please?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Fine. But after we get her back, you're going to answer for what you've done here, mister.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, what? You were coming here, anyway, and... (He accidentally steps on the button and water balloon is released from the rope holding it to the tower and flies up into the sky) Oh, and uh... As far as flinging that water balloon into orbit, hehheh... (puts his fingers on Major Monogram's mouth again) "I did that."

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Seriously. When was the last time you washed your hands?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OK, everybody! Keep an eye out for Klimpaloon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Klimpaloon?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, Klimpaloon! The magical old-timey bathing suit that lives in the Himalayas!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're making that up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on Candace, does that sound like something someone would make up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh oh, we didn't calculate for the weight of an extra body.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will this affect our arrival in Paris?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm... let me let you know in about two seconds.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It IS going to affect our arrival in Paris!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: NANG NANG NANG NANG NANG NANG NANG NANG!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And you thought I'd made it up!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Do you even have any idea where we're supposed to be going?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fortunately, Vanessa's wearing the earrings I got her. They're made out of these cool little tracking devices. Look, see; the signal's not too far away but it's on the move. Thataway! Woohoo! Team Doofenshmirtz, go! (Perry and Major Monogram glare) What? Like I'm going to let you name the team? Organization Without a Cool Acronym?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, looks like you're gonna lose!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey! I believe my Uncle Sabu lives not far from here! Perhaps he can help!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Come on, let's go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Forget it. I'm staying with the plane.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And I'll keep her company.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Back in a few.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So Candace, what is Ferb short for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I...don't...know.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He is home!

Name: Uncle Sabu
Dialog: Ah, Baljeet and friends, I was expecting you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Uncle Sabu
Dialog: No, that's just something we say up here to freak out the tourists.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uhh, Uncle Sabu, do you live up here?

Name: Uncle Sabu
Dialog: Yes, it's quite a trek, isn't it? It used to be very inconvenient for me. But then I built my factory up here, and now it's inconvenient for everyone else!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you make here?

Name: Uncle Sabu
Dialog: Ohh, wait for it. There's a whole musical number.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what do you make here again?

Name: Uncle Sabu
Dialog: Okay everyone, back to work.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, I'm just kidding. Just kidding. Could we borrow one of these?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, I've got like...no bars here.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Let's see if we get a signal further up the mountain.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got her! She's down there on that craggy mountain. Quick! Let's land this bird.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The terrain is too treacherous. You're going to have to parachute. Here's your parachute, goggles and oxygen mask.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you have everything. How about a nice cup of hot co... (The seat ejects him) COOOOOOO!!! (Doofenshmirtz lands on the mountain and begins to roll down, gathering snow and accidentally making a giant snowball)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Do you hear a...rumbling noise?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, as soon as Candace and Vanessa get here, we can...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She and Vanessa are running from the giant snowball while Candace shouts) Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I think we may wanna start the plane.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Start the PLANE! Start the plane! Start the PLAAANE!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds like you're flooding it...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I'm not flooding it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Start the plaaane!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: INCOMING!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Start the plane! Start the PLANE! (She trips over a small hill, causing the snowball to miss her) Huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! How am I ever going to explain this to Mom?!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (passes by) NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG! NANG!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's NOT helping!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (walks away scared) NANG... NANG... NANG... NANG...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace! Hop on! (Candace gets on) All right! Hold on to something!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So, how'd it go?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're all out of rubber bands... But the good news is we're gonna crash into Paris.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How is that good news?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh? I thought you wanted to go to Paris?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah, I did.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm feeling very conflicted about this!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Scene opens with the gang in the Sunbeater 3000, most of the group look a bit messed up from the crash.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right gang, we made it to Paris. We need fuel and parts so we need to split up.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, my pants are way ahead of ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: According to this sdƃ, Vanessa's in some place called sıɹɐd. Hmm...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Paris! That makes a lot more sense. That's actually where she wanted to go. Good for her.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everybody, let's get going. Candace, you go see Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Way ahead of ya! (She runs off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet and Buford, you guys go scare up the fuel we need.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're still gonna lose, but do I like scaring things.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, why don't you go to the Eiffel Tower and get a reading on the trade winds?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Drives up on a scooter) Hop on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Vanessa, you rented a scooter!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uhh, yeah. Rented. (Ferb gets on and the two head for the Eiffel Tower)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm going to go see if I can go find some parts. Isabella, you want to come with me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: YES! I mean, yeah, sure, you know, whatever. It's all good, bro.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Jeremy's staying in the hotel La Poubelle. La Poubelle, La Poubelle, La Poubelle... (She sees a woman) Oh, pardonaise-moi, madam.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oui?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Une moment. Can you tell me... Oh, "Pouvaise-vous me dire" uh...

Name: Woman
Dialog: Can I tell you directions? It's okay, I speak English.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. I speak English. Parlais anglais. Uh, ou est la Hotel Poubelle?

Name: Woman
Dialog: It's just around the corner.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, around the corner, around the corner, "oh quan de la rou-ee?"

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oui.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, never mind. I'll find it myself. (She turns the corner and sees the hotel) Hey, Hotel Poubelle! It was just around the corner! (She sees Jeremy) There he is! Jer -- (She stops when she sees Jeremy talking and having fun with some French kids. She looks depressed before walking away. A mime appears where she was previously standing, letting go of a balloon)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So Phineas, what do you think of the City of Love?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish it was the City of Airplane Parts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, you're just too stressed. You should take a moment to relax and enjoy it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. That awning could be used as a sail. Or, you know, a parachute. Depending on how things go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if they still have pieces of that hanging around? The rivets would come in handy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Phineas...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look at that nifty little blow torch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if oil-based paint is combustible...as a rocket fuel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that reminds me, we might need helmets!

Name: Vendor
Dialog: Hey you! Stop letting my balloons go!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Now Buford, your mindless bullying may have a rustic charm stateside, but now we are in Europe. A place of high refinement. So let me do all the talking. (They go inside a restaurant and speaks with a man in a different accent) Excuse me, sir. Would you have any used cooking oil that we could have?

Name: Man
Dialog: Non.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ohh, the French are so intimidating!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Out of my way, runt.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not do anything too crazy!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Cracks his fingers) Excusez-moi mon bon monsieur. Auriez-vous par hazard un soupçon d'huile de cuisson que nous pourrions utiliser sans nous démerder un sou? (Excuse me, good sir. Would you by chance have a touch of cooking oil that we could use without losing a penny?)

Name: Man
Dialog: But of course.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (to Baljeet) Not one word about that to the others.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Pardonnez-moi, monsieur, are you throwing those away?

Name: Man
Dialog: C'est les ordres.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is about the plane, isn't it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well yeah, what else?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I guess we'll always have giant plastic baguettes.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't know, Ferb. I know he's my dad and I shouldn't blame him for being busy, it's just that...he always seems to put his work ahead of me. (She sighs) I just don't know what to do.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, sometimes if you love somebody, you have to meet them halfway.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Halfway, huh? Hmm. (Ferb looks and sees a flower shop as she's talking) You mean like, maybe I should take an interest in his work? I would but, it's actually evil. I just can't... (She looks to see Ferb is gone) Ferb?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! We've come to rescue you!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? I was just gonna... Wait. What do you mean "we"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I hitched a ride! You remember these guys, don't you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello again, young lady.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I can't believe you brought work with you again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Work? What do you... Oh, you mean them? No, Major Monobrow and Perry the Platypus, they...they were helping me find you!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Monobrow?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on. You've got that whole thing up here, it runs right... It's one straight line, for crying out loud!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's it. I'm getting my tweezers back from Carl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, Vanessa. I came halfway around the world to get you!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Halfway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, halfway around the world.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You met me halfway.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose you could put it that way.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You did, didn't you? You know what Dad, move over. I'm coming with you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, this is great, Vanessa! Why don't we talk to these guys for giving us a tour in Paris? We could go check out the Guillotine Museum!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Gross.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Bye, Ferb! Thanks for everything!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, the baguettes are rubber banded on. That should get us across the Atlantic. Why didn't we think of that in the first place?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sarcastically) Gee, I don't know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Where's Vanessa?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She went off with someone else.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's too bad. I thought the two of you, you know, a boy, a girl, alone in the City of Love. I thought romance was a forgone conclusion.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Grrrr! (Isabella looks on in surprise as he says this before finally breaking her pencil in anger)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Obviously) Isabella, did you say something?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Annoyed) I need a new pencil.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace. So how'd it go? Did you see Jeremy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I saw him. I just didn't talk to him.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's too bad. I thought, you know, the two of you, a boy, a girl, alone in the City of Love...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Grrrr! (Isabella reacts the same way as before but instead of breaking her pencil, her head explodes)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, are you okay?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (annoyed) Peachy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what happened?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you know when you know someone, and you see that they have another, like, life away from you and it feels weird?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Like when you see your teacher in the grocery store weird? Or like when someone you've known for a long time starts wearing a cowboy hat weird?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The...the first thing weird.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's good. 'Cause I was thinking about getting the cowboy hat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just... Jeremy looked like he was having a really good time here. And it suddenly seem creepy and obsessive that I came all this way. What if he doesn't wanna see me? Or came to Paris to get away from me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, like the song said, you have to believe you can!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think Candace may have missed that song.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, man, she was in the house!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?! You missed Clay Aiken and Chaka Khan?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh...apparently.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that's too bad. But the jist of it was that you gotta believe in yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that's easy for you, Phineas! Look at all the things you've done. Summer belongs to you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Summer doesn't belong to me. It belongs to everyone! And that includes you. You have to believe that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, my summer's been a series of failures. (Sadly) I have a hard time believing in anything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well...you got on this plane. You know, back when it WAS a plane. Which means you believe in us!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And we believe in you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And therefore, through the transitive property of belief, you do believe in yourself!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Besides, when we did all those things, you were right there with us!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was, wasn't I?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! You're Candace Flynn! Monster truck driver. Charioteer. Queen of Mars!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I am Candace Flynn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the spirit!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're right. I'm Candace Flynn! Lifeguard!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's right, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She starts climbing on the plane) Time traveler!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't break the engine!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She stands on top of the engine before shouting) I am Candace Flynn! Cou de Crayon!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It is you! I was just over there in the taxi and I saw you over... What are you doing here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, my brothers have this idea of flying over...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Your brothers? Say no more.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops, we slipped our mooring. Guess we're leaving. Hey Candace, better wrap it up! Looks like we're on our way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? No, not yet! I have something I wanted to tell you!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Really, what is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I wanted to tell you earlier but then I saw you in front of your hotel, with those kids, and the girl with the ice cream...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, were you spying on me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, it's just that I saw you and it was like...it was like my teacher wearing a cowboy hat!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I would hope my girlfriend would have a little trust in me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Shocked) Jeremy... You said the G-word!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, yeah, I used the...oh...ugh, hold on! (He runs to the opposite side of the bridge) Yeah, I used the G-word. It doesn't freak you out, does it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, because I think of you as my B-word.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, G-word. You want a K-word?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heheheh, maybe?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uhh...Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All set, Jeremy! Start kissin'!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace...!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Opens her eyes and sees that he's too far away) No, no, no, no, no, no!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: W-Wait, you can't leave now! You would...just get off on the next bridge!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't, I'm in charge of these guys. I-I gotta be responsible. I'll see you in a week, boyfriend!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you better take your seat.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. The week will be over before you know it. (A bit bitterly) At least you got a love scene on a bridge.

Name: Buford
Dialog: "Love is a canvas furnished by nature and embroidered by the imagination."

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Voltaire, Buford? Really?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, I can't help it. Paris does it to me every time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's four o'clock, we're on a baguette boat, with a fuel tank filled with snail grease. I have a good feeling about this. Okay everyone, hold on to something!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ohohoh, YEEAH!

Name: Mime
Dialog: (Gets splashed by water as the plane zooms past) Hey everyone! I can talk!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're almost to Le Havre harbour, Ferb. After that, it's nothing but an open ocean and a couple of remote islands! We should be home in no time! (He notices a huge ship blocking the way) Huh, well that might be a problem.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On the hovercraft) Hey, check it out! It's my giant water balloon!

Name: Sailor 1
Dialog: Would you look at that. Five kids in a jet-powered baguette boat in the middle of the Atlantic.

Name: Sailor 2
Dialog: Ahh, that reminds me of Karen Johnson.

Name: Sailor 1
Dialog: Everything reminds you of Karen Johnson.

Name: Sailor 2
Dialog: I hate being a sailor.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, looks like everything worked out the best! That giant wave put us back on schedule. We may even arrive in Danville ahead of time. You know, barring any foreseen mishaps. (The stirring wheel suddenly breaks off) Oh, like that. That's what I'm talking about. (The engine breaks) And that. (Another part breaks off) And that. (The baguettes fall off) And that. (Everything breaks except for the seats) This is all exactly what I was talking about earlier.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb, that was our worst landing yet. I'm beginning to detect a pattern here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! This isn't Danville; it's a deserted island! The only things on this island are us, a couple of trees and a big fat ox!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not you big fat ox, him big fat ox.

Name: Candace
Dialog: When Mom and Dad left me in charge, I never took into account that we might not make it back at all! Now we're stranded, and now I'll never get my kiss from Jeremy! (She starts crying and falls to her knees) It's the end of romance! Aaagh! (She curls into a ball on the ground)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs) You're gonna lose!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You do realize that you're stranded on this island too, right?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't care, I'm winning! (He laughs some more) I'm done.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas, how are we going to get off this island?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we'll just have to fix the boat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hopelessly) With what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's plenty here. All we need is our imagination! For instance, we could tie those two palm trees into a raft and add a super sonic outboard motor. Oh, wait...we don't have anything to cut the trees with and...we don't have an outboard motor. (He looks at the ox) Aaah, I know, we could soup up this ox so he could run on a conveyor belt that would charge the... Ohh, we don't have a conveyor belt and we don't have any soup.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Not to mention... You're never gonna make it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll make it! After all, we've got... Uhh... (He looks around) We've got the seats! We've still got one rubber band! And we've got... (He looks at the ground after seeing nothing else before he picks up handfuls of sand) We've got sand!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, maybe you could make an hourglass and watch the time slip away.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, thanks for the lift.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Before you leave, we have one more thing for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? What is it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Those are handcuffs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know what handcuffs are. I'm not an idiot! (to Perry) And not one word outta you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, there's a list of outstanding violations as long as your arm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ohh, well, I do have unusually long arms.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But we're on vacation!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, don't worry young lady. You'll be able to continue your vacation in 10–20 years.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm gonna beat the rap, though. I've been working on a rap-beat-inator. I just don't know if it works in France. I mean, if you see the electrical outlets here, I wouldn't even know where to start.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hold it right there! (She holds up what looks like a ray of some sort) Step away from the evil scientist!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! I'm so proud of you! You are evil!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm not evil. Just get in the car before they find out this is only a hair dryer.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is a hair dryer?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah. I got it in Tokyo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cool! But they didn't know it was a hair dryer when you pointed it at them, so...that means you're little evil!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, Dad. Maybe I'm a little evil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I knew it! (He cries in joy) That's okay... I'm not gonna cry...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, guess we could kiss that pair of handcuffs good bye. I don't about you, but I'm gonna go take in a review. See you back in the States.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Desperately) There, There's got to be some minerals or something down here that we can use! I mean, we can't...we can't just be stuck here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks, Ferb. I just don't know what to do, I mean...we were in Paris! The most romantic city in the world, and... (She sobs) he didn't even notice me! (She blows in the handkerchief) I just feel like giving up, and look at him!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look! A sponge and a starfish! There's gotta be something we can make out of this! Ah! Oh no, that's ridiculous! (He tosses them before going back down in the hole)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's as if I don't exist! I would give anything if he would just sit down with me and enjoy this beautiful sunset.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Desperately) We, we, we could—We, we we could dig a tunnel under the ocean and then we could, uh, we could...we can, we can...we...we can't. I can't...I can't believe there's nothing we can do to get off of this... (He sighs before he sits beside Isabella and says sadly) I guess at least we can sit and watch this beautiful sunset.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (She stands) No, you are not going to enjoy this beautiful sunset!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm not?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You built a rollercoaster through downtown! You made giant tree-house robots! You traveled through time for crying out loud! Twice!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, Isabella, there's nothing here for me to work with.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's not the Phineas Flynn that I fell in...(She pauses, and quickly rephrases what she was going to say) to...this...situation with. You showed us all in Ferb's map how this is possible and I'm not gonna let you sit there and --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb's map! (He jumps up) That's it! Isabella, you're the best! (He hugs her before turning to Ferb, unknowingly leaving Isabella in a trance) Hey Ferb. Let's see that map again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. We're here, and we need to go there. And we've got about... I'd say eleven minutes. Isabella, grab Madagascar and bring it over here to Ohio. Now Candace, you grab the Andes and fold it over the Main Greenland.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, folding the map doesn't actually make these places closer together.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know, I know! Crease it here. Buford, Australia over to Africa. Baljeet, Hawaii to Japan. (Baljeet pulls the map) No, no, East, East! Don't go West, you'll rip it! All right...now fold it here. Buford, one more crease down this line.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas.. I don't see how an origami unicorn is getting us off this island!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's not done yet, it needs one more fold. (He makes the last fold) There you go! Now wait...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no. No, no, no, no, no! There's no way I'm getting on that plane!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, wait. It's gonna work, you'll see!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think it's beautiful.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't encourage him. (to Phineas) Phineas, this is crazy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He grabs the rubber band and puts it around the two trees) Car-salesman crazy or mattress-salesman crazy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know... Neither!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's a relief. Isabella, Baljeet, get the seats!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, grab the ox!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Lifting the ox) This is the only way I'll actually hold him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, it's made of paper!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So was the Declaration of Independence!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but it wouldn't fly over 2,000 miles of water! Buford, why are you helping?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (carrying the ox) How often do you get to lift an ox?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Have I taken crazy pills?! There's no engine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: True, but we do have this rubber band made of super special den-si-ty!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just believe we can, Candace!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. Clay Aiken and Chaka Khan cannot both be wrong.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, apparently I missed some big musical number with Clay Aiken and Chaka Khan, okay? So can we please stop using that as a reference?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, it was just very inspirational.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not getting on that plane!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you won't see Jeremy again 'till we get off the island.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She thinks) I get a window seat!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, my horoscope said I would be riding an ox today. But I thought that was a figure of speech!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A little bit further... A little bit further... Okay, that'll have to do. We're almost out of time; everybody on the plane!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everyone ready? It's now or never!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Actually Phineas, I-I changed my mind. I wanna stay here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's just the mortal terror talking.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah...that's what I was...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, pull the release!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whatever, dude. It's not gonna --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! Look!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes, yes, yes!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What are you so happy about?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I finally ate a bug!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It looks like we're gonna make it! There's the Tri-State Area!

Name: Substitute teacher announcer
Dialog: Welcome to the 27th annual Substitute Teacher Day. We begin by...

Name: Substitute teacher announcer
Dialog: All right, who's the wise guy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang on, everyone! We're coming in!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, that's probably our best landing of the day. Great, the sun's still up and we're only five blocks away. Come on!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Road construction!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It took mom an hour get around that ditch!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There's only 58 seconds 'til sundown!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What kind of watch is that?

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no, no! Ohh, I actually thought we're gonna make it! I thought we were gonna do the impossible. For one shining moment...summer was whatever I wanted to make of it! Wait...this is my house! Hold on one second! I'm givin' everybody back their bikes!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But Buford, we didn't make it back to our yard. (Sees a ramp on the construction) I get it! Everybody, get your bikes!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Here's Ferb's, here's Phineas's, here's Isabella's... And here's, uh... A recumbent? Really?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Studies say it is better for your back.

Name: Buford
Dialog: How come I don't have to stand in line to bully you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, Buford never took my bike.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Noted.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's one right there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I'm not gonna get on a silly little tricycle.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, we're in a hurry. Just get on the trike, and we'll...

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's no way I'm gonna--

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (angrily) GET ON THE TRIKE!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, there's no way we're gonna clear that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just believe we can, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that another Chaka Khan reference? Because I thought I was clear...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You don't have to hear the song, Candace, you just have to believe!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I believe!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I believe!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I believe!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay...I belieeeeeeve!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What a long day. It seem like the sun would never go down.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Where are they?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Don't worry, they'll make it.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Seven seconds 'till sundown!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Maybe it'll help if we count!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Five! Four! Three! Two!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ONE!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! We did it! Oh my gosh, that was so great!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (She hugs Phineas) You guys are amazing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom, Dad!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, for us? That is so nice. And Candace, so responsible. Not a single phone call.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I didn't have international coverage.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Never mind!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Anyway, the party looks great. But you would not believe what a long day we've had. I think we're gonna turn in early.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You guys just enjoy the party, okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, you've heard him. Let's enjoy this party!

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, I'm taking a verse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Be my guest!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By Jove, I think she's got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's what I'm talking about!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! You came back early!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I missed my girlfriend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooh! I like the sound of that!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Besides you forgot something in France.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did? What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: This.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Waiter
Dialog: (to Perry) Would you like your (imitates Perry's chatter) with or without fromage?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mumbles happily, then wakes up and gasps) Wow, trippy! I'm having one of those lucid dreams where I'm aware I'm dreaming so I can control it.

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: (Floats up, holding a picket sign with a picture of Candace) I voted for you, Kevin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! I'm gonna fly too! Okay, focus, and-- (Jumps off and falls, She lands with a thud on what appears to be thin air next to her bed. the whole landscape begins to crack and rumble) Oh no! I've broken my mind! Reality's shattering before my eyes! AAAARGH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you're fine. It's all special effects. (Presses a button; Red grids flash and the place turns into Candace's room)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Special effects?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, cool, huh? Ferb and I are warming up before we meet our special effects hero Clive Addison today at the Science-Fiction and Fantasy Convention.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gets up) That explains why you're dressed in costumes from "Giant Losers

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, I'm dressed as Captain Lump Sharkboard from Space Adventure XIV. And Ferb is dressed as Hymie Silverman from Stumbleberry Finkbat and the Whining Wand of the Turtle Wizard. They're the two biggest movie series of all-time, and Clive Addison did the special effects for both.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Stop being related to me! And take all your mirrors, and zebras, and junk and get out of my room!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Zebras? (Ferb shrugs) Anyway, Ferb and I aren't in your room. We're already at the convention! (Presses a remote's button) Special effects! (He and Ferb disappear, as red grids flash on them. At the convention, a camera folds up and a briefcase closes) Look at it, Ferb. (Camera pans to the convention building) Science-Fiction and Fantasy, together at last. (Camera pans to him and Ferb) It's breathtaking. Let's get in there! Hey...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Where's Perry?" is written on this wanted poster, hanging on a tree. And we see this little hand reach up and tear the poster down and the music kicks in and all, "Chicka, chicka, chow, chicka, chow, chow, chicka, chicka, chicka, chicka, chow," and the opening credits start, like on one of those cool 80's TV shows with a voice over. You know...

Name: Major Monogram/Voice Over
Dialog: A fugitive, semi-aquatic special forces amateur stage magician, framed for a crime he didn't commit, the 1865 assassination of Abraham Lincoln, joins forces with a rogue-trillionaire inventor-extreme fighting champion from the future. Together with the aid of "R.I.C.K.", their super crime-fighting high-tech talking rickshaw, they'll bring hope, justice, and varying degrees of aquaticness to a Tri-State area in peril. Together, they are...

Name: Major Monogram/Voice Over
Dialog: Tonight's episode, Ham on Rye, Hold the Mayor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, in the future we won't sit and read newspapers in the morning. Instead, giant robots will control us in human death matches. (Camera pans to Perry, who is putting poker cards on the table) Well, that gives us something to look forward to.

Name: R.I.C.K.
Dialog: Good morning, team. (Small monitor comes out of the rickshaw)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's up, Ricky?

Name: R.I.C.K.
Dialog: I've detected some strange, out of character behavior from our mayor recently, which has me concerned. (His screen shows Roger, waving) Here he is from a news report over a year ago. (Camera switches to the footage) Notice how he waves, it goes side to side, see? (Replays the footage in slow-mo) Again, side to side. (His screen switches to another footage at night, with two men. One with a clipboard, the other with a big scissor, Roger, and Bridgette Oshinomi, with a chopped ribbon) Now, here's footage from just two days ago. (Roger lifts his hand) Watch. See? His hand goes up, and then he transforms into a wolf with fiery, red eyes, and runs howling into the misty night.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now that you mentioned it, that is unusual for him.

Name: R.I.C.K.
Dialog: We've got to somehow get close to the mayor, and find out what's going on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) We're gonna need a turban and a wig. And while I'm out, I'm gonna pick up some bagels. Anyone else want anything?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi Candace, Where are you off to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... I'm uh... going to Stacy's.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay honey. What's in the big bag?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Cautiously) Smaller bags.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great! Have fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isn't it magnificent Ferb? Special effects extravaganzas just have a way of bringing people together.

Name: Albert
Dialog: (Dressed as a dragon, speaking to Irving dressed in a costume similar to R2-D2) If you think Lump Sharkboard can defeat Hymie Silverman, the elf prince, than you are three phlorics short of a foxonian zipfeller, my friend!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh yeah? Well, you can carry your own action figures! (Opens the hatch on his costume, and various action figures spill out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (notices Clive Addison talking with some other men near a sign) Ferb! There he is! Clive Addison! Do you have our special effects demo reel? (Ferb holds up the reel) Yes! I can't believe we're going to meet him!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh! Phineas, you're just in time. Would you please tell this dragon loving heathen that the Space Adventures movies are superior to the Stumbleberry Finkbat movies in every way imaginable?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh...uh...uh... We're just... (He groans when Clive Addison walks away)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize you were in mourning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, it also took me awhile to accept the fact that I had no brother any more. (shoots a cursory look at Albert, who scowls back)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Irving
Dialog: They actually think all those magic elves movies are better than Space Adventure's epic science-fiction genius!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well I...

Name: Albert
Dialog: Stumbleberry Finkbat and the Lost Shadow of Darkling Tower alone, was smarter and more realistic then all the even-numbered Space Adventure movies combined!

Name: Finkie
Dialog: Yeah man! You tell him!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Realistic? Space Adventure is based on hard scientific fact. It's like watching a reality show from the distant future. (The crowd of Speckies agrees loudly)

Name: Irving
Dialog: As it should...a-be.

Name: Irving
Dialog: That fantasy stuff is for kids! It's almost as lame as dressing up as...Ducky Momo or something.

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Thank you for auditioning, but we're looking for something a little more dazzling for the mayor's ball.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No wait! We can dazzle, we can. I will now saw The Amazing Platydini in half. See? See? Platypuses, they're like butter.

Name: Assistant to the Mayor
Dialog: Mayor, we got this surveillance photo from the wig and turban supply store.

Name: Roger
Dialog: It's Doof 'n' Puss.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, Plati-padapbra!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Oh very impressive, Doctor Doofenshmirtz and Perry the Platypus! Now it's my turn to make you disappear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Ninja Vampires! I hate these guys.

Name: Ninja Vampire
Dialog: Wow, he's good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I picked the wrong day to stop carrying garlic scented throwing stars.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Picks up his phone) Hey Stacy, how's it going? No, I haven't heard from Candace.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What! See told me that she was hanging with you today.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Really? She told me the same thing about you. Anyway, I'm over at the Sci-Fi Fantasy convention with little Suzy. She's really into the kids stuff. You know, like Sea-Horsie Hospital, air you know, lame stuff like Ducky Momo. (Seeing a person in a Ducky Momo costume) Ooh.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ducky Momo!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Suzy? Wait, Suzy!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Aww

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know you can't run away like that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the Ducky Momo suit) Oh, that was close. (She removes the head of the costume) Why must it be so hard for a lifelong, closet Ducky Momo fan to go to a Science-Fiction and Fantasy convention, and find cool, rare Ducky Momo collectibles, without anybody discovering her dark, humiliating secret?

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on guys, aren't you blowing this all out of proportion?

Name: Irving and Albert
Dialog: No.

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Finkies
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Speckies
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Come with me Phineas, you should meet with the Almordian Council. They'll set you straight. (They walk off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, what about Ferb?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, forget about him, he's nothing to you anymore. (pushes Phineas in front of him as he walks off)

Name: Albert
Dialog: (to Ferb) Well, I guess I'm your new brother. Carry my action figures?

Name: Irving
Dialog: We seek counsel with the exalted one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Baljeet is the only sixteenth level Space Adventure trivia master in the world.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I feel a minor disturbance in the universe, almost as if... (A toilet flushes, and Clive Addison walks out of the stall) Nope! Now it is gone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Okay. It's Clive Addison!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Pay attention! I have unfortunate news to report master. Ferb is... dressed like an elf!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, and is costume's really cool too. He spun his own wool, and the headband's made of--

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh for the love of humillian dorphite! We lost Ferb too?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's not "lost". He's just enjoying a different genre.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Never! The line must be drawn here! (gets up and shines a flashlight beside Phineas) Right between Phineas and his loved ones.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh come on. Did you ever consider that fans of Space Adventur-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Speckies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right, speckies. Have more in common with fans of Stumbleberry Finkba-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Finkies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe Speckies and Finkies have more in common then they do differences.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! Bite this prop tongue from episode eight! (produces said prop tongue)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have you ever tried talking to them?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Talk!? Have you met the leader of the Finkies?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm sure you're wondering why I, Buford, have taken a leadership role in such a geek-centered enterprise. Well, take a look around! This place is crawling with nerds! I'm like a kid in a candy store! Plus, I relate to the character of Odaf Underhump and his complex emotional inner journey.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I seriously doubt this will work. Buford is not a man of peace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nonsense, I'm sure Buford will be reasonable.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! No space bunnies allowed!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am not a bunny rabbit! I am an Almordian Vanksloth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's time to end this silly feud, so we can all enjoy Clive Addison's special effects presentation. Baljeet, you prepared a peace treaty.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did. (Clears his throat) We Speckies vow to live in peace and harmony with you Finkies. All that we ask is that you admit that Space adventure is much better than Stumbleberry Finkbat, and that you have brought eternal shame to your families believing otherwise.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Umm... that's not really what I said-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh yeah!? You and what army?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your question makes no sense as a response to what I just said.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, how 'bout this? (Ties Baljeet's costume's ears into a knot)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (feels about on top of his head and becomes angry when he discovers the knot) Alright, so it is war then!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bring it on, Speckies! We're gonna go all Hyborian age on you!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is not even a real age!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Sighs) To quote Lump Sharkboard from Space Adventure Sixteen...Glorf.

Name: Major Monogram/Voice Over
Dialog: We now return to

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He and Perry are tied up inside of a storage closet) Well what did you expect? It was like twenty of them, against one-and-two-halves of us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look! It's the mayor! Get him!  (leaps at Roger)

Name: Roger
Dialog: (After being wrestled across the room) Knock it off. I'm the real mayor, that other guy is a shape-shifter posing as me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know that's funny, you know, even while I was attacking, I was thinking; Why would did he tie himself up in a dark closet with us? Wh-what kind of a plan is that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Oh, you've freed yourself with your amazing magician skills!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And also scissors.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now we've done it, Ferb! We brought the entire convention to the brink of an inter-genre geek war. It's us to extend the olive branch of diplomacy. I'll go talk to Buford, and you can talk to Baljeet. May the luck of Sluffon be with you.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Always.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo Plushies. Momo Collectible Card Game. Momo the Movie! Oh, the Momo-ness of it all! The sheer Momosity!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ducky Momo!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Wait for me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy! Oh that poor sap in the costume.

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's relentless! (She runs into the "Alien nest")

Name: Speckie
Dialog: Hey! No cutting!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Runs in after Candace) I want to see inside you head!

Name: Speckie 2
Dialog: These Momo nuts are such an embarrassment.

Name: Speckie 3
Dialog: Seriously.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Ducky Momo? Where are you? Ducky Momo? (an alien roars, causing Suzy to run out of the nest screaming) Ducky Momo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! Now If I could just find one piece of Ducky Momo merchandise I don't already have, all this would be totally worth it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I've got to get to Buford, but how to approach it?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Working on your battle strategy, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What? No! I-I mean... yes! Yes I am. In Fact, there's a way you can help.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Me? Help you? My manipulator-slash-grasper is at your command!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! We'll have to modify your costume a bit to get behind enemy lines.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Enemy lines!?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, Mr. Barbarian, Sir.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why do you disturb my brooding on the eve of war, stumpling?

Name: Irving
Dialog: I come bearing a message. (A holographic project of Phineas appears)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Witchcraft! What trickery is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Greeting, all-mighty Odaf Underhump.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Phineas, your kind is not welcome here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just hear me out! In a theatrical landscape that's drowning in comedy, romance, and thought-provoking ecological docu-dramas, Finkies and Speckies are all outcasts. They should be friends.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There are no friends in these halls, Phineas. There are only my people, and those who must be destroyed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But that's jus--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hold your words, outlander! Once Odaf Underhump has made a hasty and ill-informed decision, he cannot be swayed.

Name: Speckie 1
Dialog: Go home Finkie, your kind isn't welcome here.

Name: Speckie 2
Dialog: Did you see that?

Name: Speckie 1
Dialog: He just vanished.

Name: Speckie 2
Dialog: He must be employing some kind of cloaking device.

Name: Speckie 1
Dialog: No, it's an elven cape of invisibility, duh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My time is limited, Magician. I must gather my positronic impulses for the coming battle. Speak.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha! You cannot charm me with your silver tongue, Elf Prince.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And your magic rune signs have no power in this dimension.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This conversation is over. Transport him away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This day isn't turning out like I'd hoped at all.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: (standing behind him) I know how you feel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Clive Addison! We're your biggest fans!

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Thanks, man. It's just too bad there aren't more of you out there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's crazy! Everyone here loves your work. In fact, the only reason they're not in line to see you is that they're about to go to war over which of your movies is better.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Oh man, I don't wanna hear that. I became a special effects artist to join the nations of this earth together in peace and hope.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, what other reason is there for creating cool visual effects for film and television? ...Special effects! That's it! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do from this point in the day on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we'd better do it fast. Look!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You cannot resist our superior technology!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (lifting his arms) Smell my barbarian pits!

Name: Crowd of Speckies
Dialog: Eww!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yuck!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let's do this.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Draws his flashlight) Ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The coast is cl-- (Gasps) I don't believe it. That's the rare Ducky Momo commemorative plate where they accidentally printed the wrong the wrong saying. (The plate reads; "I Hate People!") Score! All I have to do is get over there without drawing too much attention to myself.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Charge!

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Charge again!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Eat laser, Hymie Silverman!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (After rolling dice against Buford) Haha! That gives me a five points weapon skills advantage. You lose an arm!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine, it'll be back. Odaf Underhump has a healing factor of eight!

Name: Mayor's Assistant
Dialog: And now to present his various new, pro-ninja vampire laws, here he is, the totally, for real, Mayor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Freeze punk-fake mayor guy!

Name: Fake Mayor
Dialog: You want me? You come get me! (He then transforms into a giant pint muscled monster)

Name: Voice Off Screen
Dialog: Wait hold on a second.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, what?

Name: Jeff McGarland
Dialog: You can't just throw a monster in to the end of a story because you're stuck for an ending. It's lazy. It's lazy writing.

Name: Irving
Dialog: What is that thing?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (holding up a black box) I do not know! Those readings make no sense!

Name: Irving
Dialog: That's a pencil sharpener.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How is that information helpful at this juncture?

Name: Jeff
Dialog: On, on second thought I love it. You may have tied me up next to-what is this? A beaver or something? (Referring to Perry) And, and pitched me a TV series against my will, not to mention holding up the autograph line. But my advanced TV executive instincts tell me your show is going to be a big hit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! I'm going to have my own show, on television! And then, all of these fans will be so in awe of me, they will do my bidding. It's actually happening! I am going to rule the Tri-State Area!

Name: Jeff
Dialog: Just a thought though, can we get the platypus a girlfriend?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What! Never! Oh, so suddenly you know my character better than me? Forget it! I'm no sell out. I just crassly calculated commercial appeal in a mad quest for financial gain. No, no my artistic integrity and I are out! Peace!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford! Just what do you think you are doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What does it look like? I'm running away, hoping that while the monster is busy eating my friends, I can escape.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Is that what Odaf Underhump would do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pause) No, no it's not. He'd never run from a fight.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Exactly, no hero would, no matter what the genre. And neither will we!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And, we'll win.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fantasy...

Name: Buford
Dialog: And science fiction...

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Together! (they pump their fists in the sky together)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Archers! Regroup and protect the left flank.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ion-Laser cannons, push him back to the center.

Name: Lady
Dialog: That'll be fifteen dollars.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here.

Name: Lady
Dialog: So, you a fan of Ducky Momo? (snickers)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, why do you ask?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! Look, they've joined together to defeat our monster.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Oh guys, this is soooo cool! Watch this man, I'm gonna make him lurch to the right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is that thing? It's like a nightmare, or... (Notices the projector Phineas and Ferb are using to create the monster) a lucid dream. Of course! Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Rootah dez-tu valoomus!

Name: Albert & Irving
Dialog: Rootah dez-tu valoomus!

Name: Albert & Irving
Dialog: Brother!

Name: Albert & Irving
Dialog: Rootah dez-tu valoomus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you dweebs doing? Don't you get it? This is all baloney! It's just special effects. And even if it were real what good would this stuff do? Plastic blasters? Rolling dice? You think you could stop a think like that by waving a wand and saying; "Eugie beugie weugie!"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe that actually worked.

Name: Kid 1
Dialog: Ducky Momo defeated the monster!

Name: Buford
Dialog: My people have much to learn from your people. You must tell me how to shoot a blaster someday.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Absolutely, and you can teach me how to wield a club.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm afraid that information is proprietary.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (taking off mask) Look everybody, it's me. Candace Flynn. I'm the one you love! And I love Ducky Momo!

Name: Kid 2
Dialog: Look, she's a teenager and she's dressed as Ducky Momo! Oh that's lame, even if she did save us.

Name: Kid 3
Dialog: She came dressed as Ducky Momo. Negative.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Man, fickle crowd.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! That was so cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Jeremy. You're not too embarrassed to talk to Ducky Momo?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Maybe Ducky Momo Isn't that lame after all. Someone else seems to really like him too.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I love you Ducky Momo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo loves you too Suzy.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: I gotta say guys, that was, hands down, the best special effects show ever. And I've been at Burning Man. Your holo-projection device is brilliant!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Mr. Addison! That means the world coming from you.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Well it's just really clear that you two are going to have an amazing career in special effects ahead of you. And if that's what you want, give me a call in ten years and I'll hire the both of you in a heartbeat.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually what I'd really love to do is direct.

Name: Clive Addison
Dialog: Oh, you and me both.

Name: Voice over
Dialog: We now return to, The Platypus & His Girlfriend.

Name: The Platypus's Girlfriend
Dialog: Now Mr. Mayor, I will saw the amazingly handsome Platy-dini in half.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Watching the show) Ahh, he was right. This is better. I should have sold out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from inside) Enough moping around, Candace. (cut to inside Candace's room where Candace is sitting on her bed, she approaches her.) Phineas and Ferb said they've devised a fun way to wash the house. Why don't you join them? Have some fun for a change!

Name: Candace
Dialog: For a change? I have lots of fun!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You mean, obsessively trying to bust your brothers for their mystery crimes? Is that "fun"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have fun. I'm like the queen of fun! I have fun all day!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I can tell. Well, if you just sit inside today, you should at least do a little reading.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's one of my favorites.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Wizard of Oz. Isn't this for babies?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Or you could wipe down Perry's platypus plaza play set.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Opens book) I'm reading, I'm reading!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'll be at my weight lifting class. Have fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah! Oh, my eyes hurt! (to a picture of Jeremy) Oh, Jeremy, you're the only one who understands-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AHH! Buford, Baljeet, what do you two want?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What, like in a metaphysical sense? Nothing. I'm good.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I want to be cool!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's not gonna happen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, why are you looking in my window, duh!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, Ferb says I should tell you we're about to start washing the house, and you can help us out if you want!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not likely.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Either way, you might want to put on some waterproof undergarments.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you get out of here?!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opens book again) Blah blah Dorothy, blah blah Kansas. There's a cyclone coming?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay Ferb, let her lift.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Flies off bed) AH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Take your positions everybody! And remember, even strokes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do you guys always wash the house like this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sometimes, we give it a bath,

Name: Phineas
Dialog: but the city's using the tub as a reservoir.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa! What's happening? (Gargling) Phineas! Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Full speed now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (echoes) Try to have fun!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (echoes) I want to be cool!

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: (echoes) Hello.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (echoes) I don't want nothin'!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (echoes) Waterproof undergarments! Wheeeeeeeee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (echoes) Hey! I wonder where Perry went?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew! Gross! Perry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, wow! (Her perspective of a different landscape) Perry, I don't think we're in Danville anymore.

Name: Dream Fireside Girl
Dialog: You're in Patchkinland! We're Patchkins, and we welcome you because,... (sing-song) Little Witch Suzy was a louse, now she's squished under your house!

Name: Little Witch Suzy
Dialog: (muffled) I'm alright!

Name: Dream Fireside Girl
Dialog: I have saliva.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gross!

Name: Dream Fireside Girl
Dialog: Eyeball!

Name: The Patchkins
Dialog: Eyeball! Eyeball!

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin'? (walks up to Candace) I'm The Good-Witch, Isabella. Welcome to Patchkinland!

Name: Little Witch Suzy
Dialog: (muffled) Hello?! Can someone get this off me?!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: (shouting in the background) Don't touch those boots!!!

Name: The Patchkins
Dialog: Witch! Witch! Witch!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Not witch, Warlock! It's a robe! Not a dress!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: I suppose I should thank you for squishing little Suzy.

Name: Little Witch Suzy
Dialog: (muffled) I'm okay, if you'd just lift this house off me!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: But I won't, because I'm wicked! Heeheehee. I'll just take these little boots, and be right on my--

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: What? What happened?!? Where are my boots?!?

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: Right there... on Candace.

Name: Little Witch Suzy
Dialog: (muffled) Now my feet are cold.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Give me those boots!

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: She doesn't have to give you anything! You have no real power in this part of Odd!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Wrong! I have the power of positive thinking! True, it doesn't really... help me this instance, but you can't stay in Patchkinland forever! That's right! I'll get you,... and your little platypus too.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (Growls back defiantly)

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Now, check me out as I disappear into an evil cloud of black smoke! Ha ha!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: You know, I'm just gonna use my bus pass.

Name: Little Witch Suzy
Dialog: (muffled) Seriously! Can someone get a jack or something?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know how, but I bet Phineas and Ferb are behind all of this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Stop! How did you--? (Growls in frustration, then walks toward The Good-Witch, Isabella)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, Eyeball girl! Where can I go to bust someone around here?

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: You can always try Bustopolis. That's where the wizard lives.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can the wizard bust my brothers?

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: You bet'cha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How do I get there?

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: Well, listen to this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Police Officer
Dialog: Nothing to see here, move along.

Name: The Good-Witch, Isabella
Dialog: So, remember, if you wanna bust your brothers, stay on the yellow sidewalk! (floats away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I hope there's not gonna be a lot of singing in this thing. (sighs) How much further is this "Bustopolis"?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: For some of us, it is a world away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you supposed to be?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: I am a nerdcrow. I hang in cornfields, wedgie-style, to keep the crows away. They would not be caught dead anywhere around me. For you see, despite of my above average mathematical skills, I am not cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's fascinating. But, I'm on my way to Bustopolis to ask the wizard to bust my brothers.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: The Wizard?!? (falls to the ground) Oof! Do you think the wizard can do something for me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you want?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Allow me to put it in song!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (interrupting) Alright! That's enough!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I get it. You want to Bustopolis and ask the wizard for coolness, right?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: (eagerly) Do I!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine, you can come along.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Boy, howdy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, no singing, and don't stand too close. Too close!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace! So, you two on your way to Bustopolis? 'Cause Ferb and I made a more fun way to get there. We've built a beautiful horse path through a candy forest, and genetically engineered some unicorns to ride.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no. No, we are staying on the yellow sidewalk.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Do I have a say in this matter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. Let's go!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Yes, Candace.

Name: Phineas
