Dialog: Sorry you're gonna miss out on all of the fun! (to Ferb) I'll race you to marshmallow meadow, Ferb. (while riding unicorn with Ferb down the horse path) Well, this is fun. It's a little girly for us, isn't it?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, it is Candace's dream.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: It's not witch! It's warlock! Argh! Let me just check my security.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: (Beep) The front door looks good.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: (Beep) The back door looks good.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: (Beep, then shows Agent P climbing up) The platypus outside my window looks good.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: (shocked) The platypus outside my--

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Ooh! Oh! Gross!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Hey. I know you... you're with that little boot thief, right? Well, I'm going to send out my flying squirrels after her! (sighs) Those stunning little planes, they're cute, but, you know, that they don't fly so fast. We've got some time.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: How much farther do we have to go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All I know is, Phineas and Ferb are behind all this, and if I follow this sidewalk, I will bust them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute, I know this. There should be an oil can around here.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: (clears throat) Could you leave the lumberjack alone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Forget this! (throws the rusted tin man away, a crash is heard) Oh, hi! I-I couldn't help, but notice that you're, um...

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: A tree?

Name: Candace
Dialog: A-ttractive.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: It's OK. I know I'm a tree.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, we're gonna go and see if the wizard can go and grant our wishes. Uh,...do you have a wish?

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Do I have a wish?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: How come he gets to sing--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (covering Nerdcrow's mouth) Shhhh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooo. I can't wait to find out. Come on, let's go.

Name: Nerdcrow
Dialog: Aren't you just going to wish not to be a tree?

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Shhh.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Girls like a little mystery.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace. From this point, you have two routes to Bustopolis.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: On your right is a yellow sidewalk through a terrifying beastbog.

Name: Beastbog
Dialog: We have saliva!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And on your left, Ferb and I have built a frozen non-dairy treat sidewalk through an ice cream canyon. You can skate it and lick it for the ultimate favorable fun.

Name: Nerdcrow and Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Ice Cream, ICE CREAM!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no, you don't! We're staying on this sidewalk until we meet the wizard and you're busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Crow, Tree, let's go!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet), Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Yes, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well... there is only one thing left to do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoo-hoo! Yeah! Whoo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is better than an ice cream canyon, isn't it?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Oh, yes, I much prefer rotting vegetation and blood-sucking demons.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Sure are some scary looking trees in here.

Name: Creepy Tree
Dialog: Hey, we can't all be movie stars.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I... I... I think there's something up there.

Name: Stacy-Owl
Dialog: Whoo?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AHH!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: What is that?

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Where?

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: There!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It looks like a lion.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: No, looks like a tiger.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: I think it is a bear.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: No, I'm a combination lion, tiger, and bear.

Name: Candace, Jeremy-Tree, Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Oh, my!

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: If I had a nickel every time I heard that...

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right! Let's blow this pop stand! (pauses) What? (another pause) Oh, fine. (at Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)) My friends and I are going to Bustopolis to each get something from the Wizard. Do you want to come? There!

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Nah. I don't want nothin'.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ok. Chop, chop, fellas! Time's a-waistin'.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: But I am reminded of a song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, at least it was short. Come on!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet), Jeremy-Tree, Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Yes, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace. You guys could continue walking through this damp bog, and that would be awesome. But if you'd like to take the more fun route to Bustopolis, Ferb and I have built...

Name: Candace
Dialog: A blue sidewalk?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A bouncy sidewalk! What do you say, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think you already know my answer. Step it up, freaks!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet), Jeremy-Tree, Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Yes, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ok, have fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls in frustration)

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Soon those boots will be mine! In the meantime, I'm going to leave you in the capable hands of my spider-monkey, or maybe a monkey-spider. I don't know what he is. Hehehe.

Name: Spider-Monkey
Dialog: (laughs, then grabs Agent P's fedora; only to get punched by a boxing glove) Owww!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bouncy sidewalk. I'm keeping my eyes on the prize!

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Hey, what's that?

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Looks like a squadron of flying squirrels!

Name: All
Dialog: AHHHH!!!!

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Hey! What are you doin'? Ow, ow, ow! I can't believe I'm doin' this for nothin'!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: I wish I was still hanging by my underwear! Just kidding!

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Come on! I'm a tree! I'm friends with squirrels! ... Oh, snap. (to Nerdcrow (Baljeet)) Oh, that's got to hurt.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: You get use to it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Squirrels! Squirrels! Whoaaaa! AHHH!

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Oh, no. The squirrels have got Candace!

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: We've got to do something!

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: I got nothin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace. We're taking the bouncy sidewalk. Of course, your way looks fun, too.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not having fun, and neither will you if I ever get back to the yellow sidewaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaalk!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Kidnapped by flying squirrels and stuck in a web that came out of a monkey's butt. Hm. Well, I guess I have had weirder days.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There you are, Perry.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Silence! I've got you now, missy. You may as well hand over those boots.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I would, but they've kind of grown on me.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: I know. They're nice, aren't they? And the color really set off your eyes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, really. They've grown on me. I can't take them off.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: If I can't take the boots off of you, I have to get you out of the boots, and by that, I mean, disintegrate you entirely!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry, I'm sorry I got you into this mess. Forget about me. Save yourself if you can.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if it's that easy...

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Ahhh! Get him off of me! Ahh! He could have rabies! ... Oh, I hate spider webs! ... Guards!

Name: Guard #1
Dialog: Uh. ... Ready?

Name: Guard #2
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Getting our wishes will not be the same without Candace.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: I miss her, too, even if she was a little bossy.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: I need a firm hand.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Look! It is Candace's pet platypus. Has he always have that hat?

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: What's he want?

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Could be rabies.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Gentlemen, we're out to stop Doofenwitch. You want to rescue the girl. I see an opportunity for some inter-agency cooperation. Now, here's the plan. Wait, why am I a fairy?

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: See this hourglass? When this sand runs out, that’s when this big electric timer begins. And when that time runs out, it activates the Brat-Begone-Inator to vaporize you right out of your boots! Haha!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Ooo! Someone is at my door! (opens door) Hello?

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Hi! You've been selected for a free haunted castle makeover from Witches Brew magazine.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Not witch! Warlock!

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: What about the dress?

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: It's a robe! Whatever, I'm not going to turn down a free makeover. Come on in. I'll show you around.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: I see you have a bunch of spider webs. Sure, they're classic, but overdone. We say it's more of a modern witch.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Warlock!

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Yeah, whatever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! Weren't you taller? ... Perry! Quick! Get me out of here before that whatever -inator zaps me. ... Haha! That tickles! (giggles)

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: I like it!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Ooh! My Begone-Inator! I'm going to check my crystal ball.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: (whacks the crystal ball) Come on! Doofy wants a new pair of boots! What's this? (gasps) Well, they won't get away so easy this time!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Why did you do that?

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: It's part of the makeover.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Wait a minute! Guards! Again!

Name: Guard #1
Dialog: Dude.

Name: Guard #2
Dialog: I'm good.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Run for it!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Don't let them escape!

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Candace! Perry!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Ahahaha! How convenient! Everyone's all together.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Yeah, we're kind of expected in Bustopolis. You know; the Wizard, great and powerful.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Shut up! You're a tree!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute! You can't talk to Jeremy like that!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Put that bucket down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Melt, evil witch!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: You little brat! This outfit is 100% cotton. ... Oh, it's shrinking! It's shrinking! I have to go to change my clothes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, I only meant to melt you.

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Guards! Dispose of them while I switch into my track suit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dispose of us?!? You... you really don't want to do that, do you?

Name: Guard
Dialog: Well, no, but nobody ever asked us what we want to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: 'Well, what do you want to do?

Name: Guard
Dialog: There's a little number we've been working on. Hit it, boys.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: What the hey! Everyone gets to sing but me?

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: I'm back! Sheesh, no need to celebrate. I've been gone a minute. Wait! Where are my prisoners? ... Oh, they're escaping, you fools! After them! Raise the drawbridge!  ... Oh, great! The monkey is the only one working here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! Now what? ... No way!

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Hold on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahhhhh!!!!

Name: Doofenwitch Warlock
Dialog: Curse you...! Ahhh!!! I'll get you! Ahhh!!! Oh, forget it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Isn't this fun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fun? Not if you think so! ... Huh? ... Squirrel! Squirrel!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, tough luck, and over the Sea of Razor Sharp Rock Spires, too. ... Good thing it's so inappropriately named.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Hey! Look over there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bustopolis! Come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The stuff Phineas and Ferb made! It’s all here! The ultimate bust!

Name: Elf
Dialog: Follow the yellow...!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, shut up!

Name: Elf
Dialog: Well! (gets trampled)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fun way to the top, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Forget it! I'm taking the yellow stairs! (Runs up said stairs)

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Three please.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello? I'm Candace the me and... ... Whoa! ... Guys, you're making look bad in front of the Wizard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, hello? I would like speak to the Wizard, please.

Name: Wizard (Linda)
Dialog: Hello, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? You're the Wizard?

Name: Wizard (Linda)
Dialog: Well, I'm a whiz at the kitchen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This time the boys are so busted! Have you seen what they're been up to?

Name: Wizard (Linda)
Dialog: Up to? Why, no. I...

Name: Wizard (Linda)
Dialog: Oops, that's the oven. Boys, could you hand out the gifts while I check on the casserole?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas? Ferb? But... but... but... but...

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Does this mean I will not receive coolness?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, coolness is such a rare and indefinable quality that a few people really have it. Most people wear a pair of these and fake it.

Name: Nerdcrow (Baljeet)
Dialog: Hey, works for me, chili cheese.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, don't over-sell it. (to Jeremy-Tree) So, Jeremy-Tree. You want to be a real boy instead of a tree, hmm?

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: Well, yeah, but I'll bet you don't have anything in your bag for me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The problem with you is, you're completely delusional.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: I am?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. You've been a real boy all along. You're just wearing a tree costume.

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: He's right. There's a zipper right back here. Hey, let me get that off for you.

Name: Jeremy-Tree
Dialog: (gasps) I'm free!!!... and I'm in my underwear… (Jeremy quickly covers up his underwear)

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: Yes. Yes, you are.

Dialog: Snoresville Central, Candace Speaking.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, good. You know how my mom wants me to take things more seriously and focus on more important things like grades, my future, or becoming a doctor, a lawyer, or a doctor?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, she's forcing me to go to this leadership seminar today, and I'll implode with boredom if I go by myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you out of your mind?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There might be cute boys there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, all right, but you owe me big time!

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: This year's All Terrain Vehicle goes on the road and in the mud. In the mud and on the road! It's the all new All Terrain Vehicle for All Terrain...seh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Road and mud aren't exactly all terrains. (To Ferb) Somebody ought to build a vehicle that actually goes over all terrains.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Two, three, four...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Five, six, seven...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Uh, oop! Uh, hold on a sec. (grunts while turning his camera upside down) There we go! Doofenshmirtz has been spotted buying television cameras, boom mics, and makeup. Find out what he's up to.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ladies?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Baljeet, this seminar is for high school kids. What are you doing here?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I usually attend college level conferences, but I thought I would dumb it down for the weekend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (To Stacy) Uhh, are we supposed to take notes?

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Leaders of the Future, let's give it up for...Tedd Shaw! (reveals himself as the crowd applauds) Greetings, Leaders of the Future! I am Tedd Shaw. I may be young, but you're never too young to be a success! So, get ready to learn my easy steps which should be your goals, woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, brother.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, fellas, what's on the menu for today?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: An All Terrain Vehicle. With an electromagnetic motor, super rubber tank treads, high speed ceramic body, hydraulics and old remote control.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, let's take this baby for a spin, and see what she'll do!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can ride on the road, and in the mud!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, so good of you to volunteer for my cause! Since the cost of evil went up, my alimony checks barely cover my overhead. So, I've come up with a brilliant idea. The Telethon of Evil! With lights and a camera and uh, ooh, and a tote board, look. People will call in and send me money, and you can help man the phones. (puts a phone on Perry's lap) I had trouble finding a station that will put it on, so I invented this

Name: Tedd
Dialog: So, let's review. We've learned the principal of B.L.A.R.F.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (snoring)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That makes me wanna B.L.A.R.F.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can see it is already working.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Now, we go down to another secret of success. N.A.R.G.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isn't that...nary-g?

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Please hold all questions until the end, thank you. Now, can you see how N.A.R.G.-ing could help you... (at a girl) become president of the United States?

Name: Girl
Dialog: Yes! Yes I can!

Name: Tedd
Dialog: (at Stacy) And you! (at Candace) Do you have a goal you never wanna stop realizing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah. I've wanted to bust my brothers all summer.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: And have you used these steps?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Believe me, I've B.L.A.R.F.-ed and N.A.R.G.-ed plenty. I got nowhere.

Name: Tedd
Dialog: Well, I'm gonna tell you the final step to breaking your old, ineffectual patterns...right after the break! So, don't you go anywhere!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, did you hear that? Wake up!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (startled) Uhh! It's not my ferret!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This could really be the answer to me busting the boys. That weird guy is gonna tell us the final step after the break! Can it be that I'll finally achieve my summer goal? (hears revving) Wait, is that...? (sees the ATV) It is, it's Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Kids
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, do you wanna give it a try?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at Stacy) Oh, no. I'm going to do it right this time. Even though every fiber of my being is screaming to tell you to stay here and find out the information, then run frantically out to that ATV and drive my brothers to Mom who'll bust them, I will resist! Yes! I am going to stay right here and break my old pattern!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Good choice, Candace. I can't tell you have a p-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, take notes for me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me in!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, then, buckle up!

Name: Chad
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, do you know if there happens to be any seats left?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There just happens to be an empty seat next to me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I learn some skill that...Phineas, you're in the drivers seat, why are you operating with a remote control?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, We're too young to drive.

Name: Buford and Isabella
Dialog: Duh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no matter, because we're driving this thing home. I'm calling Mom to make sure she's there to see this. (dials phone) You're going too slow! Give me that thing! (takes remote) So, how does this thing work? (presses button, "I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun!" plays, presses another button, activating windshield wipers, presses another button, the ATV does a loop)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe give me the remote.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got it, Phineas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I hope you're ready for the big show, Perry the Platypus! [plugs the blue plug with the green wire) Because Evil Incorporated is on the air!

Name: Announcer on TV
Dialog: Down as 2 and 2, here's the pitch --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) We preempt your normal programming with the first annual Telethon of Evil! (cut to studio) And now live, because it's evil spelled backwards, your host, Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: This is a brilliant work of satire. It's my new favorite show.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, I think I'm getting the hang of this. All I need to do is B.L.A.R.F.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: And that's how socks sometimes get lost in the dryer. (pause) And cut tape.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm B.L.A.R.F.-ing! I'm B.L.A.R.F.-ing!

Name: Cameraman
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: I don't know, but it's more interesting than socks. To the news van!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And we're back. The Inator Corporation was generous enough to send us a giant check for twenty three dollars. Thank you, Sid and the guys. You do an important job. (pause) That brings our tally up to...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Twenty three dollars! Uh, let's go to the phones again. (pause) Okay, if no one calls in the next few seconds, the platypus gets it!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: We preempt this current preemption to bring you another preemption.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: This is Bridgette Oshinomi in the news breaker van, we're following an out of control All Terrain Vehicle that is barraling on down Broad Street.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is what preempted me! Ugh! The newspeople, they're behind this, and I won't stand for it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I must destroy them! (riding hovercraft) NOTHING cuts into MY television face time!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, haha, very funny! Everyone's a comedian.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: The vehicle looks to be filled with children.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good thing I installed a TV screen so I can follow the live coverage. Here's for stealing my ratings! (fires rays at the news van)

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I keep missing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: B.L.A.R.F.! B.L.A.R.F.! B.L.A.R.F.!

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: What is going on up there? Are you getting this, Don?

Name: Don
Dialog: (driving helicopter) We're right above you. Brigitte, have you seen something kinda strange up here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hey, it's me. It's me. I'm back. Perry the Platypus, look, the -- oh, oh, it's the chopper cam. (singsong) Hello? I'm back. Hi, hi, Mom. Hi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, going back to the more dramatic wide angle shot --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And the final tally is...unbearable pain. And, probably a herniated disc.

Name: Bridgette
Dialog: And...cut tape.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You stay right here, I'm gonna go get Mom.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, you've gotta come outside! I just drove up in this craaaazy souped up car that the boys invent --

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait. You were -- driving -- without adult supervision?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no, I was operating a remote.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, so it was a toy car.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no. No, it's a full-sized, and it's --

Name: Linda
Dialog: You were driving a full-sized car?! Oh, that's it, young lady! You're...GROUNDED!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, the boys --

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, GO TO YOUR ROOM! We will talk about this, later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stomps off) Ugh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought I did it right this time! Only I'd stay til the end of that seminar! Wait, Stacy's been there all day. (dials phone and laughs chaotically) Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what happened to you? The lecture's over. The gift bags were totally cruddy, by the way. It's just a bag, nothing in it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, you've gotta tell me the last step to achieving successes. The boys' ATV is still here, I still have a chance.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hmm, the last step, I forget. Hey, Chad, do you remember what the last step to achieving your goal thingy is?

Name: Chad
Dialog: Yes. It's F.R.E.E.P.O.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, it's F.R.E.E.P.O. See ya! (hangs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, hello? But what does that mean? What does it stand for?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You know, technically we didn't try all terrain.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, F.R.E.E.P.O., uh, Frequent Rampages Encourages Enormous Perpendicular Octagons. Uh, Free Raccoons Enter Existential Plastic Origami. Oh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See ya in a bit, Candace! We're going to the moon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, F.R.E.E.P.O.

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Are you and your family looking for a peaceful vacation getaway? Come visit delightful Danville! We've got grass, milk, and smiles! So come to Danville, pretty please? Brought to you by the Danville Tourist Board.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, begging is really unbecoming. I mean, I like smiles as much as the next guy, (Ferb smiles bizarrely) and milk is a classic. But what Danville really needs is a biiiiiig tourist attraction. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Bye, Candace! I'm off to make my rounds.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! (growls in frustration) I'm gonna need some backup. (Calls Stacy) Hey, Stace. Wanna come over and help me bust my brothers?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh, sounds like fun, but I have to go to the eye doctor.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, but just don't get big, thick glasses because then you'd be a nerd, and I couldn't be seen with you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, Candace. You're so shallow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. I am so shallow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But seriously, don't get any thick, nerdy glasses. (Hangs up, hears more noises outside) Ooh, as soon as I get some help, you guys are so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just dump it right there, next to the giant gorilla head.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I have decided to construct the world's tallest building. Wanna help?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure. Who wouldn't want to be a part of the "Phineas and Ferb" project?

Name: Albert
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb? Pish-tosh! I'll take ninja discipline over creative whimsy any day.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Well, I just think that--

Name: Albert
Dialog: Irving, you're my little brother. So, it's my duty to teach you all my secrets of self-defense. (Holds up a pair of nun-chucks)

Name: Irving
Dialog: I'd rather see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.

Name: Albert
Dialog: What's in the box, anyway?

Name: Irving
Dialog: It's my old collection of spy cameras. I'm going to bring them to Phineas and Ferb, and see what they can do with them.

Name: Albert
Dialog: I'll take those!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Give them back, Albert!

Name: Albert
Dialog: (Spills the box) Oopsie!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ooh! You pick those up, Albert!

Name: Albert
Dialog: (Waving nun-chucks) Make me. That is if you're...ninja enough.

Name: Irving
Dialog: You're...a jerk! I'm gonna go play with Phineas and Ferb. (leaves)

Name: Albert
Dialog: Fine! Do you realize these cameras are now forfeit!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her cell phone) Yeah, sure, Jenny, but what have whales ever done for me?

Name: Albert
Dialog: Well, hello.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine; if that's the way you feel, I'll get someone else to bust my brothers.

Name: Albert
Dialog: I'll help you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you talking to me?

Name: Albert
Dialog: As a damsel in distress, I have to help you, milady. It's part of my Medieval Knight's Code.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) I'm outta here.

Name: Albert
Dialog: But don't you wanna bust your brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm listening.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Well, have you considered applying the manly science of spy cameras to your problem?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Spy cameras? Wouldn't it be easier to just show my mom what Phineas and Ferb make?

Name: Albert
Dialog: I don't know. Is that easier?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (suddenly realizing) No! No it's not easy! It's never easy! I need help.

Name: Albert
Dialog: And manly technological surveillance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I need...nerd help. Will you help me?

Name: Albert
Dialog: You have my word. My nerd word.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Glad to have you on board, Irving! You can pick up your hardhat right over there next to Perry. (Camera pans to hardhats, revealing that Perry's hardhat is on the ground and he is gone) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P! It appears that Doofenshmirtz has been brushing up on his astronomy. He's rented an award-winning astronomical musical, Supernova? Fabulousnova! We don't know what it means, so we need you to get over there unrealistically fast. Good luck, Agent P! Agent P?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh. Perry the Platypus, why do you always rush over here just to get trapped? It makes no sense. Ya like that? It's a space helmet. I got a bunch of them used. They still smell like astronaut. I think that's what that is. Anyway, since you're here, let me tell you about my new hobby; making charts and graphs. See, this is a chart of my canteen usage! Which has plummeted since childhood. (Flips the chart to a second one) And this is my evil. I noticed that in any given month, my evilness--that's the red part--stays perfectly constant. Evenly evil. But around the same time each month, there's a spike in background evil, see that, right here? And during that part of the month I actually seem less evil by comparison! And why? Why is it? It's the full moon!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, werewolves alone must count, for like, 20% of that! How can I compete? Then I realized; if I could rotate the moon, then the dark side would always be facing us, bringing all other evil to a standstill, and making me the only evil game in town!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, to recap, I rotate the dark side of the lunar surface towards the Earth, eliminate the full moon and corner the market on evil! What? It's genius. Why are you looking at me like I'm an idiot? Would an idiot build...THIS? (Presses a remote control button. A curtain goes up, revealing a cork with a jellybean taped to it) Oh wait wait, not that, that's just a cork taped to a jellybean...but don't judge it, it's a layered idea. Now behold, the Lunar Rotat-inator! (Pans to outside Doof Inc. Penthouse ceiling rolls back to reveal nothing) Oh wait, wait, it's not up there yet, hold on. Okay, wait, wait, almost there. (The inator rises into view) Okay, there! Now you can behold!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Camera one is in position and activated. As soon as the other sixteen cameras are in place, we can render the whole take-down in three dimensions. And busting your brothers will be as simple as a quadratic equation.

Name: Candace
Dialog: For a nerd, you rock!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Albert and Candace and spy cameras? So that's your game.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, how are we going to know when to stop building?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess we'll just know when we get there.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We're there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's one small step for Ferb, one giant building for Danville!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking into the truck's backseat area, which is not shown) So, your father's an exterminator?

Name: Albert
Dialog: No. Why do you ask?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (uneasily) No reason.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Now sit back and watch the magic unfold.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not much of a nerd, are ya?

Name: Albert
Dialog: Someone has purloined our cameras!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (from atop a ledge on the building. He is holding the missing cameras by their wires) Hey, Albert! Looking for these?

Name: Albert
Dialog: IRRRVIIING! You bring those back down here right this instant!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (tauntingly) Ooh. Why don't you come up here, and endeavor to reclaim them?

Name: Albert
Dialog: WE SHALL!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Actually, I don't do high places.

Name: Albert
Dialog: I SHALL!

Name: Albert
Dialog: IRVING!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (as he rides the rollercoaster) Hey, Albert! Pretty neat, huh? Just another creative whimsy from the minds of Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (condescendingly) And you want to bust them. (He takes off again)

Name: Albert
Dialog: I do if you like them! (He jumps into another set of cars and takes off after Irving)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (from behind Albert in another car) Hey, Albert! Enjoying the monorail?

Name: Albert
Dialog: Yeah, well, I was in the neighborhood, and I--OH MY GO-OSH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is our chess floor. And up here, we have the Medieval Renaissance Fair floor.

Name: Albert
Dialog: Huz-zah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The new-in-the-box action figure floor. The M.C. Escher floor. And this is the... Oh, that's right, we sublet this floor.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That was a mistake.

Name: Office Guy
Dialog: (to Office Woman) So, what are you doing after work?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The rubber ball floor! The barnyard floor! The studio audience floor! And of course there are hundreds of other floors to see, but we'll need to get you fitted for a pressure suit first.

Name: Albert
Dialog: (Climbing out to join Irving) Thanks, guys.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (as Phineas and Ferb zoom away) So...what did you think?

Name: Albert
Dialog: I think you're right. Phineas and Ferb are certifiable geniuses.

Name: Irving
Dialog: So, does this mean you're going to stop helping Candace?

Name: Albert
Dialog: (gravely) I gave her my nerd word.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (shocked) You gave her your nerd word? But now you've only got two left!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Well, that's on me. (Walks into elevator) And it's on me to see that Phineas and Ferb are busted. And so they shall.....

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did you get the cameras?

Name: Albert
Dialog: No, but don't worry. I've done the math. There is no way your brothers won't be busted. Numbers don't lie. This building is so well constructed, there is not a force on this earth that can move it before your mom comes home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then that's it! I win! Through the power of nerd help!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Working on your cackle?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted. (Linda's car horn sounds) Ooh, what's that I hear? Oh, that's right. It's the inevitable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. (pause) I thought it was Mom's car.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs from yard) Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wha?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! I told you it was a layered idea! Now, to show the moon who's boss!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. I don't remember adding that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Giant building!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a sec, Candace. Let me grab these groceries. (As the giant building narrowly misses them as it rotates over them) Aaand...there we go. Now what were you saying?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi, boys. What did you do today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We tried to make Danville a more interesting place.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, you guys do that just by being you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, this doesn't make any sense. The moon is rotating, but the dark side isn't moving. Ohhh, I bet you had something to do with this. Didn't you, Perry the Platypus? You're always messing me up. You're mean. Mean, Perry the Platypus, born mean, that's all. Wait, what are you doing? Making magic fingers at me? Wha--are you even listening to me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, this isn't big enough to trap me!...CURSE YOU, GIANT FLYING BUILDING!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, oh, now I think I get it! The light from the moon is just a reflection of the light from the sun! Ah, dummkopf!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I should have rotated the sun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, Stacy, between busting my brothers and trying to make Jeremy my boyfriend in time for school, I just can't seem get anything this summer. Like my "Jeremy and Me" scrapbook. I mean, I have cute pictures of Jeremy and cute pictures of me, but no cute pictures of both of us being cute together! It's a real problem. But time to check on Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Standing around, dorking it up, boring. There's just too much for one person to do. If only there were two of me, one to bust my brothers and one to be with Jeremy.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look what Baljeet did to my candy bar. He got peanut butter on my chocolate. Look at this mess! Look at it! (shoves the candy bar in Phineas's face)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, peanut butter and chocolate are really good together.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't wanna taste two things at one time! It's unnatural.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you're in luck. We just finished our Molecular Separator. It's our cool new machine that breaks things down into their components parts. We used it to separate a mule into a horse and a donkey. And to separate shampoo plus conditioner into shampoo and conditioner. Ferb?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Witchcraft!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Try it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Singular goodness. (To Baljeet) Why don't you grab your peanut butter and your swimsuit and meet me at the flagpole. (He and Baljeet walk away.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, let's see what else we can separate.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has been seen at the Danville public pool, installing some kind of new device. We need you to get there immediately. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those kids are so busted! All I have to do is bring this to Mom. (tries to lift it) Wow, it's heavier than I thought.

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: MUST...BUST...PHINEAS AND FERB.

Name: Romantic Candace
Dialog: Ah, Jeremy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, I'm glad you're here. I'm just in line for the high dive. You see, it reminds me of the high dive I knew as a kid at the Gimmelshtump Public Wetness Maker.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) It wasn't so much of a pool, as it was just a...we'll just say that it only had water in it on alternating Thursdays, and leave it at that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyhoo, in Gimmelshtump, the high dive was an important rite of passage.

Name: Heinz's Father
Dialog: Are you a man or a schnitzel?

Name: Young Heinz
Dialog: I'm a man, I'm a man.

Name: Queuing man
Dialog: Das kind ist ein schnitzel. (That kid is a schnitzel!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) With all those people looking and laughing at me, I-I just couldn't do it.

Name: Heinz's Father
Dialog: Ich habe keinen sohn. (I have no son.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) After that, my father and I became increasingly distant.

Name: Heinz's Father
Dialog: Zu nah! (Too close!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, I will conquer my fear and jump from the high dive. But you know, I still don't want any of these people to look at me and make fun of me. So I invented the Look-Away-inator! You'd think it would attract a lot of attention at a public pool, but so far no one's noticed it. It must be leaking or something.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, when I do my man making dive, you can bet that no one in the Tri-State Area will be looking. Sure, it may be tough for people who happen to be driving, plus, brain surgeons might have a problem too. But it's really a small price to pay for me becoming a man, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're right. I gotta trap you.

Name: Romantic Candace
Dialog: Romance! lalalalala! It's a Jeremy bedroom.

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: O. M. G.

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb made me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Um, I've got some stretch marks that would say otherwise.

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: No, I mean, they split me in half. Well, not like I'm cut in half, but they've made another me. Hear for yourself.
