Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, um... Excuse me! (Walks away from Jeremy to resolve her inner turmoil) Urge to bust so strong, but I need time with Jeremy to find out why he likes me! Gotta resist urge to bust! Must not spoil quality time with boyfriend! (Composes herself and returns to his side) Uh, picnic in the dangerous, unauthorized, and highly bust-worthy biosphere? Sounds great! (Giggles insincerely)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, we've gotten water from a cactus, witnessed a mirage, and learned the difference between sunstroke and heatstroke. Thanks for that, Adyson.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Hey... the salamanders quit singing... (Giggles)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now we just need to either collect a sand sample, measure the temperature, or milk a camel.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You guys!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I set up this whole thing with lasers and flypaper, falling cages, spinning platforms, on the way to a trapdoor... (The camera pans across this devious contraption) And you just come and slip on a chair, and waste a day's worth of work. Eh. (As Perry emerges from the hole in the ground in a green glass tube) But it's gonna look great on the Christmas party gag reel, hehehe! Of course, it'll just be me at the party, uh...yeah. (Sighs) I need a laugh at the holidays. Anyway, gotcha! Go ahead, try to climb out of it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) It's greased! So, now that you're all comfy cozy I can introduce you to my Rain-inator! I've been using it to pour millions of gallons of water into these clouds, causing it to rain all over the Tri-State Area! I can't believe nobody's noticed it. It's kind of obvious.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay! We made it across the desert! Say, Phineas, I don't suppose you could help us out with our Rainforest Navigation Patch?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, ladies. Ferb?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, this sure beats all that rain. Not too hot, are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, not at all! I mean, isn't that what you said you liked about me? That I don't "overheat"?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heh, no. The thing I really like about you is...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, this is incredible!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, uh, what was that you were saying?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I said, This is incredible!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, before that.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I said...wow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a shallow state of calm) Pardon.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure. Hmm...

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Hey! I think I found a new species of -

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Here, Adyson! Catch this! (Throws the lasso) Swift Water Rescue Patch! Bonus!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Check it out. This umbrella makes a sweet raft. Wanna float down the river with me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still fighting between her two halves) Busting. Boyfriend. Busting. Boyfriend. Busting? Boyfriend! (Giggles) Coming!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, I bet you're wondering why did I cause all this rain. You see, while perusing local garage sales, I came upon a big screen TV from 1985. (Removes the tarp covering it) But when I went to turn it on, it was stuck on the Spanish channel!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All it played was crazy variety shows and Mexican soap operas. (Turns on the TV) I really got hooked on one of them, though

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...in which Esmerelda is going to find out why Juan loves her. At least, I think that's what's going to happen... But the show got preempted by a soccer game! Oh, I hate soccer! It makes no sense whatsoever! The clock runs up instead of counting down, what is that?! (Removes popcorn from the microwave and sits down in his armchair.) So with the help of my Rain-inator I rained the game out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, back to our regularly scheduled programming.

Name: Spanish Man on TV
Dialog: ¡La Esponja Milagroso! Absorbes... (continues under)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: In 10 minutes, the show is gonna start, and with you trapped and the Rain-inator at work, nothing will interrupt me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, less pounding back there, okay? You're lucky I sprang for the clear tube, this way, you can watch too!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I mean, it's like your hair was genetically engineered to ensnare those giant fruit bats.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you like that about me?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It's certainly interesting, but...it's not what I like about you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What then?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, let me put it in a song.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, you were saying?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, guys! Uh-oh, here comes the fun part!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fun part?! Seriously?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Jungle Navigation Patch

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold Mount Ferbius!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Sorry, Adyson.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: The salamanders are back...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who wants a Concussion First Aid Patch?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Incoming!!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (As he moves his arms and legs back and forth) Ha, hey, look, Candace, I'm making snow angels.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grumpily) I'm wet and I'm freezing cold.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, it's not so bad. I mean, we're together, aren't we?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And being together like this makes me realize what I like about you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Excitedly) What? What???

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What's that sound?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That could've squished us! That's it! I am gonna bust them!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (As Candace stomps away angrily) Wait, Candace, look! It's just papier-mâché! (Lifts the boulder easily)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good job, everyone. I think we've earned our Rock Climbing Patches.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In a hang-glider) Congratulations, ladies. How do you feel about Non-Powered Flight Patches?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, come back here! I'm gonna bust you two if it's the last thing I--

Name: Spanish Man on TV
Dialog: El Matador de Amor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (As sappy guitar music plays in the background) It's starting! It's starting!!! Okay, now, Perry the Platypus, shhh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't want to miss anything.

Name: Esmerelda
Dialog: Oh, Juan...

Name: Juan
Dialog: Por lo Tanto su manada gemela, ha sido en Venenado...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Help me!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hold on, Candace, I'll save you!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I gotcha, Candace!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, man, I love this umbrella!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, kids!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, Candace, what I was trying to say back there is that...well, the thing I like about you is...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Hold that thought! I'll be right back. (She runs over to Linda in her usual fashion.) Mom! Mom! Backyard! Now! Biosphere!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (from inside) He's getting closer...he's looking into her eyes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's opening his mouth!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's forming his lips to start to articulate the syllables! Tell her, Juan! Tell her why you love her!!!

Name: Juan
Dialog: Es! La razón porque te amo (Repeat) La razón porque te amos es... es...

Name: Juan
Dialog: Es!

Name: Sport Announcer
Dialog: ¡Ahi Van la Pelota!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?! No!!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's right here, Mom! Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Phineas/Fireside Girls
Dialog: Hi, Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (enters) Hmm, I've really got to fix the latch on that gate. (Both turn around and see the empty backyard.) Um...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How is this possible? I took every precaution! I had the Rain-inator, I had you trapped in a - what the?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ¡Maldito seas, Perry el Ornitorrinco! Man, this is gonna cost me a fortune on my water bill.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, did you ever find out why Jeremy likes you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! (She bolts over to him.) Now, please continue your thought. Tell me why you like me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You bet. The reason that I like you is...

Name: Sport Announcer
Dialog: ¡Viene, le pega! ¡GOOOOOOOL!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Stacy, isn't Jeremy's hair the perfect shade of gold?

Name: Recording
Dialog: Uh huh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And isn't it cute when he gets that little wrinkle on the end of his nose?

Name: Recording
Dialog: Uh huh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you know when...

Name: Recording
Dialog: Uh huh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy! Did you make a digital sound file of yourself saying "Uh huh" to fool me into thinking you're listening to me again?

Name: Recording
Dialog: Uh huh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Enraged) Stacy, pick up!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Picks up the phone) Well, do you blame me? (Imitating Candace) Oh, Jeremy and I went to the movies, Jeremy's house smells like gingerbread, ever notice Jeremy's mole is shaped like an adorable puppy? I'm starting to feel like the only reason you hang out with me is to talk about Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I miss you, Candace! I miss when we would spend time together, just the two of us. And I bet you didn't remember that today is the Danville Steet Fair.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I'm so sorry. I'm gonna cancel with Jeremy today. Meet me at the cafe in a half an hour and we'll hit the Street Fair afterwards. It'll be just the two of us. I promise.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really? Great! But no—Jeremy -- anything. Okay? If I even hear his name--

Name: Candace
Dialog: I promise I won't break this promise. See ya in a bit! (hangs up) Now, to call Jeremy. Wait, why call him, when I can tell him I can't see him today...in person? (runs off to do so)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is it, Isabella. The day you're going to insist on spending some time alone with Phineas! I can do this! (walks into backyard) What'cha doooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella, we're building a giant robot dog.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Like when we made that title sequence!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Mmm, I'd rather give a monkey a shower.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, uh, Phineas, I was wondering if maybe after this, you'd like to go to the premiere of the new Stumbleberry Finkbat movie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (while rummaging through wires) Huh? Oh, sure. Sounds cool.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (appears) I'd like to go to that.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, sorry, I -- I only have one extra ticket, and...it's sold out. So, I thought maybe Phineas and I would go—uh, not to necerrally exclude --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I can go after we finish up here. Done with he wiring, Ferb?(Ferb produces a back scratcher and scratches the dog, causing its hind leg to rise and twitch)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lookin' good. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Comfortable, Perry the Platypus? I've made that platy-rack so that every limb is accounted for. So, what's it all about?

Name: You see, there were only 2 things that made my miserable childhood bearable
Dialog: my giant pet cockroach, Hoarfrost and garlic ice cream. I love these two things so much I wondered if combining them would exponentially increase my enjoyment of them.

Name: You see, there were only 2 things that made my miserable childhood bearable
Dialog: So, introducing my Combine-inator! With my Combine-inator, I was finally able to make the Triple Scoop Garlic Roach Cone!

Name: Hoarfrost
Dialog: So cold...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Hoarfrost
Dialog: Ow...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So anyway, I remembered this little island timeshare that I bought on a free trip to Vegas. And, I realized that if I were to combine my tiny island with the Capitol of the Tri-State Area like so, ta-da! Then, legally, under local property laws, I will be sovereign ruler of the Tri-State Area! As long as I file the appropriate paperwork and get it in by the end of business today...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rings doorbell)

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: (answers door) Oh, hello, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Johnson. Is Jeremy in?

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Come on in. He's right over there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is he okay?

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Oh, sure. He was just up all night working the graveyard shift at Mr. Slushy Burger after a full day shift. Then when he came home...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (snoring)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: He ate an entire turkey, drank a gallon of warm milk and just passed out on the sofa. Bless him. I'd be surprised if he woke up before next Thursday. Good luck getting any conversation out of him, sweetie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks. Aw, look how cute he is when he's sleeping. (sits next to Jeremy) Psst, Jeremy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, you've asked for it! (grabs Perry and they roll on the ground, knocking over the Combine-inator. The contraption fires off a ray that reaches a nearby park)

Name: Man
Dialog: I hereby dedicate this giant prism--

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...so Stacy and I just need a little girl time, and that's a--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, that was weird... So, you'll have to take a raincheck, OK?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams) We're attached! Stacy's gonna kill me! (gets up and falls on the ground) Phineas and Ferb...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tail wag solenoids, check. Slipper chewing radio controlled by cuspids, check.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs) Hey, Phineas? What'cha still doooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just going through a last minute checklist, now that the dog is done.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh! Does that mean we can, uh, go to the movies?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Ferb! Let's fire this puppy up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Isabella) I don't see why not.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great, we can still catch the matinee!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! (enters backyard) What have you done?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we've made this giant robotic--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just look at us! We are all fused together! (close up of her) See?! I don't care what kind of freaky project you guys are doing! Just get us unstuck!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We could remove you to a sterile environment and get a board certified surgeon to cleanly, and safely preform a gerabotamy.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We could tie each of you to a monster truck, and drive in opposite directions, worst case scenario, someone loses a torso.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or, we can use the molecular separator.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That thing you used to separate me from me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! It worked before. You know, in a completely different set of circumstances.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great you guys get on it. (Her phone rings) H-Hey Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey BFF, just checking on your ETA.

Name: Candace
Dialog: About that-

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no! You had better not be ditching me to hang out with Jeremy again!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? On Street Fair day? Haha! No way, sister! I'll be there, and I'll be there early. Ah-haha. Yeah. Alone. Okay? Okay. (She hangs up) Oh crud. Make that molecular whatever and meet me at the coffee shop!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, but the movie almost started --

Name: Candace
Dialog: (overlapping, leaves) And don't be late! THIS IS YOUR FAULT!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know what she's talking about Ferb, but I do know the next thing we're gonna do today! Let's get started on the separator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz and Perry circle each other) So here we are, just the two of us at a stalemate. Each looking for something to turn the tide, but what will it be?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (He walks in carrying a large tray of cupcakes) Cupcakes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oop! Watch this! (He leaps on to the -inator, activating it, then jumps into Norm's arms) Prepare to face the wrath of Normenshmirtz! (Normenshmirtz fires laser at Perry) You can't get away from me now!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Don't you mean us?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, don't step on my moment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb better find a fix for this—Oh!! (Candace sees Stacy, and to hide Jeremy, she pulls up a chair, and throws a tablecloth over him)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey girlfriend!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh hey Stace!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (To the waiter) Two ice teas please. So, Candace, sorry I was so hard on you before. I know you and Jeremy aren't together all the time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, really it's okay. It's nice to have a little space from him. Oh look our drinks.

Name: Waiter
Dialog: Two ice teas.

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She covers up Jeremy's lips to stop him from snoring) So, I here there's a ton of vintage clothing stalls at the street fair this year.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, I'm looking for some really cool... Wow, this table's really lumpy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, lumpy tables. It's the new "hip" thing. It's so European.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (moaning) Uhhhh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey isn't that that guy from that movie.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What? Where? I don't see him! What guy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I don't see anyone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's because he's gone.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, why are you acting so nervous? I'm not mad anymore. I'm going to go pay for our drinks. (She leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. (Stacy returns, and Candace has on a big overcoat to hide Jeremy) Ready?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, why are you wearing that coat?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Brr, that ice tea gave me a chill.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, let's go, but you're walking behind me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okie-doke! (She pulls out her phone) Phineas will you hurry, we're heading to the street fair already.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think we're in trouble.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sure, now it's "we".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ta-da! Representing the molecular separator! I can't believe how fast we rebuilt this Ferb. Of course breaking the immutable law of physics is always easier the second time around.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great! Does that mean we can go to the movies now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure does. The movie theatre is right next to the street fair. All we've got to do is get this to Candace, and separate her from Jeremy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well what are we waiting for?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I believe were waiting for Rover to put the molecular separator down.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come back here boy!

Name: Buford
Dialog: This would have never happened if we'd given a monkey a shower. I'm just sayin'.

Name: Song
Dialog: "Just the Two of Us"

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hey! That hurt!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahh! He's armed!

Name: Norm
Dialog: With my arm!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Balsa wood?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was on sale. It's locked into overload.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (Opening the door to the refrigerator) Would you like a nice, frosty beverage?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! (He closes the door) That's private!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Split up guys. Maybe we can corner him.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: (After cutting Rover off) A-ha!

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: A-ha!

Name: Buford
Dialog: He's coming your way!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm running out of hiding places. (She spies a dressing room, and hides Jeremy behind the curtain)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey! I found all kinds of cute things! Move over, I'm going to try them on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Uh... I can see they fit you perfectly.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace! Are you karate-chopping me?! What's going on?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Heal boy! (Rover stops) Go ferb! (Ferb runs up, and yanks a few wires out from Rover, causing him to shut down and drop the molecular seperator from his mouth)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Slow motion) No!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Slow motion) No!

Name: Isabella and Buford
Dialog: (Slow motion) No!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How is everyone doing that?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Now disconnected) Hey, I can feel my knees again!

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm sorry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So cold...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, listen Stacy, there was this blast, and I was sitting next to Jeremy, and somehow we got--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Jeremy. Jeremy. Jeremy. Tell me later I want to try this on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, honest I really wanted to spend the day with you but... (She sees that there Jeremy isn't in the booth) But...? But? And we were? Uh... never mind.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I know this is a weird question, but do you have any idea how I got here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, don't worry, I promise I'll explain everything later, but right now you've gotta get out of here. (pushes him away) I'll call you later...I mean, tomorrow. Phew...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (peeks out from dressing room) By the way, the best part was when you used him as a table. (closes curtain) BUSTED!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, we, uh, got everything sorted out now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, want to catch that movie?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh Phineas...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (To Ferb) Okay, bro, I guess I'll see you back at the house.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh. My. Gosh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! Does this mean we can all go now?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes. Yes it does.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Credits roll

Name: TV Announcer
Dialog: Today, on the Uncovery Channel, we'll talk about the fastest land animal in the world. Possessed of incredible speed, the cheetah can outrun almost anything alive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! We're gonna build fast shoes, so we can run like a cheetah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I don't care. Because today, I'm going to Jeremy's family picnic in the park. I will be spending the whole day with my boyfriend and his extended family. And they are all going to love me, because today, I am Composed Candace. Confident, cool, and relaxed.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace...

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAH! Stop judging me!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ready to head to the library?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You volunteered to read to the kids' book club today, while I help reorganize cookbooks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I forgot all about all about that! That's so unlike me! I never forget a promise! (Her cell phone rings. She picks up.) Hello?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace! We're about to go on! (cut back to Candace) Where are you?! Candace? (Candace smiles nervously.) Candace?! Are you there?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hangs up) Heh-heh. Wrong number.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We're leaving in fifteen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh. Yeah. I've got nothing better to do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about that Jeremy thing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (storming out angrily) Don't you have a catchphrase to say or something?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is she talking about? Hey, have you seen Perry around? (Ferb shrugs) 'Cause I haven't.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. It's come to our attention that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has missed a few of his mortgage payments. He must be funneling all that money into something really evil, otherwise, he'd ask his ex-wife for a loan. (File photo of Charlene appears on screen.) She's loaded you know. Ka-ching! So get over there (Perry salutes) and find out what's going on. (he leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) A cheetah's body is built to run at amazing speeds. By carefully analyzing our own bodies' running mechanics, we can now design and build our very own super shoes. Based on the pseudoscience of reflexology, these shoes will trigger pressure points in our feet, making us exponentially faster.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm double-booked! If you count Stacy, I'm triple-booked! Oh, darn my endlessly giving nature! (Phineas speeds past the door.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opening the door) Wha?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (speeding) Yeah! Hiiiiiii, Candaaaace! You know, Ferb, with these super shoes on, (running from one side to the other and back rapidly) we can almost be in two places at one time. (Ferb stops him) Let's go see what these babies can really do. (They speed out of the backyard.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Two places at once?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, ready to head to the library?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, that's okay, Mom, I think I'll walk.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Okay. See ya there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (picks up a pair of shoes) Or maybe I'll run.

Name: Female Realtor
Dialog: Chocolate chip cookie? They're freshly baked. (Perry takes one.) Get your bids in soon. We don't expect this place to last long.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ooh, are those floors original?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So just because I miss a few payments, you're selling my building? And where am I supposed to get that much money on such short notice?

Name: Male Realtor
Dialog: I'm sorry, Mr. Doofschmidt, those are the terms of your loan.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The name is Doofenshmirtz! Like, like in Doofenshmirtz! (Perry tugs his lab coat) Now what? Oh, it's you. I'm sorry, Perry the Platypus, I'm going to have to take a rain check. You see, I'm having a bit of a financial crisis and I'm afraid I won't have time for our evil scheme today. (Perry tips his hat and leaves.) Yep. (sighs) Next time we fight, it could be in a cardboard box, 'cause that's where I'll be living. (Perry stops short and tugs Doof's lab coat again) Can't you see I'm trying to wallow? (Perry points to something) What? (Cut to a framed picture of Doof's ex-wife) That? Oh, it's a nice picture of Charlene, isn't it? But I don't think I could get much cash for it. I mean, who wants a picture... (Perry takes out a phone) Oh, you mean call her and ask her for money? Never! Y'know what she'll say if I call? She'll say, "I told you so!" And you know why? Because she told me so! She said, "Don't get the gargoyles, Heinz!" But what does she know? (Whip pan to reveal two gargoyles on the balcony) Gargoyles are a good investment. Name a cheap building with gargoyles. (Cut back to Doof and Perry) No way am I asking her for money! I—I—I'll just, uh, make this place unsellable! Then they'll have to let me stay here no matter how broke I am! (to a potential buyer) Psst! Indian burial ground. True story.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! These things are great! Much better than those completely unstable prototypes we made earlier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What a ripoff! These things are—AAAAAAAAAAH!!! (She speeds away.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, my daughter was supposed to... (Candace stops on the rocking chair) Oh! Kids, this is Candace. (to her daughter) Good luck. I'm off to file some cookbooks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, today's book is Smorky the Giant Rabbit's Family Picnic. (rocks back) Heh! I'm a little fidgety. Yes?

Name: Sally
Dialog: Why is your neck so long?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good question. (Puts her in the rocking chair) You get to be today's first reader. I'll be right back. Go on, you'll do great. (speeds off)

Name: Sally
Dialog: Brab farbu gulla brobbidy Lingonberry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is! Oh, please stop!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Whoa! Heh-heh! Hey, Candace, you came out of nowhere.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! (waves her arms trying to stay put) Uh, (grabs hold of her legs as she sits on the table) I did!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I'm glad you could make it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (kicks away Jeremy's cup) Me, too.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh. Yeah. (screen flips to Jeremy showing her around the picnic) Why don't I introduce you around? You know my folks.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Hey, there, darlin'!

Name: Mr. Johnson
Dialog: Nice to see ya!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And, of course, you know Suzy.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And I bet you remember the birthday girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course. Grandma Hilda, from the—

Name: Hilda
Dialog: I never liked you.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Hey, guys, those potato sacks aren't gonna race themselves! Let's get the lead out, kiddies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: My gosh! The kids! (to Jeremy) I'm gonna get you a lemonade refill. I'll catch up with you in a bit, okay?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, but hurry. The games are the best part of the picnic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's working!

Name: Sally
Dialog: Falooby blib dingo traloopoo-bul.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Everything okay, Candace? Y'know, you really shouldn't have drinks in the library.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. It's all this reading. It makes my throat dry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that's sweet. I think I'll watch for a while.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you don't have to. (Linda takes a seat. Candace clears her throat and begins reading.) "Smorky knew that it was wrong to steal the pie, but it looked so delicious. He knew his friend had worked hard to make the pie and bake the pie. How would Smorky's friend feel when he saw the pie was gone? He would feel sad. He would feel bad. He might even feel mad. But Smorky was so hungry. What could Smorky do? What should Smorky do? What would Smorky do?"

Name: Sally
Dialog: I have to go to the bathroom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Mom, take her! (She pushes her mother and Sally into the restroom and speeds out.)

Name: Woman
Dialog: I think this may be the place we've been looking for! I mean, high ceilings, open floor plan, purple and green? We won't even have to repaint!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I-I-I am not calling Charlene!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on a bullhorn) Go!

Name: Phineas' Voice
Dialog: Go! (kaboom!)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sonic boom! Check sound off the list.

Name: Boy
Dialog: She knocked over the Annabelle shrine.

Name: Woman
Dialog: How rude!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! (picks her up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Who's Annabelle?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: She sort of wandered off about 20 years ago. We don't really talk about it much.

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: (sobbing) Annabelle!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: (offscreen) Wheelbarrows at the ready!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you sure you wouldn't rather be the legs?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You'd be surprised how strong my arms are. Don't hold back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't think I can.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, we won.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: You might want to visit the washroom, honey. You've got a little something right (gestures all over their bodies) there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The washroom! (speeds out and returns to her chair in the library)

Name: Sally
Dialog: And that's where it goes when you flush.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What an active imagination you have, sweetie! Well, I think I'll leave these adorable little ragamuffins in your capable hands, Candace. I'm afraid I have to be elsewhere.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me, too.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Fire it up! (Ferb turns on a lamp and Phineas attempts to catch up to it.) Sorry, Ferb. The light's just too darn fast. (Ferb puts a check mark under "no" for "Light".)

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, honey, look at this.  It's like 1973 in here. My favorite year! Ha ha! Where did they ever find such rare furnishings?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no no, it's all fake. It's made out of cardboard.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Cardboard? How wonderfully impermanent!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wa-wa-wa-wait! What about the neighbors? (exits) They're really crazy. (Comes back in jumping around with his pants on his head.) Look, I live next door and I've got pants on my head! And, uh, (takes out a comb and puts it under his nose like a mustache) I'm Italian. See?

Name: Woman
Dialog: With neighbors like that, our lives will always be interesting! I can't think of anything that would make this place more attractive.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nulla, per favore.

Name: Woman
Dialog: (screams) I stand corrected!  Gargoyles! This is it! This is the place! We'll take it!

Name: Male Realtor
Dialog: I'll draw up the papers.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Never!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can't stop! Can't stop!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Well, I'm hoping for a short escr—Whoa! (Candace speeds away taking the woman.)

Name: Husband
Dialog: We're gonna check out some other neighborhoods.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Front and center, people! Now before we pass out the awards for the games, let's remember the real reason we're here

Name: Woman
Dialog: Can I get down now?

Name: Hilda
Dialog: That voice. Can it be?  (Candace puts the woman down as Hilda looks her over.) The Johnson eyes. The Johnson nose. Is it possible? (Hilda lifts up the woman's sleeve to reveal a mark shaped in the letter "J" on her arm. Hilda gasps.) She's got the birthmark! It's little Annabelle!

Name: Annabelle
Dialog: Nana? Uncle Jack! It's all coming back to me! You were right. I never should have taken that job hanging anvils.

Name: Hilda
Dialog: Candace, you've made our family whole again. Be good to her, Jeremy. (winks) This one's a keeper.

Name: Male Realtor
Dialog: You know it's a shame we didn't make that sale. Now the bank will have no choice (Doof stops celebrating) but to tear this place down and build a greeting card factory.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But— (Perry gives him the phone again. Doof growls and swipes it from Perry and dials.) Don't gloat, Perry the Platypus. It's not becoming. Hello, Charlene? (Charlene yells on the other line) Yeah, you told me so.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow Phineas, it's really beautiful up here!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! It was very kind of you to invite us to your grandparents' house. (a basketball flies by, and he ducks to avoid it) No fair! That almost hit me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Life's not fair. Earlier today I just missed hitting this kid with a basketball.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. What are you up to today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'll probably try to bust you guys... again! And fail... again! And add another link to my summer-long chain of disappointment and regrets.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Oblivious) How about that, Ferb, Candace already knows what she's gonna do today!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Soo... how's the antique business?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, it's just fine. You know, they have a saying in the antique business.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What is what?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: The saying. That you use in the antique business.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I don't use it. But there is one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, dad! Hi, grandpa! We're not interrupting, are we?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: No, no! No, come in, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I were just talking about the time you build the balloon and won the most famous balloon race in history. Tell us that story again?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, I went out to the barn, I built a balloon and I won the most famous balloon race in history.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: He makes history come alive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. If you need us, we'll be out in the barn!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Just look at all this great stuff. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P! After extensive research and computer data analysis we have concluded that the Tri-State Area is experiencing an unprecedented shortage of eggs. We need you to investigate. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You there! Weren't you listening? Go make some eggs!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa, stop! You might wanna use the sugar unless you want salty lemonade!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I can't wait to get new contacts. I'm as blind as a bat without them.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Here, use my spare set of glasses.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, now everything is different kind of blurry.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Hi, stranger. Come on in. Everyone, you remember Glenda?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Of course! Candace, Glenda was the first female train conductor in the entire Tri-State Area!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: But alas, the train is being decommissioned. And today is Glenda's last trip.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: And you know what? I'm gonna take her up to Gearheart Summit.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: (gasps) But nobody has ever taken a train up Gearheart Summit, it's too steep!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Well, that's what they say, but I'm not the one to give up!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: It's just like you became a conductor.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: That's right. They told me to give up! (Candace is interested.) But I never give up! (Candace smiles a little.) I'm not the kind of person to give up! (Candace smiles more.) Well, I'm gonna prove that an old train can make it up those tracks. You guys wanna come with me?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: We should all go.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sounds like fun!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Okay! Train leaves the station at ten sharp! See you there!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Isn't she something, Candace? That's a woman who would never give up!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: (echoing in Candace's memory) Give up! Blah blah! Give up! Blah blah blah blah blah! Give up! Blah blah blah! Give up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's so simple! I don't know how I didn't think about it before!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll give up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's right, I never even suited up, folks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I threw the baby out with the bathwater!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I forgot the Alamo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not even going for the bronze!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm staying right here, man.

Name: Candace
Dialog: In this hammock. I like it. Aw, it's beautiful, man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, let's get this race started. Contact!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Last one at the top of the mountain is a stinky dish sponge!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: About... five knots.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thought so, I'm doing six! See you at the summit, slowpokes!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, we're falling behind! What's happening?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Excessive weight seems to be hampering our progress.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we have to lighten the load. (throws Baljeet out of the basket)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aaah, aah! How does dangling me from a rope lighten our load?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Meh, it lightens my spirit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (hitting various obstacles) Ow! Ow, ow ow!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Mountain lion! (mountain lion roars)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aaah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Ah, Perry the Platypus. Well, I guess it serves me right for bringing work on vacation with me. Aaand there it is. (Perry is trapped in a egg-shaped container) Man, are we in a rut. Anyway, this is my Dodo-Bird-Incubator... well, you know... -inator. With this amazing device I can transform any egg to a Dodo egg. Once they hatch I will march my terrifying Dodo bird army across the Tri-State Area. You know, I don't really know what they look like, but they're extinct like dinosaurs, so just imagine! Giant, extinct dinosaur-like monsters laying waste to the city! Ah, you know, you, you really picked me up out of my doldrums.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: We're all here and ready to help, what would you like us to do?

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Just sit back and enjoy the view, the train will do all the work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Doin' nothing? Got that covered.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: All aboard! Gearheart Summit, here we come!

Name: Orville Wilkins
Dialog: You'll never make it! You should give up!

Name: Wilbur Wilkins
Dialog: Yeah, give up, woo-hoo!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: So long boys, and don't forget to clean your rooms!

Name: Orville/Wilbur
Dialog: Yes, mom.

Name: Orville
Dialog: It's your fault.

Name: Wilbur
Dialog: Quiet, you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like a dead heat so far.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We need to pick up the pace.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, I'll get rid of this. (throws a taxidermied marlin away)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not know why you even brought the swordfish!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a marlin.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little help, guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So Candace, you sure seem relaxed. What's up? (behind her, the kids in their balloons can be seen through the window)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just taking in the ride and not worrying about what Phineas and Ferb are up to.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well good for you, honey. Cause I've got gin.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: We're playing Kings Corners.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Are we?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's working! (the egg begins to hatch) It's wonderful! It's amazing! It's...! (giant dodo bird hatches)

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg narg narg! Narg!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's... (sighs) not quite as terrifying as I hoped.

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How am I supposed to take over the Tri-State Area with a bunch of these? Where's the horror, the terror the- (Perry gets out of his trap) Oh nooo! You, you'll have to wait in line, Perry the Platypus! First I gotta deal with this! I mean, this looks like a turkey, it's like Thanksgiving. (Dodo bird pecks Doofenshmirtz furiously) It's EXACTLY like Thanksgiving!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Glenda, how's it going?

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Mighty fine! You're looking chipper.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah, I've been feeling great ever since I decided to heed your advice and give up.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Come again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, all summer I've been just thinking about busting my brothers, but after your speech this morning I've just gave up. And now I'm much more relaxed.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: So what you got from my speech about how you should never give up is that you should give up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you did say "give up" a lot.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: I did say that, didn't I.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, Glenda? Glenda! The train is slowing down.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: So it is. I guess we're out of coal. (sits down) Oh well.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? You can't give up! No coal means no steam, and no steam means we can't make up the hill!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Meh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We gotta do something! We need fuel! Wait! I have an idea that just might work. And don't think I don't know what you're up to. I'll be right back.

Name: Linda
Dialog: She's such an active child.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just out of curiosity, what's going to happen to this train after today?

Name: Glenda
Dialog: It'll be torn apart and an sold for scrap, why?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No reason.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What are we playing again?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, what'cha doin' over there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My steering is a little loose, I think that- (stops, looks behind)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (suddenly standing next to Phineas) Do you need some help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah. Can you hold the wheel while I tighten it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (holds it) Gladly!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that's perfect.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out! A dodo bird! What's next on the list, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (crossing off a list of the title sequence) Frankenstein's brain.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeeeah, uh, that was in my balloon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woo-hoo! Yes, we made it! I knew we could, I knew we could, I knew we could!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Oh, did you now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, you can drop the act. I know you didn't forget to bring coal. It's probably in that box you're sitting on. But...lesson learned, and as long as I'm no longer giving up, I'm gonna go bust Phineas and Ferb. (jumps through the window) Thanks!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: I could have forgot the coal! (beat) I'm old!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Do you notice anything different here?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Yeah! Everything's half off at the gift shop!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here we are! Gearheart Summit. Let's put them down over there, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking at Ferb's outfit in the gift shop) Why is it every store sells this outfit? (notices the balloons) Mom, mom! Look what Phineas and Ferb are doing! Come quick! (points at the outfits and the head-shaped balloons behind them) Look, look! Right there! You see?! You see?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay Candace. (adjusts the glasses)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hello, boys. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...What? (turns around) No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A-ha! (runs to the balloon)

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg, narg, narg, narg! (runs into the second balloon)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sayonara, dodo! (both balloons take off) Hey, how did you start that with no opposable thumbs?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look, it's just forced perspective, look! They're not really here! (The real Phineas and Ferb come over.) It's an optical illusion! He's not really --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How was the train ride?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pause) Oh, I give up. (walks away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Some vacation this turned out to be. (the dodo makes a hole in his balloon)

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: So you bought a Museum of Biological Oddities, but you didn't get any biological oddities?(Doofenshmirtz falls through the roof)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh. What? (dodo falls in and lands on him)

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: There it is!

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg narg narg! Narg!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Wakes up, snoozes alarm clock) Another fantastic year older, and this is gonna be the best birthday ever! So, what are we gonna do, Ferb? (Camera pans to Ferb's bed, showing a card) Ferb? (Camera zooms in) Huh! A note! (Gets off his bed) "For the celebration of your birthday, just follow these clues to show you the way". Cool! It's like a birthday adventure. But hey, where's Ferb?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on her cell phone) I can't believe it! It's Phineas's birthday, and I still don't know what to get him! What can you get for the boy who can make everything? (Sighs) It's my fault. I should have been thinking about this before, but I've just been so distracted by trying to bust Phineas and-- Wait! (Notices Ferb behind a tree; The garage door opens and Ferb runs into the garage) What is he up to? T-T-Y-L, Stacy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! (Ferb takes off his fedora) We were just discussing our plans for Phineas' birthday. The circus we ordered won't be arriving 'til later in the day, (Irving walks up) but Irving had a great idea for a warm-up.

Name: Irving
Dialog: We should make a video compilation of all of Phineas' greatest moments!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? Like on a clip show? (Crosses his arms) Lame.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Not where a genius like Phineas is concerned, watch this. (Turns on TV)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Let's see what we can do about that pesky gravitational pull. (Ferb presses a button on a controller)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Explaining Candace her mission) After you wrestle the crocodiles, you'll corkscrew through the overpass and free-fall past the flaming high wire to make your last delivery and receive the 50th patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In a video game) Wow, a castle! Nice art direction, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Riding on a rocket attached to a bike with Ferb and Candace) Good thing we had this extra rocket engine, huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Showing a giant paper-maché plane) Eat your heart out, Howard Hughes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Showing Isabella a dining room) Behold! A romantic candlelit dinner for two.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Building a giant card house) We're almost finished with our exact replica of the Temple of Angkor Wat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Showing a giant contraption) The Phineas-and-Ferb-edge-of-insanity-kiss-your-butt-goodbye-gravity's-a-stone-cold-sucker-nightmare-rail-skate-track-obstacle-course of doom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you please tell me what's going on here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're building an animation studio.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Exiting a giant bowling ball) That was amazing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (With Linda's tricked-out car) The flying car of the future, today, is still pulling a bit to the right.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: A monster truck!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Isn't it sweet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Revealing the rollercoaster) THE COOLEST... COASTER... EVER!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Imitating fanfare. The camera zooms out as he imitates a kettle drum beat and turns off the TV)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why did you not just use the kettle drum?

Name: Irving
Dialog: I never learned how to play. (Pushes the kettle drum away, and a cat yowls) Anyway, (Candace looks through the window and swoons) By utilizing my extensive collection of spy cameras, I've got footage of everything that Phineas has ever done. But I haven't had time to edit all of it-- Well, what, with-- You know, filming more. (He and Baljeet, Buford and Isabella walk to Ferb) I've divided up all the video into 3 parts. (Shows the CDs) Each of you take a section, (Isabella, Baljeet and Buford each takes a CD) Edit your tribute, and we'll meet at the party later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Giggles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Runs to the kitchen) "This birthday excursion will take you afar, you'll find your next clue where the 2x4s are". 2x4s, huh? Perry, are you thinking what I'm-- (Camera pans to Perry's bed) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (To Carl) Okay, now let me to do the talking.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, Agent P! There's a something we need to discuss for a while, you see Perry's job and performances which come up, (Perry's face became surprised) but don't get me wrong, it's just like your entrances became "lackluster" lately. (Perry's face became sad) We just expect more from you. Roll the footage Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Right away sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What happened to that guy? No pressure, but style counts. (Perry salutes and walks away sadly) Let's, uh, let's give him a few days, and then we should talk to him about his exits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi-ya, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh hi Candace, what are you doing here? In my house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh just barging around. You know me, big barger. So, what is that?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, just a little birthday video I'm editing for Phineas.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then let's see.

Name: Computer Phineas
Dialog: (in the video, spliced together) We'll-Be-Together-Forever-Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Looks embarrassed at Candace) Hehe...

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... don't you have anything more, you know, unusual?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Of course! Watch this. (Presses play)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in video) I saw the best girls of my troop, hungry, patchless, out of uniform.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, seriously, whoa. I mean, like Phineas's inventions?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nope, I didn't get any of that footage.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then you're useless to me. Candace out!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (After Candace leaves) Hm... I'll have to talk to her about her exits.

Name: Computer Phineas
Dialog: (spliced again) Isabella-Will-You-Marry-Me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (dreamily) Ah... The magic of digital editing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz

Dialog: You have no idea. So, did a shark really eat your leg?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Arr, probably. But he definitely chewed on my arm. (shows Stacy a small mark on his arm)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uhh, that's just a birthmark.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: ...I'm tired of this conversation.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thar she blows!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: I see you, Mister Beast! (spins the ship's wheel)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can't this tug go any faster?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: There be only one captain on this ship.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like the reenactment has started! Let's give 'em a run for their money, Ferb! (Ferb salutes; so does the shark) They're still on our tail! (the shark leaps out of the water and splashes down in front of the Pea-quad)

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: He be toying with us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ayeee!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cannonball, Ferb. (the shark leaps out of the sea)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well at least we'll all get wet. (the shark splashes down, only soaking Candace; she shouts to the sky) Really? Really?? (an octopus lands on Captain Squint's face)

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Arr! It's the octopus that ate me pancreas!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the sky) Thank you.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Get back here, beast! (the shark sends the Pea-quad flying with a tail flick)

Name: Candace, Stacy, Captain Squint
Dialog: Whoa! (the Pea-quad skips across the sea)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, six skips! (to Ferb) Nice going.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here we go. (rolls backwards off the stern but lands on a metal grate) Ow! Oh, okay, that hurt. All right, better just, uh... (prods the water with his spear gun) Okay, I'm good. (jumps off his boat and swims down to the Saltwater Taffy-inator; he pushes a button) Now I will activate my Saltwater Taffy-inator. (turns a handle; the -inator begins spinning taffy) At last! Now nothing can prevent me from promoting tooth decay! Ha-HA-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha... (fogs up his scuba mask) Aw, I fogged up my mask again! (clears his mask to reveal Perry in a wetsuit swimming towards him; Perry punches him backwards) Perry the Platypus? How did you get out? (Perry flashes back to the crabs forming a ladder, but Doofenshmirtz grabs him from behind) Ha! I grabbed you while you were flashing back to your escape! Hee-hee-hee... drbt! (Perry kicks him and starts swimming away)

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: Yikes!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (holding a fishing rod with the cheese hook) I've caught many a fish with this lure. (casts the hook at the shark, catching it) Take the pole and I'll man the wheel! (lets go of the rod, causing it to yank the two girls forward)

Name: Candace, Stacy
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Stacy, pull!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Rubber ducks? Are you serious?!?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Does a penguin fly?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Aw, now I'm tired of this conversation too! (leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The ducks are back!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (emerges from the head holding a plunger attached to a rope) I'll harpoon the beast!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's a plunger.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: I didn't buy this ship for its plumbing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yahhh! Swim for your life! (the taffy engulfs Perry and Doofenshmirtz and starts spinning them around)

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: Come to Papa, beast. Well, I-I ain't really a papa; I-I never had kids of my own, see, and... if I did they probably wouldn't be... sharks, but... you know what I mean! (the shark emerges at the stern) Ohhh... ohh!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, he reaches!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We're gonna need a bigger captain.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cheese and sausage?

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: So this is what the inside of a shark looks like? I always thought it would be more... stomach-y.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think maybe it's time we just call it quits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (putting on Captain Squint's hat and wielding his harpoon) Stacy, I'm tired of this conversation!(lightning strikes behind them)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (trapped in the taffy) Ha-HA! I still have the upper hand! (the taffy spinner rotates, moving Perry above Doofenshmirtz) Well, actually you may at this particular mo... (the taffy squishes them together, then separates them again) Chew first, Perry the Plat... ahhh!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hoist the mainsail! (Stacy does so) Swab the poop deck! (Stacy does so) Watch that jib, sailor. (the jib knocks Stacy's hat off) Now take the helm! (puts Stacy at the wheel and rides a rope onto the bowsprit) I've got a date with destiny, and it ain't gonna end with a kiss! (spots the shark through a spyglass) You've vexed me for too long. Too long! Full speed ahead, Stacy; get me in close!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Aye aye, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Captain!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Captain! (aside) Yikes, what is it about that hat?

Name: Candace
Dialog: From Danville Harbor I stab at thee; for busting's sake I spit my last spit at thee! (spits onto the plunger's bell) Unh! (hurls the plunger at the shark's fin, where it sticks) Make for shore, Stacy! We've got him! (the ship turns for shore, hauling the shark with it)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (looking through a window in the shark) Say, whoever's on that boat has the story wrong. They're supposed to drive us out to sea, not drag us into shore! Looks like we're gonna need a bigger shark. (pulls a handle, making the shark grow in size; the grown shark starts dragging the Pea-quad out to sea)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now I wish I'd made that "OFF" button more accessible from the taffy itself. (sighs; he and Perry are completely trapped in the taffy) I wonder how this is affecting the surface water.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that the best you've got?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (emerging from the head with a handful of plungers) I found more harpoons! And I'm gonna pretend these have never been used!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Load the cannon! (Stacy loads all the plungers into the cannon) Stand clear! (Candace lights the cannon, which fires; however, a rope loops around Candace's ankle and pulls her off the ship)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (clicks her tongue) Yep.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (roped to the shark; screams and bangs on the shark) I know you be in there!

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: (banging on the inside wall with a large fishhook) I'm-a get this outta here, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We need more power, Ferb! (Ferb lashes the shark's tail rapidly)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hard to starboard, Stacy! (Stacy turns the wheel port, turning the ship and shark around) Okay, that's port, but whatever!

Name: Puppet man
Dialog: Arr! Arr!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You know, it's such a shame the reenactment can't be this exciting.

Name: Captain Squint
Dialog: A-ha-ha-ha! Free at last! Thanks for me new leg, boys! (his leg fires a rocket engine and Captain Squint flies away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Look, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Mom! Look at the shark!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What? (removes her wet bonnet and two starfish covering her eyes) Oh, that? (sees Buford and Baljeet in their "shark" costume) They get cheesier every year.

Name: Buford
Dialog: ROAR!! (starts shaking Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You cannot attack me; I am the tail!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (yanks up Baljeet by the tail) Shark wedgie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks up to them) That's not what I meant! (takes her hat off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: It never is, honey. (at the kids) Who wants blood pudding?

Name: Phineas, Buford, Baljeet
Dialog: Me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, this much I could've predicted, but I'm having a hard time explaining the giant metal shark. (sighs as the shark is pulled towards them by the taffy) Well, at least we'll go together, Perry the Platypus. (Perry ejects from his wetsuit through the scuba helmet and swims away) Oh sure, I reach out to you and then you use the emergency face plate ejector thing. (the shark crashes into Doofenshmirtz, the taffy, and the -inator, creating a cloud of bubbles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Plat-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: -ypus!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Walks out the sliding door) Hey Candace, what're you doing out here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey Stacy. (Blows out fire) I've got a lot of things to do today, so I figured I'd bust Phineas and Ferb early. You know, just to get it off my plate.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: How long have you been out here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Since last night.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah well... who are those guys?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know... who are you guys?

Name: Random Guy
Dialog: I thought you were waiting in line for concert tickets.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is my backyard!

Name: Random Guy
Dialog: There's always some kind of concert going on back here, I just thou--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get out of my yard!

Name: Random Guy
Dialog: Not a morning person.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, what's this big thing you wanted to do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, remember when Jeremy made that romantic dinner for me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, he microwaved you a pizza.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, a pizza for two.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ah, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I want to reciprocate and make him a romantic dinner.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Are you sure? Candace, I don't know a lot about cooking.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, neither do I, but I figure we'll use what you know and what I know and between the two of us we can figure it out right?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hm, why not? Now where's the cooking room?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's in the kitchen, that's where we keep all the cooking tools.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace! We're going to the moon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The moon? Wait a minute, why are you going to the moon? Kind of a step backwards considering you've already been to Mars.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you remember that old nursery rhyme The Cat and the Fiddle?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Vaguely.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Apparently, there was a last verse that was lost to history, until Ferb and I found it in the Dead Sea. It's a little wet and salty, but I'll read it. "Hey diddle diddle, the cat and the fiddle, the cow jumped over the moon. Due to the moon’s low gravity, the moon jumping cows' milk produced the best tasting ice cream ever!" That last verse didn't rhyme, so they left it out of most versions. Ferb and I are going to the moon to see if it's true!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't you need some cows for that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We do indeed.

Name: Cow Cup
Dialog: (moos) Cows, get on the ship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, (Scoffs) that's the dumbest thing I --

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, I'm going to count backwards from 10, and when I'm done, you better be down here so I can bust you! (The ramp starts retracting) 10...9...8...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! Let us get to our stations.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (While floating) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. Our sources tell us that Doof is up to something. We need you to infiltrate Doofenshmirtz Evil Inc. and have a little look see. To make it easier for you to get in, we have one of our operatives installing Central Access Threshold, or, CAT door. So, let's get out there and, good luck!

Name: Carl
Dialog: So now I'm an operative?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We're still not paying you, Carl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Remember everyone, (The spaceship door opens) the moon's gravity is 83.3% less than Earth.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So what? So let's bounce! (Jumps off the spaceship) Whee!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Hung upside down by Buford) No, No, Buford! Please do not drop me I-- (Buford lets go) Oh! Oooh, well this is not so bad.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah? (Jumps off the spaceship) Give it a second.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! How is it possible that you are heavier on the moon?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus. (Pause) What? Oh yes, the green? (Chuckles) I can explain.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It started two days ago when I was watering my plants. I noticed a beautiful garden on my neighbor's balcony. Oooh, I got so jealous. So the guy at the store told me—among other things—that my plants wouldn't grow because I didn't have a green thumb. A-and I should stop bothering with these types of plant questions and that my mere presence in the store was destroying his plants. So I got a big bucket of green paint, and I poured it on myself. Then I was green everywhere, except strangely my thumbs, I think it was the way I was holding the bucket.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyhoo, with another great idea, I created the Moisture Suck-Inator! See? See? I don't know why I built it here when I was going to use it on the balcony... That wasn't-- anyhoo, this device will suck all the moisture out of my neighbor's plants, which will turn them brown, and make my plants look greener by comparison. And I will finally have a green thumb! You know not actually—metaphorically! I’ll have a gre--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh! (Smacks his head) It's a metaphor! (Sighs) And I wasted all that money on green paint.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, nice job everyone! Now the cows have a place to live.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But what will the cows eat?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, not to worry. After scientists discovered the existence of frozen water on the moon, Ferb and I began shooting seeds up here. Then we shot up hundreds of these pocket warmers to melt the ice in the ground.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But Phineas, there's no oxygen here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's alright, the grass will create its own oxygen through photosynthesis!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, but you would still need so-- (Grass shoots up)—Oooh, or not.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We got our grass, Ferb. Let's get the herd fed.

Name: Cow Cup
Dialog: (moos) Cows, lunchtime.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. My gosh. Stacy. Your cooking hat looks so cute!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yours too!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (From outside) Mission control to Moon Farm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Come in Moon Farm.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Through radio) This is Moon Farm, come back.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, this is mission control. Your transmission's a little garbled, but still understandable, over!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! (Marches over) What do you think you're doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that Candace?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yes, she was just about to--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just give me that! (Snatches the microphone) Phineas, you are so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Candace. How's the cooking for Jeremy going?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey ask him what we should cook!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Roger that, Stacy. Ferb suggests lamb cobbler on account of Jeremy's British background.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We don't have that recipe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's okay, Ferb knows it by heart! You and Stacy go in the kitchen and we'll relay the recipe step by step through mission control.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright. But I'm still busting you! I'm still busting them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb says the first thing you'll need is a big bowl, over.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Roger, mission control out. (Pause) A big bow? Hm, well I guess that'll make it look pretty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Groans) I got it. Man, why didn't I put wheels on this thing?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There. (Cracks back) I'll just aim it... there perfect. Now, you will witness the dehydrating effects of my Moisture-Suck-Inator on my neighbor's garden! And (Steps on switch) Fire!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that doesn't seem to be working. Let me try it on something else. Hmm... (Drags the Moisture-Suck-Inator to Perry)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is going to hurt you more than it'll hurt me, Perry the Platypus. Fire!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Oh look at you, you're Pruny the Dehydra-pus. (Pause) Hm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I wonder why it didn't do that to the neighbor's plants. Maybe it's too far away- maybe- argh. (Grinding noise) I gotta try it again. I'm not going to let that guy make me look like a nincomp--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: --Oh poop. (Green beam hits him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm going to go get a glass of water. (Pause) You want one Perry the Platypus?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: This doesn't seem right Candace. I mean, four eggs bleated, a big bow, one pound of lamp—I mean that's not even food.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Trust me Stacy, as annoying as Phineas and Ferb are, they're usually right.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb say—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nu- Not in the house (Footsteps)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb say, three cups of self-righteous flowers.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You see? That's what I'm talking about; self-righteous flowers? What are self-righteous flowers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well roses always seemed stuck up to me.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Pause) Okay, so let's go pick some roses.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Moon!

Name: Cow
Dialog: (Moos)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Moo-na. Two syllables cow, two. Moo-na.

Name: Cow
Dialog: (moos)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Man, these cows are dumb.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, that's much better. I was parched, how about you? We should do this more often, this was nice. Now if you excuse me, I'm going to jet-pack over to my neighbor's balcony and see what's going on with those plants. (jet-pack spurts fire, burning clothes) Right after I change my pants.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So what's next, Irving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb say, bake at 350 for one hour. Serves two. Speaking of serves two, I was thinking of, you know, after you girls are done here maybe we could-- (Door closes on him)—Okay, that's golden, we'll just put a pin in it for now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what are we going to do? Jeremy will be here in five minutes!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Relax Candace, it's simple math. Instead of 350 for one hour, we'll just cook this for five minutes at... (punches buttons on a calculator) ...9000 degrees. (Pause) What could go wrong?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, ice cream's ready. Let's dig in. (Licks ice cream) Mmm. This is the best ice cream I've ever had!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey! What do you mean you blame Baljeet?

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: Well, it was clearly your responsibility.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Where are you getting your information from, disembodied reggae space voice?

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: Hey, I have a name you know.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh yeah? What is it?

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: Well, it's disembodied reggae space voice, but that's just a coincidence; you didn't know that!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, look who's sensitive! Besides, Buford could have brought the marshmallows.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, leave me out of this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guys, guys, we have limited time here! Baljeet, could you please stop arguing with the soundtrack?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He started it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey you, I got a question for you. How do you get your plants—What? Plastic! (pokes plastic man)

Name: Man
Dialog: Something I can help you with, rocket man?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah! What's with all the plastic plants? And the plastic man?

Name: Man
Dialog: I like plastic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh so you're just trying to make me look like a fool. Well I don't need you-- (accidentally turns on jet-pack) Ow Ow Ow Ow Ow! I’ll just take the stairs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know Stacy, I got a bad feeling about this. What am I going to do if it isn't even edible?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, technically it is English food.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, here goes. (opens pot, gasps) Lamb cobbler! And it's beautiful!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: How could that be? We didn't even put lamb in it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, what's going on out here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Candace, we brought you some moon cow ice cream!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't care if you brought me ice cream from the moon. When Mom sees this spaceship in the yard, you two'll be soooo busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. So how do you think our cows will do up on the moon?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, photosynthesis will start creating oxygen and eventually an atmosphere. Our bovine friends will be fine.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. We know where to go for ice cream.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Opening pot, gasps) It's all dried out!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, everybody!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! I—uh—you're here!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. It's really nice of you to make something for me. I can't wait to see what you've come up with.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh—uh—yeah...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I'll bet it's great.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um... here's the thing. It's uh... I—I just don't know if you'll like it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, ice cream.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? (Phineas gives a thumbs up) Oh, yeah. Ice cream for two.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh... Perry the Platypus? (Chuckles nervously) Yeah, I'm over here. Yeah I uh... I forgot my keys so I thought I— you know, just fit through the uh... (Perry opens door) Oh good, you're going to go get (Perry hangs a "do not disturb sign" on him) Wait, what's that? That better not be a "Do not disturb" sign. CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is the best ice cream I've ever had!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey! I thought we discussed this earlier.

Name: Singer
Dialog: It's in de lyrics, mon.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey boys, want some fat-free whole-grain granola bars? They're still warm from the oven.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whole-grain and fat-free? (He and Ferb take a granola bar) You know us so well.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Walks off) Yes, yes I do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Mom's always doing nice things for us. I think it's time we did something nice for Mom! Let's see... We could—No...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or—Uh uh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're trying to think of a nice thing we can do for Mom. Any ideas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You can clean up the whole house for her!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Or, you can get a classic wooden slide rule from Analog Emporium.

Name: Buford
Dialog: How do I know what adults like? What am I, a computer?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! I know what we're gonna do today. We're gonna make a super computer!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? Your Mom wants a super computer? What is she? Some kind of nerd?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, we're gonna ask the computer what to do for Mom.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Slide rule! I gave it to you on a silver platter!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, I'm going out. (Pulls out a coupon) I've got a coupon for a free hair styling from this new salon. I'm gonna freshen up my look. Granola bars are in the kitchen! (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. Maybe I'll feed mine to Perry. Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. The entire Tri-State Area's becoming riddled with holes. Also, numerous light beams have been shot from Doofenshmirtz's building. Either he's having some sort of a rave, or he's the one behind all those holes. Investigate at once! (Salutes) Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: And that's the story of how you made me.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's cute!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Repeatedly firing his ray) That's not it... That's not it...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's not it... (Picks up an item) That is not it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's not it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Welcome, Perry the Platypus. How do you like your trap? That's super quick drying cement. See? (Knocks on the cement) Solid as a, uh... I dunno, some rock-like substance. Cement, maybe! Now, with you safely trapped, I introduce you to the Metal-Unearth-inator! (The Metal-Unearth-inator fires, and a can comes back)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, gang, It's ready to go. We just need to perform an initial scan of the Tri-State Area so it has enough data to work with.

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Scanning the Tri-State-Area.

Name: Boy
Dialog: Between that and the random laser drills, this is like the second best mid-day scrapyard rave ever!

Name: Doctor
Dialog: (Preparing to activate a CT scanner) Hold still and... (The red scan light flashes, showing her skeleton. She pulls out her cell phone) Hello, Hospital Workers Union.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Get out of my mind!

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Gathering data from all objects and habitants. Computing all logical outcome of all events. (Finishes scanning, bell dings) Done.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, computer. Are you ready to answer any question?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Yes, my data is complete. My logic, infallible.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's 2 + 2?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: 4. Perhaps you should just count on your fingers.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry. What's the square root of 72,361?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: 269. Try something more unusual.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are the names the girls in my Fireside Girls troop?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Gretchen, Adyson, Holly, Katie, Milly, and Ginger.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, he's good!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: On a multi-valve engine with variable timing, how can I isolate an exhaust valve leak at the stem seal without removing the can shaft?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Coat the engine with tomato paste and the leak will reveal itself.

Name: Buford
Dialog: He's right! Uh, what size pants do I wear?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Boys, husky, extra large.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He's right!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Impressive! (Thumbs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you seem to be working perfectly so, computer, what is the nicest thing we can do for Mom today?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Computing... (Ding) Done. Get a gallon of industrial marking dye and a leaf blower. Tie balloons onto them. Then, go to the top of Danville Hill, and at 2

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Nothing would make your mother happier today.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You turned that slide rule for this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know, Baljeet. From what we seen so far, I think a little blind faith is called for.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know nothing about women.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Dude, it's over.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, there must be something bustable going on around here. (Notices the super computer. She drops her phone) What...is..that?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: I am a super computer. I can answer any question that you can possibly ask.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did my brothers make you?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Yes. Yes, they did.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. So, let me think of a question... Hmm... How many states in the United States?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What goes on top of pancakes?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Butter and syrup.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How do you pronounce the "J" in "Jalapeño"?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: It makes the "H" sound.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Hisses) I knew that. How many fingers behind my back?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Two.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, that's just freaky. And...bustable! All I gotta do is... (Pause) But it never works! No matter what I try, whatever the boys do just disappears before Mom looks! If only there was some way to guarantee Mom would see what the boys done? (Looks at the supercomputer) Ee-ee-ee-ee-ee-ee-ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Another one? Why are there so many helmets buried in the Tri-State Area? (Tosses it off) Ah, onto the pile you go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, Perry the Platypus, hope you didn't come here because of the holes, because the Metal-Unearth-inator is not even my final plan. May I present to you my real plan? The All-Purpose-inator! You heard of a man's man? Well, this is an inator's inator. (His hand is seen on the control panel) It does everything!
