(Takes his hand off the control panel) Of course, once I activate it, it will make all my inators obsolete, but, uh... I guess that's progress. Unfortunately, I ran into a little snag...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: After putting all the final touches on my All-Purpose-inator, I took a step back to admire my handiwork. Victory was finally within my grasp.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All I needed to do is turn the thing on. (Flashback Doofenshmirtz pulls out a key) Then fate made a cruel joke. (Flashback Doofenshmirtz slips on green paint. The key falls off the balcony) The ignition key fell of my balcony!

Name: Flashback Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nooooooo!!!!! (With binoculars, he spots a gopher take the key and run into its hole)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I could tell he was laughing. You know, that way gophers do. And there's no way I was going to go all the way down there to get the key. I've got a schedule to keep.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, I decided to build the Metal-Unearth-inator to track down and dig up the key so I can fire up my All-Purpose-inator...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...so I can take over the Tri-State Area. Somehow. You know, you can put the red king on... (groaning) Hey; you're not even listening.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But then, when I bring Mom into the backyard, it's gone and Mom never sees it. So here's my question, Mr. Supercomputer, how can I get my Mom to see what my brothers have done?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Elementary. You must build a device that makes your Mom see what your brothers have done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What kind of device?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Follow my instructions to the letter and when you have finished, I am 100% certain that your Mom will see what your brothers have done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Where do I start? (pulls out a notepad and a pencil)

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: (while Candace is writing) You are going to need a toaster, a number two screwdriver, some electrical tape...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Helmet, helmet, another helmet. What happened here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A chisel? (picks it up) Well, it's no key but at least we're getting closer in size. (tosses it over his shoulder)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A hammer? Why would someone bury a hammer? Well, onto the pile you go. (tosses the hammer)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm closing in on the key. I can feel it. (gasps) Perry the Platypus, how did you get out?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps again) Well, two can play at that game.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (chuckles; awkward silence) Uh, wait a second. Hold on. (rummages in the pile) Not this, not this. There was a whole bunch of 'em just a couple of minutes ago. A-ha! Jackpot!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, meet your doom. (screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Keep up, Buford, it's almost 2

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I don't have balloons to lighten my load.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I would have walked.

Name: All
Dialog: Three, two, one... (Phineas and Ferb releases the items into the air) Liftoff!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There they go. Industrial orange marker dye and a leaf blower. Guaranteed happiness for Mom. Somehow. Let's follow and see what happens.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This way, everybody.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Sure, now you put me down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There, finished. Did I put it together right?

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: You built it perfectly, Candace. Your Mom will definitely see what the boys have done. And you finished it just in time, because in two seconds your Mom is going to pull up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! You're right about everything! (runs off) I can't lose! (to Linda) Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mo...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace trails off as she opens the driver's side door,... revealing Linda's bad hair-do.) Uh....

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm having a bad day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, never mind. Come on, come on, come on. (pushes Linda towards the backyard)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, no so tough without your mace. (Perry glares at him) Now, I have the upper hand. (Perry takes off the helmet) Prepare to meet your doom... (He holds up the shield after Perry throws it at him.) You throw your helmet at me? That's so lame, Perry the... (Perry starts throwing helmets at him.) Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow!

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Precisely on schedule.

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: Hello gopher! (the wiring detaches from it)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pushes Linda into the backyard with eyes closed) It's over here! It's over here! See?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, Candace (turns around) most days, this is just a little disturbing. But today, with the free coupon (camera pans up) and this whole awful thing with my hair...

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: And the gopher lets go now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with eyes closed) If only I had...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (groans)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (opens her eyes; looks in the hand mirror) Huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: My hair looks so...cute! I guess it just needed some time to settle. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, buuuuuu...

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's so great when something nice happens to you, especially when you weren't expecting it. (exits)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What just happened?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did something nice for Mom. We fixed her bad hairdo. Apparently.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You did that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yup.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You... did that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's right. With a little supercomputer help.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, when Mom looked in the mirror on that thing I built, she saw what you had done?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's right.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And by the way, nice use of the accordion arm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! I hate computers! (exits)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where'd the computer go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh! The key detection alarm! I forgot I installed that. (tosses the sword and shield) Here it comes,...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...here it comes, here it comes. (pause) Wait!

Name: Supercomputer
Dialog: I knew this was going to happen.

Name: Doofemshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Doofemshmirtz
Dialog: Well, at least I found the key to the...

Name: Doofemshmirtz
Dialog: Nice! Curse you, Perry the...

Name: Doofemshmirtz
Dialog: (groans) Why does everything explode so easily?

Name: Doofemshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I knew that was gonna happen.

Name: Reynolds
Dialog: Hello, Tri-State Area. This is Al Reynolds reporting from the Danville Zoo. I'm here with Tykera Kwok and the zoo's latest acquisition. (at Tykera) Tykera, what is this thing? It looks like a beaver-duck.

Name: Tykera
Dialog: No, this is a platypus.

Name: Reynolds
Dialog: (on TV) A platypus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, he looks like you, Perry.

Name: Tykera
Dialog: (on TV) That's right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course, he doesn't look nearly as smart.

Name: Reynolds
Dialog: Well, what does it do?

Name: Tykera
Dialog: Not much. He does like sandwiches though.

Name: Reynolds
Dialog: (chuckles) So, got anything for the hundreds and thousands of people about to change the channel on me might find remotely interesting?

Name: Tykera
Dialog: Well, over here we've some pelicans and a baby rhino.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: What's that smell?

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: That's my sandwich. I left it back at the truck.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: No, I mean that other smell.

Name: Delivery Man 2
Dialog: Oh, that's you.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: Oh yeah, right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on her cell phone) I'm doing the shopping, do you need anything?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (via cell phone) No, I'm good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: The boys said they'd have fun at home so go out and do something instead of waiting around for Jeremy to call.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I do stuff! Uh-oh, call waiting. Bye! (presses a button) Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I just called to let you know I'll be at the big pet wash at the park today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pet wash?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. Instead of cars, we wash pets for charity. You know, you can really...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. Hang on, Jeremy. (at Perry) Okay, eww! Off the couch, go on. Get out of here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You heard me. Hit the road, meat brick.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at Jeremy) You were saying?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I was saying you can really tell a lot about a person by the way they treat animals.

Name: Candace
Dialog: True.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, why don't you bring Perry to the park and we can wash him together? Sound like fun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Okay, see you there. (closes cell phone) Oh, Perry! Come here, you little meat brick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I've been thinking. Since there's nothing more fun than fun, why no add fun to everything?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fun shoes, fun oatmeal,...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...fun origami. Well, origami's already fun. Fun... (close-up of Ferb's face) house! Great idea, Ferb! We'll turn our house into a fun house, by you know, adding fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, guys, where's Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think he went that way. (points to the left)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (picks Perry up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking past them) I'm borrowing your platypus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (opens his eyes) Okay, have fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Will you stop squirming? You're a platypus. It's not like you have anywhere you need to be!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Where's Agent P? You set off the wrist beacon, right, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm worried too, sir. So I thought I'd make myself useful by modifying his chair. I added a hidden button so the chair will automatically go to Doofenshmirtz's. Then automatically return here. (laughs) Everything's Agent P sized here. It's kind of cute, like kindergarten.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: Sign here, please.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let me guess, you guys just delivered to the zoo?

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: Oh, yes. Yes, we did.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought I detected a hint of western lowland gorilla.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: (sighing) No. No, that's me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Sorry, dude.

Name: Delivery Man 1
Dialog: (while walking away) That's okay, I'm learning to live with it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeesh. I could learn a thing or two from you about talking less. (pulls out blueprint; opens it) Now let's see. The hall of mirrors obviously goes in the hall, but where should we put the liquid nitrogen room?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What is taking Agent P so long?(notices the sandwich) Carl, what is in that sandwich?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gulps; pause) Peanut butter, banana, and sardines.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, I can see the smell from here. Put it down and test all the outside portals. Maybe the doors are stuck or something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, sir. (places sandwich on console; pulls down a lever)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Seems like it's working just...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Thank goodness. (pause) You're in the way, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh. Sorry, sir. (walks to the right)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we were... Wait a minute. (close-up of the zoo platypus) You're not in uniform, agent. Where is your hat?

Name: Computerized voice
Dialog: Auto hat activated.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's better. Sorry to be so harsh, Agent P, but today is a very special day. Your 100th battle with Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (blows noisemaker)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We planted hundreds of hidden cameras in Evil Incorporated (image of D.E.I. shows on monitor) so that we here at headquarters can watch the historic event and also enjoy some cheap laughs. (chuckles)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We've got hours of that, hours. Now, do us proud, Agent P.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Man, look at all these pet lovers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, my peeps.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You ready for your bath, huh, boy? Who loves Candace? Oh, who's a beautiful boy? Who loves Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) What do you need? What do you need? You know what you need?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do I need?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) A bath.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (quickly opens her eyes) What? (realizes) Oh, yeah, right. Right. Right. Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's wrong with you, Perry? Don't you wanna get clean, you dirty little... (Perry kicks her; she lets go of him) Whoops! Where'd he go?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (while Perry quickly reverts to pet mode) I think he's behind that tree. (picks Perry up, who chatters again; hands him to Candace) See, he's glad you found him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, me too.

Name: Reynolds
Dialog: (on TV) It looks like the zoo's new beaver-duck has escaped.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, local news. (turns TV off with a remote) All summer long, we have this standing appointment and suddenly Mr. Big Shot can't be troubled to... (screams; spills his coffee)

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Hurry up, Carl. The fight's about to begin.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on TV) Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So kind of you to finally show up (pushes the button on the remote) and demolish my wall.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (tosses the remote) Gotcha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the Least-Likely-inator! All I have to do is zap someone with this baby and they can't help but do the least likely thing to their nature. (activates the Least-Likely-inator and a red ray comes out of it) Ooh, touchy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Irving. Did you hear? Phineas and Ferb are building a fun house.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Really? (gets zapped by the ray; leans against an imaginary lamp post) Who cares? I'm too cool for those losers. Say, you're cute. (falls over) There used to be a lamp post there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So what am I gonna do with the Least-Likely-inator, you ask? Make my daughter obey me? Make my father love me? No, and double no! ...Well, maybe later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But first, I'm gonna aim this bad boy at City Hall and zap my brother the mayor. And he'll make a fool of himself in front of the legislature, which is the least likely thing he'd ever do. And the city will be forced to give the Tri-State Area to me, his next of kin! And don't tell me democracy doesn't work like that, Perry the Platypus. (covers his ears) I don't wanna hear it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (uncovers his ears; turns around) Perry the Platypus, you escaped already?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, don't do that! I haven't vacuumed here in weeks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whee! Wall slide's working.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Dinnerbell, where do you want the clown head?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Clown room. (at Isabella) Hey, Isabella, how's that hall of cookies coming?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great, but I had to double the recipe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, how's the basement spin?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, down on all fours! I know that fighting technique. (gets down on all fours) It's Singapore Crab! I learnt in Hoboken. (moves back and forth; stands up; imitates a crab) Oh, yeah, I'm gonna sidewalk all over you, baby.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I see what you're doing. You're messing with my head. Trying to get into my mind. Walk around in there, rearrange the furniture...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on TV) ...maybe repaint the kitchen.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Take note, Carl. You're watching a master agent at work. (eats some popcorn)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah, you're in for it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Served with butter! (imitates a crab again; chuckles; zoo platypus walks by him; gets down on all fours) Hey, where'd you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, that's my sandwich display case.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Get him, Agent P!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A fake-out, eh? (gets out from under the fallen display stand) Okay, Perry the Platypus, the claws are off now. From here on in, I fight the man style!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffling) Okay. I see you found the brick wall.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, the Marsh Maneuver. Well, I haven't seen one of those since 1974.

Name: Carl
Dialog: 1974? You had a perm back then.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Stay off the Internet, Carl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunting; takes out Perry from tub) Here's cuteness!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (holds out towel; water drips off of Perry) That little guy's just drowning in mother love.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's the matter, Perry the Platypus? Don't they feed you at the agency?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, resting now. Resting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you wanna go public? Fine.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Candace, you sure know your pet.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You're the most responsible pet owner I've ever seen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's me. Now that we're here, can I offer you a... (opens back door)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: A fun house? Man, your brothers are cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. I'm sure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was some fun, huh, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, not fun! Not fun.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from outside the house) Candace? Boys? Come help me with the groceries.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I stand corrected. (leans out of her bedroom window) Mom, Phineas and Ferb built a giant fun house inside our house!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be right there. I just gotta get the groceries.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute. I've been going about this all wrong. I should be zapping you with the Least-Likely-inator so you'll lose! But first, I gotta get this sandwich out of the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Typical. (groans) I should've zapped myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom! Phineas and Ferb built a... (gets zapped by the ray) Urrgh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why am I doing this?

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, where's this fun house?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace cleaned the whole thing up before you could see it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You cleaned up the whole thing before I could see it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that seems unlikely.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it does.

Name: Major Monogram, Carl
Dialog: Surprise!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Congratulations! Astounding work.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Your 100th battle with Dr. Doofenshmirtz...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: ...is already a big hit on the O.W.C.A. internet.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: With five million downloads so far.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're a star, Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know what, Ferb? This is gonna be the most interesting thing we've ever built.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And the tallest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, and the tallest.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And the heaviest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, we're chatty today, aren't we?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the "phone") I know, Stace, I can't believe I lost another one! I'll go out of my mind without it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (knocks on the door then opens it) Candace, I've got something for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I gonna have to call you back. My new phone is here. (reveals her "phone" is actually her hand) Wee! Gimme, gimme, gimme, gimme! (receives her phone) So, how many apps does it run? Can I play MP3s and send texts to Stacy the same time? How 'bout... Hey, wait a minute. All this phone does is...make phone calls!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sorry, Candace. You've lost four phones in four months, so I got you the cheapest replacement I could find. If you lose this one, it's life without a phone for Candace Flynn. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Life without a phone for Candace Flynn"? But...but that's me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (outside) Fire in the hole! (explosion)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, will you keep... (trips over a rug and the cell phone falls out of the window) NOOO!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Well, how about that? It's all right.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Hey, kid, where do you want me to leave these ridiculously heavy bars?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just set them down over there somewhere.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not on my phone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: On second thought, bring 'em over here.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Sure thing, kid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks a lot.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: No sweat, kid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAHH!! It's blinking. Maybe it's still okay!

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Oh, hey. I need you to sign this invoice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. And here...you go.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Thanks, kid.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Oh, forgot my pen.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here you go.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Thanks kid.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: It had a cap.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, sorry.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Take it easy, kid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs down to the backyard) Oh, no! Phonsie! Oh, what've they done to you? (picks up the phone's debris) Hello? Hello? Can anyone hear me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I can hear you, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, great, it still works. (at the phone's debris) Yeah, Phineas, I was just telling you that...uh! (realizes)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh no, is that your new cell phone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It used to be. Wait a second. You guys are good with wires and gadgets and stuff. Can you fix it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it took almost forty years to perfect the technology that makes the modern cell phone possible. So...give us thirty-eight minutes. (at Ferb) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today, before we do the other thing that we were gonna do today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: What?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Look, I'm getting messages from some diabolically clever hacker, who goes by the sinister initials "TTYL".

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, that means "talk to you later". If you scroll down, you can see that message was from me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, oh, I see. That's, uh, very clever.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good morning, Agent P. Uh...beat it, Carl. I'm on. (Carl leaves) Sources tell us that Doofenshmirtz's "ROTFL". We don't know what that means, but it sounds dangerous.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, ROTFL means...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not now, Carl. I'm briefing Agent P. (at Perry) So get out there and good hunting. (Perry leaves)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, no! Carl, now it just says q-q-q-q-q-q-q.

Name: Carl
Dialog: It means your thumb is on the Q-key sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the phone) Charlene, now I'm waiting for my exercise show to start, so I can't get Vanessa from class. Well, why can't you pick her up? Well, how long does the surgery take? What about afterwards? Okay, okay. All right, I'll do it. I'll figure something out. Yes, yes, I promise. Good bye. (turns off the phone) Sheesh. Maybe I could build some sort of Inator that would pick her up for me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas; Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We made Candace the best phone ever! (reveals the phone) What we've done here is revolutionized modern technology. We put all kinds of cool features on it. My favorite is the voice-activated phone transporter app. Show 'em, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Ferb reveals a video projector) You just say the words, "Go to", and then specify the name or place you're trying to reach, and the phone will take you there. Allow me to demonstrate. (at Isabella) Isabella, would you go stand over there on the driveway, please?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure, Phineas. (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: She's gone. Let's talk about her.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Focus, Buford.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (on the driveway) Ready spaghetti!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to the cell phone) Go to Isabella.

Name: Cell Phone
Dialog: Isabella, located.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm transporting. (to the phone) Go to garage.

Name: Cell Phone
Dialog: Garage, located.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Dang it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, then, Phineas was all like... (Phineas reappears) I'll finish my story later.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And that's how it works.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Phineas. Thirty-eight minutes is up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, Candace, you really should see our interactive tutorial.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The only thing that I wanna see is you later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rim shot on the cell phone) What was that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was the rim shot app. Are you sure you don't wanna watch the tutorial?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm a teenage girl. Nobody has to teach me how to use a cell phone. Now if you'll excuse me, me and little phonsie-wonsie have to make up for lost time. Okay? Yeah, we do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: O-kaay. Let's get back to what we were doing before.

Name: Buford
Dialog: When we get there, let's talk about Candace.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, it's dark down here. (hits over something) Uh, ohh! Turn on the light, Heinz, you're not a bat. (turns on the light) Hey! It's Norm's old head, the original prototype! I wonder if it still works.

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: (sarcastic) Oh, great, look who's here. It's Dr. Doof-degree-purchased-on-the-Internet-with-my-wife's-money-enshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I must say it's good to hear your voice again, too, after so long! I just came down here to get some parts for my new -inator.

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: Hey, take me with you. I haven't seen you blow yourself up for a long time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, Mr. Smarty-pants. Come on, let's go.

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: Hey, on the way, let's swing by the store and get you some deodorant.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quiet, you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her new phone) Yeah, so, like, then I like had to go 38 minutes without a phone, and I was like, "You guys better fix it, or else!" and they were like, "Candace, you're the best big sister we've ever had!" and I was like "Yeah." and they were like "WOOAHEEEHH!"

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I'd love to hear more, and I'm sure I will, but right now I'm trying to finish this documentary on Easter Island. Man, I wish I could go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why would you ever want to go to Easter Island?

Name: Cell Phone
Dialog: Easter Island, located.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what happened to your voice? (transports to Easter Island) Oh, how did I get here? PHINEAS AND FEEERB!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've really got to hand it to myself, Norm's Old Head. I'm a genius!

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: Ohh, is that what you see? 'Cause I'm looking at a lab coat filled with Doonkleberries on top of which someone has strategically placed a cabbage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is my new -inator. I call it the Pick-'Em-Up inator.

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: Hm-mm; so what's this one do and where can I hide when it doesn't do it and blows up?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All I have to do is enter the coordinates and launch. (coughs)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ugh. I should've known Dad would be late. (the -inator landed over her and picks her up) Oh, what is this? Curse you, unknown rocket-helmet-transportation thing! (the Inator drops her at her house) Oh, sweet, I'm home. Never mind, unknown rocket-helmet-transportation thing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, look, Old Norm Head. It worked. It functioned properly! Vanessa's all picked up and taken home, with three minutes to spare.

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: That's great. We can spend the rest of the day working on your personality. Hey, this time let's try to bump to a C minus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I'm starting to remember why I replaced you and put you in storage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? What? I didn't do anything wrong today. I just built an Inator to pick up my daughter. But, hey, as long as you're here, why don't you join me for my evil exercise show? I've got a spare headband.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Easter Island? Who makes an app that sends people in Easter Island? (a bird grabs her cell phone) Hey, come back here! I need that to get home! (runs over a cliff) Aaaah! Oh, that was close. Talk about a cliffhanger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can I get you a sports drink, Perry the Platypus? No? All right. Suit yourself. Say, as long as you're tied up, I'll tell you the evil plan I just thought of while we were working out. See, I figured my Pick-'Em-Up-Inator works so well; I could mass produce them and pick up everyone in the Tri-State Area! (drinks the sports drink) Then, they would have to do what I tell them. Man, what is in this stuff?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, bird! You better give me my phone or I'm gonna rock you to sleep...with a REAL rock!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rim shot on the cell phone again) Ugh!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes? What is it, Agent T? (Agent T shows him) Oh no, that's Candace Flynn of the Flynn-Fletcher family.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the cliff) Phineas! Aaaaah!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I better notify Agent P. Good work, Agent T.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading the label) "Glycerol, glycerol, ester of rosin, yellow 15." I guess they had 14 other yellows.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Sucrose acetate, isobut."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaah! What was that about? Man, tie a guy up and he gets all foot-stompy on you for no reason!

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: Hey, Perry the Platypus, could you do me a favor and leave that remote here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Urgh. There, I'm better. Hey. Perry the Platypus, that's it? You're just gonna thwart and run?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the... (his phone rings) Hello? Oh hi, Vanessa. Yes, that was my -inator. Listen, honey, I'm in the middle of something, hold on one second. (at Perry) ...PLATYPUUUS! (at Vanessa) So, how was class?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, give me the phone, bird! (the bird pecks her) Aw, aww! Give me a break! (the twig breaks; rim shot on the cell phone again) AAAAAHHH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (The Inator picks her up) AAAAHHH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (she passes across the ocean, across a flock of birds, a giant wave, and outside the Earth) AAAAAAAHHHH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you were right, Ferb. The most interesting thing we ever built was very tall and very heavy. And the guy from the museum seemed very appreciative.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I still can't believe it fit in his truck.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAHHH! (lands beside them)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Buford was just talking about you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are SOOOO busted! I'm calling Mom right now. Oh, no. I don't have the phone! (car honks) That's Mom! When she finds out I lost it, my life is ruined!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax, Candace. We made two, just in case.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You did that for me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you. You do realize I'm still gonna have to bust you for making me go to Timbuktu?

Name: Cell Phone
Dialog: Timbuktu, located.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meap. (disappears)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's gonna miss pie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: PHINEAS AND FEEEERB!

Name: Old Norm Head
Dialog: Finally, a place where a head can be a head. When's the bunny get here with all the eggs? Huh? Yeah, Easter Island? Huh? Huh? Oh, man, where's the bird with the rim shot app when you need him.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Boys! Boys! Come quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is it, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's the new, digitally remastered third series of Pinhead Pierre! (boys bounce down on a large inflatable ball) Only the best series ever and my most favorite show ever. That's all.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You had us at come quick.

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: Hi kids! (kids applaud and cheer) Kids, sometimes when your head is this small, you just want to get away for a bit. You know, escape from all the laughing and pointing. Whenever I feel like that, you know what I do? Magic carpet ride! Roll out your official Pinhead Pierre rugs, kids!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Right-o! (runs to get it) It's been at my bedside all these years! (pushes coffee table over) Hop on, boys! (all sit on rug) We're about to take off on the ride of a lifetime!

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: What's the magic word?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Streptococcus!

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: Whoa! Whoa! We're flying!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Here we go, boys!

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: (showing obviously fake birds and clouds) And look out below! It's Paris. There's the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower! And there's the Colosseum?! What's that doing here?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, can you look at these tile samples with me? I want to re-do the living room.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (sadly) Oh well, I suppose it wasn't quite as thrilling as I remember. Carry on, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (wakes up; clears throat) WRONG PANTS! Huh? Oh, sorry, Agent P. Guess I was, uh, dozing there. Anyway, it appears Dr. Doofenshmirtz has completely cleared the Tri-State Area out of all grape juice, red wine, chocolate, marinara sauce, India ink, and, worst of all, (holds up mug) coffee! So, uh, go and, uh, you know, do the thing, that thing... Sorry. I'm just no good until I have that first mug o' Joe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I try and I try and I try and I try, but no matter what I do, things never work out like I planned! (Stacy is starting to fall asleep listening to her) Maybe if I knew how things were gonna turn out, I could plan for that and then do the right stuff! I know. I know. That doesn't make any sense, does it?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You said it, sister. Have a cookie. (throws fortune cookie at her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I guess it's too much to expect some magic answer to all my problems. (breaks cookie) Let's see. "Somebody close to you will take a trip." Boy, I hope they take me with them.

Name: Waiter
Dialog: (trips on cookie on the ground, which is what Candace's fortune said) I'm okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha ha! That was great. What a dumb coincidence. (breaks another cookie) Let's try another. "You'll know the truth when it hits you." OK, boring.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, no, girl. You are not--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (breaks another cookie) "Let the wisest among you light the way." There! A light bulb! And an old guy!

Name: '"Old guy
Dialog: "' Does anybody know where I live?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But Candace, you jus--

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Stacy. It's real. These cookies know what's going to happen next! I can use them to bust my brothers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks for the cookies!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Worker
Dialog: HEY! THOSE COST A TENTH OF A CENT A PIECE! (puts out another bowl) So, enjoy them in good health, I guess.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (walks in, boys are sitting on rug looking at TV with controllers) Well, another interior design crisis averted.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have a seat, Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What, some new video game then?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'll see. Voice ignition system

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Has the entire second floor always opened up like this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't use it very often, but yeah.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, nostalgia's got nothing on this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Just in time. (pulls cart) Our flight is about to leave. Behold, the Stain-inator! What's it for, you ask? I'll tell you on the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It began in Gimmelshtump when I was a callow youth yearning for a career in fine art.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ' (Narrating) I quickly discovered that although I loved painting, (Shows young Doof ripping his painting in half) my muse was sometimes... inaccessible. (shows him lying on bed, depressed) Then one day, just as I was about to give up in frustration, inspiration struck.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was up for three days straight gripped in glorious, artistic fever. Then finally, my masterpiece!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I rushed across the street to get my brother, Roger. He was in the middle of his favorite meal. A sloppy joe, greasy french fries with ketchup, grape juice, coffee, and chocolate pudding. And I insisted he come at once.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That day I made a solemn vow that Roger would pay for what he'd done. (cuts to them in an office) The next morning I had the solemn vow notarized.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But today, I will finally get my revenge! You see, my brother, the honorable mayor Roger Doofenshmirtz, will be unveiling a new piece of art for the lobby of City Hall. Hence the Stain-inator, hence revenge, hence, uh... (Perry slowly wheels himself and his trap to the edge of the jet) no more hencing. That's about it.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I say, boys, you can barely feel the road! It corners like a dream! Pinhead Pierre, eat your heart out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you say we take the gang for a spin?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps) Wow! (takes his hand)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, thank you, boys, this was lovely.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And does anyone else want to be "king of the world"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, keep it, bro. It suits you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Here we go. "You choose the path that few others dare travel." Done and done. Come on, Stace! Follow me! (runs ahead)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really, Candace? What to you hope to accomplish by this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Everything! Don't you see? All the problems in my life can be solved through concrete knowledge of the future!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Right; as you create a whole new set of problems.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, stop being so close-minded. (girls walking through house/apartment) For instance, what's my biggest problem?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You believe fortune cookies are real?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, besides that.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're totally obsessed with busting your brothers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly! And with infallible fortune cookie guidance, I can accomplish that easily. (breaks cookie) Watch. "If something seems fishy, maybe it's a fish!"

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (sarcastically) Genius.

Name: Fish seller
Dialog: Hey all, catch it now! Fresh fish! Fresh fish!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you have to say now, Doubty McNonbelief?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Why am I suddenly Irish?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To the fish market!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me, have you guys seen two little... (fish seller throws a fish to Candace) Oof! (Candace throws the fish to Stacy)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ew! Gross!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gross... but foretold, Stacy. Preordained! What's next? What's next?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Better be something about soap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "One man's trash is another man's treasure." To the Dumpster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Success starts at home." Finally! It's go time! To the backyard!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It gets hard to watch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Boy, it's just gorgeous out, huh? A perfect day for ruining a City Hall lobby art dedication. You know, if you're into that kind of thing. Which I am!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh-heh. Either way, it's nice to get out of the lab for a change and, you know, try to destroy art in the fresh air.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quite a field trip! TO THE DEATH!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Thank you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm sure if I thought about it, I could come up with some emotionally-scarring back-stories that are more outdoors-y... (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz) Aouagh!

Name: Psychiatrist
Dialog: (holding up a Rorschach blot) What does this look like to you?

Name: Patient
Dialog: (pointing at the stained window) That.

Name: Man
Dialog: Well, it's great to finally meet you in... ah... chPERSON! (he sneezes on the last word; as he does so, a mucus-colored stain ball hits the woman in the face. The man coughs.) So, when can I see you again?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, not only does this thing work, it has a sense of irony! (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz) Ow!... AAAAAHHHHHH!

Name: Roger
Dialog: (addressing a crowd on the front steps of City Hall) Thank you, friends, and welcome.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (climbing back onto the Stain-inator) Right on time.

Name: Roger
Dialog: It fills me with great pride to contribute today to the cultural enrichment of the Tri-State Area. I've always been a great lover of the arts.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Liar, liar, pants on fire. (Perry starts attacking Doofenshmirtz from behind) Yah! You again? (Doofenshmirtz presses a button on the remote) There. Auto-fire in 30 seconds. Nothing can stop it now.

Name: Roger
Dialog: You see, the greatest painting I ever saw was made by my brother Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You'd better believe it! Art killer.

Name: Roger
Dialog: And I, in an extraordinary act of clumsiness, destroyed it, denying him the accolades he so greatly deserved.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And here comes the payback...!

Name: Roger
Dialog: And that's why I've spent the last two decades restoring it to its former glory.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Huh, what? (rapidly pressing the remote) No no! No no! No no no no no no... OH NOOOOOO!!!!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, (removes the cover from the painting) my brother's painting! (a purple stain ball immediately hits the painting)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: NOOOOOOoooohoohoohooooo...

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, that was 20 years well-spent. (at his secretary) Melanie, what's my next appointment?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Go ahead, Perry the Platypus. I don't care anymore.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotta get home, gotta get home... (gasps) There they are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fate is kind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold this, you stupid... (kicks Stain-inator, causing one stain ball to fly out)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (running inside) Hee, hee, hee, hee, hee, hee...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did anyone else feel a drop?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the kitchen) Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi Candace. That's a nice look for you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: A new living room carpet! Oh, that's much better than tile. How lovely!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bubububububu...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You surprised me, Lawrence. I thought you were gonna sit in front of this TV all day.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I... did!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, you. (to the kids) I think this calls for a celebration. Who wants Chinese?

Name: Phineas, Ferb, Buford, Baljeet, Isabella
Dialog: Me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Me!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I do!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You okay, kiddo?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't get it! These things have been right about everything. I mean, look!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: "Don't believe everything you read." Words to live by.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'm coming as fast as I can, Candace! I'm at your house. Now, what kind of emergency are we dealing with? A parent emergency? A Phineas and Ferb emergency? Oh my--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (has an unusual hairstyle) Ahhhh-ha-ha! AHHHH!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: A hair emergency

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, it was ME, I did it to myself.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Why?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy's mom is hosting a benefit for endangered animals this afternoon, and I wanted a new look!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So you want your hair to look like an endangered species?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, there are all these How-To videos online. They make it look so easy.

Name: Lady in Video
Dialog: Just brush it up, toss your head back, and viola! It's simplicious.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not simplicious! It's hard-plicious!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, take it easy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look at me! (Lies on laptop keyboard) A tragic victim of Internet hair stylists!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sorry, I don't think there's anything I can do, but there are a couple of guys who could...

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no way!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, are these chopsticks?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, all right. PHINEAS AND FERRRB?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you think? We been working on our spit takes all morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, you're hilarious. Listen, I need you two to get me out of this situation.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why? Your hair is simplicious!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Have you tried tossing your head back?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, I don't have time to explain. Just get me back to the way I was.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay; yeah, but I think you're making a mistake.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? What, I'm like the only person who's never said it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good afternoon, Agent P. For the past few days, our motion sensors have detected Dr. Doofenshmirtz rummaging around in his basement. So, last night we had Carl stake down there behind his water heater.

Name: Carl
Dialog: It was horrible down there!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I saw a rat give birth... to a snail!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just tell him about Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz kept coming down and grabbing pieces of his old Inators from cardboard boxes. Oh no, brown recluse spider's favor dwelling in cardboard boxes! (Major Monogram touches him in the ear; He shrieks) Get it off! Get it off!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get out there and find out what Doof is up to. (At Carl) Seriously Carl? What a baby.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think it laid eggs in my ear!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So by combining ultra-violet and infrared waves together with follicle stimulation properties, not only does it style your hair, but it stimulates and accelerates new hair growth! So that should take care of that little shaved area. (at Stacy) What's that all about?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Don't get me started.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Candace) All you have to do is sit there for thirty minutes on setting five and you're good to go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, tick-tock.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Start her up Ferb. (at Candace) Remember, thirty minutes on setting five.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks guys!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I changed my ringtone. That's a tangerine orangutan. Endangered animals! (looks at her phone) Oh, it's Jeremy! (she picks it up) Hi. You're uh, picking me up in ten minutes? Great! (nervous laugh) Bye. (hangs up the phone) Ten minutes! Stacy, crank this thing up. If it takes a half an hour on five it should do the trick in ten seconds on twenty.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I don't know Candace, maybe you shouldn't mess with-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah, it'll be fine.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (nervously) Ok.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Besides Stacy, they wouldn't put a twenty on it if it weren't meant to be used, right?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well...I guess so.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my ten seconds are up! (lifts the top part of the machine from her head) Well, how does it look?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (gasps) I can't believe it! It's perfect!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Told you it'd be fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, now help me find something cute to wear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus I don't like your tone. (plays dramatic chords on the organ) Behold...I give you...The very VERY BAD-INATOR!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's made up of only the most evil parts of my old Inators, cobbled together without any rhyme or reason. My plan is to load it on my floating platform, take it high above the Tri-State Area and, you know, turn it on and see what it does. (turns towards Perry) I have no idea but I'm sure it's gonna be bad. Hence, Very Bad-inator. (pretends to shiver) Ooh, I got a chill!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking into the museum) Wow, nice turnout.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, there's your mom.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: There you two are! Don't you look nice, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, thanks Mrs. Johnson.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Come on, I'll show you where we're sitting. (she begins to lead them to the table) We have a very good turn out this year, many of Danville's top zoologists are here.

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: (to Scientist #1) I bet I'll have more species named after me than you do, care to make a wager?

Name: Scientist #1
Dialog: No.

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: Why not?

Name: Scientist #1
Dialog: Because your last name is Pithicus.

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: (laughs)

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: The money that this banquet raises will go a long way to facilitate solutions for the problems these poor animals face.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (through clenched teeth) Great!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace, I think you've got a little food or something on your lip.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (covering her mouth with her hand) Will you excuse me for a moment? (runs off to a table with an elderly couple sitting at it) Umm I just need to see this spoon for a- (uncovers her mouth and sees the mustache growing on her face and screams. She then hides under the table.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh hi Candace. (at Ferb and Linda at the dinner table) It's Candace. (at Candace) You turned it up to twenty? So what happened?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mumbles are heard from the phone)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No way! That is so cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mumbles are heard from the phone again)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ok, I'll see what we can do. (he hangs up the phone) Mom, may Ferb and I be excused? Candace needs help with her hair.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So you guys are hair stylists now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Apparently.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what would you do with my hair?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nothing, it's perfect the way it is.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, you are good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Girlfriend, please.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the flying platform) Be careful Perry the Platypus, you're awfully close to the edge. Oh! Let me help you back. (laughs as Perry is sent from one side of the platform to the other) I'm just messing with ya.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! Candace? Now where'd she go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I gotta find a better place to hide. (Candace moves the table away from the elderly couple)

Name: Old Man
Dialog: (making magic fingers) Ooohhhh.

Name: Old Lady
Dialog: Oh stop it.

Name: Old man
Dialog: You've lost your joie de vivre.

Name: Scientist #1
Dialog: Wow, this thing keeps getting weirder every year!

Name: Professor Jones
Dialog: (practicing his speech) It is wonderful to see such a fine turnout- AAAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking at her hair covered hands) AAH!

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: (on stage) Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to tonight's lecture!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (calling Candace) Where did she go?

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: Won't you all please help welcome...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no!

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: Professor Herbert Fordsworth Weatherman Jones!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: That's not professor Herbert Fordsworth Weatherman Jones, that's the rare tangerine orangutan! We have to capture it and return it to the wild. (getting up from the table) Stand back everyone, I have an associate's degree in zoology, I got this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no! Jeremy's mother! She can't see me like this!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: (chasing Candace down hallways) Don't run away! I mean you no harm!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (now in a fossil exhibit) AAH! (she climbs up the bones of a T-Rex to reach the window outside and climbs out)

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: No no no! Don't go up there, don't go up on the roof! (at Jeremy) Jeremy, would you do me a favor and call animal control please?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure thing, Mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Ferb, look up there! That's Candace on the roof. And I was worried this function would be dull. (he calls Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Phineas help! Jeremy's mom thinks I'm an orangutan and is trying to return me to the wild!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ok, hang tight. We brought the hair remover.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This looks like the perfect spot to fire up the Really Bad-inator. (taps on the control panel of the machine) I can't wait to see what it does. Guess we'll have to wait. Ooh I brought snacks. (walks over to the picnic basket) Let me see what I have here. (rummages through the basket) Baby carrots, some grapes, and a- ooh, peanut butter! Ooh, and some honey! See, Perry the Platypus, most people like peanut butter and jelly sandwiches but I really prefer peanut butter and honey.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Very few people know that Myron's discus thrower was made with real ancient disc-throwing action.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang on Ferb! (pushes a button on the statue with his foot, sending the arm of the statue spinning) Wwwweeeee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? Ferb and I made a sonic oscillator. This baby'll blow the hair of a peach at ninety yards.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great, get this hair off of me.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: (opening the window to the roof) Yoohoo! Little friend, where did you go?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on Ferb.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: I see you!

Name: Animal Control Guy
Dialog: Animal control. You got a monkey that needs tranquilizing?

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: That is not a monkey, it's the very rare tangerine orangutan.

Name: Animal Control Guy
Dialog: (loading the darts into the tranquilizer gun) Yeah yeah, tomato potato. Just leave it to the professionals. (he cocks the tranquilizer gun and fires at Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH!

Name: Animal Control Guy
Dialog: (seeing the dart in his backside) Huh. Would you look at that. Well, you probably noticed that I'm ah...not that good at my job so...you can just take this and I'll be right back. (he passes out)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh yes. Peanut butter and honey sandwiches. The trick is the honey, and you get to use one of these weird honey-spoony things.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Playtpus, did you just say gungalingdung?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aww, great! Now I'm sticky. (he gets up while Perry goes to the controls) Aww, no, and this was my last clean lab coat too. Ugh it's on now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Hey, hey! What are you doing? Ooh I get. Payback. Very funny, Perry the Platypus. You're very mature.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: (reading the instruction manual for the tranquilizer gun) Thank you for purchasing the Hanson 3000 Family Friendly Tranquidart Air-contrast delivery system, there are many like it but this one is yours.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, hurry, while she's distracted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey it worked!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: As soon as I get this honey off of me, I- (Candace's hair hits Doofenshmirtz, sending him off of the platform and onto the pole where Candace once was.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is this hair?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! Now I'll never know what the Bad-inator does! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: The red plunger will act as a non-return valve and retain the air within the dart. Fear not helpless primate, for I will return you to the wild, or my name isn't Hawk-eye Johnson! (aims; tranquilizer gun cocks; shoots)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screams) Oh, man. Shot in the butt with a dart, while covered in honey and hair? Well, what do you know, my horoscope was right. (hugging pole) Oh, my beautiful, beautiful horoscope.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Oh, no! What have I done? She's going to fall!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (drowsily) Hold the door, Barbra. I think this is our floor. (falls)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, guys! I could just hug you! (proceeds to hug her brothers, but ends up catching a hair and honey-covered Doofenshmirtz instead)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Candace? You caught her! You saved this orangutan!

Name: Animal control guy
Dialog: I'll take it from here. (grunts) Leave it to the professionals.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mama, I'm pretty.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: I knew you were a good catch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks Mrs. Johnson.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't know you were helping out my mom. You made quite an impression on her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I guess you could say I am having a good bad hair day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (to Candace) So you and Stacy are going to a "Rock-n-Roll" memorabilia auction?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Linda) Well, yeah. They are gonna be auctioning off one of the original Tiny Cowboy bobble heads. (Flicks the Cowboy hat bobble-head) The lefty one.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So I guess I won't be seeing you at the annual Danville Meatloaf Festival?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. What's a Meatloaf Festival?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that's right! You were away at camp last summer when I won this! (takes out "Meatloaf Queen" crown)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meatloaf Queen? (doubtfully) Wow. That's pretty fancy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (puts crown on) And because my meatloaf was voted best at the festival last year, I have the honor of being one of the judges this year.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, you have the honor of eating other people's meatloaf all day?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yup. I'm living the dream!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What happened?

Name: Buford
Dialog: We were just...at the bounce house...down at the Meatloaf Festival...and...and I was there, you know, having a good time, and suddenly...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Later!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Dude! Gotta go!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And even though it was funny, I still kinda wish that the bounce house was still there. You know, for the little kids.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford's right!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Even though they're made for little kids, there's something about a bounce house that you can't resist. What if bounce houses were made for bigger kids?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Slightly bigger kids. And what if they just happened to be totally amazing? I stand before you today and I hereby declare that...that, uh, little help, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That nobody has yet done justice to the bounce house concept, and that it is up to us to show the world what a bounce house can truly be. For if not us...then, who? If not now...when? And if not when, then...something else! Gentlemen, I know what we are going to do today! But first answer me this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, seriously, where is he? I don't...I haven't seen him.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. We've recently found surveillance footage of Doofenshmirtz buying fresh produce. We've concluded there are two possibilities. Either he's up to something sinister that is food related, or he's cooking dinner 'cause he's got a beautiful woman coming over and he wants to imp...never mind, it's obviously the first thing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Very impressive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just a little bit more, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's about right.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, Jamie Oliver. I can't believe we've got one of England's most famous chefs for our little Meatloaf Festival.

Name: Jamie
Dialog: Brilliant! It's a pleasure to be here.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes. This year we've expanded our venue. We have twenty-nine meatloaf flavored ice cream, as well as various meatloaf-themed attractions and rides.

Name: Jamie
Dialog: So, what exactly is "meatloaf"?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, it's made of meat, it's got bread and onions.

Name: Jamie
Dialog: Ah! So it's a beverage.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, no. But it's sort of like shepherd's pie, except there's no potatoes or vegetables in it. You know, in the shape of a loaf.

Name: Jamie
Dialog: You put pepper in it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: If you want.

Name: Jamie
Dialog: Oh, meatloaf!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha, welcome, Perry the Platypus! I never thought you'd fall for the old "distract Perry the Platypus with a weird bird" trap. I gotta say though, it's uh...it's quite an ugly bird. And now, for something a little more confining. (puts Perry in a clear box) You like it? It's biodegradable. A biodegradable trap. You know how everyone says, "if you don't like meatloaf, it's probably because you haven't tasted my meatloaf"? Well, it's true, because mine really is the best!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: In fact, I come from a long line of great meatloaf chefs. The recipe was first created by my great, great grandmother Gretel Doofenshmirtz, who passed it down to my grandpa, José Doofenshmirtz, weird story there. Then he passed it down to my mom, who passed it down to...Roger. Ugh! Naturally, I had to steal it from him. And when I did, I finally found out what the secret ingredient was. The secret ingredient was hate. Usually it's love, but Great Grandma Gretel had some issues. With this recipe, I'm sure to win the Danville Meatloaf Festival! But just in case, I have the Rotten-inator! With a quick blast of this, my competitors' meatloaves will be completely rotten! My victory is guaranteed!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, man! This is awesome!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And that's not the half of it. We're gonna fill it with helium. (turns on a helium machine)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey Buford! We are going to float like little woodland pixies!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're never gonna let me live that down, are you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everybody, let's bounce.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Way ahead of ya!

Name: Auctioneer
Dialog: The next item up for bid is this lovely Mona Lisa reproduction made entirely out of recycled guitar picks from the Paisley Sideburn Brothers. Shall we start the bidding at $10?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to a posh woman) Excuse me? May I borrow these for a moment?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you! (looks through the glasses and sees the kids) Phineas and Ferb?! (at Stacy) Stacy, I'm gonna skip over my dramatic agonizing about whether I can resist the urge to bust my brothers and, I'm just gonna give you my $70, my auction paddle, and tell you to do the best you can to get that bobble head. (gives the woman back her opera glasses) Oh, here.

Name: Posh woman
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously? Who brings opera glasses to an auction?

Name: Posh Woman
Dialog: I'm at an auction?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dials phone) Talk to me, Stacy! How we doing?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, Candace, this is all the money you gave me, so this is my final bid.

Name: Auctioneer
Dialog: $70. Do I hear 75? $70 going once. 70 going twice. Oh, wait, we got 75 from the weird guy in the back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Noooo!!! (splashes through fountain and coughs) Stacy, I found 37 cents! Raise the bid! Hello? Oh, stupid non-waterproof cell phones!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And with this garnish, I leace nothing to chance. Ha ha ha! The meatloaf is complete. (doesn't see Perry escape) Ooh, there's the judges. I'd better zap that guy's meatloaf. (tries to zap the meatloaf but zaps Perry's box, rotting it) I rotted the trap? OH, I should've never made that out of biodegradable materials! Stupid Mother Earth! (Perry punches him) For that, I'll turn you rotten, then perhaps you'll stop annoying me! (repeatedly fires the Rotten-inator)

Name: Cucumber saleslady
Dialog: Fresh cucumbers! (the cucumbers get zapped, and she changes the sign) Fresh pickles!

Name: Old man
Dialog: This novel is so riveting. (the novel gets zapped) Oh, what a rotten ending.

Name: Milk man
Dialog: Here's some refreshing milk.

Name: Girl
Dialog: Eww! It's curdled!

Name: Milk man
Dialog: Well, I can fix that, here's a spoon.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! We're over the Meatloaf Festival! Anybody else hungry?

Name: Chef
Dialog: I don't know. It still needs something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It need paprika.

Name: Chef
Dialog: Well, how much?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Time to eat! (slides down the rope, hanging on the end)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford's pulling us down.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How is that possible? He weighs no more down there than he did up here!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's probably best not to question.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, boy, meatloaf on a stick? Let's go.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You guys go ahead. I'll catch up with ya.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, see ya in a few!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, what are you up to?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got something I need to do. (to the kids from earlier) Hey, shrimplets! I've got something for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, aren't you getting tired of this? Hold still! I'll --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: OH, NO! MY MEEEATLOOOAAAF! You know, I've noticed how often my inators hit things that I never intended them to hit? It's quite often...

Name: Doofenshmritz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, give me that back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AHH! Oh, and you had to put it on "puree", didn't you? CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right, Jamie, how about this booth?

Name: Jamie
Dialog: UGH!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ew! This is rancid!

Name: Jamie
Dialog: I can't believe I'm saying this, but some kind of preservatives in this meatloaf would've been a blessing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute. Disqualified? OHHH! It can't possibly be that bad, let me try it. (eats meatloaf and moans) Yes, someone's gonna have to...call the...paramedics, I think.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, I have never seen this side of you before. I am very proud.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I retract my former statement.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Shall we be going? (carries Baljeet) Yep! (laughs)

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Get him!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Candace. Eww! What have you got all over you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: A late entry. Okay, Mom, I've been dragged all over town by Phineas and Ferb's Mega Bounce House, which you'll probably never see, but the worst part is, I didn't even get my Tiny Cowboy bobble head!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What you need is an award winning meatloaf. This is Nigel and Adrian, they're this year's Meatloaf Kings!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nigel and Adrian?! You're Tiny Cowboy! What are you doing here?

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Well, isn't it obvious? We're here for the meatloaf. Music is great and all, but our one true passion is meatloaf.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait. Nigel and Adrian are...? Are you sure? They're not tiny. And, come on, you're not even cowboys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you're embarassing me!

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Candace, could we interest you in some of the world's greatest meatloaf?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, don't mind if I do! Is it vegetarian?

Name: Adrian
Dialog: It's got "meat" actually, in the name.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just kidding! (eats meatloaf)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, I knew I shouldn't eaten that -- wait, is that Tiny Cowboy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) That's what going steady is, Stacy! Jeremy and I aren't really engaged. But we're totally engaged to be engaged to be engaged. And by the way, that's on a "need-to-know" basis. Oh, why would Jeremy need to know?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey hon, I was just reading this article about mothers and daughters, and really listening to your teen. And I realized I've hardly seen you all summer, so for the whole day today, it's you and me. Whatever you want to do, I'm all yours. Anything at all.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute, anything? (on the phone) Stacy, I'll call you back.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi guys! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Watching grass grow.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (giggles) No, really. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you know that the secret of success for grass growth is establishing a regular fertilizer schedule? We can make you a copy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Um... I'm good.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello! Greetings from the thing with two heads! (silence) Nothing? (sighs)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I told you sight gags were cheap.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're watching grass grow.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What, with like a super growth formula or somethin'?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, that must be it. That's it, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, no. Grass is already so interesting, why bother?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, mom! Let's set up! I can't wait to see your face when they get going. Just watch.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You want me to bust them now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Give it a few minutes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, what's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lint roller. (rolls it over Ferb) Platypus hair. Hmm, that reminds me. Where's Perry?

Name: All but Ferb
Dialog: Oh there you are, Perry!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Um, can we up the action a bit here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Ferb.

Name: Buford
Dialog: If this keeps up, you're gettin' back in the shirt!

Name: Linda
Dialog: How about... Now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold on. (approaches them) What are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just enjoying the wonderful world of lint.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, who do you think you're foolin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nobody. (rolls it again)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the heck is wrong with these two?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's like they were hit with a Dull-and-Boring Ray.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, Agent P, I've got the surveillance tape from earlier today.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'll fast forward.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the video) Perry the Platypus? (gets kicked) Aaaah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold! The Dull-and-Boring Inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Perry destroyed the Inator) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wow, who knew? Sure hope you didn't hit an innocent civilian.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why aren't they doing anything? I've got a golden opportunity here and I don't wanna blow it! Hehhehh... (waves at Linda)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Guys, what would you rather do? Watch paint dry or lasso wild dolphins and ride em' across the high seas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What color paint? Can it be beige? (in background) Oh, but we do already have one paint color for today, a second might be a little, self indulging.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps) This can't be happening! Baljeet, you speak boring. See if you can do anything.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (offended) Oh, I speak boring! And getting your Whittling patch is so exciting!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Meow. Catfight!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, nice weather we are having.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, I was just saying to Ferb that the atmosphere pressure seems a bit low today which would suggest cloudy skies, yet it's completely sunny. Although, it would be interesting to take an exact barometric reading.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you know that while meteorologists used millibars to chart atmospheric pressure, a barometer has a second scale or ring which reads in hectopascals? Of course, it doesn't matter what measure you choose when your barometer doesn't have its sensory range factory set for use in elevation. Apparently, you could get your drawings from the Internet, which has a wealth of...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Baljeet's in trouble. I've got to get him out of there. (pulls Baljeet) Baljeet, focus! Come back.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have never gone so far into deep dull before. (hears Buford talking) Save... Buford...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (in background) The sun is on the meridian and the wind is blowing out of the southeast (onscreen) and temperature is the perfect balmy 75°. (Isabella slaps him) Whoa! Thanks, Isabella.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And so, all in all, I would say it's great weather we're having.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Houston, we have a problem.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? I mean, I wasn't crying... And what are you doing here anyway? What, destroying my Dull-and-Boring Inator once wasn't enough for you? Wait, what were you... Wait, you're fixing it? You ARE fixing it... Oh, you've had a change of heart! How wonderful! Go ahead, rebuild it, Perry the Platypus. Actually, you're doing it all wrong, if you put it together that way, it will be the reverse of a Dull-and-Boring Inator. It would be a Dynamic-inator which would make people more interesting. (gasps) Oh, I get it! We shoot me with the Dynamic-inator, I become more interesting and everyone else becomes duller by comparison. Oh, that's brilliant! I'm so glad I thought of it! Let's build it, come on, let's go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. This is your pile of buildy stuff. This is what you liked to do before you became boring. Now take this. (hands hammer to Ferb) Well? Let's get this thing going! Do your stuff! You, here! (hands a plank and spring to Phineas)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A funny fact about springs...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, come on! What is wrong with you guys?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom...

Name: Linda
Dialog: How about if I go get some lunch and bring it back for us?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, stay, stay! I'm really enjoying this quality time with you. (kisses her)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Me too, sweetie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are they doing anything yet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, but we did find this blueprint.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey... I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna watch golf on television!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Okay, we got to jump-start these guys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We make a great team, don't we? I think we make a great team, do you think we make a great team? (Perry continues fixing the machine without a glance at Doofenshmirtz) Yeah, you do. I can tell.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It seemed bigger when we were singin'.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do the two little lines mean feet or inches?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi kids, did you build a little castle? That's adorable. Candace, should I do it now? (acting) Boys! You are SO busted! Feel the burn!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I've always liked pointing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Me too, sweetie. Well I'm going inside to make some snacks. Any requests?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh, plain oatmeal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, no, mom! Grrrrr! The one time it actually could've worked! But no, they had to be boring! And we had to build a stupid, worthless, ridiculous... (steps on the object which is actually a rocket and she flies around) AAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I told you I knew what I was doing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (continues to fly) AAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hurry! There's no time to lose!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (being carried by Buford) Hey Ferb, did you ever notice that the sidewalk is filled with little sparky bits?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Tune it out, big guy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (flying in circles) Stupid... New age... Parenting... Articles... AAAAHH! Get me down from here, I can't control this thing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: She's in some sort of holding pattern.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Good, we will just wait here and eventually, the fuel will run out. (Isabella and Buford look at him) Ohh... And she will plummet to...yeah...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Maybe we should get a ladder.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! The Dynamic-inator is finished! And I couldn't have done it without you, new partner. Now if you'll be kind enough to point it to my face and blast me, I'll be the most fascinating and charming person in the Tri-State area! And then maybe we'll go to a movie or something.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What do you mean no? Hand me the remote!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, look at us! We're fighting over the remote like an old married couple! Hahaha. It's not cute. And I have a remote too; I'm going to get my own talk show!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What are you... You're pointing it at the suburbs! My face is over here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want you to shoot me. Hey, stop that! OH, you're just so difficult sometimes!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, Candace's fuel is running out! You have to think of a way to save her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We love thinking. In fact, we were just thinking about how much we loved the flavor of water. And how come there's no water-flavored ice cream.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, that would be because...

Name: Isabella and Buford
Dialog: (before he finishes) Baljeet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine! Point it wherever you want, baby. I'll be there. (crawls onto the machine so that it would hit him when it fired) Say hello to the new dynamic... (Perry hits him with an uppercut)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...and that in a nutshell, is the history of checkers. But it's far from the first board game, in fact...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, Candace is going to fall and only you can save her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we have some wood, some springs, and some tubing, but none of those things will break her fall.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Come on, guys! Do what you do better than anybody else! Get creative!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (eyes narrow and takes a position of thinking, as does Ferb) Creative...

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAHH!

Name: Isabella, Baljeet and Buford
Dialog: (at different times) Come on, guys! Let's go! You can do it! Come on guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, help me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I still think we should get a ladder.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (the effects of the Dull-and-Boring Inator wear off) No, that would be... Boring. Wait a minute... I know what we should've done today! Ferb, grab some wood! Isabella, hammer and nails! Buford, lift something heavy! Baljeet, lift something light! The day is still young! Hang on, Candace, we're coming for you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAHH!! Hang on to what?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You never meant to work with me, did you, Perry the heartbreaker? Yes, go. Go back to your agency with their...Their uncool acronyms! Just remember, we once had something special!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's running out... And my foot is slipping... (falls) Aaaahh... Huh? (realizes she landed on a giant slide)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (sighs) It's good to be back.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes, yes it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAHHH!! (lands on a soft cushion)

Name: All
Dialog: Yes! Yeah! Wooohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice work, gang!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, not nice work. You humiliate me all day long by being boring, then you think you could make up for that by giving me a super fun ride on the world's greatest crazy slide? (pause) Okay, you get a pass for saving my life. Maybe there's a little time for mom and me to get our toes done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (opens the door and sees Linda in a Broadway costume)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, it's like your mom was hit by a Dynamic Ray or something.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really?

Name: Radio DJ
Dialog: Good morning, Danville! It's a beautiful day, so let's get out there and be happy!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Good morning, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (Takes the egg carton and spills the eggs onto a pan) One egg or two?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: None! I don't like them the way you cook 'em. You always leave in the shells! Who does that?

Name: Norm
