Dialog: (Tosses the eggs) I like mine crunchy. (The eggs land on the pan, showing its components scattered on the stove. Doofenshmirtz's laptop beeps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just keep quiet over there. I got a call from Rodney. (Doofenshmirtz answers) What do you want, Rodney?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: I thought I'd share with you the progress on my new Super Zap-Inizer. (Turns the webcam) My son, Orville, helped me. He's a true evil genius. (Turns the webcam back to himself) I'm so glad I have a son who can assist me in my work and help me become a better evil scientist, instead of a daughter who can, (Sniffs) I don't know, go shopping, I guess? Is that what it's like, Heinz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh that's ridiculous, Rodney. (Stammers) What you'd have me believe is that daughters (Vanessa walks in) are useless, and if only I had a son instead of a daughter, I'd be much more successful, and my life would be so much better. (Notices Vanessa, who walks off) Wait—No, Vanessa-- (Gets up) No, wait—Wait! How long have you been standing there—Vanessa? (Vanessa walks into a room) Vanessa, honey! Oh I can't believe that she would think that I-- (Walks back to the desk) I mean, it sure would be nice to have a son in addition. (Sits down) You know, someone to have a nice game of catch with, but--

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir, you can have a game of catch with me! I've always thought of you as my fa--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, you're in my light!

Name: Norm
Dialog: --Ther.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Runs on-screen, wiping his hands) Well, you know one of those little spring suction cup (Puts the cloth in his pocket) things that you push down and you never know when it's gonna pop up in the air?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, what are those things called, anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. But Ferb and I built a big one!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey look! It's one of those things!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! A big one!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everybody in!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So when's it gonna pop?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the fun part. You'll never know when it's gonna take off! Hey, where's--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't know what happened, Carl, but our cafeteria officially stinks.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I don't think you're being fair.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh Mexican food station is gone, Carl... VANISH!

Name: Carl
Dialog: They still have the chili...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, right! Because chili is a perfect substitute for a nice touchy-taco. It's practically the same thing! (at Perry) Agent P, you're... here! Uhmm... Our inter-web monitor tells us that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been video conference thing with the other members of the evil organization; L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. It's obviously they're planning something big, but right now we have our hands full with this all cafeteria day debacle... so! Get out there and put a stop to it! Good luck, Agent P (Agent P salutes) .... Carl! We're going off the lot for lunch.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Is that allowed sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Noo... (sigh)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was great Phineas!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! Let us do that again!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, let's reset it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they go again... their machine mocking me... (imitating Phineas) "Oh, hi, I'm Phineas! Ferb and I are gonna do something totally bust-worthy!" (in her own voice) "Yeah, like what? A submarine that'll go into my esophagus?"

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing. Did you bring the hypnotism stuff?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: If you mean the pocket watch, then yes. Why do you want to do this, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have to meet Jeremy in the park today, but I can't go unless I get this busting out of my head!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But hypnotism? It's just so 1843 of you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, 1843 when James Braid published the "Rationale of Somnambulism" in which he invented the term "hypnotism", named after the Greek god, Hypnos.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a stunned tone) How do you even know that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's written on your poster. Apparently he also invented the comb-over. Freaky.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Still stunned) Why would I have bought that poster?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Oh this is terrible, look at her, look what I've done. (Gestures at Vanessa sitting on a chair at the balcony) She's been giving me the cold shoulder ever since she overheard something out of context. This is like one of those sitcoms where somebody says something that's misconstrued and the snooty next door neighbor got the wrong package delivered after his in-laws come to visit, somebody has two dates at one night and they have to paint white lines on the middle of the room, but this isn't a sitcom, Perry the Platypus, this is real life. (pauses, as he and Perry glanced at the fourth wall) And... I'm... And I'm the father, and I have to treat her with the respect that she deserves in a caring fatherly fashion. (pause) I'll blast her with one of my inators! Wait here (goes to drag the inator) You like it, Perry the Platypus? I built it for the 170th anniversary of the Alamo, but I forgot to use it! It makes people forget about what they're thinking right at that moment, call it the Forget-About-It-inator! Heheh, I love that name. (starts trying out different tones) Forget about it. Forget about it. Forget about it! Haha, forget about it! (to Perry's face) Forget about it! (turns to Norm) How 'bout a handshake, (swings his hand) forget about it!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (as he leaves) If only I were a real boy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (in a slow voice) You are nooooow entering a deeeeep sleeeeep...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (monotone) Deeeep sleeeep...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What? Sweet! It's working. Candace, when you hear the trigger word, um, (cut to poster that says "Holy Guacamole") "holy guacamole", you will no longer have the desire to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No more busting my brothers...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And when you hear (cut to poster that says "Leapin' Lizards") "leaping lizards", it'll make you return to normal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Return to normal...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Now, when I snap my fingers, you will awaken with no recollection of being hypnotized. Do you understand, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No? What's not to understand?

Name: Candace
Dialog: A brief recap might be helpful...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, "holy guacamole" - no busting, "leaping lizards" - back to normal. (Snaps fingers and Candace comes out of hypnotic trance.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, Stacy. I don't think it worked. I still want Phineas and Ferb to go down, down, do-

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Interrupting Candace) Holy guacamole.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What was I talking about?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think you're ready for you're date with Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh! Who's Jeremy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh-oh. I think something went wrong.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just kidding.

Name: Stacy and Candace
Dialog: Ahh!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know what I'd like to do, Candace? I'd like to rent one of those little boats.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure. Good idea.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Great. Let's go before you--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Before I rush off to bust Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, I no longer have the desire to bust my brothers. We can take our time. (A lizard hops by. Candace notices it.) Whoa, look at that.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Laughs) What do you know? Some sort of reptile hopping around. Hi little hopping reptile. Hi little jumping chameleon. Hi little springing salamander.

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Leaping lizards!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh yeah. Yeah, funny I didn't think of that one. (Notices that Candace is running away.) Candace? Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Running) Sorry, Jeremy! I've got to bust my brothers!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, that's my girl. Looks like it's just you and me, little galavanting gecko.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Vanessa. I just need to take a picture of you because ... I love you and I don't need a son.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Removing headphones) Did you say something, dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? You're wearing headphones? So you haven't heard a thing I've said all day?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Why do you think I wear the headphones?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So you're not mad at me for saying I'd rather have a son than a daughter like you.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, nothing, nothing. Just put these back on. (Puts headphones back in her ears.) There you go.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whatever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Walking back to Perry and his Inator) What about that? She didn't hear me. I'm still a great dad. And the sitcom cliche has been resolved. I guess I didn't need this inator after all. Say, here's a thought. How about if I blast you instead?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir, I just want you to know that I've always thought of you as my father.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look, Norm. This is going to have to wait. I have to blast Perry the Platypus and I'll be right with you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To Norm.) Now, who are you?

Name: Norm
Dialog: I am ... your ... son! (Pause) Yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, really? (Turns to Perry) And what's that?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Don't worry, Dad, I'll get rid of it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Funny, I don't seem to remember much.

Name: Norm
Dialog: You like playing ball with me, your son.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? I like that?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What else do I like?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Crunchy eggs for breakfast.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I do? Man, what kind of weirdo am I?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Running in through gate.) Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm telling mom right now. (Running into the house.) Mom! Mom! (Crashing noises from inside.) Mom, you have to come out to the backyard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, give me a second.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, do you want to go for a ride?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'm good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, Candace. What was it that you wanted to show me-- (Notices invention.) Crimeny! What is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You see it! You see it! (The invention takes off) Phineas and Ferb are busted for sure.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Where's it going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it'll come back down in just a little bit. Just in time for me to get my bust on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So what's this thing do? Ooh look, buttons! (Pushes buttons) Pushy, pushy! (Green ray comes out of inator)

Name: Candace
Dialog: --it comes down, that's great. We can bust Phineas and Ferb and be done in time for dinner.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So what did you want to show me, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uum, that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Good heavens! What is that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Like I said, Phineas and Ferb built it and its-- (Invention takes off again)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Where's it going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It'll be back. And then it's busting time for sure, right Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, Candace. So what was it you wanted to show me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is fun. Pushy, pushy, push the buttons. I'm pushing the buttons.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir. Sir.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, Candace. So what was it you wanted to show me? (Invention lands.) Holy guacamole! What is that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Why did I leave Jeremy in the park? (Runs off.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Noticing Perry.) Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry chatters.)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir! It's overheating and it could-- (Inator explodes.)—explode.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Wait a minute. You're not my son. You're that walking junk pile, Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: But dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I am not you're father. I'm fairly sure about that.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Bu-bu-bu-bu-but!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Here, Norm. (Gives him headphones.) Wear these. It helps.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Thanks, sis!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Sarcastic) No problem, bro.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, buddy. Are you—are you busy?

Name: Norm
Dialog: No. Not really.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, Norm, it occurs to me that though I've never had a son, there is someone I can always count on to be there. Someone I've begun to think of as family.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that someone is Perry the Platypus. See you around, junkpile.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Apology accepted, Dad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) So, I was looking up at the stars, thinking about Jeremy... (Close-up of her, on her cell phone.) Only I was walking down the stairs at the time. (Her foot is in a cast.) And now I'm stuck in bed! Doctor's orders! If I re-injure it, I'll have to miss the Tiny Cowboy concert tomorrow! Backstage passes!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (outside the door) Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See you soon, Stace. (closes cell phone)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (opens the door) Your father wants me to listen to one of his "soundscapes", so I figured I'd strap on the headphones and finally get those flowers planted in the backyard. Do you think you can entertain yourself up here alone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure. Maybe I'll count useless limbs. (points to her injured foot) One.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as he and Ferb enters Candace's room) Don't bother! We've got the perfect cure for boredom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, looks like things are under control here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't bring that junk in here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's not junk. It's cool stuff to play with so you don't succumb to cabin fever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Please. A toy helicopter? Oh, and look! Mindy Mimic! Boring.

Name: Mindy Mimic
Dialog: Boring.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or you could do some reading! Ferb and I wrote a 28-volume science fiction, swashbuckling, historical romance, tell-all, potboiler, mystery, satire, buddy-cop adventure, tragedy, how-to, action novel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Also, we rigged up this closed-circuit video screen for you. And then we planted cameras at strategic locations around the house. So, you can still be with the family while you're convalescing. This remote controls the camera and a few other surprises so you'll feel less, you know, imprisoned.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks for that characterization.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, look, there's Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (on the video screen; singing gibberish) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up all the hard salami, kaiser rolls, pickles, roast beef, mustard, horseradish, sauerkraut, and pimento loaf in the Tri-State Area. We don't know what it means, but it sounds like a recipe for evil. (pause) Or at least an evil sandwich. Investigate at once!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher. What'cha doin? Um, I said...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (as Baljeet and Buford enters the backyard) Rocking out with the headphones, huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, what are you losers up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's cosmonaut Sergei Kushnarov's birthday. Right now, Sergei is orbiting Earth an international space station, trying to prove the existence of wormholes! And in a few hours, he'll be directly above our backyard.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I hope they do not void the sanitation system.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Is that the first place your brain goes? Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyway, Ferb and I are constructing a Stratospheric Ionizer, to make a happy birthday message appear in the upper atmosphere.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow! Sounds high tech.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It sure is! (at Ferb) Hey, Ferb, toss me that bone!

Name: Cosmonaut 1
Dialog: Hey, Sergei, are you still waiting to hear from your American friends? You're missing party right here.

Name: Cosmonaut 1
Dialog: Have some cake.

Name: Sergei
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Cosmonaut 1
Dialog: Relax. Flame is cardboard. (flicks cardboard candle away) I'm not an idiot. Now, come. It's your party.

Name: Sergei
Dialog: I will join you soon, comrades. Phineas and Ferb said I should watch the skies for a special message. (camera pans out to show space station) Those boys are so thoughtful.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, look at it, all swollen and useless. You are one sorry, laid-up, mummy-footed bed potato.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why you gotta be all like that? I mean, this is serious! I can't even get down to the radio station to pick up the backstage passes and...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looking out of the window) Huh! What's that your brothers are building down there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? (trying to get out of bed) Let me see! Let me see!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No way. You gotta stay off that foot!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunts) Wait! The video screen! .... There they are! Doing things! And there's Mom! Not noticing! Mom, Mom, turn around!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know she can't hear you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then I'll call her.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, this is pretty good!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, why doesn't she answer? I'm going down there!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, you gotta help me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I am such an enabler.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Perry the Platypus. You got yourself in quite a pickle there! See? 'Cause it's a pickle. And you're inside it. Anyway, backstory. It all started the other day when I was visiting Tony's Deli.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I had gotten a bowl of chicken soup, but it had a fly in it.

Name: Tony
Dialog: It's a raisin.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a FLY!

Name: Tony
Dialog: It's a raisin.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, I took it to an entomologist.

Name: Entomologist
Dialog: It's a raisin.

Name: Entomologist
Dialog: But on the other side is a fly.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Of course, by then my soup was cold and it was too late for a refund. But now, I will wash Tony's Deli off the face of the Tri-State Area with my new Chicken Soup-inator! (camera pans to reveal the -inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It blasts out a super-concentrated rocket-like bolt (camera pans again to show a very large container...) of boiling hot chicken soup powerful enough to demolish an entire city block! You wouldn't believe how much chicken soup that baby takes, though! Luckily, Aaron's Deli was having a sale! Half a gallon of chicken soup free with every $40 purchase. All that chicken soup and it didn't cost me a nickel. Ha-ha! Of course, I had to buy a lot of food, mostly deli meats. (camera shows most of the food he had bought) They're piled up in the halls. It's... kind of warm in there. I hope they keep.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Stacy! Come on, Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on the video screen) Hey, turn around. Turn around!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on the video screen) Yeah, I mean you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on the video screen) Oh, hi, Stacy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on the video screen) It's hard to hear over all the noise we're making. Is Candace enjoying the live video?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on the video screen) She's watching right now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on the video screen) Hi, Candace! We're waving back, but we can't see or hear you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls; texts a message on her cell phone)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (after looking at Candace's text message) Wow! I'm surprised the spelling checker didn't catch that. (at Phineas) I've got to deliver a message to your mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's right over there.

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Delivery./Stacy

Name: Linda
Dialog: (turns around) Oh! Hi, Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Take a look. (walks away)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, the azaleas. You can put those down over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, lower it here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, poor little regular platypus. Did mean old Perry the Platypus stick you in there? (releases Perry from the trap, who then punches him in the face) Hey, why did you do...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! (runs toward the pile of food; grabs a bag from the pile) I don't know how you escaped or what you did with the other platypus but here, these two-day-old bagels are harder than Bessemer steel! Have a nosh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And how about some potato salad! Take this marble rye! And here's some braunschweiger! And some pickled herring! And, ooh, a red onion!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A Gunter Flagendorf? But how do you know that sandwich? He only made one movie and that was back in Gimmel... (gets hit in the face with the sandwich; screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Power test.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throwing things at the window) Mom. Mom. Mom. I may as well try that dumb remote. (uses the remote several times) Oh, yeah, I'm free as a bird. (tosses the remote away; narrows eyes then grabs the box) Okay, what else? Oh, yeah, this thing and this. Big whoop.

Name: Mindy Mimic
Dialog: Big whoop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pause; gasps) Ee-ee-ee-ee... (attaches Mindy Mimic to helicopter) Mom, turn around.

Name: Mindy Mimic
Dialog: Mom, turn around. (x3)

Name: Cosmonaut 1
Dialog: Oh, smile, Sergei. It is your birthday.

Name: Sergei
Dialog: I know. I was just hoping to get a message from the boys by now.

Name: Cosmonaut 1
Dialog: Well, until then, you should join us in some fun! We are going to empty all of canteens and drink from the giant floating water ball, like ants in rain storm!

Name: Sergei
Dialog: Okay, okay, but just a sip.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? A bathroom break? Next time go before you come...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, how about some macaroni salad? .... Antacid? The only effective defense against deli foods. (grunts)

Name: Mindy Mimic
Dialog: Mom, turn around. (x3)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, for crying out loud! (uses scissors to cut a cord; the cast falls) AAAAHHHHH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, guys. Sergei's space station is almost directly above us. Sing into the mic and the Stratospheric Ionizer will visualize our words!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay! A-one and a-two and...

Name: Mindy Mimic
Dialog: Turn around. (x2)

Name: Sergei
Dialog: "Turn around"? .... Comrades, listen! Evasive maneuvers! Quickly!

Name: Cosmonaut 1
Dialog: Those boys, they have saved our lives!

Name: Sergei
Dialog: And look! We found a wormhole!

Name: All
Dialog: (whooping) Yes! That is what I am talking about!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (crawling towards Linda) Mooooom! Mooooom! Mooooom! Moooo-oooom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Twelve pickles! How did you even get them all in there? (leaps at Perry, who kicks him onto the -inator) My Chicken Soup-inator! Nooooo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (hops to Linda and stalks her) Turn around! (the asteroid whacks the ionizer behind her) TURN AROUUUUUND!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What? Oh, okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? (sees nothing is there) But, but, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'm glad your ankle's feeling better, dear. But you should really be lying down. And look, the kids clear out the perfect spot for my snapdragons! I think that earns you for some pie.

Name: Buford, Isabella, Ferb, Phineas
Dialog: Hooray!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, not on the flowers, sweetie, I just planted those.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're lovely.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a shame we couldn't get that message to Sergei. I'll try calling his cell. (dials a number on his cell phone)

Name: Sergei
Dialog: (voice recording) Hello, I'm unavailable because I'm hurtling through time, and evolving past our human limitations. So, don't bother leaving a message after the beep.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess we'll never be able to wish him a happy birthday.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, never say never.

Name: Sergei
Dialog: (wheezing) What the... (gasps)

Name: Ferb alien
Dialog: Happy birthday!

Name: Sergei
Dialog: They did remember. Such nice boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Dad! It says on this map that America's largest sport sock is just three miles down the road. Are we gonna stop there?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Driving) I'm sorry, boys, but we only have 'til sundown to return this RV to the rental place.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We'll have to do it on our next road trip, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm ready for this trip to be over. I'm tired of being in mobile lock-down, where I can't even call my friends because of spotty cell service! That, combined with the refrigerator door opening every time we make a left and sharing a bathroom the size of a postage stamp. The only consolation for this whole rigmarole, besides the fact we didn't stop at one of those greasy spoon road stop diners, is the fact that you two haven't done (echoing) anything bustable for a whole week! Seven solid days. Are you even listening to me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we were at first, but then you got all echoey and far away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I'm gonna go take a nap.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, Candace is right. We didn't get a chance to stop at a classic, all-American roadside truck stop diner! (During this, Agent P replaces himself with an inflatable sleeping platypus) You know, the juke boxes, the sassy waitresses, the little bowl of mints by the cash register.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (yawns) Too bad you can't build one. Heeheehee. (snores)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. Hey! (sees the inflatable Perry) There's Perry!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on a miniature monitor) Ah, Agent P, we're sorry. We know you're on vacation, but Doofenshmirtz is driving a big rig not far from your current location. We need you to reroute your family and catch up to him. Find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. Oh, I envy you. The romance of the open road. The tire chunks all up and down the shoulder and that ever-mysterious single shoe.

Name: Automated voice
Dialog: Turn left at next exit.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hmm, that's odd, but I never argue with a lady.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, what's that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Uh, it's a CB radio. I can talk to truckers on it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Talk to truckers? Do it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay. (on CB radio) Uh, breaker, breaker, 1-9. This is Cheeky Monkey. Anybody got their flappers on out there?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cheeky Monkey?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, that's me. It's my... my handle.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (pause) How do you know how to use a CB radio?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Simple, I studied this.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (reading) "Truck Drivin' Hits/1975-1975".

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes, yes, handle it carefully, dear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (via CB radio) Hello? Cheeky Monkey?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh! Oh! You got someone.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (on CB radio) Yes, yes, this is Cheeky Monkey. You're shaking the windows. What's your handle, good buddy? Come back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (via CB radio) A handle? Handle, handle. Oh, my name. Uh, yeah, you got Misfortune here.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (on CB radio) Well, hello, Miss.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on CB radio) No, no! It's not Miss, it's... it's Misfortune. Like, like one word. It's like... It means bad luck. One word. So, uh, where are you?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (on CB radio) Oh, we're running a double nickel on a dime.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Double nickel on a...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: 55 on the 10.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, yes. Very clever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on CB radio) Well, let's see. I'm eastbound with a smoky on my 20, on a cab over Louie with... You know, I'm gonna level with you. I-I don't know where I am or what I'm saying, really. Is-Is there a code for that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (on CB radio) No worries, Miss. Just keep your metal up and your rubber down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on CB radio) Metal up? What kind of a... (Perry lands on the windshield with suction cups on his hands and feet; at Perry) Hey! (on CB radio) Cheeky Monkey, I'm gonna have to call you back.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (on CB radio) 10-4, good buddy. I'm gone.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know, you just scored some big man points in my book for that.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You just lost them again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, don't start anything because I'm driving and it's really unsafe. Quit goofing around and sit down! Besides, you should really have your seat belts on. (laughing) Yeah! Ah, you're probably wondering what I'm doing driving this big rig. As you know, every inator of mine has a self-destruct feature, all of which rely on a little formula top scientists refer to as "Boom Juice". I found a cheap deal on a whole truckload of the stuff out here in the sticks. But I had to drive it home myself because, well, the shipment's a little old and unstable. (beeping) Oh, pay no attention to that. That's just the mandatory early warning explosion alert. I'll just turn down the sound so we can talk. Then I can tell you some of my truck driving tales.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom. Phineas and Ferb. Bust. Look.

Name: Man
Dialog: And one little orphan boy looked up at me with tears in his eyes and he said

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, that's good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom. Bust. Boys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Lawrence, look. Candace is sleep-busting again!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Aww, that's adorable.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, go back to your nap now. Go on. (directs her away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom. Bust. Boys.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, go on. Play track three! It's the one where a group of truckers take down a corrupt police force using only their trucks and their saucy colloquialisms.

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Delivery. Hey, aren't you two a little young to be receiving a seasoned grill, 300 pounds of coffee, 200 pounds of fatback, four tons of lumber and assorted wheat, rye and pumpernickel breads?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Think about it. Age really isn't the issue here, right?

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: You got a point, kid.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, then I say to him, "That's not a penguin. It's a throw pillow." And so he throws it at me. Turns out it was a penguin and its beak went right into my mouth. And I'm all, "Ew! Their beak is their nose!" Ugh! True story. (During this Perry frees himself using the sun's ray and punches Doofenshmirtz) Ah! (Perry takes the wheel)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (kicks Perry out of the way) Perry the Platypus, I can't fight you and drive at the same ti-Ugh! It's a good thing I installed my Hitch-a-ride-inator. A-ha! Voila. We are locked together. They do all the driving and I don't have to. Now, where were we? Wait. Hey! Where did you go? (Perry attacks him from behind) Ow! Ow! Ow! No! No! (Perry pushes Doof against the windshield) Hey! Hey, what the heck, man?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh! My word, there's a truck-driving pharmacist and he's pressing his face up against his windshield. Oh, that's what I love about you Americans. You-You're like big, fun children.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, yes, we are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Well, how about that! Did-Did you ever notice that the hood ornament here is a little dog?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Right there! Red barn! Bingo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, have you seen Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (oblivious to her awake) Oh, honey, you're still sleep-busting. Go back and lie down, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, but the boys -- !

Name: Linda
Dialog: (directs her away) Go on, you're sleeping.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas? Ferb? Hello?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, is that...music? (She gets out a ladder, extends it and climbs up and sees an escalator) What?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Welcome to the No Stop Truck Stop. It's like a little bit of home, on the road!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, my last peaceful hours of vacation, and you build this?!

Name: Man 1
Dialog: More coffee, Miss?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is unbelievable! (pours coffee) When Mom, sees this one, she's gonna completely flip!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Miss, I'd like the breakfast special.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (writes in a notebook) Honestly, you can't close your eyes for one second around you boys. (to someone) Hash browns or fruit?

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Hash browns!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're having fruit! (tears out order)

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Oh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Phineas) You are so busted!

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Hey, some orange juice over here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, hold your horses. (to Phineas, picking up a pitcher of orange juice) I mean, it's bad enough in our own backyard, but at least that's stationary. (pours orange juice)

Name: Man 4
Dialog: Do the eggs southwest have bacon in them?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (holds up notebook) Ferb, bacon in the southwest? (Ferb gives a thumbs up) There's bacon.

Name: Man 4
Dialog: Is the bacon good?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's bacon.

Name: Man 4
Dialog: Okay, then, uh, I'll take, uh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not getting any younger here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you want pie?

Name: Unnamed trucker
Dialog: Oh yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throws down notebook and apron) Oh, what am I doing!?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it, Perry the Platypus! There is nowhere left to run! You have officially overstayed your welcome! (Perry goes under Doof) Hey! Hey, no fair! (He throws the lid at Perry, but he ducks and it hits a sign that flings the lid back at Doof) Ow!

Name: Automated voice
Dialog: Left in 100 feet.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Uh, okay. (Drives right into a cornfield.) This seems to have a little more corn than most shortcuts.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm outta here! Oh, great!

Name: Automated voice
Dialog: Turn right to avoid plunging 5,000 feet into Cactus Gorge.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, yes, all right, might as well.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! My Boom Juice! Heading for Cactus Gorge! (It goes over) Oh. Well, what do you know? My Boom Juice isn't as volatile as I had... (The rig explodes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Man 5
Dialog: Uh, Miss, I ordered some pie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? By banding together, the truckers saved Christmas? Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you're coming with me! (swipes the boys and goes back down)

Name: Man 5
Dialog: (at the camera) Yeah, I still never got my pie.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sighs) I think I'll go check on the kids. (unfastens seat belt and stands up, does a half moon pose and leaves; the seat lowers back down just as she arrives; sees Candace with her arms around Phineas and Ferb) Oh, look at you guys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! No, Mom! (gets out of her seat and pushes Linda toward the ladder) The boys! They built a truck stop! On the roof! Seriously, a whole restaurant! Climb up and see!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, go! Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Okay, here we go... (goes up ladder)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Farmer's wife
Dialog: It's always about you! I have dreams, too, you know. I've always wanted to own a little truck stop diner.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: There you go.

Name: Farmer's wife
Dialog: How do you do that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (pause) I don't get it. (to Candace) What am I supposed to see?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (comes up) What?! (grabs her head) NOOOO!!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (comes up) So, what are we looking at? (pause, Candace and Linda look at him) Oh. Oh, right, haha! (goes back in)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yep, gonna need some new pants. Well, I fail to see how this day could get any worse. (whistling overhead; at the camera) Flaming cactus. (screams, gets covered in flaming cactus) Yeah, that ought to do it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'll be honest, Ferb. I'm having a hard time putting a positive spin on this. But, I guess that's life, huh? One minute you're having the best day ever, the next you're being fed to a monster the size of a two car garage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah? Well, welcome to MY life! (the Goozim roars, he hides behind a robot)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. And everything started out so well this morning.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: EARLIER THAT DAY

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good morning, Perry! Now that's the way to wake up. (He hugs Perry) This is gonna be the best day ever.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Good morning, boys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Happy anniversary, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's right! Gosh, I can't believe it's been five years. I remember the day we first got you.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Come on, kids. Pick out any pet you want.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh look, Phineas! This one's looking at you! (picks up Phineas and shows him a cat)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And this one's looking at you, Ferb! (picks up Ferb and shows him a dog)

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (walks through the aquarium section and all the fish swim away as she approaches) Why won't anything look at ME?!

Name: Young Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! This one's looking at both of us at the same time!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Awww...

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: That thing? You're kidding, right?

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Is there something I can do for you?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, yes, we'd like that one, please.

Name: Store employee
Dialog: (surprised) You want to adopt the platypus?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, is that what it is? Well, yes! May we have him please?

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: What would you even name a platypus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating) 'Course, Ferb and I knew exactly what to call you.

Name: Young Phineas and Ferb
Dialog: (simultaneously) Bartholomew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And then when we got you home, we renamed you Perry. And gave you this locket!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look how young we all were.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room, talking with her cell phone) Hey Jeremy, you wanna go to the mall?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (At his house) You know, I'd love to, but my Dad is taking me to check out his old college today.

Name: Jack Johnson
Dialog: (runs in) Boo-ya! Go Polecats! Boo-ya! (he runs away)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: He's already set up an interview with the academic adviser. Can you believe that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gee, Jeremy. I forgot you're a whole year older than me. A trip to college? Heh-heh.. That's, that's really great. Okay, well, I'll talk to you later. Bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the teddy bear) Oh, Jeremy! In the blink of an eye, you'll be moving on to the next phase of your life. You'll be going to college and wearing tweed jackets with patches on the elbows! You'll be so mature! And look at ME! I'm a child! Jeremy, you'll see! I can mature! Starting with taking this silly photo off. (rips off photo) Oh, Mr. Miggins! Have you been there the whole time?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (holding a baseball bat and tapping the home plate) Alright, looks like the pitcher's ready, and...batter up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Batter batter batter, swing! (swings at the baseball and hits) Oh yes, sports fans! That may be the best hit ever in the history of platypult baseball!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And the crowd exhales loudly through their mouths! (imitates a roaring crowd)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And Fletcher snags the pop fly! He's out!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (enters) Hi, Phineas! What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Turning Perry's involuntary reflex into sporting event.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Perry! Can I try? (scratches Perry's neck and the baseball is catapulted out of the yard)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, mama! Nice shot, Isabella!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (enters along with Buford) Did someone lose a ball?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we were just playing platypult.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I LOVE Platypus-themed sports!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, if we had TWO Perrys, we could put a net between them and play platypult badminton!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who's Annette?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, that's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, seriously. Who's Annette?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everyone. I think the tail is all set. I'll just go check with the foreman.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (noticing Perry's absence) He's gone!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? (he checks under the machine) Did he really slip away? On his anniversary? Sometimes it seems like Perry's missed every single cool thing we've done all summer long. Well, I guess he can do whatever he wants. After all, it's HIS day, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, what was the small noise?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's all go walk over to it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, good morning, Agent P. A quick word, recently you've been having some close calls, and your host family has nearly caught you sneaking into your lair several times. No need to remind you, but I'll do it anyway, that if your cover's blown, you'll have to be transferred to another city, with another host family. And we both know you wouldn't like that. (chuckles) I remember the day you were first assigned.

Name: Female store employee
Dialog: Enjoy your platypus!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Thank you! Cheerio!

Name: Younger Carl
Dialog: (into a headset) Agent assignment complete, sir.

Name: Younger Monogram
Dialog: (inside a computer-filled room) Good job, Carl! If you keep up the great work, you'll make unpaid intern in no time!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) And I did!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't get cocky, Carl! Agent P, as you know, every operative is equipped with an auto-scan replication device, just like the one in your hat. We've been using the information you've gathered to replicate each and every one of Dr. Doofenshmirtz's inators. Our top men have been analyzing them to determine if they've been getting smarter or dumber. And, to be honest, the jury's still out. Now we find out that he's in the process of building an alternate dimension-related inator. Your assignment is to stop him, before he finishes building it. Behind you, rising dramatically from the floor, is Carl with some high-tech devices that you might find useful.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) Um, Sir? Hello? I didn't step on in time. Would you mind lowering the platform again?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, great, let me... cue the music again.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Voilà monsieur! (He shows a wristwatch) This first item is our new wrist-communicationizer. It has many applications that will help you in the field. For example a powerful directional electro-magnet. It will draw any metal object to you. (He pushes a button and his glasses are drawn to it) See? And these are aluminum!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Quit goofing around, Carl, and show him the hologram.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir. (he pushes a button on the watch and turns on hologram of Major Monogram)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hehe, pretty nifty, huh? (from the hologram) With this device, you'll be able to contact me anywhere at anytime, but don't call between 3

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, no! His holographic projection has become mesmerized by his video image! I better shut it off.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And if you push THIS button, it'll give your adversary an incredible ice cream headache.

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's gone. You better watch where you point that. (He hands the watch over to Perry)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (enters) Hey, girl. Uh, what are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, Jeremy's going to college soon, and here I am concerned with busting my brothers to my MOMMY and living in the NURSERY. (She picks up a ceramic unicorn) A unicorn! A UNICORN, Stacy! (mockingly) "Hi, I'm six!" You've GOTTA help me get rid of all this junk.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, bold move!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep! Goodbye, childhood folly. Hello, carefree undemanding adult life!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (enters) Yeah, good luck with that. Candace, your father and I are off to the movies. While we're gone, you're in charge, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom! (to Stacy) And you know, I'm even thinking of giving up on busting my brothers.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: The irony is, that as a grown up, you don't NEED to tell your mom. You can just bust them yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) That's it! Stacy, I'm old enough to bust them myself!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's what I just said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, quake in terror, as I punch a hole through to another dimension! (shows his Other Dimensionator) Behold! The Other-Dimension...

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (in front of a large buffet table) I've finished setting up the buffet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, for crying out loud, Norm. I was in the zone!

Name: Norm
Dialog: I just thought you were playing with your doll.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not a doll, it's a stand-in. Pretendy the Practice-pus, see? I wonder if Perry the Platypus practices with a fake me? It would be nice to know he cares about...(tennis ball eye falls off the stand-in)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All systems are green, prepare to launch on my mark, T-minus thirty and counting. 29, 28, 27, 26...

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...Of course, you'll only need this if you're attacked by one of the royals or a member of Parliament, so it's probably okay to leave the safety on. And here's your brand new rocket-car. (He shows it as Perry gets in and starts it) Sweet huh? Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, Carl, did you tell him the accelerator's a little touchy?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think he knows, sir.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...3, 2, 1, service!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, you are so bus... Oh my gosh! Where'd it go? You there! Small children! Where's the big contraption?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't know, it was here just a moment ago.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It disappeared! Stacy, do you realize what this means?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We're done?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, some mysterious force always takes away Phineas and Ferb's inventions before Mom shows up, this time, it took it away before I showed up! The mysterious force recognizes that I'm now a grown-up!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: "Mysterious Force"?, I'm not buying it, I am a woman of science, at least that's what my horoscope said.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well I'm going to prove it to you and bust my brothers at the same time, Where are my brothers?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We just launched them toward the park, Buford is there with the other platypult.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay children, as the adult here, I decree we're going to the park, does anyone have to go potty first? (Stacy raises her hand) Fine, make it quick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! It looks like we're going to hit that building that looks vaguely like your head!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to give it a little test. (he turns it on, it starts for a brief second, then shuts down) Hmm. Well I just finished it, it can't be broken already.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) I stand corrected.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Phineas and Ferb get out of the shuttlecock) Alright, what's with the giant shuttlecock?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're really sorry, sir, I don't know what happened, one minute we were innocently launching ourselves across the city in a badminton platypult, the next thing we know, we're bouncing on up to the east side to your deluxe apartment in the sky.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it looks like you've totaled my Other-Dimensionator.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An Other-Dimensionator? What does it do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, at the moment, it just stops giant shuttlecocks, apparently, but it's supposed to let me go into other dimensions.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's cool! We can help you fix it. I'm Phineas and this is my brother Ferb.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, but my friends call me.... (stops and thinks) I just got into such a funk.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb is naturally handy with tools, I'll bet we could put this thing back together again in no time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, what the heck, before we set up, there's a whole buffet here, please partake, I was expecting someone who seems to be running late.

Name: Driver
Dialog: You're lucky I got a rocket car winch, lots of guys don't have that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Almost there, okay, field compressor attaches to the auxiliary generator, was this working before?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well if by "working", you mean "functioning properly", then, uh, no.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well I think I see your problem, everything is wired through this self-destruct button, do you even need that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well of course I need tha... Wait! No I don't, I do not need that, you are absolutely right, huh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Ferb has rigged up this remote control, so that if we get separated from the portal, we can open another one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, nice touch, kid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess this is the last piece, okay Ferb, boost me up. (Ferb lifts him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, I cannot wait!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, he's our pet platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is every platypus named Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In a perfect world, yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aww, well he's a cute little fella, hi there. (he tickles Perry's chin) Gootchie... (Perry chomps down on his finger) OW OW OW!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, no! (He and Ferb pull him off) We do not bite the elderly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Again, Ow. No, it's okay, platypuses don't typically like me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well Perry, you're just in time to see us open up a portal to another dimension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, what are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, no, this is not tug of war, this is not tug of war! (Phineas pulls the piece out) Silly boy, what's gotten into him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's get this show on the road, huh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (his head appears beside Perry) Remember, if your cover's blown, you'll never see the boys again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, does anyone hear someone talking?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (actually the hologram on Perry's watch) Never see them again...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, here we go, (Ferb lifts him) right in he...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, no! (He and Ferb run over) Not on the sofa! (Ferb picks him up) Oh, I'm sorry, Dr. D, we should take him outside.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no, it's alright. (he turns over the cushion) I was planning on replacing this old couch anyway. Now come on, let's light this pop stand, or however the saying goes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know its, its kinda weird, I'm usually thwarted by this point, huh, I guess he's not coming.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (he turns it on, a portal forms) And now, the mind blowing first images from beyond our dimensional reality!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, it's a...it's a couch. That's a bit anti-climatic, I guess it's a nice couch, though.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, hey, I got an idea, let's swap my couch for that one! (he enters the portal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grabs the pink couch and tries to pull it to the portal) Okay, I got it, I got - uh, maybe, hey, you want to give me a hand here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, awesome! (He and Ferb, who's still holding Perry, enter the portal) Check it out!

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ahem.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sees the 2nd dimension Monogram) Oh uh, hello. Say, aren't you...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Dr. D! Look at this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold that thought! (runs over to a balcony and sees Phineas, Ferb, and Perry are looking out)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're famous here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension) 's VO
Dialog: Get off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Reading a blimp) "Heinz Doofenshmirtz, Your Leader"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A whole Tri-State Area where I am already in charge! (chuckles) Yeah! Wait a minute, I gotta go check something out. (he goes up to 2nd Dimension Monogram) Uh, yoo-hoo! Hello again!

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Is this some kind of test? Is that really you, sir?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Holy Boy! Even the great Francis Monogram's my slave in this dimension!

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I prefer the term "Indentured Executive Assistant".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I want to meet this other dimension me, where can I find him?

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, you're from another dimension? Well then, he'll probably want to see you, he's into that freaky sorta stuff. Have a seat and I'll let him know you're on your way up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so I just gotta sit here and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was awesome! (He slides up to a desk, a chair turns to reveal 2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Alright, who's interrupting my...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Do I know you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I'm you from another dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well that would explain the handsomeness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right back atcha, big guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Does that mean you and I are exactly alike?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Blech, no, that's gross!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Me too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But not the vending machine thing. That's gonna happen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: It's in this pouch

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I can't help but notice that your scar goes over your eyepatch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...Nothing...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, I meant Lorenzo

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, that's right

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What's that, are we doing a TV show together?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. It just sort of sounded like that. Well, I mean, we could. We should!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hmm, maybe we're not so much alike

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That can be your catchphrase! You're the grumpy one. (Pokes him) Eh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, he's done really well for himself, what do you think, Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where is Dr. D?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: So what you're telling me is you're still not ruler of your Tri-State Area?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah? Well obviously YOU did not have to deal with MY nemesis, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh didn't I? Observe! (He motions to a doorway, it opens, and something steps out)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: This is Perry the Platyborg! He was once my nemesis, but now, he is general of my army!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you are good!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Dismissed.

Name: (Phineas, Ferb, and Perry ride in on the same chairs Doofenshmirtz did)Phineas
Dialog: That was awesome!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ugh, now who's interrupting me? Remind me to berate my Indentured Executive Assistant!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, man, it's cool. They're with me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Dr. D, we thought we lost you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, guys! (2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz grabs him) Whoops!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: You dare to bring a secret agent in here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This boy's a secret agent?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: No, no, not him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The quiet one?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: No no, HIM!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This plant?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: The platypus! That's secret agent Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa whoa, hey, he's just a platypus, he doesn't do much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, oh this rich, I see what's going on here, you, you really think that he's your pet, don't you? WRONG! He's using you, you're just his cover, he's a secret agent! Here, here, let me prove it. (he looks up) General Platyborg, come down here at once! He'll be here in just a minute, and then...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Alright Platyborg, you see that platypus? You know what to do.(Platyborg charges and smacks Perry away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What was that for?! (He and Ferb run to Perry) Perry, are you okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Told ya!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are his vitals?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Wait, let me try something. Platyborg, do the same thing to those two boys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: HA! YES! I knew it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait a minute, I'm confused, why does their platypus fight so good?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) PERRY THE PLATYPUS?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (sarcastic) Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Get them!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're a secret agent?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hey, be careful with that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this is where you disappear to everyday? You come here and fight this guy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no, he fights me, he doesn't really know this guy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You fight a pharmacist? Why would you even do that?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually, I'm an evil scientist, but a lot of people are confused by the lab coat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're evil? He's evil?! (They back up to the window pane) So not only have you been leading a double life this whole time, but you sat there and let us help an evil scientist open an evil portal into an evil dimension, and you did nothing to stop us?!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, he did pee on the couch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, I just realized, that was a conscious choice! You peed on my couch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No no, that wasn't enough! That's when you should've put on your little hat, not now, after we've gone forward into this mess!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, for badness sake, you can hash all this out in prison. Guards!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ahh! Brain freeze!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I-I'm sorry, I'm just having trouble processing this right now. (Perry hands him a pamphlet) "So You've Discovered Your Pet is a Secret Agent..." (throws it away) I don't want your pamphlet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh oh. (Perry moves them away, Platyborg turns back and flies at them) He's coming back around!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you have got to be kidding me! (Perry still struggles) For crying out loud!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What, they didn't teach you how to get out of this in Spy School?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh snap! (Perry's discarded parachute lands on them) Look, there's a logo on this parachute! He's got his own logo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All this time, we're like "He's a platypus, he doesn't do much". Well apparently, you do. You... you, you're tangled up in the...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, saved by unconventional architecture.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (approaches them) May I please see your papers?

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (deep voice) Show me your papers or be destroyed.

Name: Both Doofenshmirtz's
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jinx, you owe me a soda!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: Get me, I'm a Georgia O'Keefe painting!

Name: Driver
Dialog: 4th and Main. (Platyborg gets off and hands him some money) What? No tip? (Platyborg turns his hand into the mace) Never mind, I'm good. (He drives off, Platyborg looks around)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like they're gone. (Looks at Perry) You're a secret agent?! And you've been living with us this whole time? Was that evil guy right? Were we just your cover story? Were you ever really our pet or part of our family? (Perry looks down, depressed) Apparently not, cause you didn't trust us enough to tell us. Anyone else here leading a bizarre double life? (Ferb raises his hand) Put your hand down, Ferb. (Ferb lowers it) You're a secret agent. He's a secret agent! (Ferb puts a hand on Phineas' shoulder) You're right, Ferb, we have to concentrate on the task at hand, we need to get back to our dimension, and I don't even know where to start.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's right, the remote! (he takes it) I knew that would come in handy! Alright, let's go home!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, that's not our dimension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope. Uh uh. Not that one. Great, now this thing's broken. We're gonna need some help. I know! Let's go find us!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait a minute, I just realized, you could've been cleaning your own litter box this whole time! (Perry shrugs) Oh we are not done with this conversation! (They run off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: So tell me, other-dimension me. What do you see here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: An ordinary platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: And now what do you see?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I'm starting to see why you haven't become ruler in your dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Mr. "Eviler than Thou", how did you manage to take over the Tri-State Area, anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Simple, I used an army of big, scary robots.

Name: Normbots
Dialog: We should do lunch sometime! (they revert back to the armored heads)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, that is scary. I tried that robot thing once, too. I hid the self-destruct button on the bottoms of their feet, so nobody could reach them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I've said enough. I still don't get it, if we're the same person, how come you're so much better at being evil than me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: True evil is born through pain and loss. You see, when I was a small boy back in Gimmelshtump, I had a toy train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (narrating) Then one day, I lost it.

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Choo Choo?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's... That's it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's your emotionally scarring backstory? That's your great tragedy? Dude, I was raised by ocelots, literally. Disowned by my parents and raised by Central American wildcats, and you're telling me you lost a toy train? That's it? That's all you got? Really? I had to work as a lawn gnome, I was forced to wear hand-me-up girl's clothing, neither of my parents showed up for my birth!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, how did you feel when you lost that toy train?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I never lost that toy train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, maybe if you had, you would've done better. Since you have neglected to take over YOUR Tri-State Area, I think I'll go over there and give it a shot myself.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Great, we can be a team!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (Sarcastic) Yeah, right, a team.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, was that sarcasm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (Sarcastic) No...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, right there, I'm pretty sure that's my voice when I'm being sarcastic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay Buford, where are Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Buford
Dialog: How should I know? They never showed up for me to return serve. That's considered a forfeit in catapult badminton, so I went to get some Victory Gum.

Name: Buford
Dialog: A tradition as old as the game itself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't play with me, young man, where is the giant platypult they built?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't know, it seems to have vanished.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh really? Did you hear that, Stace? The mysterious force took the platypult away before I, the grown up, could see it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah yeah, I'm sure there's a logical explanation for all of this.

Name: Driver
Dialog: And they laughed at me for installing a platypult tow rig. Who's laughing now, Wayne?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The logical explanation IS the mysterious force, the question is, why does it care so much about my little brothers? Why doesn't it want them to get busted?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, why don't you ask it, Kierkegaard? (They stare) What? Existentialist Trading Cards. (Holds up a pack) Came with the gum.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, he's right! I should just ask it, I'll bet I can reason with it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Reason with it? Candace, it's a force, that you made up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I know what I'm talking about, Stacy, Come on! (Pulls her)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Where are we going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To my backyard, the heart of the mysterious force!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Would you like to trade two Sartre for a Nietzsche?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright. (He takes the cards and hands the other over)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Sucker.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this should be our street, but it sure looks different.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad?

Name: Lawrence (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Boys, what are you doing here? You'd better get inside before the Doofbot catches you. I'm off to the factory. See you next week!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, well I guess we'd better get inside. (He is about to ring the doorbell when Perry walks up, Phineas looks) Uh, you might want to... Uh, I mean these guys might not know that you're not really a... you know...

Name: Linda (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (opens the door) Boys, I thought you were in your room! Get back inside and get your Dooferalls back on before someone sees you, if you need me, I'll be hiding in the basement.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was weird. Let's find the other us.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: And....hey, I got a one! Pick a Doofopoly instruction card. (reads) "Conform", hey, I can do that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walks in) Hey guys!

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh no, they're replacing us! (he hides behind the couch) I must not have conformed quick enough!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No no, it's not like that, we're you guys from another dimension.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: A different dimension? Is that allowed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Apparently.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh look! Perry's back! (he runs up and hugs Perry) Where have you been? We missed you so much!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, Phineas, he's not your Perry, he came with us.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, sorry. (he reaches to hand him back, then stops) Wait, can I hold him a little longer?

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (hands Perry back) It's just, well, he left one day and never came back. He's been gone for a long time and I'm really worried.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Alright, you know the only time we're allowed to make noise is on Doofens Day, so keep it... (looks and turns around) Are there four of you in this room?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Five counting Perry.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I see nothing, I have plausible deniability. (She walks off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Boy, your Candace is much less curious about you're up to.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What do you mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it seems like our Candace has spent her entire summer focused on what we're doing.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Summer? I think that was outlawed a long time ago.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys don't have summer? Well that's-that's terrible.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Summer... It sounds dangerous, yet oddly compelling. What is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is summer? Man, where do I begin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait. Maybe we're going too fast.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Wow, summer sounds like a blast!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's just the tip of the iceberg! Like this summer for instance; we built a roller coaster, we became one-hit wonders, we traveled through time...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: This is a message for other dimension Perry the Platypus, if you turn yourself in, I promise not to hurt your little friends. If you don't, all bets are off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (still talking) ...And then we launched ourselves from a giant Perry the Platypult... (he sees Perry sneaking off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're kidding me! (Perry stops) You're actually sneaking away again? So nothing's changed, huh? Did it ever occur to you that we could help you? That we could've made a great team? But I guess you can't have teamwork without trust.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You don't need to sneak away anymore, we know your secret, you can just go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, I used to think you couldn't spell "platypus" without "us". (walks back inside)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well you can, but it would just be "Platyp". (he shuts the door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess if you guys can't help us fix the remote, we could check with Isabella.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Who's Isabella?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The girl who lives across the street.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Mom says that talking to neighbors can be dangerous.

Name: Linda (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (from basement) It's true!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well it's time you meet her, come on, you'll like her.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What about the Normbots?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax, we've been avoiding them all day, if you're really careful, you can... (they stop in front of a Normbot) Okay, we got to be more careful than that.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (Norm Head) May I please see your identification?

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (switches to Armored Head) Display your travel papers or be destroyed, display-display...

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I can't stand these things!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, it's Buford!

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Do I know you guys?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're Candace's brothers, we're going to Isabella's.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Are you part of the Resistance?

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I used to be in the resistance, but I got so good at it, that I started resisting them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the Other-Dimensionator! Well actually, this is the Other Other-Dimensionator, the Other-Dimensionator is back in the other dimension. (2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz glares) Okay, step 1 is push this button, (pushes it, it powers up) and step 2, stand back in awe! (it starts up, but then shuts down) Awww...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: That's it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, now that I think about it, those two boys made some modifications to my design which may have allowed to, you know, to work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Great, now I need those two boys?

Name: Both Doofenshmirtz's
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jinx, you owe me TWO sodas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Listen, Perry the Platypus, I know I said if you turned yourself in, I wouldn't hurt your friends, but change of plans, now I need to hunt them down, which may involve a little hurting, I know that makes me a liar, but hello! Evil! (Perry glares)

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Isabella's house is right over...

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (tough voice) What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella?

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Do I know you?

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hey, Isabella!

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ugh, him I know. Buford, what do you want? I thought you were resisting us?

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I was helping Candace's brothers cross the street.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Candace has two sets of twin brothers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh no, he and I are from another dimension, we're trying to get back.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Alright girls, release them.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Why would you want to come to this dimension anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we didn't mean to come here, and now we can't go back unless we fix this device. (shows the remote)

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, we may have someone who can help you. Dr. Baljeet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: That's Dr. Baljeet to you. Were you not listening? Here is the crux of your problem. Think of the universe and all of the many dimensions as circular. The energy flows between the dimensions like this, clockwise. Say that this is your dimension, and this is our dimension, you traveled with the flow of energy, so going clockwise would be easy. Going counterclockwise would take 8 million gigawatts of energy, overloading the local power grid. I have prepared a little song to help illustrate my point, (he plays an accordion)

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (pauses) I know, it needs a chorus. Anyway, without 8 million gigawatts, you would have to go clockwise, the long way around. Theoretically, you would get home, but there is no telling how many dimensions you would have to go through.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well do you think you can get enough power to open the portal backwards so we can get home?

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, we should probably ask our leader...

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (in deep voice) Ask your leader what?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (deep voice) Who made the topiary out of wild parsnips? I'm allergic, and it's messing up my voice!

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Candace, you're the leader of the Resistance?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (deep voice) What are you two- (coughs, normal voice) -doing here? Never mind, I'll deal with you later. (walks up to Phineas and Ferb) You two! I've been spending all these years trying to keep my brothers safe, and suddenly their faces are all over the Doofen Channel!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're just trying to get home.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, what's stopping you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right now? Quantum Physics.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We need to generate 8 million gigawatts for inter-dimensional travel.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Then we've got work to do, Isabella, start redirecting the power.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Aye, aye!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Gretchen, monitor the Doofen Channel. Make sure we're not raising any alarms.

Name: Gretchen (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I'm on it.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Buford, keep resisting.

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: No!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Excellent. (deep voice) And will somebody get rid of that topiary?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (Katie (2nd Dimension) and Ginger (2nd Dimension) lower down and pull it away, she coughs, normal voice) Thank you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, great and powerful Mysterious Force. I know you are just trying to protect my brothers, but I am just trying to protect them too from their dangerous inventions. Show yourself so that I may reason with you! (nothing happens) Maybe we should build a shrine to it.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, that's ridic... (the dimensional portal opens up)

Name: Both
Dialog: Ah! It's the mysterious force! (hides behind a tree)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I think we got it, it looks like home!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What do we do now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, I can't believe it actually worked.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, thanks everyone. Hey, where's Per... Oh, that's right.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: This just in, our supreme leader has just announced the capture of public enemy number one, Perry the alternate-dimension platypus! (shows Perry's mugshot, an X goes through it) I guess we won't be seeing him any more, except as a platyborg. (the channel switches to a test pattern) It's 3

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (voice-over) Now go to bed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've got to save him!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh no, too risky. You two have to get back to your dimension.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're not going anywhere without our platypus!

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I thought you said he was just using you as a cover?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what I said, I was hurt. But even if it was all an act, he's still a part of this family, and we're not leaving without him.

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I may never be able to open this again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It doesn't matter, we're going back for him.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well then, you're on your own.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fine, just tell us where Doofenshmirtz keeps his prisoners.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We have to help them!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: No we don't.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yes we do, remember how we felt when OUR Perry disappeared?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh criminy, I must be crazy. Alright, we can get there through the tunnels.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Let's suit up, people!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what, Stacy? I'm tired of the mysterious force pushing me around. I'm gonna show it who's boss! (she heads off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I will try to keep it open for as long as possible, but the window is very unstable, even the slightest disturbance could cause it to collapse.

Name: Baljeet (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Like that, for instance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so... wait, why are there four of you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, these guys are from this dimen...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are we inside the mysterious force?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm not sure I understand the quest...

Name: Candace
Dialog: And why is Isabella suddenly fashionable?

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What do you mean, "suddenly"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously, where are we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pulls Candace) Candace, I'm sure you have a million questions, but right now, we have to save Perry from being turned into a cyborg.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll explain on the way.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: So, how do I dress in your dimension?

Name: Candace
