Dialog: (notices 2nd Dimension Candace) Hey, is that me? I look good!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh no, you two stay here.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: But we want to help.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: That's an order! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, so in this dimension, Perry is a secret agent?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, in this dimension, he's a cyborg.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, where is he an agent?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That would be in our dimension, but we're not in our dimension right now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm having trouble processing this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now I wish I hadn't thrown away that pamphlet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And why are we in mine cars?

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: This will take us as far as the underground entrance to his headquarters.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (showing a map) From there, we go up the ventilation shaft, the detainment center is on Level 4.

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: And the snack bar is on Level 5! (2nd Dimension Candace glares) If there's time!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ugh, Buford. (Puts away the map)

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I'm just gonna get some nachos.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So if there's another me, and another them, then there must also be another Jeremy Johnson here, right?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Huh? Oh yeah, Johnson Jeremy, leads a three-man strike team on the north side. Good soldier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good soldier? That's all you think of him? Don't you think he's dreamy, or cool, or even cute? Tell me at least you think he's cute!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Cute doesn't win the war, kid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... well I guess, but what do you guys do around here for, you know, fun?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Look, Candace is it? No offense, but fun isn't really on my agenda. You know, since Doofenshmirtz took over the Tri-State Area, even though I was a little girl, I've been focused on one thing, and one thing only, he's going down, down, down...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Down, I know, but what about BFF's, or slumber parties, or busting your little brothers?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Busting my brothers? I've spent every day of my life trying to protect my little brothers. I had to grow up pretty quick to make sure they didn't have to.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gee, you make growing up sound like it's a bad thing.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: It is what it is, I'll do whatever I have to do to protect the ones I love.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Aww, thanks, sis!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What are you guys doing here?

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We want to help.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Sir, we're nearing the target.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ugh! (to 2nd Dimension Phineas and 2nd Dimension Ferb) Don't move!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Okay people, change of plans, this is as far as we go.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We're not gonna help them?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: No, we're going to get you two home where it's safe.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: But we want to...

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Look, this isn't our fight, it's theirs, and you two shouldn't have gotten involved!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Maybe none of us should have. Okay, we're outta here.

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I don't remember it being so dark down here.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Dark?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's because it's a trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And if it was light, you would've seen us and run away, hence ruining the trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I think they get that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! We uh, well... well, we uh, came to rescue you! (pause) So far it's not going as well as we'd hoped. We didn't have time to, you know, plan something elaborate, but we could've, I don't know, created some sort of diversion, just in case... (sighs) Yeah, we could've thought this out more.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (laughs) I got you, and I got your little friends, too. Game over. You lose! I win! Mark this the hour of your doom, Perry the Platypus! (checks his watch) Three-forty...ugh, I got one of these watches with just the little hash marks on it. It doesn't even have numbers on it! Let's just say it's between 3

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (holograph) I told you, not between 3

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: They're getting away!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I knew this was a bad idea. Okay, everyone in the cars!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (they all hop in, and she pushes) Go go go! Isabella, start the motor!

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yes sir!

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I got it!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (to 2nd Dimension Phineas and 2nd Dimension Ferb) You two, keep your heads down and remember your training!

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: But we never had any training!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, keep your heads down! (they duck) Consider yourselves trained.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (the Normbots approach) This is going to be close. (she picks up her staff and twirls it) All right, you rust buckets, let's dance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Candace) Uh, can you do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Apparently...

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I am so in love with her right now.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Nothing!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: If we can get to the north tunnel before they get to us, I can trip the security door. (Perry pulls his collar off his neck) Isabella, give us more throttle!

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: It's all the way in, sir!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Alright, hang tough, this is going to get hairy. (She leaps away. Perry wields his collar and chain as a weapon, Phineas picks up a wrench and Ferb takes off his shoes and ties the laces together to make nun-chucks.)

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Can we make those turns at this speed?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well we're about to find out! (she uses her staff to hit the turnstile, they swerve)

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: There it is. We should be okay if we can just hold off these...

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Can we do that?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: No, keep your head down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (drops the ammo) No, no, no...!

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We're slowing down, sir!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Keep it on the floor.

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: It's on the floor! (looks) There's too much track. I don't think we're gonna make it!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Everyone to the front car. We're going to have to cut loose these cars...

Name: Isabella (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: The motor's overheating!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Sorry guys, you're on your own.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: My job, protecting you two.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We have to go back and help them!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: That's not our fight.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: But we could've made it. We could've all made it!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Or we could've all been captured, and I couldn't let that happen. These are the tough choices, people, someone has to be the adult here. You guys are safe, and that's what matters.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: But-but-but...

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: End of discussion.

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Man, I had my heart set on those nachos.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, mysterious force. I feel a little awkward talking to you, because I didn't believe in you at first. Because lets face it, it's crazy, but then I saw you eat my friend, so, I've made a little shrine here. It's...It's nice, there's a banana, and, uh, oh, Mr. Miggins! So, I hope this makes up for the disbelief thing. Are we, uh, are we good?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Now you have no choice but to fix my machine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: That's not one of your choices. Fix my machine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can, uh, can I say something? So I think I'm up to date on the whole Perry-agent thing. Strangely, that's the most normal thing that's happened this afternoon... But who exactly is this guy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Fix it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Look, I would make myself do it, but apparently, he's an idiot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Fix the machine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Very well then. You've forced my hand! (he pulls out a dog sock puppet)

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (high pitched voice) Fix the machine!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Really? When I was your age, I did anything a puppet told me to do!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How old do you think we are?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I don't know, one, two? It's hard to tell with the one eye. Anyway, I don't know why you're being so uncooperative. All I'm asking you to do is make my machine work so I can invade and conquer your world and enslave your loved ones.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See, that's just it. Why would we do something that would lead to our own self-destruction?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Self-destruction? Self-destruct... Wait, wait! I remember now! They took out my self-destruct button! (he pulls it out) I don't know why I put it back in, but here, I'll just rewire this, like so, and there! (he clips in a wire and turns it on, it forms a portal) It's working! It's working! It is functioning properly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (smirks at Phineas) Well well, look who just became redundant! Send them to their doom! (Platyborg points to Candace) Yes, her too. (He points to Perry) Yes yes, everyone. Doom, doom, doom, and...

Name: Both Doofenshmirtz's
Dialog: Doom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jinx, you owe me THREE sodas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Okay, doom for him, too.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? But, but I'm you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (sticks out the puppet) Doom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, if I had a nickel for every time I was doomed by a puppet, I'd have two nickels, which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Welcome, doomed guests. Come on. Keep trudging. Doom is that away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I would say so far, adulthood gets a three.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, this may be as good as it gets. (they walk onto a rocky area)

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: And now for my all-time favorite game...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Poke the Goozim with a stick, surrounded by lava. (the pathway retracts) My second favorite game is backgammon, love it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, hold the phone. I can be useful. What if you need a kidney? Or a stand-in for boring functions you have to attend, or another kidney?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Doom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, pooh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Cranky, cranky, cranky. Oh, I love the crank!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'll be honest, Ferb. I'm having a hard time putting a positive spin on this. Blah blah blah, two-car garage, etcetera, etcetera.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, welcome to MY life! (The Goozim roars. He hides behind a Normbot.)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Whoa, déjà vu-ish.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Perry. Check out that guard! (we see a ring of keys on a hook on his back) The keys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! (see the Normbot is also being pulled to them) Ah! Look out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Is this the plan? (they fly into the air and over the lava, he screams) Please tell me this isn't the plan!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: You are tampering with the property of... (he sparks and turns to the Norm head) Let's make omelets!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Can you get a little more lift on this thing? I think I just bruised a kidney.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: My bicycle is missing!

Name: All
Dialog: Yay! (the door then breaks off and falls down) Awww.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Ha, ha! Yes! Go, Goozim!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: It's muffin time, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Already?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, I see where you're going with this. (They all climb)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I officially prefer our dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, this may not be the best time to tell you, but I actually flunked jungle gym in grade school. I just couldn't get the hang of all that climbing and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh great, you caught it! Quick, unlock me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you even paying attention?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that's right. Uh, it can wait, later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: More guards!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: It's muffin time, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You're broken! (hits him with a muffin)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yay, other dimension Candace!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Phineas, catch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The remote!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, let go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? No, don't let go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, trust me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Two words

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Trust me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: They opened another portal! Get after them!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: And her, that banshee screaming girl. Get her too! (bots fly after her)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: Stop where you are. You cannot leave.

Name: 2nd Normbot
Dialog: (Norm head) I use aggression to mask my insecurities! (he turns to the armored head and fires, Phineas dodges)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The portal! (he shuts it, the other bots hit the lava and melt)

Name: Normbot
Dialog: (melting) (falling into lava) Wow, I could go for a (slightly muffled voice) lemonade!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: The portal closed, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh pooh. Oh well, time to start the invasion! (he goes, the bots follow) And somebody get me a muffin!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: But it's not muffin time, sir!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, follow me. We're going around clockwise!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, how about two Kafka's for your Dostoevsky?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stop wasting my time, Buford.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, I think this is it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where have you guys been?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I spy with my one little eye, a new Tri-State Area that's one dictator short of a dictatorship. (he pushes a button and the Other-Dimensionator rises on a platform) Well, that's all about to change, pretty soon I'll be ruling over two Tri-State Area's, a virtual Six-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Fly, fly, my Normbots! We've got some oppressing to do! (he laughs as they emerge)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, why is Perry wearing a hat?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have time to explain, we've got to try and stop an evil d...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no, it's too late!

Name: Woman #1
Dialog: They're never going to fire her, and... (there is a flash) Hey, did you see that?

Name: Man #1
Dialog: No, I... (he turns and gasps) What's going on?

Name: Old Woman
Dialog: Oh my!

Name: Woman #2
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Man #2
Dialog: It's a comb over, I know, I should really just shave it!

Name: Man #3
Dialog: Not happening. Not happening!

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: My watermelon!

Name: Normbot
Dialog: All vehicles must stop. (It grabs a car and throws it, it impacts into a wall)

Name: Man #4
Dialog: It's okay, it's a rental!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Oh great, Albuquerque '93 all over again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish alternate dimension Candace was here, she took out like thirty of those guys with a lawn gnome.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, our agents are being overwhelmed by the sheer number of robots coming into our dimension. You must get to Doof's headquarters and stop him!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aye aye, sir! We're ready to serve!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh no, you kids need to go home, where it's safe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: With all due respect, sir, we've been through quite a lot together. We're a team now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nope, far too dangerous, and besides, our insurance won't cover it. Tell 'em Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Perry. Let's go kick some robot chassis!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Perry takes off his collar and hands it to them) Perry? (Perry salutes and runs off) Wow, I guess we're going home then. Hey, where's Dr. D?

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, Mrs. Thompson. It's me, Heinz. I think I left my keys in the other dimension. Can you buzz me in?

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Who is this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heinz Doofenshmirtz, your neighbor, for like 12 years.

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Who?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I live in the penthouse. I wear lab coats a lot. Speak with the accent I am currently speaking to you with.

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Just like my neighbor upstairs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, exactly!

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Oh, he's not home. You'll have to come back later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no no, wait... (she hangs up) Aww!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: This is just beautiful. I decide to do the right thing, and I end up in a cell. (she looks out the barred window) Well, at least my brothers are safe... (she lays on the cot and bounces the ball) What lesson am I supposed to be learning here?

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I'm Jeremy Johnson. I'm here to rescue you.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Johnson, Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (saluting) Yes sir, and I also picked up a couple new recruits.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We figured out a way to bypass the entire security grid, it was cool!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What? You brought my little brothers? Are you out of your mind, soldier?

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I didn't know they were your brothers, but I should've known. They're smart and courageous, just like you.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: You think I'm smart and courageous?

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well, yeah. Uh, sir.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Uh, good work, soldier.

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: We should probably get out of here while we can.

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (he hands her a pair of sunglasses) Most of the Normbots are away in the other dimension, we can slip away pretty easily.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: The Normbots are in the other dimension? This isn't the time to escape. This is the time to make our move! (she puts on the glasses) Let's go!

Name: Jeremy and Phineas (both 2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yes sir! (they head out)

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Boys, wait! Thanks for rescuing me. I'm really proud of you both. (they hug)

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: And we're proud of you too... Sir.

Name: Buford (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I got nachos! Who wants some? (they stare) Nobody?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, mysterious force. You can see I'm really trying here. Please bring back Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi Stacy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And I also want a car!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I still can't believe Perry wanted us to go home. I mean, look at this!

Name: Reporter
Dialog: There's robots all over the Tri-State Area! And now for the weather.

Name: Weatherman
Dialog: There's robots, Phil, ROBOTS! (he screams and runs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'd think he'd need all the help he can... (He hears a beeping sound) Wait, what's that? Ferb, do you hear that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (he reaches into his pocket, pulling out the locket, which is what is beeping) It's Perry's locket!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (they walk up to the couch, the beeping intensifies) Oh, it's like a homing device.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Shall we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This must be Perry's lair.

Name: Computer
Dialog: (Female voice) Welcome, Phineas and Ferb. Please insert the key.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) Do you have a key? (Ferb takes out a pitch pipe and blows a note)

Name: Computer
Dialog: Please insert the key.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good try.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Please insert the key. Please insert the key. (it points down, showing a keyhole shaped like Perry's unfolded locket)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's odd, it's a shaped keyhole, it kinda looks like—wait a minute!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, this message is top secret, for your ears only. If you're hearing this, the Tri-State Area is at alert level Alpha Red. Agent P needs your help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How does he know we'll know what to do?

Name: Computer
Dialog: He knows you will know what to do. He also knows you are the only ones capable of helping him, because you two are the only ones capable of creating these.

Name: Voice
Dialog: Auto scan replication initiated.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I think I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Normbots
Dialog: You have a new leader. Put on your Dooferalls.

Name: Normbot
Dialog: 36 inch waist.

Name: Man #4
Dialog: No way. I'm a 34!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, I guess you trusted us after all. (Perry smiles)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I was wrong, it was not for me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Heads up, platy-posterior coming through!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now this is what I call busting!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, everyone. Let's kick some robot chassis!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Phineas! Anything we can do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, musical accompaniment!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We gotta do something about that portal!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, we're going to try and stop the portal!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What? Oh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I've had just about enough of you, you...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was wrong, Stacy, about everything. I'm not a grown-up. I can't control mysterious forces. I can't even get my mom to see what my brothers are doing! (she smiles) Stacy, that's it! I can't get my mom to see what my brothers are doing! (she runs off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, where are you going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm gonna bust my brothers to my mom! And I'm gonna fail!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, it's Heinz Doofenshmirtz. You borrowed sugar from me this morning!

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: I don't have any sugar. I had to borrow some from my neighbor this morning.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that's me. That's...

Name: Mrs. Thompson
Dialog: Oh, he's a nice man, but I hear he's divorced.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, THAT she remembers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Psst, mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what are you doing here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You've got to come outside and bust the boys!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm not leaving now. The girl is about to forgive the guy for the clichéd misunderstanding... (a Normbot tears through the screen) After she battles these robots.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Whoa, this 3-D is amazing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ferb, we'll handle things down here! (she fires, hitting a bot) Go help Phineas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh come on, you stupid thing, work! (the Normbots go back to normal and continue)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, so that dish must be what's controlling the robots! Maybe I don't need to close the portal if I can just take out that... (he sees the baseball launcher) Oh, yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh no you don't! Ha ha! Now the baseball is on the other foot! Or however that... that saying goes. I'm not really sure... (sees Phineas backing up) Hey, hey! Where are you going? (he aims at Phineas, and backs him into a wall) You know, all that's going to happen from you guys coming up here is that I'm going to have a brand new Platyborg! And maybe even a Boyborg too, huh? Try saying that five times fast

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: You know something kid, you've been a thorn in my side all day long...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (Perry looks and sees a bat on the ground, he whistles; Phineas looks) But that's about to change...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (Slow-Mo) right now...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (slow-mo) Noooooo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (regular) Augh! My babies! No, what have you done?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's weird that Perry's a secret agent, huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, but it was obvious in retrospect.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Has anyone seen my pants?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, they're over there.

Name: Irving
Dialog: WOLVERINES!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, if you care one iota about me, your family, and your city, you'll come outside with me right now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I guess I could use some more popcorn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! (she pulls her out) Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, bro! I just hit the best home run ever!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Now, tremble before me! (laughs) No no, I'm down here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: See? One last trick up my sleeve. It's me! See, I'm the trick up my...own sleeves. Cause look, I-I'm in the sleeve, get it? (they look) Ugh, pearls before swine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (he pulls a lever, the bot aims back a punch) Hope you got your 3-D glasses, cause I'm coming at you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What? I'm kind of in the middle of something here! (we see the arm is less than an inch away from impact)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got a little something just for you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Choo-Choo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, it's mine. See, I told you I never lost it. It was in a box in my pantry labeled "VHS Tapes". Go figure. Anyway, you can have it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I can't believe it! Choo-Choo, it is you! (he takes it and hugs it close) Oh, heart melting, backstory resolving, evilness diminishing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, it's the least I can do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: You know, I don't even know what I was thinking with the whole "evil robots" thing. Actually, when I look around, I-I'm really embarrassed. Here, let me clean this up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (he pulls out a remote labeled SELF DESTRUCT) Look, "Self Destruct" button.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yeah, here we go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on. Hurry! (she motions for her to look)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Do I even need to say there's nothing there anymore?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you can say it all you want! (hugs her and does a little dance) There's nothing there! Woo hoo! I did it, I saved the world! (she stops and smiles, pause) You can go back to your movie now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yeah, you know, we're totally cool now, I'm just going to go back to my home and live out the rest of my days with my Choo-Choo. Okay then, ciao!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: (he steps through the portal) Ah, home, it's good to be... (the 2nd Dimension Fireside Girls (also known as the Firestorm Girls) march up) Uh-oh.

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Book him, ladies.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: You know, my crimes against humanity had just completely slipped my mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, did you guys just see that? I totally saved Danville!

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Good job, soldier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what will you do now?

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Wow, I haven't thought of anything but busting Doofenshmirtz for years. I don't know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I know what interests I'd pursue. (she points to 2nd Dimension Jeremy as he comes out of the portal)

Name: Jeremy (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hey, here you all are.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: I'll take that under consideration. And what about you, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, after all of this, I'm going to give myself a little more time to be young. It's not such a bad place to be.

Name: Candace (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: You know what, me too. (they hug)

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hey, I just wanted to say thanks for teaching us all about summer. You know, opening our horizons, and teaching Ferb classical guitar.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hey, it's our Perry! (they go over to him) Looks like the evil was fried right out of him.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry he's mostly made of metal now.

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Are you kidding? That makes him extra cool! Thanks so much guys. (they head back to the portal)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm glad we could help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Man, this was the greatest day ever. Imagine how much fun we can have together now that we know you're a secret agent!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes yes, the next fifteen minutes should be a real hoot. Then, of course, Agent P will be sent away forever.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Didn't he give you a pamphlet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We threw it away.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Does anyone read those things?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I tried to warn you, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Kids, I'm sorry, but now that Agent P's cover has been blown, you won't be allowed to see him anymore.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's why you didn't want us to know your secret. (Perry nods) So we'll never see Perry again? There has to be another way!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Phineas. It isn't safe, you know too much.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now I never wished so much that I could un-know something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, maybe there is a way. What about Dr. Doofenshmirtz's Amnesia-nator?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never built an Amnesia-nator. I think I'd remember building something like that.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that might work, but you'd all have to agree.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So our choice is to

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, we've had a lot of great days, but we only have one Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Agreed.

Name: All
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from inside) Alright everybody, tall kids in the back. (zooms to the inside of the lab) Just need to do a little more programming here, and we'll be ready to roll.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, buddy. Ferb and I just wanted to say our goodbyes. You know, we thought we'd met the real you when we found out you were Agent P. But the fact is, pet, secret agent, they're both the real you. You are now, and always have been a great pet, and a great friend. We're going to miss you, Agent P. (Perry hugs Ferb, then hugs Phineas) I love you, pal.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, are you crying?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, I'm sweating through my eyes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay sir, we're ready. (They walk back. Perry walks up to Major Monogram.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay Carl, we're all set.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, Major Monogram?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, yes?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, none of us will remember any of today?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (firmly) Good. (she grabs him and kisses him right on the lips, Phineas gasps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (surprised) Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hit it, Carl!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait...!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, yeah!(laugh)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh yeah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Slash, let's roll!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You were right, Ferb. It is more fun to mount the race track on the ceiling. (At Buford and Baljeet) Hey, guys. Care to join us for an upside-down slot bike race?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No thank you. I am not a big fan of bicycle racing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, come on. Everyone loves a good bike race.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not me. You see, I come from a long line of bicycle race losers.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Narrating) In 1903, my great-grandfather was leading a bicycle race, but he fell into a tiger pit. Years later, my grandfather skillfully avoided the tiger pit, but sadly not the tiger. Then, my father was confident he had outsmarted the tiger, but he was wrong.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My point is, none of them finished in the top ten.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, tiger attacks are comparatively rare in Danville since we installed that tiger excluder on city hall.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what Baljeet is gonna do today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I was just heading out to Margie's baby shower and look what I found on the stoop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My new camcorder! Sport edition. For bustin' on the go.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, well; gotta run. Margie won't stay pregnant forever. Don't forget to feed Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. We've been monitoring Doofenshmirtz's Internet traffic and we think it's... (A pop-up ad blocks him) What in blazes? A pop-up ad? Can you still see me, Agent P? (Another pop-up ad blocks him) What, another? Agent P? Over here! (More pop-up ads block the screen) Oh, this is getting ridiculous! I give

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: up! You know the drill. Monogram out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here it is. The route of the 1st annual Tour de Ferb bike race. Featuring jumps, obstacles, rickety staircases, and here's where you start the second stretch of the underwater...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait; underwater?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We tricked the bikes out a little. Just push the button on your handle bars when you encounter any unusual terrain.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What about tiger attacks?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Technically, that's not a terrain. Isabella was kind enough to enlist the help of the Fireside Girls to make the course, guide us, and help out along the way.

Name: Buford
Dialog: More racey, less talky. (Jumps onto his bike) Sweet!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Race ya to the front-line!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet. Don't let a little thing like all your male ancestors getting mauled by tigers during a bike race get you down.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, it does seem to indicate a pattern.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just remember you have something that they didn't have. Greg LeMond! (Whistles)

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: I'm back here! (At Baljeet) Hiya, Baljeet. I'm Greg LeMond, the first American cyclist to win the Tour de France. Three times, actually.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, like recently?

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: That's not the point. The point is I see a kid who needs inspiration.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, you mean me, right?

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: That's right, Baljeet. Don't let anything stop you. There's nothing in this world that you can't do.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, I can think of many things I can not do. Flying comes to mind. Also putting my foot behind my head, but it occurs to me that you're speaking hyperbolically. So point taken, Greg LeMond! I'm going to win this race!

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: That's the spirit! (Baljeet bikes off) U-S-A! U-S-A!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Off screen) I am from India!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Ready...set....

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs) Losers!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What the...? No fair! You've got that aerodynamic head!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Indi-a! Indi-a!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Oh, Phineas? Ferb? (Notices the route map) Tour de Ferb? (Takes it from the fence) Oh, baby! Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Cackles) Welcome, Perry the Platypus. I knew you would fall for the old kickstand trap. (Scratches an ear) Of course, I didn't know exactly where you've parked, so I... (Camera pans back showing that he had installed more than one button) really got to watch my step around here. But as you see, you're trapped... in a pile of old computer cables.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've started throwing them in a drawer years ago, and I'm... I'm sure there's probably one wire you can pull like a... (Camera pans back to Perry) like a lube-bearing wire that would just make the whole thing unravel. But how you find it? (Camera switches back to him) I'd figured it would be easier to use it as a trap, so I did. See? Recycling.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, oh! Big round wet thing comin' up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Press your buttons, everybody!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Press button on his bike) Awesome!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can feel my competitive spirit breaking free! (Bike hits a tree stump then he falls into the water)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't give up, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Stands up; shaking a fist) Never!

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: (Rising from the water, bike in one hand) Baljeet, you're not quitting, are you?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, sir, Mr. LeMond. (Retrieves bike from the water then raises it over his head) I came to win!

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: I know things are tough. There's a little voice telling you to quit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I hear no voice.

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: But you can quit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But I do not want to quit!

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: Hey; true story. Hunting accident. My brother-in-law thought I was a turkey. (Imitates turkey) Kaboom! But I recovered, and you can too.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow; I have no idea how to respond that. (Pauses) I think I will be continuing on with the race now.

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: Dropping out seems like an easy way, but years from now I don't want you to look back and wonder "What if?".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Out of my way, turkey!

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: Why does everyone think I'm a turkey?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, Perry the Platypus. Let me tell you my latest scheme. The other day, I was browsing the Internet when...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) I came to an online auction for a Super Multi-inator. I wasn't even sure what it did, but you know Zupermuhltienator was my grandmother's maiden name. It was a sign. I had to have it, but then something terrible happened. A pop-up ad kept me from hitting the "Bid now" button. It really hit me where I lived too. You see, I always hated advertising ever since the early '80s when I did a little product modeling to finance my first -Inator.

Name: Photographer
Dialog: That's it. Hold the wombat a little closer to your face.

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Closer. A little closer.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) I don't want to talk about it. But then I realized I could use pop-up ads to serve all of my evil ends.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I come up with a whole slew of products and services I that could advertise and my Pop-up-inator would (Snaps fingers) put thousands of pop-up ads virtually everywhere! I'll make millions!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right on schedule and fully documented.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The best part is that pop-up ads would never go away. There's a little button that says "Click here to close", (Camera pans to Perry) but guess what? It just opens another pop-up ad! (Camera switches to him) (Laughs) Pop-up ad. Best idea ever.

Name: Female voice
Dialog: Analyzing pile. .... Locating load-bearing wire.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? .... Perry the Platypus! How did you get out? .... Aaah! .... Ow! Hey! Not fair! .... Oof! ... Alright, no more Mr. Nice Guy! .... Come back here, you little... (Accidentally presses one of the buttons; wires fall on him; he brushes them off) See? I told you I got to watch my step in here. (Pushes another button; gets trapped by wires; more falls on his head to create a turban; even more completely covers him) I know what you're thinking, but this is neither ironic nor funny. (Pauses) Are you... Are you still there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a sarcastic tone) Hello, mother. Have a nice time at the baby shower?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well; Margie's got morning sickness, so there was a little incident.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew.

Name: Linda
Dialog: But now I'm clean, so no harm done. And I can see you're dying to tell me something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh.... Not really. It's just.... Mom, (Beam from the Pop-up-Inator hits Candace's camcorder) take a look at this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on screen) Ok --

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your camera gets pop-up ads?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! Nooooo!!! But it doesn't matter. (tosses camcorder in sink; picks up Linda) I know where the last obstacle is. Hee-hee-hee-hee...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoa! Whoa! (gets placed in the bike basket) Candace, I'm not even dressed!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry Mom, it's an emergency!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Luckily, (reveals bike helmet under turban) I've picked today to wear my bike helmet into the shower.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah! There it is! The finish line, right on the other side of Danville Chasm. I am going to win this!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Not if I can help it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace! My towel!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on! Come on! Come on! Come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Get ready to see something really terrifying!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's better. (notices the billboard) Huh. I guess that is pretty scary. That guy should not be holding a wombat so close to his face.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But-but-but-but-but-but...but...but...buuuuut...

Name: Doofenshimrtz
Dialog: (while Perry's pushing the Pop-up-Inator towards the balcony) Perry the Platypus, wire you're doing this to me? Get it? Wire? Because, I mean wire. Ah, come on. Now; I know I'm defeated, but at least I got a good joke out of it. Show me some love. (pauses) Nothing? Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just going to leave me hanging here?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah, ah! Losers!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: "Ah, ah" yourself. I am going to win this race! Oooohh! I am tasting victory! It is sweet as... (Greg LeMond quickly passes him) Greg LeMond? I thought you were supposed to be motivating me.

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: It worked so well, that I even motivated myself. Finish line, here I... (a tiger leaps on top of him) Ahhh!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: They need to change the battery on the tiger excluder.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Boy, I'll say.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did it! I won a bike race! Thanks to Greg LeMond inspiring me. And then, you know, getting attacked by that tiger. By the way, I hope he is okay.

Name: Greg LeMond
Dialog: Oh, man. I got to call my brother-in-law and tell him that his tiger got out.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Your parents played it, but now you can too!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Skiddley Whiifers is the best game ever! And HA! (Rolls a double 5) That brings me out of the mud pit, into the car wash, through the terrible tower, and uh oh, Roll Again! Yes! Double kings, baby! Excuse me. Here comes the big finish. Bing! Bing! Bing! Victory bell! I've broken the winning streak. (Slaps her own rear end) Oh, that feels good! You wouldn't know about that because YOU lost! I am the Queen of Skiddley Whiffers! Who is the queen? I am the Queen!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It sure is nice to see Candace happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, seriously, we've been playing this game for what, six years? And look, I've won 19 out of 24 games this year. The last 12, in a row, it's like Skiddley Whiffers wants me to win. Consequently, you two lose! [hits bell] Over, and over, and over again. Skiddley Whiffers is too easy! I need to move on to a bigger challenge. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A bigger challenge? Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy nine hundredth and ninety ninth lair entrance, Agent P! To commemorate this joyous occasion, we like to present you with this souvenir t-shirt.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I made it myself! (gasp) I'm gonna go print up some more! Yay! Hmhm! (leaves)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just wear it for the day, it's good for his self-esteem. (reveals he is also wearing the shirt) Uh, Doofenshmirtz has been spotted en route to Danville National Park. So, I guess for you it'll be a walk in the park. Haha, 'cause you're going to the park. Where Doof is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright everyone, we're here. Let's unpack so we can get a head start.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "We"? Shouldn't you be off playing with your little platypus friend?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? And -- and leave my little girl all alone in the wilderness? No way!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I'm not your little girl anymore. Look at me, I'm sixteen years old! Sixteen!

Name: Young Vanessa
Dialog: That's practically an adult! But, you still treat me like I'm a little kid!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sigh) I just need some space, that's all. Ar -- are you even listening to me?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But Vanessa, what if there were a blizzard or an earthquake and -- and be with no one to take care of, not even kindly ocelots, like I had.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad!?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, I - I could be at that campsite right over --

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Go home!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, pumpkin. Stay safe. But what if --

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: GO!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We suppose you're wondering why I called all of you here today.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, actually, we were.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (closes eyes and extends arm, similar to Candace) Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ta-da!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's not clearing anything up for me.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't care what it is, the hairdryer is mine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs out) Alright! Nobody move! You two! You think you can just make giant...thingys for all the world to see? Well, no, sir! I'm gonna put the bust on you, but good. (runs off) Mom! Mom! Mom! Phineas and Ferb are making some giant --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (over) So in this giant version of the classic game Skiddley Whiffers...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (comes back) Wait. Did you say "Skiddley Whiffers"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Giant Skiddley Whiffers, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Giant Skiddley Whiffers?!? That is so bustable! And yet, so tempting. And yet, so bustable! And yet, so tempting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wanna play?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! I'm the sneaker!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I get dibs on the truck!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in the hair dryer) Boo-ya!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I claim the fedora, and Ferb picks the nose!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, real unicorns are pink. I am just saying.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our gameboard today will be Danville itself, where rich architectural heritage and natural wonders will provide the thrills. And the first player back home wins. And we don't even have to do any work; just roll a number on this electronic die and the game pieces will automatically move that many spaces across Danville.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, let's get this party started! Lob it over! (she catches the die, "6" appears on it) Six! So long, losers. (her sneaker moves) One, two...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: When do I get to go? (the die hits his head) Oh! (he catches it, it says "1") It is going to be a long day.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, groovy dudes and dudettes. How's it hangin'? Wanna try my seven-layer bars? Man?

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, hey there, strange man I've never met. What brings you to our campsite? And how soon can you leave?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I was just passin' by, you know, communing with nature and all, like, you know us, us hippies do it, a-and I thought, you dudes might wanna few groovy pointers from an old pro.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Actually, we're doing just fine.

Name: All but Vanessa
Dialog: Hey!/Man!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, fire is the leading cause of fire. Oh, woah. Is that a Puttmaster 3000? (runs up to Lacie's tent) I love these babies, they're -- they're so far out. They almost never collapse and...suffocate you while you sleep. But you know, (pulls out a book) Tri-State Almanac says, they should be at least twenty feet from running water, (measures the distance of Lacie's tent and the water) and yours is an inch too close, maaaan.

Name: Lacie
Dialog: Seriously?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, and-and you need to tie up your food or you're gonna attract bears, (puts all the food in a bag and throws it on a rope onto a tree branch, making the picnic table hang) which would make it extremely difficult to, hang loose and, be groovy. I've got lots of other righteous camping tips, but first, I need to get some life vests out of my van.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Woah, that guy was totally freakstyle.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You have no idea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! (catches die, it says "5") My third favorite number!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps, catches die, it says "21") Seven trade, baby! Feel the breeze! (bounces past Baljeet on his unicorn, chained to a cannon ball)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Only because I ruled leg irons!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Spoken like a true lose-ah! (tosses die to Ferb) Next suck-ah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. What'cha doin'?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (wearing a monocle and beard) Hey guys, how much longer do I wear the beard?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Until you roll a "shave".

Name: Buford
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, what's with the monocle?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's an affectation, leave it alone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see, bandages, bug spray, shoulder pads, (Perry arrives via helicopter) and -- oh, hey man, nice threads. Sorry, no scheme today, I'm just secretly overprotecting my daughter while she's camping with some friends. It's dangerous out here, Perry the Platypus, and I should know. (He begins a flashback) You see, back in Gimmelshtump in my youth... WHen I was camping, I had an incident with a swarm of bees. I only got one sting, but it did a lot of damage. (Doofenshmirtz is seen falling off a cliff, through thorn bushes, and a fire hydrant field) I still have a hydrant stuck in my leg, see? I'd have it removed, but the doctors say it's too close to an artery to operate. (Perry stares at Doofenshmirtz) That kind of thing happens all the time in the woods! Alright, maybe I'm over reacting. Actually, it;s really just a beautiful pastural setting. There's probably nothing to--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoo-Hoo! Sorry dude!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? You see? You see how dangerous it is out here? You've got to help me over protect my daughter. Please? Please? Please? Oh great! I know just what you can do!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey brothers and sisters, I'm back with this industrial size first aid kit, and this state of the art security system. Not to mention-- (and grabs a stick) Too sharp! (He dulls it down, then returns it) Righteous. (shoos birds away from Lacie) Quarantine! (puts helmets on Johnny and Vanessa) Acorn helmets. Better safe than sorry!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Uh, he's a little excitable, isn't he?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yes. Yes, he is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You have to leave! It's not safe here for little kids, I mean for practically adults. Flee! Back to the city, away from danger!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Like what?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Like that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: All right, that's enough! Really Perry? Really?! I expect more from you. And you, Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But how did you...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh please, you come out here jumping around with your costume, and your lame book, and it's... it's just humiliating, Dad. I'm not a little girl anymore.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you're my little girl

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I know, I know, but all I want to do is have a good time with my friends, and you just keep popping up. It's like you don't trust me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He sighs) You're right. I'm sorry I got in your way. I know you can handle yourself, Vanessa. (He walks away sadly with Perry) C'mon Perry the Platypus. Maybe there's still time for a scheme today. I won't even trap you. You can just start beating me up right away.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Wait! I thought your dad was a pharmacist.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) She's right, Perry the Platypus, I've been smothering her. You know, it's just so hard to let go, as a parent. But I'm going to turn over new leaf though, I can tell you that. No more worrying, no more disguises, (takes off hippie costume) no more rules! (tosses Tri-State Almanac over shoulder)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're almost at the finish! Well, most of us.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ha ha! She'll never win now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're right, I could lose. But I can't give up now! I'm the queen of Skiddley Whiffers. And I'm not gonna let anything break my streak. NOW TOSS ME THAT DICE!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The singular is "die"! (tosses die)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, that was uncalled for.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, twice in one day!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Skiddley Whiffers is a cruel mistress; cold and unforgiving.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (jumps to the front) Woo-hoo! Take that, losers!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) You know, I tried to be a good parent, but sometimes it's -- (Vanessa screams in the distance) VANESSA!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Anybody else allergic to bees?

Name: Lacie
Dialog: Me.

Name: Unnamed goth boy
Dialog: I am.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: All of us? What are the odds?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: YOU LEAVE MY BABY GIRL ALONE!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad?! What are you doing here? It's dangerous!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sarcastically) Really? I hadn't noticed! (to the bees) Alright, bees. You like honey, don't ya? (pours honey from the hive all over him) Come and get it! Come on! (runs off)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Excuse me, Perry the Platypus! (jumps into the lake)

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Wow. Your dad is totally psychotic.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yes. Yes, he is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rings the victory bell) Woo! Thirteen wins in a row! Yeah, baby! (takes victory bell off its string and shakes it) Ding, ding, ding! A victory bell!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice game, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, for me! (throws victory bell upwards) Woo! (kicks it, picks up die) I totally creamed you guys in that game. And now, I'm gonna bust you for it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom! Hey, look what Phineas and Ferb built!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're right, Candace. Call the authorities, it's a cube!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes her arm) No time for sarcasm, move! (drags her)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, watch where you're going!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (trips on victory bell) WHOOAAAA -- OH!

Name: Electronic voice
Dialog: All players advance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Skiddley Whiffers, the game that keeps on playing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (with her eyes closed) Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) And I'm supposed to see...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: So boys, do anything special today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We played Skiddley Whiffers, and Candace played with us.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, how sweet. (to Candace) Candace, did you have fun with your brothers today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I did.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for pulling me out of the water, Perry the Platypus. But...this shirt's a little snug, are you sure you don't anything bigger? (pause) Nothing? Hm? (another pause) Be careful with those marshmallows though, seriously. (to Vanessa) D-do you know how many s'more related accidents happen each year in this country alone? Do you? (the pieces jump on the mountains in the distance while the Quirky Worky Song version of the Skiddely Whiffers theme is heard) Uh, I -- don't, but admit it's a lot.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (somewhat unthrilled) Dad...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, Ferb your cousins from England are here visiting.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Nods)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, I mean your cousins from England are here visiting.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Look, boys; it's your cousins visiting from England! They're here to see the exhibition football match between Danville and their beloved Snifferton Nostrils.

Name: Adrian, Lucy, Eliza, Beckham, Beckham, Beckham, Pele, Pele
Dialog: Ooh! Nose goal!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: So, the Nostrils are here in the States?

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Yes, they've already landed and they're probably on the team bus even as we speak!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ha! Fabulous! Anyway, Phineas, this is Uncle Adrian, Ady for short, Aunt Lucy...

Name: Lucy
Dialog: Hello!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: ...and their kids, Beckham, Beckham, Pele, Beckham, Pele, and Eliza. Well, her middle name is Beckham.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, guys!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: (Hugs Ferb and tousles his hair) Good heavens, Ferb! What a fine young man you've grown into. (Chuckles) Good to know you, Phineas! I've hear about you all the time.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh! So you have reading my newsletter?

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Oh, heavens no. I read Ferb's blog.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, at least you've learned to read.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Ouch!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Why don't we go inside and continue our good natured sibling rivalry there.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Yes, that way you won't be humiliated in front of the children.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, sibling rivalry is so attractive.

Name: Lucy
Dialog: Ady has such a healthy competitive spirit.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Eliza, honey, why don't you come along. Candace is up in her room.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: So cousin Ferb, you've lived in America longer than you lived in England.

Name: Beckham (half-moon glasses)
Dialog: You haven't gone Yank on us, have you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, don't worry, guys. Ferb is as British as ever!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi guys. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello, everyone. I was just cleaning my room and I thought I would return some of the things Ferb lent me. Your cowboy hat, your baseball mitt, your banjo CDs, your American flag unitard, oh, and here is your bald eagle. (Gives all the things in order and when Baljeet says bald eagle, it flies away) Oh, and Phineas, here is your sack.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome! Come to papa! (receives the sack)

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Oh, yes. Very British.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's going on?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, it's silly. Ferb's cousins think Ferb has lost his Britishness.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ferb's British?

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Apparently not. I bet you don't even play football anymore.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You dweebs, that's a soccer ball. This is a football!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, there's no one who loves soccer more than my brother Ferb! Ferb got all of us into playing, and we've gotten pretty good if I do say so myself. But Ferb, he's the real master.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, I once saw Ferb playing an entire game of soccer using a pumpkin! And he didn't even break it! To this day, his motivation for doing so remains shrouded in mystery.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Well, if you are all such crackin' footballers, then we challenge you and your friends to a football match.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: So what do you say? Playground rules?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about Football X-7 rules?

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Football X-7? That's only theoretical!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Only for another couple of hours, because I know what we're gonna do today. Hey, maybe Perry wants to be on our team.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: (Walks up to the patch of grass that Perry was on) Who's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Coughs) I apologize, Agent P. I'm a little under the weather today. First, I was convinced that Carl got me sick, you know, that knee-jerk blame Carl thing but then, then we received this, this morning.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On speaker) (Coughs) Uh...hello, Major Monogram, this is Heinz, it's 7

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Can you believe this? He had the nerve to call in SICK? I'm here, Carl's here. Don't you think I'd rather be at home, watching Ducky Momo? Agent P, you've got to get in there and, (Coughs) I don't know, get him better. Stop him from stopping the things from which, (Snorts) you have to stop him...for...

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Brilliant!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thanks. Most of my favorite bands are British. I guess I'm kind of an Anglophile.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anglophile? I thought your family is from Wisconsin. I mean, just....

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Candace, it means that he likes songs that are British.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. I knew that.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, man, I gotta get home and help my mom. I'll be back in a couple of hours.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Splendid!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Coolness!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nice to meet you, Eliza.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: And you as well, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, by the way, cool accent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool accent? Cool accent? He's never complimented me on my accent!

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Now, to be fair...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not all Britishy and sophisticated!

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Oh, Candace, don't be silly, it's obvious Jeremy likes you just the way you are.

Name: Candace
Dialog: DON'T TALK CRAZY! You gotta teach me how to be all Anglowishy and ladylike and proper!

Name: Eliza
Dialog: But Cand...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Obviously my relationship with Jeremy depends on it! So you'll help me?

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Yeah, alright.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Hah! I've given you a sound thrashing I have!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, yes, you always did have more wind than I.

Name: Lucy
Dialog: That's my Adrian. So talented.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't know if I would be bragging about holding my breath for 13 seconds. (Chuckles)

Name: Lucy
Dialog: Well, at least Lawrence is always so gracious in defeat. Hors-d'oeuvres, anyone?

Name: Adrian
Dialog: I'll bet I can make myself sick eating prawny puffs before you can.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Carnival ride sick or emergency room sick?

Name: Speaker
Dialog: (Intro theme playing...) Sweaty Men Playing Games Network presents Football X-7. Theoretical speculative conjecture or not that what we just said, with the conjecture thing? Football. Sometimes called soccer, footy, association football or the beautiful game. But, in 1952 a British theoretical physicist, and football enthusiast Professor Ross Eforp, hoped to heighten the football experience by creating the most thrilling and challenging version of soccer imaginable, which still allowed the players to survive. He called it Football X-7. He proposed building an immense gyroscopic, gravity-low stadium, creating an omnidirectional pitch allowing teams to play in 3 dimensions. After several attempts to build a Football X-7 stadium ended in disaster, most scientists, engineers and defensive mid-fielders agreed that Professor Ross Eforp's ultimate football game could never become a reality. The final blow came when it was discovered that Professor Ross Eforp's name is the same spelled forwards as it was backwards, and in the highly-charged anti-palindrome atmosphere in the mid-1950s Professor Ross Eforp was forced into hiding. As for Football X-7, is it possible perhaps one day someone some young dreamer with remarkable building and creative skills might just make Professor Ross Eforp's dream come true? No, not a chance, don't be ridiculous it's impossible.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Impossible?! The only thing's that is impossible is impossibility. Now Ferb and I believe we figured out where Professor Eforp went wrong.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Oi. Are you actually saying you're gonna build that here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. We are gonna do what no one has ever done before. Play the biggest, baddest, onliest game of Football X-7 ever! Now, who's with me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (as she, Buford, and Baljeet raise their hands) We are, of course.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Completely mad, the lot of them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's get started. Come on Ferb. We need to—Ferb? Ferb? Ferb?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Coughs) Perry the Platypus? What are you doing here? Did you get my mess—Is that chicken soup? (Perry gives him a look) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that? Yeah I was planing to do evil today but look at me. I just don't think it's gonna happen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh man, 103? Seriously, if I was a hot tub people would be getting out of me. They'd be all like "Wow, Heinz Doofenshmirtz is way too hot. We should get out of him." Anyway, since you're here, I taped my rehearsal. I'll just play it for you. It'll be just as good. I shot this yesterday when I was feeling considerably better then.

Name: Doofenshmirtz on TV
Dialog: Lalalalala. Topeka, Kansas. Topeka, Kansas. Okay. So, Perry the Platypus, I bet you're wondering why I trapped you in this soundproof capsule? Wait, (Ugh) If it's soundproof he won't be able to hear me... Oh.

Name: (Doofenshmirtz pushes a button turning it into static. The screen goes back in a split second.) For generations philosophers have asked, "If a tree falls in the forest, and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?" The answer, by the way obviously is "Of course it does." I mean, duh! Right? Philosophers. Get a job thinky-boy! Now see, the question they should be asking is, "What sound does the falling tree make?" Behold! The If-a-Tree-Fell-In-The-Forest-Inator! Dun dun dun! One blast from this puppy will knock over a tree or anything else for that matter-and the sound it will make is
Dialog: (Whisper) Doofenshmirtz... (Normal) I, will have eternal fame as the answer to that one philosophical question! I'm also working on a Sound-of-One-Hand-Clapping-Inator. Doo-Fen-Shmirtz. I'll CORNER the markets! And speaking of markets, I'm out of vitamins. I should really get some before they close... Eh. So I skipped my Vitamin C for a day. What's the worst thing that could happen?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not one word, Perry the Platypus. You have to at least give me a chance to do my thing, okay? Good. Okay, here we go. Where is it? Here we go. (Deploys the trap on the other side of the room, nowhere near Perry) There. I trapped you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so what's next? I...activate my -inator, okay. Give me a head start here. (Groaning, stands up and cracks his back.) I'll get there, don't worry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, man. That thing is gonna be huge! I'm gonna go get my mom!

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Erm, Candace, you do know that tattling is not very ladylike.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not?

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Afraid not, no. I've five little brothers myself, so you can imagine the discipline it takes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No busting?!

Name: Eliza
Dialog: You asked me to teach you how to be proper and sophisticated for Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But- but...(Groans, then takes a deep breath.) Right. I can do this.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Good girl. The first lesson for a lady-in-training is about posture. Honestly, I'm not quite sure why this is, but from birth, all proper ladies are warned that they must stand and sit completely vertically straight, and even the tiniest bend or deviation on one side will lead directly to a life of horror and destitution.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Shrugging.) Makes sense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't get it. What, do polite people not have bookshelves in your country?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lady and gentlemen, I give you the Football X-7 stadium!

Name: Beckham (half-moon glasses)
Dialog: Whoa! That's brilliant! I'm totally gobsmacked!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I guess I could smack a little gob myself.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Now it all comes down to the game. Are you ready?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah! How about you, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh no! I was afraid something like this would happen.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What will we do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At the camera) We'll be right back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) Ferb's soccer problem started a few months ago, right before summer began. Um, actually, that's a little early in the day.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) Okay, closer. A little later than that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) Whoa, what is that, night? Back it up to about the middle of the third quarter...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) Like there! Right there. Thank you. So anyway...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) We were having a great game. Ferb, as always, was in top form. Little did I know it would be Ferb's last game. Late in the second period, the other team had kicked the ball out-of-bounds, and Ferb grabbed it. Suddenly, from out of nowhere, a herd of emu ran onto the field and carried off our assistant coach. Ferb simply put the ball down and walked off the field. That was it. Ferb hasn't played football since.

Name: Beckham (half-moon glasses)
Dialog: I don't blame him, poor fellow. It's the Emu Curse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Emu Curse?

Name: Beckham (half-moon glasses)
Dialog: It goes like this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. British curses are really specific.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, no wonder he disappeared.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna have to break that curse!

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Good luck, mate.

Name: Beckham (half-moon glasses)
Dialog: To break the Emu Curse, a boy wearing a Sunday bonnet must sing the note Eb above high C in front of the cursed one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Eb above high C? Whoa! Wait a second, who's got a piccolo? Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Argh! One day somebody's gonna ask me for some obscure musical instrument, and it ain't gonna be there. What's gonna happen then? (Pulls out the piccolo and plays the Eb above high C)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is that ringing so- is that Eb above high C? Oh, for crying out loud, Perry the Platypus, really? Really? You're thwarting the ill...? (Begins hacking up a lung)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here it is! The Football X-7 stadium! Complete with omnidirectional hover goals and observation deck/high tea room!

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Wow...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's designed so that the ground hugs your feet, making it possible to literally walk on walls! So the goals can be scored from any angle.

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Brilliant, let's play.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish we could.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. We don't have a team without Ferb.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. He was our quarterback.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You still do not know what game we are playing, do you?

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: You do realize without a full team you forfeit the match?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, you guys. If I know my brother, he'll come through for us!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hi, guys! I brought some dry ice!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aww.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, and I brought Ferb, too.

Name: Phineas, Isabella, Buford, and Baljeet
Dialog: Ferb!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you came to play!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: As long as my team will have me, curse and all.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course we will! It's not about winning, it's about the joy of the game!

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Actually, it's about winning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a phony British accent) Why, Jeremy! How delightful it is to see you again!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace...you look...great?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do come in!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what do you think? High tea and-

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Whoa! Cool! What're they doin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Some sort of silly game. As a lady, I'm not terribly interested in such foolishness. I'm much more interested in curtsying and other dainty pursuits.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy! Doesn't Candace look lovely?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. I can't say I've seen better posture.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you care to stack books on my head?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, I'm cool.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Well, why don't you two sit and chat while I fetch tea?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That sounds divine! Shall we?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Of...course!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Have you noticed my extended pinkies?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I was just about to comment on them. They're really up there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, thank you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, it's a little unusual...here we are sitting in the very heart of a giant soccer stadium your brothers built in your yard...and you haven't once shown any desire to bust them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, dear boy, no, no. A lady never tattles. (Giggles uncertainly)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Just... one... more... oh, I can't do it! Oh, darn it.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Ha! I'm wearing more shirts than you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, brother.

Name: Lucy
Dialog: It's hard not to root for him, isn't it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I think I'll manage. Excuse me for a second.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, hello, dear.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, Lawrence, what's going on here? I've seen you put on more shirts than that.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I'll let you in on a little secret

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, I can see that. But, you know what, honey, as humble and gracious as you are- and I love that about you- next time, destroy him.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Pardon?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Smear the punk. Annihilate him. Make him cry.

Name: Lucy
Dialog: You're awesome, he's not, you're awesome, he's not...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Under his breath) Got it. (At Adrian) Oh, hey, Ady, how about one last little event? Keepy-Uppy?

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Keepy-Uppy? Are you mad? I have never lost a game of Keepy-Uppy in my life.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, you won't mind humoring me then.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Coughing) I'm going to... (Continues coughing) activate my... (Loses his balance, grabs onto the -inator, continues coughing) you know the rest.

Name: Machine
Dialog: (Whisper) Doofenshmirtz...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa...check it out, Perry the Platypus, I...I'm totally beating you inadvertently. (Pushes button, -inator starts to spin) And when I say inadvertently, I... I mean completely vertently...ha ha...you know, fighting you makes me feel a little better. It's a... it's a good feeling. (Climbs onto spinning -inator) Like a comfy old sweater or something...like an old friend. Yes... (-inator fires) like a comfy old big woolen friend named Joy C. Terrific from the hinterlands... I'm literally just blathering now.

Name: Tree
Dialog: (Whisper) Doofenshmirtz...

Name: Nostril #3
Dialog: Did that tree just say "Doofenshmirtz"?

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: I think we've been on this bus too long!

Name: Bus Driver
Dialog: Hang on, lads, we're taking a detour.

Name: Nostrils Fans
Dialog: Nostrils! Nostrils! Nostrils! Nostrils!

Name: Nostrils Fan #1
Dialog: Hey, wait, where're they goin'?

Name: Nostrils Fan #2
Dialog: I made them a crumpet!

Name: Nostrils Fan #3
Dialog: Oh, is that what that is.

Name: Nostrils Fan #1
Dialog: Follow 'em!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah...that really feels good...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I'll have more cake...(falls asleep)

Name: -Inator
Dialog: (whisper) ...ztrimhsnefooD

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (mumbles) ...so evil...

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Come on, Lawrence, give it up. I've won at everything since we were kids!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh yeah? Watch this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, stop showing off, or you're gonna blow it.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Don't worry, darling, I've got the...(kicks the` ball far too high) oh, whoops.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Well, Lawrence, it looks like you've lost again.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, it does look that way, doesn't it? (the ball comes back down, he continues playing Keepy-Uppy) However, looks can be deceiving.

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: Is it my imagination, or is that a Football X-7 stadium?

Name: Nostril #3
Dialog: It's your imagination. That's just a mailbox. But there is one on this side of the bus.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace...I can't help but notice your...accent there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, yes. Do you like it? I thought an Anglophile such as yourself might appreciate the soothing lilt of the Queen's English.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: An Anglophile such as myself? (he realizes what she is referring to) Oh, ha! I get it. Well...yes. I could listen to you speak like that all day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I like it so much better than how you were...before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You do?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Of course. I'm so glad you finally decided to change everything about yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! You didn't like how I was before?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But isn't that why you changed? So I would like you better?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, yeah...but...this isn't really...oh, wait. You're totally messing with me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yes, I am totally messing with you. Now, would you please knock off the phony British stuff and go back to being my girl?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You got it, bub.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: (carrying tea) So, how are we doing over here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Turns out Jeremy liked me how I was before.

Name: Eliza
Dialog: Shocker.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now if you two will excuse me, I've got some brothers to bust.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: There's my girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! You are soooo busted! Well, I don't need this goofy thing anymore. (tosses her huge poofy hat out the window)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Pass me the ball! (Candace's hat lands on his head, he cannot see. The ball hits him right in the crotch, and he whines

Name: Pele (tallest one)
Dialog: Ooh.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ha ha!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! The Eb above high C! From a boy in a Sunday bonnet! The curse! It's broken! We can actually win this thing! Pass it to Ferb, pass it to Ferb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: OHHH! I am kind of in the middle of something here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I got it!

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: No!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Beckham (square glasses)
Dialog: Run!

Name: Beckham (half-moon glasses)
Dialog: Ha, it missed the goal by a mile.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What happened? I guess the curse wasn't broken.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No, it's broken. Sometimes, you just miss!

Name: Nostril #8
