Dialog: Hello!

Name: Beckhams/Peles
Dialog: It's the Snifferton Nostrils! Ooh! Nose goal!

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: What a beautiful kick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But he missed the goal!

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: It's not whether you score the goal. It's how good you look while kicking the ball.

Name: Nostril in Jacket
Dialog: Actually, it is about making goals.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (still playing Keepy-Uppy) I'm awesome, you're not, I'm awesome, you're not...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Shh! Just a second, Candace. Your father's doing his victory dance!

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: So you're just gonna give us this Football X-7 stadium?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure! We do that kind of thing all the time!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! Once they gave a monster truck arena to Buck Buckerson!

Name: Nostril in Jacket
Dialog: Was that you?

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: Thank you, Phineas, that's very generous of you. (to all of the Nostrils fans in the driveway) Hey, everyone!

Name: Nostrils fans
Dialog: Yes, Nostrils?

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: See this thing?

Name: Nostrils fans
Dialog: Do you mean the Football X-7 stadium?

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: Would you all help us load this on the bus?

Name: Nostrils fans
Dialog: We would all like that very much, what you just said.

Name: Professor E Forp
Dialog: (removes a bag from his head) Is that a Football X-7 stadium? I knew it could be done! Professor Ross E Forp can finally come out of hiding!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Mummy, that man's name is a palindrome.

Name: Johnny's Mother
Dialog: Look away, Johnny, look away.

Name: Nostril #8
Dialog: Man, you can get these fans to do anything. Thanks again, Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You see, Mom?!... (then, upset) Absolutely nothing. Oh, I am thinking some very unladylike things right now.

Name: Jeremy and Eliza
Dialog: That's our girl!

Name: Beckham (blond)
Dialog: Oi, Cousin Ferb, we're dreadfully sorry for giving you such a hard time. You're an brilliant footballer, an all-around good chap and a Brit through and through.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually lads, I'm not a Brit or a Yank. I'm just Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys. I'm just working on my junk sculpture for the Modern Installations by Moms charity auction.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Seen Dad?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, he headed out for that speaking engagement of his.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, we're gonna shoot darts and we thought he might want to play around.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Maybe next time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What a racket! Those guys are so busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe Mom isn't hearing this.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, I've really got a knack for this modern art stuff. I need to go get more materials! (drops the blowtorch; runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, mid-crime, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: They'll be back.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Isabella! We're playing giant darts!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (flirtatiously) I bet you'll get a bulls-eye.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (obliviously) Sure. Maybe not on the first try. It's all about little adjustments. And Buford and Baljeet are manning the target across town.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Tell me again how you are helping?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (lounging on a beach chair) I'm supervisin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, here we go! Elevation, 33 degrees. Three, two, one...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Have fun!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: With our current velocity and wind resistance, we should be nearing the target in no time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoops! Better retract the launch mechanism.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Let's see, where to. Ah, yes. 9019, Palindrome Road.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh! That was close. (rights the car back up) Whoops! Dropped my address. (picks up the paper) Well, (places paper on the sun visor) 6106, Palindrome Road, here I come!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb at ten o'clock!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops. Outer ring. We'll try again.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Zero. Write that down, Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes, by all means, I do not want to forget to add zero later.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, I meant to ask you earlier. Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Our sources tell us that the members of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.,

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally United For Frightening Investments in Naughtiness,

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: are about to gather to elect their new leader. But we don't know where or how. See if you can gain access, and we'll survey the situation remotely through your wrist communicator.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her cell phone) Mom, you've gotta see what Phineas and Ferb made. I don't know what it is, but it looks horrible.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be home right after I finish my errands.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But you gotta come home now before it disappears!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (imitating static) What's that? You're breaking up! (imitates static)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Mom! (growls) I hates when she does... (imitates static) ...but it doesn't matter. I'm not going anywhere.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) Right in there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You've heard of a ship in a bottle? Well, you're Perry the Platypus in a bottle. (picks up bottle) Anyway, today is the day I become the supreme leader of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.! You remember L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally... (mumbling) Whatever?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? Remember them?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, we gotta moving. (holds up bottle) Maybe we'll get some hot dogs or something on the way. (walks off) You like hot dogs, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps; stands up) That came from the front yard! (runs off) Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A-ha! Huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Feathers. It needs feathers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Oh. My. Gosh.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (stops his car) Well, this is the place.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, um, I'm supposed to be onstage?

Name: Man
Dialog: (puts paper down) They're about to get started. (pushes Lawrence towards stage) Go, go, go!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: I am Rodney, and I am from the great state of South Dakota, home of beautiful Mt. Rushmore... For now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "I'm Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, and I like unicorns and rainbows..." Wait, who switched my...

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (laughs)

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: I'm Dr. Diminutive and I don't have a Napoleon complex. Napoleon had a me complex! Don't cross me!

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: You can't do that!

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: Why?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Excuse me, is this the way to the stage?

Name: Announcer
Dialog: It looks like we have a late entry!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb at ten o'clock again!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome! Triple ring, triple score!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, but in the one-point wedge. Three points, Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: When do I get to supervise?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't hold your breath.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No one comes in, no one goes...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Forget it. I'm not moving.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (off screen) Okay, Ferb, let's reset and adjust both axes by five degrees.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (groans) I can't stand it! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (closes door) I'm gonna bust you yet!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now to the butcher for the finishing touch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the...?

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Welcome to the first annual L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Pageant of Evil,...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: ...where these three gentlemen will vie for the chance to tell you what's what.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (oblivious to what's going on) I thought I was already confirmed. Prepared my speech and everything.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: In addition to gaining total control of the iron...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: ...hand of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.,...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: our contestants will each receive a commemorative flashlight...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on wristwatch communicator) Agent P, it's come to our attention that Lawrence Fletcher, from your host family, has somehow entered the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Supreme Ruler Pageant.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Of course, considering his genial nature,...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: ...a win for him would really stretch my suspension of disbelief. But just in case, you better sit tight and just observe.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Remember, points will be awarded by the audience,...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: ...so get out your voting boxes.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Our first evil event, the mechanical mother.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Show us how you treat the old lady, Larry!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wish me luck, boys. (at the mechanical mother) Hello, old dear, so lovely to see you. (bows) I've brought you some peonies. (pulls out a bouquet)

Name: Mechanical mother
Dialog: Oh, such a nice boy.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: I didn't think anyone could be more incompetent at being evil than you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Me neither.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And now, he's serving her tea without a trace of irony!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (as he walks back) Remember to keep that foot elevated. (to the other two) What a lovely, old girl.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Prepare yourself for a stunning display of filial beastliness. (walks away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, knock yourself out, Rodney.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (holding a present; at the mechanical mother) Hello, Mother. (kneels on one knee) I've brought you something special!

Name: Mechanical mother
Dialog: For me? (opens present) You're such a good...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Ooh! Dirty laundry!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And there go the waterworks.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (chuckles) Yeah. That's how it's done, boys.

Name: Mechanical Mother
Dialog: Oh! My baby still needs me!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Oh, no! Tears of joy? Zero points for that move!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, you monster. Watch and learn, Rodney. (clears throat; at mechanical mother) I am getting married again.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Audience, get your votes in, please.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (at a smug Doofenshmirtz) I don't know how you did it! I don't even think I understood the event, but good show!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And we're back with everyone's favorite, the swimwear competition! Here comes Lawrence Fletcher...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: ...wearing swim attire inspired by the legendary Klimpaloon,...

Name: Announcer
Dialog: ...the magical old-timey bathing suit that lives in the Himalayas! Watch out for that Yeti, Larry!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Next up is Heinz Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, I thought this was the talent competition! (skates off balance; falls head first into a toilet; muffled yelling) It won't stop flushing!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: (pause) And last is Rodney in his... (curtain opens) Oh, my gosh!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (leaps out of tank; removes rubber mask) Technically, it is a swimsuit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meat? What possible functionality could that have?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, Rodney, the last event's about to... What? Wait, that's my Make-Everything-Evil-inator!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: No, Doofy, it's my Make-Everything-Evil-izer. It's an -Izer.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're a jerk, you know that?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Yes! And I'm going to be more of one when I zap myself with this! (pulls on a lever) I'll be so evil there'll be no way I can lose!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (quickly sits on Rodney's lap) I'll zap me first!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (with Rodney) You quit it!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: You broke my Izer!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Inator! Inator!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Shut it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, you shut it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Have you seen these flashlights...AAH!

Name: Rodney, Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Excuse us. We're here to take, uh this... thing away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stands up from lawn) What? No!

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Sorry, kid. We got a work order right here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Nooooo!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And now the final event where each of our three contestants will attempt to intimidate the others with only the force of his evil glare. Contestants, take your marks.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Get set. And begin!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: The voting has started! Look at those fingers go!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Rodney is off to an early lead. It's the pointy-ear advantage! But wait! What's this?

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Fletcher has his eyes covered. He's not even trying!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: This could be a real opportunity for Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: He leers at Rodney. Rodney returns it. With a point! A classic gambit!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: The scores are really ticking up now and... Wait! There's a stirring in the Fletcher corner.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Something's happening...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Such evil!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (shielding his face) Oh! My eyes!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And the crowd is going wild! Fletcher's numbers are skyrocketing!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on wristwatch communicator) Agent P, our sensors reveal that Lawrence Fletcher has been shot with a Make-Everything-Evil-izer. If he should become the supreme leader of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., we will have no choice but to reassign you. You must find a way to snap him out of it. Remind him of his true, good nature. Remind him who he used to be!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (off screen) This is the one, Bro. I can feel it.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: I now present to you, the new supreme leader of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., Lawrence Fletcher!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Today, Danville! Tomorrow, the world! (chuckling)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We have term limits in L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., right?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Nope!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (laughs evilly)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bull's-eye!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think that's Dad.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: What was the topic of his lecture again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (taking off medal; flings it away) Phineas! Ferb! What are you doing here?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (shaking Phineas's hand) Brilliant shot, by the way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aah, it's all about little adjustments.

Name: Doofenshmirtz, Rodney
Dialog: Mine! Mine! Mine!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: It's mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh! I hate you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as he, Ferb, and Lawrence walk away) So, how'd it go, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'm not absolutely sure, boys, but I think I just became "King of the Pharmacists".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome! (at Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunts) No! Not until Mom has seen it.

Name: Delivery Man
Dialog: Sorry, miss, I got a job to do.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace is right. Because it's not done yet.

Name: Linda
Dialog: There. Take it away, guys. That junk sculpture should bring in big bids at the auction. (climbs down the flatbed)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in surprise) Junk sculpture?! (stuttering)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honestly, Candace, it's not like lip-synching is my only talent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (continues stuttering)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, now you're just being rude.

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: I don't have a Napoleon complex, Napoleon had a me complex! Don't cross me!

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: You can't do that!

Name: Diminutive
Dialog: Why?

Name: Phineas, Ferb, and Candace
Dialog: Trick or treat!

Name: Man
Dialog: Well, now, would you look at this, Martha? We've got Frankenstein, Count Dracula, and some kind of Igor, or something.

Name: Man
Dialog: And if it isn't little Candace Flynn! Where's your costume?

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Where's your costume"?! I haven't worn my hair like this in 2 years!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Get with the Halloween spirit, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Puh-leese. Trick-or-Treating is for kids. I'm like, way more mature than that. I'm walking with you until we get to Jeremy's, and then I am outta here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There they are. I thought we'd never catch up. Goin' old school this year, I see. Sweet. No costume, huh, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice fairy princess costume! Where'd you get it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Actually, I'm not wearing a costume.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, okay.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I got it at the Googolplex Mall.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What kind of person hands out these weird, orange peanuts? We gotta find a better neighborhood.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's strange. I've never seen this place before. (Notices a haunted house) You'd think we would've noticed it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gonna give those orange peanuts a second look.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Boy
Dialog: (Flips flashlight switch) Hi, I'm Russell. I live here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Russell, like the leaves.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What are you trying to do, scare us?

Name: Russell
Dialog: No. Hiding in the leaves makes me feel warm and secure. (Ominous violin) Relatively speaking.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why do you not just go inside?

Name: Russell
Dialog: In there? It's haunted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Russell
Dialog: No, not cool! The horrifying screams, moving shadows, floating objects, ghosts, zombies, vampires. It's really freaking me out, man!

Name: Buford
Dialog: The light under his chin makes his story pretty convincing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, there is no scientific evidence for the existence of ghosts.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What do you know? You're a daffodil!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Daisy!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Case closed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we can help you, Russell. Got anything for ghosts, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa. Looks like we're in business! Let's bust us some ghosts!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold it there, fella! Nobody's doin' any busting around here without me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure, we'll all go! Coming, Russell?

Name: Russell
Dialog: If I have to.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, please.

Name: Russell
Dialog: Oh, this always happens.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't panic anyone!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How can I panic when I'm holding your hand?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think that's my hand.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ew!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey! (Turns on the flashlight under his chin; ghostly voice) Wheerrrre is Perrrrrryyyyy?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quit it, Baljeet!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Dressed as Major Monogram, Mimicking his voice) Hello, Agent P. Welcome to the Company Halloween Party. Try the punch, it's wicked good. Just be sure to use a coaster. Certain people can be downright persnickety. (Normal voice) Psst, Agent P, it's me, Carl! Had you fooled, didn't I? I've got the monobrow, the whiskery mustache, but I couldn't get both my eyes on the same side of my nose. He's like a Picasso, or something.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Dressed as Carl) Where is your coaster, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What do you think? Nice costume, huh? My lip feels so naked. (Clears throat) Sorry to interrupt the festivities, but we've been receiving some weird intelligence. The Danville Golf Course chewed down to bare dirt, strange howling at the moon, graffiti at every leather shop the Tri-State Area. And, we don't know what to make of this crop circle. Get to the bottom of it, Agent P!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (In Monogram's voice) "Get to the bottom of it, Agent P!"

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not how I sound, Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (In Monogram's voice) "That's not how I sound, Carl!"

Name: Russell
Dialog: Come on, most of the ghosts are this way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good, let's bust them and hit the road. I'm missing Jeremy's party!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ghosts, there is no such thing. Look! My EMF readings are three milligauss. Normal background radiation. And when we point it at the room, it is also... Well, that cannot be right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: 78? Did we even make these things with double digit displays? (Jack-O-Lantern rises and grows a body) Um...

Name: Jack-O-Lantern
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be hunting ghosts?

Name: All but Ferb
Dialog: Yes!! Yes, we are!!! (Screaming, they turn and run)

Name: Russell
Dialog: It's totally like this all the time!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, I was hoping you would come. (Perry points at the chains) Wh-Wh... this? Yeah, I had to place myself in restraints. There's a perfectly good explanation though. It all started a couple of days ago, when I declared war on grass, i-it's not important why exactly. Le-Let's say grass got on my bad side. Grass and me, we're on the outs, big time, so I got myself a cow, the natural predator of grass, it was slow going. What I needed was cow that was motivated not by hunger, but by a powerful hatred of grass like, like my own. Burning antipathy, so I invented the Mind-transfer Inator to give that cow a piece of my mind! (zapping sound) And as it turns out, cow brain? Not a lot of room in there for new ideas. That would have been it, but I started having these gaps in my memory. I had a strange craving to lick salt and I found myself watching the nightly farm report and the Pasture Channel way more than usual. . . I-I began to get a sense that I was not quite human anymore, which is-which is why I'm in the restraints and actually it stinks 'cause tonight's Halloween, you know, that's totally my thing, you know, the only holiday to celebrate evil, and here I am in these... Oh no! (He starts transforming into a Were-cow) It's happening again! It's happening! Argh! (Totally transforms into a Were-cow) Mooo! (Takes out the chains and watches Perry, he takes out a rope to catch him) Moooo! (Doofenshmirtz transformed into a Were-cow escapes and Perry follows him) Moooo!

Name: Doorman
Dialog: Three more years till the pension kicks in, then I am so out of here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Moooo!

Name: Woman
Dialog: There are no monsters in America, what a genius.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace gets to the front door, tries to open it) Open up! Come on, open it up! It won't budge!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Quickly!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: At least it was only a 78 on the meter, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How could this be worse?

Name: Russell
Dialog: Well, sometimes the floor gives out. (The floor gives out, causing the gang to fall in the basement, which is infested with ghosts)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I gotta say, this is a really non-traditional use of interior space.

Name: Russell
Dialog: Don't all houses have this?

Name: Female ghost
Dialog: I have a tremulous voice!

Name: Male ghost
Dialog: I'm non-corporeal, and that's scary.

Name: Female Ghost
Dialog: I'm not a ghost, I'm a sheet, that lives!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This could be related to your problem. (A shed behind Phineas bursts open, showing the Jack-O-Lantern)

Name: Jack-O-Lantern
Dialog: I'm not alive anymore. (All but Ferb shout, all start running and the Jack-O-Lantern follows them)

Name: Russell
Dialog: Across the river, we'll be safe in that house!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: River?! How big is this basement?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This is really the wrong color and viscosity for water!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't pop my bubble, man! (Zombies start to rise from the "water")

Name: Zombie 1
Dialog: Brains!

Name: Zombie 2
Dialog: Spleen!

Name: Zombie 1
Dialog: Pancreas-es!

Name: Russel
Dialog: Did I mention the zombies?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Starts shouting and runs out)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not splash! Do not splash! (More zombies start to rise, and everybody follows him)

Name: Zombie 3
Dialog: Kidneys!

Name: Zombie 4
Dialog: I don't care for organs, but I do enjoy a cucumber sandwich. (The Jack-O-Lantern runs over the cucumber sandwich zombie) Dash it all, they broke my saucer.

Name: Bridgette Oshinomi
Dialog: Danville meadows, where yesterday, thousands of layers of grass were senselessly cut down in their prime. Officials believe the responsibility for this fescue massacre lies with a were-cow. And locals are advised to stay off their lawns.

Name: Man
Dialog: Forget that! (pulls out flaming torch) I say we get him!

Name: Lady
Dialog: Yeah! (pulls out a pitchfork) Wait a minute, you brought a torch on our date?

Name: Man
Dialog: Helloo! Pitchfork!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wha-? Where... where am I? How did-? (looks around and sees crop circles that he made) What's that awful taste in my mouth? And when did they do all this beautiful landscaping? (the clouds covering the moon float away; he sees the full moon then gasps) Oh, no!! (Perry arrives) Oh, Perry the Platypus, thank goodness you're here! Quickly, we have to get me back to my lab before I moo again! Or mow, 'cuz, you know, see, it's grass and you mow grass... (starts turning into a werecow again) Mooooo!

Name: Man
Dialog: There he is! Let's get 'im!

Name: Man
Dialog: He could be hiding behind any one of these poles!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Look, there are more poles over there!

Name: Baking Academy Teacher
Dialog: First take three cups of flour. . . (screams as Dr. Doof and the angry mob break through the wall, interrupting her)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Dead end!

Name: Jack-O-Lantern
Dialog: Relax and stay awhile. Stay FOREVER!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: 'Nobody busts but me'... Smart!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait a minute, if you're a ghost, and you have a pumpkin head, what did that make you when you were alive?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: The probability of a humanoid vegetable hybrid is exceedingly remote. (He picks up a skull and hurls it at the Jack-O-Lantern, which sparks and sputters and falls the ground)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Sparks!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It was a ghost robot?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, just a regular one. I think there's something strange not going on here.

Name: Waylon
Dialog: (Sighs) Ah, darn servomotors. (To the kids) You guys really gave us a heck of a workout.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Us?

Name: Waylon
Dialog: I'm Russell's dad, Waylon.

Name: Mona
Dialog: And I'm his mom, Mona.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Russell, Waylon and Mona? They're like, themed for Halloween or something!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But our equipment! How did you...

Name: Russell
Dialog: Ta-da!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A frequency emitter! You sly dog, Russ.

Name: Mona
Dialog: We've got them all over the place.

Name: Waylon
Dialog: Hey! What's that in your ear?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How did you do that?

Name: Waylon
Dialog: Sorry, that's a (in Jack-O-lantern's voice) trade secret!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! This is one of the best Halloween tricks ever!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Impatiently) Yeah. Blah, blah, blah lovefest. Some of us have somewhere to be!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, but before we go, how about one more trick?

Name: Waylon
Dialog: (Uncertainly) Well, um...

Name: Were-cow
Dialog: Moooooo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Amazed) Wow! A mob of angry ghosts chasing a were-cow! How do you do it?

Name: Waylon
Dialog: Uhm. . . smoke?

Name: Mona
Dialog: And. . . mirrors!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Groans) Uhh...

Name: Waylon
Dialog: Good night, Phineas. Good night Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, for a minute there, I thought that there really were ghosts. (Turns suddenly and gasps) The old house! It's gone!

Name: Waylon
Dialog: We're just uh, packing it up for the season.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isn't this the moment in one of these things when someone really turns into a ghost?

Name: Russell
Dialog: (Sounding slightly irritated) Dude, that's it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, okay. See ya next year!

Name: Michael
Dialog: You can't fly away from us, Jared!

Name: Michael
Dialog: Ha, now you're trapped!

Name: Kristen
Dialog: He's bent the gate!

Name: Michael
Dialog: His vampire strength won't save him this time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Stacy) Wow, super vampire strength.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And he's super cute.

Name: Audience Member
Dialog: Ssshhh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, look! He has no reflection in that mirror.

Name: Jared
Dialog: I can't see my hair!

Name: Wolfman
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look Stacy he's cornered. Now he's really stuck.

Name: Audience Member
Dialog: Ssshhh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Speaking of 'stuck', what's up with this floor?

Name: Kristen
Dialog: Jared, Michael, don't do this!

Name: Michael
Dialog: (Growls) It's the end of the line, Jared.

Name: Jared
Dialog: I'd expect this from your kind, Michael. Football players I mean, but Kristen, we were both moody outcasts, we.. we loved each other!

Name: Kristen
Dialog: Yes, yes we did.

Name: Jared
Dialog: We did, and, wait a minute, wasn't he just wearing a shirt (To Michael)

Name: Michael
Dialog: You can no longer drink the blood of those you love.

Name: Jared
Dialog: Wait, those drapes were a gift from my.... Ahhh! (sun shines in room) The hideous light of the day star! (becomes a liquid-body of himself - a gust of wind blows his frozen body away)

Name: Kristen
Dialog: Where did that wind come from?

Name: Michael
Dialog: Oops, sorry. I opened a window, it was getting stuffy in here.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That was the best movie ever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah I know. Imagine if you had to choose between a blood-thirsty undead walking corpse and a slobbering hairy-lupine manbys for a boyfriend. (camera zooms on Candace) What could possibly be cooler? (shakes hand up knocking down the LIVE BAT from cage - Candace screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get off me!

Name: Theater Usher
Dialog: Careful with that promotional bat, it's rented.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You really rented a bat.

Name: Theater Usher
Dialog: Yeah I know, it seemed like a good idea at the time.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no, I think it's really paying off here. (Candace continues saying "Get off me")

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what you mean, Ferb, it does seem like more than 104 days.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Boys, I'm off to Bobbi's. If you need anything, your father's inside watching television.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, this isn't much of a horror movie. Where are the rock-and-roll musical numbers?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, and Ferb, you left your pen on the kitchen table. Have fun today, I'll be back later.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye mom! I was wondering where that went. (to Ferb) Okay Ferb, lets have a look through our blueprints.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Ferb clicks pen open)'

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cooking powered jet cars, haunted office building ride with tensos, a reenactment with the battle of Danville?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (walks in with a bamboo in her hand) Hey Phineas! What'cha dooooin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Trying to think of something to do today. What's that?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is Bambina, my bamboo. Only, she's not doing so well.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: She needs help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The poor girl probably just needs some sunlight. Ferb and I can rake up a super growth lamp in no time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You'd do that for me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure! Ferb, I know what we're...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Buford
Dialog: How come you guys are making something special for her? What about me?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a nerd carrier. I had a heck of a getting him in. Scratched me all up!

Name: Irving
Dialog: I'd like something, too!

Name: Buford
Dialog: How long have you been there?

Name: Irving
Dialog: I'm not sure. What's today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're doing today. Taking requests. (pause) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, oh Agent P! How long have you been sitting there? Huh, guess I'd better get started. You received a weird message from Dr. Doofenshmirtz this morning, claiming that he will no longer seek to take over the Tri-State area. Then he used a very unusual method for conveying his message. Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: He wrote a letter by hand and put it in an envelope and sent it through the regular mail with a stamp and everything. Who does that? And it's scented. (smells envelope) Mmm, Milbank Nights. One of the better perfumes to come out of South Dakota.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: When an evil scientist sends preread letters wrongdoing can't be far behind. Dismissed Agent P! Carl, let me uh, smell that letter again, would ya?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I don't know, Candace, you're just lucky that bat didn't bite you. I mean, what if it was a vampire bat?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me, a vampire? Don't be silly, Stacy. It would be cool to have super strength though. And be able to fly.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, but you'd never be able to see yourself in the mirror again. How would you put on your make-up?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the platypus, didn't you get my letter? Oh, of course not, here I-I'll read it to you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dear Perry the Platypus, I know Major Monogram will ignore my letter and send you to stop me. That's why you are now trapped. Best wishes, your nemesis, Heinz. (finishes letter, talks to Perry) Come to think of it, it wouldn't of made much sense until now, it's probably good that you didn't get it earlier. It would have just been confusing, and I would have to be stuck with having to explain it to you. Speaking of stuck, you've landed on a square of the stickiest surface known to man. It's a tile from the floor of the Danville Multiplex. I discovered it when I went to go see that teen vampire movie. Loved it! And now... (closes window of machine) Behold, the Gimmelshtump-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See, Perry the Platypus, I've been setting my sights too high, I think. Trying to subdue a modern city, I need to conquer a backward land where people are superstitious. That's why I'm going to turn the Tri-State area into a reasonable festival in Gimmelshtump. The buildings, the clothing, the or easily conquered backward mindset. Here's a sample, look.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My beautiful modern state of the art bathroom is changed into...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A Gimmelshtumpian potter room. (scene switches to Dr. Doofenshmirtz) Ahh, that takes me back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I got to get home Stacy. Jeremy's supposed to drop off my MP3 player this afternoon on his way to work.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, don't attack him, Ms. un-dead!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, as if. (talking to herself) Jeremy won't be here for another couple minutes. That gives me just enough to time to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, you guys are so... hey, they're not here. What's this? This stuff's way below they're usually bustable level. I wonder what they're doing out here with dad's old barbells. (Candace lifts barbells) Hey, I've never been able to... (gasps) Super strength. What if there really was a vampire bat? Candace, get a hold of yourself. I mean, it's not like I can fly. (Candace floats in air) Oh my gosh! Okay there's only one way to know for sure. A mirror. (Candace's reflection in the mirror disappears) Oh no, no reflection!

Name: Narrator Voice
Dialog: Two minutes earlier...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay Ferb, let's run through the list. To fulfill Isabella's request, we've rigged a super bright (lamp turns on) pro-light to inadvertent go on and off as Bambina needs it. (lamp turns off) Next, Baljeet's request to lift heavy objects accomplished by using gravity-counter acting barbells. Check.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am so happy. I have just torn my roariltica.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford's request to float in the air using levitation air jets in the lawn.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now I can look down on everyone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Last up is Irving's request to be invisible. Accomplished with this mirror shape live video playback and effects screen.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Sweet!

Name: Narrator Voice
Dialog: Two and a half minutes later...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is it possible? Am I a vampire?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace screeches) The hideous light of the day star! (gasps) I am a vampire. I must hide myself! (runs inside house)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, what's going to be the first part of the Tri-State Area (Perry tears the floor tile from the ground - his feet still attached - and jumps onto Doofenshmirtz in the Gimmelshtump-inator) to get the Gimmelshtump make over?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow ow ow ow. Oh ya, take that! (Perry's hat flies in air) Haha, oh let me go, not the fore, forhe-- (takes breath) I don't know if you noticed or not but I was boxing champion in my middle-school back in Gimmelshtump and I got a few moves in... (Perry punches him in the stomach. Doofenshmirtz falls in Inator then Perry jumps onto him)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (knocks on door, then opens it) Candace? I brought your MP3 player with... (Candace screeches)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't look at me! I have to get away from you, Jeremy! For your own protection.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey Mr. Fletcher.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh Candace! Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have to find Phineas and Ferb! They'll know how to change me back.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Did Candace just jump over that fence?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You had to take her to the vampire movie, didn't you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quit it! Quit it! Quit it!

Name: 1st Guy
Dialog: Yeah, my dad said I could drive it just as long as I didn't get a scratch on it.

Name: 1st Guy
Dialog: Oh my dad's going to kill me!

Name: 2nd Guy
Dialog: Why dude? It's not scratched.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh hey Candace! Did you come to pick up your MP3 player?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh, no-no! Have you seen my brothers?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, yeah they were just here. They went home to look for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no, villagers! (runs out of Slushy Dog restaurant and screams)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (German accent) Vat about your music box mitt ze Tiny Cowboy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no! More villagers! Gotta get home x4.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't stand a chance with that tile still stuck to your feet. (Perry jumps, and hits Doofenshmirt's knee and runs) Oh oh, my knee again, really?! (Doofenshmirtz chases after Perry. Perry comes behind a wall, forces one of his feet off the floor tile and uses it to trip Dr. Doofenshmirtz into a window) Wait wait wait! I need a bathroom break. I'll be right back. Okay? Don't do anything until I get back, okay? Don't touch a thing. I'll be right uhh... Ooohh. (Doofenshmirtz realizes his bathroom was changed into a pot and a light bulb, Perry jumps out of the Gimmelshtump-inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What was that?

Name: 2nd Guy
Dialog: Well now it's scratched.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you Perry the plat... (Gimmelshtump-inator reverses his bathroom back to reality) Ohh, never mind!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, open the door! (knocks on door) Open the door, open the door. There's angry villagers out here. Open the door!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace, what's wrong?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's a bunch of villagers and they're after me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You mean those guys? (shows marathoners running) Candace, I think they'd preferred to be called marathoners. (scene switches back to Phineas) Why would marathoners be following anyone? Besides you know, three guys from Kenya.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Because I'm a vampire Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What makes you think you're a vampire?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well I can lift heavy objects and I can levitate and... and I can't see my reflection in the mirror.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It sounds like a vampire to me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woah, woah, woah, woah, come here Ferb, come here. I think I know what's going on here. Candace, when you discovered that you had these powers, were you in the backyard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, why?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh Candace that was just some stuff we made for our friends.(takes glasses off Candace) Your not a vampire, look I'll prove it. (takes hoodie off Candace) See? The sun has absolutely no affect on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, we're gonna need a dustpan and some glue.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (from inside) Nice to see you boys down here at the shop!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! What's that thing?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, this? It's an escape chamber from an old vaudeville show. In the old days, men would go into these things and pretend to be locked inside and then they would "escape" to the amazement of the crowd. Here, let me show you. (goes inside the chamber) You see? All you need to do is just... (tries to escape) Uh.... Hmm...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You need a little help, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, no, no, I just need to, um... Oh! (Ferb helps him out) There we go. Thanks, son.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I've got bottle caps to polish. (walks away) Hmhm!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Ferb) Dude! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, no. I'm late for my introduction to ice sculpture. (Writes a note and goes outside to Candace sleeping on the hammock) I suppose there's no need to wake her. (puts the note on her head, then leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (snoring)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mumbling in sleep) Where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: And the salad fork is the one on the outside.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (holding a clipboard and pen) And you're certain of that... (Perry's chair slides forward) Ah! Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As you may know, this is International Good Manners Day. Perhaps, not ironically, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has chosen this very week to create a device that causes rampant rudeness. Go take care of it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: If you please.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (while Perry leaves his lair) I bet he calls it the Rude-inator.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What does that make you? Nostradamus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! My brother and I are here today to give you a thrilling display of escapement arts as we attempt, to extricate ourselves from this,...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...the most complicated trap ever devised by man or child! A computer controlled tower so fiendishly clever that...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...its blueprints had to be viewed in a smoked mirror to avoid driving its creators insane!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, he's really selling it hard.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But if you designed the tower, will you not know every way to get out?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (taps tower with cane) We programmed it to learn as it goes, so it's conceivable we could be trapped in there forever. (taps tower with cane again) Coming with?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes! I mean, no./Baljeet

Name: Isabella/Baljeet
Dialog: No.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It sounds ill-advised.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's okay. You guys can stay out here and be the cheering section with Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (snoring) Must bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But what if you do not come out?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If we're not out in 15 minutes, you can smash the machine and rescue us, just like in the old days.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (brings out mallet) Sounds like a party.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb? Start the timer please!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Synchronizing watches!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (he and Ferb walks onto an elevator) Women and children and the faint of heart may wish (pushes button with cane) to leave now. (as the elevator rises up) So we bid you adieu! Goodbye! Auf wiedersehen! Farewell, friends!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we'll see you in a few minutes! Or not at all!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Legally speaking, what is our liability here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A-ha! I wanted to say something clever about "cat got your tongue", but I haven't worked it out. You see, when we were small children, my brother Roger was always better at the whole manners and etiquette thing.

Name: Young Roger
Dialog: Sweet Aunt Effie, you have always been my favorite!

Name: Aunt Effie
Dialog: (pinching young Roger's cheek) Roger, so polite. (hands young Roger a coin) Heinz?

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's some mole!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) It takes a long time to clean out a chicken coop with a spoon. And I still don't see how that was rude. I mean, that thing was gargantuan. If anything, I was showing restraint. Anyway, today, it is International Good Manners Day, and we've got a visiting dignitary. She's the ambassador from England! Only the most etiquetty country in the whole world, hello! And when Roger's introducing her I'm going to zap him with my Rude-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's what I'm calling it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It makes whoever it zaps intolerably rude! He'll cause an international incident! And in all the confusion, I'll just waltz in and take over. So, why the catsuit? Well, we're going to be at City Hall to watch the fireworks, you and me, and I figured a platypus in a fedora might attract too much attention! Smart, huh? (walks away with a smug look) See, me, always thinking.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good day to you, Tower. We're ready to begin.

Name: Tower
Dialog: Welcome, boys. We're gonna have so much fun together. (puts strait-jackets on the boys) Put on your coats and stay a while.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Strait-jackets. Classic. Ready?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, shake me out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (after Ferb shakes his strait-jacket off) This is gonna be fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know, Ferb, I think we should "file" (pulls out a file) this under Dungeon Escape.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, here we are! (chuckles) Right up close! You sit here, Perry the Catypus. (laughs) I just came up with that. That totally makes up for missing the "cat got your tongue" thing from before.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to City Hall on this fine first day of National Etiquette Week.

Name: Woman
Dialog: I do love proper etiquette!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Big keys, tiny doors. We're not fitting through any of those, but maybe that one!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you're a genius!

Name: Tower
Dialog: Nice warm up, boys.

Name: Tower
Dialog: But can you escape the relentless pull of gravity?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (screaming) It's the Bottomless Pit Trap. (he and Ferb high fives)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It would be terrible if they did not come out!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I know! (squirts some shaving cream on Candace's head)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm countin' on it.

Name: Roger
Dialog: And to speak further on this topic, it is my great pleasure to introduce the Ambassador from England, the most etiquetty country in the world...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Told you!

Name: Roger
Dialog: ... and my personal friend,

Name: Roger
Dialog: ...this unbelievable windbag right here.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Oh, man! On and on and on in the limo over here. (mimicking ambassador) "Manners are so important."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can you believe this, Perry the...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, Perry the Platypus. I told you to go before we left. (at himself) He better bring back some popcorn, that's all I can say.

Name: Roger
Dialog: ...what a pompous know-it-all you are.

Name: Woman
Dialog: That's it! I want a recall.

Name: All
Dialog: Recall! Recall! Recall!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grinning) It's working!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! I've got it. Give me your hands.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Tower!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that the best you can can throw at us?

Name: Tower
Dialog: (rudely) Ooh, so special. I don't give a flying buttress.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tower, are you feeling okay?

Name: Tower
Dialog: Oh, what's it to you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, nothing, nothing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought we programmed you to be more polite than this.

Name: Tower
Dialog: You think you're so sharp, don't you?

Name: Tower
Dialog: I'm gonna show you something sharper.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think there may be something wrong with the Tower. I'm taking suggestions here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, dude, don't show off.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! It is almost time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (placing objects between Candace's toes) What if they can't get out?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (drawing an eye on the sticky note) How come you guys didn't tell me about this before?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ma-ma-ma-ma-ma.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Made it. Boy! That was close.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Was it scary?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Was it hard?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Do I still get to smash the tower?

Name: Tower
Dialog: I ain't done with you yet. (activates a force field around its lower half)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow! I thought I had a bad attitude.

Name: Audience
Dialog: Recall! Recall!

Name: Roger
Dialog: ...and so's your sister!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! Such rudeness. This is working better than I ever imagined.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Miss High-and-Mighty English Manners Person, I have got one thing to say to you. And only one thing. That's some...

Name: Roger
Dialog: ...show we just put on, isn't it, Madam Mayor?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the...

Name: Ambassador
Dialog: You see, your wonderful Mayor and I agreed in the limousine to put on this little play for your edification.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pushing button on remote repeatedly) No, no, no, no.

Name: Ambassador
Dialog: Indeed, what would we be without manners?

Name: Audience
Dialog: Four more years. Four more years.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pause) Curse you, Perry the Platypus. I didn't even get my popcorn. (realizes) Wait. If they were faking it, what did my ray hit?

Name: Tower
Dialog: Ooh, it looks like you two losers are still trapped. Might as well change your address, 'cause you're gonna be receiving your pension in here. Oopsie, activated my vacuum circuits. You dummies don't need air, do you? (blows raspberry)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm feeling such an odd mixture of pride and mortal terror.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't worry, I'll get you out in just a sec.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You guys are on your own.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, thanks for trying I guess.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No problem. What are friends for?

Name: Tower
Dialog: Friends? I have been programmed to trap you and your friends.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, yeah!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do me a favor. Next time you wanna make a fiendishly clever computer-controlled contraption, call one of your other friends.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! That's it. (at the tower) Tower. You were programmed to trap Ferb and me and our friends. But we've got friends all over Danville.

Name: Tower
Dialog: Is that so?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In fact, we have friends all over the Tri-State Area.

Name: Tower
Dialog: Well, aren't we popular?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Plus there was that small matter of circumnavigating the globe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're right. Tokyo, Paris, Nepal. We have friends all over the Earth.

Name: Tower
Dialog: Look at me, I have got friends all over the Earth. All right then.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In fact, we even have an alien friend named Meap.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He is from another planet. So, really, we have friends all over the galaxy.

Name: Tower
Dialog: A small matter for one such as me.

Name: Tower
Dialog: You will never escape. Never!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That works for me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, they only make mallets so big.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See ya.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, the entire galaxy. (grins) That enough elbow room for ya?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, for today.

Name: Alien
Dialog: At last, after two millennia, we finally reached the Milky Way Galaxy. Battle stations! We begin our assault in three, two... Oh!

Name: Alien
Dialog: Uh, anybody got a mallet?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for helping me set up for the Latke Festival this year, guys! It'll really go a long way toward helping me get that Golden Years Assistant patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Nana Shapiro.

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Can't wait for the latkes, darling. Nobody's had a bite to eat all day!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We can start cooking as soon as Baljeet gets back with the potatoes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No! No, you cannot! We looked all over the place, but there are no potatoes in the entire Tri-State Area!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I'm down to my last potato chip! Better make this bad boy last...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What am I going to do? Have you ever seen senior citizens riot? It's like a slow gray tornado of canes and false teeth!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, let me see that potato chip. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! We're gonna use the DNA in this potato chip to clone our own potatoes! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P! We recently learned that Doofenshmirtz has fallen behind on his electrical bills. This seems odd considering his generous alimony package. His ex-wife, Charlene, is loaded! And, I might add, quite a handsome woman. (Perry stares in boredom) No, not, not that I've given that a great deal of thought. (clears throat) Investigate at once. Monogram out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Summer is boring! I am so-oh-oh-oh bored...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why don't you call Jeremy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's working.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What about Stacy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grounded.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Jenny?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Protesting.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) What about busting your brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it's nice of you to take an interest, but they're not even in the backyard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, you can't sit inside on a gorgeous day like today. So, Missy, grab that pink bike! We're gonna get out and about!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't think so.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, come on, It'll be fun. (drags Candace by the arm)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoo-hoo, hooray.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) So, Perry the Platypus, do you like your trap? It's called the stocks! I read about it in this book, Ten Greatest Historical Traps of All Time. Look, it's a pop-up! (shows a pop-up bear trap) It also came with this bonus pamphlet, The Ten Greatest Historical Armies of All Time. And according to this, the Spartan Army was fierce, unstoppable, and followed every order without hesitation. Which is why I got this! (leave, emerges in Spartan General costume) Huh? It's a Spartan General costume. Yeah, it must have been...warmer in Ancient Greece. (pause) Anyway, once the Spartan Army sees me in this, they'll obey my every command! And help me take over the Tri-State Area! And how will I acquire the Spartan Army, gone lo these many millennia? With my Historical-Army-Retrieve-inator! I-it's potato-powered because I spent this month's alimony check on my last inator. You remember that, the Made-of-Gold-inator. And you know, I wore out three pairs of shoes buying up all these potatoes, but...on the good side, it smells like French fries in here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, behold the wonder that is the Spudsalot! Buford, the potato sample.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, start her up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, thank goodness! Now I can... Uh, Phineas, those potatoes have eyes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All potatoes have eyes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, but these eyes blink!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, you didn't put that chip in your mouth, did you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And if I did, would that be...actinable?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think the DNA from Buford's saliva must have combined with the potato's DNA to make some sort of... (the potatoes stand on their own) Buford potato hybrid! Let's get outta here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, look at the little guys, they're like little bullies! I am both proud and ready to soil my pants in terror.

Name: Potato Gremlin
Dialog: I like my tacos spicy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We should probably do something about them before they do, um, whatever...mutant Buford potatoes would do.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But what about the party?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right! Baljeet, you and Buford go stall the seniors while the rest of us simultaneously round up the spud spawn. Hey, wait. Ferb, isn't "simultaneously" on our list of "S" words seldom used by kids?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Linda
Dialog: See? Isn't this fun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (not so thrilled) Thrilling. (hears growling) What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! Potato, uh, gremlins! And Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (turns her head to see a carrot juice truck go by) "Potato gremlins"? Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Smiling) Never better. Come on, Mom, let's step it up! (takes off)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm glad you're finally getting in the spirit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, to summon the Spartan Army! (fires up the inator) Ooh! Here they come! Here they come! They're coming!

Name: Mongol Army
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-ha! What, wait, what? A Mongol army? Really? Huh, I must have had the dial set for..."Hun". Oh, well, you don't look a gift horde in the mouth, so...hello! Hi there, me, yeah. Welcome to the future, my ruthless Mongol Army. I realize you can't understand what I'm saying, and you're probably confused a bit by the Spartan General's uniform, uh, but together, we will rule the Tri-State Area...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Hey, what are you... (notices the Mongols messing up the kitchen) Oh, you're hungry! I guess it has been 1,200 years since you've eaten. Well I suppose we could call out... (the Mongols trample him again and bust through the wall) Oh, you ruined my helmet. Now I've gotta get a new costum... Wait a second, that's it! I'm in the wrong outfit! All I have to do is hit the costume shop, then round up my Mongols, and the Tri-State Area will be mine! (runs off laughing)

Name: Senior citizens
Dialog: We want latkes! We want latkes! We want latkes!

Name: Old man 1
Dialog: Hey! Where's my nosh?

Name: Old man 2
Dialog: I don't have to put up with this. I'm part of the greatest generation!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, what are we going to do? Phineas wants us to stall. We gotta think of something!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh...wait a minute. I got an idea. (holds up a sock puppet, in high voice) Hello, folks! I'm Mr. Sock! Hey! Who turned out the lights? (Buford draws eyes on the puppet) Thanks!

Name: Old lady
Dialog: You stink!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (As Mr. Sock) That wasn't very nice!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (high voice) Technically, we are socks.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (As Mr. Sock) Hey, Mr. Other Sock! What are you doing here?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (As Mr. Other Sock) Just looking!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (As Mr. Sock) For what?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (As Mr. Other Sock) My sole mate!

Name: Old woman 1
Dialog: You both stink!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think we have to take it up a notch.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are pluralizing "at"?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Work with me, brain boy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this is a mess.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How are we going to round them all up?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! If we reverse the backup engine on the Spudsalot and attach those hoses, we can suck the potatoes into that soothing hot tub we built into the bulkhead.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hot tub?! Why on earth would you build a hot tub on this thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'd like to think the real question is, why wouldn't we? (attaches the hoses) Time to round up some spuds.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-oh!

Name: Potato Gremlin
Dialog: I like my tacos spicy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Pull up alongside! (proceeds to suck up the potatoes) I got three more. How're we doing?

Name: Potato Gremlin
Dialog: Cannonball!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working! YEE-HAW!!!

Name: Potato Gremlin
Dialog: Spicy.

Name: Mongols
Dialog: French fry!

Name: Potato Gremlin
Dialog: Spicy!

Name: Mongols
Dialog: French fry!

Name: Potato Gremlin
Dialog: Spicy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, Buford had Mongolian barbecue for breakfast?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't think those are ours.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Costume shop!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Follow that horde!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha-ha! We've finally caught up to 'em! Mom, keep up!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (panting) Wait...up...Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But they're right around the corner!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm not...as young...as I used to be! (stops pedaling)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mocking) "I'm not as young as I used to be."

Name: Linda
Dialog: WHOAAAAA!

Name: Salesclerk
Dialog: One Genghis Khan costume. Will that be cash or credit?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm kind of low on funds right now. (shows potatoes) Do you take potatoes in trade?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stop! My brothers! And...others. Uh, gaze at last, upon my appropriately Mongolian military regalia and know that you must now obey my every command!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no! The Latke Festival is ruined.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha, ha, ha! Mom! Mom! Potato gremlins! (closes eyes and points) And...others! Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm trying, honey! These classifieds just go on and on. (tries to removes the excessive newspapers)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, we can rule the Tri-State...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (gets the last newspaper off) Ooh, coupon! (to Candace) Now, what am I looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but...but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I think you had enough fun for today. (takes Candace by the arm)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Noooooo!!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Nana, I'm sorry we ruined the festival.

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Ruined? Ha! That was the best time we've had since they cancelled Three-Bean-Salad Tuesdays. The floor show was fantastic!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: The ending was a bit out there, but trust me, they had us at sock puppets!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Form a line, people. Form a line.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it's too bad we couldn't get the potatoes for the latkes. But I'd say everything worked out fine. (Perry arrives) What's Perry doing in a pillory?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, those are stocks; a pillory forces the wearer to remain upright, exposing them to poking and prodding from passers-by.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow; I'd expect that kind of esoteric knowledge to come from someone a little older, 50 or 60. Or perhaps, a septuagenarian.

Name: Archeologist
Dialog: This is it. No one has seen this for a thousand years. (brushes off a legend and blows on it) The legend tells of an epic battle between the Mongol Army and... potato gremlin creatures, while a, uh, pharmacist from the future worked in vain to return to his time, crying out, "Curse you, Perry the Platypus"?

Name: Archeologist
Dialog: I swear! I majored this in college.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Goodbye boys, have a great day, I'm off to work.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Goodbye dad, have fun buying from auctions and private sales performing minor refurbishments to the purchase items, marking up the price and then selling them to your customers!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (To the camera) Our dad sells antiques.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know Ferb, it's strange how we wave our hands when we say goodbye. It seems so arbitrary. Why don't people jump up and down or stick out their tongues, or slap their thighs?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, if by that you mean we should create a whole new form of communication, then I couldn't agree more! That was some nice gesturing, Ferb. Do some more!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah. I...know...what...we're...going...to do...spatula! Oh, today...I really should have known that from the context.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, here's another one! Hey...where's...spatula! Oh, context again...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah Agent P. Sorry I'm running a little late this morning. Our satellites haven't picked up any Inator activity coming from Doofenshmirtz, but that's no indication that he isn't up to something. We want you to get down there and have a little look-see. Good hunting Agent P.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Finally when someone sneezes rather than say gesundheit, just play flugelhorn and give him your left shoe. I think we nailed down the non-verbal cues. Now let's look at the syntax!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? What's wrong, honey?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, they're doing stuff out there!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looks at the boys) Candace, they're just writing on a whiteboard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, that's it, they're plotting. And you know what that leads to. Implementing-guh!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you need to lighten up a little. Take it easy. Do you know what I do to relax?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You eat some pie and then laid down on that old sensory deprivation tank we keep in the basement.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's right! Would you like to try it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, I'm gonna go with no, but thank you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well you should still try to relax.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I don't need to relax, I need to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well listen sweetie, you said so yourself, they're just plotting, right? That gives you plenty of time to go to the mall before they start implementing-guh. (makes hand gestures)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, that makes a lot of sense! Maybe—Hey, wait a second, are you making fun of me?

Name: Linda

Dialog: Mog! Phinabunk and Gerb makka du kanga!

Name: Mog
Dialog: Du kanga?

Name: Can-tok and Mog
Dialog: (Coughing)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog, butta! (Notices that the Humvee is broken) Ni! (runs up to it) Ni, ni, ni, ni!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Oh, mei, Mog.

Name: Mog
Dialog: Mei, Phinabunk, mei, Gerb.

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Ni!!!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Wow. Can-tok make a foomfa!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Foomfa?

Name: Mog
Dialog: Can-tok makka foomfa!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Ah, Can-tok makka foomfa! (holds the staff high) Can-tok in charga.

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Kooya, Bunka da Bunkaquan! (Seeing Bunka walking away) Aw, bunka!

Name: Da
Dialog: So, Can-tok makka foomfa.

Name: Jerabunk
Dialog: Eh, foomfa, kookalaka.

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: (laughing) Jerabunk.

Name: Isabelock
Dialog: Can-tok makka foomfa!

Name: Baljug
Dialog: (sees Bunka) Bakida, Bunkaquan!

Name: Gerb
Dialog: I guess we should wait until tomorrow before we tell them about our new language.

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Yes, yes we should.

Name: Dan
Dialog: Eh, all right, I'll buy that, but it still feels like it's missing something.

Name: Dan and Swampy
Dialog: The song!

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Do it again.

Name: Baljug
Dialog: (Yaiiii, yai yai yai yai yai yai yai yai yaaiioh!)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aw nuts, I'm standing on Baljeet's shoulders and I still can't see anything!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This is not how it works!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax everyone. Ferb and I have devised a solution. Hop on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! With technology that's slightly more advanced than what we have today. Mom!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are doing it again!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It helps my arches!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look guys! It's Regent Monogram, and that girl must be... Princess Isabella!

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: Regent Monogram? When can I meet some of the local children?

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Princess, I'm afraid it's just not safe for you out in the wide world what with Doofus Khan on the loose.

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: Doofus Khan! He has been a plague on our land for far too long!

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: I promise once his forces have been defeated we'll throw you the biggest party money can buy. Of course it won't cost you anything because you're a hereditary monarch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, wait till you see what Phineas and Ferb have done now! Look!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Look, acrobats!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Acrobats? I love acrobats.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Mom, over-

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh no, Doofus Khan's warriors!

Name: Buford
Dialog: He's going after the royal... thingy!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is called a jou.

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: See this is exactly what I was... The Princess!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, get us down there! Quick!

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: The Princess! The Princess! Doofus Khan why that impertinent-- (Gets hit by a taunting scroll) A taunting scroll? How uncouth!

Name: General Carl
Dialog: Should I order the final attack, sir?

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: No, no, General Carl. A full-scale attack now would put the Princess at risk. Oh, if only Master Perry had not given up the way of the warrior and gone to live a contemplative life on the Unclimbable Mountain of Unclimbableness, he could retrieve the Princess. Oh, if only someone could reach him and tell him of our plight!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guys, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: Doofus Khan, (budges free from the grip of two warriors) Regent Monogram will have your head!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Regent Monogram will never attack as long as I have his Princess. Which should buy me all the time I need to complete my secret weapon and take over the Tri-Province area! Meanwhile, I'm putting you in the penthouse dungeon. You'll love the view. Of course I've planted booby traps all along the way and I alone know how to avoid them. (He gets hit by a giant shoe) Heh. Must have forgot that one. (A step opens up and he notices a hammer) Oops! (The hammer shoots a laser at him) Oh, that's right. (The step opens again) You're supposed to skip this step. (He screams as he falls into a step. He gets burnt, and gets chomped on by piranhas) Everything's under control, but-- (The step opens once again and gets hit by a boxing glove) Testing the system-- (Various booby traps are activated as the camera pans to the top of the stairs) Hey, hey, it works. (Gets caught by a bear trap) Anyway, here you are. (Takes out a set of keys and tries the keys to open the door) You'll have a nice rack to sleep on and some rats to keep you company. (Opens the door) So while your here, enjoy your stay. Ta-ta Princess! (Slaps the door) I'll see you-- (Stairs turn into a chute)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There it is, The Unclimbable Mountain of Unclimbableness.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ya know what I hate about The Unclimbable Mountain of Unclimbableness? Just to get there you have to cross the Uncrossable River of Uncrossableness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Who named all these things?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That guy over there, The Redundant Scribe of Redundantness.

Name: The Redundant Scribe of Redundantness
Dialog: Hi there! Greetings!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. (The Redundant Scribe of Redundantness continues talking in the background) Ferb do we have anything for uncrossable rivers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are they up to now?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, that'll do. (He and Baljeet get on the carriage)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Look, a Chinese eviscerating fish. Though I suppose here in China we just call them eviscerating fish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mocking Baljeet) Oh but here we just call them eviscerating-- (Candace screams and falls into the river)

Name: Buford
Dialog: So how do we get up The Unclimbable Mountain of Unclimbableness?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries, Buford. (Baljeet takes his hiking stick and leafs through his backpack) I think we have just the thing. (Pulls out a block of wood)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (While wringing her hair) Oh come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (While climbing up the side of the mountain) Stupid Mountain of Stupidness!

Name: Redundant Scribe of Redundantness
Dialog: Actually, that was my original name for it! (Candace falls off the mountain into red clouds) Oops, my bad, sorry, my apologizes, mea culpa!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Master Perry, (He and Ferb get out. Master Perry puts down the kite) This is a great honor. (He and Ferb bow)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow. I can't believe he's a platypus.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Phineas pulled a jou with giant mechanical feet out of his backpack and that is what bugs you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Master Perry! Doofus Khan has kidnapped the Princess and only you can save her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You mean you won't? But why, Master Perry? What made you give up the life of a warrior hero?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's he doing?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's a ripple dissolve. He must be having a flashback.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Does he know we can't see it? Should we give him some privacy? I don't know the protocol for flashbacks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is he back? He's back. Well judging by the time you spent staring off into space I'm guessing something pretty bad. But someone has to rescue the Princess, if you won't come with us at least you can train us to do it ourselves.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But that's just the general information. Here's some of the specific things you can look forward to in your workout...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you sure you won't come with us, Master Perry? The kingdom really needs you back.

Name: Buford
Dialog: He's doing it again.

Name: Buford, Phineas, and Baljeet
Dialog: Goodbye, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Panting) Where are they?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know I can't see anything right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Follow my lead when we get there; we're going right in the front door.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I knew we shouldn't have let Baljeet drive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Never mind that, you two stay here and fend off the guards Ferb and I will rescue the princess.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We got it covered, just watch out for booby traps.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We made it and completely unscathed. Good thing we brought along that yak bladder. Princess Isabella, we've come to rescue you stand away from the...

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: My hero!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry Princess, we'll take the banister down. It's safer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Holy mackerel! how did you guys defeat all these soldiers?

Name: Random soldier
Dialog: We're okay.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There was nothing to it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's no time for flashbacks! We have to go!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What flashback? (They all run off) I'm just rippling! It relaxes me.

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Well would you look at that a bunch of kids running away with the Princess-- R-Running away with the Princess?!?! (Slides down a fireman pole) Oh Time to take matters into my own hands.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What the heck is that?

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: It must be Doofus Khan's secret weapon. It's heading for the castle! What do we do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I've got an idea!

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: (Laughs) Amazing what you can do with a little bamboo and rice paper huh?

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Doofus Khan! What have you done with Princess Isabella?

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: That's none of your business, but there's no way she escaped forcing me to move up my plans I can tell you that!

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: You barbarian!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: I know I am but what are you. Nyaa! (Dragon sticks out tongue) Hehe. You like that? The tongue set me back a week but it was totally worth it.

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Carl, duck!

Name: General Carl
Dialog: No, actually sir I think it's a dra.. (Carl gets slapped by the dragon's tail) Oh, that kind of duck.

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: (Laughs) Hyvertical remodeling!

Name: General Carl
Dialog: We can't take much more of this! What do we do?

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Surrender! Oh what now? (A giant terracotta warrior starts marching towards them) A giant terracotta warrior? Roughly the same size as my dragon?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Left leg! Right Leg!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: What could he possibly want? (Terracotta warrior goes to "crane" position) Oh he's doing that crane thing. (Terracotta warrior kicks the dragon in the face) You know, 4 centuries from now that move is gonna be real cliché. (Dragon breathes fire on the terracotta warrior) Of course, being terracotta you would be fire-proof. Okay, mono to mono (The robots fight) Ow that's not your mono!

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Man, they would love this in Japan!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the? Phineas and Ferb! Mom!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Agh, slapies! I hate slapies! (Terracotta warrior pushes the dragon away, then the dragon tail taps on the warriors soldier and when the soldier turns around, the dragon takes a wind up key out of the warrior's back)

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: (Laughs) Gotcha!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He has the key to our defeat!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You make puns when the other guy is down, dumbbell!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Aww, poor babies feeling tired, huh? Allow me to put you to sleep! (Dragon picks up a building)

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: (Everyone gasps) Ew, who puts armpit hair on a mechanical dragon?

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Next time, don't put your wind up key in such an obvious place. I cleverly hid mine in a spot only an ancient warrior would dare to go. (It shows Perry coming down from the sky) No, Perry the Platypus! (Perry hits the dragon's nose) Hey, careful with the soft palette there! (Perry jumps into the dragon's mouth and rolls up the tongue revealing a wind up key. He chatters)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, the key! (Ferb shoots a grappling hook grabbing the key out of the dragon's mouth. Causing the dragon to deactivate and drop the building on itself) Uh-Oh! Eject everybody! (Phineas and the others jump out of the warrior as it and the dragon fall, over falling apart, just as Candace brings Linda over)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Ee-ee-ee-ee...Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: A giant mechanical terracotta warrior? Really, Candace? (she walks away) Wouldn't that be slightly more advanced that what we have today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that would've been the point!

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: Regent Monogram!

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Princess!

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: Party now?

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: You betcha!

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: Great!

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Ah, well, back to the drawing board. (General Carl puts him in a Chinese finger trap)

Name: General Carl
Dialog: Compliments of Regent Monogram.

Name: Doofus Khan
Dialog: Oh, I hate these things! (A taunting scroll hits him) Insult to injury.

Name: Regent Monogram
Dialog: Well all's well that ends well. Maybe someday we will find a way to keep our fair lands safe from barbarian invaders.

Name: Princess Isabella
Dialog: You know, I think these blocks would make a great wall.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what were going to do tomorrow!

Name: Elderly Phineas
Dialog: Well, that took longer than expected.

Name: Elderly Ferb
Dialog: But, it is a great wall.

Name: Elderly Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. So, what you wanna do tomorrow? (Ferb glares at him and then leaves) What? I kid. We can rest, how about a game of mahjong?

Name: Carl
