Dialog: Well, how are we doing today, Major? Feeling better?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? What are you doing here?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Your wife said it'd be okay if I came up here and kept you company. Would that be all right? I brought a book!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What kind of book?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Somewhat excitedly) It's a fantasy adventure with wizards and knights!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Are there woodland sprites?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, there's water sprites.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (After a short pause) Go ahead.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Begins reading) Devote your mind to this tale of the distant past, and the adventures that did befall the most noble of knights. (Scene ripples into a scene of a medieval cottage) Where stood the cottage of the humble antique dealer...

Name: Laurence
Dialog: Cheerio, dear! I'm off to hide these common objects for a couple'a hundred years, until they become valuable.

Name: Linderella
Dialog: Don't forget to put hay in the ox! (goes inside and begins to do chores) Candavere! I need you to fetch me some more water! Candavere! Oh, where is that maid?

Name: Candavere
Dialog: Stachilda, news have I upon this evening. At the harvest bonfire I shall be on the arm of Jeremiad. Signed, Candavere. (Finishes writing) There! And now to send off this missive. (Ties letter to pigeon's foot) The time has come to do your duty, my stout-winged messenger! (Releases pigeon out the window, and it flies off, and is burnt up as a column of fire shoots out of the alchemy stove)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That should catalyze it. We'll add it to our inventory of magical elixirs. What say we try a couple of these out? (They both take a potion and Ferbalot pours his on himself, turning into a cyclops) Cool, a cyclops! My turn! (Pours his potion on himself) A manticore! With a lion's head. (Ferbalot takes another potion) A cockatrice!

Name: Candavere
Dialog: (Singing) Oh yeah, getting some water, and (Slams into door) Yack! ...Gonna have a great Midsummer Woad-Gathering Harvest Bonfire's Eve. (Sees Phineas) Good morrow, Phineas! (Begins singing again) ...With Jeremiad. (sees Ferbalot) Good morrow, Ferbalot! (Realizes what the boys are up to) Grr! What flaxen homespun have we swaggering here?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Careful, Candavere. Better not look at Ferbalot, or you'll turn to stone. (Ferbalot has turned into a Gorgon)

Name: Candavere
Dialog: This is a most inopportune time for your infernal hijinks, and for once our sad sweet mother will be heralded to your inpropri- Argh, I can't talk like this anymore! You guys are so busted! Mom! (running into the house, she slams into the door again) Yack! (goes into house and slams door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know about you, Ferbalot, but I didn't get any of that. (They both pour a potion on themselves and return to normal; it begins to rain) Hey, there's something fishy about this rain. It's...it's unearthly. Come on, we better get inside.

Name: Lady of the Puddle
Dialog: (Bursts out of a puddle) Behold! I am the Lady of the Puddle!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't you mean the Lady of the Lake?

Name: Lady of the Puddle
Dialog: No, that's my mom.

Name: Lady of the Lake
Dialog: Hey, kids! You're getting a little quest of your own. Oh, that's so nice.

Name: Lady of the Puddle
Dialog: Anyway...Ferbalot, you and Phineas must find the legendary sword Excaliferb and use it to stop the evil sorcerer Malifishmirtz, who is behind this unearthly rain.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, Ferb and I were just talking about the rain. Unearthly—that's...isn't that the word I used? Yeah, I used—I just--

Name: Lady of the Puddle
Dialog: I will send the magical water sprite, Isabel, to guide you on your quest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! Can't wait to meet her.

Name: Lady of the Puddle
Dialog: And to you, Ferbalot and Phineas, I bid thee good fortune! (turns into a wave of water and splashes on the boys)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, good thing she wasn't "Lady of the Hot Coffee." (at Linda) Mom! Ferb and I are going on a quest.

Name: Linderella
Dialog: (from inside the cottage) Don't forget to goad the geese on your way out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing, mom. (at a goose) Get in there, Gertrude!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (opens the gate door) Whoa! This must be the sprite, Isabel!

Name: Isabel
Dialog: What art thou doin'? (curtseys)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Apparently you're going to guide us on a quest.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Yes. You must first cross the Raging River of Uncertainty by way of the Bridge of Comprehension. Then you must brave the Swamp of Spit-Poor Attitudes; then it's snack time, I brought along some apples. After that, you will enter the Cave of Ten Thousand Monsters, where the sword Excaliferb can be found. (at Ferbalot) Ferb, only a warrior with a true heart may draw it from the stone and wield it in battle against the evil sorcerer Malifishmirtz.

Name: Ferbalot
Dialog: (after a short pause) Yeah, okay, I'm down with that.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: (at Phineas) Do you have any questions?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, where's Parable?

Name: Monopunzel
Dialog: Good morning Sir P. (the feather in Parable's hat shoots out) The tempest we're experiencing was conjured up by the evil Malifishmirtz, we need you to fly up to his evil fortress and put the kibosh on his evil machinations.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I really like that character; is there going to be more about him?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm sorry, sir, he just comes in at the beginning. Shall I continue? (Major Monogram mumbles under his breath) Huh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: OK.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Meanwhile, back at the cottage of the humble antique dealer...

Name: Candavere
Dialog: Mom, I'm telling you; they're gallivanting around out there conjuring things with magical elixirs.

Name: Linderella
Dialog: Candavere, I've never see them gallivant.

Name: Candavere
Dialog: (sighs in frustration) When are you going to believe me? What if I got you some proof?

Name: Linderella
Dialog: I'd rather you got me some more grulewood.

Name: Candavere
Dialog: Fine. (leaves the cottage, talks to herself) Candavere, fetch me grulewood. Candavere, rake the roof-thatch. Candavere, go accuse the neighbors of witchcraft. If only I had some (sees the potions) proof! (grabs two of them) All I have to do is grab a couple of these to show Mom and (trips causing the potions to spill on her) Oof! Ugh. What is this stuff? (a unicorn horn appears on her head) Ahh, stupid potion! I know, maybe this will get rid of it. (pours another potion on her head) That didn't work. I'm going to go tell Mom. (turns around and sees a tail) Aaugh! Oh, great a tail! Phineas and Ferbalot, you are so bu.. (breaths fire) I can't go to the Midsummer Woad-Gathering Harvest Bonfire like this. What will Jeremiad think? I'm just gonna have to find Phineas and Ferb and make them tell me which one of these elixirs will change me back. (grabs some potions and runs, but trips again causing all of them to spill on her making different colored smoke to appear) Ah! Oh this is not, oh no. Oh. Oh, there's a... oh no. Oh...

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Ah-ha! Parable the Dragonpus, welcome to your doom! (aims his staff to shoot magic at Parable but doesn't work) Hey, wha-what's the matter with this thing? Hey-Hey Gnorme, can you come out here and give me a hand?

Name: Gnorme
Dialog: Of course! (walks in and drops a cage on Parable)

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Do you like him, Parable the Dragonpus? I call him a Lawn Gnorme. He protects my garden from witches' spells and wood trolls. I'm going to make small versions of him and sell them all over... Anyway, let me tell you about my plan for seizing control of the Tri-Kingdom Area. (walks down the tower) You see, I was bullfrog hunting down by the rat catcher's shack and came across a... (muffled sound from going around the back of the stairs) ...the biggest raspberry I've ever seen! It was the size of a cucumber! (muffled sound) ...is what I said because I had a gag over my mouth. (muffled sound continues until he reached the bottom) ...and that's why I decided to take over the Tri-Kingdom Area! True story. And now, I know exactly how to do it! You see, I found this ancient text, more of a-- a pamphlet really, and decided to use it to conjure up the most evil multitude to ever tread the Earth! But to do that, I needed to start with the most hideous substance known to man

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabel, why did you take us to the Inn of the Prancing Platypus?

Name: Isabel
Dialog: We need allies. There's a lot of mercenaries and thugs to choose from. Plus, they make a great taco salad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who's that creepy guy? He's been staring at us since we got here. I wonder what he wants...

Name: Isabel
Dialog: He's coming over! Be cool.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: I would recommend a little more caution from you, wizardling. Malifishmirtz's spies are everywhere. Look at that guy over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He doesn't look like a spy; he looks more like a shepherd.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: He's a shepherd spy. They're the worst kind.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you a mercenary thug?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Actually I'm here for the taco salad. But you guys look like you could do with a little muscle. The name's Bufavulous, the Wind Lord. I can help you on your quest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Welcome aboard!

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: You should also know that I travel with a companion by the name of Baljeetolas, of the Nerdling Realm.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Greetings, adventurers! If by my bow, or my vast store of useless knowledge I may aid you... Hey, where is my bow?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: You left it in the booth.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Oh, excuse me. Well, there it is. Has anyone seen my arrows?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Bathroom!

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Now that we're all congregated, we must away!

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Let everyone now task his thought, that this fair quest may on foot be brought!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Whoa, hey, whoa, hold it. What's with the banjo?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Traveling music.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Where are they going, Alabama?

Name: Carl
Dialog: What do you mean, sir?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Well, uh, questing music should have an element of foreboding and mystery, you know, lots of minor chords and stuff. And, to make it sound more medieval, you throw a major chord in right at the end.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (sighs) Okay, I'll see what I can do. And so, the merry band set off on their quest, to the foreboding sounds of minor chords. Better?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Little less sarcasm would be nice.

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: What do you know, my shepherd spy tells me that a team of erstwhile heroes bent on defeating me are on their way here right now.

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, sure. It's just down that way, past the Sally-port on your right. You can't miss it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A bridge.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Are not these kind of things guarded in these types of stories?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Yeah, like by a troll?

Name: Troll
Dialog: (Appears in a puff of smoke) Do I look like a troll to you?

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Do not answer truthfully; it will only enrage her.

Name: Troll
Dialog: In order to cross my Bridge of Comprehension, you must first answer three questions. The questions will fall into three categories

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: (Standing beneath the bridge in the creek bed) Uh, hey guys? It is not really that deep down here.

Name: Troll
Dialog: The answer must be given in haiku form.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If it's all the same to you, we'll just go around.

Name: Troll
Dialog: It's not all the same to me.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Just for the record,

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: The answer to your riddle

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: is an egg. Bye now!

Name: Troll
Dialog: Come back! You can't ju... Wait a minute! Just-for-the-rec-ord The-an-swer-to-your-rid-dle is-an-egg-bye-now. Hum, what do you know, that was a haiku.

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: The time has come, my little meat gamejos. Rain down on my enemies, and stop them from advancing. And bring me back a newspaper. (Malifishmirtz fires them from a catapult and cackles) You too. Go. (He flings one more meatling)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh oh. Doesn't look good. (In reference to the giant gorge they are overlooking) Whoa.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: This is where that crazy old bat should have built her bridge.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: This is the Rocky, Shallow River of Nevermore.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Why must everything have such long names?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going to have to turn around and find another way across this gorge.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Oh no, canned meat! Now we're in trouble.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: But they're so cute.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're getting bigger!

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: And more rampagey!

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Are quests usually this short?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're not going to go without a fight!

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Phineas! I want all of you to jump.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, you know that it's called the Rocky, Shallow River of Nevermore for a reason, right?

Name: Isabel
Dialog: I have a plan, just trust me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know, how 'bout you Ferb? (Ferbalot jumps off the cliff) Should we... Ferb? He's right. Come on! (He jumps as well)

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Mother always told me that if all the other kids were jumping off a cliff, I should, too.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Your mother said that?

Name: Bufovulous
Dialog: She was not a nurturer. Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabel, if you're going to do something, now would be a nice time! (The screen freezes with the four of them all in midair)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you- you stopped!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think we need to take a little break.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wow, bad time for that. You totally left me hanging in that cliff scene.

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's kinda the point, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I see. Very clever.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Major Monogram Geesh, Carl, what- what took so long?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry sir. I was just down in your beautiful kitchen and your wife was making two sandwiches. And I got to tell you, they were de-lish!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Did she make one for me?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh...huh. How about we get back to the book?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, did you eat my sandwich?

Name: Carl
Dialog: As our heroes fell, doubt swept through them-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you ate my sandwich!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Do you want to hear this or not, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Carl
Dialog: As our heroes fell, doubt swept through them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabel! If you're going to do something, now would be a nice time!

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Sisters! Hear my summons, beckon through the rain, carry thy waters to me now, and fill the river once again.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Nice work, girls! See you at Tuesday's brunch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was cool; a slide made out of water!

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: What would you call a thing like that?

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: I don't know.

Name: Troll
Dialog: Oh good, another customer for my bridge. In order to cross my Bridge of (She turns around and opens her eyes as a shadow falls over her) Com... Com... Com...

Name: Candavere (in a strange voice)
Dialog: Have you seen my brothers?

Name: Troll
Dialog: (Points in the direction Phineas and Ferbalot went) Com... Com... Com... Cooooom...prehension. Well, I think that went well.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: We're getting close. This must be the Swamp of Spit-Poor Attitudes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why is it called that?

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Legend has it, that in order to get across this swampy marsh, you have to have a good attitude.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This swamp was made for me! Come on, Ferbalot!

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Come on Bufavulous, what is the holdup?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: I ain't goin'.

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Just think good thoughts, and you'll be fine!

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: You don't know me very well, do you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey guys, I can see Mount Doof from here, we're almost there!

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: I have an idea. I think I have a way to get you across this swamp. I have been working on a way of solving problems by the process of deriving reliable generalizations from observation. I call it "logic."

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Logic? How come I've never heard of this?

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Because it is the Middle Ages.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Oh, is it anything like hysterical hearsay?

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Yes, in that it is the exact opposite of that.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Listen, here is how it works. By observing the swamp, logic tells me that it is too big to go around. And by gathering information about it from Isabel, I can logically make assessments about the best way to get across. Are you following me?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Absolutely not.

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: (He sighs) Phineas has pie.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Out of my way, runt! (He runs across the swamp)

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: And that's why the Earth is flat, Parable the Drogonpus. Huh, what's this?

Name: Mirror
Dialog: Thou hast mail!

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Mail? Who's it from, let me see? Ooh, a video! (Pulls up a video of the five heroes) Look at that. I don't believe it! How did these miscreants escape my meatlings?

Name: Isabel
Dialog: Behold, the Cave of Ten Thousand Monsters! Here you will find the sword Excaliferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Looks like you're on, bro.

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Let's see how they deal with this! (He throws a puff of smoke at the mirror, which causes a large pile of rocks to come tumbling down at the kids)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh! Avalanche! Quick, inside! (They all run inside just before the rocks block the entrance)

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: That should do it. (Parable chatters) Now where were we, Parable the Dragonpu- (Parable kicks Malifishmirtz in the face) Hey! How did you escape from-- (The cage is seen, burnt through) Oh, right, fire-breathing dragon, wicker cage... What do you know, that guy at the pet shop was right. (Parable launches himself at Malifishmirtz, but is knocked towards the window and tries to prevent himself from falling) Ah-HA!! (Parable gets shot by Malifishmirtz's staff and falls out the window) Man, this thing really does work when you put batteries in it.

Name: Lady of the Puddle
Dialog: Ferbalot... (He wakes up) The object you seek is near. Come this way. (Ferbalot is led towards a glowing blue light) Behold! The sword Excaliferb! (The sword is sticking out of a stone with a sign reading "One Yanketh Per Customer") The instrument that will be Malifishmirtz's end.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walking into the Excaliferb room with the rest of the heroes) Wow. Look! Ferbalot is modeling this season's latest in magical weaponry, Excaliferb. But, wasn't there something we had to do first?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, right. The Cave of Ten Thousand Monsters.

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: (laughs evilly) Finally, my greatest nemesis vanquished! Now, Parable the Dragonpus, prepare to meet your dim. Doom! I mean Doom. Prepare to meet your... Uh, man, talk about blowing the moment.

Name: Ferbalot
Dialog: Behold, evil wizard Malifishmirtz. (draws sword) I hold the sword Excaliferb. This mystical vorpal blade was given to me by the Lady of the Puddle. Get a good look at it, for it is the instrument of your demise! (The blade of the sword falls off the hilt) Well, uh, okay. So big deal, the end's come off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we're switching to plan B everyone.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Plan B?

Name: Baljeetolas
Dialog: Yes, that is where we all attack him with ten thousand monsters.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Oh, that plan B.

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Are you kidding me?! I'm not afraid of you kids or your monsters. In fact, I am not afraid of anything! Ha! Except, you know, unicorns, but other than that, nothing! Just unicorns and... and whales. That's... That's a given, everyone's afraid of whales. And squid. Uh, Unicorns, whales, and squid, and... and Pegasuses. That's it! Pegasuses, whales, unicorns, squid, scorpions, barnacles—You know, I should really make a list. And girls. I used to be terrified of girls but I sort of got over that. (The genetically twisted Candavere appears behind him) Now it's just, you know, like, sort of a mild anxiety. So just to recap

Name: Candavere
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb-a-Lot, you are so busted!

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Oh, what do you know, it's a uni-whale-scorpio-Pega-squid-icorn- girl. What are the odds. You know, taken all together, it's more ridiculous than scary. I guess it doesn't have a cumulative effect.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Advance!

Name: Malifishmirtz
Dialog: Meatlings, you advance too.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: (to Baljeetolas) Hey, are you gonna eat your cucumber? What!? I had a light lunch.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Crashing turns to quiet

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: And calm sweeps through the land

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: The battle's been decided

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: But who had the upper hand?

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: But look, a hero rises from the smoke

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Our glory has been regained

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: A cheer goes up among our army...

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Now for truth the battle's over

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: And evil's reign is done

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: Our hero stands triumphant...

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: No, no, wait, I was wrong.

Name: Bufavulous
Dialog: I feel reasonably sure it's over this time. What do you guys think? Oh, wait,

Name: Carl
Dialog: From the top of another hill, a figure appears, a shaft of light shining off his auburn hair. It was Carl, the Red-headed Paladin from the land of Internius. He--

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl, now you're just getting ridiculous.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I don't see why I can't be in this story. Besides, it's totally better this way.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: I don't care, read it the way it's written.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Fine. Suddenly they all found out a way to settle their differences, and it wasn't long before a peace accord was drafted and signed.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Cut it out, Carl! Read what it really says.

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's what it says. Look, see for yourself.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (Reading) Hmm, both contracting parties, undertake to maintain peaceful and friendly relations between them, in the mutual ib- Oh! Come on Carl! Whatever happened to Candavere, what about Jeremiad?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, I suppose I could just skip to the epilogue, sir. Hmm. Having signed the peace accord, the happy wanderers returned to their village as heroes. The rain stopped, and Candavere kept her date with Jeremiad. As they danced, she was as happy as a young girl could be. Especially as she was now back to normal. (Candavere spits out fire) Well, almost. But even as the heroes recalled their tales of glory, the evil Malifishmirtz slipped away, bent on laying the groundwork for a sequel. (Malifishmirtz escapes from his pillory) But for now, all was right with the world, and everyone in the village agreed that it was the best Midsummer Woad-Gathering Harvest Bonfire's Eve ever. Certainly the first one to have ten thousand monsters. The End. How was that, sir?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Okay, I guess.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, I guess I'd better get going.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Maybe you could come back and read to me tomorrow?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, we kind of have to work tomorrow.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Oh, fine.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Now for truth the battle's over

Name: Monogram
Dialog: And evil's reign is done

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Our hero stands triumphant...

Name: Monogram
Dialog: No, no, wait, I was wrong.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: I feel reasonably sure it's over this time. What do you guys think? Oh, wait,

Name: Carl
Dialog: From the top of another hill, a figure appears, a shaft of light shining off his auburn hair.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, you're crushing my spirit.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Yes. Yes I am.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: This is it. Giant Cannibal Cave! According to the map, Beserk Magurk stashed it here. No one ever saw him again. This way! Up these Giant Cannibal Stairs!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: There it is - the Amulet of Juatchadoon! And that must be Magurk, down there on that Giant Cannibal Dining Set! (Grins) How much rope do you have? (Rhode Island gestures to several hundred feet of rope) As always, you are prepared.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: So, the markings on this amulet should lead us to the lost Temple of Juatchadoon!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Who wants cocoa?

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Hey, let us go, you big galute!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (With disdainful recognition) Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, well, well. Ohio Flynn and Rhode Island Fletcher. What are you doing here?

Name: Ohio
Dialog: That depends - why are you slow clapping?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, I don't know, I thought it would make my entrance more dramatic. And it totally worked!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (At Rhode Island) You know, he's right. It was more dramatic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, hand over that amulet!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: No way! (Rhode Island holds the amulet away from Doofenshmirtz) We retrieved it, fair and square!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Tell it to the Abominable Snowman!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Well, that's a weird expression...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I mean tell him right now - LOOK!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (Wobbling around after the boys) I'll just run ahead!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Maybe the "Giant Cannibal" thing was a mislead! I think the dining set was his! (He hops behind Norm onto their rocket-powered sled.) Go, go, go, go, go, go, go!! (The Snowman makes a huge snowball and tosses it down the mountain after them. It crashes into their sled and they roll down the hill with it.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Wincing) Oh, mama!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (Starts slow clapping)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Way too soon for a callback, Norm.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, gents! What's your fancy?

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Well, fame, glory, money, and the preservation of semi-mystical historical treasures... but, we'll settle for hot fudge sundaes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're here! Ee-ee-ee-ee... (runs to a nearby telephone booth in the saloon, and then dials a number)

Name: Chief Linda
Dialog: (On phone, voice-only) Daily Tableaux?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Chief! Who do you think just showed up in Panama?

Name: Chief Linda
Dialog: If you're gonna try and sell me another fairy tale about Ohio Flynn and Rhode Island Flet--

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's a scoop here, and I can smell it! (A fly-ridden hick walks through the saloon doors, carrying a pig) Or they haven't invented deodorant soap yet, but there's still a scoop!

Name: Chief Linda
Dialog: Fine. But I wanna see pictures!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I won't let ya down!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (Back at their table, to Rhode Island) Someone around here is bound to know something about the lost Temple of Juatchadoon! (Isabella enters in a purple dress, holding a fan to obscure most of her face)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Said in the same manner as her catchphrase) Juatchadoon?

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (Without looking at her) Exactly. We don't even know if it really exists!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Sitting down at the table as the boys remove their hats) Oh, it exists all right! And I know where to find it!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (Intrigued) Go on...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Isabella Garcia-Shapiro. Femme fatale, ingenue, amateur archeologist, and licensed tile and grout installer. (A Tarzan-like figure in a loincloth swings from a vine behind them) A girl has to earn a living!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Pleased to meet you! Do you know anything about...this? (Removes the amulet from around his neck)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Gasps) The Amulet of Juatchadoon! The legend says it can awaken an evil corn colossus with the power to destroy the world!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Makes you wonder why ancient people were always making stuff like that...I mean, what's the upside? (A number of arrows fly behind them)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: My mother, New Hampshire Garcia-Shapiro, was searching for the Temple when she disappeared! I'm afraid something terrible has happened to her! You've just gotta help me! (Hands Ohio another card) I'm also a certified Damsel in Distress.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Well, we don't normally go searching other archaeologists slash adventurers, but I guess we can make an exception. Now if we only knew which way she went...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Pulls out a map) Would this map she sent me help?

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Yes, yes it would. We're gonna need transportation. (Puts away the map in his inner jacket pocket) (At Rhode Island) Rhode Island Fletcher, I know what we're gonna dig up today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (snaps a picture of the scene) Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Gentlemen, please! There simply are no more maraschino cherries!!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are Agent P! Welcome to the meeting of the Secret Order of the Knights Without a Cool Acronym or SOKWCA. As you know, it is our duty to...Hey! You're not wearing your fez. (Pointing to a part of the room) Better go to the fez dispenser. (Perry takes off his fedora and gets a fez from a vending-machine like dispenser) As I was saying, Doofenshmirtz is dangerously close to laying his mits on the lost Idol of Juatchadoon. If he were to get hold of it, it would be blood-sucking-Chupacabra-brain-eating-zombie-ancient-Mayan-Gods-come-to-life-weird-voodoo-curses-with-goat-heads and what not bad. Now, get out there and stop him Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why are we wearing a fez in the middle of Central America anyway?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (In a shocked tone) You mean we're not in Egypt! I thought those pyramids were kind of stair steppy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Last stop! I'm afraid there is no way to get to the East Coast by boat unless you go all the way around South America.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nothing but jungle from here on out.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Care to come with us?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Sarcastically) And spoil my carefully calculated air of selfishness and unconcern? Not until the last second thank you very much! (Baljeet and Buford sail away leaving the rest of the group behind)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ohio Wow, authentic riverboat gibberish. (Enthusiastically) This way gang!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (To Candace) Its sweet of you to help us find my mom Ms...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Candace. And are you kidding? I've been trying to get a good scoop all summer long!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well it's a lucky thing you accidentally hammered yourself into that crate marked temple expedition supplies then isn't it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Boy, I'll say

Name: Ohio
Dialog: We've found it! (He and Rhode Island look through the foliage at a looming step pyramid) It's the fabled Temple of Juatchadoon!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (He reads writing on the doorway) If you choose to go further you'll wish you weren't born. (Candace takes a picture) The road to destruction is paved with corn. Cheery! (He walks towards the glass case) There must be some trick to opening this case. A latch, or somewhere to twist it or...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Or, we could hit it with a rock. (She hits the glass case with a stone and it shatters)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Yeah, that works.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: This is it guys; the corn colossus of Juatchadoon! (Candace takes a picture just before she and the rest of the group get trapped in a cage )

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah! Oh yeah baby! (He is standing on a descending totem pole)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (With disdainful recognition) Doofenshmirtz! Nice entrance.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that whole subtle thing wasn't working out for me as you know. Now, hand over that amulet.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: YOU FIEND! You think we're just gonna give it to you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes I do. (He opens the cage door and lets Isabella out)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (At Ohio and Rhode Island) Sorry boys. (At Doofenshmirtz) Here you go! (She gives him the amulet and her map)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Isabella, you dirty double crosser!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I forgot to give you this one. (She hands Ohio a card that reads "Isabella, Dirty Double Crosser". He looks up unamused.) Okay, I've kept up my end of the bargain. Now where's...

Name: New Hampshire
Dialog: (In a distressed tone) Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mom! (She rushes over to a trench in the ground, where she finds her mom)

Name: New Hampshire
Dialog: Oh mi hija, you came!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Are you okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, she's fine, but she could use a little company! (He pushes Isabella into the trench) Ha Ha. Now, if you don't mind I've got a little ceremony to conduct. Let's see, probably instructions on the back or you rub it or twist it... (The amulet activates and starts shooting out yellow lightning.) AAAHHH! AAAHHH! Okay, okay. Getting used to it, getting used to it. Yeah, I'm good! Ha, Ha, Ha, Ha, Ha, Ha, Ha. (The yellow lightning hits the colossus and it awakens)

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is it! (She takes multiple pictures while Doofenshmirtz cackles in the background)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, I have the power to bla, bla, bla, supernatural, bla, bla, et cetera, et cetera. But first I'm going to New York; we'd kill on Broadway! (There is a loud explosion on the background) What the...!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: But you can call him Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I said you can call him Agent P!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (At Perry) Perry the Platypus, you totally one-upped my entrance. Doesn't matter, 'cos look what I got. (He points to the colossus and cackles as it approaches Perry and the dancing troupe)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: We've got to lead the Corn Colossus away from those backup singers!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: OMG! Coolest sentence ever! Somebody write that down! (Rhode Island writes it down while Ohio picks up an ear of corn)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Hey Corny! What do you think of this! (He splits the corn into two, causing the colossus to roar in anger)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Enrage the all powerful Corn Colossus; good thinking! (In an attempt to escape, they run out of the room, just as the colossus smashes through the wall)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (At the colossus) Yeah, you go smash the kids, then we'll take over the world later. As long as I still have... (He is interrupted by Perry, who kicks him to the ground)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Quick, across this incredibly fragile rope bridge! (The group runs safely across, then stops at the other side. The colossus attempts to follow them, but the rope snaps under its weight)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Get ready for some popcorn! (The colossus tumbles into the flames)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, he was a lot easier to defeat than I thought he would be. (The colossus emerges from the flames, much to everyone's disdain) Great, now he's on fire! (The now flaming colossus continues to pursue the group)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a sarcastic tone) Yeah, this is much better! (They climb up a ladder at the end of a passageway)

Name: Ohio
Dialog: I thought he would pop! I mean, corn pops right? Was I totally out of line? (The ladder leads them to the outer facade of the temple) Down the stairs everybody! (The colossus breaks through the lower portion of the temple, blocking their path) Or... up the stairs!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a sarcastic tone) Gee, you think?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (They approach the top of the temple. The corn colossus is still in hot pursuit of the group) Running out of steps here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, ha! You just wait till I connect with one of these. Then you'll wish you'd never been corned! Get it, 'cos it rhymes with... Hey what's with the fez anyway, we're not even in Egypt! (Perry pulls the tassel on his fez and it flies upwards, revealing a fedora underneath. The flying fez has an automated claw, which seizes the amulet from Doofenshmirtz. With the amulet still in its grasp, the fez flies upwards and out of the temple) You're a real spoil sport you know that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, thoughts?

Name: Ohio
Dialog: (The flying fez and the amulet appear in front of Ohio) The amulet!

Name: New Hampshire
Dialog: Ooh, we can use the amulet to control the Corn Colossus!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We have to figure out how to activate it!

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Or we could hit it with a rock. (He hits the amulet and it shatters. A yellow beam of light shoots out of the center of the temple and the colossus turns into popcorn) Oh now he pops! How does that make any sense?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (The temple starts to collapse) (In a sarcastic tone) Oh, terrific. The temple is falling apart! Are you happy? Probably my face will melt now, and for what?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's the last one. (He pulls Phineas out of the water and onto his tugboat, where the rest of the group is standing)

Name: New Hampshire
Dialog: That was very smooth of you rescuing us at the last moment.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is just how I'm playing it, babe.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: Well we found the amulet, defeated the corn monster, apparently created a much needed canal across Panama, and saved the world!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I've got the proof (She pops open the back lid of the her camera expectantly, but water gushes out and, much to her annoyance, she finds wet film and a fish) Ugh.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry about the betrayal, guys.

Name: Ohio
Dialog: That's okay Isabella, we understand. By the way, does anyone else find it weird that we were saved by an anthropomorphic platypus?

Name: Rhode Island
Dialog: The world holds many mysteries, but what seems strange to one maybe commonplace to another. The fez was weird though, I mean we're not in Egypt.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: But you can call him Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I said you can call him Agent P!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooooh! Here he comes! Oh, Jeremy. How can you even make walking to a bus stop cute? Yeah, I'm a lucky, lucky gal. (a strange object falls from Jeremy's backpack) Oh, no! He dropped something! Jeremy! Jeremy! (runs outside) Jeremy, wait! You dropped-- (bus leaves) wait! (calls Jeremy on her cellphone) Jeremy, you dropped something outside my house, and it kind of looks, uh, artsy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sounds like the gift I made you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gift? Well you didn't have to make--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well we're passing the antenna farm. I'm losing you.

Name: Woman
Dialog: My fillings are heating up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Jeremy? (groans) Oh, what a beautiful tiara... neck, uh, broach... hmm... bracelet! (gasps) Oh, it's absolutely beautiful! (flings it into the sewer) Oops! No! No! No! No! (reaches for the object) Almost got it... (water rushes in and carries the object away)

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Whoohoo! The Danville clean water flush-off!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: A million gallons straight to the ocean!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you've got to be kidding me! Jeremy will be heartbroken when he finds out I lost my gift! Phineas and Ferb! (runs into the backyard) Hey. What are you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We built a mind machine to enter Baljeet's subconscious in order to cure his fear of contractions.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are amputating two perfectly good words and stitching them together. They are the Frankenstein monsters of grammar.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've already cured Irving's fear of the color lavender.

Name: Irving
Dialog: It can't hurt me anymore.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I don't care about any of that! I lost the gift Jeremy made for me, and you guys have to make an exact duplicate of it before he comes over!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'd love to. What'd it look like?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well it kind of had this bolty screwy thing going on, and this wrapped wire like... Oh, I know what it looked like, but I don't know how to describe it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. We can use the mind machine to enter your subconscious and retrieve your memory of what the gift looked like. You don't mind if we fix Candace's problem first, do you, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, I don't (shudders) Chills! Chills! Hey where's (shudders) where is Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, Candace. You're all wired up. We're ready to go in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute. Why is that dweeb going into my subconscious?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because this dweeb spent two weeks in psychology camp last summer.

Name: All
Dialog: How does that make you feel?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, but don't forget about doctor-patient confidentiality.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Irving. We're in your hands now.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Close your eyes and count backwards from four.

Name: All
Dialog: Three...two...one...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where are we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're inside your subconscious.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, everyone take off your shoes. I don't want you tracking mud in here, metaphorically speaking.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Mindmaster calling Deep Divers. How you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're doing fine, Irving.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Remember, you have 45 minutes to retrieve the memory before the boyfriend arrives.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Copy that, Mindmaster. We need to get to the Forest of Memory.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So where are we now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Offhand, I'd say the Jeremy Mountains.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm, significant.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, what was that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Shh! Do not move a muscle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is your id.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My what?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your id. The embodiment of your deepest, most primal urges.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, fun, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wrong. It is very primitive and aggressive. We do not want to meet it here. (shows gazelles that look like Phineas and Ferb running away from the id) Obviously, you see Phineas and Ferb as some sort of prey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Run!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Almost ready, Perry the Platypus, just a few more adjustments. I'm putting an extra ratty setting on the Underwear-inator. So embarrassing! (Perry takes a contact lenses out of his eye and holds it up to the light and tries to cut through the net)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Calling Phineas and Ferb. Come in, Phineas and Ferb. What's your 20?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We copy you, Irving. We're just emerging from the Peaks and Valleys of Fickleness.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet I cannot believe there is a whole valley in there devoted to your love-hate relationship with ambivalence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have mixed feelings about it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, the Falls of Anxiety.

Name: Falls of Anxiety
Dialog: Is my neck to long? Is it okay that I wear the same dress everyday? (The falls continues to voice Candace's anxieties)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is all of Candace's anxieties.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There are so... many of them.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She has a rich internal life.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, she's real messed up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Buford?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's he doin'?

Name: Irving
Dialog: He just showed up and jacked in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You can't come in here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a free country.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No it's not! It's my head! And you're getting crumbs all over-- cru... all over... cru, cru, cru--

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's wrong with her?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The anxieties are getting to her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hurry, everyone! Through the falls! The Palms of Sweatiness!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The Harpies of Hyperventilation!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Rubber ducks?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not ask me! It is your subconscious!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I'll catch yous later. I'm keeping my hoagie dry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. You just get here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let me show you around. This place is a riot!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sniffs) Do you smell something burning? What are you doing?! Give me that! Got it! What is this, a tiny magnifying glass? Oh, you think you're so fancy with your high-tech spy equipment. (He crushes contact lenses) What are you going to do now? Huh, Perry the Platypus? Huh? (laughs) (Perry takes out the other contact lenses)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here we are Candace, the Forest of Memory.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How will we find Jeremy's gift?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we shouldn't have to walk too far since it's a recent memory. What's the last thing you remember?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm... the last thing I remember is saying, "How will we find Jeremy's gift?"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well we shouldn't have to walk too far since it's a recent memory. What's the last thing you remember?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I forgot it already.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. This should be deep enough. Everybody just feel around. Maybe we can stimulate Candace's memory.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That makes my head all buzzy. Wait, wait a minute, wait! I'm remembering! Yes, yes, I see it! Over there, through the trees! That's it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Wait, are you real?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. I stopped by your house to give your present and Irving just told me to jack right in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My present? How could you? I lost it. But I found the memory. It's right over there.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That? That's not your present. That's my drain unclogger. I don't know why I carry that around with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I didn't lose your-- (id comes in and roars)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is the id! Run!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And if you follow me now, you'll see Candace's recurring nightmares. Come on, people. Try and stay with the group. (they see everyone running from the id) Hey, where are they going? (he sees the id and screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Perry escapes from the trap) Ironic, I built my Underwear-inator while actually in my underwear. Ha! (Perry attacks him and the Underwear-inator fires up)

Name: Id
Dialog: (as children are running away from it) Clubby Momo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You all signed the releases, right?

Name: Id
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! (Underwear-inator hits Perry) Ha! You look ridic-- (Underwear-inator hits Doofenshmirtz) Ah! Moth holes?!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Who wants lobster bisque? (Underwear-inator hits him) Get it while it's hot! (Perry disassembles the Underwear-inator)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Irving! Get us out of here now!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Roger, over! (Underwear-inator hits him) Ahh! Lavender! Ahh! It had to be lavender!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello? Irving? Hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Perry is disassembling the Underwear-inator) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! You know, those, those really work for you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I cannot believe I turned down a trip to the community pool for this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's growing! What do we do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One of us has to wake up and extract the others!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am trying to wake up, but I can't! Ahh! Oh! I feel a shock!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! Let's all shock Baljeet awake with contractions!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isn't!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Won't!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's! Don't!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hasn't!

Name: All
Dialog: Ain't!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ahh! That is both a contraction and grammatically incorrect! Ahh! (he wakes up)

Name: Irving
Dialog: (running around in circles) Lavender! Had to be lavender!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The... wires... must... pull... them... out... with... no muscles.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't think I can run anymore!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't give up! Baljeet will save us!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm getting tired, too!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That's it! I'm dead meat!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Gretchen is out! Peace! (Candace falls, causing everyone else to fall)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm really complicated and weird. (everyone gets eaten by the id and wakes up)

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That was great! Let's do it again!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Not me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I wish I had my camera!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait until they hear about this at psychology camp!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Goodbye everybody!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, I guess that was a lot of trouble to go through for a drain unclogger.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, by the way, here's your real gift. (hands Candace a bracelet)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, it's beautiful! I really love it. Thank you. Wait, hold on. Where's Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (to id) I don't care what Freud said about your selfish need for satisfaction. You're alright with me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, Candace, you made a teddy bear out of baklava?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, bears like honey. Bakalva's made with honey. (tastes some of her baklava bear)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Oh, so it's like a statement?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You think it's weird, don't you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, not weird, it's just-- (a customer walks up) Oh, wait, I got a customer, Candace. I'll - I'll call you later, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hangs up) He thinks it's weird. Why is it that when Phineas and Ferb have an idea, everyone's like (deep voice) "Oh, wow, you guys are really clever!" (normal voice) And when I come up with something, everyone goes "What? Did you say something, Candace?" (picks up the baklava bear, now covered with ants) Oh you know what I'm talking about, baklava bear. Ew! (after seeing the ants, she quickly throws the bear onto the ground)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Have you just seen a chicken wearing a baseball hat run by here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, why?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was his turn to bat and-- (notices the ants harvesting the broken baklava bear) Ooh! Are you still using these ants?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those aren't my ants! Do whatever you want with them. (goes inside the house)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, Ferb. Wouldn't it be great to be part of an ant society? They're so efficient and productive. They're like tiny "us-es". Hey, speaking of us, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. Your monitor is on the fritz today...thanks to someone who isn't aware that croquet is an outdoor game.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Again, sir, there was nothing on the box to indicate--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, let's get this show on the road, shall we? (Carl hoists a cardboard replica of the screen and stops it with a rock) Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been collecting some extremely unusual items the last few days. Uh, some of the odd purchases include—Carl, where are my inserts?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, sorry, sir. Do that last bit again.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (while he is speaking, Carl holds up images of each items) Some of the odd purchases include

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Francis, you stink!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Get off the stage!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anywho, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to something sinister. Find out what it is and report back. Monogram, out. Carl, fade out. (Carl pushes a button on a remote which turns the room pitch black, and the only things visible are the eyes of Agent P, Carl and Major Monogram) Man. You can go now, Agent P. (he does so) Okay, Carl. Turn on the lights. (pause) Carl? (man laughing manically) Stop it, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: That wasn't me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, gape in awe at the sheer spectacle that is...the Antius Maximus!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Heh, more like the Anti-Cli-maximus. (elbows Baljeet) Hehheh, yeah?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (sarcastically) Yes, I got it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh that was just a scale model to get the investors interested. This is the real thing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Woah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How did we miss that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And right over there is Ferb's resize-nizer.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What does that do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you find an anthill and then, you add a scoop of it to the pot. Then, the ant Resize-inizer will rain enlarging fluid onto the dirt pile, and cause the ants to move towards the large synthostatic light, making them bigger. Then they continue to the Antius Maximus, the perfect place for the larger ants to live. In no time, we should have an ant farm filled with giant ants. Or Gi-ants.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (she and Baljeet applaud) Nice one!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, Clever wordsmithing, good sir!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, fine. And I just get an eye-roll for Anti-Climaximus?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what the heck is that thing? (walks out) Oh, I'm gonna go tell Mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In order to move amongst the ants without upsetting them, we need to douse ourselves in ant pheromones. It's sort of like ant cologne, which will make them think that we're one of them. But not too much! We don't want them getting too friendly! (presses a yellow button)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bum bum bum...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stop it, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It smells like my grandma's house!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why does your grandmother's house smell like ant pheromone?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Have you met my grandma?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's go see what the ants think of our new cologne.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know what I like about our friends? We say things like "We're gonna douse you with ant pheromones" and they're just like "Okay, whatever". They're so cool!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! (opens the buckle door) Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There's my guy. Why the Thanksgiving-themed trap, you may ask? You know how you get all and lethargic after you eat Thanksgiving dinner? Well, it's not because you're really full and, you know, slightly out of shape. It's because of all the tryptophan in the turkey. Now imagine, if the turkey were say the size of...a car or a building, there would be no resisting the tryptophanicle level of nature's little sleeping potion. That—is why—I created

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, you know Wednesday is my Famous Statues Life Drawing class. (she is dressed as the Statue of Liberty) This had better be important...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb are building a huge glass and sand thing in the yard, it looks like a giant ant farm, but I don't know what it does!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, please--

Name: Vivian
Dialog: (offscreen) Hold still, Linda!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (through teeth) Look, Candace, this is just gonna have to wait until I can take a break.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But Mom, they're abusing their liberty! Don't you find that ironic?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Not enough to act upon right now, dear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (leaving) Okay, fine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So long, Perry the Platypus! Next time you see me, I will be the indisputable ruler of the Tri-State Area! (flies off on his inator) And when I say "indisputable", I mean totally disputable! Wait, no, no that doesn't work, I mean...uh-uh-putable! I-I mean puta—no. Eh, the moment's gone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, let me in! (pushes button; gets covered in ant pheromones) Ew! What the heck is wrong with this doorbell?! Hello? (pushes button again; gets covered in more pheromones) Ow! Oh, it got in my eyes! (pushes button once again; gets covered in more pheromones) Hellooooo?! (presses it three more times) Ugh, it tastes like Buford's grandmother's house! That is it! (goes inside Antius Maximus) When I lay my hands on them, aha! (while inside) Phineas and Ferb, you are soooo buuuu... (seeing giant ant) bu......bu...buggy? Yeah, uh, you know what? (chuckles) This is the wrong giant ant farm. I'm just gonna head out, okay? But being a job on the whole digging thing, really. Okay? (sees another ant) Oh, hello, yeah, take it easy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sees more ants) (chuckles) I-I guess I can stay for a little. Ha! No need to crowd, okay?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, I wonder where they're going?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Probably to see their queen.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good idea! Let's go see the queen! (seeing Candace in throne) Wow. Candace? You're queen?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, you should really fix that doorbell. I must've pressed it like 10 times, and all it did was squirt sticky stuff on me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The pheromones! Oh, that's why the ants think you're their queen! So, what's it like to have millions of ants at your beck and call?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's great. Finally, someone understands my ideas. Only, they keep bringing me crumbs and grasshopper legs. I could really go for a salad. (an ant goes to make a salad) And you think, they'd have a fancy queen dress, or something. (another ant goes to make a dress)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, I wonder where are they going? (all but Candace exit)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, get back here! What's the point of being queen if you're all alone?! (eating crumbs) Say, these bread crumbs aren't bad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to start my Turkey Takeover! Commence random firing! (the Turkey-inator hits the following items

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace! You've gotta see what the ants are up to! I think you really made an impression on them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what'd they do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you asked for a salad and a queen dress, so first, they evolved from a hunter-and-gatherer society, to an agrarian society. Look, they mastered farming in less than 10 minutes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Then, they put it all together to make you this salad. There are still grasshopper legs in it, but other than that, it is not bad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then, three minutes ago, they had an Industrial Revolution. Check it out! They're weaving the fabrics needed to make a dress for you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, Candace, you're probably the most progressive Ant Queen ever!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is so cool! I should call Jeremy and tell him. (looks at cell phone) Oh, there's no service in here. Nice. (at three of the ants) You there! Make there be cell service for your queen!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You think that's a good idea?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, like you'd never tamper with the delicately balanced, yet awesome power of nature.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, take that! And that! (gets head stuck in control board) Oh! Oh, man, that's disgusting! Still, it can't be the first time someone's got their head stuck in a turkey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Soooo, how are my subjects doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Shouldn't be long now. It looks like they entered the information age.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: They are really into online gaming now! Hey, who cast a sleep spell on me and stole all my gold? Ugh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now that everything is automated, they have more time to devote for fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fun?! What about my cell service? Get back to work, you lazy ants! Your queen commands it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh, would you look at that? Apparently, they've advanced beyond the need for a monarchy!

Name: Ant
Dialog: (bangs gavel) Motion carried.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine! If I can't be queen, then it's busting time!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys. Why is it so quiet in here?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The ants have left.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They said something about needing to find themselves.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool!

Name: Ant
Dialog: Greetings, Phineas. We have achieved total enlightment, and have transcended the need of maternal things, like ant farms.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Good for you!

Name: Ant
Dialog: Our new colony will traverse the galaxy in search of the fabled Picnic Planet.

Name: Ant
Dialog: Oh, good, turkey! We can take that with us as an in-flight snack! Goodbye, Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Goodbye! Have a good time evolving past the need for physical existence!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dragging Linda into the backyard) As you'll see, the ants are the size of humans! (realizes it isn't there) Ta-da?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, yes. I see. (at Phineas, Ferb, and their friends) Greetings, human-sized ants.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! There were actually ants the size of people! (puts crown on head) See?! I was their queen!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, Mom. Candace inadvertently caused the ants to evolve.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly, and I was their queen!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, Candace. Just like on Mars. (walks away waving)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was—I -- Oh, forget it, I'm gonna go call Jeremy. (walks off, cell phone in hand)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) Do you think the ants will return some day?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes. Probably while we're having a picnic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, be a dear and help a brother out. Can't seem to -- (Perry takes the control board off his head) Oh! Oh, thanks. (Turns around) No! What are you doing?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (groans) I feel like a giblet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe it! Just moments away from finally achieving full control of the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I owe it all to you, Perry the Platypus, my trusted butler.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I won! I won!

Name: Carl
Dialog: No! Why didn't you listen?! Why?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quiet, you! I will not let you ruin this moment of pure joy!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Joy located.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! Everybody, it's Li'l Saul and the Breakingham Palace Crew!

Name: Li'l Saul
Dialog: Oy, poi, poi and a deetle, deetle, deetle!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Dancing) This party's gonna be off the hook!

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's not how it looks!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (enters the apartment) Uh, I think this is your... hat. I'll just be leaving now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, this day couldn't get any weirder.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'm about to be proven wrong. (at Candace) Hi, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In backyard) Mom! Mom! The cheese mountain remains, but the people have fled en masse!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Getting into elevator) What are you talking about? What people?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 5 minutes earlier.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come back! Wait! High five! Hey, don't leave me hanging!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on phone) Mom! Cheese! Huge! Scary! Home! Now!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: High five!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What happened to that guy?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 15 minutes earlier.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Talking to Monogram via wrist communicator) Sir, I think Agent P is working for... Sir? (Sees Monogram about to eat cheese in a contest at Cheesetopia) No! Don't do it! Don't do it!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (The cheese-eating contest begins and Monogram starts eating cheese and swelling up) No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Snatches Carl's wrist communicator and placing it on the table) We'll have none of that, Mr. Squirrel Man. Besides, you're too late.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ever since Perry the Platypus quit your agency to become my butler, I have been freed up to create my ultimate inator, the Vaporizer-inator! With my mind now clear, I stumbled upon a scientific fact.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Every object on Earth, when heated to a certain temperature, evaporates! With this, I'll be able to vaporize things at will, and create all kinds of mayhem! I'm a genius! (At audience) For realsies this time. (At Perry) Now, to your station, Perry the Butler!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get ready, boys! When this baby powers up, it's gonna get hot in here!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Looking away) Happy place! Happy place!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's find our first target. How about... all the sand at the beach! (Sees that nobody is at the beach.) Wait. Hey, where is everybody?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 25 minutes earlier.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! I think this is the biggest turn-out we had all summer. Eh, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yep. It couldn't get any cheddar than this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, bravo! Bravo!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How do you keep coming up with them?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Showtime, Ferb!

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Ooh! Ooh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At crowd) Cheesetopia is now open!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's like Utopia, with cheese!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (In Cheesetopia, looking around.) Cheese? Cheese?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Our cheese eating contest is about to begin!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cheese!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Via Monogram's wrist communicator) Sir! Oh, why isn't he answering?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, Agent P. If only you had your hat.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 20 minutes earlier.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Shoot!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That squirrel man dropped his hat. I should return it. I wonder what's he's doing up there.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, well. I've got to find out what happened to Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gasps; then ducks down)

Name: Carl
Dialog: (shudders; runs off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, and I just sprayed for squirrel men. (Doofenshmirtz activates a trap that Carl runs into.) Well, now, it appears that fate has dumped our mysterious guest like an immense pile of assorted "cheeses" onto the "lawn" of my evil lab. (pause) Yeah, I know it's a strange metaphor, but I stand by it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, Agent P, what have you been up to?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 25 minutes earlier.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very good, Perry the Butler. The trash chute is right down the hall. (gasps; notices Agent P's fedora lying on the ground) Hey wait, you forgot... (Picks up fedora) Oh, look at this thing, huh? Such memories! All the adventures, the excitement, the pummeling, the thwarting... Oh. You know, I'm feeling rather sentimental about it. (Tosses Perry's fedora off the balcony) Oh, well!

Name: Man in Squirrel Costume
Dialog: Man, am I pumped for Squirrel Con!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yeah! With everyone in costume there won't be any baleful looks of judgement. (Picks up Perry's fedora) Hey, this is Agent P's hat. There must be something wrong. (Calls Monogram through his wrist communicator) Major Monogram, we have a problem. (Shows Perry's fedora to Major Monogram) Look!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that doesn't look good. You can clearly see your zipper in the costume!

Name: Carl
Dialog: No! Agent P's hat.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, well, then, maybe you should look into it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Me? Like a real agent? Yes, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As for me, I'm off to Cheesetopia! (Shows Carl a Cheesetopia poster.) It's Utopia, with cheese!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, you remember what happens when you eat cheese?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, I've been cleared by doctors. Anyways, good luck, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes! Squirrel Con will have to wait!

Name: Man in Squirrel Costume
Dialog: Poor guy. I finished my deliveries early so I wouldn't have to miss this!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 6 hours earlier.

Name: Man in Squirrel Costume
Dialog: (In delivery truck, with squirrel costume next to him) Last delivery of the day!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Behind truck, directing as truck places lots of cheese on the lawn) Okay! Just dump it right there like a caged guy in a squirrel costume! (At Ferb, who's standing next to him) What? I stand by that metaphor. (At Baljeet) All right, Baljeet, I need you to help Ferb with the foundation!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Rolling a cheese wheel as Ferb balances on it) I am on it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you and the Fireside Girls spread the word!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Salutes; is standing with other Fireside Girls as they all hold giant piles of pamphlets) Girls, get ready to get our Flyer Delivery Patches!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (As they walk off) Again?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Is there something you'd like to say, Adyson?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And Buford, keep the cheese puns comin'!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Sitting on a pile of cheese, eating) Sounds Gouda to me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Sniffing) All right, who cut the cheese?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (As he and Ferb cut slices of smelly cheese, wearing gas masks) Sorry.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 2 minutes earlier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on phone while sitting in front of her computer) And then I typed in LOL, but it came out LOP, and Jeremy thought I meant... (sniffs the air) What's that smell? I'll call you later, Stacy. (Hangs up and looks out window, seeing cheese delivery.) Cheese, huh? That warrants a call to Mom! (Perry flies by on his jet-pack as she begins to dial.) What was that?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 10 minutes earlier.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, cheese. (Noticing Perry's disappearance) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. (Perry realizes the camera is zoomed in very close on Monogram's face.) Sorry about the extreme close-up. Carl's off today, and for the life of me I can't figure out how to work this thing. Anyway, we have reason to believe Doofenshmirtz is up to no good. Again, since Carl is out, I'll have to do the visual reference myself. (clears throat; begins to draw on pieces on paper, showing his pictures to Agent P.) He's recently purchased a small tux, a silver tray, and a pair of white gloves. Heh heh, I traced my hand for that one. Ooh, check this out! (Monogram draws details of a turkey on the hand.) Look, it's Agent T! (Perry glares then looks up in shock; Monogram leans down) What, too soon?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cheese?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 15 minutes earlier.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why cheese?

Name: Buford
Dialog: 'Cause cheese is cool no matter how you slice it! (Sees no one is reacting.) What, am I provolone on this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, I guess it's as good an idea as any. Nice cheese puns, by the way.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's nothin'. I've already got a whole list of 'em.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Besides, with the change in plans, we had nothing else prepared.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, what did happen to your first invention?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 5 minutes earlier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, Mom, don't leave yet! Li'l Saul and the entire Breakingham Palace Crew are in here! (Knocking on invention) Come on, I know you're in there, Saul!

Name: Computer
Dialog: (Beginning to shake) Joy located.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Li'l Saul
Dialog: (As invention flies away) Oy, poi, poi, poi and a deetle deetle deetle!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Calling back to her mom) Never mind! Have fun running errands!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Walking in the backyard with Ferb and his friends) But Saul and his crew were unemployed, and so I finally found them full-time in my celebration-seeking rocket. It hones in on joy, activates, and is guaranteed to kick any party up to an 11! Hey, where'd it go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now ya know how I feel. (walks away)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, wherever it landed, I hope they can handle a party of that magnitude.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Back to the present.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not sure I can handle a party of this magnitude! (At Perry) Either way, we've got enough power for the inator now, Perry the Butler, you'd better tend to the guests.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, (spills the drink on Perry's tux) how could you have turned to the dark side? How could you have forsaken all that's good and right to be that maniac's butler? You don't belong in that uniform! You belong in this hat! (Carl takes Agent P's fedora and puts it on Perry's head, who looks at it, confused.) See?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! You have grape juice on your shirt. I can't have my manservant looking like a street urchin. You should go clean up before it sets. (Perry gives Carl the fedora back and walks away.) Ugh, it's so hard to get good help these days, even when you ride 'em like a bicycle.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (As the Butler-inator takes measurements of Perry) When my Butler-inator is finished with you, not only will you have a perfectly-tailored uniform and wig, but you'll actually think you are my butler! You won't even remember that you fight evil for a living!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, you really kick this party up to an 11, man! (Perry knocks Doofenshmirtz to the ground.) Perry the Platypus, what's gotten into you? (Perry shows him the words on his chest.) "Thait I live"? What's that, some new band? (Perry grabs a mirror and Doofenshmirtz gasps.) Oh, "I fight evil"! Very clever. You wrote a note to yourself in the future. (Perry jumps at Doofenshmirtz again and begins to drag him across the floor.) I would not have predicted that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Cheese! Cheese! Cheese!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you know, we do have a nice backyard. (At this point, Candace opens her eyes) Although, I never noticed that cheese smell before. (walks away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My inator!

Name: Li'l Saul
Dialog: (Looking at the joy meter on Phineas and Ferb's invention) Oy, the joy. It drops. Time for us to go already!

Name: Li'l Saul
Dialog: (As the invention flies away) Oy, poi, poi, poi and a deetle, deetle, deetle!

Name: Man at party
Dialog: Well, no Saul, no ball. Let's split. (All the people at the party begin to leave.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Lying on the ground) Wait, wait. I was just about to break out the bubble machine! (Perry flies out of the building on his hang glider with Carl hanging from his feet as Doofenshmirtz yells after them.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! And you, too, large squirrel man creature hybrid thing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Who would've thought a high-fiving swollen guy would've scared everyone off like that? (Everyone notices Cheestopia is gone and gasps, running over to where it used to be.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't get it. Cheesetopia was just here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh, that's Swiss-picious! Well, I did it! A hundred cheese puns! (Seeing Perry walk up to them) Oh, and look, there's Perry! (Buford looks at the audience and bows.) And, scene.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Ooh! Ooh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (At crowd) Cheesetopia is now open!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's like Utopia, with cheese!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Phineas? Ferb? Hey, boys. So, what's on the agenda for today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We though we'd do something classic and take Perry for a walk in the park.

Name: Linda
Dialog: He does need the exercise. Well, I'm heading to the store to pick up some things for dinner. I'm thinking spaghetti and meatballs, or a spaghetti-meatball. That's spaghetti and meat mixed up into a big ball. It's less of a choice of foodm than a choice of shape. Don't forget to bring a doodie bag for Perry! (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We won't! (to Ferb) Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb, we should build a Perry. For occasions like this, when we're Perry-less. A giant anamatronic Perry with flashing eyes, fiberglass bill and... (Ferb holds up a blueprint of the Perrytronic 3000) Judo flipping tail action? Ferb, you anticipate my every need.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P, and welcome to our new Evil Science Readiness Program. You just keep circling Doof's building, and the second Doofenshmirtz is ready to begin his scheme, you'll be there. It doesn't leave a lot of time for friends and family, but -- we feel the dramatic decrease in response time could well be worth it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is he doing up there, just flying around in circles, uhh. It gives me the creeps! Well, it worked out in my favor anyway because, turn, close latch, I'm finally ready to begin my scheme!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! You want to be a bird? Is that what you want? Well, this is what we do with birds, we put them in a cage. Can you speak, little birdy? Hello? Say, "Hello, Perry want a cracker." (Perry bites his finger) Ow! Bad bird! That would not have happened to me if I was smarter, which brings me to my new inator. The Duplicator-inator 2! You know what they say about two heads are better than one, right? Well, I will duplicate my head, and become twice as smart! And look, I even did some recycling by using my old microwave oven. (opens door) Baked potato? Eh, maybe later. (closes door) All my life I've been a zero, but when I have two heads, I'm gonna be twice that! You'll see!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Too steely-eyed, Isabella! Less focus!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoops! (separates the eyes) How's this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perfect!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (oiling the feet) Sure, you get the fun part. If I wanted to oil feet, I could've stayed at home.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (peeks out of the belly) When we are done with this, what will it do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Unlike a real platypus, which doesn't do much, the Perrytronic 3000's capabilities will be limitless!

Name: Candace
Dialog: KEEP IT UP! DON'T STOP, BUSY BEES! YOU'RE BUSY, BUSY, BEES!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: WORK! WORK! WORK! WORK!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: All right, I'm out of here. You lost it. (starts to leave)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, wait! (brings Stacy back) Okay? There is a madness to my method.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You've got three seconds.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Everything Phineas and Ferb build -- disappears when they're finished. So if I can keep them from finishing the thing they're building, it will never disappear! I call it Busy Bee Busting. B. B. Busting, for short.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know what? I'll see you, La-La-Later. (leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's try this. (fires the inator at his head and laughs) At last, I am --

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Don't just stand there, pick me up!

Name: Both
Dialog: Well, hello, handsome!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we're done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? No! What are you talking about, "done"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, the tail glaze is almost cool, so we just figured we'd test her out and then close the book on this one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Test, yes. Close book, no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, I guess we could consider this a sort of preliminary test before the real test.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sh'ya! Now preliminary test his heap, and back to work. And what is this thing, anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry! The theme song will explain everything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Theme song?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It tested perfect! Looks like we're are done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no, you're not! Can it bake a pie? Can it train a seal? Can it give change?

Name: Phineas
