Dialog: Wow. She's right, guys. We're not nearly done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, you busy bees, you're back on the clock! (whispering) B. B. Busting. (normal, on phone) Hello, Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, Candace? I just checked out, I'm on my way home, now! (doesn't notice her purse left on the counter)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't understand, I really thought two heads were better than one, you know, for the thinking. But I can't think of anything!

Name: Both
Dialog: Maybe we need a break. We keep doing that! I know, it's so funny! Ahhh! we did it again! And again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, knock it off. Let's play with our inator for a while!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: (chuckles) Now, this is fun!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know, right? (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Look! Two more heads. Ha ha! Look at Perry and his little arms, aren't they adorable?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're right, let's make more.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Oh, look! A little arm that can move around on its own, (the arm frees Perry) It's got its own volition. I did not expect that. Wait, you dummkopf! Look what you've done! (the arm attacks him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, who's the Dummkopf now, Dummkopf?

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Hit him! Hit him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, good idea! (repeatedly fires the ray at Perry, cloning his arms)

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Not with the ray, you nincompoop! Oh, point that somewhere else!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (turns the inator around) Like this? (repeatedly fires ray) How is this helping? I don't understand your logic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? Where are you now?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I just pulled up the driveway.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are still working, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just taking a break before we install the chicken incubator.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look in the backyard, now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hang on, let me put the groceries away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee... (at the kids) Don't. Stop. Working.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!...Mom, you're not in the kitchen?

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, I'm just shutting the front door!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I need you in the kitchen. Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: In the bathroom, putting away soap!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did I just miss you? Mom? (to Phineas and Ferb) Work, work, work! (to Linda, knocking on door) Mom, come out of the bathroom, quick!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Nope, I'm in your room! You said you needed tissues.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But how did you -- okay, I'm on my way. (goes upstairs, sees the kids) Put that lemonade down! You're not done yet!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the -- Mom, you're not in my room!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm back in the kitchen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (watching the kids) Okay. Listen very carefully. Look. Out. The window.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from the phone) Oh, my goodness!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...yeah? Yeah?

Name: Linda
Dialog: We really need to paint that fence!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...What? That's all you have to say?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from the phone) Hang on, Candace. My other line is ringing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How could she not notice that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from the phone) Candace, that was the supermarket. I left my pocketbook there. I'm gonna run over and pick it up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, no! (runs out, but is too late) Mom! Oh, no, I'm too...too...two houses?!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (reveals a duplicate of the Flynn-Fletcher House)Okay, I did not see that coming. Phineas and Ferb, this has to be their work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh...distract them for me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Yeah, I'll give them a licking they'll never forget!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good one!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Thanks! (a few of the arms tickle him, he laughs) That tickles! Quit it! (grunts)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (runs up to the inator but the arms pull him back) Noooooooo! Oh, you guys are so annoying. You're kinda cute, though. (two of the arms punch him) Get off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Perry gestures to two of his now-cloned tails to attack Doofenshmirtz)Tails? What are they gonna do, wag me into submission? Well, you're too late, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz zaps his head with the inator, cloning six more Doofenshmirtz heads)Heads, I win, tails, you lose!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 2
Dialog: Really? That's the best you got?

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 6
Dialog: Kinda obvious.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 7
Dialog: Juvenile.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 4
Dialog: I liked it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz heads 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7
Dialog: You would!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, you guys are kind of annoying, too. GET HIM! (tosses heads at Perry)

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 2
Dialog: You guys get phantom pains? I got a heck of one in my elbow right now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Perry whistles, one of the arms bounces off his tail to press the self destruct button on the inator)(gasps) NOOOOO!

Name: What? It just -- vanished? What's wrong with this thing? (looks at the microwave timer, it says "3
Dialog: 00") Oh, the microwave was on the "baked potato" setting, so I guess everything is just gonna last for three minutes. My bad!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom! Mom, get ready to have your eyes opened wide!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a sec, hon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns around and gestures toward second house with eyes closed) Look!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but but but but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, when are they ever going to build something in that empty lot? (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! I don't have to "but, but, but". I have the Perrytronic 3000! (runs off) Mom?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grunts) Ooh, I hate you, you little green -- (the arms punch him and disappear, he punches himself) Wait a minute, wait a minute, wait a minute. I don't have to do this anymore. (at Perry) Well, we still have you surrounded, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 2
Dialog: Hey, that disappearing thing's not gonna happen to us, is it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz head 5
Dialog: Yeah, a microwave timer. Great idea. (disappears)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that's unfortunate.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: You're telling me?

Name: Linda
Dialog: "Step 4

Name: Candace
Dialog: (barges in from backyard) Mom, Mom, Mom! This time it's for keeps. Turn around, and look in the yard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: But I have to inject the cheese. Just let me finish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I can't let you finish! They might be finished!

Name: Linda
Dialog: OH! I'll just order a pizza! All right, Candace, let's see what you've got...

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Not the golf clubs, NOT THE GOLF CLUBS! (screams) SAVE ME!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There's a pun here, I know it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: (continues screaming)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He looks teed off! That's what it was! (turns around) Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! My inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: We've got to do something.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're right. (throws the head) Go get him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Ouch! Ouch! Ow! Ow! Oh! Why couldn't I have disappeared before I hit the ground? Curse -- (disappears)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Now, I'll never know what he was going to say! (the inator explodes, Perry flies away) Oh, yeah, yeah, that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (the final ray from the inator hits the Perrytronic, cloning it. The second Perrytronic hits the ground, causing them to flip in circles out of the backyard and down the street. Linda brings Candace out)(with her eyes closed) Say hello to Perry --

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello, Perry. (to Candace) Okay, that was a nice change of pace. (to the kids) Who wants pizza?

Name: Phineas/Buford/Isabella
Dialog: Me!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Then, maybe ice cream sandwiches, ice cream cut in the shape of a sandwich.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Just pie for me, please.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, now I have to "but, but, but".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Perry, as soon as I send in your photo you'll be a contestant in the Totally Tools spokes-animal contest. (looks at Perry) What do you say boy? Ready to be a spokes-animal?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the spirit! (does some typing) And send. (pushes a button on keyboard)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry won!

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Stop the Busting Retreat, a one-day seminar to teach us all to use sisterly restraint. And today, we welcome our newest member, Candace Flynn. Candace, this is Anne, Sunisa and Danielle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (waves a hand) Yeah, hi.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: What we like to do now is a little exercise. We'll start with you, Anne. (clicks a button on a remote) This is your picture of your brother turning your mother's flower bed into a swimming pool. What do you do?

Name: Anne
Dialog: Well, being a non-buster, I'll probably go to the mall and get a mani-pedi.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Good! (at Candace) See how it's done, Candace? (clicks button again) Think you can do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! Are you kidding? Just try me.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Okay, so, (clicks button for the third time) you see your brothers making a peanut butter and jelly sandwich, You...?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, being a non-buster, I wouldn't bust them for making a sandwich. But I'd bust them for making a sandwich when it's 5

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Okay, who here can tell me where Candace's approach could use a little improving? (Everyone except Mandy raises their hand) Candace, put your hand down.

Name: Manager
Dialog: Okay, welcome to Totally Tools. Now, where is that contest-winning platypus of yours? (gasps) Oh, will you look at him. Oh, and he sits up, too! Who says they don't do much? Brilliant! But sitting up isn't enough. He has to say, "Totally Tools". (pause) I got nothing. What do you guys think?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How about a hat?

Name: Manager
Dialog: Brilliant!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know we're gonna do today. We're gonna put a hat on Perry. (places a hat on Perry's head)

Name: Manager
Dialog: Hang on a minute. Wait, go back two.

Name: Manager
Dialog: Brilliant! (picks up Perry, now wearing a... fedora) Nothing says Totally Tools like a platypus in a fedora. Boys, he's got a lot of work to do. (hands Perry to Phineas) Get busy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. (runs off with Ferb following him)

Name: Manager
Dialog: Those boys are brilliant!

Name: Assistant
Dialog: Sir, your 10

Name: Manager
Dialog: Brilliant!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mmm, hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (off-screen) Francis! Hi, it's me, Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Have you seen Perry the Platypus?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Dr. Doofenshmirtz, that information is highly classified and strictly confidential.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You have no idea where he is.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not a clue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, thanks!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hey, hang on. Say, what kind of an evil scheme you got going on there today?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it isn't so much an evil scheme as much as a childish prank, but I've invented a Mustache-inator! (pause) It gives people big, bushy, ridiculous-looking mustaches. Because, as we all know, there's nothing sillier than a big, bushy... (chuckles nervously) All right, uh, uh... But hey, you know, it looks good on you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, today we give you the new face of Totally Tools, (blue curtains opens) Perry the Platypus!

Name: Man in audience
Dialog: Yeah! Nothing says Totally Tools like a platypus in a fedora.

Name: Manager
Dialog: Boys, this campaign of yours has really put us over the top. What else you got?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb came up with an idea for an exploding billboard.

Name: Manager
Dialog: Brilliant!

Name: Boy
Dialog: Hey, look! It's a Totally Tools publicity stunt.

Name: Man
Dialog: Nothing says Totally Tools like a platypus in a fedora hanging from a blimp!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hello, Agent P. We have a situation. With all these new billboards up all over town, you've become too recognizable to be a secret agent. So we had to send Agent S to Doofenshmirtz's in your place. I'm sorry, but you're going to have to go on hiatus until your 15 minutes of fame are up.

Name: Manager
Dialog: I gotta tell you, boys, our president, Tom Totally, thinks you're doing such a brilliant job!

Name: Manager
Dialog: He wants you to take the rest of the day off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds great. (at Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry. We can spend the rest of the day with you for a change.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pew! A handlebar. Pew! A pencil thin. Pew! Fu Manchu!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, now, who could that be? All right, already! (walks to the door) This better be important, or you are gonna get such a mustache...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (exclaims fearfully) Wait a minute. (pulls out magnifying glass from lab coat) Hmm, what do we have here? Oh, no, it's Sergei the Snail!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, well, this should be easy. You've fallen for my trap! (cackles) Huh? You may have survived that trap, but let's you escape the cage! Ha-ha! Oh, for Pete's sake! Will nothing stop you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, this is quite a jump from group affirmations. How is this contraption supposed to help me resist the urge to bust my brothers?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: It's a positive reinforcement machine. When you ignore your busting impulses, you get a reward. Let's try it out.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: You go out in your backyard and find that your brothers have built a rocket ship. What do you do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm just gonna... I ignore it?

Name: Automated voice
Dialog: Ooh! Who's a good girl? You are the good girl. Yes, you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There! That ought to hold you. Lucky thing Mrs. Thompson had some salt I could borrow. (chuckles) Yeah. Yeah, consider yourself "a salted". Ah, man, I'm writing that one down. And now, to business. See that guy there with the beard?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pew! (cackles) Actually, that was kind of a letdown.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fetch the ball, Perry!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on wrist communicator) Agent P, Doof found Agent S's weakness. We need you to drop everything and return to duty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I know we gave you some time off, but could you please come back in to work? (pleading) Please? (normal voice) I can't hold my eyes like this much longer.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Now, Candace, your brothers have issued a gold-based currency which has seriously devalued the euro. What do you do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs) I do nothing!

Name: Automated voice
Dialog: You are the good girl, yes, you are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, you were right. This is quite a machine. Where did you get it, anyway?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb made it for... (covers her mouth with a hand)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What did you say?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: N-n-n-nothing. (screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, why do you always build these things? It's impossible to bust you for everything! It's not my job! Not my job! (realizes) Not my job?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Candace, you had your breakthrough! (hugs Candace) I'm so proud of you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! Did you see that? I just put a mustache on that dog's...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Perry the Platypus, you're back!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What a guy! Not so famous you can't stop by to trounce an old nemesis, are you, huh? But you can't!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's against the O.W.C.A. by-laws. (puts on reading glasses)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I quote, "No additional agents are allowed to thwart any single evil scientist if said first agent assigned is still well and able to carry out his duties." And though surrounded by salt, Sergei the Snail is technically still "on duty," so as long as I have him trapped, you can't touch me! It's all here in black and and... Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (after hitting a wall) Ow, that snail is dynamite!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, ladies, thanks for everything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (A bus with a Totally Tools billboard on it pulls up to the bus stop)I feel like... (notices billboards) Uh, Perry? Perry? Perry? .... Oh, my gosh, the boys have created an enormous ad campaign around our pet platypus!

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (inhales deeply) Sisters, I know what you're thinking, but rest assured, this new Candace that you see before you will not react like the crazed little girl that crawled in here just this morning.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Good for you, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: For now, I am, and will always be, an older sister who is positive and mature.

Name: Mandy
Dialog: That's right, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I am absolutely 100% positive that I have to bust my brothers. I can see it in your eyes! You know I'm right! Sisters, will we bust our brothers?

Name: Mandy
Dialog: Yes!

Name: All
Dialog: Yes, we will!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sisters, repeat after me. Bust! Bust! Bust...

Name: All
Dialog: Bust! Bust! Bust!.... (repeats)

Name: Mandy
Dialog: (stops chanting, realizing something) Whoa, whoa, whoa! What just happened?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just for the record, Perry the Platypus, I was thwarted by Sergei the Snail, not you! You don't get any credit for this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what are you doing?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, sir, you're playing with your lip again.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I can't help it, Carl. I miss the old duster.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What the..? (at Carl) Hey, Carl! It's back! Look how great it... (moves; realizes the mustache isn't on his face) Oh. (taps the screen) Oh, doggone it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that was interesting. You defaced yourself. (pause) I didn't see that coming. To be honest, you have lost me completely.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! (stammering) Wow, I look just like my grandfather, Jose Doofenshmirtz. I mentioned him before. It's... it's a weird story. I'll tell you later. You know, after I shave.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what are you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, curse you, Perry the Mustachioed Tool Spokespus!

Name: Manager
Dialog: But, Mr. Totally, I have no idea who put those mustaches on those posters. It wasn't my fault!

Name: Mr. Totally
Dialog: I want every one of these ad torn down totally! They're mocking me!

Name: Manager
Dialog: Yes, sir. Yes, sir, all torn down. Brilliant! (crashes) Trash can!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, they are so busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, how she missed that one is beyond me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the attic...)Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I guess that answered the inflatable legs question. (at Candace) Now, what is it, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look and see for yourself! You won't believe it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, now, look up there! (points toward the billboard)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm astonished.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Finally!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: "Nothing says Totally Tools like a snail in a fedora."

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Camera cuts to show the giant billboard with Sergei the Snail on it in place of Perry. Throughout the next line, Candace turns and sees it, her mouth drops in horror)It makes me want to run right out and buy some tools. (at Candace) Now, if you'll excuse me, I had better get back to the attic before your father blows up another pair... (Inflatable legs burst off camera) Oops, too late. (runs off) I'm coming, dear! And I have the patch kit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! Wouldn't it be great...if there were trampolines...everywhere you went?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Ferb! Incredible hang time!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Pulls out small device) Personal anti-gravity device.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That gives me an idea. I know what we're gonna do...today!...Hey... (bounces and activates anti-gravity device) Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz was spotted this morning leaving this building with a shopping list. On the list were four items

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa. Did you just feel something?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Morning, hon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmm, that smells good. I'll get the plates out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, put out ten, because I was talking to Jeremy's mom earlier, and we thought it would be fun to get us all together for brunch this morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. So the whole Johnson family, and our whole family, together?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, this is the first time both of our families have formally gone together!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, relax. It's just a casual brunch. No big deal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No big deal? I'm Jeremy's girlfriend! We have to make a good impression! Breakfast is easy! This is brunch! Brunch! That's so fancy! Mom, what does this frittata say about us as a family?

Name: Linda
Dialog: There's nothing wrong with my frittata.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And a frozen orange juice?! Really?! (dumps orange mix into a pitcher of water and pants) I can't breathe. Where do we keep the paper bags?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (at Phineas and Ferb) Hey guys, I know you ate earlier, but you wanna join us for brunch?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No! No! They'll embarrass me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, we can't mom, we're on our way to the hardware store to pick up some extra parts.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay two less plates then.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good! Is this house even clean enough for this? (Picking up a few magazines) Let's see, monster trucks on the bottom, book review on top. That should impress 'em. (She looks out the window, and sees Phineas and Ferb's personal anti-gravity device) Oh no! No! No! That is hideous! What the heck did the build out here? (Reading) "Anti-gravity maximus" Oh I have got to get rid of this thing. (She begins to pulls it away, but the machine zaps her, making her float in the air) Oh no. No! N- Ahh! Phineas and Ferb! Not today! Not now! If Jeremy's parents see me like this, that's the end of me seeing him. Come on there's got to be a reverse switch on this thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excuse me sir, Where do you keep the reverse switches?

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Right behind ya'. Next to that guy buying self destruct buttons.

Name: Store employee
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz Aw sweet, fifty cents off with coupon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh my gosh. They're here.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, my hands are full, can you get the door?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm on it mom. (Candace works her way across the lawn, keeping herself grounded to the best of her ability)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, Suzy. Are you excited to see Candace.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Yes. I love Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming. Just a few more feet. (she opens the door for the Johnson family) Jeremy, and the whole family, welcome to our humble dwelling.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Good morning Candace. Where's your mom?

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's in the kitchen Mrs. Johnson. It's right through there.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Okay, here we go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's just so nice to see you, I just can't stop hugging you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anytime you're ready Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (As she walks into the back yard) Hey Phineas, what'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Isabella. We're blasting this pile of trampolines with an anti gravity machine. So we can bounce all over town.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why not blast ourselves with anti-gravity?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, then we couldn't bounce. Blast 'em Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on guys, Follow me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (With a tear in his eye) It's beautiful!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford?! You are crying!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (He removes the tear off his eye and puts it on Baljeet) No, I'm not, you're crying!

Name: Doofenshmirtz Recording
Dialog: Good morning Perry the Platypus. I had to step out for a moment, but please, help yourself to some gnosh. Eggs, vitamins, ice, or leaks. I have no idea what you platypuses eat, but whatever you do, don't destroy my new evil -inator. (Perry takes a nearby sledge hammer and go to destroy the -inator, however, Perry's feet get trapped in braces) A-ha! You're trapped! A-hahahaha Sucker!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do you like it Perry the Platypus? It's my new Tell-the-Truth-inator! One blast from this baby, and people will be forced to tell the truth. It features an Abe Lincoln robot. He doesn't actually serve any functional purpose, he just decoration. He's, he's thematically linked to honesty. Y-You know through his nickname "Honest Abe". But enough about me, let me ask you this. Have you ever wondered what it is that holds the fabric of society together? No it's no cooperation, or trust or any of that stuff hippies want you to believe, it's lies. All the little white lies we tell each other. For you see Perry the Platypus...

Name: Woman
Dialog: You look good in that hat.

Name: Man
Dialog: I don't think you have too many cats.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Your hair looks nice when it's up like that.

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: Oh dear, the house looks great.

Name: Blay'n
Dialog: You haven't put on any weight.

Name: Woman 3
Dialog: Oh, I thought you said eight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did ya' hear that high note? That was the A above middle C, not too shabby.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace will you pour the OJ?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure Mom. There's got to be something heavy in here. (She finds a wrench, and shoves it in her shoe, weighing her down somewhat) OJ, did you now that stood for Orange Juice, cause I didn't. Well, its not fresh, but it was an impromptu brunch. Brunch cross between breakfast and lunch, makes you wonder what a late night snack would be. A lack? How about a rack? Cross between dinner and snack, anyway... Haha, enjoy.

Name: Baseball Announcer
Dialog: It's a beautiful day for a ball game!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On his flying platform) But it won't be a beautiful day for long. Not after they all start tell the truth about each other. I'll start with that hotdog guy down there. Wait 'till the world hears what's in those things. And fire!

Name: Vendor
Dialog: Hotdogs, get your hotdogs! (He gets zapped) They're aren't really any hotdogs in here, I just wanted to get into the game for free.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, I didn't see that one coming. Let's just see what the players have to say.

Name: Catcher
Dialog: Here comes a fastball.

Name: Batter
Dialog: Thanks pal. (He hits the ball sending it flying, up to where Doofenshmirtz is, and knocking the Abe Lincoln robot)

Name: Baseball Announcer
Dialog: And it's out of here!

Name: Abe Lincoln Robot
Dialog: Malfunctioning. Loyalties shifting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see what embarrassing truths that women who's holding that unusually large hand mirror has to say. (He fires, but the rays bounces back and hits Doofenshmirtz) Secretly I'm very lonely. Where did that come from?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How 'bout some lemonade?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (bursts into the garage) There you are, this is all your fault! That machine of yours has made me lighter than air!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just mentioned that, I thought it would be so fun to--

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not a good time for that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm trying to make a good impression on Jeremy's parents, (Suzy peeks around the garage door, and listens in on the conversation) and I can't even keep my feet on the ground!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess we should install that reverse button now. We wouldn't want you bouncing off the ceiling during brunch.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That would be a little rough on the old frittata.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just hurry before I make an even bigger fool of myself

Name: Abe Robot
Dialog: It is all together fitting and proper that I must destroy Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Get back! Ahhh!

Name: Abe Robot
Dialog: Must destroy Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While hiding behind Perry) He's gonna John Wilkes my Booth! (a beat) What, to soon?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, Mrs. Johnson, it's so great to talk to each other like adults. (Suzy crawls under the table, and pulls out the wrench weighing candace down) Just me and you talking all adulty and stuff, and (Candace notices her leg has floated up) WHOA! (She floats up entirely, just managing to hold onto the table) Ahh! Just doin' a little yoga stretching to help this digestion, yep.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Good thing she's wearing her skort.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, do something! He's going to emancipate my proclamation!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While bouncing) What's up Honest Abe? Looks like the old Doofster's a little too, smart for y-- (The Abe Lincoln robot grabs Doofenshmirtz from the air) Oh, hehehe, hi, you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Still hanging on by the table) Hahaha! Did I ever tell you I'm thinking of taking gymnastics next year? Haha!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Awesome.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (Still under the table) Gymnastics? How about aerobatics?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Ow! O-Oh my gosh. Well, uh, that's enough gymnastics for now. (She manages to sit back down, and wrap her leg around the char, grounding herself)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Candace, can you juggle with this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! put that down. Suzy that's my 1984 collectable Ducky Momo plate, where they printed the entire design upside down. It's priceless.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Mmm, oh whoops. (She throws the plate)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In slow motion) Noooooo! (She manages to catch it with her mouth, while keeping herself from floating away, by grabbing onto Mrs. Johnson's Head with her feet)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace Flynn, what has gotten into you? I want the truth, and nothing but the truth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The truth?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No! Get off!

Name: Abe Robot
Dialog: Honest Abe Lincoln Smash!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now look what you've done. We're out of control!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well... the truth is...

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I've been trying to make Candace look bad all morning!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Suzy!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I mean, bubble!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Get over here Suzy. We're guests here, and guests do not behave like that.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: But Mom, Candace floats!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Oh, and now you're telling lies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, Mrs. Johnson, as much as I hate to admit it, Suzy's not lying. Phineas and Ferb made a ray that makes me weightless. I might as well show you I couldn't embarrass myself more than I already have.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Reverse switch, check. Is it aimed at Candace? Close enough. (He fires the ray)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look. (She removes her hands from the table, but gets hit with the ray, making her crash down) Ta da...!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So dad, what do you think?

Name: John
Dialog: She's a lot like your mom.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you Honest Abe Lincoln!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like it worked Ferb, Candace is just standing there, talking and pointing. Oh, now looks like they're coming out here. hey! Let's show them our anti-gravity maximus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's right out here Mom...It was right here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What am I looking at, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It was a machine that made me weightless, it, it... Suzy tell them.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (pause) Bubble!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, you heard her, bubble.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not too shabby.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Another week's allowance replacing wedgied underwear. If I had anything left, I would invest in the company.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (runs into the store and gives Baljeet a wedgie) Wedgie time! Thanks for savin' my place in line, nerd!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (annoyed) Buford, how did you find me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let's just say the initials are G, P, and S.

Name: Grocer
Dialog: Next!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (handing up his items) A pack of Tuff Gum, and this cheese grater.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What is the cheese grater for?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You'll see.

Name: Grocer
Dialog: $4.86. Paper or plastic?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Plastic. Pay the man, propeller-head.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (growls) That is it! I can put up with noogies, wedgies, wet willies, and even the fact that you apparently have placed a tracking device on, or inside, my person, but I will not tolerate your ignorant decision to take plastic over paper! From this moment on, I am no longer your nerd!! (storms out)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aaah, fine! I was feeling creatively stifled by you anyway! (at grocer) And you! You just cost me a perfectly good nerd! Maybe I'll make you my new nerd.

Name: Grocer
Dialog: 'Wow. Your pressure tactics are quite developed for a youngster.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes. Yes, they are. But some people...don't APPRECIATE THAT!

Name: Grocer
Dialog: Y-you may be the most intimidating person I-I've ever met.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You better believe it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pops up from behind a nearby stand)

Name: Grocer
Dialog: You could probably bully the entire Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (excitedly) I'm getting tingly!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet. You're just in time for what we want to do today. Where's Buford?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Who cares? I am finally free to live my own life! I feel like I can do anything! Like...climb a mountain!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! Let's put that energy to work building our next--

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, I mean literally climb an actual mountain! Danville Mountain!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. We've just recived some intel that Doof has hired an assistant. Some muscle, if you will. He must be up to something big. You know, I once put in a request for some muscle. Got Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And how many attacks since I came on board?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, none, but, would it kill you to at least look the part? You look like a preschool crossing guard.

Name: Carl
Dialog: No need to be hurtful, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I can see I'll be helping you take over the Tri-State Area; would afford me many new bullying opportunities. But what's with the back-story, dude? I mean, who needs a special reason to boss people around?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never thought of it like that. We'll get started as soon as I pick up some fresh lab coats. These have got scorch marks all over them.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (starts pushing people out of line) Out of my way, melonheads! Move it, or never use it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, this kid's always on the clock!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Give Dr. Toothenhurtz here his lab coats, Bright Eyes!

Name: Cashier
Dialog: I'm sorry, we have a line here. You might want to use it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And you might wanna rethink that! I mean, it would be a shame if this double-dutch chocolate mocha espresso you've been drinking, were to, say, I don't know, splishy-splash all over those prissy-clean lab coats you've got back there.

Name: Customer in line
Dialog: Hold me!

Name: Cashier
Dialog: You wouldn't dare!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Try me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Cashier
Dialog: Fine! Take your dry-cleaning and go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as they walk off down the street while Perry watches nervously) Who would've thought that after all these years, all I needed to take over the Tri-State Area was a grammar-school goon. A ham-handed half-pint. A knee-high ne'er-do-well. A pint-size palooka. A pushy prepubescent.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Are you done?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz Nah, I've got one more. (beat)  A pipsqueak pugilist. Okay, now I'm done.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There it is. Danville Mountain. My quest lies ahead of me like an unpeeled potato.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can help you skin that adventure spud! May we present, the MegaPants! (Ferb pulls out a blueprint) Y'see, these hydraulic pistons will walk-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No! I need to do this myself. And that means no inventions.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pause) What?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No gadgets, no gimmicks, just pure achievement! It will be great! Let us go! (begins running up the mountain)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No inventions. Are you guys gonna be okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as she also runs up the mountain) Sure! Why wouldn't we be?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. That rope bridge looks a little rickety. A couple of hydrochloric unicycles would-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not necessary! (He runs onto the bridge) Fear is for yesterday. Today we live!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: New Baljeet rocks!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: ...Rocked.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He made it! Well, with the bridge gone, we could probably use some spring-loaded boots! (rubs hands in anticipation) Or a drilling machine! Or...or-

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I'll save you! (swings across the river, catches them all, and they all swing back to the other bank) Who is ready for some free climbing?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Dude, what's with the playset?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Playset? No, this is a non-scale model of the Tri-State Area.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you play with dolls?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Perry jet-packs onto the balcony and hides in the rafters) Maaaybe.....but it also helps me visualize my scheme, it doesn't have to be used with dolls.....all the time. A-anyway, this is our headquarters, larger for the sake of clarity, and this, see this right here? This is my Sculptinator. This part will scan my body, and this part will shoot a beam which will then carve Danville Mountain into a lifelike statue of me! (lifts up the model of the mountain to reveal a model of a statue of him, but the statue has a lot of muscles) Visible for literally miles in every direction! Not scale miles, real miles. And then, when people see this splendid tower of manliness, they will just assume that I should be their leader. Look! Look how it captures the manly thickness of my neck.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (skeptically) That's you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think the cut of your lab coat is working against you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know, right? I've got to talk to my tailor about that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look, there's Baljeet's house! I'm gonna spit on it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Buford drops a gob of spit on the plastic model of Baljeet's house) Y'know, I'm kind of surprised that we haven't had a visit from my nemesis yet. (Switch to show Perry hiding in the rafters, looking deeply uncomfortable) I'm sure he'll be along. I can't wait to see the look on his face when he gets a load of you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet! You sure you don't need any robotic suction spikes up there?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Nope!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or how about mechanical lobster claws?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No-ope!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or maybe gas-propelled pine cone grappling hooks? Or cybernetically controlled towing spiders?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am good!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Surprise! Matching outfits! It's John Phillips of London Bullywear. Plus, monogrammed jet-packs! Doof and Byoof! We rhyme.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gee, thanks a lot! Wait till my friends get a load of me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you're not gonna need friends. You're gonna be on top of the heap! It's lonely at the top, but, you know, it's the top, so it dulls the ache. (He walks away. Buford looks surprised)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: YES! I have BEAT you, Danville Mountain! In your cliff face! Ha ha! I cannot wait to tell Buf- oh. That is right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay. That's enough triumph for one day. Are we done here, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ICE CHALET!!!!! (He instantly zooms offscreen and the sounds of drilling and hammering are heard)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: If we hadn't been able to invent something soon, I was going to scream. (He and Isabella walk over to join Phineas, leaving Baljeet alone)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, you're singing? I know what that means, you're leaving, aren't you?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry, Dr. Dooftinasian. But there comes a time when you don't wanna bully everyone. (He looks back dramatically, a single tear falling from his eye) You just wanna bully someone you love.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nice kid. Well, back to the inator-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay! We gotta melt out the inside!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know, you really ought to pace yourself!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mudroom first! Ferb, start carving the bearskin rug!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're gonna get the bends or something.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! (slams down the Sculptinator start button, then poses) You're too late, Perry the Platypus! Ooh! Make sure to get my good side!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, Perry the Platypus, aww, you've ruined it! Where am I gonna get another mountain now? (Perry kicks him again and he goes over)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great job on the snow chalet, guys! It's amazing how the cocoa stays hot in these (???) ice cups. How are you feeling, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (in an ice hot tub) Coming down now, coming down.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I myself am so down, I am in the basement. (The GPS button on his overalls starts blinking and Buford enters) Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: As much as I'd like a tearful reunion, we gotta get off this mountain pronto!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let's just say if you want a neck like mine, you gotta start lifting young.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Before any of us move, I have got one last thing to do.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There, I feel much better. Do not you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow. I had no idea that was so uncomfortable. I am so sorry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's been great sharing this bonding moment with you two, but we need to get off this crumbling mountain now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grab hold of something!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Do you ever get used to this?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Nope!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I am totally gonna wash my hands after this. Twice.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sounding bored) Who could've guessed it? It's back to normal. And explosion now. (Kaboom!) Yep. Just like that. Curse you, Perry the Platypus. Whatever.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am sorry for my outburst, earlier.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No. I'm sorry for putting the GPS on you. Consider it gone!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes. This is much less humiliating.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't worry. I'll get the duct tape. (He leaves)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He meant...for my pants, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, You're singing? I know what that means! You're leaving, aren't you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's coming!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: AAAAHHHHH!!! We're doomed!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The prophecy has come true!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We are about to pay for our over-consumption!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You created me, Garbage-zilla! And now, puny humans, Prepare to be trashed! (trips and makes a loud noise) Whoa, whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Knock it off!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I don't know what you kids are doing, but I'm taking an online knitting test in a few minutes, and I need it to be quiet around here. (sarcastic tone) You might not remember quiet. I'm not sure you two ever met. Anyway I'm putting you on noise patrol. You're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm in charge? Woo-hoo! Yeah!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Use a muffler. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She grabs and puts a cushion over her face.) Oh, yeah. Woo-ho!

Name: Buford
Dialog: This time I want an air siren, and tap shoes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, Mom put me on noise patrol while she's taking an online test. She needs it to be... (loudly) ABSOLUTELY QUIET!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from upstairs) Candace, I'm trying to concentrate! (going back to her computer) Now let's see

Name: Candace
Dialog: You heard her, right? No noise. I want you silent, and invisible. Got it? (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Silent and invisible!? What am I? A ninja?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! Gang, I know what we're gonna do today! (pause) Speaking of silent and invisible, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we have a crisis. The Agency was going through Dr. Doofenshmirtz's trash this week when we found this. (shows a magazine with doodled on cover) Defaced magazine cover. Shameful! There were hundreds of similary defaced photos of good looking men, (shows a magizine of him on the cover with a devil face drawn onto it) including this handsom devil gracing the cover of Covert Lifestyles. My interest in this incident is purely professional, but put a stop to it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (sobbing) Wh-hy? WH-H-H-HY?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold on, Perry the Platypus, I'm just getting the mail. Oh, goody! It's my order from the Power Tool and Sleleton Key Warehouse. I was wondering when this was gonna -- OH! Look! At! This! Every week, the mailman makes the same mistake and I end up getting my neighbor's HS Weekly. Here, hold this, Perry the Platypus, I need to rant. (puts mail in front of Perry) I hate all these good-looking models on the cover of Handsome and Symmetrical Magazine, mocking me with their manly perfection. Their perfect hair, their perfect skin, I hate it! And this, is why I created...the De-Handsome-inator! Soon, all these good looking faces will be hideous! (Perry, free, punches him) Ow! Wait, did you use the skeleton key or was it the power tools?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just for that, I'm not gonna tell you why the apple --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, you know, I don't have the energy for this. It's still early, do you wanna go grab some lunch? Come on. I skipped breakfast this morning. (he and Perry walk out) You like eggs?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, gang, Ferb and I made these ninja outfits using smart garment technology. Once they're switched on, the outfits are designed to hide the wearer from anyone who's not wearing the suit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey! I smell noise! Is that what the black pajamas are for? You gonna have a noise party?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, it's the opposite. We're ninjas. Ninjas are renowned for their quiet and concealment. We made an outfit for you, too. (points to a ninja outfit for Candace)

Name: Buford
Dialog: You should put it on. Take it from me. Black is slimming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, thanks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's okay. We'll leave it here for you in case you change your mind. (at his friends) All right, ninjas! Let's turn on our outfits!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! Where'd everyone go? (turns around several times, but the kids keep sneaking automatically out of her sight) That's so weird. Huh. Oh, I'll find them. (goes inside)

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was cool! I didn't have to do anything! The outfit did all the work! Whoa Phineas, which way are you facing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good question.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Left.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stupid, stealthy ninjas! (slams door)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, keep it down! (at her test) "What do you call a clever knitter?" (pause) I know! A knit wit! Heh! Is there anything better than knitting humor?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I need to stop at the bank, I-I don't have any cash.

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: Ah... (faints)

Name: Man 1
Dialog: (opens bank door for Doofenshmirtz) It's an honor, sir! A real honor! I can't wait to tell my wife!

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: Ooh, are you famous? You look like a model, are you an actor? You go first, I can wait!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Please, I'm just getting some cash to pay medicine for my kids.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (at the bank teller) Yes, uh, hello. I just need to make a withdrawal from my account, please.

Name: Bank teller
Dialog: (gives him money bags) Here, take this. It's on us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no. J-just enough for lunch.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: Sparkling sider?

Name: Water
Dialog: Scrambled eggs? That's real lobster in there.

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Preserve the moment! (takes his picture)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can you believe the service in this place, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Here you go! All framed. (gives him the picture takes

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, ah, thank you! Eh -- (sees his picture) Heh heh, see, this isn't me. This is just the superhumanly attractive male model that came with the frame. I mean, look at this guy, right? That's funny, he's wearing a lab coat just like me -- (Perry holds up a mirror) Uhhhh?! Oh, this is horrible! I can't be handsome! It's -- it's everything I despise! Don't you understand? Beautiful people, they -- they just get everything they want in the world. I mean, watch this. Hey, lady, nice baby.

Name: Woman 3
Dialog: You want him? He likes you better.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I don't want your baby. (at Perry) You see, Perry the Platypus, the unfair advantage good-looking people have? (becomes conceited) Heeeey?! (at a man) If I ran for Mayor, would you vote for me?

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Over and over again.

Name: Man 4
Dialog: No, elections are for ugly people. I'm sure they'd just give him the mayorship.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ya think?

Name: Policeman
Dialog: Sure, you've already got a sizeable mob, and I bet we could pick up a couple thousand more on the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, okay, then! On to City Hall!

Name: Candace
Dialog: My busting sense is tingling...

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's something Phineas and Ferb going on here...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb? (opens the door to Phineas and Ferb's room) You in here? (closes door)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas? Ferb! (opens another door)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! Phineas!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know you're here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (opens the door to her room) And the whole Tri-State Area knows you're here, Candace! Again. could you please keep it down? (closes door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (quietly, behind Candace) I tried to tell you before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns around) Aha! (sees no one, constantly turns around) Uh...uh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'll never be able to see us, unless you wear a ninja outfit yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I'll wear a ninja outfit, all right! Then, I'll bust the whole lot of you. (walks off, Phineas is on her back)

Name: Man 5
Dialog: My company wants to give you a life time supply of our distinctive hand mirrors.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Send them over. (he's handsome)

Name: Woman 4
Dialog: I'm gonna name all my children after you even though they're already in college.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nice! (he's handsome)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get in line ladies! (he's handsome)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm a total catch, really (he's handsome)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm quite fetching (fetching/handsome)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a word, it is! (he's handsome)

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, well, well Heinz. At the age of 47, you've finally grown into your looks!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I have.

Name: Roger
Dialog: In fact, it would be our pleasure to suspend democracy and make you our Supreme Leader.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Do you have any questions, yo-o-o-ou handsome devil?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, how is my hair?

Name: Woman 5
Dialog: He's handsome and funny!

Name: Woman 6
Dialog: This'll be the perfect place to watch the coranation!

Name: Man 6
Dialog: I can't believe how fast they mass produced these commemorative hot air balloons.

Name: Delivery man
Dialog: Hand mirror delivery!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Phineas? Come out, come out, wherever you are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, you guys are so busted, and I hace the evidence right here on my body. (runs off) Woo hoo! Mom! Mom!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I knew she'd come back for the slimming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know you're super busy and all, but you have just got to see what Phineas and Ferb made. I'm wearing it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, this test is time sensitive!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just one second!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, all right. (turns around, Candace is gone) What? Where'd you go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm right here, on the ceiling.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looks up, Candace disappears) What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm right here, under the rug!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looks down, Candace disappears again) Young lady...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heh, now, I'm on the shelf.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't know how you're throwing your voice and I understand that you want attention, but I'm really, really busy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's the outfit! (takes mask off) It won't let you see me.

Name: Linda
Dialog: But, it apparently has no qualms about letting me hear you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes entire suit off) Mom, here it is! Mom! (closes eyes)

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right, Candace... (turns around, the suit bounces out of Candace's arms) What am I looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Buford
Dialog: These outfits were fun!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I've never moved so fast!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! That was quite a workout.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! It's Candace's ninja outfit! It's hiding! She must've left it switched on. (turns off the suit)

Name: Roger
Dialog: And now, I finally pronounce you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, I'm so glad you're here to see this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's that? My inator remote? You're wasting your time. There's no way you'll get a clear line of fire from my place to here, what with all hose commemorative hot air balloons in the way. How do they mass produce those so fast?

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ew.

Name: Man 7
Dialog: He suddenly looks so...unqualified.

Name: Policeman
Dialog: Please disperse, nothing handsome to see here.

Name: Woman 7
Dialog: Hey, let's go look at fashion magazines!

Name: Woman 8
Dialog: Yeah, that sounds great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...And they fold down to almost nothing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from her window) Phineas, do not go anywhere. (walks into Linda's room) The ninja outfits, they're still there! Hurry! Wait till you see this. (drags Linda on her chair with her outside)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...By pressing the "on "button, the outfits put themselves away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There! Bust them! (closes eyes)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi kids. I wanna thank you for being so quiet all afternoon. (at Candace) Unlike...someone I know!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Mom, how your test go?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Well, lucky for Candace, I just passed. (enthuastic) Anyone for pie?

Name: All but Ferb
Dialog: (jump for joy) Me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (in a stern tone) Mush, Candace.

Name: Roger
Dialog: So sorry. It looks like your small window of fleeting beauty is now gone. (leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't understand! How -- how is is possible? Uh -- you did this, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Coming, bro?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: D'you ever notice in a certain light Buford looks...handsome?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a blessing, and a curse.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh strange phenomenon, tell me why you keep making my brothers' inventions disappear! Give me a sign! (Looks to her left with her left eye and vice versa. She smacks the floor, and a book wobbles off the shelf) Ugh! Why do you toy with me? (Picks up the book) My 4th grade science book? (Opens the book) "The scientific method has proven to be mankind's most useful tool for understanding the truth behind formerly strange phenomenon". Hee-hee-hee-hee...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You boys ready for pie tonight?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Doonkelberry Pie! Our favorite!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Arranging the groceries into a shelf) No, not Doonkelberry Pie. Everybody's out of Doonkelberries! I can't find them anywhere lately.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? (Starts typing on his laptop) Let me check.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be berry interested to see what you find.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good one, Mom. (At Ferb) We should cast our net a little wider than Danville. (The laptop beeps) Bingo! (Looks closer to the screen) It looks like there are some in... Drusselstein!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Drusselstein is a rustic Eastern European country, whose primary export is Doonkelberries.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P, and welcome to the field test of our new talking letter. As you can see, it looks like a normal letter, except for this strange gibberish text that no one can read, and the obvious fact that it's got a little talking photo of-- Actually, this is a silly idea. I mean, we had to mail this last Tuesday. Plus, it's really just dumb-lucked that no one has picked up the mail first. Well, whatever. Open the box, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's right, rockenhosen! We're sending you to Drusselstein. Doofenshmirtz will arrive there this morning, and we must know what he's up to. Now this letter will self-destruct. (The envelope closes, and the letter self destructs) Oww!! Oh, and the, uh, box, as well. (Perry picks up the scattered shreds of the blown up letter, puts it into the box, closes it and tosses the box out of the pet door) 5, 4, 3... (Perry changes into his clothes and runs off) You know, I really don't know what we were thinking with -- (The second explosion occurs. The roof opens and Perry comes out in his jet-pack)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas! What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna build a trebuchet to shoot ourselves to Europe.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool! Gravity or tension spring?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, gravity proba-- Wait, when did you learn trebuchet mechanics?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Medieval Siege Engine Patch. It was my first one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Clears throat) I'm looking for a book on scientific investigation and disappearing objects. Got anything?

Name: Librarian
Dialog: Let's see... (Starts typing on the computer) Um, Disappearing Objects and Scientific Investigation. Sound good?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Shuh!

Name: Librarian
Dialog: Oh, it's checked out to a Heinz Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Vanessa?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "Doofenshmirtz". It's my last name. Heinz is my Dad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz? What's that, like, Chinese?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It's Drusselsteinian.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, from Drusselsteinia!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm heading over my Dad's house if you want to look for your book.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And this is it, right here. (Gets off) Thanks for the ride! Keep the change!

Name: Driver
Dialog: Vhat change? You've been hitchhiking!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's an expression! Hmm! (At Perry) Perry the Platypus? Wow, Rumpkinhossen'. Five seconds and you've already gone native. Well, don't worry, I'm not doing anything evil today, I'm just here to renew my driver's license. (Shows his license) Say, as long as you're here, why don't you stay and keep me company? (pause) Pleeease? It's so boring. (Perry facepalms)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know, traditionally, these things don't have much range.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, it's a bit of a cheat to use a warp generator to bend the fabric of space, but I'm sure they would've done it in olden times if the technology were available.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If the trebuchet can't go to Drusselstein, bring Drusselstein to the trebuchet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Bending!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm! Rustic! (notices Zengle's Fruit Stand) Here it is! This may be the only place in the world to get doonkelberries right now.

Name: Zengle
Dialog: That's because I have my own doonkelberry field. So when I need more, I pick more.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But what about exports?

Name: Zengle
Dialog: Well...the canning facilities shut down after the shaft stopped working.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The shaft?

Name: Zengle
Dialog: All of Drusselstein runs off of central shaft. Or at least...it used to. Drusselstein's a long narrow land, the only country in the world where a central shaft makes any sense, except for maybe Chile. At the end of the shaft was an exercise wheel powered by thousands of rabbits. The rabbits turned the wheel, the wheel turned the shaft, and the shaft turned everything else. A miracle of 16th Century science, today! It powered our vashing machines, our blenders, our schwingel presses, and of course, it ran all of the country's doonkelberry processing plants. The rabbits wouldn't keep up, so we decided to upgrade from rabbits to a more powerful source of energy

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But the solution is so obvious!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just have one side turn their goats around.

Name: Zengle
Dialog: Yes, but we are a proud people. In our culture, turning your goats around is the mark of a coward! Neither side will back down. So it is, such as it has ever been, in Drusselstein, Land...of...the Shaft! I am done, now.

Name: Zengle
Dialog: Uh-oh. Time for the 5 o'clock demonstrations.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Counterclockwise forever!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Turn around!

Name: Man 3
Dialog: We cannot be swayed!

Name: Man 4
Dialog: You're turning the wrong way!

Name: Man 5
Dialog: Rightsiders go home!

Name: Man 6
Dialog: Filthy clockwisers!

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: Yo mama!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, how would you like a Conflict Resolution patch?

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Fill out this form and take it to line 26. (goat bleats) NEXT! Yes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want to renew my driver's license, please.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: (inspects the license) Hmm...

Name: Doofenshmirts
Dialog: "Hmm"? What do you mean "Hmm"?

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: I'm afraid you will have to be... (inhale) RE-CERTIFIED!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Re-certified? No, but that means...

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: YES!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No!

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: You vill have to take...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't say it!

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: THE DRIVING TEST!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: B-but t-there must be some mistake! I --

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Your instructor will meet you out BACK! NEXT!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold my hand, Perry the Platypus! (sniff) I'm scared!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why are you singing that?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It's just something we do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, swanky! It's all like, science-y in here.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, my dad's kind of an amateur inventor. I think I saw some books over here. (sees books cluttered with lasers on a table) Oh, here we go. Uh, we can just put his other stuff anywhere. What's the name of the book again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, "Disappearing Objects

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Disappearing objects? You mean, like socks?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Like rollercoasters, building to the moon, stampeding cows...stuff like that just disappears.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Does that happen often?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you would not believe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, let's recap. You Leftsiders won't turn your goats around?

Name: Left judge
Dialog: I believe we have made our position clear.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And you Righsiders won't turn your goats around, either.

Name: Right judge
Dialog: This point is non-negotiable!

Name: Judges/Drusselstenians
Dialog: There is only one point! There is only one point! We will never turn! (keep arguing)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, wait a minute, wait a minute, wait a minute. I think we can solve this, but we're gonna need a certain tool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, this place is just made for scientific inquiry. (spots telescope) Hey, cool telescope! (looks through it) I bet I can see my house from here. Oh, cool, it's pointed right at it! (sees trebuchet in backyard) What the heck is that? Oh, my gosh. It's another stupid invention. (patting telescope) Thank you, Mr. Scientific Instrument.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for coming along, Perry the Platypus. You know, having you around just makes me feel, you know, safer. In this circumstance, Back home is exactly the opposite.

Name: Driving instructor
Dialog: Heinz Doofenshmirtz, do you attest hat you take this driving test of your own free will?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Driving instructor
Dialog: You may go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, wait, wait, uh, I'm not ready. Let, let me psych myself up. Just a few breathing exercises, then I'll go, okay, right?

Name: Driving instructor
Dialog: We have a choker!

Name: Female Pedestrian
Dialog: I'm okay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I did okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, after careful consideration, we have come up with a solution that we believe will satisfy everyone.

Name: Male Leftsider 1
Dialog: We will not be satisfied!

Name: Male Rightsider 1
Dialog: No compromise!

Name: Male Rightsider 2
Dialog: No compromise!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb?

Name: Man 7
Dialog: I did not think it was possible!

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: The shaft is turning in both directions!

Name: Viking
Dialog: The science is far behyond us!

Name: Man 8
Dialog: The viking is right! By separating the shaft, you have united our country!

Name: Man 9
Dialog: Your goats may walk in any direction you choose, Father!

Name: Man 9's father
Dialog: Yours too, my son! (both sob)

Name: Man 10
Dialog: It's like a fluganoff miracle!

Name: Man 8
Dialog: You have brought peace to our land. Surely there's something we can do for you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, there is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fresh doonkleberries! Thanks!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (on phone) Okay, Baljeet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess it's lucky that they had a trebuchet in Drusselstein, huh?

Name: Man 11
Dialog: Henceforth we shall call this day; "Phineas and Ferb" Day!

Name: Man 12
Dialog: You mean "Ferb and Phineas" Day!

Name: Man 13
Dialog: By descending order of height! Everybody knows that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hello, Mom! I bet you can't guess why I'm calling!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't know. Did the boys build a giant amusement park for leprechauns?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) I don't know if that's what it is! But if you simply look in the backyard, you'll see it!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (singsong) All right, Candace. I'm looking.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from the phone) And surprise, there's nothing there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (looks through the telescope) What do you mean, "Nothing"?! (sees nothing) But...but but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (flatly) Thanks, Vanessa.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What about the scientific method?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's flawed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for everything, Perry the Platypus. And don't worry, I - I'll pay for the dry cleaning on your Rumpkinhossen. All right, see you back home! I'm taking the trebuchet. (Perry blasts away on a jetpack)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) More pie, anyone?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No thanks, Mom. Delicious, but I'm stuffed.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Me too!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) I think it's gonna rain. It's really overcast out there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, that's just Drusselstein.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, sorry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I should always travel like this! This is gre --

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: CURSE YOU, CONCEPTUAL ELASTICITY OF SPACE-TIME!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I did okay.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: A long time ago in a studio in Burbank, California, a ragtag group of animators made a fake trailer for a Meap sequel they never intended to make. Unfortunately, everyone wanted to see that episode so the animators were forced to write it and incorporate all these seemingly unrelated scenes.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (He is seen with blue orbs of fire in each hand) Hahahahaha! Aren't you a little young to save the universe?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (The camera zooms in on the Earth from outer space, and Phineas and Ferb are seen equipped with high-tech visors and blasters in front a futuristic steel door) Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I want your hat on my desk!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Balloony! (Balloony is wearing an armored suit with energy axes)

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Colin!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Jeremy's going to be there!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: I guess the joke was on them. We now present... (dramatically) Meapless in Seattle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ready to go?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sure. So you're okay with not, you know, busting your brothers first?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I've been spending all my time worrying about Phineas and Ferb. I used to have other things to worry about. Like... (dramatically) What? Jeremy's going to be there! I just need to broaden my anxieties.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, I guess if you're going to have an unhealthy mind frame, it might as well benefit me. Now, the mall is waiting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and no more worrying about Phineas and Ferb. I mean, if I did half the things they do, I'd get so... busted.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh-oh. I just lost you, didn't I?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy! If I do what Phineas and Ferb are doing I would get busted, and them along with me. A sacrificial bust!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I almost got you-

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can take the hint-

Name: Stacy
Dialog: -out the door-

Name: Candace
Dialog: but they'll never see it coming.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: -to the mall.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Muhahahahaha

Name: French Audio Teacher
Dialog: Où est la.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Où est la.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sarcastically) Mom, if you need me, I'll be outside with Phineas and Ferb. And when you get a break from your French lesson, feel free to pop outside and check out what we're doing, okay?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay Candace honey. Oh, would you take the garbage out, it's over by the door.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure thing, Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay Phineas and Ferb, what are we going to do- (She gets squashed in between two giant pillows, dropping the garbage bag) today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, sorry Candace. We're having a giant pillow fight.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Giant pillow fight? Perfect! Move over and give me a try. (She gets into the pilot's chair of one of the giant pillows)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This ought to get mom out here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know who else would love this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Do that. Say where's Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well I was going to say Buford, but where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is on the move. We've tracked him to northwestern Washington. We need you to get up there and see what he's up to. Oww! Oh! My back! Carl, crack!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Cracking, sir. (Carl proceeds to crack Monogram's back)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: By the way, (in an angry tone) I want your hat on my desk! Because it rains a lot in Seattle, and I'd like to spray it with this cool new water-proofing treatment. Which reminds me, we've installed new unbreakable glass in your lair monitor. Go ahead, try it out. (Perry yanks out his chair and throws it at the screen. The chair shatters on impact against the monitor) Hmm, better order that unbreakable chair too, Carl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, look Mom. We are having so much dangerous fun with these massive pillows.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Meap!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He points at the pod walker) Wow! Cool ship. Is that yours?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Say what now?

Name: Meap
Dialog: (Meap puts on translation mustache and clears his throat) RUN!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (She appears at the entrance) Hi Phineas-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He grabs Isabella by the waist and runs out of the yard with Ferb and Meap) RUN! (They reach the front yard) Wait! Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She is still in the backyard controlling one of the pillow fighting machines, unaware that the pod walker is getting tangled up in its string) Mom?! Come on out and see all the fun we're having! (The pod walker trips and yanks her and the machine to the front yard) AHHHHHH!!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (comes out, though she does not notice Meap's spaceship) Okay Candace, what did you want me to see?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm going back for Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on?

Name: Phineas, Ferb, Meap and Isabella
Dialog: RUN!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no Meap! You lost your translation mustache.

Name: French Audio Teacher
Dialog: The spaceship is right behind you. Le vaisseau spatial est juste derrière vous.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey look, there's Mom!

Name: French Audio Teacher
Dialog: Your children are climbing in the spaceship now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Mom!

Name: French Audio Teacher
Dialog: Vos enfants monter maintenant dont vaisseau spatial.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going to outer space!

Name: French Audio Teacher
Dialog: Oh for the love of, would you turn around?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See ya!

Name: French Audio Teacher
Dialog: Oh pour l'amour de, vous de serait tournez?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well when is that ever going to come up in conversation? (Meap's spaceship takes off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She is taking a video of herself with her phone) Hi mom, check me out, I'm flying away in an alien spaceship with Phineas and Ferb! I am so busted!

Name: Meap's ship's computer
Dialog: Autopilot engaged. (Meap presses a button, and a second translation mustache pops out of the dashboard. The words "Made in Georgia" are in placard at the bottom) Emergency Translation Mustache activated.

Name: Meap
Dialog: (looks back from the pilot's chair wearing the two piece mustache. He starts speaking in a southern accent) I beg your pardon for all the hustle and bustle kids. It's just that my planet needs your help!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'd do anything for you, Meap.

Name: Meap
Dialog: In a rather large nutshell, here's my problem

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. Ferb and I can build another cute tracker with these parts. Of course this time we'll have to adjust the settings to ignore Meap's cuteness. (The camera pans right to Isabella frowning) Oh! And yours too Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't need your charity. So how bad is this guy we're up against?

Name: Meap
Dialog: I think you're already acquainted with the scoundrel in question.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Ha, those kids will lead me right to it! Just as I planned! (The two robots give blank stares) What? Wh-what's that look? That was my plan. (The robots look at the destroyed pod walker) Yes, e-even destroying the pod walker was part of the plan! You know, I can deactivate the both of you, and two more just like you will take your place. (The androids clap nervously) That's better. Now let's get after those kids, before they get too far ahead of us. (Mitch's spaceship emerges out of the pod walker and he boards it)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it Meap. Did Big Mitch escape from prison?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Well, we come from a cute based society. By law the harshest judicial sentence we can pass down is a time-out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice work Ferb. The cute-tracker 2.0 is up and running.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, where are we headed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It says the cutonium is somewhere in... Seattle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How will we know when we get to Seattle?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We're here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: According to this, the cutonium is buried somewhere around these abandoned coffee houses.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Holding her sash) Well, it looks like the Unearthing Ancient Container patch I earned is finally going to come in handy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great. Let's find us some cutonium. The sooner we get started, the sooner we get busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to her phone) Look Mom. We're digging up the entire northwest United States! You okay with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Seattle. My home away from home. And to think, Perry the Platypus has no idea. He's, he's completely clueless about my little excursions up here. Ha, ha. That poor, blind, trusting pla- (Doofenshmirtz puts down his paper and sees Perry outside in the rain, staring at him. He runs to the "Dudes" room, where he sneaks out of the window and grabs an umbrella. However, Perry is outside the window waiting for him) AH! I'm not here! You are not seeing me! (Doofenshmirtz begins to run away, but falls face-first into a ditch) Oh Perry the Platypus, how long have you been... and look at that, it's, it's Peter the Panda, my ex-nemesis, what a coincidence, huh? (Perry turns to Peter, and then looks back at Doofenshmirtz, annoyed) I mean what is he doing here, in Seattle... his... hometown? And look he's got, he's got two coffees, one of which for sure, is not for me... it's not mine... (He moves his hands upwards, and in the process knocks some loose dirt away from the side of the ditch, unearthing the container of cutonium) because mine's right here. Look. See? (He drinks the cutonium) Ugh, ugh, that is not coffee. (As soon as he drinks the cutonium, Doofenshmirtz shrinks and becomes cute. Peter drops the two coffee cups in shock. Doofenshmirtz soon realizes what has happened) That's just great. What kind of a world are we living in, where a guy can't down the contents of a mysterious urn found in a trench, without undergoing major physical transmogrification? Really?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: At last the cutonium is, oh- no empty!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Dude! You're standing on my lab coat!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (He picks Doofenshmirtz up) Oh-no, no, no, no! Did you actually drink the cutonium?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, is that what that was? I totally cannot recommend it.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Well, you're cute alright, but you should have become completely irresistible. How homely were you before?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey I know you! You're that Mitch guy from space. Put me down you best friend stealer!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Well I suppose one container of cutonium is as good as any other. (to Doofenshmirtz, who is visibly annoyed) Want to go for a ride? Won't that be fun? Yes it will. (to his robots while pointing at Peter and Perry) Destroy them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
