Dialog: Wow! You're strict.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Looking at the cute-tracker 2.0) The cute signal's emanating from over there. And Big Mitch has it!

Name: Meap
Dialog: My word! Something must be done, y'all!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Soon the whole world will be mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If you don't let me down I'l-

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (looking at Doofenshmirtz) Oh, he's so cute!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep, he's definitely the source of the signal.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's get to the ship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to her phone) Hi mom, check us out!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: To the ship! (They enter the ship)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as he falls from the pipe into Meap's ship) Woohoo! Whee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (No longer wearing his raincoat) Gotcha! (to Meap) Come on, punch it Meap. Let's get out of here!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Oh no you don't!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mitch is gaining!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: I have you right where I want you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to her phone) Hi Mom. Look, I'm in mortal danger! Say hi Ferb. (Ferb waves, and pulls Candace back into Meap's ship. A tractor beam emanating from Mitch's ship stops them from moving any further)

Name: Meap
Dialog: My word! A tractor beam! Hold on children, this ship is jumpin' like a June-bug on a hot chicken!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Well my little friend, it looks we're about to meet our untimely demise.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, speak for yourself, I'm going to try to land on you, so you'll break my fall.

Name: Meap
Dialog: My word, we've been fallin' for a long time!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, a joke about the commercial break, yeah, that's how I want to spend my last few seconds.

Name: Meap
Dialog: (He lands on the space needle, and loses his moustache in the process) Meap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He is still falling) Oh look, his mustache fell off, and, and I didn't think today could get any weirder!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nice try, but the mustache thing was still weirder.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: I'll take that, thank you very much. (Mitch cackles as his ship flies off into space)

Name: Meap
Dialog: (The scene shifts back to Meap, who is still on the Space Needle) Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (They fly towards the needle with the hatch of their ship open, unaware of Meap on top of the Space Needle) Meap! We lost him. (They see Meap, who promptly gets into the ship) Hop in. Big Mitch grabbed the cutonium. (The hatch of the ship closes) Do you know where he's going?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap! (He looks at a glass panel which reads "Backup Emergency Translation Mustache". He breaks the panel, puts the mustache on, and starts speaking in an elderly English accent) He's heading back to my home planet. I must warn them! (speaking into a radio) Red Alert! Red Alert! Mitch has the cutonium, and he's on his way there. You must rally the troops, and head him off at the evil fortress. This is war!

Name: Female Meap Operator
Dialog: Meap?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Do pardon, forgot I have this silly thing on. (He takes off the mustache) Meap!

Name: Female Meap Operator
Dialog: (gasping) Meap! (She hands her notes to the Head of Radio Operations. The scene shifts to a military command room)

Name: Head of Radio Operations
Dialog: Meap! (to the Secretary to the War Council) Meap!

Name: Secretary to the War Council
Dialog: Meap! (whispering to the Lieutenant General of the Meap Army) Meap.

Name: Lieutenant General of the Meap Army
Dialog: Meap! (He hits a red button sounding an alarm)

Name: Alarm
Dialog: Meap! Meap!

Name: Meap
Dialog: There it is. My home world.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Meap! Your planet's so cute! Except, I guess, for that evil-looking fortress under that ominous cloud.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Unfortunately, that's where we are going.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, uh, do we have a plan, or are we just going to go all willy-nilly, and barge into that bad, scary place?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, willy-nilly barging is a plan, of sorts.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Here we are. The extraction chamber.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously? Y-you have an entire chamber reserved just for extracting things? That, that really comes up that often in your life? The extraction of things from other things.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Look, I don't have to justify my life choices to you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know you can drop the whole "bad guy" spiel. (Mitch's robots strap Doofenshmirtz onto a metal panel) I'm actually willingly going along with this, in case you hadn't noticed, but, yeah, okay, you're a bad dude, cool, whatever, I get it.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (laughing manically while holding blue orbs of fire) When the extraction is over, then you will see just how bad a dude I really a- (The blue fire starts to burn his left hand) AH! Put it out! Put it Out! Put it out! (One of his robots extinguishes the fire with a fire extinguisher) Okay, now that was... embarrassing. I, I'm going up to prepare the machine, while you two finish up here. Personally I hate the smell of extraction. (Mitch leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, what does it smell like?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (She is putting on a pair of boots whilst talking to Meap, who is taking mirrors out of a box) Meap, why are you taking the mirrors?

Name: Meap
Dialog: (He hands her a mirror) Better safe than sorry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She is wearing a helmet) I don't know, Phineas. That door looks pretty solid. Are you going to try to hack the locking mechanism, or crack the code sequence?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb are standing in front of a futuristic steel door equipped with high-tech visors and blasters) Yes, yes I am. I think the sequence is, (he pushes a red button with his blaster and the door promptly opens) push the big red button. (They enter the fortress)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Though he is still strapped to the metal panel, he has changed back into his usual form) Back to my old self. That, you know, that wasn't so bad. In fact I rather enjoyed large portions of that process. (Two robots load the container into a pneumatic tube, which sends it to an upper floor) Hmm, extraction. Who knew? (Peter the Panda and Perry the Platypus appear at the back of the metal panel) Peter the Panda! And Perry the Platypus! You're working together to rescue me? Oh that's really nice of you. (The two robots notice the agents and begin to advance towards Doofenshmirtz) Uh-oh. Hey guys? A little help here. (Peter and Perry pivot the metal panel upwards, which sends the robots crashing through the wall. More robots start to stream out of hatches in the walls of the chamber) This is some rescue. (Peter, Perry and Doofenshmirtz run away from the robots)

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Yes! My machine is fully charged with cutonium.

Name: Meap
Dialog: (He and the rest of the group are on a balcony overlooking the chamber) Hold it right there, Mitch.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Meap! How did you get here?

Name: Meap
Dialog: With the help of Team Phineas. (He gestures to the rest of the group)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I never agreed to that name.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: You're too late. (Mitch's head vanishes from the top of his suit. A few seconds later, he reappears at the left foot of his suit as a much smaller, "Meap sized" alien) Not even you can stop me from becoming the cutest being in the universe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I didn't know he could do that.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Neither did I.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (Mitch, who is standing on an elevated platform, is talking to his suit) Don't just stand there. Get them. (to the group) Boy are you going to get it now, when... (Mitch starts talking to his suit, which is finding it hard to reach the group) No! On your right! The ramp on your right! (Mitch's suit goes down the left ramp) Your other right! Yeah, when he eventually arrives up there you are in big trouble. In the meantime, behold the creation of the most adorable creature in the universe. Me!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Oh no! He's done it! Whatever you do, don't look upon him in that state. You'll become transfixed by his cuteness and he'll gain complete control over you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awwwww...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I just realized something about myself; apparently I run faster than a panda bear, but not quite as fast as a platypus. Eh, who knew? You really do learn things about yourself in times of crisis. Wait, wait, turn left up here. That door must be the way out. (They reach a door, which opens to reveal Balloony in an armored suit. Baloony is holding energy axes) Balloony, it's you! Oh boy am I glad to see you. (The robots stop chasing them) Chill guys, Balloony and I go way back. So Balloony it's a good thin- (Balloony swings one of his energy axes at Doofenshmirtz) Well it's been nice catching up, but uh- RUN! (Doofenshmirtz and the agents run away) I think I misjudged his devotion!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aww, look at the little guy. What's the fastest way I can transfer all my assets into his name?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (To her phone in a panicked tone) Mom, things look pretty bleak. We may not be back after all. Phineas is in a cute trance. Mitch turned himself really adorable and defeated the entire Meap Army. There's no one left to-

Name: Meap
Dialog: (He takes off his translation mustache) Meap! (Meap grabs a mirror and swings down to the platform to confront Mitch. Meap looks at Mitch through the mirror, so as not to become hypnotized. Then, just as Mitch fires a purple death ray, Meap closes his eyes and fires a rainbow death ray. The two rays meet in the middle)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aww, they're blasting away at each other with really cute death rays.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Balloony, please help me. Balloony! Oh, don't let me go like I did with you. Balloony, what ever happened to us? (Suddenly, Balloony fights and wipes out nearly all of the robots attacking Doofenshmirtz) Balloony! I knew deep down inside you were still my best friend. Think of all the good times we can have, now that we- (One of the robots which survived Balloony's onslaught fires a laser, popping Balloony) Nooo! (Balloony collapses to his knees, falling into Doofenshmirtz's arms) No. Balloony. Stay with me, I- (Peter and Perry, who are now free, look at each other and approach Doofenshmirtz, who is holding a deflated Balloony) I'm not going to let you go a second time. Balloony! I can feel my heart... popping.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Meap needs our help, Phineas, Phineas! (She drags him down) Come on Phineas, snap out of it! Phineas, Meap is down, he's been out-cuted. (She takes off her helmet and briefly swishes her hair from side to side) What are we gonna do? Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is-Isabella. Hey wait a minute, Isabella we've had a secret cute weapon all this time. You!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't you see? You can take him. He's only cute on the outside, but your cuteness goes right to your core.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So what you're saying is, you think I'm cute?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a scientific fact. (He picks up the Cute-tracker 2.0) I had to put an 8000-ohm resistor on the cute-tracker just to keep you from burning it out.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (In a slightly annoyed tone) Close enough. I'm on it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can do it Isabella, just be yourself!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Mitch.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Meap! (He gets thrown backwards towards a wall, discharging his cuteness in the process. He puts on the translation mustache) Ow.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Children, you did it. You saved not only my planet, but the entire galaxy from Mitch's adorable yet evil plan. (Phineas and Ferb slide down onto the platform) On behalf of my people, I thank you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was our pleasure Meap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She slides down onto the platform) And I've got it all right here on my phone.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (He begins to run away) Meap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! He's- Oh no! (She searches her pockets, but is forced to throw her phone towards the bay door. It hits a red button, falls to the floor, and breaks. The door slides downward, trapping Mitch as two Meap guards surround him) Oh no you don't!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (He sighs) Meap.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Good work, Candace. He's going to get a serious time out now. Fifteen, sixteen minutes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it sure is great to be home.  (The scene shifts to Meap's ship parked in the backyard) Thanks for the ride Meap.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Friends, I can never thank you enough for helping me save my planet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our pleasure. And I think we all learned a valuable lesson today, but we all know what it is so why waste our time restating it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Bye Meap!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Farewell my friends!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Goodbye! (Meap's ship takes off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye Meap!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I thought I told you to take that garbage out. You are so busted, young lady.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of...course I am.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! Where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, I'm sorry there's nothing to foil, I, I'm still down about- (Perry holds up Balloony, who has been patched and fully blown up) Balloony! (An instrumental version of My Wettest Friend starts to play to a montage of Doofenshmirtz and Balloony spending time together)

Name: Narrator
Dialog: And now, a trailer for an episode we also have no plan to make.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Pay attention up there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jerry the Platypus?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, aren't those extinct?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: As a matter of fact, I object to this union.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: The Chronicles of Meap, Episode 42.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Meap Me in St. Louis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (The scene shifts back to Doofenshmirtz in the bus) Hey, wasn't that Suzy stuff supposed to be in this one?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll combine the zipperoo with the terror drop, and move clown town after the Ferris wheel, and we end the whole ride with a house of mirrors bouncy castle. It's great! A city-wide amusement park on a single track. And you only have to wait in line once!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Delivery!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Paul!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Hey boys, you ordered 20 tons of building material?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We sure did!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Okay, sign here. Hmm, thought i had a pen here somewhere...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, I'll just use the pen you left here yesterday. (signs form) Ferb and I modified it so you won't lose it again.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Huh. What did you guys do, install a homing sensor?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, we just put a clip on it.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Cool! Haha, here's your form.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Hi, dad. Yes, I just delivered to Phineas and Ferb. Yes. Yes, they are. No, I left them the blue copy.

Name: Paul's Dad
Dialog: No, son. You always have to leave them the pink copy. The blue copy's yours. You gotta take your job more seriously. Now you're running seven seconds behind!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Dad, I'm not sure if I really wanna be a delivery guy.

Name: Paul's Dad
Dialog: Of course you wanna be a delivery guy. You just don't wanna be a delivery guy who's seven seconds behind. Step it up!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Alright, Dad. Talk to you later, bye. (hangs up phone; turns on radio)

Name: Radio DJ
Dialog: Hey hey, listeners, the WJOP's party van is out there somewhere in the Tri-State Area. The first lucky listener who spot the party van and say the Phrase that Pays, wins a special prize!

Name: Paul
Dialog: (radio off) Ooh, here's my next delivery.

Name: Paul
Dialog: What a weird looking building. (goes into Evil Incorporated to find that the elevator has broken down) Out of order? Great! (struggles up the many flights of stairs) (knocks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (from inside) It's open~.

Name: Paul
Dialog: (goes in with the package) Helloo. Delivery. (a cage falls from above, trapping him in a platypus-sized cage)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, you're not Perry the Platyp- Oh, sorry about that. (retracts the trap) I was expecting someone else.

Name: Paul
Dialog: No problem. Happens to me all the time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? (signs the form)

Name: Paul
Dialog: I'm just kidding.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaa-ah. Hey nice clip.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Thanks. Hey, I like your place. What do you do here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you know, different things, but today I'm building a Juice-inator (shows Paul the Inator) It's going to turn City Hall into juice!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Oho, is it now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, then I'm gonna take over the Tri-State Area! You know, like you too.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Well, at least you got a plan. I haven't figured out what I'm wanna do with my life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't sell yourself short, perhaps you can be one of my minions! Not an indoor minion, but a minion that keep the coalfires burning.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Yeah, I'm not sure that's a step up. Here you go (hands blue copy then leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You should think about that offer! Miniony! It's a growth industry. (looks at the blue copy in his hand) Oh, he forgot to leave me the pink copy.

Name: Paul
Dialog: (as he gets inside his truck) Juice City Hall, what a character.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Paul. (Paul waves at him)

Name: Paul
Dialog: That's what they did with the building material!

Name: Radio DJ
Dialog: We're still looking for that first listener to spot WJOP's party van, and say the Phrase that Pays--

Name: Paul
Dialog: (getting off his truck to see the van) Hey, you're the WJOP party van!

Name: Radio DJ/Party Van Driver
Dialog: Hey, you're the first listener to spot us!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Wow! If only I knew the phrase that pays.

Name: Radio DJ
Dialog: (taps his bell) That's it baby. The phrase that pays is The Phrase That Pays! You win the grand prize!

Name: Paul
Dialog: I won? I won! (fanfare) What did I win?!

Name: Radio DJ
Dialog: The band Love Händel will play at your job! (van opens to show the band inside)

Name: Paul
Dialog: That's impossible! I work..on a truck..

Name: Paul
Dialog: (answering to the headset over the band noise) Uh, hello?

Name: Paul's Dad
Dialog: I got a complaint from the City Hall, they haven't got their package yet.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Sorry Dad. I had a delay, but, but I'm on my way.

Name: Irving
Dialog: For your information, it's not sci-fi, it's speculative fiction.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Finally you're here with my box.

Name: Paul
Dialog: You know, Mayor Doofenshmirtz, I just delivered  a package to a Heinz Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Roger
Dialog: (signs the form) Yes that's my older brother. Charming...man.

Name: Paul
Dialog: That box is really light.

Name: Roger
Dialog: That's because it's empty. I just needed a box. My cat loves to play with them.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Are they with you?

Name: Paul
Dialog: (sighs) Yes. Yes they are.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Well guys, like I was sayin', I'm not sure that I'm totally fulfilled as a delivery guy.

Name: Paul
Dialog: There's a whole world of things to do out there.

Name: Paul
Dialog: I mean, look at..look at those kids.

Name: Danny
Dialog: Hey, we know them. Hey Phineas! Hey Ferb! (all three waves at the kids)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey guys!

Name: Paul
Dialog: (to the band) And you guys. What is it you really want?

Name: Paul
Dialog: Fine. (drives the truck to the nearest food stand)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So at this point I can grab Mom in her hair appointment and bring her over where I think the boys are heading. And calculating we'll go by that weird looking building downtown, at exactly 4.59 pm.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I'd really like to help you with your latest busting endeavor, but I have customers waiting. (points to the band singing in line)

Name: Paul
Dialog: (answers his phone) Hey Dad, I'm just stoppin' for lunch (listens, then closes phone) He said we have another delivery for Heinz Doofenshmirtz. We gotta go back to headquarters and pick it up.

Name: Woman
Dialog: (coming out of elevator, then sees Paul on the floor) You know, they fixed the elevator.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Delivery! Again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh goody, it's arrived. One last part for my Juice-inator.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Oh right, you're still on that juice thing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, my Juice-inator, my giant menacing machine that will turn City Hall into juice, completely discrediting and embarrassing my brother the Mayor at his 5pm media event. Step One, in my evil scheme to take over The TRI-STATE AREA!!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Wow. You've a rich fancy life, doncha?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) I've been told so. Do you have a pen?

Name: Paul
Dialog: (offscreen) Yes, I do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, I remember this baby. Y'know, if I had a clip like that on my pen, I'd never lose it.

Name: Paul
Dialog: I think your little, uh...What is that, a dachshund?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Platypus.

Name: Paul
Dialog: (offscreen) Looks like he doesn't wanna be in that cage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, him? No, no, he likes it. (giving back the clipboard) Here ya go. (takes the package) I'll take that. Thanks for everything. See ya.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Hmm...

Name: Paul
Dialog: Why don't you use the elevator? (walks in and pushes down) Got a song for that?

Name: Danny
Dialog: Actually, we do!

Name: Paul
Dialog: (offscreen) The last delivery of the day. (cut to Paul and Love Händel walking up to the door) OWCA, the Organization Without a Cool Acronym. Boy, they aren't kidding.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! A distress signal! Agent P is really trapped! Why won't he use the bevy of tools and weapons conveniently located in his hat?

Name: Paul
Dialog: Delivery!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (squeaky) Um, I'm gonna sign for the package.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, your voice just got squeaky! I know that squeaking!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Paul) Uh, where do I sign?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, what are you not telling me?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, Agent P doesn't have his hat tools. I took them out to clean and repair them.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Something inside me just broke.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (reaching offscreen) I have the tools right here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, what good are they to him here? Poor Agent P, he's just a platypus trapped in a cage. Wearing a tiny hat, a little fedora...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: ...trapped by an evil scientist...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: ...intent on juicing City Hall.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Hey, I know that guy! I've seen your friend!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All of our other agents are busy out in the field. If-If only there was a way to get these tools to Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yeah, before Doofenshmirtz juices City Hall in seven minutes!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Hightail just happens to have a seven-minute delivery! I can get those tools to your friend! I've never used it, but here's the 237 form. Sign at the bottom here, here's a pen, initial this on page two.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Put those tools in here! I've got the regulation box!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Aaaand you keep the pink copy. The blue copy's mine!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, young man! (they leave) We could use someone like him at the Agency. Carl, why don't we have a soundtrack band?

Name: Paul
Dialog: Schedule's gotta wait, Dad! I have a special delivery to make!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Rush hour! Tape yourselves together, boys! I've got an idea!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Paul!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Hey, kids! Just hitchin' a ride! (Once they approach D.E.I., he cuts the tape apart.) Right, here's good. Thanks, guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) See ya, Paul!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Here ya go, dude! Sign here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And... (The clipboard latches onto the lever.) Hey! (Perry punches Doof.) Perry the Platypus?! Take that! (Doof pulls a lever and Perry falls through a trap door.) You won't get out of there in time to stop me! (He pulls the lever on the inator. Cut to a wide shot to reveal Paul taping the inator shut.) What? What are you doing up there?

Name: Paul
Dialog: Just wrapping up a few loose ends!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! Metaphorical and literal!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Little dude, we should get outta here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus and Paul the Delivery Guy!

Name: Paul
Dialog: Paul the Mobile Logistics Technician!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, excuuuuuuuse me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (tasting the juice) Mmm...tastes like pineapple. (Love Händel swims by him.) Hey, Love Händel!

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: Hey, guys, we're covered in juice and packing tape! What does that remind you of?

Name: Sherman
Dialog: Detroit, 1984! (High fives Danny) Whoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I can't believe you made me leave my hair appointment for this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but...it's juice! (to Phineas) What do you know about this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Excellent work, young man! Excellent! Y'know, it's unprecedented, uh, you being a human, but I'd like to offer you a job at the Agency. What do you say, son? Ya wanna fight evil?

Name: Paul
Dialog: Thanks, but no thanks. I've found how I can contribute to the world. By being a mobile logistics technician!

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's a delivery guy, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I know what it is! (Perry reaches down and picks up Paul's pen.) Huh, nice pen.

Name: Paul
Dialog: Well guys, like I was sayin', I'm not sure that I'm totally fulfilled as a delivery guy.

Name: Paul
Dialog: There's a whole world of things to do out there.

Name: Paul
Dialog: I mean, look at..look at those kids.

Name: Danny
Dialog: Hey, we know them. Hey Phineas! Hey Ferb! (all three waves at the kids)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on the phone) ...So I said, "You're not getting me up into the mountains on a day like this", (She is on the couch with dozens of fans) I'm staying right here, with my beautiful air conditioning. I'm just gonna chillax right through this one.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for letting us host the French Fireside Girls at your cabin, Mr. and Mrs. Flynn. This'll be a great place for them to get their North American Tracking patches.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: What did I do again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The French Fireside Girls, or le filles coin du feu, as they're known in their country of orgin, are going for their North American Tracking patches. And you're helping us help them.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: I put a sticky note on your shirt.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: (sees the note) Aww. And you wrote "love". (whispers as they leave) I knew it was there.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Why do you play senile?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: I love your notes!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're here! The French Fireside Girls! Or le filles coin du feu, as they're known in their country of origin.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Bonjour, le filles coin du feu. Je m'appelle Isabel.

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Oh, chi paz français. An as sassa en ou toum de? Y je buhouchs e du...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, stop, stoppee! That's all the French I've got.

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Dacaz. I am Brigitte, and these are Josette and Collette.

Name: Josette/Collette
Dialog: Bonjour!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gestures to Phineas and Ferb) And this is --

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Phineas et Ferb! (Holds up newspaper) We read your column in Le filles en coin de feu Gazette.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Humbly) I'm syndicated.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Matre de maz.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (He wheels in a large crate with a tarp over it) Everyone, please stand back! Keep your fingers, and berets away from the bars.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Le filles coin du feu, to earn your American Tracking Patch, you'll have to capture the most dangerous of creatures, the vicious, American, (She pulls away the tarp, revealing Buford in a bear costume) grizzly bear.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He has not been fed.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: My friend has graciously agreed to be the bear for today's hunt.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Excuse me. (He goes around to the back of the cage) What is up?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (he pulls Baljeet inside) Get in here! I know that girl out there!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we met, in Paris. (He flashes back) It was a year ago, and I was taking in some of the local color, when I saw her, Brigitte. She was a beautiful french girl, and I was an ugly American. Which of course holds a certain mystique. With her I completely forgot myself. I read poetry, I wept at beauty, I clipped my toenails. For Brigitte, I even learned to speak the language of love, French talk.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, that is why you are fluent in French.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It was easy actually. A lot of the root words are the same in Latin. But I can't let anyone know I have a heart, it'll ruin my tough-guy image. And believe me, the irony is not lost on me in this suit. Aw man, don't you see, if I get all gushy now, I'll be totally exposed! I can't stand it! (He pushes Baljeet aside, and flees the cage)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There he goes. Let the tracking begin. (The girls run after him)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, you speak Latin!?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Go get 'em girls!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: You'll never catch me running around in a fuzzy bear suit, (He passes for a moment) in this heat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It is a tad sweltering. A little fun with water might be in order.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Way ahead of ya' kiddo. (He shows them a sprinkler)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're on the right track Grandpa, mind if we kick it up a notch?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: I was hoping you might.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. I'd tell you what Doofenshmirtz is up to but the screen isn't big enough for the little box thingy over my shoulder, but I'm sure you'll figure it out when you get there. Good luck Agent P.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Of all the clearings, of all the woods, in all the world, she had to walk into mine. (Buford's phone rings) Tell me she was deported!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, what are you doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: The forest is crawlin' with patch-crazed Europeans and I'm a bear in the woods. What do you think I'm doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh! Ooh! I know!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Am I on speaker phone? GET ME OFF OF SPEAKER PHONE!

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: This way I see a score.

Name: Buford
Dialog: They're comin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How's he doin' Baljeet?

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: I want his fuzzy fent on my wall!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha, well...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You want to help us make a super-sprinkler?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, yes I do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, Perry the Platypus, are you felling tired?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Take a rest! I figured you'd be exhausted after breaking all those doors. I-I even put a mint on your pillow, and everything, though, I guess it's probably just stuck to the back of your head now. Sorry about that. So, let's talk about pretzels. You see Perry the Platypus, when I was younger, (Doofenshmirtz flashes back) I did a summer internship at Master Drakkenblad's Pretzel Palace, He was the biggest pretzel wizard in Drusselstein. His disproportionately delicate hands, could turn any dough into a masterpiece. But even after months, my pretzel still lacked, polish. No matter how hard I tried, my work was never good enough. I don't know why he was such a stickler, I mean it's a knot. What difference does it make as long as you can't untie it? It's a knot! Anyway, I was declared unworthy. (Doofenshmirtz's Flash back ends) So now I despise pretzels. And any pretzel related entertainment. And now Danville is having it's own Pretzel Festival! Can you even imagine how angry that makes me? Can you imagine? No? Angry enough to create the De-Twist-inator! We'll see how festive they feel after I turn all those stupid pretzels into boring straight tubes of baked dough, like-like breadsticks, which I also have a problem with, but I'm dealing with one neurosis at a time. And then, when I've straightened all their precious pretzels, I will waltz in, and take over the Tri-State Area. Yeah, I know it doesn't quite follow. I mean I even made a venn diagram. (He hold up a venn diagram, with to circles, not intersecting at all) See, the-the pretzels are here in this circle, and we're talking about taking over the Tri-State Area here, and... Yeah, no intersection, nothing. Hmm. But I'm gonna work it out you'll see.

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: You see here, these tracks indicated, that he went in that direction.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great! Come on, let's check it out!

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: But, the weight was on the balls of his feet instead of the heels, he retraced his steps to here. Voilà! the footprints continue here. This way, the hunt is on!

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Fireside Girls, goggle on. (The Fireside Girls don goggles) He has gone completely animal. He smells us. Pursue!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And when the chickens hatch, that's when the marshmallows kick in. Oh, oh boy, this one really taxed my brain. I am telling you, I am pooped. Anyway, forget the details, the circles are touching so the plan can't miss. Now, I've got a pretzel problem, and I'm about to straighten it out. Hahaha, you see? 'Cause their pretzels, their twisted, their not straight. It's- You like that one Perry the Platypus? I've been saving it up. (Perry twists around in his trap, and using the mist that got stuck to his head, he rips off the sheet tying him down. He then launches himself at Doofenshmirtz, and causes the -inator the fire off a few shots, hitting a girl with curly hair, a yoga class, and a roller coaster)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Buford, what do you think of our super sprinkler? We used low turbulence mechanics, and specific gravity to make the water hold it's shape while in motion.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You had me at super sprinkler.

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: There he is!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Get 'em girls!

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: You cannot escape!

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: You think I am afraid of a little water, bear? Think again! (Brigitte runs after Buford)

Name: Buford
Dialog: What the-?! Aw man.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: She is really serious about getting this patch.

Name: Josette and Collette
Dialog: Oui.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (To Baljeet) Where have you been?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Dude, it is not my problem.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, did you order a bear?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh man, that would have been so funny without the snorkel.

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Move it or lose it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (He comes to the end of the super sprinkler) It just stops? How is that possible?

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: There is nowhere left to run bear!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No! No! Don't look at me.

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Buford?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? Another reason to hate twisting. Curse you Perry the Platypus. (The De-Twist-inator blows up)

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No! I'm not me! I'm somebody else!

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Buford, I know it is you, but why would hide from me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (He sighs heavily) Oh, Brigitte, I've spent years building up my tough-guy street cred. I can bounce back from the fuzzy bear suit, but being in love with a beautiful, sweet, exotic girl like yourself... If people found out about that, my image would be fini

Name: Brigitte
Dialog: Oh, Buford, you silly boy. I'm a well bread, refined European. I would never let the fireside girls know that I was vaguely interested in brute such as you. in fact, (She slaps Buford across the face) au revoir (She swims away)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You okay buddy?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Dreamily) She said she was vaguely interested in me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Stacy on the cell phone) Ok, Stace. I'm all set up. Nothing could get in between me and some good old fashioned vitamin D!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on the cell phone) What about busting your brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't worry. I can do both! (grabs a pair of binoculars) I've got a perfect view of them from where I'm sitting. Oh, yeah, that's what I'm talking about. I'm all up in their grill and they don't have a clue!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams) Hey, don't you know it's rude to sneak up on someone who is trying to spy on you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you know how we do something new everyday?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, well, we try to build some big project or do something...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm aware of the concept, Phineas. I was just being sarcastic.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? Hey, that was pretty good. Wow, I totally fell for it. (to Ferb) Ferb, I totally fell for it...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anyway...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, right, anyway, Ferb and I decided that today, we're gonna let you pick what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me get this straight. You are going to allow me to pick what you are gonna build today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's about the size of it, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Size! That's it! It's got to be huge. No, wait, you built a skyscraper to the moon and who knows where that went. (the camera reveals the current location of the skyscraper) No, if this summer has taught me anything, it's not the size of the project that's important. What matters is proximity. Mom's proximity. (at herself) Think, Candace, think. This could be the most important decision of your entire summer. Something that will make Mom come and see what you are building. Hmm, what will that be? (gasps) A Mom Attractor!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! You mean, like, a big tractor mother with all its little baby tractors?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I mean, a Mom Attractor. A big contraption that will attract Mom so that she'll come home and see what you guys built.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, you heard the lady. (to Ferb) Ferb, she knows what we're gonna do today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How can I help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we're gonna need a list of things that Mom likes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hey, Dad! You know Mom pretty well.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes. I'd like to think so, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm trying to think of things that Mom likes.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, so many things, really. Music, hobbies, you kids. Ooh! You know what she really likes, is my famous rhubarb creme brulee. I used to make it for her all the time when we were dating. Oh, it made her so happy. (Candace leaves but Lawrence doesn't notice her leaving.) You know, I should get out my toque and blowtorch and make one for her today. What a good idea, Candace. Thank you. (notices Candace has left) Candace? Well, all right then.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. Well, let's get down to brass tacks or whatever it is tacks are made of these days. It seems that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up all the polyethylene in town. It's a substance apparently used in disposable baby diapers. It could be an evil scheme or it could just be neutral. Get out there and absorb the situation. Now, since your hovercraft is in the shop, Carl has had to arrange last minute alternative transportation for you.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes. Hello, Agent P. So, yeah, go ahead and put on that fruit hat.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (gets a blowtorch and activates it, releasing a huge blue flame.) Whoo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is this? Some sort of Latin gorilla cha-cha gram? Hola.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ay caramba! Perry the cha-cha gram? I mean, Platy... Obviously, you're Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I was... Use the door! Yeah, that was, uh, hmm, not... Not, uh, good. Oh well. (pushes a button to trap Perry) There, that's better! I much prefer you trussed up in my happy Jump-inator! Which goes with the theme of my new scheme, the Baby-Cry-inator! I know what you're saying. "But, Heinz, you've already done a baby-themed evil plot." But this time, I've really nailed it. Let me explain.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You remember my goody two-shoes brother, Roger, the mayor? It is a well-known fact that no politician can pass up kissing a baby for fear of alienating the electorate. This can be risky, though, because if the baby cries, you can alienate the electorate even worse than if you refuse to kiss the baby in the first place. This has never really been a problem for Roger, though, everybody loves Roger! Babies, voters, dogs, cats, guys with shovels, giant squid, you name it. But this little baby, and by "little baby", I mean enormous baby, is gonna change all of that! Today, when my brother is campaigning, every time he kisses a baby, I will uncork the Baby-Cry-inator, releasing such a wail that the voters will think he is universally hated by babies, and therefore, untrustworthy. I know it sounds complicated but I've thought this one through. Babies cry, everyone's unhappy, and I somehow take over. (a short pause) It's foolproof!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Check it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my mom! That is so cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep. The Attractor will extract the essence of things that Mom loves, and use it to attract Mom! (puts the following things inside an opening on the invention) Things like Mom's Love Händel albums, an assortment of her favorite chocolate and scented candles, and of course, Mom's lucky Viking helmet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why does she have one of those?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Women are a mystery.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's got to be one of the coolest things you've ever built.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes, it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's try it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, uh, I don't hear anything!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's 'cause you're not Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Her cell phone rings.) Hi, Mom. What? You feel a sudden and inexplicable urge to come home? (to Phineas and Ferb) (gasps) It's working! It's functioning properly.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (in a hair salon) Bye, ladies. I have a sudden and inexplicable urge to come home.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace is awesome.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grunts) Hey! Ow! (He sees Perry starting to charge towards the Baby-Cry-inator.) Hey, I wouldn't, I wouldn't do that if I were...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on! Yes! Mom's coming! (Linda is shown running towards the house.) I just wanna remember this moment. Relish it. Revel in it. Bask in the sunlight of pure, busting bliss! (Candace continues to hear the Baby-Cry-inator's wail and wonders where is it coming from.) What is all that racket?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Wait! Mom! (she runs back to the backyard) Phineas and Ferb, why is it not working?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, it's working, Candace. It's just that nothing attracts moms more than the sound of a baby crying!

Name: Mom Attractor
Dialog: (in a robotic voice) Must soothe baby! (runs away from the house)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, apparently, the Mom Attractor has become self-aware. Cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, Mom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wait! (The camera shows the Mom Attractor climbing to the top of the building.) There's too many mommies! Do something!

Name: Mom Attractor
Dialog: Must soothe baby.

Name: Mom 1
Dialog: What am I doing here?

Name: Mom 2
Dialog: My goodness!

Name: Mom 3
Dialog: I better get back to pitching my board.

Name: Mom 4
Dialog: I need to pick up Will from soccer.

Name: Mom 5
Dialog: How did I get here?

Name: P.A. Announcer
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Mayor Roger Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Voter 1
Dialog: What happened to that giant crying baby?

Name: Voter 2
Dialog: Roger Doofenshmirtz came and it just stopped.

Name: Voter 1
Dialog: Babies love him!

Name: Voter 2
Dialog: Four more years!

Name: All
Dialog: Four more years!

Name: Mom 6
Dialog: Oh no! I left a pie in the oven.

Name: Mom 7
Dialog: Who's watching my classroom?

Name: Mom 8
Dialog: My watermelon!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, this place has never looked neater than this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! I just had the place cleaned. Curse you, Perry the Platypus and your destructive, fruit-loving simian friend who doesn't know how to use the door! Curse him, too!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, let go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Phineas and Ferb made a Mom Attractor and it's in the backyard! (opens the door to the backyard) See?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes. (goes through gate) Yes, there is a Mom Attractor in the backyard.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, darling. Look, I made my famous rhubarb creme brulee. Mmm, eh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't mind if I do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But -- they asked me to pick -- and I did -- and it worked -- and now -- it's gone! Where did it go? Where does it always go?!

Name: Baby-Cry-inator
Dialog: Mama.

Name: Mom Attractor
Dialog: There. There.

Name: Linda
Dialog: This is too cool! Whose idea was this?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, it was Candace's, actually.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (referring to Candace) You, my dear, are pretty awesome. (hands the rhubarb creme brulee to Candace.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've got a feeling that today is the day. Even as we speak, my brothers are planning something dangerous, disguised as playing cards!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well I'm out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Me too.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Laughs) Losers.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (enters the backyard) Sorry, I'm late.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's okay. (at Ferb) Deal him in, Ferb.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who came up with cards anyway?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: They were invented by ancient Babylonian traders and merchants.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (while shuffling the cards) Actually, the Babylonians had defunct as a distinct culture for millennium prior to the introduction of playing cards in India.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Gasps) That is right! Three months of summer vacation and I am losing my edge!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Has it only been three months? 'Cause I've been adding up all of the things we built this summer, and we're way over 150!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! My brain is atrophied! It needs exercise!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gang, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who knows?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And here, we have a marvel 16th century wardrobe. We have one just like this when I was a schoolboy. And inside it was another land filled with magical woodland creatures.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ohhh hohoho. You English and your fantasy worlds.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ahahah. Can I show you some tables...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello Agent P, sorry about the trees they were leftovers from Christmas and we didn't have anywhere else to store 'em. Oh, and uh, also the air-conditioning system is on the fritz, so pardon all the frost. All over the Tri-State Area, keys are disappearing. Businesses can't open, the freeways have ground to a halt, citizens are locked out of their homes, and I, for one, would really like to get into the executive washroom. It's got a waterfall, you know you wave your hand to the water just sort of-... well it's...it's really cool. Stop Doofenshmirtz! Quickly!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Look at this! (he shows a X-ray of a brain) This is my brain during the school year... (He then shows the other X-ray) And this is my brain now!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They look just the same.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I know! But it took me three minutes to remember how to give my self a CAT scan! I am slipping!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not to worry, Baljeet. We've done a bit of cerebro-stimulatory haberdashery since you left.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: We made a hat for your brain, slowy. (at Isabella) Boy, he is slippin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Try it on!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What does it do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold on. (Phineas then switch a control box) It stimulates your brain.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh my.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room) An electrical bike helmet? Lame! (she then lie down in bed then dials in her phone) Hey Stacy, you still wanna go to the pool?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Baljeet, how many sub-atomic particles do you suppose...are in that dandelion?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (goes over to the dandelion and picks it) Hmm... (drawing on the fence) Two point seven-three-two times ten to the twenty-sixth power of particles. But I could not tell you the exact location of any of them because of the Heisenberg uncertainty principle.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Seems like it works.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? You know, you could've waited till I put my pants on, that would've...least been polite. And do you know what we do to rude people around here? (presses remote, trapping Perry in a capsule) We put them in a water soluble capsule. Ha ha! And there's not enough platypus spit in the world to get you out of it. Yeah, hop this way, let me show you what I've been up to.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Keys, keys, keys! Master keys, skeleton keys, latch keys, skate keys, I love keys! And you know, take it from me, (on the roof) once you've accidentally locked yourself in a milk can full of cockroaches for a couple of hours, you'll—you'll develop a real appreciation. But uh, collecting keys one at a time takes forever! That's why I've invented

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, look at him go.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's like a new man!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah, he still gets de-pansed one leg at a time.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This is great! With my stimulated brain, I am dreaming up all sorts of super smart projects!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Picked out a favorite?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have! You see, the greatest impediment to making astronomical observations, is our atmosphere. It is like looking through pea soup! So to make our terrestrial telescopes more effective, I am going to take all of the Earth

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: s atmosphere, and put it on the moon! (shows poster that shows what he's saying)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't...um...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sounds... suffocatey.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aw, I will disintegrate that bridge when I come to it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But Baljeet, if the atmosphere is gone --

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And it is so simple! I can use an ion coupling device to attract each atmospheric molecule to the second greatest gravity source, which in this case, is the moon, and after the initial impact...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (At the camera) He is so hard-core!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: ...the particles will bounce up into lunar orbit! Blue skies on the moon! Imagine that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet? Can I talk to you for a second?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Of course! I will just use small words!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So...uh, we were hoping we could talk you out of transferring the Earth's atmosphere to the moon.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: On the eve of my greatest triumph? (starts fidgeting)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we were just thinking it would be sort of a hollow victory, you know, with everybody not being able to breathe anymore?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (stops fidgeting) Science marches on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, thanks! Brain booster, in retrospect...not such a good idea.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think Brain Boy's had enough stimulation for one day. (tries to touch the control unit but gets shocked) Ow! Hey, that hurts!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! Yes, it does! This way my work will not be interrupted by creatures who cannot possibly understand it! Like raccoons, or people, for instance.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I was so looking forward to Junior High.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going to have to get into that tower. Any ideas?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, so the, uh, Key to the City ceremony's not starting for a while so, uh...we got some...Oh, you know, I-I just realized that I'm...I'm wearing a white lab coat and I'm leaning back against a black tire. That's... (sighs) I think I might have to go change.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (over monitor) Maybe we could each get a tool, and come at him from four different sides.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (over monitor) Baljeet is way to smart to fall for a trick like that.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Plot all you want, I have my eye on you! No one will be able to stop me from stripping away the Earth's atmosphere! Oh, the things I will be able to see!

Name: Phineas recording
Dialog: He was smart before, but now he's like a super genius!

Name: Isabella recording
Dialog: Maybe, we should try flattery to win him over.

Name: Buford recording
Dialog: Or, how 'bout a bribe?

Name: Phineas recording
Dialog: I don't think we could offer him anything that would satisfy his super intellect.

Name: Isabella recording
Dialog: Yeah, he's so amazingly smart, now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, gang. This is our change to attack the Atmospheric Device.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's bound to notice that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Exactly!

Name: Buford
Dialog: This is just busy work, isn't it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Jetpacks? I thought you were -- (picks up Isabella's decoy) Wood pulp effigies? Ha ha ha ha! Clever, but not clever enough!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aww! I got you in my tractor beam! (starts pushing buttons) Time to strip the atmosphere from our planet, and allow an unobstructed view of the cosmos!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Danville Pool, Here I...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sternly) Hello, Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh-huh? Uh-huh. That would count as dangerous. But I can't go anywhere until I find my keys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! Great mad scientist weather, isn't it, Perry the Platypus? It's so dramatic! Ooh, the ceremony should be starting now.

Name: Roger
Dialog: And now, it is my pleasure to present the Key to the City to this great humanitarian and American.

Name: Recipient
Dialog: Th-thank you, thank you. Um, you know, when I set out to reinvent the ball-peen hammer -- (inator ray hits the key) HEY!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got it! I've got it! (at Perry) There, you see? I told you it was water solu -- (Perry's capsule melts and he punches him) OH!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Only a few more seconds to my greatest triumph! I wonder what I will do tomorrow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (over speaker) Attention, Baljeet! Prepare to surrender!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha! Surrender to whom? You are frozen!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (over speaker) Are we?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is not possible! Well, I mean, clearly, it is possible, but highly unlikely. Prepare to be --

Name: Buford
Dialog: SURPRISE! (pulls Baljeet's helmet off and sees his giant brain) OH! OH! Oh, that is SO GROSS! But it's kinda awesome.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Something is different. (at Buford) How did you get in here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We tunneled up through the base while you were busy with our jetpack decoys.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not understand.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, remember when we all made those life-sized stuffed models of ourselves this morning?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It pays to show up on time.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I will get an alarm clock.

Name: Electronic voice
Dialog: Two minutes to atmospheric transfer.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh! It is too late! I do not understand the controls anymore!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Didn't you build a fail-safe or something?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: YES! Of course! It is right here, and the key is right on that hook! (notices there isn't a key and gasps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here it comes! Here it comes! (gets the key) Ha ha! I got it! At last, I, Heinz Doofenshmirtz, can open any door with this, the Key to the City—you know, I can't believe it's cartoonishly big. It's almost like it's not a real key, but just sort of, symbolic of a key. It's... (sees Perry) Hey, what are you doing?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, whatever, Perry the Platypus. (as Perry leaves) I got what I want! This giant, metal key that, when I think about it, is probably too big to fit into any of the keyholes that I would ever come across. Which makes me question the whole val -- (gets shocked by lightning)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I'll just call the -- (her keys land in her hand, followed by the man and woman behind her) Oh, for goodness sake! They were in my hand the whole time!

Name: Electronic
Dialog: Nine, eight, seven, six, five, four...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: AAAAAHHHHH! WHERE IS THE KEY?! WHERE IS IT?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Is this it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes!!

Name: Electronic voice
Dialog: ...three, two, one.

Name: Electronic voice
Dialog: Atmospheric Transfer terminated.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (sighs)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We should do something about that helmet, huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: No! No, you should not! (he is wearing the helmet) I used my now vastly superior intellect to build the world's largest wedgie machine!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Boy, you try to eliminate the atmosphere one time...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Backyard!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Something is...different.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (opens her eyes) But there was a -- monstrous building here just a second ago!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, it pays to be on time. (at the kids) Who wants pie?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know I do!

Name: Buford/Isabella/Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, me!/Me, me, me!/Me, me, me!/Me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to get an alarm clock.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, I'm going out to a birthday party.

Name: Candace
Dialog: For who?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know Vivian's aunt's sister's landlord's son?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Evan?

Name: Linda
Dialog: His son.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dexter?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah. It's his birthday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why do they even have parties for two-year-olds? It's not like they're going to remember anything.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Baby parties aren't for the babies, Candace. They're for the moms.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The moms?

Name: Linda
Dialog: So they can feel rewarded for all the hard work they do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) Toddlers are easy. They eat, they poop, they sleep. End of story.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're a laugh riot, Candace. (starts to leave) Think you can handle watching Phineas and Ferb today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Piece of cake.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Have fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm. Time to be in charge.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So what you're saying is that we should never cut the red wire first.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, you two, I'm in charge and I'm gonna lay down some rules!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, shoot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No leaving the yard, no amusement park rides, no robots, no rocket ships, (in background) no time chairs, no remote-controlled llamas, (onscreen) no first edition issuing of commemorative coins, no asking where Perry is, no astrological planetary alignments...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (While Candace is talking) Ferb, are you getting all of this? (Ferb holds up a miniature tape recorder) Cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Surprise! It's me! I've taken over the OWCA!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, no, he hasn't, Agent P.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, spoilsport.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz claims to have given up evil. He even signed this "I Give Up Evil" affidavit to apply for work at the agency. And normally, we could have rejected him because he's not an animal, but it turns out he was adopted by ocelots, making him, in the eyes of law, an ocelot.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to do this to you, Agent P, but we're making Doofenshmirtz your responsibility during his probation period. Show him the ropes, and, uh, don't let him out of your sight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're probably wondering why I suddenly decided to quit evil and become a good guy. Well you see, I'd just built an inator. I called it the Babe-inator! No, it's not what you think. It's purpose was to transform my brother, the Mayor, and all of his cronies into a bunch of crying babies. That way I could take City Hall like babies taking candy away from... whatever they take candy... Aw, you know what I mean. Anyway, the Babe-inator was ready to go, so I took aim at my brother's office and pressed the button, but it didn't work! It didn't work for, like, the hundredth time! My evil plan did not work! And I thought to myself, "Maybe I'm just not good at being evil." That's when I had my epiphany. From now on, I'm going to be a good guy! So, here I am!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, my own cubicle. (Agent Kitty joins him and Perry) How nice! I'm gonna put a poster, right here, with a kitten that says, "Hang in there." (Doofenshmirtz turns and sees Agent Kitty; chuckles awkwardly) No offense. It's not like I think that's all you guys do, or anything. (Agent Kitty walks off) Oh, great, now he's going to Human Resources.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Oopsies! Better plug this in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And no invisible paint.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh. I don't know how you turned yourselves into babies, but that is sooo bustable! (Holds up her phone) Smile and say, "Hi, Mom!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now, you two are so... (Gasps) Where did they go? (goes off-screen and Ferb comes on) Come back here! No, put the power drill down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You stay right...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb! No, get back here with my phone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, would you look at that! Newton the Gnu is Agent Silent G. Whoo! I have to blog this. (Notices agents walking by with cups of coffee) Hmm, must be a coffee break. (Computer screen starts blinking saying "security breach" and he turns it off without looking)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Find the picture and send.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, they used to be so cute.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Thanks for the old baby picture." (Sighs) Ooh, wait! I need something with today's date on it. I could take a picture of them with one of those old-fashioned things. It's like a web page with... printed on paper... A newspaper! Ha-ha! (Runs around trying to get Ferb to hold the paper) Okay, stop and hold the paper. Ferb, sweetie? Okay, just stand here and... No! No, don't run away! Wait! Hold it! No, no, no, no. Get back here. How about if we just sit? Then hold the paper. (Ferb throws it) We don't... We... No, don't throw it. Wait! (Candace gives up on Ferb and goes to Phineas) Okay, just hold this. Stay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gah! (Throws the paper)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, no! No throwing. (Phineas crawls to her phone) We use our... (Phineas licks her phone) Ew! (Phineas throws it and it hits Candace) Ow! (Candace tries again on Ferb) Okay, hold this, Ferb. Now, I'll just... Where's my phone?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gah! (Throws her phone into a bird bath)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, fine! Okay, if pictures won't work, I'll just take you to Mom myself! I know we have an old stroller around here somewhere. (Candace finds a stroller and straps in Phineas and Ferb and they fall asleep) That's it, go right to sleep. You'll be busted in just a little bit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So then, the duck says, "got any grapes?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh, it looks like, uh, coffee break's over.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Enter. (Doofenshmirtz and Perry enter) Agent P, we have a situation.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is this about that grape joke? Who told on me? Was it the duck?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not why I called you in. Get a look at this. This is Newton the Gnu. He was assigned to Dr. Diminutive, but it seems some bonehead blew his cover on the blogosphere.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We still haven't found out who it was. In the meantime, we need you to bring him in. Get on it, Agent P, and, uh, take Doofenshmirtz with you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A ride-along? Sweet! I can wear my new fedora!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get out of here! (Doofenshmirtz and Perry leave and Carl walks by with a mail cart) Carl, get in here! When you're done delivering the mail, I want you to wash and wax my car. You know, a little wax on, wax off? It'll teach you karate!

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, it won't.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am loving this! We're all like partners, now! Like Jack and Jill, or Alice and Wonderland! And with a super-cool vehicle!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Be careful out there... (looks at Carl) ...washing my car. Don't scratch it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, look at these buttons! What does this one do? (he pushes a button which launches a missile) Whoa! Oh, yeah, this is way cool!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: DOOFENSHMIRTZ!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles) Wait till Mom sees you guys. (Baby Ferb starts crying) Shh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I didn't do anything! He's my brother, just a baby. They cry you know. (Now Baby Phineas start crying now he cried with him then puts Ferb back his stroller) I know! Toys! I buy you some toys; that's what makes babies stop crying! (pushes the stroller towards a store that coincidentally sells baby things) Oh, thank you. (the stroller gets stuck in the door) I'll just be a second, okay? Don't go anywhere. Stay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This apartment seems familiar. Hey, do you mind if I kick down the door? (he does so, proceeding to get his foot stuck)

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (opens door) Ugh, Doofenshmirtz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awkward!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Why are you wearing a fedora?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm a good guy now! I believe you've met my partner?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (gasps) Perry the Platypus? Stay away from me!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (laughing) Fools! That was only my hologram!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't worry. I've got your back, partner.

Name: Dr Diminutive
Dialog: (traps Doofenshmirtz and Perry) I trapped you in a particle bubble from my new Photon 2000 Particle Bubble-erator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, brother! 2000 was so 4,000 days ago!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Perhaps you'd like to join your friend, Newton the Gnu in his decidedly ordinary acrylic prison. Can you believe it? I was having him over for a friendly dinner, when I read your blog telling me that Newton the Gnu is really Agent Silent G!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't help it! I blog what I see!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've got some baby stuff!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! Get back here!

Name: Robber
Dialog: (coming out of store with bags of money) Suckers! (chuckles) Oh, my bike. (the police pull up) Oh, good, the cops are here! I can report this vandalism to the...

Name: Police
Dialog: (pulls out a gun) Put your hands up!

Name: Robber
Dialog: (he does so) Oh, that's right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, get back here!

Name: Phineas/Ferb
Dialog: (cooing)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, playtime's over. We've got a party to get to.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Due to your request, Heinz, I've decide to let you all go. From 40 stories up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just for the record, that's not exactly what I meant.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Yeah, I know. (drops them off of building)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as he and Agents P & Silent G fall) What do you guys think? How am I doing so far?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Hey, give it back!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Uh-oh. Oh, poop.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hang on, boys! I'm gonna bounce us back to headquarters! Yee-haw!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry about your car, sir. (presents a hubcap to Major Monogram) This is all I could find. (gasps)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, this is just not working out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Mom! I've found a couple of babies that you need to see!

Name: Ginger/Adyson
Dialog: Babies? Oh, let me help! We'll take good care of them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, what are you guys doing here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're helping Mom's aunt's sister's landlord son.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I need to show you something.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's humiliating! I'm stuck in this crummy, little cubicle while my office gets repaired! Anyway, Agent P, due to your quick action and decisive action, you were able to rescue Agent Silent G. Doofenshmirtz, you're fired.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is it because I blew up your car?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, it's because I have a list of complaints from Human Resources.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, it was the duck! (Looks at the duck. The dog and crocodile do the same)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let's face it. You've done more damage inside the Agency than you ever did outside.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, what you're saying is that I'm good at being evil after all! (calls Norm) Norm, we're back in business! Dust off the inators! (hangs up) Later, chumps!

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'll start with this one!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, these aren't babies that look like Phineas and Ferb. This is Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking loudly) Okay, I get it. Lesson learned. Toddlers aren't easy! The irony is not lost in me! Little help here? Ugh, this had better wear off before the next episode.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Boy, it seems like summer flies by so fast sometimes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, before we know it, it'll be autumn.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! Back to school, baby! ...Oh, you meant that like a bad thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There are a lot of great things about the fall. Jumping in giant leaf piles. Perfect example.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, the leaves turn such pretty colors in the fall. I love it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gourds. Gourds are great ...What? I like gourds.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we should do today. Remember how we made "S'Winter"? Let's make "S'Fall"! Hey, where's "S'Perry"?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Did I ever tell you you're like the son that I never had?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Really, sir!?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes. It's because you're so unlike the son that I did have! And here he is. Come on over here, Monty!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad, come on. You know it's embarrassing when you brag about me by belittling others.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Right, sorry. Agent P, uh, you remember my son?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah, good to see you, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Monty here just graduated from HSWACA! The High School Without A Cool Acronym.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yes. I hope to follow in my father's footsteps and join you in the battle against evil.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You know, son, I've been meaning to tell you something.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Sure, Dad, shoot.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, as you know, my father was in the agency, and what you don't know is that he pressured me into following in his footsteps. But I always wanted to be an acrobat!

Name: Monty
Dialog: So that explains...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, the constant acrobatic lessons you've been given since birth. You, Monty Monogram, don't have to give up my dream of becoming an acrobat. You can be anything you want to be.

Name: Monty
Dialog: But, Dad, I want to fight evil.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? After all that money we spent on acrobat training? (Perry gains an awkward expression)

Name: Monty
Dialog: I never asked for that!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I'll become an acrobat if it'll make you proud of me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Really? Hmm. (Takes Carl off for the acrobatic training but comes back to the screen) Oh, yeah, Agent P, uh, stop Doof. (Perry glares at him)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: A video game is more important than me? That's it! I'm done! We are so over, Johnny!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Vanessa! Let me introduce Rodrigo to you. He's starting evil science school in the fall and I'm mentoring him. I'm in mid-ment.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Call me Rod.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Is that what your friends call you?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: No one calls me that. It's just that you seem rather unique.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, what's wrong, Vanessa? You seem upset.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Nothing. It's just... Johnny, he's such a boy. I'm sick of it. No ambition, no depth...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You always go for the wrong type of guy, these bad-boy types.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, perhaps you haven't noticed but you're evil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, there's good evil and then there's bad evil. Am I right, Rodrigo?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Huh? Exactly.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, how do we get all the leaves down, anyway?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Way ahead of you. Grab an end. (Hands Baljeet a saw)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford! You can't! That's Phineas's tree. That's the tree!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sentimentality or leaves. You can't have both.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Au contraire. If you would kindly direct your attention to Ferb, who is modeling this "s'fall" season's fashion in rapid leaf production accelerators.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh-la-la, Monsieur Fletcher.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anyway, Stacy, so I decided that from now on, I'm going to stop always interrupting my life with all these stu... (gasps as she sees the leaves blocking the door) Stacy, I gotta call you back. Oh I see. So they think they can stop me from seeing whatever giant project they're working on today by plastering leaves all over the door, huh? Well, it's not gonna work! A-ha! ...Um, they've built a big wall of leaves to block the door! Well, I'll just dig in here and, uh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now that's a leaf pile.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Backstory! Backstory! Backstory! (Breaks his pointer.) The backstory is what drives an evil scientist. It is the "Why does he do what he does?" of the "What does he do?" (Accidentally throws a broken half of the pointing rod, causing a cat to yowl.) My point is, at its best, evil science is like undergoing deep Freudian analysis with a theremin constantly playing in the background.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, guys, it's such a beautiful day. I thought maybe we could put the top down?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, okay.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: See, you are the best...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No tattoo.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Shoot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! Just in time...To be trapped!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now that's what I call getting the boot!

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Wow! A real agent!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See, now that's a trap! I even made it based on my own daughter's fashion style. Vampire-pilgrim-scuba-diver.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What? Is that what you think I look lik... Wait, you made this? What size is it?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Excuse me the interrupting, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, but he can get out of there fairly easy, no?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, duh, the trap only needs to hold him for just enough time for you to get through your evil scheme monologue. At that point, your nemesis escapes and the race is on! Who will win, good or evil? No one can say, except, of course, if you go by recent statistics which, it's pretty much good who wins every single time. No matter what. But, hey, if it was easy, everyone would take over the Tri-State Area, right? Every single person would be in charge and we'd be forced to, I don't know, decide the rules together by voting or something.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: I see. It's just that I took a few advanced trap classes in school and I was hoping to show you, the master, a few of my little ideas in the hopes that you could critique them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, all right, knock yourself out.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Don't worry, little platypus agent. When I'm through here, you'll no longer have to battle this inept loser anymore. Because, you see, I plan to get rid of both of you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, now we've determined that the sweet spot for entering the pile is right here, at the top.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, and I made gourd helmets, by the way. (Buford starts giving the gourd helmets to his friends.) Here. Here. No, wait, Baljeet, this is yours. Phineas. I like to think each individual's gourd helmet captures their unique essence in some way, you know, in gourd.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Exactly how does this capture my essence?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Right, like that's not obvious.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, come on. Stop kidding around, Isabella. Oh I think we're over the drop zone. Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to "s'fall"!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? What are they up to today? Do they really think they can escape Mom's wrath by hiding in this fun, massive, glorious, autumnal leaf pile? Well, not if I can help it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, how does it feel, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I thought so.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Wait, you can understand him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, heck no, I usually just pretend he's talking about recent movies I've seen.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Trying on Doofenshmirtz's boot trap) So, uh, you didn't by any chance make a left-boot trap, did you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (scoffs) A left-boot trap? Whoever heard of such a thing?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Uh, Dad? This looks pretty serious.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nonsense. The Zoondilini under swing is child's play.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, should both my shoulders be dislocated from their sockets, sir?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Using my intimate knowledge of the Tri-State Area, I have installed, in two precise locations, these!

Name: Random person
Dialog: (at a vendor) Yay! Falafel!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know, huh? These massive propellers will physically dislodge the entire Tri-State Area from the Earth and raise it up into the sky where I will then pilot it around and you know, run some errands or something, and refuse to return it, until they make me their leader. (Doofenshmirtz activates the propellers, dislodging the Tri-State Area from the Earth.) Hmm. Well, that went well.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Extremely well. (He pushes a button that activates a hidden trap that ties Doofenshmirtz's legs together.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is this like a robot hug for a job well done?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: No. It's a trap! What does that even mean, a robot hug for a job well... Who would even consider that a possibility!? I'm taking over your evil scheme, you fool! (He pushes a button that pulls Doofenshmirtz away from the controls.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, look out! Wha... (She tries to move but she's wearing Perry's boot trap, which is attached to the floor.) Oh, you have got to be kidding me.

Name: Rodrigo
