Dialog: (Explains his plan using the blackboard that Doofenshmirtz used earlier.) You see, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, I'm going to manipulate your propellers at precise angles and literally tear the Tri-State Area apart!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, hey, dummy, if you destroy the Tri-State Area, what exactly will you have left to take over? Hmm?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: The world.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Take over the world? Tha..That's crazy! That's almost left-boot-trap crazy!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, would you get off that? Making matching boots is normal. You with the one boot, that's what's crazy.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Join me, Vanessa, and together we will take over the world. I'll let you get a tattoo. I think boots should come in pairs, like people.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Join you? I don't work for him. That's my father, you dweeb.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: Well, yeah, I just thought we had a moment.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (scoffs) A moment?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, I know. What a dip, right?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: No matter. Now, time to say goodbye to your beloved Tri-State Area!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Huh? Great googly moogly! Combining fighting evil with acrobatics? Of course! It was right in front of my face the whole time. That's my boy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gourd helmet. (Places a gourd helmet on Candace as she slides by.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: A-ha! I got you now! Ooooh, you are so busted! I can see that you're eating... candy apples. Not something I can bust you for.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You want one, Candace?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, how about this one? (He pushes a button which frees himself.) Good. Okay, well, at least I can still go on with my plan. (He manipulates the propellers in a vertical position. He raises the Tri-State Area once again.) I should go pick up my dry cleaning before it gets too...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (from inside) Kids, I'm home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (Runs to her) Mom! The boys are up to something huge! I just know it! But they've hidden it within a massive pile of leaves in the backyard. Come help me sort through them for a few hours to find it! (Pulls her out)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Wow. Sounds great.

Name: Linda
Dialog: No leaves? No nothing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No leaves, no nothing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (at the boys and their friends) Do you guys already have snacks?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We do, thanks!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (With disdain) My work here is done. (Straightens Candace's gourd helmet and leaves) Nice gourd helmets, though.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, who's up for "sprummer"?

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: (grunts)

Name: Monty
Dialog: Okay, you got it from here, Agent P.

Name: Rodrigo
Dialog: But, Vanessa, I thought you liked bad boys?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Eh, I'm over it. I think it's time I tried a... (She watches Monty leave using a jet-pack. Monty looks at her and smiles before leaving.) A good guy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, Candace, I'm headed out to the zoo to do my volunteer work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Which means I'm in charge.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, not really, 'cause Dad's here. Right, honey?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: That's right, dear.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And now back to Horse in a Bookcase.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiling and opening the door for her mother) Bye, Mom! Have fun at the zoo!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hello, Candace. Are Phineas and Ferb here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. (closes door. A knock is heard. She opens it and Irving reappears) Yes?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Can I see them?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Probably not from there. (Closes the door again. Another knock is heard. She opens it.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: I would like to visit with my friends Phineas and Ferb. Could I please come in?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, why didn't you say so?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (walks in with a tablet device in his hand) I am sure you would like to know what it is I am holding in my hands.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nope.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Well, if you insist. Behold, the Ultimate Phineas and Ferb Digital Scrapbook! UPAFDS for short. (Pronounced as "Up-af-ds")

Name: Candace
Dialog: Up-a-feds?

Name: Irving
Dialog: UPAFDS!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatevs. (exits)

Name: Irving
Dialog: It's a digital compilation of Phineas and Ferb's creations!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (skidding back in) Phineas and Ferb's creations?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, see? (He flips through the device, which includes photos of the rollercoaster, Candace's head on Mt. Rushmore, the chariot race, the treehouse robots, and the rocketship to space) It's everything they've done over the summer.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's perfect! Could I just borrow that for a—

Name: Irving
Dialog: Foo-foo-foo-foo-foo! The UPAFDS does not leave my person!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Irving! Is that the UPAFDS?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Why, yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Let's see!

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: (on TV) We interrupt Horse in a Bookcase to bring you this breaking news bulletin. Little Crikey the Crocodile has gone missing. Kids everywhere remember little Crikey the Crocodile from his popular show, Little Crikey the Crocodile.

Name: Hobo Dan
Dialog: I dunno, I just thought it would be nice for Crikey to take a ride, get some fresh air. Uh, but a couple of speed bumps later, badda-bing, badda-boom, no Crikey! I just hope he's okay.

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Search parties are looking in the swamp areas in Danville, but nobody has seen any sign of him.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're wasting their time in that swampy marsh. Everyone knows crocodiles head for the sewers. That's where we need to look. Tiny Crikey needs our help. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ferb, I know what I'm gonna do today, too!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, Ferb, I know what I'm gonna take today—I mean borrow—I mean—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Ray Liotta
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I know what you're thinking

Name: Young Monogram's Voice
Dialog: Hey, uh, Ray, I...I just did a favor for you.

Name: Young Liotta's Voice
Dialog: Thanks, Francis. I owe you big.

Name: Ray Liotta
Dialog: Anyway, our web monitors tell us that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been frequenting websites and blogs dedicated to chickens and chicken-related jokes. We don't know what that means, but it's gotta be something fowl. We need you to get out there and take him down a peg! (Perry salutes) Good luck, Agent P! (Perry leaves and Liotta laughs) That felt great, Carl! Fighting evil like that, I was like zing, wow, yeah! Why did I ever drop out of the Academy to become a big Hollywood star when I'm needed here?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, to be fair, sir, you do get paid more than we do.

Name: Ray Liotta
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So tell me exactly how you plan to catch this crocodile.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Simple. We'll use the Crocolocator. See that blip straight ahead of us? That's Crikey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that other dot?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh. Well, apparently, there's buried treasure down here. Eh, maybe some other day.

Name: Irving
Dialog: This is so exciting!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, Irving, (taking the UPAFDS) maybe I should keep this safe while we—

Name: Irving
Dialog: (swiping it back) Foo-foo-foo-foo! I am sorry, Candace, as much as I have great reverence for you, the UPAFDS does not leave my person...EVAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooh, all I wanna do is show it to Mom!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh! Well, sure. As soon as we're done with the mission, we can show her to your mother.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? I can just show her to—Wait a minute, did you just call it a "her"?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, "her", see? (falsetto) "Hi, Candace, I'm the UPAFDS! And I'm a girl!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anyway, as soon as we're done finding this little crocodile, it's straight to Mom with the evidence! (to her brothers) Come on! Move it move it move it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the spirit, sis!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are going down, down, DOOOOOOWWWWWWWWWNNNNNN!!!!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who is it? (Perry chatters on the intercom) Oh, Perry the Platypus, come on up. (He pushes the door button and giggles to himself and sneaks behind a chair. He peers from behind to laugh again. Perry opens the door and runs in. Doofenshmirtz jumps from behind the chair with a remote.) Aha! (He pushes the button and a net falls down on him.) Okay, I chalk that up to poor planning...again. (gives Perry a newspaper) Anyhow, look at this. Can you believe it? My goody two-shoes brother is getting an award for being the best Danville mayor ever for the second year in a row! And he's only been mayor for one year! I am going to make sure he never gets that award! Uh, you see, people used to laugh at me all the time. I know it's hard to believe now, but it's true. They would laugh at me. And would they laugh at my brother? No! Never! Of course not! Well, things are about to change. Thanks to my brand new Chicken-Replace-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This beautiful device replaces anything it hits with a chicken! How funny will that be? Roger gets handed the award, and suddenly, it's a chicken! Ha ha! And not just chicken, but the nearest chicken! Which, when you think about it, saves a lot of energy. I mean, why pull some chicken from halfway around the world when, uh, there might be one available right around the cornerrrrrrruh? (takes off the net and throws it onto Perry) Ah, this is much better. Anyway, like I was saying, all I have to do is point this at Roger just as they're handing him his award, and zap! He goes from prestigious mayor with a major award to just some guy holding a chicken. I mean, have you ever seen anyone not laugh at a chicken? Chicken laugh! Chicken laugh! It's obligatory.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Crocolocator says he should be right here. Maybe there's some other way to track him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, puh-leez. I'm all the equipment you'll ever need. I mean, hello, let us not forget that I wrestled a ferocious alligator. (Unbeknownst to her, a giant crocodile appears behind her.) A scrappy little crocodile is nothing for a pro like me. (to the crocodile behind her) I'n' that right? (Her eyes pop in sudden realization)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oh. Looks like Little Crikey grew up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She must be getting a bigger net.

Name: Irving
Dialog: We're gonna need another boat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on his walkie-talkie) Isabella, execute Plan B!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Roger that, Phineas! We're on our way! Okay, girls, let's light 'em up!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Lord, look at the size of that gator! Ha-ha!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, that's one mean gator.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice short cut, we're right behind her. Hey, what happened to Buford and Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Come on! She is getting away!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gimme a second. If I eat nine, the tenth one is free!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes, there he is. The second he takes that award, bazing! There it is. It's chicken time, baby! (Perry throws the net back onto Doofenshmirtz) The net? Again? (takes it off) Really? You know somethin'... What are you doin'? (Perry hits the inator with a wrench and breaks the pedestal) Careful with that! (Doofenshmirtz catches the inator) Perry the Platypus, you are gonna get such a chickening! (He zaps the wrench which is replaced by a chicken.) Ah! (He zaps something down below. Cut to a posh old lady with a dog. The dog gets replaced by a chicken. The lady laughs. Doofenshmirtz zaps it again. It zaps a car, which gets replaced by a giant chicken. The man in the car laughs. A crossing guard is then replaced by a chicken. Two boys crossing laugh.) I hope you're noting this, Perry the Platypus! Chicken laugh! Chicken laugh! See?! I told ya!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, aim your boat for the middle tube!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you did it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, come out, come out, wherever you are. You've got an appointment with the nearest chicken. I've got something that I need to— (He gets startled as he sees Perry standing in front of him) Now, prepare to be turned into a— (Perry takes out a rubber chicken) Huh, what is that? A rubber chicken? (Perry puts the rubber chicken into the inator's beak) What are you gonna do with... Actually, that's kinda funny. No matter! Prepare to meet your chicken! (He activates the inator, which starts to inflate and overheat) What the heck's wrong with this? Oh boy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no!! (Kaboom! We hear massive clucking inside)

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I don't believe it! I go to the store for fifteen minutes and when I get back, I find that you've turned our Nearest Chicken Farm into a swap meet!

Name: Farmer
Dialog: And what did you buy, dear?

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: Frozen lasagna. They were on special two for one, so I bought two, I figured we could have one tonight and then we could have the other one when your sister and her husband...Ah d-don't change the subject!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look, it's chickens! It's (groans) I guess chickens aren't as funny as I thought.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Candace, that was fantastic! The way you handled the boat and brought Crikey to safety! You are one pretty awesome big sis!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids! Hey! How did Crikey get here? They must've brought him in while I was at lunch. Candace, why are you sitting on a chicken?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs out) Wait right here, Mom! I've got evidence!

Name: Linda
Dialog: But why was she sitting on a chicken?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know, Mom. (chuckles) It's actually kinda funny.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (running up to Irving and grabbing the UPAFDS) Hehehehehehe... Give me that nerd box! I'm tired of being nice!

Name: Irving
Dialog: No way! I told you, the UPAFDS does not leave my person eveeer!!!

Name: Candace and Irving
Dialog: Oh no!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You ate my evidence, you overgrown lizard!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There you are, Perry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just can't believe it's gone!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Aw, don't be blue. All we've gotta do is wait a couple of hours—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew, disgusting!

Name: Irving
Dialog: What? My brother will be here with my backup. What were you think— (realizes) Oh, that is disgusting!

Name: Candace's Brain
Dialog: Has it come to this? (looks closer) Just standing out in the yard, (Camera zooms out, showing Phineas and Ferb sitting by the tree) Staring at your brothers, waiting? (Zoom into Phineas and Ferb) They're gonna do something bustable, I know it.

Name: Candace's Brain
Dialog: (Gasps) It's Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Flips the phone open) I know who it is! (Speaks into the phone) Hi!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey! Wanna come over today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, yeah, just checking out the situation around here. (At Phineas, covering the phone) Uh, Phineas, do you know what you're gonna do today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No jetpacks? No volleyball? No "Where's Perry"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope, nothing yet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (At phone) Yeah, I think I'm free. I'll be right over.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Cool! See ya in a bit! (Hangs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Off-screen) Hey Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! (Close up of Candace, who is wide-eyed) Let's build jetpacks...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! (Bends down)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Off-screen) ...And play Volleyball!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ohh!! (Drops to her knees and drops her phone. She calls Jeremy) Uh, Jeremy, why don't you come over here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace, you seen Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I want to apologize for my appearance. You see, I was up all night monitoring Doofenshmirtz. It seems that-- zzzzzzzzzzzz.... Yeah, I'll have cake.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Off-screen) Sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Wakes up) --Up all night, uh, building inators. See what he's-- zzzzzzzzzz....

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Off-screen) I think you can go, Agent P.

Name: Candace's Brain
Dialog: Ah yes, now that's bustable behavior. You should tell Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (whispering) Stop telling me what to do. (At Mom) Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Jeremy's on his way over here right now. I've got like 5-10 minutes to get the whole "Busting-Phineas-and-Ferb" thing over so I can relax and we can enjoy our Saturday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Linda (While her eyes are on the book) Yeah, chapter almost done. (Looks at Candace) Front yard or backyard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back. Kitchen door.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Done and done.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Wearing a jetpack and has a volleyball in his hand) Hey, Candace! Jetpack Volleyball? This is a great idea! You're gonna join us, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, yeah! I'll be up in just a second. I just got something I gotta do. (Closes door)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm ready for our little charade.

Name: Candace's Brain
Dialog: (while Candace blocks the door) Mom can't see this! We don't want to get Jeremy in trouble! You've got to keep Mom inside!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs off) Oh, Mom! Don't be so silly! You can't go out there until we've uh, uh... (Stammers, pushes Mom to the dishwasher) Unloaded the dishwasher, right! (Chuckles) Right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: But they're not dry yet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh they'll dry, Mom. (Grasps her shoulder) Things dry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh-kee.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On a cell phone) You really think I need aluminum siding? (Perry crashes through the roof and lands on one knee with a hand to the ground.) Oh, oops, gotta go, I got a guest. (hangs up, turns around and claps) Well, Perry the Platypus. Oh, hey, nice landing pose. See, that would kill my knees. (Pushes a remote) Haha!! You're trapped! (Two floorboards come out and trap him.) Let's talk about what you've been up to, Perry the Platypus. You've been sneaking into my lair secretly and building inators in the middle of the night! (Perry looks confused) Oh, don't act all so innocent. Every morning when I wake up, there's a new inator. Look! See? Three of 'em! (Cut to the inators. Cut back to Perry, who shrugs.) Re-Really, you didn't do it? If it wasn't you, then who was it? I mean, you and I are the only ones who are ever here, which is sad in and of itself. B-But I'm not building them in my sleep! (gasps) Wait, that's it! I'm sleep-inventing! That's fabulous!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, look at you. So evil. I wonder what you do. Le-Le-Let's see. (He activates the first inator. It zaps a table, which turns into confetti.) Wait, how is confetti evil? I mean, it makes a mess, sure, but i-is it really evil? (walks up to the second inator) Alright, let's try this one. (He activates it, it zaps a couch, which turns into a giant cupcake.) A big cupcake? (Walks up to the cupcake) Well, maybe it tastes evil. Yes. (He dips his finger into the frosting and puts his finger in his mouth.) Mmm, yes, chocolate!!! The most evil flavor in— (sighs) Who am I kidding? This is delicious. (Walks to the third inator.) Let's see what this one does. Oh, Norm!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Does someone need their spelling checked?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No. I just wanted to do this! (He zaps Norm with the inator.)

Name: Norm
Dialog: How about a hug?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A huginator?!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (walking up to Doofenshmirtz) Unable to resist hugging impulse.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (walking back against the wall) No! No! Noooooo!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? I told you they would dry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh...uh...so, Mom, do you have everything for dinner tonight? Maybe you ought to go to the grocery store.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Nope. Got everything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's your bridge day! Better get in the car and go! (pushing her mom out)

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's tomorrow. Candace, why don't you go outside and hang out with the boys?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha ha ha! Outside! Well, there's no reason to go out there!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Y'know, I don't hear them. Maybe I'll go check.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, ow! Ow, ow! (holding her finger)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I smashed my finger in the...thing!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Where? Let me see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (holds out her finger and moves it) Here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let...me...see!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I need a bandage!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, there's some right—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! The glow-in-the-dark ones we keep in the emergency kit!

Name: Linda
Dialog: In the basement?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow ow ow ow ow ow ow ow ow...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (exits) Okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: W-W-What does this mean? (Cut to Doofenshmirtz in Norm's embracing arms) W-When I'm awake I build evil inators that fail, and when I'm asleep, I build nice inators that work? Ah, what is my subconscious trying to tell me? It's just so exhausting. Ugh, I feel like I've been up all night, which, I, I guess I have, building nice inators, apparently. It's just... (droopily) Yeah, I'm getting sleepy. Ripple dissolve imminent.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, this had better be a dream because I don't like where this is going.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, I looked everywhere. I can't find the bandages.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's okay, Mom. It's, um, it's all better.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great! Then I'm gonna see if the boys want a—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Uh, uh, let's play chess.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Chess? Candace, I don't—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (putting her hands on her mom's shoulders) We never do anything together, okay? (Takes her mom's hand and drags her) Let's play a nice long game of chess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, everything here in dreamland is so distorted and ugly. Say... (Wide shot to reveal a short green devilish imp that looks like him) you look familiar.

Name: Imp
Dialog: I should. I'm the inner you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Inner me?! Are you the one that's been making those good inators?!?!

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was trying to help you, you nincompoop!

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Yes, late at night, I was instructing you how to make the ultimate inator!

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) That's enough! Don't overtighten it, like your brain! Now, let's just imagine how it will work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Cake-O'-Hug-A-Fetti-inator! Fire!

Name: Skater Dude
Dialog: What's happening? Dude, is this cake?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ugh, the cake is hugging us!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, everybody, it's okay! We can eat our way out!

Name: Man
Dialog: Ugh! Forget about eating it now! It's covered in paper!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's mine! The Tri-State Area's finally mine! (The building disappears and he falls into a throne and gets crowned. The throne floats into the air surrounded by herald trumpets.) Hey, wait a minute! Wait!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, was that a fantasy inside a flashback inside of a dream?

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, let me put it this way. (Slaps Doofenshmirtz.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What? What?!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Did you have a nice nap?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, enough with the hugging! Let go!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (lets go of Doofenshmirtz in a manner that sharply throws the evil scientist onto the floor extremely hard) You're da boss!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the ground moaning) Y'know, I'm gonna make a plug for you so I can unplug you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Gosh, it's been so long since I've played chess. I can't remember how the knight moves. Do you remember?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not really sure.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (standing up) Oh, the boys'll know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! (sitting Linda back down) No no no! You sit! I'll go ask 'em. (Runs to the sliding door and imitates the sound of the door opening.) Hey, guys! Uh, do you know how the knight moves? (Doing a bad imitation of Phineas.) Uh, yeah, Candace, it moves straight up and then, uh, straight down on the same square. (normal voice) Oh, hey, yeah, that's great! Thanks! Oh, wait, what was that, Ferb? Oh, yeah, you don't talk! (Imitates the sound of the door closing and draws the curtains on the door.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know what's funny?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's funny?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I have this weird desire to go outside. (Candace gets more nervous) I mean, normally, around this time of day, you're pulling me to go out in the yard and I kind of have a hankering to do it! It's like a Pavlovian "go outside" response. Let's go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Mom, what are you, a robot? You gotta do the same thing every day?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace, what's going on out there? (Linda walks forward but Candace attempts to push her back.) What don't you want me to see?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing! Nothing, Mom! (grabs onto her mother's leg) No no no!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, let go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! Checkmate! (chuckles nervously)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Let's play darts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, wow, Perry the Platypus, I just had the freakiest dream. You know those dreams that seem logical while you're having them but are total nonsense when you wake up? (Pushing the inators together) I think I was some kind of 1940s business beaver, oh, and, uh... Oh, I might as well get these three useless things out of my lab and push them out onto the balcony and... (Perry struggles to get out of the trap) Wait a minute! I've seen this before! In my dream! That's right! It's only really effective if I put them all together! (Perry gets out of the trap) Hey, hey, Perry the Platy— (Perry flings into him.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I mean it, Candace! You're acting really strange! (Candace dials her phone behind her back.) If I'm gonna go outside, I'm going to go outside! (The house phone rings.) Ugh, there's the phone! Hold that thought! (picks up) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, (holding her nose to disguise her voice) please hold for some important information.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, okay, as long as it's important.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! You guys are the best! This was truly an amazing day! It's too bad Candace missed the whole thing. And, Ferb, where did you learn to serve like that?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: At the Yorkshire Athletic School for In Your Face.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I dare you to try that again! (Perry kicks him again and the inators roll away.) Well, I did dare him, I guess. No! No! (The first inator falls off) A third of my inator! (Wide shot of the building as the falling inator activates)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? I guess the game is over? (picks up the volleyball, which gets zapped and turns into a cake.) Cake. Okay...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Norm, a little help, please!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Who needs a hug?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Noooo!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm! What did you do, you big garbage disposal?! Now two of them are ruined! (Sarcastically) W-Why don't you just throw the third one over?!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (getting up) If you insist! (Doofenshmirtz flinches in despair realizing what he's done; Norm throws the machine off the balcony)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nooooooo-ho-hooooo!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, this has been a weird afternoon.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! There you are! What's all this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, uh, uh, yeah! Heh! It's our two-month, nine-day anniversary!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, great! Uh, (at Phineas and Ferb) was I supposed to get her a present?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, if you didn't want me to come out and spoil the surprise, you should have said so. But you are going clean up all this confetti, right?

Name: Candace's Brain
Dialog: Nice going. You busted yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quiet, you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So much for that inator.

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, tell me about it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what are you doing here?! This isn't a dream!

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, isn't it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No. No, it isn't.

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, crud.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Morning, sunshine! So, what are your plans for today, besides running up my phone bill?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've got nothing. Every day, I always end up having another failed bust attempt blow up in my face. (throws some milk on a cat) Starting today, no busting, no blow up in face. I'm taking a me-day.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll believe it when I see it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (seeing a poster on a wall) Huh, I've never seen that there before!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Cool, huh? I put that up inspired by my close-encounter.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Close encounter?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes. You have heard of the Danville crop circles?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They've been appearing all over town! Some people say that they've been made by spaceships!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't believe in spaceships!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But, Buford, you've been in a space ship. Several, actually.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm a skeptic!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Gather 'round kids, and I'll tell you a story about the close-encounter. It was a dark night, and I was out for a drive, when my motorcar began to behave strangely. Twas then when a bright green light started shining and I couldn't help but walking towards the light scource.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What happened?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, as it turns out, it was just a tow truck driver I had called. He charged up my battery, and off he went!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, if you never saw a UFO, then why did you keep the poster?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let's just say that the sightings have been enough evidence of UFOs. (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: His words confuse me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad can be like that. But, nevertheless. I know what we're gonna do today

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ohh... Could you just leave? This is really embarrassing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as he and the others work) Hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, Candace. You're taking a me day. (changes channel) Back to my stories.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (flies in and gets trapped in a chef's hat)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, look at you in your "widdle" trap! So, why the chef's hat, you ask? Well, it was the cheapest way I could find to trap you. Hey, times are tough waiting for my monthly alimony check!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You have to watch every penny. And that's why the 37 minutes, or it's free deal at the local pizzarea is sure to be put to the test.

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (knocking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (whilst slowly gliding his feet along the door, constantly checking his watch while doing so) Just a second!

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (continues knocking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Any minute!

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (continues knocking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (continues gliding feet) Almost there!

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (knocks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (opens door)

Name: Pizza man
Dialog: (holds out hand, in a fashion of asking for money)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can you belive he made me pay, anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was there when I decided to get revenge. Cheap revenge. I placed explosives in his pizza dough.

Name: But you know what? He turned it into a special! And he actually charged more for it! But then, I decided that I'm not gonna stand for it! (removes lab coat sleeves) Behold
Dialog: the Dough-Blow-Inator! You wear it! (lab coat falls off) You see, this device will blow pizza dough into the air and hold it aloft indefinitely! I'm going to challenge the pizza man to a dough-spinning contest and humiliate him in front of tens of people! And why are you coming with me, you ask? (puts hat on) Well, this just completes the look.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In order to crack this case, we need to get a bird's-eye view of the situation.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, why not use a hot-air balloon, or a helicopter?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I like to stay on theme.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, good idea.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, Buford, here we are literally inside of a UFO. Do you still not believe in them?

Name: Buford
Dialog: My skepticism has evolved he and shaped my character.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's fan out and start searching for clues.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: (takes picture of UFO with cell phone) Huh, I'm not crazy after all! (to "Bob") Oh, yeah? Well, no one asked you, Farm Utensil Bob!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's a lot of crop circles around here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you say.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Look, more crop circles! And they are exactly the same shape as the others!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe they're trying to tell us something.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That they like that shape, apparently!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe... We'll have to search for more clues.

Name: Citizens
Dialog: What is that?! Oh, my gosh! It's an invasion!

Name: Man
Dialog: There is nothing that can keep us apart...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Woman
Dialog: As long as you love me...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy.

Name: Woman
Dialog: ...we'll never be separated again.

Name: Oshinomi
Dialog: We interrupt this program with some breaking news. A UFO as been spotted in Danville. I'm here with Gordon Gutsofanemu.

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: These crop circle sightings have been popping up all over Danville, yet none are as important as the UFO just spotted today. Can you describe the creatures flying the ship?

Name: Random guy
Dialog: There were these 2 creatures! One of them had this crazy triangle head and the other looked like a sideways "T"!

Name: Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Sounds terrifying!

Name: Random guy
Dialog: Oh, it was! They don't look human at all!

Name: Gutsofanemu
Dialog: No. No, they don't. Who are these invaders? What are they doing here? What is the meaning of these crop circles? Why can't I time my barbecue right? (in background) Either I'm waiting an hour when they're supposed to heat up, or they're already past their peak when I bring out the steaks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I gotta call Mom! They're gonna be so... Oh, no, they don't! I'm taking a me day!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: (Italian accent) Hey, everybody, she got-a free pizza? (audience cheers) Hey, look-a what you see! It's a dough-osaur! Ha hey! The Leaning Tower of Pizza! Ay? Everyone having a good time?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No, we're not! We're having a rotten time, you stingy jerk!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: Why you-a callin' me these bad guy things?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Because you cheated me! 37 minutes or free! That was the deal! And 38 minutes later, you welched on it!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: But I would-a never! Wait-a one second! You are the guy who set up-a the traps to slow me down, yes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I have traps, but th-they weren't necessarily for you, y'know, specifically, but... Look, enough of your excuses! I challenge you to a dough duel!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: (using his dough as a grass skirt while doing the hula) A dough duel, eh? I accept-a your challenge! If you win, I give you-a free pizza for life! But if I win, you no order my pizza ever again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Deal! I don't want your stupid pizza anyway. (Perry struggles to get out of the trap.) Don't bother! Chin strap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, this is the last one.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But we still don't know what it means.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we need to get a fresh take on this. (to Baljeet) Bring up the crop circle map.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not see anything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Exactly! Because there's nothing to see! Right...there! That's the one spot where the aliens haven't been! I'll bet that's their next stop. Let's go!

Name: Gutsofanemu
Dialog: (on TV) The alien ship has been seen hovering over...

Name: Spokeswoman
Dialog: (on TV) ...makeup tips, (Candace smiles) so you can look your best for the impending alien invasion.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Candace, didja see the news? That is your brothers, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, but I'm not busting them.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Uh, hello? The ultimate bust just falls in your lap and you're not gonna jump at the chance? What's up with that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Listen, Stacy!! Me day! No bust, no blow up in face!! FACE!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Well, now that you've put it crazy...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back to my stories. (hangs up) Takin' a me day.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (to Buford) So, if you do not believe the flying saucer is real, why did you want to take a turn flying it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Just confirmin' it's not real. Besides, I categorically deny I'm flyin' it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look out!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: A little early to be knockin' my pizza down. We haven't even-a started yet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That wasn't me. You... W-Wait, where's my chef's hat?

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: You-a ready, fella?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nope. First, I'm gonna do a little pre-gloating. I'm goin' to wipe the floor with you. I'm goin' to make you scream for mercy and there will be none! Men will weep. Children will wail! Whales will wail! Like...like this... (Mimics whale song.) Like they do, except they'll be doing it on your behalf! And women will look away as you walk the hall of shame! (beat) Okay, now I'm ready.

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: One-a, two-a, three-a...GO!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no, no!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: (also getting sucked in) Hey! What's-a your deal?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is not at all what I had in mind! Oh! Oh, this really sucks! I mean, literally! Okay!

Name: Man
Dialog: This is really uncomfortable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Boy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That failure was spectacular...even for me!

Name: Pizza Guy
Dialog: You must be a lot of fun at the parties! (American accent) But, seriously, don't order my pizzas again, okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, deal. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, this is the spot.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fan out, gang. Maybe we can find out why this is the only field in Danville with no crop circles.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're wastin' your time. There's nothin' here but grass. Grass and this...key! (He uses the key as a hair scratcher.) Ah. Oh, that's good.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's the same shape as the crop circles.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I suppose that makes it special?

Name: Alien
Dialog: Thank you for returning our key. We left large signs in fields all over the Tri-State Area, but you are the only Earthlings that came to our aid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no problem. Glad we could help.

Name: Alien
Dialog: To return the favor, here is something you lost in 1977.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! The Voyager Space Probe!

Name: Alien
Dialog: Goodbye and good luck!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So long!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Take it easy! Wow, that artist rendering on the news was really accurate!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, there might be somethin' to this whole UFO thing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I got the pizza you ordered.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I have time to do nice things when I'm not distracted by panicked phone calls.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, look! It's the boys in their UFO! And Mom is in the next room! (beat as Candace's eye twitches again) Nope! I've had a lovely day and I'm not gonna ruin it with another failed bust attempt. No way this day is gonna blow up in my— (She opens the box and the pizza explodes in her face and blocks the saucer from view.) Oh! So that's what they meant by "exploding pizza".

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's all the rage with the foodies. Oh, there's Phineas and Ferb. Hi, boys! (She waves and the gang waves back.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yup, still there. (goes back to bed) I'm not sayin' a word.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello lads!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What are you boys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I was just telling Buford about phone booths.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I'm not buying it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh no Buford, they were real. They were tiny rooms where you could talk on the phone in private.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! And you'd have to put coins in them to make calls.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You guys are blowing my mind!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Speaking of coins... What's this here? Behind your ear? (Reaches behind Phineas's ear.) It's a quarter!

Name: Buford
Dialog: How did you do that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: A magician never reveals his secrets. (Walks away)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Your dad's really great at tricks!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not really, I just keep a bunch of quarters behind my ear 'cause he enjoys it so much. (Pulls a handful of quarters from behind his ear.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wanna see what I got behind my ear? (Pulls a large ear from behind his ear.) It's another ear!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (Appearing from behind Buford.) Miiiindfliiip.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What are you doing Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am Buford's hype man. Check him out! Miiiindfliiip.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's great! You can be a hype man for all of us. Because I know what we're gonna do today. We're putting on a magic show! Hey, where's Ferb?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ta-da! I switched my body for a dummy of myself, that Ferb climbed into when you looked away.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Miiiindfliiip!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Glances back and notices Monty.) I know you. Didn't I see you flying off my dad's roof?

Name: Monty
Dialog: You're going to have to be more specific; I fly off so many roofs.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Nah, just the one. Of course I remember you. You're Vanessa Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And you're Monty Monogram.

Name: Monty
Dialog: That's right.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Should we even be seen in the same room together? I mean, you know, our dads being sworn enemies and all?

Name: Cashier
Dialog: What can I get for you two?

Name: Vanessa and Monty
Dialog: (At the same time)

Name: Cashier
Dialog: ...and two straws no doubt.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Okay, putting aside the fact that our fathers are sworn enemies, want to have those cappuccinos together?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Sure, sounds cool.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning Agent P. I guess we're getting a little bit of a late start. Our sources say that Doofenshmirtz is on his way to "Steam Noir", the hippest coffee house in town. We need you to get there before he arrives and stop him from doing anything, you know, nefarious. ...I've got a "Word a Day" calendar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, what is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're putting on a magic show. Do you want to be in it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm calling Mom right now. (Pulls out her cell phone)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah Mom! She can be in it too.

Name: Buford
Dialog: A cell phone! Perfect! (Grabs Candace's phone)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Watch this trick. (Covers the cell phone with a cloth and smashes it with a hammer) Voila! One cell phone transformed into miscellaneous electronic parts!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Miiiindfliiip!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, really amusing. Bring it back.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's not that kind of trick.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ughh! I can still use the landline.

Name: Buford
Dialog: The landline? That was my first trick! (Holds up broken landline phone pieces)

Name: Monty
Dialog: It's so awesome that we ran into each other. Can you imagine the look on both our dad's faces if they saw us here together?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Laughs) I'm surprised your dad hasn't put some kind of a spy camera on you.

Name: Monty
Dialog: You know, where's your dad's Date-Ruin-inator?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Laughs) So this is a date?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well, isn't it?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Maybe.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Do you usually have coffee with your dad's sworn enemy's daughters?

Name: Monty
Dialog: No, just girls whose roofs I've flown off of.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh see, now I feel special.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah I don't just fly off any roof you know.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Course not.

Name: Monty
Dialog: I've got standards. It's got to be a building shaped like a... like a...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: An Easter Island head?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Oh my gosh, exactly. What is that all about?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I have no idea. Hold that thought, this needs more milk.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Perry? Is that you? Listen Perry, I'd really appreciate it if you didn't let my dad know that I'm here with the son of his sworn enemy. This is going pretty well and I wouldn't want him to spoil it. Can you help me? (Perry nods) Thanks Perry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Steam Noir! Vanessa says the coolest people in town hang out right here.

Name: Monty
Dialog: My dad thought I wanted to be an acrobat. I mean it was fun but it wasn't my thing.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: My dad was the same way with... (Doofenshmirtz walks in front and Vanessa's voice fades out)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah waiter, you mind if I tell you my evil scheme? My nemesis didn't show up today and I still have to get it out. I figured since I'm getting nowhere with the older Tri-State population, maybe I should go for the younger demographic. So, behold! The Cool-inator! Well, you can't really behold it, it's out in the car. But trust me, it's behold-worthy. First, I will suck all the cool out of this place, it being the hippest coffee house in town. Then, I will blast myself with the cool concentrate, transforming into such an "awesome dude" that you, disaffected youth, will have no choice but to follow me blindly and help me, you know, take over the Tri-State Area! Anyway, the Cool-inator is so hip that it only runs on espresso, so let's fill her up.

Name: Cashier
Dialog: (Takes out headphones) What'd you say dude?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...I need ten gallons of espresso.

Name: Cashier
Dialog: We only serve it in this cup, man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, really?

Name: Cashier
Dialog: It's espresso, man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine. Let's see... this is about a quarter cup... and there's two cups in a pint... that would make... I'll have nine-hundred ninety nine more of these please.

Name: Cashier
Dialog: ...There are six-hundred forty quarter cups in ten gallons, man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Outside pouring a cup of espresso into the Cool-inator) This is gonna take a lot of trips.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, get ready for the Mindflip! For centuries, shaman conjured magic for their tribes, and countless magicians practice hocus pocus for their audiences.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is a... Miiiindflip.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How do we do it? I'll tell you how, if you can keep a secret. It's. A. Trick!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl's in the college right? He can program the most sophisticated satellite tracking computer in the world but every time I try to call my dad he cuts me off. Can't even work a landline.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You think that's bad, every time I use the microwave, Norm starts involuntarily rapping.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hit me again. Hey do you mind if I use your restroom? I mean, technically I haven't had any coffee here, but I've bought coffee here and I thought that would qualify. I had a lot of coffee earlier this morning... Heh, okay TMI, I get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is this...Waaaah!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So I look up, and there he is in front of the whole school... (indistinct)... finally stepping on the other team's feet as he walks.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well at least he showed up. I mean, if I had a nickel for every time I got the "Your father couldn't make it, he's working late." call. But I guess that's really your dad's fault.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So... what exactly do you mean by that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screams as he skids on the way out of the bathroom, stopping at the counter, sighs) ... You're out of paper.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Through the power of enchantment, and a few nifty dance moves, Ferb and I have conjured the glittered demons and are ready to pull off...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, you are so busted! What is this thing? Get me out of here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Pouring the last cup into the Cool-inator) Finito!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, heads up hipsters, get ready to lose your cool!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well what I meant is that my dad spends all his time dealing with your father's schemes.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'll have you know, my father is a misunderstood genius.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Genius? I have three words for you

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And yet, in spite of all that, there's my dad free to do it all over again the next day. Whoa, really effective bunch of spies you've got there major.

Name: Monty
Dialog: At least my dad's spy network isn't funded by monthly alimony checks.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You do know that what he calls a "spy network" is actually just a petting zoo. With hats.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Say goodbye to your street cred hip-cats! (turns on the Cool-inator)

Name: Male Customer 1
Dialog: So I said to him, "Step off my guest list, poser." (gets zapped by the Cool-inator) You want to hear how my nose whistles?

Name: Male Customer 2
Dialog: Yeah man, you know, it's all about my blogs, you know. I blog about blogs that blog about other blogs. (gets zapped by the Cool-inator along with Female customer)

Name: Female customer
Dialog: You want to hear a dream I had about my cat?

Name: Male Customer 3
Dialog: Can I get some more local, organic water? (gets zapped by the Cool-inator) I can't drink any more ice tea, because when I drink ice tea I get craazyyyyy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally, daylight. Phineas and Ferb! (Linda and Lawrence's car pulls up in front of the house.) That's Mom's car! Mom! (Runs outside)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now to set the -inator on "reverse" and blast myself with all of the cool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb built a really dangerous magic show in the backyard! You've gotta bust them!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Really Candace? Busting? That's so beginning of summer.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: There's a Luciano Rigatoni festival at the art house.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let's go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But Rigatoni's work is passionless! With minimal importance! Every piece betrays its own lack of interest in the subject matter!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, Perry the Platypus, this is very uncool of you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A beanie propeller cap? Tha... (The propeller spins and Perry takes off) Uh... alright I'll give that to you, that's kind of cool.

Name: Customers
Dialog: Are you cyber? Uh, want to do a sketch in my sketch book? Where'd you get that gnarly lab coat?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No! No you're nerds! Get away from me, I'm not like you! I'm... I'm cool! Or, I was going to be cool, when I shot myself with the -inator, which is now destroy... uh... curse you Perry the Platypus!

Name: Monty
Dialog: You know, our fathers are probably right, we shouldn't even be talking to each other.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: This was a huge mistake.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Fine.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Fine.

Name: Monty
Dialog: ...So wanna do this again?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (hands Monty her card) Call me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, in our grand finale, we make everything disappear!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Ooooh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?! Ferb?! (Sees Perry) Oh there you are Perry. (enters backyard) Where is it?! What happened?!

Name: Audience member
Dialog: All gone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You two!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here's your phone. (Hands Candace her cell phone)

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's totally fine! Okay, this may be an easy enough trick, but how did you make the whole show disappear?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: A magician never reveals his secrets.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's a little cliché Ferb, don't you think?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Miiiindfliiip!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well here we are gang, the semi-annual Tri-State Area antique show and swap meet. Here you can find anything under the sun, literally, because it's held outdoors. Ha, ha.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anything Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, actually there is one thing you probably won't be able to find here. An 1807 Dorcham and Wesley Boot Scraper, only one of them was ever made, (dramatically) and it's been lost to the mists of time! Oh, if only I could find that, I'd be the envy of the entire antiquing community; especially Worthington Dubois, (he clenches his fists) my antiquing nemesis!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You have an antiquing nemesis?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You don't know everything about me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're going to do today!

Name: Song
Dialog: Danville Swap Meet

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, I know you said that the Dorcham and Westley boot scraper thing was lost to the mists of time.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I did, didn't I? Well, I suppose I get melodramatic when I start talking about antiques.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well Ferb and I found this in that parchment booth. (Ferb takes out an old, worn out scroll)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (He examines the scroll) A Dorcham and Westley Boot Scraper's map! But only three of them were ever made, (dramatically) and they were lost to the mists of- oh I'm doing it again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we know what we're going to do today. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Man
Dialog: (to his customer) A Reno Man number forty-five, that's a classic gig brother.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. Look, here's the thing, I don't know what Doof is up to. I've been busy giving each of my friends personalized ring-tones. I have one for you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: -and one for Carl.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: I want to send out a ringtone for when I call my friends, (monotonously) but I don't have a theme song. Anyway, go stop Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What an incredible waste of time. I mean, come on. Most of this stuff if you saw it on the sidewalk, you'd walk around– it. (She sees something) A Ducky Momo, first edition, green pupil variant, with a left handed pull cord! Heavenly light, angel chorus! I must have it. But I gotta play it cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, uh, yeah, a friend needs a paperweight for her, uh, desk, and mmm, this little trinket looks about the right size.

Name: Flea market Salesman
Dialog: Please, little girl, this little trinket is a Ducky Momo, first edition, green pupil variant, with a left handed pull chord. There are only two of these in North America, they're more rare than Dorcham and Westley Boot Scraper's Maps, but not quite rare as the Dorcham and Westley Boot Scraper.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, mists of time, whatever. What do you want for it?

Name: Salesman
Dialog: You couldn't afford it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you take something in trade?

Name: Salesman
Dialog: The one thing I want is the one thing I can't have. That. Early Twentieth Century Abyssinian baby rattle. But he won't sell it to me because of that silly French cabinet!

Name: Salesman 2
Dialog: You broke the arms off my armoire, now its just a -oire!

Name: Candace
Dialog: If I get you that baby rattle, will you give me the Ducky Momo?

Name: Salesman
Dialog: Yes, I will.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You! How much for that baby rattle?!

Name: Salesman 2
Dialog: Why, so you can sell it to him?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, uh, yeah.

Name: Salesman 2
Dialog: No sale.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, come on! Everybody wants something.

Name: Salesman 2
Dialog: Okay, there is something I've always wanted. A Flenco G4 crystal radio!

Name: Salesman 3
Dialog: (With the radio) ...If you get me a cane with a cobra on it.

Name: Salesman 4
Dialog: Battle of Danville commemorative dentures.

Name: Salesman 5
Dialog: Pink Gorilla suit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo, First edition figurine I will have you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus. Well, as they say in the film business, it's a wrap! (Perry becomes wrapped up in rolls of filmstrips) Get it? 'Cause you're wrapped. In film. Well as you know, films sway public opinion better than any other medium. So I have produced a movie that will convince the people of the Tri-State Area, to make me their leader. Here's a clip.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in the film) Make me your leader.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It can't miss! Anywho, I'm going to enter it in the Danville Film Festival today. There's only one small hitch, turns out it's Danville's Young Filmmakers Festival. You have to be less than fifteen years old, but no matter. Because, behold, my De-Age-inator. With this I'll turn myself into a fourteen year old boy, submit my film to the festival, and sit back as the people of Danville are convinced that I must be installed as the leader of the entire Tri-State Area!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cigar box banjo. An old time diving suit. Fur lined telephone, be right back.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well the map has led us to Boot Scrapers Hall. (They enter Boot Scrapers Hall) Oh, the spirit of Danville, see how his sole gleams, the Boot Scapers took their craft seriously.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look there's a plaque. But what are these funny symbols?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (He gasps) By Harry! That's Boot Scrape! The secret language of the ancient boot scapers. (Reading) To gain the world, and halt the wintle, reverse your mind, and mind the lintel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The lintel?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's the space between two columns. Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that Greek?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well I know Greek, but I don't recognize some of these symbols.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait a minute, reverse your mind... Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Reading) "The disk of fate drops the boot." The disk of fate?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, it's that coat of arms right there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Statue! Guys look, the statue's boot is not resting on that podium. And that podium has a giant slot in it. (After he pulls off the coat of arms) Look, it a big penny. Ferb, pay the man.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Just like an old iron penny bank. Stand back boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, the Boot Scrapers were renowned for their elaborate spiral staircases. If that Dorcham and Westley Boot Scraper still exists, we'll find it down here.

Name: Man
Dialog: Not if I, Worthington Dubois, have anything to say about it. (He laughs, evilly)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, this seems to be unplugged. There. (The -inator fires hitting Perry's trap) Oops. Oh, the film melted into … oil. That doesn't make any sense, it's not a Melt-inator. It's a, Oh right. Film is made from some petroleum product, and it made it younger so, I goes it makes some sort of ridiculous sense. (Perry attacks Doofenshmirtz) One last setting and to the De-Age-inator, and it will be ready to fire. (The -inator fires)

Name: Younger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cool, I'm fourteen years old. Ha, ha, I totally beat you, dude. Now all I got to do is take this DVD to the Film Festival, and then I'll, like, have a lot of power, and stuff. And I'll like– (Perry runs in front of Doofenshmirtz) No way, dude! You're not the boss of me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you want for the 1965 Northern Llama Rancher's Association commemorative creamer?

Name: Man
Dialog: I don't know, a buck?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Exchanging the various items) Commemorative creamer, clear flugelhorn. Clear Flugelhorn for a baseball stein. Baseball stein for cyclops Santa.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. Inner temple.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, let's get a move on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Get down Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Cobbler's mallets. Why did it have to be cobbler's mallets?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was close.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, the Boot Scrapers were master craft-

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: The Cavern of Secrets. This entire room was made from materials scraped off the boots of Danville Elders, who were highly creative engineers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Continuing to trade the various items) Battleship hat. Coffee grinder pogo stick. Thankless letters home, evil angel suit.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, blimey.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I had no idea there was such a wide variety historical of boot scrapers. Which one is it Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, that's the question isn't it. Only one of these can be the true Dorcham and Westley. And no doubt a wrong choice will trigger a nasty booby trap. Boot scrapers were famously vengeful people. This could take every ounce of antiquing knowledge that I possess.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can do it, Dad!

Name: Dubois
Dialog: (Appearing suddenly, and grabbing the scraper Lawrence was reaching for) At last! A hedgehog, of course. This truly is the Dorcham and Westley Boot Scraper of legend.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: But Worthington, there are no hedgehogs in America!

Name: Dubios
Dialog: What, oh well that's just– (He gets squished by a giant boot)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, he chose poorly.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, seeing as the place is falling apart anyway. (He grabs all the remaining boot scrapers, and the three run out)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Still at it) Pink gorilla suit. Battle of Danville commemorative dentures. A cane with a cobra on it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dude, chill, it's mine. I don't have to give it to you. (As they fight, Doofenshmirtz unlocks the rapid fire, and sends beams of de-aging from his roof) Hey! Quit it. You're pushing me, dude.

Name: Salesman
Dialog: You actually got it! Let me see if I can find a box. (A ray from Doofenshmirtz's -inator hits the baby rattle) I don't seem to have a box, oh well. Wait a second! Where's the patina?! This is obviously brand new. It's not an antique. No trade!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (To the sky) WHY‽

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Dude, you just totally broke my -inator.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: That was an ever closer one.

Name: Dubois
Dialog: Not so fast, Fletcher. When I fell, I landed in the ruins of the Hall of the Sandal Scrapers. An order of scrapers far more ancient than your miserable boot scrapers. And with this (Dubois reveals a sandal scraper, and begins transforming onto a much larger ghost) I will become the most powerful antiques collector the world has ever seen.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps next time we should buy new.

Name: Dubois
Dialog: Prepare to (He gets hit with a green beam) Oh no! My enemies from beyond space!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey look Ferb, it's Garbog. Hi Garbog!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is going to be good. Team Danville, assemble!

Name: Dubois
Dialog: How dare you! (The fleet unloads upon him) My future wickedness!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And that was the winner of this years young filmmakers contest. let's have a hand for the directors, Phineas Flynn and Ferb Fletcher.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, crud. Can somebody drive me home?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you everyone. But we couldn't have done this on our own. We'd like to thank our dad Lawrence Fletcher for spending all afternoon making this movie with us.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (To Lawrence) I had no idea you were so good with special effects.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh yeah, but it was mostly them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we'd like to introduce the actor responsible our villain to life.

Name: Dubois
Dialog: Don't you mean (He tears off the costume, revealing Buford and Baljeet)

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: ...actors?

Name: Buford
Dialog: 'Cause there's two of us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Take a bow guys.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why is there an orchestra pit in a movie theater?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously, I need a ride.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I like the big finish, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can do without the sarcasm, Carl.

Name: Vendor
Dialog: That's one exotic dragon-fruit smoothie for you, (at Baljeet) and one for you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm just saying as a non-sequitur, a talking zebra just seems a little.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Forced?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Forced.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Mmm! The sweet taste of an unusual and exotic smoothie!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, this smoothie isn't really unusual or exotic. It's about as exotic as a stay-cation with Aunt Meryl!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But, Buford, your postcard said that she had a pool.

Name: Buford
Dialog: She has a patio.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Tomorrow, we should work on Buford's penmanship.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, most would consider dragon-fruit to be that exotic, indeed. (Buford starts to imitate Baljeet) Known for its dazzling flowers, it is actually the fruit of several... (Sees Buford mocking him) What are you doing? Stop. Stop that. Stop. Stop it. Stop. (Baljeet starts drinking his smoothie, and Buford mocks him as well) Stop that.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know, Buford's kind of right. These smoothies are sort of exotic, but I think we can do better. What do you think, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do I think? (Ferb tries to talk, but is halted by Phineas) Don't answer that. Guys, I know what we're going to do today! I wonder what kind of smoothie Perry would like?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come in. Sit down, Agent P. We have a serious problem. It seems that someone, and I'm not saying who, someone has spilled on the couch in the lobby.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I..

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A very expensive couch when we bought it in 1985.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, all I did was turn the cushion over. The stain was already...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: If the responsible party is present...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, it was Agent M. He spilled a latte in 1990.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ugh. We were hoping to get him here a couple of years out of that couch...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Anywho?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anywho, our surveillance operatives have been getting some mixed signals from Doofenshmirtz. He was observed at the Danville Library, checking out books on Eastern Australia and hydrostatic cell fusion. We haven't come up with any ideas about what he's up to...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Maybe he's trying to recreate Pangaea, sir

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Like I said, we haven't come up with anything yet. So, we need you to get in there, and find out. Good luck, and be careful out there

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, everyone! Ferb and I developed a device that can literally turn any solid into liquid, so we can enjoy all sorts of new and unusual flavors. Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Abracapocus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! That was really impressive!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just got my magic patch. Let's try this again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold! The state of the matter transfer device! All right, Buford, is that chicken ready?

Name: Buford
Dialog: All set.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I got ya! There you are. Liquid poultry.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (drinks it) Mmm. Tastes like chicken.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think we need to try something a little more.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Foul?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! No! Exotic!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, hello, Perry the Platypus! Over here. No, here. Look a-- Look a little more this way. (Poorly imitates Perry's chatter) What do you think? Huh? I've joined you in the genus Ornithorhynchus. That's right, I am a platypus! (Evil laughter) Yeah, hang on. Let me turn off the dramatic lighting. How did this come to be? I'll tell you, since you didn't ask. After years of being bested by your battles, I decided to fight fire with fire, and in both cases, fire means platypus, and with just means with. It was simple; the best way to beat a platypus was to become a platypus. That way, our skills would be evenly matched. So, after a couple of hours of promising experiments and some intricate designs, I finally created the Platyp-inator! Pretty cool, huh? Now, before I defeat you, I think I should further level the playing field. There, now I'm trapped, too. And go! You're not struggling, I said go. We should both be-- (Perry joins in) Yeah, like that. Okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you wanna go next?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why, yes. How about a romantic dinner for two? (Ferb zaps the romantic dinner ) Wanna sip, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no, thanks.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, okay. I understand. You know, you want to keep yourself open to other drink options. I get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, I didn't want to say anything in front of anybody, but, it's, I don't like zucchini.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And that is why we wear white shoes after Labor Day. And I.. (Sees Phineas and Ferb's invention) Oh, I knew it. Phineas and Ferb. Not very impressive, but suspicious. Stacy, I.. I got to go. Oh, and Happy Birthday! Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, laundry. Sometimes, I feel like our first president, because I'm washing a ton. (laughs) Ah, yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! You have to come out to the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace. I feel like our first president...

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time for the stand-up routine, Mom. You've gotta come out to the backyard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, I'll be right out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: HURRY!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is this thing? Some sort of souped-up techno-geek camera? I wonder what it... (Candace zaps herself to liquid) Phineas and Ferb! (A bird bathes in Candace's liquid) No! Get off! Ew! (gargles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well that's funny. I could've sworn she said backyard. Oh well. If anyone needs me, I'll be washing a ton. (laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's see, we've got horseradish, durians, and turmeric.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I've got a mountain yam.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I cannot wait to taste liquified sea salt.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! Watch where you're steering those sneakers, bub!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? You're a smoothie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Multiple Candace puddles) Phineas, you've got to fix this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That is so cool! Uh, what does it feel like?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It feels like you're in big trouble!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, we're gonna need some sponges and a bucket!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Phew! This whole evenly matched thing is exhausting. How about we take a short break? Do you ever get tired of lugging this big tail around? I mean, sure, it's great for fighting, but it's weird for sitting and stuff. I just figure I'd ask you because you know, you would know. Uh, sugar or agave syrup? (Perry points to agave syrup) Here. I don't know if this is fur or really tiny feathers. I can't tell. It's so warm, but it breathes. Well, back at it, I guess. (Both resume fighting)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, these are the last drops of her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Inside the bucket) Hurry up and change me before that bird comes back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure thing, Candace. We reversed the polarity, and it should do the trick. Now, try not to ripple. (Zaps the bucket)

Name: Candace
Dialog: This does not feel like the reverse of being a bucket of water.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm, so it would seem.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know, I kinda like her like that. She looks like Cand-berry sauce.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We gotta get her back into the right shape before we solidify her. And we're gonna need to adjust the contour in.. (Phineas laughs and sighs) Cand-berry sauce.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang in there, Candace. This mold that Buford brought over should help us put her back together.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Tell me again why you have a life-sized mold of Candace.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got life-sized molds of all my friends.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm not so sure how I feel about that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All set, Candace! Now wait right there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sarcastically) Ha-ha, very funny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, here we go! (Zaps Candace) Candace, come on out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) I'm me! Glorious me! You did it! You guys are soooooooooooooo... (notices Linda, inhales) ooooooo... busted!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Perry the Platypus, this isn't working. I need to become something stronger than a platypus. Let's see, what's-- what's stronger than a platypus? (Gasps) Two platypuses, that's it! I've got just the thing right over here. (Runs to the roof to pull out a sheet covering the -inator to reveal it) Behold! My Double-inator!

Name: Linda
Dialog: There, nice and clean. Ha! Now we're both a couple of good-looking dishes. Bah-da-da-duh-duh! Thank You! I'll be here all...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, watch this. I was just looking at this plate, and I said, "There, nice and..."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not right now! (Candace grabs her mom's hand and drags her to the backyard)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, my hands are wet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll just shoot myself with this baby, and then I will have the advantage because there will be two of me.. (Perry attacks Doofapus, which sets off the Double-inator, hitting Phineas and Ferb's invention, making it liquify)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyone else see that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wonder what that hit. Whatever that is, there's two of them now. Soon there's gonna be two of me, and then nothing can defeat me! Except maybe a bigger platypus made out of metal. Yeah, like that. (grunts) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Even though I'm also a platypus at this point, and, uh... I hope this wears off soon. The novelty has worn thin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm sorry Mom, but you've got to see this. Feast your eyes on... (looks and noticed the machine disappeared. Her mood changes) ...puddles.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, I saw 'em earlier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, they had a machine that would turn things into smoothies, and...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I didn't see it, Candace. (Walks Candace with her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: And Buford had a mold, of me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (taking Candace inside) Buford's got molds of all of us, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, well. I guess at least I'm back to normal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's clone
Dialog: Me, too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, good for you... (Exclaims)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas! What'cha makin'?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, sawdust machine?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope. Take a look.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, they're adorable! What are they?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're nano-bots!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Nano-bots? Can they be programmed?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure, they can link up in virtually infinite configurations to make just about anything you can imagine.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, impress me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, main title, whatever. But I think I see the potential. Like, you could use them to make a giant birthday paddle.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Or a telescope.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Or a giant birthday paddle and a regular sized cheese grater.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Or a scratching post for... HEY!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm way ahead of you Isabella.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Welcome to the best noodle house in Shanghai.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, I know it's a long haul, but the local take-out just wasn't cutting it for my sophisticated palate. I just wanna tell you what Doof is up to, but I have no idea. I've been on the plane for 17 hours, and they don't let you use your cell phones till you land, and then I realized I didn't have international coverage, so... Anyway, you should probably get back to Danville, and check on him, just in case. Don't worry, I'll bring you back some white rice and soy sauce.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right gang, let's get techno-mimetic. (pause) Let's use technology to mimic...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why you gotta talk like that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're right. Nano-bots, please.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're making a car.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Buford loves that!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's awesome!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Helicopter! Helicopter! (Phineas zaps the nano-bots and makes a helicopter) Yeah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes! Bigger!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure! We'll just need to whip up some more nano-bots!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom, the boys! Garage! look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, they're making little models. How cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't understand! It was nothing, and then it was flying and.. They made it out of dust!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace, you're not even trying.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I need more information.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Welcome, Perry the Platypus. Would you like a muffin? They're fresh and yummy! Muffins stay warmest here, close to my heart. You must be here to see Dr. Doofenshmirtz! (Perry chatters) I'm sorry he's not in right... (beeping) Whoops, incoming message.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, hello, Perry the Platypus! Sorry I couldn't be there to capture you personally. I was called in for jury duty. But no big deal, I've got the perfect "get out of jury duty free" card! (Perry chatters) Relax, it's totally legit. Meanwhile, I'm leaving Norm in charge, the big lump. Hey, try to make yourself useful, Norm! Would it kill you to show some initiative?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Show some initiative? You never asked me to do that before.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, I'm out of your blast radius today, so surprise me, why don't you? Try not to be a complete disappointment.

Name: Baliff
Dialog: DOOFENSHMIRTZ!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Present!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Please enjoy your muffin! (Muffin traps Perry) Sorry for the inconvenience, Perry the Platypus. I'm showing initiative. When I help Dr. D take over the Tri-State Area, he will be so proud of me! Maybe then he will take me out for a game of catch! But how to do it? Dr. Doofenshmirtz makes complicated inventions which invariably fail. But I'm more results-oriented, so I'll just make a weapon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Commence Operation Concisely State What The Heck Is Going On Around Here. Notepad

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, guys. Get ready for some Nano-bot morphing action!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great idea!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hahaha, pig face.

Name: Candace
