Dialog: MOM! MOM! Phineas and Ferb are making a giant tape dispenser, but it's also a faucet, and a rowboat, a baseball hat, and gingerbread man with a fist for a head, and a pig face --

Name: Linda
Dialog: Stop. Okay, your stories are always full of holes, but it's usually just one story. Here, let me demonstrate. I'll be the "Candace" and you will be the "beautiful mother". (Clears throat)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Imitating Candace) Mom, Phineas and Ferb have brought Genghis Khan back from the past and he's teaching the neighbors to throw hatchets from horseback. (Normal voice) You see? One story.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (long pause) They'll probably do that, you know.

Name: Judge
Dialog: Juror number 9, state your occupation.

Name: Juror number 9
Dialog: I'm between jobs at the moment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! You'll never get out of jury duty with that story!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Dismissed!

Name: Juror number 9
Dialog: Man! I could've used this on my resume.

Name: Judge
Dialog: Juror number 10!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My name is Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz. My occupation..(giggles)...evil scientist!

Name: Judge
Dialog: Mad scientist!?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (angrily) No. No. No, not mad scientist! I'm not angry. Evil scientist. There's a difference...

Name: Judge
Dialog: Hold on, number 10. I think your background might lend a unique perspective to the case at hand. The State vs. Dr. Diminutive!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: I didn't do it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Diminutive!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz, it's your fault that I'm here!

Name: Judge
Dialog: (Judge bangs gavel on bench) Order!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: He's the one who invented the Schmaltz-inator. Not me. I merely stole... I mean borrowed his device, and unleashed it's awesome power, unwittingly that is, upon the airwaves (Dr.Diminutive's lawyer slaps his face in embarrassment).

Name: Judge
Dialog: Do you two know each other?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have never seen him before in my life.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: He lies! I have proof. The 2007 L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. pudding review.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why would you carry that in your wallet? Why would he carry that in his wallet?

Name: Judge
Dialog: Order! Order!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Would somebody please tell me why he would carry that in his wallet!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, one story. And that one story is...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cars! (Phineas's car transforms into a jet) Planes! (Baljeet's car transforms into a UFO) Space ships! Crud!!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (Carrying a blowtorch and wearing a welding helmet) At last, my ultimate weapon is complete. Would you like to see it?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Get ready for a surprise! It's me! Dr. D will be so proud!!! Assuming he survives the cataclysm. (flies away from Doofenshmirtz Evil Inc.) Have a nice day!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just saying we only looked happy because we were singing. It's not a true representation of our relationship.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (In a distance from outside of the prison) Citizens of downtown Danville...

Name: Norm
Dialog: Pardon me for interrupting. You have two minutes to relinquish your city to me or see it utterly destroyed. Thank you for your cooperation.

Name: Woman
Dialog: What could we do?

Name: Man
Dialog: Utterly destroyed? That's like more than regular destroyed.

Name: Man #2
Dialog: But I just got a reservation at that new restaurant!

Name: Woman #2
Dialog: He was so jaunty when he was singing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Weapons!? (angrily) Oh brilliant! Like nobody ever thought of that. I mean, you destroy the Tri-State Area and what are you ruler of? Rubble! And where's the panache? The je ne sais quoi?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: He's an amateur.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not talking to YOU!!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Attention Danville, while your nervous scurrying is gratifying, I must inform you that you have one minute to...

Name: Norm
Dialog: (as he is being kicked in the face) Surrender!!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: This has been delightful Perry, but I have a schedule to keep! (Fires a blast from one of his weapons at Perry)

Name: Norm
Dialog: This is what I dreamed it would be like with Dr. D! Catch!!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Thank you, Perry. That was a deeply satisfying, emotional experience. And a well timed one coming only thirty seconds before you are destroyed along with the rest of Danville. A simple matter when you employ weapons and not one of those foolish inators. (beeping) Incoming message...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!!! Who are you calling foolish you ingrate! Boy, one successful bit for tri-state area conquest and suddenly he's full of attitude! I guess I should've expected that from a guy with a SQUIRREL FOR A HEART!!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Deep down he really likes me.

Name: Norm
Dialog: A giant acorn? How is that supposed to... (the squirrel operating Norm jumps out of him and leaps for the acorn) Oh! I see what you had in mind. Well played sir. (Norm winds down and falls down to the ground) Thank you for game of Catch. (Norm appears to explode before even hitting the ground)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, you guys done changing things up around here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like it. We left the Nano-bot programmer here and now it's gone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, giant glowing cars forever? And that's your story?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And we're sticking to it...apparently.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good! (at Linda) MOM! MOM! MOM! Heeheeheeheehee...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (has her head turned) Pie's on the table!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Look! (Leans back on one of the cars)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Falls backward as the car disintegrates) This is a car, mom! It just needs to...uh...uh...uh...see? (puts a clump of the Nano-bots in her hand) Vroom vroom! Okay. I'll admit, this does make me look a little bit...you know...crazy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Walks back inside to the kitchen) Who wants ice cream with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, any second now something will explode on me and then we can go home. Yep, any second now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaannny second.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Would you quit with the harmonica!?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mom, don't forget to water the plants. We'll be back before you know it.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: It's so exciting! I remember our trip to Africa.

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: That was Arkansas.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, that's right, but you have fun in Africa.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, my university chummy has been trying to get us to visit his animal research station for years now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I bet Perry's looking forward to meeting all the wild animals.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Agent P. We've intercepted a text from Doofenshmirtz and we need you. I'm sorry, Agent P. You know we wouldn't do this if it weren't an emergency. I'm afraid you're going to have to miss your family vacation. Use Host Escape Diversion Technique B-17.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! You okay, boy? Oh, no, I think he's sick.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, he doesn't sound well enough to travel, hon. Maybe we should leave him at home.

Name: Man
Dialog: Sorry, kids, your Mom's right. The airline forbids transport of animals who are ill.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you a pilot?

Name: Man
Dialog: No, I'm a dentist. I just like wearing these hats.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: The dentist is right, boys. Your mother is right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, if Perry can't go, then Ferb and I will stay home with him.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Don't be silly, sweetie. You enjoy your trip. Grandpa and I will take good care of him.

Name: Airline Announcer
Dialog: Flight 4311 now boarding.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Well, okay. We're sure going to miss you, little fella. Feel better soon. Eat all your food and get plenty of rest. We'll see you in no time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, world traveler! Ready to go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. Jeremy said he would see me off, but he's not here yet.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I'm sure he's got a perfectly good reason.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But he said he had something to tell me...

Name: Airline Announcer
Dialog: (In the background) Final call for Flight 4311!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...something important.

Name: Airline announcer
Dialog: Final call for Flight 4311!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking to an airline personnel, with a bull horn announcing the final call) I heard ya'.

Name: Airline Personnel
Dialog: Well!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I still can't believe you got dinner reservations at Chez Afrique. The travel guide says it's the top romantic destination restaurant. Five star service. Panoramic views....

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I'm looking at the most amazing view right now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No, no, really. Look how many suitcases they have in that tiny truck.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh, that is amazing.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Move over.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But I got here first. Why should I sit in the middle seat...

Name: Buford
Dialog: There's your reason.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, you can not solve every with your muscles. Sometimes you need brains.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, like for dinner. Little bit of garlic, a little bit of butter, brains are delicious.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (sighs dejectedly) Perry would have loved sitting on the tarmac for no reason. (sighs again) And he would have loved this visual gag, too. (referring to Ferb wearing five neck pillows)

Name: Flight Attendant
Dialog: (to Isabella) Couldn't help but notice your sash. I was a Fireside Girl myself. Enjoy your complimentary orange juice.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks. (to Buford and Baljeet) Gentlemen.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Networking is everything.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Did you know that African chapter of the Fireside Girls has its own special edition survival patches? (Listing some of the patches) "Identifying fauna and flora." Easy. "Finding water." Child's play. And, "eating a grub"?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little bit of garlic, a little bit a butter...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not worry, Isabella. You do not have to have every patch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't have to have every...! Do you even hear the words coming out of your mouth?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles) Jeremy and I are cool. Stacy's right. I mean there's a good reason why he didn't show up. And he probably want's to tell me he wants us to... Start wearing matching sweaters or something cute like that. (chuckles) Yeah, yeah. (Her cellphone rings) It's him! Jeremy? Hello? Jeremy? You wanted to tell me somethin- Oh, we got cut off.

Name: Flight Attendant
Dialog: Miss, we're taking off. Please hang up your phone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I need to call my boyfriend back. He has something important to tell me.

Name: Flight Attendant
Dialog: Not until we land, I'm afraid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How long is this flight?

Name: Flight Attendant
Dialog: Eighteen hours.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, eighteen hours, with no phone.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Make sure he's nice and comfortable, Clyde. (Perry coughs and sneezes) What do you say when a platypus sneezes?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: I'll go check my monotreme manners book.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: You have a book on monotreme manners?

Name: Grandpa Clyde
Dialog: You don't know everything about me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. It turns out the text we intercepted from Doofenshmirtz didn't actually warrant you missing your family vacation. My bad. But in my defense, his text was written in all caps, but upon farther investigation, it looks as though he just hit the caps lock by mistake. Anyway, he's up to something. Go check it out.

Name: Airport Announcer
Dialog: Jambo and welcome to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. (The announcement continues to go on in Swahili)

Name: Woman
Dialog: No, dear, our daughter's blond. Here she is!

Name: Daughter
Dialog: Eighteen hours with no texting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Referring to Candace) This one's ours.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Welcome to Africa, Candace.

Name: Operator
Dialog: We're sorry. Your call cannot be completed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Cannot be completed!" What is that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do you have an international calling card?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no I don't. Give me yours.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not have one.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got a card. (He pulls out a stack of cards) Pick a card, any card.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't magic me. This is serious.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who's magicin'? I'm just givin' away cards.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: May I have one?

Name: Buford
Dialog: No.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Hairy Larry.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, old friend.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: How are you?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hairy Larry?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, you know how there are no photographs of me between 1976 to 1979?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, there you are. (to Ignatius) Um, I'd like you to me my wife Linda, and our kids and their friends. Everyone, this is Ignatius Ukareamü, my old college chum.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Iggy. How are ya'?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Well, hello, young lady, I have heard-

Name: Candace
Dialog: So you got a phone at that research station of yours?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace...

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Ahh, teenagers are teenagers anywhere in the world.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Of course, they have a phone, Candace. Africa isn't as primitive as you think.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Your father's right. Now come on, the giraffe is waiting outside. ...I kid you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Speaking rapidly) Ah, Perry the Platypus! Come in, get trapped,... (A pair of mechanical arms grabs hold of Perry) ...listen to my back-story. When I was a child, I grew flabby, which made me want to make the Fitness-Equipment-Lock-inator. Bum bum bum. I just run on this treadmill, and out comes a sonic beam that locks every other piece of fitness equipment in the Tri-State Area. Blah, blah, blah. Everyone's fat and tired. I sprint into city hall and take over. (Perry easily pulls off the cuffs that were restraining him.) No! Perry the Platypus, don't do it. Don't push this self-destruct button. This one right here... (Doofenshmirtz presses the button, and the -inator blows up) Oopsie daisies! Pushed it myself. Grr. Boo. Hiss. That's right, I'm a loser. Alright, go on now, you won fair and square. (Perry leaves) Curse you, Perry the... and he's gone. Haha, I can't believe he fell for that decoy -inator. Norm?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Always a pleasure to see your sooty face, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-ah-ha! Perry the Platypus is out of the picture. I'm Perry-free for the rest of the day. I'm sans-Perry. I am platypus-less. And now, because I still need to get it out of my system, behold! The Ultimate-Evil-inator! Isn't it ugly? You see Norm, it occurred to me that fighting underlings like Perry the Platypus is a waste of time. Why not go straight to the top? Why not take out the big boss?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Major Monogram?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why not choke off the wellspring from which all OWCA goodness-

Name: Norm
Dialog: Major Monogram?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let me just say it, will you? Ugh, you know, Perry the Platypus never interrupts me like this. Just saying. -From which all OWCA goodness flows, Major Monogram. There, see? See? You ruined it. You ruin everything. Just like I always say. Anyway, with this I'll blast Major Monogram, turning him evil! And then he'll, you know, join me as my sidekick. And give me access to the OWCA's vast computer network. Thus assuring my Tri-State Area domination. Every afternoon at this time, Major Monogram goes up to the OWCA's roof to sunbathe. (Doofenshmirtz fires the -inator, bouncing it off a satellite on a direct course for the OWCA headquarters.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, Carl, does my uvula look unusually large to you? (He turns his mirror towards Carl. Just as the ray was to hit him, it bounces off, and hits Carl.)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing evilly) My neighbor's cat is totally shredding her drapes again. Too bad I can't see the OWCA from here. But it should be over by now. Pack up the -inators, Norm. Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated has a new headquarters!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Packing, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Remember, lift with your legs.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Welcome to the research station. (He helps the kids out of the truck)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mr. Ukareamü, what's over there?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Scrap metal, power tools, and spare parts left over from building the station.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You had me at "scrap."

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You had me at "scra-."

Name: Buford
Dialog: So when are we going on safari?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: We just need to refuel the truck, and we will be on our way.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, can you point me to the bathroom?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Young man, there is a bush over there with your name on it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My name? Really? How did it... Oh, you mean that figuratively.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phone! Phone! Do you have a phone?

Name: Worker
Dialog: Well, I do have one, but the cell towers are down for maintenance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. (A monkey pretends to use a banana as a phone) Does that banana have international coverage?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Alright, everyone, load up. We are going on a safari.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: And this, everyone is the uncharted gorge. They call it Haijulikani Wadi.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's beautiful. What's it mean?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Uncharted gorge.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Wow, they really nailed that name.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: In order to get down there, you would need a highly unconventional vehicle.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A highly unconventional vehicle? Ferb, I know what were going to do today.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Alright, everyone, back on the truck.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: (Back at the camp) And that is why there are no kangaroos in Africa, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let's give Iggy a big hand for this marvelous tour.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woo hoo, that was great.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you. That was great.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: You are quite welcome. You folks relax and enjoy the camp. I have to muck out Kalama's pen. It is not all glamor.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mr. Ukareamü? Ferb and I were wondering if we could use some of your scrap metal to make a highly unconventional vehicle.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Help yourselves, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Such imagination.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, dear, it looks like everyone's found something to do, and Chez Afrique dinner reservation's in an hour.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I can't wait. I'm Chez Ah-freaking out.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, good one.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz? What are you doing here? Did you finally come here to surrender?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, right, Francis. Wanna give me a hand with these boxes?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I! I will do no such thing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Feels good doesn't it? Being evil, huh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What are you talking about? I'm good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good and evil, wink wink.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why are you winking? And you know you don't have to say "wink" when you wink.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, Francis, you've been zapped by my Ultimate-Evil-inator. I mean, if it didn't hit you, then who did it hit?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (He comes walking in stroking a skull in his hand) Looks like I got two for one. I'm going to take over the Tri-State Area, and with my administrators access to OWCA's supercomputer, and intimate knowledge of proper photocopying techniques, I'm just the unpaid stooge to do it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you know what? I think maybe it hit him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ya' think?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, but whose skull is he caressing?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, that was fun. Thank you for teaching me the Adumu.

Name: Adumu Teacher
Dialog: And thank you for teaching us the Izzy's Got the Frizzies.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: My pleasure, Sankei. Well, I should get back to the research center.

Name: Sankei
Dialog: Goodbye and good luck with that whole grub thing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks. (She walks off)

Name: Sankei
Dialog: Eat grubs. Yuck, right?

Name: Adumu Teacher 2
Dialog: I don't remember having to do that when I was a Fireside Girl.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Figuring out which animal attributes to give to our highly unconventional vehicle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sounds cool. What'd ya have in mind?

Name: Buford
Dialog: For climbing!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Oh, Perry, it's a shame you couldn't go to Arkansas with the boys. Lucky for you, you don't know what your missing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But my intelligence specifically said that you would be sunbathing, it never mentioned an intern.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's because he's not officially an employee, he's unpaid.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't pay him?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He gets college credit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you sure you're not evil?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! You can't keep us cooped up in here. Though the self-serve smoothie machine is a welcome diversion.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm evil, not uncivilized. Did you try the Madagascar chocolate?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmm, you can really taste the Madagascar.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you're a solid B+ student with a promising future. What could you possibly have to gain from all this?

Name: Carl
Dialog: What could I have to gain? Let me tell you, old man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm evil for extra credit!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tell 'em all about it, girls!

Name: Carl
Dialog: You know I will!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I do it all!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I got a full deck ladies.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's evil!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (scoffs) You may have some cleverly concealed singing chops, but to me, you'll always be an unpaid intern.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Drink your smoothie, mustache man. (At Doofenshmirtz) And you, go unload my -inators.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually, I uh, think those -inators kinda belong to..-

Name: Carl
Dialog: Quiet, intern!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, paid intern.

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, that's not how we do things around here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (After spotting a large box of straws) Hmm, that gives me an idea. And this time, a good idea. Not like the one I had about the-

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, this restaurant is really out of the way. I bet you can see the entire savannah from up there.

Name: Maitre D
Dialog: ...And tonight our chef is making his signature dish, which The Culinary League of France calls, "Wildebeest Under Glass".

Name: Linda and Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Telephone? Telephone? Telephone? I'll never know what Jeremy wants to tell me. This whole continent hates me. That lion, those two circus clowns in the ultra-light, the mysterious object under this tarp. (removes the tarp to reveal...) Telephone! Big, weird, wind-up telephone. (Reading) "For best reception place unit in high location with unobstructed views." (begins to drag the telephone towards a tree) Heeheeheeheehee, heeheehee.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man; you know, I made a Move-A-Bunch-Of-Inators-inator at one point. This would have been really good time to use it. I don't know how that slipped my min-

Name: Carl
Dialog: Enough of you mindless prattle, minion! Show me my -inators!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, sheesh! Testy. First up is the Disintegrator-inator...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, uh, then we also have the Galaxy-inator, which...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Derezz-inator?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Overhang-inat...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Upper-decker...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Pickle-Slicer...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Stand-And...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Boar...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Inhales)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Weak.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on! I was just inhaling.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! Something terrible has happened. Listen carefully; these straws are about to collapse like a flimsy...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I was going to say "noodle."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, Danville, U.S.A. D-A-N-V- ...Yeah, D, like in Dantible Varumbie. (The monkey reaches for the phone) I'll only be a minute.

Name: Computer Voice
Dialog: Biometric scan accepted, security system disabled.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! Over here! Oh, good; you got my message. There's no time to lose we have to...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Very nice, verrrrry nice.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you slow clapping fiend!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I needed Agent P out of the way, so I left you those drinking straws.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You realize you could have just called him yourself, you do work here.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm over my minutes. But, now, with the boundless power of the mighty OWCA computer, I will bring the Tri-State Area to its knees! I will stop the power stations, de-synchronize all the traffic lights, and yeah! I'll have a vast army of interns do my bidding, each one of them paid!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're mad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, cool it, man. I think I'm getting a raise. Ooh, ooh, you should give the operation a name, like "Operation

Name: Carl
Dialog: Out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, fine. Hm, how 'bout "Operation

Name: Carl
Dialog: I heard that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I hope so, because I said it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You fool, what have you done? (at Perry) You may have escaped, but you're no match for my evil Flynn-Fletcher robots!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is really weird. I, I think I may have gone on a date with that one. I had no idea she was a robot at the time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Bravo.

Name: Buford
Dialog: He's totally better than Irving.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks Buford. Now that the fanfare's over, what's say we go down into Haijulikani Wadi.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Where should we start?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, first we'll fly down like a graceful condor landing on that rock outcropping. Then, we'll jump over those vines and brachiate like a monkey with our ape like arms. Finally, landing on the slope with our cheetah-like grace. Of course, any other path down would mean instant death.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That sounds totally doable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? ...Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Hello? Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (at the monkey) It's Jeremy.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Get that monotreme!

Name: Computer voice
Dialog: Paw print identified. Password accepted. Computer locked.

Name: Carl
Dialog: No! He's locked me out of the mainframe! If he gets away, I'll never be able to take over.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, this is really exciting!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Don't just stand around, you fool, get him!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The -inators!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You said you had something important to tell me. What is it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Candace... what I think... I though...we should...break...up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What!? Jeremy!? (Close up on Candace) You're breaking up with me!?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, everyone. Buford, Baljeet, you guys have the legs.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Now you'll see how brains are used to...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Move over, nerd. This is a job for brash, unthinking muscle. (He pulls off the control for the legs) Oops.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wait, wait. No, not all the -inators at once.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, what did you say?

Name: Carl
Dialog: You fool! What did you do?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Agent P!

Name: Maitre D
Dialog: Flynn-Fletcher, I am sorry. You have no reservation.

Name: Maitre D
Dialog: To be continued...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's evil!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, it took three hours for them to untangle my hair from the gears, but I never lost my grip on that lava lamp.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that explains the humming.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, but fat lot of good it did me. I mean here we are, thirty years later and they've lost our reservation.

Name: Maitre D
Dialog: Oh, here it is. You were listed under "Fletcher-Flynn". My apologies.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, here we are.

Name: Linda
Dialog: See, it all worked out.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You fool! Without Agent P's paw print, I can't unlock the computer. And without the computer, I can't take over the Tri-State Area.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nice recap.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Quiet back there! (at Doofenshmirtz) You! Which -inator zapped him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, ah... I really am clueless.

Name: Carl
Dialog: About the -inator or just in general?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not sure I understand the question.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Bah! I'll have to untangle this mess myself. The heat signature is wrong on the Disintegrat-inator. The angle is too obtuse for the Derezz-inator. The Julienn-inator isn't plugged in. And the Overhang-inator is just plain dumb.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, sure, until you wanna hang under something. Then what are you going to do, smart guy?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Continuing, the Smells-Like-Hay-inator, no. The Universe-inator just hit this trash can. Nothing left but this smudge. (sniffs) That means it can only be...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Smudge-inator!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Did you make a Smudge-inator?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...Ehhh... Continuing. (Carl grabs his nose)

Name: Carl
Dialog: The only -inator we haven't ruled out, that we actually have, is the Go-Home-inator. Meaning Perry the Platypus is home!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Evil Flynn-Fletcher robots, let's drop by the Flynn-Fletcher house.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You can't do this, Carl! You work for the OWCA!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Not anymore, Mono-grampa.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mono-grampa. I, I... That's good. Why didn't I think of that?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You really think you'll be part of all this? He's playing you like a penny whistle in a really bad jazz band.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No. No. I'm part of the team! I am!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, then why did he leave you behind?

Name: Candace
Dialog: He broke up with me! Of course he broke up with me. I mean, look at me. I'm a bundle of unbridled neuroses! I'm in Africa, surrounded by natural wonders, and all I can think about is finding a cell phone. (falling from tree) I'd break up with me too! Even the tree broke up with me! (gasps) Are you okay, Mr. Pockets? Jeremy's right. I shouldn't be his girlfriend. I don't belong in society. I don't deserve to be a part of civilization! (sobs) Candace is out! Peace! I'm going native!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas! Do something!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Phineas, please help us.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, please help us.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's wrong with him? I feel like we've been hanging here for weeks. I mean, I got the brawn for it, but it's not like I don't have other stuff to do.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The weight of your freakish muscles will only pull you down faster. And why does he just stare into space like that? (screams) Phineas, help us!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, help us.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, dinner bell! Help us! Phineas!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am slipping!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have to get down there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Up, good. Down, bad!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hold on, everyone! (swings on his vine, and then grabs onto his friends) Guys, grab on. Baljeet!

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Buford!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Radius times the angle of rotation, taking into account wind velocity and humidity! (He throws a piece of vine, capturing Buford by his ankle.) Brains!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, you guys. Perry needs our help!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Perry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, hello! We left him back home!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, where are you!?

Name: Robot Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, human boyfriend.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (On the answering machine) Hey, it's me. So, I was trying to tell you before...

Name: Carl
Dialog: He's not here! Where is he?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How could he be in Africa?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Maybe it was a different platypus.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Afristralia's probably full of 'em!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, I know it doesn't make any sense, but he was right here! I saw him! He's alone and he needs are help. And I'm gonna find him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't get it. How were you able to hold me up?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I tied your vine to my own. But how did you fall in slow motion?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, it's a brawn thing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, here we go again!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Why, hello, Agent P. Just wanted to catch up a bit. We never get any time to talk! In fact, we should totally get together in person. Considering that you're in such a lovely region with one-of-a-kind flowers...

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Still at the Flynn-Fletcher house) Let's see, red petals, three golden pistils... Dendrobium uncharticum. Presumed to exist only in uncharted regions in... Africa? I was sure he was struck by the Go Home-inator. We didn't even have a Go to Africa-inator. No matter; soon his tiny hand print will be mine, and then the OWCA will be mine, and then the Tri-State Area will be mine, and then I'm totally getting extra credit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't know how I didn't see it before. He was... he was using me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doctor Doofenshmirtz...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I trusted him and he just cast me aside, like a, like, like an old newspaper. He didn't even wrap fish in me!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, Heinz! Evil Carl must be stopped. We have to work together.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not that being tied around a fish is what I imagined for my...-- Wait, what'd you mean "we?"

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We have to work together to save Agent P.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no way, José! With Perry the Platypus out of the way, I can finally take over the Tri-State Area!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not if Carl takes it over first.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let it sink in. ...Two...Three...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Atta boy, now come on over here and let me out. We have to follow him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But how? He took your jet!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, did he?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl always changes my radio station when we fly together, so I had this jet build just for me. That's, uh, partly why are budget is so tight now. We can track through the on board G.P.S. Now, come on, let's go. We've got a world to save. (He puts on a pair of sunglasses)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute, wait a minute. How did you get the sunglasses to go on one side of your face? Who made these, M.C. Escher?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He was a family friend. Now get on the plane, we've got a Tri-State Area to save.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And admittedly, that's a little strange.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (In monkey language) Beautiful sunset isn't it?

Name: Monkey
Dialog: I've seen better.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Platypuses always head west when they're lost. At least I think they do and I think this is west. I think.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, Phineas? We've been thinking, too, and isn't it time we, you know, find our way back?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And stop looking for Perry? Are you kidding? He's our pet! He's more than our pet, he's our friend! And, I know he's out there. (shows reactions of Buford, Isabella, and Baljeet respectively)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We are in Africa.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Pretty much sums it up.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, has he been wrong before?

Name: Buford
Dialog: How wide are we willing to open this up?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait. Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry's footprints! Come on, gang, Perry's alone and helpless in a strange jungle. We've gotta find him before anything else does.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, that could be just a duck.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Dendrobium uncharticum. Yep, we're in the right place. Fan out and find that platypus. (The robots do so)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (in his plane) We should be in Africa soon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I'm running way low on materials. I'm going to have to get a bit creative.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Aren't we going to need that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, nah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just out of curiosity, does this thing have a lifeboat?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, we're in a plane.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I knew that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think we're getting close. I can feel it. Our worries are almost over.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (at the Lawrence robot who is in the bushes with him) Candy corn. (The robot gives him one, and Carl eats it)

Name: Candace Robot
Dialog: Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Candar.

Name: Candace Robot
Dialog: Candace. Love. Jeremy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Brains.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Brawn.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Brains.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Brawn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no. Oh, no. I lost his tracks. I don't know which direction to go.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait! Grubs! Platypuses love grubs!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They sure do, like Ferb and haggis.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Maybe he came this way for food. Ugh, how am I ever going to get that grub-eating patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry's fur!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He went that-a-way.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's go.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Were we on "brains" or "brawn"?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Brains.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, brawn.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Brains.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That thing's not going to do us any good, if we don't survive the flight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm building a Re-Good-inator, solely from parts from this plane. Do you know how many evil scientists could actually accomplish this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'll be impressed when we don't plummet to Earth on fire.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, stop panicking, Francis. I haven't even touched the main stabilizers, you know... yet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry must have crossed... here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Maybe there is another way over.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Looks pretty rickety.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Notices Perry) Perry!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! Hey! There he is!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: My gosh, you were right. Hey, it's this way. Come on, let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry must be scared. We're coming for you, buddy!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (From the bushes) Too easy.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry about your friends, Agent P. I'm evil, what can I say? (Perry looks around) Oh, the new robots. Yeah, I had some free time. And now you're going to give me a hand. Literally.

Name: Carl
Dialog: New recruits, huh? I see you want to do this the hard way. (He mimics a trumpet) Charge!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Holding onto a log, floating down the river) We've gotta get back to Perry somehow!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think we have a problem here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No kidding. Ladies and Gentlemen, brains.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Give it up, Agent P.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This would be quite fun it wasn't terrifying!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everybody, get behind me! Hang on.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Lucky for us, this quicksand broke our fall.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You modified the horn?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's what I needed the stabilizer for.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We live! See? See, one day you're gonna look back on this and laugh.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I assure you, for the rest of my life, every time I look back on this I will personally drive over to your house and smack you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is that thing ready?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I, I still need a few parts.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No problem. (He jumps off the plane, tears off his clothes revealing a leotard) We're surrounded by parts.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If you can manage it, I need a ball-joint compressor.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Catch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks

Name: Monogram Robot
Dialog: Put 'em up, handsome.

Name: Phineas robot
Dialog: I know what I am going to destroy today.

Name: Candace Robot
Dialog: You're busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh-ooh! You saved me. Why did you sacrifice yourself?

Name: Candace Robot
Dialog: No Jeremy robot for me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?

Name: Candace Robot
Dialog: Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (His earlier voice mail) Hey, it's me. So I was trying to tell you before, but we kept breaking up. Sorry, I missed you at the airport. I got caught up with my band, but I can't wait for you to hear the song we recorded. I wrote it just for you. Call me when you can. I miss you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, Jeremy didn't break up with me?

Name: Candace Robot
Dialog: Call him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (at the robot) Thank you. (at Jeremy) Jeremy! Oh, it's so good to talk to you. No, I'm so sorry about that. I was just on the top of a tree, and I didn't have any service. And then I...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, anything in the Fireside Manual about escaping from quicksand?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'll bring it up at the next meeting.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, guys, I landed up here. Should I come down?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No! Throw down that vine. NO! Just one end.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, But I don't know what you're gonna do with half of a vine.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Is it me? It is him, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, pull.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: On the vine.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oops, sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's him.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Here we go.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh man, I have never been pantsed by a continent before.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't feel bad, when we got out of here, I was gonna do that to you anyway.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hurry up, Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I-I just need one more thing. A small piece of tape.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Tape?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, you know, any, any kind of adhesive, anything. A sticker, adhesive bandage, uh... (He pulls the mustache off the Monogram Robot) Oh. This'll do. That's it, the Re-Good-inator, it's finished. Wait, wait hold on. Behold the Re-Good-in...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Heinz, just shoot Carl with it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, see, that's the problem. It's mounted to the deck, and I can't swivel it. Bit of an oversight, I guess.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Still fighting with the robot) What? Where's it pointed?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, right at that X-shaped rock. Wow, how serendipitous.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Great googly-moogly! Heinz, hold down the fort.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, we have a fort? What am I doing out here?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, I need you to get evil Carl in front of that "X". And yes, I wear a leotard under my Nehru jacket. Quickly, we'll only get one shot.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Finish them. Finish them!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I will have that paw print! Those digits are mine! You're running out of room, Agent P. (Perry and Carl reach the X-shaped rock) Now, let's get this over with.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Awaiting paw print. (Perry uses his tail to pull himself away from Carl)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Your prehensile tail won't save you now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He's coming into range.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Pull, Agent P. Pull!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oops.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He backed out of range!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All is lost.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He wants me to take the shot.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What's the point? He's out of range.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm going to take it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Game over, man!

Name: Carl
Dialog: What?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Boo-yah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What a marksman!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, it only points at one place.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You can't give me anything, can you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: ...What happened?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! How are you feeling, kid?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I feel... good!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I'm glad. Now, clean up this mess you've made.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, and Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, Major?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, recent events have brought it to my attention that you're a great help to me. And, uh, not quite sure what I'd do without you, in fact.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Really?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, and... and as of this moment, I am officially promoting you to the title of "Paid Intern."

Name: Carl
Dialog: Th-Th-Thank you, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You understand we won't actually be paying you. It's just a title.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Of course, sir. (Joyfully) Whoo-hoo!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good work, Agent P. You'll come back on the jet with us. Obviously, we can't have you...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the distance) Perry! Perry!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Go on, you've earned it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come on, we've got to get out of here. We'll just use the jet's big magnet to pick up all this stuff.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait; you guys are going to give me a ride back, aren't you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sure, Heinz; after all, home is where the prisons are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're kidding, right?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Do you want a ride or not?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not if you're not kidding.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're almost there! There you are, Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's here, guys. He's really here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, guys.

Name: Phineas, Isabella, Buford, and Baljeet
Dialog: Hi, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice outfit. Looks like you really embraced Africa. Now we just have to find our way out of the gorge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Chill, guys. I got this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't worry, it's just our ride.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great idea, Candace. You're a natural.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, right?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, there's something I still don't get. I'm absolutely positive Agent P got hit with the Go Home-inator. So why did he end up in Africa of all places?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: His family.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, they're here in Africa. Home is where the heart is, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: True, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't touch anything!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I didn't!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Look at that. Oh, I got to say, Africa is unbelievable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, wait, how was the restaurant?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Eh, not my thing.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Nothing to write home about.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I guess it takes brawn and brains together to survive in the wild.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whatever, give me your food.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Alright.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Iggy, these s'mores are great.

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: Yeah, they have my secret ingredient... Grubs.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? Thank you, Africa!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, can I have one for Perry?

Name: Ignatius
Dialog: I admit, I have never really studied the platypus, but I am absolutely shocked that this one somehow followed you all the way to Africa. It seems... impossible.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, ever since George Shaw wrote the first description of the platypus for highly skeptical European scientists in 1798, this unique creature has become synonymous with the word "impossible."

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Ferb's right.

Name: Isabella, Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? You're all satisfied with that answer?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Alright, well, we're turning in.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, me too.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: 'Night.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously, a platypus crosses the Atlantic Ocean, finds you on the vast continent of Africa and no one feels this is worthy of a longer discussion?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's been a long day, Candace, go to sleep.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, It'll probably all make sense in the morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? That's it? Nobody's with me here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: And admittedly, that's a little strange.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, give it a chance. We want your honest opinion.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We know it's a little weird.

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: Help, help! Is there a doctor in the house?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am a doctor. (Baljeet rips his clothes off, revealing a doctor's scrubs) And yes, I am single. What seems to be the problem here?

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: I think I sprained my ankle.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And you want me to take a look at it?

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: No, I want your brain.

Name: Girl 2
Dialog: Brains!

Name: Everyone from the beach
Dialog: Brains!

Name: Girl 1
Dialog: Brain.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Shape-shifting alien zombies, fair enough, but I must tell you that I am kind of using my brain right now.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh yeah, and I'm also a ninja, see.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Dr. Ninja Baljeet! ("In Color" title just appears) In color!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Welcome to the Klimpaloon and Giant Floating Baby Head Hour! Starring that magical old timey bathing suit that lives in the Himalayas, Klimpaloon! And the inexplicable Giant Floating Baby Head. With tonight's guests, Dave and Jim and the Tri-State Whimsy Jugglers, Dexter Thompson and his chocolate harmonica, the musical stylings of Bicentennial Crab, and featuring six of the original eight Kimpaloon and the giant floating baby head dancers. And now, here are your hosts, the Magical Old-timey bathing suit that lives in the Himalayas, Klimpaloon and the inexplicable Giant Floating Baby Head. (Klimpaloon and the baby head are seen dancing)

Name: Norm
Dialog: That's me!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Norm, if you're going to live here, you can't just wander into Jeremy's room like this! What if he found out about you? Then, he'd make you return to outer space!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Space is cold and unforgiving, like my father!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Oh, no! It's Jeremy! Quick, hide!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy? Is that you? What are you doing in my room?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (opens door to Jeremy) I was just making you a surprise.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: A surprise? What is it?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Well, I was just making you your own entrance.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Holy guacamole! You sure are a handful. (pats Suzy's head)

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Buford Van Stomm, world renowned chef, winner of the Palme de Mouton, runner-up of the Tri-State chili cook-off, and master purveyor of cuisine to the crowned heads of--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, get that camera out of my face!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: He's also kinda mean.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You bet your boots.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Today on Your Cooking STINKS and so do YOU!, Van Stomm will be critiquing the culinary stylings of master chef André Guilbaud, creator of the legendary Crepes Guilbaud and his world renowned olive free, olive loaf flavored olive.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Coming your way this fall, Katt Karr. The inexplicable story of a man whose car, for some reason looks a lot like a cat. Roger Doofenshmirtz, a politician of above-average attractiveness. On a never-ending crusade against the sinister, evil, cheesy smelling, and for some reason, dressed like a mouse, Professor Nibbles. Katt Karr, it's driving away from us.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Poor Ducky Momo. Are you lost?

Name: Ducky Momo
Dialog: (quacks)

Name: Man
Dialog: Yes, you are. Ducky Momo needs to get to the other side of the Dumbledown River. Can you help him find the Butter-Berry Bridge?

Name: Kids
Dialog: (Off screen) Behind you Ducky Momo! It's behind you! Yeah, right there! Right there, Ducky Momo! It's right there! It's right there! Behind you! Right there behind you! Behind you, and to the left. Your other left! Right ther- Behind you! Behind you! No the other way. Oh for Pete's sake!

Name: Girl 3
Dialog: Uh-oh, Dr. Baljeet! Who are they?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Just some old friends. In post-apocalyptic battle gear. Okay, maybe "friends" is stretching it a bit.

Name: Girl 3
Dialog: Jeepers!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: GI hope you have got your carry on stowed, because we are ready for take-off.

Name: Trucker 1
Dialog: Dude, you are so lucky.

Name: Trucker 2
Dialog: Yeah, I know. I gotta slow down.

Name: Girl 3
Dialog: (Now dangling by Baljeet's hand, who is dangling on a piece of railing from a helicopter) Whoa, that was close!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: As long as we are up here, how about we fly to a little island I know?

Name: Girl 3
Dialog: Oh, Dr. Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ninja.

Name: Girl 3
Dialog: What?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is Dr. Ninja Baljeet. You left off the "ninja" part.

Name: Girl 3
Dialog: Really?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I did not go through six years of ninja school just to be called Dr. Baljeet. It is Dr. Ninja Baljeet, okay?

Name: Man 1
Dialog: You know, the guys on these sports team have some pretty funny names these days.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Yeah, like those hockey players.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: No, no, those are just Canadian names.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: How about these jugglers, folks?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: (As she puts makeup on Norm) You're much more fun than my other dolls.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm honored!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Yes. What do you think? (shows Norm a mirror)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Self-interest dictates a tactful reply.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (Knocks on Suzy's door) Suzy? Are you there?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Yeah, just a sec! (To Norm) Quick, hide! (goes to open the door, shushes Norm, opens door)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walks into room) Hey, sis. I can't find my lucky baseball bat. I've looked everywhere. Have you seen it?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Uh... (She sees Norm, who is wearing a lampshade on his head and moves over so that Jeremy does not see him) Nope. Nothing in here that would be of any interest to you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Suzy, you're acting kinda weird. You're not hiding anything, are you?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: No. (the siblings stare at each other) Get out of my room!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Holy guacamole! You sure are a handful. (He leaves)

Name: Norm
Dialog: (removes lampshade) Look at me! I'm the life of the party!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: My lamp needs a brighter bulb.

Name: Guilbaud
Dialog: Of course I'm a-prepared. I can de-bone herring in thirty-eight seconds, and I can make five minute frosting in four minutes! (chuckles) Look out, Van Stomm. Chef Guilbaud is coming for you!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who puts tofu on lasagna?!

Name: Guilbaud
Dialog: I was just trying to be avantguard, Che--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, people need to be "ava-guarded" from your food! (kicks plate)

Name: Guilbaud
Dialog: Clearly, I have much to learn. (sobbing)

Name: Roger
Dialog: I don't know, Katt Karr. We've been all over Metroburg, and still no sign of the sinister Professor Nibbles. Got any ideas?

Name: Roger
Dialog: Saucer of milk? Okay, I don't see how that's gonna help, but you're the car.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Suzy. What are you doing out here, and what's with the lumpy table?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Oh, uh, it's my lemonade stand.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Lemonade stand? Where's the lemonade?

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I... drink-ded it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Holy guacamole! You sure are a handful. (He leaves)

Name: Norm
Dialog: I made more lemonade!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: About time! We just lost a customer! Now help me fix this lumpy table!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look, some people tend to think I'm a bit harsh with these guys. But here's how I see it. DISGUSTING! UTTER GARBAGE! RAW SEWAGE ON A PLATE! It's really all about nurturing the talent.

Name: Roger
Dialog: We've almost caught up with Professor Nibbles, Katt Karr.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Bad Katt Karr! Bad Katt Karr! No, No!

Name: Man
Dialog: Poor Ducky Momo. Still can't find the bridge? Can you help him find the bridge?

Name: Ducky Momo
Dialog: (quacks)

Name: Kids
Dialog: Behind you! It's behind you! Oh, for crying out loud, Just turn around! Rotate your body! No, not that way! Where are you going?! The bridge is right here by us! We can see it from here!

Name: Boy
Dialog: Boy, I'm hungry.

Name: Girl
Dialog: Me too.

Name: Both
Dialog: Hey! It's Meap!

Name: Girl
Dialog: Meap, did you bring something fun to eat?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap! Meap!

Name: Children
Dialog: Yay, Meap's Carbonated Goulash!

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: That's right, kids! It's new deliciously carbonated Meap goulash, the goulash with foam! Featuring quasar pork-rolls, blackhole ham hunks, death ray beef segments, spaceship tofu, and Blue Chimpanzee DNA replicate helix marshmallow!

Name: Children
Dialog: Thanks, Meap!

Name: Girl
Dialog: Meap, your goulash is--

Dialog: Meap!

Dialog: You took the words right out of my mouth!

Dialog: New Meap Carbonated Goulash, includes everything you see here, except the bowl. Batteries not included.

Dialog: Meap!

Dialog: We earn more patches before 9

Dialog: You okay there, big guy?

Dialog: No!

Dialog: Tonight, Vance Ward's exciting escape attempt, while Bob and Junebug are sidelined after Bob tries to maul celebrity judge Sherman from the 80's band, Love Händel. Tonight on Dancing with the Bears.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There is nothing to worry about way out here!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I guess he's really gone, Suzy. You've got to admit, he was a lot of trouble. But deep down, I'm gonna miss that big guy. Come on, let's go inside.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I'll be in in a minute.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay. (He leaves)

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Okay he's gone, you can come out now!

Name: Norm
Dialog: That's great, because I've got fireworks!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Holy guacamole! You sure are a handful. (She winks and Norm does the same)

Name: Guilbaud
Dialog: It wasn't to what Chef Van Stomm was saying. It was how he was saying it. So, I decided to take his teachings to heart.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I couldn't be prouder!

Name: Reporter
Dialog: Huge meteor to impact the Earth at 9 o'clock tonight. Also, who's this little fella, and why is he in a bookcase? We'll have this story at ten.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, Nibbles, it looks like you're caught like a rat in a trap. And you'll have plenty of time to gnaw on that in the state prison. And you'll be a rat in a, you'll, well... You know what? I'm out of rat metaphors. Anyway, thanks for all your help, Katt Karr.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Oh, let's pretend like didn't see that.

Name: Kids
Dialog: What is he looking at?! That's not a bridge! What is that? That's a candy wrapper, not a bridge! Oh great! Look at this! Now, where's he going?! Get back here! Where did he go? Where did he go? How has he survives this long?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, it turned out that the invasion was all just a big misunderstanding.

Name: Girl 4
Dialog: So, does that mean we're safe now?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That all depends. Do you want more carbonated goulash?

Name: Girl 4
Dialog: I don't get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So! What do you think of Ferb TV?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pause, stands up) I'm telling Mom. (She leaves to do so)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think she liked it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Enters with Linda) Right here Mom, right on top of our -- (There's nothing there) taaaaa...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Again, what am I looking at?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! Holy guacamole! You sure are a handful!

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: Meap Carbonated Goulash pieces are closer than they appear. Meap Carbonated Goulash may be subject to license title tax, and destination charges. Please wash hands thoroughly after contact with Meap Carbonated Goulash, if hunger persists after contact with Meap Carbonated Goulash, consult your--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I'm sorry, is this Studio A?

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: No, this is Studio—Hey, wait a second. You just wanted to get into this episode, didn't you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?! No...! No!

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: Yes, you did!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I did.

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: Get out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright. But I can totally read that faster than you.

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: Out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, grumpy.

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: Batteries not included.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Batteries not included!

Name: Advertiser
Dialog: OUT!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oopsy-daisy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone with Stacy) So then Jeremy said--- (The green beam passes by her window disconnecting the call) Stacy? Phineas and Ferb! That was important! You guys are so gonna get it!! Mom!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Elsewhere, in space.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think the boys are shooting green lasers in the backyard. Look.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Looking through a telescope) Ferb, I can totally see up your nose.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey kids, how's the over-nighter going?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great Mom, everyone's helping, even Perry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, do you remember two weeks ago, when we wrote up this contract?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Bust Accord?

Name: Linda
Dialog: And do you recall article twelve?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, "I will not attempt to bust my brothers more than once a day." I remember. But--

Name: Linda
Dialog: And what happened earlier today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I tried to show you a giant ant farm.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Excellent, we have an understanding. Now go to bed. You can try again tomorrow. (She leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine! I'll just wait till tomorrow. Wait a minute, at midnight it'll be tomorrow. I can just stay up and bust them.

Name: Baljeet?
Dialog: This sleep over is a good idea.

Name: Buford
Dialog: How are we all supposed to see thought that puny telescope?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The telescope is just to find the probe we launched seventeen months ago. Then we can tap into the signal from deep space. And using Dad's old projection screen, and some fiber optics to relay the images from the probe, we can view the galaxy in comfort from these lawn chairs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (From her window) Space probe? Fiber optics? Ooh, I can smell a bust comin' tonight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These joysticks should the space probe remotely.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Come on, already! Let's start lookin' for stuff.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford, I've never seen you so enthusiastic.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I have my reasons.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, here we go again. He's going to tell the story of when he was abducted by aliens.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It wasn't an abduction, it was an encounter.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Encounter?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I was walkin' out in the middle of the woods one night with my lucky tambourine.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's my story!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I didn't know you had a lucky tambourine.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This whole story is ridiculous.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No it's not! I have proof.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ugh, here comes the picture.

Name: Buford
Dialog: See? (Buford shows his picture) I named him Tristan.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is just a flamingo.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Tristan is not a flamingo, he's from outer space, and he's a whalemingo. But then he had to go home, and I never saw him again. Hey! What are you doin' with your hands?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: ...Mocking you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, I'd be angry, but I admire your honesty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are Agent P. Sorry to call you in a second time today but... (Perry stares at Monogram) Oh, this? It's- it's just an exfoliating mask. I have another ten minutes before I can peel it off, or I get zero of the benefits. Agent P, we just got word that Doof may have fired tomorrow's -inator, today. This is a major breach in protocol. So give yourself a good slap in the face, and get over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay gang, let's fire this thing up.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh. Zoom in on the swirly thing. my gut tells me that's where the whalemingos are.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Roger that. Hey! It's our milkshake bar! And business seems to be booming.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What about over to the left?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. (The probes moves over) Wow.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, wow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a whole planet of-

Name: Buford
Dialog: ...Whalemingos.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not believe it, Buford was right.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're all so, beautiful.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Gasps) Tristan.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? How did you get stuck in my double dutch machine? That's not even a trap. Anyway what are you doing here? (Perry nods to the hole in Doofenshmirtz's ceiling) Oh, that. The beam that I shot through my roof? Well that was just an accidental misfire from my Sphere-attract-inator. Luckily it was pointed up, so it didn't hit anything. Anyway, I started thinking, and realized the true measure of a man is having a world famous roadside attraction. But which one to choose? Which one would be the most spectacular? Then it hit me, nothing brings them in like a big ball of twine. So that's why I built the Sphere-Attract-inator. To steal the worlds largest ball of twine! Then all I need is some sort of road to put it beside. Right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I gotta admit Buford, I had my doubts, but whalemingos are truly amazing.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Told ya.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! Why is everything all fuzzy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm not sure, let me back it up, and we'll take a look.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It looks like the planet's growing. Planets do that, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is not growing, it is getting closer!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This sounds serious.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah! this is catastrophic! Should we not do something? Should no one inform the populous of the impending impact?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Calm down Baljeet. I'm sure the government scientists are already doing something.

Name: Scientist #1
Dialog: Duck and cover!

Name: Scientist #2
Dialog: My watermelon!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Based on my calculations, the planet will be here by midnight!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's great news!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Our planets are going to collide! You do know what that means?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sure, it's like when you have two sets of keys. And you keep one them in your car.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, it means...NO!! It means all life is going to be wiped out on both planets!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (gasps) Guys we've gotta save Tristan!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Anything else, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And the Earth.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, what do you say we open the up the roof and activate the Sphere-Attract-inator? Then I can get a good nights rest before all the crowds arrive to see the world's biggest ball of--

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are we going to do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could use electro magnets, if only we knew the planet's molecular density.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got a pail of water, and a nest to make comfortable. I figure I can keep him in my garage 'till spring.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Spring. Spring! That's it. Guys I know what we're gonna do tonight!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, sassy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew they'd practically bust themselves, if I just waited long enough. You guys are so busted, in like... nine minutes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey Candace, glad you're still up, you'll get to see the cool planet coming directly at us. But don't worry, we're building a giant spring to bounce it back into space where it came from.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A spring? That's not vert scientific. But it is still bustable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here comes the planet now.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I can't wait 'till they get here. Tristan!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally! It's tomorrow! (Candace busts into Linda and Lawrence's room) Mom! Mom! What are you guys doing?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, hi honey, we were just listening to some records. It's what we used to use for music when we were kids.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace I thought we had an understanding.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, it's midnight, tomorrow.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Don't worry, it'll be alright.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The world's largest ball of twine is on its way! You'd better stand back, it's supposed to be huge! (The ball of twine now much smaller arrives) What? That's it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Goodbye Tristan! Remember me! (Buford throws up his lucky tambourine, and Tristan catches it on his neck.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got a twine ball bigger than this in my junk drawer.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Help me Perry the Platypus! I'm slipping! (Perry grabs a double dutch machine, and catches Doofenshmirtz by the ankle with the jump rope) Oh thank you Perry the-- (Perry activates the machine, repeatedly slamming Doofenshmirtz against the building)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean curse you Perry the Platypus!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, let's go! Let's go!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Clearly we need a thirteenth amendment to the Bust Accord.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Moooooom?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You kids okay out here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we're great!

Name: Buford
Dialog: We saw a giant planet filled with whalemingos.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whalemingos, huh? Why don't you all come on in for a midnight snack. Wash your hands. Especially you, Buford.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey sleepy head, do you want a snack too?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think of you all the time, whalemingo. Especially when I've had spicy tacos just before bed. And your feather, tickle me in my dreams. Tristan! Tristan.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So then the seamstress walks back into the stateroom and says, " 'Titanium'? I thought she said 'cranium'!" Hahaha, yeah. Pretty good punch line, huh?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. All you need now is the first part, and then you will have a whole joke.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look everyone, Ferb and Perry are back.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin' back from debate camp so soon?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We finished earlier than expected.

Name: Debater
Dialog: You're right. Judges, he's right. He's changed my entire world-view. Thank you.

Name: Judge 1
Dialog: It's so beautiful.

Name: Judge 2
Dialog: That kid is in it to win it, dawg.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're just in time for acorn nut muffins made out of the training nuts from yesterday!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Training nuts? Okay, what did I miss?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It all started simply enough.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating) I'd gotten up early to help Isabella earn her surf patch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for helping me earn my surf patch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Narrating) And I told her it was no problem. (In flashback) No problem. (Narrating) It was at that point that I decided to stop narrating. (in flashback) My schedule's wide open. Here, take a look at this. I figured I'd make a few prototypes and once you pick your favorite, we'll design your board to look just like it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Awww, they're so cute and tiny a squirrel could surf on them. Now, if we only had a box of squirrels.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We found a box of squirrels!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, right next to a box of scorpions, which is what I wanted to bring over.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, I won Rochambeau fair and square.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's Rochambeau?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Rock-paper-scissors!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why didn't he just say that?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Angrily) In what universe would a piece of paper ever beat a rock?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, let's see the little guys.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, but do not expect too much from them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong with them?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: They appear to have been domesticated. They have no squirrel skills. Check it out.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Here little squirrellies. Here is a nut.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to the squirrels) It's a nut, you eat it. (to Baljeet) I see what you mean. No squirrel skills. Ferb, I... Oh, that's right, he went to debate camp today.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, oh! I will be Ferb! I have been practicing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's pretty good, Baljeet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! It's as if he's right in front of us.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh! Oh! Say "Where's Perry?" now. I've been practicing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Where's Perry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know. What are you asking me for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And so, that's how the day began. Hey, where's Perry now?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Welcome back, Agent P. We hope you had a pleasant day off. Anyways, there's a crisis brewing in Danville, (camera pans to Perry, who grips his seat, then switches back to Major Monogram) and it could destroy the very fabric of our existence. There's never been a greater threat. Peaches! (Perry is shown with a confused look on his face, Major Monogram continues) Oh, you probably want me to explain the... (Major Monogram chuckles to himself) There's been a shortage of peaches in Danville lately, and we've traced it to Doofenshmirtz. Go find out what he's up to, and good... (Perry leaves) luck. Wow, guess he's in a hurry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It was about that time that Candace came up to us and said...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! I demand to know what it is that you've got planned today!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, that.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Exactly like yesterday!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Except for the Ferb part.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, thanks. What are you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're talking about what we did yesterday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, it's, like, a confession?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace  Oh, it's perfect. I'll go get Mom and she can hear everything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good idea, Can...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (points at Phineas) Now, don't say another word until we get back. (she points at Ferb) And that goes for you, too.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was ironic, because Ferb doesn't usually talk.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (off screen) Duh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, Perry the Platypus! I take it for granted sometimes what a professional you are, especially after dealing with that guy they sent instead of you yesterday. So how was debate camp?

Name: Debater
Dialog: (to Perry) You're right. (to judges) Judges, he's right. He's changed my entire world-view. And I thought that British kid was persuasive.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, if you were flashing back just now, I couldn't see it. I'll bet you're wondering what I'm doing here at the beach... At the clam bake. With an oven. And normally, I'd be all about telling you, and it's a really cool plan, too! It involves my latest invention, the Peach Cobbler-inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I'm getting way ahead of myself. I have to tell you about yesterday for any of this to make any sense! It all started with an establishing shot at my building.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while cleaning an -inator) Huh. Perry the Platypus should be arriving right about... Now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How completely unexpected! (climbs down the ladder) And by that I mean, it really was actually enexpected. (walks towards Agent R) Well, you have a hat, so you must be an agent. I guess that means Perry the Platypus is not coming, so... (takes a controller from his lab coat) A-ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Consider yourself trapped. Allow me to explain my diabolical plan. You see, my brother, Roger, the mayor, is hosting a beauty contest that will...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! (sighs) For Pete's sake, I'm pontificating here! Sheesh! Okay, okay. Long evil plan short, I wanted to ruin Roger's day. You see, he's officiating at an "Everyone's A Winner" beauty pageant. (scoffs) That's so him. Uh, my scheme involved domesticated squirrels, paper doilies, and those containers that pantyhose used to come in. You know, about this big? (Agent R glares) But, uh, I couldn't figure out a way to make them all work together...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...because I was distracted by a leaky faucet in the kitchen! Turns out that was actually the perfect idea. So I ditched the squirrels... You know, this isn't really making my evil plan short like I promised. Sorry. Anyway, behold! The A-Leaky-Faucet-inator. I will disgrace and humiliate Roger by dropping one big drop of water and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, where'd you go? (Camera pans to Agent R, who's eating from the trash) Oh, no! You're getting coffee grounds everywhere! This is so much smoother with Perry the Platypus. I'm just saying.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (while pushing Linda) Right out here, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (waves) Hi, kids! (to Candace) All right, what's this all about?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're telling Ferb the story of what we did yesterday.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I love stories!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, oh, it's not just stories, but full disclosure!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. (to Phineas) Go ahead.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, we finally got to the musical part of the story. We all decided it was high time to teach the squirrels how to be squirrels.

Name: Buford
Dialog: C'mon. C'mon.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whooouhh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whooooooooaahh!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (after a pause) Buford, you taught the squirrels to dance?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm like an onion.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because you have layers?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, that, too.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, after I cleaned up the coffee grounds, I loaded the A-Leaky-Faucet-inator and Agent R, I guess,...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) ...onto my rocket skiff and headed off to Roger's beauty contest. We arrived just in time for the swimsuit competition.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Oh, very nice. Twelve meters. We have a new record.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
