Dialog: There he is, the big show-off. With his big smile (leans against Agent R) and his keys in his pocket and his lumberjack-like...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Hey, no. Shoo! Shoo! Get out of here. Go find another symbiotic relationship! Anyway, now that we've... Hey, hey! What do you... This actually feels great. Oh, I see why you like it. Anyway, and I'm going to power up the inator now. (pushes a button on the inator) Here we go. Powering up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yup. You know, uh, this is the time where you escape and try to destroy my inator. Oh, for Pete's sake, I... (releases Agent R) There! Now, attack! Start thwarting! (Agent R walks away) No... No, no, no, no, don't just walk awa... (sighs) I miss Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa! Wait, wait, wait. Watch out there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why isn't the water coming off? It's beautiful.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Good job, cadets! Now, back down the tree. No, not like that! Head first! Sheesh, it's like I'm talking to myself here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go, Mom. You got to see this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, look at 'em go!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're doing a pyramid! I didn't even teach them that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Good luck, little guys. I'll think of you whenever I get a rabies shot! Which is often.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Roger
Dialog: Thank you, Katie Bogosian, for the whistling belly button performance. You probably should see a doctor. But that concludes our talent competition, unless there are any last-minute drop-ins?

Name: Judge 1
Dialog: It's so beautiful.

Name: Judge 2
Dialog: That pharmacist is in it to win it, dawg! (Cameras pans left to reveal a dog) See, I'm actually talking to a dog. That's right. Talkin' to a dawg.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (now wearing a pink sash with the words "KING PRETTY PRETTY PRINCESS" in red lettering) And I was crowned (places a crown on his head) King Pretty Pretty Princess. Which, now that I think of it, is a contradiction in terms, but it was the first time I ever won anything. So it's gotten me all obsessed about entering contests. But the only thing I'm good at is baking peach cobbler, so I, I invented... Oh, yeah. I told you, "Behold the Peach-Cobbler-inator." What it does is it makes everyone want peach cobbler more than anything else in the world. So whether it's a chili cook-off or a dancing competition or a quiliting bee, or whatever, the, the judges will be compelled to choose peach cobbler as the winner every time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Plus, it's waterproof, it's shockproof, (Camera pans back to him) it's windproof, it's...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh. But it isn't sandproof. Fancy that. I suppose, since I planned to take it to the beach, maybe I should have considered...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus... and my own poor planning skills! (notices smoke coming from an oven) Oh, no! My cobbler! Oh! How can this day get any worse?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Does that mean this thing's been flying around since yesterday?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, there you have it! Are you gonna bust them, or what? (stands up) Wait. (takes out a camera) Okay, go ahead.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Actually, I just love that you kids trained poor, abandoned little squirrels and helped them get back to the wild. I am so proud of you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, you can't! I want justice! I want... (the ray from the Peach-Cobbler-inator hits her) Peach cobbler.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, lucky for you, I made peach cobbler.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Peach cobbler.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I heard you the first time, honey.

Name: Buford
Dialog: C'mon. C'mon.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whooouhh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whooooooooaahh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: A quilt?! No way! I mean, I know it's been a long summer and you guys are running out of ideas and-

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's okay. Buford. You don't have to hang with us everyday.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No no no, I mean I mean I don't wanna play alone. I'll turn into a cat-kid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's a cat-kid?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a kid version of a cat lady.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quick! Somebody say "Where's Perry?".

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Where's Perry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sighs happily) You're always there for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (turns around) Oh, it's you.

Name: Doofenshimirtz
Dialog: Yeah, so no time for traps. It's nothing personal, you see today is the annual L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Summer Stock Festival and I got the title role, so I have to take over the Tri-State Area by 3

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! Now I'm in the middle of nowhere! Now I'll never be able to take over the Tri-State Area before.... the play. (Perry starts to leave via his jetpack) Wait, wait, d-don't leave me here! Uh, Perry the Platypus, please! It's important to me! And if this works out, I might give up evil for acting! Won't you give me that chance, to succeed at something that might very well turn my life away from the evil path? Do it for the kids. Do it for the orphans.... that I might perform in front of someday if I ever do a show in an orphanage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't want to be ungrateful or anything, but is there any way to speed this up? I gotta be in the make-up chair at 4 o'clock. Hey, what about this turbo switch? That oughta shave off some time, hey, right, yeah? (Flips the switch which causes the jetpack to sped off into the distance as him and Perry fall and land on the ground) Some pilot you are. (Glares back at Perry, who then points accusingly at him) Oh sure, blame the victim. Like you didn't know about my switch-flipping compulsion. (Perry starts to run away angrily) Oh, now you're mad, sure, I don't know why I tried to be nice, I should have just trapped you, I could have been out of the hospital and on my way to the theater by now. (Starts to walk towards Perry) Instead they'll end up using my understudy. Ughh, I hate that guy!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: So, if Doofenshmirtz is late, I get to go on?

Name: Man #1
Dialog: (Unknown line) time for this entrance, you can have the part.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I guess it is summer and we're in the desert, but I I feel like it's unseasonably warm out here. I feel warm. Do you feel warm? Why do we always see cow skulls in the desert? And why do you only see the skull? Did the body die somewhere else? It makes no sense. (Perry walk away) Oh, I'm sorry, am I talking too much for you? Fine. I'll be quiet. I can shut up. I don’t have to talk all the time. It's not like I have to fill the space.... If you want silence, I'll give you silence! You watch!... And it's gonna be deafening! Mark my words!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do they say "Mark my words?" I mean, they just mean listen to my words, why don't they just say "Listen to my words"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, look how big the sun is through this magnifying glass. (Gets harmed off-screen) Ow! Ow! Oh!...No really, it's huge, you should see it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he drives a taxi, for heavens' sake, he can work anywhere. He expects her to just pack up and move to Vegas. Seriously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was sure my arm would grow back, but it never did. (taps his left arm which makes a metallic sound) See? Pure titanium. It's a fact.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't communicate, you know that? You don't share. I know nothing about your private life. Perry closed off...... Closed, that's you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I never touched an iguana again. Actually, that's not entirely true. There was one time, back in a—oh! Ooh ooh ooh! Look, Perry the Platypus, look! Two tires and an axle! Ahh, pretty soon we'll be rolling out of here! We're just gotta, gotta hop this fence. (Perry waves a finger back and forth) What do you mean no?! (Perry points to a "No Trespassing" sign on the gate) No trespassing! Oh oh you gotta be kidding me! You know what Perry the Platypus? I just have my third realization of the day, I have two earlier but I didn't share them with you. I've realized that the thing that's kept me from succeeding all this years isn't my parents not showing up after my birth, it isn't my eight month sting as organ griven monkey, it isn't the time that my arm got stuck under that boulder, also titanium see? (taps his right arm which also makes a metallic sound), it isn't any of those things. You know what it is? It's you! (points to Perry, who then crosses him arms) You are who's been holding my back all these years.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sarcastically) Oh, very clever, that my accusing finger and pointing it back at me. (Normal) So so you think I'm responsible for my failures? (Perry nods) You're wrong! I can prove it. If you just let me try my junkyard scheme without interfering, it will prove to you that you are the source of all my failures!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A little loose here, Perry the Platypus. (Perry crosses his arms) No, no, you're right, by myself. Okay all I have to do is- (gets zapped, dogs are heard and chase after Doofenshmirtz off-screen)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, okay, just this once I failed and you have nothing to do with it, but did you have to let me trip all three bear traps? Like c'mon! Why not here in the hot sun working on ways to get us back to Danville (They both stop walking and look at each other) and you never offered me so much as a glass of water or or a teatanus shot! I'm going it alone. As a matter of fact, I'm sick of you and your smug face! I don't wanna see it any more. I'm going to close my eyes and count to 3, (covers eyes) and when I'm done, you better be gone. (Perry already disappears) And it'll be just like when you're here except that YOU (Points to where Perry is last seen) won't be here! (Counts) 1...2...3! (Open his eyes) Hey! He really.... FINE THEN! I can find the bus station on my own.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (crawling; pants) I said I wanted a sea otter for Christmas, they said I have to pick my present from the bottom shelf of the kitchen cosmics aisle at the supermarket so I bought an oven cleaner. I love that oven cleaner. OVEN CLEANER!! (notices a bus station) Hey, a bus station!

Name: Bus Driver
Dialog: Danville's at point's east! (Doofenshmirtz stands up) Tickets please!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pants) I don't have a ticket for the... I've got to get to Danville to be in a play and I just gotta, I don't have any money, I'm tired and dirty and it's all my fault, I've.. It's always been my fault! I'm a failure, I'm a failure! (begins to cry off-screen) (while crying off-screen) I'm a failure.

Name: Bus Driver
Dialog: So... no ticket?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while crying) I'm a failure. (Perry shows up with two tickets in hand, he stops crying) Two bus tickets? (Grabs the tickets) Oh Perry the Platypus, you're mench. I know I can be testy and unpleasant, I know I tend to ramble on and on, to be fair, the burden of conversation is kinda all on me in our relationship. And I know that I haven't always given you the respect you deserve, anyway, I want you to know that you are appreciated Perry the Platypus. You. Are. Appreciated. Oh, hey now, check it out. Look, see? A tear. The universal secretion for sincerity. (Doofenshmirtz catches his tear in a phial) Come on. You can have a window seat.

Name: Driver
Dialog: Hold it! No animals allowed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tough break. Thanks for the ticket though.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sweet! It's air conditioned in here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To nobody in particular) It's not like I wanted to go to the desert. He just jet-packed into me and dragged me along. No animals on the bus, it's no my rule. It's company policy. It's not my fault.

Name: Passenger
Dialog: Are you talking to me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And what does he expect, he my nemesis. I'm a stone-cold villain. I'm ruthless. I have no "ruthes". ... Still he looked so sad and pathetic when the bus pulled away, and-- AH, I should think of something else. Kreplach! Kreplach! Eastern European comfort food. You like kreplach?

Name: Passenger
Dialog: As a matter of fact I do. When I was a little girl, my grandmother and I would make kreplach. First we would roll out th--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enough of your blabbering on and on! My little nemesis is out there all alone. I can't believe it! Stop the bus! Stop the Bus! Stop-

Name: Passenger 2
Dialog: What's going on?

Name: Passenger 3
Dialog: Hey what gives?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enjoying the shade Perry the Platypus? It's your jetpack! I found it stuck in the mouth of a fiberglass dinosaur I mean how often does that happen when you really need it? Climb aboard. Come on! Come on! Hahaha.

Name: Man
Dialog: One minute 'till curtain.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Looks like Doofy's a no-show.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, we're running out of time! We're not gong to make it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: '(Perry straps Doofenshmirtz tightly into the jetpack)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you trapping me? But we were getting along so- (Perry motions towards the turbo switch) The turbo switch!? Are you kidding? I can't control this thing at that speed. O-Okay Perry the Platypus, if you think so... (Perry throws the switch)

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Oh well Doofenshmirtz, the show must go on, without you. ...And there's my cue.

Name: Actress
Dialog: ...I shall never go hungry again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pizza delivery!

Name: L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Member
Dialog: What an entrance!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To Perry) Haha! We got him good! And I couldn't have done it without you. (Perry turns Doofenshmirtz's finger towards himself) Oh, why Perry the Platypus... (Doofenshmirtz put the tear he collected earlier back into his eye) See I knew I'd need it later.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was amazing! I never thought quilting could be so much fun! Think of the possibilities! Needlepoint! Embroidery! Tapestry! I'm headin' down to the fabric store right now! (walks away) Broquet! Taffeta! Saddle stitch!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually I didn't find it all that exciting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, me either.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Never getting that day back.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whew, stinker-roo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he drives a taxi, for heavens' sake, he can work anywhere. He expects her to just pack up and move to Vegas. Seriously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking to Stacy on the phone) I think you're right Stacy, the ocean would be a lot deeper without all those sponges. (Candace hears noises outside) What is that noise? It is driving me crazy! Aha!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice try Ferb, but you can't psych me out with your dead on celebrity impressions.

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, what is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Table tennis.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ping pong, for the layman.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, but is it like, laser-activated, nuclear powered, supersonic ping pong?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, good idea though.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ping pong, huh? I bet. I'll just stay right here until the inevitable weirdness happens. Any minute now. Alright, so where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Through Perry's wristwatch communicator) Monogram to Agent P. Already airborne, I see. I like that! Doofenshmirtz has recently purchased an inordinate number of chairs. Hundreds of them! Far more than necessary for a person with no friends, and only one tushee. Well actually I'm, I'm just sort of assuming about the tushee. But I'm pretty confident in the no friends thing. You think it'd be the other way around, but the way he's always playing with forbidden science, you can never really be... This is coming out kinda weird, huh. Look, you're going over their anyway, just, just take a look, okay? Monogram out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Psst! Perry the Platypus, over here. Hurry, hurry, it's- the show's about to start!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Someone in our studio audience has a date with history! So come on up, because this is your backstory, Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Me? Hahahahaha! It's me, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Let's give him a big round of applause!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Tonight we explore the life of a true evil genius. And find out just what makes him tick.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But how?

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm glad you asked! With the help of our exciting but potentially lethal memory extraction technology, all of your most deeply suppressed memories will appear right on this screen! It's like a TV clip show fueled by your own brain. Now let's start our trip down memory strasse on the day of your birth, in beautiful Gimmelshtump, Drusselstein!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't really remember much about it, I was pretty young at the time, but- ooh! Ooh-Ooh! (The tube connected to the helmet Doofenshmirtz is wearing begins to bubble) I can feel it tingling; something's coming out!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (Norm shows a clip from when Doofenshmirtz was born) Aww, how cute! But where's Mom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She didn't, uh- show up for the birth.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Remember this voice?

Name: Doctor
Dialog: When they are born, we slap their bottoms to start them breathing.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Here he is, all the way from Gimmelshtump Memorial Hospital, Dr. Mortimer Shlussel.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Shlussel, so good to—Hey!

Name: Dr. Shluelsle
Dialog: He is breathing.

Name: Norm
Dialog: And I'm sure you can guess who this next voice belongs to...

Name: Mrs. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heinz, my little hobbengusher.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, when she says "hobbengusher" like that, it's easy to forget that it means--

Name: Norm
Dialog: It's your mother!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mama!

Name: Mrs. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hobbengusher. (She whacks him on the bottom as well)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that's the way you normally say it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AH! Ow! Why!? Ow! Why!? Why!?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes, your relationship with your mother left something to be desired. But, what about Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yeah, you know, tho- those were hard times.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating with the clip) The stress of running a family weighed heavily on him. We were so poor that one day our beloved lawn gnome was repossessed. Who would protect our zatzenfruit garden from those witches' spells and wood trolls? From a tender age, my father decided that it would be me...

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewegen Sie nicht! (Don't Move!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: While the other children played Kick-the-Schtumpel and eat Doonkelberries, I would stand for hours.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewegen Sie nicht!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All through the cold night as the Spitzenhound howled.... My only companion was the moon. And my neighbor Kenny.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewegen Sie nicht!

Name: Norm
Dialog: What a fascinating life. We'll keep track of the level of emotional pain each backstory causes, on this colorful Gnome-o-Meter! As shown by Vanna, our gnome-o-meter spokesmodel. Looks like our gnome has begun his climb! (The gnome begins to travel up the Gnome-o-Meter) Scale those heights, you bearded, Scandinavian cutie! Perform a segue back to rights of passage!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Smooth, Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Thank you, don't break the rhythm, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And let me tell you, transitioning to adulthood was painful, but, actually, I guess a good indicator of things to come. (in a flashback on screen) In Gimmelshtump, jumping from the high dive was an important rite of passage.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you a man or a schnitzel?!

Name: Young Heinz
Dialog: I'm a man, I'm a man.

Name: Queuing man
Dialog: Das kind ist ein schnitzel! (That kid is a schnitzel!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: After that, my father and I became increasingly distant.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Zu nah! (Too close!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (flashback ends) Whatever, I'm so over it. (his father walks up to him)

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewegen Sie nicht!

Name: Norm
Dialog: And there's another voice you might recognize...

Name: Roger
Dialog: What exactly am I here for again?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (With distain) Roger.

Name: Norm
Dialog: It's you brother, Roger Doofenshmirtz, beloved mayor of Danville. Everybody loves him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, alright, enough with the cheering; this is my show, not his!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Can I help it if Mommy liked me best?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Look at all those burbling memory bubbles. Tell us all about it, Dr. D!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating over the clip) For a time, I was happy. It was a short time, it was... right... there. It was like five seconds when I was pushing the thing back and forth on the rug. And soon I learned my parents were expecting a brand new baby girl. My mother spent months knitting pretty dresses. Unfortunately, the baby turned out to be a boy, and because we were out of material, I was forced to wear those same dresses for an entire year! Drawing mockery and scorn from all of my manly classmates.

Name: (clip changes) I wanted to gain my mother's affection somehow, so I went to the claw machine district in hopes of winning her a gift. Fortunately, I had with me my allowance, which I'd been saving for a whole year
Dialog: one three-cent coin. I dropped it into a slot, then carefully maneuvered the claw toward the beckoning fuzzy grail! Odds were against me, but then it happened! The miracle! The claw grabbed the stuffed animal; it was mine! Then, like a knight of yore, I gallantly gave the prize to my beloved mother... who immediately turned around and gave it to my brother, Roger. I was crushed as I watched Roger produce a big red marker and write his name on the toy. And then afterwards proceed to do the same to my mother, claiming both as his own, effectively shutting me out of the family dynamic.

Name: Roger
Dialog: You know, Heinz, there's more than one way to a mother's heart.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Kickball. My mother's love was always inexplicably linked to kick... well, I'll just let the song tell you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Love Händel!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Wait a second, you had Love Händel play your flashback?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know people.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Really.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...No, not really; I told them it was for you.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Mmhmm. Well, I've got a city to govern.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't let your ego hit you on the way out!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Although your family life was tough, your social life was. how should we say, a soul-shattering void.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating over clip) A painful, but accurate choice of words, Norm. At the age of five, I was forced to throw my own surprise party.

Name: Gunther Goat Cheese's goat
Dialog: (within the flashback, enters with a cake) Hello, boys and- oh. Mmm... awkward. (puts the cake down and leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) Ten seconds later, they confiscated the cake; apparently there's a two-person minimum.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Ooh! That stings! Do you recall a young lad named Boris?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, sure. Big Black Boots Boris the Bully. (clip starts) He was always kicking sand in my face. When I was in the sandbox

Name: Norm
Dialog: Well, Boris owns a car dealership now, and declined to appear on this show. But he did send some sand! (a giant pile of sand drops on Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Well, at least he cared enough to do that.

Name: Norm
Dialog: You did have one friend...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Balloony!! (clip starts) When I was a boy, the smell of pork emanating from me was so bad because of, well, the reason's unimportant, it was part of a different emotionally-scarring backstory; I'm not getting into... regardless, the smell of pork was so bad that no one would come near me. So one day the carnival came to town and I needed money because of, well another back story that... basically, my parents disowned me, I was being raised by ocelots. The point is, I had to get a job at the carnival, but the only work was at the dunking booth, and not as the guy who got dunked though, I was what they threw to dunk him, which is again a whole other backstory. Okay, look- long backstory short, I got a balloon at the carnival, I drew a face on him, I sprayed him with special "Lifelong-Lasting" spray I created, and I named him "Balloony." He became my best friend in the whole world, yadda yadda yadda. Then one tragic day, when I was protecting our garden as a lawn gnome, Balloony started floating away. (clip ends) And then I didn't see him for a long time; it wasn't 'til... well, there was this whole thing with an alien ship, it was really improbable.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Well, here he is! (Balloony is seen in front of a backdrop)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Balloony, I-I've missed you so mu- (Balloony pops; Doofenshmirtz gasps) Baaaallllooooonnnyyyy!!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Ha-ha-ha! We're just having fun with you! That wasn't the real Balloony!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It wasn't?

Name: Norm
Dialog: No, of course not! The real Balloony popped three weeks ago! (holds up the popped Balloony)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (bawling) BAAAALLLLLOOOOONNNNNNYYYYYYYYYY!!!!! (continues bawling over Norm's line)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Aaand uncomfortable transition back to the Gnome-o-Meter! (gnome rises from 10,000 past the 15,000 line) Wow, that backstory really had some juice. Now, if you've finished weeping, let's continue! In another misguided attempt to engage in life, you entered one of your inventions in a science fair!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (clip starts) That's right. It- it was my very first -inator! Just as I was about to demonstrate my invention to the judges, a kid with a baking soda volcano stole the show! The next year, I tried again with my even bigger -inator. And again, my thunder was stolen by a baking soda volcano! I'd had enough of science. I decided to devote my life to poetry instead.

Name: Young Adult Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The movies are gray, the TV is black, the horses are running, please bring me some food.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) Yet, curiously, I still lost to a baking soda volcano! (clip ends) And what's worse, his poetry lacked subtext entirely. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what are you do- (Perry looks behind a curtain) Okay, playtime's over! Norm? (Norm flips a lever, lifting the curtain to reveal a glass dome with a bubbling liquid inside and electrodes on top; a metal claw comes down and lifts Perry off the ground) Behold, the Backstory-inator! You see, evil is born from pain and loss, but reliving one story at a time was not getting me anywhere! Now with this, I can collect the liquid essence of all my pain and suffering! And when it's all full, I can re-inject it into myself, making me the most powerfully evil person that has ever lived. Then nothing can stop me from taking over the entire Tri-State Are-aaugh!! (screams as an ocelot attacks him)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Oh, there's Mama Ocelot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ironically, she's still more nurturing than my own mother! Ow, off, quit it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any time now, they're going to do something big and bustable. I just know it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And so, Perry the Platypus, to recap what I said mere moments ago before I was so rudely and painfully interrupted, once I have charged my Backstory-inator, the tragedy of it all will be re-injected back into me, and I will be transformed into the ultimate creature of evil! And look, we're almost there! (the gnome is shown teetering at the summit of the Gnome-o-Meter) One more backstory should do it! Let's see... remember the time...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (entering) Hey Dad, can I have the keys to the car?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, sure, Vanessa! Oh no, no, good memories flowing! Aaahhh! Can't stop... pleasant reminiscences! (flashback montage starts) Aaaaahhhhhhhh!!

Name: Biker
Dialog: Hey, sweetheart. How'd you like to take a ride on a real bike?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She's sixteen!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It only matters that I think he's cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She thinks I'm cool!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay Dad, if you want to hold your head and quiver some more, that's totally okay with me, but can I have the keys?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, right. Here you go.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Have fun with your little toys. (leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, look at the Gnome-o-meter! (gnome settles at 5,000) We're practically starting over.

Name: Norm
Dialog: That's okay, sir. You have lots of painful history to explore. Tell us, how did you come to America?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it was when I was sixteen, or thereabouts; I had stopped celebrating birthdays at that point for... you know, obvious reasons. (clip begins) And then one day, my parents sent me out to the Schtor to get some doozenbratt. (in the clip, the "Schtor" is revealed to be a painting of the front of a Schtor hiding the entrance to a ship; the ship takes off and Heinz's parents celebrate and hug) You know, I've always had trouble between a Schtor and a- a painting of a Schtor, but- but it started me off on the greatest adventure of my life! I decided to seize the day with both hands! (Heinz is shown swabbing the poop deck) Aaand a mop. I was heading to a golden land of opportunity; a land with a pioneering spirit which welcomed misfits like me! But I ended up in America instead. (Heinz is literally kicked off the ship) I just knew that I was home! (a large crate lands on Heinz; flashback ends) In the sense that it was... familiar. (gnome rises to 20,000)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Once in America, you began the human rite of passage known as... high school! Leading to one of the most embarrassing viral videos of all time! ("I am a Superstar" appears on screen)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, I thought I deleted that from everyone's memory.

Name: Teenage Heinz
Dialog: I am a superstar!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, we- we've all seen this, Norm. That's enough.

Name: Teenage Heinz
Dialog: (falls into toilet) It won't- (video stops)

Name: Norm
Dialog: But you haven't seen the digital remix! (plays digital remix)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, this is really surreal. Eugh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Creeping me out a little, I'll be honest.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously, Norm, that's enough.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enough now. (remix stops)

Name: Norm
Dialog: It's got ten billion hits! And there's only seven billion people on the planet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm never going to live that down.

Name: Norm
Dialog: And yet, despite a serious lack of coolness, you still managed to date a future pop star!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Lindana is here?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Actually, she didn't remember you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that figures. We only had the one date, but it was eventful. (clip begins) It was at the Danville Drive-In.

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: Okay, the coast is clear! You can come out now! (Linda emerges from the trunk)

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: Eww. It's grody back here!

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: Well, on the bright side, you got in for free, so... we'll just split the cost of my ticket, right? Right?

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: You know, I could've gotten in the trunk, like, a block away instead of when you first picked me up at my house.

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: Wow, you just love to live in the past, huh? Is that like a thing with you?

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: (sighs) Whatever. Let's just try to enjoy the rest of the evening.

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: (does a robot dance) I am a happy robot, likey what I hear. I'm just kidding; that's a thing I do. C'mon, hop in! (Heinz and Linda get in his car)

Name: Radio Announcer
Dialog: You were listening to "That's Wings, You Turkey" by King of Loud. And here's a new one from Zanzibar, "What Do It Do?"

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: Oh, turn it up! I love this song!

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: It's okay, I'd say it's in my top seven, eight favorite songs about reverse engineering.

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: Makes me want to be a pop star!

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: Ha! Yeah right, and I'm going to rule the world!

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: Well, why not?

Name: 80's Heinz
Dialog: Yeah, like I could do that.

Name: 80's Linda
Dialog: Maybe instead of, you know, the whole world, uh, start... small, with the Tri-State Area. (dramatic chord plays) Hey, the movie's starting!

Name: Norm
Dialog: It was at that point that you realized the only business for you was... I'm waiting for you to finish my sentence for me, sir...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, of course. Bratwurst!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Actually, I was going to say "evil," sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, but before I was evil, I was a bratwurst street vendor. (clip starts)

Name: Kid 1
Dialog: How do you know when you're really lame?

Name: Kid 2
Dialog: When you sell bratwurst! (kids laugh)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, that seemed more painful at the time. Oh man, it's gonna take forever to get the gnome back up to the top at this rate.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hold your horses, sir. We're just getting to... your love life!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, boy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: (to Perry) You are the cutest thing I've ever seen. Yes, you are. Yes, you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, some people say we look alike.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's date
Dialog: Uh, I don't think so. Not at all. No, not at all.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But when I turned the Translator-inator on...

Name: Whale
Dialog: (via the Translator-inator) ..What a loser that guy up there is! She should dump that pink chimp and go out with a real mammal like me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She left me for that trash-talking 35-ton pile of blubber.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have never been so happy in my entire life!

Name: Doofenshmirtz's unnamed ex-girlfriend
Dialog: Oh, Heinz- (De-Love-inator fires) I feel nothing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But- But- But-

Name: Doofenshmirtz's unnamed ex-girlfriend
Dialog: Nothing!

Name: Norm
Dialog: And do you recall this voice?

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Hello, Heinz. I have your alimony check.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh-heh... Charlene!

Name: Norm
Dialog: That's right. It's your former wife, Charlene Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Delivered in person, like you asked. Ah, what is this, a game show set? Is this what you spend the money on?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you know, also groceries.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Well, at least it's not in my garage. Nice tux, Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: She's fantastic!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, let's bring out the big guns

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, at least I found the key to the- (his roof explodes) Nice. Curse you, Perry the- (the roof crashes down again) Oh... Why does everything explode so easily? (the entire top of his building explodes)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what I'm noticing a lot of? I blow up more than the average guy. (Perry notices a ceiling fan near his trap while Vanna is on the phone and starts swinging toward it) Do they have blowing-up insurance? I should get some of that. And if they don't have it, I think they should make it, 'cause I would buy some. Oh, baby, what an emotional workout!

Name: Norm
Dialog: And one more good trauma should send Arthur over the top! (the gnome is shown teetering at the edge of the summit)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-ha, yeah! Hit me with your best shot!

Name: Norm
Dialog: That's just it, sir! The rest are more comical than tragic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? How are we supposed to go over the- OOF! (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz off his chair) Aw, curse you, Perry the Platypus- and by "curse you," I mean "thank you!" By humiliating me, you have inadvertently provided me the last tragic backstory I need to put this baby over the top! Remember two seconds ago when you foiled my latest plan? I do!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) What? How are we supposed to go over the- OOF! (it repeats as Doofenshmirtz laughs evilly) How are we supposed to go over the- OOF!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now...! (the Backstory-inator starts to send the memories back to Doofenshmirtz) I can feel myself getting (his skin takes a red tint and his teeth become sharp) more e-e-evil!! (his laugh becomes deeper and he grows massive and muscular) Feel the doom!! Nothing can stop me now! (he picks up Perry with a claw-like hand and continues laughing; Perry pulls out his wallet and reveals pictures of the two of them, causing good memories to flow through the extraction helmet) Huh? Uh? NOOOOOO!!!!

Name: Platypus-Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do you ever get tired of lugging this big tail around? ...Well, back at it, I guess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I-I've got an even better best friend! It's clear to me that my best friend is Perry the Plat-OOF!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Peter the Panda? And Perry the Platypus? You're working together to rescue me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doofy-Doofy-Doofy, Doofy-Doofy-Doofy, Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want you to know that... you are appreciated, Perry the Platypus, you are appreciated.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You think I'm evil, right? (Perry gives him a grin) Thank you, Perry the Platypus. Thank you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! What have you done, Perry the Platypus? I'm getting less evil! (crashes into and smashes the Backstory-inator) Significantly sooooooo!! (returns to normal) Darn it, I really liked that shirt. (Perry hang glides away from the building) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Okay, so I'll see you tomorrow, right?

Name: Vanna
Dialog: (leaving with the gnome still in her foot) I'm sending you a bill for the shoes. My boyfriend's a lawyer.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, Norm, let's get this place cleaned up. There's backstory all over the place.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh, fine, you've bored me into submission. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One million five hundred sixty-two thousand nine hundred seventy-two... One million five hundred sixty-two thousand nine hundred seventy-eight! (the ball stops over the net, hovering and glowing white) We did it! We've stored up enough kinetic energy; the quantum vortex should appear any second now. (the ball sucks the table, the boys, and the entire background up, leaving only a blank white screen; Candace walks on, hesitantly and frightened)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looks around) ...Mom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He laughs evilly) I got you now, Perry the Platypus! This is the most sophisticated trap that I have ever invented.(Chamber shows Agent P trapped) In fact, it's so escape-proof that- that I couldn't get that guy out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, I had to build a whole new trap to catch you. And of course, I had to buy a new plastic skeleton for Halloween. It's a pitiful existence I lead, Perry the Platypus. Do- Do you pity me? You should because I am pitiable. Everyone should pity me. Eh, you don't have to say pity too many times before it stops sounding like a word. Pity. Pity. Pit- See? That is only like two times and it's already just gobbledygook. Gobbledygook, too. I can't- I can't even get through that once. Gobbledy- Now see, I am not even consider the last syllable and it's already... (sighs) Great. Now, I am forgetting what I was talking about... Which is another reason to pity me! YEAH! Back on topic, baby! You see, I- I figured if I get myself big sad eyes, people would pity me and get me whatever I want. And to that end, behold! The Big-Sad-Eye-inator! You like it? It sums up a lot of juice, so I am running at night when the electricity is cheaper.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But the nighttime is the right time for a party. A PITY PARTY! (He laughs) Here we go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone) Don't worry about a thing Mom everything's under control.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (In the car with Lawrence) Thanks Candace. It's been too long since your father and I had a date night.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Thirteen days, twenty-two hours, and seventeen minutes.

Name: Linda
Dialog: How do you know that?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I've got an app on my phone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't worry about us, bye. (She hangs up) Parents are weird.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes they are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It takes a while to get warmed up, but we're almost there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See I told you it took up a lot of juice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What happened?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think we blew a fuse.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't get all technical on me, just fix it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax Candace, Ferb and I'll check the fuse box. In the mean time you go find a flashlight.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Find a flashlight, find a flashlight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Ferb, isn't it cool how you can still see people's eyes in -- (doesn't see Ferb) Ferb? Where'd you go?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh-ho! You prankster.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know we have a flashlight in here somewhere. (begins feeling around in a drawer) Oh, okay, that's a stapler, Oh! Scissors. And, what is this, an old banana? Eww. What happened to all the flashlights? Ah-ha! (The flashlight flickers out) Darn, the batteries are dying. I better conserve them. Phineas? Ferb? (trips) Oh who leaves a chair right next to a table?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like the whole town's in a blackout.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella? Your voice sounds horrible.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fooled ya'! It's me, Buford! And my voice isn't horrible, it's raspy! You gotta spend hours screamin' in the closet to get it like this. Hours!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, what'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's the original. I'm glad your here Isabella. Ferb and I are working on something that will give us all the best blackout ever!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Can I help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure you can Baljeet.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey Buford, your voice is so raspy. It sounds as if sandpaper and a washboard had a baby.

Name: Buford
Dialog: See, closet time's paying off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay guys let's get to work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, hold it right there. Who else is back here? Roll call.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well there's Ferb, Isabella, Buford, Baljeet and me. Oh, and there's that kid in the corner with the eyepatch.

Name: Kid with Eyepatch
Dialog: (spookly) But is it my left eye, or my right eye? You don't know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone) Hi Mom, yeah we're okay. In fact I was just about to call you. I can't see what Phineas and Ferb are making but I'm sure it's bustable.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, it'll have to wait. Traffic lights are out all over the city. Of course you know I'd like nothing better than to give up my special time with your father, to run home and not see what they may, or may not have done.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I can't remember were you always this sarcastic?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Shh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're using a wench Mom. They're making something huge, and (Candace trips and loses her phone, to a mechanical buzzing)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Candace found the wood chipper guys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My phone!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, we got disconnected. Now who's going to grate on my nerves all night?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, so you have always been this sarcastic.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh that's right, it's going to be you.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You betcha, Duckie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: One way or another, I'm going to see what all you eyeballs are making back here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure, I want everyone to see, including Perry. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A blackout? Oh, Perry the Platypus isn't this wonderful? Now people can't see anything but my pitiful eyes. Look at them, Perry the Platypus, don't you feel sorry for me? Don't my sad, lugubrious eyes illicit compassion and mercy? (He pauses) Your secret agent training has taught you to squint well my nemesis. But you can't fight the power of these pathetic, pleading eyes. I guess you can, 'cause you're heartless Perry the Platypus. You know that? Where you're heart should be, a big empty sack of nothing. But the common man will not be able to. I'm going to go find someone on the street and test these babies out. And you're coming with me. Here come on. It's a good thing I put wheels on this trap. Try to keep up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Somebody hand me that wrench.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The power transformer is online.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It's a good thing you had this bicycle-powered generator.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We like to be prepared for any eventuality. Thanks for pedaling by the way.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford was supposed to take over half an hour ago. But I cannot find him anywhere!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And you're not gonna.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, is that you?

Name: Buford
Dialog: No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on you stupid thing, work! (The flashlight turns on) There. Now where is it? (sees a glimpse of mechanical arms) What the -- ? (The flashlight goes out) Ugh, stupid thing. What are you guys building?

Name: Candace
Dialog: An anti-gravity device?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, that's just the crane. Tighten the servomotor.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aye-aye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to fell my way through this. Okay, this feels like, metal. And this is some kind of wooden railing. Ooh, mushy-squshy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're not using any "mushy-squshy" stuff. But that's Perry's favorite spot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, gross. Can you just tell me what you're building?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'd love to. But it's kinda hard to put into words. You really just have to experience it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine. Fire it up.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great. Put on this helmet. And this mouthguard. And this lead apron. Arms up... and you're ready to go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, okay, this isn't so -- (gets flung around) BAAAAAAAAAAD!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow Candace, we never thought of riding it before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think I swallowed the mouth-guard.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Perry the Platypus, I see someone. You'll understand the power of my sad eyes when you see them in action. You ready? Watch this. Excuse me?

Name: Man
Dialog: Oh, you look so sad. I feel, I feel so sorry for you. What can I do? Here take this. There. And as soon as I find my home, I'll come back and give you more free stuff. You poor, poor thing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see? And I don't even know what it is.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Sir, your eyes, they compel me to help. Let me contribute. Here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you kind sir. Why is it all warm?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Your eyes bring out my mercy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't they just?

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Here, take all I have.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You gave me a wig?

Name: Man 3
Dialog: No.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Here take this. Ooh take that. Please take this. Here have my wallet. My toaster. My watermelon.

Name: Man 4
Dialog: Oh let's all go get him some more stuff.

Name: Man 5
Dialog: Jetpack squad away!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, if it worked on that jetpack squad, I bet ya it'll work on my brother, Roger! He'll take pity on me, and make me mayor! And that's just a hop, skip and a jump from having people give me the whole Tri-State Area!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (On Perry's wristwatch communicator) Thank goodness your wrist communicator is still working Agent P. We traced the blackout to the Danville power plant on 5th street. I know you're busy with Doofenshmirtz, and you don't normally handle stuff like this, but I was in the middle of microwaving a burrito, and center is still totally frozen. Just figured you were close, and uh... Hurry Agent P. it's, it's kind of scary in here, and I'm all alone.(There is a crash sound) Carl? C-Carl, is that you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How can I bust you if I don't know what you've made? (A car horn sounds twice) Dad's unmistakable, two honk horn signal. They're home! Mom! Dad! You're home!.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi sweetie. The restaurant was closed because of the blackout.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What's all that noise?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb made a dangerous...thing in the backyard, in the dark. Oh this stupid fence! Why do we have this stupid fence? Dad, tear down this fence!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What do you think, should we tear down this fence?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: That's that sarcasm I like.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You can feel what they made. Come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, my arm!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You, you know Perry the Platypus, I d- I didn't realize this trap would be so heavy. City Hall is still a few blocks away, you wouldn't mind if I just leave you here, do you? Hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Where's Perry... the Platypus?

Name: Worker 1
Dialog: That's all it was? That big red switch over there?

Name: Worker 2
Dialog: You think I would've know that. I mean I got a Ph.D.

Name: Worker 1
Dialog: You work that into every conversation.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, can you feel it Mom? Can you feel it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I feel something...pointy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're right Ferb. (He and Ferb take off the sunglasses they were wearing) We're cooler, even in the dark.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Where is that incredibly, huge, and dangerous thing that you built?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A bunch of guys on jetpacks came by and asked if they could have it. So we gave it to them.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh you boys are so cute.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But what was it? What was it?!

Name: Roger
Dialog: So why is it that you think I'm just going to hand over my mayorship to you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, because I've got these big sad eyes.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Yeah, and they're kind of freaking me out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I guess it probably works better in the dark. Look, it's the jetpack squad.

Name: Man
Dialog: Here sad eyed man, we brought you this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I think I swallowed my mouth guard.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Open the floodgates. (Ferb turns the hose open and water comes out from the sprinklers)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is like our own miniature Canada! But, of course, without the beavers, moose, and disproportionate number of comedians.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Or Canadian bacon.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I forgot all about Canadian bacon.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You realize it is only ham.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Off-screen) Phineas! (Walks on screen) And Ferb! You are so busted!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, boys, splendid job on the hockey rink. (He crashes into a snowbank) Well, that was amusing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great skating, Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Boys, I've got some good news for you. I've arranged for you to play a little exhibition match between the periods of the Danville Ice Trays game.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you mean like at halftime?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, it's three periods, so it's really two-thirds time.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bland sports terms. That's what keeping the Canadians down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If we're going to be the entertainment, then we'd better kick it up a notch. Hockey Z-9?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hockey Z-9.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, like Football X-7.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What happened to Y-8?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, we're saving that for croquet. Ferb, grab your toolbox. We've got work to do. (they exit)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) What's the big deal with hockey anyway?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, it's hard to explain actually, taking the flip pass from the winner, shoulder deking the defense men, and then, tossing it right over the old glove hand. Oh, it just takes hold of you like a fever!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did you play a lot of hockey in England there, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Never once.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (off-screen) Hey, Candace. (walks right on-screen behind Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What a great ice rink.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wouldn't it just be perfect for figure skating?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (as Candace says "figure skating") Ice hockey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Oh yeah. Ice hockey.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't know that you were a hockey fan, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles) You betcha! Flipping over win passes, and then shoulder dorkin' the old jazz hands. It's like some kind of disease!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh... yeah.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Say, Jeremy, why don't you join us at the exhibition game today?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sounds like fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah. Sounds like... (makes phone noise) BRRRRING!! Oh, hey. I got a phone call from, um... a real person. Gotta go. (walks out of backyard, calling Stacy on her phone) Stacy, we have a Code Teal.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looking at a color wheel) Locusts? Are you sure?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, wait. I mean Code Periwinkle.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Periwinkle. A hockey emergency? I'm on it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Speaking of periwinkle, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I'm freezing. Did you call that repair guy yet?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I left him a message, sir. I think he went to Aruba for winter break.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Lucky dog. It's cold in... Oh! Agent P! Didn't hear you come in. I have no idea what Doofenshmirtz is up to. It seems all of our computers froze. Isn't that right, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (is seen with his hands inside an ice-encased computer) Tech support says everything is fine.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I'm sure whatever Doof is up to, he's probably much warmer than we are, and that alone should be reason to stop him! Good luck, Agent P! (Perry salutes and exits his lair)

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Welcome, hockey hounds, to the hypothermic hippodrome of Danville Mountain Top Winter Arena where our own Danville Ice Trays will cross sticks with the combative cross-town contenders. Reigning over the skating skirmish tonight as guest referee is Hockey Hall of Famer, Luc Robitaille!

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: Is anyone else cold? Why is it so cold in here?

Name: Audience
Dialog: We don't know, Luc Robitaille!

Name: Man in audience
Dialog: Actually, I brought a blanket. So, I'm okay.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Here we are.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, this is so exciting! I've always wanted to be a hockey mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me for a second. (walks out and presses bluetooth button) System check. Stacy, can you read me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on headphones talking to Candace) I've got the hockey reference manuals, league website, and official rules up and ready!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Stacy, Mom said it's my turn to use the computer!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Not now, Ginger. I'm busy.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Don't make me open a can of whipped cream on you! Or however that goes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! (on an ice chair holding a mug of hot chocolate) Come in! How do you like my evil igloo hideout up in the Danville Mountains? Would you like some hot cocoa? No? Then, how about a marshmallow! (Doofenshmirtz launches a giant marshmallow out of his cocoa mug, trapping Perry) Ha. Ha! Trapped you again! I think I figured out why I haven't been able to take over the Tri-State Area. I've been too much of a nice guy. Nice guys can't take over large metropolitan areas, except for Roger. But, we're not talking about Roger. I've got to get mean. (Doofenshmirtz slides his chair across the igloo's floor; his cocoa mug falls and breaks) I've got to get ugly and possibly hairy. (Doofenshmirtz's chair slides past a picture of the abominable snowman) I've got to learn to be more like the abominable snowman. (chair crashes; a cat screeches) So, I decided to build this! Behold, the Abominable-nat... The, the Abominama... The A-bom-in-a-ble-i-nat-or. See, I can only say it if I speak slowly. The Abominable... Inator. Oh look, if I, if I separate it, it works. The Abominable Inator! It makes whatever it hits bigger and scarier and hairier. Anyhoo, behold. (removes cover from the Abominable-inator, which is covered in a huge scarf and knitted cap; Perry looks unimpressed) Okay, I know what you're thinking

Name: Dink
Dialog: And the blare of the buzzer brings down the metaphorical curtain on the scintillating second period of this titanic tussle as the grim, gritty gladiators vacate the frozen field of flailing, fighting flugelhorn to prepare for the third period of this tellican, turf-toes tower as the frosty defibrillators mill the frozen peems of icy... (gasps) Oh, man. I better go lay down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So when all the members of the offending team clear the defensive zone at the same time, the delayed offset call is negated.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, you really do know hockey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you kidding? Did you know a referee makes most penalty calls-

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (to Candace over the phone, reading from a rulebook) While the linesmen may call only obvious technical infractions. (to Ginger) Go away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Obvious technical infractions. Go away. The player who committed the infraction is no give me that. No Ginger, I'm busy. I said give me that back. If you don't give that back to me right now, Candace, gotta go.

Name: Dink
Dialog: Now for your entertainment, what we've all been waiting for

Name: Linda
Dialog: This is so exciting! (her camera beeps) Oh, I forgot to charge the battery. Oh no, I can't miss this photo op! Where is the gift shop?!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Uh, it's way over there, on the other side of the arena.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll be right back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, Perry the Platypus, as I make myself abominable. (Doof presses the button on the -inator's remote. The -inator's beam bounces off the igloo and hits the marshmallow trapping Perry, causing it to burst and splatter all over Doofenshmirtz.) Ooh, it's all marshmallow-y and hairy. Not completely unlike summer camp. Apparently, you gotta aim this thing a little better... (the -inator shoots a beam directly at Doof's rear end) Whoa! Owww! Hmmm, something's not right in the hinterland. (his bottom suddenly becomes large and hairy, causing him to fall on the front of the sled) Yikes! Oof! (the igloo slides off the mountain top and hits a rock, causing it to break; Perry flies into the air and grabs the scarf trailing from the -inator)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (skating onto the ice with Ferb) Okay, Ferb, looks like we're on.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, prepare to be transported to a world where everything you know is changed into a global, glacial dystopia. (large, flaming ice sculptures rise up from the rink) If you're looking for something fluffy, forget it, pal, because this is the future, where the only things left are hard, cold, and in most cases pointy. It's a world where the only way to survive is to play hockey while things blow up around you. It's a world of skillful skating (Baljeet skates into a spotlight) and incredible ice ramps, (Django launches off a ramp into the rink) puck-pushing prowess (Buford enters, crashing through some barrels) and savage stone gladiators. (Phineas and Ferb skate into the center of the rink)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, this is so bustable! (to Linda's now-empty seat) Mom, D... Where's Mom?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: She went to the gift shop to buy a disposable camera.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the heck is that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's a camera, that you send away to get the film part developed, and then you take the non-film camera-only part, and you throw it away.

Name: David
Dialog: What the heck is film?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (completely exasperated) Would you please just look in the back?

Name: Announcer
Dialog: This is the harsh, hybrid hockey of your dark, dystopian destiny.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in her announcer voice) Hockey Z-9! (in her normal voice) Thanks, Dink! Gotta get on the ice!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as the sled goes off a ramp) Aaaaugh!! (Perry climbs up the scarf and lands on the front of the sled as Doof's feet grow big and hairy, causing his shoes to fly off) Oh, my feet! Now it's working. (several more pops are heard as Doof becomes completely abominable) Hey, not bad. A little hairy, but not bad. Now, to deal with you! (Doof grabs for Perry, who darts under his legs) Gotcha! Hey, where'd you go? (Perry tugs on Doof's back hair) Oh, there you are. (Perry beckons Doof to come closer) Yes? (Perry punches Doof, whose head causes the Abominable-inator to point upwards) Ow! Ow, Oh, stupid thing! (Doof attempts to adjust the -inator, but it hits him in the head again) Ow! (the -inator fires)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (trying to enter the rink) 'Scuse me, I gotta get through here.

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa. You're not allowed out there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I gotta go get my mom, and this is the shortcut to the gift shop!

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: I'm sorry, you can't go out there. That's for players only.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Players, huh?

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: You're gonna go get a uniform and try to get out there, aren't you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that a problem?

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: No, as long as we're clear on the concept.

Name: David
Dialog: Hey, look at that! There was one in our "disposable stuff from the 80's" box.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks, David. (runs out)

Name: David
Dialog: Let me know if you need more things to throw away!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Where the heck... hey, how'd you get over there? Don't do that! (Perry pries a board off the sled) Oh man! (Perry jumps off the sled and uses the board as a snowboard, grinding a rail while traveling down the mountain) Okay, now you're just showing off! (Perry spots trees ahead and snowboards off to the right) What? Is there something I should... AAAHHHH!! (Doof crashes into the top of a tree, bending it down) I fail to see how this could get any worse. (Doof's head turns back to normal) Oof! (the rest of Doof's body turns back to normal; now lighter, the tree catapults Doof into the distance) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (trails off)

Name: Zamboni driver
Dialog: Okay, I'm pretty sure that's not supposed to happen. Mr. Stevens! (runs into the arena) Mr. Stevens, I'm having trouble with the equipment! (the abominable Zamboni enters the arena)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walking through a crowd of cheering fans with foam fingers) Sorry. Excuse me. Yes, you are Number One. Excuse me. Sorry. Pardon me. Alright, alright, al... excuse me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (noticing the abominable Zamboni) Aw, check it out, a monster ice-polishing machine! Okay everyone, looks like we're done, let's get out of here. (the abominable Zamboni clears the rink back to normal and exits the arena, revealing the kids and Luc Robitaille in a perfect picture pose)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh my gosh. That is the cutest thing I've ever seen. Everyone say "Canadian bacon!"

Name: Phineas, Ferb, Buford, Baljeet, Isabella, Django, Luc Robitaille
Dialog: Ham! (Linda takes the picture)

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: Great job, kids. (Candace skates onto the ice behind them, dressed in full hockey gear) That was the weirdest game of hockey I've ever seen.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Mr. Robitaille! (the kids skate off the rink)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'm all set to sneak across the ice.

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: Go ahead. Hockey Z-9 is over. (skates away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? No! Mom, they had giant dangerous... with a... (snaps hockey stick over thigh) It's not fair! (throws down gloves, gets into fighting stance) It's so not fair!

Name: Luc Robitaille
Dialog: (skating back; blows his whistle) Unsportsmanlike behavior! (points to the penalty box)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (skates there) Fine.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Candace, I had a really good time. You want to get something to eat?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, that sounds like fun! But give me two minutes. (notices Perry sitting next to her) Oh, there you are Perry.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Have fun at the party!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (in her car) Thanks for having the boys over tonight, Vivian.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, no problem, Linda. I have all the neighborhood kids tonight.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the back seat of the car) C'mon, c'mon, I don't want to be late for my first grown-up party!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Heh. Okay, hun. Bye everyone! Happy New Year!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye guys!

Name: Isabella, Buford, Baljeet, Vivian
Dialog: Goodbye!

Name: Phineas, Isabella, Buford, Baljeet, Vivian
Dialog: Happy New Year!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're gonna have so much fun! We've got noisemakers, balloons, confetti...

Name: Vivian
Dialog: And of course, we'll all stay up till midnight and watch the New Year's Eve ball drop!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Baljeet's already out! (elbowing Baljeet, who is asleep standing up) Wake up, will ya! You're drooling all over my arm!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, saliva is 98% water and the other 2% is made up of very beneficial electrolytes. It is gross, but it is science.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're lucky the gross factor outweighs the science factor, or you'd have a one-way ticket to wedgie town!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it'll be fun to finally see the ball drop.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, it's a wonderful tradition!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And, of course, there's the other tradition of kissing someone special at midnight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well then, I know what we're going to do tonight.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! We're gonna make our own New Year's ball and drop it from outer space!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Your mother is right, Phineas. You have such an active imagination!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (dryly) Not active enough.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: I'm going to make some hot chocolate. You kids come in when you want to warm up. Hey, where's your platypus?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (wearing a winter knit cap) Morning, Agent P. Sorry about the cold climate inside your lair; see, the heating system is on the fritz and we had to call a guy in from Aruba, but I can assure you that we are all in the same boat here. (Perry is now completely frozen in ice, except for his bill) You're not alone in this; we are all sharing the pain, and... (a beach ball hits the background, which drops, revealing that Monogram is in Aruba) Heh heh heh, awk-ward.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Race ya to the wet ski!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Um, uh, Doof's doing something in City Hall, uh, put a stop to whatever it is. (running after Carl) Hey Carl, I get the blue one!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: '(Perry frozenly chatters)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Phineas, we're good to go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great. Bring her down! How's the soldering going up there?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ferb is almost done.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are you doing, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why do I have to paint? Painting is for babies and beatniks!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's no ordinary paint. It's a super-sealer that will protect us from the cold, dark vacuum of space!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Beatnik talk!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (followed by the Fireside Girls and two other kids, all staring in awe at the ball) Hey, Phineas. Mind if we see the inside?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not at all! (They enter; each room is shown as Phineas mentions it) Check it out! A multi-level New Year's ball with punch bowl sailing...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ahoy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...balloon room, the bed of a thousand coats, an infinity slide, and through here, the grand ballroom! In other words, a ball within a ball!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Irving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (on the infinity slide) How do I get out of here?!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Happy New Year!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, I told you

Name: Norm
Dialog: Happy New Year!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not yet, Norm. And on to my plan

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) Uh, you couldn't change your channel on your TV,...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) ...you couldn't change your underwear,...

Name: (Flashback of young Doofenshmirtz in jail with two tough-looking criminals)Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over)...and forget about changing your hairstyle; you... you'd end up in jail.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But here in the new world, we embrace change! (beat) Apparently. And that's why I came up with the Resolution Changer-inator! Cleverly disguised as a bow tie! When I turn it on at the stroke of midnight, it will make everyone change their resolution from whatever it was, like, I don't know, "I-I'm gonna lose weight," or, "gain a limb," or whatever, to, "I'm going to make Heinz Doofenshmirtz my leader and obey his every command." That will be their new resolution. (puts the Resolution Changer-inator on) All right, Norm, how do I look?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Like a pharmacist in a bow tie!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, good enough. Time to go. (Norm blows a noisemaker) You're squandering, Norm!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (entering the party at City Hall with Linda) Ready to get your party on, dear?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Do one-legged ducks swim in circles?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (entering the party with Stacy) Wow, first year with the adults!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yep, we're all grown up now. No more pigtails, dollies, or obsessing over boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: From now on, we obsess over men. (Candace and Stacy laugh) And no more busting!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Attagirl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep, I'm sticking to my resolution and turning over a new leaf. Fifteen whole minutes and I haven't thought of Phineas and Ferb. (her eye starts twitching) How they make those things. You know, those big, like, dangerous things they make...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry! I'm back, I'm back. Resolution... kicking in. Oh look, here come the boys!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You mean men? (Candace and Stacy laugh)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walking up to them with Coltrane) Ladies.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's us! We're ladies.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Carbonation is fun!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (entering the party) Hello, Danville! (running up to a man) Hey you there, what's your New Year's resolution?

Name: Mustached man
Dialog: To update my mustache.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's what you think! (walking away) Ha-HA-ha-ha! HA-ha!

Name: Mustached man
Dialog: I don't know; it seemed achievable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sitting at a table with Stacy) This is so great, being here as an adult. (giggles) Heh-heh. Not like my brothers. Who are kids. Who are probably building something, and it's something big...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Big and bustable... Gotta go!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no you don't! This is gonna be a new year with a new Candace! Remember?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (trying to resist, gripping the table) Gotta bust. G-g-g-gotta-g-g-gotta bu-bu-bu-bust! (breaks off two chunks of the table) Bust!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (as Candace keeps chattering) It's okay. It's just a temporary relapse.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walking up with Coltrane, holding a tray with four glasses of sparkling cider on it) Candace? Stacy told me about your New Year's resolution.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Iiiiii... I need a timeout. I'll be right back!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Relapse?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Relapse.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to a woman) That's what you think! Ha-HA-ha-ha-ha! Oh, it never stops being... (gasps as Perry enters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? You can't come in here; this is a black-tie affair. (Perry closes the door, then reenters wearing a half of a tux)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually, I guess it doesn't really specify pants anywhere, so I guess you're okay.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (to Linda) Oh, and another little tidbit about the ancient Egyptians (Doofenshmirtz and Perry run past them in the background) is that both men and women wore makeup.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just like the '80s.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the ladies bathroom, washing her face with cold water) Hbrbrbrbrbr... Hold it together, girl. You can do this.

Name: Sandwich woman's friend
Dialog: Hey, I thought your New Year's resolution was to stop eating sandwiches in the bathroom.

Name: Sandwich woman
Dialog: (eating a large sandwich) But it's not midnight yet, so I can still enjoy this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not midnight yet? That's it! I've actually got an hour left to bust my brothers! (running out of City Hall) I've gotta find out what they're doing! I'll get video. Whoa! Ooh! (slips and falls on a patch of ice) Aah! Aah!! (skids down an alleyway, bounces off a pillow and goes flying) Aah!!! (swings around a street lamp's pole and lands on her feet) Ooh! Huh, that parkour training actually paid off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, let's start this bash in a ball! (pulls a lever)

Name: Kids
Dialog: Yay! (they all throw confetti)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasping) Huh, huh... (sees the ball rise) No, I missed it! And how am I gonna show Mom?

Name: Irving
Dialog: (standing next to a camera set-up) No worries! I'm live-blogging the whole event on my podcast! We're trending right now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right now? (into the camera) Hey, all of you out there in Internet Land! Watch closely, because I'm gonna bust Phineas and Ferb. (leaves)

Name: Irving
Dialog: (into the camera) Hee hee hee! She never busts them. (into the camera again) And Internet Land is not a real place!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (runs through a curtain into a room filled with coats) What is this, the coat room? (Perry launches himself from behind the coats into Doofenshmirtz, who goes flying into a rack of coats; he emerges with a pink hat and coat on) All right, Perry the Platypus, if you really want to fight, here I a... (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz into another coat rack) Ooh, Cashmere. Nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (re-enters City Hall, gasping)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I got you a glass of sparkling cider.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Raincheck! This is my last time to bust!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Serious relapse.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Irving. (plugs her phone into the wall, switching the video feed to show Phineas and Ferb's ball) Yes! Everyone, can I have your attention please? (everyone turns to face Candace) My brothers and their friends will be dropping from outer space in that giant New Year's ball.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Man
Dialog: Amazing!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Ooh, that's fantastic!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, that's not fantastic! It, uh, okay, well, I-I admit it's impressive, but it's still bustable! Mooo-oommmm!!

Name: Woman with pearls
Dialog: If those were my boys, they'd be so busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Please! Adopt me now! AAAUUUGGGHHH! Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, it's almost midnight, let's go! (pushes lever and the ball drops)

Name: Kids
Dialog: (scream)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (emerging from the coat room) Ha-HA! You'll never get out of that straitjacket. Why would anyone wear that to a New Year's Eve party? I guess maybe if you were a magician, maybe...

Name: Man and woman
Dialog: (running out of coat room) Only one minute 'til midnight!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to launch my pla-an! (runs on stage) Hee-hee-hee-hee-hee-hee!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? Mom?

Name: Sandwich woman
Dialog: (still eating the sandwich) Almost done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sees Linda and Lawrence about to kiss in the courtyard) Mom! It's New Year's! This is no time for kissing!

Name: Crowd
Dialog: 3! (Phineas and Ferb's ball lands) 2! 1!

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Happy New Year!! (cheers)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Now watch this. (to crowd) What is everyone's New Year's resolution?

Name: Crowd
Dialog: To follow you, Heinz Doofenshmirtz, our new leader!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-HA-ha-ha-ha! Mmmm, so, how does it feel to be a loser, Perry the Platypus? I mean, that's a rhetorical question. 'Course, if anyone should know how it feels, it should be me, but... (to crowd) All right, everyone! Follow me; we're taking over City Hall! (runs out of room; no one follows him, so he comes back in to find the crowd cheering) Hello? What are you doing? Obey me! Hey, wha-what about your resolution?

Name: Man with party hat
Dialog: (laughing) Everyone knows that no one ever keeps their New Year's resolution.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That doesn't even make any sense! Why would you make resolutions if you're not ever gonna fol... (to Perry) Did you know about this? You did! You knew about this and you still punched and kicked and pinched me. (Perry shrugs his shoulders) Ah, I guess you're right. That's... that is what we do. (Perry blows a noisemaker) Aw, thank you, Perry the Platypus. (Doofenshmirtz blows the noisemaker) Happy New Year.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What is happening?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is this your doing, bro?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: "Auld Lang Syne" literally means "old long ago," but I'd rather think of New Year's as an unspoiled universe. (ball explodes into fireworks)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I sure hope Candace can see the fireworks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (standing with Jeremy on a balcony, watching the fireworks) You know, I don't know if I'm gonna be able to keep this resolution.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's okay. I like you just the way you are. Happy New Year, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Happy New Year, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (they kiss; fireworks go off reading "HAPPY NEW YEAR")'

Name: Norm
Dialog: (on D.E.I. balcony, holding an air conditioner; over last two lines of song) Happy New Year! (kisses air conditioner) Mwah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone) You'll never guess what I'm doing tonight.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, you might be...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Going on a big date, but guess with whom?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Obviously—

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's Jeremy. (Squeals) But you'll never guess where.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Sighs) I have no idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Neither do I. He says it's a surprise.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, lucky you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The problem is if I don't know where we're going, I don't know what to wear.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh! I know, Hair bows. They're all the rage this days. Just don't wear any feather-earrings, they're so last Tuesday.

Name: Candace
