Dialog: (Puts feather-earrings down) Ah! Yeah, so last Tuesday, Ah hah. I-I would never wear something so Tuesdayish of last.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, seems the parts didn't arrive for our Zombie-robot pool table. Anybody have any other suggestions?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, remember how we did that super Rollercoaster? How 'bout a super duper Rollercoaster?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, you are just adding a "duper" then?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's an acceptable suffix.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We did a Portal to Mars. Maybe...a Portal to Venus?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hah! Only if they make SPF 12 million.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay-okay! How 'bout a super-super duper-duper-duper Rollercoaster? What, too much or not enough?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, instead of improving one of our old inventions, we should make something brand new! Something simple.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How do you mean?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, what is summer all about?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, we all know the song. (beat) But I'm not exactly sure how....

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, Hurry up and think of somethin', I'm gettin' tired hanging around here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it Buford. You can't get more summer than a tire swing. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, hatch mosquitoes?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No. Hey! Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P, We have a report that Doofenshmirtz is at the Shark. We don't know which Shark, but it sounds bad. Ugh! Gives me the heebie-jeebies just thinking about it...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, it was a typo, Doof isn't at the Shark, he's at the park.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well then, that's a lot lower on my heebie-jeebie scale. So Agent P, uh, change of plan. Head over to the park and stop Doof from doing the doings that Doof does ...do (Clears throat)

Name: Carl
Dialog: You have a heebie-jeebie scale, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah. You're on it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An old-fashioned tire-swing but huge and powered by jet-engines that can flatten a small village. Baljeet have you calibrated the ailerons yet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh sure, calibrated the ailerons...

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll just stay here and fiddle with stuff so I look busy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I didn't take nothing out of nowhere. But, uhm, just as a hypothetical. Uh... What do you think would happen if say you took that goofy doohickey-thing out of the thingamawhatsit?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm... Good question. Ferb? (Opens a blueprint.) Well, if we account for the coolness of the jet propulsion circuits this early in the day and the increased internal humidity while that access port is open, removing the part in question would cause the machine to emit a ray that turns a human into a fly.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'd be surprised how often removing a single component can make the difference between one thing and a highly complicated totally unrelated other thing. For instance, if you remove this part it will become a Sorbet machine. Why do you ask?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, no reason.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A hair bow? Only Stacy can pull this off. (Screams) I'm a fly, how is this possible? Phineas and Ferb, you are so buzzzzzzzzted! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bzzzz! Bzzzzzzz!!! Bzz bzzz bzzzzzz! Bzzzzzz! (close up on fly Candace as she buzzes in her mother's ear) Mom, look! Phineas and Ferb invented somethin' that turns people into flies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bzzzz bzzzzzz!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ew, get away, fly! Shoo! Oops! I'm late for my appointment.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bzzzzz! Bzzzzz! Mom! It's me! Mom!!! You need to bust the boys and get them to turn me back into me before Jeremy gets back here! (wide shot as Candace realizes she's in the car with Linda, who starts the ignition) What?! (She flies in place but not before smashing into the window) Help meeeeee!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, won't you join me for a picnic? (Perry hesitates but then walks up, but not before sinking into his trap. Doofenshmirtz laughs.) Ah! Ah! Ow, my duodenum. Oh, oh, did you see your face?! You were like, "Ooh, maybe I shouldn't," but you're then, "Well, I am hungry" and then BOOM! down you went! Ha-ha! And are you hungry, Perry the Platypus? (Picks up the picnic basket) Well, too bad, it's not for you. It's for them. (Whip pan to reveal pigeons eating seeds. Cut back to Doofenshmirtz, who retrieves an inator from the basket) Behold! My feed-the-pigeons-inator! (Perry just gives Doofenshmirtz a look) Okay, Snobby the Snobapus, I know it doesn't sound like much, but it is technically evil. I am breaking the law. See? (whip pan to a sign saying, "DO NOT FEED THE PIGEONS!") There? There. "Do not feed the pigeons". And I am going to feed the pigeons, therefore I am breaking the law. "Do not feed the pigeons". It's a-it's a metal sign with......big red letters on it and that makes it.......legally binding. (covers his eyes) Okay, here's the truth

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lady and gentlemen, may we present the good old-fashioned new-fashioned tire swing! (Cut to inside the tire swing to reveal Phineas, Isabella, Ferb, Baljeet and Buford inside the tire) Prepare to engage thrusters! (The tire begins swinging back and forth with rocket launchers) The fully-pressurized cabin is gyroscopically balanced for a perfectly smooth ride.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmmm. Now it just feels like we are watching a movie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pushing a red button) True, but we can also go old school! Hang on, everybody!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is great!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I have never been so sick to my stomach!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I think I've gleaned from your expression that you are now going to lead me through a series of bizarre and seemingly unrelated exercises that will help me get my groove back. Does that about sum it up? Good. Let's do this thing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bzzzz! Bzzzzzz! Bzzz bzz bzzzzz!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You again? Ha ha! Looks like I took you on a little trip. (opens her window) Get back to your family, little fella.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Little fella? What of me looks like a little FELLAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA! (she tumbles out the window)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasp) This is Jeremy's house! And there's Jeremy! At last! A silver lining! I can find out where we're goin' tonight! A girl's gotta know what a girl's gotta wear.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, it's a total surprise. I'm taking her to the rodeo.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The rodeo? I love rodeos! Wait, do I love rodeos or is that because I'm a fly?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hang on, Coltrane, there's a fly in here. Lemme get it.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: There's one!

Name: Holly
Dialog: C'mon, Fireside Girls!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Let's get it!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Well, girls, there goes our lizard-feeding patch.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Zzzzzz...zzzzzz! (she lands on a water spout. Close up as she catches her breath) Could this day get any weirder?

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: Hello.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Omigosh, were you turned into a fly, too?

Name: Human Fly
Dialog: Who me? No. I was always a fly. I just got shot with a human-head-inator and...now I got this thing! It's really uncomfortable. How do you walk around with these?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tell me about it. Be glad you don't have a freakishly long neck! (She buzzes out of frame)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was the most fun ever!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! And let's restock the snack bar and go again!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Now there is something you do not see every day

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Orange hair? (takes out a loupe) Uh oh! (POV shot from the loupe to show a really ticked-off Candace fly) Candace has been turned into a fly! (cut back to Phineas) Wait a minute! Did someone take the doohickey out of the thingamawhatsit? (looks aside) Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uhhh...oh no! If I catch the mug what did this...Yeah I'm on it! (he walks to the control panel) Okay, I just pull on... (he activates something and a yellow ray shoots out)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) Whoop! Wrong one!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) Not that one!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wa-wait! Go back two!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps, happily) Oh thank you thank you thank you thank you! (exits then enters again, angrily) I mean, you are so busted! (exits again, then enters again, happily) But thank you!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Took a few tries there! If I weren't thinking, I woulda just pressed this "fly" button. (He presses the fly button, causing the giant tire swing to launch, taking the pedestal with it) Oh, that kind of fly!

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Woah, that is so weird! We're in a space shuttle and the shuttle program ended years ago!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I guess that's it. Fun's over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Au contraire. (He pushes a button and the control panel changes into a sorbet machine. He passes out a couple of sorbets to his friends) Sorbet?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is great! The best inator I've ever made! And you know what, Perry the Platypus? There's no self-destruct button on this, so there's no way you can stop me from taking over the entire Tri-State— (The giant tire swing lands on his inator before he finishes his statement) Huh. Well, like my Uncle Boris used to say, "When life's goin' well, a giant tire comes along and smashes your inator." We all thought he was crazy at the time, but now it seems rather prophetic.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't get why this stuff is called "sorbet"? Ain't it just a fancy people word for "ice cream"?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: While ice cream is made from dairy products and turned vigorously with air, sorbet is made entirely out of fancy people.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Really?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No, not really.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, guys! (He comes in dressed in his fancy suit) Is Candace around?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey there, Jeremy! (cut to the sliding door to reveal Candace in a cowgirl outfit, speaking in a western accent) A lil' birdie told me we were goin' to the rodeo!

Name: Maitre d'
Dialog: (French accent) Actually, sir, it is pronounced "ro-day-o".

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, yeah. My mistake.

Name: Maitre d'
Dialog: (to Candace) May I take your order..."partner"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I don't suppose it's Dress Like a Cowboy and Get Your Dinner Free Night.

Name: Maitre d'
Dialog: No, madame. That is Tuesdays.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a dream) But, you honor, how could I have robbed that bank if I was already wearing the prison jumpsuit? It just doesn't make any-- (She wakes up to the sound of Buford humming) Somehow I want to finish that dream to find out if I'm guilty or not. (She walks to the window, to see Buford in the backyard, humming and tying his shoes) What?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (After he finished tying his shoes) Voilà.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Buford, what are you doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Just trying out my new...

Name: Advertisement
Dialog: TUFF SHOO LAYSIZZ!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I mean what are you doing in our yard so early?

Name: Buford
Dialog: There are two things you should know about the Van Stomms. One, we always set our alarms on time, and two, if we don't, we show up early and take our lumps. We've even got a song about it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's okay, I do not need to hear the song.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Too late.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Does that answer your question?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah, that explains a lot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So that's why I got up early. What's your excuse?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just getting an early start on busting my brothers.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, you should really find a new hobby. You've got no skills.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! I'd like to see you keep their contraptions from disappearing at the last second.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Is that a challenge?! Because you should know that the Van Stomms never back down from a challenge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop! Stop! Stop! I challenge you, just as long as you don't sing about it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Her loss. The Van Stomm's "Accept a Challenge" song has a killer bridge. It goes to an F sharp minor, in the key of G!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Calling Agent P. Agent P. Wake-y wake-y Agent P. Over here. No, not on the computer screen. Though that would have made infinitely more sense. To the right. Down a bit. Over a bit more. That's right. (appears on a trading card) Hey-Oh. Carl installed a nano-screen on this trading card a few days ago, disguised as a Flynn-Fletcher family member.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Dressed as Candace) Can you guess which one?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Take that off already, Carl. You're creeping me out, man.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay...

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to wake you up so early Agent P, but evil never rests and by "evil" I mean Doofenshmirtz. It's not even 6 AM yet, and our surveillance cameras have spotted him at the local caffeination station, ordering the largest, most caffeinated beverage they sell. Nothing good can come from this hideous spurt of energy, so get to it Agent-- (Offscreen Phineas is talking to Ferb) Sounds like your boys are on their way back. Get to it Agent P. (puts the real figure on the trading card in)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way to floss, Ferb. Who knew fighting plaque could be so much fun? Come to think of it, (Entering his bedroom along with Ferb) I know what we're going to do today Ferb. Hey where's Perry? That's strange.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I know we normally do this later in the day.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes we do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sweet, with Buford as my busting stooge, now I can concentrate on more important things. (Candace turns on the TV)

Name: TV Show
Dialog: It's time for "Girls Freaking Out!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I love this show. It makes me feel so normal.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (She walks into the room) Okay Candace, I'm off to the beach. Vivian called and said the waves are crankin'. I have my cell with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, that's okay. I'm out-sourcing today. Everything will still be here when you get back.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I certainly hope so. See you later hon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Speaking very rapidly) Gotcha. And you don't even know it yet. That's the beauty part. Watch this prolonged series of unnecessary events. (Doofenshmirtz launches a kangaroo, causing a ball to roll down a flight of stairs, through a tube) W-w-w-watch this. (the ball causes a car to drive into a target, launching an anvil into a catcher's mitt, dropping a cage on Perry) Yeah, yeah, yeah... Yes! Ha! I win! I know it's a little over the top, but I was inspired by this board game I love when I was a kid. Well actually, it was Roger's board game. But I would sneak a peek of it, through the keyhole of his door. You know it looked like I would love it. But, I borderline backstory. (He takes a few short breathes) You see, I have so much evil energy from the soy venti latte extra-caf-and-a-half quadruple sugar, blood pressure bomberino. Love it! So I spent the whole morning building this complex, giant version of the game. Really I surprised you didn't see it flying in. Okay, beholding time! Behold my Luff-Flex-Dill-Pickle-inator! What does it do, you ask? (takes out a screen) Well it will launch all of my enemies into orbit, and keep them floating there so far into the atmosphere, that they won't bother me anymore. Cool, huh? Yeah I know the name's a little weird, but hey, I bought it off the internet, and my rights to it expire tomorrow, so I was kinda forced to use it today. I have so much energy from that one cup of coffee, I just keep rambling-- (Perry hops out of a hole in his cage) Ooh. you know that trap was always the lamest part of the game. I always though-- (Perry attacks Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Buford, you're here early.

Name: Buford
Dialog: The early bully catches the nerd, my friends.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hello.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And my point is made for me.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi Phineas

Name: Irving
Dialog: I am here also.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well our inspiration for today's activity manifested as we performed our morning ablutions.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I love it when Phineas uses unnecessarily long words for common things like brushing your teeth and washing up.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, it is gratifyingly erudite.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's not as cute when you do it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (he sighs) I am cognizant of that fact.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Introducing the Dental-Hygenosphere. A thrill packed adventure through the exciting and colossal word of Dental hygiene. Now who's with us?

Name: Isabella and Baljeet
Dialog: Me!

Name: Irving
Dialog: We!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a little preach-y for my taste, but count me in too.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'll help with the super structure.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh! I will spray on the enamel coating.

Name: Irving
Dialog: And I'll sell ballooths. (Isabella and Baljeet stare at Irving) Balloons in the shape of a tooth.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, you mean toothalloons.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ballooths? Where'd you get ballooths from?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, that's toothalloons. And I'll lock it all down, and make sure it doesn't move.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, safety first, I guess. Knock yourself out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Looking out of her window) Let's see how the rookie's doing on his assignment. (Quirky Worky Song in the background) Hmm, not bad. I kinda like his style.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Toothalloons! Get your toothalloons here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright everybody, all aboard the tooth-buggies. Ferb even installed dental floss-themed seat belts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mmm, minty.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Wa-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not so fast! I knew too! You're giving up, and just going on the ride for fun.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Not hardly. I swiped this bad-boy (His rivet gun) from the orthodontist's section, to cut off stuff sticking out of the ride that could snag a passing plane as they go along.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Listen, this thing ain't snag on a plane is just the tip of the bicuspid. It could shrink down to the size of a real tooth, and get lost in the grass. Or turn to ice, and melt into nothingness. For all you know it could turn into a giant Ducky Momo, and fly away. Are you prepared for all that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't need to hear the "We Prepare for Every Eventuality" song.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine, for the record though, it's the "Be Prepared for Every Eventuality" song. It's in the imperative tense. (walks away angrily)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, the periodontal level was awesome.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hang onto your retainers, everyone as we travel through the pulp chamber, past the cementoenamel junction, and up, up up, to the apex of the crown.

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Yeah! Woo-hoo!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (To Ferb) You know this is tame compared to other roller coasters, but when you compare it to other dental themed rides, it is a rush!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Weaving from behind a giant pink kangaroo) Now you see me. Now you don't. Now you see me. Now you don't. Hehe. (Perry punches him, and Doofenshmirtz falls down the stairs, and slides across the ramp of the trap) Hey, where'd ya' go? (Perry bounces up to the catches mitt holding the anvil) I've got you now Perry the Platypus. (Doofenshmirtz bounces up to get him, but smashes into the anvil, which then falls on him.) Ow!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've completely protected their invention from airplane snags, stray balloons, meteorites, flocks of wild gazelles, and giant cracks that form in the crust of the Earth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if it turns into water?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Covered.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if it turns into smoke?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Covered.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if it space-harpies descend from the sky and have it for breakfast?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aw, come on, really? Totally covered.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? And how di--

Name: Buford
Dialog: I sprayed it with space-harpy repellent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, okay. Just make sure this is still here when I come back with my mom. (On the phone) Mom! Mom!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold still so I can hit you fair-and-square. (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz into his -inator, causing it to fire) Really!?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aw man! Random green rays from the sky! I forgot about random green rays from the sky! Oh, no, not on my watch. (Buford throws assorted objects in the path of a green rays) Oh, man, I've run out of conveniently placed objects. Bingo. (Buford runs, and grabs Irving's helium balloon) Coming through!

Name: Irving
Dialog: My toothalloons!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, they weren't selling anyway. Not on my watch. (Another beam hits the helium tank, and it floats away) Ah! The helium tank! Actually it's kinda ironic when you think about it. (Buford sees another beam heading towards him, and in slow motions blocks the beam with his body) Not on my watch! (He begins floating upward) Yes! The human shield tactic never failed. (He notices his shoe laces are caught on the tooth) man, I knew I should have hung onto that laser.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo-hoo.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Let us go again.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Maybe not.

Name: Buford
Dialog: AAAAAH! I guess they ain't called--

Name: Advertisement
Dialog: TUFF SHOO LAYSIZZ!

Name: Buford
Dialog: ...for nothin'.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Prepare to be blitzed by my inexplicable, new found martial arts mastery! (Doofenshmirtz shows off his new found talent, but accidentally kicks off his shoe) I hate to ask Perry the Platypus, but have you seen my other-- (Perry is seen rubbing his head, with Doofenshmirtz's shoe lying beside him) Oh, there it is. That's what I was planning to do. Perry the Platypus, looks like this is the end for you. (Doofenshmirtz lines up his -inator to hit Perry. However Perry throws Doofenshmirtz's shoe at him, causing the -inator to fire at Doofenshmirtz's building, and Doofenshmirtz to flip over the edge of the building, having him hang their by only his knees) Just not nice! (The top of Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated lifts into the sky)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (After untying himself from the giant tooth) Well, I hope that lands in the backyard of a giant who needs a fake tooth.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, hey did you say, (He mimics a few electrical noises)

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know I kind of like to sit back and relax after all that manual labour. (The floating effect wears off of him and the other objects hit by the -inator) Uh-oh. (He plunges downward) Ahhhhhh! I've got a song about how Van Stomms fall from the sky too, but, it doesn't end well.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was so much fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Too bad Buford missed it all. I wonder where he got to.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hello.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Buford. Are those--

Name: Advertisement
Dialog: TUFF SHOO LAYSIZZ!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes, yes they are.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right over here Mom. Ta-da!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi Mom! Hi Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What are you guys up to? Buford, are you okay?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Just putting my new laysizz through their paces.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay then. Then I'm going inside. Who wants pie?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I do.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah, yes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, me too.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I always want pie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stomps up to Buford) Buford, explain yourself!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (running away) I'm not hearing it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just in case anyone's wondering what happened to old Doofenshmirtz, I'm okay. (The giant tooth lands on top of him) Well, obviously not now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hey, Mom!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Flynn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, why can't I get a car?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (skates by) Candace, you only have your learner's permit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but eventually, I'm gonna have my license. I think we should be ready.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (skates by) Riiiight. In the meantime, have a cookie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's hardly the same thing. Why are you dressed like that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't you remember? The Doo Wop Hop is tonight. All the neighborhood moms have volunteered to be carhops.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Mrs. Flynn, I really like the wig helmet. (eats a cookie)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why, thank you, Jeremy. Safety first, you know. (leaves)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (to Candace) I don't know about you, but I'm gonna have another cookie. (eats another cookie)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (off-screen) Aloha, cats!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, guys. How are you doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mellow like a cello and solid to boot, daddy-o. We're going to the Doo Wop Hop tonight, so we're dressed like they did in the fifties. You know, when everyone dressed like a sitcom from the seventies? Right, Ferb?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (enters from garage) Boys, have you seen my welder?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I were using it to put the finishing touches on his shades. Right, Ferb?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, those are very hip.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What have you been working on all night out there, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's a surprise for Candace uh -- oops! Uh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, this conversation suddenly interests me. What are you making me?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Lawrence, sounds like you'd better tell her!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I wanted it to be a surprise, but I bought you a car!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?! A car?!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (leads them into the garage) Oh, yes. It's the same car I had when I was a lad. I figured it would be ready when you were old enough.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, what do you mean, "ready"?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, uh, it's not fully restored, yet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ya think?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mr. Fletcher, is that a Nedlington Nymph?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Why yes, yes it is! Jeremy, you have your license, don't you? You can take Candace for a ride in it when it's finished.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Awesome.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I think it's cool, too. Ferb, tell them what you told me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm living in Crazy Town, and Phineas and Ferb are town council.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Heeeeeyy. Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What's shakin', bacon? (camera reveals Major Monogram dressed up '50s-style) Like the threads? Carl and I are going to cruise over to the Doo Wop Hop tonight. We're going incognito. Maybe do a little reconnaissance while I take in the car show.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And he really just wants to spy on Monty to find out what of kind girl he's dating.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wrong! Wrong, Carl! We happen to know that Doofenshmirtz has entered a car in the competition. He must be up to something. And if I should happen to see whom my son is dating, well, where's the harm in that? Hmm? Meanwhile, we need you to find out what the heck Doof is building, validate its evilness, and destroy it. (Agent P salutes) Good luck, Agent P, and see ya later, crocodile!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, sometimes evil just cracks me up! (He hears Vanessa humming) Say where's that humming coming from?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, is that you? Are you okay?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What do you mean, Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Something's not right. The corners of your mouth are pointing up. (feeling her forehead) Maybe you're running a fever.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Relax, will you? I'm just looking forward to the '50s Doo Wop Hop tonight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So who are you going with?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, you know, just a friend.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Speaking of friends, I think you have a little visitor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, he can wait. So what friend? Is it that girl with the dark hair who has all those dachshunds?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (approaching the door) No. It's a...different...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No wait! No no no! Don't open the door! You'll let in Perry the Platypus!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You know he'll just blow the door down if you don't open it. (opens door revealing Perry holding a bazooka) Come in, Perry. Toodles! (she leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm worried about her, Perry the Platypus. Hey! You were going to to blow down my door! (Perry sets the bazooka down, but accidentally fires it leaving a big hole in a Warholian picture of Doofenshmirtz.) Oh, great! See, this is why I can't have anything nice! Anyway, c'mon, let me show you what I've been workin' on. Y'see, it all started when I was just a small boy back in Gimmelshtump.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Friday was always Cruise Night and everybody would come out and see the hipsters in their cool cars made from cannibalized parts left over from Drusselstein's many foreign occupations. But for me...

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oooooh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...the coolest car of all was the Boomshlaka 320-I, run by my Uncle Simpkin!

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah! You go! You show them how you're more masculine than everyone else!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover, talking over his younger self) To me, it was the coolest car ever!

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Booyah!

Name: Uncle Simpkin
Dialog: Hey! (taking off his shirt and throwing it into the crowd)

Name: Female Fan
Dialog: I saw it first!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Unfortunately, the car had one major design flaw

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) And I never saw him again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I have been able to restore his car. (Cut to a dust cover being lifted revealing the car) The 1957 Drusselstein Boomshlaka 320-I! Mmmwah! Ain't she a honey? I'm sure to win first prize with this. And here's the good part! (He pushes a button on a remote, causing jumper cables to come out of the grill trapping Perry. Doofenshmirtz laughs) Trapper cables! I needed to restrain you for this next part because it does get a little bit evil. Just to ensure there's no real competition, I built a little gadget called the Rustinator. At the push of a button, it will reduce every other car into red dust! Or rust. Wait, red dust, rust. I wonder if that's where that word came from. (exits) I'm gonna go look up its entomology. (returns) Yeah, I looked it up. It turns out "entomology" is the study of insects. Go figure. Anyway, uh, in you go! (The cables put Perry inside the vehicle.) I'll just get in the normal way. (Cut to the driver's seat) How's it goin' down there? Cozy in your steel cables? Careful with the Rustinator, Norm! (Cut to reveal Norm buckled up holding the Rustinator) Wouldn't want it to go off inadvertently.

Name: Norm
Dialog: No problemo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Boy, Ferb, Dad was right. That muffler sure is making some weird noises.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, we'd best leave him be. Ferb, show me the model you've been workin' on. Were you able to add any extras?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Candace is gonna love that...I mean except for the explosion part. We should probably fix that.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: ¡Hola, Candace! Ooh, don't you look lovely!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Jeremy'll be along in a minute, honey!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Is your mother ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: She'll be right out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: All set! See ya there, Candace! Okay, ladies, here I come! (She skates away) There I go! Ha ha! Sorry! Can't stop. FOLLOW MEEEEEEEEEEEEEE....

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Step on it, Vivian, she's getting away!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: My car broke down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I guess we're riding our bikes to the car show. (They walk to the garage) We can wow them with our irony.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (angrily) You guys are so... (excitedly) AWESOME!! Wow! I never thought it would turn out so beautiful! Right?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: How's the engine sound?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (tossing Jeremy the keys) You tell me! Dad did say you could drive it when it was finished.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, where is Dad anyway?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hmm. Well, last we saw him, he was working on the muffler.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Outta the way, luge boy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He may be on his way to the hop.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, well, maybe we should get goin'. Hop in, everyone! We're goin' cruisin'!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, look! The visor's a vanity!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My car has a turret that goes...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoo-hoo-hoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Follow me, we're almost there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's deploy the chutes, Ferb!

Name: All
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! This is gonna be a piece of cake! (The tank rolls onto the stage.) I rule! (Confetti comes out. Everyone laughs.) I don't get it, what's the joke? Why is everyone laughing?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can't find Monty. Get up on my shoulders, Carl! See if you can see 'em!

Name: Carl
Dialog: You're not gonna drop me again, are you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just do it, Carl! And watch the hair. Take these. (Carl gets on Monogram's shoulders and takes the binoculars.) Now what do ya see?

Name: Carl
Dialog: There he is! (POV shot from the binoculars to show Monty next to Vanessa) And he's with—Oh no! (Monty looks in terror and shushes Carl)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What-wh-Carl! What do you see?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Someone who owes me big time!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They dare to laugh at the Drusselstein Boomshlaka 320-I? Well, we'll just see who has the last laugh! Norm, fire up the Rustinator!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (saluting) Firing away, sir! Now, how do I set the coordinates? Hmmmm... (Perry pushes a button with the Boomshlaka 320-I on it) Thank you, Perry the Platypus! Very sporting of you! (The Rustinator activates rusting up the vehicle)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh! Well, thank goodness for the plastic gas tank. (to Vanessa) Hey, Vanessa?! Is that you?!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hi, Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute! Who's that boy you're with? He looks strikingly familiar. (Perry pushes a button on the gas tank) Say, isn't that— (The tank explodes sending Doofenshmirtz into orbit) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!! (a man passes by him) Uncle Simpkin? He's looking well.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Up next is a late entry. Wow! I don't believe it! Look at this, folks! (a mechanical hand emerges from the car. Candace takes it and walks out) Is that a Nedlington Nymph?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: And who did this amazing restoration?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, my dad's been working on it for a while and...oh, here he is!

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Looka that, folks! Workin' on it up to the last second!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I was?

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Well, I think I speak for all the judges when I say the Nedlington Nymph wins Best in Show!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What an honor! Here, Candace! It is your car after all!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (skating up to her husband) A one of a kind car for a one of a kind girl!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, you guys!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, dear, you're rolling away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giving the trophy to her brothers) This really goes to you, you know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! You were right, Ferb, it really did need a trophy shelf! (Perry emerges from inside the cup chattering) Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My car has a turret that goes...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoo-hoo-hoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Follow me, we're almost there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's deploy the chutes, Ferb!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, No, No! I've been good! Don't put me in your gundersack! Not the gundersack! Ahhhhhhhhh! The Kinderlumper!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! Der Kinderlumper!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what do you think?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think you look like you just fell off a turnip truck, and then got run over by a rutabaga truck.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah yeah, real funny. This is the official rutabaga regalia for the 100th Running of the Chinchillas from Danville to Badger Town. By wearing this it will entice the chinchillas to follow me the Princess!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So yeah, I get it. It's a huge honor and everything. But come on Candace, why do you really want to be Rutabaga Princess?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I get to start the Running of the Chinchillas!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad, and everyone in Danville will be waiting in Badger Town to see me cross the finish line!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I get to be on TV!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's the reason!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, this is my first step on my way to stardom and as my best friend, you'll be famous by association.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's my favorite kind of famous!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Off-screen.) Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is it, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look at the cool vehicles we made for you for the Running of the Chinchillas! Baljeet has grown a new super street of bio engineer rutabaga!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I simply spliced the genetic code of a rutabaga and a giant redwood.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aaaaannnnd?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And fennel.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I want it to smell like licorice!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're not getting me into one of those things! I'm not showin' up for my TV debut lookin' like a complete weirdo! (to Stacy) What? I said, "Complete". (to the gang) And now, I must leave. My public awaits.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, and I must go be famous by association.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And to think, we knew Stacy before she was famous by association.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Dah! I'm supposed to be in Badgertown! (she runs off leaving the still-on vacuum behind her. We hear an inexplicable cat scream in the background.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I was just doing a little handicapping for this year's Running of the Chinchillas. Think I'm going to box Dryer's Dust with Squeaky Toy.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (also holding a racing forum and a pen) And I'm taking Gerbil Bait to win.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're daft, Carl! (to Perry) Anyway, rumor has it that Doofenshmirtz plans to attend the ceremony. Odds are he's up to something evil. Better look into it, Agent P. (Perry zips away) Hmmm...Gerbil Bait. Heh, talk about your long shots. (He looks to his right) Dangit, Carl!

Name: Reporter
Dialog: Good morning, everyone. I'm Mike van Hatofapilgrim here in Danville for the 100th Annual Running of the Chinchillas, (walking up to Candace and Stacy) and with us today is this year's Rutabaga Princess. And what's your name, young lady?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm Candace Flynn.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (pushing Candace aside) And I'm famous by association!

Name: Mike
Dialog: That's great. (to the camera) Well, there ya have it. A good day for rutabagas, chinchillas, and self-promoting sycophantism.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahem. Citizens of Danville, it is now time for your princess....me....to start the Running of the Chinchillas! I now summon my tuber troubadour!

Name: Irving
Dialog: I will now play the traditional chinchilla fanfare. (He takes a deep breath and plays a very out of tune fanfare. He inhales again, while Candace swipes the horn away revealing he's simply musically exhaling.) What? But—Huh? (Candace throws the horn away.) I see. Not a music lover. (He holds up a purple pillow with a rutabaga on it) My Princess?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I will now take a bite of the ceremonial rutabaga. (She sinks her teeth into the rutabaga, but then promptly spits it into her other hand.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: And now I most humbly take my leave. (He leaves) Princess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You do that, Sputnik. Chinchillas, let the running begin!

Name: Mike
Dialog: Well, there they go! And now, the Running of the Chinchillas is underway! And now, back to you in the studio.

Name: Cameraman
Dialog: There's no one in the studio. It's Sunday.

Name: Mike
Dialog: Really? How'm I supposed to do a live broadcast when no one is in the studio?

Name: Cameraman
Dialog: We're not live. We're taping this.

Name: Mike
Dialog: (sighs) Fine.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, here, let me get your train. (Holds onto Candace's cape, then hears a loud squeak) Oh, omigosh, sorry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, Stacy. This is harder than I thought. (another loud squeak) Oh, sorry!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe if we ran in front of them, it'd be a little easier.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, now onward to Badgertown!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, omigosh, sorry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That should do it. (Perry emerges from the black hole while Doof's butt flap goes down.) Excellent. (turns around) Perry the Platypus? (looks at his butt flap) Oh. (he buttons it) Sorry you had to see that. It's just that...this one button. Anyway, you are just in time to witness as I activate the Kinderlumperinator and transform myself into a real live Kinderlumper! (Perry looks at Doofenshmirtz confused) What? Don't tell me you've never heard of the Kinderlumper. (Perry simply shrugs) Y'know...uh...gigantic troll with sharp teeth and nose like a broom handle, he grabs children, puts 'em in a gundersack if they...You never heard of this? My mother used to sing me this lovely song about it right before I went to bed. And it goes a little something like this. (He claps his hands twice. The lights go out. He claps twice again to reveal he is now dressed like Cab Calloway in front of a jazz band and does some of Cabby's signature walks.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So anyway, I got this actual-sized Kinderlumper costume (climbing inside the suit) and I'm gonna shoot myself with the Kinderlumperinator to make me gigantic and trollish so, ya know, it will fit. Then I will go to scare my brother, Roger, so badly that he is certain to relinquish control of the Tri-State Area to me! Well, to the Kinderlumper, actually, but when the ray wears off, I'll be me again and I'll already be in control. Stand back, Perry the Platypus. Prepare to do some beholding! (He claps twice again, activating the Kinderlumperinator. Perry jumps up to him) Oh! Knock it off, you crazy platy— (The inator zaps both of them, transforming Doofenshmirtz into an exact likeness of the Kinderlumper, while Perry transforms into a rather giant hairy bearded platypus-type monster) It worked! Hee hee hee hee hee hee! (He claps twice accidentally activating the inator again, which shoots through the black hole and out the building.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Y'know, Stacy? This is fun. I could get used to this princess thing. (The blue ray zaps all of the chinchillas making them into giant beasts. Stacy screams first followed by Candace. They flee past a news van. The chinchilla beasts follow them, tipping the van over. Mike and the cameraman open the doors and emerge from the van.)

Name: Mike
Dialog: Did you see that? Call in Chopper 4! This is the biggest story of my career! (He jumps out of the van) Let's get some!

Name: Cameraman
Dialog: Oh, why did I ever opt for work release?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously, Perry the Platypus, is it really necessary to destroy everything? (Perry jumps off the destroyed inator and chatters. Doofenshmirtz backs away leading Perry onto a giant black "X" in the middle of the room) N-nn-n-n-now, now, that's a good trollish gigantic platypus. (Doofenshmirtz claps twice activating a giant cage that drops on Perry) Ha! Let that be a lesson to you

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everyone have your signs and foam fingers ready to cheer Candace on?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (showing his foam finger) Ready!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (showing he ate his finger) Ready!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, you bit your finger off!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (threateningly) Yeah! What about it?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Nothing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Phineas Phineas Phineas...and Ferb! (she and Stacy run into the frame) You have to help us! We're being chased by monster-sized chinchillas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Monster-sized chinchillas? That's awesome!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here they come!

Name: Mike
Dialog: This is amazing! I've never been in a helicopter before!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: They're gaining on us!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And can't this thing go any faster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got the fennel pedal all the way to the rutabaga metal! And yes, I know it's a weird sentence.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas! (She screams as she gets taken in by the beasts)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella!!!! Noooooooooo!!!!! (Too late as Phineas and Ferb become the last victims)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh no! Phineas and Ferb!!

Name: Mike
Dialog: (from the chopper) Oh, those poor innocent kids. (covering his eyes) I can't watch. It's just-It's just—I'm gonna step outside where I can—WOOOOOOAHH! Did you see that?! I almost stepped out of the helicopter! Did you just see that?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Save yourself, princess! RUN!!! RUN!!!! RUUUUUUUNNNNN!!!!

Name: Melanie
Dialog: The chinchillas should be here any minute, Mr. Mayor.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, I hope they don't ask me to eat any rutabagas like last year.

Name: Melanie
Dialog: I think we can avoid (gasps dramatically) WHAT IS THAT?!?!

Name: Roger
Dialog: I think I know this guy. There's nothing to be afraid of! It's only the Kinderlumper come to join our celebration! Ha-ha! Now it's a party!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I, uh, I believe the more appropriate response would be to flee in terror.

Name: Roger
Dialog: But, Kinderlumper, why would I ever run away from you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't you remember the Kinderlumper song?

Name: Roger
Dialog: Remember? Of course I remember! Bubbe used to sing me the song every night.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: N-n-no, wait! Those are not the words!!!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, that's how she sang it to me. And I still have some of the gifts you brought me. (He takes out a box of almond brittle.) Look! Almond brittle!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: NO!!! But—But you don't even like almond brittle!

Name: Roger
Dialog: I know. (puts the box back in his jacket) That's why I never ate it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sobbing) Nooo-ho-ho....

Name: Roger
Dialog: Funny. I never thought of the Kinderlumper as such a crybaby.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! The effects are wearing off! (Doofenshmirtz reverts back to his original self)<

Name: Candace
Dialog: Run for your lives!

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're coming! Chinchillas! It's too late for me! (dropping in front of her parents) Save yourselves!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Were you this dramatic when you were Rutabaga Princess?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stop it! (giggling) Seriously!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, that was so exciting! You're the best Rutabaga Princess yet!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! I thought you were stampeded!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were! It didn't hurt. They were big but they were still fluffy.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's like being run over by cotton candy. But less sticky.

Name: Mike
Dialog: That was amazing! I got it all on camera!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, really? Did you get Phineas and Ferb and the rutabaga vehicles?

Name: Mike
Dialog: Eeyup. The whole thing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where's the camera?

Name: Mike
Dialog: (pointing offscreeen) Oh, it's right over there.

Name: Mike
Dialog: NO!!! The biggest story of my career (sobbing) and it just flew away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome to my world, Mike. Welcome to my world.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (picks him up) Get over here, you hairy little beast! (Perry chatters)

Name: Mrs. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shadowed) Heinz Doofenshmirtz, if you don't go to sleep this instant, der Kinderlumper will come to get you and put you in his gundersack!

Name: Young Doofenshmritz
Dialog: Well, that's a bit harsh, doncha think?

Name: Border Patroller
Dialog: Hey, you can't do that!

Name: Border Patroller
Dialog: Hey, that same thing, but in French!

Name: Woman on Motorcycle
Dialog: You're out of your jurisdiction buddy. (She flashes a badges showing she is a member of "C.O.W.C.A.") I'll take it from here, eh? (She jumps upon the claw, which soon breaks, letting the truck get away) Coming through! Well, there's no catching up to them now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (On Perry's motorcycle's side mirror) Agent P. We've just received word that you're on Canadian soil. We don't have jurisdiction there. Stand down! That's an order!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry Agent P. our hands are tied.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl, don't interrupt me. Return to headquarters pronto.

Name: C.O.W.C.A. Agent
Dialog: Sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good morning Perry. Ready to start another fun day?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Good morning Perry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi Perry, how are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay mom, if you go out into the yard today, and there's nothing there, I'll... I'll clean the bathroom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you were supposed to do that anyway.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So we have a deal?

Name: Buford
Dialog: So what you're sayin' is that it advocates a mixed economy, with significant roles are played by the private sector, and the government?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No it.. actually, yes. That is what I was saying.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey Perry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good morning Perry. Whatcha doin?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. Doofenshmirtz was last seen boarding a train transporting Precious Albert the Moose. Cue the graphic Carl. (A picture of Albert the Moose appears) Albert the Moose is Canada's prized animal, who represents the unity of the provinces. We need you to make sure Doof keeps his mitts off that moose. If you fail, Canada Day Celebrations will be ruined, (The picture of Albert the Moose disappears, except for the antlers) and Canada will break into civil war. Or, since it's Canada, it would be a civil conversation where secession would be topic of discussion, and... (Monogram notices the moose antlers) Carl? Antlers?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Now this train runs along the border between the United States and Canada, so you only have jurisdiction on the American side of the train. To help you out on the Canadian side of the train You'll be teaming up with an Agent from C.O.W.C.A. the Canadian Organization Without a Cool Acronym, Agent Lyla. (A picture of the woman from Perry's previous mission is shown) You may remember her from that special assignment for our Seattle Bureau we sent you on a couple of months ago. I know that didn't go too well but I expect you to be professional, and put that all behind you. Get out there and good luck. (Perry leaves in his hover jet) Carl? Can I- Can I have those antlers back?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sure sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh yeah! I'm rockin' this look!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Woo hoo! Ah, Agent P. we meet again. Aw look at that face.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: I know, you work alone. But you'll see Mr. "I can do it all by myself", having someone can be just what you need there.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Hey! Where you going?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, what an unexpected surpri--- (Perry moves to punch Doofenshmirtz) Oh, whoa, wait, wait, wait! You're trapped, by societal convention. Look, we're in a fine dinning environment, everyone knows not to thrown a scene in a fancy restaurant. That's right. You're trapped. Sit down.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Oh shoot! I see we're trapped by societal convention.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Agent Lyla, from C.O.W.C.A.? IS this an international team up? Oh, you must hate that Perry the Platypus. A loner like you...

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Oh, come on, he's warming up to the idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes obviously.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Why are you causing trouble in Canada, Doofenshmirtz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you see, I'm part of a U.S., Canada, evil scheme exchange program. I come up with a scheme, This other Canadian guy comes up with a scheme, and we switch. I do his scheme and he does mine.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: You gonna eat those fries?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't touch! Anyway I've got a little math quiz for the both of you. If a train carrying Precious Albert the Moose left British Columbia at eight o'clock in the morning, going eighty mile per hour, what time would it arrive at the Canada Day celebration? Answer? Never! Because I've tied up the conductor, and taken control of the train using my remote control Train-Operator-inator! Right now we are all headed to my scheme exchange partner's secret fortress. (Lyla reaches for the fries again) Hey cut it out, those are mine. Seriously, I can get the waiter over here if you want to order own, but please?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: This evil exchange partner of yours, what his name?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think his name was Sir Railing, or Doctor Stairway, or something.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Professor Bannister! Of course, my arch-nemesis. Can I put some gravy on those?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously, leave my lunch alone. Anyway, after Professor Banister gets the moose, it's going to ruin Canada Day, or you know, whatever. Crazy, right?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: You know what's really crazy? How good these fries are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am not kidding, leave those alone. I just don't understand it, why do you take my lunch, when you're in the dining car you can have you're own lunch. Oh it makes me crazy when people pick at my food. (Lyla winks at Perry, and Perry understands) Seriously, why is your hand out like that? I am seriously going to lose it. (Perry takes a fry) Aw, now you're both doing it!? Stop it! Stop it! Ahh! Oh no, even taking them but just squishing them! I can't take it. (Doofenshmirtz stands up and screams loudly) Get your own lunch!

Name: Woman
Dialog: That man is causing such a scene, it make me feel free to break up with you, IN A VERY LOUD MANNER!

Name: Waiter
Dialog: I can't stand being a waiter!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, you've completely dismantled my societal convention trap. (Doofenshmirtz runs off)

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Let's get that "n-ator"!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's pronounced "-inator"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To the tied up conductor) You did that on purpose!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Alright Doofenshmirtz, end of the line!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, train metaphors, so that's how it--

Name: Lyla
Dialog: I've got it! (It hits her) Ow!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Let me se-, I know how to-, just give me-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I think I'm with Perry the Platypus on this, I don't like seeing him teamed up either. (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz down)

Name: Lyla
Dialog: I don't know, I think he's warming up to it. Hey! That's the Canadian side of the train!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! You know I think I"m going back to the Canadian side.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: I've got this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no yo don't, I'm on the American side now, you can't touch me. (Perry throws a punch) Canada. (Lyla does the same) 'Merica. (Perry hits him) Ow! Oh, it's on now.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: As they all fight) Ha, take that. This is for William Hull, and the War of 1812, look it up kids. I've got him P, cuff him. Hold it, hold it, hold it. (Lyla, Perry and the Conductor rise from behind the seats) Ooh, Sorry. Where is he!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Open up big guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Occupied.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Oh, oh sorry, I didn't realize you had to uh..

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what they have in here, they have those tiny soaps, they make my hands look so big, it's like I'm a giant. All set.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: I can't believe it! He left the seat up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm up here Perry the Platypus! (to the audience) You knew we'd end up up here eventually right?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: P? Wait up!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: He's getting away!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Ah! Perry! Hey! Help me up!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Oops, sorry. My bad, eh? Hey look! An old time-y handcar! I've got an idea, come on.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: P, what are you doing? This is a handcar; there's a trick to it! Look, if we're going to catch the train, we're going to have to work together. We've gotta get in sync, develop a rhythm. Watch, I'll show you.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Don't push up, just push down; I'll push down on my side. That's it! That's right. Here we go!!!!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Ah, I see a little platypus smile there! That's right! Now we're cookin' with gas! See? It's better when we work together!

Name: Man
Dialog: Excuse me, conductor? (Doofenshmirtz walks over) You know the train doesn't seem to be stopping at any of the scheduled stations.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is that a fact? My apologies straphanger. Wait, which one was your stop?

Name: Man
Dialog: The next one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, don't be concerned, step right this way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So your wife is cooking dinner tonight?

Name: Man
Dialog: Oh, yes. We're having asparagus tips.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Asparagus tips, very classy. What's the entrée?

Name: Man
Dialog: Nova Scotia salmon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmm-Mmm. Delish! Here's your-STATION!! (Doofenshmirtz kicks the man out the door) Say "hi" to your wife for me.

Name: Wife
Dialog: Well, someone's home early.

Name: Man
Dialog: The conductor says "hi".

Name: Man on Train
Dialog: Hey look fellow commuters, it's a lady!

Name: Woman
Dialog: And a platypus.

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: On a handcar.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He pulls out his phone) My cellphone alert says there's a new platypus video online, that's trending. (He sees the video) Perry the Platypus! And Agent Lyla? On an old time-y-- (Perry come in and kick Doofenshmirtz down, causing him to spin on his head) Oh! Ha! Bet you can't do that. I learned that in the 80's. I also learned how to back away slowly on a newly installed escape platform! Ha! So long suckers! And now to watch my evil plan play out from the observat-- This, this is an observation deck? Chair nailed to a roof?

Name: Man
Dialog: Your blocking my view of Saskatchewan, eh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Saskatchewan is that way, you dolt!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Hold it right there Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No you hold it right there. Because I still have this! The Train-Operator-inator! Without it the train would be completely--

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Oh boy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...out of control.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright so I'm on a runaway train in a tunnel. Afraid of the dark, I- probably also afraid of runaway trains, never really given it much thought. Doesn't come up that.. (They leave the tunnel) Ahh!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Okay let's focus, there's got to be an emergency brake in the engine car. Let's go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I... I guess I'll go with you then.(Doofenshmirtz begins to run as well, then stops) Wait up Perry the Platypus, my shoe's untied. Just hang on a second. (Lyla and Perry stop) You can't be too careful when you're running across a moving train. There we go. On second thought, I'll double knot this. Okay let's go! (Doofenshmirtz walks forward and falls through a hole) Ahh! Aww, gross some joker left the seat up. Would you guys mind bringing me some paper towels, or something? (Lyla and Perry continue running) No?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: The emergency brake is toast, I'm going to have to jury-rig the controls. Darn it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If we weren't in the middle of a runaway train crisis, I would totally be giving you a hard time about leaving me in the toilet bowl.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Now let me just get the red wire... Ah-ha! Bingo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, not to burst your bubble, but I don't think we're slowing down.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: We're not, I just got the hazard lights working. Safety first. The brakes were too far gone to fix. Now we just need to get all the passengers and Precious Albert the Moose into the same car, and we can save them. (Perry chatters) You're right! The caboose! Let's go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is why I'd rather not make friends, they find someone else, and "Bam!" you're alone.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: (Over the announcement system) Attention passengers, there is no need to panic, but--

Name: Butler
Dialog: Pardon the interruption, Precious Albert, Sir, but your tea is ready.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Folks, everything is under control, eh? We're going to separate the caboose from the rest of the train. (Lyla see the caboose has become disconnected, speak to Perry) Oh, you already did it. Nice going partner. I'm going to take a pic of this and send it to C.O.W.C.A.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We're saved. We did it! (everybody cheers)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, I swear that wasn't me.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Banister! I should've known. You thinking what I'm thinking?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Now on top of the caboose) Aw, man, I never have a grappling hook when I need one. And I totally looked at mine this morning when I was getting dressed. Right there on the dresser. I hate it when that happens.

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Well, well, well. If it isn't C.O.W.C.A.'s best agent, the unfortunately named, Lyla Lolliberry.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Listen you, I come from a long alliterative line of Lolliberrys.

Name: Bannister
Dialog: And now you're trapped, miles above solid ground, with nothing but a beaver at your side.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Climbing into the helicopter) He's a platypus, not a beaver. Hiya Banny! Pardon me, official exchange buddy coming through. (To Bannister) Yo, bro. Back so soon? My evil plan usually takes all day. How'd you do it so fast?

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Well I'll tell you. It went a little something like this

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I guess if you've got no one to monologue to...

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Enough backstory.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually that's not uh, that's not really a backstory, it's just expositional flashback. It doesn't uh, have any childhood trauma. It doesn't really form who he is. It's not... It's just flashback, there's a difference. It's suble, but there's a difference. (To Bannister) Anyway you're not the only productive one. I've taken care of your moose problem.

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Perfect! No Albert the Moose. No Canada Day.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: And you call yourself a Canadian!

Name: Banister
Dialog: Do I? You think that just because I'm polite, smell like pine needles, and over emphasize me T's, I'm Canadian? Well, you'd be wrong! Because I'm from Greenland! (Bannister tears down the Canadian flag hanging on the wall, revealing the flag of Greenland, cue dramatic music)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cool flag.

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Thanks. Wait! No it's not! And that's the problem! We have no national pride! I mean listen to this

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're from Greenland! Do you know how it meant from mis-representing you country of origin to the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Organization? Plus your scheme is unnecessary complicated and doesn't even seem like it would work! And that's coming from me!

Name: Banister
Dialog: It's the perfect plan! Yes it will. See, he agrees. Will you stop it?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Who is he talking to?

Name: Banister
Dialog: Oh, how rude of me, allow me to introduce... (Banister removes his lab coat revealing two robots) Me-Positive, and Me-Negative! They're two magnetic robots I created for the purpose of vanquishing my enemies!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Magnetic robots?

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Yes, because it's all about polarity! You can't have two positives, or two negatives.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you can have two negatives, just look at my family.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Wait a second. Those robot parts look familiar.

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Oh, right. I got them from some friends of mine. I think you may have met in Seattle. (Banister mentions to the thugs in the truck from Seattle, who are playing cards)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, those guys have been playing cards really quietly.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: I remember them. But I knew they would lead me to you, Banister. That's why I let them escape.

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Never mind them. Me-Positive, and Me-Negative can take care of you.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Oh I get it, we're going to have an old fashioned helicopter fight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh a helicopter fight? These can get really nasty. I'm just going to go play cards.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ... (Two helicopters are seen fighting)

Name: Banister
Dialog: What!? (He throws the flag of Greenland over Lyla and Perry) I have just one thing to say to you Lyla Loliberry, (He jumps from the helicopter) Farväl!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: What does "farväl" mean?

Name: Banister
Dialog: It's Swedish for "goodbye". It's one of the languages we speak in Greenla--

Name: Bannister
Dialog: Jinx you Lyla Lolliberry. Jinx you!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Way to text in the cavalry. Okay, let's get this bird off to Canada day. We have a guest of honor to deliver.

Name: Man
Dialog: Go Canada! Go, eh?

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Way to go Constitution Act of 1864!

Name: Man
Dialog: Right on!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: WooOoo!

Name: Lyla
Dialog: So now you see why I had to let those guys go, right P.?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well how was he supposed to know you had a tracker on their truck?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: He understands how these things are. One minute your catching a thief the next you get intel they might be leading you somewhere bigger and better.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, and by "bigger and better" you obviously mean me! Right? Right?

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Yeah, right. Anyway. You've got some serious skills there P.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Stop, you're making me blush.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Good work to the both of you. I can see things went well with our neighbors to the North.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well now that our mission is done--

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Our mission?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...maybe we could drop by Niagara Falls. It's so close by, and I've always wanted to see it.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Well I suppose we could swing by on our way back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I wonder how my scheme worked out for Professor Banister. I'm sure that Cloud Magnitizer-inator was a winner.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Hey Perry.(Bends down to pets him) Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How was it that a cloud was able to carry off our metal superstructure?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Someone's got a bathroom to clean. Everyone else, there's pie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Ah, a platypus's life is a life of leisure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes it is.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: We'd like to apologize on behalf of the show, for poking a little fun at Greenland. The Greenland flag is actually verifiable cool. It was designed by Thue Christiansen as part of a flag designing contest in the 80's... Is this actually true, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: According to the internet, sir.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Well, what do you know? Also we understand that the people of Greenland do have enormous national pride, and are not necessarily short. This was all purely in the interest of comedy, and not meant to be taken seriously. Go Greenland!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Psst! Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm in here! (Perry turns and moves to side of the vent Major Monogram is in, and puts his fedora on) Sorry for the break-in protocol, but this is urgent. Show him the photo,Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes sir. Here, Agent P. (Slides photo out of the vent, which Perry takes)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Notice anything unusual, Agent P? Look closer, it's very subtle. (Perry stares down at it, wide-eyed) Here, use this. (Slides out a magnifying glass from the vent, Perry takes it and holds it up to his eye) See that small cluster of clouds? (Camera zooms in on the magnified clouds) It spells "Doof"! And "Doof" is short for "Doofenshmirtz"! (Perry puts down the photo and magnifying glass) That cloud is directly above the Danville Batanical Gardens! Two hundred acres of ecological diverse natural area. We need you to get out there and find out what Doof is. . .doofing! Here, (slides out a card from inside the vent) take my membership card. (Perry takes it and looks at it doubtfully) You get free parking and you get 15 percent off at the gift shop.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, it says "non-transferrable" right at the bottom!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, Carl, they never look at the photo. Anyway, get out there, Agent P, and good luck! (Perry salutes, then leaves) And make sure to stop and smell the roses! Well. . . he never stops to smell the roses.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I know, sir.

Name: Buford
Dialog: In fact, it was the ancient Tunisians who actually developed many of the techniques still used today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Buford. I didn't realize the wedgie had such a rich history.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) HEEELP!!! (Runs onscreen) Help! Phineas and Ferb, and to a lesser extent, Buford! I am having an existential emergency! I find myself incapable of making decisions!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Raises eyebrow) Is that a fact? You'd better sit down.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay. (Sits down)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Come to think of it, maybe your point would be better made standing up.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are right! (stands up and puts finger up, about to speak)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Then again, you look kind of tired.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are﻿ right. I'd better -- (proceeds to sit down again, but stops as he realizes what Buford is doing) CUT IT OUT!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How did you get in such a state, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I was filling out my early college admission forms, and I-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, Baljeet! College is, like, 9 years away!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I said early. Anyway, under personal preferences, I could not decide whether to select 'Loop' or 'String' theory. I was paralyzed with indecision!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gets to his feet) Oh, come on, that's easy! Loop! No, String! No- (Realizes where Baljeet is coming from) oh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Right? Then I started thinking about how important it is to make the right decision on everything! You see, every choice carries with it its own potential timeline. So every decision I make effectively nullifies the possible future! I can't even choose which flavour of ice-cream to order. If I choose vanilla, that may set me on the path to the presidency. But if I have strawberry, I could get hit by a bus!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well it's simple then. Don't choose the strawberry.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are missing the point! I would not know that I chose strawberry I would get hit by a bus, I am just saying that every decision we make has unforseen repercussions!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually ice-cream sounds pretty good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah it does!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If it is okay with you, I have prepared a little presentation to illustrate my point. (opens up laptop)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: March, my little off-the-shelf 3-D package robots!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not know what to choose!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not want to lose!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (closes laptop) I am sorry, everyone. It sounded a lot better in my head.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Exactly what time did you get up this morning?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What if you could make both choices? Would that make you feel better?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! I mean no. I mean yes and no. I mean I do not know!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait, let me interrupt you! Where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I had no idea that making smoke signals was so complicated! (Perry hops onscreen) Perry the Platypus!

Name: Ruth
Dialog: Excuse me, (scene switches to where two ladies, Ruth and Esther, are standing)you are in clear violation of the garden rules!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Docents. (To ladies, causally) So, uh, what seems to be the problem, ladies?

Name: Ruth
Dialog: You are showing blatant disregard for our signage!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Looks down and realizes that he is leaning on a sign that reads,"Keep Off The Grass" in red letters) It's all good, ladies. I am a card carrying Danville Botanical Gardens club member. (pulls out card) See? Here's my card! And I'm carrying it!(Esther takes card from him and takes out a laser pen and proceeds to scan the card)

Name: Ruth
Dialog: Then you should know better, Mr Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oof!(Exclaims as Esther sharply nudges him in the gut) And i-it's Doctor Doofenshmirtz. Okay, bye! (to Perry) See how cool I was with them, huh? (Perry's eyes flick to the camera, and he gives the audience a doubtful look) So, Perry the Platypus, I'll bet you're wondering why I haven't trapped you yet. It's because I've hired someone else to do it for me! (On cue, a boomerang flies on screen and slams into Perry. Scene cuts to show Perry tied up and suspended from an arbor) Hehe! Perry the Platypus, meet Platypus hunter Liam McCracken! I found him on an evil consultant website.

Name: Liam
Dialog: Semi-aquatic egg-laying mammals, I can't stand the sight of 'em. And you know what? I'll tell you why. (to Doofenshmirtz) D'you mind?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! You know what? Why don't you do the backstory today?

Name: Liam
Dialog: Back in Australia, I had a good life, but platypuses ruined everything. You see, when I was young, (cue ripple effect, flashback to when Liam was a baby. Baby Liam is seen in a stroller gnawing on a boomerang)

Name: Liam's mother
Dialog: (In flashback, as she pushes baby Liam's stroller) Aww, does he like his boomerang, does he? (notices a platypus near the stroller) Oh my, look at the cute lil' platypus! Hello, cute little fella! (scene changes to show that she and Liam's stroller are at the top of a hill) Hold still! (stroller starts to roll away) That's right. . .  Saay. . . Musk lily!(flashback ends)

Name: Liam
Dialog: . . . And I never saw me mum again. It was on that day that I swore revenge on platypuses.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Platypuses"?

Name: Liam
Dialog: No, no,  I know, it sounds wrong, but it's actually right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I always thought it was "platypi".

Name: Liam
Dialog: That's also acceptable. They're vile creatures, not to be trusted. . . (scene cuts to a close -up of his face) . . . the only mammals with poisonous ankle barbs-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, (turns to Perry) you have a poisonous ankle barb? How come I never knew that?

Name: Liam
Dialog: Well I'm prepared. I've got my own poisonous ankle barbs. And a little somethin' else up my sleeve. I'd like you to meet the ladies. (Opens up jacket to reveal rows of boomerangs, cue dramatic music. Perry stares at him) (Points to the boomerangs) This here is Nancy, Barbara, Jill, Lauren, (in background) Anne, Nancy, Tracy 1, Tracy 2, Troan, 41, 52, Stacy, Panavise, Jaharrison...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Turns to Perry) In all fairness, Perry the Platypus, there was nothing in his profile about, you know, naming his boomerangs. Even I find that a little creepy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha' doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're just in time, Isabella! In order to help Baljeet with his decision-making crisis, we've built the Infinite Probability Generator. (zoom out to show a giant contraption in the backyard) Once Baljeet's been through the machine's Infinite Imprinter, he'll be fundamentally altered at the probable level. (Candace peeks out from behind the tree, binouculars in hand) Then, anytime he comes to a place where he has to make a choice, (shows Baljeet going into the machine) he'll split into two probability Baljeets.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Allowing him to experience the consequences of both timelines?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Exactly, Isabella! Hit it, Ferb! (Ferb does so, machine starts to whir and move with Baljeet in it)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I love it when you guys tamper with the forces of nature.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know, right?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Is science happening yet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I-I-I a-am fee-eling nau-usea-ated!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yep,that sounds like science to me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looks through binoculars) Ohhhh, this is so bustable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, Ferb, let's get him outta there! (machine stops whirring, Baljeet is lowered, he falls from his seat onto the ground with a splat)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now how're ya feeling, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Effervescent and frothy.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Just like my mom's homemade toothpaste!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon, buddy, get up! (helps Baljeet up)

Name: Buford
Dialog: How come he ain't split in two yet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Because he hasn't made a choice yet. (Music is heard)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh boy! It's the ice-cream guy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, I thought it was someone's phone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Baljeet! Let's see if the Infinite Improbability Generator worked!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Howdy, Mike! My good friend Baljeet here would like to sample your fine frozen confections

Name: Mike
Dialog: Alright, Baljeet, what flavour? Vanilla or strawberry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Carpe diem, Baljeet. Carpe diem!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: One vanilla- (he suddenly splits in two, Phineas backs away)

Name: Second Baljeet
Dialog: -and one strawberry!

Name: Mike
Dialog: Weird. And I've also got banana splits!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) Good one, Mike.

Name: Mike
Dialog: Here you go. Vanilla and strawberry. (drives away)

Name: First Baljeet
Dialog: Now I am beside myself.

Name: Second Baljeet
Dialog: And I like it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) That's very clever, Second Baljeet.

Name: Second Baljeet
Dialog: Now that I have made both choices, I will no longer miss any opp- (DBG bus returns, hits Second Baljeet) What do you know! I was right!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, tough break.

Name: First Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. . . but that means I am going to become President!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? Carl! Where are you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm over here, sir! (pans right to show bigger vent, the one Major Monogram was in earlier)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: How did you get over there?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I was coming to see you! Why are you over there?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm trying to get out of here! What are you trying to do?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, I was looking for you so that we could leave together!

Name: Major Monogram
