Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake.

Name: Liam
Dialog: . . . Danni, oh, and this shiny girl came all the way from Greece. I call her- (notices that Perry has escaped) What the blazes?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (turns and sees that Perry has escaped) See, I told you he was good! Now, about your refund policy. . .

Name: Liam
Dialog: (to Perry) That hat don't make you special. you're still a platypus. (At this, Perry narrows his eyes and chatters defiantly) I'm gonna make you eat those words . . .(stops uncertainly) or that noise. You and your hat are gonna make a fine addition to my trophy room.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Trophy room? Whoa-whoa hold on a second, I just hired you to trap Perry the Platypus, not- (steps onto trap, trap snaps shut with Doofenshmirtz inside)

Name: Liam
Dialog: Consider me off the clock, doc. (throws boomerang at Perry, Perry dodges, but it returns, ropes burst out of its middle and trap Perry, while the boomerang returns to Liam's hand)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is this, is this a hammock? If it's a hammock, it's way too tight. (Liam takes no notice, instead grabs rope and starts pulling Perry towards him, Perry struggles and resists, but is unable to, Liam grabs his fedora and slaps one end of a handcuff onto Perry's wrist) Uh-oh, (sticks one hand out of the 'hammock') Mr McCraken, I think you caught me by mistake!

Name: Liam
Dialog: (slaps other end of handcuff onto Dr. Doofenshmirtz's wrist) No mistake there, doc. You're either with me, or against me. Come to think of it, I don't have a pharmacist on my trophy wall. . . yet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, whoa whoa whoa, what do 'you mean, "yet"?

Name: Liam
Dialog: I'm giving you sixty seconds head-start before the hunt commences.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't even know what you're talking about. (turns to the fedora-less Pery) Who's this platypus? Why am I handcuffed to him? Where is Perry the platypus? (Liam just ignores him) So to recap in order of importance, why am I handcuffed to him?

Name: Liam
Dialog: So as to make it easier to hunt the both of you. Now, run.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, fair enough. (is pulled away by Perry) Whooa!! (scene changes to show Perry pulling Doofenshmirtz as they run through the garden, Doof talks but Perry ignores) Wow! You know, I really shouldn't have ignored the ninety-seven percent of customer feedback that says he tends to go rogue. So, I guess we should introduce ourselves. My name is Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz and you being a platypus, you can't talk to tell me your. . . you know what? I'm just gonna call you Steven, is that alright? You look like a Steven to me. (stops and sniffs the air, looks off to his right and sees a rasher of bacon hanging in midair) Bacon! What luck! I have really worked up an appetite with all this eluding. (moves toward the bacon, but Perry narrows his eyes at it,hooks his foot around the leg of a nearby park bench and kicks causing it to fall onto the area below the bacon, a trap snaps shut around it. Liam, some distance away, looks up at the recently activated trap)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa, it was a trap?! I did not see that coming!

Name: Liam
Dialog: (to boomerang in hand) Alright, Nancy. Don't hold anything back, love. (throws Nancy, Nancy flies and takes a chunk out of a tree near to where Perry and Doofenshmirtz are, tree falls, Perry only just manages to pull Doofenshmirtz out of the way in time, Nancy returns to Liam's hand) What took you so long?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, you two, let's get somethin' straight here. There'll be NO messin' with the Buford. Don't make no diff how many of you there are!

Name: Second Baljeet
Dialog: I would never mess with you, Buford!

Name: First Baljeet
Dialog: Neither would I!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's good, 'cause I've still got ya number! Or would that be 'numbers'? (Candace enters, grabs both Baljeets and leaves) Hey, Baljeet, which one would be grammatically correct? (Gasps as he suddenly notices that both Baljeets have disappeared) How rude.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Finally getting 'round to spring cleaning in the summer. First up, the fridge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (enters, bringing in both Baljeets, but one of them is blocked by the fridge door) Mom! Look at this! (closes eyes) Look what Phineas and Ferb did!

Name: First Baljeet
Dialog: Hello, Mrs Flynn-Fletcher.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello, Baljeet. (Candace's eyes open) How's your mom doing? (sniffs at a bowl of gray gunk thoughtfully before dropping it into the dustbin)

Name: First Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, she is doing well!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's good. That's nice. Would you like a snack?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Something to drink if you have it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Opens fridge door) Let's see. I've got some grape juice and orange juice.

Name: First Baljeet
Dialog: I would like grape juice.

Name: Third Baljeet
Dialog: And orange juice!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gestures to both Baljeets) Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (has her back to them, so she can't see them) My, someone's thirsty. Oh, there's more juice down here. (Bends down) Let's see. I've got... (bends up) pineapple, mango and tomato.

Name: Baljeets
Dialog: (as they split) Pineapple! Mango! Tomato!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooookay, Baljeet. You weren't kidding, (bends down to show that four Baljeets have collected behind her) you really were thirsty!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Hehheh, I think we lost him, you can slow down now.(Perry stops near a lake) I just said "slow down", I didn't say "stop". What are you looking at? (Perry stares out onto the lake, a determined look on his face) Oh no, we are NOT going- (cries out as Perry pulls him into the water) Hoo! That's cold! (Perry continues swimming downwards, Doof continues talking with his head out of the water) Wow, you're like a little motorboat there, Steven. (exclaims again as Perry pulls him in once more, Liam arrives at the lake shore, we see him putting on his gear, all of which is platypus-themed. Liam jumps into the water, he takes out a kind of slingshot boomerang and fires it at Perry. Perry sees this, and quickly digs up a large flat stone and uses it to shield himself, boomerang bounces off. Liam grabs Perry's tail, but lets go when Perry swipes him across the face with his ankle barb. Perry and Doof resurface) Wow, Steven, that was sweet! You've really good at that-that barb thing. (Perry suddenly notices something downstream and starts swimming upstream) What? Why are you turning around? Don't go back that way, that put-me-on-the trophy-wall guy is back there. (comes to a water fall) Oh, I see, a waterfall. Just in time for commercial. Isn't that convenient. (Both Doofenshmirtz and Perry go over the waterfall and start falling) What's that all about, anyway? It's not a clifffaller, it's called a cliffhanger, and here we are, falling, and-watch watch watch, here we go, wait, look, yup yup see? There you go! Fading to black!

Name: Liam
Dialog: I know you're down there, ya platypus. And I'm gonna find ya.

Name: Doofenshirtz
Dialog: (Perry climbs out of the waterfall plunge pool with Doof close behind) Hey! Hang on there, Steven. I'm tired of running. And I don't mean tired like, I need to sit down for a while, I mean although I am tired and I do need to sit down for a- I mean- I'm fed up with that guy! And with your animal instincts and my vast knowledge of science, I think we can make a stand. What do you say? Are you with me? (Perry pauses for a while, then gives Doof a thumbs-up. We then see a montage showing Doof and Perry gathering wooden poles and placing them in a tree, lifting a statue with ropes, Perry stopping to sniff a rose before making use of its thorns to make a rope, which is then twined tightly around some Cattail reeds which in turn, are placed in the lake. Perry is seen moving a stone with his bill to hold them down, Perry and Doofenshmirtxz are seen constructing a cage of some sort with the poles from before and string, Perry climbs a tree to pull some of its bark down. This is used to make a glove, which Doofenshmirtz wears and uses to crush a pear. All of this happens while the dramatic music from the start of the episode plays) Groovy!

Name: Baljeet #1
Dialog: I wonder if the others would like some juice.

Name: Baljeet #2
Dialog: We should take some out to them!

Name: Baljeet #3
Dialog: What about Buford?

Name: Baljeet #3
Dialog: Baljeet #1 Indeed, what about Buford?

Name: Baljeet #4
Dialog: What has he ever done for us?

Name: Baljeet #5
Dialog: You mean to us!

Name: Baljeet #2
Dialog: Yeah! He can get his own juice!

Name: All other Baljeets
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Baljeet #1
Dialog: The jerk!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Walks in) Oh, hello, boys! Are we having a party, Baljeet? And Baljeet and. . . wait a moment, if he's Baljeet you must be. . . ?

Name: All the Baljeets at once
Dialog: Baljeet!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: . . . Oh all right then, carry on! (exits room)

Name: Baljeet #4
Dialog: So, we are agreed. No juice for Buford.

Name: Baljeet #2
Dialog: Yeah! (Stands up) No juice for Buford. Come on! (Runs out)

Name: Liam
Dialog: (sees the sprinklers turning on) Now, what's all this, then? (stands up and walks away as the sprinklers all around him turn on, spraying him) (To boomerangs) Alright, Jill, something's not right. Be a love and have a look around. (Throws Jill, which is caught by glove made by Doofenshmirtz earlier. Liam stands where he is and waits for Jill around, but continues walking forward when she does not return ) Jill? Jill? Where are ya? (turns around and sees Jill wedged in the trunk of a tree) Ah, there you are. I thought maybe you'd taken off from me. (moves to remove Jill from the tree, but find that she is, instead, fastened to the tree by a pull string) What the blazes? (Pull string activates underwater bows, which fire arrows made from the rose thorns and cattail reeds Perry had earlier, which strike Liam. He runs away, crying out in shock and pain. As he runs, he activates a trip wire that causes a water fountain to spray a powerful jet of water at him, while, overhead, a boulder rolls down a track made from two wooden poles and knocks a statue out of a tree, which Liam narrowly dodges. The statue, however, knocks a weighted rope net out of a tree, which falls onto Liam, trapping him successfully) Oof!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs triumphantly) We did it, Steven! High five!

Name: Liam
Dialog: So you think you've bested old Liam and his ladies? Sue begs to differ. (throws out a tiny boomerang which cuts the ropes of his net, Liam stands and pulls out another boomerang) I call this one Sharpay. 'Cuz she's sharp, eh? (throws Sharpay, which cuts Perry's and Doofenshmirtz's handcuffs, separating them. Sharpay returns to Liam, who growls in frustration. Freed, Doofenshmirtz and Perry run off) It's all right, Sharpay, I'll give you another chance. (throws, Sharpay, hits Doofenshmirtz, who slams nito a tree.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa!!

Name: Liam
Dialog: (catches and pockets Sharpay) That's my girl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, ow(clutches knee in pain) . . . Steven!! (Perry, some distance away, on top of a small hill, looks up) Heelp!!

Name: Liam
Dialog: This looks like a job for Natasha! (Pulls out a giant boomerang from under his coat and throws it. Perry dives, avoiding the boomerang, which sails away into the distance.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks into the kitchen with one of the Baljeets) Okay, Mom, I'm going to replicate the anomaly right in front of you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Fine. What is it, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look closely. How many Baljeets do you see standing here?

Name: Linda
Dialog: One, Candace. There is only one Baljeet, after all. (Winks at Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why, thank you, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher! That is very kind of you to say.

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's talking numbers, kid. Don't get a big head. Okay, mom, now watch what happens when he has to make a choice. (to Baljeet) Baljeet, would you like some grapes, or this chocolate bar?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Grapes, please. (Takes it from Candace and starts eating, Candace looks shocked when he does not split)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) That's really great, Candace. Now I gotta get back to the fridge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't get it, what happened?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I just really wanted grapes! (walks off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: UHHHHHGGGH!

Name: Liam
Dialog: (Puts down binoculars) No sign of him. Well, doc, it looks like it's just you and-(a plate flies over and hits him on the head, he picks it up from the ground) Ow! What the blazes?! (reads the text printed onto plate) Danville. . .Botanical . . Gardens? (both he and Doofenshmirtz look up to see Perry carrying a stack of DBG plates in his left paw, Perry holds up Major Monogram's card in his right)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Steven, you came back. That's right, fifteen percent off at the gift at the gift shop. Nice going, Steven!

Name: Liam
Dialog: Okay then, (pulls out a black boomerang with orange triangles, and an orange boomerang with black triangles) Theresa one and Theresa two, let's teach this platypus some manners. (Hurls both at Perry, who throws two more plates at him,which scatter both Theresas and hurtle towards Liam who only dodges them just in time. Perry gives him the "I'm watching you" sign')

Name: Liam
Dialog: Very clever. But let's see how you do against the (Pulls out seven identical boomerangs) Seven Sisters! (Perry throws more plates, knocking the boomerangs out of the air and even breaking some) Time to bring out Toni! With an I! (Taking advantage of the situation, Doofenshmirtz limps off)

Name: Baljeet Replicas
Dialog: (All at once) He is always giving us a hard time...He says he is our friend! Would a friend steal your bike?! To be fair, he stole everyone's bike...And what about the time he drank all the water out of our fish tank?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Something's going on over there, the Baljeets seem to be gathering.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh I don't like the looks of that! Gatherings have a bad habit of turning into mobs.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And mobs rarely make good decisions

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh come on, couldn't a gathering just as easily turn into shindig or a hoot-nanny?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Under normal circumstances, I'd say yes. But this one seems to have a ...(Puts her hand on Buford's shoulder, Suspense music plays) ..."Storming of the Bastille" sort of vibe.

Name: Buford
Dialog: See? They're playing music! It is a hoot-nanny!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh, so that's what comeuppance looks like.

Name: Liam
Dialog: (Enraged) You put her down. Platypuses can't throw boomerangs. (Perry only smiles in response, and after dramatically whirling Liam's boomerang for awhile, releases it and hits Liam in the head. Liam stumbles back from the blow and collides with a birdbath as the boomerang returns, impressively, to Perry's hand. Liam narrows his eyes at Perry and flings one of the Seven Sisters at him. Perry counters with another of the Seven Sisters, which slices through the branches above Liam, who runs from the falling boughs, only to encounter Perry again, from whom he runs in fright. Perry hurls two boomerangs at him which rip Liam's jacket in flight, causing him to lose all his boomerangs. Liam reaches for his boomerangs but realizes, too late, that he has none and slams into a tree. He ends up at the base of a tree.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Runs back into backyard) Phineas! Ferb! Ya gotta save me! (cowers behind Phineas) They've all gone crazy! (The Baljeet replicas return, marching into the backyard)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's the Mob Mentality! Once it gets rolling, nothing can stop it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! They're back! All the Baljeets are after Buford!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What do you mean, after, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: After, like they're going to get him!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (stops what she is doing) Baljeet picking on Buford? Candace, Buford outweighs Baljeet by like, 90 hamburgers!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (While backing away from the Baljeets) Now, take it easy, buddies. This is really a bad decision!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's be rational about this!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, everyone...

Name: All Baljeet replicas
Dialog: ...Get him!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, boys, break it up. What's going on out here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs into backyard) You missed it! There were, like, 20 of 'em!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is okay, Mrs Flynn-Fletcher, we were talking about how easy it is to make a bad decision. (Awkwardly dusts Buford down)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Linda; Alright, but play nice.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Who wants pie? (Holds pie out)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (takes it from her) Now that's a decision we can all agree on.

Name: Liam
Dialog: (To Perry) Okay, okay, I give up! (Looks up at the sky and sees Natasha coming towards him) you've got some skills. But there's one thing you should know about my gals. They always come back!(Gets up and runs for it, Perry turns and sees Natasha coming towards him. Natasha completely destroys the tree Perry is under. Perry climbs out of the rubble unhurt but Liam swoops in for the kill)

Name: Liam
Dialog: Aha! Gotcha! (places his boot's poisonous ankle barb right above Perry's heart) My greatest hunt ever (places Perry's fedora on his own head) ends right here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Offscreen) Stop what you're doing, McCraken! Step away from the platypus! (Liam looks up)

Name: Liam
Dialog: (In disdain) Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'd like you to meet my ladies. Ruth and Esther! (The old ladies from before appear on the scene)

Name: Liam
Dialog: Ah, docents. (Esther raises a hand and points to the "Keep off the grass sign") Oh, not again! I'll be right back, (throws Perry's fedora over his shoulder, Perry gets up and dusts himself off) I know how to handle these ladies. (To the ladies) The sign must've just been installed, I've never seen it before.

Name: Ruth
Dialog: Nice try, Liam, but this is your third infraction in as many weeks! Hand over your membership card!

Name: Liam
Dialog: (taken aback) Wha-? Let's not get crazy, now...

Name: Ruth
Dialog: All your membership privileges have been revoked for ten days. Esther will escort you off the grounds. (Esther comes up with a wheelchair. Liam gets into it)

Name: Liam
Dialog: But I can't leave! It's my natural habitat!

Name: Ruth
Dialog: Your file says you're from Pittsburgh.

Name: Liam
Dialog: (suddenly speaking in an American accent) It's not my fault, it's him! It's the platypus you want! (points at Perry, Esther lets go of the wheelchair and both ladies bend down to look at Perry. The wheelchair starts to roll away)

Name: Ruth
Dialog: Oh, look how cute he is!

Name: Liam
Dialog: (Rolling offscreen) Aahhh!!

Name: Ruth
Dialog: (Admiringly) What a handsome platypus!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: There has got to be a way out of here...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Major Monogram?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Yes, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I want you to meet my cousin Larry.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Wait wait wait wait, you got out of the vent, found your cousin and brought him back in here?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I didn't have to find him, we had a lunch date, he was waiting for me.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Why on earth would you bring him back into the vent?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: 'Cuz I wanted you to meet him!

Name: Larry
Dialog: Plus, I really like vents.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Mutual, I'm sure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How are you feeling, buddy?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oddly enough, I feel the same. But I am not worried about making choices anymore.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, it's nice to have you back, Baljeet.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I agree. It's nice to have you back. One of you back.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford! Do I detect true sentiment in your voice?

Name: Buford
Dialog: You do realize I'm holding a pie here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I retract my mocking tone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sees Perry in his fedora) Perry the Platypus! Oh, this is perfect, I want you to meet my new friend, Steven the platypus! You guys-(Looks around for "Steven" ) He's gone! I- I didn't even get a chance to say goodbye... (Perry takes off his fedora and tugs on Dr. Doof's lab coat to get his attention, Doofenshmirtz turns and notices "Steven") Steven! We were just talking about you! Hey, I'd like you to meet pe- (notices "Perry" is no longer around) Now where did he go? Oh, I really wanted you to meet him...maybe you know him! It's...not that I think platypuses all know each other or anything, (Perry shoots a look at the audience briefly before pulling Dr Doof offscreen. Doofenshmirtz keeps talking) I thought they might all run in the same crowd...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: March, my little off-the-shelf 3-D package robots!

Name: Meap
Dialog: (in a hunky accent) It was good getting down around town with my main man, Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think those translation sideburns are really working for you, Meap.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Rock n' roll! (takes sideburns off) Meap!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Later, Meap!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, what'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you missed it. We were just talking with Meap in the galactic web.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What is that flashing on your screen?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm...I don't know. Let's open it up, Ferb.

Name: Morg
Dialog: Hi, my name is Morg. Have you ever wished that you could pop off to another planet, on the other side of the galaxy for a quick visit? Well, now you can! With Mind Share Vacations! Mmm! You and your friends can trade places, with me and my friends, for the interplanetary vacation, of a lifetime!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That sounds like fun.

Name: Morg
Dialog: Imagine, relaxing in a hot rock by the pools, and then surrounded by beautiful newts! Or splork through the tubeworm forest, of put wishum foomf! Woohoo! Hmm! Here's how it works. Your mind comes to lodge in his head, and his mind goes to stay in yours. Only your mind makes the trip, mmm. All you have to do, is build this highly sophisticated device, and be on your way to priiiii...a mind share vacation of a lifetime!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I think I know what we're gonna do today.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It sounded like he almost said we were on our way to Perry.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ha ha ha. Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. We have intelligence that Doofenshmirtz may have taken up Square Dancing. He cannot be allowed to use one of our beloved american traditions for his evil purposes! So get out there and make sure he do-si-do...sen't do that, I guess.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There, finished. Well, that was easier than I thought. Let's fire this bad boy up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Brace yourselves for fun, because we're going on a Mind Share Vacation!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Did it work?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think it did.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, wait a second. (Ferb rolls the backdrop up) Where the heck are we?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ohhhh, prison. We were on our way to prison.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's what he almost said.

Name: Morg
Dialog: Hmm! Our escape plan worked perfectly! We are now free to ransack this planet! Everyone, celebration noises!(Morg and his friends make various sounds; the alien in Baljeet's body makes bicycle horn noises. When everyone stops, he still makes noises. Morg turns and stares at him)

Name: Morg
Dialog: Okay, that's enough!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It appears as though we've been transported into some sort of...inter-galactic hoosegow.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I was framed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (holding a sauce can) I'm afraid we've been duped into aiding in the escape of some rather brilliant galactic prisoners. And they did it with this little gadget --

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, that's you!

Name: Morg
Dialog: That's right losers, mmm! We pulled the old switcheroo! In case you chumps have any ideas about coming back, we're setting the device on our end to self-destruct! In one hour!

Name: Alien in Buford's body
Dialog: Why are we waiting an hour to destroy it?

Name: Alien in Baljeet's body
Dialog: Have you no sense of drama?

Name: Morg
Dialog: Sayonara, suckers! Mmm!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ain't that the squirts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, look on the bright side! (pause) I got nothing.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, guys, I just realized somethin'! I'm the only fly in a prison full of frogs and lizards!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Luckily I do not think anyone else has noticed.

Name: Inmate 1
Dialog: (offscreen) You're mine, flyboy!

Name: Inmate 2
Dialog: (offscreen) Fresh fly!

Name: Inmate 3
Dialog: (offscreen) We're gonna get you!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, it was nice knowing you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think I figured out how we can reverse this thing. We'll be back in our own bodies in no time, barring any unforeseen— (alarm blares) What's that?

Name: Warden
Dialog: Out of your cells, ladies! Surprise inspection! Cell number 12, don't make me come down there! Morg! What are you and your misfits up to this time? What's that? (pointing to the device in the cell)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, uh—

Name: Warden
Dialog: Contraband! One more infraction outta you nerds and I will put you all in the hole for good!!! You got it?!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The guard just took our only connection back to Earth! Now what are we gonna do?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think we might be able to rebuild it, if we could just get the parts.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We need to find a guy who knows how to get things. Every prison has one.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How do you know what every prison ha—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh-uh!! Don't go there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woah-woah-woah-woah-woah! Where on earth do you think you're going?

Name: Morg
Dialog: We're going to Lotsmo to steal food.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! Are you pretending to be aliens or something?

Name: Morg
Dialog: Hmm, yes, pretending. Hilarity noises! (The aliens laugh and the alien in Baljeet's body honks repeatedly again) I'm not gonna tell you again! (The alien briefly stops but not before honking one last time, much to the irritation of Morg)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gotcha! Ha-ha! I know what you're thinking. Why the snazzy getup? Why the boots? Well, ya see, I met this girl, Rosie, on a square-dancing website and I may have led her to believe that I'm...an expert square dancer. (Perry looks at him scornfully) Hey, don't give me that self-righteous look! It's the web, man! Everybody stretches the truth! You don't think that cat really eats cheeseburgers, do you? Anyway, that's why I made these boots (close-up on the boots) to help me dance. See? They have these little microphones that hear all the commands of the square dance caller and they move exactly to those commands, making me the perfect square dancer! So I really want to make a good impression. Maybe you can come along and, you know, make me look good. What do you say? Will you be my wingman? (Perry just gives Doof a look) There's my guy! Oh, yeah, and by the way, she also thinks I'm a champion bull rider, so if it comes up, you, y-, h-hey, don't look at me like that!

Name: Red
Dialog: (voiceover) There must be a guy like me in every prison in the universe. I'm the guy who knows how to get things. Dragonflies, a warm rock if that's your thing, or maybe a lilly-pad for your kid's graduation. So when Morg and his friends needed parts for a mind-swap device, (Buford and Baljeet approach the creature with a piece of paper) they came looking for me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Psst, I understand you're a guy that knows how to get things.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stop it! Stop it! What is wrong with you?! Spit him out!

Name: Red
Dialog: I'm sorry. I skipped breakfast. What is it you are looking for?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (gives him the piece of paper) Here. We made a list.

Name: Red
Dialog: (taking out a pair of reading glasses) You can find everything you need in the dumpster out back of the Lotsmo on Flyway 61.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So then you can get us the stuff?

Name: Red
Dialog: No. I'm not the guy who gets things. I'm the guy who knows how to get things. You would have to tunnel out of your cell and crawl 500 yards through the prison gunge pipe just to reach the outside. That's the length of five football fields.

Name: Buford
Dialog: How d'ya know how long a football field is?

Name: Red
Dialog: (voiceover) Later that day, to make their escape, those boys crawled through 500 yards of foul-smelling nastiness I can't even imagine. (Fade on a shot of a sewer pipe. Phineas crawls out of it into the sewage. He lifts his arms up just like Tim Robbins did in the movie.) Five hundred yards. That's the length of 11 baseball banners, one tennis court, a medium-sized male elephant and a croquet wicket. (While Red is narrating, Ferb crawls out, followed by Isabella. Fade in on a shot of the gang at the dumpster holding some spare parts.) It wasn't long before they found everything that they needed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great! Let's hurry up and put this thing together!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The sooner, the better!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But if we do the mind swap here, those criminals will still be out of jail.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're right. I hadn't thought of that.

Name: Red
Dialog: (voiceover) So even later that day, those boys crawled back through 500 yards of foul-smelling nastiness that I—

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, it is not as bad as you would think.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, gunge is actually quite refreshing.

Name: Red
Dialog: (voiceover) Oh. Well, it was still 500 yards. That's the length of two volleyball courts, a Nimitz-class aircraft carrier, a large three-drawer filing cabinet, three French—

Name: Buford
Dialog: (from inside the pipe) We're not listening anymore!

Name: Red
Dialog: (voiceover) Oh. Okay, then.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, check it out, Perry the Platypus. There she is. That's Rosie. (cut to a woman with light red hair and freckles wearing a magenta dress holding a red Solo cup) She's from Hazel Park (whispering) by the racetrack. (out loud) Why don't you go over there and sit with the other wingmen? (cut to outside a barn where three airplane wingmen are sitting and giving thumbs up) And you can, you know, give me hand signals in case I get stuck. Right? (He approaches Rosie) Heh, hi there. I'm...I'm JohnnyRingoenshmirtz217.

Name: Rosie
Dialog: (in a southern accent) Oh, so nice to finally meet you face to face. I must say, I like a man with a strong chin.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, (chuckles) well, thank you. A lot of people focus on the, you know, the weak forehead. So you...so you care to dance?

Name: Rosie
Dialog: I would love to.

Name: Rosie
Dialog: Pick it up now!

Name: Rosie
Dialog: Well, Johnny, I'm impressed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, these boots were made for dancin'... (closeup on the boots) literally.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello? Earth?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns around and screams) Why are you talking like my little brother, lizard boy?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's me, Candace, Phineas! Outer space alien super crooks from a land of frogs and reptiles have taken over our bodies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. What do you want me to do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really? You believe that weird story just like that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, it's been a long summer, kid. What do you need?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, okay. We need you to find those aliens that look like us and get them to stand on the mind share machine staging area over there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'know, that platform thing. It's the only way to get our brains back into our bodies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, the machine is set to self-destruct in one hour (Candace puts her hands over her mouth in disbelief) so you gotta hurry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right! I'm on it, Phineas! (she exits to the left side of the screen)

Name: Morg
Dialog: (offscreen) Mmmm, quickly now! Get all that gluten on the transport vehicle!

Name: Morg
Dialog: (offscreen) Hmm...let's go! I've seen Argonian moon sloths that move faster!

Name: Morg
Dialog: Pick it up now!

Name: Morg
Dialog: Hmm...what is that? That sound? (Their eyes literally widen) I feel compelled to obey its hypnotic quadrilateral voice commands! Hmm...must seek out source!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where are they going now?

Name: Rosie
Dialog: You got me all tuckered out with that fancy footwork you been doin'. What should we do now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, well, let's see. (Looks to Perry who rubs his belly) We could rub our stomachs (Perry opens his mouth and points to inside of it) and point to our mouths and later we could roll our eyes and put our head in our hands.

Name: Rosie
Dialog: I thought we could get somethin' to eat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that sounds good, too. I mean... Hang on, let me check. (Perry gives him a thumbs up) Let's go!

Name: Morg
Dialog: Oh, rhinestone encrusted oracle, command us with your quadrilateral right angle voice commands! Hmm...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's right! Cross on through there! (She beckons for the band to follow her as she leaves the dance)

Name: Warden
Dialog: Out of your cells, ladies! Inspection time!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, Candace better hurry up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (The band stops.) Oh, what the heck did Phineas call that thing?

Name: Warden
Dialog: Number 12, front and center! Number twelve!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what did he call it? The-the transfer stage arena? The...mind swap place? The...the, um...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Candace! Hurry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I remember!

Name: Warden
Dialog: What have you got to say for yourself this time, Morg?!

Name: Morg
Dialog: We were framed! Hmmm..

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you did it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's right, and when Mom gets back you're gonna be so --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And just in the nick of time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, never mind.

Name: Rosie
Dialog: Oh, Johnny, isn't it amazing how well we square-danced together?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's the boots! I don't usually have...boogie fever! Y'know I... (stammers)

Name: Rosie
Dialog: Oh, JohnnyRingoenshmirtz! You said you only square danced! Well, I would never go out with somebody who would stretch the truth on the internet! Goodbye!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, you don't think that cat really plays the piano, do you?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Guys, can you settle an argument for us? Preferably in my favor? If a vegetarian becomes a zombie, would they start eatin' people? (referring to Baljeet) Mr. Smartyunderpants thinks they just keep eatin' vegetables.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But they are, after all, vegetarians.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess they eat things like heads of lettuce...uh, ears of corn!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Eye of potato!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Leg of carrot! (Baljeet looks up questionably) What? Your carrots don't have legs? Where do your parents shop?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys! What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, we're just solving the world's problems.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Zombie vegetarianism is a world problem?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not yet. But recycling is. We've gotta lot of leftover material from past inventions and we're tryin' to figure out what to do with it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: My mom always just throws all the leftovers into a pot and makes a giant casserole. (to Isabella) It's best to just eat first and ask questions later.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! We'll use all our leftovers and make an invention casserole! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Male Voice
Dialog: I'm right here, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's Internet sensation Parry Gripp!

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: How's it goin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's goin' well! But, actually, we were lookin' for Perry the Platypus.

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: Oops. (exits) Sorry for the misunderstanding.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to the camera) Internet sensation Parry Gripp, ladies and gentlemen! (to Ferb) So, where's our Perry?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (putting a burnt pie on the floor by Perry) Oh, here you go, Perry. (Perry unwillingly sinks his teeth into the pie) I burnt another one. (Shot of Linda as she takes her oven mitts off. She looks rather baggy-eyed.) I guess that's what I get for staying up all night. Unless I get my act together that means plenty more for you, Perry. (Perry gets a look of shock on his face.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence Red leather yellow leather red leather yellow leather red leather yellow leather...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, what on Earth are you doing?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, just a few vocal exercises before my big speech for the committee of the Danville Museum. Would you like a little sneak peek?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'd love to, honey, but I've got quite a lot of baking to do if I wanna make my quota for the Live and Let Pie event.

Name: Advertisement
Dialog: LIVE AND LET PIE!....for charity.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why don't you practice in front of Candace?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, fine idea. There's nothing teenagers love more than listening to speeches.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, where was I? (she smells something and opens the oven to reveal smoke) Oh, no!!! (she takes out yet another burnt pie) Well, Perry, looks like you've got yourself another... Uh, where's Perry?

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: (speaking from the window) Right here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Platypus.

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: Oops, didn't mean to intrude. (ducks down)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. (Perry chatters wearily) Guess whose birthday it is, Agent P? (cut to the monitor showing Monogram wearing a party hat) It's not Carl's. And it's not yours. Okay, okay, it's mine! (blows a noisemaker) Help yourself, Agent P. (a piece of cake with a candle on it emerges from the floor but Perry refuses it) Not a cake person, huh? Oh, well. We've noticed a surge of revenue going to Doofenshmirtz's bank account recently. Get to the bottom of it. Are we ready to sing, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm patching in all the agents now, sir. We couldn't afford the rights to that famous birthday song, so the agents and I came up with this. (various O.W.C.A. agents appear on the monitor in separate boxes, Carl blows a pitch pipe) A one, a two, a three.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (sniff) That was just beautiful!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (reading) "Thank you for coming here today to hear my speech on the history of the ancient Ornithorhynchan tribe. (At this point, Candace's eyes begin to become heavy and she tries in vain to stay awake.) The Ornithorhynchans were a platypus-worshipping society known for painting themselves teal-blue and wearing elaborate platypus-themed costumes for their various dances and rituals."

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking at her watch) Oh, you know what? I just remembered some friends asked me to help them form a giant human pyramid and I told them that was, like, the last thing I want to do today, but it turns out I was wrong. So I-I gotta go. (leaves) The speech is great, Dad, (puts her hands on her father's shoulders) but you might want to add some visual aids. Just a little dry.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hmmm, visual aids. Ah, that's how I can (rolling his r's) sprruce it up a little. Sprrrruce! Sprrrrrruce! Spuuuuuuuuh-ruce! Ha ha ha, ah, very good then.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good to see you, Perry the Platypus! But you will be lucky to see anything after y—Oop! Oh! I almost used my final zinger before I even told you my evil plan! Just put it out of your mind. Bzzt! It's gone like...like you've been zapped by a mind zap-inator....zapperinator or something. Hmmm. Anyway, you may be wondering why you're in an ophthalmologist's chair. Well, it seems that I've come into a bit of good fortuuuuune! Some technology of mine is being used to in eye examination equipment...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...and I've been getting royalty checks. The extra money is fine and all, but it really chafes my hide (shot of Doofenshmirtz observing the equipment being used) that something I invented is being used for good! (grumbles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, y'know what I mean? So, so I invented (takes down an inator from the ceiling) the Eye Fog-inator to temporarily blur the vision of whomever it hits. It will then force people to go out and get their eyes checked, and I'll get even more money, which I can then spend on EEEEEEEEE-VIL! So, y'know I, it kinda evens out. And you, Perry the Platypus, will be my first test subject! (He puts the equipment on Perry) Okay, put your little chin on the thing. (Takes out a cloth from his lab coat) Oh, oh, l-let me wipe that off for you. Gets so greasy. (adjusts the equipment) Okay, lift your head a bit, there-there we go. Perfect. (takes down the inator) Okay, here's my zinger

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice work, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I found some slide rulers from my World of Calculation exhibit.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I found some coat hangers from that Leaning Tower of Closet Space and an old college sweatshirt.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! We can hit this baby with the Megasizer and it'll make a great parachute.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I found these catering trays from the giant picnic and this parachute from the drag race.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! We can shoot that with the Microsizer and it'll make a great sweatshirt. All this stuff is gonna work out great! It's a shame Perry isn't here to see this.

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: Here I am. And I brought some old guitar strings to recycle.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Th-thanks. But—

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: You meant Perry the Platypus, didn't you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah, but your timing is perfect. We were just about to start the song.

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: Okay, try this on for size

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got you now, Perry the Platypus! (They attempt to run into each other but miss; Doofenshmirtz punches a chair instead) Perry the Platypus, did you get yourself upholstered?

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Weeeee!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Actually, this is way too tame. (to someone offscreen) Hey, crank it up to double black diamond!

Name: Boy
Dialog: This parachute smells funny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice repurposing of Buford's chewed gum collection. Woohoo! Woah-woah-woah-woah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That sure was great! I wish Perry was here for once. He would just love it!

Name: Parry Gripp
Dialog: I do love it! I've never had so much fun! Anyway, fellas, I'm gunna hit the road. See ya! (exits)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, he's no platypus, but still a lovely fellow.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, maybe I should've thought before blurring my own vision. It was very short sighted. Anyway, could you make that "digga-digga-digga-digga-digga" sound for me? (Perry kicks him in the jaw) That was a lucky kick, Perry t— (Perry kicks him again, Doofenshmirtz makes angry noises) Wait, I just need to blast myself again and I'll clear my vision and get the jump on him. (On the contrary, Perry jumps him first) Hey, hey, you jumped on me! You used my own turn of phrasing against me! Wow, irony! (He walks off camera and we hear a crash. Cut to a shot of Doofenshmirtz standing next to a scattered pile of buckets) Really? A stack of buckets? That'll teach me to randomly stack buckets in the center of my lab.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, another reject. Here you go, Perry. (turns around) Oh, there you are. What're you doing up there? (she sets the pie down and picks up what she thinks is Perry) Oh, it's a bag of bread. Haha! Oh, (rubs eyes) I've been up so long I'm starting to see things.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. That's it. (takes out her cell phone) I can't believe I'm doing what I'm about to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I hate to interrupt your day but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on phone) I need your help with these pies. I'm so tired I'm startin' to see the weirdest things.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Weird? (takes phone away from her ear) Yes! (back on phone) I'll be right home! (She comes out of the pyramid, which topples over.) Um...that was partially my fault!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (yawns) Ugh, the pies aren't the only things that are burnt.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (exits) I gotta get outta here!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (sighs) That didn't go over as well as I'd hoped. Mmmm, perhaps I need to spuh-ruce it up more! Sprrrrrruce! Sprrrrrrrrrrrrrr—Ahh! Ooh! Ow! I do believe I've sprrrrrrrained my elbow.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Maybe some fresh air will help wake me—Huh?! (She looks at the backyard hodge podge as the song plays in the background)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, found it! Okay, I just have to take three steps back. One..two.. (trips backwards and falls off the building as the inator activates) OWWWWWWWWWWWWW! WHY DO I KEEP STACKING BUCKETS?!?! CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heeheeheeheeheeheeheehee! This is gonna be epic! (She opens the gate and runs through.) Okay, Mom! (She gets zapped by the inator.) Here I am!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, do you see what I'm seeing? (rubs eyes yet again)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I...don't...see...anything!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's it! (exits) I'm lying down!

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: I can see everything so well now.

Name: Father
Dialog: Yes, whoever invented those gizmos inside that machine must be a person who is dedicated his or her life to good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man!

Name: Father
Dialog: Ignore the upside down man, Balthazar.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, our keynote speaker on the history of the Ornithorhynchan tribe, (the curtain opens to reveal Lawrence still in his makeup, but now with a sling on his arm. Applause.) Lawrence Fletcher.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Thank you for coming here today to hear my speech on the ancient Ornithorhynchan tribe. The Ornithorhynchans were a platypus-worshipping...

Name: Jeff
Dialog: Why is his arm in a sling?

Name: Dan
Dialog: That's what bothers you about this?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That nap did me a world of good! I feel so much better now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (putting down her piece of pie) Nnnnnno, maybe not. Back to bed.

Name: Jimmy
Dialog: Why do we always end on that weird B flat with an F sharp bass?

Name: Jimmy's mother
Dialog: It's tradition, Jimmy. We don't question it.

Name: Jimmy
Dialog: I mean it's not even in the key.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, did you all have fun at the Bee Day Festival's Opening Ceremony?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It was bee-wildering.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bee-utiful.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bee-dazzling.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bee-yond.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Bee-guiling.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stops reading a magazine) Ugghh!! Just bee quiet!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh Candace, bee-have. (giggles) What's so important anyway?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh nothing, just taking the what-kind-of-teenager-are-you-quiz to unlock my true teen identity!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'll just leave that to the professionals at the magazine. (drives past an inflatable wading pool) Oh, look at that, an inflatable wading pool. Oh, it's just like the one I used to play with Candace when she was little. Remember, hon?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mmmm-hmm!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're going to do today... and I'll tell you after the wipe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're making the ultimate inflatable wading pool for Mom. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P! We, ah, ah (sneezes) Sorry, I (coughs) My allergies are acting up. This whole Bee Day business is stirring up all the pollen in Danville. Anyway, Agent P, uh, Doof's been spotted gathering bee pheromones, which is not only disgusting but probably evil. To send you on your way, Carl actually came up with a bee-themed jetpack. It's right behind you. (a hatch opens behind Perry, holding a bee-themed jetpack) Carl! Where are those tissues?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (hands a box of tissue) Here you go, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (off-screen) Single-ply, seriously?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) We're on a budget, sir. (Perry flies away on the customized jetpack)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (while talking on phone with Stacy) Okay, Stace, I'm done! Just tallying up the score.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (in her room, talking to Candace on phone) So, how did you d- (Candace screams at the phone) Okay, wh- (Candace screams again) You done?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from the phone) No. (screams)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, talk to me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from the phone) Heather Magazine says I'm... (Cut to her) an emo teen!! An emo teen, Stacy! I don't even know what that is.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, to the Internet. (starts typing on her laptop) Here we go. Emos believe everyone's against them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How can you say that to me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: They're highly sensitive and drama queens.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'm NOT!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You know, as teenage sub-cultures go, it's not so bad. You just need a new look to match your true teen identity. I'll be right over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, how's the pool inflation coming? (Ferb gives him a thumbs up)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi Phineas, what'cha doin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I are building a super inflatable wading pool. Wanna help?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'd love to, but actually, I need your help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anything for you, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (romantically) Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. (passionately) Your word is my humble command. I would travel the four corners of the globe - which I have actually done - but this time, it would be for you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All for you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ah...

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (offscreen) Ahem?!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (whispers) You were lost in Phineasland again.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (snaps out) Oh! Right. (chuckles) Right. The Fireside Girls are going for our Beekeeping patch, and we need to borrow something.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course, but you're going to bring some collateral if you wannna borrow Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh Phineas! (laughs)

Name: Ginger
Dialog: It's not that funny.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Stand down, Fireside Girl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, there you are Perry the Platypus - Hey, great costume, that's the bee's knees or you know, wings in this case. (A giant yellow fly swatter appears behind Perry and swats him) Ha! Swats happening, Perry the platypus. Swats up! Swats goin- (Perry punches him in the chin) Oof! Puh, hey, swats your problem? (Perry punches him again) Oh, I'm sorry, I-I can't help it, I got bees in the brain, especially the queen bee, You only hear about the queen bee this, queen bee that. You'll never hear about the King Bee, do you? That means there's a power vacuum that I need to exploit. (shows an -inator) Behold! The Aroma-nator. Like the queen bee, I have acquired mass quantities of pheromones. See? Right here in the tank. Once I spray myself, the bees will be attracted to me and I will be crowned King Bee! After that, it's just a hop, skip, and a jump to ruling the entire Tri-State Area.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, so the top three items on the Heather Magazine 11-step guide to be the true emo teen are dark hair, dark clothes, and pencil-thin jeans.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ughh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's see what you got.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Heeeeey, not bad!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (weakly) Whatever.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, you got the look and you got the attitude. Now there's just one last test to see if you're a true emo. Do you have enough ennui to resist the urge to bust your brothers? (Candace looks out the window, seeing her brothers building the pool) I don't think your Mom would approve.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course not! They're gonna be soooooo bus --

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Nuh, uh, uh, true identity, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (inhales heavily and exhales lower and lower until part of her hair covers her left eye) What's the point? No one understands me anyway.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, Heather Magazine is good!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks for the loan, Phineas! We're sure to get our Beekeeping patch now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem, what are friends for, if not to reconfigure a sorbet machine that turns people into flies into a sorbet machine that turns people into bees! Just remember, the effect wears off after a couple of hours. Why don't you come back for our inflatable wading pool party after your patch ceremony?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Of course! Wouldn't miss it!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: This is fascinating! Tell me more about bee dancing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really? Because usually, people are either gone or fall asleep by the time I get to this part of the sentence.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet! Mind giving me a hand with these pools?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (looks away from Ginger) In a minute. (Turns around) So to continue, the figure eight and... (Notices Ginger has disappeared) Awwww, annnnnd we are back.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, honey. Love the new look.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You obviously don't know me. Nobody does. And if somebody did, I'd just deny it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sweetie, I went through a similar phase when I was your age. Try writing some poems.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't care,

Name: Candace
Dialog: No one gets me...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Except my hair.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's my girl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (carrying a vacuum cleaner) Okay, time to fill the void in the power vacuum. 'Cause you see, it's a-it's a real vacuum cleaner. (Perry gives a look) No? Wow, either I'm off my game or you're just being stubborn. (Doofenshmirtz activates the vacuum and all the bees get sucked inside) Ha ha! Sucks to be you! So we're back in business! Now, lemme just shut off this baby—Oops! I almost hit the self-destruct button here! What? I-I install one on everything. It's my thing. I put one on my coffee machine, on my TV, (cut to a shot of Doofenshmirtz's toilet with a self-destruct button on it) I have one everywhere. (cut back to Doofenshmirtz) I even put one on my underwear. See? Look. (he activates his underwear's self-destruct button) Oof! Oh, that, uh...that was not pleasant.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, gang's all here. Let's get this pool party started!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Buford, I promised Isabella and the Fireside Girls that we'd wait for them.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (falsetto) "Ooh, I promised Isabella!"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that how I sound?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: He really nailed you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is uncanny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess we can test the pools out to make sure they're up to our usual standards.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (falsetto) "Well, I guess we can test the pools! Hey, look at me!"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (laughs) You guys are right! It's like listening to a mirror! Alright, gang, let's give this wading pool a try.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (belches, giving a thumbs up) Carbonation. Makes me belch. That's why I like it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (sarcastically) Yes, thank you for sharing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now that the bees are out of the way, let's try this baby out. Just a little spritz. (He activates the Aroma-inator and gets more than just a little spritz.) Uh...okay...needs a little adjustments. (The doorbell rings) Oh, that's right. Charlene's coming over to get Vanessa's headphones for her. (He walks over to the door with the headphones and opens it to reveal his ex-wife.)

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Hello, Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Charlene. (giving her the headphones) Here ya go.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: (taking the headphones) Oh, thanks, Heinz. Wait, are you more attractive all of a sudden?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, why, thank you, I have been trying to—Oh, wait, no, it's just the pheromones.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Wow! Well, it's really working because suddenly I can't remember why we broke up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You said you hated Mr. Tomato.

Name: Mr. Tomato
Dialog: Hello, Charlene.

Name: Charlene
Dialog: Oh, hello, Mr. Tomato. (to her ex-husband) Thanks for the reminder. (leaves) I'm outta here.

Name: Mr. Tomato
Dialog: Y'know, it wasn't me she didn't like.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shut up!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What a thrill!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) Man, that kid can wade!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sibling unit,

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wading, wading.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I sit here

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not relating.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, pithy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now we're cookin' with gas! Watch, Perry the Platypus, (Perry throws his fedora. It hits both the forward/reverse switch and the on/off switch) as I spritz myself right into ruining the Tri-State Area! (The Aroma-inator gives Doofenshmirtz a huge spritzing, but he then sees the escaped bees) Uh-oh. (All the bees surround Doofenshmirtz) Oh! Ow! I think it might be time for Plan Bee!! (Perry uses his tail like a chainsaw freeing himself from the swatter trap while Doofenshmirtz is still yelling.) Stop it stop it! (Perry puts his fedora back on) Ah! Ow! They're all over me! Ahhhhh!!! Get 'em off! Get 'em off!!!! (Perry runs over to the remote. He activates the Aroma-inator emptying it completely. The bees follow it.) Thank you for saving me, Perry the Platypus! And on the bright side, with all those bees, not one sting! Ow! (He spits out a bee and sticks out his swollen tongue.) Oh, man! I thould've ekthpected thith. At leatht my inator ith intact. (Perry pushes the self-destruct button on the remote control.) Ah, thhoot! Curth you, Perry the Platyputh! (beat) Curth you! I thaid, "Curth you, Perry the Platyputh!" Yeah, well, thee, you thould be able to get it in contektht.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What the heck is that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have no idea, but the bees sure seem to like it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And so continues the inevitability of my mundane existence. (The bees deflate the giant wading pool, squirting water out of it, and soaking Candace) Once again, I am humiliated by the universe.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What just happened?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, kids! (Cut to the sliding door where Linda comes out with a tray with a pitcher and some glasses filled with iced tea) Anyone up for some iced tea?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure! Thanks, Mom! (They run up to the refreshments. Perry enters chattering.) Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look, you kids found Candace's old wading pool! How sweet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna have a pool party! Go ahead, wade away!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry we're late, Phineas. Our bee ceremony ran long.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries, Isabella. Go ahead and join Mom in the fun.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (falsetto) "No worries, Isabella!" (makes mocking noises)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (to Phineas) Hey, he does a good you! (to Gretchen and Holly) Come on, girls! Let's hit the pool!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Aw, it's just like old times.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (coming in with the magazine) Hey, Candace, (flipping the pages) I just realized you added up your score wrong! Your true teen identity is actually the... (Shows quiz in magazine) "Busting and Crush Obsessed Older Sister Type Who Can't Do Math".

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deadpan) But, but, but, but, but...whatever.

Name: Milly
Dialog: The opening ceremony of the Bee Day festival was awesome!

Name: Holly
Dialog: It's my favorite part of Bee Awareness Day!

Name: Katie
Dialog: My favorite part is the B-flat with the F-sharp bass at the end of the song! (They all look at her.) What? It's tradition!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, girls, festivities are over. Let's focus on getting our beekeeping patches. It's the only patch that we've ever tried to get and failed. Remember last year?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (Interrupting Isabella's flashback) Eep! You promised to never flashback on that ever again.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Right, right! You're right. (Walks outside to a yard with a bee hive in the middle.) But still, if we don't succeed today, the two strikes and you're out rule kicks in, which means this spot will stay empty on our sashes forever! (Close up on her sash showing an outlined mark, she gasps and sniffles)

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Chill out, Isabella. We've got this. Ready, girls? (She pulls off the top of the hive)

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: (Gasp) They're gone!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gone? F-f-f-fighting flashforward to potential catastrophe! (Screen ripples, record scratches) Hey, where's Pinky?

Name: Admiral Acronym
Dialog: Good afternoon, Agent Pinky. I see you've taken our new handbag conveyor system. (Pinky growls) Carla here has intelled that Poofenplotz has been hatching some sort of bee-related evil scheme. Carla?

Name: Carla
Dialog: Yes, it seems that Poofenplotz is researching the use of royal jelly in the bee community. (Beeping) Oh, there's your coffee.

Name: Admiral Acronym
Dialog: Isn't she a find? She comes from an entire family of unpaid interns. Anyways, see if there is anything to Carla's research, Agent Pinky. Admiral Acronym out.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (shrieks) We've gotta find those bees before the sun goes down! But how?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: In the guideline for the beekeeping patch, it says that a good beekeeper tries to think like a bee.

Name: Katie
Dialog: Bzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz...

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: What are you doing?

Name: Katie
Dialog: I'm thinking like a bee.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: I know! We can get stung by radioactive bees and gain bee-themed superpowers!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Um, we don't have access to radioactive bees.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (sarcastically) Yeah. That's what's wrong with that plan.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But we do have access to Phineas and Ferb. And they have access to a sorbet machine that turned Candace into a fly. They've gotta be able to modify it to turn people into bees.

Name: Katie
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb have a sorbet machine that turns people into flies?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Katie, for crying out loud, look it up on the internet!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Let's see.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Bill, bill, flyer... (gasps and squeals) This must be my acceptance letter into L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.! Oh! (she tears the envelope open and takes out the letter and reads it) "Dear Esmeralda Poofenplotz..." Oh, that sounds promising!

Name: (Close up on the letter which reads
(Close up on the letter which reads
Dialog: "Dear Esmeralda Poofenplotz,

Name: (Close up on the letter which reads
Dialog: We regret to [inform] you that your application for membership has been denied. Based on your past schemes, we have deemed that you're not even close to our standard for admission.

Name: (Close up on the letter which reads
Dialog: Feel free to re-apply after you've come up with something really evil. At the very least, get yourself a decent lab coat.

Name: (Close up on the letter which reads
Dialog: Sincerely,

Name: (Close up on the letter which reads
Dialog: Heinz Doofenshmirtz".)

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: "We regret to inform you that..." Oh! Reject me, will they? No matter. (she crumples the paper up) My newest evil scheme is sure to catch the attention of that silly boy's club. (Close up on Pinky in his purse. He barks.) Pinky the Chihuahua! (Pinky jumps out of the purse and growls and barks at his adversary.) Fortunately, I was expecting you. (She pushes a button on a remote and a makeup case pops out of the rug trapping Pinky.) The makeup case doubles as as a trap. (She lifts it up.) Could you hand me that lipstick in there? (Pinky gives her the lipstick.) Thank you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What are friends for, if not to reconfigure a sorbet machine that turns people into flies into a sorbet machine that turns people into bees! Just remember, the effect wears off after a couple of hours. Why don't you come back for our inflatable wading pool party after your patch ceremony?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Of course! Wouldn't miss it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See ya later, then!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Did you know that bees can communicate with each other through dancing?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That's really interesting!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. They do a tail-wagging dance to alert others(?) to a source of food. (in background) The waggle explains the angle to the destination in relations to the imaginary line from the sun to the door of the hive.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, let's see...setting, targets... (she types in the control panel) "Fireside Girls..." And that should do it. (She presses a red button.) Here we go.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (looks away from Ginger) In a minute. (Turns around) So to continue, the figure eight and... (Notices Ginger has disappeared) Awwww, annnnnd we are back.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Fireside Bees, follow your noses!

Name: Fireside Bees
Dialog: (sniffing) That way!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Mmmmwah. Much better. Now that my lips are taken care of, I can tell you about my beautifully evil plan. (Pinky growls, and Poofenplotz sprays him with a water bottle.) Bad doggie! Okay, sit! (Pinky sits) That's better. Now pay attention as the camera slowly moves closer and we cross-dissolve to my thoughts.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: (voiceover) Behold, a humble beehive. A massively warded society just like our own. Observe a young grub bee fed mass quantities of royal jelly, which will make her larger and eventually she will become queen. So logic dictates that if I were to consume massive amounts of royal jelly, then I would grow four times bigger and live four times longer and eventually be crowned Queen of the World! The Queen!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: And I shall not be dark, but beautiful, like the night in the day, and all shall love me and despair!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: (voiceover) And I might have a grotesquely large abdomen for laying eggs, but I can live with that.

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Come, Pinky the Chihuahua! To the Myselfcopter! (She laughs taking Pinky with her climbing into a helicopter shaped in her own image as she flies off)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: My bee instincts are buzzing! This must be where our bees went!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: They must've been attracted to that heavenly scent. What is that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking under) Okay, time to fill the void in the power vacuum. 'Cause you see, it's a-it's a real vacuum cleaner.

Name: Milly
Dialog: It seems to be coming from that gigantic perfume sprayer.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Let's check it out!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woah! It looks like every bee in Danville is here! Fireside Girls, forward, buzz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He activates the vacuum and all the bees get sucked inside) Ha ha! Sucks to be you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...just shut off this baby—Oops! I almost hit the...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (from outside) ...self-destruct button here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow! Humans really take for granted not being sucked into the nearest vacuum cleaner. I'm gonna see if the queen knows anything. (She buzzes up to the queen bee) Excuse me, Your Majesty, do you have any idea how to get out?

Name: Queen Bee
Dialog: Not a clue. And without my jelly, I'm way too weak to fly. Ugh.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whadaya think, Fireside Girls?

Name: Holly
Dialog: What are we supposed to do now?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Bee Day's almost over and we're stuck inside a pharmacist's power-vac.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What? Over? Did you say "over"? Nothing is over until we decide it is! Was it over when we helped Candace get fifty patches in one day? Heck no!

Name: Holly
Dialog: I thought it was only forty-nine.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Forget it, she's rolling.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And it's not over now! Cause when the going gets tough... the tough get going! Come on, girls, we've got enough patches between all of us to make this work! We can do this! Gretchen, Milly, Katie, you've got the exploring patch, right?

Name: Milly
Dialog: Yes, and we can look for a way back out of here!

Name: Gretchen, Milly and Katie
Dialog: Right!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (picking up a piece of hair) These pieces of hair and dust are like rope! Holly, Ginger, you girls have the advanced knot-tying patch. What do you think?

Name: Holly
Dialog: We could totally work with that stuff!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: And make a sling for the queen!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And Adyson, you and I have the appliance repair patch!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Let's hotwire the vacuum and reverse the motor so that it blows us all out again!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (fist bumping Adyson) That's what I'm talkin' about!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: There they are! All we need to do is swap those leads to the forward-reverse switch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great! How's that sling comin'?

Name: Gretchen, Milly and Katie
Dialog: All good to go!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Excellent work! Recon Team, is the escape path charted?

Name: Ginger and Holly
Dialog: Yes, ma'am! Power vac hose located!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Achoo! It was murder on my allergies.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Bee-youtiful! Prepare for exit, everyone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh! (All the bees surround Doofenshmirtz) Ah!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Great job, Adyson.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Uh, thanks?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're going home to the Fireside Lodge! Everybody, follow me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh! It's wearing off! (screams)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Come on! We're almost there!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay! The bees are back! Now we just need to get them back into their hives.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Okay, little bees, go back into your hive.

Name: Holly
Dialog: We don't speak their language anymore. We can't communicate.

Name: Katie
Dialog: Ooh! I have my semaphore patch! Would that work?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Only if they were on a boat.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Baljeet is the answer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ginger, now really isn't the time t—

Name: Ginger
Dialog: No no no! He told me all about this dance they do to alert each other to a source of food or shelter.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Like the rhumba?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: No, it's a waggle dance!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Dance patches we've got!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Oh, 75 degrees is the angle in relationship to the sun.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Yeah, but it also tells the bees the distance they're gonna have to go just to get there!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Ooh...

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Let's do it!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: You got it!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That's right!

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Ah, my locatificator has led me to the motherlode! The royal jelly room at the Moist Beauty Works factory! It won't be long now, Agent Pinky. Soon I'll be able to carry out my most beautifully evil plan yet! (she laughs again. Shot of a nervous Pinky from inside the makeup case. He sees a loose thread and pulls it making the bag come apart. Pinky pushes Poofenplotz making the myselfcopter crash land.) Bad doggy! Bad bad doggy! Oof! (Shot from inside the factory. Poofenplotz is flat on her face.) Ooh. That's the last time I buy a cheap designer knockoff trap from downtown. (gasps) I don't believe it! Fortune is smiling upon me like the creepy guy on the corner of 3rd and Main! (She gets up) We're in the royal jelly chamber of the Moist Beauty organic cosmetics factory! Ha ha ha! How unbelievably coincidental. No really, I mean, I couldn't have asked for a better place to crash. Anyway, you have failed, Pinky the Chihuahua, and brought me right to the biggest supply of royal jelly in the Tri-State Area! (She laughs evilly again as Pinky kicks her into the chambers, which pours royal jelly all over her) I....can't move. Well, I...I'm not much larger and I'm not really feeling royal at all. I suppose my plan was predicated on a faulty hypothesis now, wasn't it? I guess there's only one thing to say, and that's

Name: Poofenplotz
Dialog: Ooh, how humiliating. Piloted off to the pokey by a pooch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (giving one to Milly) Here's your patch and here's my patch! Yay! Time to paaaarrr-tay!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sorry we're late, Phineas. Our bee ceremony ran long.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries, Isabella. Go ahead and join Mom in the fun.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Come on, girls! Let's hit the pool!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Aw, it's just like old times.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella, we're having iced tea! You want some, honey?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What did you say?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I said, "We're having iced tea! (taking out a honey bear tube and a spoon) You want some honey?"

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, um, heh-heh, sure!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: You got it!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That's right!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (offscreen) So we all need to be...

Name: Gretchen (cont'd)
Dialog: ...prepared. You'll want to find a safe place and establish a defensive perimeter.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Like in the basement?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: No! You never go in the basement!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is going on here?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: It's just our bi-monthly Zombie Apocalypse preparedness lecture.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! You're welcome to join us. Ya might learn something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Puh-leez, Phineas. There's nothing about zombies that I don't know.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Did you know there's one standing behind you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH!! ...Very funny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha! Good one, bro.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, Pinky's missing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, that's too bad, Isabella.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chihuahuas, that's the first thing zombies go for.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, we moved past zombies, Buford.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's been gone all morning! He didn't even touch his breakfast burrito. What am I going to do?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: We could put up posters.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We could do nothing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could make a portable positronic canine detector using the olfactory receptors that Ferb and I were gonna use for our milligram scale purification study.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's do that one!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You kids have fun. Really, I wish I could stay and bust you but I have a lunch date with Jeremy down at City Hall.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: City Hall serves lunch?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I thought they only served subpoenas! (pause) Oh, come on! What's a guy gotta do to get a rimshot around here?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: For your information, I'm going down to City Hall because Jeremy's working the Slushy Dawg concession stand at the food court there. And we're gonna have lunch...together. But don't worry, Isabella. I'm sure Pinky'll turn up. Perry always does. Speaking of which, where is Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And where's Pinky?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And where's that breakfast burrito? (Baljeet plays a rimshot on the drums.) Ah, there's my guy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. I believe you know Agent Pinky. (Cut to a shot of Agent Pinky, shaking, next to Agent P.) Agent Pinky informs us that Doof intends to steal the deed to the Tri-State Area from the City Hall archives. It seems he's discovered that whoever has the deed automatically becomes the ruler. It's an old law from a simpler time. You'll find that Agent Pinky is quite an asset, Agent P. He's good with computers, covert ops, and, quite frankly, he needs the hours. So get out there and stop Doofenshmirtz! Good luck, Agents P and, uh...P! (Agents P and Pinky leave) I guess you're just two "P's" in a pod. (chuckles) Carl, where's my rimshot?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) It's right in front of you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (picks up a flyer with the words "Ba-Dum Crash" and a picture of a snare drum on it) How did you do that?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now I am here, but the best way to the food court is...

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Is by taking the mandatory city hall tour!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Wouldn't want a bunch of uninformed people wandering around City Hall!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—

Name: Tourist
Dialog: You can't fight it. I've been on this tour since this morning and I've been caught trying to escape twice!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: (strictly) No talking back there! (enthusiastically) Now, follow me to a world of bureaucratic action and adventure!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? No way! What a coincidence! (to the person behind him) Excuse me, if you and your mullet would just take one step to the... Thank you. (to Perry) Oh, look! You brought your little dog, too! How cute! Oh, FYI, I don't think they allow dogs in here. So, y'know, watch out for that. Anyway, I bet you're wondering why I'm in City Hall, right? Well, I plan to go down into the secret City Hall vault and steal the— Oh, y-you know that, right. (huffs) Right, right, of course. That's probably why you're here. To stop me, right? (opening his box) What you probably don't know is how I will get into the vault without being noticed. (takes out an inator helmet from the box) Behold! My Blend-Into-The-Background-intaor. I will be able to search the vault and steal the hidden deed, because, like they say, it's easier to find a hidden object when you're hidden as well. Right. Th-Th-Th-That's the thing. They say that. Anyway, (puts helmet on) I place the inator on my head, like so, I press this button and, now I'm here (disappears) and I'm blended in (becomes visible again) I'm here, (disappears) I'm gone! (reappears) I'm here, I'm go— Oh, my head! I hope there's no long-term damage from this, but—ugh! Anyway, I bet you think I forgot to trap you. Well, surprise! You're already trapped...by bureaucracy! You see, you don't have a number, Perry the Platypus, so by the time you and your little dog get into the archives, I will already be ruler (disappears) of the Tri-State Area!! (He laughs and exits)

Name: Female Bureaucrat
Dialog: I'm sorry, you cannot go in there without a number, sir. (Pinky slides behind him.) Oh, please don't tell me you brought your dog!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold, the Dog Sensomatic Helmet! It will amplify Buford's senses to those of a dog. (The helmet drops onto Buford's head.) So, Buford, uh, what do you smell now?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think I can smell the future!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Do you smell Pinky yet?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I smell somethin'! (sniffs) I smell... (sniffs and runs off) I smell bacon!

Name: Baljeet and Isabella
Dialog: No, Buford, wait!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Now, this is a very old painting depicting John P. Tristate and Otto H. Adjacent—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me, I just need to get to the food court.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Please hold all your questions to the end. Those are the rules. (Candace walks backwards) Also, please refrain from gum chewing and there are no pets allowed on the tour.
