Also there are no cutsies or halfsies for funsies. (Candace attempts to unhook one of the velvet ropes.) And absolutely no crossing the stanchions, please! ¡No cruzar la cuerda por favor!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: To the basement! (a man walks up to the buttons and attempts to press up) Aah! Quit it! Fresh! (looks at the buttons) Alright, lessee, garage, basement, catacombs, pessimistic humanoid underground dwellings...Ah! Here it is

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who's a good boy?!Who's a good boy?!You're a good boy!Yes, you are!Yes, you are!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's me, right?I'm a good boy?You mean me, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Isabella, how does this help us with Pinky?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Easy, I've been rubbing his belly with Pinky's squeak toy. Now he's got the scent!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pointing) He's this way! I can smell it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good boy!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! I'm a good boy, right?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes, you are!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh? Oh! That had better not be the mailman!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (chasing after him) No, Buford, you're s'posed to be finding Pinky!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What kinda elevator falls at the speed of gravity? Why did they even put an elevator there? I coulda just jumped down the shaft or... (gasps) The deed! Well, I guess it's not...not all that hidden, then, is it? Well, maybe it's just easier to find 'cause I'm hidden! Yes, I (reappears) knew that was a real saying! Come to Papa! (gasps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! Oh, and your pet dog. How did you escape the clutches of bureaucracy? (Perry holds up a piece of paper with the number "7" on it.) Oh, oh, you took a number. I guess the line wasn't as long as I thought. But you're too late! (disappears again) Once I get outside, I will own the Tri-State Area! (Pinky kicks Doof into the ground as he reappears again and a bunch of rolled up papers fall on the ground) W-Which one is it? Oh, great, now I'm confused!!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: And over here are the spontaneous musical number dioramas.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The huh?

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Ooh, Danville is known for its spontaneous musical numbers. For instance...

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: And now, step this way for the history of the history of accounting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, lessee, the Declaration of Independence, the Magna Carta, the Deed to the Tri-State Are—I mean the Mayflower Compact? Ha ha! (goes in the elevator with the "Mayflower Compact" and disappears) Goodbye, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh! Oh! In here! Follow Buford!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys, he went here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think Buford found him!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really? A doggy door in a municipal building that does not allow dogs?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the?! Who did that?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This way, everyone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Lessee, how do you get outta here, now? (Perry swipes the inator off of Doof.) Hey!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh? Another dog! Dis way! (He jumps forward)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, I hope it's Pinky!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Right here! Right here, he—What? (takes off his helmet) He should be right here! Oh, man!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. Well, maybe the helmet needs to be fine-tuned.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (puts helmet on the floor) Yeah, you guys do that. I'm gonna go get a Slushy Dawg.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: R-I-D-E, colon. (The text "PASSWORD

Name: Major Monogram's Voice
Dialog: Agent Pinky is good with computers...good with computers...good with computers...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! That guy is really good with computers!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Now who's ready to see the whole tour again?

Name: All but Candace
Dialog: Run!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Actually, the song part was nice.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Oh, ya like the song, do ya? Well... (As he's about to sing again, Pinky, back in mindless animal mode, walks up to Candace) Hey! Hold it! Is that a dog?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, it's Pinky! (picks him up)

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: I'm sorry, no dogs allowed! This tour is officially over!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (running up to Candace) Candace! Candace, you found him! Thank you! (Candace gives Pinky to Isabella) You said he'd turn up and he did!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way to go, Candace! (picks up Perry) C'mon, you two wandering pets! Who wants a breakfast burrito?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I do!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly how long have you worked here at City Hall?

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Oh, I don't work here. I was sent by Yarnak to help uninformed citizens in need! Now, if you'll excuse me, I am needed elsewhere! Whoosh! (he runs off)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Where were you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm sorry I missed lunch, Jeremy, but this weird guy made me go on a tour.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's Don. He's, uh, kind of a fixture around here.

Name: Don
Dialog: I'm the ruler of the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great, now I'm confused!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: From the PFT Studios in still moderately charming and majestic downtown Danville, it's—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, we know the drill. We've hosted before. (pointing to Major Monogram) He's good, I'm evil, blah blah blah.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I, for one, am excited to be here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm all tingly! I've actually got butterflies in my sto—

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Let me finish my introduction! Welcome to Phineas and Ferb's Musical Cliptastic Countdown Hosted by...Kelly Osbourne! (Timpani drum plays as Doof and Monogram get questionable looks on their faces.) And now, here's our host

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Hi, everybody! What'cha doin'? I have always wanted to say that. I am so excited to be here. I promise you guys, this is gonna be a rockin' show full of surprises. And anyone who knows anything about me, they know that I absolutely LOVE Phineas and Ferb! And being a singer myself, I love love LOVE the songs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wai-wai-wai-, w-what's goin' on here?! We are the hosts!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, and, uh, aren't you a little too three-dimensional to host an animated show, young lady?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am. But I'm doing it anyway, so just deal with it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But w-we have hosting contracts and everything!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Did you read your contract?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nobody reads them, they're like a hundred pages long and pages 2 through 99 are useless, like, like parsley on a dinner plate. Nobody eats it. Y'know, if they're gonna put stuff on your plate that y-you're not gonna eat, why not make it something useful, like a-like a keychain or, or gold doubloons.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Dude, why are you rambling on about parsley? You're bringing the entire energy of the show down! Maybe you guys can be my co-hosts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Co-hosts? I don't like the sound of that. Sounds like a demotion.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Enough of you two. (to the audience) You guys ready? Let's get this party started! (applause) There were so many songs to pick from, I mean, just take a look at all of them.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wow, that is a lot of songs.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You guys voted and now we're gonna rock the top 10! Here's number 10!

Name: Guy
Dialog: Is this the Phineas and Ferb party?

Name: Guy #2
Dialog: Sure is.

Name: Guy
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb parties rule! (all cheering)

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not their party, it's my party! And it's not a party, it's an intimate get together. (Shattering) (Gasps) What was that? Put that down, pardon me, use a napkin! What's my science teacher doing here?

Name: Teacher
Dialog: I never miss a Phineas and Ferb party!

Name: Candace
Dialog: First of all, it's not a party, but if it were a party, it would not be their party, it would be MY PARTY!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! What? WHAT?! I'm sorry, I can't hear you over Candace's intimate get together!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not a party...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (groans) Demoted to co-host.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I've been a co-host before and I had a blast doing it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, goody gumdrops for you!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't worry, Kelly. I am totally down for being second banana.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, first of all, that's a little sad. But, second of all, technically, you would be third banana. It would go

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Nobody is a banana, because there are no bananas!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, we have no bananas!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Here's the song rolling in at number 9!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. From the top of this building, everyone in the Tri-State Area should be able to hear us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, why don't you sing one?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Larry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I ran out of rhymes, all right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Comes and takes Candace's microphone) Good job, Larry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Welcome home.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: This is going to be a fantastic countdown! Um, just one thing, guys. We seriously have to do something about your...fashion. It's just not working.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, really?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You look a bit, like, stiff and-and uniformy. Right, guys?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uniformy? Is that even a word?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, "uniformy." If you look it up, there's a picture of you.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You're one to talk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I mean that whole laboratory look was was never in, I mean, even if you are an "evil scientist". You should try a cape.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A cape? Where am I gonna get a cape at this hour?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You could try a Nehru jacket.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Well, go and get changed then.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (leaving with Monogram) If I could get a Nehru jacket, I could get a cape.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (shakes head) Men. While my co-hosts go backstage and bring their fashions into this century, here's song 8.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Okay, let's keep rocking and get rol—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Wa-wa-wait!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, hold the boat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mind you, this does not mean in any way, shape, or hair color, that I am your co-host. I-I'm just sayin'.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Wow! Now I know what I would look like if I had middle-aged male clones.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I can't believe I let myself get talked into this. It's embarrassing and, if I'm being honest, a bit drafty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, just go with it, Francis. (to Kelly) Hey, l-look at this! Strike a pose! Look, look, look, I'm vo—

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Vogueing?! I love vogueing! It's so '90's!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I was a bit of a secret voguer myself.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It wasn't a secret.

Name: Kelly Osbounre
Dialog: You know what we should do then? Strike a pose.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vogue. Vogueing. That's it. Look it up, kids. That's what the internet is for.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That was fun! Great idea, Kelly.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, but, vogueing was my idea! I started to say "vogueing" and you just cut me off right before when I just got "vo" out. Y'know, I— (to Monogram) What did you think I was gonna say? Vociferous? What other words start with "vo"?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Give it a rest, Heinz. (to Kelly) He's always like this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! That is it! You will rue the day that you demoted Heinz Doofenshmirtz to co-host! (he leaves)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Hmm. You know what that means?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I think I do.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (singsongy) More hosting for us!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All right! Here's a little ditty I like to call "Song Number 7"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On P.A) Ladies and Gentlemen, my sister, Candace Flynn!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The... uh... Wait a minute! It doesn't matter! I can't believe I was almost sucked into this!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Are you guys having as much fun as I am? (crowd cheers)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes! Now that I'm back in my old clothes, uniformy or not. I predict the Nehru jacket will make a comeback.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Mmm. Not gonna happen.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: But you know what is gonna happen? Song number 6!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So Phineas, what do you think of the City of Love?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish it was the City of Airplane Parts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, you're just too stressed. You should take a moment to relax and enjoy it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. That awning could be used as a sail. Or, you know, a parachute. Depending on how things go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if they still have pieces of that hanging around? The rivets would come in handy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, Phineas...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look at that nifty little blow torch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if oil-based paint is combustible...as a rocket fuel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that reminds me, we might need helmets!

Name: Vendor
Dialog: Hey you! Stop letting my balloons go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, little Miss Osbourne, (coming back onstage with an inator helmet on his head and a remote) prepare to say hello to your doom (Agent P appears on one of the rafters above the soundstage.) at the hands of—or, I guess in this case, in the head of—the man who is not your co-host! (Perry holds onto a rope with one hand and holds a mirror in the other.)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Wow. That was close.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. Was that Perry the Platypus? Great. They're probably letting him host the show.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Everyone welcome Perry! (massive applause) Oh my gosh, this day just keeps getting better and better! You know, I was hoping you'd stop by. Do you...Do you want to introduce the next song?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Let me translate for you guys. What I believe he just said was, "Swinging in at number 5 is..."

Name: Phineas (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Summer... It sounds dangerous, yet oddly compelling. What is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is summer? Man, where do I begin?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wait. Maybe we're going too fast.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: That last song just makes me wanna move and groove, but enough about me. Because I have a surprise for everyone. (applause) A friend of mine wanted to stop by and say hi, so please, put your hands together and give a warm welcome to Maia Mitchell!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Hi! I was watching from backstage and I could not wait to get out here! I love all the songs so far!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I know, right? Aren't they fun?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah, they're amazing! And, Kelly, you are doing an awesome job of hosting. Isn't she? (encourages applause) No, no, you're great! And, Major Monogram, I'm Maia. (shakes Monogram's hand)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Pleasure to meet you, young lady.

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: And Perry! I love you! You're my favorite, actually, because, we have something in common.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: We're both from Australia.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (gasp) Didn't even think of that. That's so cool!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: That is so cool. (giggles)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Maia, why don't you introduce the next song?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I was actually waiting for you to ask me to do that.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Check it out! It's number 4!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Do I know you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I'm you from another dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Well that would explain the handsomeness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right back atcha, big guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Does that mean you and I are exactly alike?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Blech, no, that's gross!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Me too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But not the vending machine thing. That's gonna happen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: It's in this pouch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I can't help but notice that your scar goes over your eyepatch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Yeah...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...Nothing...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, I meant Lorenzo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, that's right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: What's that, are we doing a TV show together?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. It just sort of sounded like that. Well, I mean, we could. We should!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Hmm, maybe we're not so much alike

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That can be your catchphrase! You're the grumpy one. (Pokes him) Eh?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: There are so many great songs!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I know! What did you think about that last song, Perry?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I have a...I have a confession.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I might, uh, make Perry noises when no one's looking.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (gasps) You're kidding! Me, too!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: You do?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: All the time!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Make that three!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, I just wanted to check to see if you— (freaks out) MAIA MITCHELL!!! I'm your biggest fan! Love your voice and your work!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Thank you so much. You're really sweet.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Hey, you know what? I've got an idea. Why don't we all make Perry noises together?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You ready?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (to Monogram) You ready? (Monogram cracks his knuckles) Okay.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: (laughs) Nobody does it better than Perry.

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: I'll never get tired of that.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Me neither.

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Well, sadly, I have to go.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: No! Really?

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: Yeah, but thank you so much for having me.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Thank you so much for stopping by!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: (hugging Kelly) Of course, my pleasure. Heh!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Maia Mitchell, everyone!

Name: Maia Mitchell
Dialog: (waves) Bye!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hey, I'll walk you out!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (chuckles) Looks like someone's got a schoolboy crush.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You think? Anyway, let's get back to the countdown. Here's number 3.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Chuckles while sweating) Who's up for charades?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what are you doing down here?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hi, Vanessa.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what are you doing?

Name: Teen
Dialog: Oh I get it, platypus is a metaphor for whatever's keeping you down!

Name: Weird Teen
Dialog: My teacher is a panda

Name: Weird Teen
Dialog: Wait! Oh wait, no, he's gone! Hey!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (At Vanessa) Your dad's kinda cool.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You're my punk-rock boyfriend! You're not supposed to think my dad is cool! (She walks over to Doofenshmirtz) It only matters that I think he's cool. (Kisses him on the cheek)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: She thinks I'm cool!

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You know what'd be really cool? To write a song so next year the song can be on the countdown!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, as a fellow musician, I heartily agree.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Oh, you're a musician?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, yes. From, uh, from time to time, I like to strum the (speaks the Hawaiian pronunciation) ukulele.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uhhhh, did I miss Maia Mitchell?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: I'm afraid so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, bummer. Anyway, as a musician, not as a co-host, mind you, I'd like to get in on this little songwriting thing you're about to do.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What do you play?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, several things, by my instrument of choice is the kazoo.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: You rock the kaz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I do.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Fine! Let's start with the lyrics then. Maybe we can do some sort of a round robin kinda thing and write a line, and the next person can rhyme it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good idea. Ahem. Me first, me first. Uh, let's see. "When I wake up in the morning sun..."

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: "I realize you're the only one."

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Dude, really?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: There's no rhyme for the word "silver".

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: She's right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, look...eh...uh..."Bilver" and, and, and there's (Kelly scoffs) What, what?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: What is a bilver?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a...water moving thingy.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I believe what you're thinking of is a bilge pump.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is that better?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: See how I just rolled my eyes? Please roll clip number 2!

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, I'm taking a verse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Be my guest!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: By Jove, I think she's got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's what I'm talking about!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy! You came back early!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I missed my girlfriend.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooh! I like the sound of that!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Besides you forgot something in France.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did? What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: This.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Right, guys, before we roll our last clip, I have to know something. Do you have a favorite song on the countdown?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I'm, uh, I'm particularly partial to number three.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I like number seven, that's my lucky number. (The background starts to ripple.) It all started when I was seven years old, back in Drusselstein—

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: W-W-Wait a minute. You're doing a flashback.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yeah, it's kinda my thing. I do a lot of these (stammers)

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Um, we can't fit that in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, what if I make it short?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: We still don't have time because...it's the moment we've all been waiting for!!! And I can't believe this, but you all picked my favorite song as the number one song! You guys have fabulous taste, I'm just saying. You guys ready? It's... Everything's Better with Perry!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good morning, Perry! Now that's the way to wake up. (He hugs Perry) This is gonna be the best day ever.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Well, this has been the most amazing day! And to quote my favorites, Phineas and Ferb, "The best day ever!"

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I completely concur.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I've been reconsidering and I'm going to give in. I'm totally gonna be your co-host.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: That's great. But—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So what are my co-hosting duties? What's next on the old co-hosting train I jumped aboard? What do I do?

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Say goodbye, Dr. D.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it? Goodbye, Dr. D!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Goodbye.

Name: Kelly Osbourne
Dialog: Thank you so much, everybody, that was so much fun! I'm gonna be singing these songs all day! See ya next time!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, gang. Today, we're gonna tie a legendary knot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Woah woah woah! We're just startin'?! No—no intro, nothin'?! Just gettin' right into it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep, we're just doin' the knot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait, how can we do something not?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, it's "knot" spelled with a "k".

Name: Buford
Dialog: I didn't think it was spelled with a "k".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No. It's "knot".....spelled with a "k".

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't understand your pauses.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, lemme start over. Today, we're gonna reproduce the Gordian Knot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, why didn't you say so in the first place?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I've heard of that, but I can't remember the story.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got this. Back in the day where men wore miniskirts...wiggle wiggle wiggle...wiggle wiggle wiggle...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover) ...Alexander the Great was vacationing in Gordium, when he came upon a celebrated oxcart that was tied to a post using a knot that was so complicated, it was impossible to untie. So he just sliced it in half in one bold stroke.

Name: Buford
Dialog: A simple solution to a complicated problem, hence the phrase, "Cutting the Gordian Knot."

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I've never heard that phrase!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is new to me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Trust me, it's a thing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, we'll tie these ropes around our waists, and follow this blueprint to recreate it, then it's up to us to figure out how to get loose. That'll make us the second people to tie the Gordian Knot, but the first people to untie it!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What if we cannot untie it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (tying his rope around his waist) No problem. Our mom was always really good with knots. There was this one time when Candace—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (leaning against the door) Hey! I thought we weren't going to bring up the clothesline incident ever again!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, right. Anyway, would you mind getting Mom if we get stuck in the ginormous Gordian Knot we're making?

Name: Candace
Dialog: When it gets big and weird, I'll go get Mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent! Does everyone have their ropes tied? Alright, lessee, Isabella and Buford, make two loops where you're standing. Great! You're good to start climbing. Baljeet, turn twice counterclockwise and then dive in five loops from the bottom. Then Ferb and I will do this and this and this, and we'll join you inside.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Shall we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Absolutely. Let's go, bro! Baljeet and Ferb, twist to the right and wiggle towards the top. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P! Seems that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been hitting every all-you-can-eat buffet in town, which can't be good! If anything were to happen to Doofenshmirtz, we would have to make some drastic cuts over here! (looking aside) Especially in the non-essential personnel department. (Perry starts to vacuum all the dirt off the chair.) Good luck, Agent P. Oh, don't worry about the mess, uh, Carl will take care of it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off screen) I guess that makes me essential, huh?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't get cocky, Carl.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Jeremy. What a nice surprise! (sees the safe) Ooh, what's that?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, it's an old mini safe of mine that I found in the back of my closet. I've had it for ages, but I haven't used it in so long that I forgot the combination. I thought your brothers could open it. I figured that's a "safe" bet. Heh heh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what's in it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's the thing. I don't remember.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe it's a rare baseball card.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, I sold all those a long time ago.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, could it be your favorite toy car from when you were a kid?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, I traded that for this safe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, maybe it's something cute, like your baby teeth.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nope. Definitely not. I still got those. (He lifts his upper lip to reveal his baby teeth stuck in his gums.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew. I mean, cute!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, the Tooth Fairy never visited me when I was a kid. (pause) Anyway...could you give this to your brothers? I gotta rush to work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes the safe) Sure. I'll give it to them as soon as they finish their Ferbian Knot. Don't ask.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (leaves) See ya later, alligator!

Name: Candace
Dialog: In a while, crocodile!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You guys have got to work on your pet names for each other. So what's in the safe?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I dunno. But it's not baby teeth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (off screen) Okay, everybody. Two twists to the left and we should all see daylight.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (coming out of the knot) Well, I just earned my Overcoming Claustrophobia Patch!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ugh! Daylight! Ha ha!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Now what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now we burrow back in and untie ourselves.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You gotta be kiddin' me! Who looked at this idea and said, "Yeah, that'd be fun"?! Y'see?! This is what happens when we have no intro!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have been making mental notes of the paths and probabilities as I have gone along. It will be a piece of cake.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If I just walk backwards, it should work.

Name: Buford
Dialog: To heck with this game! I'm just gonna chill here for a while. (gets pulled into the knot) Hey!!! Who's pullin' on my rope?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Over here, Perry the Platypus. (Cut to Doofenshmirtz at a table with a Dagwood sandwich on it and a high chair sitting next to him.) I'm just having a little lunch. Why don't you pull up a chair and join me? (He sits in the chair and, of course, gets trapped.) Whadaya think? Pretty clever, right? It's my new high chair trap! I thought of a high chair cuz you're just a little guy. Arencha? Yes you are you're just a lil' guy. (Perry chatters angrily.) Hey, you're not getting outta this so why don't you enjoy the food. (Doofenshmritz force feeds Perry part of the sandwich.) It's All-You-Can-Eat, you know. (stops) Uh, ih, you're good? (Perry nods.) You're already full, right? Me, too. I barely touched my plate. That's how these all-you-can-eat places make their money. They charge you like you're gonna eat a week's worth, but then, when you fill up after, like, two plates, they-they've really made a profit. That's why I'm opening up my own All-You-Can-Eat Drusselsteinian buffet! (Shows him a video on a smartphone) Look. I've already made a commercial for it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All You Can Eat Drusselsteinian Buffet! It's food the way your mother never made! We've got Hassenfloffer Entrail Waterzooi, with Gopher Gut Au Gratin! Fuzzy Fungus Flugelbrotchen! And an assortment of tripe-based desserts! And those brave enough can try our new Mystery Lump! Remember, "Doof" spelled backwards is "fooD"!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, come to think of it, it really should be called "the All You Can Stand", because Drusselsteinian food is terrible! That's the beauty of it. Nobody will be able to finish even one plate's worth! My profit margin will be HUGE! But, first, I've got to eliminate the competition, with this, (Takes out an inator) the Eat-It-All-Inator! You see, it gives people a huge appetite and everyone will eat so much that all of these All You Can Eat places will go out of busineeessssss! Then my restaurant will be packed! (Maniacal laughter) Maniacal laughter!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whadaya suppose it is?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's probably some dumb boy stuff like firecrackers or turtle shells.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or maybe it's his secret inner thoughts written as a sonnet. No, no, no, no, that's not it! I gotta think more like my brothers. Y'know, use my imagination.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: This could be dangerous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe it's a secret spy plan. Or a glass eye! Or Abraham Lincoln's beard!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, just watch what happens when I zap those people over there. (Perry jumps in his high chair causing Doofenshmirtz to fire off his inator. The ray bounces off a sneeze guard, off a lamp and hits Doofenshmirtz.) Huh? What happened? How could I miss? Oh, I'm so hungry all of a sudden! (He munches his way through the Dagwood sandwich on his plate finishing it whole.) Oh, that was great! I...I can cut out the middleman and do all the eating myself! (gets up) I'm going down for seconds. (He digs into the entire buffet. The man who was about to get his helping opens up a bag of chips. Cut to Doofenshmirtz eating other people's plates.)

Name: Man
Dialog: How can you eat like that and stay so thin?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I built an All-You-Can-Eat-inator that speeds up your metabolism so you don't gain any weight no matter how much you eat ever.

Name: Man
Dialog: You should mass produce that machine! Everyone would buy one! Well, you'd be a millionaire!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pfft, don't worry about me making money, mister! I've-I've got a complicated plan. I—Like I'm gonna take advice from some guy in a diner.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not...even close! (leaves) That's it, I'm gettin' the boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we all just got a few more moves to get untied. Except for Buford, who's managed to tie himself into a knot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm a victim o' circumstance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: PHINEAS AND FERB, YOU GOTTA OPEN THIS SAFE AND TELL ME WHAT'S INSIDE!!! IT'S DRIVIN' ME CRAZY!!!!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. We'd love to. As soon as we finish untying the Gordian Knot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, it's big and weird. MA!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: In a minute, Candace!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! You're too late, Perry the Platypus! Buffet number two is history! I am starting to feel a little full though. Hmm, I thought it would last more than a few minutes. Better give myself a little boost. (Zaps himself) That's more like it! Wow, I am so hungry, I could eat everything at Buffet Number Three, baby! Yeah! (Perry bounces) Oh, give up, Perry the Platypus, those chairs are— (Perry throws himself and the chair at Doofenshmirtz. He falls over backwards as the chair smashes into pieces. The inator falls down and disappears.) Huh? Oh, man, I swallowed my inator. Oh, well, at least you can't destroy it now, because it's inside my stomach. So, today, I win! (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz's stomach and the inator zaps from inside his mouth. Doofenshmirtz feels his stomach.) Okay, you broke it. I can feel all the little pieces just rumbling around in there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm starving! What's that sweet smell?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Probably licorice. We used it to make the ropes as a failsafe in case Mom wasn't around.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perfect! (She drops the safe and runs into the knot.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I never knew Candace was such a licorice fan. (Candace still munches on the licorice. Ferb gets out an umbrella and opens it.) Hey, thanks.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am so in love with her right now.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nothin'.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's a solution to the Gordian Knot even Alexander the Great couldn't come up with.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Alright, Candace, what am I looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I ate it! It was the size of the house and I ate it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You ate it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, I don't believe it either!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looking at the safe) Well, what is that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's a safe. I can't open it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Gimme that thing! I got an opener that can open anything! (He hits himself on the head with the safe, which opens.) ¡Para usted, señorita!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes out what was in the safe) A pencil?! This is what I've been obsessed with all day, a pencil?!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, I remember that! In grade school, a pretty girl loaned me that pencil and I've kept it ever since.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A pretty girl? (angrily) Who was she?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, that pretty girl was you. See, those are your teeth marks.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace. You can eat the rest of that pencil. Unless you'd like to join us all for some chocolate triple layer cake.

Name: All but Candace
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Ohhhhhhh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, my baby teeth just fell out!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (giving the safe) Why don't you put 'em in here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew. I mean cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seen when broadcasted by itself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not...even close!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So this rock climbing wall will be big! And, best of all, it'll be built of all-natural, an 100% organic, free-range yard trimmings!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So is it only rock climbing wall?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, it's not only rock climbing wall. It's free-range organic rock climbing wall!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can see how that would be relevant if we are going to eat it. We are not going to have to eat it, are we?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess if we had to we could...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Did I hear we're building something we can eat?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, for the record, I would like to not be in a position today, where I have to eat this wall.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll see what we can do, but we're not making any promises.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, have you seen my other white skirt? (Looks at the list) What are those charts?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, the rare and elusive, bent-bill knot-hatch is in it's nest building season. The birds will be done traveling North, and should be right here in town today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Snores-ville.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No dear, the bird took a left at Snores-ville, and is up here in Danville. Can I get up high? (Candace high-fives Lawrence)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Woo! Okay, more specifically, it should be right in our backyard at exactly four today! Isn't that exciting!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait wait wait wait wait! So you and a bunch of trained observers are going to be in our yard at exactly four in the P.M. today?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Love it! The Booby-hatched trash-nut whatever it is, is my new favorite bird! This is awesome, see you guys later.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (To Lawrence) See? She thinks it's fun.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes and I'm British, and so you think I'm supposed to like bird watching. (Imitating a British accent) Oh, I'm British, so I'll in the conservatory with tea and a crumpet. I'm saying that ironically but actually that sounds quite good. So I'm going to do that. Ta.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (outside in the backyard) Oh yeah. Yeah. This looks good. So how long 'till you're done with this contraption? Think you'll still be out here at four?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. I guess so.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sadly) Hi Phineas. Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Isabella, rock climbing wall.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I just came by to tell you that I can't join in on the fun today. I've been charge of the task of recording the audio book version of the Fireside Girls Compendium Guide, it's gonna take forever.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That book does not look so intimidating.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Dude! This is just the table of contents. The actual book is being transported from a secret bunker to a recording studio at the Fireside Girls Lodge. (The book is seen being air-lifted into the lodge) Seriously, this is going to take me a week.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, we can help. We'll just put this rock climbing wall off 'till tomorrow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. What? No! You guys keep working, I'll narrate the audiobook. (To Isabella) You stay here and help the boys. Not only will I finish recording your book today, I'll do it by four o'clock.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, let me get this straight; You'll do all the work, while I spend the day with Phineas? Mmm.... Deal. But do you know anyone who can work a state-of-the-art soundboard? Someone who can edit huge digital files? Someone who can understand basic mic-ing techniques?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (annoyed) What is it, Irving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Okay, I'll do it. But only if Isabella says "where's Perry?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: No deal.

Name: Irving
Dialog: You drive a hard bargain, I admit.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's okay, I was about to ask that anyway!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. we're getting reports that there is a distinct smell of confectioner sugar, and icing coming form Doofenshmirtz's building. He must be up to something evil and sweet. Sweet and evil. "Sweevil" if you will. Go and stop him.

Name: Irving
Dialog: ...and put your headphones on. Fireside Girls Compendium, page one, and take one. Whenever you're ready.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ma May Me Mo Mu. Topeka, Kansas. Topeka, Kansas. (Cut to reveal those are the actual words printed in the book.) Man this is the worst book dedication ever. How we doing in there Irving?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Levels are fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Page one. Welcome Fireside girl. You're about to embark on a trans-formative journey that you will remember for years to come. (Later) ...and water should be boiled. Now on to part two of the introduction. (Later still) (hoarsely) Section 12, part 6. How to start a fire using only bobby pins and a hat. (Even later) Section 25, part 16. How to tell if a marshmallow is properly roasted. (Candace stumbles, and coughs dryly.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Can I get you some water?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe. (She glances at the clock) N-Keep it rolling, keep it rolling. (She continues) Beginning Section 25, part 17.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, gang. Is everybody all strapped into their harness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ready! But it is also the worst wedgie I have ever had.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh really?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Present company excluded.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All righty then. Let's go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why if it isn't Perry the Platypus. And when I say "isn't" I mean "is". I know you're into martial arts. But I prefer the confectionery arts myself. (A gingerbread house falls on Perry) Gingerbread house trap. (Peeking through a window in the house)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey it looks a lot bigger on the inside than it does on the outside. Here, have some cozy gumdrop slippers. Hehehe. Now where was I? Oh yeah. I think I know why I'm having a hard time taking over the Tri-State Area It's because of dinner parties. Follow me, it goes somewhere. You see my brother Roger is a success, because of his amazing dinner parties, where he dazzles important guests, with his magnetic charm. But what if he were unable to charm anyone, because his fabulous dinner parties were over, before they began!? That's why I created this

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How about a banana split? (He shove a banana split down Perry's bill) Haha! Finally got your just desserts. What are you doing with that pound cake? I was saving that for company! (Perry forces Doofenshmirtz to eat the entire pound cake) Oh! Oh wow! Perry the Platypus, I'm getting such a sugar rush! How 'bout you? (Perry is shown to be having a sugar rush as well)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a hoarse voice) In conclusion, may your Fireside Girl experience be a treasured one with memories for a lifetime. The end.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Umm... I'd like you to do one more take on that last chapter.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'd like to hurt you.

Name: Irving
Dialog: That's a wrap!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey guys! I can see my thoughts! They're all sparkly and spread out around us.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is the lack of oxygen; it makes you light-headed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think it's time to climb down.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha-ha, coming down!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh I get it, we're in space. AAAAAGHAAGH! I heard that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can you do this, Perry the Platypus? Can you jump really fast, up and down, up and down, up and down, up and down? Yeah, that's it, Perry the Platypus! Doesn't it feel good? Let's be jumping buddies. Let's just eat dessert and jump up and down and up and down and up and down all day. It'll be our thing. Just remember

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In the backyard) Yes! it's still here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace! How'd it go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I finished recording, Irving's uploading it to the Fireside Girl mainframe as we speak

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks so much Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Now the important thing to get Mom out here. (Hoarsely and quietly she yells) Mom! Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Do you want me to get Mom?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No. You stay here. Nobody move. If we leave, this thing'll disappear. She'll be out here in two minutes, with her bird watching group. I'll wait.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. Jump. (Doofenshmirtz collapses) Aww. Oh, sugar crash. (The -inator starts beeping) Oh! The Bring-out-the-Dessert-inator it must be almost time for Roger's dinner party to begin. (Doofenshmirtz sees Perry on the floor) Haha! Sugar crash! (The -inator launches) There she goes! And you can't do anything about it, because you're on a sugar crash. (Perry takes a plate of food out from under his hat.) Wait! Wait, what is that? Protein, and carbohydrates? No, well don't eat that! (Perry does so anyway) No! (Perry chases after the -inator on his jetpack) Okay, but, but let's do that jumping thing again sometime.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (To her bird watching group) Okay gang, everyone follow me outside. The bird should be right-- (Linda gets hit with the -inator) Hey, who's ready for dessert? Doesn't that sound good?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, see now? Brits like dessert.

Name: Bird Watcher Male
Dialog: Does this mean she wants us to leave?

Name: Bird Watcher Female
Dialog: Well according to social convention, I guess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Welcome Perry the Platypus. What took you so long? I'm speaking to you through this amplifier right next to the self destruct button. The rocket will soon be in orbit around my brother's house, ready for the next dinner party. And you can ride that rocket until your tail falls off, I don't care. Or until you find the self destruct button which is right next to (Perry presses the button) Aw, dang it! Curse you Perry the Plat-- (The -inator explodes) ...typus.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (She takes out her cellphone and calls Linda)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Come outside!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, I can't here you. Let's talk in a minute. (She hangs up) Who wants this a la mode?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (She runs inside)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! Ooh! It the rare bent-bill knot-hatch! Isn't she beautiful? (The bird begins to pick at the rock climbing wall) She's finding material for her nest.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess they've got a lot of nests to make. We did build the thing out of pressed twigs and lawn clippings.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Nature's little recyclers at work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Seeing the rock climbing wall has gone) What? What? No! But, but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, I see it! (The rare bent-bill knot-hatch is shown to be on top of Candace's head) Don't move. Hold still. (Linda takes a picture) Got it! Oh, Candace, I wouldn't have seen it, if you hadn't grabbed my forcibly, and pulled me out here. Thank you! So, you kids want some dessert?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Some tea with honey would help that throat. And, there's crumpets in the conservatory as well. (He walks off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: He's so British.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Ferb, we can cross that one off our bucket list.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey guys! What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, I think the bigger question is

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm filling in for Isabella while she visitin' her grandparents in New Mexico.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The dress was all his idea, though.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I got the legs for it. (takes off wig) Ah, New Mexico. My great grandfather once saw something mysterious in New Mexico...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover) There he was, happily plying his trade, cowpunching.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (continuing) It was a dangerous in profession.

Name: Buford's grandfather
Dialog: Darn tootin'

Name: Buford
Dialog: And then one day, he saw it.

Name: Buford's grandfather
Dialog: What the Sam Hill?!? Huh?!?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It was the elusive Chapricobra.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The what?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Based on his extensive history of malapropisms, I would say that he is talking about the Chupacabra, the Latin American goat sucker, that is said to haunt the deserts of Mexico and South-Western America.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's just a myth. Like the Lake Nose Monster, and Klimpaloon, the magical old timey bathing suit that lives in the Himalayas.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Umm, have you not proven those things to be true?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So we have. (to Ferb) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. We're gonna search for an elusive creature that tends to slip away unse -- hey! Where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I-Is this thing on? I want to thank you all for taking some time outta your busy schedules to attend our compulsory O.W.C.A. Animal Sensitive Seminar. However, if you currently are an animal, you may be excused to your missions.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What -- what -- what? They get to go? What is this, Pick On the Higher Species Day?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? Humans are a higher species, everybody knows that!

Name: Carl
Dialog: And...that's why you're here today, sir.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gentlemen and gentlemen, we present to you the Chupa-Copter!

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Wow! Right on! Etcetera.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, everyone! Take your seats and buckle up! We're off to New Mexico to find the elusive Chupacabra!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But what are we going to use as bait?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, I got that handled. (He picks up an Isabella suit.) Check it out! It's reversible! (He turns the suit inside out) Tada! A goat costume!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, then! Let's start trackin' us a chupacabra!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Searching chupacabra traits

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, let's light this candle!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look! Everything in my wardrobe is jinxed!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Jinxed?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-huh. I was wearing this one when the boys made a giant gelatin monster. I was wearing this one when the boys split me into like 50 mes. And this one is from the whole Meap thing. And this one... Well, I just spilled grape juice on it. (Indistinct) But still...

Name: Computer
Dialog: Begin analysis. Rooting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gets out a perfume bottle) Ooh. Je Bust Number 12. (she sprays some on herself)

Name: Computer
Dialog: Sniffing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I guess I could wear this tonight.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Long neck. (The picture zooms out.) Non-desert dwelling. Not chupacabra.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. Somebody's judging me. (she looks outside the window. The chopper flies away) PHINEAS AND FERB! YOU ARE SOOOOOOO BUSTED!!!...For something!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, hello, Perry the Platypus. You like the new Bi-plane? Pretty sweet huh? Uh, I got it off the internet. (Perry gets trapped under a hair drying machine) Don't worry about your hat; the heat is really good for the felt. Look what I invented... (pours a tonic on a mannequin which regrows its hair he chopped off) It grows your hair back. Got it in all the stores, but it's not selling it like I thought of it. That is why it got a catchy name

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It should be flying off the shelves. I-I just don't get it. Anyway that is about to change. Behold, the Switch-Place-inator. Wha- Why do you look so unimpressed? I'll explain. I simply fly over town in my biplane, Ride off! And I look for someone with a receding airline, standing next to someone with a full head of hair. I fire, and presto! The hair switches places. The person who was formally hairline challenged, is thrilled, and the other guy is- well he's gonna spend a lot of money to get his hair back. Thus, Get Back Hair.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here, I'll show you how it works. Okay, Perry the Platypus, how would you like to trade places with a hungry, man eating shark? (Doofenshmirtz zaps the two with the -inator, causing the shark to flail on the floor, whil Perry swims happily in the shark's former tank) Oh yeah, you're semi-aquatic. Well, I've got some other tricks up my sleeve. Like switching places with a- (The shark, flails around, and manages to bite Doofenshmirtz's upper body) Aw, ah man, I did not see that coming. (Doofenshmirtz throws the shark off him) Okay Señor pantalones inteligente, that's, Mr. Smarty Pants... Spanish. (He fires his -inator switching the places of a lightbulb, and the tank. The tank flips and falls, trapping Perry under it) "Tanks" for playing Perry the Platypus. See ya' around.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay guys, welcome to New Mexico. Ferb, let's lower the chupacabra bait. (They lower Buford in his goat costume)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (bleats) Hey! Hey! Watches the cactuses. Ow! Ah! Who's driving up there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (He laughs nervously) Sorry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Flying in his biplane) Now to go make my millions with my trusty Switch-Place-inator! Where is it? (He sees Perry has it, and Perry shoots himself and a bird, switching their places, and making Perry fall into Doofenshmirtz's plane) Perry the Platypus, you didn't by any chance hand it over, it belongs to me. Give it, give it. (They begin fighting and doing other things on top of the wing, such as fishing) This is what I call "fly fishing" (or teaching Perry to ride a bike) Haha! Yes! Yes! Attaboy! (Throwing Perry a party) Make a wish. (Perry blows out the candles) What'd you wish for (Perry resumes beating up Doofenshmirtz) Really, that's what you wished for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to wait right here until the bustees return. Oh, and they will return.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sooo...since you're in busting mode, I take it, my services are not required? (Candace does not answer) Yep, I'm superfluous. (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (bleating)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm not usually a crier, But isn't that-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, guys! I think we got somethin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gotcha, Buford. Let's see if we're getting any --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sweet!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (bleats)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Almost there. (the Chupacabra falls into a hole) Bingo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right! Let's go check it out. (on the ground) So that's what a Chupacabra looks like.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. Surprising, is it not?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, I think he's kinda cute.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now we just have to get him back home.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. The Chupacabra doesn't sound too happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! A real live Chupacabra, eh? Wait til Mom sees this!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll bet he's hungry. I totally sound like that when my blood sugar's low.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Does your mom have any goat-based food products?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. Can't hurt to check the fridge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now's my chance! (runs up to the crate) Woo! Evidence at last! Wait a minute. Let's just make sure it's really in here. (opens the crate) Here Chupa... (The Chupacabra scratches her in the face) This is the best day EVER! (she stops for a moment) Wait a minute. I'd better move this to the front lawn where Mom can see it right when she gets home. (she pushes the crate to the driveway and dials the phone) Hello? Mom?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Driving, while talking to Candace with an earpiece) Hi, Candace. What is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, listen. The boys have caught a Chupacabra. You have to get home quick and bust them.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Take it easy honey, I'm just a few blocks away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Awesome, thanks! (hangs up) Whew, now all I do is wait. While I sit on top of the crate for safe-keeping.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold that thought. Mom will be back soon.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha, how convenient that your mother has a whole terrine of goat biryani.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know, right? Those gourmet cooking classes are sure comin' in handy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hehehehe,..hehehehehe...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Carrying the goat biryani) Hey! Wait for me guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! (his perspective, there is a hole where the Chupacabra's crate was) The Chupacabra's gone! (to Ferb) This must be how Candace feels when this happens.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know I've had it with you, Perry the Platypus. You never, never let me have a -- (Perry pulls Doofenshmirtz's parachute, sending him flying off the plane) AAAAAAHHHHH CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've just heard that our New Mexico operative, Agent CH, has had his cover compromised. We have the coordinates of his location, and you are the closest agent. Get to it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Keep writing sir.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ee-ee-ee-ee...ee-ee-ee-ee...Mom, you won't believe this.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now, Candace, why would you ever give me reason not to believe you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if I told you, that Phineas and Ferb captured an actual Chupacabra?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that would test my suspension of disbelief.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, disbelieve no more, 'cause I've got it right here! And it's not going anywhere.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) ...Rrright.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, ye of excessive sarcasm, (She opens the crate) I present to you...the elusive, Chupacabra!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) I don't believe it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! How did I get into that crate?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'm at least glad to see you kids are going to finish up my leftover biryani.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes, ma'am.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but, but, but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. He usually shows up by now. Oh, there you are Perry. You'll never believe this, but for a while there, we had a real, live Chupacabra. (they take out their smartphones) Here, we took pictures.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Next...next...next...next...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, I guess perhaps the universe wants somethings left un-photographed. Like Chupacabras, or...group photos where everyone has their eyes open.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (from inside) Futons, bouillon, platypus food... (Cut to her, looking in a pantry.) Ooh! Microwave popcorn! Need this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I have sodas. What else do we wanna bring over your house?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Doesn't matter. I doubt we'll not be able to eat while we're watching this movie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Grievance. So scary no one over the age 45 will even watch it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It will be even scarier 'cause my family's out for the day and we will be alone at the house.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, are you sure you can handle this? (They go out to the backyard.) It took me four days to pry you out from under the bed last time we saw a scary movie. (outside) What? What are you looking at? Oh no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! What are you guys up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a surprise for Isabella's birthday!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A surprise...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Here we go again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...for Isabella's...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Give me those sodas. (She grabs the sodas Candace was holding)

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...Birthday.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: See ya. (She walks off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building supplies? Check. Guest list? Check. Perry? Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Still leaving) Yeah, where does that platypus go everyday?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P.? (The lights flicker on) Ah, there you are. What do you think of the new motion sensor lights we've installed in your lair. (The lights go off again) Um... Agent P. try flailing your arms about that should- (Agent P. does so and the lights turn on) There we go! Now, Doofenshmirtz has been driving around town in some sort of truck that turns inanimate objects, like parking meters, into bugs. Eww. I want you to-- (The lights go off in where Major Monogram is) Really? Carl, I'm waiving my arms, why aren't the lights coming back on?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not funny, Carl.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, time to commence operation INAP.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (To Candace) That stands for Isabella's Natal Anniversary Party.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know what INAP means. Just get to the dangerous part I'm readying the phone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, we need to carry all this stuff over to Isabella's backyard, so we can set it up for--

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Phineas. What'cha doooin'? You're not planning something for my birthday, are you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't look, don't look, don't look! Nothing to see here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas! But all I really want for my birthday is-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't ruin the surprise! (He laughs nervously) Buford, get her out of here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You got it. (He throws a bag over Isabella and carries her out)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But what I real-

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've carried a lot of squirmin' bags in my time, but this is the first time I knew who was in it. (He walks off)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Augh! What I was going to say was all I want for my birthday is some alone time with-- (motions to Phineas) Never mind. (She walks out)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You wanted to be alone with this bag?

Name: Phineas and kids
Dialog: Happy birthday, Isabella!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the platypus? It's no use trying to break through my protective bubble. It's platyproof-poof. I mean, oh you know what I mean. Anyway, you're probably wondering what I'm doing, driving this evil bug bus around town. I just got to thinking about all the things that bug me. Portable outhouses, high voltage signs. "Danger High Voltage". I'll decide how much voltage I can take! That's why I created the Bugs-me-inator. It turns whatever bugs me into bugs. And, since I can't stand bugs, I'm protected from them inside this bubble. (Perry points to a bug inside Doofenshmirtz's bubble) Huh? Oh, that's on the outs-- Ow! Get it off! Get it off! Get it off! Get it off! (Doofenshmirtz open the bubble to let the bugs out) Wait I'm not ready! (Perry punches him, causing him to spin around his bubble) Whoa, whoa whoa. Right to the point huh? You know Perry the Platypus, more than anything, you bug me. (He fires the -inator at Perry, who dodges it, making the beam, instead, hit one of Doofenshmirtz's shoes) Ah! My shoe! Ow Get off! Get off! Get off! Ow! (Doofenshmirtz launches himself at Perry, but Perry redirects him back into his bubble, spinning him again.) Whoa. Whoa. Whoa. Boy I really got to rethink the design on this think. By the way, you know we're on a runaway bus careening at high speed with no one at the wheel, right?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (To the movie) Don't go in there. Don't go in there. Don't go in there. Don't go in there. You went in there. Oh, gross she brought thousands of tiny bugs into the house. What could be worse than that? (Doofenshmirtz's bus crashes into Stacy's house) Big bug! Ahhh! (Stacy hides behind the couch) OMG! Perry! What are you doing here?! And why are you wearing a hat? Look out! (Doofenshmirtz flies onto the couch) And who's this pharmacist?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? Really? W-why does everyone just stampede to that conclusion? Other people wear lab coats you know. Why, why don't you say, "Oh look a rocket scientist." Or a veterinarian?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Are you a veterinarian?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No... But that's not the point.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out. (Isabella's massive cake is seen being wheeled in.) We made your favorite, a red velvet cake, with a little surprise.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, I hope they do not have a male dancer popping out of it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: They asked, but they couldn't afford me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Will you do the honors Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (To Isabella) Make a wish.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (In her thoughts) I wish for time alone with Phineas.

Name: Holly
Dialog: (To Candace) What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Waiting for things to get dangerous, so I can my mom to come bust the boys.

Name: Holly
Dialog: That's not dangerous?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dude, this is nothing, it'll get worse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, did you get what you wished for?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, it's every girls wish to have her backyard covered in litter. Let's go you two. Next event.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're gonna love this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Is this where you go everyday Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While fighting Perry) Oh yeah, pretty much. I create -inators, and he breaks in and thwarts my scheme, and it's, it's kinda our thing. (Perry knocks Doofenshmirtz to the ground) Ooh! The Grievance! I saw this in theaters. I still have nightmares about the greasy little girl who comes out of the base--

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Still behind the couch) No! Don't tell me how it ends!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And, now, what's a birthday party without a piñata the size of your house? Ferb? Hit it. (Ferb breaks the giant piñata with a giant bat, releasing smaller ones for everyone else to hit.)

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: I'm gonna bat with this stick.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Give up the candy, yo!

Name: Holly
Dialog: (Still speaking with Candace) This isn't dangerous enough?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're getting there.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Isabella, this must be your best birthday ever.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (A little sadly) Yeah, sure. It's super cool. I didn't need--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay Birthday girl, onto the next. (He trows a bag over her, and deposits her at her pool)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gather 'round everyone, and keep your eyes on the pool. Isabella, it's grand finale time! (He pulls a lever, and the pool begins to shake.)

Name: Holly
Dialog: Um? This might be the time to call.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep! (She dials Linda) Mom? You've got to come across the street immediately.

Name: Kids
Dialog: Ooh!

Name: Milly
Dialog: What a grand, and glorious, and potentially bustable gift!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: I've never seen anything like it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That key? That key?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Here, grab these will ya?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you've got to see what the boys are doing in Isabella's yard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isabella's yard? That's a new one.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Alright, look. You're getting oil all over the place. Someone's going to have to-- (Stacy trips, and falls in the pool of oil.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! It's the greasy Grievance girl from the basement! No! No! What have I done? Why do you have a grievance against me? (Doofenshmirtz screams, and jumps out the window)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Fixing her hair) Whoa. What was that all about? Do the Flynn Fletchers know you fight evil scientists? (Stacy accidentally steps on the remote firing the -inator, and Perry whacks it with a bat, destroying it. The -inator beam bounces off a satellite and heads back towards Earth)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back here, Mom.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Butterflies? I love butterflies! Oh, thank you Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Confused at how the gift turned to butterflies) What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but... Butterflies?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, how beautiful. How long did it take you guys to collect them all?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let's go boys, looks like we've got some cleaning up to do. Alright you and you begin with the pavement area around here. And you... (Monogram rings the doorbell) Danville Water and Power. We're here to read your gas thingy.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Perry? What is all this? (Perry hands Stacy a pamphlet) A-a host family, mind erasing, balloon coverup? I mean is all this really necessary? (Perry shrugs) Wait a minute! It says right here in your silly little pamphlet that if your host family finds out about your agent status, then anyone who's seen you has to have their memory erased, or you'll get relocated. Perry, I'm not part of your host family!  I know, I know, it's a technicality. Look, I don't want Candace and the boys to lose you, but I also do not want my mind erased. I'm on the last ten minutes of that Grievance movie, and I don't want to have to watch that whole scary mess again. So, uh, can we just keep this a secret? (Perry smiles and tips his hat to Stacy)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Luckily Sir, it looks like the residents were not home.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (At the front door) Hello? Uh, anybody there?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (To Carl) I'll take care of it. (To Stacy) Oh, hello there young teenager. You live here?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yes. I walked home from the mall to find... this. What is happening here?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, you didn't see what happened? Well, um. We're with the city, and there was a swamp gas incident here. We'll just get it all cleaned up, and get out of your hair. (He turns to Carl) Psst. Hey Carl. We're not going to need the mind erasing device. (He looks back at Stacy) I mean monkey wrench. Hehe. Monkey wrench, we don't need that.

Name: Katie
Dialog: Happy birthday, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thanks guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I still can't figure out what went wrong with the grand finale. After the laser light show, and the fireballs, the swans should have been released, and-

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, I really liked the butterflies. Thank you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well to make it up to you, it's kinda lame but... maybe Ferb and I could, I don't know, take you out for some ice cream or something?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I...just remembered there's...something I need to do. You two go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is that cool?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes! Very cool. Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, did you get what you wished for? Oh, yeah, I already asked that. Confetti, and streamers. Hold on, gonna get another napkin. (He goes off)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (romantically) And butterflies, you always give me butterflies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (From her window) Ah, look at them out there. What are they up to? Ah, it looks like Phineas is saying "Where's Perry?" Huh. Where do you think Perry goes everyday Stace?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Quickly and nervously) How should I know!? Why are you asking me!? How should I know!? Don't look at me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She stares at Stacy for a moment) Nah, I don't know why I was asking you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (In her head) Whew, no one suspects a thing.

Name: Man
Dialog: (dejectedly through a walkie-talkie to Linda) Yeah, roger, Madam Chairwoman. We do have confirmation that the fireworks area has been flooded.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (through the walkie-takie) I understand. You can't do anything if your wicks are wet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! How's the setup coming for the big block party?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm totally overwhelmed and now I have no fireworks for the big finale.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anything we can do to help?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh that's sweet boys.

Name: Man
Dialog: (Through the walkie-talkie) Madam Chairwoman, we have a code blue at the beignet bus.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, OK. I got it. (to the boys) I'm at my wit's end and I've got no finale.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What about a laser light show?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's a great idea! (she hands a stack of papers to Ferb) Here's a budget and a list of companies that do light shows. Uh, can you just handle it for me? I've gotta run. (she runs off) Thanks so much!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Ferb) You know, I think it might be easier to do the light show ourselves. Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today-I mean tonight.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (he rolls his tongue) Hello, hello hello! Can you guess what my DJ costume is for tonight's big Mardi Gras block party?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh... scary post-apocolyptic handpuppet?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Why does everyone guess that? No, I'm a Mardi Gras jester. Speaking of which, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello there Agent P. Your assignment concerns tonight's big block party. We've intercepted intel that Doof is planning on attendin' tonight's festivities "just for the fun of it". We need you to attend the block party and confirm that he's not up to no good. (pause) I realize that's a double negative but I think it still works. Not up to no good... yeah, i-it works. Unfortunately since your surveillance will take place in close proximity to your hosts, you will need to be in disguise for the duration of your mission. Carl, activate the hydraulic costume chamber.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh Agent P, you look adorable as a balloon animal. Now, get out there and laissez le bon temps rouler. ("Let the good times roll.")

Name: Candace
Dialog: This dumb block party totally is throwing off my entire day. Jeremy's stuck working the Slushy Dawg concession, my parents are busy with preparation, and the boys are so preoccupied with the party they haven't done anything remotely bustable all day.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (looks out the window and sees the boys in the backyard) Umm, I'm probably gonna regret this, but wouldn't a giant robot insect count?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woohoo! I'm back in the game.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (flatly) What horrors did I just unleash?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, what is the giant insect robot thingy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's not a giant insect robot thingy, it's—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's part of the light show extravaganza for the block party's big finale.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huge. Impossible. Bustable. MOM! (she runs off to find Linda)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ok Norm, you ready to head out to the block party?

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm not going.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't tell me you're still bummed out about not having a date.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quit your whining. Just go stag like me.

Name: Norm
Dialog: You mean dress up like a wild forest creature with antlers?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah... not quite. I tried that and it did not go well.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: H-hello? I think I may have come to the wrong address.

Name: Doofenshimrtz
Dialog: Come on Norm. You might meet a nice popcorn machine or a blender or something.

Name: Norm
Dialog: You had me at popcorn machine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom Mom Mom Mom!!! Do you know what Phineas and Ferb are doing?!!!

Name: Candace and Linda
Dialog: They're working on the big finale for the block party tonight!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what'd you say?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I asked the boys to help out with the finale for the party.

Name: Candace
Dialog: On purpose?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, Candace, on purpose. I really need the help.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now leave them alone so they can get the job done.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Situation

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh, tah-wist!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Presenting the Pyrotechnic Holographic Light and Audio Simulator and Electro-magnetic Radioscope!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Or P.H.L.A.S.E.R for short.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why not just use fireworks? Isn't that traditional for a finale?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It may be tradition, but the P.H.L.A.S.E.R is way cooler without the danger of loosing a didget.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quit it, Ferb! You're creeping me out man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: As soon as we polish off the lenses, we're good to go. Come on guys, let's grab some towels.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Situation

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (sighs) Then why are we sitting here? (she grabs Candace's hand) Come on Chuckles, let's have some fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No can bust. No have fun.

Name: Occupant 1
Dialog: Occupied!

Name: Occupant 2
Dialog: Occupied!

Name: Occupant 3
Dialog: ¡Ocupado!

Name: Occupant 4
Dialog: Oui, oui!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Norm) Okay, you see that cute popcorn machine over there? You just gotta walk up to her and say something smooth. Do you remember your opening line?

Name: Norm
Dialog: You've got a pretty hot oil pan.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah, you got game now. (a man with a cotton candy machine stops next to the popcorn machine) Now, see someone else is making a move. You snooze, you lose, Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I guess I'll just have to get used to being alo-(Norm spots a beautiful girl robot, and angelic music plays) oOONE.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm are you ok?

Name: Norm
Dialog: My inner circuitry seems to be overloading.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aww man. I left the electrical tape in my other labcoat. (He notices what Norm is looking at) Oh now I get it. Y-y-you've got a thing for that girl robot. Ah, she's not bad. I think you got a chance with her if you play your cards right.

Name: Norm
Dialog: What do I say? I do not believe she has an oil pan to complement.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just introduce yourself and, you know, ask her what her sign is. And then run the other way if she says Sagittarius.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Thank you, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Go get her, Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hi, I'm Norm. What is your sign?

Name: Female Robot
Dialog: Hi, I am Chloe. I am a Pisces.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well?

Name: Norm
Dialog: You did not tell me what to do if she is a Pisces.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: In my experience you get married, and then subsequently divorced but we don't have time for that. We gotta get you rolling.

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Excuse me can I- (Perry shushes him and gives him a balloon fedora) Thanks!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So are we clear Norm?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Talk about her interests, and try to find something in common.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right, but don't be too obvious. Women like it when you challenge them, and act all superior.

Name: Norm
Dialog: That does not seem logical.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
