Dialog: We are talking about women here, right? Okay, now remember, don't forget to stay cool.

Name: Norm
Dialog: No problem, my compressor is from a refrigeration unit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What are you telling me for? I'm the guy who installed it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. just checking in to see if you noticed any evil activity from Doofenshmirtz, (Perry looks up to Major Monogram is standing right there, with Carl holding up a backboard) there's a-- Monogram out. (He walks away)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, why didn't you tell me he was sitting right there?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Hello Chloe.

Name: Chloe
Dialog: Hello Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: So, what's your prime directive?

Name: Chloe
Dialog: My core competency is dancing.

Name: Norm
Dialog: What a coincidence! My core competency is being superior, and challenging those whose core competency is dancing.

Name: Chloe
Dialog: We shall see about that. I accept your challenge. See you an the dance floor.

Name: Norm
Dialog: See you there. Right after I defrost, because I am so cool. (He walls over to Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well?

Name: Norm
Dialog: She wants to dance with me, but now I am nervous.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, go on now. You just got to get out of your own head.

Name: Norm
Dialog: How do I get out of my own head?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just get out there on the dance floor, and strut your stuff Normy-G.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Commencing stuff strutting.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Alright, I want to see everyone out there on the dance floor. Parents, kids, giant robots, sure why not? Let's kick this party into second gear!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (In the backyard) Oh, wow that's our cue, time to fire up the P.H.L.A.S.E.R. guys. Are the lenses all clean?

Name: Buford
Dialog: The lenses are good, but all the blood's rushed to my head.

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey! my tattoos are gone! Now I can finally be an accountant!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (After seeing a bunch of cats chasing a laser) Okay, that's like a lot of cats.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like the finale is ahead of schedule, glasses everyone!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Already on it.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Everyone looks smaller than the usually do from up here. And that is already pretty small, because I am so tall.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh, I've got to go and thank the boys.

Name: Chloe
Dialog: Oh, Norm, your performance exceeded my previous computations.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I had to get out of my own head.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, what a phenomenal finale to our finale. Congratulations and cued us to our two winners. And there wasn't even a contest.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you were smooth-tastic. Are you going to introduce me to your new girl?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Why yes, of course. This is--

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Chloe, what are you doing?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Rodney. Wait, wait, this is your robot?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Come Chloe. Let's get you away from this, rusted Romeo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah? Well I, I'm too flustered to come up with an insult, so I'll call you later, and give it to you then. Come on Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Goodbye Chloe. "Parting is such sweet sorrow."

Name: Chloe
Dialog: That is a reference from Romeo and Juliet, so I shall say "goodnight 'til it be morrow."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See you don't need her Norm, she's a know it all. Ugh, ooh, look, corndogs!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (She walks into the backyard) Boys are you here? I just wanted to say-- Phineas! Ferb! You are so busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What!? Get out of the way! Wait! Wait! Wait! Did I hear you just bust Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I certainly did. (Candace giggles under) What are all my good guest towels doing out here? And they're filthy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Stops giggling) Towels?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, sorry mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Towels!?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll clean them up.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, you get right on that. when you're done we'll have beignets.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So let me get this straight, after everything they've done this summer, you decide to yell at them for a few dirty towels?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isn't that enough? (Walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Way to make a mockery of my lifetime goal Mom. Towels.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, we've got a lot of leftover parts from the last time we used leftover parts. There must be something we can do with them, you know, besides hodgepodges or art pieces.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa, dudes, what's with all the junk in your backyard? It's like an obstacle course back here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What'd I say?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You said obstacle course, of course!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, I meant to say chili cook off.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Are you meaning to tell me we have never made an obstacle course this entire summer?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I'm filled with remorse

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That we haven't, of course,

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Even thought of building an obstacle course.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then let's build one and make it our new tour de force!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That is a plan I can clearly endorse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Of course!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Of course! I'm puttin' an end to this before it breaks into song! Where's Perry??

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. There are pretty suspicious goings-on...going on at the Doofenshmirtz building. We have reports that the building has been rotating all morning, so either he's got something evil up his sleeve, or he's turning it into an expensive romantic restaurant with an impressive view...in which case, I would like a reservation for 6

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, Gluttony Games is totally bloated with mindless mayhem! And the two girls, they were so brave and fearless!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We would make an awesome team, you and me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (high fives Stacy) You and me, baby! Of course, we'd have to learn to shoot a bow and arrow, and build a rope bridge...

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...and catch two leaves between two pieces of wax paper and choose matching backpacks and sharpen a hatchet, (opening the gate) and we'll live on nothing but—

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: Holy cannoli!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What in the world is going on here?! PHINEAS AND FERB!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, babies and slightly smaller babies, welcome to the Phineas and Ferb Ultimate Obstacle Course! The first team that makes it all the way to the end (you know, alive and stuff) will win this nifty trophy! So are you ready to get muddy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That tears it! Those two are so—

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hang on, Candace! We can win this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, we ca— Wait, what?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I want that trophy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why?

Name: Dr. Hirano
Dialog: Very good, Ginger. We'll put it up here with the rest of your awards. I'm...still saving a place for your trophy, Stacy. You know, just in case.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: ...hhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh... Candace, we'd make an awesome team!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, I'll do it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: For the trophy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And for whatever it was you were thinking about just now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, I wonder who that could be. (opens the door and gasps) Perry the Platypus? Well, come on in. Wipe your feet if you don't mind. I just mopped the floor. (Perry steps onto the welcome mat, which traps him.) Ha ha! Gotcha! That's what you get for having manners! Hee hee hee! Now, I bet you're wondering why my building has been turning 90 degrees every now and then. Well, that's because I was just testing out my 90-Degree-Turn-inator!! Eh, you like it? Y'know, it turns things. But only 90 degrees at a time. You see, back in Drusselste—y'know what? Just watch this documentary.

Name: Newsreader
Dialog: This Week in History! Dateline

Name: Newsreader
Dialog: You think I vill speak French?! I vill not speak French!

Name: Newsreader
Dialog: Nein!

Name: Newsreader
Dialog: 'Cause you're tired!!

Name: Newsreader
Dialog: And so, the Mayor of Stumblegimp was appeased. And, once again, all was right between the two cities...or was it? The End!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And the Stumblegimp Humiliating Dance of Contrition is just as much a tradition now as it was in the '40s...when this newsreel was made about the 1600s. You see, Perry the Platypus, my brother, the Mayor's gonna meet the present day Mayor of Stumblegimp. And I plan to zap Roger with my 90-Degree-Turn-inator. It will turn him 90 degrees, which will insult Mayor...uh...Whatshisname. Something with waffles. He'll have to sing that whole song, and when the people of Danville see him eat a featherbed or put a donut in his pants, he'll be forced to step down as mayor and I will step into his place, 100% donut-pant-free! Unless, you know, something like last week happens again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And finally, our third team, Candace and Stacy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We are so ready!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What was that about?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Oh, that's our secret code for "I love you, sis"...I think.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good luck, contestants! And watch out for giant worms! On your marks...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Get set...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did he say, "Giant worms"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Go!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aaaah! Giant worm!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it looks like Buford and Baljeet are out of the race. Sorry, guys. You know what they say

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Both remaining teams have made it to the beach! Nice job, ladies, but you may wanna get to cover.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cover?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (activating a water balloon launcher) Fire!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Incoming!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Water balloons!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just look at them go!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Get off the beach! Get off the beach!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, yes! The horse-drawn coach has arrived and Mayor...Wafflesomething is walking up to Roger.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Heheh, Mayor Chickenen, it is so good to finally meet you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Chicken and waffles! That's why I had "waffles" stuck in my head. That was it. (walks up to the inator) And...now! (fires the inator)

Name: Roger
Dialog: (holding out his hand) It is indeed a rare pleasure to— (He gets zapped and rotates 90 degrees east.)

Name: Mayor Chickenen
Dialog: Huh? What is the meaning of this? I will have to declare war now!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Maybe not. Pstt!

Name: Melanie
Dialog: What happened?

Name: Roger
Dialog: Get the Dance of Contrition team out here pronto!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, baby! It worked! And now for the humiliatioooonnnn!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, th-th-th-that's not the Stumblegimp Humiliating Dance of Contrition! (he lowers his hands to reveal there's nothing in them and sighs) One day, I gotta ask Norm what he did with my binoculars.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It looks like Isabella and Ginger are way out front!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Stace! They're getting away!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Watch your step, ladies! That's mud down there! Baljeet's suggestion!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Really?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I knew we would not make it that far.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, not with an attitude like that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We'll see who gets mud in his face, Smart Guy! (She starts to step on a platform, but it moves and she falls downs screaming and lands with a splat.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good thing mud's good for the skin!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Blehhhhh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (next to a giant fan) Let's dry 'em off, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hold on to something, Ginger! We're almost there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, he's right, my skin feels so soft. Come on, Stace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Nice hang time!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I regret nothing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That puts us in the lead! Woohoo! (A pie flies into her face.) Pie? Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And Isabella and Ginger take the lead!

Name: Mayor Chickenen
Dialog: Wonderful! The new improved Dance of Contrition always makes me want to shake a leg!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Fantastic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa whoa whoa! That was not nearly humiliating enough! Where was the part about bowing and pulling your shirt up over your face and juggling piglets? Where were the piglets?!

Name: Mayor Chickenen
Dialog: Oh, we haven't done that since the '40s when we made that newsreel about the 1600s. Things have changed. (He hums and dances.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So what's your point?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're nearing the finish line, and here comes Team Ginger and Isabella, with Candace and Stacy in hot pursuit! And now, ladies, who's up for some popcorn?

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're the last ones standing!

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace and Stacy win! (A giant gorilla hand appears out of nowhere and slaps them off the log.) Sorry. Forgot about the giant gorilla hand. My bad. Remember, everyone's a winner, but only one team gets a trophy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, we won!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Congratulations, Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ha! Now I'm like you! I have a trophy!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: But, Stacy, I won all those trophies just trying to impress you.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Yeah! You're the coolest big sister a girl could ever have! How can I compete?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, I am pretty cool.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll take that! Giant worms can do whatever they want! (They disappear.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stands up) That does it, it's busting time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a stern voice) Mother? May I please speak with you?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Oh, boy...

Name: Mayor Chickenen
Dialog: Oh, how rude! (Takes off his shoe and sock and slaps the sock onto Doofenshmirtz.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, give it a rest! (grunts) I must've left it in random fire mode.

Name: Pilot
Dialog: Uh, welcome to Flight J2261 to New York. (The ray bounces off the plane, which rotates 90 degrees.) Uh, hey, who wants to go to Alabama?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (closes eyes) Take a look outside the window!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, what's gotten into you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (turns around and sees the image of Phineas and Ferb under the tree outside) Hi, boys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (her eyes open) What...? (looks out the window) But-but -- !

Name: Linda
Dialog: Really, Candace? This is getting old. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You think I vill speak French?! I vill not speak French!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nein!

Name: Candace
Dialog: 'Cause you're tired!!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Aunt May, Phineas and Ferb are making a crossover!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah we are!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That was awesome!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! The cosmic rays we collected through our satellite dish made a great power source for our surfboards.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, I, for one, need to get back to the space station.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, these suits are equipped with—

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not want to do it in the suit!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hi, guys! How are the asteroid waves?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They were totally crankin', dude!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (laughing) He called me "dude"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're about to take the module down. Are we clear for landing?

Name: Irving
Dialog: One moment. (He gets up)

Name: Irving
Dialog: All clear! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Struggle all you want, Perry the Platypus, you're not getting out of that! It's hydraulic! I don't know if you're aware of this, but my brother, Roger, is the mayor. (Perry just gives him a look indicating that he was, in fact, aware of it.) Alright, I may have touched upon the subject from time to time, but, y'know, I figured why not mention it again just for clarity? Anyway, that job gives him all these cool mayoral powers. So I created the Power-Drain-inator to drain all his powers into this canister, and then I, Heinz Doofenshmirtz, get to wield them! Just think, I will have the power to raise taxes, pass legislation and even cut the ceremonial ribbon at openings! Where I'll finally be able to use (He produces a pair of giant scissors from behind his back) these! You like them? I-I got 'em at a garage sale. (He leans the scissors onto a hydraulic pump, which leaks and releasing Perry from his trap.) Ah, see? Th-th-that's one of those hydraulic lines that, uh, goes to your— (Perry flings himself at Doofenshmirtz, who falls backwards, and then takes the inator, smashing it to pieces.) Aw, come on!!! One kick and you destroy my inator? Right? W-W-And what? You're just gonna thwart and run? I thought this was going to be a special extended episode! Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (A piece of the broken inator zaps up to the sky.) Aaah! Uh-oh.

Name: Hot Dog Vendor
Dialog: Hey, Vinnie, the usual?

Name: Vinnie
Dialog: Yeah, same old, same old.

Name: New Yorker
Dialog: Go get 'em, Spider-Man!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Woo!! (He gets splashed by a fire hydrant) I didn't know this was gonna be a pool party. I woulda brought my trunks!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Oh, hey, kid! Glad you could make it!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: (while webbing Venom) I'm just fashionably late.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Back off, fellas! If that thing firing anti-matter blasts, it's gonna pack a big punch!

Name: Hulk
Dialog: I pack a bigger punch!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: MODOK, take zem all out!

Name: MODOK
Dialog: Fool! Your webs cannot stop my mind! (He laughs)

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Missed me!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: That's it for you creeps!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Ooh ooh! Can I web 'em up?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Let's go! (The villains all flee but Red Skull bumps into MODOK.) Move, you big tin schnitzel!!!

Name: Thor
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I dunno. But they're getting away! (He attempts to climb a wall, but falls.) Whoa! Well, that's new.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Something's wrong. I can't move!

Name: Thor
Dialog: Sit tight! Mighty Mjolnir will bring them down! (He attempts to throw the hammer, but it crashes into the ground.) My strength, it's gone!

Name: Hulk
Dialog: I'll go. (Hulk tries to smash, but nothing happens.)

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Somehow our powers have been drained. I need to get to JARVIS and figure this out. Let's get back to S.H.I.E.L.D. (The heroes all walk away, except for Iron Man who attempts to move, but remains immobile.) Hey, guys! My power's down and my suit's frozen! Could somebody get me a hand?

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Hulk, can you carry him?

Name: Hulk
Dialog: My power's gone, too.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Oh, for— Well, can somebody find a furniture dolly?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was the best thing we've done this morning!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Hurry! Here! Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why aren't you in space?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, we got hungry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, that's my cue! I'll make you guys some snacks before I leave!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Well, this stinks! Without my spider-powers, I'm just a guy in a body stocking!

Name: Thor
Dialog: And I had to leave Mjolnir in the street!

Name: Thor
Dialog: It just became too heavy.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: At least you guys aren't locked inside this metal suit. Man, do I regret having that second cup of coffee this morning. Now we have to find out where that beam came from.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Danville. Danville, USA.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Have you been standing there this whole time?

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Yes. Yes I have. (He walks to a screen which shows the inator beam hitting the space station satellite) The beam that hit you originated from the Tri-State Area, bounced off a space station satellite dish, and hit you in New York City during your fight.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Is that one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s?

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: No. It's theirs.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Man, that kid's got a weird-shaped head.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: (jumping) Hey! Hey! Guys, I can't see with the— (falls down) Little help here?

Name: Hulk
Dialog: I got him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Make sure you get all these little pieces over here, too. No no no, y-you're missing the big one.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Okey-dokey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, Norm, the Power-Drain-inator did get one shot off before it died. I wonder if it hit anything.

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: (on television) Dateline

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was me! Th-Th-That was me! I drained the power from those superheroes! Winning! Ooh, ooh, I should update my evil blog on the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. site! (sits down at the computer and types) OMG!! I drained all the powers from a group of superheroes in New York , and those powers belong to me now! Happy Emoticon (Typed out as >

Name: Norm
Dialog: Uh, sir, I hate to be the bearer of empty canisters, but this canister is empty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?! So I don't have the powers?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Time to blog a retraction, I guess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, y'know, I'm not gonna change it. Everyone exaggerates on the Internet.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: There vas a slight miscalculation. It becomes clearer upon seeing zis footage.

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: That is more than a slight miscalculation, Red Skull. It's a major mistake!

Name: Venom
Dialog: We could have destroyed the heroes once and for all!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Enough! It doesn't change ze fact zat ze heroes are now powerless!

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: Well, what could have happened to their powers?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: MODOK?

Name: MODOK
Dialog: I, MODOK, the perfect combination of human intellect and machine, have interfaced with all of the digital information stored on the vast network, the World Wide Web!

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: I can do the same thing with my phone. Plus I got free roaming!

Name: Venom
Dialog: Nice!

Name: MODOK
Dialog: As I was saying, I have found some puny inferior human known as Doofenshmirtz claiming that he has drained the heroes of all their superpowers.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Hmm, Doofenshmirtz. Zat sounds Drusselshteinian. I have a cousin who married a Drusselshteinian. She is dead to me!! So, who is zis Doofenshmirtz?

Name: MODOK
Dialog: I'm projecting his image now.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: He is beautifully grotesque.

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: All hideous and deformed.

Name: Venom
Dialog: He must have some backstory.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Vere can we find zis sideshow freak?

Name: MODOK
Dialog: (showing an image of D.E.I.) He's in the Tri-State Area, Danville to be precise!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Danville, eh? Gentlemen, it looks like we're going on an evil road trip.

Name: MODOK
Dialog: Ooh, shotgun!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: YOU DO NOT FIT IN ZE SHOTGUN POSITION!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was fun, and it's only 10

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hey, kids. I'm gonna be taking a walking tour of the Tri-State Area today. (her phone rings) Yes, Candace, you're in charge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoopee!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Bye, kids.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? Oh, there he is!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Platypus trap engaged.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platyp—You're not Perry the Platypus! Who are you guys?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Zis is Vhiplash, zis is Venom, and I am Red Skull.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes. Yes, you are. Y'know, you really should use sunblock. Y-You're burned down to the bone.

Name: MODOK
Dialog: I am MODOK, and you are the one they call "Doofenshmirtz".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah. That's what they sing at the end of the birthday song...Ah, well, y'know, at least they...would have if...anybody ever sang....that song to me. Anyway...Hey, the floating head and little arms thing. I-I tried that back in the '90s.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll rule the Tri-State Areaaaa! (bumps into a wall)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I could never maneuver out the front door, but I see you're pretty mobile. W-What are you guys doing here?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Shos your davices, Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Shess-so-davices?" I-Is that Latin?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Show us your devices.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I-I-I-I-I'm still not gettin' it. Anyone?

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: I have no idea.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: (grunts) Show...us...your...devices!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you want to see my inators! Man...Man, you've got quite an accent there! Alright, (walks up to an inator) here's what I'm workin' on now. Behold, the Slothinator! It will give me the powers of a sloth...which are super-slowness and super-leaf-eating.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: (to MODOK) Are you sure zis is ze right guy?

Name: MODOK
Dialog: MODOK is infallible!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Then he must be toying with us. Playing us for fools! He is even more diabolical than we thought!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holding up a branch) Seriously, I'll be able to eat this whole branch, but...y'know, like, slowly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, are you expecting someone?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Not them.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: (offscreen) Aren't you a little young to be stealing superheroes' superpowers?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, we would be, Spider-Man, if we actually did it. But like I said, I don't think we did.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: You can't see it, but I have a rather severe look of disappointment on my face.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This'll turn that tin frown upside-down!

Name: Thor
Dialog: Juice in a box? We have nothing like this in Asgard.

Name: Hulk
Dialog: (grunting) Straw cannot penetrate!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Hey, hey, hey! Calm blue ocean. (taking the juice box) Let me take care of that for ya, buddy.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Thanks, Isabella. Well, the power-siphoning ray originated from the Tri-State Area. And I was thinking you guys would know something about it since it bounced off your space station.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you sure it was our space station?

Name: Hulk
Dialog: It was shaped like your head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that sounds like ours, but we don't know anything about a power-siphoning ray.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: I was afraid of that. Well, the first thing we gotta do is get our powers back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna d—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming down the stairs) Alright, boys and girls, listen up, Mom's on a walking tour of Danville and Dad's tinkering in the basement, so I'm in charge. That means no shenanigans! Hey, Spider-Man. So I'll be over at Stacy's all...d-d-d-daaay???!!!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: 'Sup?

Name: Thor
Dialog: Greetings, fair young maiden.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's super...heroes...in...duh...our...kitchen!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace is gonna lie down for a while.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heroes...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thor...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hulk...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Iron Man...

Name: Candace
Dialog: In...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Our...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Kitchen...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just breathe.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're only superheroes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like you guys have a fan.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Oh, boy. (Tips over and an inexplicable cat is heard screeching.)

Name: Thor
Dialog: And it's probably good she didn't see that.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: I'm okay.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Have a seat, Agent P. (cut to reveal Monogram on an old black and white TV set) Due to the gravity of your mission today, the gentleman on the big screen will be addressing you (Wide shot to reveal Fury on the big screen) while I use this old TV monitor Carl found in the basement.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sorry, sir, I couldn't get the split-screen to work.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, this is director Nick Fury of S-H-I-E-L-D.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: That's S.H.I.E.L.D.! It's an acronym.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, like "OWCA".

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Yes, except it's cool. Now, where is your agent, Major?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He's sitting right there.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: You mean behind the platypus?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, that's Secret Agent Perry the Platypus.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Is he some kind of super-platypus with super-platypus powers?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (suddenly wearing an eyepatch) Uh...no.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Does he have some kind of robotic platypus exoskeleton?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He, uh, he has a fedora.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute, were you wearing that eyepatch when we started?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, this? Uh, yeah. It's, uh, doctor's orders. I have a stye.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) He thinks it makes him look cool.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No I don't.

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: I'm going to proceed as if this were going really well. Agent P, Iron Man, Hulk, Thor and Spider-Man have lost their superpowers to a mysterious power-siphoning ray, which we believe originated somewhere in the Danville area. We fear a group of supervillains are closing in. We need you to monitor the situation and report back. (Monogram is now wearing eyepatches on both eyes.) Francis, I'm gonna need you to—Now what are you doing?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) He thinks two eyepatches make him look twice as cool.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't know what you're talking about.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Welcome to my Hall of Inators. Ah, here's a good one. This is my Oatmeal-to-Porridge-inator. I know. It's a fine distinction. Don't get me started. And here's my Multi-Helio-Tactical-Baboon-Glom-inator. I-I-I think that one is self-explanatory. Oh, and, uh, here's my Waffle-inator, and the Junk-Mail-inator...

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: I do not understand. Zees machines are useless. What is wrong wis zis man?

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: Maybe he is a misunderstood genius.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Or maybe he is a perfectly understood idiot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And, finally, my Disintegrator-inator. Pretty impressive, huh?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Vere is ze machine zat took away the powers of the heroes?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, my Power-Drain-inator! Ooh, that was a cool one! And it was...destroyed by my nemesis, Perry the Platypus. You just missed him.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Perry ze Platypus? Is he a super-soldier platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No.

Name: Venom
Dialog: Was he bitten by a radioactive platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, he's, uh, just a regular crime-fighting platypus.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: It is no matter! You will rebuild ze machine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, so we're workin' together now! Great! I'll be the leader! I've always wanted an evil entourage.

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: Let's destroy him.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Nein. Let him think he is in charge. Ven he has exceeded his usefulness, ve vill give him to MODOK to destroy.

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: Hey, where is MODOK?

Name: MODOK
Dialog: D'oh! Curse you, Danville, town of small doors!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Listen, before I rebuild the machine, I've got some errands to run. You guys should come with. (Red Skull hisses) Is your head gonna burst into flames or am I thinking of somebody else?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen...and Hulk, allow me to unveil our Secret Hideout for Emergency Defects. Or S.H.E.D. for short.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: I think we're gonna need something a little...bigger.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, the rustic exterior's a facade. Wait'll you see the inside!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Oh, man! You guys are good!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Just a little British sci-fi technology.

Name: Thor
Dialog: Iron Man, looks like someone raided your armory.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, you like that, huh? This is The Beak Suit Mark 2. We're still working on the waterproofing so we can't take it out in the rain.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: You know, Stark Industries offers summer internships.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, but this summer's pretty packed.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Apparently.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (handing some cards to the gang and the superheroes) And these are your S.H.E.D. key card IDs. They'll get you into all areas of the compound.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Ooh! And they're laminated!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (entering with a comic book) Um, hi. Heh. Would you guys read my fan-fiction? It's a story where Thor and Hulk decide to learn ice skating and—

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I'm sorry, but we're not allowed to accept unsolicited material.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, I didn't know you were a fangirl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sure. From way back. It started 'cause I had to do a lot of research to get up to speed for the Ducky Momo superhero crossover event.

Name: Japanese Announcer
Dialog: Quack quack Ducky Momo-san Sūpāhīrō desu!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, superheroes. We have to get to work building a device that will restore your powers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hehehehehehehe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Until we find out what happened to your actual powers, this machine should be able to replicate them temporarily. Everyone in position and we'll start calibrating!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's get our hero on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just a minute, Candace. We all set?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: All set. Just as soon as I—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! All set!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: ...lock down the power assignments and reverse polarity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, what did you do?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you guys okay?

Name: Thor
Dialog: By Odin's beard, I feel invigorated! (Jumps up high)

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? It worked! Hmm?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, not exactly. Look.

Name: Thor
Dialog: Something is not right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo! Oh, boy, that was great! Hey, I've got an idea, let's go get some ice cream and spoil our dinner! I mean, who's gonna tell us no?

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: That's it! I've had it! We're wasting our time! (takes out his whips and whips a Ducky Momo kiosk) We need to bring the heroes to us!

Name: Kiosk Girl
Dialog: Well...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Something's gone terribly wrong, Candace! You've swapped all their powers. (Cut to Thor wall crawling.) Obviously, Thor's got Spider-Man's powers. (Cut to Spidey lifting up something heavy.) Spider-Man got Hulk's powers.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Yeah, I could get used to this!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I-I have a fear of heights. Could you please put us down?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Iron Man must have Thor's powers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, at least he can move now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everyone has new superpowers except Hulk. He must have Iron Man's powers. But without the suit, there's not much there.

Name: Hulk
Dialog: I am feeling entrepreneurial.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: At least his vocabulary's improved.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: So give me the hammer. What do I do? I just stick out my hand, right? Come on, baby, come to papa!

Name: Thor
Dialog: That is not how it works.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Whadaya mean? I got your powers.

Name: Thor
Dialog: Wielding Mjolnir is about worthiness, not power.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Really?

Name: Thor
Dialog: It's a fine distinction, but an important one.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Potato, potahto.

Name: Thor
Dialog: I do not know what that means.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Okay, nevermind. What about the lightning? How do I control that?

Name: Thor
Dialog: Actually, that only works with the hammer.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: What about flying? I've seen you fly.

Name: Thor
Dialog: Well, yes. But not without the—

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Not without the hammer. Right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is a disaster, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, it was an accident! But I can still help! I know that the villains will—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No!!! You don't know!! The entire Tri-State Area, and, possibly, the world is at stake here! Honestly, Candace, if you don't know what you're doing, keep your hands off the machinery!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, then, maybe I should just leave!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Maybe you should!

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Alert! Alert! Relevant news broadcast intercepted! (The gang and the heroes walk up to the TVs.) This just in

Name: Thor
Dialog: We are needed!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But you can't! Your powers! They're not fixed yet! We just need more time.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: I know, Phineas, but we're heroes. This is what we do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, can we help?

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Not unless you can fly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it's not raining! (Fist bumps Ferb.)

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Bacaw! Woohoo!!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: This should get their attention. (Evil laughter)

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Looks like somebody left the door open!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Alright, gang, it's showtime! Everybody ready?

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I feel pretty good.

Name: Hulk
Dialog: I'd feel better with a metal suit.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Sorry, big guy, no time!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: (pointing up) Look!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Ah, ze superheroes are here to save the day. But without your powers, zis is just a costume party. MODOK, destroy them!

Name: MODOK
Dialog: Yes, I will take great pleasure in destroying these puny heroes!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I got 'im, guys! Spider-Man smash!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Looking to your left you'll see...

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Whoooa!!! Whoooooaaa!!

Name: Hulk
Dialog: Was he makin' fun of me?

Name: Thor
Dialog: A little, yes.

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: They still have their powers!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Yes, but they are all mixed up! (He lifts Doofenshmirtz up by his lab coat) Zis your doing!??!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, I don't remember making a Power-Switch-inator, but, ih, y'know, I make a lot of inators!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Y'know, it'd be really nice right now to have the power to throw a hammer!

Name: Thor
Dialog: I told you it's not about power, it's about worthiness! (sigh) It's like talking to a Bilgesnipe.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Bacaw!

Name: MODOK
Dialog: Hey, what's going on?!

Name: Thor
Dialog: I find myself in a sticky situation. Oh no, I've received Spider-Man's propensity for puns!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now I wish we'd prioritized the waterproofing.

Name: Hulk
Dialog: Now I'm Iron Man! (The real Iron Man crashes into the impostor. Spidey finally comes down to Earth crashing on an eyeglass kiosk.)

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Okay, that time, I overshot the mark. Oh, hey, Venom. What'd I miss? (Venom grabs Spidey, choking him.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Spider-Man, are you okay?

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Could be worse! At least Iron Man and Thor are... (Cut to MODOK harming Thor.) Well, at least Iron Man...

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: (tied up in Whiplash's whips) Sorry, gang. A little tied up at the moment.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Okay, nevermind. It couldn't be worse!

Name: Stan Lee
Dialog: (voiceover) Welcome back, faithful viewers! When last we left our handsome heroes, their fate hung in the balance in a cataclysmic cliffhanger.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Zis vas all too easy. The time for heroes is over. Now all will bow to us. Und nossing vill save you now.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: (coughing) Stop him!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Hey, Duck Guy, thanks for the rescue! (to Iron Man) Do we tip him?

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: He's not parking our car.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I just don't know the etiquette.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Dah! Who vas that masked...beaver...duck?

Name: MODOK
Dialog: MODOK will exterminate all beaver-ducks!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, none of this would have happened if we had just gone out for ice cream like I suggested!

Name: Thor
Dialog: (to Agent P) Thank you, small but mighty friend!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, he seemed vaguely familiar.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Ya think that was Howard the Duck?

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Time is of the essence. We've gotta—No, it wasn't Howard the Duck!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: What? I'm just sayin'.

Name: Hulk
Dialog: He did have a bill.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Anyway, we need to regroup and figure out a plan B.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right! Back to S.H.E.D.-quarters!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, guys!

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, how'd it go?

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: We got our butts handed to us. (to Spidey) How was Venom able to overpower you when you had Hulk's strength?

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I don't know. I'm...I'm not feeling it anymore.

Name: Thor
Dialog: Wait, let me try something. (runs to the wall and jumps up, but falls down.) I did not stick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I was afraid of that. The powers are not bonding with your cel structures.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Yes, my suit is getting heavier again. But at least having Thor's strength unlocked the joints so I could move.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Perhaps we can give you a recharge, but, of course, this time with the correct powers. We have been working on rebuilding the machine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I'm helping!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (taking off the Beak's torso) You are?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm redeeming myself.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, and we are almost done with the first component.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hulk's gamma-ray concentration beam. Brawn first, right, big guy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's great!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: So have you done a base level particle acceleration yet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I was just about to.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: It's really important to make sure you start with a base level.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, sure. Otherwise the gamma-rays would...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, lemme get this for ya. (plugs it in)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Who plugged—

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh...oh...

Name: Hulkjeet
Dialog: Baljeet smash!! (Smashes the machine to pieces and runs out crashing through the wall running by the Garcia-Shapiro house and jumping off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow. There's something you don't see every— (sees Phineas' über-ticked-off expression) What? What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really, Candace?! Do you have any idea what you just did?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was just trying to help.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, your "help" this morning messed up so badly, we came this close to being wiped out at the mall! I thought you've learned your lesson!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but I—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "But" no! You show up again to help, and now Baljeet has been hulkified and is rampaging who knows where!! And we're back to square one with restoring the heroes' powers!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is just too important!! And we can't afford any more setbacks!! (Takes off her lanyard) I'm revoking your S.H.E.D. card! (Tears up the card.) You have to go!! NOW!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've always told her

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh no! Baljeet! We've gotta go after him!

Name: Thor
Dialog: Sadly, there is no time! Our mission lies elsewhere!Isabella

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, nah. I'll go! You stay here, little girl, it might get ugly.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What? You don't think I can handle ugly? I've been hangin' out with you all summer!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sticks and stones!

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Greetings, Agent P! S.H.I.E.L.D. has gotten intel that the supervillains are holed up in downtown Danville in an oddly-shaped building with its own jingle. We need you to find out what they're up to!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (now sporting an eyepatch and a goatee like Fury) And neutralize them if possible, Agent P!

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Monogram! Seriously, the beard, too?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're not the only one who can rock an awesome face mullet, Fury!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (standing in front of an inator) And see, it takes four orbs of mundanium finite to power it. It would only take one orb of Pizzazium Infinionite but that's so hard to find. Oh, don't get me started! So we just lock the module in here and...Viola! Yeah, I know, it's a large violin. I-I don't know why people say that. Anyhoo, what did you guys need a second Power-Drain-inator for?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: So we won't have to deal vit your idiocy anymore! (Takes out a remote and traps Doof in a cage.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, that's not nice! I-I thought we were buds! We were amigos! We had...We had a song and everything!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Your little musical interlude vas a pleasant diwersion at best! You see, ve're not going to take over ze Tri-State Area. We are going to completely destroy it and show vat vill happen if anyone attempts to swart our plan!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did you just say, "Swart our plan"?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: No. Swart! Sw- Vit a T-H! Swart!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, "thwart"! Yeah, it makes more sense. I think that maybe you should go see a speech pathologist or a-a-a dialect coach or someth—

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: SILENCE!!! Vunce ve've made our point, we will use our contraption to draw avay ze powers of all ze superheroes on ze planet! And take over ze world!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you guys really think big!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: But first, Venom, squash our little fly on ze ceiling!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Now we go and send a little message to our handicapped heroes. Come! Schnell!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) You're not very good at thwarting. I...I should hook you up with my nemesis Perry the Platypus for some pointers. It's an art form for him.

Name: Hulkjeet
Dialog: BALJEET SMASH!!!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: The courtyard also features a statue of Franz the Elephant.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sadly) Hey, Candace. What'cha doin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just laying here. Utterly dejected.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I hear you. None of the women superheroes showed up, so it's all about testosterone and...powers and...fighting, which... (shrugs) yeah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I was only trying to help but all I did was mess things up. (sigh) I'm useless.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I know exactly how you feel.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: ...trying to help, Phineas.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, girls. (Wide shot to reveal the "rain" is actually the sprinkler.) Don't mind me. I'm just givin' the lawn a bit of a drink. (turns it off) It's off now.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet! (Hulkjeet roars and picks Buford up by the shirt.) Heh heh heh...heh...I'm so happy that I found you! I worry about you, you know. Because...you're my best friend.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah. Thanks, Buford. I did not like being an angry monster.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm glad. Because you weren't very good at it anyway!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really? I think I was actually quite terrifying.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, come on! You're totally green! (No pun intended.) For example, when you grab somebody's shirt (grabs Baljeet's shirt) and lift 'em up...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Buford
Dialog: ...ya gotta twist it first! (demonstrates) And you yell REALLY LOUD!!!

Name: Hulkjeet
Dialog: (roars and lifts Buford back up) DO NOT YELL AT BALJEET LIKE THAT!!! (throws Buford and roars and runs)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, the throwin' was good! But when you grabbed my shirt, you didn't twist!! I swear, it's like in one ear and right out de other! Oh, oh! Baljeet, wait up! (goes after him)

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Citizens of Danville and ze surrounding Tri-State Area, prepare for your imminent end! Unless Iron Man, Spider-Man, Zor and Hulk show up to face us, we will unleash a device a zousand times vorse zan ze von zat hit zem! (pointing to the device behind him) Thanks to MODOK's modifications, our Power-Drain-inator doesn't merely drain power. It drains energy, matter, everything the target vas! (presses a button) Observe.

Name: Hot Dog Vendor
Dialog: Aw, man! And I just moved here from New York, cuz I thought it would be safer!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, guys, you better come see this.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: So, heroes, eizer you come down here and face us, or ve vill unleash zis veapon on ze entire Tri-State Area! (Laughs evilly)

Name: Thor
Dialog: Ah! The fiend!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: I actually missed a lot of that with the accent, but I got that it's bad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, man. What're we gonna do?

Name: Thor
Dialog: What we have to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But you have no powers.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: That doesn't matter. We've gotta fight back with whatever we've got left.

Name: Thor
Dialog: Being a hero isn't the armor you wear. But the metal in your spirit and the steel in your resolve.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Man, that was eloquent. All I ever do is quips. Like this one, for instance. And the one preceding it.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Can we please not kill the gravitas of this moment?

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Man! We've got a lot to do if we're gonna get this suit back online. I think we can get 60% function back if we reroute the power flow through the backup circuits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe if I just go in and apologize one more time they'll forgive me. I have a stomachache, I feel so bad.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're your brothers. They'll listen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, look, I'm sorry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How did you get in? I thought I revoked your S.H.E.D. ID.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isabella gave me her guest pass.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fine, but...don't touch anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb, you've gotta listen to me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) The shoulder joint's ready. (climbing down the ladder) Excuse me, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, can't you stop and listen?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you don't understand! The guys are in trouble! If we can't get downtown to help them, this may be their final battle!

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: The heroes are not coming!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Oh, don't worry. They'll come.

Name: MODOK
Dialog: My sensors tell me the heroes are approaching.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Perfect! Zey're on ze bus!

Name: Little Old Lady
Dialog: Outta my way, you weirdos! It's worse than Portland!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: A mindball? Really? Hey, MODOK, can you feel it in your brain when I go like this? (rubs his hands against the ball)

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Ve have zem now!

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: What about old lady?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Eh? Oh, she is not—She is not vis zem!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) So you're a superhero, huh? Don't you have some sort of power to get us out of this? (Perry pushes a button on his utility belt) Hey...Oh, wow! You've got...super wire cutters, huh? Oh, what are they, nail clippers that got bitten by radioactive pinching shears?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (sitting in the Beak suit) We've only got half the server motors on the right side online.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't funny, guys! You can't go! It's not safe!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Isabella. Initiate launching sequence, Ferb. (The rocket jets appear from the butt, but one goes back in.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, you've only got one butt jet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that'll have to do. Bacaw! (launches)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: The Beak
Dialog: (flying all willy-nilly) Whoa! Whoa!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: (to Iron Man) Pasetic! Look at how you've vasted your lives! Protecting zees humans, who are so qvick to abandon you in your hour of need!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Vhiplash!

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: What?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: I vas talking to him!

Name: Whiplash
Dialog: Sorry.

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Look around you! Now zat you have no powers, you have no friends, no allies, you have nussing!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: We have a Baljeet.

Name: Hulkjeet
Dialog: Hulkjeet.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Oh, my bad. Apparently he prefers to be known as "Hulkjeet". (The Beak arrives.) And this thing.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Bacaw!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: If it's a bird, it's with us, too. (Agent P flies in) The flying duck with a beaver tail. We got him! (Waffles fall from the sky) But I gotta level with ya, I have no idea who's shooting waffles.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo-hoo! Top of the world, Ma!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Yo, Red, (holding the orbs) is this doohickey important?

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Ze mundanium finite reactor core!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Huh. I guess it is important. (runs off)

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Go get him! I shall guard ze inator! (gets waffled)

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Thanks, Baljeet!

Name: Hulkjeet
Dialog: Hulkjeet!

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Bacaw!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Woo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pacing back and forth) There's one thing I don't understand about the lost superpowers. In all the comics I've read, energy can never be destroyed. Only morphed into a different form or contained somehow.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace, when we were up at the space station, we were collecting and containing data!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You were up in what?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Have a seat.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you talking about?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just go with it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, that's where this thing was!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Fast cart!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Yeah, I souped it up!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: (gives Iron Man the reactor core) Here! Hold this! (goes to the back and gets the caddy bag) You mind if I play through? (Unzips the front pocket emptying it of all the tees. Whiplash slips on the tees. Spidey gets out a club with dog-shaped cover on it and throws the caddy bag at Venom.) Go get 'im, boy! (Throws the club at MODOK.) Good dog!

Name: Bear Boy
Dialog: Beware Bear Boy! (slaps the fish at Red Skull)

Name: Hulk
Dialog: Now you kids stay back! Hmm?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't think it's weird the space station looks like Phineas?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If by "weird" you mean "dreamy".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, brother.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! The collection tank! There's something glowing in there! It's gotta be the powers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking through a telescope) Looks like the fight's begun! Now make the powers blast out...down there and stuff.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't know how to do that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whadaya mean? Didn't Phineas explain how to—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. It was like, "Isabella...blah blah blah blah blah...Isabella...blah blah blah blah blah..." He was dressed like an astronaut! I was distracted!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Ze mundanium finite! (to Venom) Get zose orbs!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, these waffles aren't enough. I...I wish I could just disintegrate them all. (gasp) Oh, right! The Disintegrator-inator! Duh! (switches it on, nothing happens) I don't know what I was—Hey! (flips the switch up and down) Hey, what's wrong? Hmmm. (picks up the unplugged plug) Oh, here's the problem. (He walks up to an extension cord outlet, but the plug is too short.) Okay, I just need an extension cord this long. (Runs off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isabella, (points to a big red button) I think this is the button that'll release the superpowers!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How can you tell?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it's red, see? And there's some red detailing on that collector thing, so it's gotta be it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's a very irrational and reckless deduction.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Isabella! I've failed twice already so the third time's a charm!

Name: Computer
Dialog: System shutting down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Computer
Dialog: Anti-gravitational jets disabled.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Orbit decaying.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're falling back to Earth!

Name: Computer
Dialog: Fuel systems immobilized. Social network friends...defriended.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, now that's just mean!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, this long. This long, lessee. (gets out a few extension cords) Too short. Too short. Too long. Way too short! Why would I even have this?!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: If you look to your left, you will see the J.P. McHenry Building, built in the art deco style. (Behind her, the battle still rages on.) And on your right is Danville's oldest arcade, built in 1982.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: Talk about being disarmed.

Name: The Beak
Dialog: That's not good.

Name: Hulk
Dialog: Hey! Over here!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Enough of zis foolishness! (Places the reactor core back into the inator) Our triumph is at hand! (The inator activates.) And now, behold, ze destruction of ze entire Tri-State—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, is that our space station?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yo, heroes, got a little somethin' for ya! (rolls down the tank)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace! The data collection tank! Of course!

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Great job! Somebody's using their spider sense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I learned from the best, Spidey!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: Get up! Get zem, you fools!!

Name: Thor
Dialog: Hmm.

Name: Thor
Dialog: (shakes the tickets off to reveal a parking boot on the hammer) Oh, for crying out loud! (He tears the boot off and reaches the hammer out. Candace smiles and touches Mjolnir and giggles giddily.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hee-hee-hee-hee!

Name: Red Skull
Dialog: (growls) I zink perhaps our window of opportunity has closed.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Iron Man, looks like you're functioning at full capacity.

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Yep. Why don't you kids take five? Enjoy the show.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oh, this is going to be sweet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah it is!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Better?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Hulk, that's using my head!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Nice!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (high fives Ferb) Wordplay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Thor!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Candace) Hey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So earlier, I really lost it. Uh, I'm sorry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'm sorry. I deserved it. Everything I did made things worse.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's okay. You were trying to help. And hello! You guys saved the day!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (taking out the repaired S.H.E.D. ID) So will you take your S.H.E.D. membership card back? I fixed it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes it) I accept.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? (she sees her mother walking by the wreckage) Is that Mom? You know I love you guys and I'm super glad we made up, but would you look at this place? Sorry, but you are SO BUSTED!! Mom! (And there she goes again.)

Name: Nick Fury
Dialog: Toss 'em in! Nice work, kids! You didn't just get back our heroes' powers. You showed true courage fighting alongside them!  (renders a hand salute) S.H.I.E.L.D. owes you a debt of gratitude. (Phineas and Ferb return the salute.)

Name: Hot Dog Vendor
Dialog: Yeah! Hot dogs for everyone, baby!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Three years later when the new day care center was built on top of the ancient burial ground...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom Mom Mom! You gotta come back to the square!! The boys' space satellite crashed down to Earth and these villains had a machine that would destroy the Tri-State Area and there's superheroes!! All in the square!! You gotta see it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm surprised that's not on the tour.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time for sarcasm, Mom! (grabs her) Come on!!

Name: Iron Man
Dialog: Here's my direct line, Ferb. Internship, next summer? It'll be fun.

Name: Spider-Man
Dialog: Next time, Phin, the juice box'll be my treat. (web slings away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You got it, Spidey!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, okay. (fist bumps Hulk)

Name: Hulk
Dialog: Ow! Hmm. Ha ha! Gotcha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ih. Finally found an extension cord the right size! (plugs in the inator) Take that, bad guys! (The inator zaps the space station away and Candace appears just as it disappears.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...giant head shaped like Phineas and superheroes! But...but...but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, yes. There they are. (zoom out to reveal a comic book stand full of Spider-Man, Hulk, Thor, Iron Man and Ducky Momo comics)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wha?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hulk, Iron Man, Thor. All of them. I forgot you had a thing for comic books.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but...This isn't how..Wait, where did...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You wanna join me for the rest of the tour?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I'd rather stay here and sulk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I did it! Did anyone see that? Anyone? Anyone? No one's lookin'. Nobody's payin' attention.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! There goes that unknown superhero! (The gang approach Agent P.) You were pretty awesome out there!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, and what's your secret identity?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, a hero never reveals their secret identity.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sure they do! Watch!

Name: Everyone
Dialog: Ducky Momo?!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo?!?! (sighs and faints into Isabella's arms)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's strange. I was convinced that he was an anthropomorphic platypus. Huh. What with the beaver tail and all.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry! You missed all the fun!

Name: Monty
Dialog: This was nice.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, I'm glad we ran into each other.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah, almost literally you almost ran over me with that scooter.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What can I say? You walk slow. So, uh, what are you doing tonight?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah, I'm gonna see Love Sandal. It's a Love Händel cover band that, uh, that plays in, in sandals. My- my cousin plays bass, he can get us backstage, it'll be fun. You wanna come?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, no, no I don't. I'll catch you later.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Keep an eye out for that scooter.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl...

Name: Monty
Dialog: Go ahead.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You mean there's more?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Look, you don't have to tell my dad about this, do you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Monty, Monty. Walk with me. You know your dad is my superior. I'm obliged to tell him everything. I can't imagine what could possibly sway me to consider such a dereliction of duty.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Alright, Carl, I get it, what do you want?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I want your father to disown you, and adopt me.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Okay, what do you want within reason?

Name: Carl
Dialog: You, you don't understand. I do all the work at the agency, but he doesn't even acknowledge me. I mean that's all I want, a simple "Thank you" is that too much to ask?

Name: Monty
Dialog: You just want him to say "Thank you"?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, a simple "Thank you."

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl, if that's all you want, then I'm sure I can get Dad to say "Thank you" to you.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, if you can do that, maybe I can just forget to mention the whole "dating a sworn enemy's daughter" thing.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Deal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Ferb, check out this cool picture of Grandma and Grandpa Flynn in their pyramid water skiing days. Wow. It's all the fun of water skiing times ten. You know, I bet you pyramids would make any sport better. Ferb...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you think you're—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (using the mic dropped down from the tree) I KNOW WHAT WE'RE GONNA DO TODAY!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: —doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (sounds slightly muffled) Oh, hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I said, "Hey, Candace."

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! I can't hear you over all this ringing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry about it. It'll go away in a sec. See ya' later, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I may not be able to hear you, but I can see you! If you stay in range!

Name: Off-Screen Voice
Dialog: (From her second story window overlooking the backyard) Oh, Candace, right on schedule.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, hi. Are you new here?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Heavens no, dear, I've been here all summer. I've so enjoyed watching your brothers build so many amazing things everyday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh that's perfect. Uh, you know what? My arms are getting really tired, just hold that thought, I'll be right back. (runs off, and returns with a step ladder) You were saying?

Name: Woman
Dialog: They're so inventive. I mean they built that rollercoaster, oh, and that spa, and I loved that platypus-themed restaurant, even though I couldn't get a reservation. The bouncer was so harsh. (While saying this, Candace smiles widely) Oh, but the best was when they had their own sitcom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, I wasn't even here for that one.

Name: Woman
Dialog: I know, but I wouldn't miss a minute of witnessing your brothers' backyard fun.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Lady, you've got to help me! You've got to come down here and tell my mom all about it!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, I don't think so, dear. Um, I just don't feel up to leaving the house.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problem. You stay right where you are, and I'll bring my mom over! (Starts to leave but comes back) Heeheeheeheehee...

Name: Woman
Dialog: Oh, by the way...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Woman
Dialog: Where's Perry?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Hey Dad.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Monty my boy. It's always wonderful to see you.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hello sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, what took you so long? Hand me that report would you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: My coffee! Huh, thanks Monty.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Actually Carl-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, the trash chute is clogged again, do you mind?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Of course not sir. (He makes his way past Monty and Major Monogram) Pardon me. Excuse me. Coming through

Name: Monty
Dialog: Uh, Dad, Agent P is here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, so he is. Morning Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted on his balcony repeatedly shaking his fist and then running back into his building. Which is obviously evil. Well, okay maybe not evil, but definitely cliche. So, go and stop him from his cartoon conventions.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Here's how you play!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't care if it's played in a field or on a court,

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: 'Cause everyone here is into pyramid sports!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think I pulled my sigmoid colon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Annoying musician. C-Come on. Come on. Come to papa. Ah! Bingo! (Perry puts his tail in front of the scope) Hey what's with the waffle? Oh very funny Perry the Platypus, very funny. If you'll just be so kind as to move your tail out of the way. (Perry does so) Thank you. There we go. That's good, an- (Perry puts his tail in front of the scope again) See now you're just being childish. Look, I promise you. I'm not even being marginally evil. I just want to stop that guy from playing his bagpipes everyday, 24-hours a day. I mean look at him. On what planet is that racket considered music? Ugh! I cannot take it anymore, so I'm gonna hit his bagpipe with my Inflate-inator! Yeah, I know, It's basically the opposite of my Deflate-inator. But I can't concentrate with all that noise! I was lucky to come up with that. But when that bagpipe blows up I will once again be able to here the usual din ringing through the city streets. Like, uh, car alarms, and babies crying, and -inators blowing up. (Perry flings himself off the -inator, and punches Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Pushing Linda towards the fence) Come on! Come on! Come on! This time I've got an eyewitness. (gestures toward the house with eyes closed) Go on. Go on. Tell my mom everything!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) Well, when the empty window feels like talking, you let me know. (walks away)

Name: Woman
Dialog: There it is, I dropped my penny. Did you say something dear?

Name: Monty
Dialog: How was your meal dad?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Absolutely delicious. What a great new place.

Name: Monty
Dialog: I know, right? Carl found it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well then, let me just say thank you, to the chef. Thank you for that delicious meal.

Name: Chef
Dialog: You're most welcome, so glad you enjoyed it.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad, isn't there something you wanted to say to Carl as well?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Of course, what was I thinking? Don't be rude Carl, thank the chef.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Thank you.

Name: Chef
Dialog: I like this table, and to show my gratitude, dessert is on the house. Now if you'll excuse me, I must go and fire a member of staff. Lachenzo! Come here!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There, you see? A little gratitude goes a long way. Pay attention Carl, you could learn something.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (Under his breath) ...really learn something from you, you-

Name: Monty
Dialog: Just chill out, I got another idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Check you out Perry the Bloat-apus. (Doofenshmirtz inflates as well) Well, uh, this is awkward. Seriously gonna-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I'm so glad I had this Helipad installed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dragging Linda out by the arm) No really, I swear the old lady is there in the window right now! I swear!

Name: Linda
Dialog: No need to swear. I'm coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There she is! (points toward where the window is)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sees nothing but a bonsai tree in the window) Funny Candace, I could swear your "old lady" looks just like a house plant. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What!?

Name: Woman
Dialog: (Watering the plant) There you go. A little thirsty weren't you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, wow. Aw man. We're not getting anywhere. How bout we take a time out?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, your hat has a pressure release valve? Wow, so that's what the inside of a platypus smells like? Could've gone my whole life without knowing that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Aw man, another 'nator bites the dust, and I'm stuck listening to Jerky McIrritating across the street now.

Name: Man
Dialog: What's that? Oh I'm sorry, I'll stop. I didn't realize I was disturbin' you. Cheery-bye!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, well I guess I may have over thought that solution, just a little bit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahhh! Curse you Perry the Platypus!

Name: Carl
Dialog: This had better work.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Don't worry Carl, once you save my dad's life, there's no way even he could avoid thanking you for it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I hope for your sake you're right. You know it's funny how no one's noticed a grand piano dangling precariously over our table.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well, I also tied a couple of violins up there so it would look like a theme. Alright, listen so when my dad returns, I'll excuse myself, and cut the rope, and you push my dad out of the way of the falling piano. Got it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let's get to that dessert menu.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Excuse me dad, it's my turn. I'll be right back, you guys start.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sure, sure. Thank you for not making us wait. Huh. That bathroom attendant was lovely, he gave me mints and some floss. I-I just couldn't thank him enough.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Watch out sir!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad! Carl! Are you alright?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I'm uh, I'm fine.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I'm alright too sir.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wow, Carl, you saved my dad's life.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, It's a shame he couldn't save the table too. Let's go find the host--

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wait. Whoa! What? Seriously?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad, aren't you going to thank him?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, well I didn't realize I hadn't. Thank you for pointing that out to me Monty.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Dad!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, uh, yes, right. Thank you Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh well, more dessert for us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, it's different this time, she promised to come down and meet us!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Right, my expectations have been completely reversed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No you'll see, she'll explain everything. Everything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Heeheeheeheehee... (the woman comes out) Yes! See? Mom, Lady. Lady, Mom. Now tell her everything.

Name: Cop
Dialog: (Speaking to the woman) You have the right to remain silent, anything you say--

Name: Peggy
Dialog: Take your hands off me copper. I know my rights. Sorry Candace, water the plant for me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't understand. What's going on?

Name: Cop 2
Dialog: Police matter miss.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What could could that sweet old lady possibly have done?

Name: Cop 2
Dialog: That "sweet old lady" is Peggy "The Pyramid" McGee, the notorious ring leader of Danville's biggest pyramid scheme.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pyramid scheme?

Name: Cop 2
Dialog: That's right, she's been selling these all over town. See? These are just flat triangles, painted in perspective. That's fraud.

Name: Peggy
Dialog: I'll be out by the time her mom serves pie.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow Candace, a pyramid scheme right under our noses!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, imagine that.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Hey.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey yourself.

Name: Monty
Dialog: I thought, uh...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, so did I. But then I figured I couldn't leave you here to suffer alone.

Name: Monty
Dialog: That's what I like. Thoughtful, and dismissive at the simultaneously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Being tossed around like a beach ball) Nooo! Wait. Wait. Wait. Is that the Love Sandals? Hey, oh, watch the hands lady.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, doing a little light summer reading, I see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is for the book club Jeremy and I joined. We all read the same book, and then we get together, and discuss over tea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds sophisticated.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, the tea was my idea. This week we're reading, The Iliad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's a great book! It's all about the Trojan War.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You read this?

Name: Buford
Dialog: We all did. You're not the only one with a book club you know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I like your idea about the tea though. Ferb, make a note of that.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The war started because Paris fell in love with Helen of Troy. It's so romantic.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, and Helen could launch a thousand ships with her face! My favorite character was Achilles, the greatest Greek warrior of all time. He had this big fight with Hector. He was all, Wham! Bam! Stab! Stab! Stab!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Cut it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isn't there something with a wooden horse?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, the Greek army build a huge wooden horse, and left it outside the gates of Troy. The Trojans thought that the Greeks had given up, and that the horse was some sort of tribute to them. So they wheeled it inside the gates.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! How'd they get that big horse in that tiny door?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, just try imagining a larger door.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, okay. Hang on. (Buford pauses to imagine a larger door) Oh, yeah, that's better.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Then late at night, the Greeks climbed out of the horse, opened the gate--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Then it was all; Wham! Zam! Stab! Stab! Stab! (Buford stabs Baljeet again)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Cut it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, it really sounds exciting. I'd better get started. Book club is in three hours. Bye.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, she must be a fast reader.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What gets me, is why did the Trojan War take so long? If I were Achilles, I could've taken the city of Troy, like, in one afternoon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! We're gonna finally recreate the Trojan War. I'll be Paris because my name starts with a P.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And I'll be Helen because- (Realizing she wrapped her arm around Phineas's) Ah, my... name... starts... with... I which is right after H. (smiles awkwardly)

Name: Buford
Dialog: And I'll be the great Achilles. And I'll be all; Wham! Zam! Stab! Stab! Stab! (He stabs Baljeet again)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ahhh! Cut it out!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (To Baljeet) And you can be Hector, now get over there. I'm taking Ferb.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (From behind the fence) Hey, everyone! Can I play?

Name: Buford
Dialog: No!

Name: Irving
Dialog: I've got baklava.

Dialog: Hey, where's your dad?

Dialog: (while tying his tie) So it goes over, under, around and through. Ooh, lovely. Time to open the shop.

Dialog: Hello Agent P. I see you used the rabbit hole entrance. Heh, freaks the heck out of intruders. Anyway, no news on what Doof is up to yet we're still awaiting a surveillance report, from our special C.R. unit. Hey Carl! Any news from team Cockroach?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Nothing yet, sir. We think they may have been scattered.

Name: Monogram

Dialog: (Looking at the Troy Castle) And they say Rome wasn't built in a day.

Dialog: Uh, technically, that's not Rome, that's supposed to be Troy.

Name: Buford
Dialog: If I wanted nerd facts I would've kept Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (From the Castle) In case you are wondering, the word you are looking for is, "impenetrable"

Dialog: Actually the word I was looking for is decimate!

Dialog: Fair enough.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we're gonna need a bigger army. Irving break out my recruitment fustanella.

Name: Irving
Dialog: You mean the little Greek skirt--?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a fustanella.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Coming, hold on. Just hold your horses. Wait. Hello? (He opens the door, and Perry flies in on his jetpack.) Ha! you missed me, Perry the Platypus. (Perry gets caught in a rope net trap) I got you. You see, I was just doing a little inventory and reorganization of all the stuff that I've collected over the last forty years. Yeah, I know it's gotten a little... out of hand. I kinda let it go, and Norm's been in Maui for like, a month, so I made a Declutter-inator. I was actually gonna shoot myself with it, which would make me want to un-clutter everything, and then I lost it, 'cause, you know, it's, it's really cluttered in here. So then I hired a nice young lady named Doreen, to help me get organized, and well, I think she may have gotten lost, too. I haven't see her in days. (Yelling into the clutter) Doreen? Are you out there?

Name: Doreen
Dialog: So thirsty...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never approved overtime!

Name: Doreen
Dialog: Food...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
