Dialog: So if you'll excuse me I have to get back to my search for Doreen. Maybe I'll get lucky and find the Declutter-inator, too. (Yelling back into the clutter) Hey Doreen? Marco!

Name: Doreen
Dialog: Water!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, she really stinks at this.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, Next! Name?

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Balthazar Horowitz, but you can call me "The Ballpit Kid."

Name: Buford
Dialog: Any medical problems.

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Well, I have a perforated A-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, yeah yeah, you're in. Get a shield. Come back with it, or on it. Next! Name?

Name: Boy
Dialog: Dimitri Popaunicolas.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Any experience being Greek?

Name: Dimitri
Dialog: Actually I am Greek. I was born on the Island--

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't want your life story. Grab a shield, come back with it, or on it. Irving, go get some more baklava, come back with it, or on it.

Name: Irving
Dialog: I'm on it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah? Well get with it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Reading) "Sing, goddess, the anger of Peleus's son, Achilles..." (She dozes off, then shakes herself back awake, and continues reading) "Achilles! And it's devastation, which put pains upon the Achians..." (She doses off again, then jolts back awake, and continues her reading) "Upon the Achians, hurled in their multitude to Hou--"

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Yelling) Hector!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh for Pete's sake! (She walks over to the window) Buford, I'm trying to tea this! (She sees that large Troy Castle) What the heck is going on out here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You've inspired us, Candace. What do you think?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you by any chance reenacting the Trojan War, like in my book?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the plan.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'll just watch you guys, and take notes for my book club. Buford, continue.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, uh, Hector? Why don't you come down here, I got something for ya'.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, sweet. I am going down there. (He comes down from the castle) Okay, here I am. What have you got for me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Get him!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no, not good. (He runs)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eat, hot chariot sucker!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, so much for Hector.

Name: Greek
Dialog: The Trojans stole Helen!

Name: Soldier
Dialog: Bagpipe solo!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, bagpipes are sort of anachronistic for this time period-

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quiet, you! Go back to being vanquished!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doreen? Come out, come out where ever you are. I should have brought some bread crumbs, or something to leave behind me, so I could find my way-- Oh you know what? Better yet, I should've brought a sandwich, cause I am famished.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, where you guys going? We're not done yet.

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: I gotta get home.

Name: Girl
Dialog: I've got a book club.

Name: Dimitri
Dialog: I've got a balalaika lesson.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You now they've got a word for what you guys are doing.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Yeah, it's desertion!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, it's-- Oh, no it is desertion. Irving get over here. It's time to execute Plan B.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Plan B.?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, you know the one where you climb into the decoy, and uh...

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, that Plan B.--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Get goin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A Trojan Platypus? Come on Buford, what made you think we'd fall for that.

Name: Irving
Dialog: I told you, Buford--

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ow! Why did you have me get in this thing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Watching from her window) Now we're gettin' somewhere.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ha, I bet you didn't see a Trojan T-rex with laser cannon mouth, and laser cannon eyes comin'. Did you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well he's got me there.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (Now in the T-rex) Seriously, if you were just gonna crush the Trojan Platypus, why did I--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Leave me my simple pleasures. Now Ferb, destroy Troy! This is why I got Ferb on my team.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh, looks like Ferb's going off book. Everyone to the chariots. (Everybody loads into the charriots, and they take off to do battle with the T-Rex) Hang on. (Phineas fires laser's out of his chariot, which just bounce off) Whoa, laser proof! Nice touch Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is really cool! (She checks her watch) Book club starts in ten minutes! (She leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have an idea, throw that rope to the other chariot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, that can't be good.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Guess they knew that a T-Rex's weakness is also its Achilles' heel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was awesome!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who won?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This time I think it was a draw. Come on, let's go tell Candace how it ends.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, and maybe we can pick up some Greek frozen yogurt on the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doreen? Come on, quit kidding around. Perry the Platypus! You found the Declutter-inator. Excellent. Okay, shoot me. Shoot me and I'll clean this whole place up. Oh, wait, wait wait, What? It's not plugged in? Hold on one second.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Upon entering the backyard) My word, what a mess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, here's an open socket. (He plugs in his -inator) That doesn't sound good. (The -inator sends out a blast destroying some of Doofenshmirtz's lair, and resulting in one beam from the -inator hitting Lawrence)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, I say, I feel the sudden urge to declutter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you have to admit it, it did get rid of the clutter.

Name: Doreen
Dialog: There you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doreen! What's happenin'?

Name: Doreen
Dialog: My invoice. You'll be hearing from my lawyer. (She walks off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (weakly) Curse you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And there goes the last of it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence? What are you doing out here?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, you know, just tidying up a little.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, the yard looks great. Come on in the kitchen. I've got a plate of cake that needs cleaning up.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'm your man.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Now that we're all here, who would like to go first?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, me! In general I thought the Greek's decoy platypus was a brilliant idea until it got smashed by the T-Rex. It's use of lasers to destroy the city of Troy really seemed unbeatable, until Paris flew down in his laser chariot. The flying chariots were all; Phew! Phew! Phew! Phew! Phew! Phew! Phew! Gak! Gak! Gak! And Eew!

Name: Boy
Dialog: Cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The Iliad is truly an epic.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, you didn't read the book, did you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (deadpan) I'm so busted.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, that's okay, I don't think anyone did.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (at the camera) I just come to book club for the tea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Looks great, Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Thank you, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb! We have work to do!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking in the background carrying her costume) Nice costume, Dad! See ya after the party!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, you have fun at the castle party tonight. (putting the mask on his head) If you need anything, your mother and I will be here scaring the sugar out of the little trick or treaters.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, how do I look, dear? (Lawrence makes gorilla sounds and bangs his hands on his chest.) Oh, no, a gorilla!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, Agent P, who do I look like? Huh, whadaya think? (Perry simply stares) C'mon! Carmen Miranda! Y'know, you really should watch more old movies.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (entering, also dressed as Carmen Miranda) Sir, I found your dosimeter. It was—What are you doing?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! Is that what I look like?! Wow, suddenly I feel ridiculous. Nevermind, Carl, you can have it.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (exiting) Sheesh.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Moving right along

Name: Monty
Dialog: (on phone) Well, hello, Vanessa.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Monty, what are you up to?

Name: Monty
Dialog: I'm just doing a little freelance for my dad. What's up?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I happen to be throwing the biggest, baddest, Halloweeniest bash ever! It's tonight and I think you should come.

Name: Monty
Dialog: A costume party? Hey, that means we can actually be seen in public together and no one will know.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's the plan! I'm checking out my Queen of the Vampires costume even as we speak.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Oooh...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It's pretty cute.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Great, I'll be there! I'll be dressed as the Scarlet Pimpernel.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: The Scarlet what?

Name: Monty
Dialog: You know, he wears a big red hat with a feather in it. You should watch more old movies.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, you know, it's a little known fact that vampire queens love Pumpernels.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Pimpernel.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, whatever, OWCA boy.

Name: Monty
Dialog: See ya tonight.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Sorry, Agent M. You're on your own from here on out.

Name: Agent M
Dialog: Ohhhh....

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, goody, trick or treaters.

Name: Trick or Treaters
Dialog: Trick or treat!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, lessee, what do we have here? Class dunce with a fake scar, and you must be the Princess of Meatland...and...uh, oh, uh, Upset Rooster Head. And what are you supposed to be, a kid in a sheet? (The "kid in the sheet" takes off the sheet to reveal

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Welcome to my castle party! Here's a mask. Lacie, wow, great costume!

Name: Lacie
Dialog: This is a...costume party?

Name: Knight
Dialog: Sir Grant of the Goth Table has arrived.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You look great, Sir Grant. (gives him a mask) Dragons beware!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (also dressed as a vampire queen) Vanessa?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoops! I guess your party's gonna have two vampire queens! What are the chances, right?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (leaves) I'm gonna go change.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did you ever pull this off?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, my dad gave me permission to use his castle and then all I had to do was call the best party planners in town.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, you go get the 4

Name: Candace
Dialog: Et tu, Vanessa?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I had to. This is a big night for me, my boyfriend's coming. Oh, here he is right now.

Name: Scarlet Pimpernel
Dialog: Ooh, a vampire! It's a good thing I have my neck covered.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You're not my boyfriend!

Name: Scarlet Pimpernel
Dialog: Whoops. Heh heh. Sorry, I thought you were my—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, it's me, Candace!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, a vampire! It's a good thing I have my—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, heard you the first time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, the first clue is in the letter. Let's see here

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "My treasure awaits you, keep on the trail.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A ride up the stairs from under a veil."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What kind of twisted gibberish is this? (Perry approaches a chair under a veil and uncovers it.) That's it! Henrietta's chairlift! Oh yeah! Here, (patting his knee) you can sit here, Perry the Platypus. (Perry shakes his head.) No? Alright, suit yourself. (He activates the chairlift.) We're comin' for your treasure, HenriettAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!! (The chairlift speeds up and flings Doofenshmirtz into the red stained glass window. It seems like he's about to crash and break it, but doesn't. Instead, the window flips over and Doofenshmirtz lands in the moat and takes out a piece of paper.) Ha! I got it! (An alligator arises from the moat.) Yaaaah!! They shipped the alligator, too? Get away from me, Susan! We talked about this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These scalloped cheese slices should be staged directly across from the crackers. But overall, nice work. (He approaches Isabella dressed as Cinderella.) Hey, look at you! You're Isabellarella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If I lose a slipper tonight, you know where to find me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (walking away, pointing at something) Ooh, that reminds me...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: ("accidentally" losing a slipper) Whoops!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) ...there's some water on the floor over by the sally port.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, it is so hot in here! Can I please have some punch?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (saunters past) You don't wanna drink that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Y'know, I think we have the best castle party costume.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Buford, look at me - (he is dressed as a castle) I'm a castle...at a castle party! Get it? Heh? Heh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. Hey, Windsor, your drawbridge is down!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Oh, my. (raising his drawbridge) How embarrassing.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Monty should've been here by now. (Another Scarlet Pimpernel approaches her.) Finally...wait, who are you?

Name: Scarlet Pimpernel 1
Dialog: I'm the Scarlet Pimpernel.

Name: Scarlet Pimpernel 2
Dialog: As am I!

Name: Scarlet Pimpernel 3
Dialog: Same here.

Name: All Scarlet Pimpernels
Dialog: We are all here!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ugh!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (also dressed as the Scarlet Pimpernel) Hey, what's going—Oh, for crying out loud.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, let's kick this biggest, baddest, Halloweeniest bash into high gear!

Name: (Song
Dialog: "Foot Stomp Mash Up")'

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "In the dungeon, you will find

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: An elevator out of time."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I really don't remember an elevator down here. (An elevator bell dings.) Well, whadaya know? How could I have missed it? (A couple of Shining twins walk out of the elevator.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "In the elevator, to the top you go,

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The next clue is down below."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (The elevator goes up.) Well, that doesn't really make a lot of sense. (The elevator reaches the top floor, which is just a view.) Why did she make us come all the way up here if the clue is all the way down— (The elevator drops like the Tower of Terror ride and drops back into the moat. A hippopotamus rises from the moat.) Wait a second! (Approaching the hippo, which has another clue in its mouth.) Gimme that thing!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Now, that is my boyfriend.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Nice of you to finally show up.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yeah, you're not gonna believe this, but all the costume shops were out of Pimpernel outfits.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, I believe it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I ran out of shoes. (lifts up her gown to reveal she is now barefoot)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's okay. (throws off his shoes) It's more fun to dance barefoot anyway. (Phineas and Isabella begin dancing with each other)

Name: Monty
Dialog: Oops, sorry.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's alright. (His visor drops on his eyes and he pushes it back up.) Monty, is that you?! With the daughter of my sworn enemy?! It can't be!! (Walks up to the Pimpernel next to Vanessa.) Alright, Monty, you've got a lot of explaining to— (the Pimpernel that is talking to Vanessa reveals herself to be Stacy)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, hello, Mr. Water and Power Guy.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I, uh, better check the...uh...thing. Yes. (leaves)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Thanks, Stacy! I owe you!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No thanks are necessary for that darned elusive Pimpernel.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, where did Monty go?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, he's up there on that window ledge.

Name: Monty
Dialog: (tipping his hat) Until next time, my queen! (He exits dramatically.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow! That was really kind of swashbuckle-y!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Let's hope she didn't see that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) "By luck or by chance, you found your last clue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Turn the corner, favorite nephew."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, uh, what does she mean, "turn the corner"? It's just a flat wall, it's a— What are you doing, Perry the Platypus? (Perry shows a combination lock near the corner of a picture frame.) Oh, the corner of her picture! Give it a turn with your little platypus hands there! (Perry turns the lock and an unlocking noise is heard and bags of cash drop out.) At last!! Wahoo!! I'm rich! I am rich! I am comfortably well off! Don't worry, Perry the Platypus, I won't forget about you. You'll be the next person I invite to my first piñata party!

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, sir, are you the owner of this here building?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: This area's not zoned for medieval castles. You're gonna have to pay a penalty fee.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Penalty fee? How much?

Name: Man 1
Dialog: One canvas bag with a huge dollar sign on it. (Doofenshmirtz gives the man a bag.) Thank you. Here's your receipt.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: At least I still have all this loot.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Danville Water Management Department. Can I see your permit for that moat? (Doofenshmirtz gives him a bag.)

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Bureau of Castle Conservation.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right. (gives him a bag)

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: (offscreen) Parking fines.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Here you go.

Name: Man 4
Dialog: (offscreen) Castle Relocation Authority.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Yeah, yeah, one for you, too.

Name: Man 5
Dialog: (offscreen) Ways and Means.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Yeah.

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: (offscreen) Means and Ways.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Take it. Here, just....

Name: Man 6
Dialog: (offscreen) Tri-State HOA.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Sure, why not?

Name: Man 7
Dialog: (offscreen) Department of bureaucracy.

Name: Trick or Treaters
Dialog: Trick or treat!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, my! Look at all the fun costumes! (passing out candy) Here you go. And here's one for you. And here's one for the little princess. And one for you. Oh, but wait! Don't go away! (singsongy) We have a little surprise for you! (leaves)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I do so love Halloween!

Name: Linda
Dialog: We're gonna save a ton of money on candy this year!

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Hello, children. Welcome to the Macabre Book Mobile. What is your pleasure tonight? How about a fright? Well, you are in luck, because I have three stories that are guaranteed to make you scream with delight. Mwa...Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! (a hand tickles him with a feather) Stop it! (takes the feather) Enough with the feather, Renfield. We talked about this. Now, knock it off and go stand over there by the Chifferobe. And stay off of those olives. I'm saving them. (zoom in) For company. Mwa...Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

Name: Hipster Guy
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, excuse me?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: What?

Name: Hipster Guy
Dialog: Can I get a free-range organic grilled cheese slider?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: This isn't a food truck, you baboon. It's a Macabre Book Mobile.

Name: Hipster Guy
Dialog: (takes out phone and leaves) Yeah, I'm totally giving you a bad review.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: (shakes fist) May the ancient moths of Sumeria feast upon your skinny jeans! (phone buzzes) One star? Man, that burns. Now where was I? Oh, yes. The first story in our (blood red title appears on screen) Terrifying Tri-State Trilogy of Terror... (notices the title on screen) Oh, for crying out loud! (Takes out a squeegee and wipes off the words, line by line.) Sorry about that. Now where were we?

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Ducky Momo Turns Evil

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Chapter one. A teenage girl chats idly (Crossfade to the Flynn-Fletcher house.) to her friend alone in her room as a storm rages outside. （A lightning flashes on background) Little does she know what evil awaits her as she discovers how dangerous careless words can be.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) No, Stacy, I have the whole place to myself. Mom and Dad are at the movies, and the boys are playing ping pong over at Buford's. Oh, so listen to this weird book I've been readin'. "If one repeats this incantation in the presence of a doll, then alive it shall be!" Ha ha! But check this out

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me? I'm just makin' a snack. Just thought I'd have, you know, somethin' healthy. What? Oh, okay, you caught me. Donuts and cheesy popcorn. (The Ducky Momo doll peers behind the door. The door handle jiggles. Cut to outside as the doll attempts to open the door. The doll reaches into its stuffing and takes out a credit card and slides it through the door. Cut to Candace getting a glass of water.) Ah, Jeremy was so great, he took us out for mani-pedis. (The door opens.) Is someone there? Oh, the storm just blew the door open. Yeah, I know. Creepy. (The Ducky Momo doll attempts to walk between Candace's legs. Candace closes the door with her leg, slamming it on the doll.) Anyway, since Jeremy's mom is a regular at the mani-pedi place, we got special treatment. Yeah, they served us sparkling apple juice and finger sandwiches and made fun of us in Thai. It was all so classy. What can I say? (closes the fridge door with her foot) I love a well-groomed foot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is someone there? (gasps and dials her phone) Stacy, I know you're gonna think this is crazy, but I honestly think something is in the room with me. Have you ever been in a situation where your whole body, like, senses a presence? Like, you can't see it, but it's, like...it's, like, right next to...you? (Zoom out to reveal the Ducky Momo doll on the arm of the couch. The doll quacks and stretches his arms out. Candace screams and runs off.) Upstairs! The only logical escape! (Candace runs upstairs but gets her ankle caught in a curtain. The doll approaches the stairs quacking. Candace screams and bites the curtain off. The doll climbs up the stairs. Candace frees herself from the curtain, hides behind a wall and dials her phone.) Stacy, you gotta help me! The spell from that weird book worked! Ducky Momo is alive and he's trying to get me!! No, he's downstairs. He—Would you stop laughing? Yes, you are! I can hear the milk shooting out of your nose! (She looks behind her and sees the doll and yells, dropping her phone.) My phone! (The phone lands by the doll's webbed feet. It ends the call.) Back! Stay back! Ah! (Takes down a picture) Stay away from me! (Takes down a poster and crumples it up.) You stay away! I'm serious! Uh! (She slides a table across the hall.) Oh, come on! (The doll sees the crumpled poster on the floor and walks around it.) No! He's unstoppable! (Cut to Candace pulling on her bedroom door handle.) Come on! Open! Open! Open! Oh, yeah. It's an innie. (Pushes the door open and pants.) Keep it together, Candace, think! Think think think! Block the door! Block the door! (She blocks the door with everything but the kitchen sink. She then pulls up the doll and screams and hides under her bed.) I didn't really mean to wish you to life! I was just goofing around! I don't understand! What do you want?! (The doll jumps on the bed, reaches out his arms and quacks.) Huh? It almost looks like you want a...a hug. (The doll jumps up and down excitedly.) Seriously? You just want a hug? Well, okay. (Hugs the doll.) But I don't get it. If the incantation made you alive, then the moonlight should've made you evil. (The doll shakes his head quacking and points out the window.) What? What? Oh, the moon was behind the clouds, so you're not evil. (The clouds uncover the full moon shining on Mr. Miggins, who comes to life and roars evilly.) But now Mr. Miggins is!! AAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Night of the Giant Floating Baby Head

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Ah, you have returned for more. (Throws away the olive.) Our second story starts upon a dark and stormy night, where a platypus will soon show an evil scientist that every wish has a twist and the wisher might not wish for what he wished. Mwa..Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, if I wasn't so hungry, this would be horrifying. (Perry is surrounded by several strands of shredded cheeses.) Well, you may have shredded it, but you haven't stopped it! (The shreds all come at Perry. Doofenshmirtz laughs evilly. Perry then kneels down and begins eating the shreds.) Oh, I see. I don't know how I forgot that cheese is edible. By the way, I believe you're over the five-second rule there, Perry the Platy— (Perry flings himself at Doofenshmirtz's head.) Ow! Well, I hope you didn't leave room for crackers! Crackers, go get 'im! (A cabinet opens and several boxes of oyster crackers fly out.) Why do I have six boxes of oyster crackers? Must've been on sale. (The boxes open and fire crackers at Perry.) Eh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus, but let's see how you do against the hard stuff. Parmesan, give 'im a taste of your crystalline texture.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, so you beat up a bunch of snacks. Big deal. But you forget, Perry the Platypus, I still have one wish left and I've learned from my past two mistakes. I'm going to do this one right! You know what it is I want, Perry the Platypus? I want to be the biggest ruler of the...What? Oh, you're right. I say "ruler" and I could end up being like a big wooden yardstick or something. G-Good catch. Good, good catch, Perry the Platypus. Let me rephrase that. I want to be, specifically, the monarch of—No, no. No, you're right, that's a butterfly. Well, how about, the super-inten—no, no. Wait, wait, I know! I wish to be the head of the Tri-State Area! Oh, shoot, I just heard that!

Name: Giant Floating Doofy Head
Dialog: Yep. Yep, I'm a head. A big old head, Perry the Platypus. That's what I wished for. (Perry leaves.) Where're you goin'? So what? I don't need your help! That's right! Just walk away,(Agent P walks to the door. He opens the door and leaves with a smiling) Perry the Platypus! Oh, you're giving me the smirk face! Nice, fine! Maybe I like being a giant head, huh? Uh, oh. Uhp, I have to itch my nose! Oh, no! I can't...Ah...AH-CHOO! (The Giant Floating Doofy Head's sneeze causes him to crash into the computer. An inexplicable cat screech is heard.) Ow! Curse you, Perry the Platypus, and you, too, you Giant inexplicable Floating Baby Head!! (Thunder and lightning) Ah, knock it off!

Name: Giant Floating Doofy Head
Dialog: Invasion of the Evil Platypus Clones

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: At dot dot dot, "funny what?", add the picture and...(notices the viewer) Ah! Back from the commercial, are we? (picks up the book) Shall I continue, hmm? The final grim installment in our Terrifying Tri-State Trilogy of Terror takes place in an unassuming suburban backyard, where five happy campers and their platypus discover they may not know what they're going to do today.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Suddenly, from out of the shadows, (making a shadow puppet) the zombie bunny rabbit appeared and then he...ate up all the marshmallows!!! Numnumnumnumnumnunmnum!!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Remember, those marshmallows are for everyone!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Zombie bunny don't care!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, it's my turn to tell a scary story.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh! What's it gonna be? Suspense, stalker, horror, action adventure, or my personal favorite, the campy costume alien teen romance comedy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, let's see what's in this weird book. "Make a Doll Come Alive," "How to Get Three Wishes," "Giant Floating Rest of Baby"...Hey, check it out! It says here you have to be careful not to spill grape juice on a platypus, or it will make an evil platypus clone. I'm not really sure why anyone would—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Keep readin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, stop! (dries Perry off with a towel and bundles him like a baby) Aw, poor little guy. Buford, you shouldn't pour anything on a platypus!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) I just wanted to see what would happen.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (unbundling Perry) Well, he's dry, but now he's purple. (The purple stain jumps off of Perry and creates a purple platypus.) Whoa!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Cool! It actually worked! (sticking a finger out) Who's my little platypus clone? (The clone snarls at Buford.) What was that all about?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What part of "evil clone" are you not getting?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Obviously, the "evil" part.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I say we take off and nuke the entire site from orbit! It's the only way to be sure.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Cheese and crackers!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no! Look! They are using our grape juice box to make more!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, this is such a Halloween thing to happen in the middle of summer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are we gonna do, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have to contain these duplicating evil platypuses somehow. (paces) Uh, we could build a vacuum that attracts only platypus fur. No, no, then Perry would be in danger. Uh, maybe an alpha-ray grid to...No, no...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (aside to Baljeet) I can smell his brain workin'.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, sure, blame it on Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I dunno, gang. I'm kinda stumped on this one.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fear not! I know someone who can help us! Follow me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it, Baljeet. Where are we going?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whenever I need counsel on a problem, I go to my life coach.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Life coach?! I am so hurt!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (ringing the doorbell) Buford, this man is the embodiment of pure thought and wisdom.

Name: Cowboy
Dialog: Well, well, if'n it ain't Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Everyone, this is Rusty Britches. Rusty, this is everyone.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, I'm right pleased to meet you kids!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wha...Howdy?

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, don't just stand there with your hair on your head and your socks tucked into your boots, come on in!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thank you for the lemonade, Rusty.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: You're surely welcome! Now, what can I do you for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If I may, Mr. Britches, the city's been overrun by evil platypuses and we can't figure out how to get rid of 'em.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, that's a real beehive in your well water. Lemme get my thinkin' bench. (He walks off and a loud creaking noise is heard. He comes back and drags a bench across the floor. He puts one boot on it.) Well, it's like old Pap used to say, "When your horse starts drawin' a bath instead of a wagon, it's time to change the welcome mat."

Name: Buford
Dialog: Does anyone else get the feelin' we're really takin' our time with this thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look, Rusty, we really appreciate your colloquial prairie wisdom, but I think we have to move along before things get worse out there.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Well, I reckon you know best. It was right fine to meet you... (His foot accidentally tips the lemonade glass on the bench over.) Aw, cheese and crackers! (He gets out a small brush and cleans up the spilt lemonade.) This is supposed to be for cleanin' boats, but sometimes, ya gotta wash with the wrong brush to get a colt to the chaparral.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wash? Brush?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Chaparral?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! You're a genius, Mr. Britches!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Aw, shucks. I'm just a simple cowboy life coach.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So since the evil platypuses are made out of grape juice stains and dark magic, these high-powered bubble washers oughta do the trick. Okay, suds up, people! We're goin' platy-scrubbin'!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: (picking up a guitar) Hey, Phineas, how 'bout some good ol', down-home, granny-slappin', platy-scrubbin' musical accompaniment?

Name: All
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, hey hey hey! What the heck, man?! Ya bringin' us down!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's really...a good song, but, uh...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Maybe you could play something a little more, you know, up-tempo.

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Oh, right! Gotcha!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Rusty!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: G'wan without me! It's like I always say, "You gotta..." (Before he can finish his saying, the platypuses pinch his nose and pull him down.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This doesn't look too good, Ferb! Everybody retreat to that factory!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no, guys! This is a grape juice box factory!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How terrifyingly specific!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Run!!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There's too many of them! PHINEAS!! (The platypuses attack Isabella and Baljeet.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella!! (Phineas runs back, but gets attacked.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gettin' tired of runnin' from these jerks! (The platypuses attack Buford and Ferb.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (voiceover) And so our heroes were ripped to shreds...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...and left to die.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait a minute! That was a pretty grim ending, don't you think?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Talk about your unlightful endings.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: He means "delightful" and he means the opposite of that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, okay. I'll give you the Hollywood ending.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I have a plan. Everyone keep your eye out for the sprinkler system supply housing.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: There it is!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you, Baljeet, and Buford hold them back while we get the soap into the sprinkler system!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You better hurry, Phineas!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There are too many of them!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no! The manual override is way up there! There's no way I can reach it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, guys, I'm out!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am out, too!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What are we gonna do?!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Yeehaw!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look, everyone! It's Baljeet's cowboy life coach! On a unicorn! Straining all credulity, he has come to save us!

Name: Rusty
Dialog: Soap's on, little tykes!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Rusty, you did it! They are all melting away!

Name: Grape Juice Cop
Dialog: You've saved my factory!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Look, everyone! It is Officer Concord the Juice Time Juice Box Flavor Cop!

Name: Officer Concord
Dialog: Well done, everyone! Let's dance!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa...whoa...whoa.....whoa!! Totally unbelievable!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Which part? The unicorn or Officer Concord the Juice Time Juice Box Flavor Cop?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah. The cowboy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You do not believe in cowboys?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Have you ever seen one in real life?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Epilogue

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: So, you see, if I had a Macabre Book Mobile, those are the kinds of things that could happen.

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: I'm gonna be blunt, Mr. Macabre...

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: It's Macabré.

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: Mr. Macabré, I'm not gonna give ya a loan to buy a Macabre Book Mobile.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: And why not?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: You have no detailed records of assets, no inventory, nothing you could use as collateral. Your stories don't even make sense! It's a bad business proposition.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: What if I were to say, "Please"?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: That's not gonna work.

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Please?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: Get out!

Name: Mr. Macabre
Dialog: Pretty please with a cherry on top?

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: A cherry, huh? Okay, but it is the last loan I am giving you.

Name: Bank Officer
Dialog: OW! (trips and falls over) Dangit!! Ah! I'm alright! You go ahead and read the credits. I...I'll just wait down here. (beat) Kinda nice down here, actually. There's a...There's a dandelion. It's all puffy and ready to go. Here ya go. (Blows, and the dandelion seeds float away.) Logo oughta be comin' up any minute. (Cue the logo.) There it is!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, guys, now you try it. (Isabella jumps over a hydrant on her skateboard.) Nice! (Baljeet does it next.) Very smooth, Baljeet! (A skateboard with no rider bumps into the hydrant.) What's the problem, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, you know, the sun was in my eyes.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford, what's with the lack of effort?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm just tryin' to be careful.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we're outta credit at the emergency room. My mom said if I break one more bone, she's gonna break the rest of them! Fairly sure that was hyperbole, besides, look how hard that hydrant is!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, maybe we could make our own fire hydrants out of soft foam rubber.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, that's a great idea! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Seriously? That's it? A soft fire plug?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah, attached to a giant revolving treadmill with a giant soft neighborhood containing soft obstacles.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oh, yeah, okay.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Where is Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What did you say?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I was just asking where Perry is.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What did you think I said?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, well, I thought you said...uh...nevermind. It was too weird.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ooh, ooh, oh, get it off! G-Get it off! Ooh! Uh, just walked through a spiderweb. Don't you just hate that? Ya spend the rest of the day worried there's a spider on ya. (shudders) Gives me the willies. Anyhoo, our sources tell us there's a cowboy hat in front of Doof's building. Normally, that wouldn't be of any interest to us, since this is the week of the Danville Hootenanny, but it is a rather large hat and, in spite of its name, the Danville Hootenanny is a dignified affair. I wish I had more information, but Carl said there was a big bee by the surveillance equipment. So get out there, Agent P! Ooh! Carl, is there... (turns around revealing a huge tarantula on his back) is there a spider on my head?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) No, sir. There's no spider...on your head.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: Meanwhile, at the Danville Space Laboratory...

Name: Sign Painter
Dialog: Laboratory?! (makes angry noises, throws his hat to the ground and stomps on it)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Jack, it sure was nice of you to show Candace and me around. This satellite stuff is very interesting.

Name: Jack
Dialog: No problem, Linda. I'm flattered you'd be interested in our humble facility, considering your background in astrophysics.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, yeah, uh, listen, that's kind of a secret, so don't—

Name: Jack
Dialog: Oh, I'm sorry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what does your father do here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, he's part of a team that makes and manages recognizant satellites. They actually had a couple of rovers on Mars earlier this summer. But they suddenly stopped working. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (nervously) Uh, how would I...heh heh...what do you mean? Heh heh.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: All right...Your Highness.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasp) Who told?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Stacy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Perry the Platypus, I bet you're wondering why I'm cowering outside my lab. Well, day started like any other day. You know, "how am I going to take over the Tri-State Area?" But I suddenly remembered a movie that I saw long ago at a drive-in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) It was called Night of the Felis. I knew right away that the old masters were onto something. Imagine taking something cute and enlargening it to frightening proportions. Brilliant! But in order to take over the Tri-State Area, I had to study with some other types of small animals, preferably, something that could fly. And I vowed to get right to work...as soon as the movie was over. The first thing I needed to do was create an inator that would make things larger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Eh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I tried it out on my cowboy hat. It was a success! My ten-gallon hat had turned into a 2,000-gallon-hat!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Whoa! (crash!) Well, that's the end of that hat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Next, I had to genetically modify a mouse so it could fly.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Then I decided it would be easier to just use a bat. So I ordered a retired stunt-bat from a low-budget bat circus that had recently gone belly-up. You know...the economy. I was on the precipice of Tri-State Area domination. At last, I had the ultimate creepy soldier! (Derek the bat squeaks) And then I remembered, I had a very mild phobia of bats.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Aaaah!!! Get away get away get away!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I also had a mild phobia of shellfish.

Name: Waitress
Dialog: (in flashback, offscreen) Here's your order, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback, offscreen) Aaaah!!! Get away get away get away!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) But bats are worse.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Scram, you flying gerbil! (Derek squeaks) Amscray! (Derek squeaks) You're making me miss the hootenanny!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (in flashback) Sir, I found your radio. It was embedded in the dashboard of your car.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Norm, don't just stand there! Do something about this bat! (The radio is thrown, and misses.) Really? That's your solution? Throw a radio at it? Whoa whoa! (cut to Norm about to throw a crowbar) Don't throw that! That's imitatable.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (in flashback, picking up the inator) What if I hit it with this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) No no! Don't shoot it with that! That's my—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) And I thought the bat was scary before when he was...tiny.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was at that point that Norm and I decided to come out here. Plus the bat kinda looks like my cousin, Narthelliot, which, as you can imagine is weird for me. Isn't that about right, Norm?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (crashed through a hole in the wall) It's even more horrible than it looks!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everybody got their helmets and boards?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm ready!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am ready!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, fire it up! We're going to Foamtown!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woo! Woohoo! Yeah!

Name: Jack
Dialog: And over here are the models of our robotically-operated rovers

Name: Candace
Dialog: You sent a rover to Ireland?

Name: Jack
Dialog: Well, we had to test it somewhere.

Name: Jack
Dialog: It took a couple of months, but we're finally starting to get some really great pictures back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you for the blanket, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa? Oh, no! Vanessa, get out of there! (Crawling inside) There's a huge bat on the loose!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really? (Sees Derek shrieking.) Wow, cool! It looks like your cousin, Narthelliot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No sudden movements or loud noises, Vanessa!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, relax. It's just a bat. They just eat bugs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But it's a very big bat!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Now, come on. J-Just stand up. It's time to face your fear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, okay. (Derek snarls at Doofenshmirtz and grabs him in his mouth.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (hitting Derek) No no no! Bad bat! Spit him out!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, gross! (Derek grabs Doofenshmirtz with his feet and flies away.) Oh, yeah, this is much better!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad!! Oh, hey, Perry. I was wondering if you could help me. (Perry grabs his jetpack and activates it.) Thanks, Perry. You're a peach.

Name: Bat-Looking Man
Dialog: So, what'd I miss?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, hey, Narthelliot! We were just talking about you.

Name: Jack
Dialog: Of course, even better than using a rover, we have these. We call them global surveillance satellites. No matter where you are on Earth, there's always one of these flying above you in orbit, streaming live video to us here.

Name: Woman at Monitor
Dialog: That's right. Here's the outside of our building right now. And we can look up any location instantly. The Eiffel Tower, the Taj Mahal...

Name: Linda
Dialog: So you could look down on anybody's backyard and see what they're doing?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Pretty cool, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, that's gotta be handy for something.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And three...two...one... (points to Candace in anticipation of her busting idea)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Really? Alright.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa! Oh, I get it! This is what it does! Flying through a hoop! That's what I get...for buying a bat...from a defunct...bat circus!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, having fun yet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, you know I am. (Sips her drink)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You know, my dad goes on and on about the cafeteria here, and I think he's right. This food is...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (does a spit take and gasps) I've got an idea! My brothers are probably building something in our backyard right now, and we can use the surveillance satellite to catch them doing it! (runs off) Come on!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I was wondering how long that would take.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just lemme punch in my address... (The backyard and Foamtown appears onscreen.) Omigosh, I knew it! Look at that thing!!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow! What is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: it's an eye-in-the-sky bust! Come on, let's go get my mom! (they walk off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, turn it off. Let's take a little break. (Ferb pulls the lever and the wheel stops rolling. Buford falls off of the wheel landing on his back.) You okay, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm havin' the time of my life! Is anybody else hungry?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I am!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon! Let's go see what's in the kitchen. (The gang jump off the wheel.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Oh no no no! Not again!!! (bang!) Ow, my head! (bang!) Ow, my head again! (bang!) Ow! Now I forgot math! (bang!) Ow! There goes social studies! (bang!) Oh, good, they're back! (Doofenshmirtz's head crashes into the giant bolt revealing the cogs, which loosen and cause Foamtown to roll away.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: This way, Mom! (motions toward the screen) See for yourself!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, wow! It's our house! (the screen shows the empty backyard and the kids) And you can see the boys! And their little skateboards! (waves) Hi, boys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: They can't hear you, you know.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I know. (keeps waving) Hi! Whoo-hoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Foamtown's gone.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You say that like it doesn't happen every day.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And you say that like an angry old prospector.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What does that even mean?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (walks away) I stand by that metaphor.

Name: Old Coot
Dialog: Finally, Daisy, we're here. Our new home! Lotsa elbow room and no one to bother us! The last frontier! A place where a man and his donkey can— (Foamtown unravels.) Dangit! Come on, Daisy, we're headin' west.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, welcome to St. Louis! Now do something about this bat, please! (Perry shoots the inator at Derek and it shrinks back to its original size, leaving Doofensmirtz hanging in midair, then falling.) Aah!! Well, at least I lost my fear of bats!! (Doofenshmirtz crashlands into a shellfish restaurant.)

Name: Waitress
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, it's you again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Aaaah!! Go away go away go away!!!

Name: Waitress
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, just stop it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) I'm totally sunk, Stace! I've been working on Jeremy's birthday present for months, but it's not even close to as good as I want it to be. (Cut to reveal she's working on a popup book showing their first kiss.) Ugh! Lame!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, come on, Candace. You're overthinking this. (The cashier puts a watermelon on the tread.) Jeremy'll love anything you make. What's your worry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just wanna do something really special to show Jeremy how much I care. Something way over the top! Something that defies the laws of physics and excedes the boundaries of the imaginatio— (realizes what she's talking about) Oh no.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, yes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No no no no no! Anything but that!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're going to have to ask for help from...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb. (Puts her head in her hand like she has a migraine.) Uggggh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, now that we've ironed out the bugs in our fusion-powered popper, the popcorn is nice and fluffy...and no longer glowing, so we're good to go. (Candace comes in mumbling under her breath.) Uh, what's that, Candace?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Lemme talk to her, guys. I speak sullen.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Candace messed up and now Jeremy's birthday is ruined.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey!! You completely misinterpreted what I said!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nuance.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So what's goin' on, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) It's Jeremy's birthday and I wanna do something really special to show I care and you guys are good at doing, you know, what you do, and, well, all I have is this scrapbook and I don't wanna blow it so can you help me, huh? (gives Phineas the book)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! This is great! It's like a blueprint! Ferb, I know what else we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! Start workin' your magic and, no pressure, but it's gotta be PERFECT!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'll do our best!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mumbling) Thnk yu.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh. She said, "Where's Perry?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: You have got to work on your sullen!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, there, Agent P! Well, it's Horrific Movie Night at my house where a bunch of agency guys get together and make fun of ridiculously bad movies.

Name: Carl
Dialog: He's always the guy shushing everybody.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, there's a time for fun and a time to pay attention.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Pfft.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Agent P, when we went to rent tonight's horrific horror classic, Night of the Living Torso, it was already gone. In fact, all the movies within the horror genre throughout Danville have been checked out, which is definitely a bummer, and could possibly be evil. Go check on Doof and see if he's bogarting those movies...uh, before 6

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I'm headed out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (trying to not sound suspicious) Okay, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What's with the box?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, uh, nothing. I just wanted to see what this stuff looked like outside.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, is this a ploy to get me to go outside to see what the boys are up to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No!! Er, I mean, uh, no need. (pushing her mom out) Just go out and, uh, feel free to stay for a while. Stay out all afternoon in fact. Heh-heh, heh.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Reverse psychology. Nice try, hon. Glad to see you changing it up. See ya later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So here's all the Jeremobilia I could find. (gives the box to Phineas) Now what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! (Ferb gives Candace a camera) Now just go around town and take pictures of all the Jeremy-related places and things you can. The camera will transmit them back to us to incorporate into our mega-interactive scrapbook-aganaza.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problemo! Candace is on field duty, peace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm sorry, were you gonna say something? (Isabella shrugs.) Okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs, pauses the movie) Isn't that always the way? Right at the exciting part, that's when the doorbell rings...or, y'know, a platypus breaks it down. Anyway, behold the Worst-Fear-inator! (pause) What? (Doof tilts his head. POV shot from Doof as he sees the popcorn cart is blocking the inator.) Oh, yeah, I-I guess from your point of view, it's a little difficult to see. Lemme just get this outta the way for you. (He pushes the popcorn out out of the way.) There we go. Now, in my never-ending pursuit of domination, I discovered that the best evil rulers used fear to keep people in line. So to get into the right headspace, I did what any logical evil scientist would do

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Once I was terrified, I was able to analyze the fear-based synapses of the brain and extrapolate some wonderful data!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Basically, I shoot someone with the machine, and whatever they are afraid of actually appears...in real life! Whadaya say, Perry the Platypus? Ya like being a guinea pig? Actually, you'd look kinda cute as a guinea pig. I mean, I wonder if you'd be teal. I bet you would. I bet you'd be a cute little teal guinea pig. Something to think about for the future. Anyway, Perry the Platypus, let's fire this baby up and see what scares you. (He presses the button activating the inator.) 'Cause, y'know, it's gonna materialize right over there. (A green beam hits Perry.) Alright, so what are you afraid of, where is it? (looks around) What the hay? Nothing? (A business card slips through the ropes. Doof takes the card and reads it.) "Perry the Platypus

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, score! That awning is the same color as Jeremy's eyes! (snaps the photo) Aaaand...daffodils! Just like the ones he gave me on our third date! (Snaps the flower.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Incoming. Perfect! Same color as Jeremy's eyes! Huh, flower. I'm drawin' a blank.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Daffodil, third date.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Riiiight...Now the machine will take the images, and print them into giant scaled-up form.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nice touch! Smells like my grandma!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought your grandma smelled like ant pheromones.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Naw, that's the other one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These should really make Jeremy's Birthday Scrapbook-aganza a full sensory experience!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sarcastically) Great, just what I always wanted

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, what else? Ah! (She walks up to a couple drinking outside a French café. She takes the man's mug.) 'Scuse. Hot cocoa! (Snaps the mug and sips.) Not bad, although Jeremy prefers it with a little more cinnamon. (Walks away.) I gotta make a note of that for the boys.

Name: Man
Dialog: I guess my fortune came true. "You will share your cocoa with a long-necked teenager." See? Right there.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Mine just says, "Your boyfriend's gonna get a fortune cookie at a French café."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get ready, Perry the Platypus! The Tri-State Area's about to confront its fears! (Evil laughter from Doof. Another business card with mechanical arms and legs slips through the rope and crawls up to Perry's tail. A laser beam shoots through the robot and burns the rope down, freeing Perry. He kicks Doof.) Aaah! Ow ow! I landed on my jawbone, right under that weird...sticky-outy part under your ear! And my jawbone landed on the remote. Ah, Doof. (The inator activates and shoots Doof.) Okay, nothing bad will happen as long as I don't think about anything scary or... (A pounding on the door is heard.) Oh no! I couldn't help it, it just popped in there! It can't be! (The door breaks down revealing evil vending machine robots.) Vending machines are taking over! I said it could happen! No! Stay back! Stay back! Back! Flee! Flee! (Doof attempts to escape, but the vending machines grab hold of him.) No no no no! I'm not really hungry! Really! (Stutters) No no, not the tiny vanilla cookies! How long have those been in there?! (The machines force feed Doof a packet of vanilla cookies.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, the scrapbook-aganza is complete! Plus, we got Love Händel to come in for a live soundtrack!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Okay, guys, performance level! (Strums the intro)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm gonna need a test run so I can make notes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. You're the boss.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That sounded great guys, but it's a B-natural in the chorus!

Name: Danny
Dialog: Toldja!

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: That's what I was playing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) No! No! Not that! Anything but the fake red licorice! It tastes like... (Doof grunts. Perry stops walking and figures he has to save Doof.) No! What possessed me to make such a horrifying inator?! (Perry jumps on the DVDs and hops onto the inator aiming it. He lands on the floor and hits the remote. The inator hits the vending machines. A giant nickel rolls by and the machines run for their lives.) Well, I guess now we know what scares vending machines.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Candace, do you think Jeremy will like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (seriously) Yeah, I just have a few notes here. (Excitedly, as she reveals she drew a smiley face on the clipboard.) It's perfect! (gasps) I love it, guys! Iloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveit...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Ferb) She had me at "smiley face".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you're back! (walking up to the inator) I am never setting that puppy off again. (He presses a button, and, as usual, the inator activates and aims across town.) Oops.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's really perfect! (The beam hits Candace.) I'm glad Mom's gone for the day 'cause my biggest fear is that this is just gonna fly away before Jeremy gets here. (car horn honks, Candace gasps) And there he is! (runs off) Woohoo!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, did anyone else see that weird green beam?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I wasn't gonna mention it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!! Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy!!! You gotta see what the boys built in the backyard!!! (drags him)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs up) No no no! No no!! It's gone! My worst fear has come true! I totally blew it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Let me guess, you had your brothers build me something super cool for my birthday and now it disappeared. It's okay, I get it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have the invention anymore, but here's what we used as a blueprint. Candace designed it herself.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oops. I really meant to hit the self-destruct button. I'll just get this for you. (Kaboom!) So, uh, you need your parking validated or, uh... Oh, oh, you found a spot on the street! Huh! Lucky you! Curse you, Perry the Platypus and all that! You know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you've been awfully quiet all day.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (looks at her watch) I have just earned my 24 Hours of Silence Patch! I can see why you don't talk much, Ferb. I actually quite enjoyed it. I ended up having an inner dialogue with myself all day.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Welcome to Ferbland.

Name: Ferb head #1
Dialog: Yes, the universe is constantly expanding.

Name: Ferb head #2
Dialog: But what is it expanding into?

Name: Ferb heads
Dialog: Ooooooh...

Name: Ferb head #3
Dialog: Okay, now my mind is blown.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What've we got so far?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I've got a bottle cap and a brass nail.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Two bottle caps and a nail.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A washer, a hinge and a nail.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I've got a nickel and a piece of brass! No, wait, it's a nail.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: You never know what you're going to find.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I do, another nail.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Or a bottle cap.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Walking into the backyard) Hi Phineas, What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're looking for stuff with Dad's steam-powered metal detector.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow. An antique that locates other antiques.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The steam-powered metal detector goes off)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, we've got another one!.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ooh! Let me dig it up.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Of, course, let me put this down.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (As he digs) Wait! It's not a nail. It's a coin.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, let's have a look then. Oh, yes. I've seen this before. It's a commemorative coin from the nineteen hundred and three Danville World's Fair. Many steam-driven devices were introduced to the world back then. It must have been quite an event...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Step in closer, I've got so much to show you.

Name: Professor Elemental
Dialog: You there sir. Yes you there, with the excellent hat, and that hand. You're clearly a man of taste. Step up here would you? Take a look at this marvelous machine.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. The future's gonna be amazing. Flying machines. Household electrification. Steam-powered submarines.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Personally, I'm looking forward to cheese that comes in aerosol cans.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Still hard at work, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (With his steam-powered metal detector) Well, hello there, my young fellows.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Find anything good yet?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, just dome old civil war coins.

Name: Voice from the Civil War Coin
Dialog: The Union assaults against the Sunken Road eventually pierced the Confederate center, but the Federal advantage was not followed–

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, dad. I'm sorry, we've got uh, chores to do.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh yes, yes. Go ahead, boys. Don't let me stop you.

Name: Voice from the Civil War Coin
Dialog: As I was saying. In th–

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, Candace, we were thinking about a way to do our chores using modern steam technology. We learned all about it at the world's fair.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh did you now? Well if I didn't have to haul water, sweep the barn, collect eggs, spin a quilt, and do whatever this is; I'd tell mom. (She walks off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder if she knows those buckets have holes in them.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hello, boys. We would like to inquire as to what you are doing at this moment.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, as we were just telling Candace, we were just about to create a steam-powered machine that will help with our- Hey, where's Sweary?

Name: Sweary
Dialog: Honk! Honk!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Found 'im! Found 'im!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Sweary the Swan!

Name: Sweary
Dialog: Honk!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Man, that pet of yours gives me the creeps.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on Buford. you know swans don't do much.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't do much? The big bite on my butt begs to differ!

Name: Major Megaburns
Dialog: Good morning Agent S. This is Major Megaburns. Your arch-enemy, Professor Von Doofenshmirtz, has been spotted creating something evil in his laboratory. Go check it out.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Perhaps Sweary would want to try my new steam-powered jetpack. It's very heavy and full of boiling hot water.

Name: Megaburns
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute. How come your zoetrope image is so much cooler than mine?

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's not "cooler" sir. It's just got more frames.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Talks loudly) Ah, Sweary the Swan, how completely unforeseen is your -- Uh, hang on a second. (turns off a large machine behind him) Ah, that's better. Sweary the Swan, how completely unforeseen is your presence here, and by that, I mean, completely foreseen! (Sweary attempts to bite von Doofenshmirtz) Hey! No bites. I've got a little something for you.

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: Well, hello there.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Allow me to introduce to you my sidekick, Pneumatic Pnorman. And both of those are spelt with a "P". You know, the... The "P's" are silent. I don't even now why they put them in there, if they're not gonna pronounce it. It's just a waste of a good letter. That's what it is. But, I babble. Back on topic.

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: Shall I put this cucumber in the salad, sir?

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's not a cucumber Pnorm. I'm sorry about that, Sweary, he has problems identifying objects. Pnorm, that's a swan, and we're going to tie him to the railroad tracks.

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: How melodramatic.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! Do you preen your feathers with that mouth? They should call you Sw- Oh! Oh, I get it. Swear-y the Swan.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, we're all set, Ferb, start her up! (Ferb pulls a lever, and the chore doing machine begins work.)

Name: Phineas (cont'd)
Dialog: Shuck the corn. Milk the cows.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mend the fences.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Lastly, plow and seed the field.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I feel like I've been carrying these buckets all summer. I'll never get to the fair in time to meet Jeremy. (She hears Phineas and Ferb's machine from behind)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that a steam-powered chore doing device?! You are so going to get it! Get back here you steam-punk!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry Candace, it won't stop 'till we run out of coal!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I shall go fetch Mother! (drops her milk buckets and runs off) Ma!

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sweary the Swan, did you know that the world's fair is in town? They have all of this amazing, new technology. Here, look. It's all represented here, on this commemorative coin– (Sweary the Swan bite's Von Doofenshmirtz's thumb) Ow! Now look what you did! You made me drop it. Pnorman, go find that coin.

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: It's probably right at your feet, sir. I can't bend over without pulling my axle out of alignment.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, whatever, think of something. Anyway, like I was saying before you bit my thumb, down at the fair they have all these neat, new steam-powered gizmos that they plan to use for "progress." Normally I wouldn't mind, but they're also attaching a lot of "hope" and "optimism" to progress. And that is something I will not put up with. So I've built a big, monster machine to smash their world's fair to bits! Behold! It's an evil swan! (von Doofenshmirtz reviles his machine) It's a- it's a big swan. It's like you, but, you know, bigger, and hammer-y-er. It's got more hammers than you do. Plus, it runs on the new technology of steam!

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: (Returning with Vanessa in his arms) Sir, I found your coin.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's not a coin. That's my daughter, you dolt!

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: No wonder she wouldn't fit in the gum ball machine.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You hear that Sweary the Swan? That is the sound of–

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Von Doofenshmirtz is cut off by a whistle of steam coming from his evil swan) ... aerosol cheese!

Name: Pnorman
Dialog: We didn't hear what you said!

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (In another steam whistle) Oh for Pete's sake!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Ma!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Churning butter) Oh, these new gadgets are so complicated. Up and down, and up and down, and up–

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs up to her) Ma! Ma Ma! The boys! Machine to do their chores! Not fair!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sarcastically) Oh my. That sound exciting. I'll come have a look, as soon as I'm done doing, whatever this is.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I don't believe it. A fuzzy doll in the shape of a bear? It's the end of decency.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: You didn't believe in me or anthropomorphism.

Name: Man
Dialog: (Running away) Everyone run! It's a big, hammer-y swan!

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! Soon you will all see the power of my– (He is drowned out by another whistle of steam)

Name: Man 2
Dialog: We can't here you!

Name: Auguste Lumière
Dialog: Look! A huge, rampaging, steam-powered, hammer-y swan! If only there was a way we could record this event!

Name: Louis Lumière
Dialog: Auguste! You have just invented the moving picture documentary! Quickly, mood music!

Name: Farmer
Dialog: This sure is a lot of shucked corn, and fresh milk.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All in an afternoon's work.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: Aren't you a bit young to be industrial revolutionaries?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes, we are.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: As a simple farmer from a bygone age, that's good enough for me. Alright Spartacus, let's get these good to market, and then it's back to the bookcase for ye'. (Spartacus the horse whinnies, and the two of them leave)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All our chores are done and it's still light out. What else do you guys wanna do today?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We could drink lemonade and sit on the porch.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We can go to Panama and start diggin'.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We could formally begin courting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nothing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Showing Linda) They built a giant machine that does their chores. It shucks the corn, and it shoots seeds out of a gatling gu– (She stops, seeing that machine is no longer there) But, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, it's 1903. We do not use that word.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To the Lumière brothers) No, no, you're not getting my best side. But here, let me show you my worst side! (von Doofenshmirtz's swan eats the camera and Louis with it) What? Sweary the Swan! (Sweary the Swan shows up, driving Phineas and Ferb's chore doing machine directly at Von Doofenshmirtz) Ah, you want to play swan chicken, ah? (Sweary rams into von Doofenshmirtz, then backs up for another go) Oh no, get back here! (Sweary uses the chore doing machine to shuck corn into von Doofenshmirtz's robot) Oh no! He's using the old quad maneuver.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Von Doofenshmirtz's swan lifts off and then explodes) Curse you, Sweary the Swan!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And that's the way it was at the Danville world's fair.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A giant steam-powered hammering swan? Come on, Dad, that sounds a little far-fetched for the time period, doesn't it?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes. Yes, it does.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, how long was I up there?

Name: (Song
Dialog: "Professor Elemental Future Past)"

Name: Danny Jacob
Dialog: Dude, somebody's gotta play it, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, universe? If you're gonna give me practically unbustable brothers, you could have at least made them not morning people. Yeah, I see ya down there. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry you had to pull that all-nighter, but we really appreciate you filling in for Agent Q. With most everyone at Agent-Con this week, we're, uh, a little shorthanded.

Name: Lyla
Dialog: Yet again, I am the only girl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has been experimenting with energy fields and it's starting to get dangerous. It knocked out our microwave oven. Get out there, Agent P, and right that ridiculous wrong. (Perry gets up and tiredly walks to his spy car. Monogram holds up a breakfast burrito on a plate.) This breakfast burrito is like a bean and cheese icicle except that it's larger and wrapped in a tortilla.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Phineas! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Isabella! You're just in time to help us build a zip-line tennis game across town for the ultimate game of sky tennis!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Or skennis for short.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now that you're here, we can play doubles for twice the fun!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll be the judge of that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perfect! 'Cause we need you to be the line judge.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Judge? Cool! Do I get one of those powdered wigs?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah, I'll do it anyway.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Woof! Woof! Intruder approaching! Woof! Woof, woof!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good boy! I love this new guard dog software. It's about time, Perry the Platypus. I was beginning to think you found another evil scientist to fight. Oop!

Name: Perry
Dialog: Zzzzzzzzzz...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, what a little angel. I'll just have to tell you my evil plan subliminally, like, like when people listen to foreign language CDs in their sleep. I did that once and now I can totally speak Portuguese to sleeping people. Anyway, recently, I was musing to myself about how lucky my brother, Roger, is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Luck is called "stinkelkrampen" in Drusselstein and it turns out I never have any of the good kind. Turns out that every object has a positive or negative energy field. I harness that positive and negative energy and created...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...the Stinkelkrampen-inator!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (yawns) Zzzzzzzzz...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shh shh shh shh shh. You see, what I'll do is I'll zap myself with good luck and then I'll go zap Roger with bad luck, then I will ascend to become the Mayor of Danville and then I will rule the ENTIRE TRI-STATE...

Name: Perry
Dialog: (yawns) Zzzzzzzzz...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I will rule the entire Tri-State Area. Aw, man, Norm, I told you, on the paper! On the paper! (Cut to reveal that Norm is drawing on the wall) Bad dog!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looking good, guys! All we need to do is hammer in this last nail and we'll be ready to go. (The gang gets zapped by the Stinkelkrampen-inator and the top of the hammer falls off.) Huh, that's odd. Glad I always carry a spare. (The hammer falls off and hits Ferb's shoe.) Whoa! Good thing you're wearing your steel-tip sneakers.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually, today I'm not. (beat) Ouch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that is how the bad luck setting works. Except, of course, I won't be shooting random blasts off the balcony. Now, check out the good luck settings. And, again, I won't be just shooting it off the balcony like this. (He shoots it.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Time to embark on my daily 500-brush-stroke marathon to manageable hair. (She gets zapped.) One...What the—? (Takes out a protractor to measure her hair.) A perfect 40º angle? (smiles) I can't believe it! A perfect hair day! I finally got my PHD!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (carrying pillows) Oh, that's wonderful, honey. Not a single day goes by when I don't appreciate my PHD.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's great, Dad, but I'm not talking about a degree.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, neither am I.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Time to take my perfect hair to a bust show. (Cut to downstairs. Her phone rings.) Hello? You're kidding! I won a random contest to sing backup for Love Händel at the Danville 24 Hour Music Awards?! Sweet! Perfect hair day? Backup singer for Love Händel? That could only mean... Wait. Lemme try one last thing. (Falls backwards. Wide shot to reveal she landed on two pillows. She gasps.) Pillows magically appear to break my fall! It's true! I'm finally having good luck!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I was using my PHD. My Pillow Hurling Dexterity.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meh. Still lucky. (gasp) I'll actually be able to bust Phineas and Ferb today! Oh, wait. Mom's at that weekend-long plant-potting retreat. (Her phone rings.) Hi, Mom! The seminar's over already?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, apparently, you just put some dirt in a pot. I don't know why I cleared my whole schedule.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! See you at four! (off the phone) Yes! Today is the day that I bust Phineas and Ferb! Woohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I just don't get it. Everything we try to do either falls apart, breaks, or somehow ends up backwards.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I know this goes completely against all logic and therefore makes it totally out of character for me to say, but I think you may have been cursed with bad luck.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gasp) Bad luck?!

Name: Danny Jacob
Dialog: Dude, I call 'em like I see 'em.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm, bad luck. That's a new one!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It happens. There's not much you can do about it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No! There is something we can do about it! If we can create algorithms to predict bad luck, we can make allowances for it and still have fun!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Just like the failsafe systems on space capsules or airplanes!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Exactly! We'll make having bad luck fun!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, it's time to go. Luck and cover. (He shoots himself with the inator and chuckles.) Good stinkelkrampen tickles! (gasp) Look, a penny! It's working! Aw, man, tails! Well, you know the rules, Heinz. Turn it over for the next person.

Name: Man
Dialog: I say, a lucky penny! Thanks for the flip, old bean. Here is a thousand dollars!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (squeals) It worked! Hee hee! Ooh, time to give Roger a dose of bad stinkelkrampen he'll never forget!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, team, all failsafe systems are in place. Go! Yeah!

Name: Sports Announcer #1
Dialog: What a great day for sky tennis, huh, Markus?

Name: Markus
Dialog: Or "skennis" as the locals call it, Mark.

Name: Mark
Dialog: (voiceover) Phineas and the gang have the ball in play so here we go!

Name: Markus
Dialog: (voiceover) Lob to Phineas and Ferb as Phineas sets up for a powerful return! Ooh, looks like Baljeet is set up perfectly for—

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: AAAAAAAAHHHH....

Name: Markus
Dialog: Oh no!

Name: Mark
Dialog: What rotten luck! Let's just hope Baljeet survives the fall. But Isabella is right there with the save!

Name: Markus
Dialog: (voiceover) And apparently, so is Baljeet. A beautiful airbag maneuver, Mark, which bounces him right back into the game.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Down you go, Perry the Sleepapus. (He turns on the ignition.) And away we go! (All the traffic lights turn green.) Sweet!

Name: Food Truck Lady
Dialog: Free samples?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes some) Thank you! Mmm, mmm, I could get used to this good luck thing. It's better than having a genie. That was a mistake.

Name: Wienershmirtz
Dialog: That wasn't a wish! It's just a song! It's not even a song! It's a jingle!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh. Y'ever try to sue a genie? Oh, you're asleep. W-Well, let's try to see what kind of tunes are on the FM dial.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while the song plays) Hey, I love this song! I guess I shouldn't be surprised at this point, but what the hey?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I love it when the song ends right as you reach your destination! Not to mention the free cans of almond brittle that I got during the chorus. (Cut to inside City Hall.) Well, hello, Roger.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Hello, Heinz. What can I do for you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, little brother, you have had nothing but good luck your whole life, and I'm here to even things up for once!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Oh, Heinz, the power of positive stinkelkrampen is the result of hard work, strong networking and thoughtful actions in matters both business and personal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pfft! I prefer to inator my way to success...just like I wrote in my book! Available in dollar bins everywhere!

Name: Mark
