Dialog: Now let's see what Ferb can do with Isabella's blistering smash. Wow! I've never seen a racket spontaneously become unstrung!

Name: Markus
Dialog: Ferb's shot is headed straight for Isabella and she...

Name: Mark
Dialog: (voiceover) Oh, that is a tough break! She's flying right past the gap. This is absolutely amazing!

Name: Janitor
Dialog: Hey, do you guys have a permit to do sports commentary on this roof?

Name: Markus
Dialog: We...totally have one.

Name: Mark
Dialog: We do.

Name: Markus
Dialog: (getting out of his chair)It's in the production truck downstairs.

Name: Mark
Dialog: (also getting out of his chair) Which totally exists. Let's get outta here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) I'm home!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I know you wanna drag me to the backyard right now, Candace, but can it wait until I repot my new plant?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen, sarcastically) No prob, Mom, Take your time.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oooookay....Uh, thanks, hon. I—Oof! (She bumps into a jacket and a fedora drops onto the potted plant revealing itself to be none other than Planty the Potted Plant himself!) Oh, how cute! My new plant looks like a little secret agent! Huh. How about you guard this alcove, Mr. Secret Agent Plant. (giggles)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Planty the Potted Plant, but apparently your cover's been blown. I'm afraid you'll have to be repotted with another family.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Roger, prepare to suffer the bad luck of the dra— (Roger gets up from his desk) Hey, hey, hey! Hey, wait! Wait a minute! You're s'posed to stay still for a good inatoring!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Aw, but I just realized I haven't said hello to your little platypus friend.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Careful. He gets a little testy if you wake him up from his nap too soo— (The floor creaks and Perry suddenly wakes up.) Uh oh.

Name: Roger
Dialog: Aw, yes. I'm not a morning person either.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great game, guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from below) Hello, brothers! (cut to her with a pie) I made you a pie...for your Bust Day!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that can't be right. (takes out a flyer) Bus Day isn't until next week. (Cut to the flyer which reads

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. Now my luck's gonna go back to normal...which is, of course, bad!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just take your time, it's not like the earth is gonna open up and s-wallow it, (chuckles, tosses pie in the air) not today! (splat!) Oof. (gasps) Oh no! That means... (runs into the house) MOOOOM!!! MOM MOM MOM MOM!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And right after Candace said that couldn't happen.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. That's borderline creepy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you still haven't explained why you're covered with pie.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, just come on, this will explain everything! A-bu-bu-wuh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A-bu-bu-bu-bu-bu-bu-bu...but...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, my luck may be back to normal buit at least I still have an entire trunk full of delicious almond brittle. (Opens a can and fake snakes pop out.) Ugh. Mental note

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Stace, feel like coming over for some pre-bust strategizing?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No can do. Gotta babysit. Why don't you call Jeremy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, he's doing some sports thingy. Eh, it's not my thing.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ooh, a whole day without Jeremy and you're not obsessing about it? Who are you and what have you done with Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Silly BFF, Jeremy likes me for who I am. It's like we're one. When I breathe in, he breathes out. His heart says, "Knock knock" and my heart says, "Who's there?" and the answer is, "Us!" (giggles) Remember those days when I was always panicking about (Phineas, Ferb and Isabella pass with baseball stuff) what he thought or what he would or wouldn't like? Ancient history.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That was yesterday.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, I'm going to the store, do you need anything?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nah, I'm good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, wait, I am out of toothpaste.

Name: Linda
Dialog: All right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And deodorant.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Got it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, and pimple cream, loofa pads, body tape, hair dye, cucumber slices, fungal cream...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know what, why don't you just come along so I don't spend the whole day in the teen hygiene aisle?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Someone has to be around to bust Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, they're playing baseball. It's not exactly a punishable offense.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, but it will be! (shakes fist) It will be!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Think of it this way, Candace

Name: Candace
Dialog: (getting out of the chair) What are we waiting for? (grabs her mom's arm) C'mon, c'mon! Chop chop!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello...? Hello?...Hellooooo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Isabella, keep your eye on the ball. (She hits it.) Whoa! Great hit!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Power Hitter Patch

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your analysis of the pitch's angle and trajectory was most impressive.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Only you can nerdify a great sport like baseball!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, hitting a baseball involves the basic principles of (graphics appear above his head) velocity, force and geometry.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) You're visualizing numbers in the air again, aren't you? (Buford pushes the floating graphics into the ground.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! We can use geometric algorithms to build the ultimate batting challenge.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (to Buford) Well?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's not as bad when he does it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (sighs) I cannot argue. So where is Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, he's at home. (Whip pan left to reveal Perry standing on home plate chattering.) He's not doin' much. What's over here?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. As you can see, I, uh, I've had a little shaving mishap with this defective electric razor. Just not comfortable with my eyebrows moving independently of each other.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) But you are rockin' the reverse mohawk, sir!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get with it, Carl! The hip kids call it a "hawkmo". Anyhow, Agent P, retail stores all across the Tri-State Area are reporting a huge influx of returned faulty items and, coincidentally, (shot of Doof whistling with an inator waiting on line is shown onscreen) Doofenshmirtz has been spotted at customer service counters. (Monogram reappears onscreen.) I have a hunch that these two unrelated things may just be related! Now go find out if Doofenshmirtz has anything to do with this! Also, find out if anyone is actually calling it a "hawkmo" and, if not, please get that started!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, this is taking forever! We'll never get home in time to bust the boys!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll tell you what, how about you shop for your own things and then meet me at the register?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, great idea! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hygiene, here we are! Okay, lip wax, pimple cream, fungal cream... Wow! Running out of all my most embarrassing personal hygiene products on the same day. Ooh, right, deodorant! Oh, now, which Ducky Momo deodorant did I use? Hmmm... (Takes one off the shelf and looks around) Well, there's only one way to be sure. (Uncaps the deodorant and sniffs. She puts it back on the shelf and smells her own armpit.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, heh, hey, Jeremy, um...yeah...I'm just trying to reach the top shelf.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Allow me. (He reaches up top for something, while Candace pushes a basket away) Here you go, one nose hair clipper. Do you want me to put it in your basket?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I mean (nervous giggle) That's not my stuff! That's my Mom's. I'm shopping for my Mom. Yeah, heh... my mom has really unruly, uh, nose hair! Yeah, really bad, okay? Uh, yeah, I...I was just on my way to the, uh... (whip pan right to where Candace is looking, cut back to Candace pointing at the sign) ...the water sports section.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I didn't know you did water sports, 'cause I'm going to the Extreme Water Park today. Wanna come?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, cool! Y'know, 'cause I'm so down with the ten-hanging and whatnot. (giggles) Yeah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha! Consider yourself marked down! Handy little shopping device, isn't it? Anyway, you're gonna love this segue, Perry the Platypus! All of my broken inator parts were messing up the feng shui of my apartment. (Whip pan to a Chinese guy pushing a bonsai in a vase out of the way. Cut back to Doof.) Thanks, Larry! (To Perry) My feng shui consultant. To keep my chi in balance, I came up with this. Behold! The Back-to-the-Store-inator! Now instead of waiting in those ridiculously long lines at the return counter, I scan each item (he scans an item and it disappears) and presto! It's transported back to the store where I bought it!

Name: Counter Guy
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And here's the best part, Perry the Platypus

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) Wow, this place is intense! (Cut to Candace and Jeremy on surfboards at the top of a water slide.) You ready, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: T-T-Totally. (She giggles nervously as she looks down at the bottom.) Who in the world designed this?

Name: Ride Operator
Dialog: Couple of kids, actually. One had a triangle head.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what? (The ride operator releases the surfboards and we hear Candace scream.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Welcome, sports fans! We have a great game for you today!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (overexcited) It's the most extreme batting experience ever!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The game is simple

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's survival of the fittest! A test of wills! Only one contestant will survive!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no, no, (chuckles) everyone will survive.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're goin' down, dweeb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I will beat you. It is a mathematical certainty.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's extreme!!! It's EX-TREEEEEME!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know how extreme it is. It's, you know, big but it is still just a batting cage. Let's...not oversell it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gentlemen, start your engines!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no, they...don't have engines. (Cut to Ferb next to an automatic pitching machine labeled the Lob 9000.) Oh...Oh, I guess Ferb...Ferb has an engine. Forgot about that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. Hello?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (angrily) Candace, I've been waiting at the checkout line for a half hour! Where are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm at the extreme water park with Jeremy.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What?! And it never occurred to you to let me know?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I expect you to be home by the time I get back to put everything away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, Mom. Ugh!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wanna go again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I gotta go home.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, very resourceful, Perry the Platypus! Using coupons to cut prices! Hey! (Perry jumps on the inator and it activates.) N-N-Not my baseball card collection! No!

Name: Counter Guy 2
Dialog: Yes! I told you genies were real, Sheila...wherever you are.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, you have no idea how much that was worth! (Kaching!) Although, judging by the jingling— (Perry hits him) Ow!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford and Baljeet are tied!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And Buford steps up to the batter's box!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Folks, you can cut the tension with a child-safe knife!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here comes the pitch! Yes! Looking good. Looking great. Looking fantastic! (The ball misses the target.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Denied!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ugh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet eyes up the target as he steps to the plate. Readies himself for the pitch. And...Wow! What a trajectory!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But not enough power!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A disappointed Baljeet walks away.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, it looks like this game could go into sudden death!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It could just be a tie.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No, sudden death!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, not my new flat-screen! (Kaching!) Hey, no way! I paid way more for that TV! (Doof falls backwards and breaks a part of the inator with his back. The machine malfunctions and goes haywire zapping randomly.) Hey, wha? Ow! Ow!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) I would like to return this electric razor.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Are you sure ya read the instructions, Carl?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And you're showin' me boring math equations why?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, these equations show that if we combine your brawn with my brains, we can conquer the final target together!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Do my ears deceive me? Are you sayin' we should work together?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I know! My ears cannot believe it either!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Looks like we made it back before your mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, sorry to have to rush— (gasps) I knew Phineas and Ferb were up to something! (Linda's car horn honks.) Mom's here. (She somersaults out of the car.) Just in time to bust the boys. Mooom?!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (gets out of the car) Don't poke the bear, Candace! You're in enough trouble as it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, Mom—

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now let's take these inside before the frozens turn int— (realizes the empty trunk) Oh, shoot! I must've left the other bag at the store.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, just turn your head, and look up! (The car drives away) But...but...but... (Jeremy approaches Candace) but it's right...there!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are those batting cages?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grabs him.) Come on, Jeremy, (runs to the backyard) there's still a chance to bust them.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Dis betta work, dweeb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Just follow the trajectory I plotted out and I promise you will hit the final target! We can do this!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Optimism makes me angry!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) Use it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Here comes the pitch!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoa! This might be the big one!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Folks, it's the power hit of the evening! But is it gooooood? (The ball hits every level in the cage and finally goes in the target.) It's goooooooood!!!!!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Yay!

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Ahhhhh...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oooooo...

Name: Phineas and Isabella
Dialog: Ahhhhh...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Awww... You'll bust 'em next time, tiger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Y'know, chasing's not much of an option with my pants full of pennies. (Cut to inside to reveal Doof's pants pretty much about to explode.) Ah, well, live and learn. (An inator beam fires, Perry uses a picture of Doof to deflect it and it fires at Doof. His clothes disappear, but his underpants and pennies don't.) 'Least you hit my clothes and not me. I wonder what happens if a person— (Another beam hits Doof.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Drusselstein. Hmm. Curse you, Perry the Platypus, and my wretched, wretched life.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Way to go, guys!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I guess we can work together after all.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I hate to say you're right...so I won't.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Fair enough.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Safe at home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And what a waste.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, the day's not a total loss. We had a great time at the water park. Wanna go back tomorrow?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I have a confession to make. The only reason I said I liked extreme sports was because I was embarrassed that you caught me buying all that hygiene stuff for myself.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Aw, nothing you do could be that embarrassing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy. (They hug. Candace farts.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, was that you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's a normal bodily function, Jeremy. Get over it. (walks away)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (follows her) Wait, wait, I thought it was cute!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: (voiceover) Welcome to the 48th Montevillebad Grand Prix Pre-Race Show.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Linda, darling, it's starting!

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Coming to you, of course, from the coast of glorious Montevillebad.

Name: Ian
Dialog: A name that translates roughly as "mountain village bath" in a variety of European languages.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Seven hours of racing jargon and mindless statistics, here we come!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, snacks!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mm-hmm, and they're race themed.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, vroom vroom!

Name: Nigel
Dialog: And there's our pole-sitter, international racing legend, Paolo Vanderbeek.

Name: Ian
Dialog: A household name. Born in the Scottish enclave of a Swiss town in the Italian alps to Dutch parents.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Not only a king among drivers, Paolo Vanderbeek is also a beloved man of the people.

Name: Ian
Dialog: No one is more passionate about his sport or cares more about his fans than Paolo Vanderbeek, earning him the name "the King of Care."

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: How can ya go outside when it's Grand Prix Day?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sarcastically) Uh, yeah, well, my pleather jumpsuit is at the cleaners and I feel underdressed.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, that's understandable then.

Name: Linda
Dialog: She was being facetious, dear.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, doesn't look like there's anything bustable going on yet. (takes a seat) I guess I could kill a few.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Give it a chance, Candace. You might find it exciting.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Let's look at an incomprehensible map of the race course, shall we?

Name: Nigel
Dialog: (offscreen) I can't make heads or tails out of it. You?

Name: Ian
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, no clue, but no doubt, it'll be exciting!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sarcastically) Oh, yeah. The excitement is killing me. Seems like a good time to wonder where Perry is.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Greetings from Montevillebad, Agent P! You'll be joining us here for your mission. (whispering) But the lines aren't secure. (normal voice) So, we'll give you the details when you get here. And to get you here in style, we've provided you with a vintage 1963 Olson Martin! (The car rises from the floor behind Perry. He smiles.) So I'll see you after the wipe.

Name: Caption
Dialog: Montevillebad...After the wipe

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello again, Agent P. International intel has indicated that Doofenshmirtz is planning to sabotage Paolo Vanderbeek and enter the Grand Prix himself. (Cut to Perry driving.) So, we need you to find out what Doof is up to while Carl and I keep an eye on Vanderbeek here at the race track incognito. (Cut to Monogram, now wearing a fake black mustache.) Nifty disguise, huh? Gives me a continental look, don't you think? Anyway, Doofenshmirtz is at the casino L'Hotel Uber-Swank.

Name: Croupier
Dialog: Monsieur in the lab coat and bow tie wins again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, I am on a roll!

Name: Agent Double 0-0
Dialog: (gets up) Stupid game. I'll never play it again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, never say never! Who's next? (Cut to Perry who takes a stick of bubblegum and chews it seriously and blows a bubble.) Oh, a mysterious platypus to take my challenge. Okay, I'll go first.

Name: Croupier
Dialog: Jeu de morpion! Monsieur Platypus in the tuxedo wins!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?!

Name: Bouncer
Dialog: Monsieur, there are no pets allowed in the casino.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? He's not my mysterious platypus. I didn't bring him in here! I just—Oh, oh, you mean the cat. (Doof takes a white cat from under the table and leaves.) Yeah, my bad.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Look at all those cars in a line.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: The collective amount of horsepower is absolutely staggering.

Name: Ian
Dialog: And so (coughs) are the exhaust fumes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You realize this is just a bunch of cars parked in a line.

Name: Linda and Lawrence
Dialog: Yes. Yes we do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasp) The mysterious platypus from the casino! (Perry puts on his fedora.) Perry the Mysterious Platypus from the Casino?!?!? Betcha tired of standing 'round, aren't you? (Doof pushes a button and traps Perry in a pile of tires.) See? Tires. I thought it apropos, you know, this being the Grand Prix and all. Wait 'till you see my new lair! (The yacht drives into a cave tunnel.) Not too shabby. Hey, Norm, I'm back!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Look what I found! Metal teeth!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uch, you've always had metal teeth, Norm.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes, but these are sharp.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What does that matter? You can't open your mouth. Here, grab Perry the Platypus. Isn't this place fabulous? I found it through an international lair exchange website. It's even got its own rocket. Y'know, I think I might've gotten the better end of this deal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, you're gonna love it. I was so impressed, I commissioned a whole new jingle!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, it's swanky!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (dancing) Yeah, look at these swanky moves!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks, Cheryl! (to the viewer) My real estate agent. (to Perry) So, my evil plan. As you may know, the Montevillebad Grand Prix is a goodwill event with all the prize money awarded to the winner's favorite charity. So, I entered the race for my favorite charity, Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated...namely me! I'm the Doofenshmirtz...in Doofenshmirtz Evil...Well, you get it. And check it out! (Shows his race car on the monitor.) I've re-engineered my Boomshlaka 320-I to meet the Grand Prix specs. I also added some extras that should take care of, like, 99% of the playing field. But then there's still that 1%, Paolo Vanderbeek. But, uh, I got something else to take care of him. Behold, my I-Don't-Care-inator! (beat) It's not that I don't care. It creates apathy in whoever it hits. It's a little esoteric, I know, but, trust me, it'll work. I'll just zap Paolo with this baby and suddenly he won't care about anything and, uh, least of all, racing. I'll turn the King of Care into the King of I Couldn't Care Less, which will pave the way for me to win the race and the prize money for my favorite charity, which, I think I said before, is me. Now, before I go, lest you try to escape, I'll show you one more feature of this place. (He presses a button that says "Shark Tank".) Look, it's got its own shark tank! (laughter) (Cut to Norm wearing a rocket helmet. Doof straps into a seat on the robot.) Okay, then, I'm off to the races...literally! (Norm launches.) Hasta la pasta, baby!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Welcome back, racing fans, to the Montevillebad Grand Prix. And the teams are making the final preparations before the start of the race.

Name: Ian
Dialog: Including our favorite, Paolo Vanderbeek.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Just look at the amazing amount of care and attention he pays to his fans and his car.

Name: Pit Man
Dialog: Listen to those fans, Paolo. They love you.

Name: Vanderbeek
Dialog: Eh, who cares? (walks away)

Name: Adrian
Dialog: What's this? Paolo is walking away from the pits.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: And the race.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! What a shot! Norm, set me down next to the registration booth and you go get the car ready.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Roger wilco, sir!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Wait a second. There seems to be a last minute entry. A Heinz Doofen...Doofen.... Ih...hopeless with Drusselsteinian names.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Hand it over, mate. Let's see. (takes the script from Adrian and reads it) "Dorkenshmitz"?

Name: Ian
Dialog: D-Doofen...Doofenshmuntz, Doofenshmuntz. Oh, that's utterly ridiculous.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Whatever his name is, he's no Vanderbeek. That's for sure.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: There's the flag! And they're off!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Psst, Agent P, over here! Doof has shot Vanderbeek with some kind of—oh, right, he probably monologued his scheme to you already. Anyhow, we need you to take Vanderbeek's place in the race, get that inator, and get back here to reverse its effect, so Vanderbeek can finish the race and defeat Doofenshmirtz. Carl has been trying to convince Vanderbeek to get back in the race using his sophisticated powers of persuasion.

Name: Carl
Dialog: C'mon, pretty please? Pretty please with a cherry on top? I'll be your best friend!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, you better get goin', Agent P. You can use the disguise setting on your Olson Martin. (Perry takes his Olson Martin out of his pocket, pushes a button, and it turns into Vanderbeek's mustache. He puts it on.) Wow, the resemblance is uncanny! Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Nigel
Dialog: What's this? Hello! It looks like Paolo Vanderbeek is back in the race!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, this isn't nearly as lame as I thought.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: That's why our couch cushions are worn so unevenly. 'Cause we're always on the edge of our seats.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see if I can rub this guy the wrong way. (He laughs as he rams a car.) Nice bumpin' into ya! Maybe it's time to use a little elbow grease. (He pushes a button and some grease spews out of the back of his car causing the car to slide right out of the race.) Alright, smoke 'em if you got 'em! (Black smoke spews out of the exhaust pipe.)

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Approaching the Phillips' head turn, millimetrically perfect!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Or .04 inches perfect for backwards people who don't use the metric system.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: Dumpendork is gonna have his work cut out for him if he wants to stay in the lead.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Paolo Vanderbeek? He's back? Eh, looks like I'm gonna have to through the works at him. There ya go. (The exhaust pipe flips open throwing everything...and the kitchen sink which the car dodges.)

Name: Nigel
Dialog: I say, that is an unprecedented amount of contact shunts and shenanigans!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Shenanigans?

Name: Ian
Dialog: You don't think there's some sort of foul play afoot.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: In Grand Prix racing? Don't be ridiculous!

Name: Nigel
Dialog: That kind of thing only happens in cartoons.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Looks like somebody needs another shot of the I-Don't-Care-inator. (The car runs over some parts and the inator slips out of Doof's hand.) What? Uh-oh! That's mine! (Perry catches the inator.)

Name: Adrian
Dialog: And that last contact has put Doofenshmuntz spinning across the course!

Name: Nigel
Dialog: And Vanderbeek is pulling into the pits! What is wrong?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Come on, whatta ya, chicken? Bagawk!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good work, Agent P! Now we just need you to...Oh, okay, yeah, you got it covered, too.

Name: Vanderbeek
Dialog: Bocce balls! I cannot disappoint my fans!

Name: Ian
Dialog: Doifenshmuntz has got himself going again with the help of an extremely large metal pit crew member.

Name: Nigel
Dialog: This is, without a doubt, the weirdest race I've ever seen.

Name: Vanderbeek
Dialog: Grazie tonto, little beaver-duck guy! I'm-a about to win-a!

Name: Ian
Dialog: And Paolo is back on the course!

Name: Adrian
Dialog: He'll have to really put his foot in if he wants to catch Doofenshmintz by the end of the race!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not to make excuses, but sometimes, it's okay to be a little bit tacky. (He pushes a button and a bunch of tacks come out of the front, piercing his own tires.) Oh, maybe the tacks are supposed to be in the back.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: Dirkenshplurtz has run himself off the course completely!

Name: Pool Guy
Dialog: Gladys, j'ai une autre. (Subtitle

Name: Nigel
Dialog: And Vanderbeek pushes past just in time to sieze the checkered flag! Well done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah! Go, Paolo! Go, Paolo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What an exciting finish!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was awesome! (looks behind her to see nothing there) Huh, I guess they're not doing anything today. (leaves) I am going to the mall and picking up a pleather jumpsuit!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, did I win? (He takes off his helmet, which splashes more water onto him.) Oh, wait, no! Curse you, Paolo Vanderbeek! Y'know, that just doesn't roll off the tongue the way "Perry the Platypus" does. Perry the Platypus, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Adrian
Dialog: And, on that bombshell, we bid farewell from glamorous Montevillebad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, it's swanky!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello, world! Welcome to our musical tribute to summer! And if you're wondering what we're doing today...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: ...we're reaching out to everyone to share our love of summer!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Using Ferbographic technology, we are simulcasting our virtual selves around the planet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: To put it simply, we're joining you to celebrate around the world, all from the comfort of our own backyard!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now help us in welcoming a very special guest and the visual metaphor for the carefree days of summer, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Gosh, sir. I've never been to a cadet graduation before. (Cut to inside the car to reveal Carl driving while Monogram and Perry are in the back.) I hope I'm not underdressed.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, you're fine, Carl. Not everything's about you, you know. (A beeping sound is heard. Monogram pushes a button on the TV monitor beneath him and a highly decorated colonel appears onscreen.) Hello, Colonel Contraction.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Greetings, Major! I just wanna wish you good luck on today's event! I've got the cake, and I'll be on my way just as soon as I'm done skimming out my kid's pool.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Very good, sir. This year's event will be held at the Knights of Danville Hall, Ballroom B.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Ballroom B? Isn't that a shared space?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just another money-saving idea of mine, sir.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: I don't know, Major. What about security?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, don't worry, sir. No one will know it's us. We're registered as the "Capulet Bat Mitzvah".

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Hmm, well, you have my utmost confidence, Major. But it goes without saying, any mishap could cost you your position. Contraction out!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I don't know about you guys, but I've got a good feeling about this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Nice goin', Norm! (Cut to backstage where Doof is having a talking-to to Norm.) Next time someone asks for volunteers to host the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Service Awards, say your own name, Mr. Blabbermouth!

Name: Norm
Dialog: But, sir, I made all the arrangements for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, and a fine job you did, too. We are sharing the space with another event!

Name: Norm
Dialog: What's wrong with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's wrong with it? Do you realize what would happen if all the other evil organizations found out we were sharing? They'd be all, "Oh, look! There goes L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.! They share! They're cocky and uncoordinated and don't wear name-brand jeans!" "Well, maybe people can't afford designer jeans, Julie!"

Name: Norm
Dialog: Wow, that was...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I heard it.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Well, don't worry, sir. No one will know it's our event. We're registered as the "Hatfield Wedding Reception".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, let's hope nobody knows it's us. (walks off) Now, get out of my way, you perfunctory party planner.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir, may I offer you one of my budget-saver hors d'oeuvres before you go on? It's an old family recipe. Strips of bologna and wadded-up white bread.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Where exactly are you from?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Chula Vista.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hmmm. Nevermind, Carl. It's showtime! (Cut to the stage) Hello, everyone! Welcome to the O.W.C.A. Graduation Ceremony!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, and welcome to L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.'s first annual... (The agents' cheering is still heard. Doof speaks louder.) I said, L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.'s FIRST ANNUAL DISSERVICE AWAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARDS!!! So, who's ready to have some fun?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What the heck is all that racket? I'm just gonna go over there and tell them to keep it down. I'll be polite but firm. (He opens the divider to reveal Doof, as a record scratch is heard, then he closes it up again.) Huh. What are the odds?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reopening the divider) Wait, you're the Capulet Bar Mitzvah?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're the Hatfield Wedding?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Alright, everyone, take it easy. Just calm down. No reason to get upset. We've got a massive security deposit on this place. So, everybody just...

Name: Parrot
Dialog: Rawk! Polly wants a streetfight!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) Defenestrate!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hup! Sorry to interrupt, I'll come back when you're done.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We are so gonna lose our deposit.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Here's your stuff from the attic, Candace.

Name: Linda (cont'd)
Dialog: I don't know why you couldn't find it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, Mom. It must've been behind something. Heh heh.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you didn't go up there at all, did you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Mom, I just couldn't go up there. It's all gross and webby.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace Flynn, don't tell me you're still afraid of spiders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfft! Spiders? Are you kidding? Why would I be afraid of an itsy bitsy SPIDER!??!?! (jumps up to the top shelf) Aah! Ahh! Ew ew ew ew!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, for crying out loud. It's a hair clip. That looks nothing like a spider.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles) I knew that! I'm just showing you how silly it is to be afraid of a little spider.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mmhmm. Well, you got your box. Now I have to go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where are you going?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your dad and I are going spelunking.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Spelunking? You mean, like, in a cave?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's a journey of self-discovery while crawling around in a hole. Your dad found it on a group coupon website.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sarcastically) Yeah, that sounds fun.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just remember, you're in charge, Miss Muffet.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Alright, Major, here's the ca--Oh! (He sees the results of the fight. The whole room is a mess and agents are groaning in defeat.) Ateahoo!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (gets up and salutes) Colonel Contraction, sir!

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Major Monogram, I hold you personally responsible for turning one of our most sacred ceremonies into a grade A countrified debacle!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Debacle?

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: DEBACLE! Now normally, I'd be able to forgive this kind of thing because of your tireless dedication and spotless record to OWCA, but it's clear to me that you lost our security deposit and that is something I cannot forgive. I'm forced to relieve you of command. I'll take that... (rips off the first "M" on Monogram's uniform) and that! (rips off his mustache)

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Actually, sir, that mustache was mine.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Not anymore. (leaves, then reenters) DEBACLE!!! Carl the Intern, until a replacement can be found, (puts mustache on Carl) you are provisionally in charge. (salutes) Congratulations, Provisional Unpaid Major-in-Charge Carl!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Major, I...I don't...

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl, be strong. I must step down. We must all do our duty. (The agents hum "The Battle Hymn of the Republic" under this.) And that is what our, I mean, your organization is built upon. People following orders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, cool, my old tiara. Ooh, sparkly! (picks up a videocassette) Hey, I don't remember this. Hmm. (reads) "For

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Candace! Nice outfit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice glasses.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks! We're using them to simulcast ourselves all around the world.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sh-sh-sh-sh! No time! I need to watch this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A videocassette? Wow, going old school, huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right? So how do I watch it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Dad has a universal video player in the garage.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where in the garage?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: 12 degrees northwest of the washing machine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks. Carry on with your non-bustable activity. (She leaves.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everyone, give it up for our sister, Candace Flynn!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Are you folks ready for a little adventure?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, we're ready for our journey of self-discovery while crawling through the belly of the Earth.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Say what?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, like the ad said, "Inner Spelunking with Soul".

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: What?! Oh, no, no, no! It's supposed to be "Saul", S-A-U-L. That's my name, Saul. There will be absolutely no self-discovery.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Awww.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You go on and self-discover, hun.

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (onscreen) Keep the camera thteady, Thtacy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, look, it's me! Aw, I was so cute!

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (on video) Thith ith Candathe Flynn. I'm five yearth old and it wath an awethome thummer! But I didn't get to do everything I wanted. Tho I made a litht of thingth that I want Future Candathe to take care of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, that's so cute. Of course, I'll take care of those things, Past Candace!

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (on video) First on the list, invent an ice cream flavor, win a first-grade spelling bee, ride a unicorn. Tho if you're watching, Future Candathe, don't—

Name: Young Stacy
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace, don't forget number four, conquer fear of spiders.

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (on video) Okay, that one creepth me out a little bit, but that should be no problem for you, Future Candathe!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but-but-but...But I'm "Future Candathe"!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just a minute, I'm mopping. (opens the door) Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus, long time, no see. Say, that was some morning we had, huh? Too bad about Major Monogram, but the show must go on or a bird in the bush, eh-eh, I dunno. (Perry gets trapped in hardening foam.) Ha! You like that? It's a gift...foam-a me to you! Get it? As much as I like our little visits, you didn't need to come over. Actually, I'm not even trying to take over the Tri-State Area today. Y-You see, I have a problem. I am very fair-skinned. I don't know if you have noticed. I always have to use SPF 120 sunscreen even on a cloudy day or I'll burn. I mean, I'll actually burst into flames. And I got this whole crate on sale, and, and look, it's all 110 SPF! I thought I was getting 120! This is not gonna work. So rather than return this whole mess, which means I'd have to get in the car, drive down there, wait in line, then answer a bunch of questions about the delicacy of my epidermis, I'm just gonna move the Earth away from the sun just enough that the 110 will work. Simple. And to that end, I have created, tada!, my Shift-The-Earth's-Position-Further-Away-From-The-Sun-inator! Eh? I know. The name's a little cumbersome, but it's basically a tractor beam that uses the mass of Jupiter as an anchor to pull the Earth just slightly away from the sun to render my sunscreen effective. Eh. I guess my fortune cookie was right. I do tend to overcomplicate things. (picks up fortune) I wonder if that means these lottery numbers are--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm? (Perry taps Doof's shoulder and grabs his nose.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hee hee hee! You fired my inat-- (gets splashed by the wet mop)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa! What was that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We are rockin' this place!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what is that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know, but I can guess. (Shouts out the window.) Phineas, what is going on out there?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't know. It wasn't us. But we can find out. Irving, take over the concert for us!

Name: Irving
Dialog: All I know how to sing is one camp song.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Then you rock that camp song, Irving!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Um, okay. Here's a campfire song my mother taught me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, according to the pocket barometer, the atmospheric pressure has lowered dramatically since this morning.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You checked the atmospheric pressure this morning?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. I check it every morning. After I brush my teeth.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You brush your teeth every morning?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh. (beat, to Baljeet) He thinks he's better than us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no! Duck! (the gang ducks) No, I mean, like, a whole lot of ducks. Look! (Cut to the sky to reveal a whole lot of ducks flying in their "v" formation.) They look like they're migrating south. Guys, I think something's weird with the weather.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We should monitor the conditions in the upper atmosphere. I have a weather balloon.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why would you have a weather balloon?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, you have full-sized molds of all of us.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We should use Baljeet's weather balloon!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, I remember this list!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep, Stace, I promised five-year-old me that I'd do everything on that list.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, let's see what you gotta do. "Invent a new ice cream flavor, win a first-grade spelling bee, ride a unicorn, and conquer fear of spiders." Ha! Good luck with that last one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you talking about?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, everyone knows you're terrified of spiders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfft. Spiders? Are you kidding? Why would I be afraid of an itsy bitsy SPIDER!?!?!?! AAAH! AHHH! GET IT! GET IT! EW EW EW EW EW!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I remember this hair clip.

Name: Saul
Dialog: Most people don't think life can survive down this deep, but most people don't know gastropods the way I do. Take a gander at this salamander. Notice anything unusual?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, his gills are on the outside of his body.

Name: Saul
Dialog: They are? Ew! Oh! Ew! Ew! Ew! Ew!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (to Linda) It didn't have any eyes either.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Thanks for not mentioning that.

Name: Computer
Dialog: You may enter.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (whispering) Psst! Agent P, down here! (Cut to reveal Major-in-Charge Carl hiding in a kennel. Agent P approaches him.) Is that goat still eating out of the inbox? (Perry nods.) It's a good thing I hid the outbox.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Monty
Dialog: Oh, Agent P, what's going on? It's like a zoo in here. Where is my dad?

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Your father's been fired.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Fired? Really?

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Yes! And all the animal agents are going crazy! (Monty opens the kennel and Major-in-Charge Carl crawls out.) On the upside, I've been promoted.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Yes, I see the mustache. (A printer is heard whirring. Monty takes out the paper.) Looks like you got a message.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: It's intel from Agent Squab, our French surveillance pigeon. Hmm, there's a small shift in ambient temperature, there's civil unreasonableness at City Hall, and L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. is convening for a secret meeting?! Oh no! Why did this have to happen on my watch?!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wait a minute, you got all that from this?

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Yeah, that's how Agent Squab types, all hunt-and-peck.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Well, Carl, you're in charge. What are you gonna do about it?

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: You mean besides freak out?!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Get a hold of yourself. You know this agency as well as my dad. Maybe better. These agents just need leadership. Think

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: You're right! (to the goat) Agent G, quit eating those memos and get out into the field! (to the dog) Agent D, go see what you can dig up! (to the owl) Agent O, go find out who's who! Agent Possum, play dead! (Agent Possum does so.) Excellent! (To the bear who is shredding documents) Agent B, go into the woods and...see what's out there! And the rest of you, get out there and fight evil! Agent P, I want you to go out to City Hall and get a reading on the situation there and then report back to me.

Name: Monty
Dialog: (puts on fedora) What about me, Carl? I can go spy on L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. if you--

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Oh, no, no, Monty. I can't let you do that. That's...that's crazy! You're not even an animal.

Name: Monty
Dialog: We've got no choice, Carl. We're all gonna have to wear different hats today...and mustaches.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Hey, Monty?

Name: Monty
Dialog: What?

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Thanks

Name: Monty
Dialog: No problem. Oh, and, uh, (takes off fedora) can I have a different hat? This one smells like a litter box.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Yeah, you should smell this thing.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Morning, your mission today

Name: Driver
Dialog: Uh, come again?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Oh, sorry. Force of habit. (gives the driver his order) Here's your order. Enjoy your Slushy Dawg. (The driver drives away. Monogram turns to Jeremy.) So, uh, how'm I doin', boss?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, this is the part of the job I hate the most, but...

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Yep. Say no more, sir. I completely understand. You don't have to fire me. (He takes off his uniform and gives it to Jeremy.) I resign.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But--

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (leaves, saluting, half-naked) Say no more. (hums)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But...but... I was just gonna ask him to clean the bathroom. (walks up to a female employee) Um, Dolores, this is the part of the job I hate the most.

Name: Dolores
Dialog: Oh, for crying out loud, just give me the mop.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay, let's see. "Invent a new ice cream flavor."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grilled cheese!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Check. "Win a first grade spelling bee."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Clover. C-L-O-V-E-R. Those stupid kids never knew what hit 'em!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Check. "Ride a unicorn."...Of sorts.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dreams can come true, Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There's just one more thing on the list. Get over your fear of spiders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I refuse! Quickly, Rainbow, we must away! Fly, now, fly! On, proud beauty! Fly, fly!

Name: Rainbow
Dialog: Aw hee haw hee haw hee haw!

Name: Gordon Gutsofanemu
Dialog: Danville is in chaos. Summer has become slightly cooler. Some sources even go as far as to say, "brisk". We have word that the Mayor is about to address this slight drop in temperature. Let's listen.

Name: Roger
Dialog: (wearing a sweatshirt) Citizens of Danville, I want to assure you that your slight discomfort is of utmost importance to me and I will do everything in my power to...recommend you wear a cardigan or light sweater.

Name: Woman #1
Dialog: But all my sweaters are ugly and Christmas themed!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, then, just wear warmer clothes.

Name: Man #1 (Evil Jingle Singer #2)
Dialog: Warmer clothes? Do you know how dumb I would look wearing socks with flip-flops? (to the crowd) Hey, his sweater looks nice and warm. Get it!

Name: Roger
Dialog: People, people. Look look look, take-take it easy. I'm still your mayor!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Thank you, good Samaritan platypus! (Perry leaves him there.) Although I'm not sure this is much of an improvement. I mean, I really don't know how to get down from here...and it's getting noticeably colder up here. Oh! It's a good thing I wore my sweater.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, according to the conditions in the upper atmosphere...

Name: Baljeet (cont'd)
Dialog: ...we are in for a moderate cold front that shows absolutely no signs of subsiding.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's odd. I can't remember a single Danville summer where I needed to wear anything more than a T-shirt.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Striped.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And shorts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Blue cargo.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But the part that perplexes me the most is that, for some reason, the sun algorithm that I created keeps coming up with the wrong result!

Name: Buford
Dialog: 'Splain?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The diameter of the sun can be calculated from the distance between the Earth and the sun. Since we know the time taken for the Earth to go once around the sun, p=1 year, and the distance traveled by the Earth in this process, 2πa...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: BUFORD!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Stop 'splainin'! Stop 'splainin'!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So that would mean the Earth has moved?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Apparently so.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that would explain why it's noticeably colder.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think we're gonna have to run some more tests.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Now, why do we always have to meet in drafty abandoned warehouses? I mean, why can't we meet in a drafty abandoned poolside cabana?

Name: Dr. Bloodpudding
Dialog: Oh ho ho ho! I'm bananas for cabanas!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Right?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Okay, enough of that! Gentlemen, it's time we pooled our resources! Both OWCA and City Hall are in a panic and I believe now is the time to strike! Now, the last time we confronted those OWCA agents, we barely got out of there with our lives! (The villains agree.) It's time to play dirty! We'll stealthily capture them one at a time and imprison them here!

Name: Villain #1
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Villain #2
Dialog: Gang up on them!

Name: Villain #3
Dialog: We can make it a musical number!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Secondly, no one under any circumstances, is allowed to say "bananas for cabanas."

Name: Dr. Bloodpudding
Dialog: (offscreen) Noted.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: And third, which one of you moved the Earth away from the sun and changed the weather?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, that would be me?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz? You've finally made an inator that actually works?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, all of my inators work! It's just that, you know, I...I don't use them properly. I have poor planning skills. (takes out blueprints) But it was me. I've the blueprints right here. (The villains all look in amazement.) Yeah, you see, just ignore the coffee stain or whatever that is. (sniffs) Uh, I think that's nacho cheese.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Gentlemen, we will now begin our takeover of...the world!

Name: Monty
Dialog: (gasps, then covers his mouth)

Name: Rodney
Dialog: What was that?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (offscreen) Maybe the building's settling.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (offscreen) So to you, a building settling sounds like someone inhaling sharply?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (offscreen) Well, I live in a strange building.

Name: Monty
Dialog: I've got to warn Carl.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (offscreen) Okay, tell me you didn't hear that!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (offscreen) Still the building settling.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (offscreen) So our building has a sudden urge to warn Carl?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (offscreen) Come on, Candace!

Name: Stacy (cont'd)
Dialog: It's the last thing on the list.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know I know I know I know okay, here I go! (Walks in nervously.) Ugh! I can't!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I don't understand what the big deal is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just the legs and the hair and all those eyes! And why do they have so many eyes?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There's nothing to be afraid of. Spiders are harmless. (opens a cage) Look. I'm sticking my hand in the cage. Hello there, little guy. (gets bitten) Huh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Poor Stacy. My fear of spiders got Stacy bitten. (happily) But saved me! Yes! Looks like it's just you and me now, Rainbow.

Name: Rainbow
Dialog: Aw hee haw hee haaaaawwww!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, Isabella, let me have it one more time.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, according to our data, this is the relative position of the sun, and this is where the Earth should be on its orbit this summer. But for some reason, we're here. (sighs) Tennis balls don't lie. (Throws the ball.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Every test scenario we run comes back with the same results. It just seems impossible. (throws the ball to Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aaah! But it is true! The Earth has moved away from the sun and now summer is gone!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Big deal! So this summer's over. There's always next summer.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, Buford. If we don't do something soon, summer will be gone forever!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: What? I'm expressing how I feel through music.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And that's what would happen if we grew magnets under the Earth's core.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The credits were a nice touch.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, there's so many people behind the scenes that deserve a mention.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess that's another course of action that's off the table. (crosses off a formula on the blackboard) Not too many ideas left.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (shudders) But we have to figure out a way to save summer or it'll be gone forever!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Baljeet, what have you got?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have composed a simulation for turning the Earth's core into a gyroscope. Maybe that would... (groans)

Name: Buford
Dialog: And roll credits!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Sure hope this cold weather isn't affecting Mum and Dad's cave adventures.

Name: Saul
Dialog: Okay, now we're gonna squeeze past this stalactite... I mean, stalagmite. Wait, which one is on top?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Actually, I believe that's just a hole.

Name: Saul
Dialog: I seem to be trapped! Turn away, folks! I'm gonna have to saw my arm off!

Name: Saul
Dialog: That was a close one. Now, follow me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Do you get the feeling that this might be his first time down here, too?

Name: Saul
Dialog: (offscreen, grunts as his light suddenly goes out) Dangit!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: There we go! With that, we've captured all of OWCA's agents.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Almost all of them. Remember Perry the Platypus. He's still out there somewhere.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Thank you for reminding me, Dr. Bringdown.

Name: Villain #4
Dialog: Excuse me, I'm Dr. Bringdown!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Put a sock in it, David! (to Doof) Time to get to our press conference! Soon, the world will bow to us, like Doofy's neck bows to his back.

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: His posture's poor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nice.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Come on, Slouchy! Let's make ourselves some demands!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey there, little fella. You're not such a tough guy, are you, Mr. Spider? Aw, no you're not. No, not a bit. Ah, who ya kidding, Flynn? To face your fear, you gotta at least look. (gets creeped out by the spider) Ahh! Creepy crawly, creepy crawly, creepy crawly! Get off me, get off me, get off me, get off me! Ew, ew! I'm sorry, 5-year-old me. I tried. I really tried. (slaps herself) Snap out of it, current me! Summer's not over yet. (looks outside the window) Hey, wait a minute, summer's over? Who did th- oh... Phineas and Ferb. (runs downstairs) Phineas and Ferb, what did you do to summer?!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Your fall is ruining summer.

Name: Woman #2
Dialog: You made me buy a blanket with sleeves!

Name: Man #3
Dialog: My toilet seat's cold.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen of the press, kindly put a cork in it. So you've probably figured out that the Earth has moved away from the sun.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: And we at L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. are responsible. And now, we're here to extort you. And to that end, let me introduce you to Señor Killbot.

Name: Dr. Killbot
Dialog: ¿Donde esta la biblioteca? ("Where is the library?")

Name: Rodney
Dialog: You know, in case any of you extortees speak Español. We don't want to leave anyone out.

Name: Dr. Killbot
Dialog: ¿Qué te parece mi bordado? ("Do you like my embroidery?")

Name: Audience
Dialog: Awwww...

Name: Female
Dialog: Aw, that's cute.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that's our new logo. Foreboding, yet comforting. So basically, if you want us to put the Earth back in its proper orbit, you have to meet our list of demands. Number 1

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Really? That's how you give demands?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What was wrong with that? I was gonna go for one of those big tubs from Lotsmo.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: You sounded like a bashful Santa Claus pitching softballs to a girl in a bikini.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, number four... Wait, you don't know what that sounds like!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Stand aside. (pushes Doof away from the podium) Listen, you dogs, with one small inator...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My inator!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: ...we've moved the Earth into an early autumn. Now, we, the collective scientific genius of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., have created an inizer ten times the size and strength! Capable of moving the Earth so far away from the sun, we'll bring about a new ice age! So, if you value your puny lives, you will meet all the demands on our list or pay the consequences!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is it just me or is this getting out of hand?

Name: Dr. Killbot
Dialog: Quiera lucha tu casa. ("I want to fight your house.")

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously? Someone moved the Earth and it wasn't you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not this time, no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any chance it could spontaneously go back to the way it was?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can't take that chance, Candace. We'll never have another summer if our plan doesn't work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Plan? What plan?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're building this massive rocket engine to put on top of Mount Danville.

Name: Candace
Dialog: One measly rocket on one mountain isn't going to move the Earth, Phineas.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pointing to a splitscreen monitor) That's why we enlisted the help of other kids around the world. See? There's Floria and Abdul on Mount Kilimanjaro, Ganesh and Kabul on Mt. Everest, Vsevolod and Vanko at the top of Mount Elbrus, and Lupert and Eporwold on Mount Haggenhuge. Eporwold's the goat. While they finish fine-tuning, we'll move our rocket up to Mount Danville.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then everyone turns them on, and the Earth goes back to the way it was?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sort of. But the burners all need to be synchronized through this control panel. Otherwise, we risk ripping the Earth's crust apart. Do you think you could stay here and help control the thrust?

Name: Candace
Dialog: These look like simple level controls.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. Pretty much the same as a sound mixer, except this one controls five megarockets capable of ripping the Earth in half.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why can't Irving do it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, he would, but he's trending right now.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Good morning, Agent P.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (different inflection) Good morning, Agent P. (to Agent P) Well, what do you think?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Carl, the evil scientists of L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. have captured all of our agents!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Ugh! My first day on the job and all my agents get captured! W-What am I gonna do?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Simple, let's go get 'em!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: But we're seriously outnumbered!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Maybe, but we have the advantage! We have the best agent with us and we have the element of surprise! We can't lose!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: You're right! Perry, Monty, let's go rescue our agents! (They leave, but Major-in-Charge Carl tries it again with a different inflection in the mirror.) Let's go rescue our agents. Let's go... (Perry comes back with his hands on his hips.) Oh, I'm coming.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there's Kilimanjaro! Phineas, Floria and Abdul's rocket is ready! That's all of them!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on radio) Great! (cut to outside where the rocket goes out for liftoff) Okay, Candace, we're on our way to Mount Danville! Lock down the capsule and stand by!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I sure hope there aren't any spiders in here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, let's put it down right there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon, everyone! Let's get this thing online!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (opening up a laptop) I'm linking up to the other rockets. Is everyone ready out there? Mount Elbrus?

Name: Vanko
Dialog: (on laptop) Check.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mount Kilimanjaro?

Name: Abdul
Dialog: (on laptop) Check.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mount Everest?

Name: Kabul
Dialog: (on laptop) Check.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Mount Haggenhuge? (no response) Mount Haggenhuge?

Name: Eporwold
Dialog: (bleats on laptop)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh-oh! Mount Haggenhuge, your rocket has gone offline! Can you fix it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: All systems are green!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on radio) Check! Firing up Mount Danville!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Candace...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (on radio) ...you're good to go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Roger! Target destination activated! Engaging thrusters! (She slides the switches up and all the rockets fire up.) Phineas, it's working! The Earth is moving back into position!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fantastic, Candace! Just a couple more minutes and we'll have our summer back!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Well, that was fun. (closeup to reveal Rodney and Doof carrying the grilled cheese flavored ice cream cones.) We should go get ice cream more often.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Didja have to order for all of us, Rodney? I'm not crazy about this new grilled cheese flavor.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: You get what you get and you don't get upset!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, he's strict!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: I think we've given our world leaders enough time. Let's see if they submitted to our list of demands! (He activates the screen and several world leaders, including a dolphin, a Scottsman, a Chinese delegate, President Barack Obama, and a female Indian delegate appear onscreen.) Well, what have you got to say for yourselves?

Name: President Obama
Dialog: Uh...you'll be happy to know that we've...uhhhh...met all of your demands, except for the...uhhhhhhh....pretzel thing.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: What?! How dare you!! Do you know what this means?!

Name: President Obama
Dialog: Look, we're sorry. Uh...We had them, but the Vice President left the tub on the roof of the car, and we...uhhhhhhhh...

Name: Rodney
Dialog: No pretzels, no deal!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (offscreen) You have doomed the Earth to perpetual winter!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Phineas, the holographic thingy shows that the Earth is moving in the wrong direction!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that makes no sense. It should be working.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe it needs more power. I'm increasing the burn!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, Candace, don't!! Never push it into the red! That's a bad thing!! Turn down the thrusters!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: This must be a special episode. He's yelling at his sister again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Phineas, what happened?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You must have overloaded the power relay on the control panel. You're gonna have to get a spare electromagnetic coupling fuse.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on radio) Where would I find a thing like that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb has one in a box in the attic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on radio) The attic?! Where all the spiders are?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, the attic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: That's just the building settling again.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (offscreen) Now the world knows that L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.'s not an organization to be trifled with!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Yeah, meanwhile, you may have plunged the Earth into another ice age.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: The world is ours for the taking!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But this is crazy talk! I-I'm an evil scientist, not a mad scientist! Th-There's a difference! Subtle, I grant you, but, still, y'know, I don't really like the new direction this organization is taking and I think we need a little fresh air. (he walks out)

Name: Rodney
Dialog: You also need a chiropractor, Slouchy!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Good one! Because he slouches!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: And as an agent, you get to wear a nifty fedora. I made that one out of an old newspaper. Yes, sir, OWCA is perfect for a guy like you, but-but, sadly, not for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, things are tough all over, bub.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: What? Doofenshmirtz?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, do...do I know you? (Monogram puts two fingers on his nose where his mustache once was.) Major Monogram? Francis, what happened to you? Look...y-y-y-you're a washed-up mess! This whole weather thing is your fault, you know!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: My fault?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, technically, it's my fault. But if you weren't sitting around in a cold alley whining to rats and feeling sorry for yourself, this whole situation wouldn't have gotten so out of control! Before, I was a regular evil scientist, and now, suddenly, I'm part of this big organization of supervillains bent on world domination! I'm not comfortable with that! The point is you should've been there to stop me! And you weren't! (He puts two pennies into Monogram's tin cup and walks away.)

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (picking up the cup) Huh, two cents.

Name: Monty
Dialog: There's the warehouse!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (grunts) Oh! Guys, little help?

Name: Monty
Dialog: What do you say, Perry? Think we can take 'em? (Perry and Monty run up to the goons.) Alright, you goons! (Two more goons appear behind the first two goons.) (to Perry) You take two and I'll take two. (Giant footsteps are heard, which is, clearly, not good news.) Great. They have a cave troll. Run!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Perry, split up!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Thanks, Carl.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Wow, good work, Agent P!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Great! Now we get all his health!

Name: Monty
Dialog: You play way too many video games, man.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Candace, you can do this! What's a couple little spiders compared to the fate of the world? (climbs back down) Oh, who am I kidding?! I need support! (She dials her phone.) Stacy, I really need your help!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on phone) Sorry, Candace, no can do.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I have to stay put until the swelling goes down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Are you okay?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'll be fine. But until then, you're on your own.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hangs up) Well, she's no help. I'm gonna have to do this myself. (climbs back up) It's just you and me, attic. You and me... (climbs back down) and about TEN HUNDRED GAZILLION SPIDERS!! OH, I CAN'T DO THIS!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I've had time to think it over and we need to put the world back. I, for one, do not want to live in a perpetual winter! (pushes Rodney) Scoot over, Rodney.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Your betrayal doesn't surprise me, Heinz. (pushes Doof) Step aside!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (fighting over the controls) Wh-What are you doing?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Just to show you who's boss, I'm going to move the Earth even further from the sun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's Ferb's box way over there. Oh, who am I kidding? I can't go way over there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAAAHHH! Phineas, how did you get up here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm using the Ferbographic technology.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's taking so long? Did you find the box?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it's right over there by all those spider webs. Be a pal and grab it for me, will ya?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What? No, I can't pick it up. I'm a hologram. You have to do it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I can't!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, what's the matter, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's my fear of spiders. I've been trying to overcome it all day.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that is a valid fear. You should be cautious around some spid—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, you're not helping!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, you've already done so many brave things. Remember when you helped us recuse Klimpaloon? And what about that time you got that really big bird to quit pecking our house? Or when you climbed up on the motor of our baguette boat after I gave you a similar pep talk?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! You know what? You're right. (Climbs all the way up.) If I could do that, then I should be able to walk across the attic, right? It's being silly. Heck, I don't even remember what I was afraid of.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Spiders.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAH!!! (climbs back down)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you forgot the box!

Name: Monty
Dialog: There they are! They're headin' for the roof! We gotta get up there and stop them from firing that inator!

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: (with a pistol) Not so fast, Monty Monogram!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Take it easy, we don't want any (attempts to punch but misses) TROUBLE! (backs away) What?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Now that we have all of OWCA's agents, nothing can stop us!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) That's where you're wrong! (emerges from the shadows)

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Major Monogram!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: I'm back! And I brought some help! (Agent Rat appears on his shoulders and whistles, followed by all of the escaped OWCA agents.)

Name: Dr. Killbot
Dialog: ¡Qué lástima! ("What a Pity!")

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Wait a minute!!!  (record scratch) This is the same brawl we had earlier!

Name: Dr. Bringdown
Dialog: So?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Aw, I'm just sayin'.

Name: Dr. Killbot
Dialog: La cabeza de medusa no es agradable para ver. ("Medusa's head is not pleasant to look at.")

Name: Villain #5
Dialog: He's right! Let's get out of here!

Name: Villain #6
Dialog: That's not what he said, but...yes, we should get out of here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, you're not giving up, are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. (climbs back up) Today, I face my fear! Back off, spiders! Candace is in the attic!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Now we're talking!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! Take that, you little... (Several more spiders crawl down from inside the umbrella.)  AAAAHHH!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I guess there are a lot of spiders up here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's all right, Candace. You're just gonna have to reach past that spider.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Are you kidding me?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, the fate of the world is at stake!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, five-year-old me. Here we go. (She timidly sticks her hand into the box, only hesitating for about a second.) Gotta reach it! (The spider sticks out one of its legs.) A little...bit...further! (She grabs the fuse.) That's it! I got it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great work, Candace! You go down and put the fuse in, I'll go back and tell the guys! (The hologram disappears, and then reappears.) And well done! (The hologram disappears again.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: In your face, arachnid!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace did it, Isabella! She got the fuse!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Um, Phineas, one of the main locking bolts came loose on the rocket, and, uh...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Yeah, we should probably fix that before Candace puts the fuse back.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Oh, this is just ridiculous! You and I should just... (points somewhere) Oh, look! A Horse in a Bookcase!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A what?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Ha! Now to move the Earth into a new ice age!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why isn't this thing going in? What is it? "Righty-loosey, tighty-whitey?"

Name: Buford
Dialog: Phineas, this thing ain't budgin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? Candace?  (to Isabella) Why isn't this com-link working?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The rocket is blocking the signal! We've got to get up there!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: There. I've disabled the reverse switch and the self-destruct button. So there's no—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nobody messes with my self-destruct button! (He sticks the mop's handle into the inizer and tries to lift it up.) You make a pretty good fulcrum there, Rodney.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, at least we're out of danger.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've gotta get the rocket in position or the planet could be torn apart!

Name: Candace
Dialog: C'mon, you stupid thing! Get in there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on radio) The fuse is in! Okay, I'm gonna fire up the engines!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not moving, Phineas! It's like something's resisting our jets!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I was afraid of that! Listen, push the rockets up...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on radio) ...above the red line!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Phineas, you said that would be bad!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (on radio) Well, there is a...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ....slight chance of pulling the planet apart!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's a bad thing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's our only chance, Candace! We should be okay if we just do it slow and steady!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, just like the rabbit in the story.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, exact— Wait, no! Like the turtle! Like the turtle!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Slow and steady. Slow and steady. (She pushes the levers up slow and steady into the red and the rockets get more powerful.)

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Look, Doofenshmirtz is trying to destroy the inator!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Come on! He needs help!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Hang on, sir!

Name: Monty
Dialog: Nice catch, Carl!

Name: Roger
Dialog: I don't know what's going on anymore.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, what's happening?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Unless I've missed my guess, the Earth is moving again! You better shut down the rockets, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotta get to the controls! Almost th— AAHHH! (She falls over backwards.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It stopped. We're not moving anymore! Candace, you did it!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? I did? (She gets up to see that she pulled the plug.) Oh, what do you know? I did it! (She opens the door and smiles as she sees the snow melting.) Aw, summer. Welcome back! (The inator lands in the backyard and takes the control panel with it.) Yeah. Well, that's to be expected.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Come on, Roddenstein! You're comin' with me!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (to Doof) See ya later, Slouchy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well y— Ugh! I can never come up with anything quick enough!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz, you just saved the world. Thank you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're welcome, Francis. Put 'er there! (Monogram holds his hand out, but Doof pulls his away) Psych! (laughs) I'm still evil! (walks away laughing)

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Yes. Yes, you are.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Well, Monogram, nice work.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Thank you, sir.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Unfortunately, we're still not getting our deposit back on that rental hall and that's really broken the budget. I'm afraid we have to close OWCA.

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Sir, why don't you start a new agency?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Good idea! What do we call it?

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: (checks his phone) Oh, looks like the name "OWCA" just became available! Oh, and so did their old building!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Great! We'll call our new organization that and move there!

Name: Major-in-Charge Carl
Dialog: Good idea, sir!

Name: Monogram
Dialog: And to keep costs down, we're gonna have to cut some management positions. Colonel Contraction, your services will no longer be required.

Name: Colonel Contraction
Dialog: Yeah, well, that's to be expected.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think this belongs to you, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You keep that one, Carl. (He concentrates and instantly grows back his mustache.)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Welcome back, sir.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Everything's all right. We're all outside.

Name: Saul
Dialog: Oh, sweet sunshine! (kneels to the ground) Terra firma!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, well...

Name: Saul
Dialog: (kisses the ground) Lovely top soil!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: We'll, uh, just be going then, shall we?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Bye, Saul!

Name: Saul
Dialog: Mwah! Mwah! Mwah! Ugh! Kissed a bug!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There she is, the hero of the day! Nice going, Candace! Hey, where'd the command center go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Probably the same place the last one went.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You really did a good job, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and not only did we save the world, but I did everything I promised five-year-old me I'd do!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let's all pretend like we understood that!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, now that we have summer back, what should we do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh! Oh! I got an idea!

Name: Everyone but Ferb
Dialog: Buford!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think there must be somethin' wrong with this program.

Name: Audience
Dialog: Dengue fever!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Whooping cough!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Thank you! Thank you very much. My mom taught me that song!

Name: Everyone but Ferb
Dialog: Buford!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (from inside) Okay, Ferb, let's get this early morning party started.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Okay, prepare for landing. That's it, lad, don't let the turbulence throw you. Ha ha! Ha ha!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Roger that, Papa Bear.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: I'm so glad we can still have our Father's Day jaunt in the biplanes.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, modern technology's wonderful. I know it's not quite the quite the same as...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (him and Ferb walk in the hallway) Hang on, Ferb.

Name: Lawrence (cont'd)
Dialog: ...the real thing but I suppose it's better than nothing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, Ferb, I know what else we're gonna do today. (walks in Lawrence's room) Surprise! Happy Father's Day, Dad. And you too, Grandpa Reg.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Hello, boys.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, how lovely. Breakfast in den.

Name: Phineas
