Dialog: (reveals the Phineas and Ferb pancakes) Ferb and I pulled out all the stops.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What excellent likenesses! Ha ha ha! Thank you, boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Happy Father's Day, Dad.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: (on the computer) Hello, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in Cockney accent) 'Ello, Grandpa Reg. (normal voice) Happy Father's Day.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: (on the computer) Thank you, love.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello, Reg. Are you having a "Grand"-Father's Day? (laughs) Hoo hoo!

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Ha ha ha! Good one!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'll leave you boys to your Father's Day fun. Candace, are you ready to go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure, mom. Bye, grandpa.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: 'Ey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I see you're trying out the new SFU 2000. It's a lot of fun, but don't let your duties slide.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, what do you think of his Father's Day gift?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, it's a lovely tie, but I'm not your father! (to Perry) Anyhoo, Doofenshmirtz has plans to gum up the entire Tri-State Area. And we need you to check it out. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gotcha, Perry the Platypus! If you think this is a sticky situation, you better hold on to that fedora. Behold, the Gum-Under-The-Shoe-inator! I took all the wadded up chewing gum in the entire Tri-State Area and fed it into this -inator. Yeah, I know, it's really unsanitary. Why don't people just throw the chewing gum in the trash? Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Today just isn't my day. It's Father's Day. It's the hardest of the greeting card company holidays for me. My issues with Father's Day began back when I was a child.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Those were lean times for my father and our beloved lawn gnome was repossessed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I know you've heard that one before, but...twice actually...but I really think that this is where my relationship with my father went awry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I mean, he made me be that lawn gnome!

Name: Doofenshmirtz's Dad
Dialog: Bewegen sie nicht! ("Don't move!")

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he was really specific, too. He made me memorize the serial number of that particular lawn gnome. (While he talks, Perry goes onto the computer and opens the Lawn Gnome Tracker app.) DAEHM23. If only there was some way to reunite him with, y'know, that specific lawn gnome, maybe he and I could start again. (Looks at the computer.) DAEHM23?! You found him with an online gnome tracker? Wow, there really is an app for everything now, isn't there? Well, let's see. It says it's still in Drusselstein! Now I can heal the old wounds between my father and me! (gets up and walks but is stuck to the chair) Oh, man that is one of my most brilliant ideas yet! (His pointy nose pops the huge bubble made from the gum.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An exact replica of Grandpa's old biplane! Dad's gonna love this! (He and Ferb climb in and put on their helmets and goggles.) Let's try 'er out! (The plane takes off.) Now punch it! (Ferb pushes a button on a remote control and four jet engines come out from the wings and the plane increases speed.) Yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) I know traveling by cannon is a little unconventional...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (cont'd)
Dialog: ...but the cannon place was going out of business, so I got them at a volume discount. (lights the fuse) Hang on. (The cannon fires.) Woohoo!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Happy Father's Day, Dad! Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry for the lack of inflight meals or entertainment, Perry the Platypus, but one cannon can only go so far, so I set up a worldwide network.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw man! Missed it by that much!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perfect landing, Ferb! I'll go get Dad. (Cut to the sliding door. Phineas leads his father out.) No peeking, Dad! Keep 'em closed! Okay, open 'em!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Tada!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (voice breaking in tears) Thank you so much, boys! I can't think of a better Father's Day gift!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, there's a hidden feature you might wanna check out.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: (emerging from the passenger seat) 'Ello, son!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: D-Dad?! B-B-B-But...

Name: Reginald
Dialog: C'mon! Give us a hug!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (hugging his father) Oh, happy Father's Day!

Name: Reginald
Dialog: What do you say we go on our traditional Father's Day flight?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Race you to the cockpit!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have fun!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What are you two standing there for? You're part of the tradition now! Come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Right then! Engine...contact...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Here we go!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wooooooooo!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Nice ad lib, Dad!

Name: Reg
Dialog: Thanks, son, I just roll with it.

Name: Lawrence and Reg
Dialog: Like you do!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Drusselstein! This way, Perry the Platypus. (Doof and Perry get up and the cat meows. Cut to outside Ye Olde Pawn Shoppe.) Okay, so the gnome tracker located my father's long lost lawn gnome to this location. (He opens the door and gasps.) There it is! (He picks up a lawn gnome, but it talks.)

Name: Gnome
Dialog: Hey, put me down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! I thought you were my father's lawn gnome.

Name: Gnome
Dialog: No worries. I get that all the time. Probably due to my height combined with my eccentric fashion choices.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, yeah. Huh. Well, I'm looking for DAEHM23.

Name: Gnome
Dialog: (picks up the real lawn gnome behind him) Oh, yeah, it's been here for years. Here you go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It is you! My father will be so happy! Well, maybe not happy, but anything is an improvement over surly and dismissive. Let the father-son healing begin! (He arrives at the old Doofenshmirtz house and takes Perry out of the baby carrier.) Wish me luck, Perry the Platypus! (Perry smiles and gives him a thumbs-up.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (knocks and opens the door) Hello? Father? You're never going to guess what I brought y— (He trips on the floor mat and the gnome shatters to pieces.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz's Dad
Dialog: Oh, hello, Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sadly) Hello, Father.

Name: Doofenshmirtz's Dad
Dialog: I see you've brought me assorted broken bits of pottery for Father's Day. Well, I suppose it's the thought that, um...counts. Your brother, Roger, remembered how much I loved that old lawn gnome, so he sent me this. (walks up to a giant lawn gnome) Look, it also makes espresso. (The gnome opens a compartment door and an espresso spout pours some into a mug, which Doofenshmirtz's dad takes out and sips.) Delicious. But, you know, rubble is...a nice gift, too.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice breaking in tears) Alright...um...Happy Father's Day. And...okay, bye-bye. (leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz's Dad
Dialog: All zis way just to give me broken shards of potter— (gasps and sees the serial number) DAEHM23?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Well, that could've gone better. (Perry consoles him.) Why do I even bother, huh? At least there's one relationship in my life that's worked out pretty well. Thanks for coming along, Perry the Platypus. Let's go home. (They walk away from the curb.) You are my rock. (Cut to a cannon.) And by that, I mean you're there for me, you're not made out of rock. You're actually made out of...well, platypus, probably. (They climb into the cannon, which fires.)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, that was the best Father's Day flight yet! It brought back some some wonderful old memories and created a lot of new ones. Thank you, boys, for making this possible!

Name: Phineas and Ferb
Dialog: (hugging their father) Happy Father's Day!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes. Yes it is.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Crikey! It's getting late! I best be on me way home. Mind if I borrow your new aeroplane?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Why don't you hang onto it 'til next year? I've got no room left in the garage anyway.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: Will do! Cheery-bye!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, honey! Hi, boys! So how was your day?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, the boys and I spent a wonderful day flying with Father!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ah, the internet is a wonderful thing.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, yes, I...pfft...s'pose it is.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, here's something special from Candace and me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giving her father a gift box) Here you go!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (opening the box) Oh, my! An exact replica of Father's biplane! Oh, it's perfect! (giving his daughter a hug) Thank you so much, sweetheart!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Happy Father's Day, Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading) "To the most evil dad in the whole world, Happy Father's Day. Love, Vanessa." Aw, a gift basket of switches and self-destruct buttons. (pushes a self-destruct button) That's my girl! (smiles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz's Dad
Dialog: Bewegen sie nicht! ("Don't move!")

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Mom. Stacy and I are gonna have lunch here at the mall so we'll be hanging out a little longer. (Stacy shows a ferret headband to Candace as she gives Stacy a thumbs up)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I thought you probably would.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (voiceover) Are the boys doing anything bustable yet?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Not yet. Although they are trying to figure out how they can both use the push broom at the same time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: OK, keep me posted. (hangs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. We're going down to the park to fly our kites.

Name: Linda
Dialog: You guys wanna ride or something?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I thought you had to meet with those landscaper guys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh right, I forgot. (reads leaflet) Du Bois (Du-bwa) Landscape Artists.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Also, that's yesterday's paper.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I thought the city council was getting a little redundant.

Name: Man With Glasses
Dialog: Hello. I'm Pierre Du Bois (Du-Boise). One-day landscape artist. (shakes hands with Linda)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi! Oh, it's not Du Bois (Du-Bwa)?

Name: Pierre
Dialog: No. It's just like it's spelled. It's French!

Name: Pierre
Dialog: Except Floraine ain't French. He's from Dutch.

Name: Floraine
Dialog: (speaks in Dutch)

Name: Pierre
Dialog: That's Dutch for "It's nice to meet you.".

Name: Linda
Dialog: Huh. To my American ears, it almost sounded like, "Where's Perry?"

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Special surveillance photos tells us that Doof is outfitting his skiff with something. It's hard to tell--

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir, I looked up the window at his building just now, and saw the mysterious object was actually a bucket. A huge bucket.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Carl) Carl!? Why didn't we just look out the window in the first place?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I don't know sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doggone it Carl, we can't keep wasting out funds like this! (to Agent P) Well anyway Agent P, I guess you can go over there and see what he's gonna do with that large bucket. (Agent P leaves)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Is he gone sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, c'mon, let's go to Vegas.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey Baljeet, check this out! It's a kite, but it totally looks like a pirate ship!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is very nice! (He walks up a ladder supported by a huge dragon kite as the scene pans out. Chinese music plays.) Have you seen my kite?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow! Is it there even be enough wind for something like that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There should be, with Phineas's wind amplification device.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: So, how does this work again?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You start by blowing a bit of wind into the intake funnel. (Phineas inhales, then blows into the funnel. Pan to a tank filled with liquid that looks like water, in which Phineas points at it.) Then we have super cool liquid nitrogen to cool things down. Cold air sinks, until it starts to warm back up again. (Pan to a huge blow torch) And that's where we heat it up with a giant blow torch. And then, as it accelerates, it sucks up more air volume, and eventually blows it out with acceleration. (Pan to a huge funnel that opens up to let wind out. A bird flying into it loses all its feathers and is blown away.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But that was just one big puff of air! How can we fly kites like that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Simple! Irving has volunteered to keep puffing air into the intake. (Irving is seen climbing up a ladder.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: I've been eating mint all morning! (shows a bunch of mint) You know, so it won't be stinky!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's very thoughtful of you, Irving.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (snidely) I didn't really do it for you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So here's the yard. I want something nice out here. I think you know what to do. (everyone stops walking, Linda turns to landscapers) You are the landscapers after all.

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Ze is gelijk in. ("She's right about that.")

Name: Pierre
Dialog: Actually, we are landscape artists. (picks up car door with poster) Do I need to show you the car door again?

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, no. It's fine. I'll be inside if you need me. (walks away)

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Een - nul. ("One - nil.")

Name: Pierre
Dialog: No, I didn't get the money up front.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is everyone's kite ready?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: All set.

Name: Buford, Isabella
Dialog: Ready!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: OK Irving, let her rip!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Roger wilco! (He inhales and then blows with all his might into the wind amplifier. The amplifier then blows out a huge amount of wind. The kites start to fly.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's working!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, minty! (Cut to him) Ah hoy! Avast ye sworty dogs!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow Buford, you look like a real pirate!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's nothing. Watch this. Fire! (A cannon in the ship shoots out cannonballs.)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (getting hit by the cannonballs) Ow, ow, ow ow ow!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, watch this! I'm jumping clouds! Whee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's awesome, Isabella. Watch this! (His robot kite turns into an automobile.) Now I'm in a car!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enjoy your welcome-to-Danville lunch and ladies. (Point of view shot from Doof.) Soon, Grulinda, you shall taste the wrath of--(Perry suddenly appears in front of binoculars) Perry the Platypus?! (Cut to Doof and Perry.) Oh, before I forget, I got you a little lair-warming gift. (Doof gives him a ring box. Perry opens it, and a yellow rope is tied tightly around him.) Ha ha! You fell for the old spring-loaded-cable-trap-hidden-in-a-ring-box trick. What the? Th-that's a thing. Obviously. I bet you're wondering why I'm spying on a garden party. (Cut to Doof.) OK, maybe not wondering, but I'm going to tell you anyway. (Flashback.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) It all started when I was a child, back in Drusselstein. There was this mean girl named Grulinda. Every day she would pour water on my head. (Young Grulinda laughs after pouring water over young Doofenshmirtz's head.) No matter where I was, (Young Grulinda again pours water over young Doofenshmirtz's head and laughs.) or what I was doing, (Young Grulinda again pours water over young Doofenshmirtz's head and laughs.)

Name: Young and Present-day Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (together) Stop pouring water on me!

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewege dich nicht! (Don't move!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But by some wonderful twist of fate, (Doof shows Perry a magazine with a picture of an ugly girl and a beautiful one.) she has moved here to Danville! See? (reads caption underneath picture) Grulinda Boubenweir moves to Danville, party being held in her honor at Danville Park. (stops reading, cut to Doof and Perry.) And the party just started, I don't know how they got this picture in the magazine so quick. Eh, I guess they're trying to compete with the internet. (closes magazine) But, I digress! (cut to a giant bucket of water.) I can finally have my revenge! With this! (turns to Perry) The Sog-inator! (evil laugh) Now I will fly over her party, and douse her, with a lifetime of soggy humiliation! (pause) What? Oh, you think that it's petty that I held onto this grudge for so long. Oh, it's not petty. It's not. (looks at Perry sarcastically) It's evil or something; it's not petty.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay guys, I'm dying to see what you-- (gets shocked and drops tray of lemonade. The lemonade falls to the ground and breaks. A cat's yowl is heard.) What is that?

Name: Pierre
Dialog: Well it's not finished yet. But it's juxtaposition of the irrigated world of the suburban lawn the dryness of the natural summer environment. A water bucket dumping desert cacti, honey suckle basket, weak glass handle, extra spiky bubble cacti in place of the water.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (angrily) That looks- that's- (groans, walks away)

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Ik denk niet dat ze het leuk vindt. ("I don't think she likes it.")

Name: Pierre
Dialog: Not to worry, great art always takes time before it's accepted.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I need you to go into my closet and tell me what--

Name: Linda
Dialog: (places hand on forehead) Candace, I- look- call me in a few minutes. I'm a little ticked off right now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (she gets a surprised expression on her face.) What happened?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Du Bois made a huge mess in the yard; they ripped off the lawn, there's a giant bucket, and a bunch of catuses. (raises voice in an angry way) I'm so mad! I gotta go.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, what's wrong?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (weakly, referring to Phineas and Ferb) It's the boys, they're busted. (She falls over.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We should be over Grulinda's party any minute. Then it's soggy revenge time! (part of water from giant bucket falls off) Whoa! It's windy up here. If that keeps up, I don't have enough water to dump on her. (Perry thinks for a while, then bumps giant bucket on purpose. He does this one more time.) What? Did you hear that? (Perry just keeps quiet)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Uh oh.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's getting a little "rainy".

Name: Buford
Dialog: A little!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we better climb down.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Just remember, Baljeet, a captain always goes down with the ship. (gives hat to Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh boy, a promotion. (Buford jumps down, and he realizes.) Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's that noise? (the huge amount of water splashes onto the machine, causing Doofenshmirtz to hold on to the handle.) What the heck there? You've been dumping out my water? Oh, this had better not not be empty.

Name: Pierre
Dialog: (offscreen) Okay Linda, I know you're gonna love this. (Cut to landscapers standing next to a giant spinning wheel.) This is the irrigation wheel! Each section represents a different section of the garden. (spins wheel) It's a comment on the capricious nature of our existence. (wheel stops spinning, and arrow points on a band of flowers) Some get water and live, others go dry and die!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (facepalm) This is ridiculous. I don't want to end up with a yard full of (pause) dead plants!

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Ik heb water in mijn laarzen. ("I've got water in my boots.")

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with still hand on forehead) What did he say?

Name: Pierre
Dialog: He said, (angrily) "GREAT ART TAKES TIME!" (normal voice) in Dutch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, watch it. (falls over) Ugh! Now watch the ailerons! (He falls into bucket again. He climbs out of the bucket. The bucket falls over and crashes onto the wind amplifier. It breaks, causing Doofenshmirtz to fly into the air carried by a huge amount of water. The water shoots into the clouds, and Doofenshmirtz falls back down to earth. Perry tears apart his trap, jumps off, and catches Doofenshmirtz by his left leg. The parachute goes off. As Perry and Doofenshmirtz, the storm clears, but Doofenshmirtz falls off again, and Perry is left with only his left shoe. He lands into a tree, and the tree flings him onto the ground, causing him to roll to Grulinda's party. He stops at a woman's feet, and thinks it is Grulinda.) Oh, you! I almost dumped a giant bucket of water on you and your party. And there was this whole mishap with the platyp- but I will get you next time! Revenge is a dish best served soggy, Grulinda!

Name: Mean Woman
Dialog: Uh, Grulinda's over there, bub.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you're not... (turns to the other person and clears throat) All right, Gruuuuuuu...

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: Wait! Is that... hold on one second. (reaches for glasses and puts them on, then gasps) Soggy bottom Heinz Doofenshmirtz! It is you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you've changed. You used to be so... you know, what's the polite way to say... you know, like this one? (points to mean woman) Ugly.

Name: Mean Woman
Dialog: Oh oh, you're on my list now, buddy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So why are you being so nice to me.

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: Nice? I don't understand.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You picked on me all through grade school.

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: (chuckles) I poured all that water on you, because I liked you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? We, we, well I guess you must have liked me a lot, 'cause there was a lot of, you know, water.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what am I doing? (Reveal she is on a forklift.) Stacy, get me off of this thing! I need to see what the boys have done!

Name: Pierre
Dialog: She holds the thorns, which symbolizes the hardships of being a mom, and she holds pink jasmine, which symbolizes the joy of children.

Name: Linda
Dialog: This, is, the most, (does the puppy eye look) sweet and adorable thing I've ever seen. (walks away)

Name: Pierre
Dialog: (in a loud and not-so-happy voice) Sweet and adorable? (angrily) She's mocking us!

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Nee, ik denk dat ze echt leuk vindt. ("No, I think she really likes it.")

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: It is so good to see you after all these years, just look at you! Oh, come here, my little soggy bottom. (hugs Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, well, eh, now, you hug now.

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: Oh, why are you all wet?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He, he, funny thing. I was flying over your party with a giant bucket of water, and this platypus hit me with a--

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: Why are you flying over my party with a big bucket of water?

Name: Mean Woman
Dialog: He's gonna dump on you for revenge.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: OK, now you're on my list.

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: Revenge? For what?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you know, you did dump water on me when we were little.

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: Heinz! I was eight! Have you been holding this petty grudge all these years?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no, it's not petty; I was explaining to the platypus earlier; it's not--

Name: Grulinda
Dialog: (angrily) Well, here you go. I pour water on your head. (pours water on Doof's head. She then throws the cup to Doof, and she and the mean woman walk away.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. Was that for the vengeance thing or do you still like me? (Water is thrown onto Doof. To Perry) Yeah, it was the vengeance thing. (a cup is thrown onto Doof.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (excitedly) Tell me. What are the boys doing at the backyard? How much trouble are they in?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, at first, I thought Du Bois were the world's worst landscapers, but they're growing on me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (suddenly surprised) Landscapers?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yeah, here, let me show you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So I figure we can attach the seat right here--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) There they are, Mom. (onscreen) Show me what they did.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What did who do?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoa, wait. Where did it all go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sarcastically) Ha ha.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (surprisingly) How is that even possible?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Very funny, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It was all here just a second ago.

Name: Pierre
Dialog: (angrily) I have never been so insulted in my life! (Cut to inside of truck.) She called it sweet and adorable!

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Mijn voeten doen pijn en ze nat zijn. ("My feet hurt and they are wet.")

Name: Pierre
Dialog: (normal tone) By the way, Floraine, I have no idea what you are saying.

Name: Floraine
Dialog: Would you rather I spoke in English?

Name: Pierre
Dialog: Well yeah, now that you mentioned it, yeah.

Name: Norm
Dialog: All set, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughing)

Name: Denmother Puppet
Dialog: Okay, just this once, Fireside Girl. I'm gonna let you ask about my business.

Name: Fireside Girl Puppet
Dialog: Denmother, are you a puppet?

Name: Denmother Puppet
Dialog: I'm a marionette. Fuggedaboutit. You gotta fam'ly? Go home to your fam'ly.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Isabella, you have some mad marionette skills.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thank you, Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know I use this word a lot, but you and the Fireside Girls were awesometacular! I wish more people could experience your talents.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, we only have so many folding chairs.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Maybe it would help if your puppets were bigger.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you mean, Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: My uncle Oslo from Oslo used to make huge marionette puppets!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover) People would come from miles around to see 'em. Or at least they would have, if he ever finished one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, Oslo's in Norway. I thought your family was Dutch.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nevertheless, Buford, I think you may be onto something. (to Isabella) We can build a huge weird puppet, and you guys could take your marionette skills to the people in the streets.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, that'll freak 'em out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So whadaya say, Isabella? Are you ready to take the next step?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (romantically) Oh, Phineas, yes! I've been right here in front of you all along just waiting for you to... (romantic music distorts) Oh...wait. You were talking about the puppet, weren't you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah. What were you talkin' about?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sarcastically) Nothing! I uh, was just...heh heh heh—Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we have a situation. Dennis the Rogue Agent, formerly our most wanted rodent—

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Lagomorph, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What's that, Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Sir, they used to be considered rodents, but were reclassified in the early twentieth century.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, well, I'll have to fix that then. Carl, run out and buy me a new set of encyclopedias.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) A set of what, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hmm. Anyway, Dennis, the most wanted lagomorph, miraculously escaped from O.W.C.A.'s maximum security prison sometime this morning. Evidence suggests that Dennis was snatched away by a ninja-disco-robot. If this isn't the work of Doofenshmirtz, (Perry takes off) then Carl will eat my hat.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey!

Name: Driver
Dialog: (offscreen) I got your 22 and 1/2 tons of reclaimed pine logs.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, aren't you a little young to be driving a semi-trailer with 22 and 1/2 tons of reclaimed pine logs?

Name: Driver
Dialog: No. No I'm not. (points to the logo on the truck)

Name: Driver
Dialog: Now back up. Here come your logs.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Babyface Trucking guy!

Name: Driver
Dialog: Now if you'll excuse me I gotta head home. Is nap time. (He takes off.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Is that everything, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep! Let's build us a huge marionette!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You can come out now, Dennis the Rabbit! (The disco ball opens revealing Dennis in cutesy animal mode.) Aw, look how cute! He's cute! (to Norm) Isn't he cute, Norm?

Name: Norm
Dialog: He's adorable! And so soft...and warm...and squishy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, back off, Lennie, you're creepin' me out! (to Dennis) And you, you're not fooling anybody with that cutesy stuff! I happen to know that you are a very bad bunny. And I am...like, totally cool with that! See, I want to defeat Perry the Platypus and take over the Tri-State Area, and what I think I'm lacking is a certain animal instinct to get the job done. You have animal instincts, but what you lack is the evil scientist technology. And that is something that I have. So using my evil scientist skills, I'll make it possible for you to defeat Perry the Platypus while I watch from a safe distance. And together, we'll take over THE TRI-STATE AREA!! Whadaya say? Are you with me? (Dennis holds up his fist.) Great! I always wanted a rodent for a partner.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (offscreen) Lagomorph, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gesundheit.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow! This thing's so cool, Phineas! Everyone ready?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All ready back here! How you doin', Ferb?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Come on, everyone! Let's take this show to the crowd!

Name: Man 1
Dialog: It looks like she's trying to tell us something important, in her own silent enigmatic way.

Name: Viking
Dialog: I feel this puppet is telling us to look into our souls and find the power to embrace love for all humanity.

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Hey, everyone, the viking is right!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, before I let you loose on the O.W.C.A., this should make you much more formidable. (shows a backpack, but walks down the still moving up escalator) I like to call it my...my...my my my mymmymy (JANE! STOP THIS CRAZY THING!) I guess the escalator wasn't such a good idea after all. Oh, well. Live and learn. Anyway, I like to call it my Transmogrification-Backpack-inator! (straps it on Dennis) It'll give you a robotic exoskeleton that can transform into almost anything. And it's perfect to wear undercover, so no one will ever suspect. Except, maybe, to say, "Hey, look, there's a rabbit wearing a backpack." Go ahead! Give it a try! (A giant hand appears on Dennis' right paw, which blows a hole in the roof.) Hey! What the heck, man?! I live here! You can't go blowing holes in my stuff! (the robotic hand disappears) Now, try it again. (The inator produces a giant robotic body onto Dennis with huge hands, which he uses to hulksmash the floor.) Eh. Okay. Also, no smashing things in here! I'm gunna have to make a list for you, aren't I? (Dennis blasts off) Hey! Wait! Let me open the— (CRASH!) roof.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) It's true. Ferb told me. It's called rennet, Stacy. (Cut to Candace and Stacy walking in.) They scrape it from the lining of a calf's stomach to make cheese.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: And yet, when I wanna talk about sushi, you say it's disgusting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Omigosh! Cutie Patootie! My long-lost pet rabbit! (Picks up Dennis) Where've you been?! Oh, honey bunny, was Perry bothering you? Poor little fluffy britches patootie pants, let me get you home.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Stay down, breakfast. Stay down.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys, the crowd is loving it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Isabella, I'm all puppeted out! What say we take a lil' break an' get some eats?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Let's take five.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cutie Patootie, I got your chowsie-wowsie! (gasps) Oh! Stacy, he's gone! Where do you think he went?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe he's down at the docks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, maybe he—"Down at the docks?"

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Or maybe he's just playing with his friends.

Name: Dennis
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to see how my little friend is doing. (to the camera) You see, I installed a bunch of nanobot cameras on his backpack.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Who installed them?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was my idea! (turns on the TV) Oh, there he is. And he's fighting a giant puppet girl. What? There's something very familiar about the way she fights. Wait a minute. (The puppet punches the camera and the screen goes to static.) Perry the Platypus?! (Gets off the chair) That does it! I'm going down there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The big difference is that the marionette has strings, while a puppet is hollow, so it can be manipulated from within. But that doesn't mean that a marionette can't be hollow or a puppet has strings. The thing to remember is that some people take the subject very seriously, even though, technically, there's no difference grammatically. I looked it up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) There he is, Norm! Down there! On top of the puppet! (Doof gets lowered on the rope ladder.) Lower! Perfect! (Falls down.) Aah! Gotcha! Heh heh! Give up, Perry the Platypus! You know nothing of puppetry— (Perry manipulates the puppet to punch Doof.) Ow! Okay, I-I admit it, y-you do have a certain knack for it. (Perry manipulates it some more. Wide shot to reveal Doof tied up in the strings.) Okay. Well, maybe, "knack" wasn't the right word. (Perry manipulates it to flick Doof off.) Oh no. No no! (Doof gets flicked off the head.) Whoa! (The puppet dives into the ocean.) Curse you, Perry the—blub! (Coughs.) Platypus. I was trying to say, "Platypus."

Name: Dennis
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (drifting away on the puppet) Okay, I guess I'll see you both later. Unless I miss my guess, I'm on my way to...Norway, so, uh, take it easy, Dennis the Rogue Rabbit and uh, curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Mr. Patootie! (cut to Candace and Stacy) Where are you?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: There he is!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Mr. Patootie! (runs off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (to the camera) Whadaya know? He was down at the docks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Cutie Patootie, I'm so glad you're safe and sound!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There you are, Perry! Cool, Candace, you found your rabbit.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (appearing in disguise with Carl, also in disguise) Oh, look! There he is! My pet bunny, Mr. Bigelow! I've been lookin' everywhere for you! Get over here, you naughty lagomorph!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But he's... (to Phineas) Do I have to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, he is a lagomorph.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, okay. (gives Dennis to Monogram) Here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You've been a bad little bunny. (walks off with Carl) Now let's get you back to your...special room.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know. There was something weird about those two.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whadaya mean, Candace? Rabbit owners come in all shapes and sizes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A flight helmet and cowboy boots?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think the tall one was wearing a wig.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And the other one had a false mustache.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Plus, they're leaving by helicopter.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You do realize that none of those observations disprove my statement, right?

Name: Ferb, Candace and Stacy
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on gang, let's get started on building our megamondo--

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, no can do, Dinner Bell! It's family day, and the Van Stomms from the low countries are visiting. (walks away) Buford is out, G!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well that's a bummer. But we can come over some workarounds. (to Isabella and Baljeet) So if you two--

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No can do, Phineas. I am taking an eastern Indian cooking class. We are going to make goat vindaloo. If we can ever find a goat. (goat brays offscreen) Oh! There is one now. Gotta run! (runs away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, good luck! (pauses) Well the plans will still work with just three of us.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walks up) I'm afraid your plans will have to wait until after Ferb's dental appointment. (walks Ferb with her) Come on, honey, time to go!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: All right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I've never seen Ferb so nervous. Hmm. Well I guess it's just the two of us, huh. (Isabella squeals excitedly with an exaggerated smile on her face.) Isabella, are you all right?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (slaps herself, acting normal) Oh. Oh yeah. We can spend the day together, that'll be fun! Whatever.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's see; with only two of us, we'd have to reallocate some weight in order to... (pause) Huh. Well, maybe if we just reduce the amount of... (sighs) No, that won't fly either. Y'know, this is a lot harder without Ferb around.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But he never says anything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's not what he doesn't say, it's how he doesn't say it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well I can get the Fireside Girl Manual for inspiration.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That sounds great! Thanks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Even Perry's gone... but that's pretty normal.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I see you've taken our new breakfast-themed lair entrance. It's the most important lair entrance of the day. Anyhoo, OWCA has surveillance footage of Doofenshmirtz raiding thrift-store dollar bins. Not sure if it's evil, but it's, just kind of pathetic. Get to the bottom of this, and stop Doof's potential poverty-driven criminal freakout. And um, how 'bout ya pick up a cup of coffee for him on your way over? It's on me. Use some petty cash. (Perry salutes, then leaves) I feel bad for the poor guy.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (offscreen, gasps) The Fireside Phone!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Gretchen at the ready, ma'am! Commence debriefing!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Gretchen, we have a Code Pink! Romeo is alone! Repeat

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Roger that. Don't panic, we're on our way.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (saluting) Reporting for duty, ma'am.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: The troop is establishing the mobile tactical headquarters as we speak!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nice hustle. (She and Gretchen walk inside.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, right? With Phineas and Ferb split up for the day, it's practically a vacation! (She passes by Isabella's house with the clubhouse next to it in the background.) Yes, I know we're already on summer vacation, Stace. I was just -- (Opens her eyes and turns around, notices the clubhouse) What? A Fireside Girls mobile tactical unit? Sorry, Stace, gotta go! (Hangs up and runs off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, what are you doing (Walks up to Isabella and Gretchen) and what has to do with my brothers?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Um... (Scoffs, cut to the other girls working on a scale model on a table, continues offscreen) it's...something of a delicate matter.

Name: Milly
Dialog: Romeo is all go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Delicate?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, you might not know, but I have a little bit of crush on Phineas?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (offscreen) Little being subjective.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (dryly) Stand down, Fireside Girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (realizing) Totally get the crush thing! You know, I don't quite get the Phineas thing. I mean, you do realize his head is a triangle.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Sighs, romantically) Yeah, it's so acute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever. I have got your back, sister. I will stay outta the yard, and keep Mom out of the way too. (Folds her arms) Like, that should be difficult.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, it's you, Perry the Platypus. (Perry presents him the coffee cup.) What? Oh, for me? (He takes it.) Oh, that's a nice gesture, thanks. (Perry walks inside.) A-and you even used the doorbell instead of just crashing through, like you usually do. Alright, really appreciate this, Perry the Platypus, 'cause you know, money's a little tight lately, I can't even rub two nickles together. (Cut to Perry standing on a white patch of floor, he continues offscreen) Although if I had two nickles, I don't think I could sit and rub them together. (While saying this, Perry stares at the screen, then eventually sinks into the floor.) Oh, oh yeah, you're trapped, Perry the Platypus, (Cut to him) it's quick hardening, non-dairy creamer. Like I said, I'm on a budget. I know what you're thinking, Perry the Platypus, how could this happen to such a (Close-up of a stern Perry, he continues offscreen) withed guy like Heinz Doofenshmirtz? (Cut to him) Well, my ex-wife Charlene is out of the country on one of those...Extreme Eco-cultural Exploration Vacations. I -- I don't know what they do on those trips, but I imagine it's (crossfade to a still image of Charlene zip-lining with money flying out of her pocket, he continues offscreen) very expensive. (dissolve to her kayaking) Ugh, she's got some nerve! (cut to her hula dancing) That's -- that's my alimony she's throwing away! (cut back to he and Perry, he's showing him the images on his phone) And the worst is, she keeps texting me these pics! (puts it in his pocket, it beeps and vibrates) Oh, come on, really?! (walks offscreen) Anyway, the problem is I've already spent this month's alimony on my new -inator and -- (cut to him walking towards his new inator) and now I don't have enough money left to send Vanessa to the Grievance movie marathon she wants to see, and they're playing all the Grievance movies in order. They've got The Grievance, they've got Grievance 2

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And it was such a stellar plan, too. I was gonna use it to send City Hall, and consequently my brother Roger, back to Drusselstein, and out of his mayoral jurisdiction. No fuss, no muss, just bzzt, and he's gone, instantly. (Cut to Perry, who counts down on his fingers.) Ugh, if only if it were that easy to get Vanessa to the movie theater, wait -- (Perry points at him.) hey, wait a second! (looks at the giant dial on the inator) I could just add another setting to my Teleport-inator and send Vanessa directly to the theater, and completely bypass those ridiculously inflated movie ticket prices. Oh man, am I good! That deserves a victory sip. (drinks coffee) Egh! Wait—what is this, decaf? (cut to a put-out Perry) It's like you don't even know me!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (from inside) Alright, Fireside Girls. (cut to her in front of a computer and speaking into a microphone, Ginger stands next to her) Initiating Operation

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (into her earpiece) Roger that! (opens gate and walks in)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, looks like the operation is in phase two and I am gonna make myself scarce. (Stands up) Cadet Flynn is out, peace! (walks away)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Here we go. Let's just take a look -- (gets a thoughtful look, sounds like a valley girl) You know, I'm kinda hungry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well then, why not just have a picnic?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (acting) Well. What a great idea! And I just happen to have... (shows picnic basket, singy-songy) a picnic basket right here!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Ooh, she's good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! Way to be prepared, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (acting) Just doing my Fireside Girl thing! I packed it with some Mexican-Jewish delicacies like... (she shows a cheesecake like meal with a gelatin fish head.) gefilte-flan! (close up of it) It wobbles.

Name: Phineas/Isabella
Dialog: Eww! (laugh)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That looks ridiculous!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Oh no! We've got a Code Irving!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Strike team deploy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's see what else I've got.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you hear something?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nope!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (salutes) Mission accomplished!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hello, ladies! (purrs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The fox hops over the log...the rabbit crawls under the log... (ties wires in a bow, closes compartment) okay, got it! Now, to send -- (falls off) Ahem. And now, to send my daughter to the movies! (horror music plays) Aw, you see, it's just doesn't work in this instance. You know what, you guys just take the rest of the day off.

Name: Slack #1
Dialog: Want to go see a movie?

Name: Slack #2
Dialog: Yeah, sure. How about Grievance 4?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey Vanessa, Pumpkin Pants. Can you come in here for a second? (turns knob, Vanessa enters) Good news, sweetie, I can send you to the movies after all!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really? Dad, it's no big deal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I did it! (Cut to Perry, who looks up at the coffee cup. He continues offscreen) And now that my super dad status is intact, it's time to take care of business! (Perry hops over to the table and grabs the cup.) And by business, (Perry takes the lid off the cup) I mean evil. (Perry pours the coffee on the creamer block, melting it.) It's time to set my sights on (Cut back to him) on City H -- (Perry kicks him, he slides down the inator.)

Name: Male tourist
Dialog: Hmm. (The vase and table appear in front of the painting.) Ohh, now I get it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. I didn't count on an oscillate function, Somehow I...I don't think this bodes well for my plan.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (onscreen, acting) That's one of my own creations! I call it the Enchillatke!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (onscreen) It was delicious!

Name: Dentist
Dialog: Ah, here we are. (turns around, sees that Ferb's gone) Gladys, we have a runner.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! You're back! (Ferb doesn't say anything.) Brilliant! (to Isabella) See what I mean, Isabella?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (acting, sounds a bit sad) Yeah, it's how he doesn't say it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's get to work, this'll be the biggest picnic ever! (walks off) I'll get the tools!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (into her earpiece) Alright girls, Union Jack is back. Operation

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (with his mouth full of procaine) Ab flabahem abla flapabla.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's alright, big guy. You guys just do what you do.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (runs into the scene, blueprints in hand) Looks like we're gonna need a change of venue. How 'bout the park?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What do you know? No more Perry the Platypus. Transported to some random location somewhere. (Perry reappears and punches his nose, he disappears.) Ow! What -- (Perry reappears behind him, grabbing his head.) OW!! OWEY!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Thanks for introducing me to the ironic enjoyment of Ducky Momo, Candace.

Dialog: Ironic, yeah. Ha ha. So, your dad was really raised by wild ocelots?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I said I'd give them space for a romantic picnic, that is not a romantic picnic. That is Bust Town U.S.A.! (She enters the park.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dialing phone) I am so gonna relish this bust! (answers it) Mom!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, it'll have to wait. I've gotta pick up Ferb from the dentist.

Dialog: Mom! Ferb's here! At the park!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, well, he must've gotten out early. I'm on my way.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Try our famous Tjinder family vindaloo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no. Try our Van Stomm family bitterballen!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (running) Try the vindaloo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (also running) Bitterballen!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Vindaloo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bitterballen!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, you got your bitterballen in my vindaloo.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And you got your vindaloo all over my bitterballen!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I wonder if these two great tastes will taste great together.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah. We should kill this with fire.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (pauses) Agreed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (groaning)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What happened? Something just happened. I smell bitterballen. Where are we? (Perry lifts his hands off his eyes.) Hey, not bad, I can totally go for a mid-afternoon walk. (Perry hops onto the Teleport-inator and looks at the self-destruct button.) What are you doing? (Perry turns the knob to the "home" setting.) CURSE YOU PERRY THE -- !

Name: Candace
Dialog: Over here, you gotta see this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (notices Phineas and Isabella) Oh, Candace, you're right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: That is just adorable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns around) What?!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. I don't know where it all went. It's a good thing we brought our own basket, huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (acting) Yes. Yes it is.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, Candace. Let's go home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but—a whole park!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yup. (walks Candace away with her) And just the two of them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) I get it. But, ew.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Okay, Stace. Let's try again.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (mumbles)

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's really more in the cheeks. Like this

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I give up! It's a good thing you won that contest to perform backup with Love Händel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, in "The Ballad of Klimpaloon", I will be playing Klimpaloon. Check out my Klimpy style!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Girl, I have already cashed that check, and I don't even know what that means.

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: (giggle) Girl talk!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Honey, the limo's here to take us to the award show!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Be right there! (gasps, to Stacy) I gotta go!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You go, girl!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's never speak of this again.

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: Come on, boys. Time to go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys look great!

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: Well, Lindana and Max Modem have to look their best when presenting our category, don't we?

Name: Lindana
Dialog: Whatcha got there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is the first journal of the famous explorer, Sir Alvin Shackleberg. He was the first person to sight Klimpaloon, the magical old-timey bathing suit that lives in the Himalayas. We got this to help Candace research her "Nang nang nangs" for "The Ballad of Klimpaloon".

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: How marvelous. It reminds me of the time when—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Dad, there's no time for that now. We gotta go while I'm still in the zone. (walking like Klimaploon) Nang nang nang nang nang nang nang.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: She's good. (gets off the couch and walks out with Ferb) It's like Klimpaloon was right here in the room with us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, sweet limo! Ferb, I know what we're gonna do tomorrow! (Ferb shows a blueprint) How do we do it? Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I see you got the memo. It's Transcendental Meditation Week. Namasté. (He bows and Perry bows back.) Doofenshmirtz has been spot—Carl, enough with the drumming!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, sir, I just, sorta, got into a groove.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Doofenshmirtz has been spotted as a seat filler at the Fourth Annual 24-Hour Tri-State Area Music Awards. As you know, Doof's brother, Roger, is emceeing the event. We're not sure what he's up to, but we need you to suss it out. (His floating cloud starts to rain.) That's the... That's the cloud. Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Live from Random Stadium, Random Swimwear presents The 4th Annual Tri-State Area Music Awards

Name: Roger
Dialog: We've got a lot great music for you tonight, and a lot of...other music. So let's get things started, shall we? Please welcome to the stage our presenters for the fact-based song category, the girl who just wants to have fun and the guy who, I guess, wants fun to have with. Lindana and Max Modem!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! (whoops) Go, Mom! Go, Dad!

Name: Stage Manager
Dialog: (offstage) Just go! Just go! I'll fix it later!

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: (bends down) Our first nominee for...

Name: Lindana
Dialog: (also bends down) ...the fact-based song category is, Slamm Hammer, with their hit, "Trees are Made of Wood".

Name: Lindana
Dialog: (offscreen) The second nominee in the fact-based song category are the Hockey Hooligans with "Hockey Z-9".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking over) Excuse me. Pardon me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Excuse me. Excuse me, pardon me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Excusez-moi. Con permiso, por favor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hee hee!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha! Perry the Platypus, your timing is incredible! And by that, I mean, "Completely credible!!" (Traps Perry in a wig) But you've found yourself in a hairy situation! Because of the trap, it's...Which is a wig. Stop me if you've already made the connection. Anyway, you're just in time for my latest inator. (Takes out a spray bottle.) Behold! (Perry just looks at him unimpressed.) I know what you're thinking. And, no, I did not invent a spray bottle, Perry the Platypus. Just stay with me through my backstory, alright? You see, I was reading The Danville City Charter...again, when I learned an interesting fact.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Back in 1805, Danville actually elected a warthog as mayor. The public was fed up with the previous administration and thought, "Hey, what's the worst that could happen?" Nepotism, that's what. He filled the cabinet with his uncles and brothers and distant cousins and all of City Hall was full of swine. Except for one chair that they kept empty, so y'know it wouldn't be...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...so conspicuous. So it was decided never to allow another warthog to be in a position of authority. Pe-Perry the Platypus, are you texting while I'm monologuing?! (He is. Doofenshmirtz takes the cell phone away. Perry simply shrugs.) Y'know, I'm just gonna hold onto this until I'm done, (puts phone in his pocket) 'cause I can get your full attention. Anyway, I'm thinking, "Nepotism. City Hall. My brother, Roger." And suddenly, I know what to do! Turn my brother into a warthog!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) So, through the use of pseudo-technology, I created this elixir, that, when sprayed on an individual, actually transforms them into a warthog.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? I said, "pseudo." Anyway, once I collected enough elixir, I put it in this

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: (passing by) Right this way, Mr. Mayor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Now's my chance! (kisses) Peace out, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: Love Händel with Candace Flynn, you're on in five!

Name: Candace
Dialog: OMG, OMG, OMG, OMG, OM—

Name: Lindana
Dialog: I guess just introduce the next act.

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: (sticking his head into the hole) The last nominee in the fact-based category, "The Ballad of Klimpaloon" sung by Love Händel...

Name: Lindana
Dialog: (also sticking her head into the hole) ...who are joined by contest winner...

Name: Lindana and Max Modem
Dialog: Candace Flynn!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (wolf-whistles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Go, Candace!

Name: Slamm
Dialog: I object! The song does not belong in the fact-based song category! Klimpaloon is not real!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What?!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: What?

Name: Lindana
Dialog: What?

Name: Sherman
Dialog: What?

Name: Danny and Bobbi
Dialog: What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Everyone
Dialog: WHAT?!?!!

Name: Sherman
Dialog: My nana told me stories about Klimpaloon.

Name: Slamm
Dialog: Well, that's not good enough. Seeing is believing! And no one has ever seen Klimpaloon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, excuse me, but I have seen him!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's right! You tell 'im, Candace!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: (emerging from the shadows) I'm afraid that's not good enough either.

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, Mittington Random!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Thank you, Max...errr...whoever. Mittington Random here, sponsor of the show and President of Random Swimwear. You're welcome. According to the rules, when a fact-based song is called into question, physical proof must be presented here within 24 hours.

Name: Danny
Dialog: How are we supposed to do that?

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Well, actually, you can't.

Name: Danny
Dialog: Wait, what?!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Oh, Daniel, the rules clearly state that the band, along with the presenters, are to be locked in a soundproof room for 24 hours or until evidence is provided, whichever comes first.

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: Wait a minute, why the presenters?

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: I can't hear you 'cause you're supposed to be in a soundproof booth.

Name: Lindana
Dialog: Oh oh oh...

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Move along.

Name: Lindana
Dialog: Candace, you're in charge.

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Okay, sorry for the inconvenience, folks, but it looks like we're gonna have to move this category to the end of the show.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, we need to find Klimpaloon and bring him back within 24 hours!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're way ahead of you! Ferb's rounding up the gang!

Name: Slamm
Dialog: Those darn kids! I'll stop at nothing to make sure they don't prove the existence of Klimpaloon! Nothing!

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: You're on next, Mr. Mayor, after the pork-based world music act.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now's my chance! (he sprays the inator, but Perry blocks the shot) No! Oh, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: Swine Flute, you're on! Where's your tambourine player?!

Name: Flautist
Dialog: No show, man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Look at you, Perry the Rasta-Warthogapus! (laughs, but Perry kicks him backwards)

Name: Flautist
Dialog: (to Perry) Kid, you've got the goods.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And now, here's Swine Flute!

Name: Flautist
Dialog: More tambourine, man!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Isn't anyone gonna talk about how we got here so fast?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Buford. We don't have the time for that. Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Two words

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got two words for you

Name: Map Montage
Dialog: At Mount Crest, Phineas and the gang and the yaks ski downhill.

Name: Baljeet and Phineas
Dialog: (whooping)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh yeah!

Name: Yaks
Dialog: (no comment)

Name: Map Montage
Dialog: Phineas and the gang Chute the Chutes. They arrive at a tunnel. A mysterious figure appears behind them.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Anyone else get the feelin' we're bein' followed?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, not a bit.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Paranoid.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Ferb, where to next? (Ferb turns the page to reveal it's blank.) That's it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We lost the auction for volume two.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We got sniped.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What about that cave up there with the weird Klimpaloon-shaped totem?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If Buford is now the brains of this operation, my life has lost all meaning!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Watch it! Long underwear makes the best wedgies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, make the sound!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nang nang nang nang nang!

Name: Echo
Dialog: Nang nang nang nang nang! Nang nang nang nang nang!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang nang nang nang nang nang nang nang!

Name: All
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's him!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Klimpaloon! Yay! We found him!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Way to go!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wish I could un-see that!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Got 'im!

Name: All
Dialog: Mr. Random!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: This unforeseen plot twist...brought to you by Random Swimwear.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (appearing over the Random Swimwear card) Wow! I totally thought that shadowy figure was gonna be Slamm Hammer!

Name: Roger
Dialog: (offscreen) Welcome back to the Tristies!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Our next category...

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: And then, the hobo gave it back to me, quixotically. And that was the day before we met! So the next day at breakfast, I ordered poached eggs with salmon. But I didn't have poached eggs with salmon! Ha ha!

Name: Danny
Dialog: I wonder how the boys are doin'.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get us down from here!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Uh, that really didn't align with my plans, sooooooooo....nnnnnot gonna happen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, if you're going to destroy my chance at stardom, I think I deserve an explanation.

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: All right. I, I do like the sound of my own voice.  So, for years now, I've wanted to find the elusive Klimpaloon. And finally, after countless hours web surfing, I found Shackleberg's journal at an online auction site only to lose the first volume to you two! I did manage to get his second journal, but it only contains the last page of the map, the map that you have in Volume One. So I concocted a long, convoluted plan to get you to lead me right to him. Huh? Hmm. Yeah.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But why?

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: You see, sales have gone flat. You can only reinvent the bikini and board shorts so many times. But if I could convince the world to start wearing old-timey bathing suits again, that's revolutionary! But to do that, I was gonna need a gimmick.

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang nang nang nang nang... (etc.)

Name: All
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: What a combo! He's self-propelled, he's got a weird disturbing face on his chest and he makes unintelligible noises. Seriously, just th-the whole package is irresistible! And he's all mine! He's all mine! (zips the garment bag back up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can't own him!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's a living thing!

Name: Buford
Dialog: He belongs to the ages!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Well, the ages should have kept their receipt, because he belongs to me now. And once I unravel his secrets, I'll make a fortune. Well, a second fortune. (A helicopter is heard in the distance.)  Ah, there's my ride! (flees) Brought to you by Random Swimwear!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can't let him unravel Klimpaloon's secrets!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Unravel? (climbs up the net) I've got this! (she frees them out of the net) Knot Untying Patch, check!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on! (the gang runs out of the cave) We've gotta save him!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But how? Mr. Random is already miles away. We have no idea where he is going and no way to get there except on foot!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow! What is with all the negativity?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Enough already! Time is running out and I am not going to blow my big break! Let's look around. Maybe we can find some clues.

Name: Buford
Dialog: See? Now that's constructive.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Look! It's one of Klimpaloon's threads and it's trying to find its way back to him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Follow that thread!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We cannot follow a thread.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Again with the negativity.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we can use it as a homing device. Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Is no one going to talk about where we got the snowboards?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's no time for that now! Come on! Come on! Come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, Roger's not on 'til the end of the show? Can't you get him back sooner?

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: No. Who do you think you are?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm his brother.

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: Nepotism will get you nowhere with me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, maybe not yet, but wait 'til Roger's a warthog! (he leaves)

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: I do not know what that means.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That must be Mr. Random's fortress! Follow me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. (gets into the snow and maps out a diagram) I'll just create a diversion here so that Buford and Baljeet can flank them from the left. Ferb can then use his intimidating shout to scatter them so that Isabella can come in from behind. That should work unless they have reinforcements. What do you think, Baljeet? Can you give me a number crunch real quick?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, gimme a sec. I am coming up with a 32.3% chance of success.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we've seen worse.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, guys, let's do this! BUFORD VAN STOOOOOOOOOOOOOOMMMMMMMM!!!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He just ran in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (going after him) Let's go! Let's go! Let's go!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (also going after him) Dangit, Buford!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (also going after him, angrily) Stick to the plan, man! Stick to the plan!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What the?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I used gamer strategy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, now I just have to set the spritzer, and the timer, and whoomp!, there he is! My brother, the warthog, mayor no more! (maniacal laughter)  Yeah. (sighs) Y'know, it's not the same without Perry the Platypus. I can't believe he ditched me. One lousy award and he goes all diva! Pfft!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the heck is all this?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's just...so wrong. They're...they're just horrible!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: You'll have to excuse me if this device seems incredibly threatening. It's only because...it is incredibly threatening!

Name: All
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Klimpaloon!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (sadly) Nang...nang...nang... (etc.)

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: As you clearly saw, my previous attempts to create the future of swimwear without Klimpaloon just were not working!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (angrily) You fiend!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Look, I'm givin' Old-Timey here a new twist! Flashback to fashion forward! It's a little high-concept, but take a look!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Pretty catchy, doncha think?

Name: Buford
Dialog: If by "catchy", you mean "sucks the life outta the room and makes me wanna puke"...then yeah.

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Anyhoo, now that I have the original, I can figure out what makes him tick. Which brings us back, obviously, to the incredibly threatening machine. So, it's time to extract Klimpaloon's life force, and, uh, then, of course, infuse it into my latest swimwear line.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We have to do something!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: How about this? (pulls the plug)

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Aw, come on! Did we blow the breaker again, Fred? Fred? Frederick, is that— (Crashes into something) That stings.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon, guys! Now's our chance to free Klimpaloon and—

Name: Buford
Dialog: BUFORD VAN STOOOOOOOOOOOOOOMMMMMMMM!!!!!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, no, not again!

Name: Buford
Dialog: So I did it again. (At least he got chicken!)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what do we do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Save Klimpaloon, of course!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang nang nang... (etc.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There he is! Follow his voice!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Got 'im!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ow! That is me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoops. My bad. That wedgie was unintentional.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got him! (the lights turn back on) Let's go!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Guards, don't let him escape!

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang nang nang nang... (etc.)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, they are too fast! We are never gonna make it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, we've gotta split up. Ferb, hide Klimpaloon under your jacket to keep him quiet and I'll lure the guards the other way with my "Nang nang nang"! Just get him to the awards show!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, Candace, you'll miss your big chance to—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Saving Klimpaloon is more important! Now go! (they split up) Nang nang nang nang nang nang... (etc.)

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Alright, hold on. (stops his dancers as he hears Candace nanging) That way! Follow that vintage swimwear!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Good thing they left the door open!

Name: Dancers
Dialog: Ooh! Cold, cold, cold, cold, etc.

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Great. Now I'm reduced to yak transport.

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: (to a security guard) Got it boss, it's go time!

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: ...and that's how we met.

Name: Stagehand
Dialog: Okay, folks, on stage in five!

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: Righty-ho!

Name: Sherman
Dialog: Wow, what a great story.

Name: Danny
Dialog: (offscreen) Bobbi, come on!

Name: Bobbi
Dialog: Huh? What? Wait up, guys!

Name: Roger
Dialog: And now, to present our final award for the evening, which, of course, was supposed to be our first award, but you remember that whole "does Klimpaloon exist" hullabaloo... Anyway, welcome again, Lindana and Max Modem.

Name: Lindana
Dialog: Unfortunately, due to lack of evidence, it appears that Love Händel has been disqualified. So, without further ado, the winner of the award for Best Fact-Based Song is—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait! We have the evidence!

Name: Lindana
Dialog: I'm sorry, kids. The journal isn't good enough. You need actual, physical proof.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But we do have physical proof! Ferb?

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: Nang nang nang nang... (etc.)

Name: Drummer
Dialog: I thought you said you'd stop at nothing to keep them from finding Klimpaloon.

Name: Slamm
Dialog: That's right. I did nothing and stopped.

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: How did you find him?

Name: Lindana
Dialog: And why are you all in parkas?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's no time for that now! Mr. Random is a ruthless venture capitalist who captured all of us in his Himalayan fortress where he performed inhuman experiments on bathing suits and tried to destroy Klimpaloon in pursuit of a revolutionary swimsuit sales gimmick.

Name: Lindana
Dialog: (thinking Candace is in busting mode again) Oh, Candace, not here. Not now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, Mom, really! Candace is telling the truth!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: Phuh! What an active imagination these kids have. We don't really have time for that now, we need to present an award.

Name: Phineas and the gang
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: No, no, let's get the award done. Tick tick tick. Time's a-wastin'. Shall we?

Name: Max Modem
Dialog: Well, obviously, Klimpaloon is real. So it gives me great pleasure to present the award for Best Fact-Based Song to...

Name: Lindana
Dialog: Love Händel for "The Ballad of Klimpaloon"! (applause)

Name: Danny
Dialog: Thank you! Thank you so much! And a big thank you to all the kids who brought Klimpaloon here! (applause) Come on, Candace! Take your place!

Name: Lindana
Dialog: Wow, he really is magical!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, he's being pulled up by a cable. Thanks, Miguel!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Let's hear it for Love Händel!

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: (menacingly) Look at them. Enjoying their triumph. "Ooh, we're so happy! We saved Klimpaloon! Let's all sing!" Well, enjoy it now, because I will get my hands on Klimpaloon! I'll unravel his secret, even if I have to rip him apart, stitch by stitch and then, the moronic people of the world will beat a path to my door, and beg for my cheap Klimpaloon knockoff line, 'cause consumers are just like lemmings, brainless little animals that I can manipulate right off the fiscal cliff like the puppet master that I am! (maniacal laughter, then realizes the mic was picking him up. He walks onstage.) Was that thing on?

Name: Audience
Dialog: Yes, yes it was.

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: My career's over, isn't it?

Name: Audience
Dialog: Yes. Yes it is.

Name: Mr. Random
Dialog: (walks off) And I'm a warthog.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the...I guess he doesn't really get credit for this one. He was just playing tambourine with Swine Flute. It's not really.... (sighs) Well....Sort of anticlimactic for me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, where's Klimpy? Don't tell me he ditched us for one of those swanky afterparties.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess he's on his way back to the Himalayas.

Name: Klimpaloon
Dialog: (waving from a Random Swimwear limo) Nang nang nangnang nang nang nang...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: See you later!Be cool!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See ya!

Name: Buford
Dialog: See you, Klimpy!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Safe travels!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't want him to go. I want him to stay with us.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Klimpaloon doesn't belong to us. He belongs to the ages.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I said that back in the Himalayas! Does no one listen to me?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, how are we getting home?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Pretty catchy, doncha think?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (from inside) Thanks for showing me the old scrapbooks, Nana. (cut to her with Nana and other senior citizens.) I love hearing about the old days. Tell me again about string art. And what was it like to get up and change the channel on the TV?

Name: Nana's Friend
Dialog: Oh, that's so cute, honey. Look at how old-fashioned I still am. I'm writing a letter. By hand.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Why don't you just text or call them?

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Hoo-hoo-hoo! You kids know nothing of the lost art of letter writing. Back when we were young, we expressed our truest feelings in letters.

Name: Nana's Friend
Dialog: Yes. You can tell someone how much they meant to you without worrying about getting interrupted. Or losing your nerve.

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Or hiccuping. That was my problem. When I was young, I had a crush on a certain boy, and I wrote a letter telling him how I truly felt. That boy ended up being your grandfather.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow. I've been wanting to tell someone how I feel for a long time, now.

Name: Nana's Friend
Dialog: Really? I've got an extra pen and paper!

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Now take your time, deeply state your feelings, and express your... (Isabella hands her the paper)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I've been scripting this thing out in my head for years.

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Perfect time, and the postman's here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Add this to your bag, my good sir. (hands over the letter about her true feelings about Phineas) So Nana, when Grandpa got your letter, did he come running to you and sweep you into his arms?

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: What? Oh no. I never mailed it. I'm not brave like you. I mean, he would've laughed at me or shown the letter to his friends. Can you imagine the embarrassment?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gets nervous) Oh boy!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, why do you have all these boxes of take out food thingys?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's such a waste to get rid of them. See? Look. Chopsticks and Ponzu sauce. That's Japanese but-but look, there's also a Chinese fortune cookie, that's what's known as fusion.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. I'm hungry.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh. Let's go get some food. Would you kids like to come along?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No thanks, dad. We had fusion for breakfast.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: All right, then. I'll clear all these drawers and boxes out later, darling. See you, boys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb! Let's do dad a favor and clear these drawers and boxes out for him! Oh, look at this! It's like a spoon and a fork together! What would you even call that?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: In the UK, they call that a "foon".

Name: Buford
Dialog: They do not!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a perfect fusion of aesthetics and utility. It's like a little work of art. Ferb, I...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Helping dad by clearing out this stuff.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're doing a chore? No way are you getting all the parent points. I've got chores to do, too. Carry on.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You know, the drawer in our kitchen is full of honey and catsup.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, and ours has red pepper flakes and little tubs of grated cheese.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, go home and grab it, guys! We're gonna make some art! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, it seems that Doofenshmirtz is into astrology now, and that makes him very dangerous to us. I know what you're thinking. I was like you. I always thought horoscopes were a bunch of hooey. But then, I read my own horoscope. I'm a Sagittarius. It said, "It's a bad to get a haircut". How spooky is that? I had my haircut yesterday. Today would be a bad day to get a haircut. How do they know that stuff? If Doof figured out the astrological science of our agents, he could predict our every move!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Excuse me, sir. I believe horoscopes are meant for entertainment rather to be taken as fact.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Of course, you think that, Carl. You're a Capricorn. You know what to do, Agent P.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in her head) Oh, come on, Isabella. What's so bad about writing a letter and expressing my feelings? Feelings are natural. Phineas is natural. We are both natural beings in the world. What feelings? (back to normal) Aw. (in her head) Did I really refer to him as "my little crumb cake"? Who does that? (back to normal) Come in, Fireside Girls!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Go ahead, chief!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I just mailed a letter stating my true feelings to Phineas and we need to stop him before he reads it! This mission is top priority! I call it "Operation Crumb Cake"!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Crumb Cake? Is that what you called him?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh boy, it's worse than I thought.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow. Artsy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. We're really getting into it. Who knew that making an art piece out of old take out stuff would be so fun?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is almost like Tadashi Kawamata's massive chair sculpture in Abu Dhabi.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Or the Sub Lyric Pile Killabuster with Onion on Marble in Salzburg, Austria.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, I think he just made that one up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus. Could you be a sport and shut the door? It gets really drafty in here. Give it a good slam. Sometimes it sticks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Betcha never dreamt you'd get caught in a dream catcher. Actually, Norm made that this morning. Who knew he was so crafty? Anyway, my astrologer believes that when Mercury is in retrograde, anything can go wrong and usually does. And, you know, she's always right, she has dark hair and bangs, and you know, as it turns out, Mercury has been in retrograde all summer. No wonder my evil schemes keep failing! And that is why I invented the Unretrograde-inator! You know, to reverse my bad luck. And I know that Unretrograde is sort of a double negative. It sounds like I'm making Mercury go forwards but I'm actually sending it backwards from going backwards which happens to look forward but it isn't. You know what? Basically, it's a Reverse-inator but... Unretrograde-inator! It sounded more astrology-y. Look. You know, I'll just show you how it works. Oh Norm! Could you come over here for a moment?

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm almost finished cleaning up your mid-morning piñata, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah yeah. Qué bueno, Norm. Now, just stand right there.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Oki-dokie. (gets zapped by the -inator) Oh my! I have a sudden urge to dump your piñata pieces back on the floor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It works!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Now, I'm going to push the giblets back into the chicken.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We'll never catch them this way! But we will get that letter back! No matter how nicely or politely we have to ask! We'll cut them off at Phineas's house. Let's go!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Now I'm going to put food waste back on the dishes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading the paper) Yes, yes, thank you, Norm. (to Perry) Does this make sense to you? Listen. "Someone is secretly speaking on your behalf."

Name: Norm
