Dialog: (offscreen) Time to unmake the coffee.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It sounds positive for me, and I like that, but who is speaking nicely of me? Wait, was it you, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Next, I'll unmake my dream-catcher.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, don't do that! (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz.) You never let me finish my sentences.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We're in luck! Looks like we're here before the mail's come! Okay, girls! Let's seal off this area! Holly, you go take up a scanning position one half-click to the north! Ginger, you got the south! The rest of you, fan out! We've got to intercept that letter! I'm going in back to keep Phineas distracted. Any questions?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Yeah. How long has this mailbox been here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oy. (runs off)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Now to unbrush my teeth. What am I doing?! Sir, the effect of your ray has worn off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sarcastically) I'm so happy for you. Listen, could you get this platypus off me?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Wow, is he hard to catch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're just noticing this, huh? Go get 'im!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey. (chuckles nervously) So, er, whatcha doin'? (chuckles again)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you think? The world's largest art piece made entirely of takeout food packets and utensils.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, wow! Huh-huh. Artsy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right? Can I show you around?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here, Baljeet has thoughtfully recreated Gainsborough's The Blue Boy completely in red pepper flakes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (revealing his eyes are red, teary and bloodshot) I wish I would have thoughtfully recreated an eyewash station. Sheesh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Watch your step up the chopstick ladder. From here, you can see the whole neighborhood.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, uh...let's switch places. The light catches the foon so beautifully from this angle.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (wolf whistles)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome! The mail's here! Wonder if that comic book I ordered arrived. (climbs down)

Name: Isbaella
Dialog: No no! Wait!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, this doesn't look like a chore to me! It looks like a bust!

Name: Holly
Dialog: (on walkie-talkie) The stamp is on the envelope.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Excuse me, but do you have a letter in your bag addressed to Danville resident Phineas Flynn?

Name: Postwoman
Dialog: (searches in her bag) Hmm, looks like I do.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (sternly) We demand that you hand it over to us immediately! (politely) Please?

Name: Postwoman
Dialog: I'm sorry, it is unlawful for a postal carrier to deliver any envelope or parcel into the hands of anyone except the intended recipient as indicated in the address column of said envelope or parcel.

Name: Holly
Dialog: What about afterwards? Can we jump him and wrestle it out of his hands?

Name: Postwoman
Dialog: Honey, what you do with your afternoon is none of my business.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Mrs. Ferguson! (walks up to the postwoman with Ferb) Did my comic book arrive today?

Name: Postwoman
Dialog: No. Just this letter. (gives it to him)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, look! It's from you, Isabella!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in her head) Well, Isabella, here it is. He's finally going to know how you really feel. There's no turning back now.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Come back here! Now I've got-- (Perry spins the inator and it hits Norm.) --rhythm? (Norm falls forward and activates the inator.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (in her head) At least you told the truth and you spoke from your heart, (smiles) I can accept this.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) "Dear Phineas..." (cut to Phineas reading) Aw, and there's a little heart.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Oh, no, I just realized I may have put the giblets in the hamster!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! Gotcha! See, I began to think, "If only I had a nickel for every time you pushed my inator's self-destruct button", and then it hit me. You wouldn't have a nickel either because you don't have any pockets! Wait, wait, wait, what are you-?! (Perry takes off his fedora revealing a nickel on his head.) Oh, I forgot about your hat. (Perry puts the nickel in the slot.) Curse you, Perry the Pla--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See?! You never let me finish my sentences!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Awww! Of course.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why did I do that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to her mother) There was like a whole bunch of stuff the boys were clearing out!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Speaking of "stuff", what's up with your room?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yep. (walks into the house) I'm on it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I guess we'll never know what was in that letter.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (smiling) No, I guess not. And neither will your "little crumb cake."

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Milly!!

Name: Milly
Dialog: (whistles innocently)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: An almost perfect day to build another one of our inventions.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey! Dinner bell! Where do you want this crate of hoojimagawas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right there is good, Buford.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: How about these helicopter blades?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just lean 'em up against the tree for now.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ten-four, good buddy.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why do you sound like you're in a 1970s road comedy?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There was a cable marathon on last night.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, I missed it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Heads up. More random construction equipment for an as-yet-unidentified project comin' in!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This rate, I'll be late for my creative writing class. Agent P! No need to walk all the way down here! I'll just give you your mission on the staircase! Doofenshmirtz has been experimenting with image technology! It's very suspicious! We need you to go check it out! Good luck, Agent P! Idea for TV spinoff. Platypus in a staircase.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stace, the thing with boys is I just don't get them. You think they're saying one thing, but then you don't know if they really mean something else. They're like those Egyptian drawings that no one understands.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You mean like hieroglyphics? Those were deciphered in the early 1800s after they found the Rosetta Stone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine. They're like something else no one understands. Like, how you know that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (mumbles) I 'unno.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Take the conversation I just had with Jeremy. I suggested we go to the movies later and he said "cool". And what does that mean? I mean, did he mean like "Cool, I totally want to hang out with you" or "Cool, I really wanna see that movie" or "cool" like "I think you're being cold and distant"?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Not that one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Over here, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, you fell for the old hat rack disguised as your nemesis" ploy, eh? Well anyway, that was a very efficient use of my time. I demonstrated my latest inator, and trapped you all in one. Trap Perry the Platypus. Check. Demonstrate inator. Check. And now, that just leaves backstory, light lunch, take over the Tri-State Area, and schedule painters. Only seventy-five percent of my list left. I am on fire today! All right, so let's get down to business. Ever since I switched pizza places, you remember that whole pizza day debacle, right? Okay. Well anyway, my orders now are all showing up cold. Nothing I can do to change that, because, you know, I'm a lousy tipper, so I invented this. The impersonator-inator! An inator so nice, I had to name it twice. Rather than move or shell out extra cash, I can use this device to create a holographic field around myself, impersonate the pizza delivery boy, and pick up my own pizza. It'll still be warm, but then I said Heinz, Heinz, you're-you're thinking too small. Why not think of pizza boy's boss, but then I said Heinz, Heinz, and I said what? I'm right here. Stop saying my name. And then I said why be the pizza boy's boss when you can be the pizza franchise owner? Uh-oh.

Name: Electronic Voice
Dialog: Database image transfer.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoops. One pizza delivery boy, comin' up! I don't know who that was for. It was such a good line. It would've been a shame to hold it back. It's uh, oh hush.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously Stacy, boys are a mystery. I mean, what do they talk about when they're not around? Do you think they talk about us?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I got no clue.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I guess I'll never know the real deal as long as I'm not a boy. (gets turned into Gary Frank) Stacy, there's a pizza delivery boy in my room!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Is that code for something?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get back! Huh? There's no one there. But he's in the mirror. But, but, (gasps) Oh no. No no no no no no no. This cannot be happening. (gasps) Ah ha! Oh! Oh! Stacy, Phineas and Ferb have turned me into a holographic image of a pizza boy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Cool. Can I have a veggie special with non-dairy cheese?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (voiceover) Stacy!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, too bad Jeremy didn't order a pizza. Then, you can hang out with him and find out what guys talk about.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Brilliant! (gasps; laughs)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Just kidding, Candace. Candace! Oh boy, I gotta work on my delivery. It's way too deadpan.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Knowing what we're gonna do today. Check. Wondering where Perry is. Check. We're on fire today!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Did you order a pizza?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Maybe, he delivered a pizza before you even thought about ordering it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, make a note for later. Time travel pizzeria.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And then I thought, why be a brigadier general when I can be a major general? I mean, why not? Right? I'm a modern guy. And then I thought, maybe I'm still shooting too low. Why be a major general when I can be a lieutenant general? And then I thought, why-- (Perry slaps him) Ow! What, do you have a blowtorch under your tail or something? (Perry slaps him again) Ow!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: 37! 42! 74! Hike! Hike!

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Hey hey! I'm open! I'm open!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Pizza delivery.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That didn't count! Pizza interference.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Pizza for Jeremy Johnson.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, sorry dude. But we didn't order any pizza.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) You didn't. But your girlfriend did. That's some girlfriend you've got there. I see you're the luckiest man alive to have a girlfriend like that.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait a minute. You look familiar. Do I know you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) No.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You really look familiar. Aren't you?--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Nope. Just an average hamburger-eating football playin', punchin', gamin' boy. (spits) Boy spit. That's why I did that.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wait. You're Gary Frank! You were the most popular senior two years in a row! Dude. You gotta join us for a pizza break. It'll be fun to catch up and talk.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Talk. Yeah. Talk.

Name: All
Dialog: (laughing)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) (laughs) That was funny. Belching. (laughs) It's so, uh... (laughs) Male (laughs) Right, bros? But yeah, maybe we should talk about something like, I don't know, does anyone have any deep thoughts they'd like to share?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Nope.

Name: Jeremy and Coltrane's friend
Dialog: What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I think... this pizza's really good.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Oh, I'm so glad. Yeah, I figured you guys would like the supreme meat lover's choice. Though, I wasn't sure about the prosciutto. Sometimes, it could be rather tough. And when it gets in between your teeth, it could be really embarrassing like, (pauses) um... yeah, and that's how I feel about it.

Name: Jeremy and Coltrane's friend
Dialog: What?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: I have a feeling.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Great. Let's hear it.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: I have a feeling if Jeremy doesn't wash that shirt soon, it's gonna be reported as a health hazard.

Name: Jeremy and Coltrane's friend
Dialog: (laughs)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh yeah. Well your face is a health hazard.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Your breath is a health hazard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking like herself) I have really been underestimating Stacy's conversational skills.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looking like Teddy Roosevelt) Okay. I can tell by the way you're looking at me that I'm suddenly the twenty-sixth president of the United States, Teddy Roosevelt. Downside is

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looking like Teddy Roosevelt) Mm, guess the animal setting wasn't such a hot (Perry the Platypus (currently impersonating a gorilla) punches Doofenshmirtz) Ow! Wait. How did you punch me? The hologram was so much taller than you. (Perry picks him up) Ah! Ow! It defies logic.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah! Well, my fantasy league is killin' it this year.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thomas got me two touchdowns, twenty-three points last week, and 189 yards. I'm in first place in my keeper league.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: You're lucky, because I drafted Kimball, but he's out for two more weeks.

Name: Jeremy and Coltrane's friend
Dialog: What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) So, uh, what else do we talk about? Mm, let me think, uh... oh, I know. Anyone here have a girlfriend?

Name: Jeremy and Coltrane's friend
Dialog: What?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: I do. Her name's Stacy. She's absolutely the best girl...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Not you, I'm asking Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Duh. Remember the whole "your girlfriend ordered the pizza" thing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Oh, right. Yeah. Your girlfriend ordered pizzas. (clears throat) Uh, so, yeah, what do you think of her?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: She's cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) And what do you mean cool? Like cool how?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I just mean she's cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) So, cool like, you like her "cool"? Like she's totally cool to be around "cool"? Or cool like she's cold and distant?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, those first two. Not that last one. She's cool. She's sweet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) You mean sweet like thoughtful or sweet like so sugary or gonna be sick?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No. I just mean she's sweet. She's nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Nice like she's nice or, what do you mean by that?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Just what I said. She's nice. She's cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) So, what you're telling me is that what you say is exactly what you mean? Like nothing more, nothing less, you say it, you mean it, that's it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, yeah. What else would I mean?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Nothing, I guess. 'Cause we're like dudes.

Name: Jeremy and Coltrane's friend
Dialog: What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Okay, so you know, um... I'm gonna go.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Great hangin' with you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Yeah. Enlightening.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow. He is not like he was in high school.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on! (Perry gets turned into a football player) Oh, I get it. Pig skin. Oh great. My -inator has a sense of... (gets turned into a dinosaur while falling to ground) Velociraptor power attack!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! Where am I supposed to find a paleo-orthodontist?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. Fire it up. (Ferb turns on the machine) Ah. Congratulations, guys. We're the first humans ever to taste blueberry air.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, I'm more of a lingonberry kind of guy. (Candace returns to the backyard as Gary Frank) Hey, you're back. I'll take a large pie with andouille sausage and chocolate chips.

Name: Candace
Dialog: First of all

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh my gosh. It's Candace. With what appears to be a holographic field projection mapped on to her.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why are you surprised? Didn't you guys do this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nope. We were just makin' blueberry air.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why blueberry? Why not lingonberry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Exactly. What's that all about?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, well how can I get this off? Buford is like, the eighth person to order pizza from me. And that's not even how you order pizza.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we didn't do it. But we'll be glad to undo it. Side project, gang.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No! Not the -inator! I totally need that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who's this nincompoop? (realizes he called himself a nincompoop) Oh, right. CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS,...

Name: Doofenshmirtz (cont'd)
Dialog: ...and-and the football player, the gorilla, and Lulu Jones, and Blanca Dishon and Director Dipthong. Everybody! Curse you all!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. We have everything we need for a holographic field disrupter. We'll build it, and you'll be totally... (Candace changes back to herself) Back to normal!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool. Thanks guys. Bust you later.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I guess my pizza orders aren't goin' in. WON'T SOMEONE THINK OF THE BUFORD?!?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. I just wanted to thank you for sending over the pizzas. That was really cool.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! You liked it?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It was awesome. So, we still on for the movies tonight?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Arctic.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What did you mean by that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly what I said.

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: Episode IVa

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: Uh, uh, can -- can -- excuse me, can you do it faster?

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: What? What? (The crawl stops.) Faster?

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Yeah, and funnier, if possible.

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: Oh, faster? Okay. (The crawl reverses.) Um...all right, uh... (inhales)

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: (faster, talking like the Tasmanian Devil) Episode IVa

Name: Dan and Swampy
Dialog: Uhm uh, yeah, yeah, no, no.

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: (normal voice) What? What?

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: Forget the funnier.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Yeah, just go faster.

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: All right...

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: Episode IVa

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: (laughs) Sounds creepy like that.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: That's good, I like it.

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: Thanks. Yeah, it was capitalized. (reading) Meanwhile, having learned the whereabouts of the Death Star's plans, the rebels send their best platypus agent to obtain them, in hopes of finding a weakness. And none of this is canon, so just relax.

Name: Caption
Dialog: Empire Administration Offices.

Name: Office Stormtrooper 1
Dialog: TK-five-eight-two, I'm gonna need you to run these numbers again.

Name: Office Stormtrooper 2
Dialog: I took a third out of the budget already.

Name: Office Stormtrooper 1
Dialog: Orders from the top, there's nothing I can do.

Name: Stormtrooper 1
Dialog: Stop right there!

Name: Office Stormtrooper 2
Dialog: Oh, uh, uh, it's work-related.

Name: Stormtrooper 2
Dialog: There he is!

Name: Imperial Officer 1
Dialog: Captain, the Rebel is escaping!

Name: Imperial Captain
Dialog: Go after him!

Name: Office Stormtrooper 3
Dialog: Whoa, what the heck?

Name: Stormtrooper 3
Dialog: I'm slipping! I'm slipping!

Name: Office Stormtrooper 4
Dialog: No no no no! Save save save!

Name: Leia
Dialog: We've received your transmissions. So you have the Death Star plans? (Perry gives it to her.) Agent P, you never cease to ama—

Name: Captain Antilles
Dialog: Your Highness, an Imperial Star Destroyer has tracked our position.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Luke!

Name: Luke
Dialog: Phineas! Ferb! What's up, guys?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb? (Ferb pushes a button) Check this out!

Name: Luke
Dialog: Pod-racing engines? How'd you hook these up?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We just picked up some power convertors at Tosche Station.

Name: Luke
Dialog: Nice!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You need help with your moisture vaporator? We can trick it out like ours.

Name: Luke
Dialog: I wish, but Uncle Owen wants to do things the old-fashioned way. Even the droids he buys are used.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Treadwell!

Name: Treadwell
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we'll catch you later, Luke! We're gonna mosey on home for lunch.

Name: Luke
Dialog: Wow, when they mosey, they mosey! What in... (Looks up and takes out binoculars.) Is that a Star Destroyer?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally some real Rebel-busting! (takes off helmet) This is why I joined the Empire in the first place.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am so excited, I can hardly contain myself!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I toldja ta go before the raid!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is not what I meant! But now that you mention it...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, lock it up! We've got Rebels to bust!

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Where do you think you're going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, space battle over that way?

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Certainly not. You know your mission

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, sir.

Name: Candace
Dialog: SOCKS?!? This is a total waste of my potential! (frustrated grunt)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Not me. This is about where I peak.

Name: Leia
Dialog: Agent P, I need you to make sure this R2 unit goes to Obi-Wan Kenobi on Tatooine. But first, I need to record a video message. Be a dear and stand over by the bulkhead. You're kinda in my shot. (Perry walks away.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: So what color socks do you think think he wants?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, black?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm just sayin', ev'rything the guy owns is black! You think maybe... (Candace signals for them to stop) What? (Cut to Leia putting the disc in R2-D2) Oh, there's somebody doin' somethin' over there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah! It's busting time! (runs off, singsongy) Oh, Commander!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh, we are never gonna get those socks, are we?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I found a pair of socks.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Where?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Right here! (punches Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't be a baby, you're wearin' armor!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But it is plastic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Commander, Commander, there's a Rebel in a dress recording something into a droid!

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Ooh! By chance, was this droid distributing socks of any kind?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well...no.

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Then it's none of your concern. Is it? Back on sock detail!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Me? I'm an argyle man.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh, I would not think that from looking at you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! Where'd they go?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Danish Head ran off, but the droids are over there. (His blaster accidentally goes off.) Whoopsie!

Name: C-3PO
Dialog: Oh, no!

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: C-3PO
Dialog: I'm going to regret this.

Name: Imperial Officer 2
Dialog: There goes another one.

Name: Imperial Officer 3
Dialog: Hold your fire. There's no life forms. It must have short-circuited.

Name: Imperial Officer 2
Dialog: (yawns and stretches) Coffee?

Name: Imperial Officer 3
Dialog: Yeah! Let's get some of that Sith Roast.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) They got away! (The Stormtroopers run in.) We've got to follow them! C'mon, we'll take the other escape pod!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Um, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, if we catch those two droids, we'll be promoted off of sock detail. Let's drift!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Technically, we will not be drifting. More like violent ejection, plummeting through the atmosphere and crashing onto the planet's surface.

Name: Imperial Officer 3
Dialog: Mmmm, that's good coffee. Did you know this was decaf?

Name: Imperial Officer 2
Dialog: Huh, I could not tell.

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (screams offscreen)

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: How do you like that, Norm? My beautiful invention floating out here in space and do you think I get any credit for it?

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: Your invention, sir?

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yeah. I designed it to be a nutcracker. Here, l-l-look. Look at this. (He uses a model Death Star to crack a nut with a laser and eats it.) See? It works just fine. But the Empire took my idea and made it so big, it's completely impractical! A-A walnut would be totally obliterated!

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: The universe is cruel and unjust.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, when they see my new invention, they'll be singin' a diff'rent tune! All I need is to get my hands on a little bit of Force to get it up and running. But where am I gonna find some extra Force?

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: The Force surrounds us. It penetrates us. It binds the galaxy—

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes, I've seen the bumper sticker.

Name: C-3PO
Dialog: No more adventures. I'm not going that way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Tatooine. Okay, my busting instincts are telling me that the droids went (points ahead) that way. Now, come on!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, I joined the Empire by accident. I was trying to sign up for a physics camp.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Physics camp? Yeah, you're better off. Hey, Candace, why did you join the Empire?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't you remember anything from orientation? Rebels are cruel, heartless sub-humans who are messing up the galaxy! And I am all about law and order.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, why am I still on sock detail when Gladys from Accounting got promoted to Commander, and she doesn't even know how to hold a blaster? No, I mean, really, she failed that part of the exam four times. She held it backwards and upside-down. But no, she's a second cousin of some midlevel Darth, and so she gets a promotion? What about me?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ya feelin' better?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Thanks.

Name: Stormtrooper 4
Dialog: Look, sir, droids!

Name: C.O.
Dialog: No, this is a bathtub stopper. TK-90210, what are you doing out here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, we followed some droids that were ejected from the—

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Hup-bup-bup-bup-bup! The droids and the missing Death Star plans are none of your concern.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Death Star plans?

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Never you mind! You go to Mos Eisley! I'm sure you can find some socks for Lord Vader there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (disappointingly) Yes, sir.

Name: Stormtrooper 5
Dialog: Look sir, a magic flute!

Name: C.O.
Dialog: (puts his head in hand) No, that's a stick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! Hi, Dad!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, boys! You're just in time for lunch.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what's on the list? Another day filled with big plans? (reads the list) "Herd all the nerfs into Beggar's Canyon, teach the sarlaac to brush his teeth, and giving a bantha a shower." That's awfully ambitious!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Just tryin' to make the most of each and every summer day! Hey, we stopped by and saw Luke.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, let me guess, was he staring wistfully at the horizon?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What? Everyone knows that boy would rather be somewhere else. What about you two? The crops are so far ahead, would you like to spend the rest of the summer at swim camp on Naboo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sounds fun, but we'll pass.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, how about ski camp on Hoth? Don't you boys ever want to see the rest of the galaxy?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not really. We've got everything we want right here on Tatooine. Sand, womp rats, brothers, and banthas. Why would anyone want to leave?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Wait'll they see there's no girls on this planet!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence!

Name: Uncle Owen
Dialog: (offscreen) Take these two over to the garage, will ya? I want 'em cleaned up before dinner.

Name: Luke
Dialog: But I was going in to Tosche Station to pick up some power convertors.

Name: Uncle Owen
Dialog: You can waste time with your friends when your chores are done. Now, come on, get to it.

Name: Luke
Dialog: Well, come on, Red, let's go!

Name: Luke
Dialog: Uncle Owen?

Name: Uncle Owen
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Luke
Dialog: This R2 unit has a bad motivator, look!

Name: Uncle Owen
Dialog: Hey, whatta ya tryin' to push on us?!

Name: Luke
Dialog: (offscreen) What about that one?

Name: Uncle Owen
Dialog: (offscreen) What about that blue one? We'll take that one.

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: Luke
Dialog: Okay, let's go.

Name: C-3PO
Dialog: Now don't you forget this. Why I should stick my neck out for you is quite beyond my capacity.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, bring all my gear down to my lair.

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: You mean the abandoned recycling compartment?

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a lair!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, whadaya know? A moving sidewalk. (Darth Vader walks by.) Oh, ooh, Darth Vader! Hey, I know that guy! It's Darth Vader. Hey! (runs up to him) Hey, w-wait up, wait up! (knocks over a droid) Phew! Darth Vader! Hey look! Eh, I'm Darthenshmirtz! (trips) I'm not sure if you remember me, the Doof Star, the little nutcracker thing. And then you sorta stole my plans. (trips again) Anyway, I gotta new invention, and it's gonna knock your socks off! (trips again) I'm wondering if you could, uh, spare a little Force. I thought maybe you had a little extra lying around— (Bumps into a couple of Stormtroopers) Okay, uh, good talk.

Name: C-3PO
Dialog: (offscreen) Please, Master Luke took off your restraining bolt, now quit complaining. (Cut to inside.) Now I'm taking another oil bath. And I don't want to be disturbed. (goes down an elevator platform) Ahhh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that bantha took a while longer to clean than I thought it would. Well, we better get home.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, little fella. Sorry about that. Say, what's a droid like you doing out here in the Jundland Wastes?

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool! A movie.

Name: Leia hologram
Dialog: Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. You're my only hope.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, she must mean Ben Kenobi. Hey, we were just there! We have Jedi lessons with him every Tuesday. He lives right up at the edge of the Dune Sea. Do you want a ride?

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (beeps no)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, suit yourself. (R2 leaves) And remember, sand people hide single file to hide their numbers. (to Ferb) Oh, he probably already knows.

Name: Tusken Raider
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Tusken Raiders
Dialog: (cheer)

Name: Major Hologram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, our sources tell us that the R2 unit is safely in the possession of Obi-Wan Kenobi. You always come through for us. (Perry smiles nervously knowing that this isn't the case.) Great work! Now to take a well-deserved rest. (Hologram disappears. Agent P smiles and takes out a hanky to dry his sweat when his communicator activates again.) Agent P, I've got your next mission. You need to get to the Death Star immediately. Darthenshmirtz is working on a new inator. We need you to stop him before he can finish building it. Good luck.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Mom! See ya later!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Don't forget your two-sun sunscreen.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way ahead of ya, Mom! Hey, what's this? "Death Star plans"? Wait, I bet it belongs to that R2 unit that we sent to Ben Kenobi's house. I wonder if he's still there.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No. He is on his way to Mos Eisley.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wow! Can you sense that with the Force?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No, I can see them. They're right over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) You're right, Ferb. And Luke's with them! Inside a—

Name: Tusken Raider
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! (cut to reveal it's only Ferb playing with a puppet) Oh, you got me!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (speaks Tusken and plays with the puppet)

Name: Blatto
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! My best customers!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Blatto, we're trying to find an R2 unit and give him back this data disc. (Blatto takes the disc.) Hey!

Name: Blatto
Dialog: Let's take a look at it. (He puts it into an R2 unit's head and it shows a hologram of the Death Star.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! It's an Imperial battle station the size of a moon! And according to these schematics, it seems to be designed specifically to destroy entire planets! Whoa, I-I never imagined the Empire would go that far! (Ferb points) Huh, you're right, Ferb. One proton torpedo in that small exhaust port and the whole thing goes blammo!

Name: Blatto
Dialog: Uh, it's like it's got a self-destruct button. What kind of idiot would design that?

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, why can't I master this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, if the Rebels have this information, they might stand a chance against this thing. A small one-man fighter could penetrate the outer defense, fly along that trench, and get to the exhaust port.

Name: Blatto
Dialog: Hey, spoiler alert!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That droid must be part of the Rebel Alliance! We've gotta get this disc back to him!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Candace, did you get the socks?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mission accomplished.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I gotta hoagie!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Are those the stolen Death Star plans we are not supposed to be looking for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't believe it! (to Phineas and Ferb) Hey, you with the Death Star plans, you guys are so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh! Let's get outta here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And they're lost in the crowd.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not on my watch! Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look! There's the droid!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You two, stop right there! (Buford fires his blaster again) Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry, my bad!

Name: Random Guy
Dialog: (offscreen) My watermelon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's the droid! Let's get over there!

Name: Stormtrooper 5
Dialog: Stop that ship! Blast 'im!

Name: Han
Dialog: Chewie, get us outta here!

Name: Chewbacca
Dialog: (roars)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we came at a bad time.

Name: Stormtrooper 6
Dialog: Oh, crud, this is going to mean nothing but paperwork.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If we don't get these plans to that R2 droid, entire planets could be destroyed. C'mon, we gotta find a pilot and follow that ship.

Name: Cantina MC
Dialog: (offscreen) Alright, Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes! (Cut to inside the cantina where the band is leaving) Not a bad set, guys. Only one death and one dismemberment. Not bad for a Wednesday.

Name: Ponda Baba
Dialog: (speaks Aqualish)

Name: Cornelius Evazan
Dialog: I don't like him either.

Name: Cantina MC
Dialog: (offscreen) Alright, let's give 'er a big cantina welcome, folks, Vanessa the Twi'lek.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to the bartender) Um, we're looking for a pilot.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Over there.

Name: Nurse
Dialog: Someone said he shot first, but I coulda sworn it was the other guy.

Name: Bartender
Dialog: Nope. There.

Name: Wookiee
Dialog: (growls happily)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, great. What do you farm boys want?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm Phineas and this is my brother, Ferb. We understand you're a pretty good pilot.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: For a price.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we have a very important disc we need to get to someone who just blasted out of Docking Bay 94.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I know whose ship that is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whose?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Han Solo.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Solo's been a thorn in my side for years. My ship, the Centennial Chihuahua, was on pace to finish the Kessel Run in eleven parsecs, and that nerf-herder cut me off!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Everybody loves Solo! Twelve parsecs! If I ever hear his name again, I'll just—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Would you two excuse me? (Isabella fires her blaster and we hear Vanessa groan.) Yeah, we should probably get going.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Here's my ship, the Centennial Chihuahua.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why'd you call it the Chihuahua?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's personal.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Seems weird you'd call it something you didn't wanna be asked about.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're right. It was a call for attention.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they are! (She blasts at them and hits a light.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! Well, looks like we got it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (pulls the two brothers onto the ship) Move it! We gotta get outta here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fire the cannon!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think the barrel end slides in here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: But then the scope is on the bottom! That's not right!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hold on, this is gonna be rough!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Give me that! (She flips the cannon around and aims.) You're goin' down! (She fires but the cannon explodes.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I see it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (to Baljeet) And you thought we were gonna die in space.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Move move move!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gosh, Ferb. Our planet looks so small from here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: First time in space?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah, now that you mentioned it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (rubs off the "planet" to reveal it's just dirt) Yeah, your planet's over here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that makes much more sense. Mom and Dad always did want us to see the galaxy, but I don't think that this is what they had in mind.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You might want to buckle up. I'm makin' the jump to hyperspace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: A little more warning would be nice.

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Ahem. I grow tired of asking this but, please, tell me you have the socks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Buford? (Buford gives it to her.) With my compliments, sir.

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Excellent, now report to the Death Star for re-assignment. I'll deliver these to Lord Vader myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally! Now we're gonna see some action!

Name: C.O.
Dialog: Whoa whoa whoa! You're not riding in here! Uh, this shuttle's full. You can ride back to the Death Star on that bus pod.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What a piece of junk!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, that's it! I solved my Force problem! I can extract it from Vader's garbage. It...It says right here, see? You can find anything on the Internet. Hey, check it out, Norm-3PO. According to this real estate website, my time share on Alderaan is worth, like, 10 times more than I paid for it six years ago! Oh, I knew the value would go up! It's just, it's such a peaceful place to.. (Alderaan gets destroyed by the Death Star in the background.) Wait, what? What's this? The value is totally dropping!! Zero?!?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (angrily) Hey, whatcha doin'?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, did you know that you have T-27 thermal couplings up here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Get down from there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I can reroute their current to double up your power supply.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just keep your paws off my ship! (beat, takes out a notepad) Reroute thermal couplings.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wonder what our family and friends are doing back on Tatooine. It feels a little strange to be so far from them. But at least we're making new friends. Like you, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This is not a friendship, it's a spaceship! So don't invade mine! (something beeps) We're coming out of hyperspace! Buckle up, ladies!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whadaya think, Ferb? A girl like her and a guy like me?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Sure. Why not?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: As promised, the Millennium Falcon. I should be able to catch him before he gets to that small moon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's no moon. It's the Death Star! Isabella, turn the ship around!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What have you guys gotten me into?! We're caught in a tractor beam! My engines can't pull us free! (puts on goggles) Looks like we're gonna have to shoot our way out! I'm powering up the turrets!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There are alternatives to fighting.

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: Episode IVa

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Hey, he's, he's uh, back...

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: HEY! HEY! HEY! GET OUTTA HERE!...

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: What? What?

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: I'M NOT TELLING YOU AGAIN MAN!

Name: Jim Cummings
Dialog: Oh Man...

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: What is up with that guy?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I should've known getting this close to Solo was a bad idea! Hurry it up back there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've modified the deflector shield with a cloaking mechanism. Give it a try.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, this had better work or you two are floating home!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't think we can float all the way home. I mean, we wouldn't survive 15 seconds in the cold vacuum of spa—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's a figure of speech!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) It worked! It even smells like donuts in here! Nice touch, Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, let's see if it fools them. (speaks in a "New Jersey" accent) Uh, Dockin' Bay control, ya got us cott in a track-ta beam heeyuh! Ya guys want donuts or not?

Name: Imperial Officer Jeff
Dialog: Oh, shoot! Disengaging tractor beam. (he shuts it off) Deliveries are in Docking Bay 427. You're clear to land. (to Dan) So, donuts?

Name: Imperial Officer Dan
Dialog: Does Darth Vader wear a funny hat?

Name: Imperial Officer Jeff
Dialog: Dude!

Name: Imperial Officer Dan
Dialog: Oh, relax, he can't hear us all the way down— (Gets Force Choked)

Name: Imperial Officer Jeff
Dialog: Oh, no! I didn't!

Name: Imperial Officer Dan
Dialog: Ha ha! Gotcha!

Name: Imperial Officer Jeff
Dialog: (grunts)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can you believe this? Making us ride the bus pod? (Buford is looking in the bag when he realizes something.) They better give us a Rebel-fighting job this time and not just running some more errands.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh-oh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, how hard is it to deliver socks?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I believe Buford requires your attention.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what is it, Buford? (Buford takes out some black socks from the bag to answer Candace's question.) Huh. Uh, Buford, I'm gonna ask you a question and I want you to think very hard before you answer.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thinking is always hard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. Here's the thing. If we have Darth Vader's socks, what exactly did we give the commander?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uhhhhh....

Name: Vader
Dialog: I find your lack of socks disturbing.

Name: Stormtrooper 6
Dialog: Hello? Are you open yet?

Name: Stormtrooper 7
Dialog: Hope they have the old-fashioned. Those are my favorites.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I can't believe that worked!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I feel guilty, though. Maybe we should get them some donuts.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: WOULD YOU STAY FOCUSED?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Sorry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, let's find Solo's ship and the droid, and then I'm outta here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, they've landed in Docking Bay 327, and we're in Docking Bay 427. (looks at the map) That's not so bad. (Sees Ferb with his eyes closed and his hand out) What is it, Ferb? What's with the hand?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I feel something. A presence I have not felt since...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry! (Perry runs into his arms for a hug) Hey, old buddy!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who is this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is Perry the Platypus. He used to be our pet until we found out he was secretly an agent for the Rebellion. We felt a little betrayed and hurt at first, but bygones be bygones. Now we're good, right?

Name: Perry
Dialog: (Chatters and thumbs up)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So you're probably on a mission right now, huh? (Perry thumbs up) Hey, so are we! (fist bumps Perry) Heh. Oh, uh, this is our pilot, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (points and clicks tongue in a bored manner)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, uh, good luck. (shakes Perry's hand)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He looks good.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ugh! Let's get this over with!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: There ought to be enough residual Force in Vader's garbage here to power it up for, y'know at least one shot.

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: One man's trash is another man's bad idea.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Just put the garbage in the chute, Mr. Wisendroider! (door beeps) Well, well, well, it's Perry the Rebelpus! (The door does not open all the way. Perry shrugs.) Oh, sorry about the door. I...I put in a work order, but the guy's not gonna get down here 'til, like, Thursday. So, y'know. Ah, ah, look, Norm, you see? You put a big red "X" on the floor, people will stand there! (A trap door opens under Perry and he drops down and gets frozen in carbonite.) Human nature! Or, in this case, platypus nature.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's wrong, Ferb? (Once again, Ferb has his eyes closed and hand out.) You got your hand up again.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Opens his eyes and puts his hand down) Perry is in trouble.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh no! We must go help him.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No. You must go get that disc to the Rebels. We cannot risk our mission.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Split up? Really?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Just do what you need to do fast and meet us at the Falcon!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: May the Force be with you and all that stuff.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on! We gotta find that droid!

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: (hanging up the trapped platypus) There. It's just like art!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, nothin' like a frozen platypus to tie a room together! Now, allow me to tell you why I created my latest inator.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Darth Vader can kiss my bantha!

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: (applauding) Very good, sir! That was better than rehearsal!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, stay close to your comlinks, ladies, and, if all goes well, I'll have a victory number in the fourth act. (to Perry) So, like I said, I'm going to make myself super-evil with my Sith-inator here, but first, I'm gonna shoot you just to make sure it's safe and, uh, y'know, I don't...die or fry myself and have to wear one of those masks like Vader, 'cuz that would not be a good look for me.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Eh, y'know, plus, if it works, you can join me on the Dark Side. We can be Sith buddies! Whadaya think? Huh? (activates the inator)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (yells in pain)

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold on. Wait a minute. Wait...what...who let a kid in here?! Hey, buddy, you okay? (to Perry) Yeah, he's gonna have a headache, but with any luck, he's gonna be so evil when he gets on his feet. Oh, great, I-I-I used up all the Force on this guy. Hey, Norm, grab the trash can. We gotta go refuel. Wait right here, Perry the Rebelpus. We'll be right back to turn you to the Dark Side, too, and then you, me, and...this kid in the cloak, I guess, can be the Three Sith-keteers!

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: Who can I be, sir?

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: You can be the horse. C'mon, let's go. We gotta get some more of that super-Force-y-Vader trash. I know just where to look.

Name: Han
Dialog: We're all right now...

Name: Candace
Dialog: TK-90210 reporting for duty, sir!

Name: Imperial Officer 5
Dialog: Just a minute.

Name: Han
Dialog: Uh, how are you?

Name: Imperial Officer 6
Dialog: Oh, tell him I'm doing great.

Name: Imperial Officer 5
Dialog: We're sending a squad in.

Name: Han
Dialog: Uh, negative, negative. We have a reactor leak here, now, uh, no. Uh, give us a few minutes to lock it down. Uh, large leak. Very dangerous.

Name: Imperial Officer 5
Dialog: Who is this? What's your operating number? (Han blasts the comlink and it short circuits.)

Name: Imperial Officer 6
Dialog: Aw, I was just getting into that conversation!

Name: Imperial Officer 5
Dialog: All of you, directly go to Level Five, Detention Block AA-23!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah!! Get them!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, wait!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Finally, some real action!

Name: Imperial Officer 5
Dialog: Ah-dadadadadda! I need you to stay here and guard this post!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but...

Name: Imperial Officer 5
Dialog: That's an order!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, bantha droppings!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...and no matter what, we always did everything together.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Are you done?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good. Then let's get going!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Serious trooper. (takes mask off seriously, then puts it back on) Happy trooper! (takes helmet off and smiles, puts it back on) Enigmatic trooper. (takes helmet off and looks enigmatic, puts it back on) Sad trooper...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) It's down here around this corner, and... Uh-oh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, you're the ones with the stolen Death Star plans!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Run!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, that's coming out of my salary!

Name: Han
Dialog: (offscreen, sarcastically) This garbage chute is a really wonderful idea! What an incredible smell you've discovered!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Come here, boy, come here, that's it. Come on. (The dianoga swims up to him) That's it. Now, now, whatta ya got for Papa there? Ooh, is that Darth Vader's inhaler? Nice! Now we're talkin'! And what's this? This looks like a perfectly good bantha-cheese hoagie. Well, it's not good anymore. It's been underwater. Wow! According to this, it's reeking with Dark Force! Vader must've touched it. Put it in here. What else have you got for me? (The dianoga takes Luke.) That's not trash, dummy, that's a guy! Just put him back, I've got enough. Man, you can lead a dianoga to garbage but you can't make him think.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-uh-uh! Don't forget to flush!

Name: Luke
Dialog: (offscreen) The walls are moving!

Name: Leia
Dialog: (offscreen) Don't just stand there! Try and brace it with something!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, someone needs to oil that thing.

Name: Chewbacca
Dialog: (growls offscreen)

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, come on, Norm-3PO, let's go make some Sith happen.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hey, they fixed the door! Must've been a cancellation somewhere. I'm gonna go check on the Sith-inator. You go see if that kid's evil yet.

Name: Norm-3PO
Dialog: Where did we leave him? Behind this box? (Perry emerges from behind the box with a blaster. He blasts Norm-3PO and he screams like R2-D2.)

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, what the heck are you standing around for? I thought I told you... Whoa whoa whoa whoa!! (Norm-3PO falls down on Darthenshmirtz. He groans.) Oh, my spleen.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, get away from that! Perry the Rebelpus, you stay away from my inator! Don't make me— (Perry pulls down on Darthenshmirtz's jaw and throws him out.) No wait! Wait wait! Whooo!!! (Perry pounces on him.)

Name: Imperial Officer 7
Dialog: You know, I'm thinking about getting a saxophone.

Name: Imperial Officer Wayne
Dialog: Huh, good for you.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: (To Perry) I'd like to see you try that again! (Perry does)

Name: Imperial Officer 7
Dialog: Uh, should we report that?

Name: Imperial Officer Wayne
Dialog: I'm not losing my place in line.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, get back here, you two!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaaaaah! (grunts, as Luke and Leia swing from a rope in the background) Help! Help! Help me! I'm slipping!! (grunts)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh no! I-I have to help her!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Don't be a fool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunts) (she whimpers as she is about to fall to her death until Phineas catches her by the hand) Aaah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I got you! (pulls her up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why would you save me? You're a Rebel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You were in trouble. I couldn't just leave ya hanging...literally.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well... (a blaster goes off) Buford! Watch where you're shooting that thing!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Seriously! Why don't they put safeties on these blasters?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry, my bad!

Name: Stormtrooper 8
Dialog: Hey, don't worry about it! I'm planning on hitting the wall and sliding down until I catch onto a radio antenna! Oh no! Wait, that's Cloud City I'm thinking of! (he crashes through to space) Oh, crud!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But why would he save me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You're either really brave or really stupid! Well, kid, looks like your luck hasn't run out yet.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There's the Falcon and the R2 unit! (They run down the stairs. Cut to the Docking Bay as Stormtroopers blast them.) It's getting away! But I've gotta get the disc to...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Quick! Back to my ship!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, what about Ferb? We can't leave without him.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If we don't leave now, we'll lose the Falcon.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But I can't leave my brother.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (indignantly) Tick-tock, tick-tock!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Isabella, you've gotta take the disc back to R2. I'll go find Ferb.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If I leave, I am not coming back!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fine. Just make sure you deliver the disc to the R2 unit.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How do you know I won't just go back to Tatooine?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (running off) I trust you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Remember that "brave or stupid" thing? I know which one it is!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is that? It looks like it was built by... (A cloaked figure drops down. Phineas knows who it could be.) Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool face paint!

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: Oh no!

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: What?

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: The disc is gone! The one with the thing for blowing up the Death Star!

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: Are you kidding me?

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: It's supposed to be right here!

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: This is not happening! No no no! We are so dead!

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: Is it right there? Is it on the floor? Maybe it fell out of the flight deck. Okay. Okay, I know. We'll blame Jar Jar.

Name: R2-D2
Dialog: (beeps)

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: Jar Jar Bi— That's a terrible idea! He retired, like, 20 years ago!

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: Hey, it's not like we have a lot of options here.

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: Okay, let's do this. You go get a thermal detonator, and we'll put it right back here on the...

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: NO! How is that better than my Jar Jar idea?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yo, tech support. Got something for ya.

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: (takes the disc) Oh my gosh! Thank you!

Name: Rebel Officer 1
Dialog: Yes, thank you! You saved our lives! (chuckles) Whoa, that was a close one, huh? Hey, where do you think she found it?

Name: Rebel Officer 2
Dialog: Hey, man, never look a gift tauntaun in the oral cavity.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wait wait wait, I can't see! (Perry fights Darthenshmirtz.) Alright, someone's getting a lightsabering now! Oh, it's, uh, just a flashlight. I guess my lightsaber's in the camping supplies. (holds flashlight under his chin) Ooh, ooh, look, I'm scary—Uch, whatever. Bye! (he flees)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So is there like a face painting booth around here or something? And where's Perry? Were you able to find him?

Name: Darth Ferb
Dialog: I found this

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (laughs) Shut up, Ferb! C'mon, let's get outta here. Isabella already left. We gotta find the ship so we can get home.

Name: Darth Ferb
Dialog: The Dark Side is my home now. (gets out a lightsaber)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, Ferb, what are you doing? (Phineas tries everything to avoid his now evil brother.) Come on, quit messin' around! Hey, this-this isn't funny. I'm not gonna fight you.

Name: Darth Ferb
Dialog: If you will not join me, then I must destroy you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, I can see you're serious. (Darth Ferb swings his lightsaber and Phineas dodges it.) Ferb, this isn't you! We're brothers!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, this is crazy! We-We-We would never try to hurt each other! (Darth Ferb reveals he has a double-edged lightsaber. They continue to fight.) Is that the best you got? (Darth Ferb reveals he has more lightsabers now.) Oh, we're allowing modifications, huh? Gimme a sec. (He tinkers with his lightsaber.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Candace, what's up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, I was just thinking, we're the good guys, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, I believe so.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's what they told us durin' the brainwashin'.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Orientation, Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Potato, tomato.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And Rebels are bad. We know that.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Of course. The Rebels are always the bad guys.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What about Robin Hood?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That has not happened yet!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, one of the Rebels just saved my life. He could've escaped, but, instead, he came back to help me.

Name: Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Hmmmm...

Name: Candace
Dialog: And didn't we just blow up a planet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm, yes, that is sort of difficult to justify...morally.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: (maniacal laughter) You're over there and I'm over here and never the twain shall meet. So I guess you're just gonna have to give up. (Perry takes a grappling hook out of his uniform.) Oh, I-I see, you're gonna swing across like a monkey-man. (pounds on his chest) Hoo-hoo-hoo! Me swingy-swingy monkey-man! Go ahead, knock yourself out. There's no way you got enough cable to reach that. (The grappling hook latches onto Darthenshmirtz's uniform.) Oh, I see what you were trying to— Yaaah! (Both Perry and Darthenshmirtz fall and get caught on another platform.) Ow! No no no! (They crash through a wall.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, well, well, Han Solo.

Name: PA Announcer
Dialog: All flight crews, man your stations.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Hey, look! It's Isabella! Isabella, you've joined the Rebellion?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Not by a long shot.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Well, you should. You're a great pilot. We need you, the odds are stacked against us. The Empire has everything, a Death Star, highly-trained troops, Darth Vader. And we're just a ragtag bunch of undertrained good-intentioned Rebels. And to be perfectly honest, Isabella, we're kids. We are actual children, and they're letting us fly fighters. That's how hopeless the situation actually is. So, you wanna help us?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Strangely, still no. (She leaves them.)

Name: Porkins
Dialog: (offscreen) Worst rallying speech ever!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Shut up, Porkins!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'll have one of those. (she gets a juice box and some peanuts. Han and Chewie sit next to her.) What happened, Solo? Garbage scow tip over and dumped you here?

Name: Han
Dialog: What are you doing here, Isabella? Did someone run out of cupcakes?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Very funny. So where are you heading?

Name: Han
Dialog: As far away from here as possible. (eats some peanuts)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. I don't have any reason to stay here either.

Name: Han
Dialog: I don't owe anything to anybody. (eats some more nuts. Chewie looks at him.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm not in this to make friends.

Name: Han
Dialog: Yeah. Obviously.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What do you mean by that? I've got friends! I've got plenty of friends!

Name: Han
Dialog: Yeah? Where are they now?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well...where are yours?

Name: Chewbacca
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Han
Dialog: Put a sock in it, fuzzball!

Name: Chewbacca
Dialog: (whimpers and growls)

Name: Han
Dialog: (sighs) Maybe you're right. Maybe I do have someplace to be. See you around, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs) Eh, the Wookiee is right. (she leaves)

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, it's good to be back. (Perry drops in) Hey! You're too late! No stopping me now! (He drops down into the trap door and gets frozen in carbonite.) Hey, it's cold in here! Ow! I've got such an ice cream headache!

Name: Darth Ferb
Dialog: Now you will join me! (a blast shoots him and he groans)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step away from the Rebel!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't shoot him! He's my brother!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your brother's a Sith warrior?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No. I mean, yes. I mean...it's a recent development. Wait, why are you helping me? I'm a Rebel!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I had to. I couldn't just leave you hanging.

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, heads up!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, watch it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold it right there, pal! Aaah! (Darth Ferb attacks her more.)

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, you're gonna stretch out the elastic.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb! Please stop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now I really wish I'd bought the three-pack!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man. I really should have ray-shielded that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (groans) Ferb? (Candace and Perry help him look under the rubble.)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (groans)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are you okay?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (hugs Ferb) Ferb!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Found this perfectly good robe lying around. Has one hole, right here. Hey, look what else I just found! My hoagie!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I would not eat that if I were you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: C'mon! Let's get off this battle station.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But we don't have a ship!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know where there's a bus pod.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry, great work! Hey, don't be a stranger!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: You think maybe you could turn this thing over? All the blood's rushing to my head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, it's Luke! They must've got the plans! He should hit that exhaust port no problem. I mean it's as practically as big as a womp rat! (beat) Yeah, we should probably get outta here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on! The bus pod is right through here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait wait wait!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No no!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no! That was the last ship!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we're toast.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, if we had to go out, at least it was for something we believe in.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My only regret is that I spent so much time on the wrong side.

Name: Buford
Dialog: My only regret is that I ate that hoagie.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess if I have a regret, it's that I never got reunited with my sister. She left Tatooine when I was just a baby.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hugs her brother) Oh, I can't believe it! You got so big!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I didn't even recognize you! Hey, wait a minute, why is this guy hugging us?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, this is Ferb. He's our stepbrother.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom remarried? What happened to Dad?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (laughs) Funny story actually. He—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, that was close! Thanks for coming back to get us, Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's what friends are for.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, but what about all those innocent baristas and bank tellers and bowling alley attendants?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're fine. The Firestar Girls got them out earlier.

Name: Everyone onboard
Dialog: We're okay!

Name: Major Hologram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, with you stopping Darthenshmirtz, and the Rebellion destroying the Death Star, this day will be long remembered. Apparently, there are still copies of the Death Star plans out there so, we still might have a teeny problem there, but, heh, we'll blow up that battle station when we come to it. Hologram out!

Name: Darthenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! So long, Perry the Platypus! Now I can live to fight in the sequel! (He goes into an escape pod laughing.) Eh. I probably should have thought this one through better. I didn't realize the escape pod would be Platypus-sized. Plus, I'm sitting on my keys.

Name: Chewbacca
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Wookiee is right! Let's party!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: All right, boys, let me hear some of that Rebel bass!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: All the Wookiees in the house go "Grrrrr!"

Name: Chewbacca
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, farm boy. We're not related, are we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no, no, no. Not a chance. I only have just the one sister.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (pulls him in) Good. (she kisses him and Phineas faints in a daze) Mmmmmwah!

Name: Porkins
Dialog: (parachuting in) Hey, look, everyone, I'm okay! (crash!)

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Way to ruin the moment, Porkins!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a mystery, Ferb. A riddle. Whispering a secret to an enigma while driving down a lost highway in an Escher painting. How do they get the toothpaste into the tube?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Sometimes, if you're lost, it's best to just go...

Name: Ferb (cont'd)
Dialog: ... along for the ride.

Name: Paisley Sideburn Brothers
Dialog: (playing on Candace's MP3)

Name: Candace
Dialog: New Paisley Sideburn Brothers album, don't make me bust.

Name: Paisley Sideburn Brothers (cont'd)
Dialog: (playing on Candace's MP3)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And how do they get the red and blue toothpaste to swirl?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa. Hmm. Apparently, it just fell out of the sky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, I guess it's the only one. Let's open it up and see what's inside.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. It's a day full of questions. First the toothpaste, and now this.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: And of course, "where's Perry?"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! See what I mean? We're up to our armpits in enigmas!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Glad you're here. Doofenshmirtz has been incommunicado for far too long. Either he's up to something big or he's met with some sort of foul play. (Perry leaves his seat) Man, that was rather abrupt. You know, sometimes, I feel like he just comes here to get his assignments.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, crud. It's the third battle ax I've broken on this thing. Sorry about that, Dumpy.

Name: Dumpamir
Dialog: The name is Dumpamir!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wow! The fact that we cannot open it makes discovering the contents that much more tantalizing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know, right? Luckily, Ferb has been working on a special z-ray machine that can see through any substance on the periodic table. It's highly experimental so you might want to encase yourself in this lead body armor.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, we can't see into the capsule, but your second molar has a cavity. And it looks like Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro is making kreplach tortillas.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (A shadowy figure grabs him and he screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! That's my lunch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I think I'm actually running out of ideas here.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And pianos.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Should I go get a pipe organ?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I know the secret of how to open that hatch!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You do?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I do! You see, for generations and generations, the Van Stomm family has been the guardian of the secret knowledge and protectors of the mystery capsule. We made the thirteenth-century Templars look like a bunch of wusses. And throughout the ages, our family has pledged our lives to conceal it from the unenlightened. And in doing so, we were entrusted with the only key that can unlock the capsule secrets.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, just messin' with ya. I found it on the other side of the fence. I saw it fall out of the lock when the capsule dropped from the sky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's worth a try.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nice work, Agent P. Carl's analyzing the footprint sample you pulled from Doof's living room as we speak.

Name: Carl
Dialog: We've analyzed the mud and there seems to be a large number of caffeine molecules in there. Along with some rain water.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So our only leads are coffee and the rainy climate. That could be anywhere!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, hello! Anyone there? Marco! Y-you're supposed to say Polo! There better be a satisfying explanation for this when it's over or I'm gonna be merciless on my blog!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, baby!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What mysteries does it contain? (gasps) Perhaps dozens of stray Schrödinger's cats!

Name: Buford
Dialog: But I ain't cleaning that litter box.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why is it smoking like that?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And why are we all tilted?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Whoops, sorry!

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: You understand what you've done?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who are you?

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: I'm you! From the future!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Peter the Panda? Oh, that was a good shot of me. Oh, and that one. That one, too. And that one, that one was terrible, my nose looked all crooked, eh, it needed scribbling on it.

Name: Shadowy Figure
Dialog: Hello, Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, inky shape hovering in the darkness, what gives?

Name: Shadowy Figure
Dialog: It is I, Professor Mystery.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Peter the Panda never mentioned me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, but he doesn't actually, you know, talk. So, you gonna tell me why you kidnapped me? (no response) Um, hello! I know you're still out there. I can see your eyeballs. What's with all the silence? It's very off putting.

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Mystery...is my allure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh. This is gonna be a fun conversation.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait a minute. You're me from the future? What happened to my nose?

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: Never mind about our nose...es. Listen to that. If that hamster stops running, the black hole will break containment, reality will collapse, and now you've exposed my hamster to atmosphere! It's only a matter of time before he weakens!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, you have a hamster that's allergic to air?

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: You must believe me!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Why?

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: Because I'm you from the future!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait, I am not Indian in the future?

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: 'Kay! (to Isabella) I'm you from the future.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That doesn't even make sense.

Name: Old Woman
Dialog: Stop telling people you're them from the future!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Who's that?

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: That's just Denise. Ignore her. She's no one from the future.

Name: Denise
Dialog: I heard that! Hi, kids. Sorry for the intrusion.

Name: Crazy Old Man
Dialog: There's no time to lose!

Name: Denise
Dialog: Settle down, Bernie! Remember your blood pressure!

Name: Bernie
Dialog: What did I tell you? It's happening. He's slowing down!

Name: Denise
Dialog: Oh, let him! I'm so tired of that hamster runnin' our lives!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's that flashing?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That cannot be good.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, you did hit it with a lot of pianos.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously though, what's with the kidnapping? And why do you have an obsessive shrine to Peter the Panda?

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Because I am Peter the Panda's nemesis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: You're surprised?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well yeah, of course. But come on, if I knew he had a nemesis. I would never want to be the other evil scientist. (sees Professor Mystery's -inator) Ooh! An inator! So what does it do?

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: I can't divulge that because mystery...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...is your allure. Yeah, yeah, I know. So do you tell Peter the Panda your plans before or after you trap him? It's just...I'm always interested in process.

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: I don't tell him at all. It would ruin the mystery...which is my—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But he's your nemesis! He's gotta know what he's thwarting! I mean, it's just common courtesy! What, you expect him to infer it from your complicated backstories? (Mystery simply walks away.) Wait, don't—Oh, no. Don't tell me that you've never even given him a backstory! Well, there's your problem! There's your problem right there!

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Lack of communication. Gimme a beat. (A beat is somehow given and chorus girls appear out of nowhere.)

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: How did you get chorus girls in here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, they're union, they'll travel.

Name: Bernie
Dialog: (holding Phineas) There's only one way to stop this! Listen carefully! (A red bird flies out of his beard with the wind.) Hey, Denise, I found your bird!

Name: Denise
Dialog: You did? Where was he?

Name: Bernie
Dialog: He was in my beard! (back to Phineas) Anyway, there's only one way to stop this! (gets blown away and screams)

Name: Isabella, Buford and Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Quick, everyone! Grab hold of the tree!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now what?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Of course, this is the one time an object has not disappeared from the backyard!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, that's an annoying break in the pattern!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, actually, that's not the pattern! The pattern makes something disappear after—

Name: Everyone
Dialog: CANDACE!!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) MOM MOM MOM MOM MOM!!!

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: You're the last person I'm going to take advice from, you nemesis stealer!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Even with musical accompaniment, you just don't get it. Ugh! I'munna have to spell it out for you

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: (activating the inator) We'll see whose fault it is, after I activate my true-purpose-shrouded-in-an-enigma-inator! (The inator activates) Because in just a few moments, you will be zapped, and my vengeance will be complete!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Yawn! I mean I-I-I'd be so much more concerned if I understood what the stakes were, man. Y-Y-You've (sighs again) Man!

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Hmm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Peter the Panda! Wow, I never thought I would be so glad to see my nemesis.

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Peter the Panda is not your nemesis!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, you're right. He's not even my nemesis. H-H-He's more of a thwarty call.

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Don't you diminish him like th— (he gets body slammed by Peter.) See? He's thwarting me! You mean nothing to him, Doofenshmirtz! (gets punched) Yes yes! (gets punched again) You see? This is good, isn't it? (to Peter) What did he give you that I couldn't give you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: An evil monologue for one thing!

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Communication! Oh, for cryin' out loud! At least tell him what your inator does!!

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Huh? Oh yes! It's an unexist-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: WHAT?!??!?! Well-Well, now I'm worried! See? Communication. It works.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I can't hold on much longer! The one day my—

Name: Announcer
Dialog: TUFF SHOO LAYSIZZ!

Name: Buford
Dialog: —are in the wash! (He lets go of the branch and flies off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Mom! C'mon c'mon! What?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That did not hurt as much as I expected.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, you're welcome, people.

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: So, my own parents accidentally created a black hole and became obsessed with containing it, eventually firing themselves into orbit for fear that they would jeopardize the planet, but they abandoned me in the process. That is what motivated me to become evil in the first place and, eventually, build my unexist-inator, which you destroyed tonight! Wow, it really feels great to tell someone all this!

Name: Bernie and Denise
Dialog: Son!

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: Mom? Dad?! You're back! (He hugs them.)

Name: Denise
Dialog: Awww...

Name: Professor Mystery
Dialog: I want you guys to meet my nemesis, Peter the Panda.

Name: Bernie
Dialog: You have a nemesis?

Name: Denise
Dialog: Our boy's all grown up!

Name: Bernie
Dialog: Why is he a panda bear?

Name: Denise
Dialog: Bernie!

Name: Bernie
Dialog: What? I was just wondering.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, Perry the Platypus. Let's go home. I talk to you enough, right? Yeah, you're right. Maybe too much.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why don't you come in for some snacks, kids? And if you see your dad, tell him to join us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But-but-but-but... Fine.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Y'know that was pretty intense, Ferb. We could've blown up the planet or ripped open the space-time continuum or something. I just hope we didn't cause any real damage. (A polar bear appears next to them.) Oh, hi, Dad! Mom has snacks if you wanna join us!

Name: Polar bear (with Lawrence's voice)
Dialog: Oh, jolly good, boys. I am a bit peckish.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe there's some pie left.

Name: The real Phineas
Dialog: Whoa! That was weird! Was that us?

Name: The real Ferb
Dialog: Couldn't be. That Phineas had four white stripes on his shirt, and you only have three.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Good point. Not to mention our dad isn't a polar bear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) C'mon, c'mon...

Name: Candace (cont'd)
Dialog: ...Stace! Cover me! We need to find...

Name: Candace (cont'd)
Dialog: ...the Bridge across the Dumbledown River before that stupid gopher!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I got your back, girl! Coin!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm on it!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: C'mon! C'mon! (Ducky Momo retrieves the coin) Nice! You did it, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Third on the leaderboard, baby! That digital Ducky Momo trophy...will...be...mine!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ours.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ours.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walking in with a piece of paper) Candace, oh, good, you're up. You'll have plenty of time to tackle the list of chores that you let pile up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, Stacy and I are this close to kicking leaderboard butt in Ducky Momo's Golden Quest!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, your chores better be done before I get back from running my errands.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problemo, Mom! You're lookin' at the queen of mul...ti...tas...king!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just make sure you hit the whole list, Your Majesty. (leaves) See ya later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: 'Kay! (back on laptop) Ooh! Ooh! Squirrel bandits!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha! You lose, bro! Eye shifts count! Ya moved!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Actually, you did, too. Since our planet's orbit of speed around the sun is 67,000 miles per hour and you are on its surface and speeding around the sun as well. (Buford spins the hat on Baljeet's head.) Quit it!

Name: Phineas
