Dialog: Cool hat, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Thank you! I got it at Astro Camp today. (Buford spins it again.) Quit turbocharging the little speed of my solar system!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I'm racin' 'em against each other. (Spins it again.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Smack Baljeet's head around?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No! We're gonna build a solar system and race the planets!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Only if I can smack around Baljeet's hat!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Only you can make the decision to succeed. You've got to dig down deep within yourself and grab ahold of your dream! (pause) Go ahead. Grab it. (beat) I'll wait. (Agent P drops in.) Oh, Agent P! Uh, I've been giving a motivational speech to the interns, and, uh, by "interns", I mean Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Very inspirational, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Doofenshmirtz has rented out a conference hall at the Danville Motel Inn and is giving some kind of motivational lecture. Who would want motivation from him is beyond me, but, well, that's beside the point. Pick up your credentials at the front desk. (Perry the Chimneypus salutes.) Good luck, Agent P! (Perry's chair lowers back and is launched from it by a spring.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm all hooked up and ready to multitask. First on the list, wash dishes. (She dusts the table while walking. Sidenote

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I think we were headed into the forest with the Grizzly King. Are you sure you don't wanna wait until you finished your chores?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, please, Stacy, I've got everything under control. Let's tackle the mountain kings vicious!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Phineas, whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I were just headin' up to our solar system speedway. We're gonna have a planet race.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Cool!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The first one to complete 50 laps around the sun wins the Galaxy 5000! Technically, it should be "The Galaxy 50", but, y'know, "The Galaxy 5000" sounds so much cooler. (Cut to the top level, where Irving is seen at the control panel.) Ferb is racing Mercury, the closest planet to the sun. (Ferb puts on his helmet and gives a thumbs-up and gets sucked up a tube into his racing planet.) I'm racing Mars. I saved Venus for you.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aw, because Venus is the goddess of love?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (shrugs) Actually, I didn't even think of that. But sure. (Phineas and Isabella put on their helmets and get sucked up the tubes.)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Alright, racers, status check!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Saturn, check!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oo-ran-ohs, check!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, that is not how it is pronounced!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It is on this channel!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Venus?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Intergalactic Planetary Racing Patch, check!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Mars?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All ready!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Earth?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: Earth is ready to go!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Neptune?

Name: Balthazar
Dialog: Check!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Jupiter?

Name: Django
Dialog: Check!

Name: Albert
Dialog: Pluto is go!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Albert?! What are you doing here?! Pluto isn't even a planet!

Name: Albert
Dialog: That is still in dispute.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Racers, start your planets!

Name: Irving
Dialog: What a break! Earth is in the lead, with Jupiter and Neptune rushing up to the challenge, but they take each other out! The Fireside Girls maintain their lead!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Watch out for the fiery falling marshmallows, Stace!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) I'll turn them into s'mores with my super sugar squeal! Bye bye, Wonder Kid!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I'll go collect the coins in the Cocoa Campground. Now to get the laundry started!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Welcome, you lucky people in attendance, I am Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz and I'm here to introduce you to my eight-step program to ruling the Tri-State Area! I- I mean overcoming obstacles and a path self-fulfillment. Heh, heh! Right! Nothing evil there. Anyhoo, behold, the Inator Method! Hit it, Norm!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's what I'm talkin' about! Yeah! (Agent P drops in) P-Perry the Platypus, whatta you doin' here? Y-You're not s'posed to be here 'til step 3. (to audience) You have to excuse me while I confer with my visual aid. (to Perry) I'm on stage, so I'm gonna have to forego the long backstory. Suffice it to say, there was a judge's ruling involved, okay? Anyway, just take a seat in the back and I'll cue you when you're on. (Perry exits) Perry the Platypus, ladies and gentlemen! You'll be seeing more of him later during the nemesis portion of the seminar.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sweet! We made it to the golden key of Crumblebum Dwarfs!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) Candace, it's the gopher!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (not paying attention to how much detergent she's putting in) I'll put a stop to you, you gold key-swipin' gopher!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) Just get the key! Oh, man!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, stupid gopher!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Now we're back to third place!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! I guess we'll just have to get him on the next level. (looks at detergent) Did I put the..? (shrugs) Hmm. (puts in the last of the detergent) Better clean than dirty. (Closes the lid and turns the washing machine on.) I'm one totally focused multitasking genius!

Name: Irving
Dialog: It's a virtual dead-heat with the planetary trine between Mercury, Mars and Venus! Phineas is out in front by a pointed nose! But check out the cool inverted move from Ferb! Watch out, boys! Venus is risin' fast!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She went intra-Venus right between us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so now that we got the basics covered, we can get to the fun part. Let's start with trapping your nemesis. (Cut to Perry with a nametag lanyard on taking notes. He gets trapped by the lanyard.) Nametag, you're it!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters angrily)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The keys to a good trap are the element of surprise and, also, if you can work in a good pun . That's always nice.

Name: Billy
Dialog: Uh, what about constraint and effectiveness?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, th-that'll be covered in the thwarting portion of our seminar. Don't...Don't get ahead of yourself. Okay, step four is the big reveal! (Takes tarp off his inator.) Behold

Name: Billy
Dialog: Billy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shakes Billy's hand) Great to meet ya, Billy! Tell me, (motions toward the back of the room) whadaya see over there in the back of the room?

Name: Billy
Dialog: Uh...I dunno, a table full of stuff?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did everyone take note of his reply? (walks behind the inator) Totally lackluster. But that's all gonna change. Okay, Billy, now hold still. (Fires the inator on Billy) Now whadaya see, Billy?

Name: Billy
Dialog: (excitedly gasps) Inator Method merchandise! (runs up to the counter and purchases practically everything) Tapes, DVDs, books, audiobooks, now! Now! T-shirts, hats, that is so cool! I gotta have 'em!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now look at him! All full of pep! He's completely motivated!

Name: Man #1
Dialog: (speaking in a female voice) Wait a second! He's just motivated to buy your junk! This is nothin' but a money-makin' scam!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly, what better motivation is there? (zaps the entire audience and they storm the merchandise counter)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice work, Stace! That last mega-wallow in the Razzleberry Swamp puts us back in second place. (lets go of the vacuum, which attempts to suck the rug right up)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (on laptop) What?! I can barely hear you over the vacuum!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hang on. (leaves the room and the vacuum still on) Is that better?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Testimonials, take one.

Name: Man #3
Dialog: I came to this seminar with no intention of buying anything and look at all this junk I bought!

Name: Man #4
Dialog: Holy cow, I bought a lotta stuff I don't need!

Name: Margaret
Dialog: I just can't stop spending money on the Inator Method's motivational products!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woohoo! With all the cash I'm raking in, I'll be able to take over the Tri-State Area in no time! (A woman gives him a book, which he signs.) Thank you very much. Nice doin' business with ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) And who do I make this out to?

Name: Man #5
Dialog: (offscreen) Uncle Phil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "To Uncle Phil, I'm wishing you the worst. Dr. Heinz Doofen—" Ow! (He gets kicked by Perry.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) This is it, Stace! The Golden Treasure of Utter Momosity! Oh, no, you don't! Leap of doom!

Name: Candace and Stacy
Dialog: (Cheer)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woohoo! We did it! (A digital trophy appears onscreen.) Oh, it's so beautiful!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Number one in the Momo Realm! (sees a planet speeding out the window) With time to spare for an astronomical bust!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Buford is in the lead with Baljeet close behind!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ha ha! I am going to run rings around you, Ice Giant!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bring it on, dweeb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Eat my dust, Buford!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Ooh! The silent-but-deadly planet has left for parts unknown! (A horn is sounded and a robotic arm waves a checkered flag.) And Baljeet wins a digital trophy!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Victory!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, hold still so I can throw the book at ya! (Perry throws one at him) Ow! (The book hits the inator, which, as always, zaps out the window and hits an unsuspecting driver, who stops outside the backyard and sees the solar system.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great race, Baljeet!

Name: Trucker
Dialog: 'Scuse me, I don't normally run into strangers' backyards, but I'm inexplicably motivated to buy your solar system racetrack. How much?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Five bucks.

Name: Trucker
Dialog: Sold!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm home! How did you do on that lis—Oh! (gets grabbed by Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom Mom Mom, you gotta see what Phineas and Ferb built in the backyard!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, the living room!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pushes her mother out) I know! I vacuumed!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) C'mon! C'mon!

Name: Linda
Dialog: But the laundry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (keeps pushing her mother) I know! I just have to fold it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: The dishes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: All done and ready to be put away! (With her eyes closed) Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom! Hi, Candace!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids. Well, at least the backyard isn't a mess.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Come on, Candace, (walks back inside) you have a lot of cleaning up to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...but but but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was a lot of interplanetary fun!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Plus, we made five bucks!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We should put that in the bank.

Name: Buford
Dialog: At 1% interest?! Are you kiddin'?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Noooooo!!!! Ah, man! Now I'm gonna have to use the money I made for repairs and medical bills.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, now, now, wai-wait! (He walks out the building and looks both directions. He then runs and screams as the planetary race track goes by.) AAAaaah!!! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella. We were just building a polymer de-stabilizer for the binding catalyst of the—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's great, Phineas. Listen, uh, there's something I wanna tell you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Uh, it's about this patch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, it's one of your accomplishment patches.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, but...it's an Emotional Bravery Patch that I can only earn by walking up to somebody I—

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (clears his throat offscreen)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nice, Ferb! You found the new power supply!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Um, Phineas? I, uh—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, what's shakin', bacon?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You do realize that bacon does not shake.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sir Francis Bacon?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I stand corrected.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're building a rubberization ray to give our skin rubber-like qualities. C'mon! We'll show you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs, to herself) So you see, Phineas, I can only earn the patch by walking up to someone I care about and telling them face-to-face that I've got a huge crush on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Remember how much fun it was to bounce around the world on a rubber ball?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If not a bit nauseating.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was the fun part!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, how awesome would it be to actually be a rubber ball?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm in! Can we shoot Perry with it and bounce him around the backyard like a plat-a-ball?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, no. But where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I see you found the new central air conditioning entrance.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (Chatters angrily)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? Oh, the hot tub. Purely therapeutic. The bubbles work wonders on a bad back. (The bubbles stop) Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (exhales) I'm a little lightheaded, sir. Can I take a break?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What am I not paying you for?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir. (inhales)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyhoo, today's the unveiling of Danville's new water tower. Mayor Doofenshmirtz is going to be dedicating it tonight at his press conference. We're fairly certain that Doof'll attempt to disrupt the event in some way. Not only is it high profile, but, since it's right next door to Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated, it's also extremely convenient. So get out there and stop him from doing whatever it is he is gonna... (the bubbles stop again) Carl! Bubbles!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Yes, sir. (groans and faints)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Fine. You've got five minutes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Ooh, Stacy, the new issue of Blasé Teen is out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You should see the models in these spreads. So indifferent. So uninterested. So cool! (puts magazine back on rack) I wonder if you and I will ever be this cool. What are you doing, Stacy?

Name: Stacy

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: No, no. Doofenshmirtz is in jail. Everything's fine. Go-Go to your picnic and relax. Dress festive, be young! Ha. You've earned it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: But, Major, I'm trained to—

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Leave the responsibility to us, young lady.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Look, Major Monogram, I found it!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Carl, no! That's a real frog!

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh.

Name: Frog
Dialog: Ribbit.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Ew!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Yeah, I gotta run. You go have fun.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (sighs and gets her red shirt from a coat hanger) Well, I guess it's time to dress festive.

Name: Female Narrator
Dialog: Once the gong is rung, the offensive team serves the pom-pom and advances down the field. The defending cyclists race past the tackling dummies and try to get into scoring position. If they manage to return the pom-pom into one of the scoring locations, they will be awarded a chance to chase the jumbo riding ball past the midfield skiing defender, while the other team tries to hit as many tennis balls as they can using golf clubs. I don't know why this guy has a canoe paddle.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace? Candace? Come in, Candace!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (Takes off her shades and turns around) Isabella? Oh, hey.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Wait a minute, are you standing sentry?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (stoic) What? No. I was about to frolic down the hillside. I'm all about this whole "fun" thing.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Y'know, you're not foolin' anybody.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Yeah?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Bo staff.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Right.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace, I thought you were going to take it easy. Whatever happened to that whole Jeremy Johnson thing?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: We were supposed to go out, but things kept getting in the way. I didn't have any time. I was busy.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Doing pull-ups in your room and watching your brothers?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I like doing pull-ups.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: There's no reason you can't do that, but you have to make room in your life for other things like fun and...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: And Jeremy Johnson?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Something like that. In the meantime, I'd like to introduce you to a little thing the kids are calling "ice cream". (runs down the hill)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: "I scream?" W-What is that? Some kind of weird yelling game? (following Isabella-2)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Nice hit, Dr. Baljeet.

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: Ha ha! I believe that makes the score six kadooms to twelve rempars.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Eleven, if Perry can find the ball.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Perry!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Come on, Ferb, we got to help him.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: What the heck is that thing?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ow! Ow!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Candace, you have to eat the ice cream slowly. What is that?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Giant mechanical ants! My brothers are in trouble! On your feet, kid, it's go time!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: There's a flying one!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I got it! (She fires a grappling hook at it.) Whoa!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: (skating past Candace-2) On your right!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh no! They got Perry!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Are you guys all right?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We're fine, but cyborg animals have captured Perry.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: The robot ants must have been a diversion. (turns on her cell phone) Monogram, we just got ambushed at the picnic. This has Doofenshmirtz written all over it.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: (on screen) Well, that's impossible. He's right here in our detention facility. I-I-I just played checkers with him. (He cheats, by the way.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: These giant ants didn't send themselves!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ask him about the cyborg animal agents!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: The what?! Was one of them a panda and the other one of those shaky rat dogs?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, where'd they come from?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Ah, well, I didn't want to say anything before, but we kind of lost track of some of the agents when Doof took over.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: How many did you lose?

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: 26, sir.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ferb, if we can access Perry's location chip, maybe we can ambush those cyborgs and rescue Perry.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Yeah, no way! You guys are staying here where it's safe.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Candace, we can handle this. Who was it that got past the security grid to free you from Doof's tower?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, but take the Firestorm Girls. It could get hairy. And while you do that, I'll go find out who's behind all this.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Come on, Ferb!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ah, Choo-Choo, look! We have company!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: All right, Doofenshmirtz, what do you know about robotic picnic ants and a fist-full of cyborgs?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ants at a picnic? So it's a...it's a rhetorical question, is it?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Don't play smart with me, villain. You're behind the attack at the park. Now, spill it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What? You're blaming me? I-I-I've been locked up in here with Choo-Choo. Isn't that right, Choo-Choo? Yes. Yes, it is. See? H-He'll provide an alibi.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Don't lie to me! There's Doof-tech scattered all over that park.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Well, it wasn't me. There is, however, another Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Vanessa! I knew it!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: And who is that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Charlene Doofenshmirtz. She's my ex-wife. I-I guess you guys have never met. That kinda takes away the drama of the reveal. But it's her.

Name: Perry-2
Dialog: (Chatters angrily)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Pinky! You're alive!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Don't you remember me?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Apparently not.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We're gonna get you outta here, Perry!

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: We got Perry! Everybody fall back!

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Now this is as much fun as bustin' rocks for the state!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: We've had Doofenshmirtz moved to this interrogation room so Candace Flynn can question him thoroughly.

Name: Carl-2
Dialog: Are you sure he can't see you?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: It's a one-way mirror. Here, watch this. (He makes a face at Doof-2.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I can see you!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, maybe it's just that he can't hear us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I can hear you, too!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Huh. Maybe I just don't know how this one-way mirror thing works.

Name: Mover
Dialog: Comin' through.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, okay. Now I'm embarrassed.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Alright, knock it off, glamour boy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I just haven't seen a mirror for two months. Did my hair always look like this?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Just park your caboose in that chair.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Choo-Choo is not a caboose. It's an engine.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Clam it, wise guy! You know why I'm here and you better cooperate, because there are worse things than sittin' in a cold, dank prison cell with your little choo-choo train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Like what?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Like sitting in a cold, dank prison cell without your little choo-choo train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You wouldn't!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Try me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Alright, I'll talk.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Tell me about your ex-wife, Charlene.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What do you wanna know?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (slams her Bo staff on the table) Where's her hideout?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Sheesh! She's got a penthouse uptown. You can't miss it. It has "Charlene" written in bright lights across the top of it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: How do I get in?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You would have to pass through the identification scrutinizer. Only a Doofenshmirtz can get through.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Lucky for us, we got one of those.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yeah. Oh! You mean me, right?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Dr. Baljeet, we're back and we have Perry!

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: That is great. And I think I figured out how to get this giant ant going again.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Great! So everything's going to plan?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, kids! (cut to reveal Doof-2 on a dolly cuffed and facemasked) Where do you keep the silverware?

Name: Isabella-2, Holly-2 and Adyson-2
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: What's he doing here?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: At ease. He's still a prisoner. I'm just using him to get into Charlene's penthouse.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Wow, cool restraints.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Actually, he asked for this stuff.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: The mask makes me sound all creepy. Here, check this out. Fava beans... Fava...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, that's enough. Hey, where's Ferb?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh, well, I'm sure he'd just—

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh! We don't have time to wait for him. We gotta get over to Charlene's. Phineas, Perry, you're with me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Fava beans... Heh heh heh heh...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (to Doof-2) Now, you, do what you have to do to get us in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Okay. Okay. (He puts his hand on the scanner, then his eye in the retina scanner.) Aaahhh... (A machine scans his tongue and ear.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wow, the identity scrutinizer is really thorough.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You have no idea. (Ding! The doors open) Come along, people.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Uh, Mom, Tony Marzulo asked me out to the movies. Can I go?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (getting her nails filed by a rat-borg) Didn't your father banish him?

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Yeah, but Dad banished every boy that asked me to the movies. Besides, Dad's no longer in power.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: The day isn't over yet, dear.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: But, Mom...

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: I don't know. (to the Rat-borg) What do you think?

Name: Rat-borg
Dialog: (squeaks)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: There's your answer.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Uh, thanks?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, fellas. There she is. Let's get her attention. (She swipes some plates off the shelf behind her with her Bo staff and the plates shatter into pieces.)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: What the heck is goin' on in there?!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (bursting through the door) We got you now, Charlene! Your evil days are over!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Oh, how sweet! Do come in and thank you for returning my husband.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Husband? I thought you two were divorced.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: It was all a ruse, honey.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wait, you two are pretending to be divorced? Why would you do that?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Naive child, let me explain.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, I get it, you're still married. But why would you send the ants to the picnic? You had to know we'd come after you.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Of course. And I also knew you would use Heinz to get in the building, bringing my husband back to me and getting you here, so I could get the drop on you.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: A lot of convoluted reasons there, too.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: We've got another song! (The music starts up again.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: No no no, we're good. (The music warps down.)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: And now, children, we have prepared a nice cozy prison cell for you. (The animal cyborgs surround them.)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: All the animal agents!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Wait, you haven't seen my newest one!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (gasps offscreen) You villain! You turned my brother into a cyborg!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Ferb-borg, relieve Candace of her weapon. (to Peter the Pandaborg) Take them to the holding cell to await cyborg reprogramming. (they leave) Oh, it's so good to have a cyborg who can actually speak.

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: Well, I usually say only one line per day.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: One line, really? Why?

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: (blinks)

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Seriously? That was it?

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: (blinks)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Eh. Weird kid.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Well, Heinz, shall we retake over the Tri-State Area now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Actually, I-I-I don't really wanna be an evil dictator anymore. I've got everything I need right here. (He gives Choo-Choo to Charlene-2.) My Choo-Choo, my family, this lovely penthouse, my freedom and... (Cut to outside as Choo-Choo is thrown out the window.) Choo-Choo!!! Backstory reforming... Evil returning... Aw, yeah! I'm back, baby!!!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh, I'm sorry I got you into this, Phineas.

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Oh, that's okay, Candace.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: But we're gonna have to be strong. Jail is a mental game. They're going to try to break us, you'll see. Seconds become hours, hours become years, until the mere thought of freedom flutters out of our consciousness like a dying butterfly. (The cell door opens.)

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: You're right, that did seem like forever.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Look! It's the Ferb-borg! Get behind me, Phineas! I'll hold him off as long as I can!

Name: Ferb-2
Dialog: (takes off his disguise) Please, Candace, you're being dramatic. (frees Perry-2)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: What? Ferb? You're not a cyborg?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Sorry we had to fool you like that, Candace, but we needed you to be convincing.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: But why?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: Ferb figured that if Doof and Charlene thought that they had the leader of the Resistance and the Platyborg under lock and key, they would devote all their attention to the frontal attack. That way, we could come up from behind and—

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Wait, what frontal attack?

Name: Phineas-2
Dialog: That one.

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) That is not how to make it climb, Buford.

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: Oh, you wanna climb the building!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, looks like someone's comin' late to the party.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: That's okay, dear. I've got a little present for our unwelcome guest. (Puts a large metal capsule on her right arm.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wow, y-you know, Charlene, you're really on top of things here. Tomorrow, I'm taking you shopping for a new evil pantsuit.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Alright, everybody! Go go go go go!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: So much for our ride home.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wow, nice shot!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: (on a walkie-talkie) Attention, all animal cyborgs, attend to our guests!

Name: Dr. Baljeet
Dialog: All we have to do is get these magnetic deprogramming chips near the cyborgs' frontal lobes and they will no longer be evil.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: How do we do that?

Name: Buford-2
Dialog: (getting a fedora out of a bag) Look, we sewed 'em into these little hats.

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Aw, that's so cute!

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Everyone, grab a hat! We've got cyborgs to reprogram!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Now finish him off! (Charlene-2 is about to shoot but Candace-2 drops down.) Ahhh...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Give it up, Charlene!

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Seems to me you're still outnumbered.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Seriously, how did he ever run this place without me?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Alright, fan out! (Isabella-2 runs up to Pinky the Chihuahuaborg.)

Name: Pinky the Chihuahuaborg
Dialog: (growls)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Pinky, I just wanna...

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Okay, so you're not a hat guy. Take it easy.

Name: Pinky-2
Dialog: (pants happily)

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Pinky! (she hugs him) Good to have you back! (kisses him)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Surrender or there'll be big trouble.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Oh, I think I'll go with that second thing you mentioned.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: End of the line, kid! What a shame! I'll make ya an offer. I could get rid of you right now or you could join me. You could be the leader of my cyborg army.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (smiling) Actually, it looks like your cyborg army may have changed their minds.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Wait, what are you talking about? (Agent R-2 breaks off one of Charlene-2's fingernails.) My manicure!! (she trips over a piece of equipment) Whoa!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: It's all over, Charlene. (The reformed animal agents surround her.) Now surrender.

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Ha! (presses a remote causing another capsule to come out of the floor) A Doofenshmirtz never surrenders! We fight until the last man!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute! I'm the last man! D-Don't I get a say in this?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Oh, come on, honey. It'll be fun.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Alright, hold it! Everybody just stop! (opening the animal agents like a door) Excuse me. (to Candace-2) Can I talk to my parents? Listen, Mom, Dad, come here. You guys, I'm only gonna say this once. (breathes) RUN!!!

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Mom, Dad, this is Tony Marzulo.

Name: Tony
Dialog: Hey, Mr. and Mrs. D.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Hey, didn't I banish you?

Name: Charlene-2
Dialog: Yeah, honey, you did, but nobody saw it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Academy graduates, Doofenshmirtz is still out there and no doubt he's planning a comeback. But so are we. We now have you, the animal agents of OWCA, who will, without a doubt, prevail. So as I step down from my position as head of the Resistance, (Monogram-2 and Carl-2 react to this in fear) I congratulate you all and wish you luck.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Whoa, wait! You're stepping down?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: It's okay, Major. You've got your animal agents back. I think you can handle it.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: But...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Don't worry. (She gives Monogram-2 her Bo staff.) If you ever get in a pinch, you know where to find me. Now if you'll excuse me, there's something I've been putting off that I need to take care of.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Where is she going?

Name: Isabella-2
Dialog: Unless I miss my guess, I'd say she's making room in her life for other things.

Name: Jeremy-2
Dialog: 15...16...17... (Candace-2 joins him) 18... Hey!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Hey, yourself.

Name: Becky
Dialog: Hey, Vanessa! How was your summer?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, the basic. Pretty cool when I was at my mom's and okay when I was at my dad's. Did you know in July, he actually removed all the blue from all the paintings at the museum? All the blue!

Name: Lacie
Dialog: Omigosh, I totally saw that! Picasso's whole Blue Period is just beige now.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yep. That was my dad.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Sigh.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hi, Johnny.

Name: Lacie
Dialog: It looks like he didn't take your breaking up very well.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (offscreen) Sigh.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It wasn't like we were going out that long, Johnny!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Just take the dissection tray and use its wax foundation to cradle my broken heart, Vanessa!

Name: Male Student 1
Dialog: Let it go, bro.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And to think I wanted to come back to school for a sense of normalcy.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: Good morning, people. As you know, there have been some staff changes. If you'll sit down, I will introduce you to your new science teacher...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Lacie
Dialog: What?

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: Dr. Doofenshmirtz is here on a trial basis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, no, we already had the trial. The judge gave me a choice of doing hard time or community service. So, here I am, ready to impart upon these young, sponge-like minds all my vast knowledge of evil sci—I-I mean science. That's right. Regular old science. No evil at all. In fact, I've crossed out the word "Evil" whenever it appears in my old textbooks. So, this should be a piece of cake. (to Vanessa) Hi, sweetie-kins! (Vanessa slams her head on her desk.) Thank you, Principal Lang. I can take it from here.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: Just so you know, Heinz, I've got my eye on you. I miss nothing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And nice to see you, too! (to the class) Y'know, we knew each other long ago, but that's a story for another time. I'm Dr. Doofenshmirtz. (writing on the blackboard) D-O-O-F-E...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, come here. (she grabs him out of the classroom)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh... (pops back into the frame) ...enshmirtz!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what are you doing here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Isn't this great? More father-daughter time!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, not at my school! Really?

Name: Johnny
Dialog: So you're Vanessa's dad? I'm Johnny.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Didn't she dump you?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: We were hardly going out!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (whining) Yes, we were!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, girls don't like guys who are whiny. You're whiny. I get it. I get it.

Name: Becky
Dialog: Mr. Doofenshmirtz, if you're Vanessa's dad, is she gonna get, like, special treatment? I've taken extra booster classes in science to ensure my early acceptance—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No! No special treatment, because this is not happening!

Name: Lacie
Dialog: (beat) What's goin' on?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Everybody, back in class.

Name: Mrs. Pierpoint
Dialog: Principal Lang, are you brooding again?

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: Why does everyone always think I'm brooding? It's my brow, isn't it?

Name: Mrs. Pierpoint
Dialog: Well...

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: Yes, I'm brooding! It's that Heinz Doofenshmirtz! We went to community college together.

Name: Mrs. Pierpoint
Dialog: Oh.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: He wound up marrying Charlene, the girl that I was in love with!

Name: Mrs. Pierpoint
Dialog: Aren't they divorced now?

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: That's not the point!

Name: Mrs. Pierpoint
Dialog: Oh, I'm sorry.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: How could she have preferred him to me?

Name: Mrs. Pierpoint
Dialog: Well, maybe it's time to give up your grudge.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: Give up a grudge? Never! What do you think this brow is for?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's start with genetics, the building blocks of life. Your genes determine what you will be. A...A turtle or a bird or... For instance... (plucks a hair off of Johnny)

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Ow! Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, don't be a baby. You've got plenty. At least for the next ten years. Let's see genetics at work, shall we? (He puts the hair in a petrie dish, and puts the dish under a microscope.) Now, all of the information that makes this young man who and what he is is stored in these DNA strands in every cell of his body. The-The genetic code is very delicate. See, now, if we move this base pair over to here, he would have been a gorilla, or you know, maybe a lizard. Y'see, there's this whole world of things going on, too small for us to even notice.

Name: Yellow insect
Dialog: So, what are we doing here again, Napoleon?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: (the purple insect) Well, Wendell, we're going to make contact with these magnificent giants!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: We will?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, we will.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Wait. Why will we?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: To be the first ones to communicate with a alien race. Just think, Wendell, you and I and Floyd are going to go where no bug has gone be— Okay, where's Floyd? Floyd!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: Sorry, sir. Ran into a spider web. Lost my wings.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: They're behind you, Floyd.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I found 'em, sir.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: So as I was saying—

Name: Floyd
Dialog: They were behind me.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, we've established that. Continuing, we are going to make contact with the giants! But first, we must scale the Cliffs of Mahogany! (referring to the desk) This may take a few tries, but—

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Sir, let me throw it! I'm the muscle!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: You're the muscle?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Yes! You're the brains, I'm the muscle, and Floyd is...

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Floyd is the ballast?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Yes! Floyd is the ballast!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: Ooh, that sounds important.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Anyway, Wendell, if you're feeling muscular, be my guest.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Stand back! (He swings the grappling hook, which is actually a string with a bent paper clip on it. The clip latches onto a beaker. The beaker tips off the desk and traps the bugs.)

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Hmm. Well, we have a limited air supply. Floyd, stop breathing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that's unfortunate. (takes the dish off) Uh, hopefully, the DNA in the petrie dish won't combine with... (Johnny starts growing a lizard tail) Oh! Oh! No, see, it's... It's happening already.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (looks behind him) Uh... (begins transforming and howls like a gorilla. His right arm becomes a gorilla arm.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so everyone pay attention to this. This is what I was talking about. The DNA of a human is only a few base pairs from that of a monkey. (Johnny's left arm becomes a lizard's arm.) Or... or a reptile for that matter.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (growls and runs away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? I told you. A whiner.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: What is happening?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, sir? I think you should take a look at this.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! I was afraid it might come to this.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters tiredly)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, pick up! (turns over sleepily and scratches his rear) Agent P, please pick up! (Perry finally picks up) Ah! So sorry, Agent P, I... I know that this is your time to enjoy some well-deserved rest, but something's gone wrong in Doof's class, and, well, the OWCA work-release program doesn't need this kind of scandal. Whadaya say, P?

Name: Becky
Dialog: Guys, Johnny's running wild out there!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what are you doing?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's one of Johnny's hairs. It's loaded with his DNA. With this, I can mix up an antidote to...

Name: Gideon
Dialog: (offscreen) He shapeshifted again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no no. This isn't Johnny. It's, uh... (whispering) Perry the Platypus, I'm glad you're here. Could you go find Johnny and bring him back to the classroom? He's got greasy hair and he's wearing a trench coat. Mmm, and he's also part-gorilla, part-lizard. You can't miss him. (out loud) Class, Mr. Platypus is the...occasional assistant teacher.

Name: Male Student 2
Dialog: Is that a real platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! It's a.... it's a man. It's a deformed, tiny...turquoise man. Vanessa, take some of your friends here, uh, uh, Ponytails, Spikey Head, Tweedle-Tie and go get Johnny.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hi, "Mr. Platypus".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, and the rest of you, Muscles, Ropey Face, Slap-Happy, Buzzy-Pants, stay here and help me with the antidote.

Name: Ropey-Face
Dialog: Wait, why am I Ropey-Face?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Take my advice

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Johnny? Er, "Creature formerly known as Johnny"?

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (hiding under the bleachers) Go away!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Johnny, you've gotta come out! My dad can help you!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: You hate me!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't hate you. We can be friends.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: (sees Perry) Huh? Whoa! What is that thing?!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: He's just a tiny turqouise m— AAAAH!! (Johnny carries Vanessa off like Fay Wray.)

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Vanessa!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Perry!!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Expedition journal, entry three. We have bivouacked on a landing halfway up the cliffs.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: I don't remember bivouacking.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I went before we left.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Oy. Bivouac. It's a makeshift camp. That—Look, it's not important. What I'm worried about is, what are we going to tell the giants about ourselves?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Floyd throws up on his food.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: It's true. I do.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Let's not lead with that.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I can also smell through my hair.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: But what do we say to an alien species to make them understand our entire culture? Our very place in this vast cosmos?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: What is happening?!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I think I just bivouacked again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Careful. Careful. Everything depends on getting the mixture precise. (Becky drops the liquid into the beaker. Doof stirs it with a straw and drinks it.) Mmm. Excellent. Now that's how you make a Shirley Temple. Hey, Muscles, how's the antidote coming?

Name: Muscles
Dialog: (wearing a hazmat suit and carrying a radioactive stick) Al...most... done. (drops it into the graduated cylinder and it explodes a bit. He pours it into the petri dish and Doof gets some of it with a needle.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, we're all set. Now, where's whiny reptile boy?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Somebody help me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) He has Vanessa! (to the rest of the class) Who's up for a field trip?

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Sanctuary!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, you're such a drama queen. See, this... This is why we broke up!

Name: Ropey-Face
Dialog: Wait, where's he going?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, now, how're we gonna... Nobody has a crossbow, do they?

Name: Becky
Dialog: I do! (beat) What? Why, is that weird?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! Thanks! (climbs in) Hey, you got new cup holders.

Name: Ropey-Face
Dialog: Whoa! Mr. Platypus has a cool ride!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hang on, sweetie! (to Perry) Well, I guess it's just like the old saying, "You turn a guy into a gorilla-lizard, and he carries your daughter up a bell tower." It never really made sense to me before, but now I guess I... (Johnny pushes a bell off and it lands on Perry with a long DONG!)

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: It is not one o'clock!

Name: Sally
Dialog: Hey, guys! How's it coming? Recess is almost over!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Almost done!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pointing) Ferb, look!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Johnny, put me down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, would you just stand still?! I can't get a clear shot!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw man! I can't wait 'til we get to high school! It looks like so much fun!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, hold still! I'll get it—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, do something!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, yes! Hold on a second! (He attempts to fire the crossbow, but he and the bell topple off of the hovercar.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad!!

Name: Johnny
Dialog: Vanessa, you saved my life!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, please don't read anything into this.

Name: Johnny
Dialog: There's still hope!!!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What did I just say?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, everyone, back to class. Nothing to see here. Just a giant bell.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: What in the bell?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: We've done it! We've reached the summit! Unfurl the banner, boys, and follow me! This is it! My entire existence has been leading to this moment, so that I can say... "Weclom Ginats!" (realizes what the banner says) Wait, what? "Weclom Ginats?!"

Name: Wendell
Dialog: What does that mean?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Exactly my point. What does our "Welcome Giants" banner actually say?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Oh, yeah, sorry, we spelled it phonetically.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: NO YOU DIDN'T!!!! Phonetically, it spells, "Weclom Ginats!" Come on, guys! This is our only chance to make a good first imp—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that, class, is DNA in action.

Name: Principal Lang
Dialog: (bursting through the door) Aha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it for today. Class dismissed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bye-bye, now.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (walking up to her father) Dad? (sighs) So, you're my teacher now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm your teacher now.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But, we're not gonna do...all of..."this"...every day, right?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Ugh. I do believe I've fractured my exoskeleton.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: And I bivouacked!

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Hey, I'm Dan.

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: And I'm Swampy. We're the co-creators of Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: The show that you're probably watching right now.

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: Hopefully.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: We get letters from kids all over the world asking us questions about the show, that we...

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: No, that's not actually true. We don't get a lot of actual, physical "written on paper" letters...

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: No, no. That's true... That's true

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: ...what we get is a lot of e-mails. Digital, electronic..

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Yeah. Actually, all of the e-mails we've ever received fit on this flash drive right here. (He holds up a flash drive) But that's not as impressive as this... (Dan motions to the large pile of mail sitting behind them)

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: No, this stack of, of letters here is much more impressive. This is a prop, though made mostly of, uh, foam, fiberglass, that kind of thing.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Yeah. Not to say that we don't actually get letters from people. Physical letters. Ih-like, this one, for instance, from– from Becky. This is a question we get all the time. "Are we ever going to see Perry the Platypus get a girlfriend?"

Name: Dan and Swampy
Dialog: No!

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: No, not gonna happen.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: No.

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: Here's another one. This one is from, uh, Donny. Says

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Yes. Yes, we are.

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: In fact, we're gonna see it right now.

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: This episode is set ten years in the future. So don't let it confuse you. Actually, uh, to avoid confusion, let's, uh, let's just synchronize our calendars right....

Name: Dan and Swampy
Dialog: Now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ugh! I'm running out of time, Ferb. I gotta choose a school. Do I stay local or go abroad? Trade school? Art school? Come on, Ferb. Help me make a decision.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Get in the booth.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, cool! All my college acceptance letters! I guess we're gonna let fate decide this one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He grabs one) Okay, Kjobstaad Academy. Uh, which one was that again?.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Mmm...great physics department, Norway.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm...Don't feel I'm ready for those cold winters.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay. Comedy Traffic School. Well, if it's fate...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, things seemed a lot easier when we were young and waiting for our voices to drop.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (in a deep voice) Hey, guys. (he coughs and returns to his normal voice) Oh! Something was caught in my throat. So, still trying to figure out where to go to school?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Workin' on it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I was just giving Buford some pointers on collegiate life. Since I've already graduated and have been accepted as a professor, I could pull some strings and get him into my school. Just think, Buford. You could be my student! I would be the boss of you!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't get too excited. I'm goin' to film school. I'm concentratin' on tragedies. The story of a struggling orphan's transcendental search for meaning in a post-apocalyptic society.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It sounds pretentious.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thank you. (he takes another bite out of his sandwich)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So, Ferb, you're off to school in England?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. He's going to Camford on Oxbury. Heh heh! "Camford on Oxbury". It sounds like a wizard school.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's not a wizard school. Well, there is some wizarding.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Phineas, why don't you just go there?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Or why not go where Candace goes to school?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Law school? I don't know.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And that concludes my dissertation on modern investigative techniques for establishing proof of guilt with or without physical evidence.

Name: Male panelist
Dialog: Spectacular! I've never had a student convince me of something so completely baseless before!

Name: Female panelist
Dialog: Now I feel like busting someone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, I don't know if Candace's school is the place for me. Forget the booth. I'm gonna go with my gut. (takes two envelopes) It's between these two

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, the epic struggle of a triangle-headed boy to choose between two schools.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Pretentious alert.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And again, thank you.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (on the phone) Sir, it's the old Evil Scientist Alert System! It's showing -inator activity on a Doctor Dooferd–...

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz‽ Great googly moogly! I though he'd given up his evil ways when we placed him as a high school science teacher. Well, it's too bad Monogram isn't around to see this.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Well, sir, he's gone to a better place.

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Yeah... (beat) Oh, what the heck? I'm gonna call him! (Carl dials the phone. Monogram, now retired and older, with a beard and a Hawaiian shirt is lounging on a beach.)

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Monogram.

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: How've ya been, sir?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Carl! I'm great! Bora Bora really is a better place. How've ya been, man?

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: I've been well. Guess who's set off the -inator alert?

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz?

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Monogram
Dialog: Heh heh. Just like old times. Go tell him "hi" for me.

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Of course.

Name: Commander Carl
Dialog: Agent P... (Agent P picks up his bowling bag.) No, it's not bowling night! It's Doofenshmirtz. He's activated the -inator alert system. We think he may have returned to evil.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: So I hear Isabella is off to Tri-State State.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, wow, really? Huh. Haven't seen much of her this summer.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (looking in the fridge) Why do parents buy such weird food? Everything's 'lite', 'low', 'non', 'free', or 'diet'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So she's...leaving?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. Huh, I always thought the two of you would end up together.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I wish. I am so in the friend zone there.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are kidding, right? You do know she had a giant crush on you for ages.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh...no...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, come on! It was so obvious! She came over to your house every day for eleven years just to see what you were doin'!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: When she looked at you, her pupils actually formed little hearts. Like, I do not know how that is physically possible. She changed her eyeballs!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We— I don't believe it. Ferb? (Ferb nods.) Well, why didn't you guys ever tell me?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We are guys. We do not talk about feelings. (Buford shrugs in agreement) ..Did you see the new car Irving got?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Could we eat yet? I'm starvin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um, I'm sorry. I feel like my brain is broken. I-I gotta think. I'm gonna take a walk. (he leaves) See ya, guys.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm...maybe it is not too late. We should try to get them together. You know, before Isabella leaves for school.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (after a beat) Yeah, all right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Eh, is it Thursday already? Hmm, well, let me go get my shoes and my ball and then... Wait, where's your stuff? (Perry points to the -inator behind Doofenshmirtz.) Huh? Oh, no that's not evil, so, so I don't think it counts. Oh, wait a minute. Did I set off the -inator alert? Oh, that is so funny. Probably scared the heck out of Commander Carl, huh? Oh, well I-I know it can look intimidating, but there's no reason to be afraid. It isn't evil. It isn't even the -inator. The -inator is this gold chain. Once it's charged, I'm going to put it around my neck, and it will activate the insecurity parts of my brain and trigger a full-blown mid-life crisis. Allow me to explain in song.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Kazoo solo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So just let me get this thing charged up and we'll be on our way. (Doof puts on some shades and covers Perry's eyes and pushes the button and gets the chain.) Ready? (He puts the chain around his neck and gets electrocuted. Perry walks offscreen to get a defibrillator, but Doof comes to when Perry arrives.) Wow, I feel pretty energized! I wanna do something exciting and fun and...and also incredibly stupid! Come on, Perry the Platypus, let's go have an adventure.

Name: Holly
Dialog: Ginger, are you texting Baljeet again?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Yeah, we're at odds deciding what movie to see later. He wants to go to the one about that planet and I want to see the one with that guy.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Well, don't fight about it. Manipulate the situation!

Name: Holly
Dialog: Manip-the-wha-?

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (sighs) Okay, ladies, listen up. Pretend you don't care about your movie, but then hint that it's playing at the theatre next to the fro-yo place he likes. The seed is planted, and he'll think it's his idea to go there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, guys! Food's up! Aw, just think, this may be the last time I'm stuffing your faces before I'm off to school. (the phone rings) I got it, Mom! (to the girls) Anyway, enjoy! Gotta treat my Fireside Girl alums right. (she leaves)

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Hey hey! Baljeet says okay to my movie!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Mm-hmm. Works every time.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Where is Baljeet anyway?

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Oh, he's over at Phineas's.

Name: Holly and Katie
Dialog: Oh, Phineas...

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: It's too bad Isabella and Phineas never got together.

Name: Holly
Dialog: Yeah, I always thought they were meant for each other.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Look at her. Working so hard.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Do we have chopped liver? What do you think this place is? Chopped li— Oh, that doesn't really work.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: She doesn't have time to manipulate a situation where she and Phineas can get together.

Name: Milly
Dialog: But we do!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: (to Ginger) Hey, Speedy-Thumbs, text Lover Boy and tell those guys we have a plan to get Isabella and Phineas together!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ginger texting you again?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. The girls want to get Phineas and Isabella together.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wasn't that our idea?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, but now I've got to write her back in a passive way that makes her think it's really her idea. She is trying to manipulate the situation. (He takes another bite of his sandwich) It is how we love.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo hoo hoo hoo! How's the dye job holding up, Perry the Platypus?! Isn't this great?! If I had known it was this much fun— (Doofenshmirtz smashes into sailboat.) Hey, this is one of those fancy sailing yachts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We could sail around the world in this thing! We could, we could visit exotic ports, fight pirates! We'd be like a couple of seafaring Huck Finns and the ocean would be our ho–! (The boat sinks, and Doof's black hair dye evaporates. He gets back up.) Or maybe we could wrestle some alligators! No, wait, even better, sports car! (He swims to shore, with Perry following.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here, let me get that for you, Nana Shapiro.

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Phineas Flynn! Oh, look at you, so tall and handsome! You're going to college I hear! Oh, how time flies. Where're you going to school?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I haven't really decided.

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Isabella came over to say goodbye this morning. She's off to—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This morning? But her school doesn't start for two more weeks!

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Oh, honey, didn't you know? She's leaving today! As soon as she's done with work. Something about needing to—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Today‽ But—

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: Phineas, look at me. If you have anything you need to say to her, you'd better go over to the restaurant and say it. Her summer's almost over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (a pried pause) I— You're right. Thanks! (he runs off)

Name: Nana Shapiro
Dialog: The restaurant is that way! (She points in the diction opposite of where Phineas ran)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks again! (He runs off in the other direction)

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Isn't this fun? It's like when we were kids! Building stuff in Phineas and Ferb's backyard!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We'll build the perfect dinner date for Isabella and Phineas. Their favorite food, music.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: And when we get them to come back here and see it and each other, they're bound to fall madly in love like they were always meant to be!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You know, you can't force these things.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Oh, come on, we're girls! It's what we do!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: When they first walk in, we'll play the songs I put on this playlist. They're all about love, and it will trigger them to start thinking about love. Then we have these streamers and balloons in both of their favorite colors, which will stimulate the romantic centers of their brains making them think about love.

Name: Katie
Dialog: What if it doesn't?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, then, we have this sign. (He holds up a sign saying

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sure you don't have anything else that's more ridiculous or irresponsible?

Name: Salesman
Dialog: Nope. This is as dumb as they come.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right! (he speeds off) Woohoo! Yeehaw! (Perry gets a worried look, as the car crashes and Doof returns with only the steering wheel.) So, what else ya got?

Name: Salesman
Dialog: We've got another one just like it, but in yellow.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He gasps) Ya hear that?! It'll be like driving a really fast Ducky Momo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, yeah, it's the perfect romantic setting out there! It'll be like love kicked 'em both in the face!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, the table looks great, but there is one thing that would make it perfect!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No way! I'm not puttin' that stupid cupid costume on again!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But it worked so well for me and Mishti!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: (jealously) Hoo, Mishti, Mishti, Mishti!

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Let it go, Ging.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think the turbo kicks in when it revs abo— (Perry gets another worried look on his face) Whoa! (The car speeds through an intersection and crashes into a dumpster.) Oh, oh! Oh, it's okay, we're fine! But we do seem to have picked up a passenger! I'll shake it loose up here at the turn. (Doofenshmirtz and Perry turn, while the dumpster continues on.)

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Now drive safely, sweetheart. And call me when you get to school.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, Mom.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: I'm very proud of you! I will miss you so much!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'll miss you, too, Mom!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, I almost forgot! Your last paycheck!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I love you! (chuckles) I'll call! (She gets her wallet out and something drops out of it.) Whoops. (She picks it up to reveal a picture of Phineas.)

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Phineas, honey, how are you?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro. Uh, is Isabella here?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Oh, no, sweetie, she's gone.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gone, like driving-car-school-gone?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Yes, you just missed her. It's too bad you didn't get to see her off. You know, since you were kids, she's had a huge crush on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (he sighs) I wish I had known. (he leaves)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs) What might have been...

Name: Ginger
Dialog: It's good, but...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It's still missing something.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: Alright, let's get 'em over here now. (she takes out her cell phone) Oh, wait, I don't have any charge.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Oh, this is her old number.

Name: Ginger
Dialog: Wait, where's my phone?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: My phone's out in the car.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I just got the 21G and the software won't be ready for two months.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (he looks behind him) Um, guys?

Name: Katie
Dialog: Wow! Now it's exactly like it was when we were kids!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what would be really impulsive? If you and me went out and did a little evil, just the two of us. (Perry slaps him in the face.) Yeah. Yeah, you're right. Maybe I should just go hit on the cute jump instructor instead. (to the jump instructor) Hi there. Y-Y'know, one of the best things about being a successful scientist is that I get to meet lots of attractive women, such as yourself.

Name: Jump Instructor
Dialog: You want to know the best part about being a jump instructor?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaaaaaaahhh!!! Hey, Perry the Platypus! (Perry opens Doof's parachute for him and then opens his own parachute.) Okay, Perry the Platypus, that is it! (he takes off his gold chain) This mid-life crisis isn't nearly as much fun as I thought it was going to be. From now on, I'm sticking with my predictable boring old life (Doofenshmirtz drops the chain) with my predictable boring old friends. Uh, uh, that reminds me, did you reserve the lanes for Thursday night? (Perry nods)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Linda! I don't know what's come over me, but I'm starting to get the most wild and uninhibited ideas! You know how every day for the last twenty years I've relaxed with a nice cup of Earl Grey? Well, not today, Linda! Today, I'm putting out all the stops! Darjeeling!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You... are a madman.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (to Isabella) Whatcha doin'? Heh heh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is this step taken? (He sits down next to her)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I actually came by to...say goodbye to you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Off to school, huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah. I'm going two weeks early because I'm an R.A., and in soccer, debate camp, student government...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. I haven't seen you all summer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I've been busy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, Baljeet said something funny. He said you had a crush on me back in grade school.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh. Yeah. I had a big crush on you.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow...I had no idea.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really? I thought I was being so obvious!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Absolutely clueless. Sorry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I sort of gave up when we got to high school.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah... I think that's when I started to have a thing for you.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's unfortunate timing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep. You're off to college.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Tri-State State. Have you decided where you're going yet?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gets out his letters) You know what? I just did. (He gives her one of the envelopes.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh. Huh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, what's wro- Oh, shoot! (takes the letter from her) I'm sorry. Wrong letter. (He gives her the correct one.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I guess I'll see you in two weeks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes you will.

Name: Adyson
Dialog: It's about time!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughs) We have been trying to get you two together all day!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You guys are the best!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (dressed as cupid again) So what did I miss?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It was as if love had kicked them both in the face!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah? Called it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm going to miss you guys!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See ya.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: In two weeks.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Eh, I've waited this long.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: So, Tri-State State, huh? Good choice.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Ferbs, you ready? (Ferb gets in the passenger seat and hugs and kisses Vanessa.) Hi, Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Nessa! Where're you guys goin'?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, Ferb's takin' me out for Ukrainian food.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Can we drop you anywhere?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm... as a matter of fact...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas? (She gets out of the car) What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This. (He kisses her, and she kisses back)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I never knew she had a thing for him.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Seriously?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (chuckles) Naw, I'm just messin' with you! Everyone knew! (She drives away with Ferb, leaving Phineas and Isabella alone.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that was worth the wait.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes it was. (They kiss again.)

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: (sobbing) I can't believe it! It seems like only yesterday we were drawing our first doodles of these kids on the place mats of that...

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: (consoling Swampy) Yeah, I, I know, it's a... It's a sweet episode.

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: Now they're, they're growing up... and going to college...

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: But it's... It is really... It's just a cartoon.

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: Why?!

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: Um... Y'know, I gotta thing. I'm gonna... I'm just gonna... (He gets up out his chair and leaves Swampy alone.)

Name: Jeff "Swampy" Marsh
Dialog: They're growing up!

Name: Dan Povenmire
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, get a grip, Swampy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know what we mean!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, I understand

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I know what we're gonna do today! I know what we're gonna do today! I know what we're—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls, gets out of bed, and shouts out the window) And I know what I'm gonna do today! Bust you guys once and for all! Do your worst or your best. Just make it big and bustable, so I can show Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow! That was awfully supportive. And you said Candace wasn't a morning person. (to Ferb)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking towards her bedroom door) This is it, Candace – the last day of summer vacation! Your last chance to bust the (steps on a rollerskate) boooo- (steps on a skateboard and rolls down the stairs) -ooooooo – ugh! (falls off the skateboard and lands in a wagon, starts rolling around the house) Uh! Why do we have this many (pauses as she rolls behind a wall) wheeled objects lying around the house?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (reading the newspaper at the kitchen table) Oooh! Looks like the zoo's got a new tiger habitat. (Lawrence playfully roars at Linda and Candace rolls into the kitchen.) Good morning, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (unenthusiastically) Uh-huh. (pauses) And so begins the last day of summer. (wagon is stopped by Perry's dish)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (getting up with her purse) Which means back to school errands for me and making the most of the day for you. (looking at her watch) Ooh! I better get a move on. Those errands aren't gonna run themselves. (chuckles) They never do! (unenthusiastically) They never do. (leaves)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, today's a big day, so it's a good thing we're getting an early start!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't wanna waste one minute of our last day of summer!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yipeeeeee! Last day of summer means first day of schooool! Ha-ha ha! (realizes the disproving looks on everyone else) I mean boooooo...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Seems like only yesterday I walked through that side gate and asked "Whatcha doin?" when you were building that rollercoaster for the first time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Since it's our last day of summer, we're thinking a grand finale is in order. Show 'em the blueprints, Ferb.

Name: Baljeet and Isabella
Dialog: Oooooh!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, could use a little somethin' more. (more blueprint rolls out above the first one) Dere it is, but where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good, Agent P, you're here! You're probably wondering about all these pulley things here. (eyes directing to tassel-like pulleys on his left and right) It's just that, with Carl heading to school soon, I'm (pauses) gonna have to learn to run this place all by myself. (grips the pulleys) Anyway, (pulls his left one to make a crudely drawn picture of fall leaves roll down in front of him on the screen) with the seasons about to change, I suspect Doofenshmirtz (a crudely drawn picture of Doofenshmirtz rolls down) will be trying to close out the summer (a crudely drawn picture of a "bang" rolls down) with a bang. (all the pictures, with his right pulley, fall to the floor) Great googly moogly! Carl! (his left pulley, still being gripped by Monogram, comes detached and dangles from his left hand.) Oh, that's right

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Okay, I've had enough of you! (to the light)

Name: Norm
Dialog: (walking towards Doofenshmirtz's bed with a slice of chocolate cake) Wakey wakey, chocolate cakey! (takes a fork of it and points it at Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (annoyed) How many times do I have to tell you that chocolate cake isn't for break— (Norm stuffs the bite in his mouth, Doofenshmirtz chews and swallows) I stand corrected. All right, up an' at 'em.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Sir, since when do you sleep in your lab coat?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Since none o' your business!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, (Doofenshmirtz stops and turns around) Dad, you have a minute?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can it wait, sweetie? I've got a lot of stuff on my evil to-do list to do today. To do today. To-do to-day,

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (angrily) Dad!!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (rolling her eyes) Ugh! (walks away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (referencing something that's offscreen) Great job, gang! Whadaya think?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sooo, what is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's everything!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who says you can't have it all?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yippee! For this and not for school. (walks away from the others and whispers) I love you school! (walks back)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (looks at Baljeet disapprovingly) Do other nerds erect statues to you?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (looks at Buford embarrassingly) Maybe.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (referencing the invention) Looks pretty mega to me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (walking over to Phineas and Ferb) Yeah, it's pretty mega, but is it really grand finale material worthy (hugs Phineas and Ferb) of these two guys? (pausing and realizing what he did) I just made it weird, didn't I?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, not at all!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hugs are a healthy expression of affection between friends.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (letting go of them and looking at Ferb) Okay, now you just made it weird.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Anyway, we've gotta make sure we've outdone ourselves on this one.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And there's only one way to do it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're right, Buford. Let's ride it! (everyone but Buford starts running towards the invention)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Actually I was gonna say focus group testing, (starts running to catch up to the others) but "ride it" works too.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking outside) Aha! The boys did it again! Big, dangerous, bustable

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Say "Hi" for us!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I know, I know. I'm on my way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the cell phone) I'll meet you up front! (hangs up, then calls again) Hehehehehehehe.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, whadya say, guys? Best ride ever?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (looking at papers in his hands) Well, empirically speaking, the test results show almost unanimous approval ratings!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (coming down beside Baljeet) I have notes.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Like I said

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (smiling) Well, you heard him, Ferb. Back to the drawing board!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (staring at their invention, now a drawing board) Wow, that was impressive, and quite literal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tada!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (waving to them while standing next to Ferb, who's drawing on the drawing board) Hi, Mom! Hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but but!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (taking Candace to the side) Look Candace, most days I would humor you, but not today. I'm way too busy. Don't you have stuff of your own to do before school starts?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, bust the boys!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: De-de ge-de de-de-de-de daaahhhh... (sulkily) I guess I can return Vanessa's DVDs.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walking away) There ya go, Hon. They're not gonna return themselves.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They never do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (approaching the drum set while looking at Perry) Ah, Perry the Platypus

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (walking past them) Please, so over it. (she opens the door to let Candace in, smiling)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (waving while holding DVDs) Hey, Vanessa! Just came by here to return (realizing it's Candace, Perry lets Doofenshmirtz out of a headlock and hides) your DVDs. Sorry I had them so long, can't say I understand French cinema. I mean, why does that mime keep letting go of balloons?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I think it's (Perry finds a hiding spot) symbolic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (handing Vanessa the DVDs) Well, anyway, how's it goin'?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (starts feeling uninterested and stops smiling) I've been better.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still smiling and gesturing) Me too! You wouldn't believe (stops smiling, but still has her eyes wide open) the day I'm having so far! I mean really. Like I could go on. Like I could tell you all about it. I mean there's a lot that happened and there's—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yooou wanna (starts smiling again) come in?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (starts smiling again and comes in while Vanessa closes the door behind her) Oh wow, ya, that'd be great!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I could use some downloading too. I'll go make us some tea. (starts walking away) B-R-B.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Awesome! (starts walking towards Doofenshmirtz, who is now standing and is brushing himself off) Oh, hi, Vanessa's dad! How's it goin'?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (turning around to talk to her) Have you seen my nemesis? He was just here a second ago. He's about (holds his hand at an approximate height of Perry) yay high and—ha. You know what? No matter. When the guy who's punching you suddenly loses interest mid-punch, it's time to take serious stock of your life. (turns around) H-ugh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can totally relate! (Doofenshmirtz starts walking away) Like from the beginning of today it was pretty bad. Like I'm all off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (trying to find Perry) Uh-huh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you know every day this summer I've been trying to bust my brothers, and it's just not happening.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-huh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do you know how frustrating it is to have a single unrealized focus in your life?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well that's just crazy. Gotta be some kind of teenage thing. (starts walking back over to her after giving up on finding Perry)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Same old, same ol' yadda yadda ya bledolbledolbledolbledolbledolbledol. That's been my day so far. (starts lowering herself onto an Inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (runs to her and frantically waving Candace off the machine) Don't sit on that, a-and stop fussing with all of my Inators!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Inators? Why? What does this (points at the machine she almost sat on) one do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, that is my Do-Over-Inator.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's a Do-Over-Inator?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? It says "do over" right in the name. I-it does the day over again, but I haven't worked out all the kinks yet. Matter of fact, I gotta work out the kinks in a lot o' these.

Name: Candace
