Dialog: (looking at the machine) A Do-Over-inator? (presses the purple button second farthest to the left, causing the Inator to make loud mechanical noises and surround her and Doofenshmirtz with a large, glowing blue-purple bubble, then emit a blue flash)

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I know what we're gonna do today! I know what we're—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls, gets out of bed, and shouts out the window) And I know what I'm gonna do today! Bust you guys once and for all! Do your worst or your— you know, just make it (starts feeling the familiarity of the conversation) big and... bustable, so I can show... Mom.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (outside offscreen) Wow! That was awfully supportive.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks away from the window) Talk about déjà v— (runs back to the window to talk to Phineas) You there, boy! What day is it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why, the last day of summer, of course!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (enthusiastically) Aaah! Yes! Vanessa's dad's machine! It worked! Which means that yesterday is today! Another chance(steps on a rollerskate) to bust the boooo- (steps on a skateboard and rolls down the stairs) -ooys! I didn't think there would be this part!– ugh! (falls off the skateboard and loses the skate, lands in a wagon, and starts rolling around the house) Har... (pauses as she rolls behind a wall) dee har har.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (reading the newspaper at the kitchen table) Oooh! Looks like the zoo's got a new tiger habitat. (Lawrence playfully roars at Linda and Candace rolls into the kitchen.) Good morning, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiling) Mm-hmm! (pauses) And so begins the last day of summer! (wagon is stopped by Perry's dish and she pauses, then points at Perry) Again!

Name: Linda and Candace
Dialog: (Linda getting up with her purse) Which means back to school errands for me and making the most of the day for you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (angrily) Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (happily getting up out of the wagon and approaching Linda) Hey! This is amazing! (approaching and holding onto a chair) Today is exactly the same as yesterday! It's repeating! (leans her elbows on the chair back)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Very existential, darling. You're getting philosophical as you get older.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking away and pointing at Lawrence) And BUSTosophical!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (looking at Candace with lowered eyelids and speaking in a sing-song voice) That's not even a wo-ord!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming back) It is now! (walks around Linda and speaks in a sing-song voice) I made it u-up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Taah... Didn't I disintegrate you? (to the light)

Name: Norm
Dialog: (walking towards Doofenshmirtz's bed with a slice of chocolate cake) Wakey wakey, chocolate cakey! (takes a fork of it and points it at Doofenshmirtz)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (annoyed) Really? Didn't I tell you cake isn't for breakfast (knocks the cake out of Norm's hands and up and over the bed) yesterday? (realizes something) Hmm. (gets out of bed and runs out of his bedroom and Vanessa approaches him)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey Dad? (Doofenshmirtz turns around to see her)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (thinking) Hmm, repeating.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You have a minute?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: M-hmm.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: We really

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: M-hmm.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: need to

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: M-hmm. (Vanessa growls and starts frowning) Yeah!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah! Everything is repeating! Th-that bang on my head, that-that thing with Norm and the stupid cake, a-and you! (starts walking to his Do-Over-Inator) I-it works! My Do-Over-Inator must work! Ah-your little friend must have (Vanessa catches up to him) activated it yesterday! A-and by "yesterday" I mean "today". Later today, your-uh little friend will activa– and the days will probably keep repeating until I shut it off!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (angrily) This is what I'm talking about. You're not even listening! (starts walking towards the door, without Doofenshmirtz noticing) I'm moving out, Dad. I'm going to live at Mom's... (walks out the door) full time. (slams the door)

Name: Norm
Dialog: (walking up to the door, still smiling) Door slams mean sadness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (running over to Norm) Wait! What did she say?

Name: Norm's speaker
Dialog: (Vanessa's voice) I'm going to live at Mom's... full time. (door slamming noise)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaah! I can't believe it! (inhales sharply) You surreptitiously record us? And even more importantly, I'm losing my little girl!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why would Vanessa want to move out?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Let's see if we can solve that little mystery! (presses his top button)

Name: Norm's speaker
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz's voice) Hey, Vanessa, hand me that cadaver.

Name: Norm
Dialog: or (presses his button again)

Name: Norm's speaker
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz's voice) Honeybun, if you go into the living room and see a pile of skin flakes, just ignore it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay.

Name: Norm
Dialog: or (presses his button again)

Name: Norm's speaker
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz's voice) I know you said the time machine in the bathroom was a bad idea, but if you need to go, you should do it last week.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay! Okay! I get it. I get it. My daughter's moving out because she thinks I'm a loser.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I like pancakes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Buuuut, ya know who isn't a loser? The Tri-Governor! I just need to win that office and Vanessa will want to (starts walking towards his Do-Over-Inator) stay with me! And this (pets the Inator) little baby's gonna help me get it right.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There it is, but where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good. Perfect! You guys built your sky-high mega-ride thingy. I just wanted to double-check, and this time, I'm not gonna call Mom. I'm gonna (starts walking backwards away from them) go get her. Ciao!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (holding his hand up) Bye, Candace! (turns back towards his friends) Sky-high, huh? I think you're right, Buford. We can make this better, and Candace has just given me a great idea how to do it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looking at his watch) Perry the Platypus should be coming in about three, two, one. (Perry comes in on his rocket chair and lands in the bass drum, then the bass drum is put in the drum set) Ha-ha! And, (Perry rolls towards Doofenshmirtz  in the drum and he hops out of the way) drum roll! (Perry rolls past him) Missed me! (Perry hits the staircase, flips over, then pops out of one of the drum's head and hoops.) And, skull! (a giant skull falls over Perry and traps him, then Doofenshmirtz walks over to him) It worked! It worked, and finally I get some use out of these old Halloween decorations. I'm the master of ti- (Perry opens the skull's mouth and clamps it down on Doofenshmirtz's body) ow! Oh, this really bites. (Perry breaks out of the top of the skull) Oh no, wait! Not my Inator! (Perry pushes the "X DESTRUCT" button on the Tri-Governor-inator and it blows up) That's okay, Perry the Platypus. I'll be the master of time tomorrow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tada! (realizing their backyard is empty) Huh? But-but, but?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (taking Candace off to the side) Look, Candace. Most days, I would humor you, but not today. I'm way too busy—

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, you're way too busy getting us ready for school, so I'll just take care of the stuff I have to do before tomorrow.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walking away) Couldn't have said it better myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no one can say I didn't try, twice. (walks to the house)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, it's a shame Candace missed out on the fun. She did give us the cool idea to levitate it, after all.

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I know what we're gonna do today! I know what we're—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (quickly and happily sitting up) No way! (sticks her head out the window and yells to Phineas) You there, boy! What day is it?... again.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why, the last day of summer, of course!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams happily and ducks her head back into the house) Yes! The days are repeating! Which means, I still have a chance to— (notices her skates on the floor and starts talking to it) Oh, no. I'm not falling for that one again. (walks to the side) Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me, but fool me three times and (steps on a third skate) whooooa! Why do I even have (steps on the skateboard) three skates? (falls off the skateboard)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (reading a newspaper at the kitchen table) Oooh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rolling past the table in the wagon and speaking unenthusiastically) There's tigers at the zoo. Roar.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (reading a newspaper next to Lawrence) And so we begin another day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (getting Linda out of her chair) Yes,-and-you've-got-errands-to-run-'cause-they're-not-gonna-run-themselves.-They-never-do.-They-never-do.(starts pushing Linda out of the house) Better-get-a-move-on-if-you're-gonna-be-back-in-an-hour-and-twenty-seven-minutes.-Bye!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sitting up, stopping before he hits the lamp) Ah! (moves around the lamp and points at it) Ah! Ha-a! (gets out of bed) Ha-ha!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (standing at the foot of the bed) Wakey, wakey—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (passing him and leaving the bedroom) Stuff it, Norm!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (approaching Doofenshmirtz outside his room) Dad, (Doofenshmirtz turns around) do you have a minute? It's really—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holding a clipboard with drawings of Perry the Platypus and traps and with an "I can handle anything" look on his face) Hush (holds his hand up and puts both hands on her shoulders) I know.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holding a finger over Vanessa's mouth) Sh, sh, sh. (lowers finger and smiles) I know exactly what you're going to say and I'm on it, but right now, I need to (looks at the clip board and points at it with a pencil) study Perry the Platypus's every move.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (angrily) Dad, this is the problem! (Doofenshmirtz writes on the clipboard) Because of your stupid work—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold that thought, sweetie. I've really gotta go and improve Perry the Platypus's trap. (starts walking away) B-R-B! (stretches back) That's uh, that's "be right back". It's hip today to talk in acronyms. (walks away again)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (rolling up to Perry while in a hamster ball) Ah-hu, hah! I can see by the confused and somewhat annoyed look on your face that your little mammal brain is working overtime trying to figure out how I anticipated your every move, not to mention the purpose of this... hamster ball. Well, it's simple! You see, this protects me from when you eventually escape from that! (notices Perry has escaped) Like, like that, but you can't punch, kick, or otherwise bruise me, because I'm safe inside of (Perry punches the ball and Doofenshmirtz starts rolling around the room) thii-oooo

Name: Norm
Dialog: (with a pan of muffins)It's muffin time, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (rolling past him) Later! (A blue portal opens and the muffins get sucked into it) Oh, whooa... (bounces off the balcony) Maybe I'll get lucky and time will loop before (crashing noise) Oh! No sudden—

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I know what we're gonna do toda—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smirking) Alarm,

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: kids in the backyard, (quickly sitting up) I'm back, baby! (slides down the banister) Yihoo! (lands on the floor and runs past the kitchen table) Tigers at the zoo! Roar-r-roar-roar-roar! Mom, gotta go

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (looking back at his newspaper) Well, she's having a good day.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There it is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is great. This time I'm gonna bust you outta this world!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. Candace has just given me a great idea on how to make this thing even better!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking towards them) Now it's all sci-fi?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You inspired it, Candace. It's out of this world!

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I kno—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (noticing the kids in the backyard with no invention) But, but, but.

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (noticing the empty backyard) But, but, but.

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: (Phineas' voice, while beeping) I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pouring oil on the floor) Okay, twenty-third time's the charm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I totally got it all covered now. (walks over to Norm) Hand me that box of angry weasels, would ya, Norm? (Norm hands it to him and Doofenshmirtz opens it, then the weasels attack him) Ow! Ow! Ow! O-ow! (closes the weasels back in their box, and reveals his face, covered with injuries) Yes, they'll do. It's the latest Perry the Platypus trap.

Name: Norm
Dialog: De-lightful!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (here Perry's bass drum roll) And here he is. Norm, hand out the victory muffins.

Name: Norm
Dialog: What is a muffin?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on. You know. Like

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Drury Lane. Why would anyone buy a house on Drury Lane? It just sounds so, it sounds dreary, even though it's not actually "Dreary", it's "Drury".

Name: Norm
Dialog: Though entertaining, your muffin song did not stir my memory banks, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm, that's peculiar. I suppose it could be some type of anomaly caused by messing with the space time continuum. Might even be dangerous. Oh well, I'll have to... ignore that in my payroll, because (shows Perry still fighting through the series of traps) now that I've gotten a full thirty steps ahead of Perry the Platypus, I'm free to take over the Tri-State Ar— Vanessa, where are you going? (walks over to Vanessa) Don't you wanna talk?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Actually, I really do, but you seem busy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (putting an arm around her) Oh, Honey, that's (smiles and points at her) very perceptive of you! (a slapping noise is heard and Doofenshmirtz turns his head) Yes! (turns back toward Vanessa) So, let's just put a pin in this. I'm kind of racing against the clock here. I know it seems like I'm putting you second, but it's only so I can put you first eventually!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whatever, Dad. (walks away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vaness— ugh. Well, you'll see. This is going to be my moment to take over the Tri-State Area and then that will prove to you I'm not as big a loser as you think I am. (walks towards his Tri-Governor-inator on the balcony) Okay, no pressure. Tri-State governor's mansion, here I come! (pulls a lever on the Inator that activates it and makes it shoot out a purple beam that creates a mansion on top of City Hall) Sa-weet! Now I've just gotta get someone to vote for me— anyone, actually, 'cause I'm running unopposed. (comes out of his building in cardboard that says "VOTE FOR DOOF", and a voting booth that says "DOOF", "VOTE HERE", "VOTE EARLY", and "VOTE OFTEN") Voting today!

Name: Man
Dialog: I didn't know there were elections today.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pushing him in the booth) Oh, get in the booth and do your civic duty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am so gonna get it right today! (runs past the kitchen table) I can feel it in my— (notices Lawrence and Linda eating cereal by dumping it into their mouth or eating it with their hands and comes back to the table) Um, ever hear of a spoon?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Spoon? Mm, no, can't say I have.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha-ha, ha! Hey! I hear there's a new tiger habitat, dahling.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Tiger? (stifles a laugh) That's a funny sounding word.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (standing up) Oh, these teenagers and their slang. (walking towards the open garage door and Candace notices something about her) I'd better go run my errands. They're not gonna run themselves. (turns around and grabs her purse, revealing she's wearing cargo shorts)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? What happened to your Capri pants?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Capri pants? Now I think you're just messing with us.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha... No spoons? No tigers? No Capris? Uh-oh, something's really going wrong!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa? Vanessa! (runs to her) I need to talk to you about your, you know, wanting to move out.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wait, you know about that? How—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grasping her by the shoulders) Honeey, just watch! (turns on the television to DANVILLE 7, where Roger is speaking live from in front of City Hall)

Name: Roger
Dialog: (on the screen) Apparently, for the first time in Tri-State history, a Tri-Governor has been elected, and the voters have chosen, (looks down at his paper in shock) my brother, Heinz Doofenshmirtz?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! See, Vanessa? I'm not a loser anymore. Now you'll want to live with me at the Tri-Governor's mansion, right? Right?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad! It's not that—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, wait, wait, ho-hold that thought, sweetie-peeps. A-as long as my Do-Over-Inator is on, this day could start all over again. I could lose it all. So, so, you know. (holds her hands) Go 'head and start packing your stuff. I'm just gonna run over and turn off my Inator. We're, we're movin' on up, Kiddo! (runs over to his Inator just as it is getting sucked into another blue portal as he grabs at it) Hey! Well, uh, I didn't see that coming, but it's gone, so I guess that's the end of the looping! And now, (flips to Doofenshmirtz on the balcony of the Tri-Governor's mansion with his left arm around an unimpressed and slightly annoyed Vanessa) everything's gonna be hunky-dory, 'cause I'm in charge, baby!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Guys! Guys! I really need your help! There's this really weird thing that's happening! Days keep repeating because of a machine thingy that Vanessa's dad made, and there was this wagon, and now things are disappearing, like tigers, and spoons, and—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's a... "spoon"?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: What's a "tiger"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? That's my point! Stuff's disappearing! and once it goes, nobody remembers it— (Phineas and Ferb get sucked up into another portal) e-ever existed... (inhales sharply) Moooooo- (runs inside to Linda, who is vacuuming the living room) -om! It took them! (hangs on Linda) Like the spoons! (inhales) Mom, Phineas and Ferb are gone!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm sure it's going to be all right, dear, but, who are "Phineas" and "Ferb"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How can you not know who Phineas and Ferb are?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lemme guess. They're your new favorite boy band?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Mom. Y'see, later on today, which is kinda like last month to me, Vanessa's dad invents this thing which he says doesn't work but it actually does, because, well, here I am.  But it also doesn't work because they're not here, so even though every day repeats, not everyone or everything repeats, because you don't even know what Capri pants are!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: "Capri Pants"? Is that a boy band?

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're— (slaps herself) Gah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Check out your First Daughter suite! Not too keen to move out now, are ya?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah. Very, very nice, Dad. But, listen, I have something I—

Name: Melanie
Dialog: Pardon me, sir, I hate to interrupt, but your schedule is jam packed today. (She takes Doof's hand and leads him out.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry, sweetie, but apparently, there's a lot of stuff I have to attend to. Look on the bright side, you can brag about your dad to your friends until I get back.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is so weird. It's Danville...but it's not. Oh my gosh, Ferb! Spoons! Now I totally remember how we forgot about them when they disappeared! Which means we must have disappeared.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Orange you glad we have somethin' to eat? (no response) You're right. You're right. We gotta figure out a way outta here. (A tiger roars offscreen.) Hope whatever that is likes oranges.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Or at least orange-related puns.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) But I'm tellin' ya, the sun's rays'll make ya crazy.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm not gonna buy your hat, Buford.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great! You're all together! Look, I need you guys to help me find my brothers!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And you are?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: She's my neighbor from across the street. But I thought you were an only child.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, I have two little brothers and all of you are best friends! But then Vanessa's dad built this machine, and now the days are repeating and things like spoons and little boys like my brothers are starting to disappear. And the worst thing is nobody remembers them!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You should stay out of the sun!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Doofy-boy, time to govern-inate! (Perry enters the room on his jetpack.) Right on time, Perry the Platypus! (reading a piece of paper) This concerns you. I have just made it illegal to thwart the Tri-Governor of the Tri-State Area, which, ipso facto, is me. (Gives Perry the paper.) Go ahead, read it. It's all perfectly legal. Looks like your thwarting days are over, Perry the Platypus. (sighs) Y'know, I-I-I really miss our good old thwarting days already. I-In fact, your presence here is making me far too sad and nostalgic. So maybe you better go. (Perry leaves dragging his jetpack across the rug.) Just leave the way you came in. I'll bill ya for the carpet.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters sadly)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, don't give me the puppy dog eyes. You're gonna make me cry. Sheesh. (Perry jumps out the window.)

Name: Melanie
Dialog: (on speaker) Pardon me, Mr. Tri-Governor, the Mayor's on the line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Put 'im through. Helloooooooooo, Roger!

Name: Roger
Dialog: (on speaker) Heinz, did you steal my secretary?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes. Yes I did.

Name: Roger
Dialog: (on speaker) What makes you think you can do a thing like that?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it's easy! (opens the floor revealing Roger at his desk looking up) Because I'm the boss of you! Nyah! (Closes the floor.) Ahh, this has already been a very productive day. (Melanie walks in with a huge stack of papers.) H-Hey, what's all this?

Name: Melanie
Dialog: More legislation that requires your signature, sir. (she leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I hate homework! I'd rather just play with this snowglobe. (Another anomaly appears and sucks the snowglobe out of his hand.) Oooh, oh! Oh, man, this is serious! I thought for sure my machine would've turned itself off when it disappeared, but it's still creating rifts in the space-time continuum! (pushes intercom) Melanie, bring me another snowglobe.

Name: Melanie
Dialog: (on speaker) Um, what's a snowglobe?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps dramatically)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, this stuff is pretty random. I hope no one at home is planning to baste a turkey while wearing suspenders and Capri pants. (no response) You're right. Mr. Keene is having a very bad day!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And so are we!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Run, Ferb! It's raining snowglobes! A-And the tigers, they are also a reason to run!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I really do have two brothers and you guys are really best friends. I can't believe you don't remember!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's impossible! Right, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh? Oh, sorry. I am too preoccupied with today's wild fluctuations in the space-time continuum. With pressure readings like this, I could potentially get sucked into a rift. And then none of you would remember I ever existed!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Huh? Huh? Huh? Huh? Huh? Huh? Huh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Sorry, Agent P, I've received confirmation that Doof's anti-thwarting legislation is completely legal and official. So I guess we're the bad guys now. And I guess this means you're on hiatus at least until his term is over. Monogram out.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters and sighs)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (on another windowsill) Perry? What are you doing here? (Perry joins her) Problems with my dad, too? Welcome to the club. (sighs) I've been trying all day to tell him that I've been accepted by OWCA's internship program, but that I can't join if I'm living with OWCA's public enemy number one. (Perry holds up three fingers.) Okay. Number three. Well, I'm just gonna have to tell him and try to convince him to see things my way. Thanks for the chat, Perry. Wish me luck! (She goes inside and Perry waves at her.)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: ...and at the destabilization point, the vortex collapses in on itself, and it becomes an actual "hole" in space-time, sucking the nearest person or object into it and they are lost in the void.

Name: Buford
Dialog: OH, PLEASE STOP TALKING!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, tigers aren't much more than big house cats, right? So what have we got that will distract cats?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't have a ball of yarn, but we do have a big bouncy ball of Capri pants!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That'll hold 'em for a while. Come on, Ferb! We gotta figure out a way back home.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sweetie pie, I'm back! Sorry it took me so long. Who would've thought being Tri-Governor would be so involved?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I got an internship at OWCA, so I have to move out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?! But that's the opposite of what I— They're the good guys! I thought for sure now that when I was Tri-State Governor that we'd be okay!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, you're totally missing the point. You spend all of your time working on your ridiculous inators and I can't—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, first of all, they're not ridiculous. Convoluted and ultimately pointless, maybe.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, come on, Dad, you build them just to exact petty revenge trying to prove you're evil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? I'm evil. I-I am evil!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, Dad. You're basically a nice guy who's pretending to be evil. And, you know, it seems like it's all out of obligation to your backstories, not something that truly comes from your heart.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. So, it, it's... It's really not about all the success-loser thing?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, look, this OWCA internship is something I really wanna do. And I don't think this lifestyle choice is making you happy either. Is it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow again.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Look, all I'm saying is try something different.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Like a...Like a new inator?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, like try to be a good guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A good guy? Me? I can be... Well, I guess I could. I-I could be a do-gooder, doing good, just for the sake of... doing good, or, er, what exactly do good guys do?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, they—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, it doesn't matter. Anyway, I get it. I understand now.  There's just one thing I gotta do before the whole thing starts over ag—

Name: Candace's alarm
Dialog: —know what we're gonna—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah. (gets up) Oh, man! I gotta start all over again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, man! I looped too soon, and I didn't have time to be good! (He disintegrates his lamp again.)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Wakey wakey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, stuff your cake!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Stuffing it, sir! (He puts the cake on his face.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad, do you have a minute?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! Yes, yes, I know, you, you'd like to move in with your mother and you want to intern at OWCA and my being evil creates a conflict.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Um, yeah. How did you know—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's just leave it at I know and I vow to be good from now on so your worries are over.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, you're kind of freaking me out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes, I'd be obnoxious if I wasn't so charming. Anyway, I have one more inator to complete and I've got to do it fast, so I could really use your help.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What's the inator?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Time-Straighten-Out-inator! It straightens out time and keeps it from looping.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I think I'm looping.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am coming!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Morning, Baljeet. Got to get an early start today. You kids chat, I'll get the thingy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Um, who is that girl in the bathrobe?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I was so asleep.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: She made us come over here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes, but who is she?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Got it! (to Baljeet) Here, Dr. Genius Boy! Take this and check out the space-time continuum.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (takes the device) I do not know what that will prove. The space-time continuum is remarkably stable, and—Oh, my goodness!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Blah blah blah blah blah, you could disappear forever and so could every memory of your existence. So here's the part you need to pay attention to! Are you listening?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am totally listening!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am so not listenin'.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Me neither.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have two brothers and you guys are all best friends. But now they're gone and nobody remembers them because of the space-time continuum thingy. Now, this is the part of the conversation where you tell me how you're gonna get my brothers back.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, they must have disappeared through a temporal rift. If we could calculate the location of the next rift, we could just throw in a rope with a life preserver tied to the end of it and pull it out.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really? A little donut-shaped pool toy is gonna save the universe?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (eating a donut) Ya had me at "donuts", lost me with everything else.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So what you're saying is the days are repeating and you're the only one that notices.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, maybe that little friend of yours, too, 'cause she was inside the bubble.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not important. Check it out. Perry the Platypus should be coming in three, two, one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! (Perry unbuckles himself) That's right, take it in, Perry the Platypus. No traps. And, no, telling you that there are no traps is not part of a trap. Though that would have been genius. Oh, I missed that one. I'm actually not doing any evil today! Seriously. I promise. (Perry looks at him with his arms crossed.) So, whadaya say, how 'bout lending an old nemesis a hand, huh, Perry the Platypus? (Perry just looks at Doof and holds out his arms.) Your eyes say, "No!" but your hands say, "Yes!"

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Isabella, what is the resonance reading on the top meter?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Forty-two point one six!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Candace, what is the cosine of eighty-one point seven?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (using a calculator) Lessee. Seventeen.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, did the light just change from green to red?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Why should I tell you?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay. (Baljeet makes some calculations.) Right... (pointing on a map) There! In fifteen seconds, that is the point of maximum disturbance! So it should be appearing right over...there! (A groundhog gets sucked into the rift.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow. Crazy how it sucked up that groundhog, huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: The what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If things from Danville pass into this dimension when a rift opens, maybe the door swings both ways. If we can calculate the rift openings, then we can get back to our Danville. Heads up, Ferb! Incoming!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. Groundhogs.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: I hope that doesn't mean six more weeks of "Nullville".

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ahhhhh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Talk to me, Baljeet!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: By my new calculations, the next rift should appear right over...there!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Quick! Throw the life preserver!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! Ferb! If you can hear me, grab the life preserver and we'll pull you back!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's a "life preserver"?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I have no idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are just gonna have to trust me on this!

Name: All
Dialog: Whoooooooa!!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who'd have though we'd be such a good team? My daughter, my nemesis, and my hot beverage. (Takes a sip.) Hmm. Counter-clockwise on that jib bolt, Perry the Platypus. Okay, stop. Perfect, it's done. The days won't loop anymore and I'll have my daughter back! My life will be on a new path and the world will be saved thanks to brand new good guy, Heinz Doofen—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, shmirtz! I was so close! (He tears the lamp from the ceiling.)

Name: Norm
Dialog: Wakey wakey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (throws the lamp at Norm and it lands on Norm's head) Eat it yourself, Norm, I gotta get Vanessa, we gotta do everything faster!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, guys! So good to see you!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (lovelorn) Phineas! (normally) Hey, Phineas.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (gasps) Spoon!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, how I have missed spoons!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Orange! (dramatic music; suddenly winds down) Eh...not really gettin' a big rush of emotions over this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And here are the Capri pants.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How can you tell they're Capri pants? Maybe they're just regular pants for someone with shorter legs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throws the pants away) The important thing is—

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: —my brothers are here and they're safe! (She runs up to them and hugs them.) I'm so glad you guys are all right!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, Candace! It's great to see you, too!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, I guess now that we're gone, too, Mom and Dad don't even remember having children. Their lives must be so empty.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Everything here is so gray and lifeless.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This place must exist outside the flow of time. Candace, you were the only one of us outside the loop. Were the looping intervals decreasing in chronological amplitude?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, they were, um... Wait, what does that mean exactly?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Were the days getting shorter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, the days kept getting shorter and shorter.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (shudders) The time pocket is dissolving!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And where does that rate on the... "good-bad" scale?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford, when the time pocket ceases to exist, so will we!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: See what I mean? One woman's Capri pants is another's... What'd I miss?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I have to talk to you—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Help me build my inator! Hurry! Quick!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What're we doing?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Building a Time-Straighten-Out-inator.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) Dad, we really need to talk!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There you are! Perry the Platypus, grab a screwdriver and help us!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Okay, this paper towel represents the space-time continuum. Normally, it moves in a straight line, (he puts the paper towel on a hook) but something has disrupted the flow. Now time cannot move forward and it puts enormous strain on the fabric of time (tears the paper towel) and tears the fabric! So now there is a little less space-time fabric to work with. The days are getting shorter. Now, you take this shortened piece of space-time (puts the paper towel on the hook and tears it again) and loop it again. Do this enough times (crumples the paper towel and puts it in his pocket) and pretty soon you do not have anything left. What I cannot seem to figure out is what could have possibly caused the space-time disruption in the first place? And an even bigger conundrum is how Candace is standing outside of the space-time interruption and somehow knew about its effects.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (nervous chuckle as she pulls on her shirt collar) Yeah, that's a puzzler. But you know that old saying

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Really?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I've heard that.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, we have to build something to close the hole and stop the looping.  But it will require einsteinium, tungsten wire, and micro-crystal plasma resistors.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, stuff keeps getting sucked into this place. Maybe we can find a hi-tech machine or some lab equipment that uses all of that stuff.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What about this machine right here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow. Strange that we didn't notice that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Einsteinium, tungsten wire, plasma resistors! Wow, this is awesome!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't touch that thing! (running to the inator) That's the machine that started all of...this...So...um...yeah...you gotta be careful with that thing.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And you know this how?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) When I was at Vanessa's, I may have accidentally intentionally pushed the button.

Name: All but Ferb
Dialog: (gasp)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I was having a rotten day. One crummy thing after another kept happening and when he told me that this thing can make the day start over again, I just couldn't help myself. And then the days just kept looping and I know I should've said something sooner, but I kept coming closer to busting you guys! And I swear I had no idea it would do any of this. I thought I'd get one do-over and that would be that, but then I saw it was creating problems and making things disappear and making people forget, but by the time I tried to stop it, it was too late, and I lost you guys! And I don't know how to fix it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, if this thing's the problem, maybe we should press this big self-destruct button.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: NOOOOO! If time stops looping, there will be no big tears in the fabric of space-time and no way for us to get home. We must find a way to get ourselves and that machine through one of the rifts and back into Danville. Then we can push the button and blow up the machine.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I call pressing the button!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, gang! We know what we have to do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah. RUUUUUUUNN!!! (The gang runs away.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it's not pretty, but we did it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I dub thee "The Buford van Stomm Time Catapult". I won the naming rights fair and square.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: C'mon, guys! No time to lose! How's it lookin', Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It looks like the next anomaly will appear any second now. I am working on the exact coordinates, but there is significant interference. It looks like there may be multiple rifts coming.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: As long as we can hit one of 'em. Stand by your hand cranks, people!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Here they come!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's cars! Baljeet, what are those coordinates?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Got them! 34 degrees, 10 minutes, 15 seconds north. 15 minutes, zero seconds west.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Launch now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where is the tear?! Where is the tear?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Any second!

Name: The gang
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How're ya doin' back there, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Takes care of that. Let's plug this baby in and get her goin'!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Are you sure it'll work?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, absolutely. There's a guaranteed 55% chance of success, so we're...we're good to go.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wait, so there's still a 45% chance that it won't do anything?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Of course not, it's not gonna do nothing. There's also a 45% chance it'll destroy everything in existence.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What?! Dad, you have to tell us things like this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is everyone okay?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aw, my muffins got smashed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on! No time to lose! Literally!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Baljeet, just to confirm, destroying the machine will put the space-time continuum back to normal.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes. And we need to do it quickly. The time loops are accelerating exponentially and—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh. We're starting here now. Hey, it has been brought to my attention that I should tell you guys there's a 55% chance this will work, but a 45% chance that it'll destroy reality as we know it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Absolute worst-case scenario.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, what happens if we don't push it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If we do nothing, there's a hundred percent chance that the time pocket will dissolve and it'll destroy every— Y'know, there's a whole illustration I can do with a paper towel and a hook, but I don't have time.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, we have to take a moment and think about the—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, man! That was quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The days must be compressing to this exact point!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time to lose! Move! Move! Move!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hurry, guys!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, here's the odds. Save the day

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whoa.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good answer! How 'bout you, Perry the Platypus? Come on, if you got something to say, now's the time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) The time loop is getting too short!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) What if I throw Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) You are just using this as an excuse!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I gotta tell ya, there's a lot of risk involved, but we've discussed it over, like, three loops already, and I think this is our only option. Are you with me?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, I am.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (thumbs up and chatters approvingly)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I should have just about enough time to press this button if I'm not too overly dramatic about it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can't reach it! There's just not enough time!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: D-Did it work?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, kids. Pie's almost ready. Anybody want some fresh orange juice in the meantime?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I used a spoon to squeeze them.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Orange juice!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Buford
Dialog: There's the emotional attachment to oranges I've been lackin'! (He gives Isabella a high eight.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, we're not destroyed, so that's a good sign.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, but did it work?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Muffin time, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We are back in business, baby girl! (hugs Vanessa)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yes! Dad, I'm so proud of you! You did it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, I'd do anything for you, pumpkin pants! After we dismantle this thing, I don't know what I'm gonna do with myself. I've got no experience being a good guy.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, I'll stick around and help you figure it out. I hear OWCA is looking for a few good animals.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I was raised by ocelots!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now, that was an eventful day!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That was an eventful summer.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What was your favorite part, Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of the summer?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah! What was your favorite thing we built?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Memories.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, really corny!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, I'm serious! We've done a lot of great stuff. How can I choose?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Remember the time we went into space??

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Which time?

Name: Buford
Dialog: The time we made the ice cream! Duh!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And remember the rollercoaster, where we...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Actually, I think my dream was inside of Perry's dream.

Name: Buford
Dialog: My mind is blown!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw... But it was fun, though!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait, what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (winking) You just wait 10 years!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Anyone want some pie?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes. Yes we do.

Name: Harry the Hyena
Dialog: Oh? Hee-hee-hee-hee-hee-hee-hee! (grunts) Heh-heh-heh-heh-heh!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! The mission!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: These are the stories of the agents of the O.W.C.A. These are the OWCA Files!

Name: Harry the Hyena
Dialog: Huh? Ha ha ha ha ha!

Name: Leader
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Enemies
Dialog: Yaaaaahhh!!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (whistles)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, Agent P, stop right there! Shut it down! Stop the exercise!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent P, nowhere in the O.W.C.A. training manual does it say, "Abandon your team and apprehend the suspect by yourself." You're not a lone wolf anymore. Your team lacks focus and they need your leadership.

Name: Harry
Dialog: Ha ha ha!

Name: Maggie
Dialog: Learn to drive, you jerk!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Heck, one of your trainees didn't even show up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! I'm here! I'm here! (arrives with some rockets) Just a little late! I'm here! Phew! But it's okay, I made this to help.

Name: Carl
Dialog: You can't shoot that at a suspect! Are you crazy?! It would blow them to smithereens!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's the big deal? I blow up all the time.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Nevertheless, individually, your scores look promising, but there's still a big problem with teamwork.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, bub, it's just a piece of clipart.

Name: Harry
Dialog: Hee hee hee hee hee...

Name: Carl
Dialog: And, Doofenshmirtz, you're lucky you're legally considered an ocelot, or you wouldn't be here at all!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah. I'd say that's probably the first time anyone has described my being abandoned by my parents and raised by Central American wildcats as "lucky".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're gonna be wearing that thing in a second.

Name: Harry
Dialog: Heh...heh heh heh...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Besides, I've, I've given up evil.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Look, if you guys can't pass this training exercise, there's no way you'll complete "Town Square Riot", "Freeway Assault", or "Escape the Ancient Ruin". Agent P, your trainees need to learn how to work together as a team or they're never gonna earn their black hat bands. And, uh, Karen? (takes out a laser pointer and points it at Karen, who is chasing a butterfly) Karen the Cat. Pay attention. Karen, I'm over here.

Name: Karen
Dialog: Meow.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Follow the light. That's right. Now, you're going to have to do the entire training exercise again.

Name: OWCA Day-Players
Dialog: Yay! High five!

Name: Carl
Dialog: No, I'm not approving overtime. We'll do it without you day-players.

Name: OWCA Day-Players
Dialog: Awwww...

Name: OWCA Day-Player
Dialog: Come on. Let's just storm out as if we have somewhere else to go.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, when you're finished with Agent P's team on the backlot, return to headquarters immediately.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. Gotta go. (gives Perry the laser pointer and the manual) Carry on. And remember! Teamwork!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, can we still use this thing? (He activates the rocket and it blasts into an unknown area.) Heh heh heh. Well, y'know, hopefully that didn't hit anything important.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: The dust clears and here we are.

Name: Napoleon (cont'd)
Dialog: OWCA Secret Headquarters.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Doesn't look very secret to me.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Be that as it may, today is the day that we will become OWCA's first insect agents.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: But they never responded to our applications.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, and I can't understand why. We mailed them in on time, right before the year-end deadline.

Name: Major Monogram and Agents
Dialog: Three, two, one!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Happy New Year!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: It's possible that our applications have fallen through the cracks. Which is why we are following up with a personal visit. That's how you get noticed, and that's how we will become agents. Imagine fighting international supervillains, traveling to exotic locales.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: And I'm gonna get all kinds of cool spy stuff, like a jet pack, a tuxedo and scuba fins!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Yeah! That oughta do it! (He turns on his jet pack setting his house on fire and bumping into the ceiling.) Napoleon, I can see your house from here!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: How 'bout you, Floyd? What do you want? Uh, a fountain pen that shoots lasers? (gasps) Or a car that shoots fountain pens?

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I want a monkey.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Mmm, yes. For whatever twisted reason, you shall acquire your primate.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: Monkey.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, a monkey is a... You know what? Nevermind. My point is, now that we're here, all we have to do is get someone's attention. Ah, here comes a helpful looking lad now. Excuse me, sir— (Carl steps on the bugs) Obviously, we need to try a different approach.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I still want a monkey.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, this new facility is really impressive. Now, tell me again where you found the money for all these improvements.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I just solved a small ongoing accounting error. You kept putting decimal points where you needed to put commas.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I see! Improper punctuation. Say, how is Agent P's team shaping up?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great! Agent P is the best we have. If anyone can get that team in shape, it's him.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir, but I—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, isn't it time that we talked about the elephant in the room?

Name: Carl
Dialog: What do you mean, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, what exactly is he doing?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Obviously something's itching him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And Agent W, too.

Name: Major Monogram (cont'd)
Dialog: It's really taking a toll on our brand new facility.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I don't understand all the itching. I handed out the new flea collars this morning.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Then something's not right because OWCA is infested with fleas. Carl, activate emergency flea protocol 993-alpha.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (on a communication device) Agent C, activate emergency flea protocol 993-alpha.

Name: Agent C
Dialog: Bawk!

Name: Agent I
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, everyone. When the sensors stop detecting the presence of fleas, the doors will automatically open. Agents, prepare for flea fogging.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: This must be our first test, gentlemen. As agents, we must know how to elude things like deadly toxic clouds.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Just for the record, that was not me.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, Wendell, I— Let's just get down in that drawer.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Look at all this spy equipment! (looks at a pair of scissors) Some sort of giant cutting device, latex bands, miles of insect rope, giant fly— Aah! Whoa!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: (behind a magnifying glass) What is happening to me?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Look at this magnification apparatus that Floyd has found. This could be just the thing we need to get noticed. (sniffs, to Wendell) Okay, that was you.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Guilty. Sorry.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Fogging sequence complete. Flea problem solved, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: First, the flea collars don't work and now fogging doesn't take? What kind of fleas are these?

Name: Agent D
Dialog: Grrr!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Agent D, would you mind? (lifts Agent D's flea collar and gets a flea with some tweezers) Hmm. Gotcha! Let me see something.

Name: Wendell and Napoleon
Dialog: (grunting)

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Okay. Gently lower it into place. All we have to do is get up there—

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Aw, nuts.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: There. You see? It's a good thing we let go, otherwise, we would've ended up just like that peanut.

Name: Bug Trio
Dialog: Whoa!!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! It's a tiny robot!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What kind of a freak would make robot fleas?

Name: Villain
Dialog: Hello.. (laughs) Francis Monogram! (laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! Who are you?

Name: Villain
Dialog: I am Professor Parenthesis. Although, I'm not really here. This is a holographic image.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Major, I'm looking up Professor Parenthesis in our database. There's not much on him.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: It's Parenthesis! Not Parenthesis!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Are you sure? Because it's spelled—

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: You would think I would know how my own name is pronounced.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yeah, you'd think.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why are you here?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: You don't remember me. We were in biology class together long ago. You barely noticed me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're not that guy who kept eating his own hair, are you?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: No. That was Jeffrey Stovel.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Were you the kid who got his chin stuck in that graduated cylinder?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: No, that was Jennifer Stillwell! And she was a girl! All you need to know is that I'm the one who sent those flea collars!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, are you that kid who wore that Robin Hood hat and passed out in the drinking fountain?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Billy Youjeka! And can we move on, please?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, sorry. So, why did you send those flea collars?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Well, it's taken me 30 years to come up with a plan this diabolical. Five of those years were spent in villains academies. Then, after school, I started working on that screenplay I always wanted to write. But revenge was always on my mind, Francis Monogram!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Stop saying my name like that!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Didja ever finish that screenplay?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: This is my screenplay! (hands Carl his screenplay) Right here. I'd like to get your notes.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, I'd be happy to. (tries to pick it up, then remembers it's a hologram. To Monogram) Seriously?! You don't remember this jerk?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Were you the kid who...

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: The robot fleas were actually inside the flea collars that you put on all of your agents. Now this remote will give me complete control over all of them!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: (maniacal laugh) And now, Francis Monogram, say goodbye to your precious OWCA! (maniacal laughter, then disappears, but reappears, to Carl) Seriously, though. I'll email you the screenplay. Tell me what you think. (disappears again)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, he's turned all of our animal agents against us!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, are you familiar with the term "a-duh"?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) What are we gonna do, sir?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Do we have any agents on the outside? Anyone without a collar?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. Come in, Agent P. Oh, good, you're all right. We need your help. OWCA's on lockdown. We're trapped!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And all of the agents are being controlled by a sinister being named Professor Parenthesis.

Name: Carl
Dialog: That's Parenthesis, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, right. Anyway, Parenthesis is using robot fleas to control our agents' minds...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Left turn!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Whoa! He snuck the fleas into OWCA Headquarters by hiding them in a shipment of flea collars.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Right turn!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And now he's...Hey, Carl! Whoa! Anyway, he's controlling them with a small remote device. It's up to you and your team to find Parenthesis and destroy that remote. You're all we've got on the outside, so...

Name: Carl
Dialog: Wet floor!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Whoa! Great googly moogly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, that sounds kind of serious. Guess the first thing we should do is start looking for clues? Huh? Huh?

Name: Maggie
Dialog: (repeating what Monogram said) Shipment of flea collars!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's the box those flea collars came in. And there's his return address. "The Bottom of the Grand Canyon." Hey, hold on a second. Parenthesis! I know that guy! I met him at an evil convention about three years ago. Walks around in those pink slippers pushing his screenplay on everyone. Sure. (closeup on Doof) And now we got his home address! (Long shot to reveal Doof alone.) Perry the Platypus, we should go to your secret lair and get your hover car... (the rest are already ahead) Okay, fine, just... Just remember it was my idea!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Well, that did not go as planned.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, Napoleon, there's peanut butter over here!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Floyd, your head is upside-down.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: There's peanut butter over here, too! (gasps) There's peanut butter all over!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, well, there's always a silver lining, isn't there? I think the problem is we need to be up on their eye level.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Like those guys up there?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Uh...yes?? And no.

Name: Butterfly
Dialog: Tell my wife I love her.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: While th-their position is not advantageous, they are illuminated by a light, which gives me an idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (panting) Man, you guys are... You guys are fast. Ah, so this must be your...your host family's house. What's with all the rockets in the r— Oh, those are mine! That must be where they landed! Wh-What a coincidence! Well, it's a good thing they're not armed or... (The rockets start beeping. Doof chuckles.) Don't worry, Perry the Platypus. Everything is gonna be okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If I can get a ladder, I can defuse them before they blow up. (Notices the house is destroyed.) Eh. Well, on the bright side, now we don't have to find that ladder.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, what a mess. But don't worry, Perry the Platypus. OWCA's got plenty of money now. They'll... (snaps fingers) They'll fix this place up before your host family even gets back and they'll, they'll replace all this junk with...y'know, pretty much identical junk. (Harry gives him a look.) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!

Name: Karen
Dialog: REOW!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, see? A cat always lands on my feet.

Name: Karen
Dialog: Meow.

Name: Maggie
Dialog: (imitating the rockets) Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep... PYEOW!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, thanks for the recap, Maggie. Anyway, you can't just go off and solve this without me.

Name: Harry
Dialog: (snorts)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was getting to you guys. I mean, without me and them. And the cat, wherever the...

Name: Karen
Dialog: (purrs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. Anyway, I know we can't all fit in this, but...if we work together, there's a lot of blown up stuff lying around here, and I'm, I'm sure we can jury rig something that will carry, y'know, all of us. Like a well-bonded machine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, the welds aren't really bonded on this machine, so, y'know, try not to move around too much in flight. Grand Canyon, here we come!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: 5 hours later...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah. If anyone happens to see a canyon that looks sorta grandish, just speak up. Or maybe not speak up, maybe meow up, or squawk, er, whatever it is that you do, up.

Name: Maggie
Dialog: Are we there yet? (plucks a feather) Are we there yet? (plucks a feather) Are we there yet? (plucks a feather) Are we there yet?

Name: Harry
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha! Hee hee hee hee hee hee! (sighs, groans)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz and Maggie
Dialog: Are we there yet?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) I have no way of knowing, because I've never been there, and...you don't talk.

Name: Maggie
Dialog: Are we there yet? (plucks a feather) Are we there yet? (plucks a feather)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, these guys are really annoying. Doncha think?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm right, aren't I? Annoying. Yeah, I'm right.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Well, that was delightful. I couldn't eat another gram.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Well, well. It appears someone has flown into my airspace. Perhaps we should send a welcome party.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, the Grand Canyon. It's nice. You got the Colorado River, you got the giant robot fleas. you got these nice red rocks right h— (gasps) Wait a second! The Colorado River?! I thought we were in Arizona! (gasps) And wait another second! Giant robot fleas?!? Yeah, those are definitely the attack drones of an evil scientist. Yeah, y-you're gonna wanna punch it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right! Nice one! Oh, let me help. We gotta have some weapons around. Wait wait wait, what does this lever do? (pulls the lever several times) No, no, no, that, uh, it doesn't...it doesn't seem to do anything. (Cut to reveal Perry's seat hitting him, revealing what it does.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Give me something to hit him with. (Takes the football helmet Karen is sitting in.) Thanks, Harry.

Name: Karen
Dialog: REEEEERR!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Take that!

Name: Maggie
Dialog: We lost the cat! We lost the cat!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, relax. The cat's right... (realizes she's gone. Rotates his seat at the fleas.) Take that! And that! One for you, too! There you go! Uh-oh. Where's Harry? Oh, there he is! I see a bright future for that kid. Well, y'know, if we survive today. Oh, and there's Karen. Hi, Karen!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (whispering) The access vent won't take us any further.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The hallway is crawling with compromised agents. We're gonna hafta do some creative sneaking, Carl. Follow my lead. (They sneak around.) The cobra. (They do a pose, while Agent C passes by, not noticing them. They start sneaking again.) Andalusian dog. (They pose again, while Agent F passes by.)

Name: Agent F
Dialog: Ribbit. Ribbit. Ribbit.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Violin and candlestick. (They pose as Gary the Gander flies past them. They jump over some lamps and a desk chair offscreen.) Garden party.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Garden party?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) Just give me your ankles.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: There. That should be sufficient wattage to illuminate us.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Why do we wanna be laminated?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Not laminated. Illuminated. It means to have light shown upon us.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Like a grape?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes. Like... Like a grape?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Yeah, I saw a grape this morning.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: And there was light shining on it?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: You saw it, too?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Moving on. Do we have enough power for all these lights?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Yup. We're all plugged into that plug collector thingy, and all we have to do is turn it on.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Well, let's do that then.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Yes! And then we can all be laminated!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: No, it's illu... You know what? Nevermind. Floyd, when we get up on the box, you throw that switch!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I like laminated grapes.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come on, Carl. Let's get outta here! (he opens the door, but it is blocked) Carl, what the heck?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, it never occurred to me that the emergency exit would be locked down, too.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Isn't that something you should've checked before we crawled through all that duct work?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I suppose... but, I was... just having so much fun sneaking around with you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Actually, I was kinda havin' fun, too. Heh heh. Nevertheless, this isn't a situation to make light of.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Okay, Floyd. Make some light!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: (jumping off the garbage can onto the switch) Weeee.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ooh! (chuckles) Uh, (points to his right) We went that way! (runs the other direction)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Heh heh heh... uhhhh... additional misdirect! (follows Monogram)

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Down here!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Look down here!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Please!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Friends, we need you!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Hello!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Hello!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Can you see and or hear us?!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Floyd, focus the beam!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: Stop, drop, and roll, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you know what they say. Any landing where you don't get stabbed with a fork is a good one. And I didn't get stabbed with a fork. Any of you guys? Hello? Harry?

Name: Harry
Dialog: (whistles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, there he is. Impressive! Y'know, as, as evil lairs go, I give that, like, an eight. It looks like a classic mid-'60s megalomaniacal design. And the water feature is very nice. Fortunately, I know a thing or two about... (pull out to reveal Doof alone again) Sheesh! (Doof goes over to the others, who are looking at a scale model of the lair.) Oh, heh. Yeah, w-way to get the ball rolling there, Perry the Platypus. I-I see you're gonna use the... (looks at the manual) Standard Evil Fortress Infiltration Technique, or SEFIT. Man, these guys are really bad at acronyms. Good choice, though. Wh-What do I get to do? (stammers) What's my part? (Perry points behind Doof as he sees a coffee shop.) Oh, I'm the coffee guy. Good start. We're gonna need to stay sharp on this one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I'm back. Eh, who had the double espresso? (Harry takes it.) There you go. And a caramel macchiato. (Maggie takes it.) Maggie. And I guess that means that Perry the Platypus had the... Yes, the oolong tea, of course. And I got a scone, but it was like, five dollars. So I only got one. Oh, you got little figurines. There's Harry, and Maggie, and eh, where's my little guy? (Perry picks up a rock and paints a crudely-drawn Doof onto it.) Ah, that's sorta nice, it's... (Perry places Doof by the model of the coffee shop to make a point.) Oh, wh-wh-while you guys do that, I'll just be back...over... Alright, well, I guess I'll just be over... over here if you need me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I coulda helped. I understand the Standard Evil Fortress Infiltration Technique. Step one

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: (to his robot fleas) Jason, Shirley, water is no longer coming out of my hole. Get down there and see what you can do about it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Step two

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Step three

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus and friends. Right on time. Actually, you're a little early. (drops open the trap door) Ah, now you're on time!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Well, well, well, now that you're all bottled up, I'm free to go to OWCA for the culmination of my evil plan! In 28 minutes, my fleas will have worked their way into each agent's neuro-pathways. And then my mind control will be permanent! I will single-handedly take control of every OWCA agent! (to some fleas) Susan, Jim, Tracy, Connie, to the Parentho-Copter! (to the trainees) I hope you find my accommodations uncomfortable. (lights a wrecking ball on fire and releases it) And yes. Soon it will be worse.

Name: Karen
Dialog: Meow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, looks like you might need my help after all! Lucky for you I brought a rope, with a dreamcatcher on the end! That's what you call style! Anyway, alright, here, catch. (throws the dreamcatcher at Karen, but she pushes it off the edge) Uh, Karen, I don't think you're grasping this whole "grab the rope" concept. Can someone else get this one? (it gets tangled in the wrecking ball) Oh, great, now it's tangled in the... AAAAAHHHH!!! (The wrecking ball ends up in the capsule.) Wow! Did you guys see that? I almost got— Alright, minor setback. No problem. I'm just gonna have to come down there and get you myself. (Pushes a rubber raft through the door.) See, this is why I brought the raft.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I might have a little bit of a pro— (falls down and ends up in the water. He gets on the raft but is surrounded by alligators.) Get back, you, before I get all Creole chef on you! (to the trainees) Come on, you guys! Jump! I gotcha! I gotcha! I got— (the trainees jump into the raft)

Name: Karen
Dialog: Reeeeeooww!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? A cat always lands on my feet. Wait, nobody move. Here. (takes a selfie) That's goin' on my blog.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, uh, that can't be good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo-hoo! Yeah! Woo-hoo! Woo! Woooo! I did it! I saved you guys and now we're safe! (some alligators land in their raft) Except for the fact that it's, you know, raining alligators. And secret lairs.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good thing we found a hiding place, Carl. What is this? A dining room table or something?

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's a desk, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A desk we can both hide under? Whose office is this anyway?

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's mine, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yours?! This is at least ten times bigger than my office!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, that's not important now! We need to find a way to escape!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And how do you rate your own bathroom?

Name: Carl
Dialog: It's actually a gym, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is that a chocolate fountain?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, listen. I got an idea. If we can get to the evacuation wing, we might be able to use one of the escape pods.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What's up with the giant bear?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh. That was a gift from our contractor.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That gives me an idea! But this conversation isn't over.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I can't see back here, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You drew the short straw, Carl.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Just a little higher. Ah, we've finally reached the summit. Come, gentlemen, it's time to get noticed!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Oh, boy! Oh, sorry, Floyd, are you okay?

Name: Floyd
Dialog: Wendell, I've had an epiphany! In order for us to obtain our noble goal, we must evaluate the— (groaning) Ow.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Sorry, Floyd, did you say something?

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I like trains.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Oh, my! By my larva-making mother, would you look at that! It's like the floor is frozen, but it's warm. It's like warm ice. Did we discover this? We should call it "wice".

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Actually, it's called glass.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: No. I think it should be some combination of warm and ice. Floyd, come take a look at this!

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I need a face shoe.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: So, what's your plan, Napoleon?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Ah, it's quite simple, actually. We are standing atop a giant duplication device. A device that will not only copy our images, but will enlarge us as well. I simply need to program in the right size. Let's see. 200% enlargement. Okay, men, get on the glass platen, and get ready to be enlarged.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: All set, Napoleon!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: And (jumps on the button) copy! Everyone smile for the camera. (The copier scans them) Excellent! Now we just have to wait for the toner to do its work.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Wendell Wow, it's a good thing that lid didn't fall on us. That would've hurt.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Well, yes, Wendell, that was fortun—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, it, uh... It could've been worse. Uh, don't..don't all thank me at once. Knowing my talent has served my fellow agents is thanks enough.

Name: Maggie
Dialog: Rawk! Lousy rescue!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I wouldn't call it lousy, per se. A little off, maybe, but... Oh, come on. Harry the Hyena, it was a good rescue, wasn't it?

Name: Harry
Dialog: A-hee-ha-ha-ha-ha! A-ha-ha-ha ha ha ha ha. Eh, heh heh... Eh... Nah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Karen the Cat? Anything? Uh, no? What did you think of the rescue, Perry the— (Perry throws the training manual at Doof) Ow! (Perry takes off in his jet pack) Hey, Perry the Platypus, you're leaving us?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shooing the letters away) Knock it off! Hope that's not permanent. Oh, I get it! H-Hey, hey, you guys, come back. Come back! Now, let me just explain.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute, guys. Bear with me just a second here, okay. Watch this, ready?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that was easier than I thought it would be. If only we had a "W", we could spell out "teamwork".

Name: Maggie
Dialog: Macaw!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) That's right! "Macaw" has a "W" in it! So we can do it! Okay, here, from the beginning.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, big finish!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, now let's spell out "collaborative alliance".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, I'm just kiddin'! I'm kidding! Come on back! Hey, uh, guys, you, y-you forgot the cat. (to Karen) They forgot you. And you're the cat.

Name: Carl
Dialog: There it is, sir! The escape pod!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great! Let's get outta here!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, sir, but be careful. There's a huge set of stairs.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (sarcastically) Well, that went well.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sarcasm isn't helping, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Aw, there we go— Aw, ow! Ow! Ow! Ow!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, this button launches the escape pod.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, Carl, how does the escape hatch work with, you know, this whole lockdown thing?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Uhhh...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Owwwwwww.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Well, well, well, Francis Monogram! It's hostile takeover time!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, how was he able to override the lockdown?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, it opens from the outside, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ehhh.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, you made your point, Parenthesis. Apparently, I didn't notice you in school. Sad story. Boo-hoo. But why are you here?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: I'm here to make your days the darkest of grays and your nights the blackest of black. I want to see your smug smile melt away like the candles on a sad little abandoned birthday cake.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sounds like he's here to bore us to death.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: As soon as my mecha-fleas completely override your agents' natural instincts, I will release them out into the unsuspecting world, where they will wreak havoc. And all you'll be able to do is sit and watch as the people of the world grow to deride and despise Francis Monogram and his monstrous OWCA as much as I do!!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (to Monogram) How about now?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, I still don't remember him!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Wow, Napoleon, we're huge!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, this is bound to get us noticed.

Name: Wendel
Dialog: So how do we get them to see it?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Well, it would be preferable if it were at their eye level.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: We could build a paper airplane.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: If we could find a staple remover, some dental floss... Wait, Floyd, what did you say?

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I want a monkey?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: No, what did you just say?

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I want a monkey.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: What were the last words out of your mouth?

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Well, actually, those were the last words out of his mouth. You asked him, "What did you say?" And he said, "I want a monkey." He said it twice, if you count this last time.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Well, I...I... Okay, Floyd, immediately before you said "I want a monkey" twice...

Name: Floyd
Dialog: I don't want two monkeys.

Name: Wendel
Dialog: Is this about the face shoe?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Oh, forget it! We're making a paper airplane!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Almost out of time! The suspense is delicious, don't you think? (laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, Parenthesis, I wouldn't get too comfortable if I were you. Heh heh.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: What?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nice upholstery job, Agent P! We got this guy. You take down Parenthesis.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Agents, you know what to do.

Name: Agent E
Dialog: (trumpets)

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Excellent! Soon all this will be mine! First thing I'll do is put that sofa back there on the atrium where it belongs. Then I'll—

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, my gosh!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Does that mean what I think it means?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No. It means Parenthesis was... a robot.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Alright. Well, now I'm confused. What did you think I thought it meant?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: There. This seems aerodynamically sound.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Now all we need is a big rubber band and two palm trees to launch us!

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: You watch way too much TV, Wendell.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Oh, just the one show.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: But, perhaps some form of propulsion would be beneficial. (Looks at the fan.) Hmmm.

Name: Floyd
Dialog: Uh, guys. (cut to reveal Floyd's head not attached to his body) I think I got a paper cut.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Uh, Wendell.

Name: Wendell
Dialog: I'll go get the gauze.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I guess that's that. We should get that remote device and... (looks inside the body) Whoa! (the robot body grabs Monogram, and pushes Carl, and Perry onto the sofa.) Oh, no, I can't. (The robot body lifts Monogram up in the air so he can see inside.) What?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: (laughs maniacally) Aloha!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait. You're a flea?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Recognize me now?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why would I recognize a flea?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: See? See? There's that attitude again! (A TV set with multiple mechanical arms pops out of the robot's body. The TV shows the flea's face.) You've always looked down your nose at me. Well, now, who's beneath who?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: He's getting away! He'll ruin everything! Hold these, guys. Susan, Jim, Tracy, Connie, you're with me!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Napoleon, how are you steering this?

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: I'm not, Wendell. We are at the mercy of the wind! YEEHAW!!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Get him!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Where did the platypus go? (gasps) Connie! There you go. Lemme just straighten your collar. To the freeway!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: How about a little oncoming traffic, you portentous platypus?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Yes! Finish him!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: What's this?

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Here, little semi--aquatic mammal. Here, boy. Nowhere to turn now! Oh, look, I'm wearing glasses. I'm a hipster.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Okay, end of the line, platypus! You've nowhere to... Oooh, cotton candy! Give me some of that!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Does anyone see him? He's small, teal, wears a hat. Oh, come on. How hard is it to find a small platypus in a carnival setting? Don't say it! I just heard myself.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah! Great throw, Harry!

Name: Harry
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha ha!

Name: Maggie
Dialog: (squawks)

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Maggie
Dialog: Mmm, got it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woohoo!

Name: Harry
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for believing in your team, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: You think this cage can stop me?! (tears the gate off, grabs the agents and laughs) I have you now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! Karen's here! We're saved!

Name: Maggie
Dialog: We're dead!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gwan, Karen, do your thing.

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Oh. I forgot the feline. Susan, Jim, Tracy, Connie, take the cat out.

Name: Karen
Dialog: Reeeeor!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: What?! No! You'll pay for that!

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Wah! (gasps) My slipper!  Ahh! NO!

Name: Karen
Dialog: (screeches)

Name: Parenthesis
Dialog: Hey! Ow! Aw! Ow! (sighs) Oh, well, you guys do work well together. But to no avail. I may be boo-boo'd and bruised, but I still have control over OWCA's agents! Ha! And it all becomes permanent in just five more seconds! (something is heard falling from the sky. It is the fan falling on Parenthesis.) AAAAAAH!!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Hey, Napoleon, our motor came off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gathering the flea with tweezers) And gotcha!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well done, team! You've earned those black hat bands. You are now officially OWCA agents!

Name: Wendell
Dialog: Look, Napoleon. They got to be agents.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: Yes, and not us. (The plane begins to plummet.) Whoa! (sighs) We should take this as a sign. (takes up a violin) Bugs are not meant to be agents. (plays "Nearer My God to Thee") Gentlemen, it's been a pleasure serving with you. (The wind carries them off.) Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hey, now that we're agents, when do I get to use this thing? (launches a rocket launcher) Whoa! (The rockets crash into the OWCA headquarters.) Oops, sorry.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl?

Name: Carl
Dialog: There's still money in the budget, sir.

Name: Napoleon
Dialog: I don't believe it! We've landed safely! I take this as a sign! We will be the best agents that OWCA has ev—

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Are these new plates? I mean, they look the same, but it feels as though they were replaced by exact copies.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Yes, and the tree in our backyard is now a pine.
